description: Toilets and water is a basic necessity in schools, however it is not available in many rural schools in North Central in Srilanka ! Due to this, children are irregular to school and eventually drop out. This project will help to build in toilets and maintain them, provide running and clean drinking water for school children in rural schools in Srilanka! The expected impact of the project is better health and improved school attendance and reduction is school drop outs among the project villages

title: Intellectual disability:Busting Myths in Colombia
description: This project seeks to reach the inclusion of persons with Down syndrome and cognitive disabilities, through an awareness campaign that allows breaking down myths that exist about them in our community.

title: The Rural Christian Development Hospital, Noakhali
description: Our country,s rural people are always suffering from various diseases for want of proper food and starving , living in bad environment. Cooking by dirty water of pond and drinking also pond water , so dieing in strong diarrhea, children and old aged people are dieing more , no hospital near area, so it is impossible for them to go hospital far from their area. For want of money they don't have the capacity even  to buy medicine . So one Hospital very essential to save their lives by prop. treatm

title: Home for 20 domestic abuse survivors- Aizawl,India
description: This project will provide a 'Safe Home' for 20 women survivors of domestic and gender violence in remote Zemabawk village in Aizawl, Mizoram, a north eastern state of India. Lalthanzami from Aizawl, Mizoram is a survivor of domestic violence herself. She now works with women facing similar situations in and around her village.  Through this project, the Safe Home run by her will be able to provide dignity, shelter, food, legal counselling, livelihood skills and leadership training to 20 women

title: Together for Burundi!
description: The people of Burundi speak the Kirundi language, but almost no resources are available for their children to begin learning in the language they grow up with. This makes school very difficult, since they have to learn everything from math to business in a foreign language. Kamusi and students at University of Ngozi are building tools for Kirundi, which will be available for free to children throughout the country. Your support will fund learning stipends and the server needed for the project.

title: Kosovo Wants to Play
description: Kosovo's lack of recognition leaves many of its athletes unable to compete on a global stage. There are no Olympic Games for Kosovo, neither world cups or master series where its athletes can compete equally, as all the other athletes from around the world. They are deprived of competition, and denied the right to grow up with the aspiration and ambition of being sporting professionals. Through a magazine, we will lobby for their cause and bring it to the attention of international audiences.

title: Take care about orphans in 8 Moscow hospitals
description: Orphans stay in hospitals alone, without their parents who could play with them, tell a fairy tale or simply comfort them when they are in pain or scared. Every day volunteer groups of our fund work in eight Moscow hospitals. They play with children, help to feed them, read for them, conduct workshops. Your donation will help us pay for volunteers coordinators' work, which means an opportunity for children to feel sincere warmth and care!

title: SHARKS, GIRLS & SCIENCE
description: The Gills Club is Atlantic White Shark Conservancy's signature action project dedicated to connecting girls with female marine biologists, sharing knowledge, and empowering them to take leadership positions and inspire others with their passion for sharks.

title: Higher education for indigenous women in Mexico
description: Many young women in Mexico do not reach higher levels of education because their families cannot afford room and board, and there are no middle, high school or universities near their communities.  We are a residential program that helps indigenous young women with free room and board, so they have access to education while providing them with personal and developmental courses.  Students give back to the community through ongoing service projects including tutoring local grade school children

title: Protect Ebola Healthcare Workers in Sierra Leone
description: Keep healthcare workers in Ebola-stricken areas of Sierra Leone, Africa protected from the disease by providing gloves, gowns, masks, goggles and disinfectant to the clinics and hospitals where they're needed most.

title: Providing Medical Aid to 4000 Osi-Ekiti villagers
description: Donating to Mercy International Mission's project allows us to provide medical care and knowledge to Osi-Ekiti, Nigeria and its surrounding villages. Furthermore, it allows us to accomplish our main goal of engaging the people we serve, encouraging them to help improve their communities and to enhance their own quality of life now and for future generations. By helping us help Osi-Ekiti, the villagers will be able to develop a self-sustaining and healthier lifestyle.

title: Care and Support to 100 Flood Victim Orphans
description: In a single month of August, furious rainfall caused terrible landslides and flood across Nepal and swept away house, land and property making thousands of people  homeless and forcing them to take shelter in public places. Hundreds of people lost their lives in the disaster.  Of the survivors, VFDN intends to support in rehabilitation of 100 children who lost everything even their parents in a shelter until permanent solution will be sought out in consultation with community and the government.

title: Chiguru-A Cultural Event for Govt School Children
description: "Chiguru", in the regional language Kannada, means "budding", and the project aims at providing a platform for the budding future citizens to showcase their cultural talents. Over a 2000 children from government and informal schools across Bangalore (India) will participate in various traditional/cultural events. It helps facilitate the all-round and holistic development of underprivileged children and also kindles interest in volunteers from the community to engage with these children.

title: Take The Challenge For Colorectal Cancer
description: This project funds our Annual Research Scholar Award that provides a young clinical scholar with the funding necessary to spend an entire academic year being mentored in a top basic science and/or clinical research laboratory focused on hereditary and early-age-onset colorectal cancer (CRC).

title: Help Change the Lives of 300 Young People at Risk
description: There are over 500000 young people in Kinshasa, the Democratic Republic of Congo, who are not in school, not employed, not in training and not fulfilling their potential. At Association des Ami(e)s du Pere Tony, we are working with community-based youth associations to build the life skills of young people at risks and create new educational, employment and economic opportunities for vulnerable youths

title: Skill Training for 100 poor girls in india
description: 100 poor girl youth beneficiaries in Punjab india under this project will train in computer skill courses namely Tally, desk top publishing, IT skill and web designing. This project will train them in computer skill which have more and more demand in marketing. And make them self reliance, self dependent

title: Ebola Rural Community Awearness Raising.
description: The Ebola Rural Community Awareness Raising Project is designed to mitigate the spread of the deadly Ebola disease in 75 village communities, this will be done by strengthening and building the capacity of community health structures (Community Health clubs) to help disseminate EBOLA sensitization massages from village to village using IEC materials. It is expected that at the end of this project, communities would be able to manage their own community preventive health problems.

title: Water for Life for people in Simanjiro District.
description: YAAPHA we are trying to make water available to women & children of Tanzania living under physical torture; walking 25 miles for less than 5 gallons, by constructing a water tower that will make water available to 30,000 by the end of 2015. This project will change the dynamics in education, for the children between age 6-12 years, economic, health, agriculture and sanitation, making the world a better place. Please Join us by supporting the project. Tell your friends and family

title: Help Blessing hear with a cochlear implant!
description: Blessing is 3 years old and profoundly deaf. His only chance of learning to talk will be if he gets a cochlear implant soon. Without the implant, he will not be able to attend a local mainstream school. He will need to attend a boarding school for the deaf which is 100km away, and will not be granted an equal opportunity to develop communication skills which (as an adult) will provide him with the same job opportunities as his normal-hearing peers.

title: Train poachers to be nature guides in Costa Rica
description: Nest poaching is rife in Costa Rica, and many communities see turtle egg as as a source of income. Within a small community on the central pacific coast, where we have a research station, we see the potential in training local youths to become turtle patrol leaders, and to offer them an alternative income. Not only will this offer a salary for otherwise underprivileged families, but this program with have an educational impact on the community, raising awareness about environmental issues.

title: Education/Healthcare for 50 Street Kids in Nigeria
description: Educational and healthcare support for 50 street children is a project to provide early education,educational supplies, healthcare and psychological support to 50 street children in Calabar south LGA of Cross River state, Nigeria, who are currently out of school and are living on the street due to death of parents due to HIV/AIDS, stigmatisation/discrimination as witches, broken homes,abuses etc. The project will support kids to enroll in school, learn, grow,have hope and reunite with families.

title: Enable 1,000 girls to stay in school in Kenya
description: Helping a girl to stay in school gives her options she wouldn't otherwise get such as staying healthy herself, opening her own business, marrying when she chooses.  Girls attendance at school is impacted by their monthly period - lack of knowledge about menstrual issues; conditions of toilets at school and access to affordable sanitary towels. Girls for Girls(G4G) addresses issues that keep girls from staying at school  through infrastructure, health education and economic empowerment.

title: Support Our Youth Marching Band Program in Haiti
description: Music of the Heart is a Marching Band School Education Program in L'Asile, Haiti.  It started with 18 students ranging from 8 to 19 years old .  We are now expanding and adding 14 more students to our program - making it a total of 32 students.  Our program provides youth hope through music in a world of extreme poverty.

title: Help us build a Community Center for 3000 DC youth
description: There are hundreds of inner city youth standing in front of gas stations begging for money in our city, It's astonishing to realize the age of a kid when there clothes are tattered and their faces are drawn with disappointment from either their ambitions not being met with opportunity or simply no one cares.It often leads to impulsive acts of desperation. B.M.D.C gives a safe haven for at risk youth between the ages of 10-21 years of age. Help our youth to stop being targeted. Lets give options!

title: Early Intervention for Childhood Disabilities
description: Early Childhood Intervention means finding specific ways to help a child become as functional as possible. Early intervention is an effective way to help children catch up or address specific developmental concerns as soon as possible in their lives. The Early intervention resource centre in Amar Seva Sangam premise to provide training and resource support to the Community Based Rehabilitation project team and parents and extend direct early intervention rehabilitation service to the children

title: Community Based Rehabilitation
description: Vidya Sagar's CBR program ( since 1990 ) aims at sharing the technical knowledge and skills on rehabilitation( capacity building ) and reach out to as many persons with disability, irrespective of their location and socio - economic background ,ensuring access to appropriate services. The CBR team with 5 projects reaches out to 28 community workers, more than 150 persons with disabilities, their families and the community.

title: SANITARY TOWELS FOR NEDDY GIRLS IN KENYA
description: Your donation will go a long way in supporting the orphaned and needy girls remain in school during their periods. This has made most of them drop out of school due to lack of sanitary towels services and the scorn they have kept on receiving from boys and other girls in school when by accident they wet their clothing while in school. This has turned out to be an ordeal and shame state that has made them loose their self-esteem.

title: Education and hygiene for students with Sp. needs.
description: This project will help the students of special school of Blind welfare council to live a better and healthy life. The students here are with down syndrome, cerebral palsy, mental disabilities, multiple disabilities and also with hearing impairment. All are from economically poor background and they come from tribal area. In last 7 years our special school - trained staff has changed many lives. Two of them are Neelam and Girish; played in Asia Pacific Special Olympics held in Australia in 2013.

title: Promoting Humane Education in Schools
description: Perpetrating Violence/Cruelty against animals is not only common among Sierra Leonean adults but children as well. This project- Promoting Humane Education in Schools will serve as an entering point in transforming the lives of the school children to exercise kindness  particularly to dogs and cats including other domesticated animals and wildlife as well.

title: Quality Education to 40 at Risk Youth in Korogocho
description: This project will provide financial support to Korogocho slum youth towards achieving high school education as well as offer mentorship. Poverty denies many youth a chance to get an education and therefore, the project will allow the youth a fair chance not only to get their right to education but also improve their chances of employability.

title: AIR SUPPLY VENTILATORS FOR KIDS WHO CANNOT BREATHE
description: This project is aimed to help kids with severe neuromuscular and other conditions obtain individual medical ventilators, to be able to breathe sufficiently and stay with their families instead of hospitals. In Russia, conditions that demand ventilator-assisted living are regarded as critical care. Some kids have never seen homes or never met siblings. Most see their mothers 5 min a day. With your help, a child will go home to be loved and nursed properly. They deserve to live, not just survive.

title: 10-Day Photo Workshops for 50 Cambodian Children
description: The Anjali Photo Workshops give underprivileged Cambodian children the means to tell their own stories, and encourage self-esteem and self-discovery - a key tool in fostering scholastic development. The resulting works are publicly screened on "Children's Day" during the internationally acclaimed Angkor Photo Festival. This event introduces the children to a world they might never have known, and exposes the public to the realities of everyday Cambodians.

title: Provide the housing to leprosy patients in India
description: This project will build the individual house to providing the women leprosy deformed patients in Madurai District, India.  because this leprosy patients are living in damaged  hut, shelters and tiled houses. Now in India has the rainy season, so rain water comes in the house through damaged roof. through this 'LOW PRICE HOUSING  project' 35 leprosy women patients will be benefited in 18 villages in our project area.

title: Send a Child to School
description: In Belize a free education isn't always an option. At Ambergris Caye Elementary School, we are trying to provide options for children whose parents cannot afford to send them to school.  Through this project your donation will go directly towards a child's education, paying their tuition to one of the best schools in Belize!  Please search your heart and educate a child. Consider a monthly donation on a recurring basis to help a child.  It's easy to set up!  Be generous, children are the future!

title: Help 350 Maasai Women Deliver Safely in Kenya
description: Maasai women in Kajiado County hardly access antenatal care and skilled care for delivery. In Magadi division, Kajiado County in South West Kenya occupied mainly by the Maasai, the maternal mortality rate (500/100,000 live births) is persistently higher than the national average of (488/100,000 live births), and facility deliveries (approx. 5%) much lower than the national average (44%). This project will educate community and support 350 women to attend antenatal care and hospital delivery.

title: Bienvenidos!: Unaccompanied Children's Project
description: This project will establish a fund to support Nationalities Service Center's (NSC) delivery of on demand legal and direct care services to unaccompanied children (UAC) from Central America who have been relocated to the Philadelphia area and identify as being in need. Since October 2013, more than 57,000 children have fled their homes and made the perilous journey north due to growing violence in their home countries, entering the U.S. without documentation to reunite with their families.

title: COMMUNITY BASED POWER FENCE TO SAVE ELEPHANT
description: Man animal conflict is a challenge in wildlife management and biodiversity conservation in India. This project secures farmers' yearly livelihood & saves the elephant (Elephas maximus). 15,000 houses and 10,00,000 ha of crops damage stay as evidence of conflict every year. Due to anger and hardship, farmers connect 440 volts electric line to farm fence, 200 Elephants die of electrocution and 200 humans die of conflict. Solar power fence will save wildlife, reduce man elephant conflict.

title: Agriculture for Nutritional and Health Security
description: A lot of Sierra Leoneans go to bed hungry due to poverty. This project will result in sufficient food availability for the average national with balanced diet intake and the eradication of malnutrition and under-nutrition. We are helping the poorest of the poor in the rural communities who suffer most from malnourishment, under-nutrition with little or no balanced diet knowledge. Engaging in very prudent crops cultivation and animal husbandry for nutrition and health security solves the problem.

title: Prevention hiv in municipality Waspan Nicaragua
description: According to health ministry statistics, the trend of HIV in Nicaragua in recent years years has been a concentrated epidemic in the age range 15 to 44 years (87%) with an increase in adolescents and youth.   The beneficiary communities have characteristics that make them vulnerable to HIV areas, such as extreme poverty, lack of educational opportunities and problems associated with drug abuse and commercial sexual exploitation work. In both cases are adolescents and young people most affected

title: Help orphans in India
description: This project will help our orphan girls with education, clothes, food and a house.

title: Help! Dog needs spaying & split dewclaw removal
description: Queen is a dog staying with the non profit Veteran Rescue. Veteran Rescue needs your help in not only spaying Queen, but removing her dewclaws, which have grown in such a way that they have split into two separate dewclaws each. Smaller donations are also accepted in order to help care for her feeding costs and other necessary care costs.

title: Youth Learning & Technology Center in Topeka KS
description: The project will establish a centrally located place for youth to come and learn skills that will allow them to grow and flourish into respectable adults. While community centers and our public library are places to hangout, a facilities committed to providing high-end instruction in technology and opportunities to develop work ethic are needed in cities across the United States. There's a dire outlook for youth; especially those of color. Will you help us offer a better pathway out of poverty?

title: Create 50 New Jobs in Impoverished Miami areas
description: EcoTech Visions will incubate green businesses which will create 50 new green tech jobs and 30 green scouts externships in poverty stricken neighborhoods in Miami.  The unemployment rate in these impoverished zones is 37%.  This high unemployment has led to systemic poverty for children and families.  .  EcoTech's business fellowship program will take unemployed men and train them and assist them in creating green tech businesses, which will provide employment opportunities.

title: Build organic gardens for 55 women in Mexico
description: This project will empower 55 women living in remote rural areas in the Municipality of San Felipe, Guanajuato, Mexico, by building productive organic gardens. The  gardens provide the women with an extra income, which strengthens their position within the family and increases their autonomy and self-confidence. In workshops the women learn how to maximize the benefits derived from the gardens and how to provide a complete and healthy diet for their families.

title: Build a healthy society protecting Women's rights
description: Decreasing the psychological problems for the marginalized groups (Women, Children, Youth and people with special needs) who are suffering from poverty, unemployment, abuse, discrimination, wars, torture and disasters in the Palestinian community and to stop the Women honor killings.

title: Free 200 girls from female circumcision in Nigeria
description: This project will be focusing on educating communities on the need to eradicate female genital mutilation in ikom & boki of cross river state. it will rescue 300 girls from 25 communities in an alternative rite of passage ceremony without the cut.  through advocacy, open community dialogue/sensitization, and media awareness  it will educate  girls and boys   about life skills, sexuality education,  hiv,  offer empowerment vocational training  and seed grant to rural women.

title: Empowering Women's with Sustainable Livelihood
description: Under this project, 500 poor Women will be connected with banks by Self Help Group, who are living poverty. Here training would be provided in the area of capacity building, life skills, EDP, Orientation, goat farming, organic manure, dairy,  etc, for increasing their self-confidence level, livelihood growth and empowerment.

title: Balya- A home for 60+ Orphan children - Bangalore
description: This project provides the orphans with comfortable shelter, nutritious food, decent clothing and valuable education which will help them grow to be responsible citizens of this world. This school currently provides free education to 60+ orphan kids and other 30+ kids who cannot afford education within the vicinity of the orphanage. This project will help us with our endeavor to provide them with nutritious food, shelter, clothing and sustained education for a month.

title: Fighting Breast Cancer in Goma/DRC
description: Breast cancer is big health problem in DRCongo and is second cause of death by cancer in the country.This disease can be easily treated if early detected but continue killing women because of missing mammo service in country.This project will help women getting access to screening and treatment of early cancer and then we can save lives of women.We will perform mammary gland detection for 500women and we'll treat all positive cases by mammary gland therapy or surgery.Awareness for 400women done.

title: Miteri Peace Learning Center for Commemoration
description: In order to commemorate the people who were dying or affected during a decade more war in Nepal, Miteri Peace Learning Center is under construction. It composed of statute, meditation hall, cafe, e-library, multipurpose hall and sports where all educated and uneducated children, youths and adult will engage locally and globally for peace and justice. It can either promote social recovery or crystallize a sense of victimization, injustice, discrimination, and the desire for revenge.

title: Soccer Field for Children in Jeremie Haiti
description: This project will build a soccer field in Jeremie, Haiti providing something resembling a real childhood to 150 orphans who are living day to day through the joy of sport and enriching exercise.

title: Provide books to Underprivileged Children in US
description: This project will build the personal libraries of children and inner-city schools and organizations serving these children in Ohio and Kentucky by providing a rich supply of books to those in need. We hope to give away two million books to two million children in the next 5 years.

title: Education support to 300 Slum Children of Rayagada
description: The project will develop and enhance the educational standard and life skill knowledge of poor and educationally weak students of Slums of Rayagada Town of Odisha, India by creating opportunities for additional learning facilities by way of special coaching. 300 students of poor economic background of 12 slums will be reached and motivated thru special coaching class. Through coaching their capacity will be built in education and life skills and Child rights.

title: Provide Respite Services for Low Income Caregivers
description: This project will provide 100 caregivers of patients with Alzheimer's and dementia illnesses with relief and a break from their roles as caregivers.  This project will also provide personal care for their love ones and improve the quality of life for both the patient and the caregiver.

title: DIS IS ABILITY - employing 50 disabled Egyptians
description: DIS IS ABILITY will help promote social equity and eliminate social exclusion by revealing hidden abilities of disabled artisans who manufacture handmade products. Their products and we sell them via an online platform SHOMZ (social enterprise). Revenue collected from products will act as profit for the disabled artisan, purchase raw materials for other disabled artisans and educate them to meet labour and market demands. Part of the revenue enrols a child in education & offer health solutions.

title: Help educate 1,300 students in Guyana, S. America
description: Blossoms of Guyana and GuyKids plan to adopt a primary and secondary school in Georgetown, Guyana. This project will build the schools' first computer labs and provide the students and teachers with books and school supplies for the 600 students at the primary school and the 700 students at the secondary school.

title: Let's FEED the dreams of 60 hungry MK children's
description: More than 40.000 families in Macedonia struggle to survive, especially when they are hit by a crisis such as the sudden loss of a job, victims of home violence that destroys their meager savings and drives them to put their own children in desperation. When Food Bank Macedonia provides daily meals to their children and families they'll flourish in school for a brighter future. Main purpose is to provide food, proper home shelter, clean clothing, medical care, education for needy children's...

title: The Children of the Night Home and Onsite School
description: Children of the Night is the only place in North America where a child can call from a seedy motel or truck stop anywhere in the United States, reach a child care worker 24/7, escape from a dangerous condition, board a pre-paid airline, be met at LAX and arrive in the safe, nurturing Children of the Night home within 24 hour of the initial call for help.

title: Special Footwear for Persons affected by Leprosy
description: AIFO India will provide 1000 pairs of special MCR ( Micro Cellular Rubber ) footwear to persons who are suffering from Leprosy related deformity of the foot in rural and remote Assam, North East India .

title: Train 500 rural youths in Zambia in aquaculture
description: Youths in the Kalichelo area of Eastern Province, Zambia typically eat once per day and teens trade sex for food, money, or clothing. This projects aims to improve youth food security and reduce their risk of contracting HIV through providing 500 rural youths with integrated fish farming, aquaponics, horticulture and entrepreneurship training. This program will also establish an online HIV information exchange and education platform to educate the community.

title: Support Social Innovation in Rural India
description: Auroville is an international township with a mandate to experiment in all fields that lead to human unity. It is a hotbed of social and environmental innovation since it's founding as a UNESCO endorsed international community.   UnLtd Tamil Nadu is a part of this experiment. We find, select and support exceptional individuals who are committed to solve some of India's biggest challenges using their passion and entrepreneurial skills. It is founded by Gijs Spoor who is an Ashoka Fellow.

title: Improve the nutrition of Brazilian children
description: Help Inmed Brasil promote sustainable improvements in children's health and nutritional status, through school-based participatory education and activities on nutrition, healthy lifestyles and gardens. The program will also strengthen family involvement in activities, to improve nutrition and the adoption of healthier life choices and behavior, aiming for cognitive and physical improvement of the children involved.

title: Create a fund to make microloans to women
description: Poverty2Prosperity.org is a microfinance non-profit that would like establish a loan fund for women around the world. 70% of women and their families are living in poverty. There are good reasons to loan to women who do not have access to traditional credit. Repayment rates for microloans made to women are higher than men.  They also contribute larger portions of their income to household consumption than their male counterparts. Working women are more likely to educate their daughters than men

title: Agriculture a business for young adults in Ghana
description: With an aging and dwindling farmers base, we hope to encourage young adults to return back to the rural areas, by teaching a sustainable agriculture system, that can be a profitable family business.

title: Menstrual Hygiene Management in schools of Nepal
description: The aim of the project is to assist in reducing school dropout rates of girl students and improve education and health by supporting the construction of girl friendly toilets (along with water and sanitation facilities) and providing menstrual hygiene management training and support in the schools of Nepal.

title: International Career Advancement Program (ICAP)
description: ICAP assists highly promising mid-career professionals from underrepresented groups in advancing to senior positions in international affairs.  There have been 20 classes of "ICAP'ers" who have participated in this seminar-- rising leaders in non-profit organizations, government, academia, and business.  The participants and program have not only advanced careers, but diverse voices in foreign policy-making.

title: Education - Job Skill Training  (200 Foster Youth)
description: Thousands of foster youth age out of care daily many with little or no support in place. We provide educational and job skills training to foster youth 16 and older. 200 youth will receive skilled based job  training in culinary arts/nutrition, journalism, the arts, and home repair maintenance. Educational employment training are provided to assist foster youth with job placement Training consist of basic reading, writing, math, grocery shopping, gardening, financial literacy and certifications.

title: Kindergarten education for 30 children in Kosovo
description: 96% of of the Roma, Ashkali & Egyptian communities in Kosovo do not complete compulsory education - a cause and an effect of poverty, exclusion, and poor health. Education is the only way to break the vicious cycle for families and communities, and after working for over 4 years to get Roma, Ashkali & Egyptian children to primary school, we have been asked by members of the communities in Fushe Kosove to open pre-school for their younger kids. Help us say yes to their dreams for their children!

title: Gordon Clem Academy: Kenya - More than Academics
description: Gordon Clem Academy (GCA) will provide secondary education including life skills, arts, culture and music, lifelong learning, individualized plans and vocational skills. Beginning as a day school and including the Aremiet Girl's Rescue Center, in 5 years will develop flexible boarding facilities. Integrated organic agriculture, alternative technologies, animal husbandry, income generating projects and an innovative fee structure will assure sustainability, comprehensive education and excellence

title: Children at Poverty Risk in Spain
description: One in three children lives under risk of poverty in Spain. What is their only opportunity to build a better future? Education. This is a social-educational project that takes place outside school hours. We give educational and nutritional support to children between 3 and 12 years old, who have scarce material resources and/or emotional support and are risking school failure.

title: Save 100 orphans in Uganda from sexual slavery
description: Young girls are exposed to sexual abuse and forced into commercial sex in order to earn a living. This puts them at a risk of HIV/AIDS infection and other STIs/STDs. Unsafe abortions, early and unwanted marriage, school dropouts are also rampant. This project will empower 100 orphans and vulnerable girls, aged 12-17 years, in entrepreneurship and life- skills and support them start piggery/goat farms improve their incomes, hence reduce their vulnerability to sexual abuse, poverty and HIV/AIDS

title: Be part of a change in Ghana.
description: With 16 years in the forefront of the fight against HIV and AIDS in Ghana, WAAF is happy when positive strides are made. A steadily dropping HIV prevalence which currently stands at  1, 3% is one of those.  Unfortunately, despite these positive gains from years of hard work, there still are many challenges that WAAF continues to encounter on a daily basis and continuing to fight for an HIV free world means dealing with these challenges.

title: "Show your support,Educate a Child now in India."
description: India is shining whereas,81,50,618 children aged 8 to13 years are still out of school.Kids in India are currently being exposed to neglect,homelessness,human trafficking,educational problems,physical and sexual abuse.Education being one of  their basic rights.Through this project,we intended to provide  about 500 youths  the School Materials,language classes,IT skills,Life Skills which will encourage them for building their career and to be competitive to be a good human being as a whole.

title: Dealing with Elderly,Parkinson and Mental Health
description: This project will help train a number of individuals to deal with elderly parkinson's patients and with the psychiatric health of elderly in the Jordanian society,Reaching more than 20 family,teaching them How to deal with elderly psychiatric patients and provide the best care for them.With the prevalence of parkinson's around the world,training to deal with patients helps improving their condition, providing the necessary advice and awareness of the disease and professional help are our goals

title: Sponsor a Puppy - Irish Guide Dogs for the Blind
description: The sponsor a puppy programme is run by Irish Guide Dogs for the Blind. For just $6,800 annually, you can name and meet your own guide dog puppy.

title: Feed 3,000 Poor Filipino Kids w/ Fresh Vegetables
description: 2011 National Nutrition Survey reported that 23% of Filipino kids claimed to be food insecure. 5 out of 10 are suffering from malnutrition. Nationwide more than 3 million of them are suffering from this health problem. To 3,000 malnourished Filipino kids from Cavite and Lipa, Aral Pinoy (Education Philippines) will help their parents to cultivate sustainable gardening system to address household food security by providing them micro-nutrient-rich and fresh vegetables for a year.

title: Investigative Report on a Persecuted Community
description: Movement for Solidarity and Peace (MSP) in Pakistan supports vulnerable groups, especially religious and ethnic minorities in Pakistan, primarily by researching human rights violations. By disseminating the resulting reports to Pakistani and US stakeholders, MSP hopes to enable all individuals and communities in Pakistan to live with dignity, security and guaranteed human rights.

title: Build training center for 400 Brazilian adolescent
description: This project will support IA3 Institute to build a training center with the objective of providing comprehensive development, professional qualification to 400 young people under social vulnerability condition of poor communities at Pindamonhangaba. Due to lack of job opportunities and no path to overcome the poverty many adolescents of these poor communities decides in taking the wrong path of selling drugs and prostitution.

title: Help Make Dreams Come True for Military Couples
description: This project is aimed to help make dreams come true for our military couples by giving them a chance to RECEIVE A FREE WEDDING; not just a free wedding gown. Some have to deploy overseas so quickly that they miss that opportunity. They just end up getting married in a court house by themselves. Other reasons for military couples can include things as financial struggle, disabilities, family issues and unemployment. It's unfair that they go through so much and receive so little support back.

title: Educate HIV Orphans in Kenya
description: In a country devastated by AIDS, many young children are orphaned and left in the care of guardians or elder grandparents. We recognize that the only way out of poverty for every child is through education. While primary school is supposed to be free the elderly find it impossible to pay for the many extra expenses needed to keep a child in school.

title: Send a Child to School in Pakistan for 1 year
description: Illiteracy rate, particularly of women in village Bola, Pakistan is very high. The main reason for fewer enrollments of children is poverty. Japan Embassy supported to construct a school building which is well equipped but the operational cost of the school will be covered with tuition fees. Unfortunately the poor peasant families cannot bear the fees which resulted in very low enrollment in the school. A monthly support of $10 by adopting a student can change the fate of this village.

title: Cancer Screening for 3500 poor women in India
description: 500,000 people die of cancer each year in India. Women in impoverished villages are vulnerable due to lack of awareness and screening. Common cancers in women are cancers of the oral cavity, breast and cervix. These can be prevented and treated when detected early with inexpensive screening. Our project involves sending our mobile unit with doctor and nurses to impoverished communities to create awareness and conduct cancer screening, to save poor women unable to afford even basic screening.

title: Campaign2End Early child marriage
description: Early Child Marriage is a slow poison killer for thousands of girl-children in Sierra Leone, the 15th countries with highest prevalence where, 18 % girls married by 15 and 44 % by 18 years. It marks end of girl's education, limited economic opportunities, exposed to physical, sexual and emotional violence.  This directly hinders the achievement of 6 of the 8 Millennium Development Goals. ChildHelp will undertake 24 months activities to end Child, Early and Forceful Marriage in Sierra Leone.

title: Help Harvest Home purchase our first rescue van!
description: Go the extra mile to help Harvest Home Animal Sanctuary purchase our first rescue van that will help expand our efforts to save the lives of animals in need near and far.

title: Support for the Distressed Elderly women,India
description: This is a support programme for 100 elderly women who are most  neglected.The overall goal of the project is to better the living condition of the distressed elderly women .The project will be implemented at 30 backward & remote  villages in Baliapal Block in Balasore district of  Odisha In India.The vulnerable and poorest of the poor elderly women who have nobody  to look after are the target group of the project.From this project poor elderly women will be provided with basic needs  of life.

title: Support for Have A Heart-Namibia
description: Animal-Kind International's Partner Organization, Have A Heart-Namibia, spays & neuters cats & dogs, for free, in under-served areas.  This fundraiser supports 2 HaH-Namibia programs: the AKI-HaH Emergency Fund & the Lifetime Care Program. These are programs that HaH has difficulty getting enough funding for. Donations to this project will fill that gap! All animals receiving care must be s/n'd, if not prior to the provision of Emergency or Lifetime Care, then afterwards, once healthy.

title: disseminaion of true info on Ebola virus in Abuja
description: GIFORD plans to sensitize the six area councils of Abuja of about 1,405,201 people on the realities and basic facts of Ebola Virus.

title: 1380 children research on rurality of Colombia
description: Schools in Southwestern Antioquia, Colombia, do not have a scientific culture. To solve this 90 researching groups conformed by 1380 poor children have been made up for them to research starting from their own questions in different areas. This will make children understand their relationship with the world with a critical perspective; and teachers in schools be able to impact the content of the classes, curriculum and educational quality thanks to the inlcusion of research in learning dynamics

title: Fund over 200 U.S. Diaper Banks with Micro-Grants
description: One in three American families struggle with diaper need, the lack of a sufficient supply of diapers to keep a baby clean, dry & healthy. A basic need of babies, diapers cannot be purchased with food stamps. Diaper banks help address diaper need by collecting, storing and distributing free diapers to families experiencing hardships. Administered by the National Diaper Bank Network, the micro-grants will help enhance the long-term growth and sustainability of individual diaper banks.

title: Help disabled youth in a giant state care facility
description: This project will help more than 160 young multiple disabled people in Russia, who live in a large residential home, to get regular special need physical exesices,hydrarehabilitation,for the weakest once - to get also everyday assistance and training in things like dressing up and having a meal, and for all take part at a broad range of activities (from wood and ceramic workshops to concerts and even birthday parties - wihich they never would have but which are also celebrated by our volunteers)

title: Support Youth Education Program in Maryland
description: One Love 4 Kids Youth Academic and Enrichment Program provides one-on-one tutoring and leadership opportunities for ESOL, Title 1, and At-risk elementary, middle and high school students in Germantown, MD and surrounding areas.  In partnership with skilled tutors,  business leaders, Montgomery County Community Foundation and MCPS Community Engagement Division, we aspire to enroll 75 minority students in our weekend STEAM (Science, Technology, Art, Engineering and Math) program in 2014.

title: Empower 300 girls to become leaders in Nepal
description: Women LEAD is the first professional and leadership development organization for young women, led by young women, in Kathmandu. Since 2011, we've empowered over 1250 female high school students to become leaders in their schools and communities. Our goal is to empower 300 more young women with the self-esteem, confidence and resources to not only become leaders in Nepal, but role models and mentors for the next generation of girls.

title: Deep water wells for safe drinking water
description: The goal of the project is to improve the life standard of women and girls children by decreasing the incidence of water borne disease and its consequences in village Chamrang. The people are poor and canot afford the expenses incurred on deep water wells for themselves, hence the need of a donor. Beneficiaries Women Girls children Boys children Men Total Locality 500 300 300 400 1500 Village Chamrang, UC Garhi Ismail Zai, Mardan KPK

title: Provide a hand "up" for 352 Ugandan children
description: The African [SOUP], or Sponsorship of Orphans in Uganda Project, provides a hand up - not a hand out - to children who dream big. We serve 352 children in our primary school, and your loving gift will educate, nourish, and empower these orphans and vulnerable children to become leaders in Uganda. Located in rural Uganda where there is no electricity, running water, or previous formal education system, the [SOUP] is a beacon of light that grants access to a future - and to hope.

title: Help 10 Caribbean-American Youth get Careers
description: This project will provide funding for economically disadvantaged Caribbean-American students in Brooklyn, New York. Starting June 2015, it is the Society's intention is to give out ten scholarships per year to help Caribbean-American youths pursue their careers . These scholarships will be given to both undergraduate college students and trade school students. Information on how to apply for a scholarship can be found on SACD's website at http:// www.sac-diaspora.org

title: Empower schoolchildren in Ethiopia with light!
description: Energy poverty is a global issue that affects over 1.2 billion people around the world. Sadly, the majority of them are children, the next generation of leaders who will be the changemakers in this world.  3M Team Africa and New Vision Renewable Energy have come together to provide clean and bright whole room solar lights to schoolchildren in the village of Koba Adi, a rural village in Ethiopia. Solar lights allow the children to further their education after the sun goes down.

title: Free Education for 10,000 Girls in Pakistan
description: The main objective of the project is establishing an Elementary School System in various cities of Pakistan, starting classes from Play-group to Class V initially. The school will be aimed to target the girls of the age 3 to 16 years belonging to the middle and lower income groups of the society. The school will provide quality education starting at the Elementary level charging no fee. The school will practice advanced educational procedures and teach an extensive curriculum.

title: Life Transforming Services for Special Children
description: In India, 1 in every 20 children has some form of developmental disorder. Aashwasan offers its unique path breaking assessment,  treatment and counseling services to children with developmental issues such as Autism, ADD, ADHD, Mental Retardation, Epilepsy, Cerebral Palsy etc. and their families from the underprivileged segment of the society in order to enable them to become independent.

title: Give Solar LED Lamps for 850 Mangyan Families
description: Mangyans are among the poorest people in the Philippines who live in remote settlements and use kerosene as their main source of lighting. This not only contributes to global warming but is also damaging to human health, hazardous, and expensive. This project will introduce and distribute portable solar LED lamps that will be of great benefit to 850 Mangyan households in Baco, Oriental Mindoro.

title: Ending Child Marriage in the Thar Desert
description: Ending Child Marriage in the Thar desert is an ongoing endeavor to strengthen girl, the dignity of the girl child and her status in the Desert. The project seeks to motivate a sustained behavior change towards girls in the community with special reference to stopping child marriage and continuing school education. Already operational in two of the largest districts of India, the project has already made long lasting impact.

title: Nicaragua Surgical Mission to "Jinotepe"
description: IMAHelps Surgical Mission to Jinotepe, Nicaragua will consist of a team of 30 to include; Pediatric Surgeons, Urologists, Internal Medicine, Gynecologists, Hepatologists, Anesthesiologists, OR Recovery Nurses and Surgical Technicians. Our pre-mission coordinators have just returned from scouting the mission location and one of the observations made was that the poverty and needs of the region are "significant." IMAHelps is going to meet their needs!

title: A toilet block to Leela Family Home ,Karnata India
description: Summary Summary Leela Family Home (LFH) is fostering 40 under privileged children for their overall development in Bangarpet of Kolar District in Karnataka, South India. LFH takes care of the the children's food, health, shelter and education, but inadequate sanitation facility. Currently, there are 2 toilets available but inadequate to meet the needs of 40 children coming from poor rural families. Your contribution will help this project to construct 4 toilet cum bathrooms and meet the demands.

title: Build a Playground for Sick Children in Kenya
description: Hospitalization is a stressful experience to all and more to children. Child Life Programs help children navigate hospitalization with minimal stress and anxiety. Play helps children respond better to treatment and so children heal faster and are discharged home sooner. Sally Test Paediatric Centre provides therapeutic play activities to sick children in a resource poor public hospital in Kenya. We serve approximate 300 children in a day both inpatient and outpatient

title: Mentally Distressed Care
description: We require funding to sustain our weekly "Welcome Centre" which we initiated for our mentally distressed Clients. At the Centre we conduct activities that allow them the freedom of expression, interaction and building of self-esteem. We do this through counselling sessions, vocational classes, creative art and music therapy, yoga and outdoor activities. We also include their family & carers to be their support system. Our Team and Volunteers conduct regular home visits to motivate them.

title: Using Video Education to Avoid Getting Ebola
description: Proper information is keen in enabling people to avoid contracting the deadly Ebola Virus, so providing the easily understandable messages to the people will help to stop the outbreak. We will use video Education in local languages to conduct interpersonal awareness on how to prevent getting the deadly viral disease using with mobile projectors.

title: CANTER MICHIGAN'S GOALS TO REHAB THOROUGHBREDS
description: canter mich.takes thoroughbreds suffering racetrack injuries and provides life saving surgery at msu large animal hospital. canter provides 6 months of rehab including vet assessments,farrier care, xrays, board at the rehab facility including fees to the rehab specialist. when the horse has completed rehab and discharged by the vet he is moved to a training facility with a certified trainer who then rehabs the horse to a new career. canters mission is rehab retrain rehome. cost per horse $6000.

title: Provide Food And Education For A Child In India
description: Hundreds of thousands of children are at risk of malnutrition due to shortage of rain and electricity in Thiruvannamalai, Tamil Nadu. This project aims to provide food and scholarships to 100 children living in poverty in rural India, so that they can get the education they need to build a brighter future and escape poverty.

title: Ebola Awareness in Ghana
description: PAAJAF Foundation believes that with awareness creation with regards to the Ebola outbreak in West Africa it can help reduce the high risk of acquisition in neighbouring countries like Ghana where record of Ebola virus is not at all/minimal. PAAJAF works with deprived and underprivileged communities, children, women and families in Ghana and our awareness creation on Ebola will go a very long way to fight EVD acquisition.

title: Art & communication for coastal dwellers in Brazil
description: The Living Culture of "Ilha do Mel" project promotes the development of education, culture and citizenship in traditional fishing communities in a island, in the coastal region of Parana, Brazil. Directly, around 100 children and teenagers, and indirectly the communities and visitors, receive benefits from the educommunication and art-education, their cultural products and information which are spread in the region.

title: Beekeeping for 40 disadvantage women of Isalo
description: Our project provides for 40 rural disadvantage women of Isalo Park new job through beekeeping. The first phase of our project is running well. Our second phase, transforming beeswax into handicraft, marketing bee-product and helping them to be a self entrepreneurs, is very crucial to improve their incomes, empowering them and enhancing family well being and the most important protecting the amazing park of Isalo

title: Micro business: Creating jobs for youth, by youth
description: Greenside Development is empowering 28 low-income young adults 18-24 years old in the San Francisco Bay Area to go from poverty to becoming entrepreneurs in one year. We are building a unique "one-stop shop" to create access to entrepreneurship for urban youth, providing entrepreneurship training, interest-free micro-loans and mentorship - all free of charge. Business ownership changes our Young Entrepreneurs' lives - creating new sources of income, marketable skills, hope and dignity.

title: English as a Tool For Poverty Alleviation
description: This Project will launch 5 Wi-Fi  Language Class on Wheel for under privileged students in 5 most poor states of India to develop their English Speaking and employ them in major companies & encourage entrepreneurship through LEDER. Lead India Foundation will train 500 under privileged students in the slums and very remote areas of India to uplift their living standard through training them and developing their skill in English Language and promote their enterprise skill through LEDER program

title: Access to school to 200 orphan children in Haiti
description: This project will contribute to send back to school in South of Haiti 200 orphans displaced children by providing them school fees, materials and hotmeals as well and organize an afterschool program in order to improve scores, developing talents and skills in arts of the children at school. That will bring back confidence in the life of the children.

title: FOOD, CLOTH AND EDUCATION FOR 40 POOR CHILDREN
description: This Education Project is to provide Food, Cloth and Education to 40 Poor Children aims to provide care, support and protection for 40 semi street & street poor children. This Project has three care takers, one teacher. a doctor is conducting health check-up & providing medicines. All the inmates are being provided with 3 time's nutritious food, one set of books and 2 sets of uniforms. Every child has opportunity for indoor and out-door recreation and play facilities along with training in craft

title: Centro Las Claras: New Opportunity for Teen Moms
description: Every day teen mothers are victims of violations against their basic human rights. The Las Claras project seeks to provide teen mothers with the adequate tools for them to re-enter society in a productive way, so that being a teen mother is not a barrier to their personal and professional development.

title: Generation Enterprise (GEN): The Business of Youth
description: GEN is run by a group of visionary, off-kilter & always optimistic young men & women from around the globe. Our Business Lab provides young, low-income & at-risk youth with living wages, business & skills training, benefits, and a career path in our local youth-run businesses. This career path focuses on upward mobility-youth can progress from trainee to employee to manager to owner/operator & have the option of exiting to start their own business with their newly gained skills and experience.

title: School Supplies for the Children of Cote D'Ivoire
description: United Aid for Africa's School Supplies program is established to enroll children into primary schools and providing them with an entire year's worth of school supplies, helping to keep these children in school. The program also aims at building schools, as well as improving the conditions of existing schools through efforts such as renovations (painting, providing desks, etc.) Due to civil war in Cote D'Ivoire, many families were left impoverished and could not afford to send kids to school.

title: Care and Education for Orphan Children in India
description: The proposal is for supporting 25 orphans and poor children in urban areas in Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh, India for provision of food, shelter, clothing and education  in Home based environment to bring them up to become self reliant and sustainable. The children in the target areas do not have an opportunity to pursue their education because their poverty. Several Indian children are in the State of degradation and misery.

title: Help 28,000 Indian Children Get Quality Education
description: The vision of Teach For India is that one day, all children will attain an excellent education. To achieve this vision, we are building a movement of leaders who will work to end educational inequity. Teach For India recruits India's most outstanding college graduates and young professionals and places them as full time teachers in under-resourced schools for two years through the Fellowship program. This year we are impacting more than 28,000 children in 250 low-income schools across 7 cities.

title: Casa de los Angeles Playground
description: Casa de los Angeles in Central Mexico serves children of single working moms who cannot afford daycare.  The center is free and the moms give one hour of service for each day their children are with us.  The 100 children in our daycare center love to slide and swing and bounce.  We can put all of their energy to good use with a new playground built near our center.

title: Helping Families Break Cycles of Violence
description: In 1995 Fundacion Junto Con Los Ninos (JUCONI) began with a mission to help street children and their families in Guayaquil, Ecuador. This project will help to break the cycle of violence within families living in extreme poverty through weekly therapy sessions and intervention based youth groups. JUCONI works to improve self-esteem, emotional resilience, and empower families to better manage their unique challenges and stresses. JUCONI: for a world without violence and free of child labor.

title: Reducing Demand for Ivory in China
description: Donate to WildAid and help former NBA star Yao Ming and other WildAid ambassadors save Africa's elephants through raising awareness in the country with the largest market for legal and illegal ivory, China. Every dollar that you donate helps amplify our message and reduce consumer demand for elephant ivory, and "when the buying stops, the killing can too."

title: The Coalition to End Ebola
description: The Coalition to End Ebola is a group of government, community, and NGO partners working together in Liberia to end the Ebola epidemic and stop the spread of the virus. The objectives of the coalition are simple: to provide information to communities about Ebola and coach them on prevention, identify the sick, treat the ill, bury the dead, reintegrate survivors, and support the families of the affected.

title: send  9 children to schools in bangladesh
description: the 9 female children need to help to get admission in the primary schools with a caretaker with special care because the family members of the children are engaged unable to give time to take their children to the schools as they are in hand to mouth financial situation.In this situation the children are deprived of obtaining even primary educational facilities, at least one year care-taking is needed for the children and the care-takers fees and educational materials dresses are needed.

title: Rescue, Re-home and Manage Stray Animals in Nepal
description: A gift to this project is a life-changing gift for a cat or dog currently on the streets of Nepal. Any animal lover would be horrified at the harshness of the lives of street animals in Nepal. The goal of the project is to assist our local partners in continuing its animal welfare programmes. This project aims to end the culling of street animals and give thousands of cats and dogs happier and healthier lives within their communities.

title: Coaching4Change - Coach Leadership Academy
description: Coaching4Change (C4C) offers a unique program that expands learning opportunities for youth.  Our goal is to increase school engagement in low-income school districts to raise the level of academic achievement.  The C4C tiered system trains and hires low-performing high school students to coach and tutor elementary and middle school students.  While the teen coaches act as mentors by providing social and academic support, our students at every age group develop a sense community and empowerment.

title: The Siege - The Freedom Theatre UK Tour
description: The Freedom Theatre, a theatre that defined the meaning of cultural resistance, needs your help in order to embark on its first ever tour of the UK with a brand new production; The Siege. The Freedom Theatre has been described as one of the world's most revolutionary artistic platforms, but it has never been to the UK. We believe it is now time to connect British and Palestinian artists and facilitate the biggest touring production ever performed in the UK by a Palestinian theatre company.

title: Help Build Homes and Eco-Toilets in Santhom Slum
description: Santhom slum in Kerala, India, has approximately 116 homes, This project will have a long term impact on the entire community, and an indirect impact on the surrounding community of Cochin. The focus points will be providing sanitary eco-toilets, carrying out home improvements to improve the standards and safety of shelter, offering vocational training skills and providing a small livestock farm to create a small supplementary but sustainable income.

title: Bring Education to 270 Nomadic School Girls
description: Many nomadic girls in Kenya have never entered a classroom. In Northern Kenya, as much as 80% of school age girls are not enrolled in school.  To tackle this issue, Adeso has created six mobile non-formal education centres in Marsabit County, Kenya for pastoralist girls to attend and thrive.

title: HIV & Health Support for Lake Tanganyika Villagers
description: All along the Zambian shore line of Lake Tanganyika there are people living in remote villages which are inaccessible by road. People in these villages have very limited access to health care and HIV services. The project will provide HIV services such as education and testing - so that a person can know their status, CD4 Cell Count testing for anyone found to be living with HIV - to enable the commencement of Antiretroviral Treatment (ART) and ART initiation within a village for the first time.

title: Improve the education of 2,000 students in Kenya
description: Kenyan schools are buckling under the weight of growing student bodies and stagnating government funding. Hopeful Africa endeavors to partner with schools in Kenya, listen to their needs, and do its best to provide the financial support necessary to increase the quality of education given to Kenya's children. By providing teacher support and funding, student sponsorships, and materials such as books, computers, or electricity, Hopeful Africa is helping 2,000 students reach better education.

title: Quality Education and Health for Girls in Uganda
description: This project will increase access, retention and quality education for girls in primary schools in Dokolo district through providing school fees, scholastic materials, provision of sanitary pads, and medical treatment for HIV affected children.

title: Send 25 Orphans to School-Donate Pigs in Cameroon
description: We believe something as simple as a pig can radically change the lives of village orphans living in severe poverty. By donating two piglets to each orphan's caretaker the household can sell the pigs each year to pay school fees, with the seed money re-invested into the project to help more orphans. BERUDA's Orphan Education Through Pig-Rearing Project provides a sustainable means for 25 orphans to pay their school fees in rural Cameroon. A piglet given today, can grow into an education tomorrow.

title: Invest in Local Nonprofits and Social Enterprises!
description: Root Cause's Social Innovation Forum (SIF) brings together nonprofits, philanthropy, government, and business to support the spread of emerging social innovations in Greater Boston to solve longstanding social problems. SIF provides promising local nonprofit and social enterprise leaders with opportunities to build the capacity of their organizations. To date, SIF has directed more than $15 million in cash and in-kind services to 70 Social Innovators and Impact Entrepreneurs.

title: Story-telling cloth for Ebola Education
description: In West Africa, textiles have traditionally served as a medium of communication, and a method of storytelling. GAIA VF has successfully developed a fabric design to promote knowledge of HPV and cervical cancer. We are now working on distributing a cloth design that would help health workers educate the population about Ebola symptoms and how to protect against the virus' spread. The cloth will be distributed to health workers in Ebola-affected countries, and used to raise awareness.

title: Livelihood Project: Empower Women in Ghana
description: This project is a self-sustainable, comprehensive approach to help women entrepreneurs secure affordable loans. Complemented by business training and field evaluations, we ensure that they use the loans to grow their business and support their families. Your donation will allow us to increase the number of beneficiaries, furthering our impact throughout these low-income communities.

title: Fighting The Outbreak of Ebola in Liberia
description: Liberia, Guinea, Sierra Leone, and Nigeria are currently experiencing the most serious and widespread Ebola outbreak that history can record. The outbreak of this virus is claiming more and more lives on a daily basis. Communities are struggling to contain the virus and control the epidemic. VAAFD will help disseminate vital sanitation and medical supplies to clinics communities across Liberia, educate people on how to stop and contain the outbreak and support families of those in quarantine.

title: Hay Donation Drive to feed Rescue Horses & Burros
description: This WFLF project helps to assure that an adequate supply of nutritional quality hay is always available to feed rescued at-risk horses and burros who have been victimized by starvation and other life threatening circumstances including roundups, slaughter, and disaster. WFLF is an all volunteer public benefit charity that relies 100% on donations to address these extremely dire humanitarian needs.

title: Feed School Children in Kenya
description: Our school lunch programme provides a daily lunch to 2,500 children across our seven partner primary schools in Kenya. Without this meal these children would go through the school day without any food, severely impacting on both their well-being and their learning.

title: Media Fund to Promote Social Justice Projects
description: Our goal is to engage people on social justice issues and to end racism, poverty, and gender oppression. At Peace Islands Institute, we know that the best way to accomplish this task is through platforms like YouTube, Facebook, and Twitter. We need your help to raise $5,000 for a Sony professional camcorder and a Nikon D300s. With professional equipment, we can broadcast our United Nations, youth, interfaith, policy and academic programs to millions of people worldwide!

title: Reforesting the Atlantic Rainforest of Brazil
description: The Atlantic Rainforest is endangered, with only at 12% forest cover left. Its importance is critical as the source of fresh water for 70% of the Brazilian population, and as one of the 6 biodiversity hotspots of the world.  Intense cattle ranching and urban development are putting extreme pressure on the forest and its resources. SINAL is working to protect and restore degraded areas of the forest, particularly hilltops and freshwater springs. With your help, we can bring back the rainforest!

title: Humanitarian Aid for Al-Shifa Hospital in Gaza
description: In response to the recent crisis in Gaza, the Village of Neve Shalom/Wahat al-Salam and its American Friends have focused on raising funds to provide emergency humanitarian assistance to Al-Shifa Hospital in Gaza. By supporting Neve Shalom/Wahat al-Salam's long-standing Humanitarian Assistance Program, the Oasis of Peace is continuing to seek funds to provide equipment and supplies for primary care assistance to the Al-Shifa Hospital.

title: Fighting Cyclone Hudhud creates havoc
description: On 13th of October, Cyclone Hudhud has left a trail of destruction in Vishakapatnam. It destroyed the premises of Lebenshilfe, and the lives of many are in danger. It made landfall in Visakhapatnam and surrounding areas and left a huge pile of debris and trees behind.  The Project Fighting Cyclone Hudhud will help us rebuild the premises of Lebenshilfe for the safety of the inhabitants and help the children live a nornal life again.

title: Give a Toy, Give a Smile
description: This project will be dedicated to providing toys for groups of children in the Dominican Republic, who otherwise will not have a toy to play with this Christmas. With your help, we will put smiles in the faces of these children.

title: School for training Children with Special Needs
description: Aruna Chetana School for Children with Special Needs is a model for many schools in the state of Karnataka, India. It has been helping children with multiple retardation, special needs, and cerebral palsy for past twenty-five years and counting. The philosophy with which this school is started is that all children regardless of mental disabilities, learning disabilities, and genetic disorders have a basic fundamental right to live a life with dignity and have got right to education.

title: Give education to 80 survivors of rape in Zimbabwe
description: 1 in every 3 girls under the age of 18 in Zimbabwe suffers from sexual abuse. In some cases, girls can be left pregnant and homeless. With your help we can support these girls with a safe living environment, counselling and emotional support, and through the provision of education so that they can go on to support themselves in adulthood.

title: Rural Ugandan Nursery School for Children under 6
description: This project will upgrade an existing community-initiated nursery school replacing grass-thatched, dirt-floored classrooms with a brick-n-cement structure. Not only will this project reduce the current unsanitary health and environmental conditions, it will also expand the nursery school's capacity from 64 students to 90 students.

title: Ebola Prevention & Support for Women in Detention
description: The Ebola epidemic continues to affect West Africa with over 10,000 deaths & more than 24,000 infected. In Sierra Leone, the disease is devastating the country with a broken health system, lockdowns, curfews, closed schools & businesses. Everyone is affected. AdvocAid is providing welfare support to women in detention, vital legal aid to those affected by the State of Emergency as well as supplying women's prisons, police stations and courts with donations of sanitation materials.

title: School Gardens for Rural Nicaraguan Communities
description: According to the FAO, 27% of the people of Nicaragua suffer from undernourishment, due to lack of education and inadequate diet.  SosteNica promotes food security for rural Nicaraguan kids.  Working with elementary school teachers and their students, we deliver educational workshops and technical assistance to establish and support elementary school gardens and nutrition. These gardens teach students, teachers and parents how to produce and prepare nutritious food without the use of chemicals.

title: Robotics, science, art and technology for girls
description: We have a permanent play centre available for girls and boys who are at risk of social exclusion: principally, children of single parent families, of those who have been victims of gender based violence, and of inmigrants. We do activities adapted to the ages of the children and the families' social and economic situations. We wish now to increase the quality and breadth of this play centre by complementing it with workshops on robotics, science, art and technology.

title: Invest in Boston Teens! Jobs + Leadership Training
description: Since 1968, YES has been living its mission of inspiring and challenging inner-city Boston youth. More than 1,600 Boston children ages 7-18 annually participate in YES's continuum of empowerment, outdoor, and leadership programs which help youth lay the foundation to achieve greater success in school, work, and life.   The YES Academy delivers high-impact leadership programs to Boston middle and high school students 194 teens participated in 2015.  Help us reach our goal of 200+ in 2016!

title: Free Finan-Entrepren. Educ.to 1000 Venez. Students
description: Supporting low income public schools located in the two country states which concentrate younger population, Jovenes Emprendedores/Junior Achievement Venezuela plans to provide free financial and entrepreneurial education to 1000 youngsters attending these schools. These programs help them to gain self-esteem by identifying and strengthening their own abilities, thus lowering school drop-outs and decreasing rates of adolescent pregnancies that are affecting many youngsters before 25 years

title: Educating and Empowering Tanzanian Girls
description: Tanzania, one of the poorest countries in the world, has one of the lowest secondary school enrollment rates, and one of the highest dropout rates of girls. Only one in four girls continues past the 7th grade. The most effective way to assist vulnerable and disadvantaged girls in Tanzania is by providing them with a quality education. This is what  Nurturing Minds is doing for the SEGA Girls School in Tanzania.

title: Help Educate 1000 Students in Pakistan
description: A vast majority of Pakistan's population comprises of the youth. Aman Tech's vision is to empower these young individuals by teaching them both vocational and soft skills and aligning them to the needs of the local and international labor market through its state-of-the-art vocational training institute. Your contribution will serve as a opportunity for these individuals to help uplift themselves and their communities.

title: Caring for children with life-shortening illnesses
description: Helen & Douglas House provides nursing and end-of-life care for seriously ill children with life-shortening conditions. The aim is to help every young person who visits live life to the full, even when that life is short.

title: Help the Visually Challenged Celebrate Diwali
description: This project hopes to provide new dresses and firecrackers to 600 of our visually challenged children on the occasion of the Diwali festival this year. The beneficiaries of this project are dependent on others for new clothes and crackers, as they are from rural areas.They are no difference from sighted people when it comes to doing anything in life. So your contribution will help in making them go a long way. Indian Association for the Blind (IAB) is an NGO that believes in spreading happiness.

title: Combating the Spread of Ebola
description: Since March, the Global Communities team in Liberia has been delivering outreach messages on preventative hygiene practices to an at-risk population of 366,000 people, placing an emphasis on women, who are disproportionately affected by Ebola due to their role as family caretakers and health workers. We are also providing local burial teams with supplies and training on safe and effective burial techniques that will reduce further spreading of the virus.

title: Jobs for 250 Impoverished Families in Swaziland
description: Poverty and lack of opportunity kill hope.  Providing opportunities for people to earn an income opens all kinds of possibilities for these families: schooling, food, health care, investment, business re-investment, clothing...   Kudvumisa Foundation looks for local resources (skills or natural) that can be developed for markets external to the local community.  So far over 150 families have participated in programs to utilize sewing skills and local resources such as marula nuts and moringa.

title: Support J&K & 6 other Indian states' flood victims
description: Every year adds new dimension of fury to devastation caused by floods in India. While the country hasn't yet recovered fully from Uttarakhand & Odisha floods last year, this year in addition many parts of Bihar, West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh, Assam & most recently Jammu & Kashmir have also been engulfed in flood waters. People are faced with death from basic necessities like food, shelter, clothing, clean water, medicines etc.This project will work to reach relief materials to flood affected areas.

title: 5th Bulgarian Creative Writing Competition
description: The Bulgarian Creative Writing Competition in English aims to encourage and expand the creative thinking among the students, as well as to enhance their English language communication and writing skills. Students will further demonstrate the potential and value of thinking outside the box. They will be given the opportunity to express their unique thoughts while writing on the given topics. The special focus will be put on involving and preparing students from small undeserved communities.

title: Educate and Train 100 Disadvantaged Children
description: Fair Life Africa will serve as a medium, facilitator and benefactor to skillful and talented children (ages 9-17), who are living with a disadvantage (e.g poverty, ill health etc), to provide the support they need to thrive and achieve success in life. Those who qualify will gain access to educational, vocational, artistic and athletic opportunities, and will be mentored to become entrepreneurs in their chosen field or aided in securing profitable employment in a competitive society.

title: Savegre Tapir Project at Rafiki
description: The Savegre Tapir Project at Rafiki is dedicated to tapir awareness in the Savegre River Watershed and the Path of the Tapir Biological Corridor of Costa Rica.
