title: Earthquake relief for remote villages of Nepal
description: The staff of the DCWC were the first on the ground in our remote district to distribute tents, blankets, food and medicine to villagers traumatized by the 7.8M earthquake and its aftershocks. While tending to the many victims, our small Rajbash hospital also became the command center from which our staff and many volunteers hiked into other isolated villages to assess extent of devastation, and needs of survivors. We are serving a population of 125000 in three remote districts, and we need help.

title: Creating sustainable jobs & clean burning biochar
description: We currently lease 319 acres outside the town of Thomonde, Haiti, where we grow the native elephant grass to make sustainable charcoal briquettes, reducing deforestation and lowering the cost of fuel for consumers. You're donations will help us eliminate the need for harvesting of Haitian forests with the end goal of reforesting denuded land.

title: Natural medicines in Nicaragua
description: The Farm-to-Clinic Ometepe initiative is a one-of-a-kind grassroots initiative that will simultaneously bring huge benefits to both community and environment. Project Bona Fide (PBF) will produce herbal medicines, otherwise imported from outside the country.

title: Bring clean water to 5 villages in Madagascar
description: This project will provide access to safe drinking water through installation of 5 boreholes with hand-pumps in villages & primary schools who have succeeded in abandoning open-air defecation practices. This project aims to address the problem of high rates of morbidity & mortality suffered in rural communities in Madagascar, particularly amongst children under 5 years old, as a result of poor hygiene & sanitation, & lack of access to clean water. It also saves women time fetching water.

title: Empower 60 Ugandan girls in Sewing & Embroidery
description: This project will teach vocational skills to 60 out-of-school girls aged 14-22 in Uganda's Hoima district. The girls will learn sewing, embroidery, hairdressing & improved agriculture production to empower them to be self-employed. They will also get life skills of saving money and supporting themselves. This will provide the vulnerable girls with skills and opportunities critically important to help them escape this fate (prostitution) and control their lives and bodies.

title: Community Toilet facility to 15 indian villages
description: Construction of community toilets in  villages who as of now go for open air defecation, is the way we can improve public health and dignity among people.  GRF plans to help 10 more villages build 20 community toilets (two in each village: 1 for men and 1 for women) and organize them to operate and maintain them.

title: Dziewczyny na politechniki! - 10 000 Girls go STEM
description: National campaign "Dziewczyny na politechniki!" encourages girls to take interest in the STEM fields. At 7th April 2016 20 best Polish technical universities invite high school girls to take part in the "Open Day: For Girls Only". Trough the great variety of events, participants gain an insight into academic life of technical universities and the STEM-departments. Laboratories are open and workshops and meetings with female students and professors available. 10 000 girls will participate.

title: Educate 600 Women & Girls in Kumbotso and Okehi
description: Women and Girls can be meaningful and supportive in all aspect of life. Once they are literate and skilled they become visible with voice. Regrettably we have many women and girls in Kumbotso and Okehi Local Government Areas of Kano and Kogi States, Nigeria that are illiterate, poor and marginalized. We need additional literacy and skill centres to provide basic literacy for 6 months as a foundation to 600 women and girls and train them on life skills that boost their status in 2 months.

title: Clean water for Ethiopian community of 5,250
description: HOPE plans to work with the community of Dorza Bele in southern Ethiopia to access clean water.  At present access to clean water in this community is 0%.  Our goal is that by the end of 2015, this will be 100%.  With safe, clean water in their own village, health will improve, children can attend school, more food can be grown and adults will have more time to pursue economic-related activities which will benefit their families and community.  Clean water will bring hope for their future.

title: Educate 900 Kenyan Children
description: This project supports the education of Kenyan children in rural areas and urban slums. Building a good foundation is essential in education. We support Early Childhood Development centres with provision of feeding programmes and teaching resources.  In urban slums the government primary schools are often overcrowded so many children attend non-government schools which have unqualified teachers and limited resources. Afterschool tuition programmes supplement the education students get in school.

title: Crisis Centre for abandoned/orphaned babies Uganda
description: Nafasi (NWC) is run by KHA. NWC has been providing crisis residential care for babies & children under 5 and support for their vulnerable families. However due to a change in the law, it is no longer able to offer residential facilities at NWC. Consequently KHA is adapting NWC's buildings & resources to operate as a day-care nursery and  kindergarten. KHA is launching a new project so that donors can support the work of the day-care centre as soon as it opens its doors in September 2019.

title: Help Stop Violence Against Women in India
description: This project works to empower Dalit and Tribal women's groups to come together to tackle issues of violence against women in India.  70% of Indian women are victims of domestic violence. Reported rapes increased to 33,707 in 2013. Many more cases go unreported and marital rape is not a criminal offence in India.  Dalit and Adivasi women are particularly vulnerable to violence due to their low social and economic status.  Please help to support women's organisations work on this issue.

title: Support Croix-Rouge francaise
description: The French Red Cross is an association governed by the Act of July 1 1901, its fundamental principles, and recognized as a charitable organisation committed to the fields of emergency response and first aid, social action, health, training, and international solidarity.  The French Red Cross works to improve the situation of vulnerable people, particularly victims of natural and technological disasters, and seeks to find each beneficiary the conditions for a dignified existence.

title: Developing Children's Talents in Mathare Slums
description: In Kenya, thousands of families  live in crowded slums,Mathare Slums in Nairobi City is not an exception. Youth survive but don't thrive due to many challenges they face growing up in the slums. At Mwelu Foundation  we strive to help children and youth realize their potential through photography training and film production. Children are able to tell their stories on film, become role models for peace and transform their communities and to use the skill to make a living.

title: Prevent Suicide & Homophobic Bullying in Chile
description: Chile has the highest rates of teen suicide in Latin America and some of the highest levels of school violence.  Kids who are or appear to be lesbian, gay, bi or trans are among the most vulnerable to discrimination and at higher risks of self harm. Todo Mejora works to save lives! We develop programs in vulnerable schools that promote diversity, safe spaces, and prevent homophobic bullying. With funds from this campaign, we will reach 2,000+ students 10-18, teachers & school principals.

title: JUCONI Football Club
description: JUCONI has worked with 200 youth since July 2014 using sport as a tool to teach life skills. To keep kids inspired JUCONI wants to use new uniforms and bi-weekly friendly matches to promote teamwork. The youth will have a unique experience as training and games will enable them to feel like a football academy with goals to strive for. 45 youth will receive new jerseys and equipment to take their skills to the next level as part of a 12 week program with JUCONIs psychologist and one volunteer.

title: Restore Hope-Build Job Status of 1500Youth inCongo
description: Improving food security and employment status of 1500 youth in the Democratic Republic of Congo through increased access to land, market, agriculture skills and technology as well as support to youth-led sustainable agribusiness programs.The project will be implemented in partnership between ASAPT, two other local NGO partners working with youth, a private company specialsed in agriculture and a microfinance institution.

title: Build a Medical Clinic for 5 villages in Uganda
description: This project will build a Primary Care Clinic in South Central Uganda, providing much needed medical care and health education to Ugandans living in rural villages.

title: From hovel to home
description: This project will build a modest home to replace a dilapidated shack.   The photo here is a sample of a home needing replacement.    Rain enters through both the roof and the walls, variously made of plastic, rotted metal and cornstalks.   Families have no choice but to sleep each night on the dirt or mud floor.  Guatemala Housing Alliance needs your help to build healthy and secure homes.

title: 21st Century Early Childhood Education
description: Every child deserves to be nurtured body, mind, and soul. TeamChildren's cutting edge approach to early childhood education is bringing that to thousands of children in our region. Our partnership with Pequenos Pasos de Aspira preschool in Philadelphia, Pa is bringing new possibilities of high-quality early childhood education to every child regardless of their parents economic situation.

title: Empower students in 100 Zimbabwean schools to lead
description: For five years, Lead Us Today has empowered over 3,000 Zimbabwean high school students with the leadership skills to mobilize their communities in addressing their own challenges through implementing collectively designed development projects. In our next phase of growth, we are expanding our program from 40 to 100 schools, and empowering an additional 4,000 students. Through our intervention, we are creating a generation of engaged and socially responsible citizens in Zimbabwe.

title: Clean water for Ebola affected community schools
description: This project will install 50 hand washing stations in Ebola affected communities in Port Loko district, Sierra Leone to stop the spread of the Ebola virus among 1,422 school children and 36 teachers in 25 schools.

title: Provide 500 Daughters an Education
description: The 'ICARE for Mothers and Daughters' campaign celebrates the efforts of mothers who fight all odds to give their daughters the gift of education. Through this campaign we celebrate mothers who did not receive an education but are convinced of its benefits and are determined that their daughters realise their right to go to school. ICARE's partners have identified 500 daughters who have never been to school. By July 2015, we hope to raise $10,000 for programs which will benefit these girls.

title: Empower 20 unemployed Spanish women
description: This project takes action against the lack of economic opportunities in Spain and makes the most of the potential of unemployed educated and talented women by supporting them in transforming their business ideas into a professional business plan and by providing them with business advice and mentoring. By the end of the program, the participants will be able to create new successful businesses, which means new opportunities for themselves, their families and the whole community.

title: Empower 30 Grandmothers in Uganda get Skills
description: There are many grand mothers who walk a distance of 20 kilimeters from Buyengo to JOPA Training center to come and acquire tailoring and knitting skills that will enable them to set up their own enterprise in order to support their grandchildren, when you support these grandmothers you will have redeemed the life of the many grandchildren under their care you can support them by conttributing as low as $10 toward the buying sewing machines and bikes

title: Help Earthquake victims in Bihar India
description: Our hearts go out to the devastation and huge loss of life in Nepal and the country is rightly at the center of a huge international response.But 66 people died in India most of whom were in Bihar ,and hundreds were injured. Today May 12th another huge quake was felt here in Bihar which brought further deaths and devastation to already poor villages .Help is needed at a local level to help the victims rebuild their lives,working together effectively and directly with the victims.

title: Enable 150 Ugandan children rise above disability
description: Katalemwa Cheshire Home is a rehabilitation center aimed at improving the lives of children with disabilities through surgery, and provision of orthopedic appliances such as wheelchairs, crutches, braces in Uganda. The home facilitates orthopedic,  plastic and neurological surgical interventions, physiotherapy, occupational therapy, casting and postoperative care.  The project targets children with disabilities from poor families in Uganda identified through community care.

title: Success Packages
description: Klitschko Foundation provides schools and athletic facilities with the necessary sports equipment by sending Success Packages. Each package contains all the inventory and equipment needed to hold different sport classes and practice indoor/outdoor games and sport activites. Any section that will record a video of their training's has a chance to get sport equipment for active healthy lifestyle.

title: Help a Child Finish School in Rural Argentina
description: This project focuses on providing assistance to the rural high school at Pampa Sena, which participates in the Schooling Program. More than 60 students attend the school, which was founded in 2011. Your contribution will enable us to improve the conditions in which the children study, with improvements to the school building, workshops and improved quality of education, working alongside the teachers.

title: Fight Sex Trafficking of Women and Children
description: Hotels can unwittingly provide the rooms traffickers need for the sexual exploitation of women and children for profit.  This project will empower hospitality staff through highly specialized training to recognize and report suspected activity to law enforcement. It will develop critical protocols to deter and disrupt this abhorrent crime and build a strong community partnership.

title: Improving Cancer Outcomes with Patient Education
description: Low & middle-income countries bear 80% of the world's cancer burden but only 5% of global spending on cancer is expended in them. Patients face enormous barriers to accessing care. In Africa & Haiti, Global Oncology (GO) is helping reduce barriers with education materials for populations with low literacy levels. Improving patient & caregiver knowledge can reduce suffering & improve treatment adherence & outcomes. Help GO put these booklets in the hands of underserved cancer patients worldwide.

title: Inside the Atrato: a Film Project
description: We will make a film and will develop educational materials that draw attention on poverty and environmental degradation in Colombia's largely forgotten Choco region. The film will show exclusive images of the hard reality of the Atrato together with portraying those who live along the river and are confronted with the environmental and violent social realities of the region. The project will be led by acclaimed artists and environmentalists and its results will be widely disseminated.

title: Purchase land to build a school in Tanzania
description: This project will enable Gohechi to purchase land and build a permanent school for children in Arusha, Tanzania.  The stability and quality of the students' lives at Gohechi will be greatly improved with this development.

title: Educational Empowerment of Children in India
description: HCHW is a registered nonprofit organization working with children living on streets and in other difficult circumstance. We are running a full fledged Residential Care Centre providing 24 hrs care and support to 57 children in crisis.Two years back we have scaled up the program to include and address the issue of preventing children from coming on streets. We are running a full fledged Day School providing CBSE education to 236 children from such background who have not been attending any school

title: Educate 84 children/teens with autism in Venezuela
description: Provide much needed specialized and comprehensive education to 84 children and adolescents with autism in Venezuela. We aim to develop their skills and abilities to allow them to integrate effectively within their communities. In Venezuela program and specialized teacher scarcity combined with hyper-inflation is severely restricting access to special education/services. Project target is to provide all students with financial support of at least 30% of tuition and extend capacity.

title: Community Media Hub For SEMA Media in Kenya
description: SEMA Media Hub Project shall create a space and will be dedicated in equipping youths both in school and non-school going age with hands on skills in media and communication for their personal and community development. This will enable youths to learn, create, connect and tell their stories through our running programmes, ranging from film training, photography training, film festival, educational forums and exchange programmes.

title: Give a Music Magician to Developmental Delay Kids
description: To better assist developmentally delayed children, we provide the Early Intervention Program including counseling, day care, referrals and other resources for affected families. In addition to the basic therapeutic fields, we believe music therapy can also be applied to the treatment of developmentally delayed children. Your support will help developmentally delayed children in Taichung City Child Development Center receive music therapy as part of their early intervention program in Taiwan.

title: Education & Healthcare for 1250 children in India
description: This project involves improving the quality of State run Early Child Care Centers by training teachers and parents committees to address education and health care requirements of 1250 children belonging to 50 child care centers which are situated in the low income areas of Bengaluru in India. 10 trainings each will be organized for both parents committees and teachers belonging to 50 Child Care Centers

title: Pediatric care in Koutiala, Mali
description: In South of Mali, MSF launched a pediatric program in 2011. Its main objective is to reduce children mortality with a free healthcare package. This package is aimed at ensuring children's growth and development and reducing hospitalization.

title: Empower 450 teenage boys to become be Great Men
description: This project will take issues of masculinity, identity and gender equality to 450 teenage boys in the UK. Through our unique, fun and lively school workshops, training programme for 45 male workshop leaders, and in-depth training for 22 teachers it will give boys the tools to be able to think about, discuss, and challenge the pressures they feel to "be a man". This not only benefits the boys themselves but also enables them to build healthy and positive relationships with those around them.

title: Save 500 Children From Sexual Abuse In Colombia
description: Our purpose is to educate children between 4 - 12 years old in sexual education and prevention of sexual abuse, and to train parents to warn and to face this issue. This will be done through reflection journeys and story books for educating childrens and parents.

title: Equine Assisted Therapy for Vets, Kids, Adults
description: In 2014, DreamPower Horsemanship provided equine-assisted activities and therapies to more than 450 children, teens and adults with special needs. Sixteen kind and patient equine partners work in the DreamPower program. This project will support our horses, making it possible for them to keep up their good work.

title: Avian Nursery and Quarantine Facility
description: A purpose built facility for the rehabilitation of water-birds, parrots and songbirds will enable Belize Bird Rescue to better assist Forest Department with its enforcement efforts, and help other organisations and members of the public with their conservation efforts. Belize Bird Rescue is Belize's only avian rescue, rehabilitation and release facility.

title: Cystic fibrosis is not a death sentence!
description: The lives of children who live in Southern Ukraine and suffer with cystic fibrosis will become more comfortable and full with the help of this project. Purchase of modern equipment and medicines will help to prolong their life.

title: Preschool Education for Palestinian children
description: Association Najdeh runs a kindergarten in Nahr El Bared, a Palestinian refugee camp in North Lebanon. The kindergarten provides preschool learning to children from 3 to 5 years old, and summer activities for children from 6 to 14 years old with families' participation. This project is offering disadvantaged children a creative and safe learning environment while affording their mothers the necessary time to seek work and assume a productive role within the family.

title: Sponsor an orphan: Children of Bududa (Uganda)
description: We are trying to help some of the poorest and most at risk children in rural, Eastern Uganda. We have a vocational school teaching them marketable skills, an orphan's program providing support and lodging and a women's micro finance initiative. Your money will keep our initiatives running for the next year, thank you for your support.   Please watch our video to learn more.

title: Job Skills for 75 Youth in Rural Belize
description: This project will help prepare 75 at-risk youth from impoverished areas of rural Belize for a lifetime of successful employment through job skills training and internship placement.   Job skills trainings include a two day intensive training seminar led by business owners from the capital city of Belmopan through the local Rotary Club, ongoing coaching from project leader/mentor, interview workshops that include mock interviews and internships with local businesses in the Belmopan area.

title: Send 5 Patients to a CFW clinic
description: CFWclinics is a franchise network of medical clinics and drug shops in Kenya that are owned and operated by a Kenyan nurse or community health worker.   Many CFWclinics patients are too poor to pay for the medical care they need, and our clinic owners end up covering the cost at a loss. To address this issue, we've set up a subsidy fund that allows for our poorest patients to get the care they need, while also allowing our clinic owners to run a successful business.

title: EM-Powerful Women with Hip-Hop
description: Powerful Women with Hip-Hop is a project carried out in Bogota, Colombia. The project is to empower 240 girls and young women. The participants are engaged in different workshop processes using expressions of rap, break dance, dance hall, and dance afro/theater, different female leaders teach them. The women in the program range between 10-30 years old, with various females emerging from conditions of high risk and vulnerability

title: Improve Utica's Health with Waste Treatment Plant
description: Disease and contamination affect the health and quality of life of Utica a Colombian town, this community recently affected by diseases such as Chikungunya, this project will diminish this risk with the adequately treating organic waste, rebuilding the plant for this purpose, developing new jobs, training for this community and generating organic environmental awareness in the region.

title: Care & Build a class room for 40 rural students
description: Allied Organization-a founding body for Christ Towers Junior School Kiboga, mobilizes resources for several education needs for less fortunate children in Kiboga-Uganda. We urgently need to raise $3780 to complete two classrooms for 40 students by June 30th to give these rural children a room to learn and grow. The school has started construction of a four room block to cut down the hiring costs for rooms, and other educational technology resources to lessen rural education inequalities.

title: Support for Women with Mental Health Problems
description: This project works for the rescue, rehabilitation, and reintegration of women with mental health problems in Nepal. These women with their already low status due to gender, suffer abuse, discrimination, and are often abandoned by their families, because mental illness is feared and misunderstood. KOSHISH's short-term Transit Home gives these women a second chance at life by providing them with medical treatment, counseling, and a caring, family-like environment to heal and recover.

title: Water for 50 vulnerable families, Fortuna Casitas.
description: The aqueduct of La Fortuna de Casitas, Nicoya, Guanacaste, Costa Rica provided water to 50 vulnerable families. Located on the Costarican North Pacific side (the driest area of the country).  They only have one water well and every day is getting dryer .They spend 70% of their income just paying the water Wells light bill. CEDARENA wants to buy a solar energy system to create the energy to get the water so they can save that money and use it for other needs.

title: Support Primary School Teacher Training in India
description: Haryana, Uttar Pradesh & Madhya Pradesh are among the states most gravely affected by poor teacher-pupil ratio and dismal quality of teachers. NeTT Teacher Training program will provide holistic education and sustainable teacher training to student-teachers enrolled in district institutes of education in Haryana, M.P. & U.P. Your donations for the project will help us reach out to 4398 teachers who go on to impact more than 40,000 primary school students, making learning an enjoyable experience.

title: A new roof for elderly center!
description: Neoumanist Association provides residential care, home visits and day treatment to over one hundred elderly in the district of Straseni in the Republic of Moldova.  Our beneficiaries are typically impoverished, vulnerable, and without family support and many of them are chronically ill and homebound.

title: Support 200 Women Start Small Businesses in Turkey
description: This project will provide 200 low income women in Turkey basic training on gender and financial literacy and initial loans for their micro businesses for one year. In Turkey, only 29,5% of women are participating in the labor force (the lowest rate among OECD countries) and this project, by providing the necessary basic knowledge and capital, aims to support women in entering into the labor force and earn a decent income by starting and running their own small enterprises.

title: Help Build a School for Vulnerable Children-Uganda
description: ARD-UGANDA is a nonprofit operating in Pallisa, Uganda to support the rights of Orphaned and Vulnerable Children and school dropout youth with access to a quality education. ADR promotes and advocates for these groups to ensure that local and international resources mobilized are prudently managed in an open, accountable and transparent manner. This project will support the construction of a school for OVC's, a vocational institute for dropout youth, as well as a health center for the community.

title: Nepal disaster:relief to remote rural villages
description: We were the first NGO to start delivering aid in Makwanpur,Nepal  where we have a base and were able to purchase supplies and deliver them with the support of the police (for protection),the army (for transport) and local people who contributed food, blankets etc. There are still very remote villages that no one has yet reached and people are hungry.Please help us reach them. Once we have met basic needs we will start building homes so people can stay dry when the Moonsoon rains come in June.

title: Equip 200 women in Managua with life & job skills
description: This project will help 200 young women from urban Nicaragua develop their self-esteem and gain practical skills that will set them on the path to economic self-sufficiency. Students learn strategies to combat the discrimination and violence that keep many women from reaching their full potential. Certified vocational classes, leadership workshops, job readiness training and hands-on, practical experience in a nurturing and inspiring environment prepare students for a life with new opportunities.

title: Give an Orphan a Teddy Bear - Pakistan
description: Provide a teddy bear to an orphan.  Orphanages and schools are providing food and education, but the children lack love and physical comfort like hugs and cuddling. Teddy bears provide comfort and improve self-esteem in children especially those with special needs.  We are gifting 1000 teddy bears because they are providing something to cuddle with for children who do not have access to such toys. We will be gifting both regular and special needs children.

title: Sponsor the education of 29 girls in the DRC
description: This project will fund the education of 29 girls in the village of Kalebuka, in Southeastern DRC. They will be the new Kindergarten class at the Malaika School, which provides a quality education completely free of charge to 202 girls.

title: LET'S HELP STOP CHILD ABUSE EPIDEMIC IN COSTA RICA
description: In Costa Rica, Physical Violence against Minors have been decreed as an Epidemic by our highest authorities on Health and Children Care. As in every other epidemic, vaccination is vital.   Our stage play MI CASA ESCONDIDA (My Hidden House), is an emotional re-education vaccine that can serve to audiences up to 400 people, touring across neighborhoods and communities all across our country.   The present project seeks to put MI CASA ESCONDIDA back in action, helping to prevent this disease.

title: Holistic Rehabilitation for Post-Earthquake Nepal
description: This project aims to anticipate and respond to the many food security, health, shelter, education, and trauma/protection-related challenges that will affect earthquake affected communities in Nepal in the coming months, focusing on the impending arrival of the monsoon.

title: Send 60 girls to boarding school in Kisumu Kenya!
description: Riley Orton Foundation exists to empower girls to reach their full potential by providing sustainable, affordable and accessible quality Christian education to needy girls in Kisumu County, Kenya. This project builds a new Akili Preparatory School Campus for 60 girls in Kisumu to meet the girls'  educational, nutritional and medical support needs in a safe environment where they can thrive and break the cycle of poverty. The girls will be fully sponsored through education and fed 3 meals daily.

title: HELP MATERNAL REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH IN SLUM
description: Limited Access to Quality Reproductive Healthcare Information & Services - ARROW AFRICA  is desirous of strenghtening and expanding the provision of antenatal care (ANC) to poor adolescents and young mothers living in Kayole-Soweto  Slums & as well as the marginalized groups in the Frontier Counties of Western Kenya.

title: Educational Lifeline For 100 Pregnant Girls
description: Teenage pregnancy continues to be a stark reality in Sierra Leone - resulting in many girls dropping out of school each year. This tragically affects their educational progress and future career opportunities.  This project provides an appropriate educational alternative for 100 pregnant girls to ensure they can make educational progress.  Girl are supported through psycho-social counseling, scholarships and computer training - focused on helping them get their lives back on track.

title: Preventive oral health program for rural children
description: This program will benefit more than 6,000 children between 6-12 years old in rural areas of Guatemala, providing preventive dental care to children without access to dental services. These children in poverty and extreme poverty have mostly never visited a dentist and have high rates of oral diseases. Not carried out this program probably they will never have the opportunity to attend their oral problems.

title: Empower 40 Dalit mothers with a micro-finance loan
description: A loan to a Dalit mother to purchase a cow will change her and her family's lives forever. A cow will provide family nutrition and enough income to repay the loan and leave some more from day one. The loan will be repaid within 20 months and the money will then be relent to change the life of another family. The loan rather than a handout gives self-respect. We have already provided over 750 loans. Repayment rate is 100% due to the internal pressure of our mothers self-help groups.

title: 1000 Kibera slum girls empowered to excel
description: Through this project, Polycom Development Project aims to support 1000 girls in Kibera Slums to complete high school through rights awareness programs, educational scholarship, sports , hygiene and sanitation. Girls in Kibera face many challenges; lack of basic needs like pads and panties, manipulation and sexual harassment, lack of hope to further their education due to poverty and most of all lack of people/platforms with whom to share their problems. This project will respond to these needs.

title: Send 200 Low-Income Kids to Daycare & Preschool
description: Centro Infantil de los Angeles provides free, high-quality daycare and preschool education to children from the most financially challenged families in San Miguel de Allende, Mexico. Our programs afford working parents (mostly single mothers) the comfort of knowing that their children are fed, nurtured, and taught in a safe and caring environment. Free childcare enables parents to work and make a better life for their children, who are more prepared to succeed in primary school and beyond.

title: Buy Boats & Jeepney for 170-Student in Philippines
description: The project intends to provide 2 school Boats that can accommodate 20 students and 1 school Jeepney living in the island part of the town in the province of Misamis Occidental, Mindanao.This island belongs to the poorest barangay in the town that has 230 families with population of 1342.   To be properly park and keep safe of the project transportation equipment, a simple terminal port is needed to be built in the port. The island has available port but owned by private person.

title: To provide income-generating training to youth
description: Identification of vocational training needs of urban centres in Chandigarh based on their core economic competencies as well as  demand for skilled labor. The training program will be designed to align the skills of the youth to income generating as well as self employability enterprises.

title: Help save confiscated or injured Sumatran wildlife
description: SRI provides veterinary care and a temporary transit centre to provide initial health checks, quarentine and beinning stages of rehabilitation to various wildlife rescued from the illegal pet trade or injured in human conflict in North Sumatra. This is part of a program working with local communities to address both habitat destruction and poaching of animals, particuarly endangered Gibbon species, the critically endangered Sumatran Tiger and Sumatran Orangutan.

title: Promoting 600 green initiatives in Costa Rica
description: Although many projects exist to help the environment and lower Costa Rica's carbon footprint, there is a serious communication problem which means that small local efforts fail to flourish and remain unknown to the concerned public. Paginas Verdes online directory helps consumers find products and allow projects to communicate with each other. We promote a wide range of good ideas - from shared transport to animal rescue centres, to help Costa Rica achieve its goal of carbon neutrality by 2021

title: ENTREPRENEURSHIP FOR 200 RURAL GIRLS IN CAMEROON
description: This project will bring social,economic empowerment and  independence to 200  rural girls, women and teen mothers in the Northwest province of Cameroon.This will allow them step out of poverty,offer training and employment to other rural girls,women and teen mothers in their immediate community and provide for their family's health and well being.

title: Cancer Screening for 500 Women in Remote Villages
description: Support to Communities NGO will provide access to gynecological / medical care to about 500 women in remote, the most vulnerable and poorest villages in Armenia. It will include preventive care with gynecological / cancer screening and general medical examinations organized by medical specialists outreach visits. It will provide also an access to proper in-depth diagnostic evaluation and specialized treatments, including organizing full access to inpatient care and surgeries to those who need it

title: Transporting 100 children in Uganda to school
description: Early childhood education is important to the growth of children. This is no exception in Kashari, Mbarara district of rural Uganda. The Zion Kids Palace Foundation is a early childhood learning center similar to the Head Start program in the United States. Zion Kids Palace Foundation offers the children breakfast and lunch and a solid foundation for learning.  This project will purchase a van to transport children in remote areas that do not have access to school.

title: Breaking poverty cycle through education
description: If every student completes their high school education then poverty in Costa Rica could drop a 50%. It is so important to make an effort to help youth to stay in school

title: Build composting toilets for 50 families in Malawi
description: The Kwathu Foundation is helping subsistance farmers in Mboma village to build composting toilets. At the moment, these farmers do not succeed to harvest enough to prevent hunger, because they can't afford to by fertilizer. These toilets will not only provide the villagers with free, high-quality organic fertilizer ('humanure") for their fields, but also improve drinking water quality because these toilets prevent avoid faecal contamination of the groundwater due to lower toilet depth.

title: Support an Underprivileged Child in India
description: This project will help support the growth, education and all-round development of the 40 underprivileged children aged 6-24 that are part of the Bal Sambal family in a well-developed facility. Our mission is to not only provide shelter, nutrition, education but also sports coaching, industrial training and opportunities for these adolescents so they can support themselves and become part of the society in a positive way.

title: Bee keeping for 100 Batwa Pygmies in Uganda
description: This project provides management skills and bee products to create an alternative source of livelihood for Batwa pygmies evicted from their indigenous home in the Bwindi forest when the area was conserved as a national park.

title: Canaan, Haiti: My Town, My Story
description: Help the people of Canaan, Haiti, tell their story through verbal testimonies and media production, and empower those living in this new urban settlement play a role in the development of their town. Internews, in partnership with Habitat for Humanity and others are working to enhance the public debate on housing and urban development in Haiti. You can help by giving a voice to people who are living in this evolving urban settlement situated on the outskirts of the Haitian capital.

title: Empower 300 children and women to overcome poverty
description: We aim to empower Cambodians to create sustainable futures for themselves. We achieve this through education, vocational training, and community support projects for our community in Siem Reap, Cambodia.

title: Cycle Miles for Smiles
description: A cycle ride by full-time volunteer plastic surgeon Dr Tertius Venter from New York (June 3) to San Francisco (July 31) in the shape of two smiles - 4 960 miles across the United States to raise awareness of the desperate global surgical need of the poor The World Population 7 Billion  1. 2 Billion people - 1/3 of the world's population, have no access to any surgical care  2. A further 3 Billion people cannot access safe surgical care when needed  A fundraising project to help those in need

title: Give youth the gift of problem solving!
description: The need to empower students with critical & creative thinking, in addition to core subjects, has never been more vital.  Future Problem Solving (FPS) fills a gap in education by providing skills for tomorrow's leaders for solving real issues, while inspiring them to impact their world and the future! FPS students integrate skills of exploration, communication, and production as they collaborate virtually to apply high level problem solving and prepare for the rapidly changing workplace.

title: 100 STREET CHILDREN RESCUE & REHABILITATION -INDIA
description: The children at risk are a major social problem in the society which needs to be given due to consideration to address their problems of the children. The children in menace are not able to enjoy their legitimate right to play associate and educate. In this connection, Gracious Paradise Charitable Foundation realized the need in rescuing the abandoned and runaway children and observed the growing intensity of the problem of massive migration of the rural children into city as an worrying phenome

title: Desperate need for a specially adapted vehicle
description: Community Mental Health and Psychiatry manages various Mental Health related long-term facilities and group homes in the greater Cape Town and Boland areas,Western Cape Province, South Africa. Our focus is mainly based on Psychiatric Rehabilitation (PSR) principles and models. Our services include housing facilities for more than 300 residents and daily support services to many others.

title: Nurses for old and disabled people in Russia
description: "Enjoyable Aging" is a charitable Fund that helps the disabled and the elderly living in nursing homes. Currently our volunteers are visiting more than 120 nursing homes in distant Russian regions. The goal of this project is to hire additional nurses who would take care of disabled people, because of the extreme deficit of current personnel. In most cases, the disabled people are deprived of the most basic needs and of any personal attitude.

title: Provide Books to 500 Students in Rural India
description: Libraries serve as a vibrant hubs of intellectual activity pulsating with the energy of a hundred creative, critical, and literary pursuits.   This project will fill a school library at the Milaan School in rural Uttar Pradesh, India that will enable 500 primary and secondary students to access necessary learning materials, explore their imagination, participate in storytelling, and a space to engage in critical thinking.

title: 700 bags for primary school girls in Nigeria
description: In 2013, about 200 girls where abducted from a school in northern Nigeria.This has added to the ever growing reluctance in the education of girls in the northern part of our country, Nigeria.This project is aimed at igniting the passion of getting an education in girls. We are targeting primary schools with the aim to encourage them to get an education and the importance of an education, at a very young age.A school bag with complete books and kit will be given to encourage excellent performer

title: Free education for 300 children in rural Cambodia
description: Helping Hands is a community project in one of the poorest regions of Cambodia. We provide free education, health care and a healthy nutritious breakfast to 300 children. We also provide school uniforms to enable children to attend state school, as well as running a University Scholarship Programme. Helping Hands' main vision is to give a 'hand up' not a 'hand out', we strive to empower our students and their families to enable them to break out of a life of poverty.

title: Helping homeless Jesica and her 4 children reunite
description: On April 15th 2015 a strong storm destroyed Jesica's already dilapidated home.  She is now in a shelter, separated from her 4 children who were all taken in by community members as this is the only way to keep them from becoming homeless.  Jesica also lost her wheelchair to the storm, as it was irreparably broken when her home collapsed. She is left without a home, without her children and without the ability to move.  This project will build a new home and stabler life for Jesica.

title: Help Stop Honor Killing Through Awareness Program
description: About 1000 women are killed in Pakistan every year in the name of so-called honor. Last year in December a family (couple & 3 children) was axed to death over a love marriage that happened 28 years ago in Pakistan. It is due to the misunderstanding that Law and Islam both are in favor of such atrocities. Such brutal acts can be stopped through the intervention of civil society & religious leaders by educating people especially women about their basic rights and laws against such brutal crimes.

title: Food and Medicines for 285 Disabled destitute
description: Seon Ashram trust, a registered rehabilitation centre for 285 disables including mentally challenged (Mentally ill and mentally retarded), physically handicapped, aged, misused women on street, orphan school going children and infants. The objective of seon ashram trust is to raise the quality of life of these destitute Disabled people of every caste and religion by creating an environment conducive to their physical, mental and spiritual growth. It provides all the facilities free of cost.

title: Tailoring Training Centre for Kenyan slum women
description: This project intends to give skills training in tailoring and embroidery, fashion designing and basic life skills for sustainable livelihoods to 300 slum women in Ruaraka. We established dressmaking and tailoring training centre with seven sewing machines and would like to expand the training centre with more sewing machines, tool kits to reach the wider population with our training services.

title: Empower 20+ ex-convicts by publishing in Georgia
description: This project will create educational, employment, and re-integration opportunities for ex-convicts and probationary youth. The project will establish a publishing house in a rural and economically depressed region of western Georgia. The publishing house will be staffed by ex-convicts, and the income generated will annually fund 20+ ex-convicts to enroll in technical courses to help them find employment.

title: Community health Programme in Sundarban
description: Sabuj Sangha intended to improve health condition of the people of remote Sundarbans; South 24 Parganas to ensure safe motherhood by providing Ante Natal & Post Natal care and reducing maternal and infant mortalities. Initiatives are taken to make people aware about common ailments, especially geriatric; through this project we would ensure quality health services with all facilities namely X-Ray, ECG, USG, Pathology & Surgery with affordable costs for reducing IMR & MMR & control blindness.

title: Stoke Mandeville Children's Music Therapy Appeal
description: This project will give music therapy sessions to sick and disabled children at Stoke Mandeville Hospital to support their recovery by distracting them from their pain, building emotional resilience to cope with their illness, connecting them to other children and to relieve the boredom of long hospital stays.

title: Educate a Girl in Nigeria & Give Her a Future
description: Educate a Girl in need and give her the ability to transform her life, enter the workforce & have a voice in the media. $100 covers the entire vocal education in media studies of one girl in Nigeria, as well as further grooming. We strive to be transparent: we document each girl's education and connect her to her donor. Join us in not only educating 1 girl, but 1000 in Nigeria!

title: Pain relief for 500 hospice patients in Hungary
description: This project serves improving the quality of life of 500 terminally ill children and adults, who are cared for by the professionals of Hungarian Hospice Foundation per year. In order to save the cancer patients' human dignity pain and other symptoms must be effectively controlled until the very end. We prefer caring for the patients in their own homes, especially in the case of pediatric patients. Our inpatient unit in Budapest is also available when hospitalization is needed.

title: Comprehensive HIV Treatment for 12,000 Ugandans
description: Help us provide free comprehensive HIV care to over 12,000 children, youth, women, and men living in one of the poorest areas in Kampala, Uganda. Providing a complete range of services increases patient retention and treatment adherence, which are crucial for maintaining healthy, happy, and productive lives. Donations allow us to continue providing life saving, complete care.

title: Help 40 Ethiopian Children with Cleft Conditions
description: This project helps 20 children in Ethiopia with Cleft Lip and Palate (CLP) with our end-to-end service. These children struggle with gaining weight as it is (almost) impossible for them to eat. By building capacity and working with local health services we provide access to life changing treatment and rehabilitation. This enables the children to lead healthier lives while also relieving them of the stigma cleft brings, helping them be part of their community and get them into schools.

title: Sponsor Kindness
description: 52 Weeks of Giving has been providing weekly volunteer opportunities to a group of 30 youth in rural Appalachia for 5 years. Your donation will help us supply weekly project materials which will be used for volunteer projects that benefit individuals and communities locally, nationally and internationally. Our goal is to show these kids that, no matter where you come from or what resources are available to you, each person has the power to make an impact and change the world for good.

title: Build a kitchen to feed a school in Chaco
description: ACDI plans to build a worthy kitchen for a small school located in an isolated community of Gran Chaco.

title: Decent classrooms for 200pupils at Grapevine Sch.
description: The Grapevine Hope Centre is a community based school. The school operate from shags- classrooms made of EARTHEN FLOORS and OLD IRON SHEETS. During the dry season, it is very dusty. Children are prone to jigger infestation. During the rain season, the classrooms are muddy, slippery & in general a deplorable state. Furthermore, more often, children are cut especially the young ones as they play with the iron sheets. Education is the only way out of poverty. We need to give these children hope.

title: Support education of Costa Rica's Children
description: We want to build an Educational and Cultural Center where we can support childrens education and where we can help them to develop their abilities and social skills.  This will allow children to break the cycle of poverty and will help to eradicate other social problems such as crime, unemployment, drug addictions and others that are present in our community every day.

title: Supporting Solidarity across the Americas!!!
description: America Solidaria (AS) is an international social justice network promoting effective volunteer engagement in the Americas. 475 fellows from Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Uruguay, and the United States have served in our year-long fellowship program. Every year, more than 33,000 people in the Americas benefit from our collective efforts together with companies, governments, international agencies, and local partners.

title: Be the Generation to End Paediatric AIDS in Africa
description: mothers2mothers (m2m) unlocks the potential of women to eliminate paediatric AIDS and create healthy families. We employ, train, and help to empower HIV-positive women. These "Mentor Mothers" work in local communities and at health facilities to ensure that women, their families, and their communities get the health advice, medication, and support they need. Our work has saved hundreds of thousands of lives, created thousands of jobs, and given health and hope to marginalised communities.

title: Educate 500 Girls in Tribal India
description: Project Nanhi Kali currently supports the education of over 100,000 underprivileged girl children across 10 states in India. It is a national sponsorship program which provides academic and material support to underprivileged girl children in primary and secondary classes, so that they can achieve grade specific learning competency levels. The project helps in curtailing the high drop out rate of girl children and aims to strengthen the existing education system in India.

title: Help Build a Classroom! Freedom Through Education
description: Since 1997, Round Table India under Freedom Through Education, has build 5050 Classrooms in 1799 Schools at a total Outlay  Round Table India  plans to build Two classrooms to provide free education for children who hail from the poorest sections of society in Jaipur  also providing the Children with free meals, Uniform and Proper education.

title: Clean Drinking Water for Communities in Kenya
description: We want to ensure access to clean drinking water for several Masai communities in Southeast Kenya. We will buy and install rainwater harvesting tanks in communities affiliated with Kenya Evangelical Lutheran Church. The tanks will provide water security and improve the lives of thousands of people for decades. The water tanks will serve our church communities and neighboring communities and families. Each tank will impact approximately 500 people.

title: Providing Free Health Services to 10,000 Villagers
description: Before RMF opened a health clinic in January 2016, the villagers of Arupokhari, Gorkha had to travel 4-5 hours to the nearest hospital for proper medical attention. Now through our initiative, the people of Arupokhari and nearby villages have access to 24/7, free health services, including medicines at a highly subsidized rate. One year later, in March 2017, the RMF Health Clinic has treated 7,568 patients, averaging 504 patients a month.

title: Therapy for 20 suicidal young people in Hackney
description: This project will provide free counselling, art and drama therapy, mentors and support groups to help ten young people with mental health issues to recover and have brighter futures. Children and young adults report a sense of hope for a positive future after coming to us; feeling less lonely, with greater confidence in themselves. We empower them to take control of their mental health and lives, and stop them becoming another tragic suicide statistic.

title: Educate Girls in Svay Rieng, Cambodia
description: The Cambodian Arts & Scholarship Foundation has been working to educate girls in Cambodia since 2001. CASF works closely with local communities to identify potential students; provides the support necessary for them to attend school; and sustains this support for as long as the child wants to learn. Much of our work has been done in a small village in the province of Svay Rieng called Ta Kheng. Now, we want to expand to neighboring villages in the same commune, Meun Chey.

title: Medical & Recovery Fund for Diseno
description: Lying in the overgrown weeds lay a dog suffering. She was shot and left for dead.  She screamed in pain for over 24 hours as residents went about their daily life, seeming not to care. The police were finally called, and then I get the call. "Dog shot in the face and paralyzed. Please come."  Diseno's care will be extremely expensive, but we will do everything we can to help her and provide her with the best medical care possible. That's what we do at Stray Rescue. We heal. Inside and out.

title: Support Ugandan orphans in Vocational skills
description: Our Organisation supports orphaned and vulnerable teenage girls and provide counseling, training in life skills,vocational skills & business, supporting them to improve standards of living for them, their families and communities. Through this project we seek support to train 40 orphans and vulnerable teenage girls in courses of cosmetology, hair dressing and tailoring for a year through our vocation school, Mityana Community school of cosmetology.

title: 330 Kids Reach Nutrition and Development in Bogota
description: This Project, "Binomial, mother and son" seeks to strengthen the emotional bonds between the mother and her baby, as natural source for security and development, by providing food support, nutritional monitoring, education and support to our 500 kids from the poorest neighborhoods from the north of Bogota, Colombia. Looking for increasing our number to 250 more kids presenting the highest levels of malnutrition and violence, precarious economic situation and barriers for getting health services.

title: Sanitation and food for 20 families in Nicaragua
description: This project will help improve the conditions of basic sanitation and nutritional status of 20 families living in poverty at Balsamo, Nicaragua. Through the project will be constructed ecological latrines, courtyard gardens will be established for the production of nutritious foods and families will be trained to improve the practices and behaviors of hygiene and food. These actions will help improve  health conditions and quality of life for families in the community.

title: Drug Prevention for 300 Ecuadorian Children
description: CDC Community Development Center aims to work in children, parents and teachers a prevention program  against use of drugs from Bastion Popular in Guayaquil, Ecuador.  This project works different aspects through professionals in Psychology, Medicine, Theology, Counseling and training resources to create new leadership in the field to be treated.

title: Sponsor 630 Children in Need Through Education
description: Fundacion DEHVI supports Costa Rican children under 5 years of age living in poverty and in high risk communities. We offer them high-quality early education inspired by innovatives pedagogies, 4 nutritious meals a day, a safe and secure enviroment, and we help them nurture values & develop life long-skills. We have 6  child centers where we provide this service for 5 days a week through extended hours.This provides the opportunity for their parents to find a job and break from the poverty cycle

title: Eye Donation Drive in 164 villages -Chiplun, India
description: Sahyadri will facilitate at least 12 cornea collection in a year and register 5,000 Eye Donors through Awareness drives in 164 villages of Chiplun, India. Sahyadri will involve hospitals, local governing bodies and will also hold 15 Free Eye Check up camps to maximize the reach.

title: Water for Life for people in Simanjiro District.
description: YAAPHA we are trying to make water available to women & children of Tanzania living under physical torture; walking 25 miles for less than 5 gallons, by constructing a water tower that will make water available to 30,000 by the end of 2015. This project will change the dynamics in education, for the children between age 6-12 years, economic, health, agriculture and sanitation, making the world a better place. Please Join us by supporting the project. Tell your friends and family

title: Operation Unchain
description: Help unchain people who are literally chained up in rural Cambodian homes due to lack of awareness about mental health issues and lack of access to services for those who suffer the impact. Your support will match a recent $5,000 donation from King Norodom Sihamoni of Cambodia.

title: Help Tribal women get water for the community
description: To help a group of tribal women finish a well they began to have water for their community.

title: Educate Thousands of Girls with Year-Round Water
description: Solar panels provide a simple solution to having light at night in rural villages in Burkina Faso.  Currently, with no electricity, when the sun sets, education comes to a halt.  With solar panels, lighting is provided at schools and homes.  Girls can then continue to study after the sun sets.

title: A borehole for 60 households in Zimbabwe
description: Project intends to drill a borehole for 60 households and train 2 pump minders in the drought prone Matabeleland South region. Currently the households (village) relies on the neighboring village borehole for domestic use and nutrition gardens. This leads to rationing of water and therefore compromises the general health and nutrition of the households.

title: SKILLS TRAINING TO 60 TEENAGE MOTHERS IN UGANDA
description: This project will train 60 most needy teenage mothers with vocational and entrepreneurship skills to restore hope and transform their future and hence the entire future generation with socio-economic empowerment. The young generation will go from job seekers to job creators hence poverty reduction and there will be reduced crime rate in our communities after taking teenagers away from prostitution in trading centers and from drug deals.

title: Improve health status of 300 poor Kenyan families
description: This project will improve the health status of 300 families with about 1,000 children under 6 years by providing medical care, health education, and treatment for malnutrition in Mukuru slums for 1 year.

title: Provide Skills for Success to Ghanaian Youth
description: We're DIFFERENT...We don't just sponsor young people to attend a rural Vocational School.....4SROGBOE PARTNERS with them at school, after school, after graduation to make sure they're successful.  We provide all Fees,Textbooks, and 'Practicals' such as Catering and Dressmaking equipment/materials, but also we provide sewing machines for Dressmaking students to help them build home businesses to KEEP them in School. At all stages, we support and work with them to make them SUCCESSFUL in life.

title: Disaster Relief for Nepal's Vulnerable Children
description: In April and May 2015, two major earthquakes in Nepal killed nearly 8,000 people, injured 10,000, and affected 8 million across the country. The Global Fund for Children is mobilizing funds to support five grassroots organizations that are bringing emergency relief and ongoing support to vulnerable Nepalese children and their families. As trusted community resources, these organizations are uniquely positioned to identify and fulfill critical needs.

title: Help 200 vulnerable Rwandan kids through education
description: The Kuraneza Early Childhood Development (ECD) project plans to provide care and basic education to 200 vulnerable kids of 3-6 years. The Kuraneza nursery supports underprivileged kids of underage and single mothers, orphans and from families living with HIV/AIDS in poverty-stricken Gasabo district. Effective Early Childhood Development helps kids at risk of poor development due to a lack of parental care and learning opportunities to break free from the poverty cycle in Rwanda.

title: Young Women's Center
description: The young women's center will be a resource and health center that will provide preventive care, diagnosis and treatment of diseases. The clinic seeks to provide specialized gynecological services which are not readily available to most women due to financial constraints. The women's center will also treat complications resulting from Female Genital Mutilation and restore them if possible. In addition to health services, the clinic also seeks to empower women through education and social service

title: Help Give A Child The Wings Of Knowledge
description: The children we lovingly nurture and support have lived through many severe and disturbing circumstances to be in a place where they now have brothers and sisters and are part of a cared for family. For them, learning brings hope to build a future. Help us continue to build this future with them.

title: change-stories-of-1000-ruralSA-vulnerable-children
description: This project will build a multi-purpose centre that will house AfterSchool Programs for 1000 orphaned and vulnerable children in rural Valley of a 1000 Hills, SA. We run programs in 9 under-resourced schools which diminishes the impact of our work - we need vehicles and education resources. The centre will incl. a Resource Centre, site for HomeWork assistance, Maths, Science and English Tutorials, a kitchen for daily nutritional meals, medical and counselling rooms.

title: Construction of a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit
description: The project will build a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit for the Achimota Hospital in Ghana. This will help save the lives of babies that are born prematurely and babies that are born too sick or with diverse complications. In Ghana, about one million babies are born every year out of which around 30,000 die before reaching 30 days of life. Newborn deaths account for nearly 40% of under-five mortality in the country. Reducing newborn deaths is essential if Ghana is going to achieve its MDGs.

title: Health & social care for 300 disadvantaged youths
description: Providing opportunities for social inclusion of 300 disadvantaged youths through sport - seminar,  informational and competitive events with care for their health, social and personal progress. We help them to form community, team-work and motivational culture; it is even chance to grow on personal and professional level. By sports linking of theoretical, practical and role-model experience, participants are able to build the much needed sports and healthy culture lacking in their daily live.

title: Helping ten victims of childhood abuse in London
description: James and Julie are victims of childhood sexual abuse. They suffer from anxiety and depression making it very difficult for them to hold down jobs.There are no free specialist services in London to help them so they have to find the money themselves to get support. They began counselling at the Aurora Foundation, but had to stop as they could no longer afford to pay for sessions. This project provides the means for them and eight other victims to get the help they desperately need.

title: Rebuild School for 479 Nepalese Children
description: PSD is working with community leaders in Harmi, Gorkha to rebuild a school that was damaged beyond repair in the recent earthquake. This school serves 479 children in grades 1 through 10. Getting these kids back in school not only keeps their education on track, but also helps restore a sense of normalcy after the trauma of the earthquake and its aftermath. While construction is underway, we will support the children with temporary classrooms, extracurricular activities, and counseling services.

title: Help to Empower 500 Women and Girls in Nigeria
description: This project seek to empower 200 women in health and agricultural sustainability and 300 girls who are orphans and vulnerable on education, health, ICT and life skills.

title: PROVIDE COOK STOVES FOR 2000 HOUSEHOLDS IN KENYA
description: This project will provide clean cook stoves to 2000 poor rural households in Nyeri County of Central Kenya where over 80% of the population  use traditional three stone  fireplace for  cooking which expose them to indoor house pollution,spend a lot of time gathering wood and exerts pressure on local forests leading to forest degradation.We train  rural households  on stove  fabrication and use and  biomass briquette making  that reduce wood consumption by over 80%  saving lives and environment.

title: Livestock dairy farm GUESSE GADIO (SENEGAL)-AID2G
description: People in the rural community of Orkadiere , northeast of Senegal appealed to the association, AID2G to help them develop a program based on the development of the dairy farming sector to raise milk consumption in deficit rural population and contribute to socio- economic development. To do this, the village women major actresses of this project want to fight against malnutrition families and especially children. In Senegal , they play a major role in livestock Through their practices from

title: Give career training to 100 deaf students in India
description: Our project plans to complete a school for the deaf in eastern India, that will provide hands-on career training and technical education to 100 deaf students each year. This will help the students to acquire skills suited to give them a job, become financially independent and live with dignity.

title: Build Toilets for 600 Students in Tanzania
description: Kilombero Community Charitable Trust plans to build toilets for 600 primary school students in rural Tanzania, improving school attendance and student health.

title: Restore the Livelihoods of 500 Ultra-Poor Families
description: This project will assist ultra-poor families in Rajanpur, Pakistan headed by widows, orphans and the disabled through the provision of small livestock, poultry and sewing machines. We aim to help provide the means for vulnerable families to develop small-scale businesses to generate income for their economic empowerment. Through these businesses, families will be able to generate income to fulfill their basic food and household needs.

title: THINKING FUTURE-KEEPING MALAWIAN GIRLS IN SCHOOL
description: The project aims at getting girls into school and ensuring safe and effective environment which can keep girls of 10 to 20 years old in school. It seeks to prevent and provide awareness on the dangers of child marriages, early pregnancies, domestic violence, HIV/AIDS, and children's rights to girls, teachers, parents and the community. Those who were impregnated and have delivered will be encouraged to get back to school. The project will support 11000 girls in11 districts across the country

title: EDU FOR 100 KIDS ORPHANED BY CONFLICTS IN NIGERIA
description: CEE-HOPE Nigeria plans to provide scholarship for 100 primary school pupils orphaned or displaced by the Boko Haram crises in a school in Northern Nigeria. It will also provide essential teaching aids and renovation assistance for their school, the Queen of Peace Model Academy in the city of Jos. In addition, it will help build a playground for the pupils.

title: Help youth in Limon, Costa Rica finish high school
description: This project will support 305 low-income youth from at-risk communities in Limon, Costa Rica, to stay in school and ultimately finish high school. Through improving the environment at the high school, strengthening the students' sense of belonging, strengthening teachers' teaching methods, developing the students' soft skills and providing vocational orientation, Fundacion Accion Joven helps prepare youth living in poverty to complete their secondary education and obtain quality employment.

title: Help Cure Childhood Blindness and Vision Disorders
description: The Vision of Children Foundation aims to cure hereditary childhood blindness and vision disorders, and to improve the quality of life of visually impaired individuals and their families. Since 1991, we have funded scientists around the world, focusing on several approaches to healing the vision pathways. Knowledge about genetic eye diseases has increased dramatically, and treatments and cures are within reach. But more funding is needed for research to give children the gift of sight.

title: Save 5000 lives in Uganda by Cancer screening
description: In Uganda, "Cancer Is Death" it is stigmatized to the point that families often lie about their loved one's cause of death. TYDI-Uganda is therefore planning to regularly sponsor and carry out Cancer screening,Awareness and Detection Camps.This will help in detecting cancer in its early stages so as to provide appropriate medication that will in return save lives.  With your support we can help save lives in Uganda.

title: Empower Citizen Journalists to speak safely
description: Cambodia generally ranks near the bottom of worldwide press freedom indices due to government control and influence over the media, and threats and violence against journalists. To reduce the risks its reporters face in the field, CCIM plans to host a tailored safety training on physical and information security. Indeed, security is an essential precursor to press freedom, as CCIM is particularly aware of following a violent attack on one of its reporters in 2014.

title: HELP ADOLESCENT MOTHERS AND THEIR BABIES LIVE
description: This project will help keep 500 adolescent mothers (15-19 years) and their children under the age 5 years alive. Adolescents get pregnant due to various circumstances thus the crucial need for them to learn how to feed their children, to understand when and where to seek health care for both themselves and the children.  And the importance of immunization for their child as well as to access Sexual Reproductive Health for themselves.

title: Improve health and income of 50 very poor women
description: Reach India provides sexual reproductive health and nutrition education to 50 young women bidi (local cigarette) workers below the age of 30 years in Murshidabad (W. Bengal, India). They partake in self-help groups to save money and access loans whilst gaining knowledge of disease prevention, freedom of choice and access to products and services required to improve the wellbeing of themselves and their families. We will train and engage them using sewing and tailoring for their safe livelihoods.

title: Save Umm al-Hiran from Demolition
description: In May 2015, the Israeli Supreme Court approved the state's plan to evict 700 Palestinian citizens of Israel from the unrecognized Bedouin village of Umm al-Hiran in the Naqab/Negev desert. Why? So that the state can settle an Israeli Jewish community in their place. Recent demolitions and a police killing of a resident have given more urgency and need for your support. As the main legal organization leading the village's struggle, we call on you to help us halt the destruction of Umm al-Hiran.

title: Transform childhoods of 300 slum children in India
description: Children in urban slums are vulnerable to abuse and exploitation. Through a Child Resource Centre in a slum in Mumbai we deliver programmes that improve school enrollment, address sexual abuse and create child friendly spaces. The Centre currently supports 30 children and through this project we will reach out to 300 children. We provide awareness on child rights and create joyful learning opportunities. We support rehabilitation for victims of abuse and train families on preventing child abuse.

title: Education for Blind Children of Bangladesh
description: The project will provide free special Braille education  to 200 poor , down-trodden and marginalized blind children of Dhaka city in Bangladesh  with provision of all free accommodation,  food,  learning  materials ( Braille books, papers etc.), free medical services, cloths so that they can lead a decent lives.  By contributing as little as $10 as humanitarian assistance , you can become a part of development of a blind child.

title: Enriching the education of students in Cameroon
description: Manengouba Foundation (MF) supports the rural community of Nkongsamba, Cameroon, by working hand to hand with its partnership schools to assist in providing technology programs to further educate students, including training of trainers program designed for teachers who will be empowered to provide subsequent training to their students.

title: Support children-victims of war in Ukraine
description: We collect money for the basic needs of 200 Ukrainian children who are the victims of war in Eastern part of Ukraine. All these kids live in sanatoriums around Kyiv (capital of Ukraine) and need food, clothes and school supplies. They have to leave their homes and instead of happy childhood they faced the warfare and death. We appeal to every conscious peson to support our initiative and help these kids.

title: Empower Children with Disabilities in Bulgaria
description: This project provides a loving family-type home for 12 children with disabilities in Bulgaria. The children once were isolated in large institutions, lost in a system which failed to treat them as individuals worthy of respect. In our small group house, they are treated with dignity and receive the attention and support they need to become more independent and valued members of their community.

title: Give 10 Abandoned Kenyan Babies New Life
description: New Life Home Trust operates a network of homes, medical centres, and day centres in Kenya designed to give compassionate love and care to abandoned, orphaned, and other extremely vulnerable babies and children, through ministering to their physical, medical, educational, emotional, sociological, and spiritual needs. New Life was founded in 1994 in response to the AIDS crisis, with a particular priority for those babies infected or affected by HIV-AIDS.

title: Health And Wealth Through Sustainable Agriculture
description: Our goal is to expand our self-sufficient system of sustainable organic agriculture which will empower more young adults and current farmers to create financial freedom.  With the help of reasonable mechanization and other important inputs we can help Ghana become a model for sustainable development for Africa and the world

title: Educating 200 Rural Poor Girls in Rajasthan, India
description: Bal Sansar Sanstha (BSS) plans to provide quality primary education to 200 girls from the rural poor families, most parents are daily wage laborers as well as building school infrastructure (i.e. 6 classrooms,   library, 1 computer Lab, 4 toilets for the girls) to provide standard school amenities to these girls in Ajmer, Rajasthan, India, allowing them to postpone their age of marriage, not to get pushed into child-labor, rise out of poverty, providing their families' health & well-being.

title: Tutoring & Support for 19 Village Children,Romania
description: Children's Helpers Worldwide is aiming to sponsor this project, which will allow 19 children, living in poverty in the village of Tarlungeni, Romania, to have educational support and other assistance, through a tutoring and mentoring programme, run by local organisation, Refugiu. Tutoring sessions take place each weekday. Other assistance, such as enrolling the children in school and ensuring they have medical check-ups, is given when needed. 14 of the children have a parent who has passed away.

title: Help 50 child laborers finish grade 6 in Guatemala
description: This project will provide didactic material, school supplies and nutritional support for 50 over-school-age adolescent laborers to help them finish sixth grade through CEIPA's alternative, accelerated education program. Most students are from Maya K'iche or Maya Mam families of extreme poverty, ages 14 to 17, and the majority are girls. These young men and women have worked form an early age to help support their families and thus were not able to attend public schools at a proper age.

title: Support 8 youth to succeed in school and society
