The new centre provides GLORES with a permanent base and bigger facilities to give 500 children each year some hope for a brighter future.

title: Building Thriving Families
description: New families that result from unintended pregnancies often struggle due to a lack of stability, support, or experience. Claris Health (Claris) plans to equip 200 families with education, counseling, mentorship, and material goods to help them thrive.

title: Jitegemee - Helping Street Children in Kenya
description: We're in the business of transforming the lives of street children in Machakos, Kenya. Every year, at least 75 former street children participate in Jitegemee's rehabilitation and vocational training program. We also support another 120 young people with education and other social services. After graduation most of our students are able to support themselves and live a life they can be proud of. We ask you to join us in changing these children's lives forever!

title: Health Post Funding in Nepal
description: Funding for running a health program in a health post in Bichhya, within the Bajura district. This funding will cover the cost of staff, transportation, training and activities related to health and hygiene.  2000 patients will be provided with primary treatment at PHASE-supported clinics, 25 child births will be supported by skilled birth workers, and 100 pregnant women will be visited at least once (ANC 1st) in PHASE supported clinics.

title: Moving Mountains for 14 Vulnerable Young People
description: Outdoor adventure has a massive impact, especially when you are 11 and vulnerable. Mountain camp is the first camp on our 3 school-year programme that gives young people the hope, confidence and skills to face the challenges in their daily lives. Challenges such as: bullying; self esteem issues; chaotic home lives; on the brink of exclusion from school; no positive role models; living in poverty or rural isolation. We give these young people a chance to fulfil their potential in life

title: Children in Families, Not on the Street
description: No child that we move off the street should ever be forced to return to the abuse & hopelessness that is their life on the street.  Lynn & her team in Ethiopia provide children with the emotional, physical, educational, and economic tools to facilitate their transition back into their family, yet some cannot be safely reintegrated. For these children, we provide safe & nurturing long-term foster.  Currently, funding is needed to expand our foster care program for an additional 20 children.

title: Your Turn to Educate 20 Girls Wipe Social Stigma
description: FOCUS Nepal as a Christian NGO has been actively working empower unprivileged and outcast  women in poor economic condition.We value  gender balance with high priority to women for education.In Nepal women often suffer being uneducated, faces injustice in many ways. We helped over 1000 women to be graduates, capable for jobs and occupations.Our goal is to raise status of women and wipe social stigma: "Do not educate women." This project will bring differences in the lives of 20 women and girls.

title: The F Word: Stories of Forgiveness
description: At a time of growing social divisions, The Forgiveness Project has gained a reputation for using narrative and storytelling techniques as a way to reach across the rifts of race, faith and geography. One of the ways we do this is through our internationally-renowned travelling exhibition The F Word: Stories of Forgiveness. The collection uses real stories of forgiveness from around the world to challenge black and white views and build bridges between people.

title: Help Build an Agribusiness Incubation Center
description: This project will build an agribusiness incubation center in Rwanda, providing agribusiness training and critical incubation support services to 100 orphans and vulnerable poor rural youth. This project aim to turn youth into successful agribusiness entrepreneurs, support them to access financing, assist them acquire new technologies and innovations, redesign the curricula to make education responsive to the market needs and trends and   link them to markets.

title: Building Homes for Poor in Africa
description: Teaching people in Lesotho, and Africa, to build climate responsive homes that stay warm in winter - even in subzero temperature. Homes are heated with Solar Hot Water (SHW). Our prototype- built  in 2015 for elderly, won a Global "Buildings" contest organized by MIT in 2016. See saridweb.org for more information. We are planning to set up a vocational center for building skills, employment generation- buildings, and require no fossil fuel for heating. Building has thermal mass for heat storage.

title: Moringa for Health and Water Purification
description: Moringa for Health and Water Purification project will provide 1,000 Community Members  from Makueni with 20 Moringa  seedlings  each to plant on their farms. Planting these high yield trees will go a long way to address malnutrition and contaminated water in the Makueni Community.

title: One Year Physiotherapy for 30 Burned Peruvian Kids
description: This project will provide 30 burned children with steady physiotherapy for 1 year. Burns are one of the most painful accidents that a person can suffer from; moreover they produce a physical and psychological trauma that accompanies a victim for his whole life. 70% of all of ANIQUEM's patients are minors below the age of 6 of whom 70% have had accidents with hot liquids and 20% with fire. In nearly all of the cases these children come from low income families that cannot afford proper treatment.

title: Beyond Ebola Making Handwashing a Habit in Liberia
description: The Ebola Virus Disease impact on Liberia was devastating and affected every sector of the Liberian Society. A post Ebola recovery plan is important and essential especially for schools in slums and rural parts of Liberia who prior to the Ebola outbreak did not have proper Water and sanitation facilities on campuses.  The Beyond Ebola Making Handwashing a Habit in Liberia Project is aimed at improving WASH and Ebola prevention related activities at 20 selected schools in rural communities.

title: Taking Tin Marin to ALL Children of El Salvador
description: Tin Marin embodies the Good News about El Salvador.  Children have fun learning through play.  Self-confidence, curiosity and an array of skills are built through unique experiences.  Our challenge is taking Tin Marin to 350 schools across El Salvador.  We've raised money locally to develop and test our plan and build our Mobil Museum.  Now we are going global to crowd source a year's operational costs.  You can make a big difference!

title: Help 50 Youths Save Bees and Beekeping in Cameroon
description: This project will train and empower 50 youths to protect and promote the health of honeybees through sustainable beekeeping and ecological farming. It will address how pesticides are used, and how poverty, food insecurity and lack of biodiversity act as active contributors to the disappearance of honeybees. This  will focus on inculcating the values of environmental protection and management in the youths of Batibo, Cameroon and provide a platform to share best practices and advocate for bees.

title: Vison for Haiti- Hurricane Matthew Relief Fund.
description: After the Hurricane Mathew the farmers in Meyer  asked vision for Haiti to help them to create a seed bank ( they lost all their seeds during the hurricane) ,to strengthen their food production and to introduce new crops to the area.  This project objective is to improve the quality of life by increasing food production, introduce new type of vegetable to the area. To start the program Vision For Haiti will start to cultivate three  lots of display garden one in Meyer, Viola and Baudin .

title: A Big Need in Scholar Books
description: In order to give better studying conditions, scholar books are needed. Todays there is up to 4 students for one book !

title: Help build  toilets for 1000 pupils in Malawi
description: This project will help about 100 children complete their primary education annually at Mtende Primary School, by providing a better learning environment through construction of improved permanent toilets. Due to inadequate toilets and their poor condition, absenteeism among girls is very high, mainly when they reach puberty and a majority drop-out of school before completing primary education. Successful implementation of  this project will increase interest of most children to remain in school.

title: KNS2 Healing Gardens for Special Needs Children
description: KNS2 Healing Gardens promote the health and wellness of children by providing nutritional foods to combat health disparities while preventing childhood hunger. Mentoring underserved, children especially those with chronic illnesses, special needs and physical disabilities.Our Handicapped accessible gardens provide a place of unity in the community for all children to be healthier, fit, educated through our various wellness programs.  A safe, nurturing environment to keep kids off the street

title: Providing Palliative Care in Kenya
description: Palliative care is more than hospice; it optimizes symptom management, nurtures spiritual support, and provides psychosocial services for individuals with life-threatening illnesses. In addition to providing care, we are developing the first accredited palliative medicine programs in Kenya for nurses, clinical officers and physicians providing sustainable access to palliative care for all Kenyans.

title: Help the Costal People Get Access to Clean Water
description: This project plans to strengthen the capacity of the action program titled 'Clean Water for Coastal People in Bangladesh' (that runs adjacent to the Sundarbans) by setting up 10 delivery points at 10 villages, procure a delivery van to transport water and two reverse osmosis systems to increase the production capacity so that it can provide clean water to 2500 households at their proximity where salinity in surface water is a great concern and ground water is contaminated by Arsenic.

title: Martha's Table
description: Washington, D.C. is often cited as one of the wealthiest and most vibrant cities in the United States. However, not every neighborhood has benefited from the city's growth. Martha's Table aims to close this gap by providing quality education, access to healthy food, and family support services through our Healthy Eating, Healthy Start, and Healthy Connections Programs.

title: Help an Immigrant Child Succeed in School
description: IFSI-USA provides after-school and summer enrichment programming to over 150 immigrant children with limited English skills and lack of financial resources.  We educate these children and improve their English skills to give them a chance to succeed in school. Children and society benefit as young people continue their education and are better placed to enter the workforce.

title: Education Challenges for Adolescent Girls Pakistan
description: Adolescent girls are absent from school due to menstruation related abdominal cramps, headaches and fatigue, coupled with poor facilities and lack of counseling, contributing to 20% long absenteeism. At school, girls are faced with poor facilities, inadequate water for washing, lack of soap, no privacy and insufficient toilets. The proposed project will address the menstruation related issues of adolescent girls to minimize the physical & psychological challenges facing adolescent girls.

title: Educate One Empower Thousands 2016
description: We are raising money to give higher education scholarships for the brave young women from marginalised ethnic communities in Myanmar, so they can influence change, drive social reform, and empower thousands more like them!

title: Inclusion of 600+ Disabled Children in Zimbabwe
description: This project will help improve health, education and economic empowerment for 600+ children, youths with disabilities and their families in Manicaland Province of Zimbabwe.

title: Protecting Painted Dogs
description: Painted dogs are one of Africa's most endangered yet least understood animals. Hugely vulnerable to human encroachment and agricultural expansion, painted dog habitats have rapidly reduced, pushing them into even greater conflict with humans.  David Shepherd Wildlife Foundation helps to protect painted dogs by funding immersive educational bush camps, alongside anti-poaching and ranger protection teams, working on the front line of species protection and community engagement.

title: Clean water for Children in Flooded Areas Vietnam
description: Viet Dreams has been providing more than 270 industrial-grade clean drinking water systems ( provides up to 300 litters/ hour) to more than 270 kindergarten, elementary and orphanages in the Central areas of Vietnam.  We are calling for fund to fulfill 5 more schools in the  area of Quang Binh where thousand of students are facing with the recent powerful floods which contaminated their main source of clean water. This will also provide water for villages around these schools.

title: Keep Massachusetts Youth Out of Court & In School
description: Our Restorative Justice (OurRJ) aims to reduce criminalization and avert mass incarceration by empowering youth to develop as valued, productive, and responsible members of their communities. Our programs permit young people to continue their education and, more importantly, avoid a criminal record that cannot be expunged in Massachusetts.

title: Haiti Earthquake - Emergency Assistance in SUD
description: Haiti is facing a deteriorating security situation; gang clashes, looting, and violent protests are frequent, and food insecurities have reached "famine" level. Cholera has also returned after a year-long absence, affecting thousands of people, but many hospitals cannot operate due to security concerns and fuel shortages. This crisis comes on the heels of the devastating 7.2 magnitude earthquake that struck southern Haiti in August 2021, leaving thousands of people homeless.

title: Relief to the Rescue of Hurricane Matthew in Haiti
description: Hurricane Matthew to ruin the Haitian population, because we know that Haiti was already under the threat of extreme poverty, and he was recognized as the poorest of America. Indeed Matthew after its passage in Haiti because the mourning the desolation, has that effect an emergency fund is necessary to help the victims of the disaster. mopab to fly to the rescue of this population horrified in provision of emergency such as food, water, medicine, and medical assistance has short, medium and long

title: Empower 50 Vulnerable Youth to be Job Creators
description: Kyusa will empower 50 vulnerable youth 15 - 25 years in five urban slum communities to start and grow their  businesses with the capacity of providing employment opportunities for at least two youth per business in the first year, bringing the total impact of the project to 150 unemployed youth securing employment in the next one year. Project will target school dropouts, teenage mothers, victims of domestic violence, single mothers, girls in the red light district and at risk youth.

title: Send Deaf Child in Kenya to School
description: KCSD plans to build 3 classrooms to provide free education to deaf children who are orphans and hail from the poorest of the poverty stricken sections of society in Kenya, also providing the vulnerable children with shelter and free meals.   KCSD project builds informal school in Kiambio slums eastleigh Nairobi, providing  quality education and critical literacy support services to over 300 vulnerable children orphans traumatized by the loss of their parents to HIV/AIDS pandemic.

title: Youth Radio Dialogues on HIV in South Africa
description: The Children's Radio Foundation trains young people to produce radio shows on issues facing youth, with 1300 youth reporters reaching 7 million listeners at 72 radio stations across Africa. This initiative will get 280 youth reporters in South Africa broadcasting shows about HIV and sexual and reproductive health at 18 radio stations, sharing vital information and personal stories with youth in their communities in order to reduce HIV infections and make well-informed decisions.

title: Sew Dog Coats for Homeless Dogs
description: Sewing classes are offered free to low-income families to gain a skill that can help them throughout their life time. Sewing machines are donated and as are often given to a person who has shown the desire to continue to sew.  Material is donated to use to sew dog coats for homeless pups in metropolitan Portland, Oregon. The Dog Coat project helps the people who learn to sew to also give  back to their community.

title: MoringAid a Social Enterprise for Burmese Refugees
description: Big international agencies regularly ignore indigenous ways & knowledge and impose western ideologies onto their beneficiaries. To help break free of this dynamic, DARE has started up a Social Enterprise  project called MoringAid.  DARE Network can create a sustainable source of funds by growing, processing and marketing Moringa Leaf Powder, a Traditional SuperFood, helping refugees to help themselves. What is Moringa?  Our goal is to reach a profit making state within 4 years. Read on.

title: Help Vietnam save endangered wildlife
description: Through engaging outreach activities - music festivals, art exhibitions, celebrity video clips, promoting youth community ambassadors - CHANGE educates Vietnamese people about the threat of extinction among endangered species, especially rhinos and pangolins. Increased awareness and empathy will translate into change in behavior, greatly reducing the demand for illegal wildlife products.

title: Give Hope to 20 Single Young Mothers in Tanzania
description: Ilula Orphan Program aims at helping Single Young Mothers gain necessary skills to get the lost hope after being the victims of early pregnancy. The program that focuses on Single Young Mothers will remove the challenges faced by the single mothers who acquired their motherhood at teen-age and were abandoned by their family members and their partners.

title: A New Climbing Frame for Children in Refuge
description: yourSanctuary is a domestic abuse charity based in Surrey, UK.  In our refuges we work with women and children who have fled their homes due to the violence and abuse they have experienced. In order to help the children  to recover from their experiences and enable them to utilise the limited garden space we have,  we are looking to raise 2,750 pounds to build a new climbing frame and basketball hoops for our children to be able to let off some steam and spend more time outside.

title: Help Rwandan Children Access Pre-Primary Education
description: Rwanda is among the few developing countries which have achieved the Millennium Development Goal of Universal Primary Education. However, children between 3-6 years still lack opportunities for pre-primary education, leaving them unprepared for Primary school. This project aims to support three community initiatives in the villages of Cyoma, Rubiha, and Kabuya to launch pre-primary school programs, raise awareness for the importance of schooling, and build much-needed school facilities.

title: Open Doors to Change for 100 Homeless Women
description: Women's Housing Coalition is opening the doors to change for formerly homeless women and their children. We are helping them take control of their lives and learn how to lead stable lives. The Women's Housing Coalition is dedicated to breaking the cycle of homelessness for women and children by providing affordable housing and supportive services to enable them to sustain social and financial independence. We offer housing, case management, and life skills training tailored to the individual.

title: After-School Program for Immigrant Teens
description: Enroot bridges the gap between education and a life full of possibilities. We participate in the movement to make America the most welcoming country on earth by helping immigrant students thrive within our education system. Our students are global citizens and we celebrate their individuality.  We provide low-income immigrant teens in Cambridge and Somerville, MA the space to dream big and the tools to succeed by providing mentoring, academic support, internships, and leadership development.

title: Community Wi-Fi Project
description: This project will provide HotSpots and educational laptops to take home for school-age children in the Fair Oaks and Redwood City areas.  More than one-third of school-age children in the Fair Oaks area do not have reliable internet access or access to a computer in their homes. If they do have one, it's usually shared between family members, allotting limited time to each child. As a result, children struggle to complete their homework, do research and move forward with their education.

title: Girls' Voices: Keep Girls In School
description: Girls' Voices is intended to raise funds for girls' secondary education through media made by girls. Our goal is for girls around the world use the power of digital media to create images and videos that can communicate their strength and potential to the world. The media that the girls create is shared here with the intention of raising funds that will directly contribute to scholarships for girls facing financial barriers to completing secondary education.

title: Support 50 Children with Disabilities in London
description: Destiny Children and Family Support Group aims to support 50 children with learning disabilities. This project support children with special needs such as Autism, ADHD, speech or learning disabilities, through tutoring, educational trips, social activities and family support to carers. We aim to provide a safe social and interactive environment for these children to build confidence, supporting them in their school homework on how to read and write to excel in school and connect with others.

title: Enable Holistic HIV Care to over 13,000 Ugandans
description: Support us in providing free, comprehensive HIV care to 13,000 Ugandans living in one of the most impoverished areas in Kampala, Uganda. The need is growing as infections spread. To address this need, Alive Medical Services provides a complete range of holistic services including clinical, psycho-social, and economic support all provided with our distinctive core value of love and dignity. Donations enable us to continue providing life-saving care and enables our clients to live a quality life.

title: #EmpowerTheFuture
description: Junior Achievement's mission is to inspire and prepare young people to succeed in a global economy.  In Dallas, our focus is providing business role models, basic business skills, and financial literacy to the most at-risk students-changing the lives of students who need our transformational curriculum in order to find their pathway to success. This #GivingTuesday, help us impact the lives of over 52,500 students.

title: Buy Irrigation Kits for 1000 Smallholder Farmers
description: Most  smallholder farmers depend entirely on rain fed agriculture for survival and their food security. With adverse changes in climatic patterns the outcome has been devastating with most rural communities in Kenya's arid and semi arid areas facing starvation and death. Over 60% of livestock has died due to drought. HDI is supporting these smallholder farmers survive through the provision of smallholder irrigation kits.  With this they can plant on and off dry seasons and be food sufficient

title: Reading Program to Kids in Nassau County
description: In an effort to stop bullying in school we have developed a program that teaches elementary school age children what makes us all different and to be kind to one another and to understand why we all are special. There are 208 public elementary schools in Nassau County, New York, serving 97,563 students. Beginning with the most diverse school district, Valley Stream, each child will receive a book teaching them what makes us different and how to be kind. These lessons can help stop bullying.

title: Defend Children's Health in Peru
description: Nearly all the children in La Oroya, Peru have high concentrations of heavy metals in their blood.  Many residents suffer from chronic lung illnesses. A metal smelter has contaminated the air, soil, and water of this Andean city since 1922. AIDA is providing free legal advocacy to help the community hold the government accountable for the health impacts and environmental damage.  After nearly two decades, the case is headed to an international court.

title: Send an NYC Child to a Free Environmental Camp
description: This free green camp makes sure that low-income city children have our community garden gates wide open throughout the summer. In a summer that for many would have been spent indoors behind video screens or in big impersonal programs, they will instead discover the wonders of nature  while nurturing their creativity in a 4:1 ratio with experienced permaculture designers, herbalists, artists, gardeners and educators. We are grateful for you partnering with us to help be the change we with to see.

title: Support Young Entrepreneurs of Tomorrow
description: Founded by business people and opinion leaders who are aware of the importance of entrepreneurship and believe that it is the key to change, Turkish Entrepreneurship foundation works with youth to advance the entrepreneurship culture and to make entrepreneurship a career alternative among young people.A country without any development in entrepreneurship is a country that has punished itself by standing on one foot. We would be really happy if we could make a little contribution to spreading it.

title: Help prevent 700 children from drowning in Vietnam
description: In Vietnam, it is estimated that 35 people will lose their lives to drowning each day and 11 of those will be children.  Help us safeguard the lives of 700 children, by teaching them to swim in our internationally recognized 18-class survival swimming course.

title: Build a class for 300 children in Kakuma Kenya
description: This class will provide a safe learning  environment for 300 children in the Kakuma Refugee camp of Kenya through  informal learning. These children are from 3-17 years and those with various disabilities. Through the informal learning children who are not able to go to school due to various reasons such as adolescent mothers, unaccompanied minors, children with disabilities find a place to learn. So far we have been able to reach 8% of the 46% out of school children in the camp.

title: Support Local Peace Building Organisations
description: Every day, people's lives are destroyed by violent conflict. Many see their loved ones killed, have to flee their homes, or are forced to engage in violence themselves. But amongst devastation, local people are finding ways to resolve conflict, and stop wars. By donating to this project, you can help us continue to support some of the most courageous people on the planet. You can help stop wars, one person at a time

title: Green Jobs & Rights for Girls in Uganda
description: The community project is antipoverty by its nature. It is designed to empower young women through multidimensional training and education opportunities in a way that help them moving out of the existing abject poverty. It is expected to enable young women to recognize the potential, possibilities and alternatives that exist in their lives, and give them the require skill to pursue their goals. The firm belief here is that multidirectional training enhances women's personal growth and self-esteem

title: Making the Slum a Beautiful Place to live in.
description: The Free English Medium Kindergarten School Project for 70 Children. Janvi Charitable Trust runs a Free English Medium Kindergarten School for the poor slum children, where classes are conducted for Junior and Senior levels. The kids are provided with all the necessary Educational material for the whole year which includes School Bags, Uniforms, all educational supplies, Football coaching for 30 kids and purchase of muscial instruments to train the kids. Estimated Project Cost: 6200 US dollars.

title: Take The Challenge For Colorectal Cancer
description: This project funds our Annual Research Scholar Award that provides a young clinical scholar with the funding necessary to spend an entire academic year being mentored in a top basic science and/or clinical research laboratory focused on hereditary and early-age-onset colorectal cancer (CRC).

title: Help those affected by Hurricane Matthew.
description: After the earthquake in 2010, Haiti was hit by the cholera epidemic that has killed thousands of people, with Hurricane Mathew which caused damage and increases the spread of cholera due to the country's health problem and represents a major problem for children, pregnant women and old.This project aims to raise awareness among the most vulnerable people (children, pregnant women and elderly) through awareness session and distribution of hygiene kits.

title: Fight Against Deforestation in 215 Villages DRC
description: Communities have seen their ecosystems, destroyed, fragmented and polluted. entrenant the scarcity of rain, degadation topsoil, malnutrition ... We take action for it to: Fight against the depletion of arable land restore the topsoil Fight against erosion by planting trees Form communities and environmentalists school clubs Awareness through various communication channels. Integration of environmental protection courses in primary and secondary schools advocacy to authorities

title: Gift a Tree on Your Memorable Life Event
description: This project plans to develop 10 plots of leasehold forest with 10,000 trees in southern Nepal by promoting a culture of gifting a tree on birthdays and other memorable life events. Global warming and climate change has become toughest problems of our time. Deforestation and global warming can be reduced by increasing the greenery through plantation by some extent. Given opportunity, many of us will be willing to take action for the solution and handover a better earth to the generation to come.

title: Children at Risk (CAR)
description: The mandate of our organization is to help people  make healthy decisions for themselves and their families. We are working in and around Kancheepuram and  Chennai, India. The Project gives life to children infected/affected by HIV/AIDS families, Orphans and other vulnerable children. It is a Community Based Programme in which we keep the children in the family and help them to continue their studies. We enroll the eligible children into the school and provide them with educational support.

title: Ride to Freedom trailer
description: Every day animals end up in trouble.  Harmony New Beginnings Animal Rescue offers save haven to every species of animals.  Many of our charges are horses, llamas, and other larger animals.  Our trailer  is their salvation, but it is tired and becoming unsafe.  With out our trailer we can not pick up animals or deliver them to their new homes.  Please help us continue to be able to help the voiceless.

title: Empowered Women Learn Code to Improve Their Lives
description: This project will provide affordable and free opportunities for women interested in learning code and software development. Through in person classes and community support in 3 Mexican cities, we will help women of diverse backgrounds achieve their technology goals and build confidence in their careers and their everyday lives.  By teaching women how to code, we aim to reduce the gender and digital gap, strengthen, inspire and empower women to change their lives.

title: Giant Trees for Climate Change Mitigation in India
description: Large trees play a critical role in provisioning of economically important and climate regulating ecosystem services such as water, non-timber forest produce and carbon to millions of people in tropical countries of the world. In absence of clear conservation policy and poor understanding of their importance in supporting sustainable societies, these trees are facing imminent threat. The project will take measures to avoid indiscriminate felling of 1000 large trees in the Western Ghats of India

title: RIDE TO SCHOOL
description: This project seeks to provide bicycles to 150 underprivileged school children in the deprived and hard to reach communities in the East Mamprusi District of the Northern region of Ghana who walk long distance between 5 to 10 kilometers to attend Junior High School daily. (Junior High School is the last three years of basic education). The distance these underprivileged students walk every day is impacting negatively on their academic lives some of which are; truancy, lateness to school, etc.

title: Empower Youth Transition from Orphanage to Society
description: Orphanages in Panama face a big problem with institutionalized youth that have no access to quality education and generally fail to integrate in society. Our program focuses on women and works on their personal development. This project will help us expand to 2 orphanages in one of the most dangerous parts of Panama City - San Miguelito, where the rates of adolescent pregnancy, drug abuse, crime and prostitution are highest. Our program provides them with a chance for a better life & education.

title: Mindanao Sanitation and Food Security Initiative
description: The project will provide safe sanitation using low-cost, durable toilets and food security by vegetable gardening, raising of small animals and fruit tree production to poor farming families in Mindanao especially in the provinces of Zamboanga del Norte and Misamis Oriental. In improving sanitation there is also a need to improve health and nutrition by small-scale agriculture.

title: Help Meet the Needs of Teenage Mothers in Kenya
description: This project will help 50 single-teenage mothers in rural areas and informal settlements in Kenya to meet their financial and psychological needs. We will achieve this through working with existing clubs and networks to host forums where we will explore with target group; their challenges and identify feasible yet sustainable solutions to some of their financial and psychological needs.

title: Joy for pregnant teens to sexual abuse in Rwanda
description: Orphaned teens and pregnant to sexual abuse need practical help of reassurance and an education.Their case of abuse beside being orphans and poverty makes them come out of class feeling ashamed and end up hating life.HELP A CHILD INITIATIVE is working to provide for them daily necessities and reassuring carers so they can rise out of hopelessness, keep safer pregnancies and have a strong maternity instinct. We will educate them for they and their families will have health, wealth and well being.

title: 13 Year Old Needs Surgery
description: At the age of 8, a young from Pakistan, received serious burns and underwent two surgeries. Now she is 13, and needs a mandatory reconstructive surgery to save one of her breasts.

title: Shelter- and Hygienekits for 50 families in Haiti
description: Hurricane Matthew hit the southwest of Haiti. Our partners are on site with several teams and distribute relief supplies to people in need.  With your help, we want to supply 50 families (each 5 persons) with shelter kits, containing blankets, tarpaulins and ropes and hygiene kits, consisting soap, shower gel for children and adults, toothpaste, toothbrushes,Diapers, detergents, water treatment tablets and buckets for water treatment.

title: Clean Water Wells for Schools in Uganda and Kenya
description: There are many schools in rural Uganda and Kenya who have no access to clean water. When children return to school, they will return to overcrowded classrooms with  no handwashing stations. These schools will become breeding grounds for COVID 19. We will drill 10 low cost deep water boreholes using the Village Drill in the rural areas of Uganda and Kenya and install handwashing stations at each site. Each borehole (well) provides water for 1,000 people.

title: Operating a School for 80 Children in 2017
description: Education is at the heart of breaking the chains of generational poverty. Children born into poverty and neglect require a compelling, holistic approach to build confidence in their ability to dream.  The opening of our school 'La Academia' in 2016 has been a great success. Our center is home to our Teacher-Training Program, Critical-Thinking, English, Spanish, History, Psychology, Homework Study, Art, Playtime, and Theater Programs. We serve 1,500 meals monthly to 81 children, 5-21 years old.

title: Provide Healthcare to 40,000 Rural Indian Women
description: The project provides free medical services to distinctly vulnerable population of 30,000, residing in a cluster of 14 sparsely connected and one of the most backward areas of Gujarat state in India through Mobile Medical Unit. Targeted maternal, reproductive, nutritional and menstrual hygiene care is offered to women, adolescent girls and children in the community.

title: Reducing Hunger by Empowering 100 Women Farmers
description: This project will provide much needed inputs for +100 women farmers in Mpumalanga Oliphants River Valley in South Africa. These women are in dire need of  agriculture inputs such as seeds, chicks, livestock, tree seedlings, small irrigation equipment and tools. We will train them on how to successful manage their farming enterprises. We will get the commitment of each participant and equip them to train others in their community.

title: Empower Girls Through Soccer
description: Girls are often overlooked when it comes to activities for youth, whether in Cameroon or in the U.S. They face numerous social barriers to accessing safe space and time to play and learn with their peers. We believe that engaging sports, specifically soccer, creates opportunity for girls to learn life skills and adopt a positive self-awareness and confidence to help them excel in the classroom, at home, and in the community.

title: School Supplies for Young Kenyan Students
description: Boost our Abundance School pupils over the Holidays by giving them a school bag full of school supplies. Your generous donation provides a pupil with a sturdy canvas school bag, locally in produced in Kenya, and a full set of school supplies for the new school year.

title: Growing Fruits for 17,500 Pupils in Gilgil Schools
description: Our project shall provide vital nutritional requirement to poor pupils for boosting their immunity and fighting malnutrition.Most pupils diet contains mainly carbohydrates and lack  essential vitamins.From our baseline survey,pupils were found to be measuring less than their equivalent age and suffering from illnesses frequently. This project seek to reverse the trend by introducing fruits in the pupils' diet through growing of fruit trees in their school garden  to be managed by the pupils.

title: Food and camp-equipment for 30 families in Irak
description: In the regions around Mossul, up to one million internally displaced persons are expected. Our camps are located in the region around the cities of Erbil and Dohuk in the autonomous region of Kurdistan.  Food security is the focus of our action. In addition, each family also receives for the time in the camps   cooking utensils, blankets, pillows and jugs.

title: Help Us Support Child Sexual Abuse Survivors
description: When a survivor of child sexual abuse plucks up the courage to pick up the phone and reach out for help, it should be available to them immediately. Often it is the first time they have disclosed to anybody, even close relatives, that they were abused. Our waiting list for counseling at One in Four was closed for three months last year. The year before we also had to close the list for four months. Simply because of a lack of resources.

title: Do Just One Thing for Children's Palliative Care
description: There are an estimated 21 million children in the world today who have been diagnosed with a life-limiting or life-threatening illness or condition. Less than 1% of these children get the holistic support they deserve to ensure the best quality of life possible. Most services for these children are in the developed world but the greatest need is in the developing world. Help us reach these children by pledging to do something to improve their odds of receiving palliative care.

title: Provide Quality Education for 850 Youth in Panama
description: Ensena por Panama (Teach for Panama) trains and supports young professionals, placing them in at-risk schools for two years, building their capacity to improve educational outcomes and to lead students and communities toward empowerment and self-efficacy.

title: Hurricane Matthew Relief -- Micro Loans for women
description: Hurricane Matthew, a Category 4 storm, hit the south of Haiti on October 3rd through 4th, wreaking havoc in the region. Many people lost their roofs, rendering them homeless.  The micro loan program will offer loans to women who were hit by Hurricane Matthew.  Each will be able to borrow up to $100 for repairs, livestock purchases, etc.  If 100 women borrow $100, this program will cost $10,000.  This money, once paid back, will remain in a revolving fund that can be lent out again.

title: Build an Edu-Tech Hub for 400 Students in Zimbabwe
description: Emergination Africa plans to build a smart classroom (EmergiHub) at St. Dominic's Girls High School that will connect 400 high school students to college students and professionals from around the world through interactive video calls that focus on educational mentorship and career advisement.

title: Wheelchairs Bring Gift of Mobility to Nairobi
description: Wheelchairs for persons with disabilities are a gift that extends hope, dignity, freedom and independence to the recipients. Family members, caretakers and whole communities benefit. It is estimated that 10% of Kenya's population has a disability, and that of these, 1.2 million people need a wheelchair. Imported wheelchairs are too often unaffordable. When we reach our fundraising goal, we will provide 1 sea freight container with 280 wheelchairs priced at $170 to those in need in Nairobi, Kenya

title: Make the holidays brighter for 1,000 foster youth
description: For foster youth, the holidays can be a very somber time.  Seeing families enjoying the season can be a painful reminder of the holiday celebrations they never had.  Every year UFC offers one thousand foster youth a warm and welcoming environment to celebrate the festive season.  We need your help to ensure that the youth in our programs receive something during this special time of year, just like the children in our own families.  Yours may be the only gift they receive.

title: Building Grass-Root CleanTech Innovation
description: In the 21st century, we all need more sustainable ways to grow the food we eat, generate the power we rely on, and protect the water we cannot do without. The report, #SMARTer 2030: ICT Solutions for 21st Century Challenges, shows that by 2030, green technology can cut global greenhouse gas emissions by 20%, make over $11 trillion, and connect an additional 2.5 billion people to the knowledge economy. Join us link the grass-roots to the resources they need to produce green technology.

title: APH GIVE Yourself
description: We want "Apolhygie" is a truly universal movement preserved health and preventive medicine, which by its teaching, living together through the spirit of sports-related team, helps to restore the quality of human interactions. Men and women, without distinction, which blend seamlessly into society. Gather, connect, unite and act to help others to live better together.

title: Build a High School for 38 Students in Nicaragua
description: The Raechel & Jackie Foundation is working closely with residents of the remote mountain village of Llano Largo in Nicaragua to build a four-classroom high school for their students and those of 5 other nearby communities. We have selected and are supporting a local, visionary leader, Carmen Maria Herrera to lead the project and residents are donating land, labor. Goal is to raise the funds needed to purchase the materials.

title: Camp Scholarships: Kids w/ Autism & Medical Needs
description: Every child deserves a normal childhood - a chance to dig in the dirt, to sing off key, to explore the world, and to discover new things along the way. The lives of certain children with developmental and medical needs are anything but normal. Sadly, these children suffer physically and emotionally - not only from coping with the treatments necessary to sustain life - but from coping with the loss of their childhood.  Dragonfly Forest provides a summer camp experience for these kids.

title: Protecting Girls from Early and Forced Marriages
description: The project will seek to build the capacities of girls in rural areas to seek education and health through conducting counselling sessions and livelihood support.  The project will further establish support clubs and conduct community meetings, small group and family centred discussions with tradition leaders, local based groups and families addressing social and traditional factors that exacerbate the practice of early and forced marriages among girls.

title: Cancer Treatment Centres for Nigeria
description: Nigeria's population of 170 million requires at least 170 cancer centers according to the World Health Organization. Nigeria currently has 2. Our cancer treatment center will provide at least 6000 treatments a year in radiation and chemotherapy for cancer patients. Due to the fact that 50% of these patients are indigent they would have received minimal or no treatment at all which would have reduced their chances of survival.

title: First Green City Hackathon in Albania
description: This project will train and develop 1000 Green Leaders to model their vision of Green City for their communities. The training program will empower them to draft, develop and deliver for implementation the First Green City Strategy for Albania. A 100  working groups will go through extensive leadership training and brainstorming to deliver the 10 Green City Hackathon milestones. The 6 months training programs will lead to the First Green City Hackathon in Albania.

title: Aid Educational Fund for Needy Students in GAmbia
description: A good education is the foundation that a young person needs to develop their mental skills, overcome societal challenges and become a valuable, income generating member of the community. This project will keep minimum of 50 needy students in school through scholarship scheme. Reintegrate street children back with their families and those that can't, will be provided a home-like environment through foster care. It will also provide Adult Literacy Classes and Life Skills Training for their parent

title: QUALITY EDUCATION FOR DEPRIVED KIDS IN VENEZUELA
description: We provide education for 400 children, living in one of the most violent and poor areas of Venezuela- 24 de Marzo, Petare. Through our school, Jenaro Aguirre Elorriaga, we provide these children with access to education, a balanced daily nutrition and health care, as part of their fundamental human rights. This school has been created and maintained by the foundation, Fundacion Madre Maria Casar, in the interest of the schoolchildren and to contribute to a life more integrated to the community.

title: Provide Home-Based Care to 10000 People in Namibia
description: This project will provide high-quality community home-based care to alleviate suffering, including home visiting for physical care and psycho-social support of clients, distributing painkillers, multivitamins, and condoms to HIV-positive people and community members in need. It will promote community health, including personal and environmental hygiene, access to safe drinking water and basic sanitation as well as food production, availability and security for more than 10,00 people per year.

title: Share Joy this Christmas with Children in Colombia
description: Conviventia will provide a Christmas experience to children in the four CDA-God is Love schools, located in impoverished communities in Colombia. These children and their families are victims of the heartbreaking cycle of poverty. Regardless of one's socioeconomic background, everyone deserves that sparkle of happiness on Christmas Day.

title: MY HEART WITH VENEZUELA
description: MY HEART WITH VENEZUELA is a fundraising campaign created by I LOVE VENEZUELA FOUNDATION, in order to obtain resources that allow us to help Venezuelan foundations that work very hard to bring health, education and welfare to our Venezuelan brothers.  The situation that crosses the country has obligated many NGOs working in Venezuela to receive a high number of requests for support, and we want to give them a hand. This is your chance to give hope to many and to keep alive Venezuela's heart.

title: Decent Living for Homeless Children of Guatemala
description: 6 out of every 10 children in our coverage are doomed to live without hope for a decent life.  Please help us to give them a decent life through the right to education, health and training them for productive leadership! It is our great purpose to improve their quality of life by improving their level of education, safeguarding their health, and educating them for visionary and entrepreneurial leadership. Join our effort, and give hope to our children.

title: iCaritas Helping the Needed Community in Macau
description: We support all the 50 organizations under Caritas Macau.  We support children who are underprivileged, physically and mentally impaired and the elderly.

title: Estudio Damgo V: A Filipino Design+Build Studio
description: Now in its fifth year, Estudio Damgo student leaders are moving towards the idea of designing a suitable public restroom facility for the users of waterfront Rizal Boulevard, Dumaguete City.

title: Help to Make Disability an Ability in Sri Lanka
description: The Sunera Foundations' disability arts workshops provides the disabled community of Sri Lanka a place to learn, feel cared for and develop both physically and mentally. Using the methodology of the performing arts, the workshops help the disabled young persons integrate into mainline society. It also creates a support group for the caregivers of these disabled young persons to interact with each other, gain knowledge, build friendships and come out of their sense of isolation.

title: 100 Smiles in 100 Days
description: Just like Ganesh & Kunal in the above video, every week we receive around 8 children from impoverished background desperately looking for their chance to Smile. And, we want to give CORRECTIVE SURGERIES TO EACH ONE OF THEM.  We have over the months, made a list of 100 children ready for their surgeries, if only we had the funds for it. Hence, this project is to raise support for surgery of at least 10 of them. But keeping that COMMITMENT DEPENDS ON YOUR ACTIONS in moments like this.

title: Helping Children from Ex-Sex workers in Thailand
description: Tamar Center is helping women that are working in the Sex Industry to find a new life, education and new jobs. But this project is not about the women, it is about their children. Most women that we are helping have a number of children and find it hard to provide for them. We would like to support them with 1000 THB (around 30 USD) per month per Child to help them pay school fees, school material, uniforms and transport to school for the children.

title: Donate Nutrition to Poor Patients in Govt Hospital
description: This project intended for the rural pitiable patients suffering with illness like TB, Dengue, Malaria, Typhoid, HIV/AIDS, neurological & pregnancy diseases, who joined in the Government Hospital from isolated places of Rayalaseema of Andhra Pradesh & Telangana. They do not have enough money to buy medicines. We helping contemptible patients by giving nutrition Milk, Breads, different Seasonal Fruits, Biscuits. With this nutrition poor patients health have been improving & recovering from illness

title: Help children suffering lead poisoning in Paragsha
description: This project helps children to improve their living condition in Cerro de Pasco. The level of lead poisoning and other metals is three times as the levels deemed safe by the World Health Organization. We will address this issue in two ways: 1) free medical consults to measure lead levels in children and  2) a community center where adults can receive training on how to avoid and address health issues related to lead poisoning, and where children can have a safe place to spend their time.

title: Help Us Transform Uganda SPCA Haven Animal Shelter
description: Uganda SPCA's Haven was meant to hold about 120 dogs & cats, but since it's the only animal shelter serving central Uganda & because animal adoption is just gaining popularity, The Haven easily gets beyond capacity. Plus, The Haven is located on rented space-at any time, they could be asked to vacate the property. AKI is raising money so Uganda Society for the Protection & Care of Animals can purchase land to create a state-of-the-art-sanctuary-education facility, the 1st of its kind in Africa.

title: Educating 400 Children in 8 Slums in Delhi/Gurgaon
description: Education on wheels is a uniquely designed program that prepares slum children for formal education by taking the school to them. EOW is a well-equipped bus with computers, TV, and other essential education-related materials. The idea is to motivate slum kids & their parents by providing suitable facilities, skilled teachers & innovative curriculum to bring kids up to the 3rd-grade school level in one year, preparing them for 3rd-grade examination & enroll them into local 4th-grade schooling.

title: Mealewya Water Project
description: Senai Foundation will help 4600 residents of the Mealewya Comminity of Three vmillages to have clean drinking water and sanitatin. Women and school aged girls travel six kilo meters a day to fetch water.  The water they fetch is from dirty ponds and streams is not good for their health. Because of this unhealthy water many people are suffering and is a cause to their death specialy children under the age of five years. School aged girls remain water bearers and do not go to school.

title: Provide clean water to 4600 villagers in Eritrea
description: Our first water project will provide clean drinking waterand sanitation to 4600 villagers in the Mealewya commnity, Eritrea. Water pipes will be laid own in trenches for ten kilo meters distance. Women and school aged girls will be relieved from traveling six kilo meter to fetch water to their families.

title: Support New Babies with Down Syndrome in Peru
description: When a new baby is born, parents who learn that their child has Down syndrome may feel anger, fear, sadness and many other emotions and this can be overwhelming. Early access to accurate, balanced information and support from other parents who have experienced this is essential to overcome these emotions and will provide the best possible start for parents and their new baby. This programme in Peru can achieve this in a simple, effective way at low cost and will make a huge positive difference.

title: English Classes for 180 Rural South African Women
description: Born to Succeed targets 180 women (age 18-30) in 3 of the highest poverty stricken provinces in South Africa. The project will empower women by helping them improve their English skills to proficient level so that they can ultimately enter the work market and provide for their families sustainably.  Collaboration with private sector partners have ensured that approximately 94% of all Born to Succeed graduates have been employed after completion of the programme over the past 3 years.

title: Crowdsourced Mapping to Prevent FGM in Tanzania
description: This is a volunteer run project mapping rural Tanzania into Openstreetmap - an open source map available to everyone for navigation, planning, and monitoring of services.  We are adding schools, clinics, villages, road  and water points using a combination of satellite images, open government data and training locals on the ground with mobile apps.  We prioritise areas where girls are at risk of FGM so that advocacy staff know where the villages are so can reach the girls at risk quickly.

title: A Training Center to Support 400 Women Every Year
description: In the city of Faisalabad,Pakistan in the dominant cultural pressures, women get little opportunities to participate in the economic activities in the rural/semi urban areas.They are confined to perform traditional gender specific roles.The project defines construction of a multi story training center which will be able to train 400 poor and marginalized women and girls in one year in multiple trainings,helping them to uplift socially and economically and get a respectable place in the society

title: Muteff Community Health Care Services Project
description: The Muteff Community Health Care Services Project is designed to bring sustained, dependable health care services to our fellow human beings of the remote, rural community of Muteff. Specifically, we will purchase a small plot and construct a small Health Care Facility within this Community.  There is no health care facility in this community with very bad roads where sick elderly, expecting mothers, infants have to walk or be carried on stretchers to nearest health facility 20 to 25 miles away.

title: Provide School Garden in 5 Deaf Schools in Lagos
description: This project will reduce the rate of hunger and malnutrition among deaf pupils in 5 public primary schools in Lagos, by providing them with school garden. About 50% of deaf pupils go to school with empty stomach, this sorry situation affect their academics, but with a school garden, they will be able to grow their own food and learn skills to be self independent

title: Install Solar Grid, Enlighten 202 kids - Freetown
description: WYCF plans to install a fully sustainable solar grid at We Yone Child Primary School, serving 202 vulnerable children in the hillside of Freetown, Sierra Leone. With 2000 wattage, the solar installation will power the 6 newly built classrooms, 9 toilets, library, & office to create a safe, high-quality learning environment with 24hr accessibility for students, teachers & the community. It will host evening educational activities, campaigns & programs hosted by both WYCF & partner organisations.

title: Supporting Safe Deliveries for Expectant Mothers
description: The population in this community is about 15,000 and 30% are of child bearing age.  The distance to the next health centre providing maternity services is approximately 6 kilometres. We have had incidences where we had to provide three emergency deliveries as the mothers could not make it to the next health centres before the baby comes. We would be helping many mothers in this community by completing the maternity centre.

title: Give Abandoned Companion Birds a Second Chance
description: Based in Bend, Oregon, our rescue takes in abandoned companion birds, provides the best care, diet, behavior training and matches them with a compassionate adopter whenever possible. Your donation will directly fund vet care, nutritious food and shelter construction. Currently we have built a shelter to house small or featherless birds and are expanding our outdoor aviary for larger parrots. There are 50 birds in our care and in 2016 we facilitated more than 10 successful adoptions.

title: Send Lilian and Her 20 Friends to Boarding School
description: Many women from Obunga slum are single mothers struggling to raise their children with little support. Because they lack education, they cannot get decent jobs, earn money & send their children to school.  Girls like 10 year old Lilian have almost zero chance of accessing quality education. Life in the slum exposes them to dangers of sexual harassment, rape, and early pregnancies as they live in poverty with their parents. We can change this by sending Lilian & her 20 friends to boarding school

title: Give Them a Future: Educate a Tribal Girl in India
description: Quality education is a fundamental non-negotiable to overcome poverty and deprivation. Yet thousands of tribal girls grow up unable to read or write. Agragamee helps girls from tribal and other deprived communities read, learn and excel through an innovative, fun and child centred approach. We also reach out to the parents helping them understand the importance of educating girls and quality school education

title: Help Fund a Skills Center for Orphans in Zambia
description: This project will build a vocational skills training centre for orphans and vulnerable children in Solwezi District of Zambia. This will help provide free education and vocational skills to 200 children orphaned and vulnerable due to HIV and AIDS who hail from the poorest sections of society in Solwezi District. Education has an enormous impact on the child's chances for success in life. The center will offer carpentry, joinery, bricklaying, IT skills, tailoring, and other skills.

title: TANF Ghana Christmas Party - 2016
description: Each year TANF Ghana organises a Christmas party for children within our community. The children are already looking forward to their 2016 Christmas party. The plan for this year is to make it bigger and better than the ones that came before. The party will be organised on 24th December 2016. We are aiming to invite up to 100 children. Donations will be used to buy food, drink, decorations, gifts, organise a DJ and music and organise fun activities, such as, board games, sports and dance-offs.

title: urgent!! help 800 people w Clean Water in Tagdicht
description: With your help we can provide healthy, clean, and fresh water tagdicht issaguen villages in Morocco by building safe and accessible potable water wells. This allows grandparents to spend time with their families and for children to go to school and learn. Just imagine the endless benefits of having clean water. We can provide 800 people access to drinkable water. Please make a generous donation for these needy people. We can only meet this goal with your help.just Imagine waking up to no water

title: Live and Learn in Kenya Int'l Sponsorship Program
description: Live and Learn in Kenya Int'l provides educational possibilities to profoundly poor children who are mainly living in the slums of Nakuru, Kenya. Besides school fees, the program also provides all school materials, madatiory uniforms, free meals, medical and dental care, mentor support and housing costs for (AIDS) orphans and university students. There are 450 children on the program ranging from nursery school to university levels. The differences made to the girls is especially astonishing.

title: Little Butterflies: supporting abused kids, Brazil
description: The project provides legal, health and psychological support to children and teenagers who have been victims of sexual abuse.  Reporting all cases of abuse to the local authorities is of fundamental importance in order to protect abused children and guarantee their rights. Group sessions with health workers, psychologists and a social worker will help the victims regain their own psychological and physical identities, using a cognitive-behaviour therapy.

title: Cervical Cancer Screening for12,000 Karamoja Women
description: It is noted that at least 2,464 women are dying in Ugandan from cervical cancer annually. This project will provide an opportunity for poor women in hard-to-reach communities of Karamoja who cannot afford to access services for early diagnosis &treatment to the disease, by hiring services of qualified medical personnel from other parts of the country to conduct screening outreaches to promote early detection and support early referral and treatment to reduce maternal deaths.

title: Living Nelson Mandela's Legacy
description: Each year for our end of year campaign,  Afrika Tikkun, celebrates Annual Mandela Legacy Week in tribute to our Patron-in-Chief in Memorium, Nelson Mandela by recommitting intensely to his legacy of fighting for human rights. Our Cradle-to-Career 360 holistic development model deliver services addressing holistic educational, medical and economic needs of the most marginalized youth from early infancy through adulthood, inspiring and enabling them to become productive citizens and leaders.

title: Provide Sanitary Water and a School in Yevi, Ghana
description: The children in Yevi Village, Ghana, have been forced to drink filthy, disease ridden water for over a year. The boreholes are not functional and the local lake is pollutes and drying up. Frogs and insects skim in the mud. Their current school is too small, falling down around them and lacks basic necessities, causing many children to stay home from school. This project will provide clean drinking water and a new school with library and computer lab for over 600 children.

title: Enhance Access to Historical D.C Landmark
description: This project will improve safety to an historic building that houses a library, museum, and archives of Masonic history. The library is the oldest library that is open to the general public in D.C. The museum houses valuable artifacts that display Freemasonry throughout history. The building is open for guided tours.

title: Gift of Hand - 3D Printed Prosthetics
description: In India there are 2.6 million people living with disability. A majority of the disabled have no accessibility, availability, and utilization of rehabilitation services.  3D-printable prosthetics are changing the face of medicine, as engineers and physicians are able to develop prosthetics that are fully customized to the wearer. What we intend to do is, to start with, make mechanical hands for children who are missing fingers and amputees using 3-D printers, and give them away for free.

title: Digital Empowerment of Marginalised Children
description: Support CRY-Child Rights And You bridge digital divide between marginalized children and their privileged counterparts, in India.The project will reach out to children in collectives formed by each of CRY implementing partners across South India. With tabs, laptops, back-up batteries, internet,learning modules and teachers, we can kick-start digital empowerment of 350 children's collectives in critical regions of four states supporting over 14,000 children; inducting them into digital age.

title: Help Care for 60 Domestically Abused Children
description: Foundation Karibu Tanzania (FKT) a Non Profit Organization based in Mwanza, operates the one and only Tanzanian rescue center for children who have been severely domestically abused and tortured. We rescue and provide medical and psycho-social care and eventually reintegrate the children back into their families of origin for a sustainable, but safe, solution. We seek financial aid to rescue and care for 60 severely domestically abused children who have nowhere else to go other than FKT.

title: Support the UNHCR this Holiday Season
description: At this very moment, millions of families are forced to flee their homes in Syria, Afghanistan and Eritrea, due to violence, persecution, warfare, and disaster. Many risk their lives in an attempt to cross the Mediterranean Sea and reach safety in Europe. This holiday season you can truly make a difference. Support the UN Refugee Agency's life-saving work and make a donation to Sverige for UNHCR, the Swedish Fundraising Foundation to the UNHCR.

title: Clean Water Needed to Transform Mela Gagula
description: The people of Mele Gagula suffer greatly due to a lack of clean water, which presently only 18% of the community have access to. Everyone else travels 3-4 hours to fetch possibly contaminated water from ponds, rivers, and unprotected springs.  Dirty water means sickness, wasted time, missed school and lost hope.  This makes it impossible for the remaining 2,400 people of Mele Gagula to meet their full potential and locks them in a cycle of poverty.  With your help, clean water can end this.

title: Change A Child's Life
description: We are aiming to raise money for children from disadvantaged and vulnerable backgrounds. We try to give the children an opportunity of a lifetime. These children have been selected and deserve to go to a Top High School in South Africa, to have a better future and be able to follow their dreams. Our goal is to provide at least 15 children with the basic support they need to thrive at a top level high school in Nelson Mandela Bay, South Africa.

title: Young Leaders of the Middle East On the Rise
description: Ultimate Peace (UP) is a ground-breaking program, annually uniting 600 Arab, Jewish and Palestinian teens in Israel and the West Bank. The character-building sport of Ultimate Frisbee is our tool. With no referees, teens learn dispute resolution, building deep friendships and trust. The 3-year "Leader in Training" Project prepares select teens for bold action. Today, Jewish graduates combat racism in the Israeli army; Muslim graduates enter medical school as peace activists. The future? Bright!

title: Let's Integrate Disabled Refugees
description: The project integrates disabled Syrian refugee children into society through physical, psychological and educational workshops.

title: Build Two School Classrooms for Youngest Students
description: Currently, our youngest nursery students plus our kindergarteners have classrooms in a very dilapidated mud and thatch building which was originally built in 2010.  Rain and wind are quickly making the walls disappear plus it is not secure.  The classes must carry their plastic chairs back and forth to a small locked storage building every day.  They're been patient and understanding.  We would like to finally be able to provide two decent lockable cement block classrooms for them.

title: Rising for Blind Children - Education4Blind
description: One of the hardest disabilities for children to overcome (or adjust to) is blindness. They explore & see the world with their hands, they need to learn braille system & access to braille books in young age in order to build core knowledge & literacy. If they don't go to school, or lack the adequate resources for enrichment, they fall behind socially, and get isolated from the society.   This project is going to create a fund to support their education & enrichment.

title: Strengthen Muslim female leaders in sports & life!
description: To develop role models and leaders in sports and life, we'll invite 6 Muslim soccer captains from 6 countries (Team Shirzanan 2017) to The Julie Foudy Sports Leadership Academy (JFSLA) followed by advocacy training in New York. Now more than ever, we value the universal power of sport to unify and unite. With Team Shirzanan 2015 as our model, we know this unique sports exchange will also contribute to cross-cultural understanding among the American hosts and multi-national Muslim guests.

title: Schools Not Slavery for Rural Haitian Children
description: Give the gift of freedom and education to girls and boys trapped in slavery. Your support helps families find and free children they've sent away, bring them home and enroll them in school and keeps so many more children from ever becoming enslaved in the first place.

title: Exceptional Learners Deserve Music, Too!
description: Students who receive special education services have often been excluded from learning to make music at school. Isolated by physical, medical, cognitive, psychological, or behavioral conditions, so many have been left out. But these children benefit from making music in deep and life-changing ways! Please join us to bring down barriers to music participation through training special ed teachers & support staff to play, sing, teach, & lead adaptive music with their exceptional students everyday!

title: Educate 20+ Vulnerable Children in Rural Tanzania
description: Ikirwa School Project is looking to sponsor at least 20 vulnerable children from rural village community of Midawe to attend our English-medium school for one year. Our wait-list has over 50 names on it - children who have lost one or both parents, kids born to single moms, and girls, who's education is of no importance. Your donations will go to those in greatest need. Along with excellent education, these kids will receive 2 nutritious meals a day, a uniform and a safe space to study and play.

title: Assist Local Indigenous Farmers in Southern Belize
description: Ya'axche Conservation Trust focuses part of its work on helping local, small-scale farmers in southern Belize transition to more sustainable farming practices. Not only does this help farmers improve their income and food security, it also helps the environment by reducing deforestation and sustaining the health of soils and watersheds.  Through this funding we will be able to provide direct support to the local farmers that we work with, such as a technical visit, seedlings, or farm tools.

title: Educating Afghans through Radio/TV
description: We have combined projects Radio Meraj and TV Meraj! Reaching many more Afghans with education to empower them to improve their lives. Some people live too far from an AIL Learning Center or do not feel safe to travel. Reaching these people with education through broadcast media is an effective means and a popular solution. Radio Meraj has been going since 2015 providing educational programs and TV Meraj will soon start broadcasting. Both stations are housed in AIL's Herat office building.

title: Save Wild Tigers of Sikhote-Alin
description: In Northeast Primorye Province, Russia, less than 50 Siberian tigers cling to survival roaming across both protected areas and multiple-use lands. Conservation measures in such a complicated landscape must address conditions that vary across the region, ranging from strict law enforcement to environmental education programs to training for young conservationists. We seek to secure a future for tigers in this vast, still wild region of the Russian Far East.

title: Empower 2000+ Kids in Brazil to Share and Write
description: A Fabriqueta de Historias (The Story Factory) believes in the power of words. This project aims to equip underprivileged children aging from 8 to 18 with language skills and strengthen them as both students and individuals by offering creative writing workshops. By engaging students from both public and private schools, A Fabriqueta de Historias also fosters a community of co-creation, which is often prevented by Brazil's high economic inequality.

title: New Hope for Antibiotic Resistance in East Africa
description: By 2050 an estimated 10 million people will die each year from antibiotic-resistant infections -- almost 90% of those in the developing world. To address this, Phages for Global Health is teaching scientists in East Africa how to develop cheap, naturally occurring antibiotic alternatives (phages) that are effective against antibiotic-resistant bacteria. Phages have been used successfully against problem bacteria for >100 years in certain regions, but they have not yet been applied in Africa.

title: Peace Education Sessions for Children of Marawi PH
description: This project will focus on funding Teach Peace Build Peace Movements' (TPBPM) Peace Education Sessions for the children of Marawi City in 10 evacuation centers for 3 months.   Thousands of children have been displaced when the conflict broke out in Marawi City Philippines last May 23, 2017, which also caused children to quit school and stay in evacuation centers. TPBPM's Peace Education sessions will teach them the values of peace, the oneness of humanity and diversity.

title: #ProjectPenya
description: This project will uplift girls in underprivileged communities, providing materials and educational courses to empower women and decrease the dropout rate of girls in schools.

title: Children's Protection Programme in South Nepal
description: After creating a model programme for street children in Birgunj, we decided it's time to help more children living on the streets and girls who have been victims of rape, domestic violence or trafficking in Nepal. We have opened a shelter for girls and the boys' one will be launched shortly. The Janakpur centre provides shelter, education, care, counselling, legal support when needed and skills training to the children to equip them for a successful future.

title: Enable 500 Children in Mombasa to have Safe Spaces
description: For hundreds of children and young people in Mombasa who live and work on the streets and on dumpsites they are unable to play sport and have fun in safety - we want to change that! Our Street Soccer Programme creates spaces where children and young people can play without the fear of discrimination, stigma and persecution.

title: Educate 225 Kids by Sending Them to Preschool
description: OBAT understands the importance of early childhood education and the essential role it plays in the future academic success of the student. This role takes on an even greater importance in an environment where poverty reigns supreme and educating  children is not a priority. For this reason, OBAT runs several preschools that focus on educating little kids living in slum like camps in Bangladesh. Without OBAT's support, the likelihood of these kids going to school is almost nonexistent.

title: Transform 100 Rural Communities in Brazil
description: GoLocal aims to help rural and marginalized communities in Brazil develop touristic products and provides them with an online commercial channel. The rural population in Brazil includes many indigenous groups and ethnic minorities. By connecting these people with tourism, GoLocal adds value to cultural heritage, fosters an entrepreneurial atmosphere and promotes environmental preservation. Our goal is to reach 100 rural communities by December 2017.

title: Help Children with Eye Cancer this Christmas
description: For Jade, being told that her six month old daughter had eye cancer on Christmas Eve was devastating. But CHECT support worker Lesley was there to help the family on the day, and ever since. Your Christmas gift means that more families like Jade's can receive support at such a worrying and stressful time.

title: Reduce Recidivism of Female Prisoners in Brazil
description: Conexao Liberdade is an online platform that sells manufactured products made by female prisoners in Brazil. It aims to empower and reintroduce female prisoners back to society, consequently reducing criminal recidivism, which is approximately 30% for female prisoners in Brazil right now. Currently, Conexao Liberdade only takes part in selling products that have already been made, but the next stage of the project is to provide training in prison and give aid to the actual process of production.

title: Help Homeless Children Succeed in School
description: Josh is 8 and homeless. He lives in a shelter with his mom and sister.  He does not attend school regularly because of his families circumstances and he is frustrated...He doesn't know his multiplication tables and is behind in other subjects too.  With the help of a School on Wheels tutor, he is beginning to catch up and is learning to enjoy learning!  He has a new backpack and a new study buddy that he meets every week and homework is no longer a chore but an opportunity to shine!
