Children often don't go to school due to the high cost of learning materials. Long-term prospects are poor as children lack critical literacy skills and awareness of forest ecology. Tigers4Ever's provision of 1000 education packs to Bandhavgarh's children will help improve future outcomes with literacy skills and environmental awareness.

title: Land for Center of Excellence for 300 Slum Youth
description: This project aims to acquire land and build a safe space for talented emerging building artists and athletes from Mathare slums. Young people make upto 50% of the population in the slums of Mathare. Inadequate talent centers for youth is a contributor to crime and substance abuse. Over the years talent development center have been a sure way of curbing crime and youth radicalization.We are certain that this center will help bring sanity in the Mathare community.

title: Improve Learning Outcomes for Ugandan Children
description: We work in 1,000 schools, directly impacting over 1,000,000 children in Uganda. Our focus is to bridge the achievement gap by helping children to learn timprove academically and complete school as well as develop key life skills. We do this through reading initiatives, Spelling competitions and writing competitions.  7 of every 10 children in primary school are not completing school on time or even at all. This is a huge problem because over half of Uganda's population (52%) is children under

title: THE ABC OF SEXUALITY
description: The project strengthens the teaching capacities of 150 teachers from 46 Maya Q'eqchi and Ladinas del Sur communities in Peten, Guatemala, to strengthen their knowledge about Integral Education in Sexuality, which will empower 2700 children and adolescents students on sexual rights And reproductive services, to help them make better decisions about their lives and sexuality, to carry out their life plans, to prevent risks to harmful practices such as sexual violence and HIV.

title: Send 350 Girls to School in Ghana for a Year
description: Achievers Ghana plans to sponsor 350 girls in slum communities back to school this year, to provide free education for girls who come from the deprived and poorest sections of societies in slum communities in Ghana. This project gives girls in slum communities in Ghana access to better education and also extra curriculum activities geared towards empowering a girl child.

title: Give 100 Brazilian children a better future
description: For more than 25 years, the NGO  has provided education, food and protection for children living in   extreme poverty in the violent slums of Recife. We also empower their mothers with profissionalization courses. In the NGO, they have 2 meals; reading, computer and sports classes, besides psychosocial and nutritional assistance.  The NGO uses the Education by Principles Methodology, which aims to restore the essential human values that are often compromised by living in a harsh environment.

title: Nursery School In the Village of Lamwo District
description: For decades, the young children of Lamwo District from day one  have had their lives dictated by the circumstances around them. These circumstances, include poor health, poor diet and above all else no  nursery education, which contributes to the drop out rates at the primary school level, as they would have stayed home, until the age of 6 or 7 before joining primary school. We are attempting to fill this gap, for every child in rural Lamwo District.

title: Give Skills for Self Relience- School Drop Outs
description: SHARE is an NGO  that supports rural household widows living with HIV Aids and in widowhood for a very long time, as well providing educational opportunities to their orphaned children. SHARE in partnerships with existing skills training centers in Uganda urgently needs donor support to train COVID-19 affected households and school drop out youth's to get a considerable impact on hands on skill training opportunities to be able to continue with their educational dreams , be good useful citizens!

title: Shelter House for Women Victims of Violence
description: When poor women who are physically, psychologically or sexually assaulted by their partners or ex-partners flee or report these crimes, they urgently need a safe place where they and their children can stay temporarily to protect their lives. With your help, we will be able to provide nutritional food, personal hygiene items, psychological and legal counseling, therapeutic activities and social accompaniment to these victims of gender violence, in our Shelter House for Women Victims of Violence.

title: Support 120 survivors of sexual violence in Uganda
description: Nyaka's SGBV Program works to prevent sexual & gender based violence against anyone- especially children.  We work with the community to create an environment where SGBV is not acceptable or tolerated. And whenever it is reported to us we take action. We have 4 healing centres where we provide medical care, counselling and legal advocacy for all survivors of sexual and gender based violence- girls and boys, women and men. We supported more than 120 survivors in 2020

title: Educate 270 Children in Northern Nigeria
description: This project will  provide educational materials (text books, exercise books, writing materials, storybooks and teaching resources for the schools ), reading corners  and  four classrooms  that will enable 270 primary school children of poor rural peasant farmers in Northern Nigeria who have been traumatized by the Boko Haram insurgency (their school buildings have been damaged and whose education have been disrupted) to have  safe and hygienic spaces  to enroll, remain in school and learn.

title: HIV Prevention to 1000 Youth in South Sudan
description: Youth in Yei ,Yambio and Mundri have little access to appropriate HIV services and that puts their lives at potential risk of HIV infection because they have unsafe sex and low knowledge on HIV.The project will increase peer education outreaches to the three areas, and with the collaboration of HIV/STI & ART service providers from the  hospitals,  provide friendly outreach services, working in these settings to improve and sustain the demand for comprehensive HIV prevention among the youth.

title: Start 3 Village Pre-Schools as Models in Cambodia
description: Establish 3 village pre-schools in 3 remote districts that will improve the children's healthy development, teach them communication skills, provide a foundation for primary school, promote parent's awareness of the importance of education and be model for other pre-schools. Caring for Young Khmer will establish the schools, provide supplies and equipment, train the teacher, support the community to manage the pre-school, do monitoring and handover to the community after three years.

title: Provide Blanket Health Care to 510 Destitute Kids
description: We are addressing the root cause of poverty - 'Lack of quality education'. The modernization in India is limited to big cities. We are currently working for 41 villages in the foothills of Himalayas.  We transform destitute rural youth by providing them value based learning & the essentials, medical care & nutrition. In our journey of 15 years, we have impacted not only 700 children but their economically disadvantaged families.

title: PAW (People For Animals On Wheels )
description: #PAW, People for Animals on Wheels, is an initiative to run a Mobile Animal Ambulance  providing On The Spot Medical Treatment to the disease/injured Animals without removing them from their natural habitat. The ambulance is aimed to consist facilities like X-ray Machine, OT , Hydraulic Lift Jack to carry heavy animals and a team of dedicated Veterinary Doctors at its service. Please Help Us Help the Helpless Animals by contributing to the required fund of $14991 for this noble cause.

title: School Kit Donation - Gift Hope to a Childs Future
description: 'School Kit Donation Drive' to gift a School Kit to children from economically weaker sections of the society. The school Kit is an assorted set of materials such as school bag, notebooks, pen, pencil, drawing book, colors and a compass box which varies as per the sections like primary, secondary and higher secondary.

title: Train 100 Women  on Land Rights in Siaya
description: This project will build the capacity of 100 women and girls in Siaya County/ Kenya, providing competent training for 10 women on land rights and campaign, constructing a legal advisory and training center,provide scholarships for 10 girls, hold 3 legal clinics, training and mentoring women political aspirants to participate effectively in the Kenyan political contest.

title: Send 120 Pygmies Children to School in Cameroon
description: Marginalized, stigmatized, rejected by the by the surrounding Bantu population,the Pygmies have no legal recognition,this project will insure the care of 120 Pygmies children and youth (tuition fees, uniforms, clothing),provide appropriate materials for different levels of education: preschool, elementary and secondary - (school supplies, textbooks, computers),to benefit from medical follow-up (purchase of essential medicines),to have a healthy diet (Creation of an agro-pastoral farm).

title: Water for Learning in Kenyan & Ugandan Schools
description: This project will address the lack of clean water, hygiene and sanitation facilities in EPAfrica's partner schools in East Africa through investment in facilities to collect, store, clean and distribute water. Complementary hygiene and sanitation facilities such as handwashing stations and clothes washing stations may also be installed. This funding will enable us to improve the water situation in eight schools, directly impacting the health and education of at least 4,000 students.

title: Internet and ICT for Coffee Growers in Colombia
description: Makaia and ALO & Partners conduct this project whit the purpose of improving the livelihoods and living standards of coffee growers in remote rural areas in Colombia through the access to internet and the use of ICT tools while strengthening the chain value, improving the education opportunities for the youngsters and promoting peace-building in the region.

title: Shipping Supplies to Source of Life Clinic
description: We have much needed medical supplies that need to be shipped to Source of Life Medical Clinics in Ouaguadougou, Burkina Faso. We are shipping a 40' shipping container full of much needed medical supplies and equipment valued at $500,000.

title: Assist College Athletes Graduate After Sports
description: So, You are watching the big college game and rooting for your old Alma Mater: The NCAA Basketball Tournament! The big bowl game! Did you know that over half the African American players that you see will not graduate college? We are dedicated to helping the national graduation rate among African American underprivileged college athletes that have exhausted their scholarship eligibility to play sports from well under 50% to 79%.(The data shows it is a financial issue as they are already Sr.'s)

title: Help Syrian Refugee Children Stay in School
description: The project is to support the education of Syrian refugee children living in Turkey by allowing them to attend school taught in their native language. Bunat Al Mustakbel in Antakya Turkey is a small private school of around more than 1,000 students and 46 teachers. The school has a standard curriculum for an international school geared for primary and secondary students. Given the desperate situation the student body lives with, the school plays an irreplaceable roll in their lives.

title: Sanitation Program in 13 communities of fungurume
description: Many people in the community are exposed to malaria and other illnesses, due to the unclean environment and lack of proper toilets

title: Help construct a sustainable Community in Colombia
description: Donating to this project will help build an ecological demonstration farm in the Indigenous community of Atanquez in Northern Colombian. This demonstration farm will provide practical solutions to pressing concerns of sanitation and clean food production. Furthermore, it will raise awareness in the community towards important sustainability issues such as alternative energy systems, recycling and the valorisation of traditional knowledge.

title: UPYA: resilient housing innovation in Colombia
description: Pacho bought a lot 15 years ago in Cartagena. He and his family are indigenous (Zenu) displaced people. Due to extreme poverty, they built the little shack where their 7 member family has been raised. The effects of  climate change now cause periodic floods where the shack stands, leaving them homeless 2 times a year.  Pacho's shack is one of 30.000 and rising, houses in the same situation. Help us teach Pacho and his community how to build a sustainable, repeatable, and resilient housing model.

title: Hands-on science for 3500 underserved kids
description: Science is Elementary brings exciting hands-on science experiments and engineering projects to 3500 low income kids in Silicon Valley. Our students come from families without resources to send them to science camps or even go to museums.  Our program increases knowledge of, and positive attitudes to, science: our students are 45% more likely to want to continue their science studies in middle school (compared to peers) and 50% more likely to want to work in a STEM field.

title: HELP 50 WOMEN FIGHT POVERTY IN NIGERIA
description: Women Cassava Processors in Akinyele Village Nigeria spend 14 hours a day in Cassava processing factory and earn less than $1. All processing are done manually and for less. Their children drop out of school to also work in the factory. With your donation, we will procure automated equipment. They will produce more cassava chain products in less time. Their children will stay longer hours in school. The women will earn more income and gain financial independence. They're counting on you.

title: Plant Clinic for Sustainable Agriculture
description: This project is about to minimize use of agricultural chemicals for people and planet through soil and plant clinic related extension services. Major activities included in the project are plant clinics where the farmers are provided tips, knowledge and skills for disease pest management of crops by use of local materials and plant extract. Reducing chemical use  and enhancing natural use in a proper way for sustainable environment and sustainable agriculture is the major motto of project.

title: Restore  Mateos and Andreas hearing , Guatemala
description: Deafness goes beyond not being able to talk, it prevents children to develop cognitive and social skills. This project aims the provision of cochlear implants, devices with which Mateo will be able to restore hearing and develop his full potential.   The sooner the better; the closer to 1 year of age, the more benefit he will get from them. He needs the surgery in the next few months to give him the chance to hear and speak.

title: The School of our Dreams
description: This project will build the first K-12 bilingual school for the children of Siloe, Cali, Colombia. Its impact will extend to 1000 low-income families within the community. Our school started 7 years ago, with a small house serving 45 primary school students. Today, our student population has grown to 250, surpassing the capacity of our current location. The School of our Dreams will reach out to 1000 students who will have access to quality education to equip them to make their dreams come true.

title: Save Sick, Injured, & Orphaned Birds - California
description: We are building an association of people and resources to assure that birds in our locale that are sick, injured, or orphaned are able to get the care they need in order to survive. We are seeking caretakers, transporters, fosters/adopters, educators, and financial donors. We do not take in protected wildlife species for which state/federal permits are required but rather the "underdogs" of the avian world who have nowhere else to go. Please help us help them and the kindly people who find them.

title: Equip a sickle cell community lab in Cameroon
description: This project, in North West Region, Cameroon, will equip a sickle cell disease laboratory for the early detection of Sickle Cell Disease (SCD), assess and monitor patient blood formation and disorders, thus, saving hundreds of children from painful SCD episodes, related complications and untimely deaths. About 25% of affected new born children die before the age of five (5), undiagnosed, from SCD preventable complications. Help prevent passing on a genetic disorder; relief a child from pain.

title: Credit of goats to 130 young households in DRCongo
description: This project strengthens goat livestock breeding for young households in the villages of SEBELE and KIKONDE in the territory of Fizi, South Kivu Province in the East of the Democratic Republic of Congo. The good practice of goat breeding is one of the sources of important revenue for the peasants of our country. Thus, we will train and then grant the rotational credit of 400 goats to 130 young households in these two villages with four goats per household.

title: Help the Orphans and Vulnerable Children Own Land
description: Long-term impact If a child got access to education, he is more likely   to develop professional and life skills, to get more stable jobs, to meet family's needs and have a steady future.

title: Save Infant Lives with Breast-Feeding Education
description: Breast-feeding can save 1 million infant lives a year. DocImpact uses a film screening & workshop model to reach health-workers in areas with high infant mortality rates. In partnership with local healthcare NGOs, each screening&workshop educates 30 health-workers with a reach of 450 expectant mothers in rural Kenya. Due to the success of the first project and high demand, the scheme is being expanded to ensure each mother is monitored and supported for the first 2 years of the infant's life.

title: Post Earthquake Classroom Furnishing Project
description: This project will furnish 4 classrooms of Lubhu Secondary School of Lalitpur district with new types of multi-piece tables that can be arranged as per need for children working in groups creating learning opportunity for both teachers and students using the new ways of organizing spaces. The book shelves with children's literature at reading corners will increase the reading habits of students making them creative which increase students' enrollment as well as speeds up the quality of education.

title: Kickstarting our Urban Rooftop Garden for Kids
description: Thousands of children on the streets of Manila beg or scavenge just to get something to eat.  Bahay Tuluyan assists these kids get off the street and back into families through holistic programs.   This project will start a rooftop organic garden in Manila where the children can be involved in growing their own food.  Not only will it help the children get good, healthy food to eat, but will also help in greening Manila and enhance the sustainability of Bahay Tuluyan's programs for children.

title: Community Hub for Young Women in Nepal
description: 1 in 5 women are violated at least once in their lifetime in Nepal . A safe public space where women can effectively learn and lead is very critical. The community hub will provide safe co-working space, resources and workshops to strengthen leadership & entrepreneurship to at least 30 young women in Nepal in one year. This space is an opportunity for young women to have access to safe co-working spaces, collaborate with each other, foster their ideas, and strengthen their networks.

title: Help Disadvantaged Children In Hue Vietnam
description: Many disadvantaged Children In Hue Vietnam need our help on all Medication, education and to fight hunger. We identified 55 poor children with really High difficulties. Essentially Farmers, Fathers and Mothers are not able to give correct life to their children. Our Association will ensure that these Children goes to School and have at least 1 real Meal by day and Medication needed, we will also ensure that kids have necessary supplies, and books to follow up education and answer to their needs

title: Access to health for MSM in Homophobic central
description: The project will reach the unreachable Men who have sex with Men.The MSM who Have no access to health services or information on the health rights.We will mobilize and reach more 500 MSM with services by creating a safe space, a stigma free environment, provide behavioral,biomedical and structural interventions.

title: Educational Support For 500 Poor Children
description: There are millions of poor and vulnerable children spread across the streets and slums of North-Central Nigeria. They are victims of prolonged ethnic, religious and other social conflicts.  These children will, naturally, grow into the society and seek to benefit from it. Without an education to help them compete, they have no opportunities. Without those opportunities they are a threat to society. This project intends to take at least 500 of those children off the streets and into school.

title: Fund Jamaican Farmers in Climate-Smart Aquaponics
description: Climate change in Jamaica is forcing small-scale food producers out of business, leading to rising unemployment, poverty and food insecurity. INMED's Financing for Climate-Smart Agriculture program helps resolve this crisis by empowering struggling farmers, women, youth and people with disabilities to start aquaponics (hydroponics/fish farming) enterprises. This program is providing access to financing, aquaponics technology, training, technical assistance and secure markets.

title: Active and Positive Ageing
description: CASMED has determined to create a community for elderly: a place where they can gather and spend time dancing, singing, engaging in healthful activities and simply interacting. CASMED's goal is to build a 40 person DAY CENTER where elderly will benefit from medical services which cannot be brought to their houses, a gym and additional social services.

title: Unspoken Smiles Fellowship
description: The Unspoken Smiles Foundation is addressing the world's issues with oral health through two major programs: an oral hygiene curriculum designed for children in low-income, under-served schools, and, the Unspoken Smiles Fellowship, which trains unemployed women as dental assistants. This program also benefits the economy by giving jobs and enabling people to perform better in their jobs and in school because they will not be suffering from pain due to limited oral care.

title: Haitian Women Small Business Initiatives Project
description: Women and children in Haitian are dying of hunger just because the single mother do not have the mean to get basic food on the table. The Haitian Women Small Business Initiatives is helping women to start their own small business in order for them to be self sufficient. With a small business, these single mothers can and will be able to have the means to feed their family, sent their children to school and help themselves to be some what sustainable. Please help now with small donation.

title: Protecting Tanzanian Women and Girls from Violence
description: In Tanzania, sexual abuse and violence against women and girls are pervasive, and systems fail to hold perpetrators to account. At UZIKWASA, we believe systems only truly change when the individuals who inhabit them change. You can help us work with every leader in Pangani District-every school committee and village council member, every religious leader and village elder-to leverage her/his unique position to protect women and girls, and holistically address and prevent abuse and violence.

title: Day Activity Center for Challenged Young Adults
description: Build an Activity Center for Challenged Young Adults with physical disabilities such as physical handicaps, individuals that are blind, those that suffer from cerebral palsy and muscular dystrophy, individuals with mental health background, patients with Prader-Willi syndrome, intellectual disability, learning disabilities and those with emotional and behavioral challenges. This project will help build a properly equipped center for over 350 weekly participants, to have as their day-time home.

title: Africa Drought and Famine Fund
description: Civil war, drought, and economic instability have led to famine conditions in South Sudan, where nearly 6.5 million people-more than half of the population-face extreme food shortages. Severe drought conditions across the region have also led to food crises in Ethiopia, Kenya, Somalia, and Yemen. This fund will provide emergency funding to international and locally driven relief efforts, providing food, medicine, and other essential supplies to address regional food crises.

title: Help Document the Legacy of a Global Peacebuilder
description: Frank Buchman was a revolutionary thinker and leader whose trust-building, reconciliation and peace efforts have greatly influenced the 20th century. His vision and legacy are a powerful answer to the growing mistrust, injustice & extremism facing the world today. Your donations help IofC International document his life-story and raise awareness of his impactful work. We will also promote the film at major public events and in our peace-building grassroots initiatives in 50+ countries worldwide.

title: Build 5 Playgrounds for Children in Afghanistan
description: This project will fund local people to fabricate, install and maintain 5 playgrounds at schools and orphanages in Afghanistan. There are 13 million kids in Afghanistan and most do not have safe places to play among the ever-present war around them. Every dollar goes directly to building the playgrounds. The impact is immediate! At lease 15,000 kids will have safe places to play and laugh without fear.

title: Fight famine with farming in South Sudan
description: Famine and severe hunger are ravaging South Sudan.  60% of the population is facing hunger. They don't know where their next meal will come from.  We are working to help families in Old Fangak, that are in desperate need of food, start small gardens and farms so that they can feed themselves while increasing the the amount of food available to the community.  This program will teach farming techniques, providing seeds and small tools, and micro loans for water pumps all to fight famine.

title: Cultural Center for Earthquake Victims in Ecuador
description: Help build a Cultural Center in Don Juan, a fishing village struck by Ecuador's 7.8 earthquake.  A seismic resistant building will house a library, computer center and training areas for 1200 villagers left homeless by the quake. We currently gather in a precarious bamboo structure called "the Library."  Children come to do homework, browse encyclopedias and read. For them, the library is interesting, entertaining and provides a safe haven from grim situations caused by the housing emergency

title: Provide WASH libraries and Pads4Girls in Nigeria
description: By investing in girls' health, and literacy education, they are empowered to reach their potentials and build better lives for themselves and their communities. These projects by Hope and Dreams Initiative will boost: school attendance, hygiene and health; literacy education.

title: Education support to 25 underprivileged girls
description: LWSIT's proposed project-GOURI aims at achieving lasting improvements in the quality of life of disadvantaged and marginalized children, their families, and their communities who face abject poverty and injustice, through the protection and promotion of their rights, interests, individualities, independence and dignity. LWSIT recognises that the inmate children are the victims of a difficult childhood and do not deserve their future to be ruined as a result of their past.

title: PEACEFUL PRESIDENTIAL ELECTIONS AND BEYOND 2017
description: Factors and root causes of conflict, triggers to violence and the increased availability of illegal firearms in civilian hands that easily fuel violence continued to pose a major challenge to national peace and stability. To transform these conflicts and their root causes, reduce their triggers to the minimum and consolidate the good governance signposts already gained, all stakeholders, specifically the grass-root focused civil society need to craft common fronts in the areas of legislation

title: Survival of Animal Welfare Charity in Zimbabwe
description: Mutare SPCA is the main provider of animal welfare in the Eastern province of Zimbabwe, home to +/- 1.5 million people. We find ourselves on the brink of closure due to the current economic crisis, at a time when our services for animals are most desperately needed. Our unemployment rate is 90%,  hence our donor base is eroded and exhausted. Our mission is the eradication of animal neglect and abuse through outreach to, and education of, our communities, working largely through schools.

title: Moldova Small Business Assoc. Fights Corruption
description: In FSEA we are raising our collective voices to demand an honest, rules based business environment in Moldova. We are optimists who are bullish about Moldova. One and all we have invested our blood, sweat, dollars and tears here. We desire a level playing field. From corruption to overbearing bureaucracy we fight daily to keep our doors open and our consciences clear. We work to protect and support each other while supporting our shared vision of Moldova. One that is prosperous, fair and free.

title: Build School for 120 Brazilians in the Rainforest
description: The Forest School will be based in the Atlantic Rainforest of Southern Bahia, Brazil, teaching skills to approximately 120 people per year who are interested in working within forest based economy sectors. This education will promote biodiversity conservation and forest restoration, while research fostered through the School will provide lasting contributions to better protecting and understanding this fragile ecosystem.

title: Counselling for 300 children in Romania
description: Te Aud Romania plans to develop a therapy practice, with a specialised team of counsellors available at any point in time to provide counselling to orphans and disadvantaged children with severe emotional trauma. We will develop a system of referral with schools (primary through high school) and with orphanages to identify children who need help the most. Our goal is to provide 300 orphans and disadvantaged children in Romania, Suceava county with in-depth counselling, to help them heal.

title: Safe and Pure Drinking Water and Health Care
description: Drinking water is the BIRTH RIGHT of a living creature on Earth, for the whole universe is for human being, flora and fauna to be equally share, utilize and divide judiciously for their own living and survival. But the "elixir of life" with minimum purity for a good living is denied to many of our own people. But pathetically there are people living even without drinking water!!!..... So this is a unique effort to provide drinking water to 94 needy resource poor families, children......

title: Support Nutrition Intergrated Component
description: Support nutrition integrated components (SNIC) child and mother is a nutrition project implemented by Women's Hope for Change in conjunction with the Ministry of Health that will be implemented in Mchinji District, among 8 selected villages around Mchinji district hospital. The project  seeks to scale up and improve nutrition status among women and children through application of nutrition-specific interventions such as support for breastfeeding, fortification of foods, vitamin and mineral suppl

title: Educating orphans & the disadvantaged in Kenya
description: Roko 20 Academy is a primary school providing a free education for AIDs orphans and the very poor many of whom are excluded from school because of fees.  Roko 20 provides children with a free education, clothes, food and basic healthcare.    Roko 20 also assists families out of poverty with small income generating projects to raise hope and provide an income.   Elderly grandmothers are left to raise orphaned grandchildren without support

title: College Experience for 30 Students w/Disabilities
description: For the millions of young adults living with intellectual disabilities, there are very few opportunities for continued learning, growth and interaction with peers after the completion of secondary school. This project seeks to change that, by providing students with disabilities such as autism and Down syndrome with the opportunity to attend an adaptive college program and to learn to live independently.

title: Medi-App, Detecting Child Abuse When It Occurs
description: Child abuse is rampant in South Africa, with statistics like 1 in 3 children being abused before the age of 12, TEARS Foundation has developed software which enables medical professionals to track &record suspected abuse of children. This software, uses machine learning to detect children who are being abused on the 2nd or 3rd time being admitted to medical facilities for assistance, thus enabling the medical professionals to report cases, leading to more successful convictions!

title: hunger-childrens-55-feeding-education-in-india
description: Here in India Poor and down-trodden people for them to uplift in the villages and slum areas and make them to be reliant by themselves.  At present 55 Children in our care whose age group of 5-21 years, we gave them admission into our Children's Home and providing food, clothes, medical, sheltering and education etc if you train up in occasional to be self-reliant.  For that purpose we beg the Donors to send funds to meet all these essential needs in our Children Home, Maruteru, Andhra Pradesh.

title: Educate 150 Girls in Tech,Engineering & Maths STEM
description: The project aims to increase and support the participation of 150 disadvantaged girls in South Africa in the fields of science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM). Measures will be taken to address the disparities between male & female students studying STEM based program by providing incentives & mentorship programs to women. The participation of girls in STEM fields is essential, but unfortunately throughout history, female participation has been consistently lower than that of men

title: Help Conrad Lewis Give Vision to Thousands
description: Millions of people live with low vision.  I know this and founded eSight (www.esighteyewear.com) and a charitable foundation to assist low vision people. We have the technology to restore vision. I believe that no one should live without sight and that's why I am asking you to help the Lewis Vision Improvement Foundation to help low vision people access the tools and technology that can give them back their precious sight.

title: Reaching the most marginalized girls in Benin
description: Despite good intentions, many programs fail to reach the girls most in need. Batonga goes beyond the paved road to reach Benin's most excluded girls by surveying communities one by one and collecting granular data to clearly identify the girls most in need. Next, our program equips them with the assets and experience they need to make a living, to become more resilient to stress, and provide opportunities for the next generation- we are truly breaking intergenerational cycles of poverty!

title: Educate 50 high school students from Rwanda
description: This project will support talented poor girls and boys who have or are at a high risk of high school drop out due to poverty related issues. AOG fellows are grateful youth who have been helped by family, friends, and charity organizations (especially during their studies) and aspire to pay it forward. Since 2011, Acts Of Gratitude (AOG) supported 15 students.  AOG pays for their school fees and equip them with important life skills trainings. AOG has a goal of offering 50 scholarships annually.

title: UPCYCLING HANDMADE PRODUCTS BY 100 KENYAN ARTISANS
description: This project aims at reducing the effects of water hyacinth weed that has invaded Lake Victoria (Kenya) making fishing and water navigation impossible thereby affecting the livelihoods of families which depend on the lake. We aim to utilize the water hyacinth weeds to make functional products which we shall sell and in the process create employment for 100 artisans at the shores of Lake Victoria.

title: Build Maternity Center for 5 Villages in Nigeria
description: This project will build a maternity health center facility in 10 villages in Nigeria, to help improve access to health care services for more than 3000 women. This will reduce the incidence of maternal and child mortality and morbidity, low quality antenatal and post-natal care. To support special health related activities and preventive programs such as literacy training for female, sanitation and nutritional needs of pregnant women.

title: No More Invisible Girls: Confronting Trafficking
description: La Pampa is a place of illegal mining located in Madre de Dios, in the jungle of Peru. Around 3,000 children (mostly girls) are taken there for trafficking in reference to sexual and labor exploitation.  PROMSEX is promoting a Community Center, so the community, Civil Society organizations and States Institutions can provide Care Services to victims of trafficking and through this strategy trying to rescue them; considering that service providers can go into areas with difficult access.

title: Mon Valley Circles - Circles Out Of Poverty
description: Mon Valley Circles, Inc's mission is to serve impoverished individuals and families in the Mon Valley region of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania by assisting them in gaining self-sufficiency. As our name implies, the core of Mon Valley services is the circle. Circle Leaders (of lower income) are matched with 2-3 Circle Allies (of middle or upper income). Allies provide emotional and relational support to Leaders as they seek to make their transition to self-sufficiency.

title: Water and Sanitation
description: We plan to eliminate rampant diseases caused by contaminated water and poor hygiene in poor and deserving  remote villages in the Upper East region of Ghana, where open defecation is common. We will do this by ensuring communities have safe water and sanitation. We have started conducting awareness raising sessions with the local community about hygiene.

title: Philippine Medical Outreach 2017 for 2000 patients
description: In 2016, One World Institute's project in the Philippines performed more than 150 surgeries for cleft palate/lip and cataracts.  We also gave free eyeglasses to more than 2,000 patients.  We went to remote areas and examined  2,000 patients and gave free medicines to many.  We gave the Manyang People sacks of rice, children's books, slippers, warm shirts,etc.  In 2017 we will do a similar project in Mindanao, and need funds. We support a child cancer hospital. We have been doing this sinc

title: Screening & Awareness of Colon Cancer
description: The Colon Cancer Coalition mission is to reduce colon cancer deaths through early screening.   1 in 19 people will be diagnosed with colon cancer which is the nation's 2nd leading cause of cancer deaths.

title: Provide Housing & Jobs for 6 Women Leaving Prison
description: Benevolence residential reentry program supports women leaving the North Carolina prison system by offering housing, employment, career development, and agricultural skill building.  This farm-based social enterprise combines the health and healing of nature with the critical resources and knowledge needed for success. Participants grow their own food and generate income through harvest sales, building transferable skills in marketing, finance, customer relations and small business management.

title: One Health in the Argan Forest
description: This project is improving the health of Amazigh families and of their unique ecosystem : the argan forest. It is using a One Health approach linking up the health of people, the health of animals and the health of the environment. Amazigh families are the traditional custodians of the endemic argan forest which represents the last shield against desertification. Your support will reduce health risks emerging from a degraded ecosystem and help protect vital biodiversity.

title: Help Family Learning Centre at Gbawe in Ghana open
description: This project is premised upon a firm belief that that education is the key to upward mobility. The family learning project is an ongoing project initiated by the PAAJAF foundation to address the different educational challenges faced by the Gbawe community. This is phase two of the Family Learning Centre project to benefit 120 pre-school students, 15 primary school students and 10 adults through adult literacy education.

title: Help Us Keep Our Community Library open in Codito!
description: This program aims to contribute to the strengthening of skills and abilities in boys and girls through the new "learn to play" education and the use of their free time.  Activities:  Accompaniment in the construction and development of the children's life project  Advising on tasks  Workshops in construction, appropriation and practice of values  Reading and writing workshops  Strengthening workshops for parents and caregivers  Prevention workshops

title: Proper Nutrition for 10 families with Huntington's
description: Huntington's is a neurodegenerative disease that disproportionately affects vulnerable families on the Colombian Caribean Coast. With this campaign, we will provide nutritionally optimal meals to 10 families affected by the disease in very rural areas, in addition to medical, educational, and social support. Our goal is to first meet the immediate needs of these families and then work to help with education access for the children and secure flexible income generation means for the families.

title: PARTI Youth Service
description: The P.A.R.T.I. Program is a youth leadership program that organizes youth events in order to change lives and conditions in social economic disenfranchised communities.

title: Spay/Neuter Surgery Training in Veracruz, Mexico
description: McKee's recent experience offered a chance to gain in-situ knowledge of the situation of dog population management in Mexico. We plan to implement a High Volume/Low Impact Spay and Neuter, and Community Outreach program in Veracruz, where rabies currently remains an important public health concern and government-run shelters still trap and kill large numbers of dogs each year.

title: complete building for 70 stigmatised autistic kids
description: This project gives disadvantaged and stigmatised children and young persons with autism access to a facility for education.  There their potential can be nurtured and their lives made worthwhile with different interventions.

title: Support for SDA School Pupils in ICT
description: Ghana Code Club came to life through the activities of HCI. Our organization's goal is to equip every elementary school going child with basic coding literacy  skills. The Code Club kids from Nii Boye Town SDA School in a suburb of Accra are a team of very determined kids who won the best award during our maiden coding competition in Feb 2016. The kids from this School are among many in Ghana that lack the basic Computer Lab infrastructure and GCC seeks to provide a mobile computer lab for them.

title: East Africa Food Crisis
description: Right now, over 20 million people across East Africa are in urgent need of food. ActionAid's local staff in Ethiopia, Kenya and Somaliland are delivering life-saving supplies, such as food and water to those worst affected by the crisis, and are planning to scale up our response. We have decades of experience responding to emergencies - providing immediate relief as well as rebuilding for the long term.

title: Reading Families
description: In Bolivia most poor families have no access to books nor reading activities. Thus we look to provide them with substantial books related to their culture and needs their younglings have. We would focus primarily on people from poor regions. Thuruchapitas teachers would visit their neighborhoods once a week during 8 months to share readings and life experiences in order to motivate them to read. All of this reinforces with family gatherings between all the program's families.

title: Canteens4Kids! Providing Eco-Friendly Alternatives
description: In conjunction with our Responsible Schools: Environmental Education Program, this project will provide 8,000 STUDENTS in low-income California school districts with their very own reusable stainless-steel canteen, giving all children equal access to be part of the solution to disposable plastic pollution. We will fund the installation of eco-friendly, filtered, bottle-refill stations in 6 SCHOOLS,  encouraging students to make wholesome choices for their health and the environment.

title: Sensitize 15000 children to reduce salt in India
description: What is your daily eating schedule? A morning cup of Coffee. You are either late or lazy hence binge eat on a packet of chips on your way to Work. During lunch,your taste buds crave for that extra tablespoon of salt, they say Follow your heart&you do it!!  When you come home you practically eat anything served!! Some of this is imbibed in our daily schedule. How without even realising SALT,the invisible killer,penetrates in our daily lifestyle leading to several health related problems.

title: Help Enroll 100 Girls to Schools in Rural Pakistan
description: Gender based disparity in access to education is particularly prevalent in low socio-economic rural settings of rural Pakistan. ORDER plans to enroll 100 girls to elementary schools in secluded and neglected mountainous locations in northern Pakistan by providing them books, uniform, and meals.

title: 1 Bed 1 Life: The Gift of Addiction Recovery - US
description: 10,000 Beds coordinates addiction treatment scholarships for addicts who desperately need and want help but are completely without resources. Our application process is rigorous and serves as a screening and placement process that most treatment programs do not have the resources to conduct for scholarship awardees. 10,000 Beds provides a dual service: 1) by helping addicts find the right treatment and 2) by helping treatment centers scholarship their empty beds with the right candidates.

title: Educate a Child Affected by Prostitution in Uganda
description: HSG Uganda will educate children affected by prostitution and human trafficking in the brothels and slums of Kampala, Uganda.  The project will enroll at least 10 children per year into schools, provide  school fees, scholastic materials and psycho-social support to children born through prostitution and other forms of sexual exploitation.   Potential beneficiaries have been already identified pending the availability of resources.

title: Engage 40 Children Living with HIV in Nepal
description: In this project, SPARSHA Nepal (run by People Living with HIV and friends) aims to provide computer literacy classes and art therapy for 40 Children Living with HIV (CLHIV) from Kathmandu for 3 months. It plans to provide opportunities to CLHIV as every other child deserves. It aims to enhance their self-esteem, creativity, reduce stigma of society and provide psycho-social help, boost confidence in one's worth so they can develop ability to face competitive environment and have a secure life.

title: Changing Urban Lives Through Food Forests
description: This project seeks to create a Urban Food Forest Greenbelt in Katlehong, Johannesburg South Africa. Rushed planning to address inequitable housing policies have left many South African townships with houses but little or no nature, trees, biodiversity or greenery. We want to change that and make sure that children grow up in a landscape with trees and communities are able to live in a healthy, resilient, beautiful environment.

title: DofE adventurous journey for young offenders
description: This project aims to support the personal development of 20 young offenders who are part of the Duke of Edinburgh's international Award and are developing life and leadership skills with the support of dedicated personal mentors. This is the final stage of their program and it will provide them the opportunity to plan, practice and execute an unforgettable adventures journey in the nature. This experience will build skills like teamwork, orientation composure and inspire their adventures spirit.

title: Create Employment for 100 Youths in Nigeria
description: CVL Young Entrepreneurship Training Progamme (YETP) is a One-Year Project aimed at providing Technical Skills Training; Entrepreneurial and Micro-enterprise development for 100 youths in Makoko Area of Lagos State, Nigeria. The programme will involve assistance to all participants to start their own businesses. We believe that if the youths are gainfully employed, the problems of kidnapping, armed robbery, human trafficking, cultism and political thuggery in the area will be minimally reduced.

title: Completion of 4 Classrooms for 120 Children
description: A plan to complete 4 classrooms for 120 children of families living with HIV is intended to provide basic education. This is done through  identifying  beneficiaries, employing teachers,  providing scholastic materials, providing  food and constructing a learning space

title: Provide Medicine and Feed 10000 IDPs in NE Nigeria
description: Ohaha Family Foundation will provide mobile healthcare services and food assistance to an estimated 10,000 migrants and internally displaced persons (IDPs) of the 7 million people urgently in need of food and livelihoods assistance in North East (NE) Nigeria affected by Boko Haram conflict that killed over 20,000 people, countless women and girls abducted and children drafted as suicide bombers since 2009. 80% of NE Nigeria considered high risk for international humanitarian actors

title: Special Education Centre for 30 Indian Children
description: Icha Foundation is a home for 15 abandoned children with significant physical and mental disabilities. We offer therapeutic learning and  we wish to establish a vocational centre on our campus to enhance their abilities by promoting different methods: audio-visual aids, arts and crafts, and other didactic materials. Additionally, we have identified another 15 children located in the villages surrounding our campus with similar disabilities.

title: Stop Famine in South Sudan
description: Helping end starvation and child mortality of women and children escaping war from South Sudan. Women and children are suffering from malnutrition due to scarcity of food and lack of water services in the Ugandan refugee camps. Reports of rape, killing, abuses and false imprisonment of many civilians has triggered mass exodus of refugees from Kajo-Keji seeking for shelter in neighboring camps in Uganda.

title: support 3500 hiv/aids affected people  south sudan
description: The project intends to provide HIV/AIDS services to 3500 key populations, preferably female sex workers and their clients through Health counseling and Testing (HCT), Psychosocial support and referrals to health facilities. It also intends to support 10 adolescent girls who are engaged in commercial sex to undergo vocational training.The project will be in three counties of south sudan namely, Wau, Torit and Kaya .

title: Mobile App to Report Child Abuse
description: Children may experience cyberbullying, grooming, sexual abuse, sexual exploitation or even emotional abuse online. The worse thing is that the abuse in such cases can come into safe spaces as their bedrooms. Images, videos, chats are stored and the abusers mainly tend to threaten children by sharing them with their close family members or friends. The mobile application will allow children to report abuse enabling both police and himaya to respond faster and better to the reported cases.

title: Provide Safe Shelter for Families in the Mid-South
description: It's hard to leave an abusive relationship.  By providing housing, along with wrap around services and psychosocial supports, we can nurture at-risk youth, parents, and families. There are over 20,000 families in abusive relationships here in the Mid-South. A week ago, 2 murder suicides occurred in Memphis.  Had those 2 women had a safe place to escape, perhaps their children would not be orphaned. Help us reach a $60,000 goal to provide a year of safe housing to 2 Mid-South families.

title: Access to maternal care for 500 villagers in kenya
description: This project will increase access to quality maternal and new-born heath services by; i) Increase demand for quality maternal and new born services. ii) Strengthening the health systems to manage and deliver quality maternal and new born health services

title: Provide Early-Childhood Care to 250 Children
description: With this project Little Rock plans to provide early childhood care, learning and school based occupation therapy  to 250 vulnerable and special need children living in Nairobi's  urban slums.

title: Promoting Nutrition for 500 Children in Gaza KGs
description: The objective of the project is to support KGs with healthy meals for 500 children in marginalized area in Gaza strip. We will provide nutritious meals at KGs three times a week during the fall (September - November) 2017 school semester. The project simultaneously provides training in food production for 25 women heads of household, employing 3 female fresh graduate as health promoters to raise awareness about child's nutrition.

title: Transforming Maternal & Child Health in Myanmar
description: This year, the project will provide training in life-saving midwifery skills to Traditional Birth Attendants (TBAs) in 24 remote villages in western Myanmar through a team of local trainers which has been developed over the last 2 years of the project. This will provide support to a further 180 women each year in pregnancy and childbirth and will facilitate a sustainable change in knowledge, attitude and practice surrounding maternal and neonatal care in rural Chin State, Myanmar.

title: Build a School Gym and Community Hall in Hungary
description: We seek your help to build a gym, a modern place for 400+ students to engage in physical education. It will also serve as a much-needed community hall for enlivening the cultural and social life of our town. We've raised 80% of the funds for the gym. We are seeking support for the remaining 20%. This is our first step toward building a campus for our non-profit school that has been providing quality education for 23 years for 12 grades in Hungary. Constructions have started in April 2017!

title: Help 60 diverse young people to become UK leaders
description: "The world is in urgent need of a new generation of diverse leaders who bring a diversity of experience and approach to craft innovative solutions for the many problems faced by society." Ken Olisa OBE -Chair, Powerlist Foundation/Lord Lieutenant for Greater London. This project will provide significant lifetime opportunities for young people with the main focus of identifying and developing leaders for the future; equipping them with a strong sense of ambition, drive and confidence to achieve.

title: Let's help farmers in Drought Affected areas
description: Around 900 farmer suicides were reported in the eight districts of Marathwada region of Maharashtra State India, between January and October last year. Farmer suicides are not just due to crop failure or mounting debts, "There are several factors behind their suicide. It could be family pressure or illness, We started with helping the families of farmers who are drought affected since 2015. This help was initially at a personal level. The help package included a rice and wheat 5/kg and 10/kg etc

title: A new book for 14,300 children in Mitchells Plain
description: Many children in Mitchells Plain in South Africa have never owned a book before. We believe that book ownership can ignite a love for reading. Children who love to read, will excel at school and go on to become constructive members of society. It all starts with reading!

title: Empowering Bangle Girls
description: Thousand of teenage girls deprive their education  makeing  glass bangles at their home to contribute earning bread for their families in Hyderabad which is  notable for handmade glass bangles in the world yet 80 % of the total work force is women & girls. Poverty, non-availability of education & hazardous working condition for little girls are the major issues. This project will change the life of 1000 girls (6-20 Ages) by providing them education to live their life without risks & child labor

title: Protection of 3,000 street children in mine in DRC
description: There are more vulnerable children who suffer in the congolese mines and the street because they lack enough to survive, their incersion can prevent their good future.

title: Help Mongolian Single Moms Escape Trash Salvaging
description: This project will setup of a charity shop and train 6 single mothers and 1 person with disabilities so they can earn a sustainable income to support their families. This will allow them and their children to stop salvaging trash. A portion of the revenue will be placed in a joint fund for the children's schooling and to provide support for 400 community members. After six months, this project will be scaled up, building additional stores, forming a cooperative and impacting 1,000 people.

title: Support 100 Girls In Barbados
description: 1 in 3 girls in Barbados are exposed to bullying, domestic abuse, sexual abuse and violence, in many forms. This project will provide non-traditional training, mentorship, and expose 100 girls aged 5 - 18, to first time experiences (STEM Careers), while also providing free meals and school supplies. The aim is to empower those 'at risk', and coming from the poorest communities in Barbados, to become active female leaders that give back to their country under our philosophy 'Reach One Teach One'.

title: Build a New Future for 33 Children in Paraguay
description: We give a concrete response of protection through foster families to 33 Paraguayan children - legally separated from their families, due to a situation of maltreatment, extreme poverty, sexual abuse. Through a foster care, children have the possibility to grow up in a family until their social and legal situation is solved, avoiding the institutionalization and respecting their basic human right to live in an environment that promotes their Integral Development.

title: Help  Victims of Military Conflict in Ukraine
description: Medical support to victims of military conflict in the East of Ukraine when they cross the fire line to buy food, medicine and regain access to social links and services.

title: Provide Dental Care to 18000 students in India
description: Oral diseases qualify as a major public health problems owing to their high prevalence and incidence. In India, children form about 38% to 40% of the total population, and 80% of them have high levels of dental diseases. School dental screening is seen as a vehicle for bringing children with dental needs in contact with dental services. Dental screening of school children can help disadvantaged children by identifying their dental problems and educating them about their oral health status.

title: Help 200 of Uganda's Most Vulnerable Children
description: This nursery project will prepare 3-5 year old children in rural Uganda for school, so that they do not fail or drop out into a life of poverty. Currently, 80% of rural children drop out of school by the age of 12 because they haven't learnt to read or write. We will train their teachers, in 6 government nurseries. This will empower them with the skills, tools and knowledge to ensure all children are equipped to succeed and progress throughout school.

title: Digital System to Professionalize 400 Artists
description: This project will provide a point of sale electronic system at the African Art Centre in South Africa to ensure accurate sales of African art for 400 artists and crafters from disadvantaged communities.

title: Turn around the lives of 30 vulnerable young girls
description: The girls we work with in our Love4Life project feel trapped in a cycle of personal social and educational failure, becoming completely disengaged with education, family and opportunity. Through our after school clubs, they find the strength and confidence to take increased responsibility for their lifestyle choices and futures - including improved education and life skills. We have a waiting list of 30 girls and need to start a new club.

title: Support Literacy for Brazilian Children
description: This project aims to provide pedagogical materials for students and teachers to ensure adequate literacy for children in Brazil.

title: Scholarship Fund of Alexandria Scholarships
description: Established in 1986,  Scholarship Fund of Alexandria is a nonprofit 501(c)(3) organization providing need-based scholarships to Alexandria City Public School Students who come from diverse socioeconomic backgrounds.  Each year we award $1 million in scholarships to more than 300 bright students who may not otherwise have the ability to attend college -- many of them the firs generation in their family to attend college. Ninety-three cents of every dollar we raise directly supports scholarships.

title: Palace of Culture at Newlyn Art Gallery
description: For 4 weeks Newlyn Art Gallery will be transformed into a Palace of Culture created by young people for young people (15 - 25).  Different Cultural Secretaries across the arts will programme inspiring, eclectic activity to the gallery audience for free, all of every day, and aim to bring in those who wouldn't otherwise engage in art. The model offers much in terms of creative development for young artists to grow in confidence and responsibility, and in growing young participating audiences.

title: Help 650 At-Risk Children in Mexico Stay in School
description: Provide quality Social, Financial and Entrepreneurship Education for 650 disadvantaged kids in Mexico whose parents cannot afford these service otherwise. (These children are students in the states of Mexico City, State of Mexico, Chiapas, Michoacan and Queretaro)

title: Skilled and Educated Children for Better Bosnia
description: We have developed an online platform STEM.BA that serves as a free, educational hub in the areas of science, technology, robotics, programming, and engineering, to enable children in B&H to access the best available educational materials in their own language. Educational materials include translation of world-class videos, lectures, courses, tutorials, fun and science games, and experiments, as well as educational materials produced by B&H students, schools and experts.

title: Amplifying voices on the migrant trail to Europe
description: No one is more qualified to evaluate and shape the provision of humanitarian assistance than those who receive it. This project aims to enhance the voices of displaced people, improve the quality and relevance of the services they receive based on their most urgent needs, and empower them to exercise agency over their own lives. Donations to this project will inform humanitarian workers about people's needs and aspirations, making the migrant trails safer for people at each stage of the journey.

title: Resilience Academy Mental Health Classes for Teens
description: The Resilience Academy is an evidence-based training programme to build resilience and coping skills for young people. These necessary resilience and coping skills are often expected but rarely taught. This programme is designed to provide students with the information, strategies, and resources that they will use through their school careers and beyond, to cope with stressors in a positive and constructive way.

title: Toilets and Drinking Water for 398 School Children
description: In 2015, two of our rural primary schools had no toilet on the school ground. School children had to go the bushes to use the toilet. Unable to raise enough to build new pit latrines, we repaired the old one while we were waiting for grants. Recently, the latrine collapsed due to heavy rain; leaving over 200 school children without any toilet again. Now, our fear is the likelihood of the other school's latrine to collapse very soon.

title: Classrooms for E. Baltimore After-school Programs
description: This project will create classrooms and studio space for after-school and summer programs by renovating an abandoned row home in East Baltimore.  This part of Baltimore is lacking in educational services,  and suffers heavy urban blight.  Capoeira classes and after-school subject reinforcement will be offered in this space.  Capoeira is a martial art that combines music, language, culture, and movement which helps build confidence and engages multiple parts of the brain

title: Give Every Child the Right to Clean Drinking Water
description: Water in Kawempe division is contaminated with sewage because it is in a low laying area with no clear swearge system.  Drinking of unsafe and unclean water is common  The disease burden of water borne  diseases is very high health effects are high and the impact of drining unsafe water on Education is well documented and the cost of not having clean water is deverstated. We are helping communities in the Peri urban slums of Kawempe. Use of Solar wave  water purification system,  reduced cost.

title: East Africa Hunger Crisis: Concern's Response
description: Famine has been officially declared in South Sudan, and drought conditions throughout the region have also led to food crises in Ethiopia, Kenya, and Somalia where 19.5 million people face severe food insecurity. Concern Worldwide is one of few NGOs in the hardest to reach areas in the region. Our experienced team is currently reaching 1.8 million people through life-saving cash transfers, improved access to clean water, treatment of malnourished children, and preventative health and nutrition.

title: Help Serve A Village build a library in Kenya!
description: We at Serve A Village are working to build a permanent library & community centre in Vihiga, Kenya which will be called The Kigima Resource Centre. With the mission to create a functionally literate & informed society through reading & listening; developing self-reliance & creating harmony & unity among the community. Being the only free library in the county it will serve 9+ elementary schools, 3+ high schools & 1 technical school (hundreds of children and youth) all within a 30 minute walk.

title: Change 30 Lives through Music in West Adams
description: This project will help build an instrument library for students in the underserved community of West Adams in Los Angeles.  Students want to learn to play the violin and piano, but many need assistance with purchasing method books, tuition costs, and even an instrument to participate!  All children deserve the opportunity to learn music, and The Blue Violin Foundation is committed to making the arts accessible to all communities!  We strive to close the gap of exposure to classical music.

title: Equiping a Centre for 8,000 Women in Nairobi
description: The project will provide a safe space and support for  8,000 female sex workers and bar hostesses in Nairobi as part of health services offered by Bar Hostess Empowerment and Support Programme (BHESP). These women who are mostly single mothers face violence and stigma. We will provide couches, computers, dryers and other beauty equipment's for their comfort and learning. Other services like HIV prevention and care will be better received.

title: BRIDGE - Give Disadvantaged Kids a Chance, Hungary
description: Our foundation, like a well built bridge is trying to help the kids to be able to run their life which is especially convoluted for them. Within the project there are more smaller goals, like the bridge building blocks, all contribute to make the whole structure strong and stable. The children need to have a strong support to overcome obstacles. A) BRIDGE between the children and their families B) BRIDGE between children and society C) BRIDGE between the present and the future of children

title: CASA of Contra Costa County (CA) Expansion Program
description: Foster children  with a CASA volunteer have much better outcomes than those without one. Only 48% of foster youth overall graduate from high school or earn a GED. However, in the last two years, 100% of our CASA youth earned a high school diploma or GED or were still in school. Only 10% of foster youth attend college,but  last year 67% of our youth with a GED or high school diploma were in college. With these outcomes we must serve more children and we aim to serve 40 additional youth this year.

title: Build 100 Ducks a Home!
description: All Species Kinship (A.S.K.) is south central Michigan's only large scale abandoned waterfowl Sanctuary! Ducks and geese get thrown out after Easter, or after Spring duckling sales, left to fend for themselves at city parks and along roadsides. Helpless, these birds are confused, and often injured or ailing when rescued.

title: Fund a Childrens Hospital
description: There are children in hospitals, without clean sheets, in dire need of our help. Support this cause to bring smiles to their faces and ours.

title: Drinking Water Hand Pumps in Needy Areas in India
description: The Project provides safe drinking water for poor and needy people in hot summer. More than 72,500 people in 100 communities will be benefited through drinking water will be benefited through sanitation and Hygiene in drought hit areas in Andhra Pradesh, India. Our Project beneficiaries belong to Backward Class, Scheduled Caste and Tribal communities who are poor and marginalized. The Project is aligned with sanitation and hygiene. The community people will get awareness on sanitation.

title: Resettle 200 Karamajong Women and Children.
description: This project will  provide an integrated resettlement scheme that will remove 200 karamajong women and children currently living and begging on the streets of Kampala city , skill them in custom-tailored income generating activities, provide the beneficiaries with inputs and help them market their products.  The impact of this project will be to provide an alternative and viable means of a sustainable income for a better and dignified livelihood for the karamajong people  and their children.

title: Holidays from Cancer - Where Children Can Relax!
description: From many conversations with families, affected children, parents' associations and our own experiences, we have noticed how gladly the families wanted to "just go out" in treatment pauses, or after the end of the therapy, perceive air changes, away from everyday life from the clinic . We have taken up this idea and created a user network of parents' associations all over Germany. The small complex for 3-4 families is located at the Bernsteinsee "in Stuede / Germany.

title: Support 2000 Students in Cambodia
description: In Cambodia, government funding for schools is limited and it is up to the community to resource school improvements such as: toilet block construction, libraries,  dorms for teachers and students,  desks and whiteboards.  Many students also require support for their education such as bicycles, and school supplies.  Our program lets communities  take ownership of their school improvement priorities.  This project funds the efforts of secondary schools in Siem Reap impacting 2000 students.

title: Education is our Way for Peace and Democracy
description: This project will help victims of war in Sudan. The problems faced are that there are 3 million children out of schools, public expenditure on services decreased so much recently. To Leave no one behind, our organization Asmaa will try to help in filling this gap by helping illiterate women and girls, children drop outs, and youth to find education and life skills as literacy, bridge schools and vocational training. Education will be accompanied by improving understanding of peace and democracy

title: Early Education for 25 Children in Brazil
description: Provide access to child education for 25 children from zero to 3 years and 11 months who were not provided with public school access and who are in vulnerable social position. Parents of the beneficiary children will receive training so that they can take responsibility for the education of their children at home, properly manage their resources and live in society.

title: Restore hearts in Aleppo
description: The people of Aleppo, Syria have suffered great trauma, horrific events and tremendous loss.   Most have fled to nearby villages and towns, some fled to the countries surrounding Syria.  Many are simply waiting for the freedom to return and rebuild their lives in their home city.  Now is that time.  But, they need your encouragement and partnership to succeed.  GHNI has teams on the ground already in place, trained and equipped to begin.  Will you help make Aleppo safe for families again?

title: Care for moms to be and newborns in Haiti
description: We want you to help us honor haitian mothers by supporting a project that will help new moms and moms to be in Croix de Bouquets and Cite du Soleil -Haiti. With your donation we will provide medical care early in pregnancy, healthcare information, nutrition education to 6.500 low - income pregnancy and postpartum Haitian women who do not receive any other medical care.

title: Sponsor London Rhythmic Competition for Kids
description: "Life is a succession of moments, to live each one is to succeed" - C.Kent. Please help rhythmic gymnasts to have an opportunity to compete at  International Rhythmic Gymnastics Competition - London Spring Cup 2018.

title: Quality Education and Health for Girls in Uganda
description: This project will increase access, retention and quality education for girls in primary schools in Dokolo district through providing school fees, scholastic materials, provision of sanitary pads, and medical treatment for HIV affected children.

title: Adopt free treatment -1000 Hepatitis C Patients
description: This project will prevent disability and in most cases save lives of the poorest, marginalized section of the society suffering from Hepatitis C in hard to reach areas of Pakistan . They have no access to basic health care and no finances to support treatment/cure  from this debilitating and often fatal disease.

title: Ranger Challenge Marathon at Chiquibul Belize
description: Ya'axche Conservation Trust's arsenal of rangers are one of the best trained nature protectors in Belize. These highly skilled rangers directly protect over 151,000-acres of forests in southern Belize. Their passion for keeping the integrity of Belize's natural resources is beyond this world. Two of our rangers have been called-out to run 20K in the first ever Chiquibul Challenge Marathon. The marathon aims to raise awareness on beauty and threats of protected areas and to celebrate fitness.

title: Urban Slum Health Action (USHA) Project
description: As per the latest report more than 50% of women and children in India have anemia and malnutrition.  The goal is to detect, treat, and prevent anemic & malnutrition condition among mother & children. This will reduce Infant Mortality Rate (IMR) & Maternal Morbidity Rate (MMR). The project aims to provide basic health care services through regular checkups for pregnancy, ANC & PNC, vaccination, medicines, counseling, timely immunizations, nutrition for mothers, infants & young children.

title: STEM Education in Botswana: Girls Getting Geeky
description: Stepping Stones International plans to offer STEM education to orphaned and vulnerable girls ages 12-25 through our partnership with Design Squad Global.  This project will allow us to expand STEM activities to all five centers and will provide a meal for all participants.

title: Make Sure 500 Kids Can Enjoy Sport
description: This project makes sure that children who grow up in poverty can enjoy the same activities as children who don't grow up in poverty.  It ensures that children are not excluded.     Improvement in these habitats 1. Increasing the confidence of children, sports also lowers the level of stress. Stress is a common problem among children growing up in poverty 2. Coming into contact with peers.  3. The risk of obesity decreases

title: Trust and Truth in Media Fund
description: We are launching our 35th anniversary appeal to enable us to nimbly and quickly respond with the most creative solutions to threats to trusted, independent media worldwide.  Many of us share a growing concern that we are entering a "post truth" reality where trust in traditional media and civic institutions is at an all-time low whilst propaganda, disinformation, hate speech, rumour and misinformation thrive. Your support can change that.

title: Response to  Sudanese Refugee influx into Uganda
description: Uganda has received over 1 Million South Sudan refugees in need of humanitarian assistance.  Since August 201, on average there are 420 South Sudan refugee arriving into Uganda daily. CARE has reached 60,082 beneficiaries so far through Maternal Health, WASH, GBV, livelihoods and Shelter programmes in Rhino camp settlement, one of the main refugee settlement in  West Uganda.

title: Support Empowerment for Women in Pakistan
description: Women's Empowerment Programme (WEP) is working to empower women in disparaged communities of rural Sindh Pakistan through sharing with them the importance of education and motivating them to send their daughters to school. WEP further provides these women with training, Adult literacy education, and loans to start small businesses that enables them to bring change in their own personal life as well as in their community.

title: Quality Education for 5,200 Brazilian Children
description: This Project will offer twice monthly sessions of Story telling, puppet theatre and reading mediation to 5,200 elementary school children to improve the quality of their education. It will be delivered by 20 specially trained local high school children.

title: Teach 500 Schools about Neurofibromatosis
description: The Neuro Foundation believes that children with NF have no lesser potential than those who do not, but caring for a child with NF is sometimes complex, and there can be a multitude of extra considerations to take into account. We want to provide schools with information packs and connect them to support networks to enable educators to provide the quality of education and care that will give children with NF the start in life that they deserve.  Together, we can stand up for those children.

title: Continue Guatemalan afterschool project - 60 kids
description: In this neighborhood, drug, violence and alcohol are prevalent.  The afterschool project wants to continue to safeguard up to 60 children.  It ensures their developmental and educational needs are met through play, creative handicrafts, cooking workshops and participating in sports and dance. Aged between 5 and 14, most come from one parent families and often have to fend for themselves after attending primary school in the morning. Therefore, Caras Alegres is invaluable to the community.
