description: This is a special scholarship campaign for donors to invest directly in Atlas Corps Fellows from Asia or Europe. Donations made to this campaign will support Fellow stipends, health insurance, plane tickets, training costs, and end of service awards for Fellows from these regions.   While you may donate once (of course!), we ask that you become a monthly donor to this campaign and to get to know the leaders over the course of the year from Asia or Europe.

title: Atlas Corps Latin America
description: Celebrate #diversityandinclusion! This project is a special scholarship campaign for donors to invest directly in Atlas Corps Fellows from Latin America and the Caribbean. Donations made to this campaign will support Fellow from Latin America. While you may donate once (of course!), we ask that you become a monthly donor and to get to know the leaders over the course of the year from Latin America and the Caribbean.

title: Help Feed 250 Hungry Children in Kenya
description: We have been working with a local Primary School in Mombassa since 2010. The school has grown from its humble beginnings as a care centre to a fully-fledged school. As the centre grew and developed, this project has helped to cater to its diverse and ever-changing needs. With 14.5 million individuals facing a food crisis, this project is a start to alleviating their struggles. Funds are used primarily to fund a feeding programme and to cover the school running costs.

title: Keep a child with Epilepsy in school
description: Most of our epilepsy patients come from families that depend on day today casual labour living on less that $ 1 a day.  Children on expensive epilepsy drugs are at times forced to go for weeks without medication, resulting in recurred seizures, and missed classes.  Help keep these kids in school. So far we have helped 8 children using money raised through GlobalGiving.

title: Assistive Device support to 1000 Disabled Persons
description: It is believed that people with disabilities can not participate in the education, livelihood, religious and social functions due to disability. The fact is their participation is restricted not because of disability but they do not have appropriate devices that can increase their functional abilities. The project proposes to provide good quality assistive devices like wheel chairs, try cycles, smart canes, hearing aids to 500 women with disabilities from Gujarat and Rajasthan state.

title: Help investigate Eco-Crimes in Southern Africa
description: Like the colourful Oxpecker birds that remove parasites from wildlife in Africa, our investigative journalists target problems in the environment and peck away at them until they disappear. You can help reduce environmental crime by supporting the dedicated journalists who expose and track the villains.

title: Dental Care for 1200 Vulnerable Children in Kenya
description: For local communities in rural areas in Western Kenya dental care  is largely inaccessible. At the same time local diets are changing, being complemented increasingly by sweets and soft drinks. Statistics show that tooth decay and poor oral health in children are increasing rapidly due to inadequate nutrition and care. The proposed project sets out to address these issues in the schools where children will be treated, taught about nutrition and how to brush their teeth.

title: Give Healthy Food to Poor Children in Hungary
description: This project will provide free, healthy, daily lunch to poor children in our school, for whom nobody can pay the cost of lunches at the school.

title: Educate child in Sri Lanka
description: The Preschool child friendly spaces project will initially support 20 selected Preschools (early childhood education centers) in the North Eastern province with easy access to resources such as learning materials, enhancement of Physical resources, formulation of Parents committee, technical support to formulate the catchment area mapping and allowance for the teachers in the rural schools.

title: LIVES Food Truck "OOPEN"
description: The goal of the LIVES Food truck is to expose as many people as possible to people with disabilities so they can nurture understanding and help change the mindset of the society. The food truck will be run by special needs individuals and student and adult volunteers, in collaboration with social welfare organization, universities and local government. Change is achievable when we all work together!  Please support our cause by donating to this project, so that this can develop throughout Japan!

title: Help a Child with Cleft Smile in Ethiopia
description: This project helps 60 children in Afar, Ethiopia with Cleft Lip and Palate (CLP) with our end-to-end service. These children struggle with gaining weight as it is (almost) impossible for them to eat. By building capacity and working with local health services we provide access to life changing treatment and rehabilitation. This enables the children to lead healthier lives while also relieving them of the stigma cleft brings, helping them be part of their community and get them into schools.

title: Cancer and HIV/AIDS services to 10,000 in Lango
description: This project will raise awareness, respond to concerns and needs of persons affected and infected with cancer and HIV among men, youth, Children and women in Lango, conduct training for medical persons, Screening and linking infected persons for treatment. This project identified and providing palliative care to 20 abandoned vulnerable needy patients suffering from Cancer, HIV and TB. Screened and refereed 270 men, 350 women, 100 youth and 60 children for cancer and HIV care and treatment.

title: Employment Packs for Adults with Neurofibromatosis
description: The Neuro Foundation believes that adults with Neurofibromatosis deserve just as much support as children receive. Last year, we created our "Schools Information Packs", and they have since become an important and in-demand service that the charity is able to provide. We want to offer the same opportunity to teach employers about the challenges their employees with Neurofibromatosis face, and offer them the chance to receive their own support, so they, in turn, can provide for their staff.

title: Emergency Aid to Stabilize Orphanages in Ethiopia
description: The country of Ethiopia has recently closed the door on International Adoptions, which has presented a challenge for the children who live in orphanages and those who care for them. International Adoptions provided a great deal of financial support for the day to day functioning of orphanages. We are raising funds to help stabilize orphanages in the short term while they make long-term plans.  We want to support 100 children for at least one month (our goal is three months of support).

title: iLEAD Fellowship
description: The iLEAD Fellowship is a two pronged initiative; on the one hand it equips and prepares young varsity graduates who are interested in social change with the skills, knowledge and basic competence to become ready talents for the social sector in Nigeria. On the other hand these graduates in turn inspire and empower students in secondary schools by cascading leadership, life and employability skills required for personal effectiveness and to transition successfully to high education or paid jobs.

title: A Supportive community program for Alzheimer's
description: ARTZ offers persons with Alzheimer's, with one-on-one support and the accompaniment of a trained volunteer, cycles of adapted visits to art museums. Participatory, reciprocal engagement experiences benefit the person with dementia, volunteer, and caregiver. The interaction with culture contributes to the prevention of the loss of autonomy through a structured methodology which permits the stimulation of cognitive, motor, or relational capacities in these individuals.

title: Empower women in Mumbai slums with jobs & hygiene
description: Myna Mahila Foundation provides access to menstrual hygiene education and products to more than 10000 women every month at their doorstep in urban slums in Mumbai. We employ women from these slums to manufacture and distribute affordable sanitary pads locally, improving menstrual hygiene, providing stable employment, and building a trusted network across the community. We also support girls from single-parent or orphaned families who cannot afford pads with menstrual hygiene kits every 3 months.

title: Feed Starving Children
description: This project will provide food support to 1,200 starving children living in remote barrios in Mindanao, the Philippines by providing them with rice, milk, dried fish, meat and vegetables. We will also provide seeds and train their families to grow their own food by using resources around the house.

title: New reception area at School with 140 children
description: This project will remodel the reception area (which includes the library, IT area, and cooking area) in our small school.  This will ensure the best use of the available space making a real difference to the education of each of our 140 children.  The new area will make a real difference to how our children are taught and will significantly enhance their overall education experience.

title: TANF rural women and girls empowerment project
description: We have identified that the girls and women in the community are at a particular risk. Especially we have noticed single teenage mother drop out of school, child marriage, a lack of gender balance in most professions, and a lack of sexual education. We would like to tackle these issues in the community through education. We also would like to support and encourage teenage mothers to return to school or support them to be able to start their own business or start and apprenticeship.

title: Inclusion for Special Needs Children in Ecuador
description: Fighting a stigma against special needs in Ecuador, the NOVA Education Center is working to promote an inclusionary education model. NOVA brings 95 children with special needs and normal children into the same classroom. This project works to promote diversity, respect, and community involvement. By sponsoring a child at NOVA you can ensure that children with special needs and children who can't afford education are given the opportunity to learn and grow, while promoting a culture of diversity.

title: Bringing Help and Hope to Lebanon's Refugees
description: Refugees fleeing violence in Serbia, Iraq and Syria have established their own "camp" in Lebanon making a long-term community as best as they are able.  Working with UNHCR, these refugees have established latrines.  Working with GHNIs team, they've dug a well for clean water and begun growing vegetables and fruit in a nearby plot.  Recently, working together, they've begun educating young children in a "home-school" setting. Please help continue to develop a community of dignity and belonging.

title: Support 2000 peasant in commercial poultry mgt
description: We are Kick Peasant Farming Assoc.Ltd incorporated in Uganda as a company without share capital to engage peasant communities in commercial agricultural activities.We have designed a three years work plan to manage ten thousand local birds such as hens,turkeys and ducks which are currently reared domestically under free range system by setting up 100 production structures and one management unit to manage them using modern technology and skills so as to meet international demand and markets.

title: Empower Refugees To Build A New Life In Athens
description: We Need Books was founded  in 2016 in response to the overwhelming refugee crisis. We have  provided  refugees in camps and shelters with hundreds  of books in their native languages. This project contributes to funding Athens' first multilingual library, which also serves as an inclusive community center. It will help provide more than 400,000 refugees and migrants in Athens with access to educational resources, language classes and networking opportunities.

title: Help Canada Represent at the Shaolin Olympics 2018
description: It is very expensive to organize an optimal team with adequate training and financial resources. Without donors, we are unable to effectively promote and encourage more Canadians and especially children to represent us on the international stage. With donors and your support, we will be able to spend more effort and resources training and doing even better at the Zhengzhou International Shaolin Wushu tournament this October!

title: Train 3 Building Instructors for Apache Builds
description: Apache Builds is a program by members of the White Mountain Apache Tribe to provide sustainable, affordable housing and integral trade skill training to community members.  We need to send our 2 on-site building instructors and a program coordinator to get certified in a number of natural building techniques such as cob and straw bale construction so they can share the knowledge through ongoing community workshops and lead construction projects for the community.

title: Yogurt con Amor, Nutrition for Kids w/disABILITY
description: Yogurt con Amor helps 80 poor children & young people w/disability who lack concentration & energy to complete their daily classes & or physical therapy. The reason is often due to the poor nutrition they receive in their homes.  The project makes natural products: yogurt, cheese, granola, regional desserts. In addition, they strive to support the cost of lunch & breakfast in the different programs through sales, plus offering employment to young people/disabilities.

title: Jobs for People w/disAbility  Creates Independence
description: "I want to work"  is repeated continually in Matagalpa, Nicaragua, with unemployment for people with disabilities at 90%. In this agricultural coffee-based economy, Familias Especiales (FE) started five small businesses to offer employment to train & integrate people who have never left their homes before to learn the "culture of work." In addition, the social team supports a psychologist to work with 40 young people with disABILITIES in On-The-Job skill training & social integration.

title: Restore Health to 5000 Nigerians with Hypertension
description: This project will raise awareness about prevention and provide training to community volunteers to act as health champions who will screen, treat, and share vital information on hypertension and diabetes through peers group, meetings, and through other health campaigns. We will provide medical screening, medications, nutritional supplements, and advice that will aid 5,000 people in Ibadan communities to cope with existing conditions and live a healthy lifestyle.

title: Send 300 Kids to School for USD300/Child in the PH
description: Did you know that while public school is free in the Philippines, some students, especially the poor, still find it hard to attend classes? Due to financial constraints, poor students encounter problems to sustain daily expenses of transportation and food, and financing their uniform, school supplies, and school projects. At USD300 per student in Senior High, the project aims to help 300 poor kids cover these expenses for a school year to facilitate attendance and good performance in school.

title: SUPERANDO RETOS / OVERCOMING BARRIERS
description: Toyota Insurance Challenge aims to help achieve real integration of children with disabilities into schools and communities of Les Cayes and Lilavois in Haiti.  This challenge wants to raise funds to support the work of America Solidaria Haiti in order to help them develop functional and learning capacities, promote skills and empowerment to enhance autonomy, and strengthen physical and social skills in children with disabilities

title: Empower 103 Households for their Livelihoods
description: The community skills development organization, a national organization of South Sudan located in Yambio plans some strategies to support single mothers in Yambio.   The total number of our target population is 17,000 Households in Gbudwe state. Community Skill Development was established in the year 2008 by a volunteer group headed by Father Ignatius Mborihenga. CSD is a national organization registered by South Sudan Relief and Rehabilitation commission.

title: Education For Children Inside Syria
description: Now in its eighth year and with no end in sight, the conflict in Syria has become the largest humanitarian crisis since World War II. Education remains central to the humanitarian response plans in Syria. To ensure access to education for internally displaced children and those living in hard-to-reach and besieged areas in Syria, UNICEF has designed a Self-Learning Program, which aims to reach 298,000 Syrian children who have limited or no access to schooling.

title: Storybooks by N. Korean Women Victims of Torture
description: This project seeks to provide support to North Korean women who had experienced torture at the hands of the North Korean regime to have their voices heard and recover from their traumatic experiences through the creating and publishing of their own personal storybooks. This project will help these women mentally organize their past experiences, develop their future, and relieve themselves of the psychological challenges they face upon having such experiences of torture.

title: Water Tanks from Plastic Bottles in 50 Needy Homes
description: This project will help 50 needy households  in Uganda whom were trained by BUVAD to build their own 2000ltrs safe rainwater harvesting tanks using waste plastic bottles as bricks. The key objective is to control the accumulation of hazardous waste plastic bottles, while helping needy communities to overcome the low water storage levels coupled with prolonged draughts. In a coopertive form  members shall construct water tanks as teams at each's household to benefit about 600 households occupants

title: Educate Children in Mexico: A Bridge to Success
description: The children of Santa Rosalia, Mexico deserve a high quality education that will pave the way for their future success as contributing members of the community. Our goal is to expand our program to more schools so that we can provide 360 more students with a comprehensive social emotional learning program that will support them in reaching their full potential.

title: Filmmaking Program for Street Youth in Freetown
description: The aim is for the program to last 6 months wherein vulnerable youth will be taught the art of writing stories (based either on the UN's 17 sustainable goals, or their own lived experience), and then bringing them to life in short documentary style films. Eventually, we would like to see this as a self-sustaining project, with previous participants advising the new recruits. Through this program, we hope to inspire social change, encourage creative self-expression, and promote education.

title: Rebuild the Nelsonville Community Garden
description: Record flooding destroyed the Nelsonville Community Garden in Southeast Ohio earlier this year. This garden, established in 2009, has been a hub for community members to come together, learn gardening skills, and grow their own healthy foods to feed themselves and their families in a region challenged by poverty and food insecurity. Working collaboratively, the Nelsonville Community Garden is being relocated to a flood-proof location, on the site of an old parking lot. We need your help!

title: Monthly food expenses for 26 elders in our home
description: 26 neglected elderly are provided by food, nutrition, health, recreation, safe accommodation and counseling. It gives safe accommodation, food, health and free of isolation and mentally they are freed from the burden and isolation. Till death they are cared and then funeral is done in their religious belief in death.

title: Provide FOOD to 120 underprivileged kids
description: The aim of this Project is to assist 120 vulnerable kids, that have being dramatically affected by the COVID 19 pandemic.  The income of most of these families would normally comes from non-formal jobs that during the pandemic suffered the most. Through this project, we would cover the basic needs of the kids by providing a food package every 15 days for each family.  Our support will ensure that children will not end up on the streets begging for money instead of  safety going to school.

title: Helping 50 Destitute Elderly people In Remote Ethi
description: Destitute elderly are marginalized & stigmatized in Ethiopia for lack of care from relatives or extended family. They are also are living in deteriorated economic and social reality due to poverty, physical disability. We planned to provide food items, water, clothing, shelter, medical treatment, sanitary materials, psycho-social support & supportive equipments for   50 destitute elderly, with a special focus on those living with disability and Women

title: Help Provide Education to 300 Children in Need
description: This project will help provide both academic and vocational skills education to 300 children in need at Fortune Community School in Solwezi District of Zambia. Charity Centre for Children and Youth Development has constructed six (6) classroom that is providing both basic education and skills training to the less privileged children in the community. The project will help raise money for payment of salaries for teachers and tutors, school uniforms, Books, food, sanitation pads for girls etc.

title: Naming and Faming honest government officials!
description: Integrity Icon is a movement to celebrate honest civil servants around the world. Now in its fifth year and in 7 countries, the campaign is led by civil society to "name and fame" the do-gooders in government rather than "name and shame" corrupt officials. This flips the script and creates role-models for a new generation of civil servants. Support the campaign to help cover its costs and further these efforts to build greater public sector accountability.

title: Early support to 20 special needs children
description: The project will ensure that 20 children aged 0-3 who are at risk of falling behind in their development, including preterm and/or low-birth-weight infants; who have developmental delays or disabilities, will receive a complex quality early intervention service. They will have opportunity to social and educational inclusion and will receive therapy to stimulate their development. Families will be supported and empowered to be main actors in their child's life and care.

title: Permaculture Teacher Training in East Africa
description: PRI-Kenya offers a professional and comprehensive education programme in permaculture design and related subjects. Our Teacher Training provides skills in teaching permaculture for those who have already completed their PDC and who already have some experience implementing permaculture. As part of our TOT and together with International Permaculture facilitators, we focus on giving students an in-depth insight into the permaculture design process alongside.

title: Sport Senza Frontiere Onlus
description: Sport Senza Frontiere Onlus believes that sport is an effective "instrument" for the social change.  Our mission is to guarantee access to sport to those who need it, bring it where it does not exist and spread its values and principles.  Education, social integration and wellbeing through sport represent Onlus' mission.

title: Help 1000 Girls Manage their "Days" in Kasese
description: From the age 12-16 most young girls experience their Menstrual Periods for their 1st time. As a result they feel embarrassed when accidentally they find their Menses in either class,or Playground without any preventive tool to stop bleeding,Innocent and ignorant about Menstruation, they end up using grass, sponges,feathers,soil,handikerchiefs,and pieces of Paper. Some end up being mocked,nicknamed and laughed at. Your support will help provide Sustainable Sanitary Pads and reduce School dropouts

title: Livelihood support for vulnerable households
description: The majority of vulnerable or poor household live in rural Uganda. These are characterised by low income which is $1 a day, food insecurity, diseases, poor hygiene and sanitation. The Sprout Care Foundation aim to promote increased income, food security and reduce vulnerability of poor rural households in the project areas.

title: Meals for 2,000 Unfortunate People in Indonesia
description: Truck equipped with kitchen, making it the mobile public kitchen. Able to deliver free meals up to 1,000 portion in a day. These meals are cooked for the less fortunate people in Indonesia who are affected by disasters or economic crisis. Led by professional chef, this truck can provide healthy and delicious meal for the needy. The Humanity truck deliver the cooked meals during the emergency response and also on daily activities to provide free meals for the poor in Indonesia.

title: Equip 60 youth in Ghana with vocational skills
description: Skills Initiative Program (SIP) is aimed at creating job opportunities for unemployed youth in Ghana through skills acquisition in interior decoration and beads making. SIP will directly reach 60 unemployed youth from deprived communities with training in vocational and entrepreneurship skills leading to employment. As a result, these targeted youth will increase their income and savings and create job opportunities in the sector, thereby indirectly benefiting their families and economy.

title: Build a Bilingual School in Nicaragua
description: Help build a campus where ALL children can receive excellent bilingual education, regardless of family income. We are currently raising funds to finish our dynamic 6-classroom primary school with rooftop terraces and start construction on our innovation center for high school. Escuela Adelante's inquisitive students are breaking down language and cultural differences and bringing hope for increased equality and unity among the diverse population of San Juan del Sur. Help us serve more students!

title: Employment for young adults in honey coops
description: Young adults in rural Mexico don't consider field work as a dignifying activity. They see their family struggling with unstable income, climate change and difficult livelihoods, no matter the amount of work invested in their productive activities. They don't want this for themselves. They prefer to migrate -mostly to the US- seeking for better opportunities. By offering them a real job with stable income, real responsibilities and working with their families, youngsters can choose to stay home.

title: Daycare Center for children and youngsters at risk
description: This project consists in support and assist children and youngsters at risk to improve their personal development and autonomy through prevention (circumstances and behavioral risks), caring (looking for the fulfillment of their necessities such as, education, nutritional follow ups) and strengthening their family ties and social network.  Additionally, since 2012 we had to run social kitchens for long-term unemployed families at our Daycare Centers across all Spain.

title: Help Kenyan Girls Qualify for Secondary School
description: The Literacy Garden Project aims to develop the skills of 500 marginalised rural girls annually, to promote literacy, food security and environmental stewardship by establishing a safe environment for girls from 7 rural primary schools. In a country where success in life is determined by the final scores in national primary school exams, girls face the greatest challenges. Those who fail these tests cannot access secondary school, and face prostitution, child marriage and early teen pregnancy.

title: Rising Stars: Empowering Children as Leaders
description: Prime Trust organizes Children's Parliaments for children of the remedial schools and of our Self-Help Group members. These parliaments are designed for children between the age of 9 and 14 and encourage them to engage in local, national and international democratic processes. Essentially these children are discussing issues that directly affecting their lives.  Through these parliaments we believe that every child should be able to express themselves openly and without fear.

title: Window and Door Campaign
description: This project will help us complete the first phase of our permanent campus located at Manya Jorpanya. This would afford us the opportunity to provide brilliant but needy students with the most conducive and convenient environment for teaching and learning. Your support will go a long way to educate a poor but brilliant student in Ghana.

title: Building sustainability in the Philippines
description: In the Philippines we will begin work on our cacao production project on the island of Mindanao.  This project will create jobs for multiple indigenous people in that region, enabling them to earn a living and provide for their families.   Our hope is that this project will help to bring economic security to the people of Mindanao, which will lead to good nutrition and health as well as educational opportunities for the local children.

title: Support Syrian Refugees
description: Support two community centers for refugees near the Syrian border, where young women are transforming their lives through business training, women's health sessions, child care, computers, and a safe space to build community.

title: Help fund the incoming class of 2020
description: If you have been waiting for the right moment to donate, now is your best time because every dollar you contribute will quadruple.  This challenge could not have come at a better time.  We have only recently learned that some of the expected UWC International scholarship monies are not coming.  We have a deep commitment to our 80+ scholars who will be arriving in a few short weeks. This ends July 31st!

title: Give 220 Disadvantaged Children a Brighter Future
description: The fallout from COVID-19 sees underprivileged communities face increased financial instability and continued health risks.  Disadvantaged families in Phuket now have less disposable income.  More children from low-income backgrounds will need our assistance in the near future, as vulnerable families will send their children to Kamala School to ensure 3 meals a day and a safe place to sleep. WE NEED YOUR HELP!

title: Give Second Chance to Abandoned & Sick Elderly
description: Summary: Old Age is undoubtedly an accursed lot when the organs of the human body fail to perform their function properly. The youngsters are distancing themselves from the elderly and society. Some are guilty of not just indifference but also abusing them aggressively in many forms - psychological, financial exploitation and neglecting their basic needs of food & shelter. SHEOWS provides free food, accommodation, medical care (Medicines, Doctors, Physiotherapy) and rehabilitation of elderly.

title: Empower Asian Leaders for Holistic Sustainability
description: Awakening Leadership Training is a 6 month empowerment training based in Thailand that weaves inner transformation and societal understanding with techniques for community building and effective mindful leadership. It provides space for dialogue, reflection and contemplation on the deep questions facing humanity and our planet. We will support 5 young changemakers from diverse backgrounds from Southeast Asia to join this program , to cultivate a new leadership for future generations.

title: Giving Children a Chance to Learn and Grow
description: The project 'Giving Children a Chance to Learn and Grow' is intended to support the community of Mutulani Village in rural Kenya to achieve higher standards of hygiene and sanitation, reduced cases of school absenteeism and increased agricultural economic activities. This projects, seeking to bring solutions that are emerging, originates from a previous project, 'Improved Health for 1500 Women and Children in Kenya', that aimed at providing water to the Mutulani community and schools.

title: Renovating a  Dormitory for 10 Midwifery Students
description: Zimbabwe Health Education and Sustainability Trust (ZHEST) assists in the improvement of health of people living in rural communities in Zimbabwe. We work with local communities, supplying hospital equipment and building health care facilities. In this project we are working in partnership with Mnene School of Nursing, Mberengwa in the Midlands province. We are renovating a fire damaged midwifery students' dormitory for ten students.

title: Help HOPE bring clean water to Chano Dorga
description: Clean water can change everything for Chano Dorga.  This project will cap 2 nearby springs to provide water for their daily use,  and more than enough as the village grows in the future. Together, HOPE and the community will lay 14.3 km of pipeline, and will build 2 water reservoirs, 15 water points, and 11 wash basins. The arrival of local, safe water will bring improved health and increased time for schooling and pursuing income generating opportunities.  A new future will then be possible.

title: Provide hope to 50 special needs children.
description: By providing financial assistance for these children we can help the families secure uninsured medical costs or supplies. Children will be aligned with necessary medical care, therapies, medicines, equipment, lab work, imaging services and other related needs that fall through the cracks of existing insurance and social services programs.     Your gift can make a difference!

title: Help care for preschoolers in Vietnam
description: While their parents labor to create products sold around the world, the 1.2 million children of factory workers in Vietnam often spend their days without the simple care and attention needed to thrive. With 20 years of success in helping vulnerable children, we know how to positively change these young lives with our Factory Model programs for the children of factory workers in Da Nang, Vietnam.

title: Water, Light and Shelter for Puerto Ricans in Need
description: CDRS has been distributing much needed emergency relief to needy American citizens in Puerto Rico since Hurricane Maria devastated the island in late September. Our team has provided high quality and very long-lasting water filters and solar lights to communities that have been cut off from these resources due to the overwhelming damage to essential infrastructure, as well as medical supplies, hygiene items, clothing and more. CDRS will continue distributions and rebuilding damaged communities.

title: Prevent Cruelty to Animals
description: This project will treat and take care of 2000 stray dogs and cats, provide them food, shelter and medicine.

title: Golf Clinic for 100 Kids in Nigeria
description: The game of Golf is an elitist sport thereby exclusive to the rich and the privileged. I believe Golf is a life game and should be for everyone especially children and youths, this is the future of the game. Learning this game, knowing and loving it will enrich the lives of high school students in the rural setting like Elekuru and its environs. I invite you to support me in the recruitment and training of 100 high school boys and girls in Elekuru Village Ibadan, Nigeria. Thank you

title: Rehabilitate Physically chalged children 70Karkala
description: School started in 2004 to rehabilitate Mentally & Physically challenged children. Provides Physiotherapy, Speech Therapy, Computer & Vocational Training to students. 9 specially trained teaching staff & 7 non teaching staff are working. School provides free education, food, conveyance etc. to all the students. Constructing building for Physiotherapy unit at Cost of Rs.50.lakhs.School is spending about Rs.3,00,000/- p.m to meet the expenses. Donations recd.are exempted from Sec.80G of IT Act.

title: Educate African Children about the environment
description: The mission of DAKTARI is to educate and inspire local children to value their environment and stimulate community development. DAKTARI Bush School & Wildlife Orphanage works in the South African bush to educate local children about the environment and ignite their passion for wildlife. Each week, DAKTARI welcomes eight new students to our camp to attend lessons, do activities, and interact with the animals in our wildlife orphanage.

title: Help 80 vulnerable women to sustain themselves
description: We work on empowering around 80 vulnerable women and youth living in Kenya poor suburb through revolving funds and also by an individual follow up. Our goal is to enable them to start and run  their own small businesses in order to sustain their families and also improve local and sustainable economy. Some of our members are HIV positive. We want to financially empower them, and thanks to economic independence they are no longer stigmatized by the society!

title: Maternity Ward for HIV+ Women in Kamenge, Burundi
description: Ntaseka's Clinic has found that 7% of women tested at the clinic are HIV+. Many of these women will have children which currently are being delivered at home with a great possibility of transmitting the HIV status to their newborn babies. With the addition of the maternity ward these women who will have attended the clinic for pre-natal care will be able to deliver in the new maternity ward where they will receive properly medical care so that the do not convey their status to their child.

title: HELP MEXICAN WOMAN TO DEVELOP THEIR OWN BUSINESS
description: This project educates mexican woman in technologies in order to develop their own online businness. We provide hands on training and powerfull conferences. We believe in this, we believe in education, in empowered woman, we believe that committed people can do the difference in Mexico.

title: Build a Wall for Busia
description: Girls and young women have been harassed by men who trespass on the Busia orphanage property in Western Kenya. We want to build a wall to keep them out. Threats from dangerous snakes coming into the compound are also problematic. We want you to help us build a wall for Busia and we need $50,000 to secure the grounds from these threats. Will you help us by donating today? Our goal is to have dollars raised by the end of 2018 to immediately begin wall construction.

title: Solar Lamps for 900 Indigenous Filipino Children
description: This project provides solar lamps to 900 indigenous children and youth in the Philippines, so they can gain access to safer, less expensive, healthier and more environmental friendly light source to help them study after dark.

title: Love Your Neighbor Launch for Eid!
description: As we celebrate the end of Ramadan and Eid-al-Fitr, the Muslim-Jewish Solidarity Committee asks for your zakat-al-fitr and tzedakah donation to launch our "Love Your Neighbor" program! After our flagship Iftar-in-a-Synagogue, we come together as Muslims, Jews, and allies to practice what we preach - standing together against hate, oppression, trauma. Our Love Your Neighbor program will create monthly Muslim-Jewish service projects in partnership with underserved neighborhoods.

title: Opti Music Sensory Room
description: Setting up a state of the art Opti Music Interactive Sensory Room/immersive space at the Centre to meet the children's sensory issues. The unit will help with treating some hypo/hyper sensory challenges some children on the autistic spectrum face. All children with special educational needs will benefit from the space as some technologies enhance communication for individuals/groups,increase strength and motor skills, increase hand/eye coordination enhances concentration and other useful skills.

title: Transforming the Social Finance sector in Brazil
description: Sitawi is committed to protecting the environment and changing the lives of the most vulnerable people in Brazil. To achieve this, since 2008 SITAWI Finance for Good has pioneered financial solutions for social impact and in the analysis of the social and environmental performance of companies and financial institutions. We dream of a world where capital is cheaper, more abundant and more patient for organizations and businesses creating positive social and environmental impact.

title: Songs for Help, Hope, Healing & Comfort
description: This project will produce a book of songs to equip teachers and families to help children facing difficulty from everyday struggles, loss or trauma whether they're having a hard day, a hard time or a hard life. The book/CD will help impart hope, build resilience & restore joy.  This project is almost ready to put into book form now! Support GITC to chart, record and produce these brand new printable songbooks/CDs  for people teaching and caring for children and donate copies for 300 classrooms!

title: Protecting the health of AIDS Orphaned children
description: In Togo, more than 70% of children who have been orphaned or made vulnerable by HIV/AIDS do not receive any medical, educational, social or psychological support. in the first year, this project  40 vulnerable orphaned AIDS children  Action Pour l'Humain will provide assist to Lome North West neighborhoods orphan facing a challenging increase in poverty due to death of parents du to AIDS. Our organization  needs financial support to make shine  a smile in vulnerable children faces.

title: Protecting the Lives of HIV+ Teens
description: AIDS is still the leading cause of death for African teens. In a resource-limited country like Malawi, there is a gap between pediatric and adult health care that leads to HIV+ teens being forgotten. As a result, they face a high risk of stopping treatment and putting their lives at risk. Teens who are not on treatment regularly miss school due to infections. Without access to youth-focused health care, HIV+ teens have become a lost generation. Together, let's be the generation that ends AIDS.

title: Help giving for Cassava-Grater Machine
description: The organization's aim to contribute to a sustained improvement of living conditions, stability, health, education and economic growth in the rural population of four communities in Gbinle-Dixian chiefdom in Kambia District Sierra Leone West Africa. Harvesting cassava farm is now in progress after 1 year 6 months in field. Thanks for your donations. The project activity is designed to focus on buying a machine for cassava-grater and enhance them to produce enough food which becomes available.

title: Heaven Through the Backdoor
description: Part myth, part documentary, Heaven Through the Backdoor explores the mystery of death through the unconventional friendship of Anna and Yo, two kindred spirits born 49 years apart. Using intricately built miniature sets and other creations, the film juxtaposes intimate verite of Yo's last year with Anna's wildly imaginative interpretations of her stories. The film highlights the enduring power of friendship and what we learn from each other in life and through death.

title: Occupational Therapy Model Apartment
description: This project at Fundacion Triada, Quito-Tumbaco, Ecuador, will create a model apartment simulating living quarters, where patients with neurological disabilities will experience and train for an autonomous life by learning how to carry out daily activities such as preparing a meal, eating, making a bed, bathing and getting dressed by themselves.  The project will benefit 60 to 80 patients and their families.

title: Help 73 Tanzanian Vulnerable Children go to School
description: Tanzania is experiencing an unprecedented increase in the number of orphans and vulnerable children (OVC). Despite discrepancies in statistics, the number of vulnerable children in the country is increasing. HIV/AIDS induced orphan hood that constitute 58.8% of all orphans in Tanzania.TA Foundation plans to support education materials to vulnerable children who are in-school and those who dropped out of school due to lack of education materials so that they could go on with their studies.

title: Installation of Paper Recycle Mini Factory
description: Kathmandu the capital city of Nepal known as polluted city in Asia. Anybody can see thrown away plastic and papers on the street of Kathmandu. CONCERN had once started a paper recycle factory which was destroyed during earthquake 3 years ago. But, damaged severely from earthquake. Since then the production of recycle of paper was stopped. The proposed project has targeted to collected thrown away papers on the street and also collect from different organisations and produces recycle products.

title: Holistic Health for Youth and Women in Harlem
description: At the end of 2019, IBREA opened Harlem Brain, a holistic training center at the heart of Harlem, New York City. After working over the past 4 years with youth living in Harlem, IBREA recognized that many young people in the community and their families suffer from a variety of physical health issues, high levels of stress, anxiety, depression, lack of focus and motivation. Harlem Brain offers a space where they can improve their health, calm their mind and regain their strength and focus.

title: NDF Rehab Center, Nawabshah
description: All over the world, mental health is one of the biggest issues to be handled in our society. Keeping in view the big data of Intellectual Disabilities in Sindh, NDF established NDF Rehab Center in Nawabshah, it brings regular services to children with intellectual disabilities, such as life therapies i-e Physiotherapy, Psychotherapy, Occupational Therapy, Speech Therapy, vocational/non formal education & independent living to 100 Children with Intellectual Disabilities with boarding facility.

title: Help Underprivileged Children Get To School
description: The Quality Education Program for Underprivileged is a school-based program which aims to improve the overall schooling experience for the students as well as the teachers by bringing in mainly co-scholastic activities as well as support for scholastic work at schools if needed. It complements Government's programs to improve learning levels by creating institutions where all stakeholders including parents are involved in creating a change for the better.

title: Cashews and bees - reducing rural poverty in Ghana
description: Bees are amazing! They can help to improve lives in more ways than one. In Ghana many cashew farmers live in extreme poverty . Bees can change this - twice over! They give farmers honey to sell AND they improve cashew nut yields through improved pollination. Research has shown that bees can double cashew yields. This project will help some of the poorest farmers in Ghana to learn beekeeping and secure a better future for themselves and their families - with the help of the honey bee.

title: Support 4 Slum Boys Compete at World Championships
description: After 10 years of working progress Victor, Kennedy, Derrick and Eddy (4 of the boys in our long-term sport development program) have earned a spot at the World Duathlon Championships Elite & U23 to be held in Almere, Netherlands from 5th to 13th Sep 2020. These 4 athletes are at a critical stage of transition from amateur to professional athletics.

title: Girl-mother Empowerment program
description: As an organisation we have identified that the girls-mother in communities are at risk. The issue of  teenage mother dropping out of school, child marriage, a lack of gender balance in most professions, and a lack of sexual education. We would like to tackle these issues in the communities through skill training for teenage mothers. We also would like to support and encourage teenage mothers to return to school or support them to be able to start their own businesses or start an apprenticeship.

title: Build libraries for 2 deprived schools in Akweley
description: This project will build two libraries which is integral to the teaching learning process. The libraries will benefit 500 basic school children in the Akweley community where there is a high rate of illiteracy due to poverty. Book to Read Foundation in pursuit of one of our aims towards bringing to the barest minimum the high illiteracy rate has so far donated over 1000 reading materials ,stationery , desktop computers and organized spelling bee competition for the pupils in the community

title: Uniting the Community to Uplift one OVC Household
description: The project of  Uniting the Community to uplift One OVC Household  will be implemented in Makadara Sub county,  targeting 340 highly vulnerable Orphaned Children's households by training the caregivers on Income Generating Activities and transfer assets to initiate  the income generating activities to support the Children's Education, Nutrition, Security and Access to Better Health

title: Support 300 Orphaned&Vulnerable Children in Uganda
description: This project will build  an orphanage Center in Kasanda County in Mubende District in Central  Uganda,  to provide Basic needs  and social support services  to 300 Orphaned & Vulnerable Children affected by  absolute Poverty, HIV/AIDS as a result of  civil  Wars  and  on and off immigration.

title: Support to Victims of Guatemala Volcano Eruption
description: This project will support the long-term recovery of families through legal and psychological support to victims of the deadly volcano eruption in Guatemala on June 3rd, 2018. The eruption has killed over 100 people, with many still missing, and has displaced thousands. By partnering with local NGOs who work directly with the hardest hit areas, WJI will provide legal and psychological support to those in greatest need as they begin to reconstruct their lives and overcome trauma.

title: To build entrepreneurs' centre for training youths
description: This project builds a well resourced entrepreneurs' training centre to help  educate and train 300 youths per year. The target segment of the population is comprised of illiterates, primary, and secondary school dropouts and school leavers. Some college graduates need to go through the entrepreneurial ability and behaviour development program to become innovate and smart entrepreneurs. The centre will provide innovative direction for youths to become successful entrepreneurs.

title: WELTI Scholarship Scheme for 20 Young Women
description: The WELTI scholarship scheme for 20 young women is an initiative of the WELTI leadership academy.  This initiative aims at sponsoring the senior secondary education of 20 destitute young women from Lambe, Mushin, Badagry and Ijora badia areas of Lagos and Ogun state respectively in Nigeria. WELTI Leadership academy is going to admit these 20 young women into its academy and groom them for 3 years with a leadership curriculum, skill acquisition curriculum and their normal school system.

title: WE NEED ACTIVITIES FUND FOR THERAPY DOGS IN SUMMER
description: We would like to ask your donation for our activities funds in summer for therapy dogs. In summer it is so hard to get funds, because one of our main income is from fundraising activity on the street, but in summer, mainly June to September, the activity is difficult for temperature. But we must get funds for dogs. Then we'd like to ask you donation to our association for summer season.  All donation is used only for dogs to spend and get over summer healthy.

title: Give Awareness to 300 At-Risk Children and Parents
description: The lack of awareness on child sexual abuse/exploitation risks and offending behaviour within children and families results in child protection lagging behind developments, leading to continued vulnerability of children and communities being targeted by sex offenders. This project intends to provide awareness to 200 children and 100 parents/carers in 3 different communities in Battambang, Kampot & Kandal and will address an understanding of children and parents/carers on child sexual abuse.

title: Orkeeswa School Scholarship Fund
description: The Orkeeswa School Scholarship Fund provides the necessary resources to provide high quality, affordable education to the students of Orkeeswa School. By offering our students a diverse array of programs, opportunities and resources, we are developing a generation of well-rounded and inspired leaders in Orkeeswa Village, who are equipped and motivated to make a positive impact on their communities.   Help us fund 10 students who are in need of scholarship support!

title: Give a child the start to education for a year
description: Northern Uganda lags behind across a range of development dimensions especially education. A whole generation lost out in education, during the war. The new Agape School, will enable children to learn the basics and be socialized for success. Parents will bring lunch and learn in their own groups-farming or managing a small business. They will learn together as we rebuild education in N. Uganda.

title: Empowering 240 self-help groups in Gulu
description: Many households in Northern Uganda still suffer from the effects of the two-decade civil war. The project will empower groups around the Karin health centers through projects that enable households to become self-reliant. These projects include modern dairy farming, microloans, artisan training, Bio-sand filter safe water, value chain management, energy saving stoves, etc..Empowered households will be able to take care of their health, send their children to school and increase local incomes.

title: Rebuilding complex body deformity to 80 Ethiopians
description: Haddis agape Bell's palsy plans to do surgical missions and build microsurgical unit for the people of Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.   This project builds a capacity to perform complex surgeries for people suffering body deformity of any cause.

title: Support to Rural Girls Education in Liberia
description: Complex societal challenges are preventing girls from attaining education in rural Liberia. Learning Squared supports vulnerable and underserved girls in rural Liberia by providing partial and complete tuition fees, learning materials, after-school programs, and backpacks for girls aged 8-18 years to overcome some challenges on a need and merit basis.

title: Support Syrian Refugee Mothers in Turkey
description: No one gives more than moms, it's now time to give back to them! Make your mother happy by giving to another who is as strong as her, support a newly-born baby just like she once supported you.  Syrian Crisis is on its 8th year. Since the beginning, 225 thousands Syrian babies are born in Turkey. Displaced by the war, refugee mothers are trying to keep their children and our hopes well and alive.  Let's envision a world in which every baby that's born is growing in health, wealth and safety.

title: Opening doors to 2000 bright futures in Mexico
description: The Club de Ninos y Ninas Tecamac/Ecatepec offers a safe and secure place to  vulnerable children and youth during the time after school. We offer our Club members well oriented activities such as arts, music, sports, recreation, homework help, computer tutoring and nutritional programs, thereby promoting the health, social, educational, vocational and character development of boys and girls. Our members acquire the necessary skills to succeed and to leave the Club with a path for life.

title: MakersLab 2.0: Empowering New Makers in Mexico
description: In Mexico the TIC industry represents only the 1% of the employments.  Help us to create new spaces for children, youth and adults from disadvantaged communities in the country, where they can learn robotics, 3D printing, laser cut and electronics. Lets encourage them to be the new economic developers for their families!!!

title: Youth Empowerment through Practical Skills & Sport
description: This project  will contribute towards empowering  youths in the rural and slum areas through provision of life skills for their safety and protection and addressing psycho-social issues and socio-economic that affect them including stress, anxiety , depression, identity , suicidal thoughts , alcohol and drug abuse , violence ,reproductive health , peer pressure, relationships, discipline, and other social ills of concern for youths in their situation.

title: Save a life and Adopt a Donkey in Cape Town
description: We are creating a wonderful opportunity for the public to " adopt a donkey" to help Mayday and his mom this Mother's Day. By donating towards our project you will be helping provide much needed care to vulnerable donkeys at our horse care unit. The care of a donkey per month costs $80 and every cent donated will allow us to provide feed, veterinary treatment and care to our precious donkeys and their foals.

title: Help Women & Girls Escape Domestic Abuse and SGBV
description: Founded by a survivor, Unsilenced Voices' objective is to provide shelter and relief for victims of domestic abuse and sexual gender based violence in Ghana and Sierra Leone. Currently there are few, if any shelters or vocational centers protecting and educating women and girls about their rights. Unsilenced Voices is working with our partners to implement shelters, sensitization programs, legal assistance, vocational training, medical and counseling to women and girls in both countries

title: Saving Canine and Human Lives in Afghanistan
description: Rabies is a deadly viral disease that kills over 59 ,000 people worldwide each year. Dogs are the main cause of human rabies deaths, contributing to over 99% of rabies transmissions.    Mayhew Afghanistan delivers a mass vaccination and neuter programme for owned and free-roaming dogs with the primary aim of eradicating rabies in Kabul. Through the delivery of our programmes, we aim to protect communities from rabies and empower communities and make Afghanistan rabies free by 2030.

title: Educational trip for 100 school children in Kenya
description: This educational tour to the Kenyan coastal city of Mombasa will provide a rare learning opportunity for 100 pupils from our partner primary schools in a rural corner of the country.

title: IMPROVING WOMEN LITERACY IN TRIBAL POCKET  ODISHA
description: Make literate  4500  women and girls in the age group of 15 to 35 years literate and empowering both socially and economically through SHG and Federation by undertake vocational training and undertake different trades and link with the market in most backward Kalahandi district of Odisha and free from exploitation and social improvement.

title: Building Bridges, not Walls
description: Maternal and newborn health program along the U.S./Mexico border

title: Transform Education/Improve Livelihoods in Liberia
description: This project will raise the educational attainment of more than 500 young people by transforming the quality of teaching in Gbarpolu County high schools.  Working with the District Education office, we will:    1) Provide tools, resources & training for teachers and students   2) Integrate technology in learning activities & nurture innovation   3) Embed Financial Literacy as a subject in the curriculum   4) Strengthen safeguarding policies and run peer-led consent workshops in the community

title: Africa plays Hockey: engaging youth in sports
description: AYPAD created the Hockey Project with a mission to expose the sport to thousands of young people while promoting peace through sport. Hockey is a relatively a new sport in Africa and with many young people living through hardship and deplorable conditions, the need to introduce the sport was timely as it engages young people to reduce the traumatic effects of War, Violence, Abuse and embrace peace while developing their unique hockey talents that can contribute meaningfully to societal growth.

title: Support our newborn care training team
description: This project will provide financial support for our three key neonatal clinical trainers in eastern Uganda. Our neonatal specialist doctor and two neonatal clinical officers provide free medical care for over 2000 sick and premature babies every year. They run regular training courses in basic newborn care in surrounding district hospitals and lower level health facilities and provide ongoing support supervision visits to ensure sustainability and lead improvements in standards of care.

title: Educate Impoverished Girls in Kashmir
description: Pakistan is one of the few countries in the world with a rising illiteracy rate.  In a country where 60 percent youth are illiterate and only 1 in 3 women can read and write, HOPE has been working hard to reverse this trend.  HOPE has implemented an innovative solution to helping girls in Pakistan's rural and remote areas such as Kashmir - HOPE home schools - whereby girls who ordinarily face multiple obstacles to obtaining an education are becoming teachers and role models in the community.

title: Protect 20 disabled children in kgf from starving
description: This project is created to gather funds required to provide food provisions and necessities to currently identified 20 severely disabled and neglected children from very poor families in the defunct mining town of Kolar Gold Fields (kgf), Karnataka, India.

title: Project Asian Elephants 101 for 101 Youth in India
description: There are fewer than 40,000 Asian elephants on earth, 60% in India. Many animals in forest ecosystems depend on elephants for their survival. Asian elephants are dying at a rapid rate. They are endangered. They need help! Educating and empowering the youth of India is necessary to protect them. Project Asian Elephants 101 was developed by a group of conservationists to equip 101 youth with necessary tools and skill-sets to lead the conservation movement. We need to raise a total of $15,000.

title: Animal Rescue Project
description: This project will rescue 750 household pets especially dogs and cats that are abused and or abandoned by providing them shelter, food and veterinary care.

title: Assisting Children with Disabilities
description: This project will provide medical, financial and social support for 200 children with disabilities in order for them to live healthy and meaningful lives.

title: Kids with disabilities: catch them young!
description: Latika Roy Foundation's Early Intervention Centre (EIC) is for very young children with developmental delays. The earlier we start working with children, the better they do. At EIC we work with children from birth to six and their families. We encourage their overall development, enhance their abilities to the full and help them circumvent their disability. All our programs are activity-based, with the emphasis on learning through play.

title: Help Breast Cancer Patients Receive Chemotherapy
description: IHI offers life-saving surgery, chemotherapy, hormone therapy and facilitate access to radiation therapy for all of our patients regardless of their ability to pay. We want to provide cancer care and treatment to the women that need it the most while maintaining it at a low price. The treatment options available include chemotherapy, surgery, hormone therapy, pathology, and all other imaging and testing. The program is also entirely operated by a Haitian medical staff.

title: Over 1 million refugees in Bangladesh
description: Global Hope Network International has partnered with other organizations working to provide immediate relief, help and hope to over 1 million refugees who are currently living in extremely challenging conditions in Bangladesh.  Our teams on the ground desire to provide increased shelter as monsoon season fast approaches, basic nutrition needs, hygiene while offering hope and trauma counseling. These families have experienced much trauma, and are living in horrific situations. Your help is needed

title: Sukarya's Center of Excellence for Social Change
description: The plan is to build the Center on the existing structure of Sukarya. The goal is to build the capacities of non-profits through customized thematic and project management training, to build knowledge and understanding of corporate/for-profit companies on relevant social development sector issues and build the capacities of youths by providing training/short courses directed towards social development sector requirements and provide internship opportunities. (both domestic & overseas students).

title: Donate and give a prosthesis!
description: This project delivers a prosthesis to a disability person who also has a high level of poverty, our Foundation gives all treatment and therapy needed with the implant. This program not only gives a prosthesis but addresses with mental, emotional and social trauma experienced by amputees

title: Ramadan Food Basket for Poor People of Pakistan
description: People in Sindh Province like Tharparkar and other area living under poverty line and they not even afford one time food, FRDP Planning to provide food packages to most vulnerable families of Tharparkar i.e. widows, orphans and poor families in the month of Ramadan Ul Mubarak so they can fast easily. Food packages will be distributed among the poor, deserving and miserable people.

title: Don't Just Give Them Food-Teach Them How to Get It
description: It is great to give hungry children food. It is better to teach them how to take care of their own needs. Live and Learn in Kenya International feeds over 460 children on a daily basis. With their school "shamba" garden, the children are taught how to grow their own food with the help of their parents, who tend the field. But the field is much too small for our needs. Now that we have 3 cows, we would like to buy the neighboring field to grow more vegetables for the children.

title: Volunteers for Greece
description: In order to help arriving and stranded refugees from war-torn countries and to show solidarity with the totally overwhelmed Greek society, Echo100Plus has set up a platform for volunteers coming to Greece from all over the globe. Since September 2015 we have had more than 600 volunteers from 30 different nations.

title: Veterinary care for animals of India's rural poor
description: Our Rural Animal Health Mobile project provides free veterinary treatment and advice to Rajasthan's rural poor, who depend on animals (goats, cows and buffalo) for their livelihoods. By visiting 24 villages with our mobile clinic and trained staff, TOLFA offers the only veterinary services reaching out to these remote villages. A healthy animal can keep a family from falling into poverty.

title: HIV Services for LGBT in 15 health units in Mukono
description: This Project will provide a frame-work that will ensure that MSM/LGBT have access to friendly HIV services in 15 general health units & provide avenues where MSM and LGBT are able to access information on the location and staff who provide these services within Mukono district.The regular models of HIV services delivery for the general population are not easily accessible to the MSM/LGBT communities due to stigma, discrimination, the punitive laws & the negative attitude society attach to them.

title: ECHO HUB Leros: Prepare Refugees for Integration
description: In December 2016 Echo100Plus launched the Echo-Hub, a community centre in the town of Lakki on the island of Leros, to help arriving refugees from war-torn countries prepare for the next steps of their journeys and foremost the arduous task of integration. Neither the Greek authorities nor any other NGO currently offer similar assistance to adult refugees on the island.

title: The Future of Youth & Political Engagement
description: What issues drive the youth of today? And how do they engage in politics? Orb Media's most recent story is focused on how young adults around the world perceive and participate with their governments. Focusing on countries across four continents, Orb Media conducted intensive on-the-ground reporting, data collection and analysis, and social journalism to identify and report on emerging trends associated with young adults' participation in political engagement.

title: Educate 220 underprivileged children in NOIDA
description: Sai Bal Sansar is a free non formal education centre providing midday meals at village Aghapur, Noida for the street and slum children to make them literate.It has a strength of around 220 children.  This project will provide basic education to those who have never gone to school before, because of their extreme poverty. It will take 1-2 years to mainstream the children to enable them to get admission in the regular schools that will lead them for higher education and to make their livelihood.

title: Think-before-pink
description: Table will provide a rich free booklets to every female in the all educational institutes and working places, villages and poorest sections of the societies in the project area through 10 ambulatory campaigns in a month. during campaign  Trained volunteers encourage to improve personal hygiene during her period, pregnancy, pre and post delivery also encourage for breast feeding, provide 80 female free screening test for early detection, free 10 female breast cancer treatment to poorest section.

title: Food & Water for Refugees in South Sudan
description: This project is based in Fangak County, South Sudan.  It will provide sustainable access to the most basic necessities: clean water and food through farming for families displaced by civil war, flooding, tribal violence and the current conflict in Sudan.

title: Seeds for Life Project
description: We will provide open pollinated vegetable seeds to very poor farmers in order to improve their nutrition and income in a sustainable manner.

title: To education and beyond
description: Education is key to empowering those who were once vulnerable.  Education allows them to learn, achieve and graduate to independent living, no longer at being at risk of being trafficked.  Education costs - the funds raised through this project will pay for tuition, school materials, transport and other related costs.  It will give orphans and some of the world's most vulnerable young people the opportunity of education that they have never had.

title: From street to school desk for 200 kids in Ecuador
description: ViaNinos UK will support the street outreach programme at CENIT by financing the salary of a local social worker. CENIT runs play groups in the markets of the poorest sectors of Ecuador's capital city, Quito. Volunteers and social workers identify working children and build trust with families in order to offer the chance to enter the education system.

title: Donate a counselor for 30 children at Kids Haven
description: Kids Haven in Benoni, east of Johannesburg, is home to 145 children with street connections.  Our children turn to the streets when things go wrong in their homes.  At Kids Haven, every child takes time to settle in, cope with schooling again and imagine being reconnected to their community once again.  There is no magic to make this happen, it happens through the deliberate work and care of a committed counselor who can reach the child and build the bridge to their families in the community

title: Donate for Braille Books-Help Blind children read!
description: Mitra Jyothi has now taken up the ambitious project of supplying Braille Books for visually impaired children from rural Karnataka. This shall be a select collection of 100 educational reference material for children and aims towards promoting education in the visually impaired community with more focus towards the rural poor. This is possible only with the availability of accessible reading material! Post Accelerator extending the project to get extended support to produce additional 100 books.

title: PAWS for Change: Help Roaming Dogs in Peru
description: PAWS helps reduce the suffering of roaming dogs around Cusco, Peru and addresses the issues of animal welfare and over-population, through Education, Healthcare and Sterilization. Many dogs on the streets have owners, but attitudes around animal care mean that it's common practice to let dogs roam free. Access to veterinary care in villages is limited and low incomes mean families can't afford it anyway. Our mobile clinic offers free veterinary care and sterilizations to help solve these issues.

title: Rebuilding Strong Communities in Puerto Rico
description: This project plans to rebuild homes and strengthen local economy in the town of Loiza, Puerto Rico, severely impacted by hurricanes Irma and Maria. Taller Salud, a Puerto Rican feminist grassroots organization focuses its work on helping 10 women leaders thrive to ensure Loiza's communities gain long term capacity and strength.

title: Be a Jagrik- Active and Responsible Citizenship
description: A Jagrik or Jagruk Nagrik in Hindi means aware citizen. The project motivates young people or Jagriks to own up the Constitution of India and the SDGs through a board game. The game enables young people between 14 to 30 years across India translate civic education to reflact (reflect +act) journeys  and experience real life concerns (social, political and ecological) that cannot be taught in classrooms nor acquired as a gift. It has to be experienced on the streets in daily life.

title: Rescue Suffering Animals
description: This project will rescue 300 dogs and cats abandoned by their owners and roaming the streets, a pity to behold and a danger to people when they become rabid.

title: Give 100 U.S. Patients Life-Changing Hand Surgery
description: This project will give free hand care to 100 patients in 8 U.S. cities, providing life-changing hand surgery, therapy, and resources to restore injured hands to fully-functioning hands. For these patients, access to this care means returning to work, being able to provide for their family, and having the joy of complete mobility.

title: Ramadan Appeal Protect Street Children in Pakistan
description: CPRT centres take children off the streets in Pakistan protecting them from abuse, slavery and a life of crime. Our project has been successful in 13 centres in 9 cities across the country and already transformed the lives of our children in CPRT centres by inspiring them to leave the streets and join main stream education.  Please help by donating your Zakat.

title: In-water sea turtle population study
description: In January STCC found that half of the turtles that were captured during the annual in-water survey had tumors. Most likely these are related to fybropapillomatosis. This herpes related disease is found worldwide, but the sudden high prevalence is reason for concern. We need to conduct additional research to get a better understanding of the spread and severity of the disease. But we we don't have sufficient funding.

title: Digitally Preserve 4 Historic Sites in Venezuela
description: This project will help fund our efforts to digitally preserve and archive historic sites, monuments, cultural events, and artifacts in Venezuela, including San Rafael de Mucuchies Chapel in the Andes, the Dancing Devils of Corpus Christi, a historic barrio (shanty town) in a Caracas suburb, and El Calvario Park in downtown Caracas. In addition we'll be training photographers there in order that the local community can sustain their preservation practices independently.

title: Roshdieh and Abir's Wedding Charity!
description: The Muslim American Leadership Alliance is committed to individual freedom, diversity, and Muslim American heritage. Every year, MALA presents scholarships to talented young Muslim American students like Laurel Hilbert, a sight-impaired Syrian-American who overcame teen homelessness and became a social advocate before starting college. Roshdieh has been a MALA supporter since its inception and invites her friends and family to support MALA's scholarship program in honor of her wedding!

title: Basori Village (Gambia,) Children Empowerment
description: The project is to re-integrate fifty (50) street children in to homes, prevent those at risk of entering the street, provide them with health care, reliable and relevant education, and enhance their participation in community and national development at Basori Village, The Gambia,West Africa. The project will commence in September 2018 and ends in August 2023. Project Beneficiaries Street and under-privilege children,Parents,village community, government, donors, teachers.

title: Support children and persons with Disabilities
description: Persons with disabilities (PwDs) are the most excluded and marginalized community. With 40-80 million disabled people, India has one of the highest numbers of PwDs globally (World Bank report); 69% of them live in rural areas (India Census 2011). We seek your support to provide relevant medical aid and healthcare, and improve access to greater educational and employment opportunities. We, thereby hope to enhance and empower the quality of life for 308 PwDs in 14 villages.

title: Million Dollar Smiles! :)
description: With a healthy body comes a happy mind. With this conviction, our organization is currently working for 41 Indian villages in the foothills of the Himalayas.  We transform destitute rural youth by providing them not only quality education but also medical care & nutrition - all for free. In our journey of 15 years, we have impacted over 700 children and their economically disadvantaged families. Your contribution to our cause would be deeply appreciated.

title: Congenital Heart Treatment for Mexican Children
description: Kardias enables access to high quality treatment for mexican children with congenital heart defects. We fundraise so that every Mexican child who needs it gets the best surgical treatment and attention. We do this by supporting a group of outstanding dedicated doctors in a innovative  hybrid model combining  work in the public sector and the private sector which allows us to enlarge the volume of children we assist and to improve the quality of every surgery.

title: From vulnerable towns to University
description: From 100 children in Mexico, only 13 reach University. Peraj Mexico works through one-on-one mentoring sessions between University students and children from public elementary schools.  For 10 months both mentors and mentees are involved in activities that help develop their social skills. So far, we have worked with 27,000 kids and 27,000 mentors all over the country. We want to go further and take the program to 3 indigenous towns in Veracruz, Oaxaca and Chiapas.

title: Support Families Searching for their Disappeared
description: The Project aims to empower the families of the disappeared, contribute to the grieving process and give them tools to fully understand the forensic investigation process. Through an innovative educational system based in popular education, EMAF will implement workshops to instruct organizations and relatives of missing persons in topics often considered technical such as case documentation, ante mortem information, search methods, chain of custody, osteological and genetical analysis.

title: Conserving Wild Asian Elephants
description: The Asian elephant is as enigmatic as it is endangered.  With a wild population of perhaps less than 30,000 globally, it occupies some of most biodiverse ecosystems on the planet. Despite having lived alongside people for thousands of years, wild Asian elephants are often mysterious and misunderstood.  Our mission is to better understand wild elephants, the lives of people who live near them, and facilitate coexistence with these magnificent giants of Asia through science and education.

title: School Support for 130 orphan children-Addis Ababa
description: Summary  Orphan children are under served due to lack of parental care, as a result, children are forced to work and live on the street to fulfill their basic needs.
