They are likely to drop out or have low academic performance. So that, our organization committed to improve the academic performance by purchasing education materials including school uniform, facilitating tutor class and providing supplementary snack for 80 orphan children residing in the slum villages of Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.

title: Enhancing Climate Change Knowledge Management
description: Sustainable Environmental Development Watch plans to design a communications strategy and toolkit to address barriers in integrating climate change in Kenya.  This project will contribute toward better articulating climate information, reduce knowledge gaps and provide understanding of the benefits of the different inter-related roles in carrying out climate actions by the Kenyan people, state and business sector.

title: Trauma Healing for 100's of Syrian Refugee Youth
description: More than half of Syrian refugee youth in Jordan suffer severe psychological distress from the impact of violent conflict, displacement and loss. We will serve over 100 children and youth living in refugee camps through specialised support. We integrate body therapy, music practice and empowerment trainings through the martial art capoeira to bring support and hope to these communities and work towards a peaceful future.

title: Promote Deaf Literacy in Nigeria
description: This project will promote deaf literacy for deaf children in Nigeria, increase access to indigenous signed language for deaf education through signed language documentation using technology-based innovation, and the implementation of Early Intervention Program. It will also save the endangered indigenous signed language varieties.

title: Mindanao Refugee Relief Fund
description: This project will provide housing, food, medicine and livelihood support to 1,200 families who have left their homes and lived in the town centers or nearby cities being displaced by a confluence of natural and man-made disasters among them, the longest-running communist insurgency in the world instigated by the New People's Army, Muslim extremism and massive typhoons happening more frequently as well as long dry spells caused by El Nino weather events.

title: A call  for zero forced captivity  and abductions.
description: The vulnerability of innocent girls in  war areas and the forced  life choices have ruined many lives and hopes. Girls have become victims of greed, power hunger  and abused for their sex. Beats in a jungle   explores girl abduction and  effect of this senseless act. It inspires a girl's fight to escape  captivity amidst treachery, remorselessness. It seeks to restore hope and living on despite ruins and encourages a never give up resolution. An inspiration to girl child powerful instincts.

title: Sending pupils to secondary school in Madagascar
description: The project aims to improve school performance of pupils finishing primary school for secondary school in isolated area in the Middle West of Madagascar. It will provide a supply of solar kits. Once home, they will be able in the evening to do homework, revision of lessons and exercises to be well prepared for the secondary school entrance exam. 120 little girls and boys in three hamlets are concerned. In addition, they will receive school bags for notebooks, pens and books for the school year.

title: Rebuilding Shree Saraswoti School, Helambu, Nepal
description: Three years ago, the earthquakes in Nepal destroyed hundreds of schools, many of which have been replaced by 'Temporary Learning Centres'. The Rotary Club of Yeovil, U.K., with its partners, Mondo Challenge Foundation, School in a Bag and the Helambu Education Livelihood Partnership, in conjunction with Rotary District 1200 are rebuilding Shree Saraswoti School in Helambu Province, Nepal.

title: Build Cambodia's First Nature Discovery Center
description: This project will build educational exhibits and installations, as well as equip a wildlife cinema & science classroom for a new Nature Discovery Center opening soon in Siem Reap, Cambodia. The Nature Discovery Center will provide high-quality environmental education and awareness raising to 3,100 Cambodian teachers, monks, and young people in its first year. The center will use the latest media technology and interactive nature discovery to inspire a new generation of nature lovers in Cambodia.

title: Empower 150 girls victims of violence in Uganda
description: The project will address the issue of sexual and domestic violence in Gulu district (Northern Uganda) through community dialogue and advocacy and will help 150 girls who are or have been victimized through education, counseling, art therapy and economic empowerment.

title: The Carry Bag
description: We will put together a bag with all the basic needs for a newborn baby on the run. In part, the Carry bag will be filled with the products collected in the Netherlands and we'll complete it with locally purchased products from your donations. To make this bag complete we need 28,- euro's for each bag. Our goal is to fill 500 bags.

title: Restore Toilets for 400 Disabled pupils in Uganda
description: This project will build two blocks of accessible toilets, five toilets per block in two schools for younger disabled pupils in Wakiso District central Uganda, hopefully this will promote inclusive quality education for younger disabled pupils among able boarded pupils. Such accessible toilets will reduce risks of disease infections to disabled pupils, hence, reducing their healthy risks resemble those of their known disable peers. Apparently disabled pupils will enjoy quality services in society

title: Ramadan
description: Because we Carry will prepare the food for the refugees during Ramadan in campus Kara Tepe on the Greek Island Lesvos.  Because they lost almost everything, we would like to give them a little bit of hope and our love. The preparations for Ramadan 2018 are in full swing and we have put together a super-international menu for this special month. The cost of this month of awareness, gratitude and sharing is 54.000,- dollar which is a major expense for us. All contributions are very welcome!

title: Empower 2000 local Rwandan Farmers & Restore 100ha
description: This project aims to empower 2,000 poor farmers in Eastern Rwanda. We aim to plant 28,000 indigenous, agroforestry and fruit trees , provide manure and thereby increase income through agriculture and small livestock rearing. Provide regular support, mentorship and capacity building in managing community institutions, climate change adaptation strategies, forest and landscape restoration and establish sustainable community-managed incentive systems for farmland restoration.

title: Provide School Supplies Kits for Children in Ghana
description: Child Rights International is one of our partners that helps us implement Cocoa Life, our cocoa sustainability program. This project will provide kits for young children between 2 and 12 years old, as well as teaching and learning materials for schools in Cocoa Life communities in Ghana. The kits, which contain books, pens and pencils, will enhance children's learning experience and support them to develop to their fullest psychological, social and physical potentials.

title: Support for Families Displaced by Insurgency
description: This project will provide food, livelihood and shelter support for 700 families affected by the Communist New People's Army violence in Zamboanga del Norte.

title: Provide Rainwater Tanks for 23 Kenyan Families
description: This project provides funding for 14 new groups consisting of 265 women to participate in Path From Poverty's micro-savings and rainwater catchment tank access program in rural Kenya. With matching financial support from Path From Poverty-US, the women have set a target to purchase 23 of the 10,000L tanks in 2018. These tanks will provide clean water for their families/communities and save over 40,000 hours each year in walking (with 40lb jerry cans) to and from water sources.

title: Autism - recognising ability not the disability
description: Since 2012 the Anna Kennedy Online Autism Awareness Charity created a legendary show 'Autism's Got Talent'. Unlike other charities, this show is a star studded spectacular event will showcase amazingly talented performances by adults and children with autism.The performers consist of singers, actors, musicians and dance troupes, who fly the flag for autism and show what people with autism are capable of and celebrating the diverse talents of children and adults with autism.

title: HELP A CHILD WITH DISABILITY REACH THEIR POTENTIAL
description: The aim of this project is to improve and promote the quality of life of children and youth with disabilities in Malawi by providing them with assistive devices and technologies that will help them to maximize their skill development, independence and integration into community life thereby reducing dependency and poverty. The devices will be used for special needs education, activities of daily living,medical rehabilitation and vocational training.This project will affect more than 300 children

title: HOPE HOUSE
description: Hope House is a temporary rehabilitation Centre for survivors of Domestic violence and Sexual Assault. Hope House was launched in 2008, it provides shelter, feeding, medical care. Over 400 girls and women since inception facing a wide spectrum of challenges come into this facility discouraged, helpless, broken, and sometimes depressed but leave after a minimum stay of 12 weeks empowered, re-energized, and ready to take in the world.

title: Making peace through music
description: Through this project "Time of Peace Foundation" wants to develop an introductory course in music in order to prepare our children in vocal techniques and teaching them to play an instrument as an strategy for carrying our a peace culture in an enviroment of violence and poverty.

title: Empowering 80 people with disabilities in Iraq
description: Some of the most vulnerable and neglected Syrian refugees and Yezidi IDP's (Internally Displaced People) in Northern Iraq are families who have a family member with a disability. Operation Mercy empowers people with disabilities and their families by providing assistive devices, physical therapy and emotional resilience programs. Currently, Operation Mercy serves 80 clients and their families.

title: Empowering Women to Enhance Livelihood in Nepal
description: Health and economic prosperity are interlinked with each other, resulting towards an improved socio-economic and livelihood status of a family. Bajra Samaj Nepal (BSN), working in remote rural areas of Ramechhap District of Nepal, focuses on supporting the underserved and underprivileged women groups. Organizing health camps, raising awareness on cervical cancer, supporting women for income generation & access to finance through micro-credit are the major activities focused through this project.

title: Emergency support for Palestinians
description: Our local Palestinian team is on the ground in Gaza, and here is their most urgent request: fuel. Fuel to power hospitals, water pumps, sanitation vehicles, and sewage drains. We will provide fuel for essential services to more than 327,000 Gazans  over the next three months in Nuseirat and Al Mughraqa, as well as food vouchers for 2,000 families in Middle Gaza and Rafa. Will you help?

title: Help 30 women entrepreneurs recover their business
description: REN is requesting donations to provide emergency funding to women-owned micro and small enterprises affected by the political conflict affecting Nicaragua. Some women entrepreneurs lost their merchandise with the lootings and are not able to sell their products or services because of the instability. For example, Ivonne Noguera's house and business, an event venue located in Masaya, was burned to the ground this past Saturday leaving her family without a home or an income.

title: Reconciling Youth and Police in Bujumbura, Burundi
description: The current crisis in Burundi which began in 2015 has involved youth demonstrators in opposition to the government with considerable retaliation by the security forces. The social structure of the society, particularly in Bujumbura where most of the demonstrations occurred, has fractured social cohesion. Through workshops and dialogues, this project will bring reconciliation between the youth of different political parties and between the youth demonstrators and the security forces.

title: School Infrastructure in Ghana
description: Child Rights International is one of our partners that helps us implement Cocoa Life, our cocoa sustainability program. By funding this project, you will help renovate and build school infrastructure such as classrooms, furniture, sanitary facilities and a kindergarten for children in Cocoa Life communities in Ghana.

title: Help To Provide Uniform for 200 Poor Slum Students
description: This project will support the poor slum  students those who are managing their studies with only one set of uniform and few note books for their all subjects. Most of the students are dropouts within their elementary school level due to insufficient of uniforms and schooling materials. Now with the support of the donation, We will provide two sets of uniform cloth, notebook -5, pen -1, geometry box-1 and a school bag for every poor students. It increases the confidence and interest in learning.

title: Youth-Led Hurricane Philanthropy & Service - USVI
description: Through the Jr. Angels Program at the Community Foundation of the Virgin Islands, high school students will be mentored through engaging in youth-led disaster philanthropy and community service - empowering them to positively impact their communities, which are recovering from Hurricanes Irma and Maria.

title: Healthy food classes and training in Medellin
description: Via Cocina teaches motivated low income Colombians and Venezuelans in Medellin to transform local produce into sugar-free, non-fried healthy international dishes: combined with personalized small business training, participants combat diet-related health problems with normally unavailable high quality affordable food in low income neighborhoods. We've been renovating for months, exhausted all credit, and need a little help to finish the spaces where participants can cook and sell to the public.

title: Economic Empowerment of Girls and Single Mothers
description: Traditional and legal norms for property rights and land tenure in this area give little room for women to contribute in economic development.  Above 70% of single mothers have no vocational skills for financial empowerment and live below 60 dollars a month. This has led to financial difficulties for most homes. This project is an effort to work with single women in poverty alleviation actions. The women will be train on the production of different household detergents for economic empowerment.

title: Give Medical Care to 3500 Venezuelan Indigenous
description: During the month of August 2018 a group of 40 doctors, including specialists and medical volunteers, assisted more than 950 people from 10 indigenous communities of La Gran Sabana  in Venezuela. All epidemiological data and biological samples necessary to determine the health problems of the population will be collected and the necessary medicines will be given to treat the detected diseases.We'll repeat the medical mission every 6 months. The next one will be during the month of April 2019.

title: Improving Self-Belief in Young New Zealanders
description: New Zealand has some of the worse statistics for young people in the OECD, including the highest rate of youth suicide.  Graeme Dingle Foundation plans to trial and evaluate a community referral programme aimed at building resilience and self-belief of New Zealand teenagers, equipping them with the tools to face any obstacle.

title: Water, Health & Women's Empowerment- Guinea Bissau
description: This project will supply rural communities in one of the poorest regions of Guinea Bissau with the tools they need to reduce poverty, water-borne diseases and increase gender equality and social empowerment. The project will install clean water wells, build latrines, establish market gardens and train young people and women on how to maintain these resources and take ownership of their community's development. Your donations will play a vital role in transforming the lives of these people.

title: Restore healthcare to rural communities in Ghana
description: In Ghana, many rural areas are saddled with major healthcare problems that deters development and nation building.  Either healthcare facilities are absent or difficult to access and/or personnel are absent. Only very few rural inhabitants use the healthcare facilities available in the District because of poverty.  DoctorsAct visits rural communities across the country providing free professional medical care with the aim of meeting the acute healthcare needs of these deprived inhabitants.

title: Help Save a Pet's Life
description: If your pet needed veterinary care to save their life, what would you do?  This project will help Frankie's Friends provide life-saving and life-enhancing emergency and/or specialty veterinary care for pets whose families cannot afford the full cost of treatment.  You can help save the life of a pet in need and keep them with the family that loves them.

title: Help us eradicate Homelessness in Mexico City
description: Mi Valedor is Mexico's first street paper generating a legitimate income for homeless and at-risk populations, following in the footsteps of the UK's 'The Big Issue'. The magazine works as a social tool to facilitate access to opportunities. At the Creative Center, we offer a variety of workshops for the vendors, which focus on recovering the self esteem and social skills that are often a symptom of social exclusion. Through these workshops, the vendors contribute to the editorial content.

title: Preserve the El Cano Archaeological Park & museum
description: The El Cano Foundation achieved it's goal of reopening the the El Cano Archaeological Museum in April 2019 with an exhibit of artifacts discovered between 2010 and 2016 in the over 1000-year-old necropolis. Now the project moves to the stage of preservation and maintenance of the museum, exhibit and artifacts. There is still work to do in and around the building as well as the exhibit, work that was left undone due to lack of funds. Continued investigation of the site is planned for 2020.

title: Train rural women of Karnataka in Business Skills
description: Industree is committed to building sustainable livelihoods for rural producers in India and empowering them. Industree's project in Karnataka involves aiding rural women in setting up and running micro-enterprises to produce goods for the apparel sector. A key element of the intervention includes imparting business skills and social empowerment training to the women, so that they are able to manage the enterprises themselves, and develop their communities.

title: Soil care in western Kenya using Vetiver Grass
description: Population pressure leads to cultivating more unstable land, while making the best use of that land.  With climate change rain tends to come in heavier downpours, leading to more erosion and more run off.  Run off causes more flooding.  Farmers need a method of caring for their soil that is based on using of local resources.  Vetiver Grass is very effective in this.  We want to increase the number of farmers caring for their soil by making Vetiver Grass more available with relevant teaching.

title: Send refugee children to school in Uganda
description: Every child in the world should attend 200 days of school each year. This year, 80,000 refugee children in Uganda attended 0 days of schooling. This will change, because with your support, Vijana Corps will deliver free education to 500 children in five refugee settlements across northern Uganda. Vijana Corps has designed a Mobile digital classroom for accelerated computer assisted learning. The kit will rotate weekly classes between camps to deliver quality primary schooling and edutainment.

title: Sustainable agriculture for small farming families
description: We propose to revolutionize the culture of food production and demonstrate the practical and economic viability of organic agriculture. By implementing productive Agroforestry Systems for family farmers in rural communities located around the Serra do Brigadeiro State Park, we will blend agriculture with forestry. We hope to promote the transition from from harmful agriculture practices and foster techniques to produce healthy, safe, pesticide-free, and environmentally-friendly produce.

title: KSTR Wildlife Bridges & Reforestation
description: Our Reforestation & Wildlife Bridge Programs both help connect fragmented forest areas, improving safe passage and habitats for the animals, including the endangered squirrel monkey. Our current Reforestation Project aims to plant trees in the Pacific Coast of Costa Rica that will serve as a biological corridors. KSTR is also building Wildlife Bridges in more developed areas to protect wildlife and mitigate the risk of getting hit by cars and electrocutions.

title: School Gardens & Skills Training For 2000 Gambians
description: Grace Foundation Gambia provides free meals, school gardens and skills training in schools to mainly 2000 poorest girl children and youths in the West Coast region who turn up in schools daily on hungry stomach and made to engage in street trading where they face child trafficking, girl marriage, teenage pregnancy etc in order to feed at home. Your donations will go into very needy infrastructures like school gardens, kitchens, starter packs, learning materials, dining hall etc.

title: Help children living with HIV in northern Thailand
description: The project will provide three years of vital funding for the education of orphans and children infected or affected by HIV in rural communities adjacent to the Thai-Myanmar border with whom Rejoice Charity has worked closely for many years. Without help these very disadvantaged young people are often forced to drop out of education. Providing just a small sum enables the child to attend school whilst allowing them to grow up within their own ethnic community

title: Reducing the practice of Female Genital Mutilation
description: The main objective of the project is to reduce the practice of FGM in the targeted areas through applying massive, integrated and inclusive community mobilization project. The target is all groups in population but specific targeting applies to mothers, Traditional Birth Attendants (who are also FGM practitioners) and the youth. This is because of the findings we have from past research conducted as mothers need more priority in awareness creation that other community groups in relative terms.

title: Support a class of at-risk South African children
description: If only you could see the smile and the joy in the faces of the children that participate in Youth Potential South Africa - YOUPSA's programs here in rural South Africa - you would understand what kind of a difference your support makes. With your help we bring weekly Creative Youth Empowerment programs to Grades 4 - 12, serving 16 different classes throughout the year. Supporting a class equips each student with unique learning experiences that reaches beyond the classroom & into the community.

title: Subsistence to sustainability to 1000 women
description: This project will show the women & girls the way to build income step by step by micro-saving, micro-gardening, micro-crafting, and investing in one long term tree and an annual crop to have regular supply of nutrition, which saves health expenses and goes to micro-saving &  girl child education.     This also builds confidence in them to create their own development and prosperity rather than depending upon government; which ultimately will create greater governance, and self-rule.

title: Beautiful Wrinkles: Support Elderly Widows
description: Elohim Development Association is working to support a vulnerable elderly population in the community of Bombo, Uganda. During political conflict, these widows fled their land and are now destitute, living in dilapidated houses. Through the Beautiful Wrinkles Project, Elohim supports them with medical care, legal aid, and nutritional meals. Now the Beautiful Wrinkles Project strives to improve their poor living conditions by building 5 simple houses.

title: SAFE HOME 4 ORPHANS &VULNERABLE CHILDREN NIGERIA
description: Hope Rising Homes Foundation is about providing safe homes for Orphans, Vulnerable and At-Risk Children. Our goal is to provide hope for these children so they can attain a brighter future and a vision of life beyond their present vulnerable situations. As our name is, we hope to give them a better life.

title: 'Closer to Home'  Cancer Care Mobile Support Units
description: The  Mobile Support Units offer patients In Wales more than lifesaving treatment; they are a haven where patients can get the support they need without the stress and expense of travelling long distances to hospital. People in Wales face challenges  such as rurality, deprivation and poor care access.  Tenovus Cancer Care, a Welsh Charity , already operates two units which deliver chemotherapy and associated treatments in local communities and is seeking to meet increasing demand with more units.

title: Give a future to over 1000 indigenous youth
description: We reduce illiteracy and poverty levels in over 1000 indigenous children and youth in La Guajira -Colombia by providing holistic education in rural schools and vulnerable communities without access to education every year.      Our students write books,  handcrafted paintings, audiovisual works and compose music with ancestral and modern instruments, that are shared in our web platform and exhibitions worldwide to improve their human and economic development and disseminate social inclusion.

title: Educate One Empower Thousands 2018
description: Our aim is to raise a total of  $6,500 so that 10 women can access the Leadership Academy. We women Myanmar has just become an independent organization. Alumni Num Aye is now Director Myanmar and she needs your help more than. We women's main goal is to build a critical mass of women in Myanmar which are currently still underrepresented in leadership positions, and politics. We consider education a tool of empowerment that is essential for these women to achieve their goals and aspirations.

title: Support 125 mothers of disabled children in Uganda
description: Imagine your mother, sister or Aunt being chased out her matrimonial home living on her own as a single mother having to work extra harder doing all sorts of odd jobs to feed and care for herself and children just because of giving birth to a child with a disability.There are many such mothers in Uganda facing similar challenges; living in hopeless lives and in abject poverty and just need to be empowered with skills for sustainable economic development. AICOD trains mothers in mushroom growing.

title: McKinley Barrier Free Park
description: Curing ignorance through play, the Fraser First Booster Club was formed in 2010, with the goal to raise funds to build Fraser and Macomb County's first-of-it's kind barrier-free park and playground. Once completed, this innovative and inclusive play environment will be specifically designed to meet the needs of children with sensory, development & physical challenges. The benefits of barrier-free play include fostering physical and cognitive strengths, decision-making abilities for all children.

title: Send 200 Filipino kids to better daycare centers
description: The project will improve 6 (originally only 4 were targeted) ill-equipped daycare centers in poor rural communities located in La Union, Northern Philippines.  Through this, 200 poor Filipino children age 3 to 5 years old will have free access to learning facilities that will ignite their interest & love for knowledge & learning. Improvements include classroom repairs; creating libraries with books & toys; & provision of audio-visual equipment such as televisions & educational videos.

title: School Uniforms for children in Rural Africa
description: A problem in South Africa is that children, whose parents can't afford a uniform  are not allowed into to Primary School. We believe that uniforms empower children to carry out their dreams, because something as small as lack of a uniform can often be a deterring factor in the lives of children in rural communities. Dress 4 Success school uniform project equips a child with full school clothing as well as basic school supplies & enable them to go to school with confidence & self respect.

title: Provide Water to 50 Families in Nepal!
description: This year, Conscious Impact will build a 40,000 liter water storage tank in the village of Takure in rural Nepal to provide sufficient water to more than 50 families. This project will triple the current storage capacity and replace 20+ year old broken water tanks. Takure was devastated in the 2015 earthquake, losing 99% of homes in the area. This project will meet the community's #1 priority need, and will reduce wait times for water, keep children in school and keep families healthy and happy.

title: Sports for Girls in Gaza: The Big Ride 2018
description: Successive Israeli attacks on Gaza have traumatized children & caused psychological problems. Physical activity improves mental and physical health. After a successful pilot project, The Big Ride for Palestine is teaming up with MECA to raise funds for girls sports in Gaza.  Ride with us for Freedom, Justice & Equality for the Palestinians! Sign up for the Big Ride (www.thebigride4palestine.com) and create an individual fundraising pages by clicking on "Start a Fundraiser"!

title: Reconstruction Of Animal Shelter in Latvia
description: This project will build a multi-functional Animal Shelter in south-east of Latvia, providing veterinary care and shelter to abandoned dogs and cats, place for educational seminars and workshops regarding animal welfare, place where neutering and microchiping campaigns will be carried out.

title: Help us save Thembi the poached White rhino
description: The aim of this project is to treat 'Thembi', a White rhino cow who was poached in 2010 and had received very limited veterinary care since. She has a horrific wound where poachers hacked off her horns. This extremely tough and resilient rhino has had two calves since the attack.  She will still require on-going treatment for some months to come as her facial wound is extensive. These treatments are exceedingly expensive (sometimes upwards of US$ 2500).

title: Build an eLearning Center in rural Malawi!
description: Mbando is an off-the-grid rural village in Malawi - with no electricity, no Internet, and limited mobile coverage. The people suffer from a lack of educational learning resources, that have kept them in poverty. Abundance is helping to address this by building a solar-powered eLearning center using RACHEL and KEEPODS providing offline versions of the world's best free educational websites, which are updated with the latest content regularly. Help build this rural eLearning center in Malawi!

title: 10 Years, 10 Countries, 10 Voices
description: Let's Dance International Frontiers plans to celebrate the tenth birthday of the annual dance festival by presenting diverse dance performers from 10 different countries. This project will allow young and emerging dancers to perform at an international level and give them the opportunity to share their creativity to a wider audience. The festival aims to make leading dance companies from around the world more accessible, bringing people together through dance.

title: Reduce Hunger & Food Waste in Trinidad and Tobago
description: Food wastage and hunger are two major social problems in Trinidad & Tobago. Nourish TT uses an app to move surplus food from the supply chain directly to charities who serve meals to the needy and vulnerable.

title: Empower 100 Women Entrepreneurs in Eastern Congo
description: This project will provide a yearlong training program and grants to 100 women from some of the poorest households in Eastern Congo to become entrepreneurs and enable them to build sustainable livelihoods for themselves and their families.

title: Plastic Pollution Free India
description: Besides Women Economic Development, our dream is to see Plastic Pollution Free Nation.  India is one of the most damaged country environmentally and Plastic Pollution is a major threat in every cities, river and seas in India. We are sure our campaigns and project would bring the change.     1) Awareness about the hazards created by discarded plastics   2) Available Alternatives to the Disposable Plastics     3) Awarding a new life to plastic waste through reprocessing

title: Completing the Craft Center for 500 Women in Ghana
description: ASIGE women baskets is the innovation that uses straw  and dye to design colourful baskets for local and international markets. This project will will create sustainable employment for over 1000 women the value chain and contribute to eliminating poverty  completing. AWB,  therefore wants to build craft centre/park where we can produce quality baskets/crafts and also serve as an International tourist destination in Ghana. This project is the future of the rural women of Bolgatanga Ghana

title: SOCAN (Solution for Cardiac Afflicted Needy)
description: Nearly 85% of India's Population cannot afford expensive cardiac surgery.90% of them can become normal with expensive cardiac surgery.SOCAN is a holistic project that  includes Creating Awareness & Camp Detection, Travel & Shelter, Preparation & Performance at Public Health Centre.Impact Study on Individual & Society is by periodic follow-up.Multisource funding supported 300 Cardiac Surgeries.  < Rs 72,000 Annual Income is the eligibility criteria."Quality care & Accountability" is the Slogan.

title: Environmental trips for school children in Kenya
description: This project will provide the opportunity for underprivileged pupils from our partner schools - the next generation of conservationists - to view wildlife in its natural habitat and to learn to see it as an asset rather than as a threat or a potential meal.

title: Foster Social Integration of 8 Bosnian Teenager
description: The Project Sailing4Youth aims at promoting social integration and engagement, peaceful conflict management and education of 8 Bosnian teenagers from destitute families. The project is centered around a week-long sailing trip, putting the teenagers into the confined space of a boat. Here they will form a temporary community where everyone will have to contribute to maintaining a peaceful and safe environment.

title: Access to Adventure for People with Disabilities
description: People with disabilities often report isolation as one of the greatest challenges they face. Waypoint provides access to adventure education opportunities for youth and adults with disabilities. This project will launch a canoeing program to include people with disabilities for whom kayaking is not an option.

title: Connect Rural Uganda School to the World
description: This project has provided an e-library in a secondary school in remote Uganda. There is no facility like this in the entire district.  The community-wide impact will empower the 650 boarding students, the local hospital, neighboring schools and local residents; a total of 2,000-3,000 persons annually.  This wonderful facility still needs more books and computers.  This opens up a world of knowledge to the community and help students compete for scholarships.

title: Empowering People With Disabilities Through Nature
description: ACCESS NATURE creates safe, educational and enjoyable FREE nature programs for the disabled and disadvantaged. Spending time in nature improves mood, energy, stress and well being. Our goal is to provide programing and education to those we serve, so that they too can gain the benefits of  nature. Currently we work with the intellectually challenged, mentally ill, and non-English speaking immigrants. We have also launched a free educational workshop to teach other groups to duplicate our work.

title: Support children infected and affected by HIV/AIDS
description: Due to social stigma and lack of awareness, children infected/ affected by AIDS are often neglected and abused - worst case uncared and left to die. Since 1998, Society for Serving Humanity (SSH) has been working on community-based rehabilitation of PLHAs (people living with HIV/ AIDS) - particularly children. We want your help to strengthen and scale our project to ensure quality care and support for these children in Dindigul and Namakkal districts of Tamil Nadu, India.

title: FEED 75 CHILDREN IN KENYA TO KEEP THEM IN SCHOOL
description: Victory Foundation Programme's plan for the 75 children of Mkuru Kwa Njenga, Kenya for 2018, is to provide food so as to increase retention, completion, free the children from hunger, improve their health and nutritional needs, to improve attention and concentration levels hence improving academic performance  through provision of quality education and free feeding to the children admitted, empowering them for sustainable livelihood.

title: Village to School
description: Going by the adage that 'childhood should be a journey, not a race'  the John Martyn Memorial School (JMMS) imparts basic primary education upto Class 5 in an enlightened & nurturing environment. Set in the foothills of the Himalayas, JMMS provides education to 1st generation learners of 20 villages. The all round development empowers the children to spread their wings as their world is opened to digital classrooms, exploration & travel while  they remain strongly connected to their roots.

title: Water 4 Life
description: Donate to help us bring clean water and make a difference in the lives of the children in Kasoa and their community.    What is a borehole?  A borehole is a deep hole drilled in the ground that acts as a well and provides water.  Why a borehole?  A borehole will provide clean and accesible water to people that do not have access to a public water supply.  Who needs a borehole?  Over 800 children at Savior Childrens Foundation in Kasoa, Ghana, West Africa for bathing, cooking, and basic health.

title: Women's Rights in  28  Villages Cameroon Africa
description: . This project will upgrade the existing health care and educational systems for women and girls in 28 rural villages in NW Cameroon, through skill training,  social economic development, women's rights and gender equity.  . It will also resolve the need for the JRCCA MPC and Urgent Care Center.  The urgent care center, school and meetings can be held indoors with the upgrade of the guest house!

title: Help 15 Girls in bali Graduate From High School
description: Many girls living in poverty may stop going to school, so they can work to help their parents and provide foods for their families, which leaves them without literacy and numeracy skills they need to further their careers. YKIP plans to provide a 3-year scholarship for 15 girls from disadvantaged families in Bali to complete their 12-year education and graduate from senior high school. The scholarship cost will include school fees, uniform, school supplies, daily allowances, and a workshop.

title: Help Educate 150 Disabled Children in India
description: The Center for Inclusive and Vocational Education (CIVE) provides all round special educational and therapeutic inputs to the children availing this service. The center is run on the lines of a school and Individualized Educational Programmes (IEP) are drawn up for each child which is periodically evaluated. The role of parents is given much emphasis as they are closely involved throughout the training program.

title: Resource Centres for Adolescent Girls in Warangal
description: Setting up resource centres for adolescent girls in 15 villages of Warangal will help them to develop wholly and be empowered citizens. The idea is to enable adolescent girls to translate knowledge, skills and attitudes into specific behaviours to tackle life's challenges. To function as strong women by breaking the social barriers, young girls are taught life skills, and are supported with their education, cycles, stationery, in a conducive environment where learning is fun!

title: Help 52 HIV affected kids go to school in India!
description: In Virudhunagar, Tamil Nadu, India, HIV still carries the weight of stigma and exclusion. Children affected by HIV (infected themselves or with an infected relative) usually come from poor and marginalised families; often their mothers cannot afford to send them to school. Education is free, but school supplies are too expensive. With a focus on girls, this project will provide school supplies to 52 children. It will directly impact their education and their family's quality of life.

title: Help 30 Young People Learn To Code in Turkey
description: You can Help 30 Young People Learn To Code in Turkey. Your support will directly enable us to provide free coding classes to youth living in a socioeconomically deprived neighbourhood. The project aims to build practical skills to succeed in entering the tech workforce, to offer an opportunity to earn their livelihoods and stand on their own.

title: Young Carers activity fund - Northamptonshire
description: Young Carers are children as young as 5 who take on responsibility for helping to look after someone (usually a family member) who has a long-term illness or disability.  This could include a physical disability, learning disability, mental health problem or substance misuse issue.  We know that many Young Carers miss out on socialising  due to their caring commitments want to provide more activities for Young Carers to give them a chance to meet other Young Carers in a similar situation to them

title: Educate and Feed 100 Orphaned Children in Uganda
description: Randi child care junior orphanage school provides care for 100 orphans with educational and scholastic materials  (books,pens,pencils,uniform, school fees, shoes... and it will also provide health care and free meals to 100 underprivileged children of  Butebo District in Eastern region  in Uganda so that they may be able to develop their educational standard. This project helps distressed children get better opportunities to be educated and contribute in the development of the community.

title: Help 100 women suffering from violence in Nepal
description: The project will provide emergency mental health and psychosocial support to 100 Nepalese women and girls with mental health issues who were subjected to violence and who have subsequently been abandoned in the streets.  We will provide counselling, therapeutic services and legal support to the women and girls. We will facilitate them to experience recovery and reintegrate them back in their own family and community to lead an independent and quality life.

title: HIV Prevention Drop-in Centre For Uganda's LGBT
description: The project will acquire premises on a renewable lease to provide on spot and community outreach HIV/AIDs counselling, testing, and consumables distribution to 300 LGBT key populations in Eastern Uganda. Triumph Uganda plans to rent premises on a 2 year lease which is renewable, hire an LGBT friendly professional medical worker to provide on spot HIV/AIDS testing and also make available condoms and lubricants for peer educators' continuous distribution to LGBT peers to fight HIV among them.

title: Safe Haven for Rohingya Refugee Children
description: Rohingya from Rakhaine State - Myanmar became the biggest humanitarian crisis in the 21st Century. Since August, 2017 they have faced violence and been forced to leave everything behind. Until now, hundreds of thousands have fled their birthplace. The JAAGO Safe Haven Project (SHP) aims to support the physical and mental well-being of these disenfranchised children by providing them with a safe space where they can engage in regular childhood social experiences, learning and emotional healing.

title: Project Nanhi Kali- for the girl child
description: Project Nanhi Kali is India's largest programme that enables disadvantaged girls to complete 10 years of schooling.The project provides 360 degree educational support to girls in government schools from Class 1-10. Nanhi Kali works to increase enrollment and retention of girls via a three-pronged strategy that includes academic, material and social support. Since inception, the project has supported over 350,000 underprivileged girls and at present is reaching out to 150,000 girls across India.

title: Scholarships for low income girls
description: We seek to bring education to low income girls through our scholarship program.  From 1991, we have served 16,194 girls and 12,573 families.  The project is currently providing scholarships to 702 students.

title: Tapping Entrepreneur Women's Potential
description: We train entrepreneur women in managerial and personal initiative skills. Assisting them to improve their businesses or transform ideas into enterprises. We have supported over 30,000 Mexican women to realize their potential, increase their income through managerial capacities, and gain confidence to end cycles of violence and poverty. This project intends to fund the training of 60 women, aiding them to start a healthier life through business development and self-fulfillment.

title: Keep Balinese Alive for Tomorrow's Children
description: The Balinese language underpins the unique culture of Bali. In some parts of Bali the language is still alive, but island-wide the Balinese Cultural Agency said that only 25% of Balinese can still speak the language. We are trying to reverse the decline while there is still a solid base of speakers with a Balinese cultural wiki, named as the 2018 International Linguapax Award winner. We need your help to take the wiki to the next level. Together we can save this language for tomorrow's children.

title: Emergency Response to the Ebola Outbreak in DRC
description: One week after the most recent Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) was declared over, the government confirmed new cases of the deadly virus in North Kivu. International Medical Corps' Emergency Response Team (ERT) was already in DRC responding to the most recent outbreak, in Equateur Province. The ERT is now working in North Kivu with the Ministry of Health to help with infection prevention, monitoring and surveillance, and building local response capacity.

title: A podcast celebrating global development's women
description: The GlobalDevWomen podcast and radio hour empowers women and girls to rock in the global social impact industry! Our show pairs aspiring women leaders with dynamic women at the peak of their careers, to share in a unique mentoring session with exponential benefits. This project is a win-win-win: diverse women leaders are recognized; promising women receive mentoring; and healthy mentoring practices are demonstrated for others to replicate.

title: Gift Freedom to 500 Victims of Sex Trafficking
description: Trafficking of persons is a global phenomenon that adversely affects millions of human lives. It not only undermines rule of law and human rights but also constitutes the most heinous crime against humanity especially women and children. The projects aims at working with law enforcement to rescue women and girls trapped in abuse and exploitation. Restore lives and dignity of those rescued and deliver justice to them by ensuring effective prosecution which will prevent trafficking of many others.

title: CHETANA
description: CHETANA is a special school working with differently-able children. The school has been providing financial and mental support to 50 mentally retarded children. it was academically recognized since 2nd of March, 2001.  Integrated approaches have been adopted for the protection of the children through different campaign program in different blocks of Murshidabad with the support of National Trust of Government of India, State level authority and Dept. of Mass Education Extension Dept.

title: Chance to live for 100 000 dogs from Ukraine
description: Over 100,000 of stray dogs live on the streets of Ukrainian cities, and the destiny of these animals depends on each of us and our position!  This is unacceptable! These animals must be protected and treated humanely! Yet it is impossible to accomplish that without counting and estimating their quantity firstly.  With your help we will protect strays in Ukraine and also assist with their further socialization and adoption.

title: Help Provide Education for 1200 Orphan in Cameroon
description: This project will provide 1200 orphans with basic education including School building construction in  Cameroon. O.A.A is working to free orphans and vulnerable children from the cycle of poverty by providing free education for orphans, street children and destitute children. Your donation will provide children with free education, nutritious food, medication, scholastic materials, uniforms, socks and shoes.

title: Leadership Empowerment for 200 School Girls-Ghana
description: Moremi Initiative intends to establish 10 girls' clubs and build the leadership capacity of 200 girls within schools in marginalized areas in the Greater Accra Region. Empowering girls with leadership skills will give them the capacity to lead change and design solutions to issues facing them, their peers and their communities. Among others, violence, reproductive health and financial issues.

title: Giving ourselves to bring community GARBAGE to 0%
description: This project will provide a sustainable solution to the people of Likoni Community in Kenya who have for a long time suffered the disastrous effects of Mosquito caused diseases and waterborne diseases that have caused deaths and severe illnesses. We seek to clean the community as whole up to 1000 houses which are a home to about 24,000 families. We intend to clear all dumping sites and make beautiful gardens out of them and implement a waste management plan that we and the community came up with

title: Stop Child Marriage, Promote Girl Education
description: Join us in stopping child marriage to 21 vulnerable teenager girls in Nkaiti,Tanzania - and educating 14000 community members on the adverse effects of child marriage. Strategically implementing the program within four most impoverished villages; Unique Development for Future Organization (UDF) is advocating to eradicate child marriage and promote girl education. We educate on sexual reproductive health and providing scholastic material, sanitary product, school uniform, shoes, bicycle and more

title: Farm to Improve Orphan Food Security and Nutrition
description: This project will allow Happy Totos to buy a plot of land, seeds and basic farm tools required to carry out nutritious food production for their children and vulnerable children in their community. This will transform the children's diet while cutting their dependence on donations. The farm may also create opportunities for the home to earn some income and educate orphan children on sustainable farming.

title: Inclusive Education through sport
description: Children with special needs face a lot of stigma and discrimination  in schools and community.A few  privileged ones who attend school,do not effectively participate in education,sport and recreation in order for them to experience their full potential.Therefore,we use adaptive sport activities to encourage children with disability to  participate in  learning and take part in inclusive sport .We build capacity in the community school teachers to deliver inclusive education.

title: Destiny Kids- Supporting SEN children in Bromley
description: Destiny Kids is a consortium platform working in association LWFCI-UK aiming  to raise fund for 3 local charities that support children with special educational needs and disabilities.  The project will provide tutoring, social activities, educational trips during school holidays , giving opportunity for bonding where carers can  support each other, whilst the children can socialise and enjoy new experiences.  It enables children to learn, families to have fun and spend quality time together.

title: Sponsor women entrepreneurs to start an e-business
description: ShopO Invests trains and provides the technical and start-up capital for women in Nairobi to create their own cross-border, e-commerce businesses. Going way beyond the traditional microfinance model, we develop women business owners with the skills to operate in an ever-expanding digital ecommerce marketplace. Each new ShopO-wner receives a $1000 interest free loan to start her business. This loan is paid back to ShopO in 3-4 months and we use the funds to restart the cycle with another woman.

title: Improve Vision Health for 1,000 Guatemalans
description: Vision Health International will provide eye exams, fit eyeglasses, perform life-altering surgeries, and improve the vision health for 1000 adults and children in medically under-served regions in and around Villa Nueva, Guatemala. Guatemala is one of the most populous and poor countries in Central America, with over half of the population living in poverty. We're partnering with the City of Villa Nueva to conduct vision screenings in schools and community centers, & perform cataract surgeries.

title: Power of Leverage: improve 3000+ lives in Southend
description: We use the Power of Leverage to encourage businesses of all sizes, even sole proprietors, to support local charities, community groups and educational establishments. In this way, we can turn 5 pounds into 50 pounds, 500 pounds or even 5,000 pounds worth of support. Our work already benefits approximately 1,000 people every year, but we want to improve our resources, web platforms and marketing reach so we can increase engagement levels and positively impact more than 3,000 lives annually.

title: St. John,USVI - Long Term Recovery: Home Construct
description: After hurricanes Irma & Maria, our team developed a rebuild program for St. John. The program facilitates construction solutions, focusing maximum impact on the under-served in our community. This includes the senior roofing initiative, adding required structural reinforcements, AND making homes habitable. We are already dedicated to reintroducing thirty displaced seniors safely back into their homes before the impending hurricane season. Our setback now is funding for materials & skilled labor.

title: Indigenous Women's Leadership Program
description: This project helps indegenous women in the southern Mexican state of Oaxaca with personal and skill development to become leaders in their communities.  Women from indigenous communities are not often involved in leadership roles in their communites and are often activly blocked from those roles.  Our program supports women from indigenous communites to learn about themselves, the systems that they live in and gender equity to support their leadership in the community.

title: Heart-Mind Well-Being Toolkit
description: We will produce and test a toolkit of evidence-informed resources and strategies to help adults across British Columbia's Lower Mainland to support young children's social-emotional development. By leading eight three-hour workshops, we will enable at least 160 early-childhood educators and family resource staff help nearly 5,000 children be secure and calm, compassionate and kind, get along with others, solve problems peacefully and be alert and engaged.

title: SUPPORT  HIV AIDS AWARENESS  THROUGH EDUCATION
description: Access Health Initiative is dedicated to support community members awareness on HIV/AIDS through use of Education campaign, IEC materials, Drama, Video, Leaflets,Community Educators  at  Makete District in Njombe Region which has  the highest HIV prevalence at 14.8%.  The disease is mainly transmitted through heterosexual intercourse and perinatal transmission, risky sexual behavior, However, community members are ignorant on how the epidemic is transmitted. Project cost is US$33,140

title: Venezuelan Refugee Fund
description: Entire families are forced to leave their homes with only what they can carry on their backs. The long journey across the Colombian border has become very common these days. The majority of Venezuelan refugees, who make it into Colombia, are sleeping in refugee camps, unemployed and without enough food. This fund will support Venezuelan refugees. We will work with other organizations in the Colombia-Venezuela border who are committed to providing assistance and support to those in need.

title: Aarohi Bal Sansar - School Farm Project
description: Aarohi has initiated a school farm project to integrate agriculture into its curriculum and further our goal of experiential learning by teaching subjects-Mathematics, Science and Social Sciences-and useful life skills through practical work done in the fields. The school has identified a patch of land within the campus and would be building a greenhouse and a water storage facility and we are seeking your support to build a greenhouse and water storage facilities.

title: PACT ( Parent Adult Children Against Trafficking)
description: The aim of this programme is to mobilize and involve community adults to create a safe community for children  The capacity building of parents and adults of the community is done by implementing several protection mechanisms  Through PACT, we hope that parents and adults will be able to recognize and identify signs of isolation, understand its consequences (risk of being trafficked, early marriage, abuse, etc.) and make linkages to services in the community on addressing vulnerability

title: Educate & Shelter 300 deprived children in India
description: WF Children's home,Balmandir,is an integrated community development program reaching out to the rural and tribal kids across India. It's a free schooling & shelter initiative for the underprivileged kids, additionally engaging in a holistic approach to education,health care, nutritious meals, character/life skills development & continued guidance after graduation. We now support 300 kids, to discover their unique potential, overcome poverty & become self-sufficient to lead a value-oriented life.

title: Change 200 Kenyan girls life's through education
description: Women Without Borders-Kenya would like to empower 200 girl with knowledge through education by providing them with school basic needs like books,uniforms,sanitary pads and tuition fee and other school nesecities like desks to keep  - .Our basic education we shall support girls/ adolescent girls to transition to lower- secondary and completion of full basic education. -Teachers- engage female and male teachers to develop gender responsive teaching attitudes and practices and become  change agents

title: Prevent the spread of Ebola in the DRC
description: The outbreak of Ebola has now been declared over in Equateur Province in the North-West of Democratic Republic of Congo. However a new outbreak has been discovered in the Beni region of DRC. To date, 33 people have died from the disease. Beni is a much more populated region and is also one of the most conflict affected. The result is that thousands of people are moving within and out of the region, which makes the disease much harder to contain.

title: KOMAL
description: KOMAL is a program launched by Suprava organization in the year 2016 focusing upon child sexual abuse. Awareness programs related to sexual abuse (physical, verbal and visible) and good touch and bad touch is conducted to make children among the age group of 6-12 aware about their surrounding. Murshidabad being a backward district is still not aware about sexual abuse and child sexual abuse is often ignored and disregarded. Suprava is aiming towards protecting children from these sorts of abuse.

title: Help us break the chain of Mental-Illness
description: There is wide spread of mental illness in Somaliland due to numerous factors; post war syndrome, unemployment, poverty, climate change affecting agriculture and inaccessibility of proper treatments. As a result, mentally ill people are often chained at home by relatives in the fear of losing them altogether and hence some of them become disabled by prolonged chain confinement. Our aim is to Free 150 people who are chained at home by proper diagnosis and medication from a qualified psychiatrist

title: My Yoga Journey of Self Discovery
description: This project is a continuation of my yoga journey that i started 4 years ago. The aim is two-folded, it will help me on a personal level develop my yoga skills, and take good care of myself. Being a Yoga teacher in Palestine, where there are not many Yoga teachers, requires me to be a continuous student too.  The second aim is that this project will also help me help others. Through Yoga i reach out and work with many Palestinian fellows including activists, traumatized women, girls and kids.

title: Support refugees and asylum seekers in Lewisham
description: AFRIL empowers refugees to rebuild content and purposeful lives in the UK. We support refugees and asylum seekers in Lewisham to help themselves and integrate into the community. We run a Foodbank, Saturday school for refugee children, Legal advice services for housing, education, employment and more, English classes for refugees and opportunities to volunteer and work. We help over 100 refugees every week, and your donations will enable us to continue providing vital services.

title: Education 4 All!
description: Education 4 All! will break through the barriers to education for children with disabilities through providing special needs teacher training to 200 teachers and equipping 50 schools with the resources to meet the needs of pupils with disabilities.

title: Provide Clean Water to 10 Villages in Thar Desert!
description: This project is of extreme importance to serving humanity. By providing Clean Water to approx. 500 families in extreme far areas of Thar Desert. *(an average family size is 2 to 3 Adults + 4 to 5 Children = 8 Persons). Deep water-well's will be dug, and provided with a "hand-pump" for smooth operation, to the 10 villages. A regular maintenance is necessary every year to maintain the serviceability of these wells.

title: Education for Social Inclusion
description: Fundacion Fraternidad sin Fronteras provides life quality to people with intellectual disability that were abandoned by their families in Mexico City. People with this condition have no access to services and have limited opportunities for social engagement.  The organization has a innovative model that not only provides shelter and medical services, also delivers tools for skills development and basic capabilities for social inclusion. It promotes the culture of respect and tolerance among all.

title: Shelter and Education For needy Kids in Bangalore
description: Our project (NELE) aims to provide education and shelter to 250 children in the age group of 8 to 15 years in Bangalore. Most of these kids are from poorest of the poor background where they are deprived of basic necessities of life not to mention about Education & health. Because of lack of amenities, they either run away or become rag pickers on the street doing all kind of odd jobs. If these kids are not taken care properly at right age they become vulnerable to all kinds of social evils.

title: Promote Nutrition Health for 27 Tanzania's Regions
description: Youth 4 Social Economic Development Organization enhance health promotion on nutrition, hygiene and nutrition therapy for local society who are in danger on marasmus and malnutrition effects  especially Young Children of age 0-15,pregnancy and breastfeed mother of a local society of Tanzania. Also Providing the Young Children with free Nutrition substances.

title: Document Human Rights Violations in South Sudan
description: Since 2013, South Sudan has suffered a devastating civil war that has been marked by systematic violations of the rights of civilians. Individuals have been targeted, often on the basis of their ethnicity, for killings, looting and sexual violence. A valiant group of South Sudanese activists are seeking to document these crimes, with a view to raising awareness, advocating and ensure that, in time, the perpetrators are held accountable. Without documentation, there can be no accountability.

title: Help Teach Africa to Read
description: About Edu Fun: Our mission is to improve English literacy. We teach learners in grades 2&3 at Diepsloot Combined School in the informal settlement of Diepsloot, South Africa. We had to get creative in 2020 to adapt to Covid guidelines. At first the schools were closed which meant children missed out on what was sometimes their only meal of the day. So we set up mini education hubs and provided children and their families with food as well as literacy lessons in their local communities.

title: Educate Poor Children in Rural India
description: India is sadly the home to the largest number of child labours in the world, poverty and the increasing gap between the rich, poor and lack of quality education.  Indira Shanti Niketan Upper Primary School (grade 1st to 8th) and there is no school surrounding 7- 8 kms. We provided free, holistic, value based education to very poor children with the strength of 300 students & Pre-Primary with the strength of 120 kids  We need your constant support, food, School's children items, uniform, books.

title: Help ease the suffering of Venezuelan dogs & cats
description: We want to continue helping dogs and cats in Venezuela, by preventing new ones from being abandoned by families that no longer have the resources to feed them, and by improving the life quality of thousands of animals that live on the streets of our country. The requests for our help have exponentially increased in the past few months and will only continue to do so in a country with an expected inflation of 13,000% (according to IMF estimates) so we are urging you to help us help them.

title: Orphan smiles project 2018
description: The goal is to provide 17,500 free meals for 500 orphans through their orphanage homes for a period of time. This would greatly assist the orphanage homes to reduce the cost burden of feeding orphans and help focus attention on other key aspects of the orphans upbringing. About 20 orphanages would be selected to pilot the first phase of this project

title: Education and Healthcare for 81 Albinos in Rwanda
description: This project will promote education and provide a better healthcare for 81 children with albinism in rural western Rwanda. Most importantly, the project will help to build a more inclusive community for people living with albinism. To achieve this, albinism awareness campaigns will be conducted to eliminate discrimination against them.

title: Help Refugees and Immigrants Meet Basic Needs
description: Often forced to leave their homes due to conflict, violence, natural disasters, human rights violations, and persecution - refugees and immigrants struggle just to survive.  This project provides diapers, period products and other basic needs supplies at no cost to trusted partner agencies working with refugees worldwide. We also provide cloth products where culturally relevant as a long-lasting solution to solving hygiene needs for this population.

title: Give Disadvantaged Youth in Phuket a Future
description: Our organization aims to provide English education to over 600 students at two government schools in Phuket. In order for these children to receive an English education, we must raise money for the fully qualified, native English speaking teachers.  The amount we are currently raising for will provide 20 underprivileged Thai students with an entire year of English education by covering a portion of qualified, fluent English speaking teacher's salary and the cost of class equipment and materials.

title: Seed Mothers promote Climate Resilient Crops+Food
description: The project will support 100 Adivasi Seed Mothers to conserve Climate Resilient local seeds, organise local women farmers groups and support 5,000 small family farms to produce enough food for their families and earn by selling surplus food, in Southern districts of Odisha state in India. Adivasi communities lost diverse varieties of traditional drought resilient paddy, millet and pulses seeds to hybrid market seeds and severe climate change effects over last few decades.

title: Change behaviour of 2000 drivers and conductors.
description: This Project plans to educate and train drivers and conductors on customer care relation hence changing their behaviour and attitude towards passengers and community at large.  Most Kenyans travel by Public Service Vehicles getting into direct contact with them.  The drivers and conductors are semi-illiterate and use alcohol therefore harassing  passengers sexually, give no change of the amount of fare, lack road courtesy, use foul language, shaggy, and some collude with thugs to rob passengers.

title: Help Build Processing Machines For 100 Uyo Farmers
description: This project will bring economic independence for 100 local farmers and their families, including women and children, in six villages in Uyo, Nigeria. The cassava and palm processing machines will increase the farmers' revenue by reducing waste due to decay and maximizing harvest used or sold to market.  We will leverage strong partnerships for additional in-kind technical support and knowledge transfer and build on existing structures to ensure active community participation and sustainability.

title: HorseTherapy for children with disabilities Mexico
description: Hoga's Children Rehabilitation Center goal is to provide unique rehabilitation to 100 Mexican children and young people with physical, intellectual disabilities and Autism Spectrum Disorders through scholarships for Horse Therapy Sessions (Hippotherapy), a well-known and medically proven method for rehabilitation where horses are utilized as therapeutic helpers together with a team of health professionals making a faster improvement in the quality of life of children and their families.

title: End Child Marriage, Educate Girl Students
description: Andhra Pradesh, India reports 60% girls enrollment in secondary education as against 96% in primary school (ASER Report). The girls dropout rate in Kadapa district is 34.34%, third highest in the state (DISE, GoAP 2016). Parents treat girls as burden and force them into marriage at early age. We seek your support to ensure the girls stay in school and continue higher education. This prevents not only school dropouts and child marriage, but also eventual child labour and potentially trafficking.

title: Digital Citizens
description: Starting with career assessment tests for the future, we have several programs where the children living in group homes in Japan can choose to sign up & pursue the skills we are helping them with. 1) NightZooKeeper English training which is a game and online 2) Helping connect children with elderly to teach them ICT Skills (how to Skype, how to use a smart phone and order online as career training 3) Train them to be Japanese language instructors for the future and 4) Robotics courses & coding.

title: Helping 20 Bedouin women start a cultural co-op
description: Bedouins Without Borders wants to help preserve a dying heritage while generating sustainable jobs for 20 Bedouin women in Bethlehem. This project will set up a Bedouin Cultural Cooperative that will use local common materials (Sheepskin/wool/Silver/Bronze) to produce new innovative products while preserving the fading arts and designs of Bedouins. From raw materials to finished unique handmade made-to-order products sold online through a professional website and an interactive catalog.

title: Build Puerto Rico Through The Creative Economy
description: After years of economic hardship, then the devastating Hurricane Maria, Puerto Rico is in need of sustainable, long-term economic development. Supporting the island's creative economy by investing in arts, cultural, education, and entrepreneurship programs is one way to build a better Puerto Rico for the future.

title: Stop Hypertension and Diabetes in its tracks
description: HFA provides free healthcare to communities in rural Eastern Nigeria. Hypertension and Diabetes are diseases that can be controlled and never truly cured, and must be treated with ongoing care. This project will ensure we continue to provide blood pressure and blood sugar monitoring, and provide medications to participants through our monthly clinics. HFA averages 100 to 120 participants who receive either Hypertension or Diabetes medications, or both, every month.

title: Help Educate 150+ vulnerable children in Serbia
description: Ask is creating self-sustaining Centre for Education in order to provide schooling, tutoring and guidance for children from vulnerable groups. Centre will not only be capable to educate up to 150 children per year but as self-sustainable it will help future generations to build their future through education, benefiting them directly and their communities indirectly.

title: Help 1,000 Tanzanian pupils use tablets to study
description: Lyra will provide sets of 50 tablets to 3 rural secondary schools in Tanzania. We also send a trained young woman mentor to help pupils and teachers use the tablets for teaching and learning.   1,000 pupils will gain exposure and confidence in using tablets, improve their maths and English comprehension skills, and research / self-study skills.

title: Save 50 children from statelessness in SouthAfrica
description: A stateless child is a child who is not recognised as a citizen of any country in the world. Lawyers for Human Rights helps stateless children (especially orphaned/abandoned) living in South Africa to access their right to a birth certificate & citizenship. We use legal representation, DNA testing, litigation, training & outreach to help children get birth certificates & ID documents. These documents allow them to access basic rights such as education & healthcare while preventing statelessness.

title: Virtual Autism Program for 50 Refugee Families
description: Whenever possible, A Global Voice for Autism provides in-person training and support to families of children with autism in conflict-affected communities. However, in high-conflict areas and active war zones, we are not always able to reach the families we serve in person. This virtual autism program will provide training and remote support to 50 refugee families on the move through low-bandwidth training seminars, 1:1 consultancy hours with autism professionals and virtual support groups.

title: Pragmatic and Adaptive Skills for Children at Risk
description: Reachout.BG has been helping children at risk for more than 8 years. This project provides a one year special training to 15 abandoned children with emotional behavioral problems and intellectual disabilities.The group work sessions will be carried out twice a week. The curriculum is designed according to children's needs and includes different types of activities as well as educational visits. Due to the proper help and support the children will be able to succeed at school and in everyday life

title: Access to clean water for 400 vulnerable Malagasy
description: This project will enable provision of safe water in vulnerable households living surrounding protected areas in Madagascar. Two hand pumps boreholes will be installed with a budget of $5,994 to boost the livelihood of 400 people. One borehole costs $2,945, has a capacity to pump between 20-35 liters per minute and serve 200 people. This project will improve well-being, reduction in women and children's burden collecting water. Starting with just $14.98 you can boost the livelihood of 1 person

title: Help build a Playground in the Cloud
description: Help us build the Playground in the Cloud, an inspiring and fun open online platform to build and nurture a community around SOLE. People can share, talk, play, learn together and connect communities all over Colombia, especially people most affected by the armed conflict. We want to change education and empower communities in Colombia with SOLE, invented by TED Prize winner Sugata Mitra. His vision was to build the School in the Cloud, we want to turn it up with our Playground!

title: A small step, a great dream - transforming lives
description: Passos da Crianca is founded in 2004. It is located in Vila Torres, where people are daily confronted to poverty, drug abuse and violence. The project welcomes 60 children living in conditions of social vulnerability. It gives them access to many activities such as capoeira, brazilian percussions, among others - and food, before or after school.  The children, surrounded by a team of educators, social psychologists, social workers, and volunteers find in Passos a safe place dedicated to them.

title: Psychological help orphans and disabled children !
description: In Russian Federation there is a serious problem in the psychological help to children in orphanages. Children in orphanages are subject to serious psychological disorders, which eventually leads to serious consequences. We help children get rid of psychological diseases and maintain their morale with the help of our professional psychologists.

title: Nicaragua is in Crisis: Help us feed 96 kids!
description: 96 children in the poverty-stricken community of San Andres suffer from nutrient deficiencies caused by poor diet and intestinal worms that impede the absorption of nutrients and make them more vulnerable to illnesses. The project aims to complement the meals they receive in the after school reinforcement program, which in some cases is the only meal they get during the day. In addition, they will benefit from nutrition education, deworming campaigns, and eco-stoves.

title: UNLOCK THE FUTURE OF 100 TEEN MOTHERS IN NCHELENGE
description: Using a two-generation approach for girls education has strong benefit for both adolescent mothers and their children.It is important to note that well educated mothers are more likely to take a better care of their children and see value in providing a strong educational foundation for their children.Thus,100 teen mothers,who were victims of early/child marriage,sexual abuse,gender based violence and got pregnant,and dropped off school to get a second chance opportunity to school in Nchelenge

title: Empower  and educate 50 girls in Liberia
description: Partner with Stella's Girls in providing tuition assistance and school supplies to  girls from the bush communities in Liberia whose families are unable to pay for in them not attend school. We are dedicated to empowering and educating girls until the literacy rate reaches 100 percent. Help us break the cycle of poverty due to a lack of education and resources.

title: Give chairs for public schools in the PH
description: The project is an initiative with Philippine Business for Social Progress (PBSP) and the Department of Education that aims to help address the need for chairs in public schools in the Philippines. It aims to partner with organizations that produce chairs from upcycled materials.
