description: This project strives to ensure effective menstrual hygiene management through a comprehensive approach of addressing girl's and women's immediate needs of sanitary products and menstrual health-appropriate sanitation and hygiene facilities for the mapped 2774 adolescent girls and young women who live in street-connected environments and urban slums.  The multiphase program aims at creating awareness about sexual and reproductive health issues of adolescent girls and women living in the street.

title: Code Her Future
description: Code Her Future has been designed to empower young, refugee women in Nigeria by teaching them how to code, providing them with mentoring and career training and linking them to potential employers. The project will provide economic opportunities for these women by equipping them with a skill that is applicable across different sectors and can be leveraged to address challenges in their communities including access to education and financial services.

title: Entertainment Picnic program for Deprived Children
description: Nepal consists of 1.6 mi child laborers who have to work everyday for their day today survival. So many children who get involve in labor intensive work won't get chance for their relaxing time, as such they get depressed and be in disillusioned conditions. Therefor the project has been initiated, based on our past experience, to conduct frequently such picnic outings programs to getting rid of being sadness. Such activity sure would help these children for their mental and emotional development

title: Transform 7 South African Preschools for 450+ Kids
description: We know that when children receive quality early education they can go on to achieve remarkable things in life. The Community ECD Network project transforms basic care sites in a South African community into quality preschools, giving the neediest children a better start in life. The project serves over 450 children from birth until age 5 by empowering the 33 women who care for them in their preschools. The preschools are in Duncan Village, a high-poverty area in South Africa's Eastern Cape.

title: CHANGE THE LIFE OF 300 SALVADORAN SCHOOL GIRLS
description: 300 girls and adolescents from 10 to 18 years old, from 3 schools in San Salvador, protagonists of the Interactive Program of CEMUJER for the Prevention of Sexual Violence (Phase I, 1 year). Provide tools, develop legal/emotional guidance, awareness-communication-information, training-empowerment, participation/advocacy. It will coordinate with actors of its environment, strengthen individual/collective capacities, its integral development and its familiar/school/community fabric.

title: 50 Microloans for Low-Income Women in Argentina
description: Through the microloan program, we provide loans, training, advising to women living in poverty so that they can launch their own small business enterprises and generate extra household income. Our entrepreneurs live in communities with few formal work opportunities, and with additional income these women are better equipped to meet urgent needs such as providing themselves and their children with adequate meals, healthcare, education, and in turn, a more promising future.

title: Inspire Kenya's Future Wildlife Guardians
description: We are developing a conservation education program for young people in the Maasai Mara. This grassroots project - carried out by local Maasai - brings wildlife lessons and films to five area schools, supports an innovative radio outreach program, and takes hundreds of young people out into the Maasai Mara National Reserve to witness wildlife firsthand. Through knowledge and direct experience, we are helping inspire the next generation to become future guardians of their wildlife heritage.

title: Providing safe housing for orphaned Pakistani boys
description: This is Ali and his friends. They are just 3 of the thousands of homeless kids living on the streets of Pakistan. A poll found 90% of homeless kids in Pakistan are victims of sexual abuse at some point in their lifetime.  Imagine if kids like Ali could spend time without the threat of sexual assault. Imagine the lives they could lead or the good they could accomplish. HAS is going to Pakistan to partner with a local organization to set up a safe haven for homeless kids and we need your help.

title: Be a hero for vulnerable children in Mexico
description: Crecemos is a community organization that enables children and families to break the cycle of poverty and marginalization through comprehensive programs in nutrition, education, sports and personal development in the poorest and most isolated neighborhoods of Oaxaca, Mexico. Their 5 educational centers provide a safe environment for 500 children. Over 5,000 families and 15,000 children have been reached over the past 25 years and over 500,000 nutritious meals have been served.

title: EMPOWERING 500 YOUTHS WITH HANDS ON SKILLS
description: The overall goal of this project is to empower youths by providing hands-on skills and raising awareness on key issues impacting their lives such as HIV/AIDS sensitization. Mentorship, guidance and counseling shall help them make good decisions about their health.

title: Provide Better Life For Widows in Nigeria
description: WealthyGen develops sustainable livelihood activities for widows who are struggling to feed their children and fight poverty after the loss of their husbands. This project plans to establish businesses and other income generating activities for widows in Nigeria. Your donation will go towards renting a retail store for one year, purchasing all the marketable products to equip the store, and providing training on the success skills they need to run and grow the business successfully.

title: Lunch for 50 underprivileged youngsters of Flacq
description: The beneficiaries are young school dropouts aged between 16 to 19 from poor families . We propose them an academic and technical training with internships in the hotel around so that they become professional in their chosen field which will help them financially and they would be able to support their families and integrate the society easily. To motivate those youngsters we offer them a lunch and school mateirals at the MFRE, as most of those youngsters' family cannot meet their basic needs .

title: Help Reduce Youth Suicides In Japan
description: This project will train 40 crisis lifeline chat support workers in Japan, who will focus on youth suicide prevention. Every year more than 20,000 people die by suicide in Japan, one of the highest suicide rates in the world. Many of those dying are teenagers and young people. Your donation will help to reduce suicide by increasing the number of support workers trained to use TELL's online chat service, thus enabling young lives to reach their full potential. Together we can save lives.

title: Securing marriage equality in Taiwan
description: Last year, Taiwan's Constitutional Court ruled that prohibiting same-sex marriage is unconstitutional and gave the government 2 years to amend existing laws to legalize marriage equality. However, anti-gay groups have proposed three referendum draft bills to ban both same-sex marriage and LGBTIQ equality being taught in Taiwanese schools. Accordingly, we are proceeding with litigation against these false charges and will produce videos to counter this misinformation and let equality wins.

title: Giving Young Mothers a Future
description: Tanzania is kicking hundreds of pregnant girls and adolescent mothers out of schools, families are thrusting them from their homes - they are forced to commit suicide, just for one reason; they have "prematurely" brought another life in the world. Tanzania Journalists Alliance plans to empower 400 of these poor girls and creating their protection structures, equip them with skills relevant for women to voice out, advance revolving seed money and build a small business center for them

title: Treat 1000 severe anemic women in Karnataka
description: Anemia is a condition in which people don't have enough healthy red blood cells to carry adequate oxygen to the body's tissues. District household survey in Ramnagara district in Karnataka by Government of India exposes 84.2% women, 82.6% of pregnant women were suffering from anemia. Unfortunately, most of them were not aware they are anemic and they need an intervention. This project intended to create awareness, detect and treat 1000 severe anemic women.

title: End Child Abuses in Cambodia by Positive Parenting
description: Sadly, Cambodia has the highest rate of violence committed on children by parents in the world; with more than 50% of the children experiencing physical abuse and more than 30% experience emotional abuse. ICS-SP is recognized by the government for parenting expertise and this project is part of Cambodian Action Plan to Prevent and Respond to Violence on Children 2017-2021. The plan focuses on strengthening parent's knowledge in positive parenting, providing long-term benefits to 500 children.

title: GIFT HEALTH... Help Screen 5300 Rural Indian Girls
description: Non Communicable Diseases (NCD) has become the leading cause of death & disability in Indian children over the last decade. 'My Child Health' preventive school health screening aids in early detection of NCD's which will help reduce the disease burden. 5300 rural Indian girls in Telangana will be screened comprehensively for various physical and mental health conditions. Early Identification & Intervention of these will positively impact a child's development ensuring a healthy future generation

title: Help 23 needy families get sustainable livelihoods
description: Kickstart Kids is seeking to establish micro-enterprises for families of vulnerable children in our child protection programme to economically empowering them in readiness for reintegration. In year 1,the programme will benefit 325 direct and 1,050 indirect beneficiaries through community owned micro-enterprises that make and sell reusable sanitary towels at 22-33% the cost of commercial alternatives and leasing of solar lamps which give access to safe and affordable lighting for study and work.

title: A Caravan Comes True!
description: In order to improve refugee children social integration opportunities, URDA seeks to establish a Community Center Caravan in Al-Yasmine camp in west Beqaa, Lebanon, that hosts 107 syrian refugee families, 60% of which are children.  In this center, 300 children from the refugee and host societies will have access to a wide range of services including vocational training courses, psychosocial counseling and various peaceful coexistence related activities. Awareness-raising sessions on SGBV, will

title: A bright financial future for 4,000 Kenyan pupils
description: This project aspires to teach and inculcate a culture of financial savviness amongst 4,000 children in impoverished Nyanza region of Kenya. It integrates financial capability and entrepreneurship skills into the formal and informal education curriculum. Instils positive social behaviour and appreciation for industry and saving culture. As adults they will participate in matters affecting them and their communities as socially and financially empowered citizens.

title: Improvement of six natural spring wells
description: The initiative is to supply clean safe running water, reduce mother to child death, water related illnesses and health risks by improving six natural springs in Butangasi village Masaba Sub county Busia district Eastern Uganda.

title: The Guardians of 28 Korean Gorals in Mt.Seorak
description: The Korean Goral's Right Project is a campaign to raise awareness that the Korean gorals inhabiting in Seorak National Park, South Korea have the right to live safely in their original habitat. The Green Korea United(GKU) is going to file a lawsuit against constructing cable cars, becoming the legal agent of 28 Korean gorals spotted in the area designated for cable car construction in Seorak National Park.

title: Asset financing
description: The organization will continue finishing its renovation project that started January 2018 but it is yet to be completed. The organization is to complete on proper electrical wiring; plastering and repairing the floor, toilets, kitchen; tiling floors, toilets and kitchen, putting sinks and toilet flash; repainting; adding more rooms upstairs. The project will need a budget of USD$ 7,314 to complete. The project will first work on completion of repairing of walls, electrical piping, plastering,

title: Eat Better South Africa!
description: We are changing the lives of women in under resourced communities impacted by chronic disease and malnutrition. Our primary focus is to reduce the consumption of sugar, refined carbohydrates, refined oils and highly processed 'junk' foods and to encourage the consumption of nutrient dense whole foods instead. Our programs, implemented over 6 weeks, provide nutrition education and tools related to non-communicable diseases (NCDs), budget shopping, healthy cooking and healthy food choices.

title: Help for animal rescue shelter
description: Rifugio "Jill Phipps" is a vegan shelter in Piedmont (Italy) rescues animals from slaughter and lets them live their lives in peace and away from harm, until they die naturally. We have a large land and our goals is building resistant fences to keep the animals safe from any danger and to provide them foods and care. Even a little help can make the difference.  "Whoever saves one life saves the world entire."

title: Rebuild School for 138 children in Thailand
description: Yaowawit School, Farm and Lodge were badly damaged by the heavy rains, floods, and landslides. This devastation has disrupted our school activities and the lives of 138 children and 15 teachers. The three buildings of our school, dormitories and learning facilities are in need of an urgent rebuilding and restoration in order to resume our education services.  With your generosity, we will be able to fix the damage to the school and restore comfort to the lives of our children.

title: 5 Kw Solar power plant at an orphanage in India.
description: This project will help us to feed the kids by lowering electricity costs.  In our state, non-profits are required to pay the electricity charges at a commercial rate which is taking the precious money away from children (food for example).  Every month, we pay Rs. 10,000/- as the cost of electricity and this saving would help us to pay for 75% of the monthly groceries to feed 20 people each month.  Your one time donation supports us to feed the children for an extended period of time.

title: Create peace
description: To achieve the project goal,we shall use the potential of local and central authorities,religious groups and international organizations. Young people will be able to take part in the actions comprising of particular educational/informational and visual components,which will significantly improve their knowledge.This type of combined and several-component project against extremism and for civic peace and progress will be implemented for the youth of Pankisi Gorge for the first time.

title: Justice4Her
description: Justice4Her fights gender-based violence affecting young Chinese women migrant workers in the country's three most populous provinces: Shanghai; Beijing; and Guangdong.    Involving the legal sector and the media, the project focuses on raising awareness, educating migrant workers on their rights, strengthening capacities for exercising rule of law, fostering an enabling a media environment, and ensuring young women get legal aid.  We aim to reach 50% of the 70+ million women migrant workers.

title: Eco-education 2020
description: This project will strive to implement environmental education on youth based on human rights, creating environmental awareness, building a connection to the environment and changing the perceptions of youth has on the environment. It will offer students the possibility to learn more about the ways of fighting against environment changes, learning and applying their rights to a healthy environment, safe and sustainable one.

title: RAPHIA BAMBOO USE BY CHILDREN FOR CRAFTWORK
description: CAMGEW will work with boys and girls on how to use the raphia bamboo to produce items like chairs, benches, mats, beds, tables, picture frames, window, house ceilings, food crop storage facility and picture frames. Raphia nuts w to produce door blinds for in bars, restaurants etc Raphia palm fronds for brooms and house roof. Raphia bamboo used to produce beehives and also food storage facilities like corn band. Honey has a high market here and beehives can be made with local bamboos

title: FROM THE STREET WITH A VOICE FOR 40 BOYS AND GIRLS
description: Turning Tables Kenya will help 40 boys and girls from the streets of Nairobi, Mombasa and Kisumu nurture their talents in Music and acting and make them self supporting through the skills by the production of own audio and visual materials within our studio. This will involve creating talent shows, seminars and linkage with local media outlets. With the productions the boys and the girls will have the opportunity to pass their message about the other children suffering in the streets.

title: send-a- girl- child-to-school in uganda
description: The project aims to enroll,  send back and retain 500(five hundred) disadvantaged female pupils affected by floods and landslides in the disaster prone districts in Eastern Uganda back to schools in one year, by ensuring access to a child friendly learning environment for the learners for improved learning outcomes.

title: Smiling Toy- Saving Children with Cancer
description: UCCF supports children with cancer undergoing care at the Uganda Cancer Institute through  our major program called patients support/Smiling Toy  with  activities like; therapeutic play, case work counseling, care giver support and academic learning..  Annually about 700 children attend our programs that mainly focus on bringing hope and support to children battling cancer and their families.

title: Maternal clothing line by marginalized women
description: This project will train and hire more than 10 marginalized women in post-war Kosovo to produce a designer maternal clothing line, using organic materials to create versatile pieces that fit women during and after pregnancy. Selling these items at affordable prices will generate employment for marginalized groups, while the funds raised will finance our healthcare programs such as the opening of 'Mothers Classes'.

title: Intergenerational entrepreneurship
description: The project goal is to create a social enterprise that will empower elderly people with income under the minimum consumption basket to create and to sale traditional handcrafting objects through modern digital ways. These activities will be organised in partnership with young volunteers and will create a strong support for intergenerational cooperation, strong exchange of experience and knowledge. Also, the project will create social services for elderly people and youth from rural areas.

title: Women of Worth - Community Involvement.
description: Our project is important because a community is only as strong as its women. Our project is designed to help women recreate themselves. Giving a woman hope for the future not only strengthens the woman and her family, but strengthens the community as a whole.

title: Ending Veteran homelessness in Michigan
description: This project will help provide affordable section 8 housing and food to homeless veterans and less privileged in Michigan. Michigan ranks #11 (608,271) in total Veterans Population (Sources: Population, VA Office of Data Governance and Analytics, US Census Bureau County, FY 2016) and with this project, HIRED Project aim to reduce this social issue of hunger and displacements of our Service Heroes. Provide them a place to call a HOME.

title: Building home for less privilege people in Nigeria
description: Ife-ooye Women's Association is building homes for less privileged people in Nigeria. This project will help us continue to build housing for vulnerable and disenfranchised people and also provide for their basic needs, such as providing food, clothing and healthcare.

title: International YouthBank Conference
description: As a member of YB international network for 7 years, within this project implementation term TOG would like to organize an international conference. 60 participants who are YouthBank members, youth workers and YouthBanks coordinators will come together to talk about the YouthBank project that will be organized in Istanbul at the dates of 27/30.11.2018.

title: Help Fish and Wildlife
description: For more than three decades, NFVVF has been a driving force in national conservation. We've supported more than 16,000 projects that align with our mission: to protect and restore our nation's fish and wildlife species and the habitats they need to survive.

title: Free 300 girls from child marriage in South Sudan.
description: Community Initiative for Development Organization (CIDO) plans to equip one secondary school to provide free education for 300 girls in Jonglei State, South Sudan who are war-traumatized, poor and at risk of forced child marriages after completing primary school. The project will engage volunteer teachers and provide teaching and learning materials (books, school uniforms, school bags and re-usable sanitary wear for the girls) including psychosocial support, mentoring and life skills training.

title: Help Nicaraguan Farmers Build their Resilience
description: Certain farm communities face crises like climate change and volatile markets far better than others. Knowing 'why' will help some of the poorest farming communities in the world better prepare for inevitable environmental and economic shocks. We ask for your support to bring farmers this understanding of resilience in a coffee-growing region in Nicaragua.

title: Women Empowerment and Resource Center
description: One of the major drivers of domestic abuse is lack of financial independence.Domestic abuse also leads to economic set backs resulting from controls, disability,depression. Through this project we hope to teach victims and survivors of domestic abuse certain skills that will enhance their confidence and financial independence. We shall be teaching  100 women ceramics, basic computer lessons, Arts and Crafts,,sewing, crafty cakes, and basic entprenuership skills over a period of one year.

title: Manage Menstruation to Keep 1500 girls in school
description: Peoples Association for Rural Development Serere plans to train 1500 poor adolescent girls in 10 schools unable to buy expensive factory made sanitary pads to make reusable sanitary pads to enable girls have  sustainable access to effective, low-cost menstrual hygiene sanitary pads The project supports rural girls in Eastern Uganda, with skills and materials to make reusable sanitary pads and knowledge to manage menstrual hygiene to keep them in school thus improving their academic performance.

title: Going for Gold
description: We have 4 wheelchair tennis players from disadvantaged backgrounds who need support to qualify for the Paralympics, and stand a chance of playing for 4 medals.   The players mostly live off disability grants of about $ 80 / month, come from rural, remote or township areas of South Africa, and do not have the funding to get them to the events needed to qualify for the Paralympics.   We need sponsors to provide adequate & quality coaching, equipment, and access to international ranking events.

title: jobs for people in fife with mental health issues
description: This project will provide people with severe and enduring mental health conditions the skills to better self-manage their conditions, prepare for, enter and sustain employment or other meaningful activities such as volunteering or further education.

title: 6yrs on ARVS with no AIDS! Help Her & 500 Ugandans
description: This project will help Kiconco afford treatment of her Liver & Kidneys damaged by ARVS she took for 6 years yet with no AIDS but wrongly tested because poor patients who cant bribe healthworkers in Uganda are neglected or left to practicing students thus many die. Project will awaken 1000s of patients neglected/wrongly tested demand their rights, re-test & 500 will be saved. 50 negligent/corrupt healthworkers will be taken to court, face justice & scare others stop neglect/corruption on Patients

title: Give music to a child with a critical conditon.
description: Chase the Music gives children battling critical conditions love, hope, strength, and joy. We do this with original music - composed and performed just for them. We will provide an original composition and a concert for a boy in a small town near Prague in the Czech Republic, who suffered from a traumatic injury that resulted in neurological issues leaving him fully paralyzed.

title: Help Children to Access Therapy After Sexual Abuse
description: In the last three months over 60 children living in Nottinghamshire have been referred to Imara after speaking out about sexual abuse. When we meet them they are often scared, blaming themselves for what happened, wishing they hadn't spoken out and sometimes feeling that life isn't worth living. By providing and equipping more therapy rooms, we will be able to take important steps towards empowering more children to recover from the trauma of sexual abuse and to feel positive about their future.

title: Give 300 Students Access to Art
description: This project will provide ten under resourced classrooms with arts education for a full academic year. Art is an equalizer and is shown to enhance student performance in core curricular areas. Art develops tools for self expression and ignites students with actionable curiosity for innovation. There are six million students in the United States with no access to an arts education. Support the expansion of arts education, and grant a space for creative exploration for 300 students.

title: Discovery Programs - Make a difference!
description: "... Discovery goes way beyond self-help. Self-help programs can help for a while but Discovery gives you the tools to take control of your past, present and future and empowers you to walk out of fear and into freedom. There is simply no better program than the Discovery Program and I will forever be grateful for the experiences, the friendships and the tools required to walk in Joy and freedom." Bob Y.  Everyone truly deserve this program!

title: Complete Shea Butter Processing Centre for Women
description: This project will complete the construction two Shea butter processing Centres to serve women in two cluster rural communities in the Bole district of Ghana.  The  project will provide  rural women  opportunity for off season livelihood diversification strategy, increase production efficiency and effectiveness and incomes through the use of improved technology to reduce their climate change vulnerability to guarantee long term livelihood improvement.

title: Support 500 women with cervical cancer in Uganda
description: HealthAid Uganda is carrying out cervical cancer screening for women living in slums of Kampala and those in rural areas, also providing treatment, psychosocial support, nutrition and accommodation to 500 of those diagnosed. This project works with organized groups such as churches, women associations, and local health service providers to promote awareness, early screening, counseling to the family members and the patients, reducing patient abandonment and promoting recovery.

title: Protect land rights and lives of Mayan communities
description: Indigenous Mayan communities in Southern Mexico are on the front lines defending their lands, people, natural resources and culture against the violent imposition of resource extraction projects in their territories. Frayba provides the communities with knowledge on territorial rights, increases the impact of their public advocacy efforts, and strengthens their organizational capacities to defend their land and prevent irreversible socio-environmental impacts and serious human rights violations.

title: Ambitious Girl Project: Empower Girls  in the CSRA
description: This educational mentoring program empowers girls at risk in the CSRA by creating and equipping role models, increasing self-esteem, leadership skills, creatively, and educational achievement.

title: Building a Home for the Torres Family in Mexico
description: This project will build a home for the Torres Cedillo Family in Ocuilan, Mexico. The five members of the family currently live in inhuman conditions. The couple has three children ages 1 through 12 and their dream is to provide a safe lasting home for their family. Their current house is made of out old wood, has no safe ceiling and they all live in one bedroom. The new home consists of three bedrooms, one bathroom and one common area.

title: NAANI - Education to Kids of Brick Factory Workers
description: The project will give 40 Nepali kids of seasonal brick factory workers access to formal and non-formal education as well as provide nutrition during the 6 months each year, during the labor season, thus helping them to stay within the educational system and not drop out of school, which in most cases leads to extreme poverty cycle.

title: behavior change of 100 youth in Eastleigh.
description: The youth go through numerous challenges the young men and women are most victims of all criminal activities in Eastleigh, such as radicalization, violent extremism, ethnic conflicts, political violence and being recruited into militias and criminal gangs. We will put in place mechanisms for peace building and empowerment training for 100 youth volunteers to act as peace ambassadors. The strategic approaches will enhance peace and conflict resolution and empower the youth for employment.

title: Support Young Women Gain Essential Business Skills
description: Youth Horizons is dedicated to the economic empowerment of young women in western Kenya. Our flagship Business Skills Program is designed to provide young and marginalized women with the knowledge, skills and support necessary to become successful entrepreneurs and make informed financial decisions.This program is run at our main campus based in Eldoret and in select schools based in rural and slum areas

title: Mount Kenya Landscape Restoration
description: Mount Kenya forest  over the years has experienced massive deforestation through various illegal activities starting early 1960s to the late 1990s. The illegal activities which led to massive deforestation included; unlicensed timber harvesting, charcoal burning, forest grazing and Shamba systems forms of forest cultivation. Those degraded forest lands never regenerated back and thus need for restoration through planting of indigenous tree species.

title: Provide pads to 30000 rural girls in Punjab, PK
description: The project trains 15 underprivileged women (aged 16 - 45) from 3 villages of Punjab to produce body-and-eco-friendly, reusable cloth pads for sale to 30,000 rural girls at the rate of PKR5/pad. To this end, advance training, sewing machines and production materials to women workers will be offered to ensure a fixed livelihood. The project also includes awareness workshops on menstrual hygiene management. The project is affiliated with Eco Femme India.

title: ThisLittleCard Can Save 2000 American Kid's Lives
description: This Little Card (TLC) project will provide local law enforcement officials, teachers, and social workers with a pocket-sized help resource card, to ultimately prevent child abuse and neglect in America. Each day, almost 5 children die from this epidemic. By offering support, educational resources, and a caring community, American Society for the Positive Care of Children gives kids a voice, stands up against child maltreatment issues and puts an end to negative childhood experiences.

title: Hope for 50 children with Down syndrome in Nigeria
description: This project aims to save lives of indigent children born with Down syndrome in Nigeria who are viewed as taboos, labelled and are at increased risk of abuse, neglect, sometimes death because of poverty, stigma and ignorance. Therapies to facilitate growth and development through early intervention programs like oral motor activities, fine and grow motor skill development and language communication skills would be administered at Government hospitals and our learning Centre

title: Help 350 Children Without Homes Access Preschool
description: Bright Beginnings seeks to disrupt the cycle of intergenerational poverty and homelessness in Washington, D.C. by providing targeted services at points of vulnerability for families with young children and without homes. Bright Beginnings provides free, developmentally-appropriate early childhood education programming and wrap-around services to ensure that children enter kindergarten ready to learn and that their families have access to the tools and resources that they need to thrive.

title: Empowering 1,000 youngsters for work in Colombia
description: We aim to reduce poverty and inequality, educating young people in vulnerable conditions with a focus on work opportunities. This project will increase the employment rate for youngsters in vulnerable communities. In 2023, Fundacion ROFE will develop training programs for 1,000 youngsters in Colombia covering 3 areas: 1-Soft skills - leadership, teamwork, conflict resolution, communication skills; 2-Entrepreneurship - ideation, validation, and expansion of the business  3-Computer programming.

title: Help Educate 22 Children in Zandspruit, S.Africa
description: Thandanani was established to provide a secure and loving home for socially disadvantaged children. Having taken them out of the environment of the Zandspruit informal settlement, where they were abused and without hope, a good education is one of the key components of renewing that hope. We need to fund their education at a number of local schools, some of which render much needed specialized teaching, plus the transport costs to get them to school.

title: Rebuilding lives of Mexico's earthquake victims
description: Impulsemos un nuevo modelo de reconstruccion eficiente en Mexico! Hagamoslo a traves de una politica publica de derechos humanos y autogestion que responda a las diferentes necesidades de las 180 mil familias en viviendas danadas por los temblores de 2017. Let's promote a new model of efficient reconstruction in Mexico! Let's do it through a public policy based on human rights and self-management, able to respond to the different conditions and needs of the 180,000 families in damaged homes.

title: Support young leaders to improve education
description: Ensena Ecuador is a non-profit that believes in education as the best way to achieve equal opportunities for everyone. How do we do it? Our leadership program recruits young professionals that area committed to their country and want to change their reality. They teach in schools located in communities in need for two years as full time teachers to impact the lives of hundreds of students and their families.

title: Project: Enhance Climate Change Knowledge in Kenya
description: Sustainable Environmental Development Watch plans to design a communications strategy and toolkit to address barriers in integrating climate change in Kenya.  This project will contribute toward better articulating climate information, reduce knowledge gaps and provide understanding of the benefits of the different inter-related roles in carrying out climate actions by the Kenyan people, state and business sector.

title: Vocational training,  job creation for young PWDs
description: Teaching traditional apparel and crafts, and integrating life skills, drawing, photography, teamwork and management skills, developing new product ideas and starting a business, The project has two objectives: Create jobs for people with disabilities, Use waste materials to create useful products. After that, they will become the production base of handicapped handicrafts business gifts Objects: 25 missing age disabled age from 15 -30, They are disabled people living in poor rural areas

title: Professionalize 200 young mothers in Cusco Peru.
description: We give access to higher education for work to low-income youth in rural areas of Cusco, Peru, with dysfunctional families and family burdens, who otherwise would not be able to access or pay for it. This reality puts at risk the culmination of their formation and their future. The project will implement garden nurseries for children while parents study, and a system of subsidies to be titled. This includes: tutoring, food, equipment, play material and scholarships for study or degree.

title: Education through livelihood support
description: Children residing in the tribal community of Mahakulung rural municipality, Solukhumbu district, Nepal are deprived of education. During the tourist mountaineering season most of the children discontinue their education and together with their parents engage as child labour porters, surviving on a daily wage. This project will provide parents with income generation opportunities, sustainable livelihoods, and access to education for their children.

title: Helping Street Mums in Bali with Empowerment
description: We train mothers who work in the street and live in the slums. These mothers can come and make handicrafts and jewelry for buyers and in turn the mothers are paid a wage. Many of these handicrafts are being sold all over the world. Every day a woman can work is a day her children don't have to go beg on the streets. We train the mothers to make various handycraft so hey can have soft skills and make money for the family. Now we have 15 women who enter our program and need your helps.

title: Soch - Journey with Homeless Young Women
description: 33.5% of women face lifetime of domestic violence, along with discrimination and abuse. The lasting effects of gender and caste based violence result in life-long emotional distress and mental health issues within women, who lose their sense of self-worth, leaving them vulnerable and further exploited. Our aim is to sensitise and create inclusive communities to address this fundamental right of mental health wellbeing for homeless young women enabling them to lead their lives with dignity.

title: Kerala Flood Relief Fund-Rebuild families in india
description: The overall death toll rises to 483 more than 8 lakh people are in relief camps, there are no matters to sleep, there is no gas to cook, wearable cloths remind in dirty water they were destroyer by Floods. Theressa Organization Volunteers was Collecting Rice, Clothes, Daily need material Bags, medical Kits, Blankets to rebuild the lives of people displaced by Floods.

title: Help Sustain Primary Education in Rural Nepal
description: This project will provide salaries to 7 teachers and education training in 5 different public primary schools of Dhanushadham, an extremely impoverished area in terms of quality education and exposure. Depending on a child's involvement and parents' engagement in education, the project will also provide seed funds to mothers seeking to establish their own revenues of income. Our mission is to promote quality education in Nepal, all the while promoting financial independence for women.

title: Provide Clean Water to 500 Families in the Desert!
description: This project is of extreme importance to serving humanity. By providing Clean Water to approx. 500 families in extreme far areas of Thar Desert. *(an average family size is 2 to 3 Adults + 4 to 5 Children = 8 Persons). Deep water-well's will be dug, and provided with a "hand-pump" for smooth operation, to the 10 villages. A regular maintenance is necessary every year to maintain the serviceability of these wells.

title: Give healing to 20 survivors of violence in Kosovo
description: O. Mekembjes (Operation Restoration) is the only organisation providing long-term support to women and children who have suffered domestic violence and human trafficking in Kosovo. We offer a full program of rehabilitation through therapy and counselling; schooling and job skills training; healthcare and legal help; life-skills training and more - every kind of support necessary to make sure that these families are ready to build a new life, free of violence and full of hope. We need your help!

title: educational support to 10 helpless children
description: PNCC, an organization for migrants workers, under this project aims to provide scholarship support to 10 helpless children of deceased and missing migrant workers from across the nation enabling them to attend good private schools that offer quality education. The support will cover the cost of their tuition fee, books, stationery, school uniform and day meal. With the help of this support, they will be able to acquire quality education which in long run can change the context of their life.

title: Provide Lifesaving Kits for 10000 women in Nigeria
description: Organized by Rural Health Mission Nigeria, this project will procure and distribute 10000 lifesaving Clean Birth Kits to 50 rural communities in northeastern Nigeria. The project also will train 2000 birth attendants on lifesaving skills. Rural Health Mission Nigeria has established relationships with these communities. It has been supplying essential medicines for pregnant women and has deployed volunteers to render direct service and to train health workers on basic lifesaving skill.

title: Renewable energy for 200 disabled kids in Congo
description: The project aims to install a photovoltaic system in the village of Balou, in order to provide enough electricity to the Balou Center, which assists 200 children and young people who, because of their physical and mental disability, have been abandoned by their families. The interconnected modules plant will be installed on the structures of the center (dormitory, primary school, hospital, canteen,...) and will guarantee energy and light for psycho-health, social and educational activities.

title: Help the homeless families and children
description: The Transitional Shelter(TS) provides immediate accommodation to the most impoverished and homeless families. When a family is displaced, and exists outside of mainstream society, the children are mostly affected. Many drop out of school and tend to have emotional and social issues as well. The TS program serves to help these families start the journey to stabilize their situation, find employment for the parent and assist with financial, permanent housing and education for the children.

title: Save Animals of Nepal by building AWT
description: We are building an Animal Welfare Trust (AWT) with the motive to make our welfare activities sustainable for long time. Nepal Animal Welfare and Research Center (NAWRC) is serving needy animals (including stray dogs population management, anti-rabies vaccination, rescues and treatments, supporting abandoned baby calves, serving victim wild animals, post-disaster supports etc) in remote villages of Kavrepalanchok District of Nepal. We are a registered non-profit, non-governmental organization.

title: HELP ALLEVIATE MISERY FOR ANIMALS IN CAPE TOWN
description: Every year, tens of thousands of unwanted animals are born into a life of misery, suffering, abuse and neglect in the impoverished communities of Cape Town. Our Project seeks to address this problem in Capricorn and surrounding settlements, home to +-25 000 people and an estimated +12 000 companion animals. Our objective is to sterilise 200 animals a month over a six month period, and provide primary health care (vaccination, worm and flea treatment, and in need, mange treatment).

title: Construction of New Water Well in Chargel Village
description: To provide safe drinking water for a highly populated rural community in Central River Region of The Gambia. 1300 people shall benefit from this project

title: Empower 60 Chilean Women Through Entrepreneurship
description: This fundraiser will help 60 female entrepreneurs start and develop their own business. We will provide weekly guidance and mentorship, basic business education, and we will also finance their projects.  Our support consists in granting micro credit to those who do not have access to traditional banking, but who do have a great entrepreneurial spirit and the strength to achieve their dreams.

title: Sustainable Agriculture Development Campaign
description: My name is Narayan V Solanke, and I am raising funds for Universal Versatile Society which is working towards the sustainable agriculture in climate change scenario. Farmer are needed to take immediate action to alter the crop patterns, switch to organic farming, water harvesting, zero budget farming, etc. We are at present working in farmer's suicide prone district of Vidarbha assisting farmers for Water harvesting, organic farming. Moreover through field visits and training we are associated w

title: Empower 50 adolescents with farming skills
description: This project intends to encourage adolescents to becomes entrepreneurs; enable them master technical skills as well as learn essential life skills, hone their senses solving real hunger challenges in community. The project further leverages the energy to become a changemaker and create entrepreneurial spirit among the community. They learn to grow their own food chemical-free; explore the narratives and cultural relevance of food.

title: Help Bulgarians have a healthy work-life balance
description: The forum Career with a Cause is the only one of its kind in Bulgaria. This is a free one-day event, organized yearly since 2013, which provides a variety of opportunities for networking, volunteering and employment in the non-profit sector. Every year the event gives opportunity to more than 35 NGOs to present their work and find new supporters, like-minded individuals and potential employees. The 5th edition of the event reached over 2500 people live and via live-streaming panel discussions.

title: Feed Our Orphans
description: We're coming to the end of the dry season and we're running low on food.  We have to buy the large bags of beans and maize for the kids.  If you would like to help us out, please donate.  Anything will help.  We struggle every year to keep everyone fed so this fundraiser is coming along at just the right time for us.  Thank you so much for your generosity over this time.

title: Change a Girl's World with a Scholarship in Kenya
description: High school is not free in Kenya. As a result of widespread poverty and cultural practices in the region, an estimated 65% of Kenyan students will never see their graduation day - most of them girls. This project will provide 50 girls with 4-year scholarships to boarding high schools throughout Kenya. In addition, all KEF Scholars attend our dynamic Life Skills and Career Readiness workshops where they get the support and guidance they need to be successful adults and break out of poverty.

title: Train 500 Activists to Fight for Lower Drug Prices
description: At least 81 million Americans struggle to afford life-saving drugs. Many Americans believe prescription drugs are too expensive and prices should be lower. The Right Care Alliance (RCA)  will teach 80 clinician and patient activists in MA, FL, CO, and DC about how drug prices are set and regulated. The RCA will train them to organize against the drug companies and the middle men who set prices; and to become leaders who train at least 100 other people in their communities.

title: Campaign Help us to Find Them in Chile
description: Since 1990 Chile has struggled for truth, justice and reparations for the families of forced disappeared persons during the Dictatorship. From more the 3000 forced disappeared persons only 125 were found in the last decades. This campaign aims to produce and launch 5 videos where relevant public persons will call for any information that could help to find those victims that, otherwise will never give rest to their families and to the society as a whole.

title: keep Syrian Children Warm this Winter
description: Support our efforts to provide warm clothes and blankets to the most vulnerable children in Syrian IDP camps near the borders with Turkey. Since the beginning of the current crisis in Syria, internally displaced people (IDPs) have expressed concern about winter. Many lack warm clothes and blankets living in tent camps that are ill-prepared for cold weather. More than 200,000 IDPs living in tent camps 60% of them are children in need for assistance this winter.

title: A Brick for My Library
description: PeerLink Initiative Uganda (PELI-U) seeks to mobilize and raise funds to utilize in constructing a community library and empowerment center for rural community members of Nyarushanje Subcounty, Rukungiri District. The library and empowerment center serves as a one stop point through which community members access education, skills development, sexual reproductive health, sports, cultural and recreational services.

title: The Rooster Project
description: Every year, hundreds of roosters die because there is no room for them at sanctuaries. The Rooster Project will start saving lives immediately by helping sanctuaries welcome more roosters. The Rooster Project's educational efforts will save lives into the future by both increasing the expertise of sanctuaries and reducing the number of homeless roosters facing euthanasia due to stereotyping, cockfighting, and backyard hen-keeping. A leader in rooster rescue, VINE is ready to go but we need you!

title: Mossuril Museum of Slavery's Nursery School
description: 85% of Mossuril's 144,000 people are under 25. With 65% illiteracy, no nursery school or youth training and over 80% unemployment,  this rural part of Mozambique needs help.   The ruin of its former slave prison will become multi-functional as a museum of slavery and a nursery school for 50 local under 5s.  And it will also host computer lessons for women and girls as well as a craft center for disadvantaged youths.

title: Fund 640 scholarship to empower students in Chile
description: This project will train 800 students from vulnerable backgrounds in Chile so they can reach their full potential. This will be achieved through 10 mentoring sessions where they will be trained in growth mindset, determination, self-esteem and collaborative work. In addition, students will practice these skills through projects for their schools, designed and made by themselves. The 60% of the  students project are about how to improve school climate.

title: Empowering women in Los Alcarrizos, Santo Domingo.
description: Under this project, 45 women living below poverty line (BPL), will be trained the essentials to be a pastry baker. They will learn the basic pastry recipes, costing and the fundamentals of entrepreneurship in order to be able to start their own business. The project will increase their self- confidence level, livelihood growth and empowerment and diminish their socially and economically disadvantaged.

title: Handwashing & Health for 2000 Children in Nigeria
description: The "HAPPY LEARNERS PROJECT" will use Visual aids, Poems and Rhymes to teach and create handwashing awareness in 2000 children 5 to 12 years in 25 schools in Kaduna State. We are also using this avenue to support children's school attendance and teacher's shift towards embracing proper hygiene and health education. A 6-month sustainability plan will give these children and their teachers time to embed these new habits and secure a healthy future where they become change makers in the community.

title: Community Development in East Java
description: This project will allow us to double the capacity of our Community Development Program for a community of impoverished and exploited families in East Java. We will also use part of the funds to begin a second similar program over the next two years.

title: Medical Outreach
description: To screen, diagnose, and treat the under-served people of Abalabi and surburbs in Abeokuta, Nigeria; we will screen participants for abuse in women/children, diabetes, hypertension, urinary tract infection, oral and tooth problems, eye screenings for refractive error, and cataracts. We will set up a clinic for ongoing care, to continue management of chronic health problems, with the hope of enlarging the scope of treatment to include obstetrics/gynecology, surgeries, and emergency care.

title: 500 Indigenous Malaysian rice farmers  go organic
description: Modernization has brought dangerous pesticides and other agrochemicals to the once pristine landscape occupied by the indigenous people of Malaysia. Living at the foothills of Mount Kinabalu, Sabah, about 500 indigenous Dusuns are turning to organic rice and vegetable farming for their families' health and livelihoods. In the last five years, only 25 families planted, sell and feed their families with organic food. They lack basic farming equipment such as small tillers and training.

title: Help Educate Kandal Community Kids
description: This project will help over 200 underprivileged children get the opportunity to go to class every day. This project aims to focus on English education, basic health & hygiene, sports, arts which lead these kids to fully develop and grow up with well-rounded capacity. With the proposed USD7,200 fundraising will help those over 200 children to go to class for a year for 2019.

title: FLOOD DISASTER VICTIMS REBUILDING AT KERALA, INDIA
description: The heaviest flood devasted 12 Districts, Kerala India. The worst affected districts Pathanamthitta, and Alzapuzha were completely submerged. 350 people  died of landsides. 1,20,000 Stay in to relief  camps. The extend of damage inflicted by inacessant  flood in the linear coastal state has its priority of agri.  farming. Our victims are small farmers, coolies and women farmers. It is our aim to rehabilitate thro training, Provision of seeds, manure,saplings and to provide long term development

title: Ethno Cambodia
description: Ethno workshops are international celebrations of music, culture and heritage. For 1 week, young musicians from around the world convene and teach each other music and songs from their hearts and homes. The first-ever Ethno Cambodia will bring young people from around the world with a passion for sharing traditional music to Siem Reap. It will focus especially on bringing together musicians from the Mekong region, where many young artists lack opportunities for cultural exchange and mobility.

title: Give Young People a #ChanceToThrive
description: ENABLE. EQUIP. EMPOWER. These three words encapsulate the impact Dream a Dream seeks to make in the lives of young people through life skills. We enable them by providing opportunities, equip them with skills and knowledge, and empower them to thrive in the 21st Century. Donate today and raise funds and give 200 young people a #ChanceToThrive in our programmes for one year. Help us ENABLE, EQUIP, and EMPOWER our young people by raising $10,000.

title: Support a Child for High School Education in India
description: Located in a small village of a tribal belt of Gujarat, Vivekanand School of Muni Seva Ashram provides free high school education in an exemplary residential setting.  It provides tribal students with a learning environment, nutritious hygienic food, & quality education. With a nurturing & holistic approach to education, the school has transformed lives of more than 3000 children in 25 years and continues to do so. You can sponsor a child (education, stay and food) for less than $1.25 per day.

title: Help Persons Affected by Leprosy Stay in School
description: Leprosy is a chronic, infectious disease of the nerves and skin.  It is curable yet the stigma and discrimination may last a lifetime, leading to poverty.  This project will help support the school needs, health care, and counselling of 30 Filipino children and young adults who have leprosy or whose parents have been disabled by leprosy. Formal education and skills training will enable them to gain income, escape poverty, overcome stigma and discrimination,  be productive and live with dignity.

title: Clean Drinking Water For When Disaster Strikes
description: A major problem facing emergency relief crews is delivering clean drinking water. The "Aguadapt" takes our already certified ceramic water filter and makes it easily adaptable to nearly any container in just minutes. This fund will help us finish prototype testing, mold the adapters, and ultimately create a stock of adaptable water filters that can be distributed to vetted partner organizations - providing clean drinking water in disaster areas in Mexico and beyond.

title: Saving lives of 50 sick babies in Singida
description: We care 500 deliveries and about 50 sick babies every month at our Neonatal unit. 10% of them die of Birth Asphyxia, Premature birth, Neonatal sepsis, Pneumonitis or Congenital malformation.  Birth asphyxia cause (50%) of all deaths followed by Prematurity (20%) and the rest accounting for 30% of all deaths.  Supporting our skilled attendants, warm rooms, Kangaroo mother care, timely feeding and medication has not saved as many lives.  Hope your help will reduce death toll from 10% to 5%.

title: Aid for Goma Victims of Nyiragongo volcano
description: The volcanic eruption in May 2021 has left thousand of families in the Democratic Republic of Congo,  Goma and its surrounding areas displaced and panic-stricken. Due to the Nyiragongo eruption and earthquakes, many evacuation roads have been blocked and hundreds of deaths reported. Multiple people have been displaced ,no access to food or shelter. Children Hope Forever is collecting donations to provide emergency fresh food, water, shelters, and blankets for 500 displaced families. Donate today

title: Nelson Mandela Children's Hospital (NMCH)
description: Founded by Nelson Mandela Children's Fund, this hospital is a dedicated facility that services children of Southern Africa. It was born out of Madiba's wish that all children have access to the health care they need and deserve, and was built with the help of donors around the world. NMCH opened in June 2017, and continues to help children who need specialised services such as Radiology, Dialysis, Neurosurgery, Cardiology and General Surgery - with your help we can continue to save lives.

title: Improve Quality Childhood Cancer Care in Uganda
description: This project provides access to comprehensive quality cancer care to children in northern Uganda who are treated by St Mary's Hospital Lacor in Gulu.  The project will pay for costs of diagnosis and treatment and cover families' expenses including transportation, food, accommodation, education for children undergoing treatment, and psychological support.  It provides training for health care personnel caring for children with cancer, and public awareness to increase the speed of diagnosis.

title: Help Feed Hungry Seniors, Children, and Families.
description: This project will help feed hungry and food insecure members of Fifth Ward and northeast Houston, the majority of whom are children and seniors and many of whom are continuing to recover from the devastation caused by Hurricane Harvey.

title: Look at Me! Giving HIV+ Women a Voice
description: This project will give digital cameras and photo instruction to 10 ethnic Burmese women refugees who are HIV+ and living on the Thai/Myanmar border.  These women are unable to work because of their undocumented status and health issues.  By giving them a voice and a means of creative expression,  they will build their sense of self-worth and empowerment. Their images will be exhibited and proceeds from print sales will be  split 50/50 between them and the project.

title: Rebuild 100 Homes at Punta Santiago, Humacao
description: We are rebuilding 100 homes that were totally or partially destroyed by Hurricane Maria. Owners of these houses either did not get government support or received insufficient funds to cover the damage. P.E.C.E.S. is channeling donations and grants to help with structural assessments for their houses, as well as windows, doors, paint, roof sealer, kitchen cabinetry and materials that might not be covered by FEMA or other aids. Work will be done by local builders to support the local economy.

title: Educate 150 Children in Kananga/DRC
description: The project is focused on educating children who are being removed from the mining sector but cannot afford to pay for a place in school in order to gain an education. The project will enable 150 children go to school for one year in Kananga. The project will pay for the children's school fees, buy shoes, uniforms provide three meals a day and pay for teachers salaries. Education changes lives. Donate today to support the future of these young kids.

title: 250 Tablets For Disadvantaged South African Youth
description: Afrika Tikkun invests in the future of disadvantaged young people in South Africa, enabling them to compete in the job market and become productive citizens. We know that technology plays a significant role in their future. Whatever sector our youth plan to go into, there will be computers and a there is a constant need to be up-skilled to keep up with the forever-changing technological environment. This project will raise $5,800 for 250 tablets and will bring technology to 2,500 young people.

title: Support survivors of gendered violence in Myanmar
description: Jeepyah's safehouse provides shelter to women and often children who have survived domestic and/or sexual violence. This project will provide them with access to justice, access to healthcare, and financial independence. These three services will empower survivors to thrive despite trauma.  Justice - hiring lawyers to take cases to trial  Health - care for injuries, pregnancies from sexual assault, deliveries  Financial Independence - vocational training, purchasing equipment, start- up costs

title: Hope for 500 + children with Speech disability
description: This project will offer an opportunity for every child to have access to therapy services. Bringing hope and raising voices for children with disabilities through speech therapy, advocacy and education in Uganda We are targeting to help 3,000 children with speech disability in Uganda. We are solving the stigma and restoring hope to the hopeless children who for long lacked therapy yet most of the conditions are treatable through therapy, Community outreach services through our satellite clinics.

title: Hokkaido Earthquake Response
description: A 6.7M earthquake struck Hokkaido the northern island of Japan in the early hours of September 6, causing landslides which destroyed several villages in Atsuma Town and Mukawa Town. Operation Blessing is in the area delivering needed supplies and preparing to support a volunteer team that will help people clear their homes.

title: Hokkaido, Japan Earthquake Relief Fund
description: A tremor of 7, the highest level on Japan's seismic intensity scale, was recorded in Hokkaido, Japan on Thursday, September 6th. The massive quake and ensuing shocks caused destructive landslides with at least 44 deaths and over 650 injured. Over 2,600 victims are sheltered in evacuation centers and 6000 households are without clean water. Your contributions will fund Civic Force's rescue operations and provide medical assistance at evacuation centers.

title: Women's leadership and decision Making  in Liberia
description: LIWEN seeks to enhance the rights of 2000 rural women in leadership and decision making processes to effectively participate and influence integrated development through information campaign and stakeholders dialogues at their community levels in Liberia. This project will be implemented in Lofa, Gbarpolu and Bomi Counties.

title: MAASAI COMMUNITY CARBON TREES AFRICA
description: THE MAASAI Center for Regenerative Pastoralism specially the Village Enkutoto Nalalala have invited COMMUNITY CARBON TREES to replicate our groundbreaking model for COMMUNITY EMPOWERMENT THROUGH BIODIVERSE REFORESTATION PROJECTS WITH LONG TERM MAINTENANCE. The Maasai people are ready to plant more trees as part of their pastoral lifestyle, especially in light of drought and other symptoms of climate change being experienced in recent years. Yay! We love trees in Kenya!!

title: Support female prisoners in a process of change
description: Using real life stories and the creative arts, our RESTORE prison programme empowers prisoners in the UK to create change in their lives. RESTORE for women has a strong track record in working with women who have refused to engage with other programmes. RESTORE increases women's self-belief, emotional wellbeing, and motivation and engagement to change their behaviours. 'It has been life changing for me. I have the power to steer my life in a much more positive direction.' RESTORE participant.

title: Mexico Earthquake - Girls Student Housing Repairs
description: Funds raised will go to repair the damage to student housing.  The home in El Espinal, Oaxaca has extensive damage to walls and currently too damaged to house students. At our property in Juchitan neighbor's wall collapsed decreasing the safety of our students. The neighbor has not repaired his wall and we need to build one property to keep the students safe. Through these repairs, we can increase the students served in the project.

title: An Ultrasound for our Antenatal health Services
description: In 2015, maternal mortality in Cameroon stood at 596 deaths/100,000 live births.  After opening the third micro-clinic of Unite For Health Foundation a month ago, over 10 deliveries have been carried out in our  maternity. But surprisingly, all these 10 women have never had a single antenatal visit for check up during the nine months of their pregnancy. We want to offer these services and we lack means to acquire an ultrasound machine to help us check the status of pregnant women at UHF.

title: Empower the HIV/AIDS Youth and save the Community
description: By skill training the HIV/AIDS positive women, educating the HIV/AIDS positive youth and working towards economic sustainability for the community we can break the poverty and we can save the lives of the community. Lend a hand to lift up them by providing vocational training, marketing technique, quality seeds and manure for kitchen garden, and farming skills for their income generation and better seeds for health.

title: Tohum Autism Foundation-Continuing Education Unit
description: The Tohum Autism Foundation has established much of its life in its own 'Continuing Education Unit' to reach teachers, children with autism and their families around Turkey.

title: Sustainable Water Conservation Action Plan
description: Water shortages within the Federation affect one in every five household daily. The Sustainable Water Conservation Action Plan (SWCAP) seeks to resolve this environmental problem by educating the population on the effectiveness of cisterns (for households) and groundwater dams (for farmers) installation in the water conservation process and the overall benefit to the environment. The project will also seek to amend the National Conservation and Environmental Protection Act.

title: Hurricane Florence Relief Fund
description: In 2018, Hurricane Florence's damaging winds and torrential rains caused widespread flooding in the Carolinas. This fund was created to support both immediate relief efforts such as access to food, water, and medicine, as well as the longer-term assistance to help residents recover and rebuild. All donations to this fund will exclusively support Hurricane Florence relief and recovery efforts in the United States.

title: Share a table food with 25 Moldovan children.
description: Through this project we address the issue of poverty and lack of education in rural Moldova and we offer a concrete, immediate impact solution for the children suffering from hunger and who are most at risk of pre-school abandonment.

title: Saving children from Violence in Mexico
description: Through community education UTOPIA attends 128 children who live in front of a dump in the municipality of Chimalhuacan, Mexico, one of the most violent, poor and with the greatest educational backwardness in the country. Generating tools that contribute to combat the constant violation of their human rights, it would be impossible without this program to which they have access for free.

title: Hurricane Florence Children's Relief Fund
description: As Hurricane Florence continues to intensify into a life-threatening storm, bringing up to 140 mile per hour winds and heavy rains towards the coastline of North and South Carolina, Save the Children is assembling a team in North Carolina to help children and families bracing for the powerful storm.

title: Back to School- Help Refugee Children in Greece!
description: Starting this fall Lighthouse Relief wants to expand its assistance to children in Ritosna refugee camp who will enrol in local Greek schools. For many of them it will be their first  encounter with Greek language and culture. We want to help them in the process of adapting to the new realities. We aim to do this by providing them with school supplies, after-school Greek language classes as well as a packed lunch.  Help Lighthouse Relief restore the dreams of refugee children in Greece!

title: Support Refugee Babies 2018-2019
description: Over 2.7 million Syrian Refugees, displaced by the war, currently reside in Turkey. Every 2 people out this number, is under 6-years-old. Given all the challenges of trying to survive through the crisis, refugees' biggest support today is being able to live with their families. The newborns keep their hopes alive...

title: Emergency Response to Hurricane Florence
description: International Medical Corps is mobilizing resources and deploying an assessment team to the Carolinas, as Hurricane Florence has grown into a potentially catastrophic storm. With landfall in southeastern North Carolina, the storm is likely to paralyze a large region of the country, and the millions in Florence's path could be without electricity, straining healthcare and other critically needed services. Our teams are pre-positioning to quickly respond should local officials need support.

title: Hurricane Florence Disaster Response
description: COHI's team is watching Hurricane Florence closely and we are ready to respond. Our allies living and working in the communities directly in the storm's path are bracing for flooding, storm surges and high winds. COHI will respond by prioritizing the unique needs of vulnerable women and children, and specifically people of color and the LGBTQI community. Our response will focus on meeting the needs of our allies in the area to provide women and children with the services and resources they need.

title: Kick Obesity and NCDs Cameroon
description: Kick Obesity and NCDs Cameroon is a health awareness campaign launched by Sports and Health Development Organization [SHDO] to sensitize  urban and rural communities in the North West Region of Cameroon about the role of sports/physical activity especially in preventing noncommunicable diseases [NCDs] like Hypertension,diabetes and obesity. We plan to launch  FREE body health screening, indoor and outdoor fitness training in Bamenda urban area.

title: Hurricane Florence: Help Babies in North Carolina
description: Hurricane Florence is set to make landfall in North Carolina. This fund will provide diapers at no cost to our community partners, who are recovering and rebuilding. When we think about disaster recovery, we tend to think about hunger, homelessness, and clean water. Diapers are an overlooked, yet crucial, basic need. All babies deserve to be clean, dry, and healthy.

title: Emergency Fuel - Hurricane Florence
description: Hurricane Florence is has caused life-threatening storm surge, powerfully damaging winds and catastrophic flooding across the southeastern coast of the US. With over 1 million people evacuated and over 3 million at risk of losing power, widespread fuel shortages are being reported. This project will support FRF's response teams to source, transport, and distribute free fuel to those who need it most. Help us help the Carolinas!

title: VOICE FOR THE VOICELESS
description: This project will help the animals in distress / abandoned / sick / met with accident / and old. A small contribution is helping them in their treatment, food, Ambulance and a place as a shelter

title: Community Learning Centers in Lamidanda, Nepal
description: Residents of rural villages in Nepal will gain access to useful resources - including reference and continuing education materials as well as recreational and cultural topics - and will have a place to meet at their new Community Learning Centers.

title: World Central Kitchen Hurricane Florence Response
description: WCK's Chef Relief Team is committed to providing 150,000 chef-prepared meals for victims of Hurricane Florence in the southeastern United States.

title: Emergency Funds For Displaced Families In Cameroon
description: Project will provide emergency support for displaced families to obtain water, food, medical supplies , personal items, household needs , mosquito nets, insect repellent, and shelter Families  have been hiding in the bushes and have escaped to a safe area from the crisis currently occurring in the NW/SW Regions of Cameroon. We need to transport over 200 men, women and children out of the country to a safe place until the civil war is over. Humanitarian challenges will require years to resolve.

title: Self-Employments Various Affected woman's Disabled
description: The main objective of this program is to improve the basic needs. We identifying now there are 162 families without homes, assets and employments lost and some people disabled by affected tsunami and armed conflicts. For these poor taking begging to get their living needy foods health and fundamental needs. The goal of this project is to raise their livelihood. We ask your help to self-employed these poor people. Who are taking by these employments, daily foods health needs fulfill every day.

title: Women Farm to Earn
description: Ripples Farms Program is co-designed with village women to give them a 'hand-up' to fight the causes of generational poverty.  Ripples Farms gives African woman land, seeds, irrigation, tools & training on sustainable farming methods, to help women become financially independent, able to feed their children, send them to school and pay for medical services. Ripples wants village women to be able to give their children a fighting chance to survive, have a good life and better life choices.

title: Typhoon Mangkhut Low-cost Sanitation Initiative
description: The project will provide toilet repairs and install new toilets for those affected by Typhoon Mangkhut in severely-affected villages in Northern Luzon especially in Conner, Apayao. We aim to provide safe sanitation to 5,000 individuals in this project. Aside from sanitation, we will provide support for vegetable gardening and root crop production in hardly-hit villages.

title: Responding to Hurricane Florence
description: Hurricane Florence has brought torrential rain and widespread flooding. World Vision is launching an emergency response in the Carolinas, providing emergency relief supplies to those in the hardest-hit areas. Your gift will help provide immediate relief to children and families impacted by this fierce storm.

title: Stabilizing Communities after Hurricane Florence
description: On September 14th 2018, Hurricane Florence hit just outside of Wilmington, North Carolina. This hurricane yielded record breaking damage caused by wind, storm surge, and 18 trillion gallons of water. All Hands and Hearts has been in North Carolina since Sept. 23, performing the immediate clean up activities necessary to stabilize suffering communities. Between Oct. 1 and Dec. 31, this project aims to help 175 families take their first steps toward sustainable recovery.

title: Supplies For Train 100 Girls Project
description: Community Focus Group (CFG)'s vision is to create a centre for teenage mothers that will support these young women in their new roles as mothers on the one hand, while at the same time help them to further develop their personalities, take control of their lives, and offer them a path to independence through professional training that will prepare them for a range of careers.

title: Typhoon Mangkhut Food Security Project
description: The project will provide vegetable seeds, organic fertilizer, garden tools and peri-urban gardening training to 3,500 families affected by Super-typhoon Mangkhut so that they will be able to  quickly recover from the disaster.

title: Typhoon Mangkhut Relief Fund
description: Super Typhoon Mangkhut (known locally as Ompong) made landfall with winds as high as 170 miles an hour. This fund supported relief efforts in the immediate aftermath of the storm through emergency supplies like food, water, and medicine. This fund is now supporting long-term recovery assistance to help affected communities recover and rebuild. All donations to this fund will exclusively support Super Typhoon Mangkhut relief and recovery efforts in the Philippines.

title: Hurricane Florence First Response and Flood Relief
description: Update:  Originally we serviced in the capacity of rescue and flood prevention response from SEP 14 to SEP 22nd (with two days of prep before. Now we are planning a course of action to resume operations in a combined light rescue and supply mission. We plan to take needed supplies to evacuees and where needed, we will do light (low water-under 6 ft) rescues with rafts and rescue lines/ tubes and vests. We foresee this mission going into the holidays and request help from mission partners.

title: Typhoon Mangkhut Food and Sanitation Project
description: This project will provide immediate food and hygiene kits to hardest hit poor families devastated by Typhoon Mangkhut. The typhoon is comparable in strength and destructive capability to Typhoon Haiyan and the landfall has brought extensive damage to crops and sanitation facilities as well as houses and infrastructure facilities. There is a need to provide basic food and sanitation to thousands of those affected.

title: Super Typhoon Mangkhut Children's Relief Fund
description: Millions of Filipino children are at risk from Typhoon Mangkhut. Save the Children has deployed a team to respond to the unmet needs of children and families. We are pre-positioning relief items across the country, including household and hygiene kits.

title: Typhoon Mangkhut Relief-Philippines Birth Clinics
description: As Super Typhoon Mangkhut rages across the Philippines , it has taken our Mercy In Action clinic roof with it.  Both our prenatal clinic and the adjoining midwife guest house are badly damaged on Luzon island. Please help Mercy In Action repair our buildings and reconstruct our roofs on these buildings so that the vital maternity care provided by our dedicated midwives can continue to serve the local women living in poverty.

title: Typhoon Mangkhut Emergency Response in Cagayan
