We empower them to build a peaceful future in Alibori, where active fundamentalist groups, violence at school, instability and oppressive norms threaten their schooling and their lives. The mission is co-funded by the Swiss Development Agency.

title: Alleviating poverty for 100 through Skill Gurukul
description: In India, the state of Jharkhand is badly affected economically and politically, due to long existent Naxal insurgency in the state. This has caused poor child development over the years and resulted in poor education, & high school dropouts. PanIIT Foundation, with this project, aims to empower 100 such school dropout youth from remote villages with technical skill training and life skills under strict supervision of ex-army principals, and assure employment to alleviate them out of poverty.

title: Give a voice to 50 citizen-led refugee projects!
description: Since 2015 1 million+ refugees arrived on Greek shores. But how much do you know about the citizen-led projects on the ground helping 1000s through dignity and empowerment?  Campfire Innovation maps them, connects them to each other and makes their work visible. Now, we need the help of technology to go further! We travel across Greece discovering projects and we want to make our mapping public so anyone can easily connect to citizen & refugee-led initiatives. Help the helpers be seen!

title: Nursery Education and Empowerment Fund
description: In Zanzibar, nursery school is compulsory for a child to enroll in primary school. However, all of the local nursery schools are community-run & do not receive funding from the Department of Education. Due to the high rates of poverty in Jambiani, families, teachers, and schools financially struggle to provide children with adequate tools, resources & updated classrooms. This project focuses on three main improvements: teaching & resources, health & well-being, & renovation & maintenance.

title: Empower Children through Literacy and Education
description: At Clara Luna our mission is childhood  literacy. Help us  establish a source  where children have easy access to books.

title: Brick by Brick Classrooms for 471 pupils in Uganda
description: This exciting project has a goal of building a classroom block at Kakongoka Primary School in Iganga District, Uganda. This will provide a safe and conducive learning environment and give 471 children an opportunity to access a chance at a quality education. The classrooms will help to decongest the lower primary classes by splitting them into streams and provide one classroom for the Primary 4 class which has been studying in a neighboring church or under trees.

title: ACCESS TO POTABLE WATER FOR 3 VILLAGES IN BURUNDI
description: This project aims at supplying potable water to villagers up to  500 families who, currently, lack potable drinking water causing children to suffer from various diseases caused by  unclean water. Supplying potable water to these families in three localities of Burundi would have a big impact on the children's health as well the villagers'well being.

title: Monitoring Bird Migration to Protect and Conserve
description: This project will protect migratory birds and the places that are critical to their survival.  RPBO informs and influences conservation and ecological management practices for migratory birds in western North America through monitoring, scientific research and public education.

title: 1000 GIRLS WITH FGM DISEASES,MEDICAL CARE IN Kenya
description: Over 170,000 females who has undergone Genital Mutilation (FGM) develop complication. At least one out of every ten persons with FGM developing serious health complications likeexcessive bleeding and infection, chronic pain,swelling,problems with wound healing, urine retention, recurrent urinary and vaginal infection, and difficult labor.anxiety and post traumatic stress, stigmatization and castigation. And ABNORMALITY in the female sexual function.So they need urgent HEALTH CARE

title: Easter Island Original Language Rescue
description: According to Unesco, there are at least six thousand consigned languages in constant risk of disappearance. Every two weeks one of them is lost. In the furthest place in the world, we are working to preserve our language and culture.This project aims to create children's stories in Rapanui language so that our children can access the language in new formats other than oral.

title: School Reconstruction in Oaxaca
description: After one year of the 8.2-degree earthquake in Mexico, 170 children from the community of Salina Cruz, Oaxaca, lost their school, we want to provide them with a safe and resilient place that will allow them to continue their education and provide better opportunities for their future. The project is considered completed in 8 months. The scope is reconstruction: 7 classrooms, office, library and some parts of the perimeter wall; retrofit 4 more classrooms and repair the bathrooms.

title: Help Educate 250 students in Guyana
description: The home economics program at Kingston Secondary School is one of the school's largest academic programs.  Many of the students who attend the school come from poor families with limited career options.  Students who go through the program can graduate and go on to pursue careers in culinary arts.  During 2018, Blossoms donated pots, pans and other kitchen equipment to support the home economics program. During 2019 our goal is to renovate the kitchen used by the students.

title: Zapotec Post-Earthquake Reconstruction | Oaxaca MX
description: Many villages in Oaxaca, South Mexico, are going through multiple crises: it has been subject to land dispossession for decades, and the 2017 earthquake disaster and COVID-19 economic recession have only exacerbated these issues. Our Womens of Una Mano Para Oaxaca aims to provide education for local people to improve their living conditions. This model strengthens their collective voice and power through healing, self-esteem, cultural, and artistic workshops for women and their children

title: CANCER TREATMENT CENTER IN UGANDA
description: Launching a cancer treatment center for unprivileged cancer patients including children and adults.  NOTE : Future Focus Uganda is partnering with Makerere University Kampala to support the program.

title: Feeding Children and Families
description: Sarahuaro, A.C. has provided thousands of meals to elementary school-age children who would otherwise have gone hungry at school. We believe in the long-term effects of education. Providing a healthy meal is a simple way to help strengthen a child's chances of having a successful life.   "La Cocina de los Ninos Sarahuaro" addresses this health problem based on a long history of feeding children living in poverty, thus applying our experience to the school environment.

title: Nutritional food for 280 chidren living in shelter
description: One of the essential elements of life is access to a well-balanced diet. The NPH Nicaragua home has 150 children that live at the home and more than 130 children that attend our school as external students. The proper diet and nutrition can help the children succeed inside and outside the classroom and their daily activities.  The NPH Nicaragua kitchen serves around 5,000 meals per week, with an average weekday serving 750 meals. Weekday lunches are the busiest meals for the kitchen because they

title: Rescue 20x more food with transportation
description: In just five years, MEANS recovered over 2 million pounds of food. In Philadelphia, MEANS partnered with Food Connect to provide free transportation to recipients that didn't have the resources to transport donations themselves. Free transportation allowed us to recover 20 times more food than in years without it. With your help, MEANS can hire more drivers for Food Connect and continue to fund our pgram and expand our impacts.

title: Hill & Woolsey Fire Sudden and Urgent Needs Effort
description: The Hill Fire and Woolsey Fire have already destroyed dozens of homes. Ventura County Community Foundation has set up the Hill Fire/Woolsey Fire Sudden and Urgent Needs Effort Fund as a vehicle to collect the generous donations from our community. This Fund is designed to support the immediate needs of community nonprofit organizations serving those affected by these wildfires. VCCF continues to monitor the status of these fires and is in communication with government and public safety officials

title: Community Response to Mass Shooting at Borderline
description: While the horror washes over all of us, many from around the region and around the country are leaping into action to support the victims, families, law enforcement community and organizations providing first and second line support.  Ventura County Community Foundation (VCCF), in coordination with City of Thousand Oaks, Conrad N. Hilton Foundation, Amgen Foundation, California Community Foundation, and others, has set up a specific fund to serve this purpose.

title: A bathroom for Santi
description: Santi's family does not have a bathroom. The nights and early mornings in the Popocatepetl Volcano area are very cold. Santi cannot have a warm bath before going to school and has to use an outhouse when going to the toilet. Help us build this families a bathroom (with sink, shower and toilet), a rainwater collection system, a solar water heater and a biodigestor for turning waste into compost.

title: NHEG Resource and Literacy Center
description: No Limits, Just Goals! Education is for everyone willing to work for it. HELP US BUILD AN EDUCATIONAL RESOURCE AND LITERACY CENTER TO REACH STUDENTS IN NEED OF EDUCATIONAL HELP! Create a place for all families regardless of school choice or beliefs.

title: Chemical free farming promotion project in Laos
description: This project produce avocado powder as a new special product of the village.Nongyatheung Village, Southern Laos is a small village where roughly 580 people. The village people earn their living mainly from producing coffee during the coffee harvest season (November to December). They also grow vegetables during the rest of the year . However, the income the villagers obtain through these two activities are very low. Most villagers are very poor living without water wells and toilets.

title: A SURGERY ROOM FOR THE CRISTOBAL SHELTER
description: This project will impact on a population of 4million inhabitants, the city of Cordoba second capital of the country. Also on the more than 600 thousand abandoned dogs and cats, in a street situation suffering from ill treatment and some contagious diseases to the human being putting their health at risk and contaminating the environment. It proposes to obtain massive and free castrations of dogs and cats only measure that eliminates the overpopulation in cities of the third world.

title: Help Save 1000 Mothers From The Pain of Suicide
description: This project will enable Suicide Sucks to support Mothers fighting against suicide. A Mother's fear and concern for her children can turn into the heaviest grief and heartache imaginable when she loses a child to suicide. Suicide Sucks seeks to empower Mothers to take bold steps in caring and protecting their children from Suicide by sharing the strength of those who've already experienced the pain.

title: Camp Fire Evacuation Relief Fund
description: Our fund is going to support the needs of the evacuation centers who opened their doors to support the people who lost their homes and are fleeing the fire. These centers are very often not prepared to handle the massive influx of people but do it anyway. Our immediate funding priorities are to make sure they have whatever they need to continue providing these vital services. These needs include portable toilets, portable showers, blankets, energy and water costs, and countless other needs. Once

title: Life-Changing Winter Camp for Marginalized Youths
description: Mirai no Mori creates unforgettable outdoor programs for abused, neglected, and orphaned children in Japan, supporting them into happy and successful adulthood. We provide monthly "Back to Nature" programs, and annual 3 night - 4 days camps in Summer and Winter. These programs are valuable opportunities for the children to go on outdoor adventures, learn real-life English, and see positive role models who join the programs as volunteers.

title: Addressing violence against LGBT persons in Malawi
description: This project will build capacity of faith leaders to develop an understanding of human sexuality as a starting point for creating an enabling environment for Lesbians, Gays, Bisexuals and Transgender People  in Malawi.  This will in turn reduce violence against LGBT persons.

title: HELP MISTY AGAINST BLOOD CANCER
description: MISTY,a baby girl of age 3.5 years who is diagnosed with blood cancer and is suffering from this deadly disease.Her elder sister Deepika thought of fighting for her when misty is diagnosed with the disease.The baby girl is suffering from high fever,stomach  ache and chest pain. Deepika found hope that her sister can live a happy and healthy life when she will be treated with advance medication which costs about $6318 (4,55,500 INR). She needs help to gift her sister a new life.  PLEASE HELP!

title: Economic empowerment for 150 families in Ethiopia
description: This project will help 150 vulnerable children to continues their life and education by providing the necessary materials that helps to continues freely and empower their guardians to start new profitable small business by train and provide what they need to the new life. The project also aim to deliver 150 families from poverty by creating new small business opportunity.

title: Self Employment opportunity for  Abandoned women
description: The key resource  of this project is Cow. 30 cows  will provide to 30 widows. It is tried to achieve partial independence in energy requirements using bio-gas  generated from cow dung for cooking,lighting and electricity generation at village level. Along with rural energy need, milk and milk products are to be produced at village level and further these are to be consumed in the house hold and also sold in the local market for income generation and economic empowerment of poor widows.

title: Give Rural Women Group Modern Shea Butter Centre
description: This project will complete the construction two Shea butter processing Centres to serve women in two cluster rural communities in the Bole district of Ghana.  The  project will provide  rural women  opportunity for off season livelihood diversification strategy, increase production efficiency and effectiveness and incomes through the use of improved technology to reduce their climate change vulnerability to guarantee long term livelihood improvement.

title: Promote reading for children in Tobago
description: We want to help and encourage children to read by providing books, tablets, reading aides like (Jolly Phonics Classroom Kit in Case) at the afterschool program we have for the children.  When our children can read they will excel both in their academics and other areas in life.  They will also be able to support their parents who are having literacy challenges.  This will help build a library with different reading tools to help children who're having challenges to acquire reading skills.

title: Educate the future conservationists of Kenya!
description: Children in the communities surrounding Ol Pejeta have up to 12km to walk each way between home and school, and often encounter elephants, lions, and leopards on the road. This has led to an increase in human/wildlife conflict and decreased school enrolment rates. You can help us to build dormitories for Mwituria High School to educate and safeguard 400 children who will grow up to be ambassadors for our work in conservation.

title: Empower Street Youth with Sustainable Livelihood
description: Living in the streets is an option of last resort for youth who have no alternative for either income or accommodation. This project will provide accommodation, rehabilitation and sustainable livelihood to 20 street drug dependent youth through vocational skills training in ICT,  Fashion & Designing, Shoe Making, Handicrafts, Hand Bag Making, and Website Design etc.

title: Providing Hope Through Chess
description: At the Maximum Security Prison on Trinidad and Tobago, there are many inmates who committed crimes at an early age and are now paying for their mistakes decades later. These persons would have missed out on key opportunities to develop personally and professionally. Many are actually quite talented. This project will allow for approximately 300 inmates the opportunity to develop key skills e.g. decision making and critical thinking, that can assist in their transition back to normal life.

title: Little Cup Big Change: Improving Menstrual Hygiene
description: This project will equip 100 women with sustainable menstrual cups as well as comprehensive sexual reproductive health education and training to ensure full inclusion in their communities. Single use sanitary pads and tampons have a harmful impact on the environment and are often costly for community members. Their disposable nature makes them both less sustainable and more expensive than alternatives. Reusable sanitary pads made of cloth contract bacteria that can be difficult to clean safely.

title: Storytelling as a catalyst to promote literacy
description: Purpose: Using the love of stories as a catalyst to promote a culture of reading for pleasure, as the foundation for literacy and learning. Concept: Build on the highly innovative 1 Telling Stories of KwaZulu-Natal ` project and its extension into 24 rural schools into KZN South Africa, through which 66000 school kids have been involved in storytelling and literacy activities at libraries and schools. Rationale: In rural KZN, there is no culture, and very few people read for pleasure.

title: Give Someone A Future
description: Magic Bus works with children living in poverty, taking them on a journey from Childhood to Livelihood, and out of poverty. We attempt to ensure children complete secondary schooling and have the right skill sets and knowledge for the world of work.

title: A Call to Action Literacy Initiative
description: The Literacy Initiative provides multi-sensory literacy instruction to over 1,300 youth in Philadelphia's most impoverished communities. In these neighborhoods, up to 80% of youth live in poverty and the on-time high school graduation rate averages just 62%. Across Philadelphia, only 17% of 4th graders read proficiently according to the NAEP. Impoverished youth, who do not read on -level by the end of 3rd grade are 13-times more likely not to graduate than their wealthier, proficient peers.

title: Australian Animal Disaster Relief
description: With this project we aim to develop a National program based on providing Disaster Relief to Animals both stock and domestic. We hope to create Dedicated Community Animal Response Teams that will provide Preparedness, Response and Relief to animal owners across Australia. We hope to support owners and their animals in the event of evacuations to help reduce the loss of life, both human and animal where possible.

title: Personal development to 750  pupils in Madagascar
description: Ank'Izy plans to bring personal development to 750 disadvantages pupils in Madagascar. This will be done through ludic activities and also by giving support to these  children  (school supplies and food).

title: CHIKS suffers with sad Kerala
description: The world watched in August as floods devastated Kerala.  The Orphanages we support were not spared and one in particular suffered severe damage. We are asking for your help to rebuild the Carmel Matha Home. Severe flooding washed away part of the Home and the foundations beneath, to leave the Home in  a parlous state. We WILL rebuild and need your help.

title: A Documentary About Ladysmith Black Mambazo
description: This documentary will tell the life story of Joseph Shabalala (77), founder of Ladysmith Black Mambazo, and the way in which his message of peace and harmony, spread through the medium of his music, has touched people around the globe while promoting South African culture.  The project will also provide opportunities for unemployed South African women, offering experience in a variety of roles during the production to give an understanding of the job opportunities that exist in the industry.

title: EMPOWER 300 NIGERIAN SINGLE MOTHERS IN KEBBI STATE
description: Our findings show a lot of differences concerning what many single mothers are going through at Diggi in Kebbi State.We have come to realise that there ways they could be assisted to brace them up by empowering them in terms of creating skill acquisition, supporting them financially and engageing them in what will give them life after little work and assistance to be renbdered by The Vision for Teenagers Adolescents and Youths Wellbeing Initiative.

title: Vocational skills for 320 Orphans
description: This project will build an Orphanage school in eastern Uganda providing a wide range of life vocational skills, basic knowledge, start up kits to 320 orphans traumatized by the massive  landslides in Bududa district.

title: Education for Women and Children in Uganda
description: We were established in 2015 in Uganda with a mission of caring for vulnerable children and to reach their potential. BEF is located in Kashija Village Rubuguri Parish Uganda. Our main objectives are to give children and women who have had to end their education because of poverty.  BEF also provides opportunities for families where vulnerable children come from to earn a living through self sustaining projects such as farming, jewelry making, and most of all education.

title: Help our Divas find their DREAMS!
description: We are SUPER excited to share with you our Diva Dream Academy!  This will be a 6 month course hosted to our Divas who have maintained housing for 6 months. This program will provide life changing skills and motivation needed to live a positive and productive life. We will have 2 trainers providing impactful courses to help our Divas discover their dreams! It's time to change the mindset to end homelessness for GOOD! Help us give these ladies a real platform for success!

title: Organic Farming Promotion of 1000 Family in Beed
description: Organic farming is a system of agriculture that uses environmentally sound techniques for raising crops and livestock that are free from synthetic compound. The methods used in organic farming seeks to increase long term soil fertility, balance insect and organism populations and reduce air, soil and water pollution while maintaining or increasing levels of production. As opposed to the conventional farming system, organic farming keeps the welfare of every player in mind.

title: AmancCampeche Center for children with Cancer
description: This Project would build a Center in Campeche, Mexico providing children with Cancer around the state,  Roof,  Healthy food,  Room where they can recover after treatment, School (when they miss), Psychologic help, Playroom, Learning tools for families. All care needed to 75 Children and Families so they can have a better opportunity to beat Cancer.

title: STEM&Computer Science Center for Girls in Mongolia
description: The STEM&Computer Science center and its STEM materials such as computers, microcomputers, robotics materials, lego and snap circuit discovery kits promote an atmosphere that inspires creativity and scientific thinking in girls from a young age.  We will motivate and prepare at least 300 at-risk kids in grades 7-12, each year, to complete one year STEM training with final projects. Currently, we have a STEM lab rented with very limited access to STEM materials.

title: Feed 50 children in Mombasa during the holidays
description: This project will provide food for 50 children in a Mombasa slum during the school holidays. These children are well nourished during term time by a feeding programme provided at school by Mustard Seed Project. This project will prevent the poorest children from severe mal-nourishment during the school holidays.

title: Train and support 45 widows in tailoring
description: Under this project 45 widows in rural areas of Kigali, Rwanda will be trained in tailoring with various types, styles and models of making clothes within 6 months and after graduating they will be supported each one with a tailoring machine. Those widows will be able to provide for their families and send their children to school and be able to pay for health insurance for their families.

title: Gift for Gendit: Building Classrooms for Ethiopia
description: There are too many children dropping out of education in rural areas of Ethiopia because they don't have a local school. Children in Gendit often have to walk over an hour to get to the closest school, which results in children ending their education early. The long walk to school is worrying for parents, especially for girls due to the increased risk of gender based violence. We want to help stop young children from dropping out of school by building two new classrooms at Gendit!

title: Trash Hunter
description: TrashHunter will take action on problematic waste hotspots (such as rivers), aiming to build specific civic engagement to help with a clean environment. We will identify some problematic hotspots  across the country. Local TrashHunting advocates will set-up action camps at hotspots, and through actions we will bring attention to citizens, institutions, and media. Raising national awareness about pollution, these actions address the urgent issue while also  providing positive progress.

title: Solar Powered First Response Center in Puerto Rico
description: This solar-powered cafeteria and emergency response center will provide 7,000+ Puerto Rican students, families and community members with access to hot meals, satellite communication, and electricity during emergencies, as well as clean sustainable energy for the school's cafeteria year-round.

title: Help Children w/ Disabilities to Become Our Future
description: There are over 6,300 children in the Coachella Valley that have autism, intellectual disabilities or developmental delays. This project will help the 500+ children including all the children in the family that Angel View helps living in the Coachella Valley/High Desert area that are living with disabilities and their families with such things as gas cards for medical appointments, mini-grants for medical equipment, activity sponsorship', and other supplies & services not covered by insurance.

title: Say Yes to Women's Education of Oaxaca, Mexico.
description: For 25 years we have been helping young women from indigenous, Afro-Mexican and rural communities in Oaxaca, Mexico, have access to high school level and university level education.  With this project, we will continue to provide scholarships and virtual training to 25 young people in high school studies in the 2021-2022 school year. This requires a budget of $48,000 US per school year. Education is a vital investment for the future.

title: Give a Hope: Health for infants and children
description: 23 children from 0 months until 7 years, who are victims of physical, psychology and sexual abuse, abandon and neglect from their parents or family, will receive a good health program from the doctors (pediatrics, and specialties doctors) and mental health program: psychology and psychiatric, development therapy: occupational, language, physical and talk therapy, with your sponsor.  These children live in our center that we call: The House.

title: Health care and water for 2,000 Togolese enclaved
description: Action Committee for Research and Development plans to build a six-room health center to provide first aid to residents living in the remote locality of central Togo, more precisely in the locality of de wissan (prefecture of Blitta), by also providing them with free medicines. This project builds a borehole in the center of wissan, providing communities with potable water and essential hand hygiene training services to 500 children suffering from hand-related diseases,

title: Help stop animal suffering in Chiapas, Mexico
description: Animalix AC is a Civil Association created on January 24, 2014.  We have five main areas of action: Animal Welfare: rescue, shelter, nutrition, medical care, deworming, vaccination, and sterilization Public awareness Dog education/training and socialization Responsible adoption Social networking Through these actions we contribute to improving the lives of animals, of public health and safety, and of the environment in San Cristobal de Las Casas, Chiapas.

title: Blankets & Winter Clothes for vulnerable families
description: Life in Yemen is very difficult, according to reports of UNOCHA Yemen has the world's worst humanitarian disaster. Poverty and disease is everywhere. We are working together with your support to provide winter clothes and blankets for 100 families, classified as:  poorest and most affected families of the war in Sana'a, Yemen who are unable to buy. This will also protect them from diseases caused by the cold. 214 girls and 206 boys, 143 men and 137 women will benefit from this project.

title: Send 20 children back to school in Bwari, Nigeria
description: This project is aimed at supporting the education of children (primary school leavers) who are unable to further their education due to either their poor family background and/or displacement due to insurgency through their Junior Secondary School years (JSS1-3). The implementation of this project will increase school enrollment and improve literacy in Bwari community. This will in turn reduce child labor and abuse and other social vices.

title: ICT learning platform
description: The ICT learning platform  project will accomplish girls education in the manner that it will have all secondary  materials as per syllabus that will be accessed online or offline. The platform will be to establish a platform learning stations within the remote villages where girls that walk long distances to and from school due to the fact that schools has no hostels will be learning their secondary education and  hence reduction of long  distance walking which is dangerous to girls.

title: Rotary Lifeboat Appeal
description: In 2017, RNLI lifeboat crews, using over 350 lifeboats, launched 8,436 times into the sea  surrounding the United Kingdom and Ireland. They saved an average of 22 people every single day.   Rotary International in Britain and Ireland would like to help replace one of those much needed and vital lifeboats in memory of Paul P. Harris the founder of Rotary International.  As a first step, we would like to raise sufficient funds to buy the outboard motor or engine.

title: Give therapy to 30 children at Kids Haven
description: Kids Haven in Benoni, east of Johannesburg, is home to 154 children with street connections.  Our children turn to the streets when things go wrong in their homes.  At Kids Haven, every child takes time to settle in, cope with schooling again and imagine being reconnected to their community once again.  There is no magic to make this happen, it happens through the deliberate work and care of a committed counselor who can reach the child and build the bridge to their families in the community

title: Girls equality and community action in Ghana
description: GGG has created community-based projects that respond directly to the root of the issue. As the goal is to achieve long term, sustainable change, we looked at projects that will educate, facilitate and inspire not only girls  but the community as a whole. Ultimately we want to enable girls to let their voices be heard and to be educated so they are be better prepared to take care of themselves and their family, consequently contributing to an improved quality of life within their society.

title: Enhancing livelihoods for 3360 Women in Somalia
description: An increasing number of women are becoming the heads of their household, because of conflict, bereavement or displacement. Faced with generating a livelihood and with domestic responsibilities, including caring for children or elderly, they can struggle to make ends meet. It empowers women by enabling them to create sustainable businesses. From henna application to weaving of baskets, these women are self-made entrepreneurs despite the myriad of challenges they face.

title: Critical Healthcare for Uganda's Vulnerable Women
description: This project provides healthcare to the most hard to reach and vulnerable women in our community, including cervical cancer screening and treatment, antenatal and postnatal care, safe delivery, ultrasound scans, family planning services, nutrition, and HIV testing and counseling. We conduct outreaches into remote villages and provide care in our state of the art clinic.

title: Original music for critically sick children
description: Chase the Music gives children battling critical conditions love, hope, strength, and joy. We do this with original music - composed and performed just for them. We have projects awaiting funding around the globe. Kids with terminal illness, major injury, debilitating syndromes, or severe mental crisis.

title: Youth Impacting Youth (YIY)
description: Youth Impacting Youth is an after-school mentoring program for young men ages 13-18 years of age primarily from the Whitehaven Community. It is designed to reach young men and encourage them to reach other young men. The program provides Academics, Athletics/Arts, Service Learning and Community Projects, three days a week during the school year and five days a week during the summer months. Participants also participate in intramural basketball sponsored through Memphis Athletic Ministries.

title: Help children in Varna access free art courses
description: Dedal is an art school in Bulgaria that provides free classes in the art and sciences for children from orphanages, single-parent families, foster families and children with minor disabilities. In addition to free access, the centre provides the diverse social environment necessary for promoting social integration. Dedal has helped over 900 children overcome social isolation by developing their skills and talents while working actively with art professionals on a completely voluntary basis.

title: Help 80 need young Brazilians get their first job
description: We promote, ethical and professional training opportunities  for  that low-income young Brazilians  people, who lives in communities with high violence and drug trafficking levels,   and no   access to the  quality education standard,  to get their first job through a Personal and Professional Development Course, which improves their oral and written communication skills, logical reasoning and personal presentation, making them a  differentiated professional demanding corporate world.

title: 14th Amendment-Birthright Citizenship Protection
description: Our project will help raise awareness and educate, through social media and local town halls, about the history and importance of protecting the 14th Amendment.

title: Provide 150 Safe Nights to Young Homeless in Herts
description: 'Nightstop Herts' provides emergency, short term accommodation for 16-24 year olds who are homeless or threatened with homelessness.  A safety net from increased vulnerability. The aim, to prevent young people from sleeping rough, "sofa surfing", or staying at increased risk in unsuitable accommodation. Just 25.00 GBP a night provides a safe, warm place to stay, a listening ear and 'breathing space' giving hope and opportunity for a positive future. Your 25.00 GBP  ...their warm, safe place.

title: Protect the Environment,Eradicate Plastic in Lagos
description: The impact of plastic bags on the environment is enormous. Approximately 100,000 sea turtles and other marine animals die every year because they  mistake the bags for food and get strangled in them. In Australia, 50 million garbage bags end up as litter yearly, the "plastic soup" patch floating in the Pacific Ocean is twice the size of the continental United States. It is roughly 80 percent plastic. Lagos State, Nigeria with a population of 21 million will have severe damage if not addressed.

title: Saint John Paul II Catholic Academy CrisAlex 2019
description: The CrisAlex program is a twelve week course taught on Sundays to help parents learn techniques to coach their children to speak clearly and confidently.  The format of the class, for up to twenty parents, is a discussion format.  CrisAlex facilitates the sessions and provides the materials for discussion.  The last four weeks of the program are devoted to having the parents coach their child to present their personal "I Believe" speech.  This is the second year of the CrisAlex program at SJPII.

title: Training for 70 teachers and 70 youths in Myanmar
description: 70 teachers and 70 youths in the poorest rural areas of Burma/Myanmar will receive Teacher & English training who otherwise would not have access to such training. The training will enable 70 students improve their English proficiency, critical thinking and problem solving skills, and leadership qualities which are important for them to prepare themselves for the future and to succeed while 70 teachers will deliver improved quality teaching services to 2000+ students every year.

title: Offer health care to internally displaced children
description: This project will construct a primary health center in Bawum Bafut NW Region of Cameroon to serve 40,000 people and provide special care to 2000 orphans. With the main aim to reduce infant mortality rate in the area. Good health being the power to development and growth in every of its aspects, supporting the project will be contributing to the economic, social and physical growth of a marginalized community.

title: Empower and Educate 40 Children in Waterloo Iowa
description: Afro-American Community Broadcasting, Inc. is building a learning lab to provide free literacy support to 40  3rd through 5th grade students each school year in need of improving reading fluency.  Students will be engaged by reading books "live" on-air; writing program content and producing a round-table discussion program.  High school and college students will serve as mentors to the younger students to assist them to improve their reading skills while building confidence and self-esteem.

title: The people of Chametla need your help
description: Citizens, Girls and boys from the community of Chametla have headaches and breathing difficulties, due to a fuel company that is emitting toxic gases nearby this community of 2187 inhabitants, specifically, two schools and in. Many complaints have been filed against this company, but the authorities have only temporarily closed this industry that processes fuels. In addition to this, many inhabitants of the area burn their garbage, worsening the air quality and causing serious healthalterations

title: Enterprise Development Training for Local Youths
description: This project is a one month enterprise vocational based skills development training program for 20 returning migrants of Nigeria origin deported from foreign land, it will focus on creating self-sustenance opportunities. Many migrants after their return try to take up jobs and settle at home, but in many cases they face complications in pursuing their new jobs. The added problem for women returnees is that they often face social stigma and lack of respect from the community.

title: CALIFORNIA WILDFIRE RELIEF
description: Changing Tides Foundation is raising funds to support local groups and non-profit partners working with the Camp Fire and Woolsey Fire victims.

title: Fund Gold Medals for Graduation of Girls
description: Celebrate a girl graduating first in her class from university in Pakistan by funding her Educate a Girl gold medal.  Each gold medal is $100 and features her name and will be a keepsake as well as something that will help her get a job.

title: Kick Start CUH Cancer Diagnosis Machine
description: The Karen Fenton Ovarian Cancer Fund was established following the death of our eldest sibling Karen Fenton in April 2017. Since then we have been relatively successful given limited resources and time volunteered mainly just from Karen's family. We wish to really push on with our efforts to raise funds for a machine in a local hospital in Cork that would be one of a kind for Ireland not to mind the Cork region. This machine will help cancer diagnosis.

title: Help us make La Paz, BCS, Mexico, a Human + City
description: Many of us believe that cities are only built by experts.Cities should be built by us, the ones who inhabit them. With our daily activities we make the city. How can we change that? Getting involved in our city's decision making process about where,how and what to build.To achieve this, we are to elaborate a guide to build +Humane Cities to empower its citizens, to establish communication with the government,to organize,and to know their rights, making their needs and ideas about the city heard

title: Restore Hope Educate 500 Child Beggars in Sokoto
description: This Project will focus  500 shoe-less boys roaming the streets in tattered clothes. With bowls move around in groups begging for alms and food. Their religious teachers, supported by parents and cultural beliefs, encourage them to beg.  Future Hope Links Initiative Planned to Provide them  Access to quality education, with  meals bags schools Uniforms  and food and Books to   Restore their  Hope for a Better Future

title: Prevention of unwanted pregnancies in 300 schools
description: Early or unwanted pregnancies in schools are becoming an alarming phenomenon in Togo, especially in remote areas.  It is a situation that hinders the academic development of young girls and becomes an obstacle to their development.  Every year, more than a hundred young girls become pregnant during their school years. In Togo, 129 cases of pregnancy were recorded in secondary school between 2014-2015. In this batch, 44 students nevertheless continued to complete the course while 78 dropped out.

title: SheCanCode - Rwanda
description: She Can Code provides training to young  Rwandan women 18 -25 years with skills to code, build web design, and applications.  While attending the cohort participants develop designs for local businesses and create a path way for securing a job.  In order to continue offering girls and women an opportunity in a predominantly male field we must support their efforts. The students are learning coding from Berkeley University Master level students who are consulting for the program.

title: Upgrade and Expansion of Kardinia Hope School
description: Kardinia Hope School is a Nursery school project for economically disadvantaged children living in poor rural communities in Nigeria The foundational years are the most important years of a child.  In Nigeria, government's funded education starts from primary school and only children from rich and middle-class homes can afford private nursery schools. Our mission is to develop a free nursery school model and to Advocate for Public Nursery Education in Nigeria

title: Create 50 guardians for Bahia Magdalena mangrove
description: Mexico ranks 4th place of 125 nations with mangroves, representing 5.1% of the world total. We need to create 50 guardians to protect 1,700 ha of mangrove forests from which families depend on.  This ecosystem provides shelter to grey whales, turtles and more than 122 migratory bird species, including the southernst bald eagle population of the hemisphere. This project will motivate the community to value the natural environment, reaffirm their identity, and conserve this precious ecosystem.

title: Saving Infants Lives Across Georgia
description: The infant mortality rate in the State of Georgia continues to rank as one of the highest in the United States with African American women and infants twice as likely to die when compared to White women and babies. Help us raise funds to improve maternal health and reduce infant mortality in our communities.

title: Turn indigenous women into women entrepreneurs
description: Through training and technical advice, we will ensure that 450 indigenous Mexican women improve their productive activity and become micro-entrepreneurs. These women live in poverty and situations of discrimination. By becoming micro-entrepreneurs they will be able to increase the family income to be spent on education and food, especially for their children.

title: Saving Kids & Turtles in Jurado, Colombia
description: Around 100 Kids in Jurado, Colombia (Ocean Pacific), live between poverty and war. They  are working hard to establish an Enviromental Group that protect Sea Turtles for poaching and damage. Also they are Cleaning their beaches and recolecting plastic to avoid sea contamination. Our Aim is help them with Clothes, School Supplies and Food Supplements. Kids would be the Guardians of Sea Turtle, because they will relocate nests to a safe Facility near to the original Beaches (Hatchery)

title: Empower Women to End Malnutrition in Afghanistan
description: Since 2003, NEI has been dedicated to improving the lives of Afghan families, especially women and children who are the most vulnerable and food insecure. NEI has trained over 100,000 farmers to cultivate soybeans throughout all 34 provinces; over 14,000 village women on the health benefits and home use of soybeans and soy foods; & more than 3,450 youth on community development, agriculture techniques and livestock rearing practices. All donations will go to disadvantaged rural women & children.

title: Build an English school in Nakivale Refugee camp
description: Choose Yourself in partnership with Ubumwe Foundation is raising funds to build an English school and provide English lessons to Burundian refugees in Nakivale Camp. Uganda being an English speaking country, Burundian refugees in the camp have been struggling to integrate as they speak French. Our target is the youth between 6 to 17 with a focus on young girls.

title: Rehabilitation of 7 schools in Djugu Territory
description: The Djugu territory has been the most affected by ethnic conflicts that have been aggravated since February 2018 and have caused the destruction of more than 16 schools. When these displaced persons returned to their home environment, 858 students, including 476 girls and 383 boys from the seven most affected schools, no longer had adequate education for lack of adequate infrastructures. In that sense FORDECO (Congo Reconstruction and Development Fund) plans to launch this project.

title: ICAN DREAM Scholarships for 50 Students in Vietnam
description: Since 2000, ICAN has given underprivileged children in Vietnam hope and a path to a brighter future. Every year, we raise funds to provide K-12 and college scholarships to children from underprivileged families in Vietnam to allow these young minds to continue pursuing their educational goals.  We hope that you will join us in our mission!

title: Building Peace Through Music In Colombia!
description: Al ComPAZ is a music-for-social-inclusion program that provides a safe space for children to express themselves through music in Bogota, Colombia. We serve over 90+ underserved students with weekly, yearlong music classes at no cost. Al ComPAZ strives to combat inequality by using music as a vehicle for social inclusion, building student skill sets such as respect, teamwork, discipline, and identity.

title: Help Educate Kandal Community Children
description: Kandal Community Centre (KCC) situated 60km from Phnom Penh; deep in the countryside is where our project located and operated since early 2017.This project benefits about 400 underprivileged children through: 1). Having daily English learning, sports, the arts, basic health & hygiene to them. 2). Providing students with school supplies, used clothes, toothpaste & toothbrushes. 3). providing nearly 100 families with essential housing supplies and food.

title: Relief Fund for Disasters occurred in Japan 2018
description: The record-breaking torrential rain which began to fall on July 5, 2018  has caused significant and widespread floods damages in western Japan. Also on September 6, an earthquake with a seismic intensity of 7 with Hokkaido epicenter occurred. Many dead people missing, houses collapsed and landslides occurred.We have begun an emergency relief fundraising effort, with the aim of supporting emergency rescue operations and reconstruction.

title: Teaching Trades to Empower 40 Kids in Cabo, Mexico
description: The kids and teens of Cabo San Lucas lack practical, professional training required to enter the workplace when they reach adulthood.  This project will acquire and renovate a 40-foot shipping container to create an onsite, trades-training classroom to empower kids and teens living at Casa Hogar de Cabo San Lucas, our Social Assistance Center (orphanage).    Trades include: hairdressing, sewing, bicycle repair, plumbing, carptentry and electrical.

title: Youth center and skills development in Addis Ababa
description: The project will equip a youth center in Addis Ababa with books, computers, music and sport materials, and will offer weekly free-time courses to children and young people. Such opportunities lack in the city and young people are left spending their time on streets and vulnerable to bad habits. The center will help the young people to develop their skills and confidence and prevent engagement in harmful activities. The center will offer a safe space to learn, play and grow up in.

title: Sehat Ghar - Maternity Home
description: Sehat Ghar - Maternity Home caters to the women of the community who give birth at home in an unsafe environment. The community doesn't understand the need of proper nutrition and its need from the time of conception to delivery. Most women are diagnosed with anaemia while they are pregnant creating a risk for their own lives and that of the child. With an average of 11 children per family and seasonal jobs not each child is able to receive proper nutrition or healthcare.

title: Connect US and Taiwanese Teachers
description: This project aims to engage three Taiwanese and three U.S. teachers in an intensive cross-cultural education experience in NYC in the summer of 2019. Building off a successful program that trained US teachers to teach about Taiwanese culture and society in 2018, the 2019 program will deepen understanding among participating teachers. The overall aim of EngageAsia is to build community in the Asia-Pacific region by cultivating a network of educators who can deepen understanding and empathy.

title: Restore lost hopes this Holiday.
description: Imagine a child waking up on Christmas morning without a Christmas tree, without gifts and often, without breakfast. Unfortunately this is reality for many children who live in poverty under the care of Saved By Music Foundation here in Uganda.  We believe every child deserves a gift during the holidays ,especially children living in poverty. Your donation will be used to provide items they need, like new clothes, food, healthcare ,school fees and supplies.  Every little bit helps!

title: Mia Wants A #ChristmasToRemember
description: Hello, my name is Mia. I'm an 8 year old long haired Siberian husky, with a human mum named Charnell Ruth. Mum is always bringing me new friends to play with, these are huskies that are abandoned and homeless. We call home Husky Rescue KZN, because mum says the huskies need to be rescued. I want my friends to have a #ChristmasToRemember. Please help me by supporting this project. YOU can provide for their food and medical needs, as well as assist in creating a sustainable project for 2019.

title: Survivors of violence that support victims
description: The Idea Dignity Foundation plans to train women survivors of violence in Ecuador so that from their own experiences they can support other women who are still victims of this serious problem. The project will train 20 survivors and they in turn will support 240 victims through: training in rights, promotion of psychosocial support groups, development of a blog to share experiences and strategies, and design of teaching resources for intervention.

title: GRAND CHILD TO SCHOOL-UGANDA
description: The biggest number of orphans in Uganda are left under the care of their grand parents, This is mainly caused by HIV/Aids, With the financial difficulties these elderly grand parents are characterized with, its quite hard for them to take these little ones to school  THE GRAND CHILDREN EDUCATION FUND UGANDA is set to have this problem solved by taking the children left under the care of the most disadvantaged older persons to school.  "EDUCATION is a right to every child"

title: Reduce New HIV Infections among Children in India
description: This project will support our ongoing efforts to diagnose 3,000 HIV positive pregnant women spread across 22 states of India and to initiate them on lifelong treatment for protecting their own health and preventing HIV transmission to children. The women will be supported through home visits on the importance of positive living, hospital delivery, feeding and care of the newborn, adherence to hospital visits and medications, early HIV testing of children and linkages to socio-economic services.

title: Early Intervention on Alcohol and Drug Abuse in SA
description: Substance abuse is a challenge in South Africa with detrimental effects on health, wealth and security of the nation. In South Africa drug abuse has been associated with crime, interpersonal violence, risky sexual behaviour (with accompanied increased risk of HIV acquisition and STI incidences), negative health of users and negative psychological impact to their families. Swahili Language Board of Southern Africa aim to combat alcohol and drug abuse amongst the young people in Western Cape.

title: Holistic development of 300 women in Gujarat
description: The Information centres will offer women and adolescent girls building their capacities and make linkages to the required services of local government as per their need through our information centre. It includes getting prepared for documentation to avail the govt. welfare services for food, nutrition, vaccination, health and livelihood. Make sure that every child in the community goes to school. The centre will provide life skill related training and linkages for holistic development.

title: educational support to 10 at-risk children
description: PNCC, an organization for migrants workers, under this project aims to provide scholarship support to 10 helpless children of deceased and missing migrant workers from across the nation enabling them to attend good private schools that offer quality education. The support will cover the cost of their tuition fee, books, stationery, school uniform and day meal. With the help of this support, they will be able to acquire quality education which in long run can change the context of their life.

title: Stimulating Early Childhood Reading in Bulgaria
description: The project will bring to children in the 1-6 years age group in low-income and underserved neighborhoods about 850 media items (books, games, videos). Those items will enrich the collections of 10 active libraries in small towns and villages and help them develop programs to stimulate early childhood reading; organize reading of children's books to both children and their parents; educate parents about the benefits of early childhood reading and train them how to read to their children at home.

title: Support 1000 Sexual Violence survivors in DR Congo
description: Women's Initiatives for Gender Justice will support two local community-based safe houses providing medical, psychosocial and legal support to survivors of sexual violence in conflict-affected provinces of eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Support will also include relief in the aftermath of the May 2021 eruption of the Mount Nyiragongo volcano.

title: Press play for 300 people detained at Gatwick
description: Right now, hundreds of people are detained at Gatwick Airport Immigration Removal Centre. Many have been here for months, some even for years. Their lives are on pause, indefinitely. Sadly many self-harm or attempt to take their own life. But together we can press play. Music In Detention plans to run music sessions to create a unique album, forever capturing emotions and stories of the people detained. Donate today and we promise you'll hear the music that we all made possible.

title: Special Education of Hearing Impaired Children
description: Ashray Akruti is a registered NGO working since 1996, to improve the lives of people with disability and marginalized sections of society. The organisation strongly believes in the potential of persons with disability and envisions a society where people with disability lead a life of dignity as equal citizens with equitable access to opportunities and services.It's belief in 'rights' based approach to development, are rooted in the principles of Transparency,empowerment and accountability.

title: Boost Science in Liberal Education in Bulgaria
description: Despite its highest educational quality, the American University in Bulgaria (AUBG) does not have sufficient science content in its curriculum due to the lack of fundamental scientific infrastructure. The Science Lab will allow us to offer students majors in Science (physics) and Environmental studies, enable our faculty to conduct research and participate in collaborative academic projects, and promote science among the local community and nationally via workshops, lectures and demonstrations.

title: HELP POOR KIDS FOR THEIR EDUCATION
description: Summary Tribal culture and rural development agency intends to promote quality education to many poor deserving rural children in India.Due to lack of financial support of their family,they are not able to attend school with full school aids.To buy the required education aids,their parents borrow money from money lenders with interest .With your support,let the children go to school with full education aids like uniform,books,note books,school bag,shoes,tuition fee, etc and achieve quality educa

title: Empower the Careers of 10 Young African Scientists
description: We provide scholarships for talented under-privileged science students from Tanzania, Kenya, Malawi and South Africa to attend the London International Youth Science Forum. These African students will join 500 of the best science students from all over the globe learning from world leading scientists through lectures, debates and visits. The Forum provides life changing knowledge and contacts which will empower their science careers and address the critical shortage of scientists in Africa.

title: Support 20 persons with disabilities in Bosnia
description: This project will contribute towards achieving the full social inclusion and participation of 20 persons with disabilities in Bosnia and Herzegovina trough the sustenance of personal assistance to support independent living and self-determination.

title: Stop Child Marriage, Promote Girl Education
description: Join us in stopping child marriage to 21 vulnerable teenager girls in Nkaiti,Tanzania - and educating 14000 community members on the adverse effects of child marriage. Strategically implementing the program within four most impoverished villages; Unique Development for Future Organization (UDF) is advocating to eradicate child marriage and promote girl education. We educate on sexual reproductive health and providing scholastic material, sanitary product, school uniform, shoes, bicycle and more

title: Gardens Give Hope, Health, and Income in E. Africa
description: This project will increase long-term resilience to climate change, social crisis, and political crisis, for communities in East Africa who are most vulnerable to upheaval. We do this by investing in indigenous East African leadership to deliver training and resources: installation of simple, appropriate drought-resistant technology such as water storage, shade nets, and ecological small garden design; and connection of people to good seed, including local seed sources in their region.

title: THE ORPHANAGE FOR THE POOR AND OLDAGE HOME
description: Here in India Poor and down-trodden people for them to uplift in the villages and slum areas. At present 55 Children in our care whose age group of 5-21 years. We train up in occasional to be self-reliant. And for 18 widows we provide food, clothes, medical, sheltering, and education to the orphans and safe accommodation along with them, for all the oldaged and destitutes are being provided all the facilities with the budget allocated to them. Always we serve them and love them with God's Grace.

title: Refugee girls empowerment project
description: This project will equip 100 refugee girls living at Adjumani refugee settlement of Uganda with practical vocational skills for self employment and income generation. The primary target will be separated girls from their families, child mothers, survivors of early and forced marriage, those living with HIV and those with disabilities. They will be trained and supported in areas of shoe making, jewelry, soap making and Bakery. This will help them fight poverty, become self reliant and healthy.

title: Youth sponsorship program
description: Aspire Rwanda provides hard-working young people with the skills and confidence to make their own choices which allow them to become self-sufficient. For the past 7 years, Aspire Rwanda has witnessed the transformation that occurs in youth's lives when they complete our vocational skills training. Our graduates are able to use their skills to secure jobs, start their own businesses. Doing so, they break the cycle of poverty. Last year we trained 100 persons and the employment rate is 85%.

title: HOPE FOR ABUSED GIRLS AND YOUNG MOTHERS IN KENYA
description: This project targets 200 abused school drop-out girls and young mothers in Kenya with education or vocational training in realizing their dreams for a better future and for their families. Trainings to cover rights, life skills, alcohol, drugs and substance abuse, legal support, capacity building on reproductive health and services, linkages to business financial support services, referral services for care and support, teen mothers' community integration, peer counseling and mentoring.

title: Handbooks for Parents after a Prenatal Diagnosis
description: Every parent hopes the arrival of a healthy baby. When you are told that there is something wrong with your baby, your hope has been suddenly taken away from you. You may experience a wide range of conflicting feelings. You may be lost in what you need to decide and even think. We would like to publish handbooks to support Japanese parents and people surrounding them after prenatal diagnosis. We aim to help them gain the information, advice and support they may require.

title: BUILD 16 TOILETS FOR 2846 PUPILS IN NYANZA, KENYA
description: The project aims at enhancing 2846 pupils' learning conditions through the construction of 16 toilets in 8 schools within Alego Usonga, Gem, Rachuonyo East and Seme Sub-Counties. Currently the pupils are using dilapidated pit latrines.

title: Girls: Menstrual, Sexual and Reproductive Health
description: This project strives to ensure effective menstrual hygiene management through a comprehensive approach of addressing girl's and women's immediate needs of sanitary products and menstrual health-appropriate sanitation and hygiene facilities for the mapped 2800 adolescent girls and young women who live in street-connected environments and urban slums.  The multi-phase program aims at creating awareness about sexual and reproductive health issues of adolescent girls and women living in the street.

title: STOP ILLITERACY AS A LEGACY
description: This project will increase the number of children and adults that learn to read and write, provinding a rich supply of educational materials for teachers to offer interactive lessons in at least 5 primary classes per year in rural schools from Romania.

title: Jossam Village Borehole Project
description: The project will construct a borehole in Jossam Village in Blantyre district in Malawi. The borehole will provide clean water for 1242 boys and men and 1224 women and girls in the village. The project is expected to cost $6500. The project will be implemented by Centre for Child Development and Research a duly registered local NGO in Malawi.

title: Keep Syrian Children Warm This Winter
description: Support our efforts to provide warm clothes and blankets to the most vulnerable children in Syrian IDP camps near the borders with Turkey. Since the beginning of the current crisis in Syria, internally displaced people (IDPs) have expressed concern about winter. Many lack warm clothes and blankets living in tent camps that are ill-prepared for cold weather. More than 200,000 IDPs living in tent camps 60% of them are children in need for assistance this winter.

title: Free 300 girls from child marriage in South Sudan
description: Community Initiative for Development Organization (CIDO) plans to equip one secondary school to provide free education for 300 girls in Jonglei State, South Sudan who are war-traumatized, poor and at risk of forced child marriages after completing primary school. The project will engage volunteer teachers and provide teaching and learning materials (books, school uniforms, school bags and re-usable sanitary wear for the girls) including psychosocial support, mentoring and life skills training.

title: Clean Cooking Stove Reduce Climate Emission
description: The project cleaner cooking stove seek to improve women and children`s health & well-being through socioeconomic, public health and Climate co-benefits. The use inefficient traditional stoves, such as three-stone fires, with incompletely combustion solid fuels which use firewood and charcoal, releasing toxic substances. the smoke produced by the traditional stove causes serious health risk like stroke,heart disease,lungs cancer, respiration disease.

title: Soup on the footpath
description: Monthly we go to the streets with RITA (our cargo bike) giving a cup of homemade soup to poor people and give them infomation about our activities. We hope that they will come to our meeting house for a meal in a cosi place.

title: Be a helping hand to those who need of blood
description: Project 'Life' not-for- profit organization was incepted in 1978.This worldwide acclaimed humanitarian service organization is the result of 40 years of endeavour and dedicated service. Recognizing the need for this critical life-saving blood component Life Blood Centre managed by Saurashtra Medical and Educational Charitable Trust was established on 1981. It was the first blood bank in the entire Saurashtra region of Gujarat state, Western India. Our aim is to provide high quality safe blood.

title: El teatro como herramienta de empoderamiento LGBTI
description: We propose to explore the potential of the dramatic arts that allow the LGBTI population of the center of Bogota and belonging to the project, to potentiate social skills that allow to improve the confidence, the self-knowledge, the self-esteem and the transfer of corporal techniques to our daily life to mention only some . It seeks to sensitize, to promote the culture of respect and acceptance of the population with sexual orientations and diverse gender identities

title: EDUCATION AND  WASH (WATER, SANITATION AND HYGIENE
description: The Project will assist the community to build a three-unit classroom block for lower primary school children (age 6-9 years). It will also provide Borehole and overhead tank which will benefit a population of 3,579 with clean water as well as Toilet facility that will solve and reduce sanitation problems where women will benefit most. Target children enrolment is 265.

title: Careers Inspiration For Every Child
description: We are seeking your support to make a gift of inspiration to young people in Cambridgeshire. Many of them face a major struggle to make something of their lives, including knowing how to navigate the world of work and careers. By bringing employers into schools and providing workshops, mentoring and work experience, students increase their careers awareness and skills, motivation and ambition. Our goal is that all young people move successfully from education into employment.

title: Build a library in Uganda to benefit 700+children
description: At The Literate Earth Project we believe that literacy is truly at the core of human development, and it is our responsibility to provide developing countries with books, libraries, and literacy education.  We believe in harnessing the power of a community. We collaborate with communities to create, equip, and staff our libraries. By building community investment we create a foundation for continued success. To date we have built 16 libraries, the largest network in Uganda.

title: Feed and Empower Domestic Violence Survivors-Kenya
description: Be a heroic part of feeding an Entire Community of abused women & girls through the battered women's refuge, Agatha Amani House-AAH. Provide a life of purpose and sustainable enrichment with your support providing land to cultivate food,a green house,fencing,drip irrigation, water & the love & fun of sustainable, resilient & regenerative agriculture. AAH(https://www.agathaamanihouse.org/) is a Domestic Violence Shelter that  also provides community outreach through abused women support groups

title: AIDS United - Help Us End AIDS!
description: AIDS United (AU)'s programs are driven by the primary goal to ensure every person living with HIV in the US - and all vulnerable individuals impacted by the HIV epidemic - have access to quality health care, prevention, and support services. AU provides technical assistance (TA) to AIDS Service Organizations and Community Based Organizations. TA includes impact of trauma on PLWH and the importance of implementing trauma-informed care to ensure engagement and retention in care.

title: Tech changing child cancer detection (Colima)
description: AMANC (first NGO in Mexico to help children with cancer, since 1982) commited with the development of an intelligent digital platform that facilitates the detection of child cancer and speed up the start of the treatment. Colima joins in this national effort to raise the rate of early detection and survival of pediatric patients in our country.

title: Fund a fire engine for Northern Albanian community
description: This project is to assist the local North Albanian community to have their own functioning fire appliance (engine). Bodmin Rotary have donated a fire engine appliance to the community but need funding to renovate it, get it there and teach the community how to use it. This project will not only save lives but will give the community a focus on fire safety and prevention -creating employment for the local community will have a positive impact on the local economy and on their individual families

title: Fire Response in Ventura County
description: On November 8th, 2018, Southern California was hit again with another fire emergency and the Humane Society of Ventura County went into action. We rescued over 70 horses, cows, goats, and pigs using the new horse trailer that GlobalGiving kindly funded. We were able to bring these animals, some of them severely injured from the fire, to our Ojai facility. These animals will stay here for as long as necessary until they can be safely reunited with their owners. We are forever grateful!

title: Empower Survivors of Trafficking with BFF
description: Beauty for Freedom (BFF), exists to empower survivors of tracking through creative expression and skills training. Through our programming, BFF has empowered and supported 2000+ survivors of trafficking and at-risk youth in the United States, Cambodia, Ghana, Haiti, India and the Dominican Republic. Support our program as we expand with a job readiness program for survivors in the US and SE Asia which will include resume writing, image consulting and job interview prep for 15 survivors.

title: Recreation for 200 Special Needs Children in India
description: Tamahar works for children with developmental delay due to brain damage. Apart from regular alternative therapies, we realize the importance of recreational activities in the holistic wellness of these children. Currently we are working with over 60 children in Bangalore and believe that they deserve to go beyond mere survival and should get the opportunity to explore variety of games and fun programs like any other children. The idea is not to impart skills but to bring them sheer joy!

title: Save the Child- Help to Orphan Child in India
description: Theressa home for children working for the Orphan,Poor Disabled Children in Tribal Area.This project will provide Free Education,Nutrition food,Shelter for orphan Children in Tribal Hill area. We have 23 Orphan,Disabled HIV affected Children in theressa orphan home and we identified 25 orphan children in Tribal  area of andhra pradesh in India. Please Pray for them and Show your Love and help to provide bright future.

title: Build habitat equipment for 25 families in Ecuador
description: TECHO - ECUADOR plans to building transitional housing, ecological bathrooms ,water and energy solutions to 25 families in a slums in Duran, Ecuador. All these habitat equipment will reduce the vulnerable life situation of these families. All these work is made by the action of inhabitants of slums and former volunteers and will impact more than 350 people in a direct way.

title: Change the odds for kids in California
description: Over 2 million students in California are falling behind in Math and English. Think Together partners with school to help change the odds for these kids through expanded learning programs and innovative curriculum like coding. Help us prepare them for success in college and career this holiday season.

title: Empower Students | Heal India
description: Our mission is to empower students from developing communities in rural India to pursue medical studies. Funding will help us continue to provide professional coaching for students who demonstrate potential and desire to study, giving them the resources and support they need to pass the competitive entry exams and go on to medical college. With proper education and training, we believe these students can transform their communities and break cycles of poverty, disease and lack of education.

title: Tech Changing Child Cancer Detection
description: AMANC (first NGO in Mexico to help children with cancer, since 1982) commited with the development of an intelligent digital platform that facilitates the detection of child cancer and speed up the start of the treatment. Guerrero joins in this national effort to raise the rate of early detection and survival of pediatric patients in our country.

title: Road Home - Housing First Supports in Fredericton
description: Homelessness requires a shift in our collective approach to a widespread social challenge. Fredericton has joined the movement of communities in developing time-bound, targeted plans to end homelessness. 'The Road Home', presents our vision of being a community where all who find themselves homeless have options for housing and support, with the ultimate goal of ending homelessness. With housing builds underway, we are raising funds to provide the supports to ensure people remain housed.

title: Provide Healthcare for 1000 Under-served Families
description: Yanawana Herbolarios is a 501c3 nonprofit organization based in San Antonio, TX, that offers free botanically integrative healthcare clinics through partner organizations to the medically under-served. Community needs greatly exceed the current clinic days that Yanawana Herbolarios is able to offer without a permanent clinic location. Our goal is to establish a clinic that will offer 1 walk-in day weekly, free to the community, providing over 1000 families with vital healthcare in the 1st year.

title: New education for 5,400 rural students in Peru
description: The project applies education in alternation in Peru: students spend 2 weeks in school dedicated to the study and 2 weeks on the family farm, researching, developing projects and business plans, which generate inputs for teachers to develop a teaching according to the reality of the students and their families, thus breaking the cycle of poverty. Parents are actively involved in the management of the school. . The project seeks to improve the capabilities of teachers, principals and parents.

title: Empower 100 South African girls affected by GBV
description: The Bear Foundation (TBF) was formed in 2011 to help survivors of violence build their confidence and realise their self-worth. It is an organization born out of the personal struggle of the Founding Director of the BEAR Foundation, who survived an emotionally and physically abusive relationship. She felt the need to help other women who were struggling to get back on their feet and regain their sense of self after they left their abusers and formed the organization.

title: Empowering Our Girls: Girls on the Run - DC
description: Last year, Girls on the Run - DC offered financial assistance to 76% of girls who participated in the character development program and continue to see that need grow. By donating today, YOU can help girls feel greater confidence in who they are and what they can accomplish.   Your donation will support program scholarships for 16 girls and help them find the positive in themselves and others. You're giving girls social, emotional and physical well-being at a critical time in their lives.

title: Tech changing child cancer detection (Queretaro)
description: AMANC (first NGO in Mexico to help children with cancer, since 1982) commited with the development of an intelligent digital platform that facilitates the detection of child cancer and speed up the start of the treatment. Queretaro joins in this national effort to raise the rate of early detection and survival of pediatric patients in our country.

title: Prevent Childhood Stunting in Ghana
description: Help us prevent stunting in Ghana by providing supplemental feeding for children in their first 1000 days of life. For just $10 per month, a child can receive a one-months supply of GrowNut lipid-based nutritional supplements to prevent stunting. Stunting is caused by an inadequate diet in the first 1000 days (from conception to two years old) and lead to irreversible damage to a child's brain and body. Daily lipid-based nutrition supplements can prevent stunting for just $10 per month!

title: EcoKids Orchard
description: Less than half of Cameroon is forested. Almost 1% is lost annually due to population increase and its over dependency on the natural resources of the forest for their survival. At this alarming rate of deforestation, the next generation may not have a forest to interact with at all.  With your help, 20 kids will plant and care for 100 indigenous fruit tree seeds. Within 3 to 5 years and with the right care and attention they will grow, just like 50 EcoKids, to become big, strong and fruitful.

title: Youth Cricket Festival 2018
