description: This project aims to expand Real Medicine Foundation's lifesaving nutrition and hygiene work in rural Madhya Pradesh, India by 1) training and equipping more tribal women as community educators and 2) training and equipping women and adolescent girls to produce reusable sanitary pads. Women learn how to preserve their health and that of their children, while adolescent girls gain knowledge to keep them in school during menstruation, greatly improving their chances of completing secondary school.

title: Beauty Beyond Speech
description: This project will engage over 2000 deaf girls in 9 Schools for the Deaf in Nigeria on a life-saving training on stopping sexual/domestic abuse of deaf girls and providing them with literacy materials.

title: Pit latrines for 13 schools in the Philippines
description: The project aims at building blocks of pit latrines and lavatories in 13 schools in the Mindoro Island (Philippines). Currently the schools lack totally pit latrines and therefore there are great hygiene shortcomings, especially for the girls. The WASH project aims at guaranteeing the basic hygiene and at reducing the vulnerability of a population who lives in an area hit by natural disasters (almost 30 per year).

title: Empowering the local community through Textiles
description: Weaver classes for local men and women to help provide a sustainable business model for the local people.

title: Eradicate all forms of inequalities through Sports
description: Women Up is a female only program focusing on adolescent girls. Our goal is to build a community of vibrant, confident women who are able to set goals, make informed decisions and become responsible, accountable adults therefore breaking their cycle of poverty.

title: Providing Safe and Clean Water in Peru
description: With the increase in tourism and demand for water for local farming, there is an urgent need for water management and conservation efforts around Peru. The surge of the pandemic also means an increase in demand for clean water for sanitation and hygiene, this is unfortunately not possible due to their infrastructure. A gift to our project will help us to focus on water conservation to improve the lifestyles of the whole community and provide sustainable access to clean water

title: Advancing Digital Skills for Nigerian Girls
description: This project aims to broaden the participation of disadvantaged secondary school female students in STEM and Information, Communication and Technology fields by engaging them in afterschool workshops and STEM competitions that teach coding, artificial intelligence and mobile app development, in order to increase their motivation and capacities to pursue careers in STEM and ICT-related fields. MindAfrica will engage 200 girls from under-resourced schools in Rivers State, Nigeria.

title: Be the ray of hope for patients in dire need
description: The project aims to support 8 most needy patients from different provinces of Afghanistan. They are suffering from various diseases and cannot afford their treatment. Your generous support can help them regain a normal life. For example, Maryam (40) comes from a family with monthly income of 130 USD whereas her open heart surgery would cost 2565 USD. To sum up, a total of 7300 USD would suffice to save 8 precious lives in a war-ridden area with meager resources facing heightened challenges.

title: Girls w/disAbility & Moms Stop  Cycle of Violence.
description: 25 Nicaraguan girls w/disAbilities & their moms are walking in each other's shoes: growing together in health, recreation, education, & awareness of abuse & violence.  Magic Shoes are affirmation groups of moms & girls building communities, giving space for girls & moms to get to know each other. So often, girls, w/disAbilities  receive less attention in a family, invisible, even to her mom except for her disability.  The cycle of violence can be broken by aware moms & girls together.

title: Fruits and Shade for Schools (FSS) Project
description: Future Connect Ghana will create 20 orchards with 10 varieties of fruit and shade trees in 20 schools, 5 public playgrounds, and farmlands. This project will plant 10,000 fruit and shade trees to provide over 20,000 children with nutritious fruits to eat and play in a safe environment whilst away from their parents. The project will also benefit 1000+ farmers by planting trees on farmlands to provide resiliency to climate change and alternative livelihood to the underserved farming communities.

title: RESCUE ENDANGERED ELEPHANTS IN SRI LANKA
description: In the country of Sri Lanka, with a population of approximately 21 million people, there are about 5,800 elephants. With a land mass of 65,000 Km on this small island, it is easy to surmise that contacts between elephants and people are quite common. The ecosystem of the wild Asian Elephant (Elephas Maximas) is being encroached upon by human habitation, threatening the welfare of these endangered animals, as well as their human neighbors.

title: Empower Feed Educate Single mother headed families
description: Our main objective is the 'Prevention' of the worst forms of abuse, exploitation and discrimination of girls and young women. The EduCare Project is an innovative, unique, pragmatic and efficient new approach to support the helpless, hopeless and the most vulnerable. 'EduCare' stands for Education, Healthcare, Food, Clothing, Hygiene, Counseling and  Protection. We are focusing on families that are headed by single mothers/grandmothers with dependant daughters.

title: STEM education for 200 deprived girls in Ghana
description: Females in Tech Initiative is a project which trains young girls from slums and deprived areas in Ghana to develop problem-solving skills by educating them in STEM, IoT and coding. The end goal is to empower the girls to facilitate technology creation and impact their community. This is generating opportunities for societal transformation and ensuring inclusive and equitable quality education in Ghana.

title: Stability Assistance dog program
description: Dogs for the Disabled operates the only Stability Assistance Dog programme in Europe and currently has 56 child applicants on a 5year waiting list, these dogs are specifically trained to help children to walk.  Based on current projections for many of these children 5 years will be too late for them to achieve their goal of wanting to walk as their lack of muscle development and correct bone growth will result in the children being confined to wheelchairs permanently.

title: Build the Agency of 150 Adolescent Girls and Women
description: This project will provide 100 adolescent girls and young women, AGYW with vocational training and link them up to economic empowerment opportunities in Kaduna state and support 50 AGYW with funds to return to school and complete their secondary education. We will partner with the state education board and the state Ministry of Women Affairs to ensure enrolment back into school and linkages to economic opportunities to strengthen the agency and social capital of the 150 AGYW.

title: Job Training & Placement for 10,000 Liberian Youth
description: Eighty-five percent of Liberia's youth population is unemployed and our Employment Accelerator is aimed at creating a youth-led local workforce for the emerging Liberian economy. Through tailored trainings, we will develop a pipeline of young people who have the technical, social, and critical thinking skills for a changing local/global economy.

title: Rehabilitation of 300 neglected  children
description: Every child has rights to enjoy and ensure his or her childhood education cloth food health and hygiene love and affection from their parents. Neglected abandon helpless children have no such facilities due to loss of parents and negligence of relatives. State can not denied the problem as because children's are future of the State. these neglected children have every right to get their rights from the country or State. Our Association has extending support to them for sustainable dev.

title: Deliver 62 Single Mothers from abuse, Kibera Slums
description: Single mum in Kibera are prone to discriminated. Most of them gets unwanted pregnancies because of lifelong poverty. Their children are sexually abused in exchange for money, gift, food & accommodation. In this community Women are marginalized , especially when they do not work. Your $10 will give joy to one family. We nurture them & Support as entrepreneurs  & Artisan Skills through Education & use of Technology, to run sustainable Businesses using their creativity for their Independent living

title: Teach Chess to Low-Income New York City Students
description: Our goal is to improve the lives of New York City children by raising a total of $25,000 to pay for programming in an additional school.

title: Kick Off : Playing, Learning, Growing
description: [Toda la descripcion en espanol, aqui: https://bit.ly/2X62641]. The underlying  goal of this project is to work with rural schools to implement an educational approach based on football to tackle challenges faced by individuals and communities of distinct disadvantage.  Children are the future for their community and  what better way to educate life lessons and improve their well-being than with and through a school based on the world's most popular game: football (soccer).

title: Empower 20 Adolescent Girls from Rural Peru
description: Sacred Valley Health's (SVH) Adolescent Girls Empowerment Initiative (AGEI) will offer a health education and leadership development program to adolescent girls in rural Peru. Small groups of girls will meet weekly at local schools and participate in educational, team-building, and leadership training activities.

title: Support the Empowerment of Girls and Young Women
description: Supporting our work in Jordan and the Middle East and North Africa region means empowering girls and young women to take charge of their lives. Our work focuses on supporting girls and women who have lived through dangerous and harmful physical, emotional, or psychological experiences.

title: Women and Girls Education & Empowerment in Uganda
description: The women of  Uganda are the most undereducated gender for many reasons; one of the catalysts is poverty. Families so poor that the girl is the one removed from school to help at home or to be married off (as young as 11) to alleviate another mouth to feed. Whatever the reason, these women/girls no longer have access to education which then continues a cycle of poverty because they are usually the ones left alone raising children. We want to end this cycle by bringing classes to these villages.

title: Recycling plant to support children with cancer.
description: Installing a recycling plant is born to support 164 children and girls suffering from cancer, care sickness and high cost medical treatments.  The project integrates the areas of health, solidarity, environmental education and care of the environment, gathering and marketing for the economic, financial and self-sustainable sustainability assumed by the families and their small patients of cancer. Those who must travel to 3,000 km and begin their treatments, accompanied from their mothers.

title: spaying of street dog
description: Earth is mother land for all living beings despite everything we human our self has emphasized on our development, so every day in world  we see animals are suffering from hunger and disease, may be there can be good situation on develop country  but country like Nepal have much worst condition then we thought , currently we are working on street animals specially for street dog  on capital of Nepal to improve their betterment by providing medicine service for sick and injured spaying program.

title: Women's Right to Own & Inherit Property
description: The purpose of the  project is to raise awareness and build understanding of the factors that enable and constrain Afghan women, particularly the more vulnerable ones to eventually lead to the ability of, to enjoy their rights to access, own and inherit property in 5 provinces (Kabul, Herat, Mazar, Sar-e-pul and Parwan).

title: Training rural students for 'Joy of Making !'
description: To promote 'Learning while doing', 200 rural students from 10 rural secondary schools will be trained in Fab Lab at Vigyan Ashram. They will learn various skills in digital fabrication viz laser cutting, 3 D printing, Vinyl cutting, electronics and use of design software's. They will make STEM projects useful for them and their community using Fab Lab. They can use Fab Lab through out the year for making new things ! Projects will be displayed in science exhibition to encourage other schools.

title: Sponsor Education of 341 Orphan Children for 1Year
description: Social Action for Manpower Creation (SAMPARC) is a non-profit making Public Charitable Society and Trust in India established in 1990 for the rehabilitation, care and educational development of orphan children, children of socially victim women and all other needy, poor and disadvantaged children. SAMPARC needs your support in providing education to 341 orphan, poor & needy children in SAMPARC Orphanages in India.

title: Vegetables seedlings production and distribution
description: Due to most of the vegetables are imported from neighboring countries like Syria, Iran and Turkey, so we plan is to establish Five greenhouses in Bashiqa Sub-district to produce vegetable seedlings such as Tomato, Cucumber, Eggplant, Capsicumetc. Many IDPs families already returned and many other planning to return to the area and have no income and their main source of income depend on agriculture specially vegetables. So we will produce the seedling of the above vegetables

title: Let's Keep Food on 560 Needy Children's Plates
description: Live and Learn in Kenya International educates, feeds, clothes, provides medical/dental care and extracurricular activities, and is in the midst of building a school for over 500 devastatingly needy children mostly living in the slums of Nakuru, Kenya. Feeding all of the children a warm and nutritious meal on a daily basis, 6 days a week is a daily challenge! For nearly all of these children, their school meal is the only meal of the day. Join us in putting smiles on their faces. Feed a Smile!

title: Empower Kenyan Girls with Education
description: Makindu seeks to empower poor destitute girls in Kenya to complete full secondary education and obtain skills for an independent, healthy life. Girls in Kenya often drop out after primary school (8 years) when tuition is no longer covered. Girls receive socio-cultural pressure to abandon education in favor of early marriage, family caregiving, and home chores. This project pays tuition for girls to attend and complete secondary school, launching them towards higher studies or vocational careers.

title: Empower Young Rural Women with Vocational Training
description: Located in a small village of a tribal belt of Gujarat, the Vocational Training Centre of Muni Seva Ashram provides employment-oriented vocational training, soft-skill training, and employment assistance to young women in an exemplary residential setting. In a learning environment, with nutritious hygienic food and quality training, the centre has trained more than 2000 young women and placed more than 75% of them. You can sponsor a student and transform her life for less than $500.

title: Girls Matter - Stop Sexual Violence In Japan
description: Sexual violence and harassment toward women is far too frequent, affecting one-third of all women regardless of age, education, or economic status. This project aims to reduce the incidence of sexual violence against girls and young women in Japan through innovative school and university-based educational consent workshops. Striving to change attitudes through trauma education support groups to help survivors thrive. Please join TELL in our fight to create #BalanceforBetter in Japan.

title: Help 50 Indonesian Kids Continue Their Schooling
description: Most kids in Jakarta's poorest districts never make it to secondary education. They face immense hurdles from social and financial conditions they live in. This project provides much needed scholarship for 50 young students to ensure that they can continue their schooling on to junior high.

title: Inspire, Empower, Teach 200 Mozambican girls
description: This project will teach, inspire, and empower the girls who play rugby with ADEDAR iand other clubs in Mozambique. It will provide a safe and open forum for any type of discussions, critical life and employable skills, along with building confidence and a group of empowered women to empower other women. About 150 girls play rugby currently in Mozambique.  The project will serve these girls and encourage more to play and join.

title: Improve learning enviroment to 200 girls in Hai
description: The project will provide technical skills for manufacturing local sanitary pads to 200 girls student who trends to escape school during their menstruation period, local materials for manufacturing will be freely provided. For health improvement the project will build 2 toilet and washing facilities to support more girls to access and become more comfortable in schools during their menstrual cycles.

title: Education on HIV prevention
description: Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) refers to the use of antiviral drugs as a strategy for the prevention of HIV and AIDS.  This project will raise awareness about PrEP and will allow Mbarara Rise Foundation to provide medical testing and counseling services to over 200 youths individuals in Western Uganda, a population that is at high risk of being infected with HIV.

title: Skills Training to Empower Women in Meru, Kenya
description: Our project at International Peace Initiatives (IPI) Kenya will provide 105 women in Meru County free access to skills training so that they can provide for themselves, their families and change their lives by having a secure and stable income. Currently we are running year 3 of a 3-year project to support vulnerable young women in Meru to complete an accredited Diploma in Hair and Beauty. They will be able to care for their children and become agents of change for their communities.

title: Empower 1000 Girls: Menstrual Health in Uganda
description: Girls in Uganda are missing school when they have their periods due to a lack of access to sanitary products, sanitation facilities & the entrenched taboo surrounding periods - an average of 18 school days, per girl, per year are lost. Support 1000 girls within Gombe sub-county to manage their menstrual cycle with dignity, through the provision of affordable, reusable sanitary pads, menstrual health education and hygiene training - keeping them in school & furthering their education.

title: Empowering War Widowed Women in Sri Lanka
description: This project will focus on empowering 100 women heads of household in eastern Sri Lanka, who were widowed during the 30 years of civil conflict. Many  of who are ex-militants. Major components will include equipping women with the knowledge and skills to develop small businesses to earn and income and provide for their families and become self-sufficient, and strengthening the gender based violence desk to help these women report cases of violence, and gain the support required to rehabilitate.

title: Joga Garota
description: Sports event that values female sports practice as a way to break down gender stereotypes and patterns.

title: Transform Lives of Girls in Rural Kenya!
description: Girls of Wamunyu in rural Kenya are bright and eager to learn, but have to overcome many barriers in obtaining an education. Kenya Connect is working to help female students overcome these barriers by proving Reusable Sanitary Pad Kits (Wings Poa), Sexual Health and Family Planning workshops and ongoing enrichment programs for girls in technology, literacy, and economic empowerment. Help us keep girls in school and empower them to find and use their voice to lift out of extreme poverty.

title: Empower & Educate Mexican girls in Cabo San Lucas
description: Casa Hogar de Cabo San Lucas A.C. works with girls to transcend poverty, abusive family environments, and gender-based violence.  We work to restore violated rights and strive to equip young women who excel beyond the norm of our society, break cycles of violence and become agents of change in our communities. This project will focus on providing academic growth opportunities to 25 girls. Key components to drive change are Academic Coordinator and development of customized life plan.

title: Pink Pad Project
description: Pink Pad's primary focus is to distribute mensuration kits to underprivileged girls in the remote villages of Himalayan region. Each kit includes one year supply that contains 12 packets of sanitary pads, gloves, soap, pain killers and a guide book on usage and awareness. The aim of the project is to slowly remove the mensuration taboo, create health & hygiene awareness and give financial relief to families of these girls. Project plans to have a special focus on disabled and orphan girls.

title: Take Control! Children Life Skills Program
description: Take Control! aims at impacting 1'000 boys and girls (aged 10-15) living in the slums of Nairobi. Through life skills camps held during school holidays, students will learn how to strengthen their internal resilience and character to overcome their daily challenges. Participants are introduced to skills of Self, Others, and Decision Making through sport.  They are challenged to think differently and live differently, not becoming just another statistic of the slums.

title: Access to sanitary pads for refugee girls
description: This project will ensure consistent monthly supply of sanitary pads to 1000 refugee girls in their final year of primary schooling. Each girl will receive one pack of pads monthly over 12 months period which will help these girls complete and sit for their final primary leaving exams. In 2018, more than 200 refugee girls at Adjumani could not sit for their primary leaving examinations due to lack of sanitary pads and poor performance among girls was attributed to absenteeism during menstruation.

title: Girls for the future Project
description: The Mango Tree-Kenya has been implementing a girl for the future intervention in Homabay County, Kenya a view of eradicating the education barriers which prevent girls from regularly attending school and also to empower them to achieve their potentials in school. This has been done through provision of Reusable sanitary towels, school fees, home based care for the most at risk girls, peer- to- peer mentoring and health education/life skills seminars. Over 1500 girls  have so far benefited.

title: Youth Center for 250 Students in Rural Kenya
description: This project will equip a Youth-Friendly center as part of a larger project of Student Hostels for our Vocational Training students who come from remote hard-ship areas in Kenya. The center will provide 250 Vocational Training students a safe space where they can spend their time after school, playing games and hanging-out with friends, letting laughter take over and forgetting  about their harsh life circumstances, if even just for some moments.

title: Project for Skilling young women  in Uganda
description: The proposed Project for Skilling young women in Uganda to ensure equitable Development is to be implemented in Lukwanga Parish Wakiso District. The project is in line with the Government's Vision 2040 blueprint, aimed at transforming Uganda from a "Peasant to a modern and prosperous country within 30 years." Specifically, it supports the Education Sector Strategic Plan 2011-2020 "Skilling Uganda." Moreover, it conforms to the Sustainable Development Goal No. 4:

title: Sports4girls to end ECM-support500Indian girls
description: The project supports 500 girls to be educated & empowered on personal, legal & social aspects to see through their childhood specifically avoiding marriage and grow up in to aware, healthy, independent & productive adults. Empowering the girls through sports and enabling them to challenge the social norms to stop Early and child marriage (ECM) is aimed in the project. Early marriage violate the girl's right to health, education, protection & development making them dependent with lost identity.

title: Help us Empower Female Victims of Domestic Abuse
description: We run Freedom Programmes for women who are or have been affected by Domestic Abuse.  The Aim is to help them to make sense of and understand what has happened to them. The facilitators are wonderful and will give lots of support and practical help to the women who attend. The Freedom Programme also describes in detail how children are affected by being exposed to this kind of abuse and very importantly how their lives are improved when the abuse is removed.

title: Kids for Patagonia National Parks
description: Kids for Patagonia Parks will give kids from vulnerable schools access to outdoor learning experiences in the national parks of Chilean Patagonia. By introducing a new generation of Chileans to their natural heritage, this project will nurture future defenders of nature and stimulate their curiosity about the wonders of protected areas. The experience will help participants appreciate natural areas, and by doing so, create a new culture of national parks in Chile.

title: NEW Learning Center for children in poverty Mexico
description: Mayama aims to build the best learning center to empower and transform lives of thousands of girls, boys and their families who live in high marginalization and violence conditions in Jalisco, Mexico. In this new space they will have access to learning spaces based on our five development areas, a central courtyard and extensive sites for running and playing. Till the date we have attended more than 543 children, with your help more of them will have access to better education opportunities.

title: Help Street Women in Bali Escape a Life of Poverty
description: On a mission is to help mothers get off the streets and escape poverty. Our goal is to equip and empower 10 mothers with the skills they need to earn a living. We will then work and fund 1 of these mums each year to open their own small business. You can help the mothers by supporting them in creating a small business that's sustainable. Teaching them these skills will equip them to be employed or start their own business. The project will be a sustainable solution for mothers living in poverty.

title: Eradicate the avoidable blindness
description: India has the largest population of the blind in the world; with over 55M visually impaired and 8M of them totally blind. Good news is that nearly 80% of them are curable. Please help us eradicate curable blindness in India. Donate towards surgeries or towards the construction of upcoming super specialty eye care hospital in Braj Bhoomi, Mathura-Vrindavan, Uttar Pradesh, India.

title: Digitalization of Special Child's Development
description: Each special child is assigned a development plan basis his IQ level and ability called Individualized Education Programme (IEP) unlike a standardized plan implemented in mainstream education. The current framework (because of its comprehensive nature), does not lead to optimum development of a special child. Hence, Suryoday trust has developed a platform leading to : I. Efficient and Streamlined IEP development & tracking II. Robust database to drive innovation

title: Empowering Girls and Women as Mothers
description: This project will build sexual reproductive knowledge, understanding including pregnancy prevention and parenting skills into 100 students and 200 women.Training will be implemented in 39 different villages in our catchment area. Lack of parental knowledge as to pregnancy prevention and parenting skills in the adults lives leads to their children being ill prepared for life as young sexually debuting teenagers. Greater Tzaneen Municipality has one of the highest HIV prevalences in the country.

title: Teaching menstrual hygiene to 100000 Indian girls
description: This project will enable 100,000 young marginalized girls in Southern India (Vellore District to be precise in the state of Tamilnadu) to learn about puberty, menstrual hygiene, adolescence and reproductive health through peer education using print and audo-visual aides.

title: Boost Women's Livelihood Collectives for Equality
description: The project plans to assist 200 women mushroom growers in six villages in Tamulpur and Nagrijuli blocks of Baksa districtin Assam. The villages are Pakhribari, NatunHaoli, Montangapar, Kalipur, Ulubari and Ahuzarguri. Baksa district sharesan international border with Bhutan which is about 5 kms away from the above mentioned villages. The project aims in providingthe women mushroom growers a platform towards sustainable development though economic benefit. The target women belong to Bodo, Nepali,

title: Support  Kenya Teenagers to Get Financial Reality
description: CHAP will provide a free Financial Literacy Reality Fair project to over 1000 poor teenagers in  high school and out of school in Vihiga County and provide unique opportunity for students to experience some of the financial challenges they will face when they start life on their own. It's a Hands on experience in which teenagers will identify their career choice and starting salaries then complete a budget sheet requiring them to live within their monthly salary while paying for basics needs.

title: Integrating Energy, Water, and Food - Cestos City
description: Liberia Emergency and Disaster Relief Fund, LEADER FUND, plans to implement a green infrastructure project that uses 3KW of solar energy to:  access and distribute groundwater for drinking, sanitation, and hygiene to 10,000 persons; irrigate a small agriculture demonstration project growing food crops (pepper, okra, bitter balls, potato greens, etc.); and provide electricity for the County Service Center and planned Internet Cafe that will benefit more than 2,000 youths.

title: "Pink Bags" scholarships for young girls
description: In the world, more than 60 million girls cannot attend primary and lower secondary school. The roots of this gender gap can be found in child marriage, early pregnancy, poverty and in schools, that often, not meeting the safety, hygiene or sanitation needs of girls. Since 2018 we promote the "Pink Bags" project: scholarships for deserving young girl students living in difficult economic and social conditions. Because to educate a girl means creating a virtuous circle out of poverty.

title: Breast Prostheses for 341 Breast Cancer Survivors
description: Life without breasts is hard for any woman. 80% of women in rural Kenya are diagnosed with late stage breast cancer, ending in mastectomy. Given the high costs of mastectomy bras and breast prostheses in Kenya ($200-$300), it is unaffordable for these women who have already incurred the hefty treatment costs. Therefore they resort to using rags, socks etc in place of a prosthesis. This project will distribute 341 breast prostheses and mastectomy bras to deserving women in rural Kenya.

title: Plant 100 Hectares, Support 100 Families in Choco
description: Sustinere and its partners' reforestation project is in the Choco, Colombia, one of the world's most biodiverse areas, with more than 8,000 species of plants and 600 species of birds. In the 2000s, the Choco suffered 60% of the deforestation in Colombia, due to mining  and logging. The project will restore 100 hectares of forest that will benefit 100 families with fruit trees and medicine plants. Trees will absorb 15,000t of carbon, create a group of 50 women entrepreneurs and educate children.

title: CONSTRUCTION OF HOSTEL BUILDING
description: This project will help the students of Sri Sathya Sai Institute of Educare, (a CBSE school) to have a comfortable stay in a new hostel building, changing the present situation of class rooms being used as hostel rooms after school hours.

title: Train Hundreds of Haitian Women Beekeepers
description: Beekeeping can be an important source of income for women and children in Haiti, where over half of the population lives in poverty. We are raising $50,000 to set up and staff 10 beekeeping demonstration sites and bee-plant nurseries. These sites will train 400 new beekeepers (at least 60% women) in Western Haiti each year and become a small, but important, part of the global effort to save the bees.

title: Empower Children for a Greater Tomorrow
description: Empower children for a greater tomorrow understands the importance of healthy self-esteem in the development of youth. Through after school skill building workshops and mentoring programs, YNOT will assist students with everyday experiences and empower youth to make positive choices in the future. Supporting  youth to be self-assured and confident in their future choices.

title: Support Women's and Girls' Empowerment
description: With the packs we deliver for 'better self-care' or 'return to school,' or with the awareness/information sessions on early marriages, civil rights, gender equality, or with vocational trainings; with vocational trainings helping women create sustainable change in their lives, we aim to empower women, increase their awareness of gender equality and self-reliance help them gain skills to achieve a sustainable improvement in their lives.

title: Employability and Leadership for Young Women
description: The Employability and Leadership Program for Young Women in a Vulnerability Situation seeks to develop capacities for employability, leadership and community transformation in female students of the last levels of schools located in the Greater Metropolitan Area of Costa Rica. The Program seeks to directly impact 200 young women in 4 high-risk communities, which have been declared a priority because of their fragile socioeconomic context.

title: Help Build a Clinic for 35K people in Dondon Haiti
description: Healthcare infrastructure in Haiti is almost non-existent. In Dondon, Haitian Vision Foundation is changing that. We are a collaboration of dedicated Americans and Haitians already providing care in Dondon, despite the lack of a clinic, electricity or running water. Now, the town leaders have given us a challenge- they have given us 3 acres of land with the caveat that we build a quality clinic, and soon. The challenge is great, but working together we are on the verge of something special!

title: Provide Emotional Support for Girls in Quito!
description: 60% of the 685 children UBECI works with in the markets of Quito are girls. This alarming statistic means girls are less likely to attend school than boys and therefore have fewer opportunities later in life. With the Global Giving 2019 Girl Fund Campaign, UBECI will: work with psychologists to improve girls' self-esteem and work to change the community's mindset to focus on the importance of women's education and equal opportunity.

title: Donate a brick for the Education of Rural India
description: Gopali Youth Welfare Society, an NGO run by the students of Indian Institute Of Technology, Kharagpur, West Bengal aims to empower the rural children by imparting 'quality education' to them. The project is to make the infrastructure for a school upto class XII. We need reserves of the qouted amount to start so that the process runs smooth.

title: Save the girl child from cervical cancer
description: This project is providing HPV vaccine to 1000 (one thousand) boys and girls between the ages of 11-12 years in Nigeria whose parents cannot afford the lifesaving vaccine. This vaccine will protect them from Human papilloma virus infection that causes cervical cancer. Hence this project will save the 1000 (one thousand) beneficiaries from cervical cancer and other related cancers (cancer of the Anus, penis,).

title: Empower and educate girls free of sexual violence
description: Fundacion Idea Dignidad works with girls and their families to eradicate sexual violence and forced pregnancy. We develop training and accompaniment through art to increase their self-esteem, knowledge of their rights and create protective environments in which they can develop their skills and life projects. With this project, girls, their families and caregivers will have access to psychosocial support, didactic material and education about rights through art and play.

title: COMPREHENSIVE EDUCATION FOR 16 INDIGENOUS CHILDREN
description: The 160 indigenous children living at NPH arrived poorly educated, malnourished and not speaking Spanish. If they stayed in their community they would not be able to break their cycle of poverty. We provide comprehensive education to our almost 800 children, and indigenous children need extra help. We offer them a safe home, schooling from kindergarten through college, balanced meals, medical/psychological care, and guidance to help them become responsible adults.

title: Star Cities 2
description: Continuation of Star City Models Project; a joint project with YMCA-Gabrovo, Planetarium-Gabrovo and Club Icarus 2010-Sevlievo. Practical training with children between 10 and 15. Lecturers will teach the children astronomy, astrophysics, astronautics, space engineering, rocket building and general knowledge about space. Based on gained experience from the first project and the implemented good practices, we will double the number of participants (from 15 to 30) within the same budget

title: UPGRADING OF GEORGE IWILADE LIBRARY
description: In an increasingly digital world, we see the role of libraries as community and cultural centers at times undervalued, and occasionally under fire. When shrinking government budgets combine with the nonstop technological revolution, public library services that focus on building community face-to-face, inspiring and educating the younger ones about art, sciences, literature, and music, and helping them engage in civil discourse can seem quaint.

title: Enable children to attend preschool in SouthAfrica
description: Children in a rural areas in the Eastern Cape in South Africa are not able to attend pre-school because their families cannot afford to pay the minimal fees required for each child per month. As a result, when children enter the schooling system, they are already way behind their peers who went through preschool. It becomes very difficult for such children to catch up with others. Early learning is crucial for a child's development and every child should be given the opportunity.

title: Productive Rural School: education and autonomy
description: This project will help young people in the Nahua community of Tepetzintan to have an educational-productive space managed, designed, and built by the student community, which will allow them to detonate local trades, recover traditional knowledge and generate community development.

title: Construction to Combat Climate Change
description: Climate Change=Hotter Summers=More Air Conditioning (AC) use=Skyrocketing Energy Usage=More Climate Change! Is there an alternative? YES! We are it! Our cutting-edge, ecological and healthy building is a game-changer. We have a cooling system without ACs! Even at 42 degrees Celsius (107.6 F) this summer, we were fine inside without any air-conditioning. This building is an example for the whole world! We are in it and loving it, but we need your help to finish it and its unique cooling system!

title: Save Lives in sub-Saharan Africa from Snakebite
description: Every year, over 138,000 people die from snakebites globally, with at least four times as many left disabled and often in life-long debt. At Health Action International, we're fighting to stop this needless crisis, as the only life-saving treatment, antivenom, has already existed for decades. This project will allow us to educate communities and rural healthcare workers throughout Kenya on crucial prevention and treatment of this widely neglected and misunderstood medical emergency.

title: Women's Initiative for Sustainable Empowerment
description: This project provides 3-day training opportunity for women and younger generations to shape ideas into actionable project plans. Many areas in Japan still lack inclusive environment where women and younger generations can maximize their full potential. We can create new social values by turning such challenges into (social) business ideas. JSIE will provide inclusive working-together opportunity in rural areas in Japan with people of diverse background. Please join us to lead social innovation.

title: Youth For Change
description: About Youth For Change:  The goal of our program is to equip participants with life skills and work experience by employing them in a variety of projects.  Some of those projects include:  Constructing, maintaining or repairing hiking trails, restoration of natural areas, park construction or repair, trash removal and general clean up of natural areas.   Program Mission:  is to provide young adults withopportunities for success through job skills training, education, teamwork, andwork experience

title: Protect 30 girl children at risk of prostitution
description: The program named "Where Dreams Bloom", aiming to protect 30 children aged 6 -18 and are daughters or sisters of women earning living from prostitution. The program facilitates their study by supporting school fees until they complete K-12; helps to reduce the risk of leaving school, involving in prostitution and related risks.

title: EDUCATE A GIRL TO END CHILD MARRIAGE
description: Summary 40% of Ugandan girls are forced into early marriage before the age of 18 in return for pride price from the groom's family. This has resulted into high school dropout rates, illiteracy and vicious cycle of poverty. Life Concern will help to address this through provision of scholastic materials, boarding facilities, and also addressing all forms of violence against girl child by;- educating parents on value of girl child education, sexual reproductive health rights and empowerment.

title: Hong Kong LGBT+ training for 200 Service Providers
description: In Hong Kong, LGBT people exists in all kinds of occupations. However, sexual orientation discrimination and gender identity issues may be a problem for some LGBT people when they need medical and counselling services. Providing training to service providers allows them to understand the needs of the LGBT+ community. In our project, there will be 4 sharing sessions & 5 education trainings for 200 service providers. There will also be 10 volunteer trainings and 2 exhibitions for public education.

title: Ipogun Water and Sanitation Project
description: Ipogun-Ayo community in Ifedore LGA, Ondo state has a growing population of 421,100. The entire community does not have toilets, potable water (polluted stream) nor refuse disposal system. The elders, youths and the local health workers have reported that many diseases suffered by the people, such as chronic diarrhea, soil transmitted helminthes,Schistosomiasis, Elephantiasis and Hepatitis were directly related to the open defecation, lack of good water supply and poor hygienic practices.

title: Waldorf Training to three teachers in Kenya.
description: Based in the UNESCO Statistics from 2016, less than 10% of women in Kenya have the opportunity to go to university, and with this fundraising project we will pay the complete fees of Rudolf Steiner training to one teacher, finish to pay the partial fees of the two other teachers from Hai Africa School and buy pedagogy books providing them with high quality education in order to impact the education of  39 kids from our kindergarten. In addition, the funds raised will also help cover 1 year rent.

title: Full brain development for 200 children in Mexico
description: 90% of a child's brain is developed in their first three years. We attend 180 families to achieve their children's optimal development by working with the child and his caregivers. Neuroscience affirms that a child that experiences family violence and does not have positive interactions with adults, suffer irreversible damage resulting in a smaller brain size for life. De Cero A Tres is building with families of communities in Mexico, a future with hope and equal opportunities for their children

title: Help 20 students with low school performance
description: Descubriendo al Ser is a nonprofit that helps children with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD). With our project, we want to help 20 Mexican children with low school performance for a full school year. Through free psychopedagogical assessment and customized learning plans, we help students  acknowledge and enhance their abilities and virtues. We also want to provide free pedagogical support and continuous psychological care, in order to keep children from vulnerable situations.

title: Save Children Medical Outreach Project
description: Save Children Medical Outreach Project plans to build a dispensary in order to increase friendly healthcare services to street connected children (Most Vulnerable Children) in Mwanza. Save Children Medical Outreach Project have being in operational for past four years where street connected children were provided with free wound care, nursing, treatment, skin diseases and screening of parasite related diseases such as intestinal worms, schistosomiasis under the temporary tent on weekly basis.

title: Build an Orphanage for 300 Orphans in Mavoko Kenya
description: St Annes Rehabilitation Centre is an international Non-governmental organization. Currently it provides care and support to 130 orphans and abandoned; 318 vulnerable children. The Centre has enabled over 621 orphans and vulnerable children complete education and have quality livelihood. St Annes Rehabilitation Centre is raising resources to build a morden children home for 300 orphans, business resource center and an Education centre that shall provide primary and high school education.

title: Hope to the Hopeless_Donation of washable pads.
description: Sponsor hopeless school girls with Rewashable Sanitary Pads.While most girls started school again , many were forced to stay home due to their period. Buying sanitary pads is a monthly struggle for so many families in Botswana. Washable pads are a sustainable solution to help keep girls in school and break the cycle of poverty. This initiative runs until 26th of June 2019 and  we donated a batch to 50 sanitary rewashable  pads to school girls on the 30th January 2019. #KeepAGirlChildInSchool.

title: Malaria parasite screening in Langbasa village
description: Malaria parasite screening and distribution of free mosquito nets for malaria prevention,  to benefit 200 poor families in Langbasa village in Ajah area of Lagos state, Nigeria.

title: Livelihood for 300 young people with disability
description: The proposed project aims to work in the legal framework of Indian Act to ensure all young people with disabilities have access right skills and in turn decent employment, quality life and independence. As per our past experience, it shows less than 10% of population is gainfully employed. Hence the focus of this project to drive unattended young. The goal of this project is "To ensure livelihood opportunity for 300 young people with disabilities annually".

title: Medical Support Please Lend a Hand and Save a life
description: This project will look to support someone in need in Bangladesh where it is difficult to get proper medical support. It is further worse conditions for those who face poverty in Bangladesh whom cannot even get basic medical needs.

title: Child care to 10 Orphans and vulnerables in Uganda
description: This project will provide child care support to 10 orphans and vulnerable children in Namulesa Village in Uganda through Providing educational support and meals to affected by HIV/AIDS epidemic

title: Save 500 Girls from Child Marriages in Bangladesh
description: We propose interventions to enhance the enforcement of child marriage laws in rural areas of Bangladesh by ensuring universal coverage of birth registration (UBR) of girls within the target group (aged 14-17) as well as creating awareness of a mobile-phone based surveillance and reporting system - connecting enforcing agencies with potential victims - to restrict the practice of child marriage.

title: Support Storytelling By Women Living in Palestine
description: femLENS offers photography education as a tool for empowering women and supporting them during lifelong learning. With support of a local partner, our photography and storytelling workshops will give 20 Palestinian women a chance to create and share their own stories. This will give women a voice, much needed in the media space, and will enrich the representation of Palestine. With the workshops we hope to raise global awareness on social issues through first-hand accounts.

title: Save babies from prisons in Abia State,  Nigeria
description: Every day  innocent babies are left languishing in Nigerian prisons (AU Report, 2013). CRAPI'S visits to just two prisons recently revealed 10 pregnant women and 10 nursing mothers with their babies, and 15 babies respectively;  typical evidence of administrative incoherence in justice system in Nigeria with poor implementation of the child's rights laws

title: Lets build classrooms for 120pupils in Mukono
description: This project will build and complete our primary seven classroom, furnish our other classrooms and possibly sponsor a few more children to stay in school. Yes and Amen Education Centre's vision is to give as many children as possible the opportunity be in school and with this funding the children of Nsavu village will be able to acquire an education under a properly roofed classroom with a good learning environment.

title: ATP Community Medical Outreaches for Nigerian Kids
description: Ask The Paediatricians Foundation promotes good health and well-being of indigent children in Nigeria through our periodic community medical outreaches. We do two main outreaches annually targeted at indigent children in under-served communities throughout the country with no regular access to healthcare services. The Outreaches feature health talks, mass deworming, nutritional assessments, healthy lunch-packs, free medical & dental consultations, basic lab tests, essential drugs and clothes.

title: Empower Cambodian Girls with Hygiene and Education
description: PROJECT G, as in G for Girls!! We are focused on bringing health education and sustainable menstrual solutions to girls in rural Cambodia.  Without basic hygiene education and sanitation, rural girls often miss many days of school ultimately dropping out. Partnering with Days for Girls, we provide safe, beautiful, long-lasting washable menstrual Kits along with our important health education. Our Kits are sewn locally in our sewing workshop in Siem Reap providing employment to local women

title: Provide Education to AIDS Boko Haram Victims
description: Hope 360 Initiative for Peace is working to free orphans from the cycle of poverty by providing a high-quality, free education, both formal and informal, to children who have been Victims  due to insurgency order to counteract pervasive hunger, poverty, and systemic deprivation. Your donation will help provide a student with a uniform, meals, medicine, and supplies for one school year. For our secondary students, your donation will also include transportation to their school.

title: Rescue and Conserve Mission Taiz Zoo Taiz, Yemen
description: An ongoing civil war has left both people and animals in a lifeboat situation in Yemen. A Lion's Heart has dedicated itself to care for a war torn zoo of almost 300 animals trapped. They have no one else and cannot be moved. We provide all life's essentials including food, water, vitamins, veterinarian supplies and care, hygiene. Without these essentials, all animals would die.  Our goal would be to meet these needs and go further by replacing all substandard enclosures providing more jobs.

title: Early Hearing Detection & Intervention Equipment
description: Hearing impairment is the most prevalent sensory deficit currently affecting our population, globally.Without screening for hearing impairment, children routinely remain undetected, which is critical for language and speech development.The resources provided will ensure accessiblity to early hearing detection and intervention. Babies would be screened after birth, or before being discharged.Those identified would be  provided with timely and appropriate intervention services before six months.

title: "Help the Babies Grow Healthy"
description: The new project of Mavi Kalem aims to support basic health needs of the babies in the region and to reach 250 babies of Fatih / Balat neighborhood where Mavi Kalem has been implementing important projects since its establishment. "Help the Babies Grow Healthy" project is a small step to meet the basic hygiene and health needs of the babies. The idea was proposed to Mavi Kalem by high school student volunteers Arin Akcura and Can Tulpar and it was enthusiastically supported by Mavi Kalem team.

title: China Coastline Monitoring and Cleanup
description: Marine litter has been a global issue, and getting worse in recent years. In this project, we will make surveys along China coastline on the category, quantity and sources of litters on the beach, and estimate its change trend. The research report can help the public, the national and regional authority to realize serious situation,  and make efforts together to protect marine environment pollution.

title: Help a rural youth to be employed in Varnasi India
description: Social Action for Manpower Creation (SAMPARC) is non-profit making Public Charitable Society and Trust in India established in 1990 for the rehabilitation, care and educational development of orphan children, children of socially victim women and all other needy, poor and disadvantaged children. SAMPARC needs your support in providing skill development training to 1200 rural youth in SAMPARC Vocational Training Centre, Varnasi Uttar Pradesh.

title: Employment Creation for 150 Youths in Kisumu
description: This project will create employment for at least 150 unemployed youths in Kisumu, Kenya by initiating five different worker-owned cooperatives and providing support to progressively increase capacity of the new establishments to be able to absorb at least 30 unemployed youths in the first year and then a limitless number of other unemployed young people in the community in the next year, in order to address the challenges of unemployment including gang involvement and drug abuse.

title: Sports Program for Vulnerable Youth in Cape Town
description: Introducing a new three day sports holiday program! Due to COVID-19, our annual seven week Street Sports Tournament which offers sport to hundreds of vulnerable youth in Cape Town has been cancelled. However, with children out of school for so long this year and spending more time on the streets, it is more important now than ever to get children involved in healthy activities with coaches that can be positive role models.

title: Happier Homes in the UK
description: Koach Parenting will support 35 disadvantaged families who have a child with challenging behaviour.  Qualified Parenting Practitioners will provide  free one-to-one coaching.  Parents will be listened to and learn new skills to create a calmer atmosphere at home.  Parents will gain confidence to put boundaries in place, through understanding life through the eyes of their child.

title: SAVE OUR OCEANS: STOP MARINE LITTER
description: This project will implement an island wide outreach programme to educate Saint Lucians on the impact of marine litter on the critical marine ecosystems and resources on which the country's economy  depends on.  The project will include activities to restore the ocean bed and remove trash  and waste from marine habitats where they can injure young and juvenile fish, reptiles, birds and other aquatic lifeforms.

title: Women Motorcycle Riders
description: In Rwanda, early pregnancy has increased from 6.1% to 7.3%. Most of these women drop out of school, and they are jobless. They're not able to raise and cover their children and expenses. They go for prostitution and drug abuse as a response. SafeMotos Institute plans to economically empower 200single mothers and poor unemployed women in Rwanda by enabling them to work in a male-dominated industry, motorcycle taxi industry. It's a worthy career, as they earn $10/day as an income to live and save.

title: Help Create Enriching Library For Rural Students!
description: Help us create a library full of magic and wonder for 120 rural students! The Los Algarrobos School was fortunate enough to build a new building this year that will become our new library and multi-purpose classroom. There is a lot of space to fill and at the moment we have just two book shelves of books and one with toys. Help us create a magical library where students can learn, create and imagine!

title: Horse-based therapy for disabled children in China
description: HOPE enriches the lives of disabled orphans, and others with special needs, through therapeutic horsemanship. Children in China who typically have extremely limited access to therapy services, connect with HOPE's well-trained therapy horses to provide a proven avenue for physical, cognitive, and social growth.

title: FIGHTING HUNGER  For The Homeless Community
description: We are mobile task force providing, immediate relief to the homeless community by delivering meals, personal hygiene items, clothing, job referrals and hope-direct to those in need.  We are a platinum Guide Star participant. What makes OSTS organization unique is our "mobile services" because we specialize in seeking out the most critical homeless areas.  We have fed over 18,000. Our objective is to reach 10,000 homeless persons within one year.

title: Educate and Energize Girls in Guinea, West Africa
description: This project energizes girls from some of the poorest families in Guinea to get an education by paying their schools fees, as well as uniforms and supplies.  In addition, an education monitor is assigned to each girl to keep the support of the family, especially the father.  At times we must provide food for the family, so the girl is not forced to work. By providing the education monitor, the girl can give 100% to her class work.

title: Better health for Chepang Community of Nepal
description: The Chepang is one of the poor, marginalized, indigenous ethnic communities in Nepal. They have lived a semi-nomadic life, fully dependent on natural forest resources surrounding them. Households average about 6-8 people in small inadequate conditions, leaving families vulnerable to infectious diseases. The nearest health post can be up to 7 hour walk away. Implementing WASH awareness program for the Chepang will make them be aware of infectious diseases and help to prevent ill health in future.

title: Water - crisis - Mentally Challenged children
description: Project Site  - village in South East Bangalore - India.  Water shortage exists due to urbanization affecting Gerizim's Boys Home waterless for the past 4 months.  The beneficiaries of this project are more than 60 orphaned & Mentally Challenged teenagers.  This crisis forces us buy water everyday shelling a lot of money meant for the child care ($10 /load /day) - a great cause of concern. The issue could be sorted out by digging up/ deepening the borewells costing approximately $10,000/-

title: Haiti children in desperate need of food and water
description: EMERGENCY IN HAITI. THE COUNTRY IS ON THE VERGE OF CIVIL WAR. THOUSANDS OF CHILDREN ARE IN DANGER. URGENT APPEAL  OF THE FOUNDATION FRANCESCA RAVA N.P.H. ITALY TO HELP FATHER RICK FRECHETTE, DOCTOR IN THE FIRST LINE, LEADER OF N.P.H HAITI AND OF THE FOUNDATION SAINT LUC, IN RELIEF  TO THE PEOPLE OF PORT AU PRINCE.

title: Make Motherhood Safe with Ultrasound Imaging
description: Based in rural northern Tanzania, FAME is a modern hospital, laboratory and outpatient clinic with more than 27,000 patient visits annually. With 52 medical staff trained in emergency obstetric and newborn care, FAME is the go-to hospital for high-risk pregnancies in our area and beyond. Help FAME purchase an ultrasound machine - a critical diagnostic tool - to provide advanced care for pregnant women and their babies through our comprehensive Prenatal Program.

title: Every 4th girl is a child bride. Help change this
description: Rashmi, a young girl in India, has a simple dream: of passing class 10. For many of us, this isn't even an aspiration. But for almost 80 million girls, this is where it begins. Girls in India live with restrictions: from being taught early that they will always be second best, to being married off at a young age. Rarely do girls get a say in their own lives. Yet they dream. And you can help girls realise that their dreams aren't impossible to fulfill.

title: Empowering girls through education and leadership
description: Woman's Hope , through the seasons for girls program intends to convene, connect and mentor girls through education and leadership development. The season for Girls Leadership Program educates, empowers and champions girls living in the urban slums of Nairobi - setting them off on the path to self discovery.

title: Helping children and women to help themselves
description: Children are the future citizen of our country and women are the pillars that hold the family and community at large. Providing educational support and vocational training will empower these women and children living in the slums around Lake Gardens in Kolkata to reduce social vices like school drop out, early marriage and domestic violence

title: The Pitch - Batting Cage in Sosua
description: Working hard to grow a Youth Baseball Enhancement Program to a large community of at-risk and impoverished youth in Sosua on the Dominican North Coast we opened the current facility in Oct. 2017. Serving on avg. 150 kids/week we encourage kids to get off the streets, stay involved in youth activities (baseball) & continue their education. In 2018 we distributed $15K USD value in used equipment donated to us, then redistributed to the kids allowing all children under age 16 to practice for free.

title: JOY is a kindergartener playing the violin.
description: The Yamhill Enrichment Society (YES) wants funds to expand its JOY music program to cover K through 5th grades.  Based on the internationally successful El Sistema program to harness the power of music for social change, JOY brings joyful learning, discipline, and achievement to an underserved population in rural Yamhill County, Oregon.

title: Save Life of 1,500 Donkeys in Afghanistan
description: More than 1500 Donkeys and thousands of other animals suffering from different kind of diseases and also face with hunger, the local people are unable to supply food or medicine to their Animals. Our full time technical staff using traditional medicines to 30 donkeys per month for their treatment & supply food to 50 donkeys per week to save them from hunger. Help us to save the life of 1500 donkeys from death in Afghanistan because of their owner's financial situation

title: Empowering dreams in Mexico
description: This project helps, through education, to economically empower Mexican women so they can start and run a successful business and create a better future for themselves and their families.

title: Help Build a Science Laboratory in Rural Liberia
description: The Gorblee Science laboratory project is being constructed as the only regional lab to help prepare rural junior and senior high school students. Our goal is to empower the school with a fully equipped shared regional lab to prepare students in science courses (biology, physics and chemistry) needed to obtain their school diploma. In Liberia, over 80% of schools have no functional laboratories making it very difficult to succeed in the learning.

title: Pedaling 400 Paws per year to rescue
description: BARC currently transports at least 100 dogs and cats per year to rescue groups, foster families, and forever homes.  The dogs and cats must be transported from a fairly rural area.  Volunteers are currently using their own vehicles which are not always optimal for safe transport.  For this reason, BARC seeks a transport van to "pedal" our dogs and cats to rescues, fosters, and adopters safely.

title: Build a solar - powered classroom in South Africa
description: Greensleeves Children's Trust is a home and school for 55 children who have either been orphaned or come from abusive and vulnerable backgrounds, located in South Africa. The Trust plans to build a self - sufficient classroom powered solely by renewable energy, which will help provide an education for these children, while reducing our impact on the environment.

title: Construction of School Building for Blind Girls
description: Through the proposed project, a new building for Smt. Ambubai Residential School for Blind Girls shall be constructed on the land located at Gulbarga, Karnataka, India.The building shall comprise two separate floors. The ground floor shall comprise the primary, secondary and high-school to provide education for more than 100 blind girls, whereas the first floor shall comprise their dormitories, library, kitchen, dining hall warden rooms etc.

title: Build A Wall to Keep 47 Ugandan Children Safe
description: A high security wall needs to be built to ensure the safety of the 47 children currently living at the Children's Home in Namugongo, Uganda.  The existing chain-link fence is in a bad state, and even if it was to be repaired, would be inadequate.  Victory Child Care Project - Ty Cariad Children's Home is a childcare institution approved by the Ugandan Government. It currently looks after 47 children at the home, and their needs include love, security, food and nutrition, and education.

title: Supporting Satsang with Mooji
description: Mooji is a world-renowned spiritual teacher who guides seekers to who they are beyond the limitations of conditioning and identity. Thousands of people are deeply touched by Mooji's teachings and their lives are being profoundly transformed.  Mooji Foundation brings Mooji's pointings to people all around the world so they can discover true freedom. The charity offers grants and concessions and provides support for Satsangs, online teachings and the growth of Monte Sahaja ashram in Portugal.

title: A sensory room for traumatized kids, Palestine
description: The project intends to the reduce the problems of the children hosted by the Creche centre, who are traumatized and who suffer from hyperactivity or inactivity, with a new sensory room. The sensory room is specifically designed to provide the kids a complete sensorial experience, so that they can develop their senses and skills. Special lights, music and objects in the room have a soothing and relaxing power on the traumatized kids.

title: Raising 200 young women with market skills
description: The Gift Of A Girl Foundation plans to hire a hall for one year to provide market skills to 200 young women in Kanapa community among the  poorest who have dropped out of school

title: Send surplus donated medical aid to Sierra Leone
description: People living in extreme poverty in Sierra Leone suffer greatly from ill health, disease and malnutrition. This project will send one shipping container full of vital medical aid to rural health centres and hospitals where they constantly face shortages of vital healthcare supplies.  Everything in the container is donated surplus healthcare goods which would otherwise have been incinerated. Up to half a million beneficiary patients, 60% children, will access the healthcare goods free of charge.

title: Support STEM education in 1000 Bulgarian schools
description: DigitalKidZ wants to donate the GO! coding boards to 1,000 Bulgarian schools and return the excitement of learning to bring students back to school.

title: HCF SUPERMOM PROJECT
description: The HCF SuperMom Project is part of HarryCares Foundation (HCF) Community Development Initiative to create a platform for women to educate themselves on managing motherhood and self-development.   1. Provision of pre-natal vitamins, maternity wipes, and other health support. Increased access to Maternity Health Care. 3. Learning how to balance work life and family time, embracing the power of "NO", prioritizing and accomplishing more.  4. Learning to single task and creating time saving ideas.

title: Educate and Equip Girls in Rural China
description: CWEF High School Scholarships educate and equip students from low-income families in rural China. We work with local partners to identify students who are well-qualified (good character and grades) and vulnerable (low-income, female, minority, etc). Beyond financial support, CWEF staff, local partners, and volunteers invest in these young women and equip them for life through enrichment activities that help build resilience, leadership skills, and readiness for university or career.

title: Educate and Empower Girls in Kenya
description: Hekima Place is a safe, loving and faith-based home for orphaned and vulnerable girls in Kenya. We support excellence in education and empowerment for their futures.  This project will educate and empower orphaned and vulnerable girls by providing them with everything they need to succeed at school. This includes access to education, books and uniforms, nutritious meals, medical attention, counseling and individualized, loving care in a safe, stable home.

title: Hope for People with Neurological Disorders
description: Public awareness of the impact of neurological disorders (AD, MS, ALS, epilepsy, Parkinsons & many more) - the greatest cause of long-term disability and a primary cause of death in the US and abroad - has improved, but there is still too little public support for the research necessary to improve treatment and cures for these conditions. At Hope Happens, we provide resources and create an efficient research infrastructure that accelerates the translation of basic research to clinical cures.

title: Educate100 Disabled Mentally challenged -Bangalore
description: Summary Since 2009, CAD MS Trust (Care At Door Medical Service) is working with People with Disability And elderly with the main objective of facilitating and empowering them to be functionally and financially independent. Our work via Education, Vocational Training & Livelihood, Healthcare, Therapy & Mobility Aids, advocacy. Registered under Govt of Karnataka Department of Disability. At any point of time we reach out to over 10000 people with disability across Karnataka through our NGO.

title: Generation of worthy job for 500 women
description: Entornos Educativos A.C. will work on generating employment and productive options for women without opportunities because of their age, lack of education, lack of resources; through an intervention strategy with a gender perspective to develop capacities, abilities for producing healthy, organic food and cleaning products for personal ecologic use, free from plastics and pollutants, to empower 500 low-income women and fight the climate change and lack of water by adaptation and mitigation.

title: TOTAL RECALL OF 50 HIGH SCHOOL DROP-OUTS IN OTUAN,
description: Based on the recognisance survey and the visibility study done, through our ONE-ON-ONE questionaring by our field officers, the following where observed;   There is a deliberate student drop out from schools, which are not failure or illness related.Particularlly at the SENIOR HIGH ENTRY LEVEL.The drop out rate is increasing with marginal level.  The drop out trend is not peculiar to any gender,most is not at the instance or interest of the student,So the need  to re-inject them back to school.

title: Changing Women's Lives with I was a Sari
description: I was a Sari (IWAS) - a sustainable brand of accessories and apparel -  CORP and CHIME FOR CHANGE have partnered together to help scale I was a Sari's programs, which provide embroidery training to vulnerable and disadvantaged women living in Mumbai. The embroidery training programs are a safe place for women, run by women. Participants learn new skills and earn a regular income, opening pathways to economic opportunities for women, their families, and their communities.

title: Help us protect girls from becoming brides
description: In many villages, most girls who leave their school after Class VIII, are also forced to leave their childhood behind. As an unsaid norm that most families follow, looking for a groom for a girl child begins as soon as she crosses 13 years of age. With the help of partners and our well-wishers, we have managed to stop the practice of child marriage in many villages and slums. Help us save many more girls.

title: Empower 17,000 kids to Save the Ocean
description: Ocean Blue will reach 17,000 students in 750 classrooms in the U.S., Canada, and the U.K. through interactive live lessons centered around the state of our One World Ocean. The Blue Schools program educates youth of all ages about the link between the Ocean and Climate Change, the challenges of ocean plastics, and impacts of marine debris on marine wildlife, while inspiring kids to be stewards of our local and marine water resources.

title: Prevent 500 girls in Gulu from early marriage
description: The traditional practice of paying a bride price to the girl's parents makes it more attractive for their families to encourage early marriage instead of sending their girls to school.  Most girls married at an early age suffer during child birth as their bodies are not ready for reproduction. Yet the majority of these girls do not have a voice on family planning. Child Equal Opportunity Uganda is running a community-led campaign against early marriages of girls and supports their education.

title: 50 community e-waste drop boxes in Karnataka
description: E-waste is emerging as a fast growing and dangerous waste stream, especially in developing countries like India. Saahas is working towards creating awareness around scientific disposal of e-waste and establishing an eco-system for safe and sustainable recycling of e-waste.  One of the key requirements is of easy to access and pilfer-proof drop boxes where citizen are encouraged to drop their e-waste.  We would like to place 50 drop boxes in different parts of Karnataka to collect e-waste.

title: Prepare Bulgarian Kids for the Jobs of the Future
description: Telerik Academy School provides free education in programming and digital science, helping students aged 7-18 develop key digital competencies and knowledge and become bold inventors, digital leaders and sought-after professionals. Our aim is not to turn all kids into developers, but to teach them creative thinking and problem-solving skills and prepare them for the jobs of the future. For 12 years we've taught 17,000 BG kids how to code.

title: Engage & Educate in Bosnia and Herzegovina
description: The Hastor Foundation works with 1976 child/student, aged 6-25, hailing from the poorest sections of society in Bosnia and Herzegovina. By transferring life skills, supporting education and infusing hope, we are impacting and rebuilding Bosnia and Herzegovina today. The children learn and apply integrity, honesty, self-leadership, and leadership in practical everyday situations. They are given an opportunity to grow into leaders of their own communities.

title: Economic Empowerment for 500 Kenyan Youth
description: Through this project, BroadVision will empower 500 youth in Nyandarua County, Kenya through the provision of basic business & entrepreneurship training,  life skills, free vocational skills that are in high demand in Kenya's rapidly growing informal sector,  agro-based production resources & improvement of their access to capital.

title: Sow seeds of literacy!
description: Brazil is 260 years behind. A recent report by the World Bank, states that Brazilians will need 260 years to reach current OECD's reading results if the current trend persists in the country. How could Brazil grow and deliver a better standard of living to its citizens if education as a whole is so far behind? Your support will help to change this cruel reality for 150 students by helping them to become passionate about reading. Let's help them to write a better ending for their life stories.

title: Empower  800 disabled people in South Africa
description: The increasing incidences of financial exploitation have forced us to start formal financial training for disabled people in the communities that we already serve. This project will equip 800 disabled people with the necessary formal financial skills to enable them to stop borrowing money from informal money lenders (Loan sharks) who trap them into debt. The Association for the physically disabled sourced funding and has developed training material. The funds are needed to roll out the program

title: Hacking Hate Speech on Social Media in Chile
description: Our project seeks to limit expressions of hatred on social media (xenophobia, racism, antisemitism, homophobia and others). We will do so by developing a social intelligence methodology to detect and denounce xenophobic discourse, hate speech and fake news on social networks, and empowering key actors such as students, social activists and  journalists to recognize and denounce these pages, creating a community of influencers to combat hatred and promote inclusion on these powerful platforms

title: Provide 50 Instruments for Under-Served Children
description: The Tunes program focuses on supporting and growing the next generation of musicians and artists while fostering an appreciation for the arts. Through the program, we raise funds to purchase new instruments which are donated to Title I public school music programs across the country. These instrument donations are presented by nationally touring bands (Tunes Ambassadors) who perform for students, lead music workshops and allow kids the opportunity to learn from successful touring musicians.

title: YouthAlert! (YA!) "Youth Peace" Program in CA
description: Violence, bullying, and abuse, are the "Head of The Snake" TM. They are the number one root cause of many of society's woes including mental health, social health, physical health, substance abuse, unhealthy eating, risky behaviors, and extreme poverty. Fortunately, we know how to stop it; school-based universal, comprehensive violence prevention education "+" for youth. We must reach all 1.8 billion youth between the ages of 10 and 24 biennially.

title: Community Defibrillator and CPR Training Programme
description: This project will provide people in Redditch, UK with Public Access Defibrillators (PADs) and Training in Cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR). More people will know what to do when someone has a cardiac arrest; with less than 1 in 10 people in the UK surviving an out-of-hospital cardiac arrest, the project will help save lives.  Tailored packages meeting community need include a defibrillator and CPR training manikin, a cabinet with all the necessary accessories, training and ongoing support.

title: Stopping Child Slavery in Remote Regions - Myanmar
description: Saffron Aid is wanting to help 500 children in remote parts of Myanmar attend school and to graduate.
