Unfortunately, many children do not get to attend school due to family economic reasons. The need for children as young as 6 to work in the fields to help their parents is common. Worse, children are being sold as slaves to the sex industry in Thailand or as factory workers overseas. We help children attend school and families to generate extra income.

title: A LIFELINE FOR STREET CHILDREN/GIRLS
description: We've been at the forefront of providing welfare and educational services to indigent children since 2006. We have recorded some successes as over 800 young people have benefited from our mentoring program apart from millions of people that have been reached through our motivational programs on radio and television. The growing number of street children/Girls and abused victims of recent times is uncalled for. Our target is to pick them off the street and empower them for a great future.

title: Support networks for NGO's and indigenous peoples
description: This project aims to strengthen the support networks that are built through links with more than 36 organizations, indigenous communities and Mexican and international volunteers who live in Casa Junax and contribute their time, knowledge, and professional skills throughout the duration of the project. These committed people provide affected groups with the necessary resources to defend their human rights.

title: Help Poor Children to Play Sports
description: Poor Children in India are deprived of basic sports infrastructure in their schools.  This fund raiser by "Sports Coaching Foundation" is for project Build India Through Sports(BITS).    This Project objective is to develop basic sports infrastructure in 2 Indian Government Schools & Enable 500 Poor Children to avail sports facilities in their school premises.

title: HELP FOR 85 Elderly ORPHANS AT TAMILNADU, India
description: At New Life Charitable Trust, we take care of many bedridden elders. Many of them need 24*7 nursing care. We need to construct nursing quarters for the accommodation of nursing staffs and to give special care for the bedridden elders for their speedy recovery. This quarters we have planned with 4 rooms with emergency medical facilities. This will help us appoint 4 nursing staffs to work on shift basis. We seek donation for this noble cause which helps 85 abandoned elders who we take care of.

title: Health and Hygiene of 'Kidizens'
description: Belonging to a vulnerable and marginalized sections of the society, mental health, personal hygiene and menstruation remain most neglected by their families.  With this initiative, the objective is to provide, family counselling and individual counselling for children experiencing deprivation, abuse, identity crisis etc. Our focus through this initiative is to bring acceptance in the community about seeking help for mental health issues and making hygiene and sanitation a priority.

title: Give knowledge library to young people in Myanmar
description: Support the hopes of young people in Myanmar by adopting an eTekkatho library, providing rich educational resources to use without the Internet. MyLibrary is a tough, tiny, portable, battery-powered capsule which stores educational content and makes it available even in places with no internet connection or reliable electricity. This means we can provide access to educational materials to people living in many more places, including hard-to-reach areas.  Ethnic language

title: Empowering PAPs facing IFI Investments in Kenya
description: Jamaa Resource Initiative (JRI) is a Civil Society Organization (CSO) that advocates for communal participation and management of resources from resource rich communities. The organization works to explore the idea of self-reliance and community-led and resourced development.  Among its specific objectives is to encourage and promote full accountability of International Finance Institutions (IFIs) including the AfDB and the World Bank, Foreign Direct Investors, Companies and Governments in the m

title: HELP TO ENHANCE PREVENTING POVERTY WITH TREES
description: The charity Organization Compagnie Agricole et Environnement (CAE) wants to continue training other 240 local students to plant and protect 240 000 life-giving trees. These trees will provide food, water and income for their families by bearing fruits to improve nutrition, protecting their cattle's water supply from evaporation and boosting their crop harvests by enriching the soil.

title: Ageing Well Without Children in Dorset UK
description: The Prama Foundation and the organisation - Ageing WithOut Children, will research the numbers of people ageing without children in Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole and the issues affecting them. We will bring people ageing without children together to create their own support networks; develop and test key messages that resonate with organisations and communities to make them AWOC aware and provide training to organisations about people ageing without children and the issues affecting them.

title: Stop drownings in EU-Educate & save a child's life
description: Safe Water Sports plans to gift/donate five educational kit bags to schools in five European countries in order to educate children on how to stay safe in the water and sea. Safe Water Sports is a non-profit organisation founded in 2015 with an interest in (among others) providing information and raising awareness on safety issues in the water, in the sea and in water-related sports and recreational activities.

title: Keep 250 Bemba Tribal Girls in School in Zambia
description: This project will distribute 'kits' of underwear, washable sanitary pads, and a sex education to 250 Bemba girls who have been known to miss school as they resort to leaves and rags to manage their flow.  Kits last up to 3 years.   This project will partner with the King of the Bemba People and will also facilitate the establishment of a sewing center startup to initially employ 12 deaf women to sew the kits. Your donation will be matched by provincial schools for expansion and sustainability.

title: YouthAlert! (YA!) "Youth Peace" Program NY-NJ-CT
description: Violence, bullying, and abuse, are the "Head of The Snake" TM. They are the number one root cause of many of society's woes including mental health, social health, physical health, substance abuse, unhealthy eating, risky behaviors, and extreme poverty. Fortunately, we know how to stop it; school-based universal, comprehensive violence prevention education "+" for youth. We must reach all 1.8 billion youth between the ages of 10 and 24 biennially.

title: YouthAlert! (YA!) "Youth Peace" Program CHI & IL
description: Violence, bullying, and abuse, are the "Head of The Snake". They are the number one root cause of many of society's woes including mental health, social health, physical health, substance abuse, unhealthy eating, risky behaviors, and extreme poverty. Fortunately, we know how to stop it; school-based universal, cross-cutting, comprehensive violence prevention education for youth. We must reach all 1.8 billion youth between the ages of 10 and 24 biennially.

title: YouthAlert! (YA!) "Youth Peace" Program in Florida
description: Violence, bullying, and abuse, are the "Head of The Snake". They are the number one root cause of many of society's woes including mental health, social health, physical health, substance abuse, unhealthy eating, risky behaviors, and extreme poverty. Fortunately, we know how to stop it; school-based universal, cross-cutting, comprehensive violence prevention education for children and youth. We must reach all 1.8 billion youth between the ages of 10 and 24 biennially.

title: Partnering to emancipate tomorrow's citizens
description: SFM Clichy provides the means for social and cultural inclusion to underprivileged populations in the greater Paris area. It allows them effective citizen participation through access to knowledge and rights.  We assist more than 300 families in their emancipation journey through a range of activities, from childcare to adult language courses and parenthood workshops. We also offer notary public services with the help of a team of 35 volunteers and cater to over 4000 queries every year.

title: Legal Aid for 75 refugees ASAP in Mexico
description: Do you think it's okay for a refugee to wait over 2 years for restarting a life with dignity? No. We neither. But it's happening, again, at the southern border of Mexico. This project will ensure the delivery of legal aid during the Mexican immigration status determination process to at least 75 refugees fleeing violence from Central America throughout 2019. Be part of the movement committed to providing a second chance in life, with dignity, AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. Donate now and join today.

title: Global Media Fellowship to Promote Untold Stories
description: This project will provide emerging filmmakers and journalists from developing countries with access to media training and a Fellowship, which gives them a production grant, mentors and training to complete their reporting. We know the vital role of a free and plural media in opening our eyes to diversity of the world around us. We give new talent who may be looking for their first director role or their first solo investigation the backing to tell under-reported stories.

title: Send 40 Girls in Niger to Secondary School
description: This project will provide 40 girls in Niger, ages 11-22, with a scholarship to attend secondary school and receive a high quality education. These students have aspirations to continue their education but do not have the funds needed to pay for school. Only 9% of girls in Niger continue past 6th grade. Our scholarships provide tuition, supplies, transportation and other critical supports to keep girls in school. Remember Niger schools provide a caring environment where girls can succeed.

title: Feed 190 Malnourished Children in Haiti for a Year
description: One in four children in rural Haiti are malnourished. The Haiti Goat Project is dedicated to alleviating child malnutrition in rural Haiti while also supporting the local agricultural community.  The Haiti Goat Project will provide weekly goat meat-vegetable based lunches to 190 malnourished rural Haitian school children for a year.  Because our Haitian team members buy meal components from local sources, this project also supports the local Haitian farming community.

title: HPV Vaccines for Adolescent Girls in Haiti
description: The Haitian Global Health Alliance in support of GHESKIO is working to stop the spread of human papillomavirus (HPV) among adolescent girls in Haiti by providing vaccines to at-risk young women. HPV is a sexually transmitted infection which can result in cervical cancer, a leading cause of cancer-related deaths for women in Haiti. Haiti has the highest rate of cervical cancer in the world (50 times higher than the US), and providing HPV vaccines can save the lives of women across the country.

title: Help Give the Gift of Sight in Honduras
description: VHI has worked closely over the years with the Serving at the Crossroads and La Clinica Manos Amigas in La Entrada, Honduras to build capacity and provide vision care. This month, we will implement one of two annual trips to La Entrada, where we offer cataract and oculoplastic surgery, in addition to comprehensive eye exams and free eyeglasses. Our team will also help set up a newly-donated phaco machine in the clinic, in order to build local capacity for providing vision care.

title: Parkinson walk to help 60 parkinson patients
description: Parkinson is a neurodegenerative disease that has no cure as per the technological advancement level so far. It affects the mobility of patients as the disease advances.The situation is more worse in a nation like Ethiopia where there is no organization working on awareness, support, research and development on Parkinson's (PD).  This year (April 2019), we are planning to conduct PD walk so as to raise financial assistance for poor PD patients to buy Walker, walking stick, wheelchair.

title: School Greening Programme for Kenyan Pupils
description: We support Kenyan primary schools to teach children how to plant and care for trees in their school grounds, engaging young people in protecting their environment and learning about the benefits of trees. School Greening Programme for Kenyan Pupils is a campaign aimed at planting 200,000 trees in Kenyan schools in 2019. Need

title: Empower a First-Generation College Student
description: BTF's Empowerment Scholarships Program supports educating and empowering girls from underserved regions in Turkiye. We are imagining equal opportunities for all genders in life, equal decision-making power for everybody, and that every child has the right to an education. These are some of our beliefs and guiding principles. With your support, we are investing in education, and building futures for underpriviledged first-generation college students in Turkiye.

title: Improve Community Fire Safety in Northern Albania
description: The North Albanian community need to have their own functioning fire appliance (engine) and Bodmin Rotary have donated a fire engine appliance to the community but need funding to renovate it, take it to the destination and, more importantly, teach the community how to use it. This project will save lives and give the community a focus on fire safety and prevention -creating employment for the local community will have a positive impact on the local economy and on their individual families.

title: Mission of Love Children Project
description: Mission Of Love Support Community Based Organization (MILSCO) was initiated in 2017 to address the factors contributing to poor quality of Life among the OVCs in Kisumu County. Currently we are providing care and support to 120 OVCs both gender. We ensure they have a safe environment, access to quality health care, basic food, clothes, education and spiritual development, We also work within school on Gender Based Violence and  30 children have been rescued and perpetrators taken to court.

title: A Healthier Future for the Children of Venezuela
description: Join Chamos in our mission to bring healthcare and hope to the children of Venezuela. We are providing resources, long-term care and guidance to children and families. Your generosity today will help give lifesaving support to malnourished babies and new mothers; facilitate healthcare and dentistry clinics in rural communities; fit paediatric wheelchairs and provide physiotherapy to children with disabilities, and ensure families have clean water to improve their overall health and sanitation.

title: YouthAlert! (YA!) "Youth Peace" Prog. KY-MI-OH-TN
description: Violence, bullying, and abuse, are the "Head of The Snake". They are the number one root cause of many of society's woes including mental health, social health, physical health, substance abuse, unhealthy eating, risky behaviors, and extreme poverty. Fortunately, we know how to stop it; school-based universal, cross-cutting, comprehensive violence prevention education for youth. We must reach all 1.8 billion youth between the ages of 10 and 24 biennially.

title: Send DC Students to Study Abroad in Tanzania
description: This project will provide ten, 5th and 6th grade, students with an opportunity to study abroad in Tanzania this summer. They will Skype and Pen Pal peers in Tanzania and compare and contrast their lives and experiences. With the support of an expert, students will document their journey through videography, photography, and storytelling. They will develop skills in global competency and become future global leaders. This trip will also increase student's likelihood of successfully graduating.

title: SUPPORT 200 RURAL WOMEN FARMERS GROW FISH IN KENYA
description: The Project will  provide 200   rural women in Central Kenya with high quality fingerlings  and feeds and train them on how to  grow fish using raised ponds . Women will be trained to build and manage raised ponds .Female farmers produce more than half the developing world's food but lack land,economic support such as equpiments, tools, and training.  By providing  high quality fingerlings  and extension services,we will empower them economically,socially  while promoting food security.

title: Help to Stop Child Sexual Abuse in Nigeria
description: 1 in 4 girls and 1 in 10 boys are sexually abused before their 18th birthday in Nigeria, and only 2% of girls and 4% of boys receive any help. Our Child Advocacy Centre and free Child Helpline provide a one-stop multi-disciplinary response by providing counselling, medical evaluations, forensic interviews, advocacy and support, court preparation and community education services for free -  leading to a safe space for children to disclose abuse, less trauma and more successful prosecutions.

title: Eyeglasses for Struggling Kentucky Families
description: The state of Kentucky ranks among the poorest in the United States. Kentucky working-poor families struggle to pay for basic needs like rent and food but have no resources for the simple, yet critical, tool of eyeglasses. For them,  clear vision becomes a luxury. This project will provide new prescription eyeglasses to 217 Kentuckians so that they may navigate their daily lives, pursue education, gain employment and live more safely, securely and independently with clear vision.

title: Sports Program for the Stateless Community
description: Khel aims to provide a chance of respite to this generation of younglings with the provision of a space which is tailored to encourage children to be children. Our program aims to provide the basic needs of a child; recreation, rest, leisure, education - as identified by Article 31 of United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child.

title: Decrease poverty in Memphis by serving 100 youth
description: The Global College Pipeline Initiative was established to break cycles of generational poverty in high poverty cities through offering our participants high impact result driven educational and financial literacy preparation. Our program objective in Memphis, TN is to decrease the 44% child poverty rate by increasing educational and career outcomes through the integration of 100 youth into our 4 year intensive 6 component pipeline program.

title: Reuniting 200 children and parents for a day
description: This project will support reuniting children throughout the country who live in state care, and their parents throughout the country. Many children are unable to live with their families, due to harsh economic conditions. To help the transition into state care, we are providing 200 children with the opportunity to reunite with their family in a positive and safe environment.

title: Stop Violence Against 3000 Women in Rural Tanzania
description: The project will work to fight violence against 3000 women and  young girls aged 5 to 49 years in rural areas, Tanzania. This project will provide legal aid to victims of violence, creating awareness to community to recognize women violence as a violation of women's rights for society to stick together against violence, as well as empowering women by raising awareness on policies and laws that protect women and address violence against women so as to build women's confidence to report violence.

title: Support 9500 Girls in Rural India Go To School !
description: India is home to 4.1 million out of school girls. It is a fact that sending girls to school brings social & economic benefits to our society. Educate Girls works towards enrolling the rural, marginalised girls back in school, ensuring quality education & transforming the community mindset towards girls' education. Your donation will be matched & supported by one of our funders to enrol girls in schools. When you support us, you help girls enter the schooling system.

title: Motivation Romania Wheelchair Fund 2020
description: Your donation gives back freedom of movement and self-confidence to 100 Romanians with mobility disabilities, by funding the renovation and donation of 100 quality wheelchairs in 2020. This project is part of Motivation`s pledge to provide 1,500 appropriate wheelchairs annually in Romania through the Wheelchair Fund initiative. In Romania, 1 in 5 persons who need a wheelchair does not have one. Every 5 years, 42-78,000 Romanians need a new wheelchair, but only 15,000 receiv one.

title: Lifesaving Sanitation Project at Grace Orphanage
description: The children of Grace Orphanage School, a rural school in the heart of Uganda, needed your help to set up lifesaving sanitation - & the community has responded, raising $10,000 to fund the build of a 5 drop toilet & washroom, and a bore/water well.  The next immediate needs for the orphanage is electricity, shelter & food. Another $16,000 will help us make significant improvements in these areas, so we have increased our project goal to $26,000 & would appreciate any contribution you could make.

title: Support 1200+ Young Leaders in 180 Countries
description: Rehabilitating victims of ISIS, providing free health screenings for cervical and breast cancer, connecting small holder farmers to markets & facilitating the entry of 200+ street children into school - these are stories of just 4 of the young leaders we support! Global Changemakers is a global pioneer in supporting youth-led development. Through skills development, capacity building, mentoring and grants, we support young leaders addressing the most pressing challenges around the world.

title: Survey the health of corals & people in San Andres
description: Corales de Paz plans to run the first five-day meaningful diving expedition to assess simultaneously the health of five coral reef sites and 150 members from marginalised island communities.  The San Andres Reef & Covid-19 expedition, planned for 13  - 16 Nov 2020, will send a team of 12 medical specialist doctors and Reef Check EcoDivers to run for three days underwater surveys in the mornings and medical brigades in the afternoon.

title: SPONSOR 165 MEXICAN KIDS ASPIRING TO GET EDUCATION
description: This community Foundation is focused on breaking the poverty cycle in the Community called Don Diego, in San Miguel de Allende, Mexico. Our program is addressing the causes of poverty and the lack of education. Our Education Center, managed by volunteers and paid teachers is providing supplementary education to a community that needs external help. We now reach 180 students. As a community Foundation, we work hand in hand with other associations that have similar goals.

title: Empower internally displaced youths in Cameroon
description: The project seeks to train and support 1000  vulnerable and underprivileged internally displaced youths in Cameroon including single teenage mothers, young widows, school dropouts, ex-convicts and Orphans in simple, low cost business start-ups (computer studies, tailoring,hair dressing, beads jewellery production) as alternative income generating activities. These vulnerable youths will be trained and supported in activities of their choice within our vocational training program

title: Help Kids in Nepal to Walk on Their Own Two Feet
description: Amid the majestic mountains of Nepal, children living in poverty often struggle to stand.  Every year 782 children in Nepal are born with clubfoot. Since the 2015 earthquake, 3,078 children were born with clubfoot and thousands more injured during the disaster.  For the past 11 years, a team of fearless volunteers from the US have traveled to Nepal to bring their gift of healing.  In one medical trip they can assess 70 patients, perform 55 surgical procedures on 20 patients.  What an impact!

title: Help Otia Victory treat conginental heart disease
description: We are writing to inform the Global giving Community that Otia Victory died today in Yaounde Cameroon. We are grateful for the effort you all made to ensure that Victory can survive.  Thank you so much for the love and support you've shown for the past two days. We will be in touch with all the individual donors with regards to the donations you made.  Thanks

title: Life Enrichment for 100 Homeless Teens in Arkansas
description: Homeless teens live in Emergency and Residential Housing and are being taught life planning skills such as cooking, cleaning, personal hygiene, social skills and coping skills to help them become self-sustaining adults.  House parents ensure Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs are met including safety needs, love and belonging. There are more than 5,000 youth in foster care in Arkansas.  We will take as many as we can into our program.  Your donation will cover 2 months of care for these teens.

title: PEDAL POWER FOR KENYAN EDUCATION
description: Five Kenyan schools have now received a total of 300 bicycles, helmets, safety vests and tool kits. These are on loan to students who otherwise walk 5-6 miles each way to and from school. Attendance, promptness and academic achievement have all improved among participating students. Female students feel safer during their commutes to and from school. The goal for 2023 is to provide two more schools with a total of 100 bicycles and accessories.

title: Bus to school! The children of Casa PAS need you
description: Joyfully we have received a VW Bus 2013 in which we have made minor mechanical repairs with you donations we received in the March Campaign. We have also painted the bus and we are waiting to receive permission plates to circulate. The bus needs to upholster the 20 seats, buy and install 20 seat belts  as well as a new carpet for the floor. It is the las step to be able to have a new school bus.

title: Provision of Sanitation for a Village in Nepal
description: Gimdi is a village 45 miles south of Kathmandu and has a population of 2500 people over a 25km area and only one toilet. Our aim is to provide 70 long drop toilets, providing safe clean sanitation to the villagers enhancing the safety of vulnerable adults, young girls and boys and as an end result providing fertiliser for sustainable crop growth. Health, Welfare and safety of vulnerable adults and children are a major concern and with this project we can make a difference.

title: Empower 200 vulnerable migrant women in Strasbourg
description: This project will help 200 vulnerable migrant women in Strasbourg gain skills for socio-professional integration through individualized support, centers for assistance, and training workshops. The key technological, digital and transferable skills that they develop will help these disadvantaged women escape from isolation and marginalization.

title: Bringing Hope Through Palliative Care in Uganda
description: You can help bring hope to those in need! Through our 'Bringing Hope Campaign' join our dedicated team who provide skilled, compassionate care and support to people with chronic disease and their families. We aim to help people live well and die with dignity. Based in Uganda's major hospitals our team helps care for people from across Uganda including refugees from neighbouring countries. Your generosity will enable us to continue to provide this vital service and reach more people.

title: Engaging Children in Climate Action
description: Children will have to assume the consequences of a warming planet, but the also hold the solutions to adapt to a changing environment.  We will educate 1000 children using innovative methods, harnessing their creativity, fostering sustainable behaviours,  connecting them with experts and change makers to inspire their future careers, co-creating solutions in their schools to reduce emissions in areas such as renewable energy, waste management, mobility, and urban agriculture, among others.

title: Help Haitian Midwives STOP VIOLENCE AGAINST WOMEN!
description: Midwives, as trusted health care professionals, play a critical role in supporting and caring for survivors of Gender-Based Violence (GBV). They are often the only care provider that a woman will seek care from in her lifetime. To improve and support their skills in providing trauma-informed care to survivors, FAHM will provide 4-day training for 50 Haitian midwives, interactive live webinars for 200 midwives, outreach and education to 200 youth and ongoing public awareness campaigns.

title: Help Us Expand Our Reach In Nigeria
description: Mentally Aware Nigeria Initiative plans to expand beyond its current reach of four states to other parts of the country. This will enable us take our messages of increased awareness and campaign against mental health stigma to more young people and help build a community that allows them to share their struggles without being afraid of judgement, prejudice and discrimination.

title: Provide Peace Education for 100 Rwandan Students
description: Our Youth Peace Camp brings Rwandan youth together for one week to learn in depth the history of Rwanda and develop skills to build and maintain peace in their communities, ensuring a stable future for their country. These young change-makers return home to initiate projects of their own that sustain social cohesion and foster peace in their communities. Through these activities, CTP alumni share their training and new-found skills learned to more than 1,000 young people nationwide.

title: Classrooms for 85 indigenous children in Mexico
description: This project will build classrooms in the Wixarika Sierra, northern Jalisco, providing 85 Wixaritari children proper infrastructure for a better education so they can contribute to their culture legacy and their community development.

title: Educate & Empower 30 Filipinos with leprosy
description: Leprosy is a chronic, infectious disease of the nerves and skin.  It is curable yet the stigma and discrimination may last a lifetime, leading to poverty.  This project will help support the school needs, health care, and counselling of 30 Filipino children and young adults who have leprosy or whose parents have been disabled by leprosy. Formal education and skills training will enable them to gain income, escape poverty, overcome stigma and discrimination,  be productive and live with dignity.

title: Recycle Storages for 16 Villages of Java Island
description: Indonesia has been being the 2nd biggest plastic waster in the World. Those plastic waste mostly end up in the ocean. People in district Tulakan Pacitan East Java respond to this national and global problems by proactively sort their waste. Greenwave NGO helps 16 villages in district Tulakan of Pacitan regency in East Java Indonesia by educates people, invites 2 Consultants and plans to build 26 Recycle Storages. By donating to this project you save the planet earth from the household level.

title: Computer literacy for 400 poor Pakistani girls
description: The rural areas of District Muzaffargarh and Faisalabad, 80% of the population is not sensitized of the basic computer literacy and in the females it is even worse. Majority of the Government schools in the rural areas of Muzaffargarh and Faisalabad does not consider and offer computer education. The project has been designed with the purpose of providing computer literacy (10 months training) to the poor and school dropout girls of District Muzaffargarh and Faisalabad to meet current trends.

title: Transform the lives of  young Mayans in Guatemala
description: Educaid offers the opportunity of a high school education to indigenous youth from rural communities of the country that live in extreme poverty. Merit-based scholarships will be awarded to boarding students at Instituto Santiago, granting them comprehensive education, housing, and meals, in a safe environment.

title: Support Women and Girls with Vocational Skills
description: Adolescent girls and young women in Uganda face discrimination and are at high risk of poverty, exploitation and high risk situations. Girls may be forced into early marriage, early pregnancy or survival sex. Forward it support vulnerable girls and young women in Uganda and offer counseling, training in life-skills, vocational skills and business to empower and equip girls to escape extreme poverty, secure an income and support themselves, their families and their communities.

title: Environmental Education for the KwaXimba community
description: The Mayibuye community based in KwaXimba have put 5000 hectare of land into creating a game reserve. The game reserve will house many species of wild African animals such as elephants, buffalo, giraffe and more. This campaign will bring environmental understanding to 3000 members of the community. The great thing is that the educational material created in this project will also be used for other projects that we do thus spreading the conservation message far and wide.

title: Engage 1000 Bulgarian students in public speaking
description: Empower 1000 Bulgarian students each year with the skills and confidence to express their convictions and effect change. The structure of formal education can often silence the voices of young people, fostering a toxic culture of apathy. Your donation supports the operation and hosting of public speaking and debate tournaments across Bulgaria. These events equip high school students from diverse socioeconomic backgrounds with tools they need to become leaders in their communities and the world.

title: Help Save More Lives, Healing Smiles and Changing
description: In a world in which "Image is everything", can you imagine waking up every day with a facial disfigurement and knowing what await you outside?   Thousands of children are born with clefts each year. Operation Smile Thailand strives to help children born with cleft lip, cleft palate or other facial deformities by providing free, safe surgeries and post-operative care such as speech therapy.  We need support by generous donor like you!

title: 10000 Children - 10000 Trees - For You
description: 35,000 will fund the continued involvement of 1000 children in planting 1000 trees every year until 2025, provide opportunities to visit their wood and support an outreach programme to other communities. The wood we plant will provide both an emotional connection to and hands-on practical learning about caring for our natural environment - a space that inspires a love of nature, teaches about the role of trees in mitigating climate change and demonstrates what can be achieved when we take action

title: SAVE 1000 WOMEN &BABIES IN NIGERIA;GIVE BIRTH KITS
description: Every 10 minutes,one woman dies on account of pregnancy or childbirth in Nigeria-UNICEF. 33% of neonatal deaths are attributed to infections; the main factors contributing to the high incidence of neonatal and maternal tetanus and sepsis is that majority of deliveries take place under unclean circumstances-WHO. This project provides clean delivery kits, treated bed nets, pregnancy health training and blood pressure checks to 1000 rural women across Nigeria.

title: Career Program for 1000 Year 9 Pupils in Lagos
description: My Community and I is a Career Guidance Program aimed at Junior Secondary School students in their final year of their Basic Education (Year 9).  It defines a Career as an expression of oneself in service to one's community.  The goal of the program is to prepare these students for life after Basic Education through a series of workshops and "Talk with the Professionals" Events where they will get to speak with professionals from different walks of life.

title: Star Cities 2
description: Continuation of Star City Models Project; a joint project with YMCA-Gabrovo, Planetarium-Gabrovo and Club Icarus 2010-Sevlievo. Practical training with children between 10 and 15. Lecturers will teach the children astronomy, astrophysics, astronautics, space engineering, rocket building and general knowledge about space. Based on gained experience from the first project and the implemented good practices, we will double the number of participants (from 15 to 30) within the same budget

title: Feed and clothe 350 children in South Africa
description: Human Resource and Social Information Centre (HURESIC) plans to help 350 Orphans and Vulnerable Children and youth in five villages in South Africa with after school services such as assistance with school work, afternoon meals (food), school uniform, clothes, basic computer literacy, life and leadership skills, children and youth dialogue, crime diversion initiatives in sports and culture. Will support families with social, economic challenges to cope establishing poultry and vegetable projects

title: Uplifting the lives of 120 women in Purko location
description: The project intends to empower 120 women in Purko location of Kajiado County, Kenya in briquettes making as an alternative source of cooking fuel and income. The women were dependent on charcoal selling which has now  been banned. The women will be able to use the briquettes as their own source of fuel (slashing their cooking-fuel costs to a tenth or less) and selling to the readily available market within the county. Help resolve the cooking-energy poverty faced by the poorest and air pollution

title: Save the food to serve the hungry !
description: 670 000 tons of food are wasted annually in Bulgaria, where 41 % of children live at risk of poverty. Every year the Bulgarian Food Bank saves hundreds of tons of food from being wasted and share it with those in need. We are expanding our network to two more locations in Bulgaria in the city of Varna and the town of Mezdra. Help us reach more people. Give the food a hand !

title: Empower 500 Haitian Youth with Education and Sport
description: PowerForward runs multiple basketball and education programs during the year. These events bring 500+ Haitian youth together to learn about the sport; receive meals, sneakers and clothes; and be inspired by success stories of PowerForward athletes playing in US high schools, colleges and professionally.

title: Embracing life since its conception in Mexico
description: Betania is a non-profit organization, founded in 1959 and dedicated to improving the quality of life of women.  by two services, a gynecology and obstetrics clinic for a recovery fee end a home for single mothers support during and after pregnancy  all without cost for women. With this it will be possible to expand the clinical area, building 9 private medical offices, 2 operating theaters, area of neonates for 20 babies and area of nutritionist, offering quality integral of maternal and child.

title: Changing the lives of disabled people in Tanzania
description: Providing rural Tanzanian disabled men and women with the opportunity to develop their small entrepreneurial businesses and Transform their lives. We will supply the beneficiaries with refurbished Singer sewing machines and training, together with support in small business management skills. Disabled men and women are significantly disadvantaged and are totally reliant on hand outs. Giving them the opportunity to earn a living will not only improve their lives, but also their status in society.

title: Supporting Education of 660 Talented,At-Risk youth
description: The LISI institute gives 660 scholarships to talented, at-risk youth from impoverished communities near Guadalajara, Mexico. 414 of the students are attending middle school and the other 166 are in high school. The teenagers are distribuited at three of our institutes located in poor and marginalized communities south of Guadalajara Mexico. We are trying to raise US$100,000 to continue with the education in this 2021-2022 scholar year.

title: Build a School for Children in Rural Honduras
description: World Accord will be constructing a concrete block kindergarten in a rural mountain village near Lago Yojoa in Honduras.  Children will be able to get a head start on education  - providing opportunities and hope at a time when many of the poorest in the country flee to other countries in order to survive.

title: Health & Hygiene Training for 1,000 Women in Nepal
description: Without access to health education, rural women and girls of Nepal are subject to harmful practices surrounding menstruation and reproduction. Aythos is changing the way people think about old myths about women's health by giving communities training on health, hygiene, and reusable pad-making.

title: Bed and mattress for 87 orphans in Nandaime
description: This Project will provide new and clean beds and mattress for 87 orphans that lives in NPH Nicaragua Houses. Obtaining healthy sleep is important for both physical and mental health, mostly for boys and girls in development age; it can also improve productivity and overall quality of life. In this way, we provide an integral growth at any aspect of their life.  The Project includes Mosquito nets, which helps to prevent diseases such as malaria, skin infections and viruses.

title: Continuing Medical Education on Stick
description: We utilize novel Information and Communication Technology (ICT) to deliver free and high-quality continuing medical education (CME) content to doctors and nurses working in resource-constrained regions. The project called, Continuing Medical Education on Stick (CMES) delivers the CME via thumb drives or a Raspberry-Pi, a computer the size of your hand, and smartphone apps. The CME content, available in English, French, and Spanish, covers Emergency Medicine (EM) and Primary Care (PC) topics.

title: Mind, For Better Mental Health
description: Mind is the leading mental health charity founded in 1946. We won't give up until everyone experiencing a mental health problem gets both support and respect.

title: Help build a better future for kids in Brazil!
description: We develop our activities in country towns in the state of Sao Paulo, contributing directly to the integral development of children and teenagers, aiming at the improvement of social indicators, especially those related to low professional qualification, drug addiction, early pregnancy and school dropout.

title: Build a Brighter Future for 25,000 Kids in Nepal
description: We started rebuilding schools in Nepal after the earthquake. Now, looking for a sustainable way to improve the education of thousands of kids, we propose the creation of the first national "Teacher Training Center of Excellence". The Center will enhance the quality and relevance of education offered to teachers that currently have none or incomplete training. This is phase one of a bigger project. We have a plan, the land secured, love and excitement, and are ready to begin. We just need YOU!

title: School without pregnancy
description: The main objective is to bring the Ministry of Health to put in place a system of prevention and psycho-social and medical care of girls who are victims of early pregnancy and sexual and school-related abuse in 50 institutions. Tambacounda, Kolda, and Kedougou regions by 2020 This plea is based on the 2005 SR law, which gives pregnant girls the opportunity to resume their studies after childbirth.

title: support the treatment of kids with type 1 diabetes
description: Did you know that diabetes mellitus 1 is not preventable, it is not curable and the treatment is very expensive? This project will support low-income children living with this condition with medical supplies. Our goal is to prevent serious and chronic complications that risk the life of the child and affect the quality of life of these children.

title: Help us bring 15 Venezuelan kids to play baseball
description: To promote baseball with a team of 15 Venezuelan children (ages 11-12) by financing flight tickets, round-trip Mexico City-Hermosillo, which will allow them to play in the Little League Baseball Championship of the Americas, 40th Edition, to be held in Hermosillo, Mexico. This event promotes values such as cooperative coexistence, friendship, respect, solidarity, team work and discipline, among others. (Costs of the Venezuela-Mexico City portion of their transportation has already been paid).

title: Empower Youth to Overcome Conflict & Trauma in US
description: SOAR will provide opportunities for 50 youth and teens, in the Greater Denver Metro Area of Colorado, to overcome suicidal ideation, juvenile justice conflicts, substance use, vaping, and psychosocial and emotional conflicts within their schools and their family unit through community engagement activities that include music, yoga, and athletic clinics, animal-assisted therapy techniques (canine & equine), mindfulness education, and life skills education.

title: Living the DREAM for low-income Grade 6 Students
description: This Project will provide financial support to underprivileged but talented elementary graduates go thru secondary education.  The beneficiaries of this Project are low-income/underprivileged families from rural areas in the northern part of the Philippines. Your donation will help pay for matriculation fee, school supplies, 3 sets of school uniform, 2 sets of PE uniform, and allocated fare. Please help us continue to make these children's dreams come true and support them in their journey.

title: Support 300 Kids with Learning Disabilities in Imo
description: In AFRYDEF, we see children and youths as assets, and do our best to encourage them develop their full potentials. The above project is aimed at providing 5 toilets/bathrooms and medical care for the 300+ children at the Special Education Center, Imo State, Nigeria.  To achieve these, we shall engage 5 nurses and 5 care givers at the center to provide medical care and support to the children, including cleaning their beds, cutting their hairs/nails as well as take care of their sanitary needs.

title: Fund a Kitchen, feed 900 underprivileged girls
description: In rural India, majority of the girls don't get even ONE substantial meal in a day. BSP Education Society provides free education to about 900 village girls. Keeping the girls at school has reduced early child marriages from 30% to 2%. Currently we are able to feed only half the girls with 1 meal however our goal is for all to eat. Please help us build a large scale, equipped kitchen where a simple, nutritious meal will be prepared for all the girls in our school. Any contribution will help!

title: Rescue Dogs & Cats In Need - East Tennessee
description: Almost Home's project will help provide vetting for mistreated and homeless animals. It will also provide our foster homes with much needed supplies and medications allowing us to place our rescues in safe and loving environments.

title: Support orphan girl children education
description: The aim of the project is to support the education costs of the orphan girl children living in Manasu home.  The home is a unique place in the city of Visakhapatnam, India. The home is the only exclusive girl center in the city and around 45 children stay in the home. The children go to regular schools and they study well and excel not only in education but also in sports and other activities. Your support will help the children to continue their education for academic year 2019-20.

title: Global Warming Crisis: Our Global Recycling Drive
description: Improper waste management is a global issue and has negative effects on the environment. Due to a lack of education many communities around the world still burn or bury their trash which has a huge negative impact on our planet. This is down to a lack of support or viable effective options for waste management which is what this project aims to change. With your support we will educate and motivate communities to recycle and help tackle the global warming crisis community by community globally.

title: Rescue a Malnourished Rural Child in Uganda
description: The project will improve nutritional status of 12,533 rural children under five in two rural districts of Katakwi and Amuria, providing supplementary feeding and increasing coverage of appropriate Maternal Infant and Young Child Feeding practices to post war marginalized families. Acute forms of malnutrition in children under five even in homes with high food production indicative of poor utilization.prevalence of chronic malnutrition in Uganda currently rated at 33% compared to recommended 22%

title: Pre vocational training to orphan special children
description: Teaching pre-vocational skills to Orphan Persons with disabilities for their improving the life skills through they can also learn the particular interested skills so that they can lead their life in a independent manner.for example the Persons with disabilities can interested in preparing paper bags we should give raining in that particular skills so that he can improve the skill and get expertise in that particular area and he can start earn in that particular work&lead independent life

title: Lighting Up Young Lives
description: The Choma community in Malawi is far from the electricity grid. Recent exam results are disappointing and the community has decided that for two months prior to the Standard 8 exams, the children camp out at their schools to get extra tuition in the evenings. When it is dark any tuition ceases. The Rotary Project will provide solar charged battery lighting for classrooms, offices and a Girls' Hostel as well as portable, rechargeable lamps put in sunlight by day and used in rooms by night.

title: GRACE CARE SCHOOL BUILDING
description: A charitable boarding school is one of the best ways to help children in need keeping the present political, social and cultural environment in India. There are more poor children in India who badly want a boarding school than an orphanage. Grace Care boarding school wants to fulfill the desire of at least a few hundreds of those needy children by providing them better living and better education. Being in the Grace Care boarding school these precious children will have opportunity to grow.

title: Small Island Recycling & Waste Management Dawasamu
description: The Dawasamu Waste Management Programme has been implemented to improve waste disposal. Collection points have been built in the villages, where families can recycle their tin cans, glass, hard plastics, aluminium & ceramics instead of burning waste or using landfills. Focusing on education & behaviour change prior to the construction of recycling points, followed by effective monitoring & additional workshops. This sustainable solution puts ownership directly in the hands of the villagers.

title: Baseball  For Social Change
description: This project aims to provide sports and cultural activities to 60 children in order to prevent crime and to effectively build resilience of at-risk youth. Also, we will provide the cildren with healthy meals.

title: Support the Bulgarian Natural Science Teams
description: This Natural Sciences Olympic Teams Association project aims to financially support all stages of preparing the Bulgarian natural science teams for the international Olympiads. Organizing and conducting National workshops on Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, Informatics, Mathematical Linguistics, Astronomy, Astrophysics, as well as supporting the Young Physicists Academy, are critical for the good performance of Bulgarian youths at the Olympic Forums.

title: Safe Childbirth in Rural Uganda
description: In Uganda women and newborns die every day from complications related to pregnancy and childbirth that could have been prevented or treated. Poor quality care due to an insufficient number of skilled health workers and lack of basic equipment are leading causes of those complications. Within this project we will optimize access to safe birth, obstetric and neonatal care in the rural areas by provision of safe, comprehensive and simple lifesaving solutions and training of health care providers.

title: Help us buy tables and chairs for 40 nursery kids.
description: This project will help us buy tables and chairs for nursery children in a rural village to have a better seating and conductive environment . It will also help us provide school supplies to nearly 40 children likes books ,Pens,pencils, rulers ,geometry sets and colored pencils.  It will also help us train parents about the value of education hence eradicating illiteracy rates in rural areas.

title: Solar security for 150 Vulnerable Widows in Kenya
description: This project will provide high quality solar and battery kits to 150 vulnerable widows and their children in rural Kenya, improving the security of families who suffer abuse and exploitation. In addition, it will provide clean electric light to replace the use of dangerous kerosene lamps enabling children to do school work safely at home. The kits will also provide charging facilities for mobile phones, giving more security to the widows as they are able to make emergency calls.

title: Anti Addiction for 3000 Youths (IMPRESSIONS)
description: IMPRESSIONS - is a Mega Youth Program Organized by ISKCON Prayagraj for educating and inspiring over 3,000 youths from Colleges and Schools for Anti-Addiction and Anti-Stress and motivating them for a Positive Value Based Lifestyle.

title: Compton Innovation Center
description: Hacker Fund plans to build the first innovation center in Compton for the following purposes: (1) provide thousands of students from Compton Unified School District (CUSD) with career pathways in S.T.E.A.M. education, (2) promote expansion of the CUSD Career Technical Education Program, and (3) create a homebase for entrepreneurship and professional development for Compton stakeholders. This center will feature classes/workshops, access to mentors, prototyping equipment, and coworking space.

title: Support to Educate OVCs in Rural Central Uganda.
description: Better Standards School provides formal education to Orphans and other Vulnerable Children (OVCs) in Katabalanga ward, Mubende Municipality, Central Uganda who cannot otherwise access and afford it. The school adopted nurturing, holistic approach to education helping children learn joyfully. 75% of the children get full sponsorship while the rest pay a subsidized fee. Your donation goes towards critical infrastructure like learning materials, classroom construction, food & construction of toilet

title: Education can change 93 children's lives in Mexico
description: In Mexico, 53% of families face poverty, marginalization and vulnerability, causing our children lack access to education and development problems; limiting their opportunities and exposing them to the risk of participating in criminal situations. By ensuring the education of 93 children, we will attend problems of learning, school lag, or deficient development of cognitive and psychomotor skills, providing the tools to break the cycle of poverty and transform their lives and communities.

title: Resilience through Arts for SA Farming Communities
description: * The families in farming communities in the Western Cape of South Africa remains a marginalized group that suffers the psycho-social effects of apartheid and ongoing trauma. * This project use the arts therapies to develop resilience in individuals and their communities, towards a sustainable solution to alcohol and substance abuse, gangsterism, violence and abuse. * We will run arts-based projects with children, their parents, unemployed youth, teachers and other community leaders.

title: Adopt a Forest Guard & Save Colombia's Wildlife
description: Deforestation has skyrocketed in Colombia, destroying habitat and driving wildlife to the edge of extinction. To combat this threat, dozens of committed forest guards stand at the front lines of conservation, defending over 150,000 acres of rainforests and vulnerable habitat for endangered species at 27 nature reserves owned and managed by ProAves. Your donation will ensure vital support for our forest guards to secure the reserves, monitor threatened species, and educate local communities.

title: Ensure Freedom for 400 Talibe Children in Senegal
description: By building the capacity of local social service providers, the project aims to impact the lives of 400 talibe children across 10 communities by improving the provision of basic social services including, but not limited to: registration and regularization of civil status, access to socio-economic services, and protection against violence, abuse and trafficking. Free the Slaves brings 19 years of  expertise to sustainably engage local grassroots organizations in Senegal to resist trafficking.

title: Clean Water Improves Patient Care in Rural Zambia
description: The Mwandi Hospital serves 27,000 people in Western Province Zambia. When the hospital's nurses and doctors don't have sufficient clean running water to wash hands between patients & before surgery, health suffers. Mwandi Hospital American Partners will construct a water system that will reliably supply clean water in amounts that will improve medical practices and limit exposure to water-borne diseases. The system will use an elevated bulk storage tank, filtrations system and UV purification.

title: Provide clean water and humanitarian aid to Yemen
description: To raise funds to help Aquabox produce and deliver up 250 Gold boxes (each containing a family filter) and 10 Community filters to Yemen. The Aquafilters have the capacity to supply potable water to up to 8000 citizens. This helps avoid cholera and other waterborne diseases. A Gold box provides a family of 5 with a water filter and up to 70 humanitarian aids. The box contents help meet other immediate and urgent needs such as shelter building, cooking & eating, health & hygiene, education.

title: Safe Water for School Children in Rural Vietnam
description: MEDRIX is proud to have installed water filter systems in schools in rural Vietnam to provide safe drinking water for the children and their teachers.   When we visit these schools, the only complaint we hear is, "it takes too long to filter the water for our 200 children". Now we have a solution to that problem, the larger LifeStraw Community model filter system. Will you donate to help us buy, install and evaluate 3 of these larger systems?

title: Improve Literacy for 40 Waterloo Iowa Children
description: KBBG's Community Learning Center will provide literacy support to Waterloo, Iowa 3rd-5th grade students by having them read books and plays on-air and write content for programs and social media.  High school and college students will serve as mentors for the younger students while gaining "hands on" experience and "real life" transferable skills that can be used to secure employment opportunities.

title: Help a community in Mexico plant 50,000 mangroves
description: Conquista Campesina is a community in the Pacific coast of Chiapas, Mexico. Their livelihood depends on small-scale agriculture and artisanal fisheries. Hurricanes and earthquakes have impacted areas of their mangroves. With your support, Pronatura Sur will donate funds to the community so they can restore wetlands and plant 50,000 mangrove trees, improving their fisheries' productivity, resilience, and biodiversity, and helping reduce climate change impacts globally and locally.

title: Perinatal education for 1400 mothers in Albania
description: Statistics from the latest World Bank Report rate Albania as the country with the second-highest child mortality rate in the Balkans. As many as 75% of pregnant women in Albania have never received education on prenatal or postnatal care, making them and their child highly vulnerable to easily avoidable health risks.  The Mother and Child Hospital Foundation is helping bridge this gap, empowering and educating mothers through offering free of charge, prenatal and postnatal classes.

title: Yagazie Foundation for Children of Plateau State.
description: This Project "Yagazie Foundation for the Children and Youths of Plateau State will focus on provision of enhanced education, clean environmental sanitation and quality health care program for Children in Plateau State, Nigeria.

title: Support 300 peasant farmers in Nkoranza
description: The National Beekeepers Association will train and supply bee hives  and other beekeeping equipment to 200 women and 100 men from 10 villages in the Nkoranza district to incorporate beekeeping in their farming activities to increase crop yields through pollination and also harvest the honey, beeswax,and other bee products to increase their income and improve their livelihood.We will establish a community honey processing center to process the honey to sell.

title: Giving Girls Confidence: Girls on the Run - DC
description: Last year, Girls on the Run - DC offered financial assistance to 76% of girls who participated in the character development program and continue to see that need grow. By donating today, YOU can help girls feel greater confidence in who they are and what they can accomplish.   Your donation will support program scholarships for 16 girls and help them feel great about themselves, inside and out. You're giving girls social, emotional and physical well-being at a critical time in their lives.

title: Saving children born without an immune system
description: 70% of all the children with a Primary Immunodeficiency need an antibodies replacement treatment in order to survive. Poor families do not have medical social security to cover the treatment. This antibodies replacement treatment is available in Mexico. However, it is only guaranteed  for children 5 years old or younger by the Mexican Public Health Ministry. We is seeking to work alongside with the Mexican Public Health authorities and families to modify Public Health Policies and Laws

title: Build young women tech job opportunities in Mexico
description: Develop sustainable capacities for employability, leadership and community transformation to  250 low income and unemployed young woman through mentoring, training and technical advice. We will ensure education resources, self employment abilities, computer, design and coding skills in order to fill the technical void and improve their lives. We will serve scholarships for the most deserving talented underprivileged youth & young women residing in rural areas and belongs to low income families.

title: Protecting the rights of 1000 Tajik women from dom
description: The project is aimed at the social and legal protection of 1000 vulnerable women from violence in the Rasht district of Tajikistan, through the establishment of legal clinics in 4 regions of the region. The action of the project is to provide free legal and psychological consultations, conduct a training seminar on legal literacy and access to legal advice for 660 women, develop and publish 2500 copies of the brochure "Questions and Answers on Women's Rights" and 15,000 information sheets

title: After School Program for Children in Cameroon
description: The project aims to help underprivileged children from different schools in Cameroon by developing their skills & creating an emotionally safe place to meet and improve the educational level of young people. Since the beginning of the Anglophone crisis, which has persisted since late 2016, the schooling of young people has become increasingly precarious. The program will help them to catch up with some of the topics they have missed. This initiative is to focus on Phase 2 budget of the program.

title: Overcoming Speech, and Swallowing difficulties
description: Organization for Speech and Swallowing Therapy Cambodia (SSTC) provides ongoing clinical supervision to medical professionals, including doctors and nurses, at public hospitals in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. Our main focus is the evaluation of swallowing disorders (dysphagia), a condition suffered by stroke patients and which can lead to malnutrition, pneumonia, and if not treated death. In short, we are here to save lives and improve the quality of life for Cambodians who have suffered strokes etc.

title: Provide 18 farmers with irrigation for life
description: Farmers in Rajasthan are stuck in poverty due to low farming incomes due to a lack of water for irrigation.  This programme lends farmers money to buy a new drip irrigation system and teaches them how to use it. Higher crop yields result in higher incomes. Over five years, farmers pay back the money they were lent and the funds are then lent to a new farmer to buy a drip irrigation system. The programme offers a lot of hands on support. Drip irrigation is a simple system but hugely effective.

title: BUILD 16 TOILETS FOR 2846 PUPILS IN NYANZA, KENYA.
description: The project aims at enhancing 2846 pupils' learning conditions through the construction of 16 toilets in 8 schools within Alego Usonga, Gem, Rachuonyo East and Seme Sub-Counties. Currently the pupils are using dilapidated pit latrines.

title: Restore a house to mobilize ignored labor pools
description: This project will positively influence ignored labor pools of young adults to address staff shortage to serve Madagascar hospitality and tourism industry: chronically unemployed, lost one of their parents, recovering addicts. The renovation of this historic landmark will also signify the preservation of the architectural ensemble of the Old Town Fianarantsoa. For each collected donation, a painted mural will be dedicated to you

title: Help Vitalize Nine Bulgarian Villages
description: Devetaki Plateau Association works to boost the economic and cultural development of the Devetaki Plateau region and its 9 villages organizing a Jazz Fest and a Jazz for Kids event.  This will bring together talented musicians and children as well as adventurers and journalists from all over Bulgaria, who will spend time there and further promote the region as a tourist and cultural destination.

title: Education Gift to 9 Girls at Hope School, Kenya
description: Orphans and Vulnerable Girl's in Africa face various hurdles on their path to education. Culture and tradition often keeps them at home while their brothers go to school. Some girls are forced to marry when they are as young as 13 in exchange for a few cows. If a girl convinces her family to send her to a "free" government school, she often cannot go because she lacks the funds for a uniform or supplies. Hope School is a social enterprise giving quality basic education to poor children.

title: Sponsor 100 children in Kayole Slum in Nairobi
description: Tunaweza Pamoja Children's Centre helps neglected, needy, orphaned, vulnerable, deprived and destitute children mostly from the Kayole-Soweto slum area in Nairobi, Kenya. We help the children by paying their school fees, giving them shelter, food, clothing and medical attention. We provide a loving and safe, family environment that enables children the right to a happy, educated, skilled, happy  and healthy life. Currently we are helping 100 children aged between 3 to 15 years.

title: Give medicines to 550 diabetic children in India
description: The purpose of this project is to provide monthly medical expenses, glucose testing kit and strips to 550 underprivileged type 1 diabetic children.  These children belong to poor families and these families are unable to afford monthly medical expenses.  Give your generous support to these type 1 diabetic children for access of monthly medical expenses.

title: "Empower 20 Nepali Women for a year"
description: CASANepal is a safe home for female GBV survivors and their children runned by Apeiron in Kathmandu, Nepal. Upon referrals from the Nepali Police, Women and Children Offices, GBV Watchgroups, and other NGOs, survivors come to CASANepal seeking support and services. For each survivor, CASANepal provides complete case management that is tailor-made and survivor-centered. Women receive psycho-social counseling, medical support, legal counseling, various therapies, and skill development training.

title: EDUCATE MALAYSIA'S INVISIBLE CHILDREN
description: For refugee children in Malaysia going to school is only a distant dream. Due to a lack of legal status, refugees cannot seek legal work, children can't attend school, and access to healthcare is limited. Fugee School provides education and life skills to refugee children and youth so they can build meaningful and dignified lives. With your support, Fugee School will be able to guarantee access to innovative learning and care programs for over 180 refugee children.

title: One Life At a Time
description: MANYO aims at building bipartisan support to make sure every child in the slum of Mathare North in Nairobi, Kenya have access to high-quality early learning and to protect children living in conflict zones around the city. We limit our reach to a smaller number of children who will benefit from this project to 30 enabling us to concentrate our effort on building trust. These are the under privileged kids and their families who are living in poverty. Teachers are among the beneficiaries too.

title: 3 Micro-bakeries for rural women in South Africa
description: This project will establish 3 mobile micro-bakeries for women-led charities  in rural South Africa, providing income and bread for them and their communities. In South Africa 30.4 million people survive on less than $75 a month. This project offers affordable access to food and income security by training 12 women change agents to become artisanal bakers. Equipment and startup ingredients are provided alongside training and mentoring, ensuring that bakeries can start producing immediately.

title: Support 20 Kenya County Education Equality Forums
description: Elimu Yetu Coalition plans to hold policy forums in 20 marginalized counties in Kenya to enhance access to quality basic education for both boys and girls.

title: Build Two Classrooms for Orphans in Uganda
description: This project will build two classroom structures, and will enable children to study in a less congested and more conducive environment. At God's mercy Orphanage Centre children share one classroom structure with students of the Adult Literacy. The classroom has a separation of plywood. The classroom is congested during study time for both classes. The New classroom structures will be allocated to children only.

title: Designing Sustainable Fashion for I was a Sari
description: I was a Sari(IWAS)-an award-winning sustainable fashion brand- and Fashion in ProcessLab(FiP) at DesignDept. Politecnico di Milano have partnered with CHIME FOR CHANGE to make sustainable fashion impactful.IWAS's work transforms pre-loved Indian saris into unique style,providing regular income and valuable skills training to vulnerable women in Mumbai.To further IWAS's work, the brand will engage a DesignResearcher, selected from a global competition, to train and work with the female artisans.

title: Improving the conditions of IDPs in SWR, Cameroon
description: Cameroon has always been considered as a peaceful country.  The one's peaceful country became plagued by a political crisis which started in November 2016. As we write, the crisis is still ongoing with so many people affected. Amongst the effects of the ongoing crisis in Cameroon is the rampant loss of lives and properties as well as the burning down of houses. The homeless nature now causes inhabitants of the affected areas to resort to seeking refuge in bushes and unorthodox means of survival.

title: Help Rural Communities Access Healthcare in Peru
description: Healthcare is an expensive and struggling area for most countries. Action Change works on over 70 projects around the world. Working with communities we aim to increase our impact by running community healthcare provisions. Funding permitted we will be bringing in local health professionals to provide resources, outreach awareness and emergency services to the local community to ensure everyone has access to support for a healthier and safe future. This project will be 100% funded by our donors

title: Support disabilities in kakamega Kenya
description: People living with disabilities in Africa have been forgotten both children ,youth and adults I just came to realize that they are hidden in houses and not taken to schools, some of don't have shelters ,clothing, bedding and food, others don't something v to support them move form to  place,also those that are females are raped and Left with HIV ,No one is caring for them in the societies we are living,Wylis has seen a need of coming in fully this asking the donors to help remember this families

title: Very first UCAC scholarship outreach
description: The UCAC Scholarship program intends to support high performing students who would otherwise be unable to attend the university due to financial obstacles.  Since the early days of our institution in the 1990's, we have relied on institutional and private donors and have been able to provide more than 6,000 students with scholarship support for the past 25+ years. As our donor list has diminished over the year for various reasons, we are in dire need of support from friends and fellow alumni.

title: Give hope to10 vulnerable children in South Africa
description: Harambee Entrepreneurship Programme identifies orphaned and vulnerable children in South Africa and working with local schools provide them with food rations and school fees for 3 months and within the three months provide business skill training and seed capital to their guardians or foster parents to enable them start income generating activities in order to continue meeting the needs of the children in the absence of further donor support. Your donation will secure a future for 10 children.

title: Education Is Key: send 500 Ugandan kids to school!
description: Help us to empower families in Uganda in 2023! Our mission is to empower families in Uganda to rise above poverty. We use an integrated approach and focus on the development of economic, social, natural, human, and cultural capital. 22STARS collaborates with communities in Acholi Quarter in the capital Kampala and Danida in Jinja, who live in extreme poverty after having fled conflict zones in Northern Uganda and neighbouring countries.  With your donation we pay for meals and school fees.

title: Operation MIND (Mentor,Inform,Network,Deploy) Set
description: Set|Ready provides support to Military, Veterans, & their Families to aid in successful transition into the civilian workforce through holistic approaches that go beyond resume preparation.  We address Mental Health, teach Mindfulness-based Stress Reduction, and the effective use of Mentors to develop meaningful outcomes for those utilizing our services.  All services are provided  FREE to Military, Veterans, and their Families.

title: Transform the lives of 120 children in Trujillo!
description: Giving a child a healthy smile makes a new life possible!  From May 24 to June 2, 2019, our volunteer medical team from Global Smile Foundation (GSF) will provide pro-bono comprehensive cleft care to underserved patients in Trujillo, Peru. Our patients will receive the individualized care they need to change their lives including corrective surgeries, dental and orthodontic care, nutrition counseling, speech therapy and psycho-social support.

title: Make STEM clubs possible for 600+ girls in Ghana
description: To build girls' confidence, interest and knowledge in science and math, The Exploratory gives teachers hands-on and gender-responsive training and the necessary supplies, equipment and stationery to facilitate free, weekly hands-on science clubs. This project supports weekly, interactive, after school sessions for 600 girls and 150 boys in 16 public upper primary and junior high schools in the greater Accra and Eastern regions in Ghana in 2019. See our other project to create coding clubs.

title: Save All Species on The Galapagos Islands
description: Animal Balance is planning a return trip to the island of San Cristobal in the Galapagos, Ecuador. We have been working on the islands since 2004, providing humane population management for cats and dogs in order to allow all species to coexist together peacefully. We work with government agencies and train local veterinarians to continue our work when we leave. Our work helps to protect all species that inhabit the island, including sea lions, marine iguanas, giant tortoises, and many others.

title: Save 745 lives from opioid overdose in Detroit
description: This project will enable peer-networks in Detroit's most opioid-impacted communities to distribute enough naloxone (overdose antidote) to save +700 lives. Your donation could save a life this week. Plus, 93% of overdose survivors are still alive 1 year later--so your donation will give someone's daughter, son, husband, wife, or grandchild a great shot at living long enough to make it to treatment and recovery.

title: Carbon Credit for Humanitarian Solar Power
description: The average American is responsible for about 18 tons of carbon dioxide emissions per year.  You can offset 1 ton of your carbon emissions by helping The Appropriate Technology Collaborative provide solar lighting to families that currently light their homes with candles and kerosene lamps.  Our program helps families improve their lives and see better at night.  Their kids do their homework at night for the first time and girls don't have to hike long distances to charge the family cellphone.

title: Fostering Indigenous Women Political Participation
description: Our gender-focused, community-led development approach, soughts for indigenous women and men from 11 communities in Oaxaca, to lead a healthy, fulfilling life of self-reliance and dignity by unleashing their vision, commitment, leadership, capacities and  power. In order for these communities to achieve a life self-reliance, enabling indigenous women's leadership and political participation is the key component. Be our partner with them in their journey to achieving a life self-reliance.

title: Transform the life of a child with autism
description: We are the main institution in Tijuana, B.C., which provides services for children and young people with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) in vulnerable situations. The effective treatments we offer consist of early detection and intervention through an educational program. During the past 20 years, PASITOS served 793 students with its school program, enrolled 53 students in regular classrooms, completed 37,972 therapy sessions, and benefited more than 5,794 parents, teachers, and residents.

title: Empowering Deaf Women
description: The Deaf community is a vulnerable population, since language deprivation impedes their access to information and knowledge. When it comes to Deaf Women, this situation deepens and results in dependence, poor self-esteem and health risk.  We will bring information to deaf women through a series of videos in sign language to encourage their own empowerment through the reinforcement of their bonds, access to information and linguistic and cultural recognition.

title: Bringing Iris Back Home
description: Iris lost her home after Hurricane Maria. She has received no government support and has been displaced from her home for over a year and a half. Iris is a mother, a community leader and a reflection of so many Puerto Ricans that have been neglected their basic human rights. The construction was stopped for a period of 3 months due to a lack of funds. Join us as we get Iris back to her home and reconstruct a story of justice for our people.

title: Educate 357 Moms About Health & Nutrition in Haiti
description: Support 3 Care Groups and provide nutrition & health lessons to 357 moms of children under 5 to help treat & prevent acute malnutrition, which is devastating to their healthy growth & development. We will provide lessons in maternal nutrition, child feeding and water sanitation & hygiene.
