title: Provide Quality Education to 900 Kenyan Children
description: Every child deserves an excellent education! We imagine a world where every school is a vibrant place for children to gain the skills and strength of character they need to thrive and succeed. Teachers have the biggest impact on children's learning.  We believe in equipping and empowering teachers so that 900 students marginalized by poverty can receive quality education and fulfill their potential.  Quality education transforms students' opportunities, and gives them a pathway out of poverty!

title: Help Break the Cycle of Illiteracy and Poverty
description: The Spring Blossom Scholarship Program supports deprived Dongxiang children aged 8 to 16 to receive education and empowers the young generation to end the vicious cycle of illiteracy and cross generation poverty.

title: Help save the Little School in the Kalahari
description: The Khomani San,  live in one of the most remote and least serviced areas in South Africa. An estimation of 500 people live on the farms that fall within this land.  This project serves those inhabitants of the area, both parents and children in an attempt to provide culturally inclusive foundation phase education to Khomani San children and to ensure that the ancient N/Uu language and culture are transferred to younger generations and it starting to disappear.

title: Transform the lives of 200 Kenyan girls
description: Women Without Borders-Kenya would like to empower 200 girl with knowledge through education by providing them with school necessities,including books,uniforms,sanitary pads and tuition fee among others.Our education sponsorship in partnership with 39 schools wil support young girls/ adolescent girls to transition from primary to secondary education system,as this where we see most drop outs given the increase of fees.This will impact the whole community at large.and scale up with 4000 in 2 years

title: Give Liberian Ebola Orphans a Home and Future
description: Children's Aid Liberia (CAL) seeks to build and maintain a children's home providing basic needs, sanctuary, security, shelter, food, care, education, love, and hope to the orphans of Liberia who have been impacted by the Ebola crisis and Liberian Civil War, preparing them to be productive and thriving members of society.

title: Chimpa Alccassana afforestation project
description: This project aims to eradicate environmental degradation and rural poverty in the Chimpa Alccassana community through large-scale afforestation.

title: One Water Well for India
description: This project will provide ten clean water wells for rural villages in India! With clean water, avenues to better sanitation and education are opened. With better sanitation and education, even more paths to a better future are opened. It all starts with a simple donation.

title: Help 120 Afghan Widows Become Expert Tailors
description: Our project will establish five community-based vocational training centers in Afghanistan where we will provide education in basic literacy, simple numeration, basic hygiene, and peace-building, and deliver practical skills of tailoring to 120 widows and orphans in Afghanistan over the next seven months.  Our main goal of the project is to deliver financial self-sustainability to the targeted population of women which will, in turn, provide food and education to their children at home.

title: Teen Center for Leaders in Training
description: Boys and Girls Club Tijuana will remodel a room for their 50 teenagers  called Teen Center. This space will offer them a place away from the street risks where they will be giving the tools to develop their leadership skills and contibute to improve our community. Since the priority right know is securing the operating funds for the current cost of the Clubs in Tijuana, a Teen Center will not be possible without your help!

title: Aus Animal Disaster Aid
description: With this project we aim to develop a National program based on providing Disaster Relief to Animals both stock and domestic. We hope to create Dedicated Community Animal Response Teams that will provide Preparedness, Response and Relief to animal owners across Australia. We hope to support owners and their animals in the event of evacuations to help reduce the loss of life, both human and animal where possible.

title: Get 16 teens out of poverty through education
description: With your support, we will help 16 young Chileans, aged between 15 and 16, through "back to school" programs. Our study program will help them to catch up on their studies in 3-4 years via an innovative educational model. They have been out of the school system  because they are from very poor neighborhoods and go out to work at an early age. Your donation will assure them a comprehensive help: meals; clothing; hands on workshops; and continuity in their studies, thus, making up for lost time.

title: Protect the Amazon Rainforest and its Guardians
description: What first started as the documentary Tribes on the Edge, a film about the Javari Valley and its Indigenous Peoples by humanitarian and environmentalist Celine Cousteau has now become a much larger integrated impact campaign. Named The Javari Project, it aims to protect the indigenous tribes of the Vale do Javari and, by extension, the region's irreplaceable biodiversity. These tribes are truly the guardians of the rainforest and by protecting them we protect the Amazon and the air we breathe.

title: Release 30,000 sea turtles in Guatemala
description: ARCAS will hire local guides (the majority ex-poachers), conduct educational activities and purchase nests with the goal of incubating at least 30,000 olive ridley, green and leatherback sea turtle eggs in the Hawaii and El Rosario hatcheries on the Pacific coast of Guatemala.  The project will contribute to the conservation of these endangered species while also  contributing to the sustainable livelihoods of low-income local residents.

title: Teach 21st-century skills to 800 youth in Tanzania
description: This project will build a learning lab with 20 computers, where we will train 800 youth (in the first 3 years alone) in the skills required by 21st century Tanzania. Course alumni will excel in university and the workplace and will have the mindset to address the social and development challenges of our nation. Will be creating a community of productive young professional and change-makers.

title: Teach self-esteem to 600 needy Romanian women
description: We are offering for 600 Romanian disadvantaged women from rural areas, group therapy sessions in order to improve their mental health, informative medical sessions about reproductive health, lessons about the legal ways to protect themselves from domestic violence and, for those who need it, free hairstyling look changing sessions. We bring precious information, gifts, joy and we ask them to change their attitude, to be courageous and to value their person.

title: Cycling Whole Life Coaching for @Risk African Kids
description: Prochorus uses cycling as a development Whole Life Coaching tool for poor and marginalized kids of the urban and township areas surrounding Stellenbosch in South Africa. The program inspires them to start dreaming again, believe in themselves, see their own potential and opportunities, empowers them to attain success in whatever they set as a personal goal. We intentionally work to develop their Occupational Intelligence, also emotionally, physically, socially, spiritually and intellectually.

title: Empower 80 teenage mothers with economic skills
description: This project seeks to provide 30 rural teenage mothers with economic skills in dressmaking, hairdressing and catering to improve their socioeconomic well-being and that of their children.

title: Provide Clean Water to 500 Families in the Desert!
description: This project is of extreme importance to serving humanity. By providing Clean Water to approx. 500 families in extreme far areas of Thar Desert. *(an average family size is 2 to 3 Adults + 4 to 5 Children = 8 Persons). Deep water-well's will be dug, and provided with a "hand-pump" for smooth operation, to the 10 villages. A regular maintenance is necessary every year to maintain the serviceability of these wells.

title: Tech Training for 100 young people in Lagos.
description: Our goal is to give the Nigerian youth an opportunity for a better future. Our focus for this project is on the underprivileged youth, those who due to poverty or some other reason, do not have access to formal education beyond high school. Our Tech Academy not only trains young people in the ever-changing field of tech, but also teaches them basic workplace skills and provides the opportunity for internship, work placement, and follow-up.

title: Hope for People with Neurological Disorders
description: Public awareness of the impact of neurological disorders (AD, MS, ALS, epilepsy, Parkinsons & many more) - the greatest cause of long-term disability and a primary cause of death in the US and abroad - has improved, but there is still too little public support for the research necessary to improve treatment and cures for these conditions.  At Hope Happens, we provide resources and create an efficient research infrastructure that accelerates the translation of basic research to clinical cures.

title: Purposeful Play to help disadvantage children
description: Our project focuses on connecting, engaging & educating disadvantaged girls, of the Pafuri area of southern Africa through in soccer, specifically rural South Africa, Zimbabwe & Mozambique.  Through soccer, we are able to reach into the most rural of villages and harness the energy, create safe spaces, motivate the girls to discuss and learn how to tackle social issues affecting them and the environment in which they grow up in, from HIV, teenage pregnancy, gender equality, poaching and abuse.

title: Library and ICT lab for 70 former street children
description: Through your generous contribution, over 70 street connected children will have access to a well stocked library and ICT lab from our Day Care Centre (FCP) in Ashaiman and our Temporary Shelter (WEM) in Ayikuma.

title: Hurricane Dorian Relief and Recovery Fund
description: This disaster relief fund has supported people impacted by Hurricane Dorian's storm system in the form of emergency supplies like food, water, and medicine.  Beginning in 2020, and we will be investing in the rebuilding of homes, communities and livelihoods on Grand Bahama, Abaco,  and in ongoing support of evacuees in Nassau. All donations to this fund will exclusively support relief and recovery efforts in areas impacted by this storm.

title: Support Mission Based Trauma Recovery for Vets
description: Warrior Canine Connection utilizes a Mission Based Trauma Recovery model to help Warriors recovering from the stress of combat reconnect with their families, communities, and life.  By interacting with the dogs as they move from puppyhood to training to adult service dogs, Warrior Trainers benefit from a physiological and psychological animal-human connection. As a result of their efforts, Veterans with disabilities receive the finest in trained service dogs.

title: Tranzmission Emergency Housing Fund
description: The Tranzmission Emergency Housing Project finds safe housing for nonbinary and transgender people in housing crisis in Western North Carolina.

title: Save Austrian Prison Newspaper for 1000 inmates
description: The Austrian prison newspaper BLICKPUNKTE does not only give editors and experts the chance to write about the issues of the Austrian prison system and other relevant topics but also enables inmates to actively participate in creating this newspaper and presenting their point of view. About 20 volunteers work on our monthly newspaper. We address issues in our newspaper such as the shortcomings of the Austrian forensic commitment, life behind bars, international prison systems, etc

title: Improving Lives of Children with Celebral Palsy
description: KCDF wishes to support a group of children living with cerebral palsy condition   by reducing the distance they have to travel to visit the main clinic at Donholn Nairobi for therapy. There is need for 3 satellite therapy clinics to be set up in strategic peri-urban locations in Nairobi to ease the burden of transport for mothers who carry their children on their backs in public service vehicles which are not disability friendly. 30,0000 USD is required to purchase equipment for these clinics.

title: Help relocate 10 zebra in South Africa
description: 10 beautiful zebra are currently being sold and are at risk. Help us relocate them to a safe Haven in Environs of Isimagaliso World Natural Heritage Site, Zululand, so that they can join fellow zebras Stripy and Tammy. These 2 zebra need a larger structured herd for better protection. Two young females and a male will be relocated to Suni-Ridge Wildlife Sanctuary and 7 to Khumbula Wildlife Sanctuary. Their security will be monitored and they will never be at risk or be sold again.

title: Save US Families from Homelessness
description: Homelessness in the US needs no explanation.  It's an epidemic, especially in California.  In 6 years of operation, we have helped over 325 individuals and families stay in their rented homes. These people are going thru a temporary financial emergency from which they can recover.  We've found that it takes an average of $2,300 that makes the difference between staying in their home and avoidable eviction and/or homelessness.

title: Keep them Singers Singing
description: The project will deliver a sustainable future for women's and disabled tailoring groups in two regions of Tanzania. It will provide refurbished sewing machines and deliver practical and business training to these groups. It will also identify and train regional networks of sewing machine mechanics who will maintain the machines ensuring sustainability into the future.

title: SCHOOL FOR 300 ORPHANS IN NIGERIA
description: Skills Learning Centre and School for Orphans will strives to provide underprivileged people in Nigerian communities with affordable quality of education that will help them to break the cycle of poverty.   The project goal is to equip youth, women and less privilege people with sufficient skills and education through focussing on skills like tailoring, computer repairs, installation of renewable energy systems.

title: Clean & Efficient Cook Stoves in Guatemala
description: Currently, many families  in rural Guatemala are cooking with open flames within their homes, contributing to respiratory illness & inefficient wood burning.  $150 covers supplies and installation of one clean and efficient cook stove in the home of a Guatemalan family. $15,000 is needed to support the next 80 stoves built!   Your donation will positively impact the health and wellness of families for years to come, providing a much needed hand up.

title: Puppy Flood in Public Shelter Bucov
description: Every year more and more Romanians bring nearly 800 unwanted puppies into the shelter, instead of drowning or killing them as they did before.  Even if a lot of these puppies do not survive the first days or die because of the vaccination there are still many puppies which survive the vaccination phase. For them good food is needed and new kennels and roofs have to be built.  And every year we try to carry out a puppy rescue transport to give about 50 puppies a good future.

title: Help 300 Survivors of Violence Smile Again!
description: 3 seconds! That's how often we blink our eyes. Sadly, its also the Exact amount of time that lapses before someone becomes a Victim of Violence! That's 1200 times per hour, 28,800 times a day & 10,512,000 a year! Its shocking to think of what happens in the Blink Of An Eye! Let's Join together to Fight for Survival! Your Contribution will make an impact to help Survivors Break Their Chains, Get Support and Find a Safe Haven. Help Bring Hope. Breed Trust. The futures calling, won't you help?

title: The Bahamas Recovery Fund
description: Thousands of families remain without electricity, drinking water or a safe roof to protect their families. Recovery can take months and everyone's participation is necessary. Our teams are assisting with immediate needs.  The reconstruction phase is just started.  We are supporting several organizations focusing on women and kids.  Unemployment is reaching strategic numbers and we need to take kids away from the danger in the streets.

title: Reading Kids - Children's Library in rural Uganda
description: The project is aimed at providing a modern library specifically for children aged 3 - 12 years of age, in the rural village of Agule in Pallisa Uganda. The project will support between 800 - 1000 children from 4 schools  by providing and giving them access to a variety of books in a  conducive child appropriate environment in which they can enjoy reading and studying. The overall goal is to improve literacy and numeracy competencies which are below 20% in Eastern region of Uganda.

title: Empower Higher Education for Scholars in Cameroon
description: In the midst of an ongoing civil crisis in Cameroon, Open Dreams has opened a new Center in Cameroon's capital, Yaounde, replete with computers, desks & books, providing a safe haven for aspiring college scholars. Despite difficult circumstances, over 200+ Open Dreams scholars have achieved their dream of attaining a full college scholarship. With your help, we aim to grow our center in Yaounde, offer more housing for displaced students,  & offer courses in the hard hit North to more students.

title: Spread anti-FGM messages through the media in Mali
description: Female genital mutilation (FGM) is a harmful, humiliating practice to control women, which leads to lifelong damage.  We will play anti-FGM songs on the radio and show music videos, the trailer of a film about a safe house that shelters girls in danger, and a video of Malian legislators speaking out against FGM on Malian TV.  We will erect 2 billboards in Bamako.  Our goal is to convince Malians to abandon this age-old practice, which has such devastating effects.  Read more at StopExcision.net.

title: St. John's College Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Business Internship Program, Kelsey and Chika from St. John's College High School, have been working with LI to help create & sustain businesses in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to build a business development center. At this center, vulnerable men and women will receive training in life-skills, vocational skills & business to empower and equip them to escape extreme poverty.

title: Empower the lives of 300 talented peruvian kids
description: Peru Champs wants to tackle the pressing issue of education in Peru. Unfortunately, a high quality education is only currently accessible to families with a high income. Our mission is to identify and empower talented, underprivileged kids (whom we call 'Champs') by providing them with scholarships and a Leadership Program for a world class education. Your donation can give the possibility of contributing in the necessary tools for 300 of our Champs to become future leaders of Peru.

title: inclusion by educating girls with disabilities
description: construction and equipping of a social complex on an area of 4168 m2 for 925 girls and children with disabilities in Azilal, Morocco to facilitate their empowerment, inclusion and access to basic services.

title: Workshops on Lifeskills for Foster Youth in Poland
description: This is a long-term program enabling the care leavers to meet on regular basis during the school year (twice a month, every workshops last about 5 hours) and learn important life-skills in group, and at the same time get emotional support. Program helps care leavers to preaper to independent life. Part of these meetings is dedicated to housing, law, health and vocational topics -training, writing CV, job appointment,  labor standards and rules ect.

title: EQUIPPING 2 CARDIAC THEATRES AT BMH
description: With a population of 55 million people, Tanzania has only one cardiac hospital, Jakaya Kikwete Cardiac Institute (JKCI) located in Dar es Salaam and staffed to treat only 400 children a year. The New BMH (Benjamin Mkapa Hospital) in Dodoma has been dedicated with a wing for the cardiac facility to assist. This project aims to equip 2 empty cardiac theatres at BMH to facilitate the provision of free pediatrics cardiac treatments to the Tanzanian children in need.

title: Help 50 youths/women start business in Nigeria.
description: A support of $200 each for 50 unemployed youths and women in Ikorodu, Nigeria; will help to start a piggery farm, dressmaking outfit, cassava mill, poultry farm and fish farm. This is based on their vocational interest and skill acquired from our prescribed training for them.

title: Supporting 50 women with cancer in Baja, Mexico
description: This project will provide turbans, breast prosthesis when they are mastectomized, a sleeve for lymphoedema and an adequate bra to women in Baja California that will allow them to improve their image, reduce the risk of sequels and go through the process without so much emotional pain./Proveeremos turbantes, mangas para linfedema, sostentes y/o protesis mamarias para mujeres en B.C. lo que les permitira mejorar su imagen, reducir el riesgo de secuelas y vivir el proceso sin mucho dolor emocional.

title: Mentor and support 2000 poor kids in Madagascar
description: This program will consist in direct mentoring and coaching of the pupils through innovative and playful training on specific themes (such as personal development, English language initiation, protection of the environment and development of learning and logical capacity. We will be providing also material aids (such as school supplies, clothes, books, board games, manual books, computer equipment, etc.) to disadvantaged children who are enrolled in public primary schools.

title: Digital literacy for 200 girls in Kampala slums.
description: Girls living in slums in Uganda often do not make it to school or drop out at an early stage because of the rate of violence and poverty in these areas. Girls are lured into prostitution and child marriage due to lack of alternatives that can foster their development. Rego Foundation offers hands-on computer programming skills for girls 9 - 19+ years old empowering them to become coders rather than child brides. Our project will provide 200 girls with skills essential in this digital century.

title: Providing ART Treatment to 9770 South Africans
description: This project will build PeleBox (SmartLockers) in the City of Tshwane, South Africa, to provide chronic medication to under-served communities and promote treatment adherence for 9770 people living with HIV/AIDS.

title: Keep A Girl Child In School.
description: Our NGO- Grace World Africa Foundation is organising a pads drive to raise 57000 pads in 57 days.As a small organization with great hopes, we want to restore women's dignity affected due to poverty. This campaign aims to keep a girl child in school through collaborative cross sector partnerships, bring to a halt school drop outs of girls who are unable to attend school  and help disadvantaged women due to them not having means to provide themselves with sanitary pads.

title: Inclusion of youth with disabilities in education
description: This project aims at inclusion of youth with disabilities in higher education in Uganda through formation and strengthening university students associations, creating awareness among university administration and developing a policy on students with disability.

title: Train 300 Tourism teachers in South Africa
description: Our project trains and up-skills teachers from previously disadvantaged communities to teach the subject Tourism in high schools more effectively in order to produce a skilled, competent future workforce for South Africa's blooming tourism & hospitality industry. We need your help to continue the training and up-skilling of Tourism teachers through our annual flagship event, the annual 4-day National Tourism Education Conference. Help our students to find employment in the tourism industry.

title: Link 3000+ South African Youth to Opportunities
description: 22% of South African youth do not have direct access to people that can help them find work or opportunities. enke: Make Your Mark works to develop youth to recognise their own value, thrive, and mobilise for meaningful change for themselves and their communities. This project will build a digital "bank" of training, opportunities and resources for our 3600+ alumni to access opportunities and social capital they need to succeed and thrive as economically active, socially responsible citizens.

title: Love and Laughter In Lebanon
description: Clown Me In provides free, public and accessible touring clown shows for children and adults in some of the most disadvantaged regions around Lebanon. With every show, we will reach between 200-300 people, at the rate of two shows per day in different areas, to provide them with much-needed laughter and positive, humanitarian messages.

title: Emergency Response to Hurricane Dorian
description: Increasing all the way to a life-threatening Category 5 storm at its peak, Hurricane Dorian has pummeled the Bahamas, wreaking havoc in the islands of Abaco and Grand Bahama. Hurricane Dorian then moved along the southeast coast of the U.S, devastating Ocracoke Island in North Carolina. International Medical Corps is in the Bahamas to address most urgent needs, and deploying to North Carolina to support affected areas in the wake of Hurricane Dorian.

title: Fight child labour in Peru through education
description: Children living in poverty and helping their parents in brick production is a common picture in San Isidro, a district outside of Perus second-largest city Arequipa. The goal of Intiwawa is to contribute to the integral development of the children and their parents and encourage them to improve their living standards and fulfil their dreams as well as to fight widely spread domestic violence and child labour.

title: help a child access life saving healthcare now
description: In situations where malnutrition is likely to become severe, MSF takes a preventive approach, distributing nutritional supplements to at-risk children to prevent their condition from deteriorating further. The risk of death is particularly high for those with severe acute malnutrition, up to 20 times higher than for a healthy child. Severe acute malnutrition in early childhood is common in Sahel. MSF admitted 74 200 malnourished children to inpatient or outpatient feeding programmes in 2018 only

title: Teach Translation to 20 Students in Post-ISIS Iraq
description: Ideas Beyond Borders, an Iraqi-led non-profit organization, plans to teach and certify 20 university student translators while providing them with a stipend and resume help in order to foster economic growth and empowerment in cities that were brutalized under ISIS.

title: Sustainable Energy for Island Communities in Ghana
description: The goal of the proposed project is to use technology, in the form of climate smart solar lighting solutions to improve the health, education, water access, security and economic livelihoods of 1500 inhabitants including youth, women, and children in the Bomigo Island in the Keta District of the Volta Region of Ghana. The project will install 5kw decentralized solar system of 0.5kw-2kw units for the community clinic, school, water supply, irrigation farmlands, street lights and community center.

title: Growing Free of Gendered Violence in Costa Rica
description: Empower at-risk kids from the vulnerable community of Carpio in Costa Rica, against gender-based violence by challenging beliefs and attitudes based on stereotyped gender roles. To educate them to better deal with situations associated with gendered violence within their families and community by teaching them alternatives to violence. To promote gender equality by raising awareness of equal human rights for all for a more equal community and world.

title: Changing Lives through Arts & Education
description: The Gabriela Dias Foundation works with hundreds of children and youth to provide them with high quality education and access to the arts. We focus especially in those who live in disadvantaged areas, and who are overlooked due to the lack of educational opportunities and economic challenges. Through our social initiatives such as Reading Awareness, Art, Music and Poetry Appreciation we tell their stories to inform, engage and inspire the public to take action.

title: Sport Hall construction for 800 Armenian students
description: Anania Shirakatsy Lyceum is constructing a multi-functional complex Sports Hall to provide Physical Education classes for 800 students. In addition to this, 250 poor students from the nearby 3 rural communities can take part in  different sports activities free of charge. There is a lack of financial resources to complete all the relevant infrastructures and launch the program. We aim to raise 34,900$ for reconstructing 220 sq/m bathrooms and changing rooms to provide essential facilities.

title: Create 10 jobs in an under-served community in NY
description: This project will create jobs and support successful employment for individuals typically excluded from the workforce, by:  1) Creating jobs open to the community by advising employers on Greyston's Open Hiring practice. 2) Providing occupational and life skills training, to equip adults and at-risk youth with nationally recognized certifications. 3) Assisting with the financial burdens (not covered by grants) obstructing employment, and addressing food insecurity and personal/community health.

title: Get a mobile library to refugee camps in Greece
description: As conflict persists in Syria and Afghanistan, refugees continue to flee. Many are housed in isolated camps whilst they undertake the arduous process of applying for legal asylum. The camps consist of rows of tents and container boxes: most have minimal access services and transport. ECHO is a multilingual library on wheels that gets books, learning resources, internet and a community space to these places. As the border crisis continues, we need your help to run this service:

title: Help Preschoolers Heal from Trauma
description: This project will provide weekly yoga classes, music & movement, & gardening, for infants, toddlers, & preschoolers who have experienced trauma as a result of homelessness or maltreatment.  These activities are part of a comprehensive, trauma-informed child development program.  They help foster creative self-expression, channel children's abundant energy into wellness activities, & help them learn the coping & self-regulation skills that are critical to healthy social & emotional development.

title: Buying medicines for 164 children with cancer.
description: In Arica-Chile There are 164 children between 0 and 12 years of age who are cancer patients and come from families that are under the 40% poorer, do not have the resources to acquire 100% of drugs. They transferred to the Capital of Chile, where they receive treatment, the state only contributes with the transfer, hospitalization in hospital and part of the treatment, they must be between 6 to two years in that situation, a family accompanies them and they must contribute a 45% to cover the Reco

title: Train 2,400 Indian girls as peer health leaders
description: Gender inequality is widespread in India and impacts the health & education outcomes of its 120 million adolescent girls. Through our flagship program, Girls Health Champions, we'll train 2,400 Indian girls as peer health educators ("Champions") in 100 schools in India in 2023. We'll support these Champions as they provide 26,000 classmates with the critical health education & support they need to thrive in adolescence, covering topics like menstruation, mental health, reproduction, and gender.

title: Protect Wildlife by Educating Poor Communities
description: Wild animals are a treasure and pride of every nation. They should exist naturally in the wild and be free from hunger and thirst, pain or injury, discomfort, fear distress, and able to express their normal behavior.However, they are the source of food and income for poor communities living near protected areas who kill them in very inhumane and painful manner.We are protecting these animals by educating children and unemployed youths who will in turn get employed and cease from relying on them.

title: Empowering Students for a Greater Tomorrow!
description: Due to recent events across our nation's schools, we are driven to inspire as many teens in our community as possible. Our program promotes this foundation of such idealistic principles such as self-esteem, respect, mental clarity, wellness, and leadership. All of these skills are essential to forming healthy coping skills and relationships well into adulthood. However, we cannot do this alone. We rely on the support of our community to help us thrive in order to have a profound presence.

title: Cazadero Music Camp Scholarship Program
description: Cazadero Music Camp draws a diverse student body from across the Bay Area and beyond to participate in a dynamic music curriculum which inspires young people to develop their musicianship, make lasting friendships, and learn important life skills such as teamwork, leadership, creativity, and more. We are committed to making our program accessible to all aspiring young musicians. Our scholarship program helps hundreds of young musicians with financial need take part in our program each year.

title: Create a new life
description: Give Hope to kids and children between 0 months until 7 years to have a new life without violence, abuse (sexual, physical, psychological) and abandon.  With your contribution we provide everything they need for their child, academic, and mental health development.  25 children will receive food, health services, they will attend school and have cultural and recreational activities.

title: Nicaragua Sea Turtle Hatchery & Community Outreach
description: We work in partnership with local families & the communities around Padre Ramos estuary in northwest Nicaragua to save the three species of sea turtles that return to nest and lay their eggs, including hawksbills (critically endangered), greens (endangered), and olive ridleys (vulnerable). We offer incentives for nests found to local collectors in the area, who may otherwise be tempted to poach, as a mechanism to avoid sale of the species in domestic and international black markets.

title: Empowering 100 households for disabled children
description: Children with disabilities face discrimination, have unfulfilled education opportunities, are often vulnerable to serious illnesses, and at high risk of poverty and social exclusion. ECoS reaches communities to identify affected children; empowers caregivers with skills to provide appropriate care; conducts community sensitization to change negative attitudes; provides education, health support, skills & capital for economic empowerment; and reaches leadership to provide appropriate facilities.

title: Support refugees from northern Burkina Faso
description: Burkina Faso is a poor country with the majority of its young population. since 2015 the country is subject to numerous terrorist attacks. This increases the number of IDPs to nearly 330,000. The project aims to provide relief to displaced populations by providing them with sleeping materials and paying school fees for children whose parents no longer work. The project will also strengthen the economic capacity of mothers to carry out Income Generating Activities

title: Helping School Children in Vanuatu
description: Progress Pikinini is a charity that is determined to help the children of Vanuatu to have a brighter future. We do this by providing a holistic approach sourcing donations for education and home life. We not only distribute to the children, but also schools in need. Many schools lack the basics for education and the children of Vanuatu need all the help we can provide. Help the children of Vanuatu reach for a brighter future with us today.

title: Community Garbage to bring 300 jobs to the Youths
description: This project will provide a sustainable solution to the people of Likoni Community in Kenya who have for a long time suffered the disastrous effects of Mosquito caused diseases and waterborne diseases that have caused deaths and severe illnesses. We seek to clean the community as whole up to 1000 houses which are a home to about 24,000 families. We intend to clear all dumping sites and make beautiful gardens out of them and implement a waste management plan that we and the community came up with

title: Bahamas Hurricane Relief Fund
description: This project will provide much needed disaster relief aid to the Bahamas. Every year thousands of tourists head to the beautiful country of the Bahamas to enjoy their beaches, hotels, and wonderful people. However, the average tourist does not realize the poverty that exists in the country. This poverty combined with an extremely powerful Category 5 storm like Hurricane Dorian has had terrible consequences.

title: Planting of 15,000 trees in Northern Philippines
description: This community-led project will reforest a 20-hectare (40 soccer fields) barren mountains in Lagangilang, Abra Province, Philippines using 15,000 trees. In 5 years, the planted trees will help prevent landslides in upper stream communities, and will prevent floods and loss of farmlands due to river encroachment in lower stream communities.

title: Young Care givers Healing and Connection Project
description: This project will provide a mental health resilience programs for up to 40 young people that care for their Mum, Dad, Brother or sister with a medical condition or disability.   These young people miss out on their teenage years to care for their loved one.   Because of the extreme stress involved with caring, 2 out of 3 teens have severe mental health issues such as anxiety, social isolation, bullying, depression; often leading to suicide.   WHO CARES FOR THESE  YOUNG PEOPLE?   We do!

title: Gift a Child a Camera in the Barrios of Caracas
description: You might have seen Venezuela in the headlines lately...in a time of crisis, where the whole world is talking about Venezuela...what can we do to empower the next generation?   MiRA is our answer. By bringing free photography workshops to Caracas' most vulnerable neighborhoods, we are fostering a mobile, community-first space that promotes agency, democracy and creativity. We hope that, by creating a link between the youth and the world, we can show the reality of Venezuela through their eyes.

title: Emergency Fuel - Hurricane Dorian, Bahamas
description: Help Fund Relief Fund's team of disaster responders bring emergency fuel assistance to the Bahamas, where Hurricane Dorian made landfall as a Category 5 storm on September 1st. Abaco Islands and Grand Bahama especially, experienced catastrophic conditions, including 225 mph winds, life-threatening storm surge of 18-23 feet, 12-30 inches of rain, resulting in 70,000 people being left homeless and a death toll that continues to rise.

title: Provide Meals in the aftermath of Hurricane Dorian
description: Hurricane Dorian is the largest hurricane to ever hit the Bahamas as a catastrophic category 5 storm with sustained winds of over 185 mph. Our Relief Team has been in the Bahamas since before the hurricane hit and is ready to provide meals to those impacted as soon as the storm passes. Additionally, we have teams and kitchens prepared to serve meals in Florida as the trajectory of the hurricane is still uncertain.

title: Kenyan Women Infected and Affected by HIV
description: Kenya has been experiencing rapid population growth and more than 34,000 women live with HIV. This project will prepare and equip up to 60 women living with HIV/AIDS in the Kisumu City slums to become more economically independent, self-reliant, develop positive self-esteem, and reduce financial vulnerabilities. This project will provide women and their families with a Women Center to learn new technical and entrepreneurial skills for the purpose of launching viable microenterprises.

title: Help protect the Amazon forest - Emergency Fund
description: Spikes in fire outbreaks in the Amazon are often related to increased deforestation. The Amazonian municipality of Apui, at the border of the so-called "deforestation belt", has had four times as many fire outbreaks compared to the same time last year. While they have a small local fire brigade, it lacks proper funding. WeForest has now started an Emergency Fund with local conservation and sustainable development NGO Idesam. This fund will invest in fire prevention and firefighting in Apui.

title: Help Animals affected by Hurricane Dorian
description: Baark! will be working in collaboration with other organizations to do what we can to assist animals (pets and strays) affected by Hurricane Dorian.  Whether it is sending food and supplies to the affected areas or helping to feed and care for rescued animals that are transported to Nassau.    We are located in New Providence.    Any donations you send will go directly to help animals.

title: Create a mandala mural for CILA's kids
description: Linda Laino believes in art's ability to connect people from different cultures, economic statuses, languages and experiences. She created The Mandala Project as a way to bring art to those who may not have exposure to it on a daily basis. Linda is seeking partners who would like to help fund an original mandala mural for Centro Infantil de los Angeles, a non-profit daycare and preschool that provides free childcare for low-income families and single mothers in San Miguel de Allende.

title: Hurricane Dorian Rescue & Relief
description: The US Veterans Hall of Fame natural disaster response team is ready to deploy to the east coast region between Savannah, GA and north towards Cape Hatteras (North Carolina).  These are familiar grounds for us as just one year ago, we were boots on the ground for our operations with Hurricane Florence. Now our neighbors need us again as storm surges of 4-7 ft are expected, with the potential for even higher flood walls.  We are going in with low water rescue capability to evacuate citizens.

title: Mentoring Program for at Risk Kids
description: Mentorship program for kids ages 8-18. Teaching basic life skills, the value of education, quality life-choices, and how to create a thriving future.

title: Hurricane Dorian Emergency Support
description: Hurricane Dorian lashed the Bahamas with winds of up to 295 km/hr, starting on 2 September 2019. Within three days, IsraAID deployed an emergency response team to the Bahamas to provide urgent humanitarian aid for affected communities. The team is working both in Grand Bahama, which was hit directly by the storm, and in shelters in the capital Nassau to distribute relief items,  provide psychosocial support and child protection activities, and Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) solutions.

title: Help Street Girls in DR Congo
description: Street Girls in Congo are vulnerable to sexual exploitation, violence and addiction, and are often invisible on the streets. The Kimbilio projects offers on the street support to approximately 35 girls a week and provides a loving home for up to 24 street girls. If and when it is safe to do so Kimbilio will try to reunite each girl with her family.

title: The Long Way Up - Nici's hike for Conservation
description: Hi, I'm Nici, a young at heart and a bit crazy, german girl living the bush life in South Africa. I'm the Operations Manager at African Impact in the beautiful Greater Kruger Region and I'm about to hike up the highest mountain in Africa, Mount Kilimanjaro, 5,895 meters above sea level to raise vital funds to protect the majestic animals surrounding our home. It will take me 8 days to hike to the summit conquering changing altitudes and icy temperatures.

title: Distributing Medication to Prevent Blindness
description: Trachoma, a bacterial infection of the eye which can cause blindness which affects many people in impoverished regions. It is most common in children. However, there is an inexpensive antibiotic available that is effective in preventing and treating the disease.

title: Partnering With You to Prevent Suicide
description: The Center for Health & Learning (CHL) has been a dedicated provider of suicide prevention and public health education programs for 25 years. With the VT Suicide Prevention Center, CHL has been integrally involved in preventing suicide across multiple settings. CHL also developed Umatter, connecting schools and communities with practices that save lives and promote institutional knowledge -- helping care providers, educational leaders, young adults, and professionals prevent suicide.

title: Joy In Every Bundle
description: Support The Food Bank Singapore's Bundle Campaign where we bring Joy In Every Bundle! We believe that a better life starts with eating better. Beside just filling tummies, we want to fill their tummies with better food so that our beneficiaries can perform better at work, at school and in turn create better lives for themselves.

title: Help Babies in the Bahamas
description: Hurricane Dorian has devastated the Bahamas. This fund provides basic hygiene necessities (diapers & period products) at no cost survivors of Hurricane Dorian in the Bahamas. Diapers and period products are overlooked, yet crucial basic need. With your support, we can distribute hope and dignity to people in their time of need.

title: Love, food, education for 100 children in Bogota
description: Children in Patio Bonito face a context of poverty, drug addiction, malnutrition, crime and poor educational quality. The Fundacion PT develops methodologies based on affection, friendship and respect. Through this work children strengthen their confidence. Our strategies are art, culture, school permanence and healthy and nutritious food. With your support we will improve the quality of life of 100 children and their families to receive training, food, affection.

title: Giving ALAS to children born with immunodeficiency
description: Out of 100 children born without immune system each year, 70 will die before five years old due to lack of medical diagnostic. Primary Immunodeficiencies led to serious infections in children, like pneumonias, and first contact medical personnel cannot identify the cause. This project will give training to 5000 medical doctors in 8 countries in Latin America to allow them to identify these diseases early in time giving children the opportunity and hope to survive with adequate treatment.

title: Support Indigenous Tharu Museum in western Nepal
description: Tharu are an ethnic group indigenous to the Terai - the southern foothills of the Himalayas in Nepal. History of tharu living in the area about five thousand years old but  society slowly modernizing and adopting western and European culture. Ancient tharu culture and tradition disappearing everyday therefore to preserve and promote indigenous culture tharu museum has been establish where tharu women have been selling tharu dresses, ornaments and ancient materials for their income.

title: Help vulnerable children go to SAMaritan Schools!
description: SAM - The Samaritan Day Care & Kindergarten and  SPS - the Samaritan Primary School are modern early learning centres for vulnerable and underprivileged children aged 6 months to 12 years on our campus. We develop each child's early educational and social skills within a  healthy and stimulating environment in our purpose built facilities. Their parents - often vulnerable young single mothers - are given support whilst we educate and care for their child. Our motto is "From Hopeless to Hopeful."

title: Education, Food and home for Orphan Children-INDIA
description: GRACE CARE is non-profit, non-government, fully charitable organization working with special focus on helping 'Children in Need'. Repeated surveys by UNICEF, WHO and all major media statistics places India on top when it comes to child mortality rate.  Every Child have opportunity to learn in a friendly, constructive and progressive learning environment to assure the best and bright future of each child.

title: Help us keep Zanzibar's only music academy open!
description: This is an urgent call to keep our doors open and the music flowing at Dhow Countries Music Academy, Zanzibar's one and only music school in historic Stone Town. The DCMA faces the most critical moment in its 17-year history. We need to raise $70,000 in 2020 to sustain our award-winning music programs, classes and concerts. Over 80 dedicated students and 19 teachers now depend on your support. Without you, the soulful sounds that make these islands sing may cease.

title: Peace Education for Colombian children
description: Inequality and acts of direct violence present in much of Colombia increase in territories with fewer economic resources. In these places, children are constantly exposed to scenes of violence, micro-trafficking and other activities that put them at risk. For 10 years, TECHO Colombia's peace education program has worked with approximately 260 children and adolescents a year, who live in poverty, providing analytical skills so that they can discern and make decisions about their reality.

title: New toilets at a primary school in rural Kenya.
description: It is estimated that over 620 million children worldwide, many of them in sub-Saharan Africa, do not have access to basic sanitation services in school. We are investing in brand new sanitation facilities at Kisimenyi Primary School which will include VIP latrines and urinals, a girls' washroom and, for the first time at the school, proper hand-washing facilities.

title: The Armed Rangers of Ol Pejeta
description: Ol Pejeta's armed rangers are the untold heroes of conservation. Every day and every night, these incredible heroes, who keep our rhinos and other wildlife safe, put their lives on the line. It is not easy to be a ranger. It requires stamina, courage and commitment. And it also requires a lot of resources and training to keep them properly equipped and safe. Today we ask that you help these brave men by contributing to their safety and well-being.

title: Support Children Impacted by Hurricane Dorian
description: UNICEF is working to ensure the safety of the 18,000 children and their families whose lives have been impacted by Hurricane Dorian. UNICEF's immediate humanitarian targets for the children of the Bahamas will focus on access to safe water, creation of child-friendly learning spaces, provision of psycho-social support  and support for infant feeding programs.

title: Ensuring children have adults they can trust
description: This project will provide support to homeless children and young people and children in prisons across Mombasa.

title: Rescue/Vet/Transport/Adopt 200 Street Dogs from PR
description: This project will focus on the tremendous number of street dogs in Puerto Rico, particularly in the poorest sections of Toa Baja Beach, Vega Baja and Vega Alta. We will focus on this area to pull our goal of at least 200 street dogs suffering from neglect, abuse and abandonment, get complete veterinary care, transport to our facility in NY and find adoptive homes.

title: Rehabilitation of 500 homeless abandoned
description: Shree Amrutvahini Gramvikas Mandal is a voluntary organization dedicatedly working for the rehabilitation of homeless abandoned roadside mentally ill patients in Ahmednagar District of Maharashtra, India.  We have 45 patients in our Manavseva Project and around 2500 have been successfully reunited with their families so far. We are providing shelter, food, cloths and treatment as soon as complete the treatment we find out their families and rehabilitate them in their family.

title: MMW 10-Year Anniversary $10,000 Goal
description: This year Mindful Medicine Worldwide celebrates our 10 year Anniversary. With your help, 52 volunteers have given over 85,000 treatments to high need patients  in and around the Kathmandu valley of Nepal. With you, we experienced the shocking effects of the 2015 earthquake and you rallied to bring immediate relief in the form of housing, medical care, and a new clinic. Help us to make the next decade as successful as this one, raise $20,000 by 2020 and to treat another 100,000 people in need.

title: North Karnataka (India) Flood Relief Effort - 2019
description: Much like a boxer in a ring, Karnataka is continuously receiving blows one after the other from its opponent, i.e. the incessant rains. Despite being knocked down repeatedly, it tries to get back on its feet again.  1.2M people left their homes. While few lost their lives, few have gone missing.  Hectares of land in lakhs are damaged.  Dreams of children are shattered.   Are you ready a lend a helping hand to our bloodied fighter? Every life matters; every help counts. Be their help

title: SUPPORT CHILDREN WITH AUTISM IN MOMBASA USING ARTS
description: Sheilah Sheldone Arts for Social Change CBO was founded by community members in Mombasa county to support the dreams of a child prodigy, Sheilah Sheldone Charles to impact on the lives of children suffering from neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs) in her community through her creative work involving painting. Neurodevelopmental disorders include; autism spectrum disorders, down syndrome, as well as cerebral palsy. Sheilah is 10 years old. She is a great painter, a model, a poet, and a designer.

title: Educate and House a Child for Three Years
description: Supporting Children Initiative Foundation M.B.I. Nepal is a small orphanage in Kathmandu  - the capital of Nepal. A non-profit social organization, we house 14 orphans Our orphans are cared for by a house manager and 3 staff members, who earn minimal wages and help with the children, tutoring, cooking, and cleaning.Our dreams and goals for these children is to put them through University, so that they can get a decent job, and maybe even migrate in the future and help more children.

title: Foodprint
description: Foodprint aims at providing free and healthy meals to children and youngsters in need whom visit the open accessible houses of Habbekrats. Next to food and other basic needs, these houses are full of colour, warmth and inspirational people and projects. By investing in the youth on a daily basis, we believe they will grow to become worthy citizens whom in their turn, leave a positive footprint on our society and future.

title: Save a 10 acre Tropical Rainforest in Sri Lanka
description: Through this project, "Rainforest Protectors Trust" of Sri Lanka will purchase and permanently protect a privately-held pristine tropical rainforest currently on sale and in danger of being clearcut, bordering the Sinharaja UNESCO Biosphere Reserve/World Heritage Rainforest. Spanning 10 acres with crystal clear water river frontage, this land provides habitat to many endangered and endemic species, and is crucial for protecting the biodiversity of Sinharaja, our last viable primary rainforest.

title: Save Abandoned Cows from painful death in Gujarat.
description: The project is to promote scientific rehabilitation and will motivate the community people (both rural and urban) to save these homeless abandon stray cows for sustainable Agriculture, Health & Nutrition and environment. It save cows from various zoonotic diseases such as anthrax, brucellosis, tuberculosis by vaccinating them and  will improving public awareness on cow care management.

title: SEND A SEED WOMEN'S PROJECT KABALE UGANDA
description: Send a Seed Women's project in Kabale Uganda is a women's Project in Kabale Uganda aimed at sustaining the indigenous good seeds and utilizing seeds  not only as food sources but also for income for the families of the women involved.Also natural farmyard manure,compost manure and other forms of organic manure are used and not artificial manure to increase soil fertility.

title: Education support for 120 disabled Children in Eth
description: This project is aimed to provide special need education materials, school feeding, life skill training and personal hygiene training to children with different types of disabilities. Moreover, the charity will provide awareness enhancement training to community members about persons with disabilities. The project also provides sign language and braille training to special need teachers functioning in the project area.

title: Improving lives of vulnerable families in Chiapas
description: This project seeks to contribute to local development of families of the Tzeltal-Tzotzil Cooperative, a group of women and men from Pantelho, Chiapas, dedicated to the production of organic coffee and honey and the elaboration of handmade textiles. Through the strengthening of its production and commercialization processes, developing capacities and including and promoting the participation of women and young people.

title: Aviation Education 4 Kids
description: Youth Inspiration Nation's mission is to provide motivation, inspiration and education through aviation.  We teach kids the fundamentals of flight, the science behind keeping an aircraft in the air, the recognition of distinct types of weather phenomenon, test their skills with building activities, and actually teach them how to fly in static and full motion flight simulators. Aviation education improves focus, builds self-confidence and exposes kids to a multitude of STEM related professions.

title: Ensure care and dignity to the 20 destitute
description: Ensure access of 20 (Twenty) poor helpless and destitute and Old Aged persons in Mandya, to safe accommodation, tender love, proper care, nourishment,  health service and other basic needs through establishment and operation of a sustainable destitute centre.

title: P.A.P.I. Childs Patient Support Program
description: This project seeks to guarantee access to specialized medical care for low-income patients, residents of the city of Tijuana, Baja California, Mexico, through the PAPI assistance fund, aimed at offering financial support to families who cannot cover the recovery fee, for the payment of pediatric consultations and / or subspecialty of your child.This project will provide health services for 200 economically vulnerable children and youth in the region of Baja California.

title: Educate and Empower Poor Children living with ADHD
description: Our fund raising campaign aimed at creating awareness and building a school for learners diagnosed with learning disorders specifically ADD/ADHD living in Johannesburg ghettos. Our ghettos have a large number of poor households where parents cannot afford private schooling for their children with learning disorders and the State provided schools have 45 or more children per class due to overcrowding and children with learning disabilities need classes with smaller numbers

title: Connectivity for Hurricane Dorian first responders
description: Communication among those organizations and individuals responding to Hurricane Dorian was critical for saving lives and restoring normalcy. After Dorian wiped out the Bahamas communications and internet infrastructure, it was impossible for first responders to communicate and direct rescue and recovery efforts. NetHope, a consortium of global nonprofits and tech companies, stepped in to provide the powerline of internet and communications technology to get responders where they needed to be.

title: Economic initiatives for 200 indigenous women
description: Solidarity and inclusive economic initiatives for 200 indigenous women of the Lacandon Jungle in Chiapas. The main objective is to mitigate the poverty of the participating women in a considerable way and, within the communities, creating visibility and independence for these women, providing them useful knowlegde. Xilotl will contribute to their empowerment and training for their individual and collective growth. Their families as well as members of the community will be indirectly benefit.

title: Appeal for those affected in Mindanao Earthquake
description: The Philippine Red Cross aims to continue our goals in supporting the most vulnerable - those affected by the recent quakes in Mindanao. 75,000 families are displaced and residing under temporary shelters.  Help us help them! We need your support now!  #MindaNOW

title: Transform The Life Of Homeless People In Venezuela
description: Through the Panabus Program we provide necessary attention to 2,400 homeless people a year, dignifying them as human beings and promoting their social reintegration. We make this possible through especially equipped transportation units, and a specialized team that provides to each individual fundamental primary services such as shower, wc, handbasin, clean cloth, haircut, healthcare, nutrition and supports them through their rehab process towards their social reintegration and family union.

title: Ayapel garbage-free. Recycling & swamp protection
description: Environmental and visual pollution, caused by poor disposal of solid waste, is a problem in Ayapel, where Colombia's second most important wetland is located. Unfortunately, the absence of a recycling and waste disposal culture resulted in most waste ending up on the streets or finding its way into the sensitive wetland. CorpoAyapel implements an innovative social, economic and environmental model for recycling solid waste and preventing further degradation of the ecosystem.

title: ISKCON YOUTH FORUM - IYF VOICE BACE INDIA
description: This project by ISKCON is to support young needy students in India with education, food etc. The project aims at supporting students by providing Nutritious food, Academic Scholarships & Education for Skill Development and Positive Value Development to empower these youths with a better character and skill set to flourish individually and socially. We protect these youths from Stress and Addiction by providing them a positive culture of love and care with our Hostel Facilities.

title: Fighting Malnutrition in 10 Villages of Nyanza
description: Our project will support 1,000 vulnerable families in 10 villages of Nyanza District, Rwanda.  Each family will receive training plus 2 fruit and 10 banana trees, 2 laying hens and manure for 1 kitchen vegetable garden. A children's program will be provided every Saturday. Your support will help to alleviate hunger, malnutrition, poverty and unemployment.  98% of the families have no other source of income. Improved agricultural practices will be taught therefore, increasing food production.

title: Mobile science laboratory for remote rural areas
description: Through this project, volunteers from different geographical locations will help set up science and electronics laboratory classrooms in a remote rural and disadvantaged community in the northern part of Romania. All volunteer activities will consist of live online video conference, hands-on experiments, and will be focused on explaining the basics of using the Internet of Things platform and electronic components to about 30 high school students and 4 local engaged volunteers.

title: Down syndrome training for parents in Rwanda
description: This project will enable the Rwanda Down Syndrome Organisation (RDSO) to train family members and teachers in Rwanda to support the development of children with Down syndrome. This project has two parts:  1. An intensive 'training of trainers' workshop run by DSi in Kigali to train RDSO staff and volunteers to become early development trainers;  2. Training workshops run by RDSO for teachers and parents on how best to support children with Down syndrome in their early development.

title: A Space4all
description: CHANCE4ALL needs your help to sustain Space4all its multipurpose space in the heart of Bauleni, Zambia.  SPACE4ALL welcomes students to meet with tutors and mentors, to study, and to access computers and the nutrition program. It also serves as a space for education and community events. This space is more than just a building - it is another tool CHANCE4ALL and the whole community uses to support vulnerable children who are not able to afford the quality education they deserve.

title: Help victims of Hurricane Dorian on Grand Bahama
description: This disaster relief fund will support people impacted by Hurricane Dorian in the form of emergency supplies like food, water, clothing, personal hygiene, and medicine in addition to longer-term recovery assistance to help residents recover and rebuild. All donations to this fund will exclusively support relief and recovery efforts in Sweetings Cay, Grand Bahama which was completely  destroyed by this storm.

title: More Vocational Options through new Building
description: For 20 years, Tamar Center has offered hope, healing and a new life to the prostitutes in Pattaya, Thailand. Our future vision is to reach bar girls and their children through opening a guest house and adding 6 more vocational training options centered on the hospitality industry.  We will also create an expanded counseling center, to offer services to women, their children and the Pattaya community. On the 3rd of September we purchased the building and started renovations! Update doc attached.

title: INTERGRATED INTERVENTION PROGRAM FOR  ORPHANS{OVC}
description: Orphans and most vulnerable children (OVC)   have increased substantially over the last four years  in Kenya with Nyanza project ( area of this project) taking lead. Among orphans, 15% are double orphans.  Generally, orphans and most vulnerable children (O.V.C) face special challenges: rejection, lack of basic facilities, psycho socia torture, loneliness and hopelessness. Special attention therefore should be paid to OVC to prevent further vulnerability and ensure their well-being and developmen

title: One child one book  8000 schl children rural Kenya
description: We provide books to deprived school children promote Reading and  social/ ethical values in an environment where behavioral role models are lacking. Many children in the rural areas have restricted access to books.  Hardly does one find a child that has a book to call its own.  Even among educated Kenyans the habit of book reading barely exists so gaining knowledge after education ceases. Acquiring the reading habit will encourage these children to continue educating themselves after schooling.

title: Help Good360 Ship Requested Product to The Bahamas
description: Good360 seeks funding to ship desperately needed products to nonprofits working on Hurricane Dorian recovery in the Bahamas. Our partners are assisting communities in the early stages of recovery, but they have many unmet product needs. With your funding, Good360 can ship products donated by our corporate donors, like Soap, Personal Hygiene, Diapers, Wipes, Socks, Underwear, Flashlights, Earplugs, and Cleaning Products. Good360 has these products, we just need help covering the cost of shipping.

title: Supporting of the Children Working on the Street
description: There are many children working on the street without any parental care and they have no viable alternatives. Our project aims to solve this issue through financial support for parents. We want to detect children whose families are in need and provide assistance to them in order to make sure that they send their children to school in return. Parents do not see the value of education, either because it is not seen relevant to their lives or it is an obstacle to make money.

title: Giving milk to poor children with critical illness
description: The project aims to address the malnutrition and micro-nutrient deficiencies of poor children with critical illnesses, which are preventing children from achieving good results in treating or even killing children. Every two weeks, the project will donate fresh milk glasses to poor pediatric patients at National Cancel Hospital, Vietnam.  In addition, the project will also raise public awareness about nutrition care and spread the values of love and share with vulnerable children.

title: Training of Informal School Teachers
description: Over 2 years, we aim to conduct inset training with teachers from the Informal Schools that exist in the informal "slum settlements. Having been teaching 6th Form students on Zoom over the past 3 years we realised that their teachers were attending our lessons too. We are now conducting Insets in Maths, Physics, Chemistry and English on Saturdays purely for the benefit of the teachers. We will be continuing the cycle term by term and will continue to do so each term over the next 2 years.

title: Provide healthy learning space for kids
description: Technical high school in Vladicin Han is one of few that offers quality education and development of technical skills for students in Southern Serbia. It has programs for electrical, mechanical and transport engineering which provides kids with knowledge easily applicable in business sector and helps with their employment.  Students are very successful on competitions and currently holds second place in robotics in the region. School has good results on keeping Roma kids finalize their education

title: Eight years' of water filtration for Guatemala.
description: Vida Para Todos Guatemala will provide 150 water filters to three villages in Guatemala. Only 15% of the water distributed throughout the country is potable.  Three million people lack public water. The water filters that we will provide (we have provided 188 filters to date) use the same technology as dialysis machines and can be back- washed. This gives them a life of  eight (8) years. Proper water filtration easily prevents water-borne diseases such as cholera, dysentery and intestinal worms.

title: Improve Response to Child Abuse in the Arctic
description: The Umingmak Centre provides best intervention for children and youth in Nunavut who have experienced abuse. It does this by 1) increasing access to good quality services 2) strengthening coping skills and knowledge 3) reducing the secondary trauma of an investigation 4) improving inter-agency coordination 5) strengthening skills and knowledge in professionals working with children and youth 6) improved collection of evidence

title: Saving lives with diagnosis on time
description: This project favors the access to an opportune attention for cancer on children and adults in Colombia. It is focused on the acquisition of better equipment that allow to have an anticipated diagnosis and, in that way, bring a better possibility for patients to survive against cancerous and precancerous lesions. The project also will help to pay the devices that make easier the proper attention for pediatric and adult patients

title: "Help Me Find a Forever Home"-Fundraising Program
description: Origin  The Child Welfare League Foundation has developed the adoption and adoptee services since 1992. For more than 20 years, the Foundation has helped many abandoned children or adoptees to find a new home or family. - Service Target: Those commissioning the Foundation to assist with finding suitable homes or families for adoptee children who are forced to leave their birth family for reasons such as underage child birth, financial difficulties or major change in the family.

title: Empower Girls from Mumbai's Red Light Area
description: Kranti (Revolution in Hindi) empowers girls from Mumbai's red-light areas (Revolutionaries) to become agents of social change. We provide a healing home, healthcare and psychotherapy, formal and extracurricular education, leadership training and the skills to solve social problems. At Kranti, we believe empowerment should not just lead to a salary - it should lead to a voice - because every Revolutionary has the power to be a leader for herself and her community!

title: Kick out child sexual violence - Namuwongo slum
description: This project will create awareness of the crisis of defilement among 1800 children;  600 caregivers (home to home model), 130 local leaders and distribute 600 rape whistles to each home to reduce the vice. In Need Home plans to create and empower 15 Child protection committees in the slums who will work with civil leaders to reduce defilement. Through this project, sexual violence survivors will be provided with support for medical and psychological recovery and aided with litigation services.

title: Support 500 Kosovo Youth Learn by Volunteering
description: This project trains and mentors 50+ teachers and youth workers from all over Kosovo to lead 25+ volunteering groups with 20+ youth participants each.   These groups design and implement Service Learning projects in their community, leaving a permanent positive impact for thousands of beneficiaries.  Service Learning projects are directed towards the improvement of a community, which also help volunteers develop skills that increase their chance of future employment.

title: Save the lives of animals in our Nation's shelters
description: Every day, more than 1,700 dogs and cats are killed in our nation's shelters because they don't have safe places to call home. But people like you are changing that.  Animal shelters, local stakeholders, lifesaving groups, and individual community members are working together to take collective responsibility for at-risk pets right where they live. Together, we can create compassionate no-kill communities nationwide for pets and the people who care for them.

title: Eradicate Female Genital Mutilation in Kenya
description: Last Mile4D was established in 2014 and focuses on projects for women's and girls' rights-to-health, safety and freedom from gender-based violence. This project will eradicate female genital mutilation (FGM) in Western Kenya by providing ongoing educational workshops for 1,000 girls, parents and community elders on the harmful effect of FGM. Trained community workers will use VPack to register girls ages of 9-15 in schools and will provide them with real time intervention to safety and shelter.

title: Give immigrant kids a future with education
description: Chungbuk Multicultural Family Support Center's vision is to provide a school for kids, regardless of culture or background, and help them on their feet and lead them on the road to success. By extending a helping hand to those in desperate need by giving them new hope and a foundation for their lives, we plan on building a new school to provide troubled mid-entry immigrant children who cannot attend public schools with the support and education they need to establish a secure life in Korea.

title: SAVE NEWBORNS ABANDONED IN NAIROBI KENYA SLUMS
description: No child deserves to be abandoned. Every child needs a family and every child needs a home. Help Home of Hope Kenya rescue, care and place every child abandoned in Nairobi slums, streets, garbage, and hospitals into an adopting family, Foster family, reintegrate the child or create a family unit of eight children cared for by a loving couple. Your support gives these children, a place to call home and a family, food, clothing, medical care, education as well as support the caring staff.

title: Nutritional Food & Health Care for 200 Children
description: Providing  Nutritional Food and Health Care Support for Remote Tribal and Poor children in western gate of palani Kodaikanal Hills.

title: Build Somo's Kisumu Hub!
description: Somo's first cohort in Kisumu launched in August!  This cohort will graduate in November and we will be making our first investments in January of 2020. In order to prepare for onboarding these newest members of our Acceleration program we will be launching our Kisumu Hub. We have secured land in one of the informal settlements we work in, Nyalenda. Now we need to build the space! If you would like to help us build please contribute to our crowdfunding campaign.

title: Rescue project for 900 dogs & cats in Accra.
description: Sancore Animal Rescue and Shelter, based in the Greater Accra Region of Ghana, helps abused, Injured, hungry and stray dogs and cats, who would otherwise be trapped, euthanized, poisoned or eaten, by rescuing and rehoming them. Most of these rescued dogs and cats come to us wounded, abused, or neglected, or are very ill. We have cared for about 400 cats and 500 dogs last year, incurring veterinary care and feeding bills of $7,500-$17,500. We are the first animal rescue NGO in Ghana.

title: Time Sensitive: Ending Human/Elephant Conflicts
description: Not only is poaching a serious problem threatening the future of elephants, but the rise in human-elephant conflict is increasing the peril elephants face. If we don't act quickly, Myanmar's elephants could face cruelty or death, and countless humans could lose their livelihoods, their homes, and their lives by human-elephant conflicts.

title: CONSTRUCTION OF TWENTY FOUR ULTRA MODERN LIBRARIES
description: This Project is aimed at constructing two ultra modern libraries in each region in Ghana.

title: FOUR PAWS
description: FOUR PAWS is the global animal welfare organisation for animals under human influence, which reveals suffering, rescues animals in need and protects them. Our vision is a world in which humans treat animals with respect, empathy and understanding.

title: Rescue 75 Second Hand Dogs from the Deep South
description: This project will save 75 adoptable dogs each month from high kill shelters being euthanized for space. These highly adoptable "second hand dogs" make "first rate pets" for thousands of families in the US. Paws New England helps to rescue, rehabilitate and rehome these dogs into New England families.

title: A Promising Future for Children In Medellin
description: Preventive program  aimed at children and teenagers in Medellin who are between 8 and 18 years old.  They are under psychosocial risk due to a low sense of life, almost no motivation, limited opportunities for personal growth, children of single parents heads of household living under precarious socio-economic situations. We strive to motivate them to plan their life project and reduce the risks that limit their personal development.

title: Veterinarian Volunteers Housing
description: Combined Animal Rescue Endeavour (CARE) is a non-profit organisation dedicated in rescuing and rehabilitating stray and abandoned animals, which aims to promote the Animal Welfare Act of 1966 (RA No. 8485) that has yet to be recognised by the public. The law was established to protect and promote the welfare of all animals in the Philippines.

title: ECHO HUB Athens: Prepare Refugees for Integration
description: In September 2019 we opened our second ECHO HUB, this time in Athens. Given the constant flux of refugees and countless relocations from the islands to the mainland, we recognised the importance of expanding our services and operations to Athens.  Not only does it allow refugees to continue their studies despite relocation, but it also offers a sense of community and support during times of distress and uncertainty.

title: Empower, educate, and protect young Thai mothers
