description: For almost 10 years, The Light Center's mission has been to give hope and support to vulnerable pregnant women, to provide foster care for children waiting to be adopted, and to protect and restore victims of sexual abuse.  Our vision is to support strong and healthy families in Thai society. Mother's who can raise their own children. Foster children who live in safe and loving families. Justice and a new future for sexual abuse victims.

title: Thailand Foster Care Transition Homes
description: In the past decade, orphanages have increased by 500% in SE Asia but the number of orphans has decreased. Why? In Thailand, mainly because of poverty. Help us support reintegration of children from orphanages to families by supporting family-based transition homes. This program will provide support to the Thai social welfare system as they do not yet have a budget or staff to address this issue.

title: Help Venezuelans with digital and media literacy
description: In times of crisis, information saves life. Venezuelas coming to Colombia need the right digital skills to access and discern information that can help them improve their living conditions. MAKAIA has studied the situation from the information point of view and found that most Venezuelans in Medelin don't know where and how to access social services such as health, education, housing and food. Information is available but they don't have the have the time, resources or knowledge to access it.

title: Male participation in reducing early marriages
description: The project will enhance male participation in the fight against early, forced marriages in the rural areas of Masaiti District of Zambia; by engaging and dialoguing with 310 men and boys, formation of Men/Boys Take Action (MBTA) groups; addressing negative factors that exacerbate child marriages including community acceptance of early marriages, tradition and cultural norms that undermine girl's abilities to make decisions on their reproductive, education and health rights in rural areas.

title: Enable 50 Women in Angola to Generate Income
description: Among fistula patients at our partner hospital in Lubango, Angola, there is a need for a longer term approach to restoration and rehabilitation into community. Their post-operative recovery period has been used productively to train in language and literacy/numeracy, sewing, and craft-making, such as baskets, greeting cards and bags. Your donation funds these important transitional skills, which enable our sisters to earn an income and empowers them to regain their place in their culture.

title: Reintegrate 50 IDPs with Disabilities in Cameroon
description: REWAC plans to provide free mobility aids to  fifty (50) internally displaced persons with disabilities, victims of armed conflict, who hail from the most remote and poverty stricken areas of the North West Region in Cameroon, to lend them  support to enjoy freedom and independence  as they undertake financially independent ventures for poverty alleviation in their homesteads.

title: Mobile Library (Kitab Gari)
description: This project will multiply mobile libraries for improving reading habits through interactive learning in the urban slums of Lahore/Karachi. Target groups include the most marginalized children found in: streets- orphanages- with disabilities-public parks and from garbage picking communities, with special focus on girls. Approximately 9000-10000 beneficiaries will benefit from this outreach project annually. This is a high impact low cost model for the most vulnerable.

title: A Vibrant Space for Arts to Thrive in Tanzania
description: Nafasi Art Space is Tanzania's most vibrant & vital independent art space, providing artist studios and mentorship, trainings for young artists, curators and arts managers, and creating platforms for artists to reach the public. The goal of Nafasi is to protect & strengthen cultural rights, such as freedom of expression and equitable access to cultural experiences. Thanks to you, we raised nearly $24,000 in 2020-22 to survive difficult times. We're now extending our goal to reach new heights!

title: Save a community in Nairobi from hunger & disease
description: 144,000 Nairobi slum city dwellers live under the mercy of environmental mess. Majority live in deplorable conditions due to lack of clean drinking water, littered neighbourhoods with garbage all over and disease rampages majority of them due to poor living conditions. Urgent Interventions are needed to curb this disaster. Little children are affected most.

title: Support foster parents and adopters in Russia
description: Project gives foster parents and adopters support of specialists, when they need them. We provide online consulting of psychologists, laywers and other specialists for thousands of parents all over the Russia, and service of babysitters in Moscow region.

title: Women's Empowerment in the groupment of Kaniola.
description: In the eastern part of the DRC, ravaged by repeated wars, particularly Walungu and Kalehe territories, women have endured decades of misdeeds and live in increased marginalization and poverty, and have difficulties to meet their family's needs when they have become the first to be responsible for the context of their lives. Victims of a non-protective environment, young people and women become vulnerable to abuse, exploitation and other violations of their rights.

title: Teach Technology to Vulnerable Children
description: This project will provide education in technology to 100 at risk adolescents,  especially girls, who receive health services, meals and education from Casa Esperanza, a non-profit organization that provides educational alternatives to children and teenagers in extreme poverty conditions. The project will introduce girls and boys to digital concepts and resources that will help them in their school and life activities and future jobs.

title: Provide Vocational Training for 10 Ugandan Women
description: This project will provide employment and vocational training in artisan crafts for 10 women in northern Uganda, where poverty is extreme and opportunities are few. By creating opportunities to earn supplemental income for their families, the women are then able to pay children's school fees, provide adequate nutrition, and keep their families together. The ripple effects of providing training for women are endless and positively impact future generations.

title: Water for Life (Kampong Speu)
description: Water For Life (Kampong Speu) is a project initiated and managed by the Sao Sary Foundation.  The objective of Water For Life is to provide over 8,400 Cambodian villagers with convenient access to clean drinking water through the installation of 1,400 bio-sand water filters in rural households over three years.

title: Earthquake relief fund for Pakistan
description: Thousands of people affected and are still vulnerable by the deadly earth quake in Azad Kashmir Pakistan. The earth quake has killed 33  people and left nearly  1000 injured with  damaged houses. Donations will  provide relief to survivors in the form of supplies like food, shelter,  water, and medicine in addition to longer-term recovery assistance to help residents recover and rebuild.The donations to the project will support  relief and recovery efforts throughout the region.

title: Team with disabilities in the Culinary Olympics
description: The Culinary Olympics has been going since 1900 - this is the First time ever that a Team with Disabilities will be taking part.  We are arranging various fundraising opportunities locally, between now and the Culinary Olympics in February 2020, to raise funds towards the team training and participation.

title: Help to children with cancer in Ukraine!
description: Help raise funds for the moral and material support of families from Ukraine with seriously ill children. In order to attract young people and teenagers, as well as others who wish to do good, the SUPPORT Foundation has developed an angel statue of the Good Angel.

title: Help Sesame Street Educate Girls Worldwide
description: In more than 150 countries around the world, Sesame Workshop is reaching girls who may have no other means of education. Investing in girls' education isn't just the right thing to do; it's the smart thing to do for overall economic and social development. From India to Mexico to Afghanistan-and in many other countries-local versions of Sesame Street are teaching basic skills that are critical for both girls and boys, in a context that values women and girls and their contributions to society.

title: LLevar agua a comunidades vulnerables de Veracruz
description: This project consists on the construction of sustainable rainwater harvesting systems with a storage capacity of 19 thousand liters in the region of the High Mountains in the state of Veracruz, Mexico, which will allow the supply of water for families, improving access to water, sanitation and hygiene in girls and boys living in vulnerable communities with a very high degree of marginalization.

title: Ending Large Scale Sex Trafficking in India
description: The Safe Village Program is a unique, flagship prevention programme run by Operation Red Alert of My Choices Foundation to end sex trafficking in India. Through the programme, we have reached over 5,000 vulnerable villages in India, ensuring the safety of each person in the village. At present, The Safe Village Programs are being conducted in 8 states - Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Jharkhand, Rajasthan, Bihar and West Bengal.

title: Organic rooftops farm in Palestinian Refugee Camps
description: The social and physical environment within Palestinian camps continues to deteriorate (overcrowding, lack of green spaces, and poor living conditions,). Jafra will improve the lives of refugees by supporting organic rooftop gardening for food security and enhanced livelihoods via small production initiatives, fostering a sense of community belonging, beautification and improved air quality which will help to restore a damaged environment and in turn alleviate stress and local anxieties.

title: Protect-forests-marine-wildlife-in- the Gambia
description: This project will enhance -Ecotourism infrastructural development as livelihood options to 27000 inhabitants through employment opportunities and sustainable income.It will help provide  -Field equipment to the staffs/rangers for regular patrolling and surveillance.It will also help -Capacity building/ strengthening for the rangers to give skills to unemployed youths for employment-It will safe remaining aquatics, wildlife,forests will contribute reduce CO2 emission

title: Winter Fundraising for Charmaghz
description: As the winter nears, we are raising $5000 to fully equip the Charmaghz Mobile Libraries with a heating system so children could have a cozy environment even when it snows. We believe that nothing should stop them from learning, neither the heat nor the cold. Also, after two years of operation, our Blue Mobile Library requires renovation. So we will repaint the exterior of the bus, replace the old furniture with new ones and add more exciting books to our collection.

title: Improving Human-Wildlife Coexistence in Mola
description: Infertile land and minimal access to infrastructure has lead to competition for natural resources between humans & animals in the Mola Community, on the shores of Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba. Conflict incidences are high and compromise the future of both human & wildlife populations. This project aims to improve human-wildlife coexistence and food security by empowering communities to improve their livelihoods, whilst developing greater trust and appreciation for the presence of wildlife in the area.

title: Helped to keep 690 girls and boys in school-yemen
description: The poor conditions in Yemen had a negative impact on children, specially in the field of education In Ma,bar,Thamar,the project will help more than 690 girls and boys and protect them from the risks they may face while studying without chairs and sitting  on the ground. This atmosphere exposes children to drop out of school, especially girls. School dropout is one of the most important factors that make children work in qat farms and markets We will provide school furniture as window closures

title: Saving Asian Elephants and Protecting Livelihoods
description: In the last 75 years, 50% of the Asian elephant population has been lost. In India, conflicts between elephants and humans cause an average of 400 human and 100 elephant deaths annually. Every day, stressed and hungry herds raid crops and trample homes. To reduce the harvest of forest-based fuelwood in the project area, an important factor contributing to degradation of wildlife habitats and human-wildlife conflict, we will provide households with free LPG cookers and funding for solar lighting.

title: Make the Impassable Possible with a New Vehicle
description: ChildVoice provides psychosocial counseling and skills training to war-affected adolescent girls--often former abductees of Boko Haram and other groups--living in IDP (internally displaced persons) camps in Nigeria. We had planned on raising funds to purchase a vehicle capable of traversing washed-out roads during the rainy season. The COVID-19 pandemic and resulting hunger issues have forced us to shift our goals and purchase the best vehicle we can find for the money we have already raised.

title: Help 6,500 disadvantaged kids with free sport
description: Sport dans la Ville has built 45 sport pitches in the heart of disadvantaged neighborhoods to make sports activities available and free for all. Through that, Sport dans la Ville imparts the values of self-confidence, teamwork, dedication, leadership, entrepreneurship and hard work leading young people on the path towards a brighter future. More than 6,500 young people aged from 6 to 25 are currently involved in the programs.

title: Back to School: Sponsor Refugees in Lebanon
description: This project will provide 30 Syrian and Palestinian refugees in Lebanon with their school tuition fees, transportation fees, and school books. Back to School Campaign targets children living under the poverty line and those living in remote areas where there is no access to schools.

title: Protect Children from Sex Trafficking in Thailand
description: The HUG Project Thailand is preventing, protecting, and restoring children from sexual abuse and human trafficking.  By partnering with police, schools, communities, families, and children themselves, HUG is helping to bring JUSTICE to those who harm children sexually, and HEALING to survivors.  Founder, Boom Mosby, has been recognized by the US State Department as a Trafficking In Persons HERO (the first Thai woman to receive this honor) and by Vital Voices as a Global Human Rights Leader.

title: tcasa-project
description: This program is to improve the medical care and feeding of dogs and cats in the association. These animals were rescued from animal shelters where culling and threatened environments  was carried out. The project will focus on promoting public education on animal protection and the meaning of life.

title: Provide quality education to 200 children
description: At La Nazarena we provide comprenhensive quality education to underprivileged children in Argentina so that they can lead their own life change. La Nazarena is a center for human development aim to support educate and encourage the needy and to promote the dignity of each women and their family. We provide them with tools, inputs, resources and knowledge. Thereby, each family can develop sustainable solutions and eventually improve their quality of life.

title: Biosand filters clean 100 Bolivian families' water
description: Bolivia is facing a drinking water crisis, due to climate change. We, young people in La Paz, have been seeking solutions, so we started the Biosand Water Filter Project to help families stay healthy and well. We are mostly young women leading the project. Even though we are still often excluded from leading peace and justice work in Bolivia because of machismo, we volunteer long days to build biosand water filters for families in need. Please help us cover the cost of materials and transport!

title: PACH Vision 2020
description: We have ambitious plans for 2020 to expand our impact, empower our local partners, and ensure health care for thousands of additional Ecuadorians in need.   Our vision for #PACH2020 is to:  *Bring 20/20 vision to 20 new communities *Care for all 20 teeth of at least 200 children, and  *Provide Cervical Cancer screening to 2,020 women.  In all, we aim to treat at least 20,200 patients next year.

title: Support Community Leaders in Rural Honduras!
description: The Solidarity Project supports Honduran leaders in creating positive social change in their community.  Our Mesa Comunitaria micro-granting project cultivates and supports Honduran leaders in addressing pressing community problems. Together with the community, Honduras leaders design, select, and execute development projects.  We are unique because we support Hondurans who do not generally have access to resources, or opportunities to implement their own ideas for change in their communities.

title: Winter Necessities & Meals for Taiwanese Children
description: Bright Side Projects provides necessities and plant-based food staples pack to families and youth in need by working with local community centers, elementary schools, and the church. Packages will be distributed to 15 indigenous Atayal families in Hsinchu ChingChuan and 8 indigenous Amis families in Taitung, provide meals to children in orphanages, while over 1000 lbs of organic locally grown rice will be distributed to even more families in need.

title: Empower and educate teenage mothers in Chile
description: Join us to continue providing education to 11 teenage mothers in Chile who, despite their situation, are willing to continue studying and to achieve better future prospects by developing their self-esteem through quality education in a safe environment based on our Christian values of justice, respect and solidarity. Your donations goes towards school fees, learning materials, guidance and support for their children

title: Helping 16 low income students return to college
description: In Colombia 27% of the population lives in poverty. 44% of people earn 1 or less minimum wages, whilst 75% earn 2 or less. Yet, college graduates earn at least 3 minimum wages just as they finish school, and eventually end up earning up to 100X. So, college education is the best way for a person to get out of poverty. Yet, only 38% of students have access to higher education. 62% of families can't afford college. The Daniel Rojas Mora Foundation is looking for $50.000 to help 16 bright students.

title: EduSikh - Sponsor a sikh child's education!
description: Dharma Bharathi Mission, has partnered with Edusikh (www.edusikh.org) to help them provide scholarships to 550 Sikh students every year.   The literacy rate of Sikhs in India is less than 70% and more over less than 11% know how to read and write in Punjabi. EduSikh has started the Sikh Vidhwaan Scholarship to support the education of needy Sikh students across India.

title: Support 26 000 children with palsy in Kazakhstan
description: Every year Kasietti Zhol Fund is giving qualified and free services to 1,560 children with cerebral palsy from low-income families and orphanages to embrace the diagnosis, to learn every-day skills (walking, sitting, eating, etc), to communicate and get adapted into a society. And now, looking forward for fundraising to let those in waitlist reach their aim.

title: Small steps - Education for single mothers
description: The "Pasos Pequenitos" Day Care Center in Honduras, gives young, single parents the opportunity to complete their education. While their children are cared for in a safe and loving environment, they can finish the high school education, get an upper education or go to university.

title: Mental Health Support to 1600 pupils in Gulu,
description: The project will support 1600 Pupil in post conflict Gulu district who suffered  trauma, mental health conditions, epilepsy domestic violence during  20years of LRA war. the project will  offers psycho education, mental health sensitization, home visits, diagnostic assessments, referral, debates on mental health issues that affects pupils, talking compound/anti stigma    This will done through outreaches,  collaboration with school administration, partners in educations and  health department.

title: Do it for Mathare Foundation
description: Do it for Mathare Foundation is a fundraising campaign that targets 1,000 individuals and organizations to support our activities. Currently, we are reaching out to about 10,000 young people. Young people in Mathare slums live in poverty and are affected by crime, drug abuse, early marriages and pregnancies, radicalization and rape.   We are offering hands on solutions by not only training them in arts, media and sports but also offering life skills  so that they can be responsible citizens.

title: Help Preserve Houston's History, Culture, and Art
description: Disasters can destroy a city's historical/art landmarks and are becoming the new norm due to climate change. To protect Houston's $1.1 billion cultural economy, Houston Arts Alliance's Disaster Services program is developing an integrated support network composed of ~100 emergency managers and arts professionals. Funding will ensure that thousands of individual artists and over 150 nonprofit art/culture organizations in the Greater Houston region are ready and resilient for the next disaster.

title: Improve conditions for our sea turtle heroes
description: This project will provide better conditions for our volunteers in Pacuare beach, a key nesting area for leatherback, endangered green turtle and critically endangered hawksbill turtle in the Caribbean of Costa Rica. Our objective is to rebuild at least three of our six volunteers' dorms by the end of June 2020. We believe that better conditions in our station equals happier volunteers and better performance in the sea turtle conservation activities.

title: Educate 200 IDPs Children from Anglophone Cameroon
description: The education of an entire generation of young Cameroonians is at risk because of the anglophone conflict.This project will provide basic school supplies and  fees  with critically support services to 200 internally displaced children traumatized by the anglophone war to attend school in regions not affected by the war.This will enable the children to stay in school and study for a  future that allows them to rise out of  poverty and contribute to community development and nation building,

title: Civic Skills for 2.400 Youth in Brazil
description: Join Politique? in engaging 2.400 underprivileged youth aged 16-18yrs in developing civic skills such as leadership, public speaking and a sense of agency in their communities. We will transform train 120 teachers and school advisors inside public schools to run our Debate Clubs with our support. "I could jump over the school wall and go home. But every Thursday I don't do it so I can stay in the debate club." - says a student engaged in our Debate clubs in 2019.

title: NYABIKONI WOMEN VEGETABLE GROWERS KABALE UGANDA
description: The purpose of the project is to eliminate hunger,poverty,diseases ,illiteracy,from the community where it is being implemented. It also serves as demonstration for neighboring communities on promotion of plant food against animal food and using natural fertilizers to get good quality food safe for human consumption as well as protect the environment.

title: Creating 2,000 Jobs  for Jobless Nigerian youths
description: We are training 2,000 Nigerian youths with vocational skill and equip them with necessary tools as a mean of creating Self-reliance Jobs for teaming unemployed Nigerian youths  and women which will definitely save many life against premature death arising from criminal engagement altitude of Jobless youths in search of daily survival. .This project  is targeted at providing Vocational job acquisition for 60,000 youths  over a period of 4 years to better their future.

title: Arbat Brighter Future
description: Arbat Brighter Future offers the opportunity for a university education to young deserving syrians living in the Arbat refugee camp. This camp is located in Iraqi Kurdistan, 30km from Sulaimanyah, sheltering 10 000 refugees ( over half are under 18 years old ) who fled the horrors of the war in Syria. The project aims to finance full scholarships for a higher education at the American University of Iraq in Sulaimanyah for at least three new students every year for the next 12 years.

title: Empower Young Turkish Women to Lead
description: The Turkish Women's Initiative (TWI) offers an eight-month skills-based experiential "Sparks" leadership program. It is free to women of low and modest means, usually the first in their families to attend university. Ten years of Sparks programs have demonstrated that with confidence and leadership skills, young women can reach their career and life goals and make solid contributions to their professions, the economies of family and country and society.

title: Support 500 girls in India through football!
description: This project will support 500 at-risk girls in India through our Just For Kicks football program, focused on empowering them with confidence to become role-models and break the gender stereotypes. The program entitles students to 48 lessons, learning materials (footballs, jerseys, shoes) and participation in a football league. Today, Just For Kicks reaches 3820 at-risk children in India.  $10/- month or $120/- year can support a child. In our 100% model, 100% of your donation supports the child.

title: Help Ghanaian Children Leave the Streets
description: Future of Africa has been providing meals, healthcare, and support to hundreds of children living on the streets of Accra, Ghana since 2015. In 2019, we opened Norviwo Community Centre to provide long-term shelter, food, and a transition to school for the kids we serve. We now hope to accommodate more students at Norviwo by building onto our makeshift facility and purchasing sturdy equipment and educational tools. We seek to end streetism in Ghana by developing leaders with empathy and agency.

title: Build four libraries for Children in Sierra Leone
description: Children's Assurance Program Sierra Leone (CAP-SL) plans to establish four libraries and resource centres each in the four regions of Sierra Leone with focus of improving access to education, Information, Communication and Technology (ICT) skills for children in rural communities in Sierra Leone. These facilities will also serve as a resource centres to provide mentorship, leadership and psychosocial supports for children in the Western Area Rural District, Freetown, Sierra Leone.

title: Education for the Rag Picking Community Children
description: Introduction    The project mainly focuses on children between the age of 3-5 years of rag picker community of North East Delhi and enable the parents to get their children admitted to schools post the age of 5 years. Its aim is to provide them quality education right from early in their life and help them to attend the formal education

title: Care 2 Change, send a Student to Nursing School
description: This project will support girls from Eastern Uganda, providing an education in the nursing profession. Education is the key to breaking the cycle of poverty within families and the community as a whole. 18 young adults are currently in Nursing school, their education will impact the 200,000 community members within the district of Kaberamaido. We have already seen the students make a change by providing health care services to the community either in the hospital or home health care.

title: SUPPORT 5 ELDERLY  CAREGIVERS TO 20 HIV+CHILDREN
description: This project aims to support 5 elderly care givers looking after 20 HIV+ children. These households are both socially and economical vulnerable since the community pays less attention to their needs, yet they most often lack sources of livelihood. To make matters worse such caregivers have lost their children to HIV/AIDS! They are left with a burden of looking after orphans,(many of them are HIV positives). Caregivers in Lyantonde will be supported with clothes,bedings,utensils and small houses.

title: Land rights forever for AfroCaribbean Colombians
description: Since the 17th century, fleeing enslaved peoples brought from Africa to America, established little townships all over the Colombian Caribbean. Yet, although more than 2 centuries have gone by, these people have not received land titles. The Colombian legislation allows them to file a land solicitation procedure but it has technical requirements that they do not know about or do not have the resources to fulfill. With this crowdfunding, we will request land for over 2000 people in Bolivar- Col.

title: More Afghan Women in Business Campaign
description: We will enhance knowledge of 500 women entrepreneurs in 10 provinces of Afghanistan in the informal sector to formalize their businesses and get the benefit of formal networks and opportunities for further development of those small/home based businesses. We will deliver entrepreneurship seminars to 500 university girls in 5 provinces of Afghanistan to inspire them see entrepreneurship as an option creating jobs for themselves and others.  We will improve both group's CONNECTIVITY.

title: Educating 500 rural nursing students in Cameroon
description: Everyone should be able to access a nursing education, no matter how far away they live.  We are creating the foundations for a sustainable primary healthcare delivery system in rural Cameroon.  Neyang Health Academy Distance Learning educates the next generation of healthcare professionals where they live - in remote communities by leveraging e-Learning and Wi-Fi.  Once graduated, these new nurses will be embeded primary healthcare professionals within the communities they serve.

title: Promoting girls education through re-usable pads
description: This project will purchase materials and train teachers and girls in making re-usable pads to benefit over 2,000 vulnerable and marginalized girls from the rural and hard to reach schools ( 3 Primary& 3 Secondary) in Sironko district, in the Elgon sub-region of Uganda-Africa. Girls in upper primary  and secondary schools miss out on education when they are in their menstrual periods and this affects performance at school and sometimes leads to drop out.  This project will support girls education

title: Develop Young Agribusiness Entrepreneurs in Ghana
description: Empower passionate young entrepreneurs to create jobs in Ghana by offering hands-on entrepreneurship skills development and capacity building training. The year-long Graduate Entrepreneurs Program (GEP) offers an enabling environment for innovative graduates in agriculture to test and validate their business ideas. Selected graduates will become growth poles in rural villages to create jobs through sustainable practices that will improve the lives of other young people in their communities.

title: Lets end unemployment for 50 youths in Ikorodu
description: A giving of $10, $20, $25, $50 per person, from a cluster of twenty, ten, eight and four people, for 50 unemployed youths and women in Ikorodu, Nigeria; with this, each youth can start a textile/hat & bead craft business, printing tech, photography business, footwear production outfit, make-up art studio business, piggery farm, dressmaking outfit, cassava mill, poultry farm and fish farm etc. This is based on their vocational interest and skill acquired from our prescribed training for them.

title: GLOBALGIRL MEDIA GREECE
description: The abject failure of European governments to open safe and legal routes to refugees fleeing war, drought and violence is putting women and girls at increased risk of harrowing abuses. And yet despite the challenges, these women are finding the strength to speak out.  GLOBALGIRL MEDIA GREECE is a multimedia, interactive storytelling and leadership training project that celebrates and champions the voice of female refugees and migrants living in Athens, Greece.

title: Deepavali celebration to support their education
description: Anandha Deepavali celebration to support the Education of Children "Deepavali celebration for those who cannot aord to celebrate" has been the theme behind celebrating Anandha Deepavali for the past 21 years. The smiles on their faces are priceless! And witnessing the smiles, year on year, fills our heart with utmost satisfaction.  We bring cheerful children from 17 orphan homes under one roof and spend a day with them. This is your opportunity to join hands, and support their education.

title: Saving Girls From Female genital Mutilation/Cut.
description: Female Genital Mutilation/Cut is the worst form of gender based violence against women/girls. We advocate against FGM/C. We believe in health of our women and girls. We support SRHR of girls and women. FGM/C in Kenya is 21% we target Tharaka Community where  56% of women/girls  Undergo FGM/ C and in Nairobi where 8% of girls Undergo FGM/C. We conduct SRHR workshop in schools and villages to sensitize both men and women about dangers of FGM/C. Our advocacy against FGM/C is to end FGM/C.

title: 10 Sewing Machines for VAW Survivors
description: The Women Inspirational Development Center plans to graduate 10  women survivors of domestic violence from our vocational training in tailoring. These disenfranchised women will need sewing machine to start their small business right away so that they would be providing for themselves and their families. As a result of these they will be free from violence and oppressions that has been plaguing them

title: Super Typhoon Hagibis Relief Fund
description: Peace Winds Japan (PWJ) is providing humanitarian assistance to the victims of Typhoon Hagibis, the 19th typhoon to hit Japan in 2019. As of Oct. 15th, at least 58 people have died, 15 missing, and over 210 are injured across several prefectures. PWJ organized search-and-rescue operations and is continuously conducting needs assessments to provide the victims with what they need most.

title: Typhoon Hagibis - Emergency Response Fund
description: Civic Force is conducting search-and-rescue operations and will be providing the victims of Typhoon Hagibis with emergency relief items as they recover from the disaster. Hagibis caused widespread flooding and landslides across several prefectures as 77 rivers overflooded, displacing thousands of people from their homes. The evacuees will require immediate essential items such as food and water in addition to other needs such as bedding, clothing, and cookware.

title: School Supplies to the Children of Afghanistan
description: This project will provide school supplies to the youth in Kabul, Afghanistan who have been affected by the long lasting war that has taken away their childhood.

title: Register A Child's Birth: Help Then Access School
description: Imagine not having access to education, healthcare or any basic services just because you don't have a birth certificate. A seemingly avoidable problem but unfortunately it is an issue that is rife in Zimbabwe, particularly amongst the rural communities and orphans. A number of factors contribute to this issue and the result is that children cannot study further due to lack of education, preventing them from gaining employment and breaking the cycle of poverty. It costs $20 per child

title: Help Us Provide Access to Clean Water in Zimbabwe
description: Many African countries rely heavily on agriculture as their source of income and many families often grow their own food due to lack of income/ access to shops. These pressures can be further amplified due to the fact that water is scarce in many African countries. Innovative farming solutions such as vermi-aquaponics, allow for these critical areas to continue farming successfully even in times of extreme drought, as these systems use 10% of the amount of water that normal farming requires.

title: Lifetools for 30 adolescents of Chiapas, Mexico
description: The project will strengthen the education, nutrition and values for 30 adolescents in socioeconomic crisis in the highlands of Chiapas. We will implement life-skills workshops and tools for the beneficiaries to approach life better equipped to improve their conditions. We will promote their reintegration into school and consistent attendance.  They will receive a daily healthy snack to improve their overall nutrition. They will learn trades that will open better job opportunities than in streets

title: Syrian Kurds fleeing to Northern Iraq
description: All you have to do is turn on the TV or open the internet to see the latest tragic humanitarian crisis unfold.  Currently, hundreds of thousands of people are running for their lives as the Turkish Army starts an offensive against the Kurds of Northern Syria.  It doesn't matter what side you are on, these families need a hand-up!

title: SUPPORT TO 40 FARMERS TO FIGHT HUNGER IN SINKUNIA.
description: Sierra Leone is ranked 179 out of 188 in the Human Development Index and the third hungriest country in the world says Global Hunger Index. There are more than 6.4 million people living in Sierra Leone, 52.9 percent of who live below the national poverty line. Roughly 60 percent of the population lives in rural areas, the majority of whom rely on subsistence agriculture for their livelihoods. Malnutrition has been the greatest cause of child mortality in Sierra Leone, accounting for nearly half

title: Educate women creating stable economies globally
description: PEACE THROUGH BUSINESS(r) has been educating women entrepreneurs in Afghanistan and Rwanda for 14 years. To date, 80% of the 755 graduates are still in business and have created over 16,000 jobs for their countrymen and women. 90% of 2019 graduates pay it forward in their communities by empowering other women and young girls for a more stable and sustainable global future. PEACE THROUGH BUSINESS(r) women are excelling in all major industries; such as fashion, agribusiness, IT, and construction.

title: Samburu Girls Foundation Education Fund
description: To have a fund dedicated to the support of education and psycho-social support  to 420 deserving girls in Northern Kenya  rescued by Samburu Girls Foundation.

title: Reduction stunting of the children in Bangladesh
description: This project will create a piece of evidence to reduce the stunting of 1200 malnourished under 5 years of children in the northern & southern parts of Bangladesh, providing Nutrition Education (NE) & demonstrations of nutrient-based homemade recipes through the Mother Support Group in the community.  NE strategy will be based on the nutrition triangle model proposed by UNICEF i.e. food security, caring practices, disease control. Groups of mothers & caregivers of the children will be trained.

title: Disability Rehabilitation of 200 children in Kenya
description: The Proposed Project will address physical and health conditions and challenges associated with disability among poor children under age 12 in Busia and Siaya counties of Kenya through medical rehabilitation by reaching them through community clinics. The community outreach will provide comprehensive intervention care including Occupational Therapy, Physiotherapy and provision of assistive devices to correct the suffering of the target children and help them lead a normal and productive life.

title: Safe House for girls
description: Gender Based Violence (GBV) is one of the most persistent violations of human rights across the globe. According to the WHO, about one third of women worldwide have experienced violence.  In Kenya, a recent study found that 32% of young women aged 18-24 years  reported experiencing sexual violence before the age of 18. Gender-based violence reduces the bargaining power to negotiate safer sex, stay on treatment or remain in school. We plan to rescue these girls and give them holistic safe space.

title: Build a Kindergarten Classroom in Cape Town
description: African Impact Foundation partnered with Kuyasa Educare Centre in 2016, however in 2018 the preschool lost their government accreditation due to a change in building regulations. The current Pre-Grade R classroom is falling apart & is unsafe for students & teachers. It lacks safety measures & endangers their lives. Re-building this classroom will allow them to receive government funding, & ensure the children have a safe place to learn, build skills, & prepare for primary school.

title: Support 6,000 Mums & Kids' Health in Sierra Leone
description: This project will support over 6,000 women and children in rural Sierra Leone to improve their health and nutrition.  In addition to sharing information about nutrition, we will support mums in learning about raising livestock, setting up community gardens to grow their own food, and by giving cooking demonstrations to parents in their villages. We will support community health workers to raise awareness around health and nutrition, as well as provide equipment and supplies to health clinics.

title: Typhoon Hagibis Disaster Relief in Japan
description: Operation Blessing is already helping families in Nagano, Chiba, and Fukushima, whose homes were flooded or damaged by wind following Typhoon Hagabis, Japan's most devastating typhoon in 60 years. Our home cleaning team, will help families dig out mud from their homes, and clean up, and tarp wind damaged roofs, and providing water to areas still shut off from local water supply.

title: Provide quality education to 1750 youth in Panama
description: Ensena por Panama (Teach for Panama) trains and supports young professionals, placing them in at-risk schools for two years, building their capacity to improve educational outcomes and to lead students and communities toward empowerment and self-efficacy.

title: Nutritious food for TB Patients in South Sudan
description: Charity and Empowerment Foundation (CEF) support undernourished patients of tuberculosis (TB) in South Sudan by providing them with nutritious food to prevent them contract diseases resulting from under nutrition. Through provision of nutritious food, we are helping 100 TB patients overcome the effects of the disease and recover from the sickness

title: Stop Child Marriages Today in Africa
description: In Africa, around 30% of girls marry before the age of 18. This contributes to high fertility rates, increased health risks, reduced educational levels and cost the countries billions of dollars in lost earnings. By providing girls with mental and educational support, as well as sustainable solutions for partners to independently earn a living we contribute to gender equality as well as quality education which will give people the opportunity to make educated decisions.

title: Funding The Integral Heart Family School in 2020
description: Education is at the heart of our work. Children born into generational poverty require a compelling, holistic approach to build confidence in their ability to dream.  The opening of The Integral Heart Family school, with your help, back in 2016 has been a great success. Our school is home to our Teacher-Training Program, Critical-Thinking, English, Spanish, History, Psychology, Homework Study, Art, Playtime, and Theater Programs. We also serve 1,500 meals monthly to 81 children, 5-21 years old.

title: Build a Brighter Future for 80 Kids in Guatemala
description: Updated January, 2022:  Since early 2012 this program has been serving 80 children from 42 poor families in the villages near Antigua, Guatemala, cultivating the love of learning while they are young. At our school, children are cognitively and emotionally stimulated through educational activities and games. In addition to helping children, this program empowers mothers to work in other jobs than in the fields, not only improving their financial situation, but also increasing self-worth.

title: Sponsor a Women to Start Her Own Business in Ghana
description: This project aims to identify aspiring local entrepreneurs who want to set-up a business and give themselves a sustainable income source. Often these women have a great business idea but with no means of funding it themselves, the government is also often not an option due to lack of funding. We will provide these women with grants to get a head start in their business and instead of paying high-interest rates on a loan they instead can give back to the project to help the next woman

title: Free rural Health Care
description: About 70% of Nigerians lives in rural communities area of  Nanti village,they do not have  access to basic healthcare services.this population is mostly made up of women and children. Many communities on this riverine area are difficult to reach due to topography of their geographical location. Many women and children travel long distance through boat and spend a lot of time  to access health care outside the village.This project will provide essential primary healthcare to the 5000 people.

title: Repurposing Toys for Low Income Kids
description: Since 1998, Go Green Toy Foundation has directly tackled two very important issues in the Dominican Republic: environment and poverty. Our model is directed towards creating and repurposing toys for low income kids through the use of recycled materials. This has expanded to tutorials, trainings and seminars, so that these kids can be educated regarding environmental preservation. Funds collected will be used to educate kids, get storage space for donations and materials to produce the toys.

title: Buying medicines for 164 children with cancer.
description: In Arica-Chile There are 164 children between 0 and 12 years of age who are cancer patients and come from families that are under the 40% poorer, do not have the resources to acquire 100% of drugs. They transferred to the Capital of Chile, where they receive treatment, the state only contributes with the transfer, hospitalization in hospital and part of the treatment, they must be between 6 to two years in that situation, a family accompanies them and they must contribute a 45% to cover the Reco

title: Create Livelihoods for 2000 Women in Rural India!
description: We are inspired by dynamic entrepreneurs with a business vision and aspiration who are changing the status quo in their communities.  Our artisan partners are social enterprises leading community initiatives for education, clean energy technology and business development all while creating economic opportunities in rural communities.  Your generous gift will help support these community development initiatives in rural India.

title: Protect their Journey #GirlsWhoMigrate
description: Every year, thousands of girls migrate from Central America fleeing violence and poverty. Fondo Semillas is a Mexican feminist fund that mobilizes resources to support, strengthen and connect women's organizations and grassroots groups. We currently support 13 organizations who work with migrant girls, but with ever-increasing numbers of people fleeing, the needs continue to grow. With your support we can continue to fund more groups carrying out vital work across the country.

title: Give One Year Scholarships for Children in Ghana
description: Since the beginning of PAAJAF Foundation in 2007, our priority has been to provide opportunity to disadvantaged children in Ghana of a better future through education. We proudly see our students taking new steps towards fresh directions in life in each year. Currently we have 145 students enrolled from 2,5 to 9 years of age - who likely wouldn't have access to education and a safe environment to play, with little hope to improve their future.

title: 2019 Emergency Response to Typhoon Faxai & Hagibis
description: Japan Platform(JPF) has decided to launch a program to assist victims of Typhoon Hagibis, which caused serious damage in many regions of Japan.   Tyhoon Hagibis wreaked damage in Chiba Prefecture which was also affected by Typhoon Faxai. As it is difficult to distinguish between the damages caused by these two typhoons, this program will merge with the current program for Typoon Habigis, the Emergency Response to Typhoon Faxai.

title: Providing Education over challenges at summer camp
description: Camp for peace Liberia aim to brings together 500 in and out of school youths Male & females) ages 18 - 30 years from across Liberia to address pressing national challenges within the context of self-esteem education and diversity. This educational camp is designed to strengthen youth knowledge and skills, empowering them to be more effectively involved in building peaceful societies and collaborating across differences, through increased networking and innovation.

title: Help reunite Hadil with her parents
description: This project will raise the visa application fees for the parents of refugee, Hadil, who lives in Edinburgh. Her father is currently in Aleppo, where he cannot receive the medical treatment he needs. Time is running out to bring him to Edinburgh where his loving family can care for him. The first stage of this project is to help this family to raise the visa application fees of 4000 GBP

title: Typhoon Hagibis Relief Fund
description: Donate to Typhoon Hagibis relief efforts in Japan. This disaster relief fund will support people impacted by Typhoon Hagibis.   We are providing emergency supplies like food, water, and sanitary items.  Our efforts aim to expedite early recovery of the survivors and to accelerate their return to normal life. All donations to this fund will exclusively support relief and recovery efforts in areas impacted by this typhoon.

title: School girl dropout empowerment with life skills
description: To create hope to these girls as many of them yarn to have something to place there hands on such that at the end of the day they're  able to meet their needs & those around her. The number of school drop out girls in our communities  is increasing every year and transition to secondary and Tertiary by the girl-child  is extremely small. We plan to train them in market  skills. By doing this we would have saved her from early marriage, early pregnancy, birth complications  and child trafficking.

title: Reforestation campaign
description: With unparalleled green expanses and a history stretching as far back as the earliest of human activity, the country is littered with natural treasures. Sadly, on the 14th of October 2019, pictures circulated on social media of sky-high smoke rising in Lebanon, aided by strong winds and unusually high temperatures, the nationwide fires have been described as the worst in decades.  To protect Lebanon's nature, forests and nearby residents, URDA is willing to launch an afforestation campaign.

title: Creation of Infrastructure at Ashagram Orphanage
description: The main focus for this project will be to create an inner safety compound to keep wild elephants away from children living at our orphanage. This is a necessity for children's safety as well as ensuring renewal of permission from the Government Authorities. In addition, we need to link the water system to the building in order to have 24/7 water available for the children. Increasing the number of children from 20 to 50 also needs an expansion of the kitchen-cum-dining facilities.

title: Anti-Encroachment Campaign.
description: ADEC has licence to operate in conservation,The main protagonists  are local communities namely ex-poachers as well as partners in wildlife conservation. It will use crowdfunding and its operating budget will be based on raised funds. On annual basis, it will train and disseminate  600 community workers into the population to campaign against forest encroachment. Each community worker will exercise its activities and cover 100 inhabitants. project conceived to extend to national parks of Rwanda.

title: Promoting STEM Subjects for Girls in Africa
description: Science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM) are subjects which are phasing huge ethnic and gender gaps across the globe, including Africa. This limits the infrastructure, innovation and industrialisation of the continent and hinders it from developing with the modern times. By providing information and resources for STEM education to marginalised communities we are contributing to reduced inequality and the opportunity for the continent to grow and develop

title: Fund a Small Business Grant in Southern Africa
description: With high unemployment rates and low foreign trade, people in Africa are heavily reliant on micro-businesses. COVID has made this worse. Thus, without credit becomes impossible to get a loan to get your business off the ground. Through our up-skilling projects across Africa we identify key potential successful business people and provide the support network through mentoring and funding to setup their own business.

title: No more Menstrual Stigma. Period!
description: Even during the years of impressive innovation and technological success, poverty is still affecting Africa. Those affected the worst are young girls. The products first cut from the households include sanitation products, resulting in maintained gender inequality. Without intimate sanitation, girls can no longer attend school, causing them to miss up to a quarter of the school year and consequently falling behind, keeping the girls one step behind.

title: Fighting for LGBTQ+ Rights in Africa
description: Belonging to the lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and queer (LGBTQ) community is still illegal in many countries across the world, including countries in Africa. This is a violation of human rights which cause people to face daily discrimination and violence. This project supports LGBTQ activism in Africa to achieve policy change but also to end homophobia at a community level. We are also dedicated to educating individuals on the stigmas they may face to increase safety and awareness.

title: Educate 65 Bright&Needy Children in Nyalenda Slums
description: James Were Foundation provides educational possibilities to profoundly poor children who are mainly living in the Nyalenda slums in Kisumu, Kenya. Besides school fees, the program also provides all school materials, mandatory uniforms, Boarding fees, medical and mentor support for HIV/AIDS orphans and vulnerable children within the slum. With this project we aim at supporting 65 very vulnerable but bright students to go to school and pursue their dreams.

title: Provide Education to 12 Orphan Children in India
description: IDRF supports free residential care for destitute children in a friendly and caring environment which makes them feel at home. The orphanage known as 'Brindavan' in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, provides care for 12 abandoned and orphan children who are vulnerable to exploitation by criminals and anti-social elements. The objective of this program is to provide good schooling & extra-curricular activities to these children so as to help them stand on their own feet as adults and become good citizens.

title: Help African Children Come to US for Surgery
description: Since 1979, Healing the Children has provided hope and healing for children around the world.  We are perhaps the oldest and largest registered charitable organization focused single-mindedly on helping poor children worldwide access the urgently needed medical care they need and deserve. Healing the Children partners with American and International healthcare providers to maximize our impact. Our 40 year history is a testimony to our commitment to helping children to have healthy lives.

title: Give a Child in Ghana a Safe Place to Learn
description: This project is fundamental for the organization to be able to operate while securing the school-building for our students.

title: Support athletes with special needs in Pakistan
description: We empower children and youth with varying Intellectual Disabilities (ID) using the power of sports. Our sports camps and dedicated coaches help develop fine motor and sports skills in youth with ID, which enables their participation in life experiences. Our unified sports help build confidence and social skills in athletes. We also deliver coaching clinics for teachers and coaches of special schools to equip them with the expertise to execute our inclusive sports program in a school setting.

title: Save his life.
description: Bikram, a young man who spent his childhood at our orphanage, was recently experiencing blindness in one eye so we took him to a local clinic and they performed an MRI and CT and he was diagnosed with brain cancer. We are raising funds to help him with treatments and to lessen the pain and symptoms he is experiencing. As director of the orphanage I have know Bikram since he was a small child.He finished high school just 2 years ago and has been very excited about pursuing further education in IT

title: Restore Eyesight to Children in Africa
description: Worldwide, the most common eye problem and a big contributor to school drop out rate's and unemployment is uncorrected vision, with millions of adolescents in the most vulnerable areas lacking sufficient eye testing and necessary care. Children are falling behind in school, therefore leaving them uneducated, unemployed and falling into the cycle of poverty and locking them into a lifetime of disadvantages. By providing children with the gift of vision, they will be given another chance at life

title: Pathways Out of Poverty for Youth in Africa
description: The African Impact Foundation equips young people with education and skills to move out of poverty. Our holistic approach gives young people in Southern and Eastern Africa the best chance of real, long-term change to break the cycle of poverty for themselves and their community. Our programs focus on 4 pillars that contribute to a brighter future: gender equality, education, wellness, and livelihoods.

title: Help Shamwari Yemwanasikana save lives of girls
description: Shamwari Yemwanasikana will raise community awareness through information on wheels to fight against the violation of women and girls' rights at water collection points. Our rapid strategy is to buy branded bicycles for male champions who will be moving around water collection points in the District and give information on Violence Against Women and Girls at water points.  This project promotes positive masculinity; hence we intend to have men create safe cities

title: GIRLS' EDUCATION
description: The Small World's aims to raise fund for 30 orphan & vulnerable girls at Himalayan  Hope Home to cover the educational as well as day to day living expenses..Children in this program either have parents who cannot afford/does not want to care for them or who have been orphaned. With your generous support , these children will have a safe place to live, education opportunity, happy, healthy & peace. We believe !  best ideal if she is educated, she will share with her family & community .

title: Enabling Opportunities for 50 Venezuelan Refugees
description: Humanity is going through one of the toughest crises in history. Vulnerable communities, such as Venezuelan refugees, have been financially affected by COVID19. Through our POETA Program, we seek to empower Venezuelan refugees in Latin America by providing digital, entrepreneurial and technical skills training to access employment or start small businesses. As well as fostering the creation of support networks to access local resources to improve the integration in receiving communities.

title: Education Reduces Serious Health Related Suffering
description: An estimated 61 million people around the world live and die with serious health related suffering each year.  Access to palliative care can relieve most of that suffering.  The IAHPC provides educational resources to palliative care professionals, workers and informal caregivers, through  workshops, curricula development, access to peer-reviewed journals, and much more.  These opportunities result in better patient care and reduce the suffering of millions of patients and their families.

title: Education Center for Disadvantaged Families Ghana
description: The major aim of this project is to make the foundation of a permanent education institute where the organization's future would not be dependent on landlords and tenant fees.

title: Planting fruit trees for Guatemalan families
description: This project brings the many benefits of fruit trees to vulnerable low-income children and their families. We plant orchards at schools and family homes in indigenous Mayan villages along the Rio Dulce River of Guatemala, where most live in extreme poverty and chronic malnutrition is among the highest in the world. Help us provide long-term, sustainable nourishment for kids' growing bodies and minds as well as income for their families and support for this environmentally fragile region!

title: Libraries for two day-care centres in India
description: In a child's early years, it's particularly crucial that they develop the necessary reading skills to give them the best chance to succeed in school and beyond. Day-care centres, also known as Anganwadis, in India's impoverished communities, suffer from a severe lack of books. Worldreader is raising funds to bring a digital library of 500+ books via tablets as well as projectors to two Anganwadis. You can help bring stories and joy to these young children.

title: Help Provide Housing and Medical Care To Parrots
description: This project will provide ongoing funding to ensure that the medical, housing, and daily necessities of our birds are always met.    The cost of medical care for our birds varies, but overall it is a significant percentage of our annual funding. To be able to access care without worrying  about fundraising  to cover the cost of that care would be a welcome change.  The secondary goal of this project will be to help pay our monthly rent on our shelter location.

title: Regenerative Aid for Philippine Typhoon and Quake
description: In collaboration with local partners, we are supporting 300-500 families affected by Typhoon Kammuri and 300-500 families from Cotabato affected by the earthquake through our Garden Releaf assistance. Using permaculture we will provide vegetable food packs from local farms, water systems, herbal remedies, earthen stoves, pop up gardens, and simple waste management system. We aim to fundraise scholarships for a select group of displaced leaders for a training on Permaculture in Disasters.

title: Provide Special Education to Hearing Impaired Kids
description: To provide a comprehensive instructional program from Pre School through high school.  To Provide Hearing evaluation and appropriate hearing aids   To provide counseling services to students and parents   To encourage parental involvement and understanding of special education programs.  To provide support and services for the students to enable them to access higher education.

title: Typhoon Hagibis relief fund for Soma children
description: Friends of El Sistema Japan (FESJ) has launched this disaster relief fund for musical instruments at the local children's orchestra and the school brass band that have affected with water immersion caused by Typhoon Hagibis in Soma city, Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. All donations to this fund will support the repairing and purchasing new instruments for recovery of the orchestra and the brass band.

title: Second home for 130 pupils - Witajcie w domu!
description: The project ensures support for 130 pupils of Polish descent from the east (Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Georgia, Moldova, Armenia, Belarus, Russia, Ukraine) in the Dormitory. Children come from poor families, who can not afford to fully pay the costs of them living and studying in a Polish high school.  Pupils live in the School's Dormitory for 10 months a year. The Foundation collects funds to provide them with food, care (both pedagogical and psychological) as well as cleaning/hygenic products.

title: Fresh Start - Building Furniture, Rebuilding Lives
description: Life presents both triumphs and adversity. Some face challenges alone cannot overcome. For these individuals, we offer the opportunity for a "Fresh Start." We provide meaningful work to enable people in desperate need to lift themselves up, choose life, and become productive and contributing members of society.  In the process of "rebuilding" themselves, they are, in turn, building furniture.

title: Send 5 Athletes to the Costa Rica Special Olympics
description: July 2019, at the Regional Special Olympics Event, five athletes from Daluz Vivencias Equinas qualified for the National Special Olympics Equestrian event in Costa Rica.  Those five athletes are part of the Daluz sponsored athlete program for 2019 but their sponsorship ends in December.  Please consider helping these five athletes achieve their dream of competing at the first National Special Olympics Equestrian event in Punterenas, Costa Rica in April 2020.

title: FEED A CHILD TO STAY IN SCHOOL
description: Vulnerable and Street children are on the street to scavenge for food in the dustbin to survive at the expense of enrolling in school. Feeding program not only give incentive for the child to go to school but help reduce the number of street children. Sheepcare believes that without education such children have no hope and the circle of poverty will be endless. Feeding such is the surest way that he/she will finish school and secure a bright future.

title: 40 Women Improving Income through a Sweet Business
description: The project is meant to back groups of small entrepreneurs who work hardly to make a difference in their home by producing and selling artisanal jams, pickles, canned vegetables and other regional products based on local resources like prickly pear cactus, palms and citrus. They belong to small rural isolated villages where ACDI arranged to organize and equip elaboration centers. Women's challenge now is to sustain their business alone and we are looking for people who can help them.

title: Supporting the Typhoon Hagibis Survivors in Japan
description: In Oct 2019, Typhoon Hagibis, the most powerful tropical storm to hit Japan in six decades brought a record-breaking rainfall, and flooded more than 25,000 hectares of Japan's mainland.  Japan International Support Program (JISP) based in the Northern capital of Sendai, aims to provide emergency assistance to the severely affected rural communities of Tohoku (Northeast of Japan), the area which had been severely affected by the 2011 Japan Earthquakes and Tsunamis.

title: Emergency flood response in Greater Akobo & Pibor
description: This project will provide nutrition food, provide food and medicines/ medical supplies, NFI and fishing kits for children, women and elderly displaced by the flood in Akobo, Lanken, Walgak and Pibor With the support from the donor.   Over 4000 and 5000 women and men will be trained on minor sanitation and hygiene management in emergency crisis . About 100 big tents will be purchased to support accommodation of children and lactating mothers displaced by the flooding in Akobo and Pibor

title: Single Step Community Center - a Social Enterprise
description: After successfully introducing comprehensive support services for LGBTI youth in Bulgaria (online chat and a network of psychologists), we purchased a property for a community center, to serve as an inclusive hub for all young people. It will feature a cafe, multifunctional event space and all profits will go to ensure the sustainability of the foundation. The project is 90% funded; pls help us with the homestretch! This fundraiser is generously supported by Bradford Shellhammer & Georgi Balinov

title: Retain 1000 Ghanaian Girls in School
description: Many girls in Ghana miss school because they do not have access to menstrual products yet this is preventable. This project aims to create menstrual hygiene awareness, provide menstrual cups to 1000 vulnerable school girls and hand washing facilities in schools. The outcome shall be increase of girls' education by improved school attendance and concentration in class during menstrual cycles and also create environmental awareness by changing behaviors through use of long-lasting menstrual cups

title: Project: Teen Center for Leaders in Training
description: Boys and Girls Club Tijuana will remodel a room for their 50 teenagers  called Teen Center. This space will offer them a place away from the street risks where they will be giving the tools to develop their leadership skills and contibute to improve our community. Since the priority right know is securing the operating funds for the current cost of the Clubs in Tijuana, a Teen Center will not be possible without your help!

title: Helping affected nonprofits & recovery activities
description: Responding to the Typhoon Hagibis disaster that hit the eastern part of Japan from the Kanto Region, including Tokyo, to the Tohoku Region with record-breaking rain and wind, the Japan NPO Center (JNPOC) as an infrastructure organization, is planning to support one of the following three areas: 1. Equipment purchase/repair for NPOs damaged by the disaster, 2. Supporting NPO activities helping disaster-affected areas, and/or 3. Supporting disaster volunteer centers.

title: Feed & Educate 50 children to break poverty trap
description: Muwakhat Foundation provides quality education to rural children in Pakistan who cannot access or afford it. The selected schools adopt holistic approach for education, help them to come out from personality problems, make their healthy mind and strong body for bright future. Your donation goes for infrastructure like learning material, uniform, fees, food, warm clothes, educational tours, school bus, classroom and building renovation etc for 6 Community based Schools Support Program.

title: Help feed to 50 a children with cancer in Mexico.
description: 70% of children with cancer are treated in hospitals in our state of Sonora, all children come from all parts of the northwest area with their parents, since in the hospitals of our city there are specialized treatments. of child chemotherapy, children come from humble families. With this project we intend to grant 2 safe foods and in our care room called "SULAM", which means stairway to heaven. to all children with cancer and their family caregiver.

title: Support the Mobilize Recovery Initiative in 2020
description: The initiative's purpose is to identify, train, connect, and work with recovery advocates in all 50 states. By sharing resources, building skill sets and taking action as a powerful confident constituency, our goal is to affect change impacting millions of people in a positive way by focusing on local issues across the country specific to addiction recovery and ending America's long-standing addiction crisis.

title: Support green incubator for 250 youth in Senegal
description: To tackle youth economic vulnerability,  in the rural area of Ross Bethio (Saint-Louis, Senegal), Association Jeunesse Espoir is setting up a green agricultural incubator for the training, the coaching and the formalization of 250 young boys' and girls' startups in different agricultural sectors. This incubation is also intended to provide an effective response against illegal emigration of young people to Europe and rural exodus to urban areas so that the  latter can succeed on their own land.

title: Lactation Training for 10 Under-Served Communities
description: Many U.S. communities are "first food deserts," where professional lactation support is practically nonexistent, and maternal & neonatal outcomes are worst for non-dominant culture groups such as Indigenous and Black People of Color and LGBTQ+ families in these communities. Increasing qualified lactation support in these communities will improve health outcomes for parents and babies on a community scale. Our program removes barriers to accessing this training through scholarships and support.

title: Empower 500 refugees in Greece with tools & skills
description: The money you raise will provide the materials and tools that people living in refugee camps need to create basic furniture, curtains for more privacy and other crucial items that are lacking in their daily lives. These items will be created in the intercultural "maker-space" Habibi.Works, a space offering 11 working areas for people living in three different camps in the north of Greece. Moreover, every person who comes to the centre receives a healthy, delicious meal for the day.

title: Argentina: Improving Children Access to Education
description: COVID19 continues to paralyze education. In Argentina, 1.5 million students risk dropping out, while the pandemic has further widened the educational gap between rich and poor. Less than half of public school students have access to quality distance education, compared to 75% of private schools.ACDI is responding to this challenge with "Padrinos Solidarios", a comprehensive education program with the possibility of reaching thousands of children in situations of social vulnerability in Argentina

title: Cradle Community Pre-school & Aftercare Center
description: The only way we can break the circle of poverty in future generations is by helping our children to obtain a good education. This project ensures that children in need have access to a quality preschool and aftercare center. Our program based on the PLAY WITH A PURPOSE curriculum, focuses on the 8 learning areas of the child's brain. As far as possible, we will try to expose our children to the "world out there" so they can develop optimally, which also includes emotional intelligence.

title: Build a Women's Training Center in Rural Uganda
description: SustainME plans to build a Rural Women's Center outside Nyenga Uganda. The Center will offer vocational and business training along with basic literacy and numeracy. It will have a surgery with a free to use full-time nurse. Once open it will impact the lives of over 1600 vulnerable women in the area, helping many of them to create sustainable livelihoods to provide a daily meal for their families, send their children to school and ultimately build a brighter future for their whole community.

title: Help Teenage Mom to get education in Tanzania
description: The main aim of our project is to inform and educate the society about the problem of teenage pregnancies.  To provide the affected group with sustainable support systems in the form of legal aid, psychological help, alternative life skills, and health insurance when needed.  To build a Second Chance Home Centre which will help those who drop out from school and instead giving them a reason to think of pursuing their dreams

title: educate 100 orphans for one year in uganda
description: This project will sponsor 100 orphans in school through feeding, tuition fees, scholastic materials and other school requirements for one year in Uganda at New Junior school Mityana

title: Mending 15 Kids' Hearts in Afghanistan
description: Many Afghan infants with Congenital Heart Disease (CHD) require surgery to survive.  FMIC is a place where CHD patients can find help and hope. Join forces with FMIC to make the miracle happen in the lives of infants and their families.

title: Help 50 Afghan Children Suffering from Spinal TB
description: TB is one of the most common diseases in Afghanistan. It takes a minimum of three operations to treat a child with spinal tuberculosis. There are many children from humble backgrounds who cannot afford the operation and remain deprived of walking for life. With just $500, you can help these young kids for surgeries which can make them walk and again and enjoy their lives.

title: Provide free surgery to 60 Vietnamese Children
description: In the U.S., surgery for a procedure such as microtia can cost around $40,000 PER CHILD. Some of these need to be done in multi-year stage. For the same amount, we can perform surgery on SIXTY children in underdeveloped countries. Our mission teams consist of plastic surgeons, nurses, and volunteers who give freely of their time and skills. We provide free surgery to children and adults suffering from congenital facial deformities. Would you help us give smiles?

title: Build the Movement: Support Achvat Amim!
description: Solidarity of Nations - Achvat Amim is a unique five-month movement-building project that directly engages with the reality of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict through grassroots human rights work and critical education, based on the core value of self-determination for all peoples. Rooted in Jewish values and a desire for a more just world, Achvat Amim offers young activists a way to find their place in the movement for peace, justice and human rights alongside Israelis and Palestinians.

title: BRINGING A SMILE TO A TEENAGE MUM  THIS CHRISTMAS
description: Uganda registers the highest (over 25% every year) number of teenage pregnancies in sub-Sahara Africa with.  Extreme poverty is one of the major causes that has triggered teenage pregnancies. Parents are forced to send their daughters into marriage because they can't provide for them. Parents also do this because they get some money and material things as a bride price. Many times such victims are isolated, shunned and neglected by society and we would like to bring a smile to them this Xmas

title: Build a classroom for grade six students
description: We established Nenkashe Primary School in January 2022.  The new school follows the new government enforced Competency Based Curriculum (CBC) where learning is based on the needs and potential of individual learners under flexible framework and parameters that move and shift according to the learner's needs.  Our urgent need for now is to build a permanent Grade 6 classroom for use in January 2023 when the new academic year begins.

title: HELP 500 SLUM GIRLS  ATTEND SCHOOL IN KENYA
description: Children in Kiandutu slums, especially girls, engage in sex in exchange for a meal during lunch break since there is no food at home or miss school during the menstruating period. They also engage in casual work to ensure they have a meal at home and buy sanitary towels or school requirements   low attendance leads to poor grades or early pregnancies hence dropping out of school altogether.  Kenwa provides necessities- sanitary, food  fees   to improve attendance, grades and reduce drop out rate

title: FROM US... A HOME FOR YOU
description: Fundraising:  Funds will cover the integral care of more than 30 babies ages 0 to 2 years deprived of their home environment. Besides covering their nutrition and care requirements, they will receive medical and psychological care, as well as social and legal supervision... and last but not least... love and affection. Duration: November 7th to December 20th, 2019 Goal:  US$ 25.000 Location: Caracas, Venezuela.

title: Journey With Women To Freedom and Self-Empowerment
description: Your partnership will ensure the women have an opportunity to benefit from the programs of Sari Bari: At the heart of Sari Bari is partnership with the women themselves - a commitment to holistic freedom, and empowerment-focused programs.
