description: This project will bring Christmas to women, babies and children living on the streets of Nairobi. We will supply masks, diapers, sanitary pads, blankets, new underwear and food to 100-200 people living in the streets on Christmas Day!

title: Sponsor small agro-ecological farmers in Colombia
description: Supporting small-scale farmers in Colombia requires MAFS, an agro-ecological model for sustainable families. This project seeks to encourage  local production, distribution and consumption in Subachoque, Cundinamarca. Through a formative model provided by our organization, a network of 20 farmer's initially, will acquire techniques and supplies to build a sustainable sowing model. Local markets and the communities health will benefit from this entrepreneurship, aiming for a 0km consumption.

title: Develop 1,000 future business leaders in Zimbabwe
description: Emergination Africa plans to run its third National Business Case Competition (NBCC) 2022 in 240 high-density and rural high schools across Zimbabwe. Through this fundraiser the organization plans to raise funds to enable 35 high-density and rural schools to participate in the 2022 competition. The organization will capacitate 35 teachers who will in turn coach over 1000 students for 6 months in developing business ventures that can compete nationally for the chance to get their ventures funded.

title: ENHANCE ACCESS TO CLEAN WATER & SANITATION
description: Water and sanitation are essential for life and health, but they are also essential for a dignified life, empowerment and prosperity. Water and sanitation are human rights, fundamental to every human life. In Kenya, poor sanitation and hygiene as well as unequal access to safe drinking water, in the informal settlements, slums and the rural villages, make thousands of children very sick and at risk of death. Many households spend thousands of shillings in and out of hospital every other day.

title: Xenophobia Barometer in Colombia
description: Our project is a platform that systematizes and spread as public information the result of the analysis of conversations on Twitter and the media about the migrant population in different cities of Colombia. Our objective is to shape narratives and negative language that causes the massive spread of hate speech towards migrants and refugees in Colombia and create an alert system to inform key stakeholders that can provide support and mitigate risks  in the territories.

title: Provide Education and Hope for Children at Risk
description: We provide a safe home for 45 children from isolated mountain villages and broken families who have no place else to go. We offer an opportunity to succeed through education, with family-style housing, balanced nutritious meals, school uniforms, tutors, and medical care.  We sponsor 30 additional children at Ton Roong, a government boarding primary school for Hill Tribe children. But it can only care for the kids five days a week. We provide caregivers, meals, and teachers on weekends.

title: Provide for Children Rescued from Sex Trafficking
description: Young victims of sex trafficking not only endure sexual trauma but also face many challenges in trying to rebuild their lives. Unexpected financial burdens can include medical care, unplanned pregnancy as the result of abuse, counseling, and transitional housing- as the trauma is often perpetrated or aided by family members. Our team, led by Vital Voices Human Rights Global Leader, Boom Mosby, assists children under 18 years old (as young as 3 years old) to find hope and healing from abuse.

title: Forest landscape restoration in Northern Ethiopia
description: In northern Ethiopia, most of the forest has disappeared or has been severely degraded. This means less productive soils and more frequent climate extremes like droughts and floods, causing extreme poverty. This programme in the Desa'a and Amhara regions aims to stop this vicious circle of forest degradation and poverty through restoring the forest and diversifying the population's income.

title: Rainwater Systems For 20 Indigenous Families
description: Over 9 million Argentineans lack access to safe drinking water. In rural, isolated communities in the northern provinces, groundwater is contaminated with arsenic and not suitable for human consumption. The lack of safe water poses a significant health risk to the families. EWB-Ar works to implement rainwater catchment and storage systems in these isolated areas, including in San Antonio de Copo. With your support, we can help secure access to clean drinking water for this indigenous community.

title: Stichting Because We Carry
description: We give ordinary people from London, Melbourne, Hawaii or wherever the opportunity to make a difference to ordinary people from Syria, Afghanistan, Congo, Irak and more who have fled their homes from wars, conflicts or natural disasters.

title: Donate a wheelchair to a Pakistani in need
description: There is a shortage of good quality wheelchairs in Pakistan. We are donating to private homes and hospitals.

title: Give a free book to a Pakistani child
description: Fostering 5 Pakistani children's books authors to write a children's book each, set in Pakistan, for publishing and distributing for free to children under age 5 to foster reading and give them a technology-free safe space for learning.

title: support Girls Lower Secondary Education (SGLSE)
description: Friends Welfare Association (FWA) Pakistan has established a community-based girls' lower secondary school in UC Jijal of District Lower Kohistan where no lower secondary school was available for girls. FWA is supporting the cost of salaries of female teachers. As there is no infrastructure where the girls of the said school could continue their education, FWA requires the support of construction of three classrooms for the community-based Girls' lower secondary school Jijal.

title: Free Dialysis for poor patients in Pakistan
description: We are raising funds to provide free treatment to 50 poor patients suffering from renal failure ($65000 will cover six months' cost of treatment). The therapy includes free Dialysis (a process of removing excess water, solutes, and toxins from the blood in people whose kidneys can no longer perform these functions naturally), provision of free medicines, consultation and laboratory examinations.

title: 3 Classrooms Needed for Orphans in Godavari Nepal.
description: Education is  key to a successful future.  The children at the Orphanage in Godavari (outside Kathmandu) receive food, shelter, a sense of family, and education for grades 1-6. (Older children attend a near-by Government school.)  Classroom space for the young students is desperately needed.  This project will add four new classrooms to support their educational needs. The  classroom building is partially constructed from funding by a generous sponsor.  $3000 is needed to complete the project.

title: School education for 750 under-privileged children
description: This project aims to raise enough funds to support the one-year educational expense of 1000 underprivileged children living in the backward area of Chakra Goth, Korangi, Karachi. These children are studying at Al-Mustafa Academy, a project of Al-Mustafa Welfare Society. Our students included orphans and children belonging to poor families and were denied quality education due to their economic and/or social circumstances.

title: Expanding Sanitation Acess in Urban Haiti
description: This project will support the expansion of household sanitation in Haiti. It is estimated that nearly 70% of urban Haitians do not have access to safe, hygienic and dignified sanitation. Since 2006, SOIL has been working in urban and peri-urban communities in Haiti to expand access to safe, affordable, and restorative sanitation services in some of Haiti's most vulnerable communities.

title: From poor girl to power girl - invest in education
description: Funding will be used to run a second student home: Master Home, Dar Moustaqbel II. This facility will house 25 promising but extremely disadvantaged students from rural areas in southern Morocco. While Dar Moustaqbel I houses 55 students pursuing a bachelor, our second home will focus on giving bright students a chance to complete their education. Our facility provides an elaborate skills program that considerably increases chances to land higher ranking jobs. Poverty should not be an obstacle.

title: The Font of Kindness Campaign
description: All the funds raised during this campaign will go towards ongoing support for children with severe motor disorders from low-income and single-parent Russian families. They will receive assistance in paying for rehabilitation sessions, purchasing orthopedic furniture, clothing and footwear, as well as technical means for home-based rehabilitation.

title: Clean Water + Shelter = Survival
description: Disaster Aid USA is responding to disasters in the US and around the Globe! This project supports our Family Survival Packs which gives a family the basic tools to rebuild their lives. All products contained in our box meet and exceed UN and Sphere standards and have innovative differences. Inside the box is a range of support items, most importantly, the Disaster Aid tent.

title: Support a healing integral house for Nahuat Women
description: Yolpakilis is a non profit from Cuetzalan, Mexico. Their members have worked defending womens human's rights tirelessly for the last 15 years. The healing integral house where they host women that have been victims of violence is in danger of closing due to lack of funds. We need funds soon to keep fighting for women and their children, and keep the shelter open!  You can know more in this video: https://youtu.be/4IKf8LkwuD8 For this purpuse we need 2 thousand donors per month.

title: Innovative pilots in Kenyan and Ugandan schools
description: The educational landscape is changing rapidly in Kenya and Uganda. More young people are in secondary school than ever before. The purpose of this funding is to encourage and support our partner schools to develop and pilot new ideas. These pilots, as well as making an impact in their own right, will keep EPAfrica's programme vigorous and will ensure that our partnerships with schools continue to evolve, our investments are relevant and together we achieve the best possible outcome for students.

title: Technology for Learning
description: Electricity, the internet, projectors and smartphones have created new and exciting opportunities to improve students' learning, but rural schools in Kenya and Uganda struggle to use these tools due to a lack of facilities, resources and training. This project will help EPAfrica's partner schools level the playing field through investment in e-learning, projectors, the internet, computers and solar power, and by supporting teachers with capacity building and training.

title: Educational opportunities in Kenya and Uganda
description: We want to grow so that we can improve the quality of education available to 15,000 students in Kenya and Uganda annually. This funding will enable the delivery of EPAfrica 2021.

title: Girls Education for Brighter Futures Post-COVID-19
description: For 100 years, Graduate Women International has developed, coordinated and operated impactful global education, gender equality and empowering projects for women and girls around the world. Our vision is for 100% of girls and women in the world to achieve quality education beyond primary school to reach their highest potentials. The advocacy work and micro-projects held throughout the world remove the sociocultural, gender-related, and economic barriers girls face towards education endeavours.

title: GBV Legal Represantion Fund For Refugees Uganda
description: This project is aimed at helping the victims of Gender Based Violence in Uganda by facilitating legal representation for Gender Based Violence Victims. This will involve assisting victims in reporting their cases and fighting their cases in court. Most victims of GBV rarely report their cases because they are not sure of their legal rights or because the justice system refuses to believe victims.

title: No Isolation for kids at hospital
description: The program has 2 main objectives :   1/ reduce young patients' relational isolation and loneliness  and maintain close contact with their relatives/school/friends during long-term hospitalizations ; 2/ Facilitate the return to school and to the family, limit the psychological impacts on siblings. This is possible thanks to an easy-to-use robot being the avatar of the patient outside. The robot has become unavoidable in this period of pandemic and dramatically increased patient isolation.

title: Mobilise and Support 1000 Female Local Farmers
description: Blossom Trust is mobilising 1000 marginal and smallholder female farmers into 50 Farmers Interest Groups to start up an all-female, community-owned Farmers Producers Organisation, ultimately uplifting the livelihoods of resource-poor women and their communities in Tamil Nadu. This project will support internal savings to build women's economic capacity while providing training and skill-development on financial literacy and entrepreneurship, Climate-Smart Agriculture and gender advocacy.

title: Tropical Storms Eta & Iota Response
description: Hurricane Iota (Category 5 storm) hit Central America in November, bringing catastrophic winds and a life-threatening storm surge. Iota's arrival comes as the region is still recovering from Hurricane Eta. The emergency in the face of storms and the global context of the Covid-19 pandemic increases the risk of the most vulnerable families. Habitat Guatemala is responding with hygiene kits, reconstruction kits, and home reparation and reconstruction.

title: Child Protection Program
description: The Small World has been dedicated for years to providing education to children and is convinced of its significance in breaking the cycle of poverty in remote Himalayan Communities of Nepal.

title: Successfully Impacting Haitian Women Organizations
description: The Haitian Women's Collective (HWC) gathers women led organizations in Haiti  to increase the effectiveness of their local projects by providing support in training, increasing technical capacity and building skills of the leaders at the forefront. We do this through community based/service gap assessment; leadership training, effective networking, developing tools,  and developing an advocacy agenda to make a difference in the lives of women and girls; supporting communities.

title: Help HALO give emergency care to animals in need
description: HALO offers free veterinary care for domestic animals in rural communities bordering the Kruger Park. By vaccinating dogs we help save the lives of wild population of leopard, wild dogs and hyenas. HALO has a holding facility for animals in need of emergency treatment, HALO does outreach programs to the communities, gives free vaccinations, sterilization and provides education to the owners on animal kindness. We rely on donations only to do our work in these remote areas.

title: Provide HIV services to 13,000 Vulnerable Ugandans
description: The COVID-19 pandemic has increased the poverty level of many Ugandans including our clients and negatively affected HIV/AIDS and Sexual Reproductive Health and Rights services and all other medical services. AIDS is not over yet! This project will enable 13,000 clients in Uganda access HIV prevention, care, treatment  and support that has now been threatened by COVID 19 and contribute the HIV epidemic control.

title: Ruadt Annapoorna midday meal programme for elderly
description: Annapoorna Midday meal for the elders BY RUADT The coronavirus pandemic and poverty go hand in hand. The lockdown has seen many people striving hard to live and survive. And for a joint family, which typically involves five to six members of three generations, the lack of regular work has caused severe problems. it is a burden. This unforeseen time is testing the bond and strength of the family and for many, it is 'joint' in name only. Because of poverty, the elders of the family are increasingl

title: Playground for 842 students in Rwanda
description: Building a sustainable playground for 842 students in most underprivileged district in Rwanda. This playground will be build in the school's land to create a space for children to connect, play and grow while they attend school.  This playground will encourage more children in nearby villages to attend the school.  These villages have no electricity or running water. Some of the children walk up to 2 hours a day to get to school.

title: HELP FRED RECEIVE CANCER CHEMOTHERAPY TREATMENT
description: Fred has been the Managing Director of Self Reliance Promoters NGO since 1999. His passion is to serve the communities, Orphans and Vulnerable children.  He started his illness 8 months ago and his diagnosed was 3 weeks ago where it was finally confirmed when the cancer is already at level 4. With the Anglophone crises,  all his home was burnt down. The crises has been for four years and all the NGO activities are on a halt, no salaries. He is now sick and needs financial assistance.

title: Disaster Relief: Feeding the Hungry in Honduras
description: Missoula Medical Aid is supporting a Save the Children Honduras project to feed hungry families impoverished by the Covid 19 pandemic, and Hurricanes Eta and Iota. This project helps small farmers get supplies to plant a crop of basic grains this year, and gives groups of rural women training and seed money to start businesses making bread or tortillas. It also provides oral hygiene kits, and instruction, to children.

title: Ma7boobin - Divorce Care For Kids in Egypt
description: A Ma7boobin (translates Beloved) support group is a safe, fun place where children can learn skills that will help them heal from. Ma7boobin groups blend games, music, stories, videos and discussion to help kids process the divorce and move forward. Groups meet weekly and are designed for children ages 5-12. The session topics help to strengthen children, turning their sadness to hope and their anger to joy. All sessions are led by trained therapists.

title: Educate50 orphan youth in Yemen
description: The project targeting 50 impoverished orphan youth who are vulnerable to abuse, neglect, & exploitation by Criminals & extremists. providing holistic care in the areas of,education, food, legal protection, medical & psychosocial services to orphans & vulnerable kids.Our program reaches 300 youth providing the only meal most will eat for the day, & our scholarship program allows youth (boys & girls) opportunity to attend school who otherwise wouldn't be able to attend.We offer hope beyond poverty

title: Fighting covid-19
description: Organ transplantation is a gift of life. A second chance to live made possible by an organ donor. Unfortunately, transplanted patients are a high-risk population for COVID-19. But thanks to technology, it is possible to help optimize the treatment of these patients and thus, save them from losing the transplant and/or losing their life.

title: AK Impact Growth Strategy
description: By 2023, AK's Impact Growth Strategy aims to:  Make. Employ 250 adults from vulnerable job groups by innovating production processes and products at existing centres and opening a new centre in Uganda.  Play. Have given 9 million young people access to sport through the donation of AK sports balls to community projects.  Live. Have trained over 250 community leaders to deliver ongoing vital health education to over 10,000 young people.

title: Save Yemen - Safe Water to 2100 Poor Persons
description: Yemen is facing the largest humanitarian crises in the world due to the current conflict. The project target three villages in Al Turba District of Taiz governorate in west Yemen is one of the most affected by the humanitarian crises with more poor people in increase everyday. The project target 300 families/about 2100 person thru sustainable water project based on solar power. The average cost of providing sustainable drinking water for life time through this project is 10 USD per person.

title: PROVIDE 66 ADOLESCENT MOTHERS WITH MILKING COWS
description: This project will provide adolescent women and their children with milking cows. Many unwed mothers who face unplanned pregnancies are subject to abuse, neglect and malnutrition for themselves and their child. COVID has increased this. Cows provide a sustainable income, create self-sufficiency for the single mother, and combat nutrient deficiencies for the child. This leads to a healthy life for both mother and child due to sustained income which provides health care and education opportunities

title: Ignite love for math in Bulgarian students
description: The world-renowned JUMP Math program helps younger students overcome stress and anxiety related to learning math, as well as develop important skills and mindsets. Our organization has worked to make JUMP Math available to Bulgarian teachers and students since 2010. Your donation will allow us to train more teachers and provide instructional materials free of charge to schools and educators serving soon-to-be-discovered math prodigies growing up in less fortunate circumstances.

title: Plant Trees in Cambodian Community Forests
description: Peace Bridges will partner with Buddhist monks, a local forest group, and Christian pastors to organize tree plantings in their villages and community forests. This is a unique opportunity for Cambodians of all faiths and backgrounds to cooperate and restore areas that have been deforested. The goals of this project are to plant 5,000 native trees, engage and educate youth and faith groups about the environment, and mitigate the global threat of climate change. Timeline contingent on COVID-19.

title: create means of livelihood for 15 women in Nigeria
description: This project will create means of livelihood for poor women most of whom are illiterate, widowed, with dependent children through income generating activities so that they will be financially independent to be able to take care of themselves and their children

title: FIRE DISASTER VICTIMS RECOVERY CAMPAIGN
description: This project will help complete an ongoing building apartment to shelter the homeless disabled couple (Uzor and wife)  and their five kids who were victims of a fire incident in a deprived rural community in Southeast Nigeria. The Fire Disaster Victims Recovery Campaign intends to complete a build RUWAI started for the family and provide food, clothing, healthcare support, water, and school items to recover from shocks. It will empower the couple with alternative income skills for livelihoods.

title: Hepatitis Free Project- Rashidabad
description: Pakistan is facing a Hepatitis epidemic as, according to the World Health Organization, it has the highest prevalence of Hepatitis in the world.  The Hepatitis Free Community Project will be initiated in adjoining villages of Rashidabad. The Health Foundation will be implementing a holistic Hepatitis Free Community Project model in these areas, with the following 04 main components: 1. Mass Awareness, 2. Hepatitis B Catch Up Vaccination, 3. Hepatitis Screening. 4. Hepatitis Treatment.

title: Inclusive daycare center for 45 children in Rwanda
description: This project aims to provide comprehensive, inclusive early childhood development services to young children with developmental delays and disabilities at risk of losing their developmental potentials during their first 6 years, from poor families in rural Rwanda. The project will help the healthy growth, development, and inclusion of 45 children under school age who will be identified in their community, contributing to a wider community inclusive development.

title: Heart2Heart-Children with Congenital Heart Defects
description: Many children with life-threatening conditions are in the queue facing dire consequences. At Heart2Heart we treat Egyptian children with heart Congenital Diseases with Catheter Procedures 100% Free. These children need your support. Help us save them today.

title: Prevent sex trafficking of girls in Las Vegas
description: Girls Athletic Leadership School (GALS) provides a free middle school education to at-risk girls living within 2 miles of the Las Vegas Strip.  GALS students live below the national poverty level and are routinely exposed to violence.   GALS provides a safe and supportive education environment to learn self-advocacy and obtain a high quality education to prepare for college.  The purpose of this project is to provide educational tools to raise academic proficiency.

title: Victims of Humanitarian Work
description: On Wednesday November 4, 2020, two of our very own staff lost their lives as they were serving others. The Syrian Regime forces shelled two sub districts of Idlib - which killed Ibrahim and Raghid as well as other civilian casualties.  Both men left behind their families and children. We at Syrian Forum USA are raising funds to support Ibrahim and Raghid's families and to provide basic services to their children.

title: Anti-Poaching & Conservation In South Africa
description: Our collaborative wildlife conservation project in Limpopo, South Africa, is situated in the heart of the African savannah and focuses upon the immediate and long term conservation of Southern Africa's wildlife, including large game (lions, leopard and cheetah, rhinos and elephants and many other IUCN red listed species). The project works with a multitude of local partners, including local reserves, the Endangered Wildlife Trust, local and international universities, and local schools.

title: Women's Empowerment in Nepal
description: In Pokhara, our project focuses upon improving gender equality through health, education and opportunities. In a country relying on tourism, the impact of the global pandemic means that issues related to poverty such as human trafficking, access to healthcare, education and employment opportunities are increased. Women are particularly affected. Our project collaborates with local community members and organisations to help them achieve their long term objectives.

title: Elephant Welfare & Sustainable Income In Thailand
description: Our collaborative project is based in the village of Huay Pakout and focuses upon supporting and empowering local communities to achieve sustainable incomes through the implementation and promotion of ethical treatment of elephants.  The project supports the reintegration of elephants, that have previously worked in the tourism industry, back into the forest and the local community to develop an eco-tourism model dependent upon the conservation of the  local forests and habitats.

title: Quality Education & Public Health In Thailand
description: Through the collaborative project in Phang Nga, we work with a number of dedicated local organizations on a sustainable community development project focused upon education and preventative health. The project provides educational support to children and adults, teacher training with emphasis on girls and women, and community health education outreach and resources and workshops for health professionals.

title: Education and Public Health In Fiji
description: In Dawasamu, Fiji, our collaborative project focuses on community development, where we assist members of the local community with gender equality initiatives, global public health, early childhood development, waste management and recycling. Our primary goal is to support and strengthen environmental, health, and educational awareness through the dissemination of information via workshops and community-based learning, and stakeholder engagement.

title: Coral Reef Restoration & Conservation In Mexico
description: Riviera Maya, is home to the world's second-largest coral reef, the Mesoamerican Barrier Reef, important habitats including mangrove forests and coastal wetlands, and diverse marine life such as critically endangered species such as whale sharks and the Hawksbill sea turtle. Wework with local partners and communities to restore and conserve the Mesoamerican Coral Reef System.Our community-led project focuses on uplifting the communities through both education and women empowerment.

title: Coral Reef Conservation In Seychelles
description: Our collaborative project supports critical marine conservation in the Seychelles, surveying coral reef ecosystems, including megafaunas such as sharks and turtles. The project conducts marine research, environmental education, and capacity-building workshops, and works towards attitude, regulation, and policy changes, through activities operated in collaboration with NGOs, universities, and government agencies.

title: Shark & Turtle Conservation In Seychelles
description: Our long term collaborative project supports local partners focused upon marine conservation on the small island state of the Seychelles, which relies upon tourism and fisheries as its 2 principal industries. The project supports the management of Curieuse Island National Park and conducts research on several threatened species including sharks, turtles, and endemic species such as the Aldabra Giant Tortoise and the Coco de Mer, whilst working to strengthen local capacity and regulation.

title: Gender Equality, Public Health & Welfare in Ghana
description: Our collaborative project works with various stakeholders including governmental organizations, local NGOs, and schools to improve access to gender-sensitive education, improve gender equality in the community, and to provide critical healthcare support and funding to children and vulnerable adults - including mental health support, menstrual hygiene support, breast and cervical cancer awareness, sexual and reproductive health knowledge, and neglect and trauma counseling.

title: Food supply for a refugee camp in Bulgaria
description: This project have the aim to support more than 500 families, who live in a refugee camp in Bulgaria. Our hope is to help them, providing the first need of food, as in the place they live now, there is a shortige of food supplement.  The lack of food for all those hundreds if people is a permanent problem and there are many children between them in the camp. Please, help us to give them a little bit better life and feed them. Thank you!

title: Offset Your Emissions: High Atlas Carbon Solution
description: Since 2000, the High Atlas Foundation (HAF) has been committed to advancing sustainable prosperity throughout Morocco. HAF aims to achieve local, regional, and global benefits by collaborating with companies and institutions that want to balance their carbon footprints, and by planting trees. Why trees? The destruction of forests for agriculture or industry is one of the main drivers of the climate crisis. Planting trees, which sequester carbon directly, contributes to reversing climate change.

title: Marine and Coastal Conservation in Thailand
description: Our collaborative project focuses on protecting the marine and coastal area of a small fishing village called Ban Nam Khem. We collaborate with our partners to protect endangered sea turtle populations, restore habitats, catalog species, and carry out valuable scientific research. Our project also focuses on educating the community on the importance of conservation, offering training, and sustainable tourism workshops.

title: Education and Women's Empowerment In Laos
description: Although tourism has picked up in Laos over recent years, it is still one of the poorest countries in the world. Our project is based in Luang Prabang where we collaborate on sustainable projects that aim to have a long-term impact on the lives of local community members. With projects focusing on SDG4 Quality Education, we work with local partners to improve English literacy, opportunities for women, and preventative health practices.

title: Urgent life aid for100 black affected people Yemen
description: As a black man living in the most underserved neighborhood in Yemen, Abdo works as a janitor. He exposes himself to the most hazardous conditions and deals with infected wastes in order to offer nourishment and shelter for his 14 children, whereas federal medical aid is inattentive. Yet, 4 children died consequently from Cholera owing to the absence of favorable living conditions. Abdo needs heroes like  you are to help his 10 children survive COVID global pandemic and educate his children.

title: Build a 50 Capacity Geriatric Home in Kuje Nigeria
description: The project will build a geriatric home in Kuje Area Council a densely populated rural settlement in the federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nigeria to house and retain aged population for care, diagnosis and treatment of geriatric diseases & ailments, and create support network, social interaction, knowledge & experience sharing among the aged in Kuje. The project will utilize an available land space strategically situated within a clustered population of poor, marginalized and disadvantaged aged.

title: Help llama farmers access water to improve pasture
description: Andean llama farmers rely on rain season to water their crops and pastures. Global Warming alters season cycles making farming tasks challenging and unpredictable and reducing pasture quality.  Water collection through hoses allow llama farmers to irrigate grassland during dry seasons and improve quality of pasture for llamas. Each irrigation system provides improved nutrition to 210 llamas which generate alternative sources of income for 30 families improving the quality of life of 135 people.

title: Renew Puerto Rico - Revving up for 2021
description: Puerto Rico has a new law (called a Renewable Portfolio Standard) requiring going from 3% renewable energy today, to 100% by 2050, while also reducing electricity usage by 2% per year with new energy efficiency programs. Passing a law was just the first step - now comes the very detail-oriented work of crafting the specific rules & policies to actually help make this a reality. This project funds important policy analyses for solar & battery companies and our allies.

title: Mayor Potencial Annual Fund
description: Mayor Potencial goes the distance to serve destitute rural Honduran communities and develop lasting partnerships for lasting impact. We inspire volunteers to disseminate social change and empower youth in Honduras through education. At the heart of our mission is the voice of those we serve.    While we are very blessed to be 100% volunteer run we have increasing expenses. Every year we add new projects or we have people contact us with emergency needs.  This will help breach that gap.

title: Empower 30 Thai Children Through Education
description: The province of Chaiyaphum is located in northeast Thailand's Isaan region. Children, young adults and young families often migrate to larger cities seeking labor opportunities. Many of these migrants are impoverished and illiterate increasing their vulnerability of being trafficked or exploited. Educational, nutritional and wellness support in an encouraging family atmosphere provide young adults, teens and children with the opportunity to overcome poverty and illiteracy in their community.

title: COVID-19 Relief Fund for Families in Ghana
description: This COVID-19 relief project will provide crisis management support to our families by ensuring that basic necessities such as food and water are provided.   Although GEC typically works to provide school tuition support and mentoring to students and families in Ghana, we have had to shift our priorities to help students and parents make it through the pandemic safely until schools reopen.

title: We rebuild together the children's library!
description: The project will benefit 160 children who attend the school N 175 "Ruca Anai", in Trelew, Chubut in Argentina, a country where 52% of the children between 15 and 17 years cannot understand properly a simple text. The school is located in Tiro Federal, a very humble neighborhood in the City of Trelew that for 25 years has suffered from sewage and flooding problems.  At the beginning of 2020, the water tanks overflowed again on the roof of the library, spoiling the few children's books they had.

title: Help Russian disabled kids to improve their lives
description: The project of Dvizhenie Vverh (Movement Up Charity Foundation) will help kids with disabilities to get rehabilitation in medical centers. Rehabilitation (i.e. recovery of capabilities, lost either during disease or injury) is so vital and necessary for such kids since it might help them become independent and return to an ordinary life: to socialize with age-mates, go to school, make friends, travel, etc.

title: Love, Learning, and Support for Gaza's Children
description: Over the past year, with your support, 150 underprivileged children in Rafah, Gaza, have been receiving after school Art, Science, and English lessons during COVID in a safe and caring environment. Dedicated and hard-working teachers took it upon themselves to bring smiles to children's faces after the May 2021 bombings. In addition, two distinguished artists brought joy to deaf children in Jabaliya Refugee Camp through a wonderful art instruction program. Help keep this going!

title: Urgent help needed for a teenage cancer survivor!
description: 17 y.o. Danylo needs help to raise money for tumour endoprosthesis. He suffered from osteosarcoma of the left distal femur which destroyed his bone. He is hoping to have the surgery as soon as possible at ZEM-Germany hospital in Munich. The treatment costs Euro 42,000 which Danylo's parents can't afford. We would love to raise some money to contribute to the costs. Having the treatment will enable him to rebuild his life. Help Danylo fight for a new life after everything he has been through!

title: Fight 4 Haiti's Communities-Konba Pou Kominote!
description: Covid-19's impact on the economy of Haiti was staggering. OUR ACTION PLAN to impact 1000s of residents: Invest in agriculture by providing seeds,training related to climate change & land/crop management;Invest in economic growth by supporting Local Mutuelles Solidarites (community cooperative financing platforms with affordable interest rates);Develop with women's organizations a soap making small business initiative; Work with local universities such as L'Universite de Jeremie & local students.

title: Save an endangered southwest willow flycatcher
description: Every winter, the willow flycatcher travels from the U.S. to Central America for the season. Five years ago, we began studying the bird's habitat use in Nicaragua. What we learned was surprising! The birds return each year to nearly the same location. These small flycatchers prefer scrubby vegetation near water. Sadly, these are areas most frequently burned or cleared by farmers.  Will you help save one willow flycatcher? We will enable farmers to delay clearing and to keep the birds safe.

title: Technical Skills Training-50 poor Youth
description: An opportunity to change disadvantaged young lives for the better through vocational training skills. We encourage socially vulnerable young people to choose education, inspiring them to dream and aim higher. We offer training opportunities in recognized educational institutions and provide continued individual follow up. We also create initiatives to increase our participants' chances in finding work.

title: COVID-19 Education and Training for Myanmar
description: COVID-19 continues to have a huge impact on the livelihood and health status of people in Myanmar. Many people in this community lack access to proper education and training regarding COVID-19. Our training is designed to address health and safety in the context of COVID-19. The courses are developed and delivered in collaboration with Eastern Michigan University, Global Health Services Network, and the American Nursing Institute in Myanmar.

title: Sponsor for Manuel De Jesus
description: Manuel is Diagnosed with Hydrocephalus, Epilepsy, Cerebral Paralysis and severe malnutrition.  Pediasure is the only thing he can eat. He needs 4 cases a month. His mom gives him chicken broth with blended vegetables but its not enough to sustain him. The Hurricanes that devastated Honduras have impacted greatly the local economy. His dad is blind from one eye and can see 40% with his other eye. His dad collects can to take to the recycling center to provide for his family but its not enough.

title: Affordable Dining for Haitians!
description: The World Treasure Hotel on Ile a Vache, Haiti will soon be open for business. This affordable inn is great place to stay and relax. But even relaxing can work up an appetite and, currently, the only restaurants in the area are in high-end hotels and charge outrageous prices! Your help adding a restaurant to this local hotel will boost the economy by using local vendors and workman.  Once open, it will employ neighbors and be a delicious place for the community and visitors to meet and eat.

title: Climate Action with Farmers in Rwanda
description: GCS has been carrying out this project since 2015 to support self-reliance of the vulnerable people in Nyarubaka Sector. However, climate change creates enormous challenges for those people's everyday lives heavily dependent on small-scale agriculture. To overcome these challenges, GCS will start 'climate-smart agriculture' skills training program for farmers in Nyarubaka. This program will equip the farmers with adaptive capacity to climate change and pave the way to realize self-reliance.

title: Tackling Homelessness in South Africa
description: This project addresses the immediate issue of homelessness in Cape Town while being a sustainable project tackling the social issues that lead people to homelessness like poverty, inequality, quality education, and decent work. Our phased program has a track record of over 80% of homeless graduates remaining sober and employed and we hope to increase our reach with your help!

title: Gift of a wheelchair to persons with disabilities.
description: We believe everyone should have the opportunity to live productive lives with dignity and self-fulfillment. Your donation gives back freedom of movement and self-confidence to 50 Rwandans with mobility disabilities. This project is the initiative of Rwandan Youth Development and Voluntary organization (RWAYDAVO) to provide 50 appropriate wheelchairs annually in Rwanda through the Wheelchair Fund initiative. We have a 20 individuals with disabilities who urgently need wheelchairs.

title: Support conflict affected children accesseducation
description: This project will build a Temporary Learning Space (TLS) and engage 450 conflict-affected (returnees, Internally displaced persons (IDPs) and community) boys and girls with informal learning within 12 months in Maiduguri Borno state in Nigeria. Also, this project shall support girl child with back to school enrollment package which includes written materials, school bags, & school uniform. Every child have right to access quality education, it is paramount to ensure conflict affected children.

title: Help raise girls' aspirations around the world!
description: We believe in the power of role models. Our organisation seeks to raise the aspirations of young girls around the world by connecting them with amazing women. By introducing girls aged 10-15 to a variety of careers and options, we can combat the gender stereotypes which still play a major role in their future education and career choices. We work with thousands of volunteers across the world to help empower young girls to follow their dreams.

title: Funding The Integral Heart School in 2021
description: Education is at the heart of our work. Children born into generational poverty require a compelling, holistic approach to build confidence in their ability to dream.  The opening of The Integral Heart Family school, with your help, in 2016 has been a great success. Our school is home to our English, Spanish, History, Psychology, Homework Study, Art, Playtime, and Theater Programs. We also serve 1,500 meals monthly to 80 children, 4-12 years old.

title: Atlas Corps: 15 Year Anniversary
description: Celebrate 15 years of global impact with Atlas Corps! Join us to recognize this milestone anniversary and partner with our community of 1000 social change leaders from 105 countries. Support Atlas Corps and empower our global network of changemakers who possess the training, skills, and commitment to solve the world's most pressing issues. BONUS - Reserve your participation in the 15 Year Anniversary on November 20, 2021 with a $250 donation!

title: Develop Life Skills Through Sport for 300 children
description: This project develop children essential skills through sports. Sports activity is an exclusive things for children in marginal community. To use a space for playing, they need to pay rent. They have no trainer although they have the potential talent and physical ability. On the other side there are many potential  harmful activity offered in marginal community which put children at risk. BOLA futsal aim to prevent them to fail in risky behavior by build positive values and awareness.

title: Give daily healthy meals to the aged in India
description: This project provides love, care, healthy meals and health care to 50 destitute aged people in the slums  and Guntur district, India. Many aged people are abandoned due to poverty, by their families and suffer with sickness and end up by begging for survival. At least one daily best healthy meal, timely health checkups and proper care will save the lives of neglected aged people. Can you join with us to support 60 elderly at least with $900 per a month to care and give healthy meals ?

title: Scholarship for Vulnerable Youth in Asia
description: Education is one of the effective ways to get out of poverty. Thus, due to family or social issues, many vulnerable youths who are willing to pursuing higher education have lost their chances. This project assists vulnerable students in Cambodia, India, Nepal, and Malaysia to continue their studies in higher education (collegiate institutions) to obtain academic qualifications and certificates, so as to increase the advantages of vulnerable young people and eliminate poverty in the future.

title: Provide Counseling & Support to Sexually Abused
description: The COVID-19 crisis has highlighted another global epidemic: child sexual abuse and online exploitation. With both offenders and children at home using the internet, casework has been soaring. The impact of these crimes against children is impossible to overstate. Depression and suicide are common and on the rise. This project will provide trauma-informed counseling, as well as other victim support such as home visits and family therapy through the Child Advocacy Center in Chiang Mai, Thailand.

title: Education Beyond 6th Grade: Dreams Can Come True
description: Most students in southern Honduras end their education at 6th grade.  The reasons they don't continue to the next level of education is purely ECONOMIC.  The families cannot afford to purchase school uniforms; pay for transportation, school lunches, and school supplies.  Scholarships provide these things to approximately 125-150 students every year, so they can continue their education past the 6th grade and graduate high school!

title: Support Domestic Violence Victims in Zimbabwe
description: Domestic abuse of any sort is a major problem around the world, but in countries like Zimbabwe, the major gender inequality and financial dependency all contribute to the increasingly high statistics of violence within homes. This abuse is generally targeted at the woman and has heightened since COVID, which is why we aim to provide a safe space for women to reach out as well as therapy and assistance to help them rebuild their lives.

title: Support for the Most Vulnerable Syrian Children
description: We seek to make protection services available for 200 of the most vulnerable children in Syria, by providing the following services: fitting hearing aids for children who suffer from partial or total hearing loss, speech teaching sessions, providing children of physical disabilities with wheelchairs, psychosocial support sessions and conducting events and recreational activities for moral support.

title: Support the girl-child in Computer training
description: This project aims at creating a Computer lab to provide free ICT training for Girls  in Bombali District. This project will capacitate these girls in computer skills,make them independent and frown at early marriage. The world has gone ICT. No child should be left behind. The lab will also be used in the Communities to reach the unemployed youths with no skills to seek employment. This will enable them to seek employment, become self employed or further their education in ICT or other careers.

title: Support a child in refuge
description: We support children who stay with us in both safe houses.   Our children's service focuses on therapeutic support and play alongside group play work. We aim to undo the harm caused by experiencing DA and help children understand that the abuse was not their fault

title: Health Support for Rural Youth in Ghana
description: This project will provide free health support to adolescents and youth living in and around the Ayenya village in Ghana who are at risk of becoming victims of health challenges which includes teenage pregnancy, abortion, suicide, sexually transmitted infections, HIV/AID, and drug abuse.

title: Open door school for blind children in Guadalajara
description: 87 ninos 87 children with visual impairments and other associated disabilities develop holistically at Helen Keller School.    With your contribution we guarantee the operation and make it possible for children to join regular schools

title: Save Maternal and Infant Lives in Pakistan
description: This zakat-eligible project supports maternal and infant health for poor villagers and urban slum dwellers within Pakistan.  Pakistan has the highest Infant Mortality Rate in the World and also accounts for 28 percent of the global Maternal Mortality Rate.  80 percent of Pakistan's infant deaths and over 33 percent of its maternal deaths are preventable - join the fight to save lives by sponsoring maternal and infant health within the HOPE USA hospital network!

title: Provide Psychiatric Medications in West Africa
description: This project will help finance essential medications for 14,000 residential patients with chronic mental illness and seizure disorders (epilepsy) in treatment at Association Saint-Camille (ASC).  ASC is a comprehensive outpatient and residential program in Benin, Togo, Ivory Coast and Chad.  Medication costs an average of $900,000 per year for 125,000 consultations.   ACS is unique in accepting all patients regardless of ability to pay. Patients are asked to pay $2.00 per month for medications.

title: Papi's Playhouse & Special Needs Enrichment Centre
description: This project will provide enrichment day-care centres for Papi and friends - our special needs birds. The structures would be close so we can keep an eye on them while they enjoy the outdoors, giving them freedom to safely adventure and relax.  Each area would incorporate their favourite foods, toys and spaces, greenery, safe rain-bathing and sun-bathing plus a noon-nap area.

title: Educational Aid &Life Skills for Children At Risk
description: This project will provide educational support and life skills training to children and young people at risk. Up to 500 children and young people will be assisted by this programme in Ukraine and Moldvova.

title: Gift nutrition and safe space for migrant children
description: This project runs creches in Bangalore- daycare centers for children of construction workers in the age group of above 6 months and under 6 years. The objectives of creches are to provide a safe environment and to provide protection, nutritional and immunization support, and a stimulating environment for the all-around development of these children.

title: Community Canteens: Food, Friendship and Fun
description: Be Enriched's Community Canteens bring people together using food and friendship. Our three Canteens are run by volunteers, who use surplus ingredients to cook fresh, healthy meals for residents. We offer the chance for people to meet others, learn skills, and gain confidence in the kitchen. All our Canteens are thriving hubs of activity, and everyone is welcome.

title: Education for Nomadic Children in Tibet
description: Education is a right no matter where you live. The Pureland Project supports Tibetan nomadic children by funding schools close to their families and their homeland.

title: The Wisdom Center: Bridging a Generational Gap
description: Health Nest Uganda, a nonprofit organization and member of the HelpAge Global Network, has found that older people in the community, particularly during COVID-19, can experience loneliness while facing deepening poverty and health issues. Younger people have little opportunity or space to engage with older people. To bridge this generational gap, Health Nest Uganda aims to create a Wisdom Center, which will provide a space for both groups to share their knowledge with one another.

title: Empowering Women in India at Every Stage of Life
description: The Desai Foundation's holistic approach to elevate the health and livelihood of underserved communities has led to empowerment of women and girls in rural India.  Our over 25 sustainable livelihood and health projects have impacted women at every stage of their lives. We organize health/hygiene camps, livelihood programs, and community awareness sessions. These programs prepare women and girls for each life stage and  encourage them to dream beyond their circumstances.

title: Sustain Palliative & Hospice Care in Lebanon
description: The devastating blast in the port of Beirut on August 4 and its economic repercussion on the national level has driven us to rearrange our priorities, bringing our sustainability at the forefront of all our concerns. This project will help SANAD to sustain its provision of comprehensive free of charge home-based hospice care to advanced chronically and terminally ill patients and their families in Lebanon, while preserving their dignity and enhancing the quality of their remaining life.

title: Ocean Academy Girls Rising and Staying in School
description: Girls Rising is an empowerment group started by girls at Caye Caulker Ocean Academy and part of the UN Girl Up movement. The club started as FLC (Female Leadership Community) with a focus on exploring emotions through journal writing. Now the girls want to invite guest speakers on topics such as self-esteem, domestic violence, communication skills and also financial literacy and entrepreneurship.

title: Advance Wellbeing for Mothers in Japan
description: Mothers in Japan have a high risk of pre/postnatal depression and face obstacles in rejoining the workforce and attaining leadership positions after childbirth. The gender gap in Japan is one of the worst in the world, and the pandemic has further aggravated the situation. This summer, WIT will launch the Board Fellow Program to support direct-service nonprofits in maternal health, which will build their organizational capacity and contribute to advancing women's wellbeing and gender equality.

title: Supporting Subsistence Farmers in Malawi
description: Through the Gift of the Givers Hunger Alleviation project in Malawi we will deliver farmer inputs to rural families who depend on agriculture for food and income. The farmer inputs provide a long-term food security solution to families who are otherwise surviving on less than a dollar a day.

title: Survival appeal
description: The coronavirus crisis means the near total loss of income for wildlife conservation NGO Biosphere Expeditions. Please help us survive the crisis by providing funding that will help us to make it through 2021 and 2022. Any donation, large or small, will help. Please give generously to help us survive!

title: Protecting the African Elephants from Extinction
description: A gift to this project will save an African Elephant from dying. Today poaching has increased tenfold, putting them at risk for the ivory trade along with the Rhino. Climate change is destroying habitats and tourist trade has really impacted their homes, they are fighting a loosing battle. On the current path our children's children will likely never see an elephant in the wild in Africa unless we step up and force change to help protect and save these amazing animals.

title: The Elspeth Jack Music Academy
description: The late Elspeth Jack first moved from Cape Town to the Napier district twenty years ago. Elspeth's keen interest in the local community and her desire to stimulate social upliftment left an indelible mark on her son Bruce, who continues her work through the HeadStart Trust - The Elspeth Jack Music Academy is established in her memory to provide music education opportunities and outreach programs for poor and needy children in impoverished, rural areas of South Africa.

title: Educate Girls in Zambia on Gender Equity
description: The primary objectives of the project are to address the issue of girls' education, and address the root causes that hinder their full participation and attendance, which have also been exacerbated as a result of COVID- 19. This will be done through school sessions and safe counselling groups, which will provide awareness and sensitize the students (including teenage boys) on the benefits of gender equity. The focus of the intervention will be to reduce the number of out of school girls.

title: A Ride for Hope Center Orphans
description: This project to replace our 17-year-old vehicle will assure safe transportation for over 150 orphans and staff to medical appointments, boarding schools, and errands for supplies.  Currently, nearly every trip incurs a breakdown in rural and dangerous areas.

title: Emergency Response: Sulawesi's Earthquake
description: ACT Foundation Disaster Management team is continuing to monitor for further developments and updates to overcome the situations and conduct data collection on the impact of the disaster. ACT Foundation is distributing emergency assistance to the affected people. To provide emergency relief, on a humanitarian basis, on material aid and emergency medical care necessary to save and preserve human lives. It also enables families to meet their basic needs for medical and health care, shelter, etc.

title: Plant 10,000 Trees to Reduce Carbon Footprints
description: Seva Mandir is working to restore degraded Aravalli hills in south Rajasthan. Till now, we have planted more than 2 million plants in the area which is drought prone and experience irregular rainfall. Through this project, we aim to plant 10,000 plants in this area which will restore local ecology and will also benefit local people with food, fuel and fodder. The local community will ensure survival of the plants making the project sustainable.

title: Covid Relief NC and SC
description: We have been deeply involved in sustaining North and South Carolinians with food, hygiene and PPE needs for six months.  We reallocated our entire 2020 budget to doing so as well as what we currently have remaining.  Our team has been also focused on making sure our elderly military veteran population (of over 750,000), as well as our civilian elderly, can survive this time in history, as they are often forgotten about.

title: Galiwin'ku Baby Hub
description: The Galiwin'ku Baby Hub is a wellbeing centre set up like a house where young parents, families and babies up to three years old can relax, learn about health practices, nutrition and be supported to thrive. Baby Hub targets community needs in collaboration with Miwatj Health Aboriginal Corporation to provide practical support to young mothers, parents and carers with underweight and anaemic babies in a home-like environment.

title: Nutritious Foods for Sierra Leone Students
description: Over 400 students, (ages 5-14) who attend Diamond Child School (est. 2005) are at risk of dropping out if they aren't guaranteed a balanced meal daily; for most, the only nutritious meal received in any given week. A healthy diet that includes vegetables and fruit boosts the immune system of these vulnerable "Diamonds", especially during this lingering Covid-19 pandemic. A nutritious meal is key to helping students listen, focus, learn and stay healthy, while staying in school!

title: Solar Wells for Women & Children in Syria!
description: It's been almost 10 years since the conflict in Syria began. Over 6.2 million people are displaced - and over half of this figure are women and children. For these families, living conditions are rough. Water is hard to come by, as wells were targetting by the conflict, leaving families with limited access. This project will empower displaced and vulnerable families by building self-sustaining solar-powered wells in displacement camps across northwest Syria.

title: Fight Menstruation Taboos Through Education
description: Harmful social norms, stigma, misconceptions and taboos surrounding menstruation marginalize women and girls. In India, menstruating women are often viewed as dirty, impure, sick and even cursed. In 2021, Save Kids Trust is focusing its work on women's issues. As part of this work, we're implementing a new education program by which community leaders will run workshops designed to dispel menstruation myths, providing women with the knowledge and resources they need to have healthy periods.

title: Continue GL's Legacy- All Funds Matched to $15k!
description: ALL FUNDS MATCHED up to $15k by an anonymous local foundation.  After 24 years of empowering students & serving our local & international communities, GL was forced to pause operations due to COVID. GL is asking for financial support to continue to serve the Northern Colorado community. GL has taken significant measures to cut costs to stay afloat through these difficult times (salaries, rent, insurance, etc...). Help GL leap into the new year stronger than ever. Donate today & SHARE THIS LINK!

title: 50+ Elderly Empowerment | Value Senior's Lives
description: For senior citizens aged more than 50-years, retirement brings them to face a great transition in life which makes them don't know where to put their efforts... The 50+ Elderly Empowerment project launches various classes to build up the elderly's skills to match their second careers which encourages them to be empowered with learning, have active interpersonal experiences in the classes, have a healthy physical condition, slow their aging, and value their own lives.

title: Empowering female newcomers with digital skills
description: She Matters' Lotus Flower Programme (LFP) provides career readiness training, mentorship and job placement opportunities for female newcomers in the Netherlands. In 2020, the LFP has been disrupted by COVID-19. We aim to provide online LFPs, allowing women across the country to gain both digital and soft skills needed for submitting online applications. Having an adequately-paid job will transform our participants' lives and have an immediate positive impact on them and their communities.

title: Literacy skills for 200 refugee women and girls
description: Ability to read and write is vital in helping women and girls access important information, build self-esteem and confidence to walk with one's head high, while helping them to actively participate and have a voice at local and national level on issues that affect them. This project will equip the illiterate refugee women and girls with basic literacy and numeracy skills through a six months integrated Functional Adult Literacy program.

title: Helping kids with clefts to Smile again (Colombia)
description: Fundacion Sonrie was born in Pereira (Colombia) 22 years ago. We help children with clefts from 5 departments (Risaralda, Caldas, Quindio, Choco, and Valle)  to smile again. We give our patients complete treatments that include operations, orthodontics, psychology, and speech therapy. The treatment for cleft lasts 17 years for each patient, so we accompany the patients and families during that time. If you want to know more about us. Our webpage is www.fundacionsonrie.org. SmileTrain is our ally

title: 5 Accessible Vehicles for Kids with Disabilities
description: Our team was in Sujawal few days ago to identify children with disabilities who can become part of our Special School. We were informed by people that there is a kid with disability named Mir Ali, who is desperately waiting for us. As soon as we went there, the first sentence he uttered was, "Can I please become a student at your school?" We are very close to fulfilling hopes of over 100 kids like Mir Ali with a fully equipped school. We are looking for your support for 5 accessible vehicles.

title: Help us to Save A Dad
description: Over 12,000 men die from prostate cancer every year in the UK.  And over 50,000 men are diagnosed with it.  Tackle Prostate Cancer acts as the patient voice for just under 100 prostate cancer support groups across the country and this project will allow us to support those groups with grants to carry out PSA tests in the community to help with early diagnosis. We want to #SaveaDad.

title: Educate a child from Kibagare Slum at St Martins
description: St Martins School is an oasis where 777 primary and almost 250 high school girls receive daily food, clean water, education, computer access, and guidance.  We are a non-profit and we rely on charitable donations to fund our activities. Our goal is to provide education with sponsorships to all our students and as many children from the Kibagare slum as possible. In communities like ours, one in five high school-aged girls are in school and we wish to bridge this for the good of this community.

title: Hearts For Hearts - Valentine's for IHF Students
description: At the Integral Heart Family, we believe in the power of kind hearts coming together. It's the energy of your generosity that sustains our program. This Valentine's Day weekend, we are calling on the hearts of all our supporters for our first funding drive of 2021. As we prepare our kids to engage in our home-study program, we continue to provide social work, food baskets, medical care, clothes, and education to 83 children and their families.

title: Help to eradicate bedbugs at Nakuru County Homes
description: Let come together and assist Gillian Sabatia Foundation to eradicate bedbugs and proper hygienic infestation at  Nakuru County houses for the elderly persons so that our elderly persons can have peace well sleeping. Most of a elderly persons have not tangible help.

title: Life-changing Education for South African Children
description: If only you could experience the joy in the hearts of the children that participate in Youth Potential South Africa - YOUPSA's After-School Enrichment program in rural South Africa! It takes a network to help a child unfold their full potential & become an engaged, confident and successful young adult. We invite you to become part of this beautiful family by supporting disadvantaged Primary School children to attend YOUPSA's life-changing program. We are the only education nonprofit in the area.

title: Provide poultry to 500 women and children with HIV
description: The project will provide one local chicken to each of the 500 poor, malnourished women and children living with HIV/AIDS yet with poor adherence to treatment due to poor feeding. This will act as a way to empower them start poultry farming for better nutrition and improved adherence to drugs.  The beneficiaries will benefit from the eggs, meat and direct sale of the chicken which will supplement on their nutrition and increase on their income levels from the sale of chicken.

title: Provide COVID Relief for Families in Rural India.
description: The COVID-19 crisis has devastated lives across the globe -- and has been especially brutal for the poor in rural Rajasthan, India. People from this arid region often migrate to distant cities to find work in order to support their families. The lockdown due to COVID-19 this past spring forced these migrant workers to return home. They have little food or money, and no work. The Barefoot College Tilonia has responded by organizing relief efforts in these rural communities.

title: Promote Good Health Through Sports in South Africa
description: Sports education and being active is a vital part of a child's development and success in schooling. However, for many children in South Africa, there is a lack of sports equipment, proper and safe infrastructure to practise in and often no teachers educated or dedicated to providing extra-curricular or sports education. Our goal is to provide our local township school in South Africa with the necessary resources and improved infrastructure to provide activities for the children.

title: Add Trees in MULIA Children's Home Gardens
description: This project supports home gardens to teach children farming skills, help the environment, and provide food and income to families in need. Each child will receive 5 fruit trees and 1 chicken. The child will learn how to take care of the chicken and also gain nutrition and income through egg production. The manure will be used as fertilizer for the trees.  We are amazed at the level of donor interests and so thank you to their generosity we are able to expand the program to reach even more kids.

title: Online education for 1250 low-income kids COVID-19
description: Mexico is the second country that after the pandemic will have the highest school dropouts between the ages of 6 and 17, approximately 628,000 students, according to IDB calculations.  With HOMEWORK we want to give teachers tools to continue teaching online classes, such as computers, chairs and internet.   With this we can ensure that thousands of children can continue in school despite the pandemic.

title: Cyclone Eloise Relief in Mozambique
description: Cyclone Eloise just hit Mozambique, causing widespread destruction, flooding, and displacement. Local ActionAid offices and community partners are coordinating immediate relief, including supplies like food, fuel, hygiene kits, and school books.

title: Fund Healthcare Awareness Workshop in South Africa
description: South Africa is facing a number of major issues when it comes to the healthcare system, and for a country with high rates of disease, this is not something they can afford to deal with. A lack of funding and pervasive poverty is keeping a high number of the population in ill health and with thousands dying due to a lack of testing centres, treatment facilities and inefficient infrastructure. Our local school is aiming to tackle these issues by becoming a hub for healthcare in the community

title: Feed 1500 Households a Month in Ramadan in Ghana
description: Ramadan Feed Project is an initiative under Achievers Ghana to help raise funds to feed (Iftar) up to 1500 poor and deprived households in slum communities of Ghana who affected by the economic effect of COVID-19 pandemic due to lockdown which has derailed their business ventures. These individuals finds it difficult to feed themselves and their families.  The funds raised will be used to purchase raw foodstuffs which can last for 29 or 30 days during the period of the month of Ramadan.

title: Together promoting leaders who transform education
description: La educacion y la ninez estan pasando por una crisis nunca antes vista. En una busqueda de apoyar a nuestros ninos, SER y Ensena por Mexico nos hemos aliado para seguir lideres y agentes de cambio que puedan ofrecer una educacion de calidad.   SER & Ensena por Mexico come together to support the promotion of leaders for the educational system. The COVID-19 pandemic elevated an already existing crisis in the education sector and it is time to create alliances.

title: Roaring back: Remove a snare, save a tiger
description: Tigers face a high risk of extinction. Google "tiger in Laos" or "tiger in Cambodia" and see for yourself - it has already happened.  Several areas previously recognized as "source sites" where tiger reproduction was documented a mere decade ago are now devoid of tigers altogether or experiencing rapid declines. With a population of ~500 individuals, Sumatra likely contains ~20-25% of the global number of wild tigers. But indiscriminate snare traps severely hinder Sumatran tiger conservation.

title: Sponsor Children to attend School in Zimbabwe
description: Early Childhood Development is a fundamental part of the success of all children and especially children living in difficult situations this can give them an opportunity to have a abetter start in life. Working with local partners in Zimbabwe we hope to improve the ECD learning by providing resources, teacher training and even assisting in developing schools in areas where children don't otherwise have access.

title: Invest in Menstrual Health for girls and women
description: This project supports young girls to remain in school and graduate. It also delivers a Community Menstrual Health programme through our trained Ambassadors to both men and women through education, eradication of myths and taboos, provision of reusable sanitary pads, access to clean water, handwashing facilities, and safe reliable washrooms in schools.

title: Tricycles Donation for Street Disable People
description: Sri Lanka is a high concentration with beggar community in South Asia. Most of them are disabled and cannot work on their daily work. This project will support disabled beggars and their families. They have taken to begging as they do not have homes any means of living and also as they do not have homes of their own. This situation has been arisen due to various factors prevailing in our society. Poverty, parental death and illness, loss of parental love

title: Helping Rural Communities in Nicaragua to Flourish
description: Nicaragua is the fourth most at-risk nation in the world due to climate change. We equip rural communities in Nicaragua with the skills and resources needed to develop sustainable responses that lift them from poverty and promote food security.

title: Cityzens Giving for Recovery Yokohama and Tokyo
description: In Yokohama and Tokyo, YouMeWe will support children and staff in care homes by equipping them with the essential goods and tools they need to run efficiently and provide a safe environment for children to live and learn.  Japanese translation is provided in the project documentation.

title: WOMEN FOR SMALL BUSINESS
description: The crises Cameroon is faced with affect both girls, boys, women and men differently.  Being a young boy, an adolescent, a man in the prime of life or an elderly woman greatly determines the role that each one plays within the family and the community, but also their experience, their capacities and their priorities in this regard, to whom  humanitarian assistance and protection services should be provided.

title: Support Montessori public education in Puerto Rico
description: Instituto Nueva Escuela serves Puerto Rican public schools that have opted for a public Montessori education as an instrument to achieve a social transformation in their communities. We provide them training, support, resources and we help the community to establish a shared governance strategy that empowers and strengthen the school.  This method has been successfully proven in 52 public schools and 8 non-profits. Our vision for 2025 is to be in 100 school communities around the island.

title: Center "Nasiliu.net" (No To Violence)
description: Our main task is to make the problem of domestic violence visible and create such conditions that the victims know where to find help, and society would stop blaming them for what happened.

title: Vocational Training - Women Escaping Prostitution
description: Her Academy is a revolutionary non-profit organization, working holistically to create a safe, empowering and accessible learning space for women escaping prostitution in Israel. Through 14-week vocational courses taught by  volunteer professionals, we help women seeking a stable economic future  - outside of sex work  - to develop skills and harness those they already have in the realization of secure and stable futures.

title: Alpha Edtech - Social Code Academy
description: An accelerated training code academy, with excellence, non-profit, that enables high-quality education for people in situations of vulnerability, talent for the IT area, focusing on the expansion of female and minority participation, in search of an opportunity to transform their reality. The project foresees the remuneration of these people to allow their full dedication during the training, working on real projects in direct connection with companies and the labor market.

title: Save the teachers from COVID-19 Pandemic set-back.
description: This campaign is up to supporting GOFA to be able to get out from the set back caused by COVID-19. Most of our programs were put on hold because of the pandemic but the most affected one is formal education program where we have a school project and now we are looking for support to be able to pay staff salaries, staff accommodation, feeding and other facilitations.

title: Help Women independency during COVID.
description: Along with Project Tres, we support 15 women who are the mothers of our "babies" at the Hai Center. With our partnership, these women became artisans and nowadays the "Mamas company" plays an important role in their lives: they depend on it to feed their families and pay the rent for their homes. Strengthening our women through emotional and financial support directly impacts their lives and, consequently, their families, and the community around them.

title: Build Vocational School to Train 400 Dominicans/Yr
description: Cienfuegos, Dominican Republic is home to some of the most destitute people in the world. Residents live in shacks made from materials scavenged from the local dump. Most have no way of making money to provide for themselves or their families. This project proposes the construction of a vocational school to provide FREE training in mechanics, medical assisting, plumbing, construction, cosmetology, and more so the citizens of Cienfuegos can become self-sufficient and gainfully employed.

title: TAILORING TRAINING TO POOR GIRLS AND WOMEN INDIA
description: The target group Adolescent Girls, Widows and Women are drawn from the lower strait of the society where influenced people are dominating and ruling them since the ages together. Poverty is the main drawback found in almost all the families where the unemployment and seasonal income do not satisfying their livelihood requirements. Sometimes they are migrating to some other places in searching of work for their daily bread. Their deriving income do not used for the production purpose,

title: Enpowering Young Women Through Education
description: It is time for young women in Kenya to stand up for their rights to a high-quality education. The necessity is not only the obvious empowering of young women who are often left to fend for themselves, but also for their own children or future children. An educated woman will be an educated mother who will bring up her children to understand that education is the key to the future.
