We have managed to raise $16,000 and we need to raise $7334. after this expansion we expect to be accommodating 800 people which is double the current number

title: RELIEF FUND: avoiding starvation for 110000 people
description: With two million dollars, WeForest can buy enough seeds and material for over 110,000 people so they can plant in May, harvest in November and feed their families for at least a year. This urgent intervention will make a real difference and save 23,000 farmers' families from further cycles of poverty and starvation.

title: Supporting Children with Disabilities in Uganda
description: MAITS Community Healthworker Empowerment Programme (CHW) will train 60 Community Healthworkers based at two centres in rural Uganda, Kyaninga Chlldren's Centre in Karabole and Kasole. Our programme will support 240 children with developmental disabilities, from cerebral palsy to autism, and 240 caregivers in  resource-poor districts where there is little access to therapeutic intervention. Our training will improve children's quality of life and independence, as well a parents/carers' wellbeing.

title: Climate Change Along the Amazon River
description: The vast, pristine forests of northern Peru are home to an incredible array of rare wildlife. But this spectacular diversity - along with the indigenous Cocama people that live there - are under serious threat due to intense climate fluctuations that cause severe, unpredictable floods and droughts. Working with the Cocama, Earthwatchers collect data on the health of the ecosystem to help improve their traditional hunting and fishing activities and to develop climate change mitigation strategies.

title: Hurricane ETA & IOTA Nicaragua Response
description: Taking into consideration the high risk that Nicaragua has in the face of natural disasters, the Nicaraguan Red Cross provides rescue, search and rescue services for people who have been affected by the disaster. It also offers humanitarian assistance through primary health care, food delivery, hygiene kit, kitchen kit, mosquito nets, Reinforced Plastic, among others.

title: TRANSFORMING WASTES INTO SALABLE ECOFRIENDLY ITEMS
description: As trash breaks down in landfills, it releases methane and nitrous oxide gases. Approximately eighteen percent of methane gas in the atmosphere comes from wastes disposal and treatment.  Reducing, reusing and recycling is a key part of climate change strategy to reduce our green house gases emission and reduces carbon emission. Creating employment to women in the community by making salable crafts. To bring income to households and enhance their social welfare.

title: Relief through art and laughter in Lebanon
description: Awrad-Clown Me In spreads laughter, fights inequality and heals through the power of performing arts. Our artistic relief work aims to help people overcome the traumas caused by the very hard social and financial conditions in Lebanon. We reach people in remote areas, refugee camps, and underprivileged suburbs.

title: Women and Girls Education Support
description: We will provide educational support to women and girls in very poor villages. Education is the best way for women and girls to succeed in life but oftentimes and due to poverty and lack of resources this access is denied them. We will provide free education on topics ranging from health and hygiene, small business incubation, home economics, local livelihoods, good parenting and the rights of women and girls. In addition we will provide immediate material relief especially during disaster.

title: Support local entrepreneurs REDEMPRENDE IMBABURA
description: Promote the economic and social development of the province with the creation and implementation of a Network of Entrepreneurs with an Inclusive Approach, focused on benefiting families from the rural parishes of Otavalo, Cotacachi, Antonio Ante, Urcuqui, Ibarra and Pimampiro, which articulate producers and consumers, towards a production and commercialization of the emblematic products of the rurality of the province in new markets, generating more economical incomes to participants families.

title: Polio - Help eradicate this terrible disease
description: This project will help to eradicate Polio from the world and make it only the 2nd disease ever to be eradicated.   Since 1988 Rotary has worked tirelessly to eradicate Polio and we are 99.9% there. Just 2 Countries to go.

title: Shelter, Feed&Educate a needy child in Rural Kenya
description: -TFEC aims to keep students in school to bring hope to very needy & vulnerable rural Kenyan children,nurture them to fit and compete favorably in the society  -We aim to offer free feeding to orphans and less fortunate children in the center   -We aim to protect those at risk of sexual abuse, forced early marriages by giving free healthcare, sanitary pads,tution materials and free education -we protect them  against COVID-19  -We aim to support our students in  secondary schools after grade 8

title: Rwanda: Help 82 kids study without Covid-19 risks.
description: When schools reopened in Rwanda after a whole year due to COVID-19 the challenge has been accommodating children. Despite the construction of additional classrooms, still classrooms were over-crowded. This is how SPES NOVA Junior Academy was created to help address the issue. Since then, the school embarked on a long process of finding enough classrooms, school equipment and materials, teachers for 82 kids. Unfortunately, the school still needs basic facilities such as water and toilets.

title: House of Hope - A way out for homeless women
description: Many women in India suffer extreme cruelty at the hands of their families. There is a need to provide shelter for homeless women who receive no support. El Shaddai accommodates a safe house for homeless women in difficult circumstances.

title: Clean water for 11 970 students in Burkina Faso
description: This project will provide 11,970 students in 45 villages in Burkina Faso with 45 boreholes to make drinking water available. The action of Global NEEED Burkina will contribute to improve the living conditions of the population through the reduction of cases of water-related diseases, to reduce the time reserved for fetching water by women and children. It will also raise the school attendance. In short, this project will raise students' school performance.

title: PROJECT RURAL SCHOOL SAFETY AND SANITARY HEALTH
description: The project seeks to promote a safe,healthy,and sustainable learning environment for rural primary pupils and schools in Nigeria,where infrastructures such as improved learning classrooms, toilets,and water facilities are lacking.  The basic aim of the project is to improve the learning environment for rural primary pupils and schools with basic learning facilities as well as reduce their vulnerability to hazards, especially girls, who defecate in bushes and walk many miles to in search of water

title: Noche De Cine Gratis -help the children of the DR!
description: The Noche De Cine Gratis program will bring a traveling movie theater and life improving educational seminars to over 10,000 underserved and poverty stricken children throughout the North Coast of the Dominican Republic.

title: Help us make 1,200 children smile and dream awake
description: We are a group of young volunteers that are looking to transform lives of unprotected children who live in vulnerable situations throughout our different programs. Sonar Despierto not only changes lives of children but also from volunteers who realize they can use their abilities to make a positive impact in their community.  We seek to light the fire of hope in the hearts of our kids, parents and volunteers who are a part of this big family. It's a team work and we need you to make it happen.

title: Helping our elderlies while they get vaccinated
description: The goal of this campaign is to protect older adults while they wait to be vaccinated. For achieving that , we need your help to be able to implement cutting-edge technology in nine care centers and in a hostel for elderlies, during the months of March to May in order to follow the WHO recommendation of testing, tracing and isolating COVID-19 cases.

title: Agro-Forestry Project for Indigenous of Honduras
description: This project will help 80 poor indigenous families living in the dry corridor of Honduras.  Using an agro-forestry model, it will diversify and improve the diet of at least 400 men, women and children and help create surpluses for sale, as well as enhance the environment and increase water conservation. Farming in this way will give the families added resiliency to climate change disasters that are plaguing Honduras.

title: Forest preservation in Mexico Manos a la Tierra
description: Each year 4.7 million acres of forest are lost in the world, exacerbating the effects of climate change. For 14 years, Manos a la Tierra has inspired thousands of volunteers to join activities for the preservation of forests, planting around 450,000 trees in Mexico without any financial support. Your donation would allow us to carry out more reforestations, river cleanings, pest control, prevention and control of forest fires and soil regeneration and the purchase of the necessary equipment.

title: Help recover Rheas population in Chilean Patagonia
description: Darwins Rhea plays a key role in the Patagonian steppe as seed dispersers. In 2014 less than 20 birds remained in the Chacabuco Valley after a century of overgrazing, fencing, poaching and egg collection. The rescue of two orphaned rhea chicks (Ojitos y Cote) triggered the creation of a Rhea Breeding Center. There have been 5 releases of rheas into the wild by the Tompkins Conservation Chile team, led by women. We aim to achieve a wild population of 100 rheas in Patagonia National Park

title: The Cultural Imperative Program
description: CIP increases cultural awareness and enhances critical thinking skills for students of color. Critical thinking skills are essential to academic success and also influence how students navigate their daily activities. A foundation of cultural awareness for people of African ancestry is built upon accurate interpretations of African history and culture, which will positively impact students' self-image and behavior, and strengthen their connection to Africa.

title: Support the integration of 50 disadvantaged youth
description: Sport dans la Ville is a not-profit organisation, founded in 1998, with the mission to drive underserved youth into careers of meaning and stability through sport.  Sport dans la Ville operates in 51 urban, low-income neighborhoods. We use the power of sport to help young people across the country get into education, training and employment. Today, all our programs serve young people at every single stage of their development (from early childhood through young-adulthood).

title: Serving 1,765 elderly in our In-Home Care Program
description: The 1,765 elderly we serve are facing not just isolation and effects of loneliness, but many times abandonment, exacerbated by preexisting inequalities and long stories of deprivations, health problems, poverty, and social exclusion. In addition, the long coronavirus restrictions have aggravated all the above factors. Our aim is to provide them quality of life, preserving personal independence and dignified-end-of-life care. We need your help to continue assisting on this life-saving cause.

title: OVD-Info: stop political persecutions in Russia
description: OVD-Info is an independent media project on human rights and political persecutions in Russia. We provide and coordinate legal assistance in cases related to the restrictions of freedom of peaceful assembly and study the emerging problems this helps both to develop tactical solutions for today, and to lay the foundation for future changes. By donating to OVD-Info, you contribute both to the support of specific people and to changing the whole picture of human rights observance in Russia.

title: Shelter for 50 at-risk children
description: One million internally displaced people living in Shire, Tigray, Ethiopia. Among them are separated and unaccompanied children.  The children have been traumatized by the effects of the war and sometimes they have been abused. The children live without adult caregiver thus exposing them to more risks. Abraham's Oasis provides temporary shelter for these children till a permanent solution within their family can be found. The children receive holistic services during their stay.

title: Prevent Child Abuse America: Empowering Parents
description: We can prevent child abuse by supporting parents. This project will fund a new initiative for parent graduates of Healthy Families America. The group will help train graduates to serve as mentors to new parents and to advocate for family friendly policies in their communities. Healthy Families America reduces child abuse and domestic violence, improves child and maternal health and education outcomes. We serve 70K families annually across the U.S., and this project will expand that impact.

title: Hope for disabled people
description: Disabled and physically challenged young people and adults in Nigeria are at risk of extreme social exclusion. Sadly, such ignorance results in many being neglected, abandoned and isolated from an early age leading to early death as well.    Our project provides support for physical and mental needs in a secure environment, with a basic education, to improve their own future and the way that disability is regarded in their community.

title: Food Bank /Food Distribution
description: Food - The program at Life's Investments is an education curriculum and employment training program to prepare individuals for successful and stable employment in the food services industry. The curriculum includes food services operations, kitchen fundamentals, basic cooking techniques, professional licenses/certifications, and professional portfolio basics.  Online resources, mentoring, and real-life work experiences prepare students for a variety of foodservice careers such as chef, prep,

title: End Workplace Discrimination with AI
description: COVID-19 has worsened disparities found in workplaces worldwide. In the US alone, 80% of pandemic job loss has affected women, and 25% of women might reduce their hours or leave altogether. Compounding on this, minority women have had the highest rates of unemployment throughout the beginning of the pandemic. Sexism is a Goliath to tackle and can make a solution seem pretty impossible. That is where AI comes in. Simply put- our project will screen for bias and incentivize companies to do better.

title: Computers for Pathway Students in Africa
description: Computers for Pathway Students in Africa is a powerful project directed by The Lord's Hands, a humanitarian NGO based in Democratic Republic of Congo. Responding to the desperate need of BYU-Pathway Worldwide students throughout Africa for computers capable of completing university-level courses, The Lord's Hands awards refurbished computers to students through a competition. Students, who would have to withdraw due to inadequate equipment and no funds, are enabled to graduate and lift others.

title: SPONSOR 50 ORPHANS IN PAKISTAN
description: Roshni Homes Trust provides residency, education, safety and a host of other services to orphan children without parental care in Pakistan. Whilst providing adequate housing for 80+ orphaned children, Roshni Homes delivers Social and Moral Development, Health and Physical Development, Academic Development and Support, and fundamentally, a regular family unit, preparing the children to depart from Roshni Homes as productive citizens.

title: Heartfelt love for families in need in the DR
description: With this project, 600 families in extreme poverty and from the poorest neighborhoods of Santo Domino will receive nutritious food, gifts, new clothes, toys for the children, recreational activities and happiness. We will develop for them a program of activities that includes both solidarity aid and training events to begin to build with them the realization of a great dream, that they can achieve the financial stability that is needed through education.

title: Enhance (mental) health of 1,358 Kenyan youths
description: In Trans Nzoia County, Kenya, KAP will enhance the emotional and social capacities of 1,358 youths (of whom 338 intensively) facing mental health challenges, in order to enable them choose healthy behaviors, especially those concerning sexual health, alcohol/substance abuse and trauma/violence prevention and management (& COVID-19). KAP does so by providing community-based training of 'Unreached Youths' Community Resource Persons and professional counselling and (psycho-) education services.

title: Free artistic training for 150 children in DR
description: The economic depression caused by Covid 19 has strongly affected the Dominican Republic, and there are few teachers of the arts who are willing to teach children and adolescents from impoverished communities for free or economically. Our institution has been working to revive and now protect and promote the musical arts. This project now supports up to 150 impoverished children, between the ages of 8 and 17, from the Haina and San Cristobal neighborhoods to receive free quality classes in the ar

title: Socio-emotional learning for young people Brazil
description: This project aims to design and implement a socio-emotional education course and to prepare a life project for young people in vulnerable situations.We believe that young people who are better prepared to deal with their emotions, and more confident of their abilities, will make more conscious choices and follow more successful personal and professional paths, improving their future lives. We have several partners, such as the Department of Social-Human Rights Education in Rio de Janeiro.

title: A Gift of an Education.. Will Change a Generation
description: Our mission: Have Hammer Will Travel A.C. (HHWT) teaches Mexican youths (both boys and girls) life skills through woodworking, carpentry and CAD. The current job market requires more advanced skills. As vocational leaders, we are committed to filling gaps in education and life skills to ensure that local Chapala's Mexican youths ages 11 to 19 in year 2021 receive these skills, gain confidence and the required training they need to excel in this job market.

title: Keep a Girl Child Safe and Educated in Malawi
description: A Girl Child is at risk of dropping out of school, abused and raped because of lack of academic resources, leading to early pregnancies and marriages. Malawi has registered an extremely increase (63%) in teen pregnancies and marriages especially during this period of COVID-19 pandemic. Our project aims at empowering and providing access to academic resources to the less privileged girl child learners around Ndirande community as a means to keep a girl child safe, occupied and empowered.

title: Give education to 60 vulnerable Roma children
description: CSI NADEZ is running Educational Centre for children from vulnerable groups, in the biggest Roma municipality in Europe-Shuto Orizari.  We are preparing and getting these children into school, by providing all necessary school materials, additional after-school support, nutrition snacks and advisory support for the parents. Donations to this project will provide our Centre to be able to educate up to 60 children per year, ages 5-14,and help new generations build their future through education.

title: Fruit trees for micronutrient-rich diets in Zambia
description: In Zambia, heavily starch-based diets are common, and child malnutrition is high. This project is working with health workers and government nutritionists to raise awareness of the dietary value of indigenous fruits and wild foods like caterpillars. It also works with nursery operators to grow seedlings of these important trees. The aim is 10,000 homes with year-round diets rich in micronutrients and new earnings from sale of fruit. "We did not know we could plant these trees," say communities.

title: Food for Good for Cancer Patients in Kenya
description: A healthy and nutritious diet is important during treatment and management of cancer.This project will ensure that up to 200 cancer patients and their caregivers will gain food security and better nutrition through vegetable cone gardens.Fresh organic produce will provide proper nourishment for these patients as they undergo treatment for various cancers. The 2013 National Guidelines for Cancer Management in Kenya identifies nutrition care for person with cancer as an integral part of treatment.

title: Aid for 750 malnourished children in Afghanistan
description: Village of Peace will provide help to 750 malnourished children in Afghanistan. Our teams will visit weekly the families at home to follow up on the situation of the child and provide meals. The group of malnourished children will be selected in consultation with Social Work in Afghanistan. During the period of providing aid to the malnourished children, we will also support the families to achieve sustainable change for the future by training.

title: Future Rising: Girls' Education and Climate Change
description: Future Rising is a new Girl Rising initiative to address the deep links between girls' education and the world's ability to address climate change. A multi-pronged storytelling project, public awareness campaign, and education program, Future Rising aims to advance girls' access to quality education and influence leaders to prioritize gender equity, and specifically educating girls, as part of climate change and climate justice action.

title: Help us prevent teenage pregnancy in DR
description: In the Los Manguitos community, there are still many challenges faced by adolescent girls and young women in obtaining adequate menstrual and reproductive health and counseling services. This situation has been worsened by the COVID-19 crisis. Teen pregnancies are on the rise. With this project the Foundation intends to improve its sexual, reproductive and menstrual health services for its more than 200 young women to include: weekly health text messages; monthly access to pregnancy tests; acces

title: United Against Hunger in the Rio Grande Valley
description: Food insecurity is a crisis affecting a disproportionate percentage of our population. The Rio Grande Valley is one of the poorest places in the U.S. The safety net isn't large enough or sturdy enough to support all of those who are suffering from food insecurity stemming from high unemployment and escalating food costs. We are distributing lots of food. And we're hiring young workers who need an income boost to help us do it more efficiently.

title: Provide 500 At-Risk Youth with Education Services
description: Pandemic Professors offers individualized education services to at-risk youth. We pledge to fight the effects of the growing inequalities caused from COVID-19 and school closures. We provide 1:1 tutoring services, as well as ESL tra, financial literacy, coding tutoring, and socioemotional support. We have served over 250 students in 20 states, and we are dedicated to serving more students in need, with the ultimate goal of closing the education gap caused by socioeconomic and racial disparities.

title: Sponsor Working Children in Guatemala
description: Traffickers exploit thousands of Guatemalan children by forced labor within the country, often in agriculture or domestic service. Indigenous Guatemalans, especially children, are particularly vulnerable to being exploited through forced labor. We fight against the labor trafficking of 100 indigenous children by removing barriers to education, providing programs to children in hazardous work, and prevention education to indigenous tribes in Guatemala. The time to end child slavery is now!

title: End Poverty and Empower Women Through Education
description: The Gibson Soto Foundation works to break the poverty cycle by supporting young women from impoverished or marginalized communities in Mexico to complete university-level education and providing additional programs and developmental skills to have a sustainable, fulfilling life and rise above poverty.  This project will give the gift of education to 10 more amazing women, allowing them to break down barriers of gender inequality, leave poverty behind, and achieve a new life beyond their dreams.

title: Grow brighter futures for 301 Guatemalan children
description: The Covid Adaptation Fund will offset the rising costs of our hybrid preschool program. Students are coming to school in small 4-person groups twice a week, and their parents facilitate the rest of the activities at home. This fund will help us provide phone data for children to communicate with teachers, safe transportation for in-person classes, training for parents, a book-lending program, cleaning supplies, and an emergency food bank for the most vulnerable families.

title: Cradle to Grave: Providing Basic Needs For Living
description: Doesn't everyone deserve necessities for everyday living? For 28 years we have provided holiday gifts for over 25,000 people. With this project we want to ensure that hundreds of people of all ages, cradle to grave from under resourced communities, will have access to items to keep themselves clean, warm, clothed, cared for and safe each day. Fresh diapers.  Clean clothing.  Warm blankets.  Necessary toiletries.  Access to incontinence pads and tools for aging safely.

title: E-VEN : Evening the educational gap in Venezuela
description: Education Venezuela "E-VEN" offers educational opportunities for children and adults living in Los Roques and Canaima, two highly touristic difficult access communities in Venezuela. By teaching demographically adapted English focused on 3 main pillars; tourism, conservation, and civic values E-VEN aims to promote economic diversification and growth by diminishing the communication barrier. The place you were born should not limit your opportunities, we EVEN them !

title: Nutritious Diet for 15 Children with Disabilities
description: Mother Charitable Foundation (MCF) is a registered nongovernment initiative working for the children with disabilities, who are often at a disadvantage due to difficult access to education, planned to provide institutional care with free nutritional diets to 15 children with disabilities from families with low income, while providing  an intensive education & skill training programme to develop their communication, behavioral, literacy, arithmetic, esthetic & vocational skills.

title: Caring for Life-Limited Children, Northern Ireland
description: This project will support Northern Ireland Children's Hospice to purchase new specialist equipment to safely care for babies, children and young people with life-limiting conditions. Each year, this charity provides respite, symptom management and end of life care to more than 370 children, both in the family home and at Horizon House in Newtownabbey (the only children's hospice in the province). This care is free of charge and available to any family in need.

title: Goat for Women's Nutrition and Income
description: We will provide goats, supply of vitamins and medicines and forage starter seeds for 700 poor women farmers so that they are able to start their goat-raising livelihood for their income, nutrition and well-being. The goats are easy to raise, does not require large investment as they eat only grasses and is always highly demanded in the market especially with the swine disease attacking swine industry. Raising goats have the potential to improve the well-being of women.

title: SAVE 160 Vulnerable Older People from LONELINESS
description: Loneliness can affect anyone at any time - you, your relatives, your loved ones. The pandemic has made things far worse, especially for older people living alone. For the vulnerable and housebound, this has a devastating impact on a person's mental health. For those living with dementia, it can quite literally mean the difference between life and death. Your donation will bring loneliness to an end through practical support that connects older people with their communities, families and friends.

title: Crisis Relief to People in Myanmar
description: The people of Myanmar need your support to weather devastating upheaval and to rebuild their lives safely. Engaged groups on the ground are finding that adolescent girls in rural villages are particularly impacted. The girls are multiply burdened -as girls, children, often poor, and those from minority ethnic and religious groups-and are quickly taking on very real adult responsibilities that put them at-risk and tend to limit their future opportunities.

title: Protect endangered biodiversity & 100 farmer lives
description: Do you want to protect one of Earth's last biodiversity strongholds - the Osa Peninsula in Costa Rica - and support the livelihoods of its inhabitants? The Osa Peninsula is "the most biologically intense place on earth" (National Geographic). The Sustainable Agriculture Network (SAN) needs your support to conduct training and capacity building with 100 farmers and their families on environmental friendly agricultural production practices, biodiversity protection and forest restoration.

title: Help 200 children change their lives through music
description: Sistema Cyprus is a social-music orchestra and choir program established in 2018, offering free music education to the children and young people of the small island of Cyprus, including migrants, refugees and children and young people with fewer opportunities.  Sistema Cyprus ensures these groups are respected, recognized and included in society, focusing on the personal development of its participants focusing primarily on empowerment and helping them reach their full potential through music.

title: Revive Elimu Resource Centre in Kenya
description: Elimu Resource Centre makes a huge impact on children in Malindi, Kenya. Using digital technology we put educational resources into hands that had never held a textbook much less a laptop!  Since 2018, thousands of energetic kids have passed through its rooms and stairways-leaving their mark. Walls are discoloured. Paint is peeling. Outdoor signs are faded by the sun.  It used to make a great visual impact as well as a huge educational impact. Will you help us revive Elimu Resource Centre?

title: Brighter future for 275 dogs of Guatemalan dump
description: The indigenous community of Lemoa in Guatemala is home to hundreds dogs & cats that survive from the garbage found in the nearby dump. Reproduction of animals is accelerated and they struggle to survive outbreaks of infectious and skin diseases, as well as malnutrition. We need to spay & neuter 275 dogs & cats to immediately stop exponential breeding and provide a better quality of life to these animals. This campaign will be accompanied by 4 educational workshops on responsible pet ownership.

title: Mobile Clinic Initiative & Institute Construction
description: The  AIMST project will address health/education needs by constructing the Oti Institute of Science and Technology that will train healthcare workers to provide medical services in the region, as well as train the youth to be cognizant of programs in Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics (STEAM). The immediate strategic plan also includes the purchasing of a mobile clinic and hiring two nurses to provide medical services, as well as conduct STEM programs for about 20 youth.

title: CONSTRUCTION OF 3 HOUSES FOR VULNERABLE FAMILIES
description: Our Foundation seeks financing for the construction of around 50 houses in the different Municipalities of the Dominican Republic, but we do not have the necessary resources to start this project, in the first phase we want to build 3 houses for the most vulnerable families in the Municipality of Haina, San Cristobal Province, these families live in unsanitary and precarious conditions, our commitment and hope is that these families can have a decent roof.

title: Help orphan children to get healthy
description: Shag navstrechu (Step Forward) is raising money for providing regular medical help to dozens of boys and girls with developmental disorders and health issues from a specialized orphanage.

title: From the Rooftops! Urban Community Garden Program
description: Beirut Art Center's community rooftop garden is a mutual aid initiative centered around food sovereignty. The garden seeks to connect local grassroots initiatives and provide farmers a foothold in the city, while creating an interdisciplinary approach to questions of sustenance, with farmers, activists and artists. The project centers around a vegetable garden and a seed bank, to create a hands on approach to alternative forms of nutrition, political thought and social organizing.

title: Support Foster to plant 4000 trees in Merida!
description: Do you think is normal to feel warmer every year? See neighbors flooded by strong tropical storms?  In Merida, my friends, neighbors, and relatives more often experience these problems and deforestation is one of the main causes. Trees regulate temperature, provide shade, cool the air, and filter water into the ground. Trees are urgently needed to remedy this problem!  I ask your help to, with Kanan Kab, produce and plant 4,000 native trees, benefiting neighbors and families of Merida city.

title: Stand Together with CKA & #StopAsianHate
description: The rise of anti-Asian hate sentiment has precipitated renewed efforts to serve and protect our most vulnerable populations in under-resourced Korean American communities. Stand with us as we commit to #StopAsianHate and uplift Korean Americans with limited access to 1) care for the elderly; 2) mental health/family counseling services, and 3) economic support for undocumented families.

title: Empower 1000 Nigerian Girls to End Sexual Violence
description: In Nigeria, 1 in every 4 girls is subjected to sexual violence before her 18th birthday. Through after-school education clubs and empowering martial arts training, this project will equip 1000 vulnerable adolescent girls with basic self-defense skills while increasing their knowledge about sexual violence and their confidence to advocate strongly against sexual violence across their local communities.

title: Give Clean Water to 300 New Mothers in North Haiti
description: We are partnering with the trailblazing organization of MamaBaby Haiti to build a solar-powered water filtration system at the new MamaBaby Clinic in Cap Haitien! Your contribution will help provide thousands of gallons of life-giving water to hundreds of Mamas, Babies, and everyone in-between for years to come.

title: Restoring rights of 60 children in San Salvador
description: As Fundacion Viva Juntos por la ninez El Salvador we are working on a project aimed at restoring the limitation of children's rights exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic, which has caused severe damage to mental and physical health, access education, malnutrition and food insecurity, as well as limited recreational spaces. That is why friendly spaces for learning, integration and play are being created for the children of communities and markets of San Salvador, restoring their rights.

title: Divest from Factory Farming
description: Factory farming is unsustainable and causes tremendous animal suffering, environmental degradation, and social and health problems in neighboring communities. To meet the climate goals and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), a global shift in food systems is urgent. For that to happen, investors need to shift where their money is going.

title: Give an education to 100 teenage mothers in Ghana
description: Due to the COVID-19 pandemic resulting in closure of schools, lots of school going girls in rural Ghana have become pregnant and if nothing is done immediately to send them back to school, they would be married off and have their lives destroyed. This project seeks to support 100 teenage mothers in rural Ghana go back to school to acquire secondary or vocational/technical education. The project will give scholarships to these girls to enable them go back and stay in school till completion.

title: Create a community library in rural Costa Rica
description: Futuro Verde will expand their book space into a community library, providing literacy support, cultural enrichment and life skills to the children of the village of Cobano and surrounding communities in rural Costa Rica.

title: Help wounded soldiers and refugees (Karabakh war)
description: During the war in Nagorno-Karabakh, tens of thousands Armenian refugees, including women, children and the elderly were taken out to Armenia for security purposes. About 40,000 refugees lost their homes as a result of bombing and the opportunity to return to their homes doesn't seem realistic. Several thousand soldiers, mostly young people, were injured.  The goal of the program is to provide emergency assistance to wounded soldiers and  refugees  living in different social centers in Armenia.

title: Help Tackle the Conservation and Climate Crisis
description: This project supports locally led, collaborative initiatives, across Latin America, Africa, Asia and the Pacfic, that work towards reducing habitat and species loss, and support local communities to protect their natural resources and adapt to the climatic change. The goal of this project is to work globally to increase awareness of the current conservation and climate crisis we face and mitigate against their combined effects

title: PAKISTAN COVID AFFECTEES NEED HELP
description: PAK MISSION SOCIETY is launching an International Appeal for supporting 500 COVID affected families through Food Support and Life Saving Equipment's. The unreached and people living under poverty are the focus of this Appeal. COVID enters through 1 person and usually affects everyone at home; disrupting the complete livelihood chain and putting all family at risk . The total cases in Pakistan reaches to 637,042 and total deaths so far are 13,965. We need to STANDING NEXT TO THOSE STAND ALONE1111

title: Restore devastated classrooms in Marib, Yemen
description: This project will help to restore two devastated classrooms of 200 students in the Marib city in the northwest of Yemen by providing restoration, double chairs other teaching/learning materials. Some students bring their own chairs from home to sit on which adds gravely to their impoverishment and destitution. As students are taught in wrecked wet classrooms, number of students- especially girls- are dropped out as they frequently get sick because of the unhealthy environment in the classes.

title: Relief Hub for families of COVID-19 victims
description: Covid-19 has had a tremendous impact on people ranging from children, young people, adults, parents and the elderly, some of whom have lost a spouse, family member or loved one. Nurturing Foundations plans to provide a hub where children will have access to books and STEM materials to promote their creativity and innovation and also provide support, information and resources to adults and families of the victims of the pandemic ensuring that they live happier and healthier lives going forward.

title: Healing children and youth in Sri Lanka
description: This project will fund the Shanthi Maargam "Art of Living" youth center which provides free professional counseling, mindfulness meditation, art and music therapy to strengthen the emotional well-being of children and youth in low-income multi ethno-religious communities in Colombo. Children and Youth develop skills to manage emotions, find a deeper level of peace, and in the long-term learn to break the cycle of violence in their families and communities.

title: Transform unemployed Youth with Computer training
description: Built Africa is a youth and women development centre based within Pretoria, South Africa. Our key focus areas are economic empowerment in the form of skills development and Computer skills training as well as mentorship for unemployed youth and women between 18 to 35 years old. The aim of computer training is to equip 240 youth and women with a skill that is highly sought and used at the workplace for a better chance of securing employment to achieve their full potential in life.

title: Sponsor Environmental Education of Kids in Brazil
description: This project will equip and maintain a community school in a rural village in the mountains of Northeast Brazil. As well as providing a holistic and joyful education to over 150 children, the school seeks to empower the next generation to be economically autonomous and to be guardians of the environment in this important ecological reserve and resist the growing urbanisation and destruction of natural beauty spots and wildlife habitats.

title: Protect lions in Namibia from retaliatory killings
description: The Kevin Richardson Foundation, in partnership with the Namibian Lion Trust, is working towards reducing human-wildlife conflict in the Kunene region of Namibia. By collaring lions and training locals to become lion guards, both local communities and their livestock, as well as wild lions, are protected. The project will supply predator-proof bomas for livestock which secures the livelihoods of villages. Being a flagship species, healthy lion populations result in overall ecosystem health.

title: Hi Life - Support The Syrian Newborn Babies
description: The conflict in Syria has lasted a decade. A generation of Syrian children has known nothing but violence, hardship, destruction, and deprivation. We in IDA are serving in North West Syria where1.4 population are living in camps and tents in poor living conditions.  on average 370 new babies say Hi to Life in IDA's 24 clinics and 2 Hospitals in North Syria amonth. The new babies need to be protected with baby clothes set holds warmth and happiness.  Please help us to support 250 newborn children

title: Hearing screenings to detect childhood deafness
description: In Colombia, 3- 5% of screened children under the age of 5 are found to have hearing deficiencies.  Appropriate treatment and follow-up can pose significant challenges since much of this population migrates often due to political and economic factors.   In this project, your donation will directly support Oyeme's work detecting and addressing young children's hearing loss through additional screenings , and enhanced education of care-givers on related behavioral signs and overall hearing care.

title: Jookender Family Camp September 2021 Boston, MA
description: This project helps to build a vibrant and diverse community of 1st generation Russian Speaking Jewish Refugee families to the United States and rekindle their Jewish identity, connect Teens through generations, and overall increase the health and well-being of this highly underserved community, especially, right after the COVID ease, when many families are left without employment and the ability to provide their children with proper educational and emotional care.

title: Keep 250 Pets Out of Shelters
description: One of saddest things is watching a pet owner walk out a shelter door in tears, leaving behind a bewildered and often scared pet they love, but could not afford to keep.  Second Chance is more than just a shelter, providing access to affordable veterinary care and a pet food pantry program to help keep people and pets together.  This project will help pets get the veterinary care they need and stay with the people they love.

title: Provide Empowering Care Packs for Women & Girls
description: GOOD TO BE GOOD, a grassroots nonprofit organization, offers an Empowerment Care Program (ECP) to diverse women, girls, and gender-diverse folks with intersecting identities experiencing gender-based violence, structural poverty, and facing forms of marginalization who need urgent relief and care.  ECP helps meet their basic needs through supports of nutritious food boxes, direct cash transfers, gift cards, menstrual and personal aid, community resources, and low-barrier personalized referrals.

title: Empower Students with Life-Changing Skills, Kenya
description: Have you ever considered how technical skills such as metalwork, hairdressing, or electrical installation can change someone's life? At the Mabati Technical Training Institute, our students are able to learn these, alongside life skills, entrepreneurship & IT skills to earn a decent income. Ever since Covid-19 came along, our students aren't able to afford the training fees and risk dropping out. Support our project and empower our vulnerable students to lead better lives.

title: Train 500 people in wetlands ecosystems in uganda
description: The project seeks to support communities to take climate change issues (increased climate variability and extreme weather events such as drought,floods, high temperatures, violent storms) into account in the management of critical wetlands. The project activities have been identified to especially respond to and take into account the specific climate related impacts and vulnerabilities of these wetland ecosystems outlined in the project feasibility study.

title: Teach Literacy Skills for Better Learning
description: Reading is an essential component of education however most rural students are deprived due to so many factors including teacher deficit. Studies have shown, Reading is the greatest component of education, before one can speak fluent English one should be able to read fluently, all subjects in school including mathematics demands reading and understanding. Our project is working directly towards the indicators of UNSDG 4-Quality Education

title: Educate and empower 200 kids at-risk in Ecuador
description: Early childhood education breaks the cycle of poverty, strengthens families and communities, and sets kids up for happy, successful lives. With your help, Fundacion Sembrar will provide holistic health and educational development for over 200 children under 5 years old in Quito, Ecuador, while accompanying parents to reinforce positive habits and foster a safe and supportive environment at home.

title: Providing a Safe Home for 25 Seniors in Ponce, PR
description: Finding a safe home for our elderly loved ones is not an easy matter. And when you finally get the right one, with quality staff where your loved one feels respected and cared for with love, then you want to preserve it. This was this elderly facility care in Ponce, before it was destroyed by the earthquakes of January 2020, which have not received the necessary help to rebuild it, leaving 25 seniors without the home they cherished and that allowed them to live in dignity and love.

title: Transforming Lives of 500 Maya Women in Mexico
description: Do you want to help Maya women fight discrimination and violence? Pursue their education? Pave the way for their generation and the ones to come? Together,we can transform the lives of 500 inspiring indigenous women. By establishing a Development Hub in Yucatan we empower them with resources,training and counseling to boost their potential and secure long-term betterment.Being Maya comes with centuries of values-but also systemic stigma.Let's create a safe place where their goals become reality.

title: Empowering Fathers To Be Caregivers
description: Throughout our "Fathers as Caregivers" campaign, Fathering Together is training dads to see themselves as caregivers for their children and to translate the skills that make them successful at work into their homelife. These skills include leadership, communication, emotional intelligence, and program management.   By engaging in 1-on-1 coaching and small group virtual workshops, we support dads in building more gender equitable homes through active engagement with their families.

title: Prevention of Hyperammonemia
description: You can help to reduce child mortality from liver disease in Russia. The project aims to raise funds for the purchase of devices to measure elevated ammonia levels of infants with genetic metabolic diseases. Your help will increase the effectiveness of emergency treatment of children with hereditary metabolic diseases and help to save their lives.

title: Empower 1500 Orphan &Vulnerable Children in Kenya
description: This project will provide   food, Sanitary towels, inner wears, Hygiene items, hand washing Systems,face mask, build empowerment center, training, clean water, guidance and counselling  to 1500 Orphan and Vulnerable children  subjected  sexual abuse,child labour and psychological stress in Kenya. The emergence of COVID-19 has compelled impoverished girls to indulge in sex in exchange for food, sanitary towels resulting to child pregnancies and  child marriages, STIs and HIV/AIDs infections.

title: Ignite Hope: Feed 23000 Vulnerable Kids in Jakarta
description: Foodbank of Indonesia through the Mother's Wing Program will provide nutritious meals for 23.404 children in poor and marginalized areas of Jakarta. By doing this, we can bring closer access to food, prevent kid's malnutrition, and ignite hopes for supporting children to spread their wings achieving dreams.

title: Support the Next Success Story in Kosovo
description: This project will make American university studies accessible to talented students with limited financial means from Kosovo. Your gifts in this project will help provide immediate scholarships to freshmen students joining RIT Kosovo (A.U.K) in fall of 2021.  As one of the most active civil promoter of American values and ideals in Kosovo; many ventures, businesses and civil society initiatives came to existence on our campus' classrooms and hallways. Support the Next Success Story now.

title: HELP US FIGHT GENDER VIOLENCE IN BOTSWANA & MALAWI
description: This project seeks to reduce the percentage of incidences of Gender Based Violence in Botswana and Malawi with 30% in Four years. we will take the approach of prevention, treating and Rehabilitating. On Prevention we shall have National Civic Education and sensitization targeting the youths and young adults. With the victims of GBV we want to treat them with counselings and entrepreneurship trainings. The Project will as well, endeavor to rehabilitate perpetrators through the counseling session

title: Revitalize Education
description: Education is a fundamental and universal human right. It plays a crucial role in our work to give children brighter futures and sustainable development. Ensuring girls and boys complete free or affordable primary and secondary schooling. To create empowered communities, we ensure girls and boys are empowered equally. We provides vocational, enterprise and life skills training for both genders. We are providing education to 1000 children in our community-led schools.

title: Provide sustainable greenhouses to feed families
description: Last year, Valparaiso's community in Chile has been struggling to survive to this crisis. Unemployment is raising because of extended lockdowns and economic uncertainty. This issue is affecting and putting in risk all the basic needs of the families. With the sustainable greenhouses we're able to help and give hope to these families, bringing them tools to become self-sufficient and independent with their alimentation, and also support between them, coworking as a community.

title: IMPROVING MENTAL HEALTH
description: This project will address the issue of mental stress and depression caused by due to COVID-19 and this will give access for psychiatry medical access for ninety children,girls and youth and eighty families whom they were show signs of depression and stress. Hiyaw Fikir Planned to make health screening of all the beneficiary including their families or guardians and providing access for psychiatry medical treatment by covering all medical bills

title: "The Oasis": Restoring Girls From The Inside Out
description: This project will create a "Oasis Center" in Detroit MI, that will be designed to provide services to girls ages 9-17, to combat the issues they deal with mentally from the inside out. It will serve as a calming space for girls to come practice mindfulness techniques, gain self-esteem tools to boost self-awareness, self-love and self-identity, combat traumatic experiences interfering with their good mental health and a atmosphere that will provide peace and tranquility.

title: Educate & Empower Slum Teen Moms in Nairobi, Kenya
description: This project will provide education to marginalized girls who are teenage mothers in Kibera Slum, Nairobi Kenya with access to life skill development techniques, education, leadership, and Socio-economic empowerment skills. This project also seeks to raise Teen pregnancy advocates who will champion to end teenage pregnancy in the community through peer to peer mentorship program.  Through the peer mentorship the projects seeks to reduce the rate of teenage pregnancy amidst COVID-19.

title: Send Maya Ixil Youth to University in Guatemala
description: At Filantropis, we believe that all youth have the potential to be leaders who are capable of transforming their lives and communities. Through our University Scholars Program, we invest in the future changemakers of the Maya Ixil community of Chajul, Guatemala. Our holistic programming includes university scholarships, career counseling, personal and professional development training, internship opportunities, and a supportive community within which passionate Scholars can learn and grow.

title: Raise Up HIV Heroes
description: The Leading Women's Society (LWS) is comprised of outstanding women from across the country that have lived with HIV for 20 years or more while serving as change agents and advocates in their local communities. The members of LWS are chosen because of their commitment to raising awareness using their own experience to champion accessible HIV testing, prevention education, linkage to care, and more women-centered research.

title: Support Young Defenders in Mexico
description: What comes to your mind when you think about young people and what would you say are their top priorities? "Defending their rights" may not be the first thing that we think of. From a very young age, people in Mexico have to deal with several obstacles in order to exercise their rights, such as freedom of expression, education, liberty and even the right to life. This campaign seeks to support them, so they can keep working collectively to search and build a dignified and peaceful country.

title: Protect Kenyan girls from Gender-Based Violence
description: Imagine being afraid to fetch water or being forced to marry instead of going to school. In Kenya we are building a community resource center to protect girls from Gender-Based Violence (GBV). It will house and educate 30 girls who have survived GBV and host our afterschool program designed to prevent GBV and keep 100s of girls safe and in school. We are now raising funds to complete construction of the resource center, where we will be able to serve the community for years to come.

title: Improving the rural education in Colombia
description: In Colombia children face serious risk of dropping out because their school does not offer them the right conditions to go to study. We created Escala programme because we think that a person who stays in school and completes the learning process until graduation, will have a better quality of life.

title: Support Families in Mexico to Start Saving
description: Our programs serve to reduce poverty in rural and marginalized communities in Baja California Sur, Mexico. Through personalized training, we accompany community members to create a self-managed Community Savings Group (CSG) that offers them the opportunity to save and have access to loans (generated from their own fund), with the aim of improving the families' quality of life. We include dynamic financial education workshops that support participants to improve their family financial status.

title: Fighting Corruption in Puerto Rico's Recovery
description: Contratos En Ley seeks to make data truly open so that citizens can monitor government spending in Puerto Rico, particularly in public contracting. At present, public contracting is the area with the highest risk of corruption, costing billions and threatening the lifeline of many. By creating transparency and developing monitoring tools, citizens can oversee and protect public resources, bringing significant savings and guaranteeing a fair and inclusive recovery from recent natural disasters.

title: EDUCATION & SPORTS FOR KIDS IN COLOMBIAN WAR ZONE
description: The Conect Vision Foundation's VITAL program is helping to overcome mental poverty and keeping 350 children, adolescents and young people away from social scourges, while also providing opportunities for 130 adults - many of them farmers involved in coca processing and former combatants in the process of social reincorporation - through sport activities, education in social values and academics, in Puerto Asis and 18 rural areas of Putumayo, one of the unfortunate conflict zones of Colombia.

title: $10000 in Summer Camp Scholarships for City Youth
description: All children, not just children with families who can afford it, deserve access to high-quality programs where they can connect, learn, and grow. You can help make camp possible for children and teens who truly deserve a break this summer, after a difficult year that included social distancing (including isolation from friends), challenging blended-learning models, and general stress. Your support helps make nature-based camp accessible for families who are facing financial constraints.

title: Children's Eco-Storybooks in Central America
description: The Children's Illustrated Eco-Storybook Series promotes conservation, regeneration and a harmonious relationship with nature. Through a contest recruitment process, an author and an artist will be selected from each country in the Central American region to create an illustrated storybook based on their culture, language, history and ancestral wisdom, to familiarize young children with how we can take care of our planet.  From the heart of Central America for the children of the world!

title: Support the Growth of Bulgaria Startup Ecosystem
description: We believe that entrepreneurship and innovation drive positive social and economic change, create jobs, elevate communities and improve lives. Our project supports Bulgarian and SEE/CEE innovators who are passionate and determined to solve global challenges and build resilient communities. We create a two-way bridge between the Bulgarian and SEE/CEE startup ecosystem and Silicon Valley in order to cultivate an entrepreneurial growth mindset and strengthen the private sector in the region.

title: Give the gift of light & help educate children
description: Tonight, when the sun starts to set, please will you resist for a moment the urge to turn on your lights?   Instead, watch as the gloom creeps through the room, and the deepening shadows slowly consume every corner of your home.   At first, your eyes will compensate. But when the last rays of sunlight are gone, the darkness will be complete. And at that point, I ask you to try to imagine what it might be like to be one of the many children for whom this isn't a one-off.   Please donate today.

title: Help 1000 women to assess potable water in Ghana
description: Somewhere in the western region of Ghana, there's a village called Krobo Bosomdo where the entire village depends on a dirty river for drinking and other purposes. Help let's provide them with mechanized well to improve their livelihood and health.

title: MAKE "HOME EDUCATIONAL CORNERS" FOR 150 CHILDREN
description: SOS Children's Village Macedonia plans to create "Home Educational corners" to enable 150 children to attend classes from home due to COVID 19. Coming from the poorest families, not having basic conditions for home education we will provide them with study desks, chairs, educational materials, and internet & educational support services for one year. This project will prevent these children from leaving the educational process and prevent them from living by the rules of the "street".

title: GDC- Unleashing the potential for youth in Albania
description: Global Digital City (GDC) links digitalization with attributes of each specific city in Albania, Albanian speaking communities. Prevents "brain drain" & develops local communities in the Balkans: 1) A 3-day event with local, national & international speakers, workshop sessions, training, information sessions & pitching for start-ups; 2) Launching 50 employment/training opportunities, B2B events with 50 businesses; 3) Social Event where youth can promote their communities globally.

title: Wild bird rescue centers in Bosnia and Herzegovina
description: Ornithological society "Nase ptice"("Our Birds") for almost two decades now, is dedicated in preserving wildlife and bird habitats. Very often we came across injured and orphaned wild birds. Vultures, eagles, buzzards, owls, herons, storks... life of every individual is important in order to preserve wildlife. With the help of you that care our goal is to establish care centers for wild birds that will cover all the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Houndreds of birds will return to the wild.

title: Critical Resources for Urban Refugees in Bangkok
description: Creative Life Foundation is expanding the ways we support urban refugees and asylum seekers in Bangkok, Thailand. In collaboration with the refugee community and partner-organizations, CLF will connect under-resourced families with food, supplemental income, and education resources for children and youth.

title: SUPPORT ARTSAKH VETERANS AND WARAFFECTED WOMEN
description: We believe that 8000 veterans of Artsakh war, families of victims and 66000 displaced people must be confident that they have a next mission, a future worth looking forward to. We realize that the path of return to routine life looks complicated and we will pass this journey together, with dignity and justice.  We plan to put in motion a synergy of 3 steps of rehabilitation and integration for up to 300 people, including psychological recovery, vocational education and recruiting in job market.

title: Avoid school dropout in children with DownSyndrome
description: The National Emergency caused by Covid 19 have prompted schools to provide care for all students virtually.This strategy has managed to mitigate the impact in terms of access to education. However, this provision fails to respond to the necessary adjustments for the population with intellectual disabilities.This project seeks virtual pedagogical support in a way that facilitates developing the academic skills required in the different grades to  avoid school dropouts

title: Quality education for 5 000 poor children.
description: The TEACH Cote d'Ivoire Program aims to train 180 transformational teacher teachers in five years to impact the lives of 20,000 children from poor and disadvantaged backgrounds in Cote d'Ivoire, giving them the opportunity to have access to quality education. Focusing on leadership, Teach Cote d'Ivoire project aims to help end the inequalities and inequities in the Ivorian educational system so that all children, irrespective of their socio-economic background, can access to quality education

title: Providing Water through 3 Drilling Boreholes
description: People in rural areas travel long distances to look for water, some will travel between 2-7 miles to look for water most especially during the dry seasons. However, with the water charity project, Friends for human survival and development charity organization save these people these long distances by bringing water closer to them.  This is done by constructing an artisan borehole which is enough to provide to a small village in Eastern Uganda

title: My sanitary Pads My Education {Pads 4 school girl}
description: This project will assist young vulnerable girls in Primary and secondary education in Uganda to access sanitary pads. These girls come from very high need families that can not afford sanitary pad (1 U$ day). As a result many end by being irregular at school and eventually drop out of school. The project will support 1000 girls from 10 schools as for the start.  For sustainability, the project will carryout a feasibility study to establish a cheaper production facility of  the sanitary pads

title: Combat Corona to the Last Mile In Kenya
description: In Kenya, most people live from hand to mouth, with 40% of the people living  below the poverty line and 50% just above it. For our community, staying home makes it difficult to get necessities like soap, food, and salt. This project   is acting in response to the COVID outbreak or its consequences, through raising awareness about prevention, supporting vulnerable populations during the economic stop-down. MCDC plans to support 200 households to access ,food ,shelter,education and healthcare .

title: Market Gardens for 40 starving Families in Kabuba.
description: NAP Elite Trust plans to drill 2 boreholes and install solar powered pumps to empower 40 starving families whose some of children are currently not attending school due to lack of funds, to establish market gardens, in Kabuba Village of Binga district in Zimbabwe.

title: Women for Freedom
description: Our women fight for democracy as well as for equal rights for all ethnic groups inside Myanmar. Join our cause today and donate for the freedom for all people in Myanmar!

title: Group Home(s) for Special Needs Taiwanese Children
description: In Taiwan, more children with severe neurodevelopmental disorders experience abuse, neglect, are separated from family, and are institutionalized by the Taiwan government in nursing homes or long-term medical facilities, usually populated by the elderly. The Taiwan Love and Hope International Charity is running the first ever group home in Kaohsiung, Taiwan that adheres to a family-based model of care. Children experience the enjoyment of family life and a supportive community.

title: A new future for survivors of abuse, South Africa
description: Women in the poor, underserved community of Mabopane, South Africa are battling a war of gender-based violence and femicide. The "Ikemele" women empowerment project provides free skills training, counselling & practical support to help survivors of GBV rise above their circumstances & become financially independent - the key to walking away from an abusive situation. With the tragic increase in partner violence during COVID, vulnerable women need hope and a second chance more than ever before.

title: Support Abaco Community Center & Hurricane Shelter
description: Sol Relief and the Disaster Reconstruction Authority have teamed up to build a community center and hurricane shelter for the community of Central Abaco in the Bahamas which is still recovering from Hurricane Dorian, a category 5, that devastated the area in September 2019.

title: Young Women Political Leadership in Kenya (YWPL)
description: Through this project, JWF aims to create a critical mass of 100 young women leaders from the North Rift Valley of Kenya, who will seek elective positions in 2022, amid poll violence and corruption that marks such elections. Giving them a platform to understand and engage in democratic processes, this project will train and support the 100 youth women in organizing a campaign around a political issue that affects their community, bringing them together in an important space of civic engagement.

title: Girls Right to Pad Initiative
description: In Nigeria, sanitary pads costs an average of $1.30 per pack, while most families live below the poverty threshold of $1.20 per day. The high cost of sanitary pads in Nigeria have made them inaccessible for poor girls. In some situations, girls face sexual abuse in their quest for money to buy sanitary pads. During  menstruation  they are unable to attend school. On the other hand, those who cannot afford a good menstrual pad, rely on old rags and and tissue papers as alternatives.

title: Aid & Protection for Refugees in Bosnia & Serbia
description: Up to 1400 people are living in abandoned buildings, old factories and outdoor makeshift camps on the hostile Bosnia/Serbia border the main struggle in all spots is how to cope with the violent pushbacks suffered when entering neighboring countries, mainly Croatia, and how the trauma diminishes people's resilience to face the lack of shelter, food, clean water, electricity, healthcare, shoes and warm clothes. Grassroots volunteers are there giving essential food, clothes & hygiene with our help.

title: Afghan Youth Peacebuilders Community Initiative
description: The project is a platform which aims to empower 75 young social activists, peace-builders and equality activists by enhancing their communication and leadership skills for peacebuilding and conflict management through 3 days training for each batch of 25 individuals. We aim to provide Afghan youth with a strong insight of peace and inclusive societies. We engage and mobilize young peace-builders and emerging community leaders to foster collaboration, build resilience and strengthen capacity.

title: Horse Rescue Needs a New Home by July 1, 2012
description: VFHRN needs to move by July 1, 2021 due to the property they are currently on has been sold and now they have to move, the property owner sold part of the pasture and has plans for the remaining pasture our horses are on, we currently have 12 horses and no where to go we have save hundreds of horses over that last 21 yrs, and now we need your help to continue our mission, your donations will allow us to buy a permanent home and save many more horses and give sanctuary to 8

title: Supporting Siblings of Disabled Individuals
description: This project will provide emotional and practical support to 1,000 siblings who have a disabled brother or sister. While support programs and services have been developed for individuals with I/ DD and their parents, supports for siblings have been limited.

title: Providing the marginalized group with clean water
description: This live-saving project will provide clean water for 160 families including 800 people from the highly vulnerable marginalized group living in conflict front line areas of Taiz, Yemen. The project aims at improving the access of the marginalized people to clean water for drinking, cooking and personal and domestic hygiene. The project will contribute to reducing outbreak of Cholera and other dirty water-borne diseases that have spread in the targeted area due to inaccessibility to clean water.

title: Empowering 10 Ni-Vanuatu Women Entrepreneurs
description: The women of Vanuatu have been impacted by repeated cyclones, and covid-19, which has closed the border and stopped Vanuatu's tourism industry which accounts for 40% of the economy, and lastly to better address gender inequality in Vanuatu. Many women find themselves in dire straits financially. Women who want to overcome these challenges struggle to overcome the constraints they face.

title: Canine Commandos
description: Students (400+) of thirty elementary schools learn compassion and empathy, teaching basic commands to shelter dogs and raising adoption rates for the homeless animals.

title: Support Widow Farmers
description: Support Widow Farmers to become self sustain in a year and lend a helping hand.   * Our Approach: Visit Widow Farmers to review their self-sustenance ideas, provide counselling and suggest suitable options. Rather than one time donation, we support the farmers until they become self-sustain.  * Our Support Plan: Fund 90% for each Farmer's self sustenance Idea and request the Farmer to contribute 10% to create responsibility.  * Our Goal: Develop a working model to make Poor Farmers self-sustain.

title: Help Build A Women and Girls Education Center
description: Queen Sheba Village organization is setting up an Education Social Center in the city of Mbour, that will enable girls and women to have access to education in an easily accessible location. At this center, they will have the opportunity to learn, share in participation, and meet other like-minded individuals. The center will focus on 4 main objectives. * Micro Entrepreneurship * Health & Hygiene * Spreading Awareness of Female Genital Cutting and girl educational programs.

title: Equip 250 girls with Reusable Sanitary Pads Skills
description: The Girl2Girl Initiative will provide hands on training to 250 adolescent girls and young teenage mothers in making Reusable Butterfly Sanitary pads for adolescent girls, women and young teenage mothers in both rural and semi-urban communities of Uganda. As the world is still struggling on containing the spread of Covid-19, many adolescent young girls in Uganda continue to face greater challenges of poor menstrual hygiene due to lack of access to free and low-cost sanitary pads.

title: Help Nyitawuta Village Build a Clinic
description: This project will build a medical clinic to serve the 500 members of  Nyitawuta village and its surrounding communities. currently there is no clinic in the community and members have to walk long distance to assess an health facility. The roads to the community is cut off during the rainy season. Pregnant women do not go for antenatal delivery of babies is at the mercy of one untrained birth attendant with nothing to assist during child birth. Most children are malnourished or have defect.

title: Disaster Relief for Fire Victims at Susan's Bay
description: On March 24th, 2021, a terrible fire broke out at one of the densely populated slum communities in Freetown, Sierra Leone, Susan's Bay. The entire community was burnt down to ashes and it is believed that more than 5,000 people were left homeless as over 600 houses were destroyed.

title: Ramadan Appeal 2021
description: Ramadan is the holy month for the muslims and maximum charity donated in the Month of Ramadan for people in need, Every Ramadan your donations help us share food, Providing clean drinking water with families who really needs support!

title: Battered Women Rescue and Support Project
description: We will provide material, emotional and legal support for women subjected to domestic violence by their partners. Our material support will be in the form of food, shelter and medical supply and long-term livelihood projects of their choice. Our legal support will be in the form of advice, referral to competent lawyers and aiding them in their long-drawn legal battles with those who have caused them harm.

title: Poor Orphan Girls Education Project
description: This project will improve the educational status of 40 orphan poor girls to meet the millennium development goals, formation, and strengthening of girls club. The total budget of this project is $ 10,000.enclosed for a better understanding of the Duration of the Project in the Long term(will be Viewing annually) from August 2021 July 2022.The direct beneficiaries of this project are 40 orphan poor girls in Garowe whereas the indirect beneficiary is their families.

title: HELPING THE POOR IN BIHAR INDIA TO SURVIVE COVID
description: This project now over a year old combines many aspects of the helping the poor in dealing with the devastating consequences of the Covid 19 pandemic here in Bihar one of the poorest states in India. Our Rescue centre in Gaya became overwhelmed with requests for help as returning migrant labourers often after walking hundreds of kilometres could not feed their children. Our emergency response saved many lives. However Covid is going to be around a long time and our response needs to be too..

title: Create a refuge for the Axolotl in Xochimilco
description: Did you know there is a whole ecosystem with unique species and history within Mexico City?  Xochimilco is that place, we're working with the people living there to recover this important wetland which in turn, is the habitat of the mexican Axolotl. In this project, we will keep running a Conservation Center, a space where locals and visitors will learn, work and train on species conservation. In this place, we will also produce native trees, that will help to recover the habitat of this importa

title: Empower marginalized women and men in rural Kenya
description: Since 2011, Action10, with the help of Human Rights & Science (HR&S), has been engaging and empowering marginalized people in Kenya's remote villages through the table banking model, which improves access to investment capital. This ensures that people, especially the poor, participate in economic activities that benefit both the person and society. As a result, these individuals are better equipped to combat poverty, maintain financial stability, and run profitable businesses.

title: Rehabilitate 1000 Persons W. Disabilities in Nepal
description: People with Disabilities living in remote Himalayan districts of Nepal have little or no access to healthcare, physiotherapy or assistive devices, such as leg braces or walking frames. As people have to walk for days to reach the nearest health facility, disability adds further challenges.  This project targets those 1000 PWDs who are in compelling need of basic health, physiotherapy and assistive services close to their homes, contributing to improve their social, mental and physical health.

title: Maphunziro265(Education for all Malawi)
description: Just $20 per term can give a young Malawian a Secondary school education, access to Tertiary school and most importantly, access to a world of career possibilities for young people to thrive on the job market

title: Save water in 3 rural towns in the arid Karoo
description: Trapsuutjies Environmental fixes household water leaks in 3 poor communities in the arid Klein-Karoo.  We also make communities aware of the necessity of using water sparingly and demonstrate to households how to fix minor leaks themselves, adding to sustainable water savings.  This helps to reduce the many kiloliters of unintended water losses which can be retained in highly stressed water systems.

title: Educate and empower 1,000 Child-brides in Nigeria
description: More than 12 million girls become child brides every year. That's one girl every three seconds who is robbed of her childhood, one girl every three seconds who is at increased risk of violence and child sexual abuse.   Over the past two months, Girls Not Brides members have come together through #StopStealingHerChildhood campaign to show world leaders that inaction isn't an option. As a member of Girls Not Brides, we are determined to end child marriage in Nigeria at all cost.

title: Give Solar Lamps to School Children in Myanmar
description: This project provides solar powered lamps to school children who live in off-grid communities in Myanmar, such as the Hlegu Center and Saytanar Mercy Village.   Jezuba is a non-profit organization that works with the next generation on solutions to hard-to-solve problems such as poverty and the environment.    Check out: https://www.jezuba.org/

title: East Asian Village Community Development
description: This is a community development effort impacting several small villages - totaling 400+ individuals -  through empowering work including summer camps, literacy programs, clean water projects, community development training, meeting basic needs of villagers, and supporting staffing needs to keep the work going. #GivingTuesday
