title: Help 30 Albanian women survive a divorce
description: Albania is facing divorce in higher rate and Covid-19 pandemic made it worse. Even though in Albania family is seen as saint, numbers of divorce are growing up and women are left alone. This project will provide psychologic and economic support for 30 divorced women to recreate their life. Your donation will provide them counseling sessions with the psychologist, a rented house for at least 3 months, professional training course, daycare center and schooling for the children.

title: Abused Girls Rescue and Support Project
description: We will provide medical, legal, material and psycho-social support for abused girls in 5 rural villages here. The villages are experiencing extreme poverty and hardship because of climate change and diseases and girls are at a severe disadvantage with abuse especially in the households common and under reported. Abuse comes in the form of physical and sexual with common relatives often the culprits.

title: University for Low-Income Students in Cambodia
description: Your gifts make it possible for bright young students from low-income families in Cambodia to attend university. Higher education for young Cambodians results in lasting transformation for families and local communities by improving job opportunities and intellectual capital. Without this critical financial support, these bright young students will likely work in low-wage factory or service jobs, reducing their immense potential to effect positive change for their communities in the future.

title: Girls' Period protection in schools-Minembwe-DRC
description: Around 1,000 girls in Minembwe Highlands miss a week of school per month because of period and lack of access to suitable hygiene products. A feeling of shame and absence of hygiene products that lead to gradual drop-out reduce the girls' chances to succeed in school.  This girls Hygiene Kit assistance consists to distributing washable pads to 250 girls and promoting good practices in schools and villages on menstruation to improve girls' living conditions and school success in Minembwe.

title: Workshops on Lifeskills for Care Leavers in Poland
description: This is a long-term program enabling the care leavers to meet on regular basis during the school year (twice a month, every workshops last about 5 hours) and learn important life-skills in group, and at the same time get emotional support. Program helps care leavers to preaper to independent life. Part of these meetings is dedicated to housing, law, health and vocational topics -training, writing CV, job appointment,  labor standards and rules ect.

title: Black soldier fly larvae production
description: The project will consider the feasibility of rearing Hermetia illucens (black soldier fly or BSF) using their larvae to primarily supplement fish and livestock feed . Considerations will also be given for the utilisation of the larvae castings as organic fertiliser.

title: Art in the Paint
description: By using art, the goal of Art in the Paint is to transform neglected courts and surrounding spaces  into monuments which the community can have pride in and promotes ideas of meaningful change to the various systemic and human rights issues that plague the world today. We will marry great artwork with sport and community. We want to ensure that communities are the voice that drives the art. They will playing an integral role in the design, installation and upkeep process of these murals.

title: Palliative, End of Life and Bereavement Care
description: Learning that you, or a loved one, have advanced cancer can make you feel frightened and distressed. Being prepared to deal with what can happen toward the end of life can enable you to get the support and care you need so that you can have the very best quality of life possible.  We are a team of professionals: clinical psychologist, oncology nurses, social workers, dieticians and art therapists who provide the needed support to both the cancer patient and their family members.

title: Motivation Romania Wheelchair Fund
description: Your gift gives back freedom of movement and self-confidence to Romanians with mobility disabilities, through quality, personalized wheelchairs and other mobility equipment.  Since 2019, GlobalGiving donors helped give back freedom of movement to over 50 children and adults with disabilities, through appropriate mobility equipment.  In Romania, 1 in 5 persons who need a wheelchair does not have one. Every 5 years, over 40,000 Romanians need a new wheelchair, but only 15,000 receive one.

title: Help Us Build A New School in Kenya
description: Education plays a very important role in the development of children and communities alike, however, it is costly to run a school and provide quality education as well as fund staff, buy resources, run the school grounds and keep everything safe and suitable for the children to learn. Our goals with this project are to cut all these costs by building a 100% sustainable school in Kenya, that will be able to continue educating and feeding all 280 children regardless of the school's income.

title: Helping Children with Cancer Across the UK
description: The diagnosis of childhood cancer in a loved one can be incredibly upsetting and often the treatment can be lengthy and expensive, removing the children from their normal everyday life. Together with our partners in the UK we are working to raise funds to give these children and their families to experience a getaway from the difficult situation they are facing and help them to have quality time together, away from the doctors and treatment, whilst still being close enough to a hospital if need.

title: Inspire for Peace
description: This project will provide school supplies like school bags, notebooks, and stationery for 100 internally displaced economically disadvantaged primary school pupils whose education has been affected by the civil crisis that has plagued Cameroon English-speaking regions for four years now. The targeted pupils are those who have been able to relocate to Douala, one of the safe regions, and are currently going to school but face significant economic challenges and may likely drop out.

title: Help Allen & His Friends Fly to USA
description: Allen and 14 of his friends are SURVIVORS. They've been through the unimaginable. That's in the past now, and nothing but a life of color awaits them in USA. They have a chance of a lifetime to make a getaway from the shelter. In a few short weeks, they can start the next chapter of their life.  Please help them board a plane destined for Chicago on May 6, 2021, where they can be adopted into loving families. See before and after photos here, https://www.triggercares.com

title: Operating Expenses for Vision Centre of Women Can
description: Primary survey result in southern areas of Bangladesh 36% and above Village people are sufferings refractive error,at the same time they are not capable to take services with cost. In these circumstances 8 Women Entrepreneur taken a project for providing support to under served people. As a result 2000 people will be benefited directly(vision test,primary health Care&Cataract)in these project period.At the same time Women can-vision centre will be able to self driven project with there revenues.

title: Zakat & Fitr for Darussafaka Society in Ramadan
description: Darussafaka Society provides talented children who have lost their father or mother and have limited financial means, with a full scholarship, college-level, boarding-school education by our Society's equal opportunities in education mission since the year 1863. Donations made as "Zakat and Fitr" are spent for the needs of our students in Darussafaka Schools. During the Ramadan Feast, Darussafaka Society invites you to support the education of our children by donations.

title: A DROP OF WATER, A SAVED OF LIFE
description: Water been a necessity of life, shall become a problem solved in Amoanda community. Citizen will have their separate source of drinking water while animals will share streams only for themselves.  The issue of humans sharing the same streams with animals will become a thing of the past. Lives of humans shall become healthier and better living conditions shall be improved.   Funding the drilling of a bore-hole water facility in Amoanda  will help solve the current water crisis Amoanda.

title: Mother2Mother - network for vulnerable mothers
description: Children need their mothers in order to grow healthy and to gain values that they need for their whole Life. Our Mo2Mo project provides a global network for mamas to share, chat with mentors and peers and learn about family care and wellbeing. Through the network and localised campaigns, we advocate on mother's role in the society by breaking barriers to support and reducing stigma towards vulnerable mothers and their children who are socially excluded or judged by the society.

title: Repair a Broken Well in South Sudan
description: Water for South Sudan (WFSS) is committed to creating sustainable water systems for rural communities in great need. The WFSS well rehab team returns to the organization's older wells to bring them up to a new, stronger design standard, and responds to local requests to rehabilitate wells drilled by other organizations.   WFSS delivers sustainable quality-of-life services to and with the people of South Sudan by efficiently providing access to clean water, sanitation, and hygiene education.

title: London to Cape Town Challenge 2021
description: Starting 1st April 2021, Atlas Foundation supporters are going to attempt to virtually run, cycle, swim and walk the distance from London to Cape Town, in order to raise funds to build an Atlas DigiBus for our children in the townships of KwaZulu-Natal.

title: The Girls emPOWER Project
description: This project will build and rehabilitate water supply, toilets and hygiene facilities in 5 districts in Sierra Leone; providing the enabling environment for children especially the girl child to learn and thrive. Youth Partnership for Peace and Development will provide handwashing kits to 20 schools as well as facilitating training in life-skills to girls, build maintenance capacity of caretakers and School Management Committees, while at the same time providing dignity kits to 50,000 girls.

title: Taiz Zoo Rescue and Conserve Mission
description: An ongoing civil war has left both people and animals in a lifeboat situation in Yemen. A Lion's Heart has dedicated itself to care for a war torn zoo of almost 300 animals trapped. They have no one else and cannot be moved. We provide all life's essentials including food, water, vitamins, veterinarian supplies and care, hygiene. Without these essentials, all animals would die.  Our goal would be to meet these needs and go further by replacing all substandard enclosures providing more jobs.

title: Fleeing Myanmar: healthcare for refugees
description: Burmese people are currently passing through a dramatic period, afflicted by the violent consequences of the coup begun in February.  Thousands of women, children and elderly flee the country every day, looking for asylum in Thailand but completely deprived of any resource. Our goal, thanks to a collaboration in Ranong (Thailand), is to offer medical care to refugees who cannot get access to the Thai healthcare system (as illegal immigrants) and food assistance to poor families.

title: Family Futures - pathways out of extreme poverty
description: Towards preventing child labour our project will help 150 families of the children on our education programmes into sustainable income generation. Family poverty drives families into sending their children to work and COVID-19 is pushing more people into extreme poverty. We identify a suitable enterprise, contribute a micro grant to get it off the ground and embed business support to ensure success. This is underpinned with social and welfare support to safeguard the education of their children.

title: New Center To Improve Reproductive & Child Health
description: Global Health experts agree that a community's health begins with effective reproductive and child health services. To be successful, these services must be fully utilized by women, men and children, preferably as a family unit. At Mwandi hospital in western Zambia, a new reproductive health center will triple patient capacity, provide greater privacy and safety, and create a space for nutritional counseling and health education, thus improving antenatal and childhood health in Mwandi district.

title: Culinary Sponsorships in El Salvador
description: This project will provide culinary scholarships for young people in high risk conditions, in order for them to have better job possibilities that directly impact their lives.   The young people participating in this program live though various scenarios as surviving cancer,  orphanage and taking care of their brothers, immigration problems, teen pregnancy. Funds raised will provide scholarships for young people to be funded to attend the Gente Ayudando Gente Cooking School.

title: Abortion Access in Latin Migration Routes
description: There are 57.5 million migrants in the Americas, and most of them are women and girls. During migration, they are frequently subjected to gender-based violence, which puts them at risk of unintended pregnancy and other health consequences. As a part of this project, we will increase access to abortion along key migration routes in Latin America and the Caribbean by disseminating a ChatBot that will provide information about SRHR and abortion access to migrant women and girls.

title: Kakamega Rainforest Restoration Project
description: This project will help restore Kenya's only tropical rainforest while supporting farmers surrounding the forest in adapting income-generating activities compatible with the forest's ecology. The project will alleviate climate change by increasing tree cover while helping local farmers to adapt to a changing climate.

title: Advance Economic Growth for 50 women in DR Congo
description: Amid a food security crisis & COVID-19-related lockdowns, women distillers of Rwenena, in Eastern DRC, created a plant-based hand-sanitizing gel. You can provide training and capital for this licensed & certified enterprise run by the 50-member women's cooperative, "Pama Kaci-Let's cultivate love" Donations will also fund activities that advance community-led development. This project is implemented by the Congo Federation of Smallholder Farmers Organizations of South Kivu (FOPAC-SK).

title: Help 2,000 School Girls Access Clean Sanitation
description: "A toilet is not just a toilet. It's a life-saver, dignity-protector and opportunity-maker" (United Nations). Therefore, access to clean water and basic sanitation is the right of every girl. However, in remote areas of Vietnam, many school girls have limited or even no access to clean school sanitation and safe water, making them vulnerable to diseases caused by poor hygiene. Our program aims to promote a standard model of school sanitation and health education in those disadvantaged schools.

title: A maternity unit to save 2,300 lives in Burundi
description: This project will build, equip and operate a maternity and new-born pavilion to provide affordable and high quality of maternal and new-born health services to underserved and poorest communities in the peri-urban area of Bujumbura/Burundi. This project will save 2,300 lives which could be lost in the absence of this maternity.

title: Fruit Trees for Retired Primates
description: The Fruit Tree Planting Foundation is excited to work with Peaceable Primate Sanctuary, one of the few animal sanctuaries in the United States that provides homes for retired primates, to plant fruit trees at their Indiana sanctuary! Fruit trees will create a source of fresh, healthy nutrition for the sanctuary's 45 primate residents, many of whom had been used in the research and pet industry before coming to their new home at the Sanctuary.

title: Clean up Action - Ilegal Landfill in Prishtina
description: There have been many months since a massive landfill was created in the Arberia neighbourhood, in Pristina. To be particular, near the US Embassy (near the roundabout at the entrance of Pristina).  Multiple times until now, we have asked for cleaning of that part, but due to some property disputes of the location in question, this landfill is unfortunately growing every day. And it is becoming a risk to the health of citizens and even an unpleasant appearance of the entrance to the capital city

title: End illiteracy in Pakistan by 2025
description: The project will establish/ assist 2000 nonformal schools to enroll, retain and educate around 40,000 out-of-school children. In the pilot phase, we have successfully established/assisted 926 one-room schools across Pakistan.

title: Sewing Machines + Equipment Needs for 16 Artisans
description: This project will create dignified and salaried work for 16 artisans in Kenya. Equipped with sewing machines, looms, tools, and other basic equipment like extension cords, tables, and chairs, we will be able to employ and care for 16 artisans and their families through our holistic programming.   Help us get them started by purchasing the equipment they need today!

title: Protect a Cambodian Community from COVID-19
description: This project will support Cambodian Children's Fund's effort to protect the vulnerable community of Steung Meanchey from COVID-19 by providing hygiene and sanitation products and resources to students and families to ensure they are educated and updated regarding COVID-19, they remain safe and healthy, and to prevent the spread of the virus across vulnerable populations in Cambodia.

title: Empowering 25 people from Oaxaca and Hidalgo
description: This project will strengthen 25 people and young people from Oaxaca and Hidalgo, Mexico, who were economically affected by the covid-19 crisis. Unfortunately, thousands of people were affected by the situation and lost their jobs; also several micro-businesses had to close due to the sanitary measures, affecting entrepreneurs. We will strengthen and encourage them with business knowledge, so they could start or improve a microenterprise to recover and generate economic resources.

title: St Vincent volcano LGBTQ+ fund #prayforstvincent
description: On April 9, the La Soufriere volcano erupted, causing the evacuation of thousands from surrounding villages in St. Vincent.  We will provide immediate assistance to LGBTQ+ evacuees affected by the volcanic eruption and already battling with COVID-19 and discrimination in a region where they are criminalised. Our relief assistance will include food packages, clean water, hygiene kits, sanitary products, clothing, heavy-duty face masks,  relocation and housing support.

title: Month of Hope: Ramadan Aid Project
description: The Holy month of Ramadan has begun, and like every year, needy families are struggling to make ends meet or even survive. This year URDA is launching an initiative that aims to remind the needy, poor and fragile that hope is still alive and that compassion still has a positive impact in the world. You can participate and contribute in teaching the poor that a meal means more than just nutrition, it represents safety, dignity and hope for a better and safer future!

title: Technology Drive for impoverished kids in Ethiopia
description: Summary: This campaign is to open a research library for underprivileged students who have no access to devices or the internet. Our goal is to provide support for students who lack the technology necessary to pursue academic interests and higher education. Through the creation of a research library, we provide students with an opportunity to explore and research whatever they may be passionate about, so that they may in turn go on to lead in their respective fields.

title: OFFER HOPE FOR 500 COVID-19 VICTIMS IN SOUTH SUDAN
description: This project will support the health system of South Sudan by assisting  500 COVID19 victims  by encouraging  adherence to strict physical several distancing measures, using hand washing and  proper sanitation and hygiene by establishing hand washing stations in communities on proper hand washing techniques in low-income communities. Raise aware about how to prevent the spread of covid-19 through radio and several media campaigns. and counseling using medicine approach

title: Proper menstruation protection for 2000 poor girls
description: Menstruation is taboo within most rural families in Burkina Faso. The available disposable protection for menstruation are very costly, of poor quality and not biodegradable. The consequences of those facts are many: lost of dignity/self-esteem, absence from school, health problems, and work difficulty. We propose to make 50 sexual education presentations in schools and for women's associations. We would also like to offer 2.000 washable menstruation kits for poor girls/women.

title: Finfinne Theater Project in Addis Ababa Ethiopia
description: We investigate a better place for performing arts, especially Theater and Film in Oromia, which enable to create a vibrant society through the process of dialogue and artistic imagination. Ensuring this vision which pragmatically implemented during the practice will be the goal at large. Broadly, the Association will be created a critically mass of Art practioniers capable of producing ideas, attitudes that greatly matters in developing the Arts. These in turn, stimulates and strengthen the grow

title: Build primary school  for 200 Students in Liberia
description: Safe Community Inc plans to build Six(6) classrooms  primary school to provide free education for 200 children yearly who never been to school and dropped out of school from the poorest background of Logan town, Kpelle town, Wein town, Lorma quarter and New Israel communities within Johnsonville LIBERIA. Education empowers children at their adult age to establish successful careers and give back to their communities. We need your help to raise 14K  to construct the primary school.

title: Provide start-up Capital for Widows
description: After the breakdown of Covid 19, the vulnerability of women increased in 2020. The widows who lost their husbands due to Aids are the most affected by the pendemic. Suubi Vulnerable Children and Women Orgnisation takes care of over 50 families of Widows and their children by providing them with basic needs like food, shelter and school fees for their children.

title: Give scholarships to poor students in Guatemala
description: The families in this community scratch out a living by scavenging at the landfill, and their children attend the local school. However, even though these schools serve deeply impoverished children in Guatemala City, it receives little governmental support. It lacks regular maintenance that brings pride and safety for the kids. Also, we are helping poor kids in schools in Morazan, El Progreso. With your help we will keep children safe repairing the schools and providing school supplies for them.

title: Free Family Photos for Refugees/Disaster Survivors
description: Can you imagine having to flee your country and leave behind everything you own, including your framed memories? Can you imagine a fire or hurricane destroying your home and all of your belongings? This US-based project offers free family photos to refugees, migrants, asylum seekers, displaced people, and disaster survivors. Retake gives a little bit of hope/joy/dignity in the form of new keepsakes and framed portraits to people who have endured so much and are now rebuilding their lives.

title: Support Youth Entrepreneurship & Technology
description: With the global pandemic disrupting employment and traditional education, this is the perfect moment to inspire the entrepreneurial spirit in young people. As young people look toward their future, they need new options. Our one year online Entrepreneurship & Technology program taps into the creativity of young people to position them to be able to succeed in any economic climate. Your donation goes toward laptops, Wifi hot spots, career mentors and career workshops and panelists.

title: Build Bakery to Empower Indigenous Filipino Women
description: Our project will build a bakery shop to empower indigenous women who live in the rural areas of Mindoro Island, in the Philippines, providing them and their local communities food security and informal economy.

title: Help the Mulu Maternity Center in Ethiopia
description: Gondar is in the north of Ethiopia. The city has a high mortality rate of pregnant women and children under one year of age, exceeding the average for African countries. Since 2013 we have been working with Ayme NGO to build and maintain The Mulu Maternity Center, reducing the mortality rates because women can now have prenatal controls, give birth or attend during the puerperium stage. We need help to maintain the regular expenses and guarantee electricity for surgeries, helping 6000 people.

title: Supporting Health Workers in Myanmar
description: THET has supported Myanmar health workers for over 7 years. COVID-19 and the recent coup have placed them under unprecedented pressure, resulting in an increased demand for training and information exchange with their counterparts in the UK, particularly in the field of acute and emergency medicine. This project will strengthen the skills of Myanmar health workers and equip them with the tools to continue delivering healthcare to the communities & patients they seek to serve at a time of crisis.

title: Champions to Feed Odisha Elephants
description: As forest resources in Odisha rapidly dwindle due to development pressures, distressed and famished elephants are forced to enter villages and cropland in search of food, by crossing major highways. This is intensifying human elephant conflict and causing an unprecedented number of elephant deaths by vehicle collisions. Restoring degraded habitats with favored elephant plant species will provide safe foraging grounds for elephants and prevent them from crossing treacherous roads to find food.

title: Empowering 200 girls to continue with primary educ
description: We helping 200 girls from Mabinya village in Lilongwe back to school. We have removed them from early marriages. We going to conduct  civic education about the importance of school. We will give them vocational skills in tailoring and saloon. We will inviting women role models to encourage to finish school. We will help them to make simple reusable sanitary towels. We give them solar lamps for study and charge phones for income generating activities.we will also buy bicycles for girls.

title: Red-Pak/Dry-Bottom/ Und-Her-Wear Projects
description: These projects restore dignity, self-esteem, hope, and improve physical and mental health through our unique outreach and collaboration programs. Our Red-Pak (feminine hygiene products), Dry-Bottom (diapers, pull-ups, and other baby products), and Und-Her-Wear (new and gently-used bras and new panties) Programs provide basic need hygiene, underwear, diapers, and more for homeless, low-to-no income women and children/infants, teens, and trans men.

title: Educational support project for 200 children
description: Our project fights against the educational and digital gap of 200 children who attend the Day Centers that we have in Spain. These are children who, due to the pandemic, have worsened their economic and social situation, and who do not have possibility of accessing support resources to improve their academic performance, which aggravates their situation of educational exclusion. We help them through: 1. School reinforcement 2. Delivery of tablets 3. Internet connection 4. Digital training

title: 28000 trees/year to reforest Azuero Peninsula
description: Pro Eco Azuero invites you to help expand our efforts to restore stream-side tropical dry forest habitat in Azuero. Last year, through the pandemic we were able to plant more than 5000 trees with 11 local cattle ranchers. Each year the demand from landowners for reforestation partnerships is growing. Riparian reforestation creates habitat for monkeys & other wildlife, connects existing forest, & enhances farm sustainability. Help make our yearly reforestation efforts a success!

title: School for Justice- education survivors SEC Nepal
description: The School for Justice programme is a programme that started in Nepal in 2019 and targets survivors who fell victim to sexual exploitation of children (SEC) as a minor (but can now be young adults) in which they become change agents and assist in combatting/preventing SEC and raising awareness on SEC locally.    To empower survivors to become change agents  and speak up about the issue of SEC, they are provided with education in a humanitarian direction (journalism, law, social work, etc.) as we

title: 15 Year Anniversary
description: Since 2006, AdvocAid has learned about what works to achieve feminist law reform. With your support, we will use the insights from our hands-on legal services and projects to raise the voices of the women and girls we work with to national and international platforms, creating change for generations of Sierra Leonean girls to come.  Your contributions through Global Giving give us the independence allow us to adapt and react to the needs of the women and girls we work with.

title: Provide Pandemic Relief For 500 Cambodian Families
description: At-risk youth should still have their basic needs met during Covid-19. As Cambodia faces a major outbreak, poor families are struggling to make ends meet. In April, a nighttime curfew began in Phnom Penh, and other restrictions make it harder for the poor to earn income as food vendors and day laborers. Mission Dove Cambodia will provide food and hygiene supplies to vulnerable families and at-risk youth of its learning programs and target areas in Phnom Penh city and in six other provinces.

title: Reaching a Child: Online Education for Refugees
description: After conducting various statistics and studies in Lebanon, numbers show that more than half of Syrian refugee children have no access to any kind of education. A staggering number of hopeless children are illiterate and have no hope for the future. Online learning is a solution to cover the illiteracy of the Syrian refugee children in informal camps. Through this project, we are intending to connect online teachers with out-of-school children age 6-14 living in camps. You can help in doing so!

title: The Superheroes Challenge
description: The Cedar Foundation superheroes are faced with yet another serious challenge - to raise funds for summer camps for 30 disadvantaged children. Due to the pandemic the children have been confined to the Small Group Homes with reduced physical activity and without the chance to travel during the vacations. To celebrate their success in raising the necessary funds, the team will climb one of the country's highest peaks dressed as superheroes.

title: Help provide PPE for paramedics in Mexico
description: Our community has been hit hard by the COVID-19 pandemic and, as a response, we are providing free pre hospital emergency services to those who are suffering complications from this condition. We are committed to provide these services by implementing the highest safety standards for both, our paramedics and patients.

title: Food/Shelter/Emergency Aid for 4,800 FL Veterans
description: Many veterans are returning home to Florida.  Marion County Veterans Helping Veterans Inc. wants to make it possible for them to maintain their independence and dignity.  Without requested funding, we would be unable to serve more veterans.  Veterans would be left with an unstable support group, improper housing, and a difficult time incorporating their way back into society.  Our desire is to make veterans feel honored, welcomed and safe in their communities.

title: Help Save The Bush in Australia
description: As cities across Australia expand the natural habitat for many special and unique wildlife is shrinking at a quick rate. With this and the heat leading to bush fires this project works to protect, educate and preserve the Australian bush and also be ready to respond to emergency rescue of wildlife when fires break out. A gift to this project will go a very long way to making sure we leave a beautiful planet for future generations.

title: Saint Vincent - La Soufriere Volcano Response
description: La Soufriere volcano on the island of Saint Vincent has been erupting since April 9th, coating the island in ash and forcing 16,000 people to evacuate. The ash has caused local water sources to become contaminated. Displaced people are in need of basic supplies such as food, clean water and hygiene items.  GlobalMedic is responding by sending Family Emergency Kits that contain a water purification solution and Emergency Food Kits which will be distributed to families displaced by the eruption.

title: Ilela COVID-19 Relief project with Kindamba FCO
description: Currently the problem of Corona virus and the shortage of water at Ilela and Ngelenge dispensaries in Ludewa District has a terrible condition. The out and in patients have no water to wash hands, and for toilets when attending the health facility services. Two nurses are daily have to come to these dispensaries with 5liters of water from home for the staff use. The villagers contamination is rampant, crowding at a water source, no social distancing, no hand washing as self protection to COVID19

title: Village of Abwanget (Uganda): Community Library
description: Libraries for the World is partnering with the Centre for Children and Library Foundation to build a community library in Uganda's rural village of Abwanget. The library will be housed in a community center that will also serve the educational and mental health needs of the local children. The library will serve all villagers --- population 1000 --- by providing access to books, computer terminals, and library programs.

title: WILDLIFE RECOVERY & EMERGENCY PREPAREDNESS
description: The wildlife trade is a multi-billion dollar industry that threatens endangered species' survival and human health as zoonotic diseases such as COVID-19 emerge. Bangladesh is both a wildlife source and transit country, and illegal trafficking was rampant in 2001 when the Wildlife Rapid Rescue Team (WRRT) was established to crack down on the trade. To date, WRRT has rescued over 69,000 live animals, apprehended over 7,700 traders, and confiscated large quantities of animal parts and contraband.

title: Preventing sexual abuse for vulnerable children
description: The project aims to prevent sexual abuse of nearly 100 children affected by HIV/AIDs, orphans, and poor children to ensure that they have a healthy, safe and happy life, instead of suffering the consequences of sexual abuse in both the short and long term. The main activities include: Strengthen life skills and knowledge for children to protect themselves; Support for adolescents in apprenticeship and job seeking; Provide monthly financial support; Raise awareness and skills for stakeholders.

title: Donate health to 40 low-income Venezuelan migrant
description: Colombia registers the highest number in its history as a host country for Venezuelan immigrants. Most of them come into the country illegally, making it almost impossible to access basic healthcare among other necessities. Even though the Covid-19 crisis has worsened everyone's situation, in 2020 Patronato Foundation had 37 Venezuelan beneficiaries who received 219 health related services. Help us keep providing comprehensive health-care services, to immigrant children from Venezuela.

title: Not alone: Legal support to stop foreclosures
description: Between 2017-2020, during hurricanes, earthquakes and a pandemic,  12,800 homes were foreclosed in Puerto Rico. We provide education, support and legal empowerment tools to families unable to pay their mortgages in Puerto Rico. "Derecho a tu casa" has been working for 6 years to provide free legal ed workshops, know your right toolkits, legal helplines, and advocacy toolkits to empower particularly women and elders at risk of foreclosures.

title: Support Sign Language Legal Literacy - Puerto Rico
description: It is estimated that 218,495 deaf adults live in Puerto Rico (2018). While these numbers may be underestimated, they signal a huge population excluded from civic participation and development. Lack of legal literacy and access to justice fosters impunity regarding the discrimination and violence deaf families experience. This project supports know your rights campaigns, legal empowerment, and support In sign language. Together we can build an equitable and inclusive world.

title: FOR $20 HELP A POOR WOMAN JOIN A COOPERATIVE
description: This project helps to uplift rural poor communities especially women and youth living in extreme poverty by joining community cooperatives.  Kigezi Healthcare foundation has been supporting families to join community cooperatives that in turn support their small enterprises through savings and credits, so many families have joined crafts cooperatives, mushroom cooperative, vegetable cooperatives, rabbit cooperatives, and many others. $20 can help a poor woman join a cooperative.

title: One Month of Fuel for the Lake Clinic Boats
description: The Lake Clinic provides health care to nine floating villages across the Tonle Sap in Cambodia. Taking care of each patient would not be possible if there wasn't fuel to ensure the transportation for the medical teams to the lake villagers.  Through health care and wellness education, TLC serves the underserved. Help fund a month worth of fuel for The Lake Clinic!

title: CLUB 10 INITIATIVE: Clean Water and Sanitation
description: Hifadhi Africa Organization is launching CLUB 10, a new monthly giving community that invites donations of just $10 monthly. This budget-friendly entry point recognizes that even those who might not have much to give can still play an important role in supporting the cause of clean water for all under SDG 6. While $10 monthly may not seem much, over a year's time, this grows to $120 and provide at least one person with reliable water access for an entire year.

title: Home for parentless children in Caracas.
description: Bambi 5 is dedicated to give refuge to babies under two years old that don't have a family environment to grow-up in. We guarantee them an affectionate care, feeding, medical attention, vaccinations, and early stimulation. We also offer orientation and support to biological and adoptive parents, ensuring that babies return to a family a soon as possible.

title: K2K Coffee - Kenyan Coffee Supports Kenyan Kids
description: In continuation of our longstanding partnership, Junction Coffee and Prelude Coffee Roasters has created this special roast of Kenyan coffee.  The proceeds go towards supporting Orphans and Vulnerable Children (OVC's) in Western Kenya who have been orphaned due to HIV and AIDS. Money from this Kenyan coffee will help Kenyan kids grow to be self-sufficient adults! One bag supports one child for one month.  To partner with us in this cause you can give a one-time gift or give a monthly donation!

title: Let Girls Learn
description: Without school, girls are considered to have a lower status than boys. This is why ARA pays special attention to girls and the promotion of their rights.  The extreme poverty of families, the Boko Haram conflict in the Far North and NOSO (North West and South West Cameroon) deprive girls of school. For all of these girls, one of the survival options for them and their families is marriage, prostitution and/or transactional sex.  Girls' education is therefore the precursor to sustainable change.

title: Digital Skills for Underprivileged Kids in Lebanon
description: In order to ensure that all of our student beneficiaries have access to online learning and have the opportunity to develop digital skills, we are raising money to purchase laptops we will then distribute to the schools where our Fellows serve (Teach For Lebanon Fellows serve as teachers and leaders in underprivileged school communities).

title: Making Organ Donation a Reality
description: There is an ever widening gap between demand and supply of organs in India. As a result precious lives are lost each day. One of the biggest impediments to organ donation is the lack of awareness and a positive outlook towards donation.  Funds raised through this project will aim at creating awareness on organ donation especially amongst the youth through innovative ways to engage public interest,  encourage family discussion, build positivity and motivate people to pledge for organ donation.

title: Building a home for the Flores family in Mexico
description: Gildardo and Cristina earn the minimum salary to be able to support their family. They use this salary to feed and educate their children and that is why they have not been able to find a decent space to live. Currently they live in a room with their 3 children, this room was lent to them by Gildardo's father but it is very difficult for children to grow up in an environment where they do not have space or privacy.

title: Let's be a beacon of hope for Autism in Venezuela
description: Family dynamics has a big impact on a family's wellbeing. When a member(s) has autism, designing, implementing and managing a structured, predictable environment, and routine improves day to day living for all. We provide our families and caregivers tailor-made personal advice, guidance and intervention strategies to address their family dynamics. We have re-invented our services to help and accompany our families meet their needs, while ensuring our community stays safe, healthy and productive.

title: Building Libraries in Rural Uganda
description: We are building 2 libraries, in conjunction with Help one Child Uganda, in rural areas within Uganda.  Each library will not only focus on creating and nourishing a culture of reading, but will serve as a community center in these remote villages.  A dedicated librarian will serve each library and offer programming that includes daily story times and arts and crafts classes.  Each library will provide an outlet where children and adults can go to learn and explore.

title: 500 t of food: saved from wasting, given to poor
description: 393 thousand tonnes of food get wasted in Lithuania annually, while 20 percent of the Lithuanian population is struggling to afford a healthy diet. Lithuanian food bank "Maisto bankas" saves more the 6000 tonnes from getting wasted every year, but there is so much more. A new minivan added to our fleet of food-saving vans could save another 500 tonnes a year. We kindly ask you to help us purchase a van-food saver!

title: Combating Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trafficking
description: -This project will help reduce poaching and wildlife trafficking: Uganda bush meat hunting is identified as one of the threats to wildlife in national parks. Its impact on African savannas receives far less attention. Bush-meat, typically occurs on a continuum from hunting for direct consumption and/or community trade, to large scale commercial trade in urban centers.  -Strengthen Community Wildlife conservation in 4 National Parks -Create community awareness in 20 community locations

title: COMPLETION OF CLASSROOM FOR CHILDREN WITH DYSLEXIA
description: Rare Gem Talent School is a day and boarding school with over 200 children who have learning difficulties and other special needs. The school currently is on a rented compound that has insufficient classrooms that do not give the children a conducive environment for learning.   This project is aimed at constructing permanent classrooms for children with Dyslexia on the acquired land. The new classrooms will provide the environment and the necessary resources for multi sensory learning and skills

title: Help save the lives of Cambodian mothers & babies
description: In rural areas of Cambodia, mothers and babies are vulnerable to complications due to high-risk pregnancies. Japan Heart Cambodia has built a perinatal ward at the Japan Heart Children's Medical Center for managing high-risk births and pregnancies, maternity classes and midwife training for local nurses. Japan Heart will expand this project by hiring and training more midwives, purchasing much needed equipment and expanding our capacity to save the lives of more mothers and children.

title: Restore Lives of 100 Children with Disabilities.
description: This  project will support 100 Children Living with Disabilities within the four slum communities of Kampala Uganda To Access free physiotherapy rehabilitation services as well as access free assistive devices like wheel chairs, hearing aids, walkers, and white canes, to enable them raise above their disabilities.

title: Provide one Mechanised Borehole to Bongo Hospital
description: The project is meant to provide one mechanised water supply system to Bongo District Hospital in Upper East Region, Ghana. The hospital is an 85-bed capacity, serving about 134 communities with total population size of 84,545. The hospital has a history of recording frequent water shortages hence the maternity and surgical wards do not get frequent water supply thus resulting in frequent deaths and high rates of referral cases of minor surgical and caesarean operations to the regional hospital.

title: Mongolian Herder Veterinarian Training
description: Mongolian herders that have relied on traditional animal husbandry for generations are struggling to adapt to our changing world. One of the last nomadic horse cultures on earth can benefit greatly from modern veterinarian methods to make the lives of their families and animals better. Steppe and Hoof travels into the Mongolian countryside with programs, tools and supplies to help herders live better so they can continue to live as they have for a thousand years.

title: DARAJA EDUCATIONAL EMPOWERMENT PROJECT
description: Daraja Educational Empowerment Project is part of the Organization's programmes targeting basic education needs for the orphans and vulnerable children in pre primary, primary and secondary schools in Alego Usonga Sub County, Siaya County Kenya. The project will pay school fees for 50 needy students in secondary schools, buy uniform for 60 pupils in primary schools and, equip the Early Childhood Classrooms at Hills Merchant School with desks and chairs for 40 children.

title: Provide 900 pregnant women access to maternal care
description: This project will provide 900 pregnant women from low-income communities and rural areas in Zambia with access to sterile supplies to use during childbirth ensuring safe delivery. Due to the broken healthcare system, pregnant women are required to bring their own sterile birth materials for their childbirth to be allowed to give birth from a public health facility, but many cannot afford to due to the high cost of accessing the services leading to high maternal and neonatal mortality rates.

title: initiatives to support haitian adolescent mothers
description: This project will train 25 single mothers and teenage mothers in trades related to the green economy Artistic ironwork (recycled iron) or installation and assembly of solar panels at Leogan (Wes departement of Haiti) and train them also in sexual and reproductive health in order to that she can become ambassadors for the other young girls of their community around themes related to sex education, sexuality early, early union, underuse of contraceptive, the promotion of female entrepreneurship

title: Build a special needs unit for 40 kids, Kenya
description: Do you think it's ok for someone with a disability to miss out on equal education opportunities? We don't either. Help us build a comprehensive special needs unit at the largest primary school in Kitengela, Kenya. The unit is so important now, as COVID-19 restrictions mean only 12 of the 40 students can attend class owing to insufficient space. The new unit will provide ample room and the only ambulant toilets in the town. Ken-ya support us?

title: Emergency Peace: Rapid Funds for Local Response
description: This project will provide micro grants to volunteer District Peace Committees (DPCs) in over 30 districts of Somalia to support their reconciliation efforts. The project, by helping DPCs respond to conflict rapidly, will ensure early action to prevent escalation of disputes that may lead to violent conflict. DPCs already respond to issues related to gender-based violence, property disputes, and clan conflicts. They provide mediation, community dialogues, and conflict prevention activities.

title: Strengthening Schools' Infrastructure for Learning
description: This project will improve school's infrastructure for 1000 vulnerable students from resource-poor households in violence prone communities of Ketu, Lagos.  The implementation will include the replacement of 13 dilapidated white board markers, provision of classroom furniture and generator, as well as, painting school walls to create positive learning ambience and incentives for students to be highly motivated and expunge truancy and physical, sexual and emotional abuse

title: One Million Leaders Africa Project
description: The One Million Leaders Africa (OMLA) project is helping to build the movement to put Africa on a new path by 2030 by empowering (through a training in Leadership, Sustainability, Social Innovation and Social Entrepreneurship) one million credible young leaders who will be proud to be leaders guiding Africa to a better future.

title: Building Peace Through Entrepreneurship in Cyprus
description: SocialTech Lab's CyprusInno transformed by hand a 4-part military container which we call The Base by CyprusInno, the first space of its kind in the world located in a Buffer Zone that combines the elements of a coworking, innovation center, studio, & accelerator/incubator. This fundraiser helps to sustain our yearly operations necessary to continue scaling for impact and allows us to train, accelerate, and incubate startups from our divided communities to build peace through entrepreneurship.

title: COVID-19 Help for India
description: While some parts of the world are seeing vaccine roll-outs, India is currently gripped by a lethal second wave of coronavirus. Hospitals are overwhelmed and there have been reports of oxygen shortages and insufficient hospital beds. There are urgent calls for more beds, medicines, oxygen, essential drugs and COVID tests.

title: Educate and Empower 200 Rural Girls in Nigeria
description: We support rural girls back to school and also run an after school club where girls can read, socialise and play games with their pairs. We teach them about their rights so that they can protect themselves against harmful practices like child sexual abuse and child marriage. We Offer; Home Work Assistance, Healthy Snacks & Meals, ICT class, Counselling, Mentoring, Body Safety Class, Arts & Crafts,  Mental Health & Wellness, Physical Fitness & Sports, College & Career Access Programs and Movies

title: Protect mental health, keep our centres open!
description: This project will save lives. Keeping our centres open means we can protect and further improve the positive mental health of 350 students. They will learn the skills to support thousands of people from their tea estate communities who live in cramp conditions, with little access to resources during this terrible pandemic.  Tea Leaf Trust is a critical part of the community providing consistent support, to the children of women who pick your tea.

title: SUPPORT FOR KIDNEY DISEASE PATIENTS IN NIGERIA
description: This project will provide blood pressure monitors, glucose monitors, routine medications and dialysis support for 200 indigent chronic kidney disease patients in Southern Nigeria, to promote self-monitoring and effective management of hypertension and diabetes.

title: Basic Health Care Services to IDPs in Afghanistan
description: Afghanistan is facing a great challenge of IDPs due to recent change of Afghan government. The economic and security reasons forced thousands of Afghans to leave their homes and take refuge in the major cities across the country. According to OCHA report 570,482 people were displaced due to conflict at the end of Aug 2021.Under this fund HEALTHO will provide Basic Health Care (BHC) & MCHC Services to 3500 most vulnerable individuals (Mothers Children and Elderly) of IDPs in Kabul, Afghanistan.

title: Sand Dams, Climate Change, and Hope
description: A sand dam is a reinforced concrete wall built on bedrock across a seasonal sandy river to collect water and sand during the rainy season and store it for use during the dry season. When it rains, the dam captures soil-laden water behind it - the sand in the water sinks to the bottom, whilst the silt remains suspended in the water. HAO has found sand dams to be the most cost-effective method of water harvesting, conservation and recharging in dry land and very remote environments.

title: SCHOOL REOPEN - Let's Get Girls Back to School
description: This project will fund the training of less privileged population of girl child in Nigeria, providing access to quality education, books, school bag and food to support 1000 disproportionately marginalized poor and orphan, affected by the economic and civil crises, add to the COVID-19 lockdown effect on parents' financial power.

title: Send girls in Turkana to school
description: Uhai Binti 'Girl Alive' will advocate for the rights of up to 1500 girls in Lopiding, Turkana to education and against early marriage and subsequently facilitate their education through the provision of sanitary towels and textbooks

title: FEED THE PEOPLE WAITING IN QUEUES AT CREMATORIUMS
description: ISKCON Varanasi with the help of HOPE WELFARE TRUST is providing free meals to the family members & people waiting in queues at crematoriums/cemeteries for the last rites of the bodies of their loved ones lost to COVID-19. The second wave has hit India very badly and Varanasi is one of the top five affected cities. Currently, the waiting duration is more than 15 hours at most of the places simply to get to cremate the mortal remains of the deceased.

title: TRAIN OF HOPE
description: We bought an old locomotive and a wagon. Now the train of hope is on its own tracks on the grounds of our recreation complex "Bernsteinsee". So, the train stands on the site where families with children suffering from cancer should recover and forget about this disease for a while. To make the stay more varied for the families and to offer activities also for bad weather, we want to make this train something special with a cinema and a great fitness area.

title: SPONSOR OXYGEN FOR OLD VILLAGERS (COVID PATIENTS)
description: ISKCON Varanasi, with the help of UMEED & HOPE WELFARE TRUST, is trying to help poor villagers afflicted with COVID-19 in arranging for oxygen cylinders. The beds in hospitals are full and there is a scarcity of oxygen cylinders in the whole country. Several patients need oxygen provision even at their homes as they struggle to breathe & pass this tough phase.

title: Help Get MULIA Donations From Lexington To Uganda!
description: EXTRA FUNDS RAISED BEYOND SHIPPING COSTS WILL BE USED TO SUPPORT ONGOING PROGRAMMING AND PROJECTS. Please click on "Music for Life Africa" at the top of this page for more information!  The 32 boxes from our amazing friends in Lexington will help MULIA establish a computer lab, equip the music program, provide health/hygiene/school/recreational supplies and library books, supply reusable bags/backpacks, and provide materials to make solar ovens as well as reusable menstrual pads and diapers.

title: Transform Lives Of Marginalized Boys in Mazatlan!
description: You can help transform the lives of at-risk, vulnerable boys by supporting UFM (Un Futuro Mejor - A Better Future) . This innovative program in Mazatlan, Mexico provides marginalized children a stable, nurturing environment; and a quality education. UFM supports their children from middle school through university or technical training. UFM equips the boys to break free from poverty and provides them tools to increase their employability, social mobility, and competency in critical life skills.

title: Support Children Orphaned by HIV in Uganda
description: Due to the tragic HIV epidemic in Uganda, there are many children orphaned and there are limited resources to help care for them. We aim to help some of these children. With your help, we ensure that each child is well cared for and all basic needs are provided.  In addition, each child receives medical care and an education and is fostered within a nourishing environment.

title: Help India Fight the Unprecedented COVID Surge
description: This project will help build and operate COVID Health Center in the poverty-stricken area of Western India, which along with entire India is facing an unprecedented second wave of COVID. The Health Center will have 100 beds and essential medical supplies like oxygen tanks, ventilators, CT-scan machine (and much more). It will save thousands of lives and help the underserved section of the society avoid succumbing to the disease.

title: SAFE GIRL .
description: Safe Girl manufactures, distributes and trains reusable menstrual kits to rural girls and women in Mpigi. With a goal of making over 30,000 reusable menstrual  kits that we shall distribute to girls and women in rural areas of Mpigi and disadvantaged communities like nakivale refugee and bidibidi refuge camps. We aim to keep the girl child in school enabling her achieve her dreams . Your donations will enable us acquire sewing machines , purchase materials and  facilitate the distribution proc

title: FOOD AID FOR INDIAN FAMILIES IN CRISIS
description: Vaccinating adults in the Mumbai slums against Covid-19 is OSCAR Foundation's priority. Misinformation, fear, lack of time, loss of income & accessibility is preventing adults from low income communities taking up the vaccine. OSCAR's 'Vaccine Education & Participation' programme provides the science, the facts & the urgency. The OSCAR team will help with vaccine registration & support adults too afraid to leave their communities to travel to the vaccination centres. Read on...

title: PAM Supporting Communities
description: Provide  assistance to the victimized people and prisoner with a conducive environment in the society for developing their confidence, mutual trust and harmony to get through their social status and behavior to overcome their problems. PAM becomes a Community Service Centre by providing judo training, library and gym services, and agricultural technologies, training and services

title: Hope Alive 845
description: Families, victims, & law enforcement with support/necessary services for the missing, kidnapped or exploited children & adults. Your contributions let us offer a multitude of different areas & support. Search & rescue teams Grief counselors for family People to go into the schools & educate our children Private Investigators Workshops Materials for informing the public & spreading awareness Better systems to help aid law enforcement Ability to maintain the Hope Alive 845 org. as a whole and more

title: Inspira Cambio A.C.
description: We are an organization of Mexican civil society dedicated to promoting people's sexual and reproductive health, as well as the full exercise of a healthy, diverse and taboo-free sexuality; especially of people with HIV and other STIs, women, people who use substances and the LGBT + population.

title: OMICRON EMERGENCY-MASK-SANITIZR FOR WOMEN,CHILDREN
description: Covid-19 - 2nd wave created a very dangerous situation in India. All people affected physically and mentally all aspects of her life. Children, women are very troublesome.  Now  OMICRON MUTATED virus has spread in nook and corner in India. a lot of prevention things are required as well. Emergency need mask, sanitizer to the women Aged peoples and children.  It is very important to control the omicron. Low poverty line people are not able to buy this frequently. We protect women and children.

title: Emergency COVID Care support in Bangalore
description: India is grappling with the apocalyptic spike that has wreaked havoc on our health care system. More than 200,000 people have lost their lives. In Bangalore, there are 300,000 infected, and around 15,000 have lost their lives. We expect the actual numbers to go up by 3 or 4 times. Lack of beds, oxygen, essential medicines and a depleted healthcare team is what we have now. Your donation will help treat, save people with COVID and slow the spread of COVID-19 in Bangalore and its rural villages.

title: Medical assistance to rural Venezuelan communities
description: CUMIS UCV is a project created by medical students from the Universidad Central de Venezuela that contemplates 3 fundamental pillars seeking to ensure a multidisciplinary approach to the health problems we found in each community: health care, research, and education. We provide medical assistance and treatments to more than 6 remote and indigenous communities and develop educational and research programs that seek to prevent countless diseases.

title: Help the Neediest Get Veterinary Care
description: Throughout the United States, animals are in desperate need of medical care.  This project provides free spay/neuter, vaccinations, and veterinary services to pets belonging to low-income and no-income individuals and families in impoverished areas of Maryland, Virginia, and DC metro area. We aim to help 50 owned dogs and 500 owned cats every year for 10 years. The Maryland Department of Agriculture Spay and Neuter Grant Program provided seed support for this project in 2019, 2020, and 2022.

title: Support HIV/AIDS Prevention in Nigeria
description: This project will conduct HIV/AIDS education and sensitization in the secondary schools and tertiary institutions in Anambra State, placing billboards on the roads and in those institutions, to encourage people to get tested for HIV, know their status and avoid stigmatizing and discriminating against people living with HIV/AIDS. HIV/AIDS education is key if we want to prevent new HIV infections and end AIDS, as it concerns people who are living with HIV/AIDS and those who are not.

title: Holistic Education, Vulnerable Cameroonian Youths
description: This project will build a school to provide education to at least 240 orphans,vulnerable youths & internally displaced persons (IDP's) in a remote village called Ashong,NW Cameroon. The holistic education program started in 2018 in a rental apartment, providing free elementary education to children, blended with computer literacy,tailoring training,emotional and psychological support.Many more children keep knocking on our doors but COREDA did not have the physical space to accommodate them

title: Clean Water and Light for the Andes
description: Access to safe, clean water and light is a basic necessity for all living beings. Yet, those living in many communities in the Sacred Valley of Peru have access to neither! Their water is contaminated with parasites and viruses like giardia and salmonella. Their home lighting is from smoky, lung-disease causing kerosene lanterns. This project will provide filters with safe drinking water and solar lanterns for families in six Andean communities, impacting over 2,500 people for one year.

title: Extension of the project "SOS We need to continue"
description: In 2021, with the worsening of the pandemic and the shortage of vaccines, families that were already in a vulnerable situation have become even more fragile, at the mercy of extreme poverty and hunger.  To support these families, food baskets, hygiene kits and masks in Camacari, Dias d'vila, Lauro de Freitas Simoes Filho and Taubate will be distributed in partnership with the  Rede Asta . This is an expansion of the existing project that will be benefit 1500 families over a period of 4 months.

title: Support Advanced Cancer Patients in Lebanon
description: SANAD was established to address the many challenges experienced by advanced chronically and terminally ill patients (serious illness) and their families as they deal with their illness and its reality. SANAD's holistic approach to hospice care addresses any medical, social and psychological challenges patients and their families may need.

title: Cycle Kosovo for Children
description: The Cycle Kosovo for Children is a fundraising event, started in 2014. Since then, a group of 40 - 50 cyclists participate in the annual tour, cycling around Kosovo, passing through major cities in the country, including 500 km of cycling and 6,000 meters of climbing. The tour continued each year with the same goal, namely raising funds to buy medical equipment for the healthcare institutions in Kosovo.

title: India COVID 19  continuing education for children
description: Thamarai Education projects (www.thamarai.org) offer education to 130 children in rural villages, Tamil Nadu. The current wave of COVID 19 is very difficult for families, children are particularly in need. We, at Thamarai Education Projects, are committed to working towards the full potential for all. We have adapted our after-school programs to provide daily learning calls, emotional check-ins, and home drops of education supplies.

title: Mask Plus Income
description: COVID-19 pandemic is still incredibly growing in Brazil in 2021. Urgent actions are needed to minimize social and public health negative impacts. This project is an expansion of a previous project to produce additional 15,000 handmade masks with 15 low income women. We will pay them to produce and distribute the masks along with hygiene kits (alcohol and bleach) to low income families in the states of Bahia and Sao Paulo. We will generate income and provide basic protection against coronavirus.

title: Build a preschool for 58 children in Vietnam
description: Giang Si Tung is a mountainous commune in the North of Vietnam, where people often live as social outcasts in famine, poverty and neglect. This village has a one-space wooden shack with insufficent conditions to teach preschool pupils. They dream to build a proper school that teach 58 children, using local materials. CHPF foundation and the 2000 Power Group has teamed up to help. This project will build a new preschool with a slassroom, small toilet room, kitchen to provide daily breakfast and .

title: India COVID-19 Relief Fund
description: India is grappling with a deadly COVID-19 outbreak. More than 200,000 people have died due to a second coronavirus surge in India and hundreds of thousands of people are infected each day. Many are unable to get the medical help they need. Donations to this fund will help treat patients and slow the spread of COVID-19 in India.

title: Covid-19: Aid to Slum Communities in India
description: India is passing through a deadly 2nd surge of COVID-19 outbreak. More than 3,000 people are dying, and tens of thousands are infected each day. Marginalized populations, mostly daily wage workers, living in the slums & villages need food & other basic needs and Vaccination to stay alive. Your donations will help distribute essential nutrition, dry ration kits, and hygiene kits to families living in slums & villages of Delhi, Haryana & Rajasthan while educating them on prevention & vaccination.

title: Support 10 girls to start reusable pads project
description: This project will help 10 female jobless youths to make reusable sanitary pads for school girls who miss school during their menstrual cycle or completely drop out of school because blood 'embarrassed' them in the classroom. They will be making reusable sanitary towels for 700+ females at REF community center and 5,000+ female villagers in the surrounding communities. This beneficiary-centered project will fight menstrual stigma in rural communities and promote menstrual hygiene among women.

title: Mobile classroom empowers 1000+ kids in Langa CT
description: This project will provide online literacy programmes for primary school learners from the impoverished, Langa community.  South Africa has an unequal education system and high drop-out rate which perpetuates the cycle of poverty. This mobile classroom, equipped with 40 laptops & 2 teaching stations  will support 5 Langa schools in the Langa Township, offering programmes that will utilise the expertise & materials of leading school, Bishops Diocesan College.

title: Zakat for Palestinian Medical Students Scholarship
description: We are fundraising to help medical students pay their tuition and relief their families financial hardship Cost per beneficiary.  The project provides one time $1000 scholarships to students OR Full tuitions for others "about $6000 a year".   These scholarships benefit medical students in Gaza and the West Bank. The impact of these scholarships on the students and their families is huge as described by the students themselves.

title: COVID Relief India: Support Low-Income Communities
description: There is a desperate need to support India going through the second wave of COVID-19. With several hundred thousand people being affected everyday India's social and health support system is overwhelmed. Bhumi's COVID Relief Support is aimed at connecting people in need through our volunteers and helpline with either funding support and/or people who can support them.

title: 2021 PAMA COVID-19 Urgent Relief to Palestine
description: During these uncertain and challenging times, PAMA continues to update you on the situation in Palestine. Currently, there are 163573 confirmed cases of COVID-19 in the West Bank and Gaza, and 1684 deaths cases as of 1/7/2021.We at PAMA are committed to supporting Palestine throughout this crisis and we know that you are too. We have seen how, together, PAMA and its supporters can save lives and we know we can count on you to meet this challenge with us.

title: COVID 19 RELIEF FUND Rural India
description: AVAG is launching a participatory education and preventive initiative to support 20,000 families in 75 settlements around Auroville, Tamil nadu, India in cooperation with Auroville units and schools, the villagers and the local authorities to contain the spread of the pandemic.

title: Cochlear implants - Palestinian children hear loss
description: Every year in Palestine there are 250 to 300 children born with hearing loss. Their hearing loss is severe to the point most of them will need cochlear implants. Cochlear implants are devices that are surgically planted under the skin and in the skull bone and help replace children restore their hearing. The implants are very sophisticated devices and very expensive. Unfortunately, without your help, most Palestinian children who need this service will end up not getting it.

title: Support 6 Teens From Kibera Compete in Amsterdam
description: After 10 years of working progress Victor, Kennedy, Derrick and Eddy (4 of the boys in our long-term sport development program) have earned a spot at the World Duathlon Championships Elite & U23 to be held in Almere, Netherlands from 4th to 13th Sep 2021. Two of the girls in our program have also qualified to attend the global showpiece. These 6 athletes are at a critical stage of transition from amateur to professional athletics.

title: India COVID-19 Emergency Relief Fund
description: This project will ensure oxygen support to 152 critically ill COVID-19 patients, food and ration support to 500 vulnerable families, and home-based care and treatment to hundred COVID-19 patients who have no financial and emotional support during the crisis. The project will also support our frontline workers who have been infected with the virus while working on the ground, ensuring emergency relief to the families worst affected by lockdown. Beneficiaries will be supported across India.

title: Covid-19 Help For 50 Animal Welfare Staff In India
description: TOLFA Animal Hospital has been working to help the sick and injured animals of India for over 15 years. We have helped over 225,000 animals in this time. We wouldn't be able to do this without our incredible Indian team - 50 men and women from mostly impoverished backgrounds who support their extended families through their employment at TOLFA. As the terrifying new Covid-19 Crisis rips through India we have a duty to keep our staff safe and well. This project is to provide support for our staff

title: Protect India's children from the second wave
description: The second surge of coronavirus continues to worsen the struggles of the underserved at a faster pace compared to last year. Ground reports also suggest that one of the main, emerging worries during this second wave is the increasing number of children being affected by the virus.   We at CRY, Child Rights and You, along with our project partners have assessed the situation and created an emergency plan to address the immediate health, nutrition and safety needs of children and their families.

title: COVID-19  relief for Medical Emergencies in India
description: Agastya International foundation is committed to help its beneficiaries in these tough times. The proceedings from this fundraiser will go to helping our beneficiaries in medical emergencies, ICU care, PPE kits and home care kits in India.

title: Continuing education for children during COVID-19
description: Agastya International Foundation is creating a self learning education kit for the underprivileged children in India. With significant learning loss for especially those without access to technology (75% of underprivileged children), an opportunity to learn creatively (do, question, observe, explore and experiment) at home.  Aha Book is a powerful, low cost "creative maker book" that promotes self learning anywhere, anytime.

title: Food Security for 115 Families in COVID-hit Pune
description: The Waghri and Sikligar communities are Denotified Tribal (DNT) communities residing in several slums in urban Pune, India. These families, already extremely economically and socially marginalized, have been unable to work due to the devastating COVID-19 pandemic, and desperately need food ration support to make it through this crisis. Ashraya Initiative for Children will provide food and sanitary supplies to the 115 families in these communities to help them through the pandemic.

title: Emergency Response to COVID-19 Surge in India
description: India is currently fighting a wave of COVID-19 that is sickening hundreds of thousands each day and is killing thousands. The situation is extremely serious, with more than 18.4 million confirmed COVID-19 cases and more than 205,000 confirmed deaths as of April 29, 2021. At the current rate of infection, it is projected that nearly 960,000 people in India will die from the disease. International Medical Corps is activating our emergency response to address the dire situation.

title: RESPONSE TO COVID19
description: Recently we lost our beloved Bishop Collin Theodore due to CORONA...in his rememberance we want to help and support the vulnerable/ needy people  who are affected due to CORONA. Presently saving the life of the people are  very important.  Our organisation want to start " Bishop Collin Memorial Fund"  and use the fund for the people who are suffering from CORONA.

title: POST-COVID RESPONSE FOR VULNERABLE WOMEN
description: This project aims to contribute to the socio-economic well-being of women heads of households and girl mothers who are victims of acute vulnerability due to the unexpected closure of cross-border activities through which they were trying to fill the void caused by unemployment unfortunately suspended with the arrival of the Covi-19 pandemic. Hence the need for an emergency relief through which the recovery of the economic power will be done precisely in the territory of Nyiragongo.

title: Freetime Activities for Visually Impaired Children
description: The project provides innovative freetime and educational activities for visually handicapped children, in total for around 25 children along with their families. Our lessons are weekly and we mostly use our own space and equipment to help children during their free-time. The children we work with are either completely blind or have combined handicap. We provide them with special interactive lessons in sports, arts, cinema, music, painting. We are based in Prague and co-operate internationally.

title: Support street-connected girls & women in Tanzania
description: Life for girls and young women on the streets is particularly hard and the support they need is challenging to provide. Our aim is to help teenage girls and young women on the streets of Tanzania, South Africa, Burundi and India to rebuild their lives and realise their rights.

title: Breast screening for 5,000 women in Gaza
description: Women in Gaza City are dying of breast cancer when their deaths are completely preventable, or are living with the scars and debilitating impact of medical techniques that should no longer be practiced. We want to end this suffering.

title: Vaccinate & stop spread of COVID IInd wave-India
description: Vaccination, Oxygen & educating our communities about sanitizing, mask and keeping social distance against spread of Covid-19 is CHHASE priority. We will remove Misunderstanding, fear, confusion; loss of income is preventing our community taking up the vaccine. We educate the urgency & facts about vaccination and to encourage vaccination, we will provide transportation to the vaccination centres & return them safely and we will provide food groceries to people, who suffer due to COVID 2nd wave.

title: Bring Youth Baseball Back to Abaco
description: Hurricane Dorian, the most destructive hurricane in the history of The Bahamas, wreaked unimaginable devastation on Great Abaco Island in 2019. COVID 19 brought even more challenges to a community that is struggling to rebuild. We are providing gloves, bats, and helmets for the boys and girls of Abaco, and raising money to restore the baseball/softball field at Central Abaco High School. Practices and conditioning have already begun with over 100 children attending.

title: IAHV India Covid-19 Appeal
description: India is in the midst of a deadly second wave of Covid-19. The daily infection count has gone all-time high. There are horrific stories about lack of oxygen supply resulting in the tragic loss of lives on a daily basis.  During these very testing times, IAHV is working with various state governments in India to help procure Oxygen concentrators, Oxygen cylinders and other medical equipment to help the Hospitals. We appeal to you to kindly donate and help during this calamitous time.

title: Daily snack & education to 140 children in India
description: This project will feed 140 most marginalized children six days a week, that are affected directly by COVID lock down in a town called Vellore, India, with an evening snack and engaging them in activities of academic and recreational value.

title: Food Aid and School Supplies
description: The longstanding drought in semi-arid areas has resulted into shortage of food which affects women, children and old age people. Pandemic hugely have affected women's social economic activities such necklaces, bracelet, belt etc which are made from beads and sold to tourists to support family income.
