Elyon & Friends Tanzania through Global Giving partners stands to help affected families with food aid such as dried maize, beans and cooking oil, also school uniforms and stationeries for students

title: We are not s Priority to society, we are Invisible
description: An estimated 1.5 million children live on the streets of Pakistan, according to various numbers from government surveys and private organisation. Extreme poverty, broken families and physical or sexual abuse are all factors that force many children and young people on to the streets. There is no social security system in place. Particularly in Pakistan's large cities, the number of children living or working in the streets is increasing dramatically.

title: India's covid crises
description: India is going through the worst humanitarian crisis in centuries. The healthcare system is collapsing. The nation is gasping for breath. Every day the number of patients is over 400,000 and there countless innocent deaths. What are we looking for? Funds for oxygen concentrators, essential medical equipment and their maintenance, nutritious meals for COVID +ve patients, rehabilitation support to farmers & rural women microentrepreneurs, construction of a diagnostic and consultancy centre, etc.

title: India Covid-19 Relief fund
description: India has been witnessing a rapid surge in active COVID-19 cases recording the world's highest number of daily cases over 4 Lakhs. It appears to be a bigger threat than it did during the 1st wave due to its homegrown mutant variant which is proving to be more infectious and deadlier. most of the people are unable to get medical support.  In this grave situation we need your donation, that will help to Petain's for treatment and control the second wave of Covid-19 situation.

title: CLEAN WATER ACCESS AT THE CENTRE OF LOVE KIBERA
description: The Centre of Love's sustainable WASH project has made a great impact! Minimizing the spread of disease throughout the pandemic 500 households and 3000 community members access water at a reduced price and our water champions promote the values of clean water, sanitation and hygiene.  Our water storage tanks provide water when the Nairobi water supply is rationed. Improved water pipes, an upgrade to our purified water systems, and a closer line will assist in meeting additional water needs.

title: From mud hut to a  small bricked House
description: Tharparkar is a remote and extended area of Pakistan where basic immunities of life are non-existent. Even drinking water is not available. Women have to travel long distances to fetch water for their families. People live in mud huts which are often burnt due to small fires resulting in damage to life and property. In this backdrop Customs Health Care Society has contemplated building low-cost one-room homes for the poor people of Thar which will provide them shelter and safety from fire.

title: Donate for Disability Image Building
description: Pakistan has signed UN Charter on Rights of Persons with Disabilities (UNCRPD) in 2009 & ratified in 2011. The Province Sindh, has brought local law on disability to protect rights of persons with disabilities to ensure their equality & dignified access to rights in the province. The law on Disability in Sindh "Sindh Empowerment of 'Persons with Disabilities' Act 2018" covers civil and political rights. There is dire need of strong advocacy campaign for disability image building.

title: Australia Bushfire Recovery Continues!
description: This project is restoring 5 hectares (12 acres) of rainforest in north-eastern Australia that was severely burnt in the Australian bushfires in 2019-2020. It will remove invasive weed species that have inundated burnt areas and restore much needed habitat for endangered wildlife including the Koala. This project supports Indigenous people of this region and local community affected in the bushfires. The world watched as this land burnt and it is our chance to restore this beautiful rainforest.

title: COVID RELIEF FOR CRITICAL CASES
description: ISKCON Varanasi with the help of HOPE WELFARE TRUST is helping to arrange free food, medicine, oxygen, etc for people stuck in Hospitals in emergency cases. Old villagers are not able to arrange for basics amenities due to financial constraints. There is a lot of rush in Hospitals, and relatives have to wait with patients to get them to doctors and it becomes very difficult for them to arrange for food, medicine, oxygen, etc leaving the patients alone in an emergency.

title: "Great against cancer family homes" for children
description: Children affected by cancer are subjected to long and exhausting treatments for several months, often far away from home, school, friends. This means a big burden for families, both for their finance and for their mental health.  Help Soleterre Foundation host children with cancer and their families in the "Great Against Cancer Family Homes", close to hospitals. Here they can find a comfortable place to stay for free along with their parents and siblings while going under cancer treatment.

title: Path to Womenhood
description: Path to Womanhood is a project designed to empower and educate young women about what to expect as they journey into womanhood. The nature of this project is to remessage the period with curiosity and anticipation and to remove the shock, shame, and embarrassment often felt by young women when it comes to menstruation. The aim of this is to cultivate an interest in learning and celebrating monthly cycles, so that every young woman can have a deep and holistic understanding of what to expect

title: #EndMenstrualAbsenteeism for 1000 Girls in Zambia
description: In September 2021, the Basizana Project launched with 300 beneficiaries in Central Province Zambia. This year, 2022 the project is expanding to the Western Province to impact 1000 beneficiaries. On average, rural girls miss about 20% of school days annually due to lack of menstrual supplies and often missing exams or performing poorly as a result of their absenteeism during their period. The Basizana Project aims to address this issue by providing sustainable reusable pads to the beneficiaries.

title: COVID Relief for WEP Students and their Families
description: A second Covid-19 wave is devastating families and whole communities across India. The impact will be long-term; WEP's support will be sustainable. WEP has identified XXX students and alumnae and their families (over xxxx people in all) whose needs have become critical. WEP's strategy is 1. providing dry rations/sanitary goods parcels. 2kitchen garden seeds and chickens. 2. training on integrating this relief into livelihoods in their homes and communities -WEP Academy Ripple Effect Certificate.

title: Climate smart agriculture for 500 farmers in Ghana
description: More than 70% of the people living in the rural communities, mostly small scale farmers, in West Africa rely on agriculture for their livelihood.  Climate change has negatively affected the rainfall pattern, eroded soil nutrients, increase high temperature-resistant viruses, with minimal harvest that threatens food security. Biochar technology offers numerous opportunities to addresse these challenging situations in agriculture for sustainable food security.

title: Szlachetna Paczka (the Noble Gift)
description: Noble Gift is one of the most recognizable social program in Poland. Our premise is the idea of providing direct aid so that, it is meaningful, but also gives an impulse of change. Only last year, the program helped over 14 000 families in 600 locations. This project will enable us developing the Gift so that, it reaches people at risk of exclusion in new locations. They will be provided with much-needed material help as well as mental support to take responsibility for their lives again.

title: Emergency COVID in India
description: This project wants to respond to the primary needs of food and health security of 150 children and their families who live in Mumbai, who are facing a very dramatic health crisis due to Covid 19.

title: COVID-19 Safety and Relief Response in Nepal
description: As of recent report, the COVID-19 pandemic will push 96 million people into extreme poverty by 2021, 47 million of whom are women and girls. The essential food items & health kits will be great support for poor and marginalized people. These are largely neglected by the COVID-19 related treatment, care and food insufficiency. This campaign can support essential food, basic COVID safety, health and hygiene materials along with sanitary products like face masks, hand washing soap and sanitizers.

title: Support Clean Water for Maiwut Town, South Sudan
description: GWC is partnering with Aqua-Africa to bring clean water to the African community of Maiwut, South Sudan. The $300k project will improve overall community health and gender equality. Led by a South Sudanese team, the project will bring clean water to 10,000 people, 2 schools and 1 clinic. Clean energy will be provided to the schools and clinic and a septic system will be installed at the clinic. Community members, with a focus on women, will be trained to manage the community resources.

title: Covid-19 Relief: Supporting Mumbai hospitals
description: We are providing support to public and charitable hospitals in the city of Mumbai by purchasing the basic medical items they urgently need to offer the appropriate assistance to COVID-19 patients.

title: Agriculture for The Aged Project (AFTAP)
description: Agriculture for the Aged Project (AfAP) is an economic growth centered project that will accelerate income generation for over 300 older persons and over 100 community youth. AfAP approach is for older persons to come together, lease land every year that covers two farming seasons and engage in the farming of maize and beans in select Kenyan counties of Narok and Kakamega.

title: Miriams 50th birthday Fundraising for "Las Claras"
description: Celebrating 50 wonderful adventures around the sun is a moment for sincere gratitude. Miriam's goal is to celebrate by "giving back" with a personal goal to raise at least $5.000 for Vital Voices Panama and the young mothers and babies they help. She has pledged to double every dollar donated, so, together with her, YOU can make a meaningful difference in the lives of these girls and their babies!

title: Anti-bias body image curriculum for high schools
description: Help create a high school image education curriculum viewed through an anti-bias lens. Understanding Others will be the first curriculum of its kind, adding appearance prejudice to the body image discussion. Specifically focused on race, gender, body size and ability, we discuss how appearance is not just about beauty norms, it is about appearance-based prejudice and how that affects a person's self-worth, equal rights, and opportunities. Valuing diverse bodies leads to valuing diverse people.

title: Teen/ young mum's empowerment program
description: During the Covid -19 pandemic we recorded high numbers of teenage and young girls pregnancies. Many were chased out of home and had to fend for themselves, others lacked basics such as food or sanitary towels and were forced to compromise sex for the items. Others dropped out of school with no skills to fend for  themselves and their children, which led to be depressed, frustrated and desperate. This resulted to desperate measures like suicide, prostitution and early marriages.

title: Support marginalized Indian children through Covid
description: India is currently witnessing the world's worst coronavirus crisis. The families of Teach For India's 28,000 students are struggling with loss of income, limited access to medical resources and disrupted learning due to school closures. This project aims to provide: a. Food and medical (physical & mental) relief for students' families b. Vaccine support for our Fellows, who are frontline workers serving children c. Learning devices to our students and upskilling Fellows so learning continues

title: Coastal Cleanup in China
description: Since 2007, we have been working on organizing coastal cleanup activities, aiming to reduce the litter amount in the ocean environment and to educate the public about marine protection in China. By the end of 2020, 2,179 coastal cleanup events with over 95,000 volunteers have been carried out in China, cleaning up over 450 tons of litter.  In 2021, we plan to carry out at least 900 coastal cleanup activities, mobilizing over 22,000 volunteers to clean up more than 80 tons of coastal litter.

title: Children should grow up in a family
description: Prevention of social orphanhood is one of the main goals of our organization. The specialists of the Fund help families in difficult life situations to overcome their life crisis in order to prevent their children from ending up in orphanages. The Charity Fund Our Children ('Deti nashi') works with the beneficiary families within the comprehensive systemic assistance program "Stick Together". Now the program is being implemented in the Smolensk region in Russia.

title: Stop gender-based violence (GBV) in India
description: We have been working to empower & end the systematic violence against women & girls in India since 1989. We believe every woman & child deserves a life free from inequality, cruelty & discrimination & we stand with them to create the lives they truly deserve. During the pandemic it is women & girls suffering most from restricted movement & freedom & financial burdens faced by families, resulting in dramatic increases in GBV, exploitation & demand for our support.

title: Pedaling for houses
description: This project will raise the money to build 5 quality homes and provide support for families in need living in very poor areas near Bogota, Colombia. Their current homes barely stand and are built with pieces of wood and metal which make them dangerous and insufficient to provide safe shelter. Having a home dramatically changes the lives of children as they can stay away from drugs, violence and abuse while they struggle to leave the extreme poverty status.

title: Help tribal children to learn and grow in India
description: This project supports tribal children and needy families with nutritious food and educational support. In India, live seems back to normal but many children are still suffering from the fallout of the pandemic. Many show symptoms of malnutrition. Especially in tribal areas and slums, people could not afford food rich in vitamins and proteins. The children are bearing the consequenses, they are not growing properly and in school their learning gaps are huge.

title: Project Promise Building Rehab Project
description: It's obvious to many at-risk youth on St. Croix that their future prospects are bleak. After all, they're living in poverty, doing poorly in school, and lack positive role models and the tools to make good decisions. It's no wonder so many of these youth give up and turn to risky behaviors. What have they got to lose?   To help them turn their lives around, a holistic approach is needed. Programs that address just one or two of the many issues they face are not likely to succeed.

title: Bathrooms for Colombian families living in poverty
description: Can you imagine living without a bathroom?  It is estimated that in Colombia there are two million people without a bathroom. We are TECHO an NGO that works to help families in poverty. With your support, we want to reduce the number of people who do not have a bathroom in Colombia, providing 55 bathrooms to these families who do not have the resources. Thus impacting approximately 200 people.  A bathroom saves lives, protects dignity and creates opportunities. Sanitation is a human right.

title: Legal support for Southern Cameroonian Prisoners
description: Ensure legal representation for over 1000 prisoners detained in the context of the conflict in the Cameroons. Victoria Relief Foundation will provide financial support to cover transport fair, local accommodation, and other logistics for a team of 17 common law lawyers who volunteer and work on a Pro-Bono basis as counsel for Anglophone detainees in Cameroun. The detainees are tried in french which they don't understand, using civil law which causes many of them to receive lengthy sentences.

title: Ensure a Future, Feed and Educate a Child
description: We will provide food, vitamins, educational materials and school support to 300 child in order for them to start or continue their schooling and thus ensure that they have a head-start in shaping their future. Children without education often follow the fate of their families and they become poor, miserable adults continuing the poverty that they experience when they are young.

title: Train 50 youth in rural Kenya in Agribusiness
description: The COVID 19 situation has worsened Kenya's endemic problem of youth unemployment. As a result, many young people have become disillusioned and hopeless, and have turned to crime and drug abuse. CORAT Africa will train 100 unemployed youth from rural Kenya who have unused family land for Agribusiness ventures. The youth will also be provided with rainwater harvesting tanks and farm inputs so that they can make a living selling agricultural products.

title: FREE EDUCATION AND THERAPY SERVICES FOR CWDs
description: Sonakhali Manobkollan Seba Sangha is an association for working the development of poor special children with disabilities in Bangladesh, we are planning, Measuring, Counting and educating to implement adequate service delivery in action of special Education, health and rehabilitation. Through this project our- organization intends to achieve remarkable improvement of destitute, disadvantaged and most vulnerable children groups in the community. A total 250 disable children would be benefited.

title: Support Our COVID-19 Relief Kit Campaign
description: The COVID-19 pandemic has severely impacted Nigerian women and female workers who survive by daily pay and menial work including hawking on the streets.  Your donation will help save girls from starvation and other negative consequences resulting from the COVID-19 lockdown in Ogun and Lagos States. AGE Network will provide these emergency kits to 250 families of girls who face an increased risk of exclusion during the lockdown (orphaned, unemployed, financially excluded- child marriage)

title: COVID -19 Second Phase Food relief 2021
description: Due to another surge of COVID in Bangladesh, Second phase of food relief during month of Ramadan is taking place in Dhaka, Bangladesh to help day laborers, small store owners, teachers, rickshawpullers and others who are suffering immensely from the lockdown and lost their jobs.

title: Improving children's health and education
description: Project Sekoly is SEED's ongoing school construction project. It aims to improve health and education outcomes for children in rural communities of southeast Madagascar. Alongside school buildings, we construct rainwater harvesting systems, latrines, menstrual management facilities, and deliver WASH education sessions. We also aim to mitigate our environmental impact by offsetting our carbon footprint and establishing plantations for sustainable community harvest

title: International summer camps for underserved kids
description: Sport dans la Ville is French leading not-profit serving kids from underserved neighborhoods through sports and job-readiness training. We wish to build a Summer Camp and Training Center in Provence (south of France) to provide 1,100 youths a place to live unforgettable moments. Thanks to our sister organizations from all over the world, we will offer unique experiences to our youth, helping them escape their everyday life, make them believe in themselves and give them tools to succeed in life.

title: New Flooring for the VICM
description: The Virgin Islands Children's Museum aims to improve the safety of the museum while beautifying the space. Donations will help with the purchase of 68 cases of plank to cover over 1,600 square feet of museum floor as well as the tools & staff hours needed to install the material. Yes, the VICM staff plans to install the flooring themselves to save on instillation costs & gain some new carpentry skills! Please help the VICM help families Explore, Play, Discover in a safe & pretty museum space.

title: Project For Me - Let's train 3,000 women
description: Gender violence in Puerto Rico is reaching its highest level.  Recent fatalities have put in evidence the lack of support by the system and the fear of the victims to look for help.  This program seeks to empower women both personally and professionally. Through various workshops, seminars and classes we seek to reinforce and focus on their strengths and talents in the various areas of life.

title: Help Us Keep Rescuing Refugees in Peril at Sea
description: Refugee Rescue are working to prevent loss of life at sea. Mo Chara, our rescue boat, will operates  in partnership with Sea Eye 4, in the Central Mediterranean route, to prevent any more lives being needlessly lost in the Mediterranean sea. However, In order to continue to provide lifesaving search and rescue services, we need your help. We are relying on donations to cover running costs of the boat to the amount of 60,000.

title: Child Protection Edu-Sport Safe Hub
description: Help us build a Safe-Hub - targeted at children and youth between the ages of 1 and 25 years. We envision a Safe Hub that will provide quality early childhood learning and after-school programmes for all groups by the end of 2021 and beyond. We hope to focus enrollment on women and girls, targeting 60% of the Hub's children and youth to be girls and 40% to be boys. We also aim to include both able bodied and differently abled youth in our programmes, which are set in a rural context.

title: Help 500 Orphaned Children in Rural Kenya
description: This project will support Orphans and Vulnerable Children infected and affected with HIV/AIDS  by paying school fees to 50, purchase school uniform to 100, purchase masks and sanitizer to 100 households, sanitary packs to 100 girls. To caution the highly vulnerable households affected by HIV coupled with COVID 19 impact 70 caregivers will be trained on Community saving and lending model and given business start up kit while Adolescents will be trained on life skills and HIV risk reduction.

title: Improve Girls' Education in Ethiopia
description: This project empowers poor girl and their families resides in remotes areas of Ethiopia. In Ethiopia girl school enrollment rate vary law especially in rural. The root causes are: economic and deep-rooted harmful traditions and value. Owing the problem, MHO is uniquely prepared to help poor girl and families to get rid of such Problems through the provision of educational material, accommodation/transport, and female hygiene and by helping poor girl families economically and mentor scheme

title: Help marginalized Indian children keep learning
description: Since March 2020, India has witnessed the world's worst coronavirus crisis. The families of Teach For India's 28,000 students have grappled with disrupted learning due to prolonged school closures, among other challenges. Teach For India U.S. empowers Teach For India with intellectual, human, and financial resources to eliminate educational inequity in India, and we actively support TFI Fellows as they up-skill and serve marginalised students as frontline workers in this pandemic.

title: Improving educational justice in Iraq
description: According to the latest government statistics, more than 4.6 million dropouts from primary schools in Iraq. The educational gap between urban and rural areas remains a serious social problem, with crises of displacement, displacement, communal violence, and orphans to address this problem, for 17 years BAORD has been leading a social movement to bring tens of thousands of disadvantaged schoolchildren into the classroom, to transform their lives.

title: POULTRY FARMING FOR MENTOR ORPHANS AFRICA
description: Poultry project was decided upon due to the urgent need to extend educational support to more children at our centers and also provide children at the centers with food, skills for development and endorse their free time into productivity. It has been so hard for the project to sustain the growing number of kids and to provide them with everything necessary to enrich their well-being, including a good education. Therefore, the project has sought ways to establish additional, independent income f

title: Sanitary Pads Keep Ugandan Girls in School
description: The REDU Girls Support Program has three main initiatives: keeping girls in school, informed about their sexual health, and economically independent. The REDU Girls Support Program has developed initiatives to assist girls in successfully completing their education. These programs include: Supplying sanitary pads to girls who are menstruating; Constructing private 'girls only' latrines; Providing accurate health information and mentorship through a female health worker.

title: Sister Campaign
description: Sister Campaign aims to keep vulnerable girls safe from unplanned pregnancies by raising menstrual hygiene products for 400  adolescent girls across 4 counties in Kenya; Mombasa, Nairobi, Kisumu and Kakamega.

title: Support Covid-19 vaccine programme in rural Kenya
description: There are huge challenges in delivering the COVID-19 vaccine programme to remote areas of rural Kenya. We urgently need your support to reach our most vulnerable. Nobody is safe until everybody is safe. Despite the good news that vaccines have started to arrive in Kenya, we lack basic necessities and face huge logistical challenges in order for us to get the vaccine safely into the arm. This project will ensure Communities will get the vaccination protection they need.

title: Help These Girls Have Better Living Conditions
description: Our house hosts over 30 girls who have suffered abuse, abandonment or girls that were at risk in their communities. Over a year and a half ago the government suspended all type of economical support to every nonprofit association in the State and we are struggling to support the house operation. We are looking for help to continue with our mission and to try to lower our operating cost by making building improvements such as insulation, roof repair and replace non efficient appliances etc.

title: Conservation action in an Andean diversity hotspot
description: This project promotes conservation in Serrania de San Lucas (Colombia), one of Latin America's most urgent conservation priorities. We are conducting baseline camera trap surveys to assess the distribution, population status, and habitat requirements of focal species such as jaguars, tapirs and bears. In parallel, we are working with coffee and cacao producers to promote sustainable agricultural practices compatible with the conservation of this biodiversity hotspot.

title: Big Ride 2021: Playground and Sportsfield in Rafah
description: The ongoing siege and occupation of Gaza have traumatized children & caused psychological problems. Physical activity improves mental and physical health. The Big Ride for Palestine is teaming up with MECA to raise funds for building a new playground and sports field in Rafah, Palestine. Ride with us for Freedom, Justice & Equality for the Palestinians! Sign up for the Big Ride at www.thebigride4palestine.com and support our fundraiser

title: One toilet for one poor family in Rwanda
description: This project intends to construct 20 ventilated toilets and provides hygiene education to the targeted communities especially vulnerable people, people with disabilities and orphans children, to reduce diarrhea and other illnesses related to poor hygiene, with the main purpose to improve Hygiene and infectious diseases in Rulindo district, Northern Rwanda.

title: Train 500 disadvantaged students in North-Nigeria
description: This project will train and support disadvantaged school aged students(12-18)  a. on life and career skills needed to survive in a changing world (COViD19 backdrop). b. with educational materials and resources to start and complete basic education (k12) c. on vocational and enterprise skills and equip them with seed capital to enable them earn a source of living after completing basic education  Train teachers on 21st century teaching skills, career guidance, enterprise skills who train students

title: Support 125 Vulnerable Children in Zimbabwe
description: Zara's Center (www.zarascenter.org) is an after-school safe haven for over 125 AIDS orphans and vulnerable children in Bulawayo, Zimbabwe. 65% of Zara's children have lost at least one parent, most to HIV/AIDS-related complications, and more than half of Zara's children live with extended family.   The Center provides twice daily meals, academic enrichment, medical care, work training, recreation, and artistic development in Emganwini Township.

title: Change the world 1 woman at a time - India & Kenya
description: This project aims to offer social support to 31 women based in Kenya and India who currently work in our organization, Project Tres. The COVID-19 pandemic has hit them and their families hard, making it a huge struggle to continue their own development. Since March 2020, we have been sending money to our teams, primarily so they can access water, food, medicine, and cover their rental costs.

title: Support An Orphan In Uganda
description: The V.O.T.U Orphan Support Program focuses on: keeping needy orphans in school, protecting them from hygiene related illnesses and hunger, as well as developing vocational skills for rural youth. VOTU has developed initiatives to assist orphans in successfully completing their education. These programs include: Providing lunch for orphans in public schools; Supplying sanitary pads to adolescent girls; Providing tuition and user material for youths in vocational sector

title: 50000 trees/year for a self-reliant rural Senegal
description: With your support, CREATE! will plant 50,000 trees in 19 rural Senegalese communities in 2022. This will not only provide food, shade and fuel to the communities, but also help fight desertification, improve soil conditions, regulate temperatures while offsetting more than 1,730,000 pounds of Carbon each year. This reforestation effort will also fight challenges like human migration, loss of resources and economic opportunity and reduced quality of life that is brought on by desertification.

title: A million trees to energize DR Congo's rainforest
description: Thousands of hectares of land in Yangambi (northern DR Congo) are no longer productive after decades of overexploitation. The soil is poor, agriculture yields are low, and trees for wood energy are scarce. In response, local communities are planting trees to restore the land. Over 1 million trees have been planted in agroforestry systems that enrich the soil, feed families, and meet local energy needs. With your help, we can plant another million trees!

title: Habibi and Sport with Refugees (HSR)
description: HSR is a growing community supporting refugees to teach, develop skills and become empowered through sport. This project is a unique synergy between Yoga and Sport with Refugees, Habibi.Works and KOIZ. Now, we offer a full weekly schedule of sports for all. Our inclusive and community-led approach allows us to adapt to the needs of our community and facilitate positive development for our project and participants. We need your support to improve and expand the scope and impact of HSR.

title: Agham Para Sa Pagbabago (Science for Change)
description: A pilot project in the coastal area of Lobo, Batangas (Philippines) that supports Malabrigo public school students aimed at raising their interest in science and technology subjects that could help them become successful scientists and engineers that will build disaster-resilient communities. Grade 3 and Grade 7 students who benefit from this project will receive tablets and special learning kits that will allow them to participate in an advanced and innovative science and technology curriculum.

title: Help Needy in Remote Villages in India Fight COVID
description: The impact of COVID-19 in India has been highly disruptive, destroying both lives and livelihoods.  As we adapt to these unprecedented circumstances, Educate Girls is continuing to serve the most marginalized and vulnerable communities who have been disproportionately affected with the loss of livelihoods, lack of food, poor access to health facilities, sub-optimal education and other basic needs. We were able to impact 500k people and 250k children last year through this. Need is much more now!

title: Restore Hope to Child-Headed Families in Uganda
description: The Road to Hope program empowers 34 child-headed families with social services and resources to improve the quality of life for the family. These are families with persons living with severe health-related suffering due to life-threatening illnesses where primary caregivers are children below 18 years.  The program offers access to palliative care for the ill, psychosocial support and basic needs for the entire family, and educational support for the children heading these impoverished families

title: Help People & Parrots Recovering from Hurricanes
description: One Earth Conservation is helping endangered wild yellow-headed amazon parrots and local communities in Punta Manabique, Guatemala that were impacted by two hurricanes in 2020. One Earth is training local people to improve their conservation efforts and pay stipends that will help them rebuild their community, heal and grow stronger. The project leader, Miguel, and his family were left homeless after Hurricane Eta. Even so, his 2 young adult children continue to patrol and protect parrot nests.

title: Returning to San Marcos October 2021
description: Fully vaccinated volunteers from Cape CARES are actively planning to return to Honduras in October of this year, 2021, and we plan to serve high priority patients from both San Marcos region and El Rodieto. We will extend our service week to see as many patients as possible. We will be implementing international COVID planning guidelines around social distance and masking, triage and isolation of ill patients.

title: Help us Send Instruments to Talented Students!
description: MFW provides free virtual music education to vulnerable communities worldwide. Throughout our journey, we have witnessed the struggles faced by many talented students around the world, many of whom don't own an instrument, and can't afford one of their own. Some of these students live in locations where music instruments are out of reach.  Your donation will help with buying musical instruments that are not usually donated, and cover all incurring costs of handling and shipping.

title: Support A Child's Education in Jordan
description: The pandemic has left children unable to meet their educational needs, when school shifted online. Lack of access to the internet and online learning courses increase the risks of children dropping out of school. The community led tutoring project aims to address the gaps in the education system by providing free and accessible tutoring. Tutoring will be organized in the afternoons and early evenings, five days a week at CRP's community centers.

title: Nepal COVID-19 Relief Fund
description: Covid 2nd wave is killing a person every 5 min in Nepal, our health system is at breaking point. People are dying because of lack of oxygen and hospital beds. Infection is spread from Indian boarder to Mt Everest. Therefore it is a critical time to keep our girls and over hundred children and their families safe.  Make sure they attend distance learning. Your support will help us prevent them from COVID-19 & provide them with emergency supply, recreational, life skills activities & awareness.

title: Free school fees for displaced children in Burkina
description: Education is the basis of all development. Many children in Burkina Faso are unfortunately excluded from the education system because of security crises leading to the massive displacement of populations. The situation is catastrophic for displaced children aged 6 to 15. They find themselves forced into begging to survive. Global NEEED Burkina aims to ensure the reintegration of 500 children in the classes by covering all the costs relating to their schooling and their food.

title: AHAVA Safe House for Child Survivors in Mexico
description: Help us fight Child Sexual Exploitation in Northern Mexico by providing a safe place and care for rescued victims of Human Trafficking.  That is why AHAVA Home exists: to cover all the needs that a victim requires after being rescued. Thanks to the support of our donors, our home has been partially rehabilitated and we are now caring for mothers and their children at our location. There is still more usable space in the home that is still in process of renovating.

title: Education and Sport for 200 vulnerable children
description: Goals for Peace will provide educational support to 200 vulnerable children in Bucaramanga, Colombia. Delivered through homework club and workshops by psychologists, accompanied by physical training (usually football). We have 10 years of experience working continually with the local community. Our HQ and all programs are based in the deprived areas (barrios) of "Olas 2" and "Santos Bajos".   We have a diverse team of professionals, local youth leaders, university students and volunteers.

title: COVID-19 EMERGENCY RESPONSE
description: The COVID-19 second wave has directly impacted several vulnerable, and marginalised communities in India. The majority of the rural population have no access to better health quality services and they prefer to stay in their villages to recover. The proposed project will provide emergency support like protection kits/home isolation support/covid protection awareness/supplementary nutrition/youth engagement in 5 states of rural India and will reach out to more than 50000 families.

title: Ufulu menstrual cup distribution project in Malawi
description: Ufulu is providing free menstrual cups to women and girls to Malawi, via educational workshops.  We train local women to run the workshops in their villages or districts. 80% of females in Malawi do not have access to sanitary products.  Many use cloth rags that are unhygienic and cause health issues. Girls are prevented from attending school and women from work, due to shame, discomfort and embarrassment caused by staining and leaks.  Menstrual cups are reusable and last 10 years.

title: Empower 100 Tanzanian Youth through Education
description: Karibu!  We are a Tanzanian NGO dedicated to training, mentoring and coaching disadvantaged youth that have not had access to education.  Our one-year Training of Youth is a personal and professional development program that gives vulnerable youth the skills to gain meaningful employment, transforming their lives and breaking the cycle of generational poverty.

title: COVID Relief and Revival for Women Artisans, India
description: The project will focus on 700 women artisan families in rural, tribal and peri urban areas Udaipur and Rajsamand districts of South Rajasthan.     - The project will provide COVID relief to artisans through food and medical kits; small emergency fund and awareness through volunteers.    - Focus on long term livelihood support through generation of home based work, market linkages and fair wages.   This project aims to prevent communities from transition into extreme and irreversible poverty.

title: Sea and Joy for Children in Need in Ukraine
description: Help us make the last leap and open Wellness Camp for vulnerable children! Way Home team has done a great job. A 2-storey equipped big house was built near the sea. Every year, up to 120 children in difficult life circumstances will rest and strengthen their health for free, swim and undergo a socialization program. However, for the first specialized camp for vulnerable children in Ukraine to receive guests this summer, we need to complete the interior finishing works and improve the territory.

title: COVID19 - Food and Oxygen for Kolkata's Poorest
description: This project will provide life-saving emergency oxygen to COVID patients and emergency food parcels to hungry families whose incomes have been badly affected by the coronavirus pandemic. Tiljala SHED's target communities comprise around 5000 families who depend on a daily wage in order to eat. These marginalised communities living in shelters on pavements, beside railway tracks and open sewers are always at the back of the line - a forgotten people. Tiljala SHED puts them first.

title: Support to Transition; Free GBV survivors, Kenya
description: This Project will help to transform and transition 52 women; survivors of sexual and domestic  violence sheltered  at Agatha Amani House shelter in Naivasha, Kenya,  through livelihood empowerment. The initiative seeks to prevent them from leaving the shelter,  economically inadequate which  heightens the risk of going back to harmful relationships or being taken advantage of. It will make them regain control over their lives and instill in them motivation to reclaim their positions.

title: Get our Girls to Graduate!
description: This project will support girls and young women in Guatemala to graduate from school. This is especially significant in a country where only half the population graduate from primary school & girls and women are disproportionately kept out of the schooling system. We are working to ensure that girls are given an equitable chance, not only recieving the same education as their male peers but also the additional support programs needed to succeed, such as sex-education, health & nutrition.

title: CARE - Community Alliance for Resilience & Equity
description: Livity Rising, Integrative Healers Action Network (IHAN) and Acupuncturists Without Borders (AWB) will provide disaster relief, recovery and support to build resilience in communities affected by disasters, environmental devastation, poverty and social injustice throughout Santa Cruz County. Services provided include acupuncture, chiropractic care, massage therapy, homeopathy and naturopathic medicine.

title: Renovation of Schools for Underprivileged Children
description: Aalem for Orphan and Vulnerable Children, Inc. is seeking a grant to renovate a six classroom primary school, a six class room secondary school for over 400 underprivileged children hailing from the poorest families who cannot afford to pay for quality education in other schools. The objective is to provide free quality education that will equip underprivileged children for employment upon graduation. Funding in the amount of US $ 54,901 is requested for the construction of the two schools.

title: NETWORK OF READING PROMOTERS IN BOLIVAR
description: The NETWORK OF READING PROMOTERS- BOLIVAR, seeks that throughout the department of Bolivar (Colombia), there are reading promoters in order to provide bibliographic material to children and adolescents, and additionally promote reading through reading aloud to early childhood, with illustrated bibliography, with the model of reading promotion, methods and means of the corporation. This in order to increase reading rates in these populations and increase the possibility of access to higher educat

title: AID FOR 100 ORPHAN CHILDREN IN TABORA, TANZANIA
description: CEDO signaled its commitment of protection Orphans missed education due deaths of parents due to AIDS, by provide the basic human needs. Our target is to reach 100 orphans vulnerable aged 5 to 17 years old. Given that thousands of orphans in Tanzania are outside of school due to poverty and lack care services. Experience show that children living with elderly, poor families, sick parent/ guardian, people living with HIV, Are among of factors cause orphans to be outside of school in Tabora region

title: COVID-19 CRISIS SUPPORT FOR 1000 ADOLESCENT GIRLS
description: Jabala Action Research Organisation intends to support the adolescent girls and their families as they respond to and recover from the Covid-19 crisis. As the situation on the ground is changing rapidly, we are seeking support to carry on relief operations ( Dry ration, OTC drugs, Community Kit, Health Kits) among the 1000beneficiaries in the selected areas of  West Bengal & Jharkhand with a primary goal to ensure the adolescent and young women are not adversely affected by this pandemic

title: Empower 850 girls & women to become self-reliant
description: In our women empowerment project we focus on skill development & vocational trainings for vulnerable women in Wakiso District in Uganda. The goal is to empower 850 girls & women to become self-reliant. After graduating from our program they will be equipped with the necessary knowledge & skills they need to set up their own tailoring and weaving businesses. This project will provide encouragement, connections & tools that women need to confidently and competently make an impact in the community

title: FIGHTING POACHING - SAVING RHINO
description: Enviro Crime Solutions is a world leader in the fight against poaching.  Our holistic approach to rhino conservation is founded on three specific pillars.  Our Forensic Investigations into poaching Youth Education Programs building tomorrows conservationists today Community building programs  By viewing the problems of poaching in a holistic manner and seeking long term solutions we make a real difference where it matters most.

title: Hand Pumps for Persons with Disabilities for WASH
description: Persons with disabilities face hardships to fetch drinking water from Neighborhood, because lack of own Hand Pump in the house. If they donated Hand Pump with installation labour charges, he/she will get rid of fetching pure clean drinking water from far-away. Persons with disabilities led houses are found in each Village but their living style is very poor bcz of their disability & poverty. They have limited earning resources to meet the needs. Water is life so NDF decided to provide it.

title: India COVID-19 Second wave relief
description: In India, now second wave Covid-19 direct support of health materials such mask, soap, sanitize item and herbal water as prevention of Covid-19 and livelihood support to the daily wage workers families, who lost work and earning. Rural and Tribal women, children and aged persons are getting support. The precaution on the aged people and big awareness and counseling to poor and marginalised people.

title: Preventing 6000Children &3000PLW from Malnourished
description: This project will focus on improving nutrition and food security status and make the greatest impact to 6000 children 6-59 months and 3000 PLWs affected by malnutrition through support the scale-up of integrated community management of acute malnutrition;Strengthen Micronutrient Powder supplementation;Scale up efforts for community awareness-building on COVID-19, children health and nutritional need;Support integrated livelihood and nutrition programming for improved nutrition and food security.

title: Support COVID-19 coronavirus response in Nepal
description: Over the past few weeks Nepal has faced a new wave of the coronavirus COVID-19, causing an alarmingly large spike in the number of new infections and deaths as it spreads rapidly across the country. Health experts predict that the wave of infections Nepal is currently experiencing is highly likely to follow a similar trajectory to that of India's recent, ongoing second wave. The lives and livelihoods of all the people of Nepal are rapidly and fixedly approaching a crisis point.

title: Saving lives by closing oxygen access gap in India
description: The second wave of CORONA virus has hit India in a devastating manner crumbling its entire health care system. Importantly, it has thrown up a complex supply challenge-making medical oxygen available across this vast nation on urgent basis. It's logistic nightmare and it takes mammoth effort. In spite of  this, lives are being lost. With your support, we will address this bottleneck by setting up four decentralized oxygen generation units next to the COVID centers and save 1000 lives in a year.

title: Gaza Relief Fund
description: The recent military attacks on the Gaza Strip have caused many families to leave their homes and take refuge in UNRWA schools or at other family homes. Other families have lost their homes and their shops completely due to the bombings, while others sustained damages to their homes as a result of nearby bombings. The project seeks to provide urgent relief for those families to get them through this difficult times.

title: Technical school/Innovation Hub
description: Our project will build a trade school to impart career skills to orphans, at-risk youth, and other area residents facing life challenges in Nakuru, Kenya. The trade school will offer certificates and diplomas in programs such as agricultural technology, plumbing, electrical-mechanical technology, automotive technology, coding, and web development. We're looking to raise our next $5,000 to build the trade school's foundation, just like education is the foundation for building a thriving community

title: Education for autistic children  in Rural Rwanda
description: The project will initially support 30-50 children and adolescents by establishing a cost-efficient model for care, support and education of children with autism and similar disorders in the Eastern province of Rwanda. It will increase the skills of teachers and parents to support children with autism and other similar disorders and will help them to learn to their potential. It will also organize special classes for children with severe cases and integrate moderate cases in regular classes.

title: Help Improve Hygiene of Afghan Street Children
description: A quarter of kids between the ages of 5 to 14 in Afghanistan suffer child labor - a hazard to their health and well being. Due to poverty and low awareness, hygiene practices are not part of their daily life and therefore, prone to variety of diseases including COVID-19. Awareness raising and supply of basic hygiene materials is the solution. CPD aims to identify street children in districts 9, 10 and 16 of Kabul city and disseminate basic hygiene information and materials for their protection.

title: Let Care spread faster than Corona
description: We are all devastated by the terrible distress and hardship unfolding due to the Covid-19 pandemic. The current wave of covid-19 has reached a crisis point. We have been hearing heartbreaking stories from our Shalinis that their families were not having enough money to afford food, medicine or did not have to afford treatment during this second wave of pandemic. This is the time for us to reach out to our girls (Shalinis) and let them know we are there to help them to overcome this situation.

title: Peacebuilder Emergency Fund (Former COVID19 Fund)
description: This fund provides emergency relief to peacebuilders and their communities who are from low-income and vulnerable communities. Sickness, accidents, and natural disasters can create significant financial burdens that reduce their ability to engage in peacebuilding work. Therefore, we created this fund to provide basic necessities and relief in emergencies. Although this fund was originally for the COVID-19 crisis, we decided to continue because of many observed needs in our peacebuilding network.

title: Skills Training for Youths
description: Child Rescue Kenya has worked with many youths over the years.  Increasingly, we are moving into the field of prevention - preventing children from running away or ending up on the streets - and we have realised that the best way to achieve this is through ensuring employment possibilities for youths and young parents, achieved through vocational and life skills training programmes.

title: Help Us Train Montessori Teachers in Uganda!
description: The school we are supporting was started in September 2017 as part of Acholi Diaspora Initiative, and has been embraced by community members who lived and experienced over two decades of civil unrest which caused massive displacements, loss of lives, livelihoods and broken family structures. The school faces a barrier in accessing Montessori Teacher Training, and must travel to Kenya to access it, which this project will support.

title: Empower a Life. Give the Gift of Clear Sight.
description: RestoringVision works to address the unmet need for eyeglasses (primarily readers) for people living in poverty who have vision impairments, live in communities lacking access to eyeglasses, and have no available income to afford them, or both. Our Global Access Program creates equitable access to glasses for this population worldwide.  A 2018 study verified that a simple pair of reading glasses increased productivity by 32%. For those earning $2 a day, this can mean an additional $140 per year.

title: SUPPORT A DAYCARE CENTER FOR 250 KIDS IN ARGENTINA
description: WE BELIEVE IN A FAIR AND EQUAL SOCIETY. This project supports a Daycare Center in Ushuaia, Argentina, the southernmost city in the world. The Daycare Center provide education, nutrition and health care to more than 250  children living in poverty.  We Aim to protect the rights of children who are at high risk of social vulnerability by adopting intensive care practices to ensure their growth, development and survival.

title: Lesedi la Batho Social Relief Fund, South Africa
description: Lesedi la Batho ("Light for the People") offers social relief and hope for people living in poverty-stricken, underserved areas of our community with little opportunity to improve their lives and become independent of handouts. We believe every person has the right to basic needs and to provide for their children. COVID-19 pandemic widened the gap of socio- inequality making access to basic services even harder for low income groups who need a helping hand now more than ever before.

title: Stand with Palestine
description: In the days following October 7th, 2023, a total blockade of Gaza was announced, depriving an already vulnerable population of more than two million civilians (half of whom are under the age of 18) from all essential goods including food, electricity, water, and fuel, plunging them even further into crisis.  With Gaza completely cut off, ActionAid is alarmed at the rapidly escalating humanitarian crisis, which is affecting the lives of those caught in crossfire.

title: Joining hands for responding to COVID-19 Impacts!
description: Marginalized communities are left with little help during this time of the COVID-19 pandemic. With everything closed down, food and hygiene supplies have come forward as essentials. Therefore, collaborating with multiple community organizations and local stakeholders, Visible Impact aims to distribute food rations and hygiene supplies to vulnerable and marginalized communities.

title: TAIWAN COVID-19 Emergency Response
description: COVID-19 outbreaks in Taiwan. The national Level 3 COVID alert is extended continuously. Many vulnerable families were already in financial difficulties have a harder life. The sudden drop in income due to the epidemic has forced families to lose their meals and income, and they cannot apply the government's bailout grant. Through COVID-19 Funds for 3500 vulnerable families and 200 vulnerable children, hoping to be their urgent and timely support and continue their learning at home.

title: Save the lives of Injured in the Gaza Strip - OPT
description: The Gaza strip is under the aggressive attack by the Israeli forces. They target governmental facilities, infrastructures & health facilities. Thousands of residential units were demolished, and more than 40,000 people are now displaced. Until this moment, 1400 injured, more than 200 martyrs. Electricity outage more than 20 hours/day. Your donation will contribute to save the lives of many injuries through supporting Al Awda Hospital to continue providing emergency services to the injuries.

title: BUILD PEACE IN THE HOLY LAND
description: In recent days hundreds were wounded and killed in Gaza after heavy bombings; among these at least 15 children. These are just the most recent victims of a war that has been going on for too long now. Pro Terra Sancta Association has been committed to peace building in the Holy Land for years with social projects in support of the community in Gaza. Due to the recent events many are in danger now and need our support!

title: Sponsor Water Technician development and training
description: Poured Out Water Technicians are an integral part to our community connection and involvement - that's why we're asking for your help to continue funding their crucial work! Our current staff of 3 Technicians complete the bulk of our water filtration projects and provide maintenance and education to families. With this project, we're aiming to provide on-the-job training, foster stronger people-management skills, and explore new opportunities to serve new communities via safe clean water access.

title: Support families struggling with hunger in Puebla.
description: Food is a basic and fundamental human right - it is essential. However, in Mexico, every day there are more than 50 million people that do not have enough food in order to live a healthy and active life. On top of that, the COVID-19 virus has increased the hunger problem around the world. Due to this situation, we are looking for international help. With only $20 dollars, you can ensure food for a whole family during an entire month.

title: SPONSOR A SMART PHONE & HELP A VIDYA STUDENT STUDY
description: The fundraiser targets to donate 5,000 devices to all VIDYA students who are involved in all schemes in Bangalore, Mumbai, and Delhi to continue their online classes. Our students are hardworking with visions of achievement and social progress. We do not want any student left behind and ensure that they continue education. We want to ensure that our students continue to pursue their dreams unhindered with the same diligence and enthusiasm.

title: 2021 Palestine Relief Effort - HOPE USA
description: Join HOPE USA in providing victims of the atrocities in Palestine with relief (shelter, medical care, food) to help them recover and rebuild their lives.

title: Breakfast for Kids
description: Every child should be encouraged to develop his/her health. Nobody needs to endure the hunger. Just Breakfast meal changes significant child development. 1. Enhance the physical development of children 2. Enhance the education through better concentration, readiness to learn and attending to school activities 3. Enhance the happiness of "Donors", sharing happiness to disadvantage children By donating 240 USD, YOU can help one child get his/her breakfast for the whole academic year.

title: Equip 200 young mothers with business skills.
description: This project will equip 200 young mothers who have been married off at an early age with sustainable entrepreneurship and leadership skills in order for them to start businesses or secure employment.

title: Building leadership center for Women and Girls
description: Girl Concern Org is a non-profit organization that supports women and girls through building their leadership capacity. Girl Concern Org leadership program has a massive impact on enhancing human rights and promoting equality when young women and adolescent girls are fully empowered.

title: Education for children/girls in Teahplay, Liberia
description: This project will increase reading and English-speaking skills and provide books and critical support services for 250 underserved and at-risk children and teenage girls in Teahplay, Liberia, who are affected by poverty and Liberia's civil wars. Strategies include reading and writing circles, vocabulary building, discussion groups to learn how to apply language skills, public speaking skills and vocational training.

title: Nepal COVID-19 Emergency Relief Fund
description: Nepal is overwhelmed by COVID-19 at the moment. There are no more hospital beds, medicine or oxygen. With the country in lockdown, daily wage earners have no work and so cannot buy food and they and their families are going hungry.  This project will raise money to provide protective equipment, emergency food parcels for the children, families and communities we support. Everything we can do to keep the people of Nepal safe and stop the spread of Coronavirus will make a real difference.

title: Influencing Land Rights for women in Karatu.
description: The proposed project seeks to address the issue of land ownership among the poor women community in Karatu District. The project is proposing to influence CSOs, local leaders and the community in the district to address the issue. The project will be implemented for the duration of nine (9) months. TAJPI anticipates that, after successfully execution of the project women will be empowered through the promotion of human rights.

title: Better Schools for Girls in Benin
description: We are training teachers, school counselors and education leaders on how to ensure that girls get the education they deserve and need to lead successful lives. Our program addresses the problems of violence, exclusion, harassment and negativity against girls perpetuated by school systems and teaching methods that fail to value girls and their amazing potential. Graines de Paix's Better Schools for Girls is transforming education and schools into safe, positive places for girls to learn and grow.

title: Safe water for 2500 children in Argentina
description: This project will provide safe water for 2500 children in Argentina who attend rural schools, through a correct diagnosis of the quality of the water and the land, the incorporation of rainwater harvesting systems and filters, education on health and hygiene for students, teachers, and the local community, to generate a better living condition and a healthier future for Argentine children and rural communities.

title: Financial Independence for 40 Women in Uganda
description: Through engaging courses taught on low-bandwidth phones, the MindLeaps Virtual Academy will build the business skills, digital literacy, and self-esteem of 40 marginalized young women (ages 18 - 25) in refugee settlements and some of the most impoverished neighborhoods of Kampala, Uganda. In addition, MindLeaps Uganda will seed fund their business plans, putting them on the path towards financial independence.

title: Brave Together
description: We have an opportunity to provide the right support to help tackle obstacles that stand in the way of women and young adults making their mark. That's why we launched Brave Together, a program that helps destigmatize anxiety and depression, provides critical one-on-one support and helps everyone, everywhere bravely take on their world.

title: Serve 150 People Compassionate Care in Bangladesh
description: Compassionate Narayanganj provides holistic home-based palliative care to 150 people living with life-limiting and serious chronic illness and to their families.  Your help will supply vital medicines, food parcels, pain/symptom control, compassionate care-giving, and hope for the future.

title: Providing Safe Water for Poor Families
description: We will provide safe, pure water for poor farm families whose water sources have been found contaminated and needs rehabilitation. We will target 3000 families in this initiative. Aside from those lacking sanitary water sources, we will also provide drinking water to families affected by typhoons and other disaster. We ensure quality, safe water by the use of spring water sources and filtering them with commercial water filters. In this way we ensure the prevention of water-borne diseases.

title: Child Brides Support Project
description: We aim to support child brides in order for them to live wholesome and improved lives as they go about with their new status. We aim also to provide education and financial support to remote, poor communities where child brides and early union is prevalent in order for them to held in abeyance this negative situation and be economically prepared and productive while waiting for full adult status.

title: 30 volunteers will help children with disabilities
description: Our Foundation plans to organize two summer camps for the Little Explorers - these are 60 children with disabilities from all over Poland (participation in the camps is free).They need to go to summer camps more than ever before! After spending several months at home because of the pandemic, their bodies and psyches are in bad condition.  We need your help to organize the stay of 30 volunteers at this year's camps. They bring a lot of positive energy and organize the children's time very well.

title: Help people with blood cancer to survive COVID-19
description: The Leukemia Foundation helps adults with blood cancer (leukemia and lymphoma). Since the start of COVID-19 pandemic, number of requests to our foundation have increased dramatically, almost doubled. Newly diagnosed and relapsed patients need expensive treatment and bone marrow transplants.  At the same time, due to chemotherapy our patients have weakened immune system and are very vulnerable to COVID. We need to provide them with outpatient apartments near clinics, special treatment and PPE.

title: Donate hope to children in San Jose, Costa Rica
description: This project helps the children of the Tejarcillos de Alajuelita community in San Jose Costa Rica not go hungry. Help provide three times of healthy meals a day.

title: Help us to take care of 11 million trees in Cusco
description: Peru's farmer families with their vision for the future have Sown Prosperity with 11,000 hectares of forest trees, which improve the climate, reverse soil degradation, shelter animals, reduce pressure on natural forests and capture large amounts of CO2.  Their contribution to climate change mitigation is undoubted, however, families need sustainable income while these trees grow, their solution is to harness the potential for CO2 sequestration through Carbon Credits with a technical study.

title: Help 750 pupils catch-up post COVID-19 in Hungary
description: The project supports 750 children to develop their reading skills after school lockdown via an innovative, child-centered educational program, in which the new learning environment filled with toys, games and movement activities will change student's motivation, make learning more interesting and help progressiveness. Due to the Covid-19 pandemic, children had limited opportunity to get adequate support from their teachers, so their reading skills have worsened and must be improved.

title: Addressing Humanitarian Needs in Gaza
description: The conflict between Israeli forces and armed groups in Gaza has resulted in casualties among civilians on both sides. Between May 10-17, 200 Palestinians have been killed, more than 4,700 have been injured and 58,000 people are currently displaced across Gaza, as reported by the UN's Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA). International Medical Corps is activating our emergency response team to address the humanitarian needs.

title: Sanitary napkins for young  Ugandan women
description: In May 2021 Mariah Tendo from Rockies Organisation started the #2kPadHerChallenge in order to provide young Ugandan women in the Nakawuka-Community-Wakiso District with sanitary napkins which they cannot afford on their own.   Mariah managed to collect enough money for 300K UGX of which she was able to purchase 5 boxes of Sanitary pads and was able to help 65 girls!    Touched by this first success, Mariah decided to try to launch this as a monthly event!

title: Have you ever imagined living children in garbage?
description: Can you imagine children living in garbage?  The village covered in garbage. Children of the village are exposed to all kinds of disease from the piles of garbage. Under this project, 1000 children will be given multivitamins to boost their immune system, ointments to treat skin disease, medical kit etc. Gift a healthy life for the children.

title: Empower street kids with vocational skills!
description: As Covid-19 continues to devastate mankind forcing people to take safety precautions such as social distancing, wearing face masks, avoiding handshakes and using hand sanitizers regularly or staying home, street kids continue going about their lives as if there isn't imminent danger. This project seeks to rescue street kids from the streets of the city of Kitwe and 'house' them our in facility where they shall have chance to undergo vocational training in career paths of their choice.

title: Break Cycle of Poverty & Patriarchy With Education
description: Bittu (10) & Chand (8) hail from a small village in Bihar and are daughters of migrant labourers who live in a semi-permanent slum in Uttarakhand, India. They are the young leads of the short film Bittu that depicts the challenges girls like them face in rural, remote corners of the world. They need your help to break the intergenerational cycle of poverty and patriarchy, change their lives with access to quality education, nutrition, electricity, drinking water and a roof on their heads.

title: Help the Rehabilitation of TLC's Floating Clinics
description: The Lake Clinic provides health care to nine of the numerous floating villages across the Tonle Sap Lake in Cambodia. Each year we provide outpatient care to the more 10,000 villagers who live year-round on the lake in their floating homes. To serve this community, TLC has four clinics on the lake and one more on the Stung Sen River. TLC also maintains a small fleet of boats to travel from port to clinics. These clinics are in their tenth year of operation and need a bit of rehabilitation.

title: DLG Coffee: 1 Year of coffee sales for 137 farmers
description: De La Gente (Spanish for "From the People). De la Gente (DLG) is a non-profit organization based in Guatemala. Your support of De la Gente helps to create economic opportunities that improve the quality of life for small-holder coffee farmers and their families. Your donation will allow us to build capacity in our partner cooperatives, provide micro-financing opportunities, and build relationships with conscious buyers ensuring our farmers get a fair price for their product.

title: California Wildfire Relief
description: Imagine waking up to sirens and banging on your door telling you to leave immediately due to fire. Imagine panicking and leaving with what you have on and nothing else. Imagine then losing everything you have ever owned, worked for, and  cherished. This is a true grim reality for those in California dealing with wildfire. There have been over 6,049 Incidents just for CAL FIRE this season.   Thousands of homes have been destroyed.   Livelihoods lost.   California is dealing with pure destruction.

title: REHABILITATING REFUGEES  IN KENYA THROUGH SPORTS
description: Sports Aid Africa (SAA) is a Kenyan Non-Governmental Organisation dedicated to serving the forcibly displaced persons residing in refugee camps and broader community. Kenya is a host to about 600,000 refugees, most of whom are children and youth.  Sports Aid Africa helps the youth in refugee camps and the host community cultivate their character and contribute to the world through sports programs. We nurture the gifts of youth and impart values that serve them and the world.

title: Nepal Rapid Response Program to 2nd Wave of COVID
description: Across the country, people are dying in rural and urban areas alike for lack of basic medical treatment & basic food supplies. Like the devastating 2015 earthquakes, the present COVID-19 humanitarian crisis in Nepal was both highly predictable and without a bold intervention, will, tragically, recur. Similarly, most of the rural women communities of the Terai districts of Nepal have started to reel under the following problems due to the 2nd wave of COVID 19.

title: COVID support to families of conservation warriors
description: The second wave of COVID-19 in India has devastated entire families with very high infection and mortality rates. In all the lockdowns imposed, frontline forest staff continue to foot-patrol their beats. Unlike most of us, they cannot work from home. In March and April 2021, we have lost at least 10 frontline forest staff besides many other conservation beacons to COVID-19. This appeal is to honour their life committed to conservation and provide immediate ex-gratia support to their next-of-kin.

title: Dairy Farming
description: This project shall help provide milk, one  meal for the  420 children who attend our who  training and education programs.  Khwisero Sports uses power of education to secure education support for talented and needy children gain opportunities and education.

title: Infection prevention and awareness in remote Nepal
description: PHASE Nepal's existing Himalayan Healthcare project has been providing primary healthcare and maternity services in remote areas and also responding successfully to the COVID-19 pandemic. Further this project aims to address the risks of communicable diseases and limited healthcare-seeking behavior by conducting community and school-level programs to raise health awareness and improve long-term healthcare-seeking behavior.

title: Keep a Girl in School In Northern Nigeria
description: Over 15 million children in Northern Nigeria are out of school due to crisis and poverty out of which 70% of this figure are girls (UNICEF Report 2018). This project plans to build a 5 blocks of classrooms with furnitures and fittings, provide sick bay equipments and first aid, Ventilated Improved Pit Latrines, provide supply of books, literacy support services for girls in Government Junior Secondary Schools in Tarauni Local Government Council in Kano. This project will affect 1950 girls

title: Children Conditions in Yemen & Dire Needs of Women
description: This project aims to reduce the suffering of Women & Children who are severely affected by the war in Yemen. More than 70% of IDPs in Yemen are women and children, an. 30% of IDPs Households are now headed by females, total of 20.7 million people, 66% of the population, are estimated to need humanitarian assistance in 2021; 12.1 million people of whom are estimated to be in acute need (severity 4 and 5). This includes 4.6 million women, 5.5 million girls, 4.7 million men, and 5.7 million boys.

title: Support our Disadvantaged Youths this Covid19 wave
description: Singapore is into another worrisome wave of Covid19 variants, dealing with the unforeseen challenges caused by the pandemic. It marks the highest number of community cases in a year and some unlinked, unidentified ones. Many of our youths are most vulnerable as their daily learning and programmes need funding. In Trybe, we are doing our best to continue to journey with youths who are marginalised and overlooked by the society. Your contribution will help them pull through this difficult time.

title: Empower 300 Social Innovation Projects
description: Undergraduates are the future of our society. We as a non-profit organization, empower more than 300 people the social innovation projects. We are determined to promote social responsibility through project-based learning. The funding will be directed provided to students' project such as "Rest for Love", dedicated to solve the dilemma of caring for elders with dementia and disability, to alleviate the pressure of caregivers by developing prototypes products suitable for the elders.

title: Go Girl against teen pregnancy due to covid 19
description: Under the name Go Girl, partners of The Constellation in Cameroon, Ghana, India, Indonesia and Kenya have joined hands after signalling a growth in (unwanted) teen pregnancy in their countries. The same thing is happening in several places in the world, possibly as a result of school closures and other lockdown measures in response to the covid-19 pandemic. In those locations girls drop out of school and their health, livelihood and safety is at risk. A cultural sensitive intervention is needed.

title: Quality education in Fiji
description: In Dawasamu, Fiji, our collaborative project focuses on quality education, where we assist members of the local community with early childhood development and vocational support whilst offering equal opportunities to women. Our primary goal is to support education efforts through the dissemination of information via workshops and community-based learning, which is an effective learning approach that increases the engagement of participants and the development of new skill sets.

title: Public Health in Fiji
description: Our goal is to strengthen the health system by supporting local communities with preventative health measures in Dawasamu, Fiji.  Our collaborative project assists community members with public health, where community health practitioners like District Nurses have access to mentorship programs. The mentoring scheme helps community nurses develop their full potential and promote health and well-being best practices such as promoting value-based nutrition and offer training in CPR.

title: Waste Management in Fiji
description: In Dawasamu, Fiji, our collaborative project contributes towards waste management initiatives. Additionally, the program supports and promotes single-use plastic reduction among communities, partners, and educational facilities. Our goal is to boost environmental awareness by providing local communities and stakeholders with environmental solutions to manage local waste better.

title: Rainwater Harvesting in Fiji
description: In Dawasamu, Fiji, our collaborative project focuses on installing rainwater harvesting systems, and assessing and enhancing sustainable agriculture by building vegetable gardens. Our goal is to support communities with fresh-water management, water security and water and sanitation hygiene whilst contributing to gender equality through our other collaborative, community led projects such as health, education and women's empowerment.

title: Women's Empowerment in Fiji
description: In Dawasamu, Fiji, our collaborative project works on community development, focusing on women empowerment. Our goal is to support gender equality initiatives and workshops that raise awareness on gender gap related issues whilst providing practical solutions. The pandemic is posing greater risks to women and girls, suppressed by poverty, violence and inequality. Our project collaborates with local community members and organisations to help women and girls empower themselves.

title: Education in Nepal
description: In Pokhara, Nepal, our collaborative project focuses on quality education, where we help members of the local community improve their literacy and numeracy and facilitate after-school classes for young pupils as well as conversational English classes for local women. Our primary goal is to support educational efforts through the dissemination of information whilst increasing the engagement and the development of new skill sets.

title: Fellowship Program Support
description: An annual fellowship program for three [3] emerging African contemporary artists from the continent or the African Diaspora.
