The fellowship program will always have two [2]  junior fellows and one [1] senior fellow. Taking place from each Fall at the Noldor Residency is a program proudly based in Accra, Ghana.

title: Support the Scholarship Program at Uninorte
description: This project aims to overcome a gap in access to education for underserved and low-income communities in the Colombian Caribbean Coast by providing scholarships for college education. The scholarship is awarded at Universidad del Norte, one of Colombia's best-ranked universities. The scholarship includes full enrollment in an undergraduate program, second language full course and maintenance assistance costs (food, transportation, accommodation and study materials) throughout the semester.

title: Food and Nutritional Security
description: The project aims to guarantee food and nutritional security for more than 300 families that live in social vulnerability in Brazil. All donations will be used to distribute food baskets for poor families, milk and supplement for children in need, and guarantee nutritional and medical orientation for more than 300 families. This project will reach more than 1,500 people.

title: Empower Mozambican girls to go to high school
description: This project will empower girls from rural Mozambican villages to go to high school, equipping them with the skills and education to rise out of poverty. Specifically, this project will address the particular needs of each student, including financial, logistical, and social support, to ensure that each girl can succeed in her high school studies. This project will target girls who would not be able to go to high school at all without this support.

title: WeCare-Informed Parenting Project 37
description: This project will establish over 500 learning centers with a provision of mobile resource facilities to train parents in nurturing child (-1 to 3 years) according to WHO nurturing child framework, with a greater focus on stunting prevention, holistic child development and mother health. The geographic focus will be the mountainous regions of the Karakorum, Himalayas and Hindukush targeting mothers and children. The project will create an enabling environment for child protection and development

title: HELP IRAQI CHILDREN WITH DISABILITIES
description: Autism is only one disability that plagues Iraqi children. The prevalence of autism in the Middle East is higher by far than in other regions of the world. What makes the need for our action in Iraq so crucial is the lack of focus on mental health and disabilities. Years of war have taken their toll most significantly on the children. Our focus is on orphans, children being raised by single mothers, and children living in extreme poverty. Many children need additional educational services.

title: Help a woman feed her family in South Africa
description: Young Global Entrepreneurs plans to set-up sustainable vegetable gardens for 400 women and youth living in disadvantaged marginalised informal settlements in Johannesburg, South Africa, empowering them with small-scale farming and agri-business skills to produce food for their families and sell the surplus for an income. Addressing gender inequality by empowering women is an effective way to address hunger and poverty issues and has immediate positive multiplier effects in improving livelihoods

title: Support our community volunteers on Lesvos
description: Our community volunteers play an integral role in the operations of our projects inside the new, temporary refugee camp on Lesvos. Currently, we have a team of over 300 hardworking individuals who all live and work in RIC Lesvos. They spend their days cleaning the camp, operating WASH facilities, coaching sports and running food distribution points. By donating to this project, you can help us provide our community volunteers with essential clothing items for the upcoming summer period.

title: 15 Uruguayan Girls in Tech
description: This project aims to reach and encourage young girls to follow STEM careers. We look forward to enroll 15 girls who live in disadvantaged settings in 2021 group.

title: Improve 385 Tanzanian pupils' quality of education
description: Terrat Secondary School has a vision to improve the quality of education in Simanjiro district, Tanzania. Despite inspiring teachers and passionate students, achieving this vision is being prevented due to a lack of resources in the school. An average class size of 70 students means that many do not have chairs to sit at or desks to write on, much less textbooks or the benefit of other teaching aids. Inadequate sanitary facilities caused 14% of girls to miss school due to their period in 2020.

title: IGNITE! Empowerment for LGBTIQ Youth
description: In 2019, Youth Voices Count (YVC) opened its flagship IGNITE! Empowerment for LGBTIQ adolescents & youth program. Following the vision of YVC in supporting LGBTIQ youth-led initiatives in the region, this small-scale technical & financial support program hopes to empower & develop the capacities of youth-led projects in countries in the Asia-Pacific Region. So far YVC has provided support in 9 countries across the Asia-Pacific Region. We hope to continue doing this work with your support!

title: Goma Volcano Child Protection & Relief Fund
description: On May 22, the Nyiragongo volcano erupted, causing the evacuation of thousands from surrounding villages in Goma and more than 170 children feared missing.We will provide immediate assistance to children and evacuees affected by the volcanic eruption and already battling with COVID-19 in a region and armed conflict. Our relief assistance will include volcano awareness, food packages, clean water, hygiene kits, sanitary products, clothing, heavy-duty face masks, relocation and housing support.

title: Help us to guarantee the internet access for kids
description: Most of the children and young people who attend the projects offered by Institute Oswaldo Ribeiro de Mendonca has only one mobile device in their houses and this device is used by the entire family for work. For this reason, during the pandemic, these kids and teenagers don't have access to online classes of their schools and IORM's projects. The access to online classes is vital to ensure the continuity of the learning process.

title: Empower, Educate Women & Youth in Kenya
description: This project will provide a free training in Embulbul Ngong, Kenya for 100 women and 100 youth who are desperately need help and support .We will provide knitting and crochet training and recycled arts and crafts skills which leads to employment opportunities or small business for women, and youths so they can support their families. This will includes training ,education and raise awareness of recycling and how make products and generate the income.

title: Rescue relief & Rehabilitation of YASS victims
description: On 26th May 2021 the Sundarbans area of Bengal witnessed a devastating natural calamity like severe Cyclone "YASS" just after one year of "AMPHAN" as a result entire area is ruined due to flood. Houses are destroyed.  Because of this reason we need support for relief, rescue and rehabilitation programme for ill fated people of Sundarbans those who are living with dire sequences losing all living amenities. Thus we need support for rescue relief & rehabilitation.

title: strengthen the local economy for 25 families
description: This project through transformation and use will strengthen and promote the local economy, participation and leadership of women and their families in contexts of social and armed conflict in the municipality of Quibdo-Choco, in the recovery and transformation processes of native fruits and the reconstruction of traditional knowledge, by means of dehydration and commercialization of the fruits of the region.   creation of a microenterprise dedicated to the production of dehydrated exotic fruits

title: Inspiring Women of the Future
description: Every child has the right to quality education - whatever their gender or background. Help ISF to educate, motivate, and inspire vulnerable Cambodian girls to challenge the inequalities they face and strive for a future with greater opportunities and hope.

title: Rescuing Imperiled Wildlife in South Africa
description: This project will enable the rescue and protection of wildlife in peril in South Africa. The illegal killing of wildlife for the bush meat and black market trade is a growing problem and it robs local communities of their rich biodiversity and natural heritage.

title: Improve 500 farmers' productivity in Mbata, Uganda
description: This project will build a centre to benefit rural farmers in the remote community of Mbata in mountainous Western Uganda, enabling them to increase crop yields, reduce post-harvest losses, find new markets and carry out more processing locally to obtain more value from their produce. This Farmers Enterprise Centre (FEC) will create new opportunities for community entrepreneurship, and sustainable local wealth generation and development, as well as providing energy to the wider community.

title: Slum Girls: End Period Poverty in Nairobi slums!
description: Girls living in Nairobi slums cannot afford to buy common hygiene products and do not have access to clean toilets. In Kenya, it is estimated that 65% of women cannot afford sanitary pads. During their period, girls are forced to stay home, missing a week of school each month. Your support in this project will bring hygiene kits to all 340 girls in our schools. Each girl will receive gynecological and emotional support, as well as sexual education and protection.

title: More equal opportunities for rural women
description: This project empowers women in their rights of equity and gender equality, through the creation of family microenterprises so that they have more independence and their own economic income.  Through "field schools" where we train and work with both men and women, so that they recognize the importance of gender in the family and at work.

title: Global Covid Emergency! - Oxygen On Demand
description: Emergency Oxygen -  The Appropriate Technology Collaborative is making an oxygen concentrator for Covid relief.   Millions of people in India, Africa and Asia are now suffocating due to lack of oxygen.  Hospitals are over run with Covid patients.  The situation is dire, but Covid patients, if given oxygen early on, can recover at home.  Home oxygen means fewer patients are hospitalized and fewer are intubated.  Oxygen is essential.  Let's help local people take control and make their own oxygen.

title: Girls' Access to SRHR Information & Services
description: To empower children and young females with accurate information and skills from a gender perspective for social action

title: Help 50 Title 1 Classrooms Meet Wildlife Up-Close!
description: This project will bring our at-school wildlife conservation programs  directly into Title 1 classrooms in the Triangle area of North Carolina, giving students an up-close and personal experience with animals (turtles, snakes, mammals, owls, hawks) that they may have never seen or interacted with before.  Up to 1,500 students will learn conservation tips, gain a new understanding of the world around them and gain a personal experience that they can share with family and friends.

title: Clean water and bathrooms for 1,367 schoolchildren
description: Children need to be nourished to thrive at school. Safe drinking water is essential to ensure children stay healthy and retain all the nutrients they can.   A recent assessment at the Entebbe UMEA primary school found that the water and sanitation systems at the school were insufficient, jeopardizing the children's access to safe water and their health. We need your support to build an effective water filtration and storage system and improve the latrines and changing rooms for girls.

title: Help the victims of volcano eruption in DR Congo
description: After the eruption of Nyiragongo volcano in the DR of Congo, the inhabitants of the region need urgent help. The lava began to flow towards the city of Goma 20 kilometers to the south, it had flowed into the city, destroying hundreds of homes. Tens of thousands of people have been displaced. At least 31 people have died and 30,000 were forced to flee their homes. They flee with bare belongings. We have to help the children and deliver food and shelter for the victims.

title: Send 300 Girls Back to School (COVID Recovery)
description: In India, 250 million people have been pushed into extreme poverty over the past 15 months. According to the UN, 20 million girls worldwide who have left school will never return.  This project will send 300 of the girls we serve, survivors of trafficking and those at high-risk, back to school to ensure they do not become a part of that statistic. Girls living in poverty or in high-risk environments cannot afford to lose the progress they have made in school. Education, Not Exploitation.

title: Helping people forced to flee
description: The Norwegian Refugee Council (NRC) is an independent humanitarian organisation helping people forced to flee. We deliver high-quality aid where needs are greatest. We work in both new and protracted crises across more than 40 countries, where we provide camp management, food assistance, clean water, shelter, legal aid, and education. In 2021, NRC assisted almost 10 million people worldwide, and with your support, we can help even more.

title: Empower African Youth in Software Development
description: This project will build the capacity of at least 30 Nigerian women on software development in Kano State, Nigeria. It will provide them with the necessary theoretical, practical and experience needed for a career in software development. Over $40,000 has already been secured in strategic tutoring both online and in-person, including internships and mentorships. An additional $10,000 is required to conduct the training.

title: Prevent Campus Sexual Violence & Empower Survivors
description: Would you feel safe going to college knowing there is a 34% chance you are raped or sexually assaulted? Imagine if you could look up how safe each campus is before deciding where to attend? With your support, we will make this a reality. We're raising money to launch the SVPA Score - the first and only assessment for campus sexual violence. By empowering students, the SVPA Score holds universities accountable for preventing sexual assault and supporting survivors.

title: Help 200 Youth Families become self-employed.
description: Help Networking for Society Development Organization to implement the project of solving among of the main challenges facing youth in Tanzania which is unemployment caused by population increase hence accumulation of skilled and unskilled youth. Project aims at increasing opportunities for youth access to implement self employment based on profit making through cultivation of high value crops by using irrigation technology and equipping 200 youth on moneymaker pumps to increase employment

title: DRC Volcano Eruption Relief
description: On May 22nd, Mount Nyiragongo volcano erupted in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).  Although the lava flow stopped the following day, there have been repeated earthquakes in the same region, prompting fears of another eruption. At least 28 people have died, and over 170 children are missing. ActionAid has been working in this area for nearly two decades, and is responding immediately with emergency support, while also planning for a longer-term response to support those impacted.

title: Alpha Lumen Technology Education Program
description: This Project is part of the Alpha Lumen Technological Education Program that brings opportunities for young people and children,with high skills, but in situations of social vulnerability,to have access to Science and Technology. The program aims to combat digital illiteracy,evasion and disinterest in the school by inspiring vocations and bringing opportunities for talent students in the field of Robotics and Programming.The project also focuses on a working culture of values and social skills.

title: Treating Children suffering from Retinal Diseases
description: Mahavir Netralaya's child care  is preventing blindness by detecting retinal disabilities and treating them (including surgery) at right stage. The plan is to primarily survey all the new born child at the dedicated pediatric and new born unit. Retinal specialist visits these centers to regularly trying to detect retinal problems and take necessary palliative measures. Th

title: RANCHI EYE CARE CENTRE
description: GLOBAL SIGHT SOLUTIONS FORMS PARTNERSHIPS WITH ORGANISATIONS IN THE DEVELOPING WORLD, USUALLY ROTARY  CLUBS, AND TOGETHER WE ESTABLISH A HIGH QUALITY EYE CARE  HOSPITAL THAT PROVIDES FREE EYE CARE TO THE WORLDS POOREST. ONCE ESTABLISHED THE RANCHI FACILITY WILL PROVIDE A FULL RANGE OF EYE CARE INCLUDING UNDERTAKING 7000 CATARACT OPERATIONS PER ANNUM

title: SAVE PLANET EARTH - TIDE TURNERS
description: Plastic wastes are lying everywhere around us and creating havoc on the ecosystem - animals, humans & climate. Plastic has entered our food, water, air everywhere. ISKCON has joined hands with UNEP to fight this problem. The Tide Turners Plastic Challenge is a global youth movement, designed to inspire and empower young adults to reflect upon their plastic consumption, discover solutions to reduce this consumption, and lead change in their homes, communities, institutions, and offices.

title: LIVELIHOOD FOR RURAL WOMEN
description: ISKCON Varanasi with the help of the HOPE Welfare Trust is building a Stitching Centre & Cottage product centre at the village of Raja Talab in Varanasi, India. This centre will facilitate the rural women of nearby areas in skills like stitching and home-based small industry, with the focus to make them self-dependent and have an alternative source of earning a livelihood to help their families so that none of them falls prey to domestic abuse or human trafficking in want of basic necessities.

title: Technology and Education for Kids in Kenya
description: Elimu Resource Centre is a digital hub for learners in Malindi, Kenya that uses technology to put educational resources into hands that had never held even a textbook much less a laptop! The pandemic shut our doors last year, so as we welcome students back for their personal study and computer training we want to offer them a fresh clean environment. Will you help us make Elimu Resource Centre into a clean, safe study environment for kids again?

title: Gift Music Therapy to very Vulnerable People
description: 'Connect By Music' brings the lifeline of music and singing to refugees - mostly women and young children - struggling with the stress and fear of daily life. CBM provide regular classes at three otherwise desolate and depressing refugee camps on mainland Greece. For each student, music and singing means everything, which is why we need your help now to make sure they continue to sing.

title: Supporting the Mobilize Recovery 2021 Initiative
description: The initiative's purpose is to identify, train, connect, and work with recovery advocates in all 50 states. By sharing resources, building skill sets and taking action as a powerful confident constituency, our goal is to affect change impacting millions of people in a positive way by focusing on local issues across the country specific to addiction recovery and ending America's long-standing addiction crisis.

title: HELP TRIBAL KIDS GET FOOD, EDUCATION & SHELTER
description: India has 1,17,064 recognized Tribal villages where 88,295 villages lack basic facilities. ISKCON Varanasi in collaboration with ISKCON Pirpainti under the inspiration of His Holiness Bhakti Purushottam Swami is establishing a Gurukul where tribal kids are provided with free shelter, food, clothing, education, health facilities, spiritual values, skill training, and a warm family environment, in order to give meaning & fulfillment in their lives.

title: Saving manatees and monkeys in Belize
description: Wildtracks provides successful rescue, rehabilitation and release of endangered primates (Yucatan black howler monkeys and Central American spider monkeys) and Antillean manatees in Belize. It uses a blend of wildlife rehabilitation and conservation planning to work with its partners to contribute towards addressing the illegal wildlife trade and supporting Belize's national wildlife conservation strategies.

title: Emergency Response to COVID-19 in Sri Lanka
description: Street Child will deliver and support ground level relief efforts in Mullaitivu, Batticaloa and Trincomalee by contributing towards urgent non-medical items for frontline workers in intermediate care centres (ICC), necessary personal protective equipment (PPE) to protect households and encourage safe hygiene practices and emergency food relief packages to families of daily wage workers facing existential challenges during the lockdown due to Sri Lanka's second wave of COVID-19.

title: Help Youth Recover From Mental health and COVID
description: Not all wounds are visible, Youth persons consistently face threats depression, anxiety disorders, and suicide thoughts to life challenges. This project will help 50 Youth individuals to increase the chances for early intervention which can result in a fast recovery, reduces negative adjectives that have been set to describe our people with a metal illness.

title: Help deliver quality healthcare to 35,000 in Kenya
description: The Mabati Medical Centre (MMC) attends around 35,000 patients in Kilifi County every year. Here, healthcare services are far and few between, with most lacking the necessary human and medical resources to serve their communities. This is especially concerning during a global pandemic. At MMC, we believe that by continuing to provide our basic quality healthcare services at a low fee of $3.19, we can ensure that our elders, parents and children can lead healthier and more productive lives.

title: Provision of Clean  water to 2,680 peoples Karagwe
description: The core problem for this project is that the 2,680 communities  and pupils  at Mato location lack access to safe sufficient water to meet their basic need. While sufficient water exists at a spring 8km from their home Omwibale stream, thus this water source is not protected and thus is at high risk of contamination and poses a threat to the health of Local communities who collect water there. When there is insufficient water at school, pupils are required to walk 7km (each way) to collect water

title: Support a "Smart Village" in Malawi
description: Abundance is a non-profit organization that has worked at Mbando village in rural Malawi since 2016. Working closely with the communities, over 5 years, we have set up a library, solar powered e-learning center, trained youth on vocational skills, provided a communal bicycle ambulance, blankets to elderly, trained girls on sanitary napkins making, planted trees, piloted a waste to energy bioenergy cooker and are setting up a rice mill. Support us to make Mbando a "Smart Village"!

title: THE AKILI GIRLS SCHOLARSHIP FUND
description: We are sending marginalized rural girls  from Kisumu Kenya to high school and eventually to University. These girls have been studying at Akili Preparatory School for girls since 2012 and are now transitioning to high school in July 2021. We believe that by giving them scholarships to access quality high school education, we are empowering them to achieve their dreams and lift themselves and their families out of poverty.

title: CAMPS manufacturing shelter coats for the homeless
description: This project has three main goals:  - Create decent jobs for people going through our Emploiment Training Center' sewing workshops, who will manufacture jackets/sleeping-bags (CAMPs) for the winter. - On the other hand, train our ETC beneficiaries in the arts and crafts of sewing, adding skills to level job opportunities. - Last, but not least, we will provide homeless people with the production of the jacket that turn into sleeping bags for the cold winter nights.

title: Support the personal development of 300 women
description: Poverty is the biggest barrier to entering higher education and to equality in Colombia.Only 4 out of 10 teens manage to get into college. More than 60%survive with precarious jobs. Through a donation, you will help the Asociacion Cultural Femenina in its program with social meaning, Juventus, to keep transforming positively the life of more than 300adolescents and their families. Closing the gap through economic support,driving entrepreneurship,and giving opportunities in professional education

title: Donate to support online medical consultations
description: In Brazil, the Horas da Vida Institute wants to provide free medical assistance to families living in extreme poverty. The Institute's main goal is to help them to diagnose non-communicable chronic diseases such as high blood pressure, cholesterol and diabetes - diseases which, when not diagnosed, can be life-threatening. Founded in 2013, Horas da Vida has already provided healthcare services to around 400 thousand poor families in the country.

title: 100 autonomous & digitalized argentine seniors
description: The project was created to shorten the digital gap and the isolation of 100 people over 65 years of age from Gonzalez Catan, Buenos Aires, facilitating the creation and maintenance of links through technology. In order not to leave anyone behind, we develop face-to-face workshops with playful and friendly actions that promote digital skills that allow them to maintain their autonomy, live with dignity, share, be active, make decisions and learn from others.

title: COVID-19 Relief for Brazil, Colombia and Bolivia
description: The Covid-19 crisis in South America has taken an alarming turn, with cases increasing in Brazil, Colombia, and Bolivia. Hospitals are overwhelmed and there have been reports of oxygen shortages and insufficient hospital beds. There are urgent calls for more beds, medicines, oxygen, essential drugs and Covid-19 tests. Hospitals are overwhelmed and are running out of ICU beds and other critical medical equipment.

title: Climate Action! Support Nature Reserve in Colombia
description: Our goal is to create and manage two private nature reserves in Colombia, to provide a concrete climate action by developing multiple activities in them aimed at enhancing human-nature harmony, irradiating a positive example to both locals and visitors, and provisioning site facilities for a participatory-and-academic science able to nourish our communities with sustainable initiatives on good practices. We aim to generate a dynamic calendar of harmonious activities to learn and care of nature.

title: TRAIN 1000 YOUNG MOTHERS IN GULU IN TAILORING
description: This project will train 1000 young mothers in Gulu district in tailoring, enabling them to gain critical skills that can earn them employment and also allow them start their own tailoring business.  Child Equal Opportunity Uganda (CEOU) plan to expand its newly created young mothers tailoring center to provide free training in tailoring to young mothers who hail from the poorest communities in Gulu.

title: Conserving forest biodiversity in Madagascar
description: Over the last three years, SEED has been working to conserve the biodiversity of the Sainte Luce Littoral Forest (SLLF), home to endemic lemur species. The SLLF is threatened by mining, illegal logging, and high community dependence on its resources. Building on the progress of Project Ala Phase I, Phase II will continue to expand habitat corridors between forest fragments, while also addressing unsustainable resource use in the local community-protecting the littoral forest and its biodiversity

title: Timely Care for Early Childhood and Families
description: The aim of this project is to promote comprehensive health of 120 women and their children between 0 and 5 years old from Villa 21-24 of Barracas, the biggest slum in Buenos Aires City. The project proposes to work with 4 specific areas: pregnant women and their children during the first year of life, prevent cases of malnutrition and undernutrition, work on the prevention of gender-based violence, and stimulate play and early stimulation in children.

title: Help the Tharu Prevent a COVID disaster in Nepal
description: The Advocacy Project is seeking $2,500 to help our partner, Backward Society Education (BASE), fight back against a devastating second wave of the coronavirus in Midwest Nepal. Drawing on its roots in the Tharu community, BASE will work in 60 villages and train volunteers to lead a prevention campaign, as well as deploy a mobile medical team to conduct rapid testing and provide emergency care. We hope to reach over 12,000 villagers and set up a system that could eventually support vaccinations.

title: Together for Nepal
description: This summer, as COVID devastated Nepal, 5 organizations representing +2.9M households launched the Together for Nepal (TFN) campaign. This project supports them to prevent a third wave by promoting vaccine acceptance and access among Indigenous peoples and local, rural communities. With your support, TFN will also support emerging community resilience by promoting locally-led enterprises, traditional ecological knowledge, and community forestry across their national reach.

title: Help with COVID-19 relief materials to hospital
description: We will support two hospitals; Manmohan Memorial Community Hospital, Dakshinkali and HANDS Polyclinic, Sindhuli. As COVID-19 infection is increasing, hospitals need urgent support to handle patients. With the lack of PPE and other basic equipment such as oximeter, the hospital staffs, patients and visitors are at high risk. We will provide hospitals with PPE and other requisites for fighting the pandemic. This will help hospitals to deliver health services smoothly in the communities.

title: Garage run by female car mechanics in Nairobi slum
description: We offer every year 30 girls from the Mathare slums in Nairobi/Kenya the chance to study car mechanics. A profession that empowers and secures these young women with a job and an economically independent future outside the slums. Safe Spaces has lengthy experience in offering this 2 year vocational training. It is now time to open our own garage, where these girls can be educated, do their internships and grow. For Safe Spaces it means becoming less dependent on funding over time.

title: Street Lawyers, Doctors, Hope Buses for Iraqi Kids
description: The Iraqi Children Foundation intervenes in the lives of children who are vulnerable to abuse, neglect, and exploitation by criminals, human traffickers, and extremists.  Street Lawyers, social workers, doctors, and Hope Buses deliver education, food, legal protection, medical care, and psycho-social services to at-risk orphans, child laborers, street kids, and the disabled.

title: Provide clean water to over 1800 Nyamongeans
description: This project drills a bore hole, installs a submersible water pump, a water tower, constructs a digital kiosk, and water bottling plant, to provide clean safe drinking water to 1200 students/pupils, 100 staff and about 500 villagers in the drought-stricken Nyamonge Community.

title: Help 1000 women farmers with good quality seeds
description: Your donation will help support 1000 rural women farmers in Gulu and Nwoya districts. When women are provided with good quality seeds, improved farm inputs and fertilizers, their yields improve, so are their earnings and family well being. The earnings are usually reinvested into food, education and healthcare. They are also able to feed their families with nutritious foods, buffer against illness,  hunger and nurture the soil.

title: Covid-19 relief for families in remote area
description: Currently, this is the third wave of pandemic has increased in severity and has caused more impacted.The virus has spread into many provinces in Thailand.The Operation Blessing (Thai) has seen the urgency to help 600 families those who are affected by Covid-19 in the northern remote area through projects for short-term periods like a relief package, alcohol hand gels, and face masks and for a long-term project that aims for sustainability like income assistance by giving fund for livelihood.

title: Coronavirus Relief For LGBTQ+ Community in India
description: As COVID-19 sweeps the world, LGBTIQ+ communities in India are be particularly vulnerable. LGBTQ+ people experience various health disparities which magnify the impact that COVID-19 could have on these communities.  Barely able to access health facilities, these people are hanging on by a thread. We plan to support economically weak sexual minorities and transgender persons across Andhra and Telangana with groceries and nutritional supplements in order to feed them and improve their immunity.

title: Recovery Fund - Massive Yezidi IDP Camp Fire
description: On June 4th, a fire broke out in Sharya camp, one of 15 camps housing 16,000 displaced Yezidis who escaped genocide in 2014.  In total, more than 370 tents were burned; 184 families comprised of 994 individuals living in these tents lost all their properties and belongings. These families are currently without shelter, food, and other basic necessities. We are asking you to to join our campaign to raise $100,000 US dollars to support these families and help us address this emergency situation.

title: #AdvanceFolk Care Package Program
description: Our programs are under the umbrella of the #AdvanceFolk Care Package Program. Through this program, we provide outreach, basic needs care packages, case management support, and education to promote the well-being, healthy aging, safety, and independence of older adults while strengthening their dignity and self-respect, and encouraging their contribution and participation in community life.

title: Food relief, COVID kits and educational support
description: This project aims to provide immedicate food relief, essential COVID-kits to 196 rural women (benefitting 980 family members) in Doti and Dadeldhura district (Far-Western Region) who are facing social, economic and natural hardship due to second wave of COVID-19 pandemic.  Further, it helps to provide educational support to 10 children for a year,  who lost their family members due to COVID-19.

title: Book Clubs in Secondary Schools across Nigeria
description: Poverty and high cost of books have been identified as reasons for the poor reading culture in public secondary schools across Nigeria. This project is critical to bridging the gap. It will create and monitor book clubs in 100 public secondary schools in Nigeria, providing them with a rich supply of books. It will impact about 10,000 pupils from low-income families across Nigeria by improving their critical thinking  and reading skills and consequently improving their socio-economic prospects.

title: Support Girls' Education in Rural China
description: Gender inequities continue to persist in China, especially in rural areas. According to the NBSC, evidenced by a skewed sex ratio at birth (111.3 male to 100 female births in 2020), 6.8 lower than 2010. Girls from the rural area have a smaller chance of attending school than their male counterparts, due, in part, to a long-held perception that men are entitled to more privileges than women. With 26-year experiences, SOAR has decided to create a project dedicated to rural areas girls' eduction.

title: Preventing Pakistani youth from suicide and drugs
description: No such institution in Pakistan is working to improve youth's mental health and helping them to lead a prosperous life. The youth needs counselling on mental health, suicidal prevention, marriage , exploring faith, after-marriage counselling, maintaining relationships, harassment etc. more than ever, as the number of suicides among the youth have increased significantly during the last 5 years. AWARD wishes to setup training and counselling sessions with the youth to improve their abilities.

title: EMPOWER CHILDREN FROM UNDERPRIVILEGED BACKGROUNDS
description: Founded in 1994 by the late actress Anne Wanjugu, Tumshangilieni Mtoto is a project in Nairobi, Kenya whose aim is to empower street children and other underprivileged children from economically challenged background. Tumshangilieni uses performing arts as a tool of rehabilitation and offers formal education from primary school to university.  In so doing the children are empowered to be financially independent and ready for reintegration back to society.

title: Keep 1500 Rural Ayamelum Girls in School
description: Girls Lead Club formed after the COVID-19 lockdown returned vulnerable girls to school and prevents those at the verge of dropping out. Lack of access to hygienic pads, reoccurrence of infections, unhygienic menstrual practices, all keep them away from school, miss classes. Seeking money for pads leads to sexual violence, unwanted pregnancies and underage marriage. Menstrual Hygiene Education will be provided in the LGA with distribution of certified Pad-Up Reusable Menstrual Kits to 1500 girls.

title: Decent food for those needed due to COVID-19
description: The COVID-19 outbreak, declared a global pandemic on 11 March 2020, has reached all corners of the globe. As of 14 June 2021, Vietnam has had 10,337 confirmed cases with 58 deaths. The pandemic has alarmingly threatened the food security and nutrition of the most disadvantaged groups across Vietnam. With your kind support, AFV is taking proactive steps to provide emergency food assistance to vulnerable population in Bac Ninh, Bac Giang and Ho Chi Minh city to help them fight against COVID-19.

title: Growing up as a family
description: The purpose of the project is to educate vulnerable families in skills related to parenting, coexistence and their role as caregivers; facilitating the overcoming of adverse situations, preventing future risks and promoting the generation of healthy and safe environments, suitable for the development of girls and adolescents.

title: Cycling to School: Education for young girls
description: This project will empower 150 young girls who have dropped out of school due to transport issues, by providing them cycles to travel to school. Young girls often drop out of school because they don't have any access to travel long distances and parents are not supportive to let girls continue their education. Through this project awareness sessions will be conducted with the parents of these girls to motivate them to support their girls and provide cycles to these girls to continue going school.

title: Help to Monitor and Protect Orangutans in Borneo
description: Help us to raise the funds needed to protect Mardianto, Zakia and other rescued and rehabilitated Bornean orangutans, by putting non-invasive camera traps in the pristine rainforests of Central Kalimantan. Let's make the Bukit Batikap Protect Forest in Indonesia a safe place for orangutans to thrive!

title: Help St Mungo's to end rough sleeping by 2026
description: St Mungo's aim is to end rough sleeping completely by 2026. We need your help to achieve this.  St Mungo's are one of the largest providers of frontline homelessness services, supporting vulnerable people 365 days a year. Each night we provide a bed and support to 3,200 people who are affected by homelessness. Our dream is a country where nobody has to sleep on the streets and has the support they need when they fall on hard times. Please support us to end homelessness and rebuild lives.

title: Empower 30 Young South African Leaders
description: Our Futsal Academy in Stellenbosch, South Africa is a safe space for equipping & empowering at-risk boys to become transformational young leaders. Throughout the year 30 boys receive education outside the classroom, futsal coaching, & academic support. Our curriculum is accredited by Coaches Across Continents. We bring the curriculum to life through purposeful play activities. Our relationship-based approach has demonstrated clear impact over the last 8 years.

title: Radiotherapy for 10,000 Nigerian women with cancer
description: The mission of St Cyril Cancer Treatment Foundation is to provide quality treatment to as many cancer patients in Africa as possible, starting with Nigeria

title: RESTORING DIGNITY FOR GIRLS
description: Girls from humble backgrounds in rural areas have the heart to go to school but struggle to stay in school during their menstruation period.    These girls are in day secondary schools and their parents/guardians have no extra money to buy them sanitary towels nor underwear. TMSC has taken an initiative to teach the girls about Women's health, to ensure girls have access to washable menstrual kits that will last them four years of secondary school.  We hope to  provide 3000 kits every year.

title: Build 3classroom blocks for 200pupils in Manyangwa
description: Gods children ministry will build 3 class rooms to help provide free good quality education to vulnerable and orphaned children in manyangwa village in primary level .we ensure all children are under a  safe and loving environment while learning,we are dedicated in providing food for students  we work  hand in hand with the community as we educate them the youth ,guardians the value of sending their children to school. your donation provides free education to all vulnerable children in manyangwa

title: Stop Child Abuse and Bullying Project
description: Our goal is to reduce child abuse and bullying from our communities. We provide a child-friendly questionnaire to reveal incidences of child abuse/neglect, bullying, mental health concerns both at school and at home. Our tool addresses a wider set of issues and can be answered anytime, anywhere. Question sets are age specific and best address their needs. Along with the tool, we develop educational programs to nurture diversity and inclusion for every mind of future global community members.

title: Free Healthcare For 1,000 Poor Kids in Tanzania
description: This project will enable us to set-up a high-quality Medical Centre which will provide 1,000 children from poor families from the local community with access to free healthcare delivered by world class international doctors.

title: Kitchen Gardens for 100 Households in Cameroon.
description: The project will address high rates of food insecurity, and malnutrition in Cameroon, by establishing 100 kitchen' gardens for 100 malnourished  households,with nutrient-rich seeds .  It will provide education in adequate nutrition and balance diet, to malnourished households with average size of 7 members per household. It aims to empower poor families to cultivate and sale assorted vegetables to reduce poverty and improve health and well-being of women and their children in rural Cameroon.

title: Help 120 South African children attend pre-school
description: Ubunye Educare Centre (Ubunye) is an Integrated Early Childhood Development (ECD) Programme in Dunoon Township, Cape Town.  The purpose of the programme is to provide quality Grade R early childhood education, routine paediatric health check-ups and nutritional needs for 120 children aged 5 - 6 from Dunoon Township enrolled in our care.

title: Help Artists Impacted by COVID-19
description: As the US rebounds from COVID-19, artists are facing a particularly long road to recovery. Through multiple cycles of relief funding, CERF+ has provided grants to over 1,000 artists facing food, health, and housing insecurities. We remain committed to helping artists recover from the economic setbacks they've experienced due to COVID-19. Demand for CERF+'s programs has never been greater, but together we can meet the need and ensure that the safety net for artists remains strong.

title: Help us build a Fence to Protect our Water Well
description: This project will build a fence to protect our water well at Scotty's Rescue Centre. Our water well is crucial in making Scotty's a self-sustainable Rescue Centre for the women and children currently living on the streets of Nairobi. By selling the water, the local rural communities will also have access to this vital resource. The fence is a vital means of protecting the well, building our fence will push us further along our mission of completing Scotty's Rescue Centre.

title: "Seeds of Resilience: An Indigenous Women-Led Tree
description: Highland Support Project's reforestation efforts empower Indigenous women in the highlands of Guatemala by planting 1,000 trees. By employing a nursery run by Indigenous Mayan women, the project will mitigate the adverse effects of deforestation, such as erosion, soil infertility, and climate instability, bringing long-term environmental benefits. This reforestation project will engage the local community in sustainable agriculture while also increasing their incomes and economic resiliency.

title: COMPLETION OF BLOOD BANK FOR TRANSFUSION SERVICES
description: The ECG hospital is located in kpandai, a rural community with a population of about 108,816. The hospital carry out emergency operations that need the availability of blood and blood products. Also, antepartum hemorrhage, post partum hemorrhage and anemia cases need urgent transfusion.  However we do not have a standard blood bank and our services are hampered by such a deficiency. We are therefore rolling out this project in order to procure a blood bank and refurbish a room for this services

title: First Latam Integral Center for childhood cancer
description: Fundacion Nuestros Hijos provides free integral support to disadvantaged children with cancer in order to increase their life expectancy, improve quality of life, and decrease the psychosocial impact of the illness. With your help, we will build a world-class Childhood Cancer Center to improve every patient's chances of survival and bring them the best possible quality of life. We want to expand our services beyond Chile and serve more children and their families.

title: Supporting Youth with Mental Health Symptoms.
description: Many youth in Singapore face different struggles that require different levels of support. Left unaddressed, these adversities may result to behaviours that could put the youth and others in danger. Trybe's services guide and engage youth with adversities through intervention, rehabilitation, and reintegration works. Our services provide a safe environment for our youth to deal with their emotional and mental struggles. This campaign allows us to reach out to more youth in need.

title: Help Women who Help Women thru Midwife Training
description: Our midwives deliver safe, gentle loving care at our clinics across Indonesia. Many have worked with us for years after completing a 3-year nurse-midwifery degree. The Indonesian government has changed regulations for midwifery training. All midwives must now have 4 years of study: the equivalent of a Master's Degree. This means even currently licensed midwives must return to school for an additional year of training in order to stay certified. Bumi Sehat needs funds to train 6 midwives.

title: Refuge for abused women in Tigray, Ethiopia
description: During the armed conflict in our region many women have become the victims of serious violence, taking their dignity and scarring them for life. They ran, hurting bodies, crushed minds, and now little clothing, food, help and dispersed families. Slowly they come out of hiding and start looking for help. The hospital treats immediate injuries, and we admit the women, who are in need of in-depth-psychological rehabilitation, into our refuge.

title: Sports for children with disabilities in Bosnia
description: By supporting this project you will assure that children and youth with developmental disabilities in Banja Luka (Bosnia and Herzegovina) have free access to sports and physical activities. This is vital for their health, fitness and  overall well being, as sports activities also act as a form of active therapy and as such help individuals with developmental disabilities become more independent and integrated into society.

title: Transform a Child's Life through Music
description: At Nucleo, we believe every child should have the opportunity to learn music. Our free, immersive programme aims to make this a reality for the young people in the areas we serve, from every background and circumstance.  We build strong, connected musical communities in which children and young people discover and fulfil their potential.  As they do so, they develop a range of learning and life-skills that can have a truly transformational impact.

title: Accelerate ALS research to help handicap patients
description: In 2011 died our mother in ALS disease. There are appr. 500 000 ALS patients in the world. We started our organization to accelerate research to find a better treatment. We are meeting many patients like Charles in the video for which we bought an equipment that allow him to write from his eyes. ALS is a disease where patients get handicapped and with short live period. You can make a difference by giving a donation that will help the research team in Paris as well as an handicap center

title: Project Pamoja! Build the school of tomorrow
description: Project Pamoja, (pamoja means together in swahili) will deliver a high quality school building redevelopment to the community of Kibera. The new building will host state of the art education facilities composed of nine classrooms, laboratory, library and services according to relevant highest health and safety standards.  Up to 225 students will benefit from highest educational standards and facilities in the heart of one of the largest slum in Africa.

title: Protecting 650 Ugandan children from trafficking
description: We focus on combating domestic child trafficking, from the origin in Karamoja to the destination, Uganda's capital Kampala. Our work centres on both survivors and children at high risk of trafficking: 210 survivors are supported to return home and resume education, while 440 vulnerable children are protected by keeping them in school. A local child protection network of community champions deals with child rights abuses including potential trafficking, thus functioning as an early intercepter.

title: Emergency COVID-19 support
description: Emergency COVID-19 support project will be addressing the needs that are currently needed by the children's Home, Another Hope Children's Ministries. The COVID-19 or Coronavirus crisis has made a tremendous impact across most of the countries around the world. The entire social, economic and cultural structure is gradually transforming into an unexpected reality. Poor communities have become more vulnerable to the basic issues of hunger, housing and shelter.

title: Let's Jointly Build Trans Community Safe Space
description: This project will help to furnish and equip an already acquired safe space in the center of Yerevan, providing Trans and sex worker community members from all the regions of Armenia to socialize, get free education, IT and language skills, vocational trainings, psychological, legal, social services, hold group activities and initiate new projects, strengthen social bonds and form a sense of community, relax and have a safe space.

title: Help Essex & Herts Air Ambulance Save Lives
description: Help us build an intensive and realistic training environment for our critical care doctors and paramedics.  High-tech visual projections and sound will submerge our critical care team in ultra-real training scenarios so they can practice advanced procedures on human-like medical mannequins under the same stress and pressure of a real-life incident.  From a car crash by a busy road to an incident in a child's bedroom, this immersive training will help our teams go out and save more lives.

title: FEED 500 VULNERABLE CHILDREN AND ELDERLY IN KENYA
description: Victory Foundation Programme plans to feed 500 Orphans-Vulnerable slum children of MATHARE, MIHANGO & KIBERA Kenya for 2021 - 2023, by providing food to increase OVC's retention at rescue centers, safer homes for elderly to free them from hunger, improve their health and nutritional needs, to improve concentration levels thus improving health and productivity. VFP will provide virtual learning and free feeding to the children and street families, empowering them for sustainable livelihood.

title: Tigray Famine and Crisis Relief Fund
description: People in Ethiopia's northern Tigray region are caught in a devastating conflict that has taken lives, displaced millions, and forced people to the brink of famine. Donations to this fund will help provide aid and relief to people impacted by these crises and the local organizations working to help them.

title: Provide for 2 Ethiopian Towns During Drought
description: For many years we've funded the operation of schools and orphanages in Ethiopia who're currently experiencing tragic drought. People are dying of starvation faster than they can be buried. We'd like to provide maize corn to 2 towns, 700 families, until their crops are ready for harvest in September. CAN YOU HELP SAVE LIVES?

title: BETTER VISION FOR THE PEOPLE OF SOGUNRO, LAGOS
description: Sogunro is located on the Makoko/Iwaya waterfront area of Lagos. A community rooted in culture with several unorthodox practices to treat the prevalent eye defects and diseases arising from their craft. Children are more adversely affected as they require good vision for successful education. Unfortunately, proper eye care is a luxury that few can afford.  Drug Aid Africa has identified this gap and seeks to provide eye screenings, medication, and prescription glasses for 1500 residents.

title: Connect 35000 vulnerable Egyptians to clean water
description: Nadia was happy at last to have clean water at home for her family's health. Similarly,35000 beneficiaries in small hamlets in Minya Upper Egypt poorest rural areas need clean safe drinking water connections from UPVC sustainable for 60 yrs.MEK spreads awareness of hygiene/sanitation in relation to Covid-19.Women & girls can spend less time and less physical effort collecting daily needs of water from contaminated canals;contract less water-related illnesses; and be more economically productive.

title: FOR $10 HELP THE POOR IN POST COVID 19 RECOVERY
description: Uganda  went through a series of lockdowns as a result of COVID 19 pandemic and this disrupted many aspects of already fragile health situations. Maternal deaths went up, many children were not immunized. A number of people with non communicable diseases could not have access to critically needed medical care. Our clinics for non communicable diseases have remained closed and there is urgent need to reopen them. We need to repair our ambulance and start evacuating mothers, provide delivery kits.

title: Training leaders in Zimbabwe's Deaf Community
description: How can a deaf person be a confident leader? 30 young deaf men and women from urban and rural Manicaland Province in Zimbabwe will be reached through workshops to develop their confidence, problem solving, planning, team building and facilitation skills. You gift will enable deaf men and women to lead community groups and other deaf young people in livelihoods training and information sharing, increasing visibility and value of deaf people in the society.

title: HELP  KENYA WIDOWS RISE OUT OF POVERTY
description: Provide capital for 500 small-grocery businesses for the poor, marginalized and vulnerable widows who have no access to income in the achievement of  Zero Hunger and No Poverty. To provide  food stuff for 1000  widows to cushion the effects of Covid-19 in Kenya.

title: Gift of mobility to 250 persons with disabilities
description: Inaccessible public transportation restricts the ability of persons with disabilities to access educational and economic opportunities, which keep them in the vicious circle of poverty. Each year, we intend to impact the lives of 250 persons with disabilities through skills-based training and job placement. We need your assistance in bringing these trainees to our campus through a dedicated transport service. Help us so no person with a disability stops dreaming for a better future.

title: HELP DEAF & DUMB CHILDREN IN INDIA
description: ISKCON with help of the UMEED Foundation is helping deaf children have a fulfilling and meaningful childhood and a bright future ahead. Our 'Anubhuti Center for Deaf' in Bangalore, India connects with deaf & dumb children, organizes retreats & food for them, provides computer education to make them TechWizs for a better-abled future. We also train them in communication techniques, which helps them to safeguard themselves from being exploited or abused. We also provide hearing aids to the needy.

title: Friends of The Brilho
description: Sponsor the education of a child in rural Brazil during the pandemic.  A small but regular monthly donation will secure places for over 100 children to access online lessons while their physical school is closed with a curriculum focus on everyday climate action, environmental science, permaculture, preserving local culture and sustainability. Be one of 100 monthly donors to sponsor this special community school and keep it alive during this crisis.

title: Bringing clean water and so much more to Markala
description: This project will sustainably transform the Markala community of 840 men, women and children through access to safe, clean water and the provision of skills to earn needed money, grow needed food and practice good public health. Ultimately, HOPE helps them to help themselves out of poverty and at this time enables them to protect themselves against COVID-19 and their other current challenges, eg. great global uncertainty, political conflict, regional locust swarms and deadly local landslides.

title: Healthy lives for children with cleft in Ecuador
description: Our volunteer team will be in Ecuador in March 2023 to provide free care for patients living with the tremendous burden of untreated cleft including social stigma, poor health, malnutrition, & poverty. Cleft surgery is the first step for our patients to have healthy lives & access education, employment, & financial stability. Funds will help provide medicines, surgical care, & COVID-19 testing for 5 of the 50 patients scheduled for the trip. Every dollar donated will make a difference!

title: Crafts & Enterprise Training Center
description: The Enterprise & Training Center (ETC) houses an assortment of initiatives, projects, and centers to empower Yezidis, with a focus on Yezidi women. Through activities, trainings, and enterprise opportunities, participants have the chance to develop tools, improve their economic prospects, collect relevant information, and begin earning income. This innovative livelihoods campus is designed to provide targeted, useful education and skills training for Yezidis, especially women.

title: Provide fruit trees to 300 rural farmers in Haiti
description: Asosyasyon Peyizan Fondwa Haiti (APF) -- a proven successful peasant association in rural Haiti with 30+ years of experience -- is continuing reforestation and economic empowerment efforts in the mountains of Fondwa Haiti. APF will distribute 3,000 fruit trees to 300 farming families in the region, providing both reforestation and economic activity for recipient families.

title: Covid: Feed 145 families living in Bangalore slums
description: Ashwini Charitable Trust is continuing efforts since March 2020 to ensure that none of our student's families go hungry due to job insecurity in the time of a global pandemic and periodic lockdowns. The low income slum dwellers in urban Bangalore are hardest hit. The senior students of the Trust are key in ensuring fair distribution of food provisions amoung the community. Each kit contains: Rice, Toor, Sugar, Atta, Sooji, Chilli Powder, Dhaniya Powder, Tamarind, Oil, Jeera, Turmeric, Salt.

title: Keep Families Fresh: Hope & Hygiene Kits
description: Living in poverty is about more than needing to afford food and shelter. In fact, often times, those struggling with extremely limited budgets have previously made the decision to sacrifice their hygiene health to instead afford food or shelter. This fundraiser changes that, providing hope and hygiene kits to families in need.

title: Bakery Training Center
description: At the Bakery Training Center Yezidi women each year learn the basic skills of working in a bakery, while earning a basic wage. In addition, trainees receive basic business and mathematics classes to boost their skill sets and aid in their employment searches in the future. Regardless of the industry in which they choose to work, each trainee leaves the Bakery Training Center with the experience and confidence to participate as empowered economic actors. FYF seeks funding to support this effort.

title: Miles with Smiles: Donate for a School Bus
description: Miles With Smiles aims to  provide a school bus for children with special needs who travel long distances between their homes and our non-profit educational and rehabilitation center located in Qana, South Lebanon "Al Bassma Center". The project will enable these children to reach the center safely, take the burden of transportation from the shoulders of their disadvantaged parents, and allow children to enjoy their right to education.

title: Enable Vulnerable Children in Nairobi to Thrive
description: Every child, if given the right support, will thrive and achieve their dreams. Unfortunately vulnerable children do not get enough support and care that they need. Many times, they are exposed to traumatic experiences that affect their lives. This project equips  vulnerable children between ages of 8 and 13 years  in 3 slums of Nairobi with life skills through fun age-appropriate holistic health interventions that will enable them to cope with trauma and be able to face life challenges.

title: "Give the Gift of Life" Water to Schools in Gaza
description: Only about 25% of Gazans have access to water in their homes for up to 7 hours a day, 65% get it for 7 hours every two days, and 10% every three days. Gaza's unsafe drinking water rate rose from 90% in 2012 to 97% in 2019. Poor families have the choice of drinking tap water or purchase safe and drinking water. This project will provide and maintain a purification and desalination unit that is independent of municipal water and electricity and will target schools with a minimum of 2500 students.

title: Independent Living Program
description: The Cedar Foundation Program for independent living is designed to support youths who have reached the age of 18 and have to leave our family centers. The program includes group and individual training and consultation sessions on subjects such as budget management, strength recognition, problem solving, self-advocacy etc. It provides financial aid to cover housing expenses, utility bills and qualification courses as well as psychological support for career choice or emotional issues.

title: Feed, House & Educate Colombia's Most Vulnerable
description: We believe that everyone in Colombia, regardless of their race, gender, or religious affiliation has the right to feel healthy, educated, and safe. An individual's physical & psychological health are critical to their ability to grow economically. Consequently, we aim to help residents in some of Colombia's most vulnerable neighbourhoods to improve their basic nutrition, sanitation, hygiene & education (including sexual).

title: Empower Flood Affected Victims Families in Nepal
description: Heavy rain since 15 June has caused flooding and landslides in many parts of Nepal.About 7 districts mainly hills are more affected where more than 2000 people have been displaced and some are still missing.The death toll recorded till date are 7.Still the monsoon is continuing and remain few days.The displaced people stay in school and tent who urgently need foods,medicine,temporory latrine,sanitation,water,tents  and temporory houses.Rescue process is continuing by government but not enough.

title: Build a Standard Health Center for the Poor in UG
description: This project will build a standard health center in Lwannume, Uganda. Providing basic health care services to the less privileged, esp. women and children. Due to extreme poverty, high illiteracy levels, poor road networks and social stigma, accessing rural health care services remains a mystery that calls for more work. This community and nearby villages lack a standard health care facility. As a result, residents continue to suffer and die from diseases that are easy to prevent and cure

title: Helping Children at risk to make dreams come true
description: In Mexico PACO, I.A.P, works with children and adolescents in situations of social abandonment. Through our comprehensive care model, we seek to restore their human rights, through quality services that impact the physical, emotional and social well-being of our users. Our home program offers medical and emotional care, formal and informal education, training workshops in blacksmithing, bakery and carpentry, to equip children with tools that allow them to improve their living conditions.

title: Art for Peace & Human Rights
description: GRACE Cares' B4 Peace Project/Namaya Production by Namaya the poet, artist, & Veteran uses art, word, performance to engage communities in peacebuilding and reconciliation. A key component of the Pornography of War "Agent Orange: Do Not Forget Me" is to increase knowledge and action regarding the ongoing damage caused by the chemical defoliant used by the US military during the Vietnam War. As we approach the 50th anniversary of the end of the Vietnam War we want to promote healing.

title: Support poor families left homeless by flash flood
description: The winter wave started in Colombia. Torrential rains and flash floods have hit families living in informal settlements in Bogota and Soacha extremely hard, in two areas with a history of acute poverty. At TECHO we want to provide food kits to those affected and emergency housing especially to low-income families and women. As an NGO, we have been working in these territories for more than 10 years to ensure that the kits and housing allocation are for the people who need them most.

title: COVID-19 STREET DOGS & ANIMALS WELFARE FUND -INDIA
description: The Padagam and nearby villages in Tamilnadu have 1000 +above Street Dogs roam its streets. They roam neighborhoods seeking food, water, and shelter.  They fight over the limited amounts of food available and suffer from painful diseases, While humans harm them. So first of all, we give food and health care to them. Next, we try to set up a dedicated Animals Habitat to rescue the animals suffering from significant health issues & human-inflicted abuse.  Again, efforts from all sides in and out,

title: JUCONI environments: safe spaces for children
description: This project will be developed in the localities of Atzala, Chietla, Santa Cruz Cuautomatitla and San Antonio Alpanocan, which are located in the southwest region of the state of Puebla and which present great challenges in terms of violence and poverty, as well as problems associated with migration.In addition, the project's cross-cutting themes include addressing climate change from a vision of sustainability and community food security.

title: Create Vital Workspace & Jobs for Women in Ghana
description: Global Mamas works together to create a life of prosperity for women and their families in Ghana. Global Mamas is in the process of constructing and will soon operate Ghana's first Fair Trade Zone (FTZ) - an eco-friendly, centralized, people-first, production facility that will create 85 new jobs for skilled craftswomen in Ghana's Eastern Region. After several years, the walls of the first building have been erected. We invite you to help us bring the building to life - from the inside and out.

title: Support to Children of Prisoners in Tanzania
description: The project will focus on assisting children of prisoners in two regions of Tanzania, Arusha and Kilimanjaro. The parents of these children have been imprisoned for various offenses including rape and others. According to Tanzanian law, a person having an affair with a child under the age of eighteen is considered as rape and may be sencences to 30 years in prison. When he is taken to court and convicted, the law does not say anything about the wellbeing and  upbringing of unborn child

title: SUPPORT HUNGER RELIEF AT COVID-19
description: This past year 1 in 4 households have become food insecure - including children. Covid-19 has definitely changed the way Rescuing Leftover Cuisine operates, but not a single week in 2020 has passed without food being rescued across the nation. On the contrary, we have provided over 1,224 meals every single week since August. As we prepare for the winter and a potential second wave of Covid-19, our mission is more important than ever before. Solve food waste and hunger one plate at a time!

title: Access to education for underprivileged students
description: The project will directly support brilliant but underprivileged students by paying school fees and providing necessary educational supplies and allowing them to receive tutoring in mathematics outside of the classroom. It will also improve the learning environment by providing classrooms with necessary supplies teachers need to be more effective at their work.

title: Empowering Women's to Sustainable Livelihood
description: Under this project, 500 poor Women will be connected with banks by Self Help Group, who are living poverty. Here training would be provided in the area of capacity building, life skills, EDP, Orientation, goat farming, organic manure, dairy, etc, for increasing their self-confidence level, livelihood growth and empowerment in Barguna District.

title: SACRIFICE THE BLESSINGS OF RAMADAN WITH THE NEEDY
description: It is tradition to open your Ramadan fast with a date. We appeal to you to donate dates (khajoor) for orphans in Bangladesh to open their fasts.

title: SUPPORT 197 CHILDREN WITH CANCER IN COLOMBIA
description: This project will give psychological, social, and economic support as well as occupational therapy to 197 Colombian children with cancer and their families. SANAR NINOS CON CANCER Foundation will also solve access barriers to health services and create adherence to treatment by providing tools to better understand and manage the disease.

title: SURVIVAL IN LIFE DUE TO COVID
description: Project will support for the family and migrant who lost thier work because covid panademic and struglling for survival in life near and around the land of Buddha because of lost the work and difficult to feed their family specially for the family whose children are attending in the school and the migrant who return after lost their work because of covid panademic and lockdown. Its became risky for the children who may dropout in the school because of family circumstances.

title: Fund Training Programs in Singapore
description: Social Health Growth is a charity and IPC social service agency in Singapore. Our beneficiaries include low income families and single mothers. We are raising funds for our various programs, which include Financial Literacy, Woman Empowerment Leadership Management, and Computer Literacy (SDGs 5 and 8). These training programs will enable our beneficiaries to upskill themselves and better their situations.

title: Change Makers Training Program
description: In Peru, growing up in a dangerous neighborhood represents a series of challenges that place young people in situations of social risk. There are few programs that address mental health and provide opportunities for development. With the Change Makers Training Program, we try to accompany the growth of young people in the project, developing skills, improving their level of well-being and creating a support network that benefits them and their community.

title: Provide Workshops to Empower 90 Women in Argentina
description: The Workshops will train 90 underprivileged women in Argentina to gain hard and soft skills that can be used to break the cycle of poverty in their families, and to become leaders of their own lives.

title: Fulfil vision for multipurpose street kids centre
description: This project will provide the funds to purchase a site which will become a multipurpose support centre for vulnerable children&families at risk of breakdown -a safe place for street children to eat, access clean water, play & be listened to; family& community support for families on the edge; life skills training for former street children as well as parents of children without an income. Providing families with an income could be the key to preventing their children ending up on the streets.

title: Community health in Chiapas: water and first aid
description: Health, as a part of the integral development of a community,  includes many aspects. Water quality for disease prevention and community first aid education are solid tools that open the possibility for a resilient community to build their own healthy path, to have more options and more choices on how to face unexpected accidents. Aguacero Tecnologia y Salud Comunitaria would like offer this tools of resilience in Chiapas rural and indigenous communities, are you in?

title: Give disabled girls in Nepal a family home
description: This project will create a family home for two disabled girls that reside in institutions at present.  The mother of one of the girls works long hours as a cleaner to pay the fees and has another daughter to care for as well.  The other disabled girl has Cerebral Palsy and requires hire care  Covid-19 has increased the risks associated with institutional care and has prompted this wonderful project. We will create a family home and pay 'mum' to care for girls full-time.

title: Solar panels for families in Syria
description: Help us provide solar panels to 100 Syrian families! 2/3 hours of electricity a day. Public electricity is enough for 4 lightbulbs, or 1 lightbulb and a fridge, to work for, just two hours. Then lights turn off in Syria and those who cannot afford fuel for power generators live in the dark. Pro Terra Sancta has already assisted around 1.000 families providing the minimum amount of energy to survive. The solar panel project is a new sustainable long term solution.

title: Help Give Siti The Macaque A Better Life
description: Siti, a lone young Moor macaque rescued from the illegal pet trade in Malaysia urgently needs to be transported back to her native home in Indonesia. Moor Macaques are endemic to the island of Sulawesi and are now sadly endangered. Macaques are a very social species and she desperately needs to be with others of her own kind. A new home has been found for her there with other macaques at a specialist primate sanctuary. Please help us return her home and help conserve this endangered species.

title: CEF Food Pantry & Delivery Program
description: CEF's Food Pantry & Delivery Program provides free groceries to people who are currently homeless or housing insecure in Durham, NC. The 1,320 Members served by CEF's Durham office have access to the program. Members can pick up food of their choosing in person or request for it to be delivered to a location of their choice.

title: Provide a Gift of Hope for Abatex, Philippines
description: Maybe you are asking, "Is there something I can do?", looking around we saw how the pandemic affected the lives of many Filipinos. The need for food access and water sustainability has become a challenge to the Abatex community. Our goal is to provide nourishing foods for the children, proper education about livelihood, health, and nutrition, and bestow clean drinking water. You can do something whether you are from a different part of the globe, you can still impart in the life of our children.

title: ECADE's 5th Anniversary Fundraiser
description: ECADE is working hard to create a better life for LGBTQ+ people. Will you help us make a change and create history?

title: Strengthen 60 Women Farmers in El Salvador
description: This project will help provide food security to women farmers and their families in rural El Salvador. Women traditionally have less access to land and resources than men and women-led households are more vulnerable to food insecurity. These families, especially hard-hit by the pandemic and climate change, will benefit from this project through access to farming materials and training. As a result these women will have the resources and knowledge to feed their families and face future disasters.

title: SECURING OUR SUSTAINABILITY WITH A TRUCK
description: This project is proposing to purchase a truck. The proposed truck will be used to carry out activities of the farming and water life projects such as water tank and toilet construction The truck will help reduce delays that have been encountered while carrying out these actives and it will also be an addition to the transportation options AHCM has. Another Hope Children's Ministries is a registered entity, no individual will benefit from the Ministry's assets other than the Ministry itself.

title: Help Colombia Ride2Learn: bikes for Guajira youth
description: In the Guajira region of Colombia, there is a need for sustainable transport to get children to school and home safely when buses or private cars aren't available. Help Colombia is working with local leaders to organize the purchase and distribution of bicycles for students at the Centro Etnoeducativo integral Jacobo Arends Gouriyu, which is the only high school available to kids in the region. Your support will allow Help Colombia to ensure no students are left behind for lack of transport.

title: Computer Tablets for Kids in Jamaica
description: P.A.C.E. is seeking funding to acquirer at least 10 tablets for students at each of the 250 kindergarten schools supported across the island.  This will allow the 5-6 year old students to use the device at home and have access to their lessons and learning software.  The proposed OneTab device comes with built in applications for math, reading and writing without the need for any internet or online access.  Refer: www.onebillion.org for details about the device.

title: Education for Refugee Children in Uganda
description: Education is vital for helping children develop healthily to become productive members of society. However, refugee children are 5 times less likely to attend school than their counterparts. This project aims at providing all Primary school education's requirements  to refugee children from 7 years old and above who are not currently attending schools within the Kyaka II refugee settlement.

title: Gift Laptops to Sphoorti Undergraduate Students
description: This project seeks to provide digital devices - a mobile phone and a laptop to 40 orphan and destitute students who are pursuing Undergrad Degree in various Colleges.  These students require Mobiles and Laptops for their assignments and coursework. Because they are either orphaned or destitute, they need your support to procure digital devices.

title: VAP Youth Empowerment Centre
description: VAP is seeking support to construct a youth-friendly centre on recently purchased land in Nairobi which will provide training, safe space, clinical services, and psycho-social support to young people when they need it most.
