In addition to football pitches, the VAP Youth Empowerment Centre will have a library, gender-based violence recovery centre, volunteer accommodation, and vocational training centre. The centre will be a social enterprise, bringing in revenue for sustainability.

title: Stop The Killing of Dogs & Cats in Japan
description: Each year tens of thousands of stray pets are killed in Japan. Through its "Peace Wanco," or "Peace Doggy" project, Peace Winds Japan is striving to halt this practice by rescuing cats and dogs, retraining them and finding them new homes. Since starting the project, we have saved more than 6,000 animals that otherwise would have been euthanized. Please support our ongoing efforts to eradicate pet euthanasia, establish pet adoption centers and broaden our awareness-raising activities.

title: Inclusive secondary education support
description: Inclusive secondary education support for all the poor/orphans and vulnerable children with disability, and adolescent girls in targeted communities of Chipangali District.  Education is central to all and especially to women in the fight against poverty and discrimination. However access to education by the girl child and children with disabilities in Chipangali district is low. This is because of several reasons. The first cause is poverty itself.

title: Training  C.I.C. and bowel management Spina Bifida
description: Children with Spina Bifida have no sensitivity from the bottom down. Sensation and voluntary emptying of the intestine and bladder are not always possible causing urine to "back up" into the kidneys which can cause permanent damage over time to the kidneys or incontinence. Children may have frequent urinary tract infections and pressure sores. The goal of the project is to train nurses/physiotherapists, mothers and children with SB on Clean Intermittent Catheterization CIC and bowel management.

title: Be The light! To Empower and Educate, A New Campus
description: The concept of light-truth, empowerment, education, teaching life skills through classes for women and Mexican youth has guided HHWT since our beginnings 14 years ago. Each year HHWT sets out to create a learning environment for our students that prepares them to lead-to be the light. To accomplish this tall task, we renewed our strategic plan to enhance the student experience with an improved campus.

title: Provide School Supplies to 3,050 Students
description: This project will provide 3,050 underprivileged students in the rural villages of Sierra Leone with all necessary school supplies and a uniform for the upcoming school year.

title: Support Animal Balance and Help Save Lives
description: Despite the pandemic, we we've been able to accomplish a LOT this past year. However, many communities have fallen behind on their spay / neuter goals and we're ready to double our efforts to lend a hand. We need your support to continue this vital work.

title: Emergency Medical Expenses
description: BonZeb's agronomist Myriel FanFan is facing some unexpected medical bills. After visiting the dentist he was told he'd need four teeth replaced. The bill totals over a thousand dollars, an amount that would stress out most Americans, and would be impossible for many Haitians. At the same time, BonZeb board member Jovenel Dubois is back in Miami to treat a recurring back injury after surgery a few years back.  We are trying to raise $7500 to help defray these medical bills and help our team get b

title: Not For Sale: Rescuing Victims of HumanTrafficking
description: Since 2011, Rescue Foundation has rescued over 700 women and children from Traffickers in the North India region. Our New Shelter home aims to support rescued women and children with holistic services to help them recover and renter society. We have the capacity to provide Care, Protection & Support to over 100 girls.

title: Provide Medical Services to Palestine's Poor
description: Chronic treatment fails to reach the poor in Palestine. Gift of the Givers Healthcare project in Palestine will continue to provide essential medical services to Palestinians who, through poverty, do not have access to suitable treatment. Patients will receive subsidized, life-saving treatment at private facilities as the public healthcare sector is under-resourced and under-staffed due to the unrest and economic crisis.

title: Improve literacy and IT skills for young Zambians
description: This project will build a library and e-learning centre for vulnerable children at Siansowa Primary School along the shores of Lake Kariba, in rural Zambia. The centre will provide over 700 children with a new library that will house a rich supply of books, provide access to computers and a safe space for the children to study after school. Over 400 of the children at the school are girls, which is critical when female literacy rates in Zambia currently stand at less than 60%.

title: Resilience for 1000Left-behind kids in Rural China
description: China's 6.97 million left-behind children confront, lack of parental support and inadequate access to mental health education. In response, Shining Star implements a resilience curriculum which aims to enhance rural children's interpersonal competencies, sense of belonging, and optimism. By 2020, the organization has provided the resilience camp for four schools, from which children have improved their resilience capacity from 62.29% to 86.49%. For 1000 kids, we need your help!

title: EID AL-ADHA
description: From attacks on Gaza to home demolitions in Jerusalem, and to the dire economic conditions in the West Bank, Israel has subjugated Palestinians to extreme violence over the past two months. As we recover from Israel's latest assault we're also facing economic uncertainty. Since the start of the pandemic, families who live off a daily wage have been unable to afford the basics. We aim to support these families financially and distribute food, meat and gifts to them this Eid.

title: A.R. Educational Programme
description: On 25th June 2021 we remembered our beloved founder Fr.A.R. Rajamoney  on his 86th Birth Anniversary.... in his memory we have launched the project A.R. Educational Programme for the vulnerable children. A.R stands for AMOS RAJAMONEY.... He loved children and he always helped the vulnerable children with free education and said education is the wealth of the poor. In his memory we have started this project to support 50 orphan/ semi- orphan/ vulnerable children with educational support .

title: Providing COVID Relief for Farmers in Rural India
description: COVID-19, high unemployment, and a crumbling public health system are combining to devastate rural communities in Bihar, India. Nalanda district faces a dire shortage of basic medicines, equipment, trained healthcare workers, food and work opportunities.  FORRAD, our NGO partner in India, has been distributing food rations, basic medicines and equipment in Nalanda. But after weeks of COVID relief, FORRAD recognizes that what is most urgently needed is paid employment in the local area.

title: Socio-aesthetics for sick children
description: Cancer treatment is very intense and the child then experiences the painful body or its alteration (skin alteration, hair and eyebrow loss, weight...). For several years, we offers weekly therapeutic support workshop sessions to children in Mother-Child poles at the hospital.  It brings them relief, enhance self-esteem, facilitate family relations & many other psychological/physical positive effects. In a few years, the services have seen an increase in the number of children welcomed.

title: Containers of Love to Displaced Women & Children
description: This project supports the shipment and distribution of humanitarian aid containers to thousands of women and children living through humanitarian crises.

title: Give a Girl a Chance: Help Educate Tanzanian Girls
description: This is the story of so many girls Lyra works with: I am a Tanzanian rural girl. The chances of completing my education are small. Just 1% of us who start primary school will complete our education. The school is far from my village, & I must walk to school, facing sexual harassment along the way. Some of us stay in a room in the village close to school, but these rooms are not safe. Many of us share a room, and girls exchange sex for rent. 1 in 4 of my teenage friends will become pregnant.

title: Giving Hope to the Needy in Lebanon
description: A Fire Breaks in a Syrian Refugee Camp Within the Qub Elias Area in Bekaa  On the morning of August 4th, 2021, a massive fire swept through Camp 004, one of Qub Elias' Syrian refugee camps, opposite the Caesar field in Bekaa, Lebanon. Civil defense teams extinguished the fire after it had fully burned 25 tents in IS004 camp and 1 tent in IS005 camp, in addition to causing partial damage to 4 tents in IS008.

title: Educate 300 children of the Himalayas in Nepal
description: The children living on the lap of Himalayas are willing to receive quality education but due to the geographical remoteness, lack of infrastructure and absence of qualified teachers, they have been denied of the fundamental necessities. Through CREASION, Karnali Education Mission looks forward to creating a self-sustainable and inclusive educational system in Dolpa by uplifting and empowering children with and without disabilities, youth as well as women of the community.

title: Breaking poverty cycle of 150 students in Turkana
description: The project plans to support needy high school students from poor families in Turkana County-Kenya who are unable to meet their school fees demands & other school requirements to enable them receive full education. This is significant because education act as a catalyst for societies to pull out of the vicious cycle of poverty by improving individual employability and entrepreneurial innovativeness; that helps to positively transform their poor backgrounds and build a prosperous future society.

title: Home for the homeless women in Nigeria
description: For the past two years several women in the northern part of Nigeria have been subjected to banditry, kidnapping and raping.  Many girls were kidnapped  from schools and taking the forest by the kidnappers.  As a result of this ugly situation, the girls were force into pregnancy and abandon.  Many of them has to flee for their lives from the forest and from the northern part to the southern part of the country.  The project is to give them good homes and skill acquisition and rehabilitation

title: Saving the last Black Oak forests in Colombia
description: The Black Oak (Trigonobalanus excelsa) is a species that is on the IUCN red list, in danger of extinction (EN). Its forests are highly fragmented by deforestation and one of its last remnants is in the Alto Rio Fonce micro-region south of Santander, Colombia. We, the peasant communities of the area, have decided to protect these forests through voluntary conservation agreements, Participatory Community Monitoring (MCP) and environmental education for rural and urban children and youth.

title: Help Amazonian Community protect their native bees
description: Amazonian communities are at risk as unsustainable activities are invading their land... It's urgent to support their regenerative activities - as they support our global climate!  With the correct support and partnership, they can be key to protect the world's most biodiverse region!  Native stingless bees can be the perfect partner! They support pollination, food sovereignty and traditional communities' culture.

title: Quality Early Childhood Education
description: The project will support the Municipality of Dibra to develop a quality and healthy educational environment. The project will improve the conditions of Dobrova kindergarten in Dibra Municipality and will contribute to an inclusive and quality education.

title: The Phuleli Community Health Center
description: The establishment of the Phuleli Community Health Center will provide much needed free healthcare services to several villages in the southern Solukhumbhu region of Nepal. Phase 1 construction of the facility is now complete, and this campaign will support the Phase 2 implementation, including the purchasing of equipment/supplies, staffing, facility management, and delivery of services. Our goal is to bring affordable quality healthcare to multiple rural villages in Nepal.

title: Johanna Omolo Foundation
description: To support the underprivileged children and young people in Dandora, create a critical mass of young, talented, educated youth who can transform their lives, their families, their community, their country and the WORLD.

title: Corona Epidemic Emergency Response Project
description: The Corona epidemic has added new suffering to the Yemeni people, who have been suffering from the scourge of war for six years, and with the severe weakness of the infrastructure in Yemen and the poor medical services, the epidemic is spreading among Yemeni society rapidly, as the daily statistics which are in fact inaccurate due to the limet of PCR tests, so people face the epidemic without assistance.  This project aims to provide aid and assistance to poor families to confront the spread of

title: Empowering 300 Women/Youth in South Sudan
description: The Hope Society (HS) aims to train talented youth and women to enable them advocate for peace in the society and also make their voices heard. The training will provide the beneficiaries needed skills and materials. The project will be implemented in three (3) locations which are Juba, Wau and Malakal respectively. In order to equip 150 youth and 150 women in these areas with materials and skills.

title: Emergency Assistance for the locals of Myanmar
description: More than four months after the political upheaval in Myanmar, the UN agencies have warned of its impact to the country`s economy, extreme poverty, food security and malnutrition. The double punch threats of political turmoil and unsolved corona pandemic have a great effect on people`s lives. In rural areas where we operate since 1996, the deteriorating agricultural supply chain is affecting the villagers` way of living.

title: Provide Emergency HEALTH Facility (Maternity Care)
description: SHARE NGO established build an emergency health facility's to care for the poor rural mother's have a safe place to give birth. The facility was started majorly to provide antenatal care and postnatal healthcare, including prenatal assessments, birth assistance, and supplementation from pregnancy until the postpartum period to help them get safe birth control. The pregnant woman is checked and treated for any conditions which may harm her pregnancy, such as Malaria, Anaemia, HIV/AIDS, STDs.

title: Help 25 US Schools Start Strong and Inspire Girls!
description: Inspiring Girls USA is an organization dedicated to raising the aspirations of girls by connecting them with women role models. We introduce girls to the full variety of careers and options and inspire them to aim high! After these challenging years of missed milestones, supporting schools in connecting with amazing women role models is the best way to help. By donating, you are helping us connect schools with free resources and role models across the country to empower more girls!

title: Urgent Action to curb COVID to people and gorillas
description: COVID-19 continues to pose a major threat to people and endangered mountain gorillas in Bwindi, Uganda. Limited awareness and poor access to healthcare compound risk. Transmission of COVID-19 to the closely related mountain gorillas would be catastrophic for the species. We must protect both people and gorillas by urgently supporting 59 Village COVID-19 Taskforce committees to continue conducting home-based care, community surveillance and prevention awareness and continuing to test gorillas.

title: Re-enroll 50 girls in school after childbirth
description: Our mission is to support the re-enrollment of adolescent mothers to school, facilitating their access to safe learning during and after COVID19.  HACI through its back to learning campaigns will raise awareness about the re-entry program and advocate for the identification of girls who as a result of the pandemic become pregnant and are unable to continue with normal studies due to increased vulnerability to stigmatization, poverty and exclusion associated with their new status

title: PINK Skills & Training Center
description: In Pakistan, a root cause of the socio-economic problems that transgender women face is their exclusion from public economic platforms. In response, the PINK Skills & Training Center provides training, capacity building, micro-financing, mentoring, and resource mobilization for trans women to use entrepreneurship as a tool of socio-economic empowerment. We aim to support trans entrepreneurs as they maintain their businesses, become independent, and make informed decisions about their lives.

title: LETS GIVE THEM THE DIGNITY THEY DESERVE
description: We have seen a sharp increase in people living in the street as a consequence of the economic crisis and the ongoing pandemic. We need your help so we can continue providing life saving solutions to the people living on the street in towns throughout Chile. We aim to make every corner of Chile a decent place for EVERYONE.

title: Bringing Virtual Reality to hospitalized children
description: Reach For A Dream is thrilled to announce the launch and introduction of virtual reality dream experiences. Through virtual reality the boundaries are bridged and children in isolation will be able to immerse themselves in a world that allows for escapism, creativity and freedom. The idea is not to replace the actual dream, but to make otherwise impossible dream experiences come true with the power of VR, ultimately enabling children the ability to dream.

title: Saving lives; with organ & tissue transplantation
description: This project will build and run (facilitate the development and implementation of) an operational support centre designed as first point of contact to coordinate and communicate the availability of organs and or tissue for donation in South Africa.

title: Amplify Her Voice Project
description: The Amplify Her Voice Project seeks to respond to the specific issues and needs that women and girls are facing as a result of COVID-19 lockdown measures. The project is uniquely implemented through community-based, small dialogue circles covering key concerns for women and girls, using setting up a 24/7 toll-free line for GBV victims and tele-counseling services. This project ensures to reach women and girls in our community with much-needed pandemic interventions and protection.

title: COVID-19 Emergency Response Project
description: The effects of COVID-19 epidemic to the people of Uganda, the majority leaving in abject poverty, with the severe weakness of the health infrastructure and the poor medical services, the epidemic is spreading among in Uganda rapidly,  due to the limited PCR tests, with a government lacking adequate resources to provide relief assistance to its people. This project aims to provide aid and assistance to poor families to confront the spread of the pandemic.

title: Give Disabled Romanian Orphans their 1st Playspace
description: Imagine growing up spending most days in a tiny living room with other children and shifts of caregivers.For hours you sit on a rug, watch tv or circle the room. Shelves hold stuffed animals and toys but what you want and need is a safe place for exercise where you can express yourself through art, music and games.Your brain craves stimulation but there is none. So you self-stimulate, rocking your body back and forth. But what if you had a play space for exercise, painting, dance, and more?

title: Empower WestNile's vulnerable poor respond 2 COVID
description: West Nile-Uganda having 76% of the rural population living below one dollar per day is struggling to respond to health and livelihood challenges imposed by COVID-19. Seed money of atleast $31,080 is urgently required to develop a community health insurance scheme dubbed "chicken for health". The scheme will link improved livelihood of members though rearing of chicken to community economic empowerment to facilitate enrollment and strategically purchase of health services in response to COVID.

title: Protect 500 Cleft Kids from Covid-19
description: Covid 19 is affecting communities across the globe. The pandemic has put enormous strain on vulnerable communities. For around one million kids with Cleft in India, this is a highly challenging time. Born with a condition that affects nutrition, they are very susceptible to infections. The pandemic has reduced family income for the families, which means lower food for these babies who need special care. This project addresses the core issue, i.e. NUTRITION FOR THESE KIDS WHO NEED SPECIAL CARE

title: Books for Lebanon
description: Books for Lebanon promotes childhood literacy and addresses the economic crisis that is currently crippling Lebanon. Given the spike in inflation, buying textbooks and stationery can be a huge burden on families across Lebanon. Thus, the project aims at providing equal access to quality education for students in Lebanon through distributing free textbooks and literacy resources before the start of the academic year 2021-2022.

title: 2021 Heavy Rain Disaster Assistance - Japan
description: In 2021, heavy rains have caused enormous damage throughout Japan, most recently from Kyushu to the Tokai regions, including Saga City where Civic Force's branch office is located.  Civic Force is conducting needs assessments and working with partner municipalities, organizations, and businesses to provide emergency relief assistance. Civic Force has already provided emergency supplies such as hand sanitizers, towels, food and drink, etc. to evacuation centers.

title: Women's Healthcare Initiative La Ceiba, Nicaragua
description: This project provides access to obstetric and gynecological care for over 400 women living in the rural community of La Ceiba, Nicaragua. Health Outreach for Latin America currently employs two local OBGYNs to work at clinics in similar locations and has worked with the Nicaraguan Ministry of Health (MINSA) to expand into this third location. The rural nature of La Ceiba leaves many women isolated from key health care services and has been designated by MINSA has a definite area of need.

title: Rural Medical and Surgical Eye  Health Outreach
description: Long before the outbreak of Ebola and the COVID-19 pandemic, access to eye health care in Liberia was difficult and nearly impossible for rural community dwellers. As a result of this, New Sight Eye Center is proposing a comprehensive rural community eye health care in rural Liberia, focusing on   ten communities and targeting ten thousand beneficiaries in Margibi County.

title: Promote Theatre & Performance to Youths in Africa
description: Our project is in the heart of a black township and provides opportunities to the youths to explore their creative side. From poetry, film writing, dancing and performance. Our inspired community leaders are providing a safe space for young creative people, often for the first time, to join forces with others to explore their passion for performing arts. This project helps keep young people off the streets and provides them with an escape from poverty and depression.

title: Re-enforcing COVID-19 risk communication in Uganda
description: The project will design & disseminate easy to understand integrated health response 3-5 minute short videos for face-face/on-line learning, social/broadcast media to facilitate risk mitigation, prevention, psychosocial support & tele-therapy. To address information crisis, our community engagement initiative focus on women, caregivers, frontline health care providers & elderly  not reached with information thru door-door visits, home-care, mobile van, & outreaches to reach maximum risk target.

title: Angaza Education Grants
description: Angaza (Swahili for light up) intervenes at pivotal and potentially catalytic transition periods for girls and young women. The program awards comprehensive multi-year high school education grants to girls from underserved and under-resourced backgrounds through Angaza's recent primary school and high school graduates access networks and platforms, giving them a competitive edge to acquire both high school and post-high school education grants as well as personal development opportunities.

title: A new Van to deliver freshly made food to 1000
description: This van will be used daily by our local grassroots team "foodKIND" to transport a combination of freshly cooked hot food, dry food packs and specially prepared nutritious mother's packs, to refugees living in the Malakasa and Oinofyta Refugee Camps, as well as families in nearby Athens. The foodKIND volunteers are often providing the only meal of the day for up to 1000 very vulnerable people living in poverty and they cannot do it without a reliable van.

title: Solar System for Children's Home in Nepal
description: Started by a 19 year old girl from New Jersey, our mission is to change the world by empowering Nepal's youth, and we work towards a day where every child is safe, educated and loved. The Kopila Valley Children's Home https://blinknow.org/pages/childrens-home serves around 50 children. Help power the home by helping replace the damaged battery in the hybrid solar system. Not only does the system provide children with electricity, but helps develop a sustainable environment for Nepal.

title: Recover COVID crisis for Ethnic Race in Bangladesh
description: The project- RECOVER will recover COVID-19 crisis and disaster hazards, reduce vulnerability and reform livelihood and economic security of total 12000 COVID and disaster affected unemployed, extreme poor, ethnic and excluded people including 6532 poor fishermen, 4850 indigenous people, 495 excluded (Dalit) people and 128 LGBTI from 2000 targeted households in Uttar Sreepur and Dakshin Sreepur Unions, the remotest humanitarian settings of Tahirpur Upazila in Sunamganj District in  Bangladesh.

title: Empowering communities with Sustainable Livelihood
description: Under this project, 500 families from the poorest communities of Northern Potosi, Bolivia will be empowered thanks to local experts.   Here, training will be provided in the field of capacity building, micro-enterprise creation. In the last phase of our project, we aim at the economic growth of the families, the increase of their quality of life, their empowerment towards a self-sustainability of the practices acquired during the whole life of the project.  So that they become actors of change !

title: Keep Hope Alive for Single Black Mothers
description: Everyone deserves to access quality health, better education, and a good job but we all know the challenges that single black mothers face daily to take care of themselves and their children. Covid 19 has even made the situation worse. Keep Hope Alive seeks to provide relief and resources to 500 single black mothers in the Fox Valley area of Wisconsin.

title: Poverty reduction and women empowerment in Banglad
description: To generate alternative income generating activity for 75 targeted people, especially women.  Create skill livestock farmer through providing appropriate training with a view to poverty alleviation.  Creation of self-employment and sustainable development opportunities and facilitating women empowerment

title: Covid-19 Relief project
description: With the onset of the Covid-19 pandemic, our direct involvement in our core project is to continue with online support, and with ensuring economic hardship, we funded food supplies. While the students stay home and also their parents, we will provide vegetable seeds, organic fertilizer, and pesticides, plus training to vulnerable families in the rural area to start their garden at home.

title: Young Authors Award
description: Help Children's Literature Festival empower children across Pakistan, with advocacy and educational programs based on critically developed curricula as well as hands-on learning, expression, cultural enrichment and more. Your donation will help fund the annual Young Author Awards, a nationwide writing contest for children (age group: 8 - 18 years), currently in its second year, in both Urdu and English. The program creates a rare platform recognition, publication opportunities and mentorship.

title: Move 167 Rescued Animals to their New Home!
description: CIWY needs to leave Machia Sanctuary and move the rescued animals who live there and depend on us for daily care.  With your help, we will build new enclosures for them at our Jacj Cuisi Sanctuary.

title: Sponsor and Support Kenyan Students
description: Kenya Keys helps students unlock their potential through education that leads to marketable skills and gainful employment. Sponsors pay tuition for individual students, or contribute to the programs that provide basic, but vital support, so students can succeed at school. Such essential programs address food insecurity, feminine hygiene, and transportation, as well as emotional health. We provide service in the rural, sub-Saharan area of Southeast Kenya focused on subsistence farming families.

title: Assist Autistic Children in Israel
description: The Fund for the Keshatot Children was established in 2011 by parents of autistic children who studied at the Keshatot Center in order to assist autistic children in their schools. The fund seeks contributions for complementary para-medical treatments [which are not among the therapies and treatments provided by the Ministry of Education], therapeutic and technological equipment and infrastructure improvement.

title: Support toilets for school children in Nigeria
description: This project will build 12 toilets in Adani Enugu state in Nigeria, providing good hygienic learning environment for over 200 children, protecting them from contacting disease or infections and also providing sanitary equipment's for the  children to use.

title: Help more young people to finish their studies
description: Fundacion Accion Joven runs its annual fundraising campaign, this year called "I say present" which proposes to execute actions that promote student in public high schools in a vulnerable condition to continue studying, in the context of the impact of COVID-19; this in order to provide opportunities for young people to successfully complete their studies, as a strategy for social mobility and the achievement of personal goals.

title: Food support for elderly people in need in Russia
description: Since October 2016, the charity foundation "Dari edu!" provides food assistance to people in difficult life situations. You can buy products set or hot meals for people in need. We support families with disabled children, large families, single parents, orphans, elderly people, disabled and homeless people. This project help us to provide 10 000  elderly people with products set and hot meals every day during one month.

title: Financial Literacy and Self Worth for Sex Workers
description: Thailand is home to a rich culture of almost 70 million people, many of whom have the sole pressure to support parents, children, siblings and grandparents.  This pressure often forces women to work jobs in the sex industry they would not otherwise consider. Our desire is to see these women benefit from education and financial literacy training in order to transition to a life free from selling themselves and one full of self-worth.

title: EQUIP AND EMPOWER 200 GIRLS WITH CREATIVE SKILLS.
description: Fundamentally the program is geared towards orienting a growing young girls towards becoming a Contributing and Positive member of their community aligned to their life given abilities, interests and potential. To achieve this, it will aim at horning one's:  Character which is the bedrock of a successful and fulfilling life.   Competence to navigate life and develop a work ethic  Connections: people skills   Confidence to surmount life's challenges and  Compassion:  care about other people.

title: Empowering 300 underserved women in Cordoba
description: Las Omas is a non-profit that serves 300 women from vulnerable situations in Cordoba, Argentina. These women often lack formal education, have limited job opportunities, and often are victims of gender-based violence. The organization provides job training for these women in fields such as cosmetology, clothing production, and the food industry. Currently, Las Omas lacks a facility to carry out these activities, so this project involves constructing their own building.

title: Improve 3K community dog&cat feeding in Venezuela
description: The "Food Bank for companion animals" will contribute to improve the life of 3000 companion animals that are circumstantially in precarious conditions in 3 cities of Venezuela : Caracas, Cumana and Maracaibo   This translates into positively and substantially modifying the quality of life of the people, families and communities with whom they live, from the human-animal bond, whether are under direct protection or are community animals.

title: Help 2000 tribal families fight hunger, Rajasthan
description: The project will set up kitchen gardens for 2,040 extremely poor and vulnerable families in Rajasthan to help them keep hunger and malnutrition at bay during the pandemic. Women will be trained and empowered to manage these kitchen gardens. We have already trained 1,895 families with food security during the second deadly wave of the pandemic as it became clear that if Covid didn't kill them, hunger would. This concept has proved to be sustainable and has a high impact.

title: Provide 100 newborn babies' essentials in Nigeria
description: Since 2014, 128 babies have been born in one Internally Displaced Persons (IDP) camp in Abuja. The camp midwife uses polythene bags as gloves to deliver the babies. Pregnant women (including service men's wives and widows) have no access to medical centres and cannot afford their babies' essential needs due to poverty. Our goal is to provide mothers and their newborns with essential needs such as clothing and toiletries and medical supplies of gloves, first aid kits etc., for the first year.

title: Help Survivors of Landslide in Atami, Japan
description: This project will support the survivors of the landslide that occurred in the famous hot spring and tourist town of Atami on the Izu Peninsula, near Tokyo.  Landslide was caused by torrential rains that hit the area on July 3rd, but due to an underlying civil engineering issue where a mountainside swamp had been filled in with earth beyond regulations.

title: Young Scientist Program for 80 Orphans in Pakistan
description: Roshni Homes Trust is collaborating with Science Fuse on a 1 year long science education program for children 6 to 12 to learn scientific thinking.  Program includes 4 modules/year, each lasting 8 weeks and will enhance their learning through custom curriculum + hands on practical science experiments. This collaboration will also train education staff as science educators providing relevant material & knowledge, which will result in running this program for future kids at Roshni Homes Trust.

title: Build a Future for 40 Trafficked Children
description: This project will help 40 rescued children/adolescents learn important skills in sewing and garment making so that they can build a future for themselves, their families and communities.  Identified through established referral pathways, each student will be given access to trained staff, materials and sewing equipment to develop the necessary skills to find a job with local manufacturers or even set up their own businesses.

title: FIGHT HUNGER & FOOD INSECURITY IN S/EAST, NIGERIA
description: This project will help to reduce hunger and food insecurity among farmers. In Nigeria, about 3.7 million people, across16 states, are food insecure. Several factors have driven this. These include civil conflicts, large-scale displacement, rising food prices, climate change, natural resource degradation, poverty and population growth. About 9 out of 10 Nigerians cannot afford a healthy diet. The COVID-19 pandemic has worsened the hunger situation, particularly impacting food supply and price.

title: Helping scavengers children & mum in Bali
description: About 15 minutes drive from Kuta is Bali's biggest official tip at Suwung, where mountains of rubbish dominate the landscape. It's a 30 Hectare Trash Mountain Site.This area is also a home for 100 plus families who work in this area by sorting trash by hands, who most of them coming from Various area of Indonesia. Many of the families can't afford to school the their children as the results of a very small income.We help through education, empowerment, medical support and other assistant.

title: Help a Ukrainian Child Get Surgery in the USA!
description: 8 y.o. Nikita needs help fundraising for surgery. He has cerebral palsy that severely impairs his mobility, causing him pain. A St Louis hospital is ready to give Nikita a Selective Dorsal Rhizotomy, which permanently reduces spasticity and greatly improves mobility. Nikita will walk, even outside with an aid! The US$46,245 cost is unaffordable for his mom, so we want to help. Even if we miss the target, any funds raised will be used for Nikita's everyday needs!

title: Support for Ethiopia
description: The humanitarian and hunger crisis in Ethiopia has worsened. Food insecurity, conflict and violence, climate change, and economic turmoil have pushed more than five million people - almost 90% of the population -into a state of emergency. ActionAid will provide food, shelter, and medical support to the most vulnerable and marginalized families in the country.

title: Feeding the needy amidst South African unrest
description: SOUTH AFRICA IN NEED - As a global community, we have recently witnessed some of the significant challenges facing the nation of South Africa.  Amidst this turmoil, the challenge of helping those in need becomes even greater. There are families facing challenges unlike ever before. As a global community, we can't stand by and simply observe these atrocities. We need to take action.  We would appreciate your donation to help our organization to get food to those who need it most.

title: Enable 40 African womxn become rideshare drivers
description: 64.4% of young black South African womxn are unemployed and not studying, yet 95% of welfare is distributed to communities through womxn. Khwela Womxn believes that self-empowered womxn are change agents for their communities. We help womxn by equipping them with skills (drivers license, road & personal safety, platform access, finances) & access to safe peer-mentorship spaces, so they can transform their mindsets & uplift themselves personally & professionally. Our impact:3891 Mentor bot users.

title: COVID-19 APPEAL - Help Feed our Community
description: Covid-19 affects us all in some way but for those without a safety net it is even more life-threatening. Rwanda is currently in its third major lockdown since the start of the pandemic. Our EDD community is struggling to make ends meet at this time. Many of our Alumni (both staff and former street children who grew up in our centre) as well as their families have lost their jobs or sources of income. This project will help provide basic food and essential supplies to these vulnerable families.

title: Solar Power for Refugees in Bidibidi, Uganda
description: This project is to improve health and education sector and the performance of small businesses through the installation of Solar Energy at 4 Health Centres, 4 Schools (each with 4 computer classes constructed and equipped) and 4 Business Hubs at Bidibidi with a total population of 505,381 (Refugees and Host Community). Bidibidi Refugee Settlement is located in a hard-to-reach place and the lack of reliable power has hampered the performance of the Health Centres, Schools and Business.

title: Project Fearless
description: Our programs have been specifically designed to future-proof the interests and skills of girls and gender-fluid youth (ages of 9-14). Giving them the tools and confidence to discover who they are, follow new passions, break stereotypes and find their voice.   Mind & Movement lab: Building confidence, strength, and resilience.   Community & Leadership: Creating a connection between the community within our own walls and beyond.  The Makes Space: Try new things, get messy and feel empowered!

title: VENEZUELA: EDUCATE-HEAL-FEED 400 KIDS AND COVID-19
description: This project will guarantee that 400 children can continue their basic education attending virtual and on-site classes. While attending school, they will have a light breakfast, balanced lunch, and medical assistance. For the virtual period, food will be handed for them to take home. Our medical facility cares for the children as well as for the community and has developed a rapid response during Covid pandemic.

title: Providing Oral Health to 18,000 students
description: Oral diseases qualify as a major public health problems owing to their high prevalence and incidence. In India, children form about 38% to 40% of the total population, and 80% of them have high levels of dental diseases. School dental screening is seen as a vehicle for bringing children with dental needs in contact with dental services. Dental screening of school children can help disadvantaged children by identifying their dental problems and educating them about their oral health status.

title: Gift a Smile to 75 Cleft Children in India
description: Trinity Care Foundation has been providing free surgeries for Cleft children who hail from the poorest sections of society in Karnataka State since 2007, also providing the children with speech therapy and further treatments. Your donation helps to provide free reconstructive surgeries and emotional counseling to support these children and their families during the Covid19 Crisis.

title: Restoring Kelp Forests with Nanotechnology
description: Around the world, massive kelp forests are rapidly declining due to coastal development and erosion, warming waters, invasive species, poor water quality, pollution, and overfishing.  Nova Scotia has lost 85-99% of their kelp forests over the past 4-6 decades, putting their fisheries and livelihoods in jeopardy. Reef Life Foundation is developing a new method for restoring kelp using nanotechnology artificial reefs with the ocean science company IntelliReefs CAN and Dalhousie University.

title: Recover 5 Million Pounds of Ocean Plastic
description: Oregon-based environmental nonprofit Ocean Blue Project aims to recover 5 million pounds of plastic and other ocean debris along U.S. coastlines and waterways by 2025 through the deployment of new ocean cleanup machines as well as volunteer cleanup initiatives made possible by local communities nationwide. Every 1 U.S. Dollar donated funds the recovery of 5 pounds of plastic from our oceans and rivers. Climate change and warming waters means the ocean inhabitants need us now more than ever.

title: Western Europe Flood Relief Fund
description: Severe rain caused intense flooding in Germany and Belgium, destroying homes and towns. Dozens of people have died, and thousands of people are unaccounted for in Germany. This fund will provide immediate relief to survivors and support long-term recovery.

title: Digital Skills for Disadvantaged Children in China
description: Millions of rural, migrant and low-income children in China do not have access to computer classes. This project will help over 1,000 disadvantaged children and youth in China to improve their digital skills, learning about internet security, search engine, Microsoft Office, and other digital tools. This will improve their confidence and self-esteem, and will increase their access to better work opportunities in the future.

title: building wells for community
description: This project will build wells in lwengo district which will provide safe water to over 15000 villagers currently faced with COVID 19  second wave.The community is in great need for water.GWAM has been repairing broken bore holes,digging wells ,installing water tanks to schools,COVID 19 hand washing tanks and installation of drinking water filtering stations in this community.

title: Empower Communities Through Healthcare & Education
description: Moyo believes that Education and Healthcare play key roles in fostering sustainable development and women's empowerment. This project will support pastoralist Samburu and Pokot communities in the North-Western corner of Laikipia - Kenya by providing healthcare access to remote areas and the opportunity to attend education at both primary and secondary level. By improving healthcare and providing access to education we can help shape a brighter future for those in dire need of help.

title: $21 for 2021 - Feeding the Wildlife Community
description: Rural communities in Northern KwaZulu-Natal are some of the poorest in the country and we provide food parcels to households in need. The economic impacts of COVID has impacted heavily on the tourism industry and therefore many people are now unemployed and living below the breadline. Many families on the Manyoni Private Game Reserve boundary are struggling to make ends meat. If you would like to donate towards the community food parcels, please click the donate button!

title: Provide Emergency Supplies after Riots in SA
description: Our response will provide emergency provisions to those worst affected by the looting & fires. This includes families who have lost their income, micro and family run businesses that have lost their livelihoods, essential workers who are unable to return home to care for their families. For businesses and  community doctors whose premises were looted and burnt, we will assist in re-establishing their businesses through cash contributions and supply chain support.

title: Scaling Up Distribution of High-impact Cook stoves
description: Mma Eunice Owenson Foundation strive to change three-stone open fires cooking method with high-impact cookstoves and solar lighting systems in rural communities of Niger Delta - Nigeria. MEOF project objective is to provides,distributes improved cookstoves and solar lights through innovative support to women entrepreneurs,which will allows more than 500-1000 households access to health care,clean cooking,solar electricity and protecting the environment - to end extreme energy poverty in Nigeria.

title: German Red Cross Flooding Response
description: More than 3,500 of our volunteers and employees are responding to the flooding in North Rhine-Westphalia and Rhineland-Palatinate. Many people affected by the flooding will depend on our emergency relief for days and weeks. Many have lost all their possessions and need access to basic supplies.

title: More and better water through ecotechnics
description: Increase the availability of drinking water for the benefit of peasant families through the construction of cisterns, the installation of filters, reduce the pollution caused by the disposal of gray water into the environment with the installation of artificial wetlands at the family level, increase the availability of water drinking water for community use through the establishment of water pots, promoting good practices for efficient water use.

title: Surf Therapy for veterans with disabilities
description: One More Wave (OMW) provides customized surfing solutions and community to veterans with disabilities. Our customized surfboards are customized to amputees, burn victims, spinal cord injuries, and mental issues such as Post Traumatic Stress Disorder, Major Depressive Disorder, and Traumatic Brain Injury.  OMW also boasts community chapters in Oahu, HI, San Diego, CA, Ventura, CA, Pismo Beach, CA, Santa Cruz, CA, and Surf City, NC.

title: Empower artisans in marginalized areas of Kenya
description: Action10 together with Human Rights & Science (HR&S) aim to raise funds to decrease poverty in the Kibera slum through increased employment and business activities. The Kibera slum in Kenya suffers from low employment and high poverty rate where the latter is as high as 50%. By supporting local business operations we will contribute to an increased standard of living in the area.

title: Spreading the love of books in central Mexico 2022
description: While middle and upper class families were able to go to zoom classes, take private lessons and access books at home, many of Mexico's poor struggled disproportionately during the pandemic and many children dropped out of school due to economic reasons or lack of access to internet.  We doubled down on our efforts to bridge the gap and make sure all children have opportunities to explore and flourish as intellectual, creative, and emotional beings.

title: YouthAlert! (YA!) "Youth Peace" Program in U.S.A.
description: Violence, bullying, and abuse, are the "Head of The Snake" TM. They are the number one root cause of many of society's woes including mental health, social health, physical health, substance abuse, unhealthy eating, risky behaviors, and extreme poverty. Fortunately, we know how to stop it; school-based universal, comprehensive violence prevention education "+" for youth. We must reach all 1.8 billion youth between the ages of 10 and 24 biennially.

title: Food for children affected by South African Riots
description: The mass destruction of businesses, homes and city infrastructure caused by violent riots in the South African provinces of KwaZulu-Natal and Gauteng has left thousands of young children in vulnerable communities without access to essential items - specially food. We are providing emergency aid to young children and their families in these areas in partnership with various disaster relief organisations, food and logistics partners as well as volunteers.

title: Cultivate Plants- Cultivate Peace in Ethiopia
description: Ethiopia is currently from hope to conflict.Hope of the people overshadowed by a war, Ethnic conflict, socio-political instability& land dispute, Also Youth unemployment, food security & environmental degradation a remaining challenge & has the potential to further exacerbate existing instability. MHO is fascinated to help build a peaceful community through educative actions that includes school Entrepreneurship, plant of fruit, trees & vegetable gardens while promoting culture of peace values

title: COVID19 Relief in rural India
description: India is currently facing one of the worst covid outbreaks in the history of the pandemic. The second wave is far deadlier than the first and our healthcare infrastructure is under a lot of pressure. Individuals, as well as organizations like us, are trying to support the needs of the many affected by covid as best as we can.  We are fundraising for the following :  Infrastructure at Government Healthcare facilities. Community Outreach Health Programs [ Vaccinations & NCDs ]

title: Help DBerbatovF to establish a House of talents
description: To fund the creation of a real space (a house) for the FDB's children. In order to further support the development of their interests and their feeling of community, we will be hosting various events (lectures, masterclasses, talks, exhibitions, mini concerts and etc.) We will be working towards the establishment of a space where our beneficiaries will feel welcome at any time and will be able to find appropriate resources for their studies or just communicate with like-minded or supporters.

title: Flooding Relief in Germany
description: Massive floods, collapsed houses, missing and dead people: Severe storms and heavy rainfalls have left widespread destruction in western Germany.  Aktion Deutschland Hilft, an alliance of German aid organizations, is on site and provides help to the people: We help with evacuations, organize emergency shelters and support traumatized people. The aid organizations are in constant action to help people now. You can also help affected families.

title: Rescue , Rehabilitation and Sensitization project
description: We rescue and rehabilitate vulnerable animals,to eliminate mass poisoning . Offer advisory services  , and benevolent assistance to pet owner in need and answer community queries concerning their animals and promoting welfare. We support and enhance the sheltering of homeless dogs and cats at household  and community levels. We offer annual rabies vaccination  and we work in regions where animals have no rights, and people have not been informed about animal welfare / health management.

title: A BRIGHTER TOMORROW: FEED 250 OVC IN ISIOLO-KENYA
description: Feeding children with nutritious meals provides good health and improved immunity  which will better their education chances and hence improved individual and national incomes in the long run. Every child deserves equal opportunities regardless of race, religion or gender . The WAYAAP feeding program seeks to provide a continuous access of nutritious food to the children at the WAYAAP Centre by offering at least 3 meals a day to 250 OVCs. Let's come together to achieve this goal.

title: Help Baran, a four-year-old Chimpanzee!
description: Please help us support Baran, a four-year-old chimpanzee who arrived at Sweetwaters Chimpanzee Sanctuary in July 2021. She was born prematurely in Eram Zoo and once her mother died, it became impossible for her to integrate with the other chimpanzees and so she was moved to a cage for her protection. She was brought to the Sanctuary, to live a better life and we cannot wait to help her settle in.

title: Feed & Heal 100 malnourished children in Guatemala
description: Our project will provide nourishing food to children suffering from malnutrition, growth delays,  and poverty. We will teach mothers nutritional care and how to cook enriched foods. Impoverished communities will learn better farming, food production, and sanitation to aid their children's health.  Diets will be supplemented with milk, cereals, atoles, and multivitamins.  Every child will be monitored by home visits.

title: Provide Textbooks for Children in Liberia
description: This project seeks to provide full sets of curriculum texbooks for the Carolyn A Miller School in Paynesville, Liberia. The school is one of only a few non-fee paying schools that provides education from kindergarten to 12th grade, and is currently delivering free education to 500 of Liberia's poorest children who do not have the means to buy their own textbooks. The school is helping to rebuild the damaged educational infrastructure that 14 years of civil war has created.

title: Educate Underprivileged Children in Liberia
description: CAMES provides free education to over 500 children in Liberia who have relocated from the Buduburam Refugee Camp in Ghana as well as students who were internally displaced during the civil war.

title: Asia Pacific COVID-19 Appeal
description: Australian Red Cross is raising funds to help local Red Cross and Red Crescent teams across the region scale up their emergency response, and continue their life-saving work on the ground.  Donations will go towards supporting our local partners across the Asia Pacific to scale up their emergency response to these COVID-19 surges and sustain their essential services such as health, water, sanitation and hygiene services for the worst impacted people and communities.

title: Eradicate COVID-19
description: The Ministry of Health (MOH), Liberia through the COVID-19 Incident Management system (IMS) confirms that there are increase in the number of COVID-19 cases in Liberia as of now. Giving the new variant of transmission among the populace, about 120, 000 COVID-19 TESTs have been conducted; with 2,453 confirmed cases to date (June 9, 2021), 608 of these confirmed in 2021, 300 active cases as of June 9, 2021, 92 confirmed COVID-19 deaths, 28 cases (21 confirmed and 7-suspects) in treatment unit.

title: Young Agents in Conservation Agriculture (YACA)
description: This project will increase income levels (by 30%) of 500 youths farmers and  women, providing Climate Smart Agriculture knowledge as well as business development services in Muchinga, Eastern and Central Provinces of Zambia.  The Project plans to strengthen Agro-enterprises of the youths and women in Chinsali, Lundazi, Mkushi, Serenje, Chitambo districts of the three provinces of Zambia to be able to restore and conserve 50 hectares of land/forest (Ecosystem), Supporting them with seed funds.

title: 7 Communities Respond to Glacier Loss in Peru
description: This project supports 7 high-mountain communities (Peruvian Andes) who are restoring indigenous water management technologies to cope with the loss of their key water source-glaciers. Their goal is to restore wetlands, using proven techniques to secure water for their livelihoods and wildlife. They document their results and share techniques with other mountain communities. As climate change advances, these indigenous communities are an example to the World. Join their efforts!

title: Help Educate Ebola Orphans in Bong County,Liberia
description: Liberia, Guinea, Sierra Leone, and Nigeria are currently experiencing the most serious and widespread Ebola outbreak that history can record. The outbreak of this virus is claiming more and more lives on a daily basis. Communities are struggling to contain the virus and control the epidemic. VAAFD will help disseminate vital sanitation and medical supplies to clinics communities across Liberia, educate people on how to stop and contain the outbreak and support families of those in quarantine.

title: Feed 740 Displaced Children in Abuja, Nigeria
description: Displaced children in the IDP camp are facing severe hunger and malnutrition. This project will help provide daily meal packs to 740 hungry internally displaced children who are living in Kwachingoro IDP Camp in Abuja, Nigeria.   We have been able to distribute over 20,000 kg of food to displaced children and families, and blood donation to treat at-risk children and elderly patients but we need your support to continue providing food for the displaced children during this uncertain time.

title: "Feed& Educate  Unhoused children in Busia, Kenya.
description: No  Child should experience  anxiety & depression, Malnourished children are more susceptible to sickness and missing school, they also find it harder to concentrate and succeed in their studies. Children from impoverished families often have only a meal a day , these children includes Orphans, unhoused children caused by domestic violence or systematic poverty .This project will support 143 of them with shelter, clothing, education, medicine , life skills, livelihood & sanitary pads to  girls.

title: Climate change adoption for 100 farmers in Uganda
description: Daisy is one of the women most affected by climate change in Hoima district. We are empowering 100 smallholder farmers to plant a total of 1,200 bamboo seedlings around their farms that will act as sources of cooking fuel and provide an opportunity for bamboo value addition. They will also be supported to improve their soils using biochar, organic fertilizers and pesticides. Furthermore, each of the beneficiaries will be supported to own a clean cooking Gasifier stove.

title: COVID 19 is beaten; Now Learning must Resume.
description: Girls' dreams of working their way out of poverty through quality education are being shattered by the pandemic. Our COVID ACTION AGENDA has beaten off the worst impacts of the pandemic. Now with syllabus linked digital learning, continuous assessment of  learning levels and customized self learning, we seek to excellence for our girls. Learning packages like DIKSHA, PEHLA, ASSET, MindSPARK help take girls to the frontier.  For $50,000, let us bring the digital revolution to  500 more girls.

title: Orphan & Vulnerable Children Care in Bangladesh
description: We are committed to supporting orphan and other vulnerable children in Bangladesh who are disadvantaged by poverty.  We are supporting 350 children in remote Ramu hilly area of Cox's Bazar district.  We provide child centered community based support  through education, healthcare, foods, protection of the children. Your donation will provide primary necessities to those who are struggling with the poverty to provide food, healthcare, school uniforms, education materials, tuition fees etc.

title: Save the Gili Turtles & Help to Build a Hatchery
description: Gili Islands are famous for year-round experiences with endangered Green and Hawksbill turtles. We aim to create a safe haven for turtle nests that currently are under threat from poaching, trampling, storm surges and pollution, with a hatchery on the beach for protected incubation before immediate release to the ocean. Along with this, we want to boost eco-tourism with a Turtle Education Centre for guests to immerse themselves in the mysterious life of a sea turtle without cruel exploitation.

title: Protecting Street Children from contracting Covid
description: The boys we serve alongside other many street children are at great risk of contracting Covid-19 bearing in mind that they are scavenging for food from dumpsites, and do not have accessibility to face masks, hand sanitizers, soaps, and other protective gears.  It is in this regard that we are reaching out for support to enable us to support these street children with face masks, hand sanitizers, soaps, food, as well as facilitating their vaccination.

title: An urgent appeal to save 2 girls from traffickers
description: It is an urgent appeal to save two girls in Rajasthan, India, from commercial sex work. Parents of Kiran and Pooja (name changed) have lost all means of livelihood during the pandemic and are now sending their daughters to Mumbai to practice the age-old custom of sex work to generate income for the family. Kiran and Pooja have aspirations to build their career. The fundraiser will support their education for two years in a premier education and boarding school and keep them safe from traffickers

title: Mobile Healthcare in Syria
description: In partnership with a local organization, Shafak, COHI is working to ensure that the women and children of Syria get the healthcare they need. Through culturally and linguistically literate care, COHI is working with midwives and women's health workers to staff mobile clinics that move throughout Northern Syria - ensuring that rural communities and refugee camps have access to medical attention. Times of conflict too often prevent women and children from receiving care, let's work to change that

title: Covid Relief For 10 Elders in Buwenda
description: The Project will provide Basic Needs like Food,water,clothing,Soap,Masks,Sanitizer,Sanitation,nutritional requirements and medicare to Ten Vulnerable Elders in Buwenda Village.

title: Ground Breaking Malaria Research
description: Your donation will help support the launch of the first-ever mosquito abatement project in Mali, West Africa!   We are partnering with Dr. Mueller & his team at the University of Bamako, the Salt Lake Mosquito Abatement District, & Mosquito Control District in Florida to conduct this groundbreaking research that could terminate malaria-carrying mosquitos. We are passionate about this project because it has the potential to save thousands of lives.

title: Health, Sanitation and Food Security Project
description: The project will provide low-cost dry latrines, support vegetable gardening and raising of small animals and provide capacity-building activities for marginalized farmers and coastal dwellers.

title: Non-formal Education for Disadvantaged Girl
description: This project will provide non-formal education for 750 disadvantaged women and girls who by difficult circumstances have stopped formal schooling and live hand-to-mouth existence in remote communities. Non-formal education will be through individual coaching, small group discussions and practical site visits to successful projects in the locality.

title: Rainforest Biodiversity Improvement Project
description: We target to improve the biodiversity of the rain-forest in Zamboanga del Norte by mobilizing 3,000 youths to plant at least 40 trees in their farms. This translates to 120,000 trees which will improve the biodiversity of the rain-forest threatened by illegal logging and unsustainable farming and would mean improvement in the lives of the Subanen Indigenous people living there.

title: Happy Meals for 500 Hungry Children
description: Five hundred hungry children in remote villages that we are serving here in Mindanao shall partake of sumptuous meal  in order to make them happy, enjoy good food, improve their nutrition and well-being. The meal will be served by our teams and volunteers and will comprise fried chicken, rice, roasted pig, candies, chocolates and native delicacies. We will also provide toys and slippers for the children. We will target 1,500 children to be served by this initiative.

title: El Nino Water, Sanitation and Hygiene Initiative
description: The project will provide water, sanitation and hygiene support for local communities badly affected by the El Nino in the Philippines. We will provide dry, waterless toilets, water containers and hygiene kits focusing on mountainous and hard to reach areas. The choice of dry, waterless toilets is because the traditional pour-flush toilets is no longer effective due to lack of water and open defecation is a major problem due to spread of diseases.

title: Help us build a school for children in Ghana
description: This project will build a school for children in Gbawe, Ghana, to provide education to improve their well-being and positively impact their families and the community.  PAAJAF Foundation is a non profit organization whose main objective is providing free good quality education for children in the Gbawe region of Ghana. Educated children are better prepared to build a more prosperous future for themselves, their families, and their communities.

title: To Empower & Educate the children of Kenya
description: Do you think everybody should be given a chance at education no matter their circumstances? We do too. This project looks to empower and educate the children living in extreme poverty Barani, Kenya.  BBK has established a strong connection with local school teacher Betty, who helps to provide uniforms and shoes, as well as reusable sanitary towels and underwear to the high school girls.    BBK encourages you to help us in this wonderful opportunity to provide for those in need. Thank you.

title: Mentor Girlchild For A Just World
description: A program aimed at protecting the life of the girl-child through eradication of girl-child school dropouts, early pregnancies, early marriages as well as the general improvement of their socio-economic welfare to become future mothers of strong ideals. The outcomes include: Zero school-dropout rate of girl-childre,  Zero rate of early pregnancies and marriages, and High number of girls completing post-high school education/training.

title: Support to 80 street connected Kenyan youth
description: We look to offer holistic support to street connected and homeless youth in Kitale in western Kenya. Our World of Work (WOW) project has two main objectives. The first is to provide the young people with livelihood and self-reliance opportunities through lifeskills, business and other trainings, business grants and ongoing support. Secondly we will assist the young people to access appropriate housing and help them in practical ways to be self-reliant as they transition from life on the streets.

title: Bring Healthcare Access to >40000 Rural Tanzanians
description: This project will enable remote Tanzanian Maasai communities to access the services of a qualified doctor at a fixed time each week via videoconference. Currently, patients must walk up to 6 hours or face high transport fees to see a doctor. This is infeasible for many, so patients resort to traditional remedies or wait weeks before seeking treatment, by which time it can be too late. Our telehealth hubs will enable remote communities to receive healthcare access at reduced cost, time and effort

title: Psychology skills training for Kayamandi youths
description: We are a research and humanitarian organization that provides world class psychological interventions to poor and disabled youths. "LifeMatters" our 10-session program teaches psychological skills through active participation and physical activities. Research evidence shows our program promotes physical- and mental health, academic achievement, self-esteem, and personal growth. We develop prosocial youths into citizens with agency who contribute to their own lives and their community.

title: Support South African Township Cricket Programmes
description: This project focuses on creating sporting ecosystems and healthy alternatives for township communities by providing quality infrastructure that is safe and accessible, and quality coaching that produces sporting excellence. The programme supports more than 350 children and eight community coaches in the poverty stricken community of Khayelitsha near Cape Town, South Africa.

title: Economic Empowerment for Smallholder Farmers
description: This project will be facilitating or Empowering the community to attain economic growth through interventions; Awareness creation on climate change, adaptation, mitigation and build their resilience.  Another intervention that will be facilitated is application of sustainable agriculture land management practices and tree planting. In order to have sustainable and profitable agricultural products Gender involvement will be promoted and of great concern and farm product value addition.

title: Housing for the Vulnerable Refugees of Lesvos
description: This program provides community-based housing, medical and psychosocial support, access to the labor market, and the provision of food, clothing, and hygiene items on Lesvos. The housing program accommodates refugees in need, responding to the inhumane living conditions in refugee camps. Safe housing restores people's dignity and provides security, independence, social inclusion and empowerment. Support for people's needs is provided by a team of mental health and social work professionals!

title: Rebuild burnt down school in African township
description: Love Story has been supporting Sinethemba Creche for the past 9 years. Gladys, the owner, has been an inspiration to her community by not only looking after over 80 children daily, but also running a community kitchen that serves over 100 needy people in her neighbourhood. A few weeks ago an entire classroom burnt down from a fire that started at her neighbour's home. This classroom housed 26 little children.

title: Arts & crafts for migrant and indigenous children
description: With your support, this project can grant 400 children from hostile family environments access to cultural and educational workshops. Due to the current social violence crisis, child abuse in Oaxaca has increased by 300%, and many children now live in risky conditions and have no safe spaces. The Art & Crafts School program promotes guidance and care for children. By participating, you can help give these children valuable experiences that will enrich their lives and broaden their horizons.

title: Safe housing for 5 low-income families in Colombia
description: The project seeks to support 5 families represented by 15 people, who, due to social and economic situations, do not have the resources to improve the housing conditions of their homes.  This project will contribute to the improvement of the living conditions and habitat of the vulnerable low-income families of Medellin, Colombia, aiming at the United Nation's 11 objective of Sustainable Development.

title: Empower 1000 vulnerable women for work in Colombia
description: The unemployment rate for women in Colombia has exceeded 25% -10 points above the same rate for men, and the highest in the region. There are 7.1 million unemployed female heads of household who have been the most affected by the pandemic, risking the progress achieved in gender equality in recent decades.   Our project provides an integral environment to empower women for them to reactivate economically, by supporting them on four fronts related to their coaching and training as entrepreneurs.

title: Educating SuperWomen in Guatemala
description: Powerful. Strong. Resilient.  These are the young Superwomen generation from Barra Sarstun, Guatemala, Fundacion Mundo Azul seeks to empower through this project to enable 35 women to reinsert to the new reality through providing them access to IT tools and building their capacity's to carry out their schooling online.     Your support will help these SuperWomen to strengthen their IT skills to continue their education and follow their dreams.

title: Enough of domestic violence
description: The project' main objective is to contribute to combating domestic violence in Brazil, where violence against women indexes was extremely aggravated during the pandemic. This project will train 50 female entrepreneurs from Raizes do Rio, ASPLANDE, as Women's Rights Ambassadors. It will impact at least 1500 women's lives, catered by the ambassadors in their territories. It'll produce the digital booklet "Resistance, Struggle and Conquest of Rights" and the "No to Violence" collection.

title: Restore hope for 1,200 widows in Burundi
description: This project plans to provide land titles to 1,200 hopeless and marginalized Burundian households made of widows and orphans at risks, traumatized by injustice and extreme poverty, caused by spoliation; the grabbing of their land holdings; bad judgments from  courts and plots boundaries' recurring conflicts. 60 women will be trained in Human Rights, Gender-Based Violence and provided with legal texts so as to know their rights, spread them and be capable to raise their voices against injustice

title: IMPROVING AIR QUALITY IN PUBLIC SCHOOLS IN NIGERIA
description: Most school environment In Nigeria are bare and void of trees leading to hot, noisy, and polluted environment making school children to be restless, prone to ill health, and generally low performance in their studies.  Children with attention deficit disorder have been more affected as trees  that will boost their immunities are not available. NCF intend to plant 240,000 trees in 240 public schools, create 240 conservation club, train 800 teachers and train  4000 children on greenspace creation.

title: Help Save Education and Renovate Asikam School
description: Van Moorhouse Foundation will adopt Asikam primary & Junior high school which consist of 650 pupils in the East Akim district of the Eastern Region of Ghana. This project will equip the school with classroom furniture such as chairs,desks,school supplies ,STEM equipment's, digital skill centre, sanitation facilities and help renovating the school block including building Library,kitchen and playground.

title: Support 100 Filipino Women Migrant Returnees
description: The Project aims at supporting alternative livelihood for 100 Filipino women migrant returnees through "SIKHAY". Women acquire new skills in sewing and hand-loom weaving and how to handle tasks, which eventually leads to women's economic self-reliance and empowerment. SIKHAY requires funds for further expansion to reach out to more women.

title: Ronald McDonald Family Room Bologna Remodelling
description: Fondazione per l'Infanzia Ronald McDonald Italia believes that when a child is sick, the entire family needs comfort and support. Many families travel far from home, and spend several weeks or months to get treatment for their seriously ill or injured children. Since 2008 Ronald McDonald Family Room Bologna provides a place for families to call home. However, after over ten years it is necessary realize a family space remodeling to improve the hospitality!

title: Peru Earthquake Relief Fund
description: A 6.2 magnitude earthquake caused widespread damage in the Piura Region of Peru. This fund will provide immediate relief to survivors and support long-term recovery.

title: Raising Funds for local & International charities
description: The Rotary Club of Billericay is seeking to raise funds for our Benevolent Fund from which we make donations to local and international charities each year. The organisations we support in this way typically fall under one of Rotary International's seven areas of focus:  Peacebuilding and conflict prevention;  Disease prevention and treatment; Water, sanitation and hygiene;  Maternal and child health;  Basic education and literacy;  Community economic development; and Supporting the Environment.

title: Home base Enterprise for Women with Disabilities
description: Women with Disabilities are facing double discrimination because of Gender & Disability. They deprived of fundamental rights even Education & Skill development so that they always depend on parents. They have no choice of livelihood option with dignified access but they have potential to deliver. NDF has established NDF Youth Skill Development Center for the proper training, Career Counseling & Home Based Enterprise for Women with Disabilities in Nawabshah, to empower them.

title: Technion Women In Science Initiative
description: The Technion Women in Science Initiative aims at encouraging women to undertake career paths in Israeli STEM academia and related industries. The initiative seeks to encourage women to undertake graduate studies in the engineering and hard science disciplines; it similarly focuses on removing practical and economic roadblocks to a postdoctoral commitment and to improving the conditions of entry-level academic faculty.

title: Low-cost Sanitation for Typhoon Odette Survivors
description: We will replicate the activities we did when Typhoon Haiyan devastated Leyte by providing low-cost pour-flush toilets, water filters and water systems this time for families affected by Typhoon Odette. We will target 1,500 families in the provinces of Southern Leyte and Surigao.

title: Sports Equipment for Children
description: The project will provide sports equipment such as balls, bats, uniforms, chess boards, shoes and assorted educational toys to children of impoverished families in order for the children to be healthy, productive, sports minded, disciplined and have a bright future.

title: Mindanao Sanitation and Food Security Project
description: The project will provide low-cost, durable and scientific sanitation hardware and food security support via root crop and vegetable production for very poor, vulnerable families in selected target areas in Mindanao and mainly in the provinces of Misamis Oriental and Zamboanga del Norte. A total of 3,000 families is targeted for this project aiming to improve their health, hygiene and nutrition situation and enabling them to live with dignity and fully participating in the life of the community.

title: Family Rescue from Extreme Poverty Project
description: This project will improve the socio-economic situation of 1,500 very poor and marginal families living in extreme poverty by providing them with financial and technical support so that they will be able to start their individual micro-enterprises using most of the resources found in their farms.
