Example of these are vegetable gardening, raising of ducks, chickens and pigs, selling food products, sewing and handicrafts. In so doing their well-being is improved.

title: EAST - Excellence Arab Students at the Technion
description: Arab citizens of Israel make up twenty percent of the country's population, and as a minority group have traditionally been under-represented in Israeli universities. The Technion has made huge efforts to include greater numbers of Arab students by strengthening internal empowerment systems and has achieved such great success that the model is being rolled out nationwide.

title: Reinforcing homeless women's autonomy
description: The goal is to help homeless women entering the labor market through a process of accompaniment before, during and after. We implement a methodology designed by Multipolar which includes: Vocational guidance, Psychological therapy, Coaching, training and workshops to succeed in interviews, mediation with employers and support on productive entrepreneurship projects.

title: Providing A Home For Orphaned Children In Bali
description: Who could they become if they were given a chance? Our Children's Home in Bali, Indonesia is at the heart of why we exist. We take in children who have been orphaned, abandoned and rejected and provide them with a loving home where they feel comfortable and safe enough to be just that - children.  We have over 60 children in our home. Through our valuable supporters and donors, we provide Food, Shelter, Healthcare, Education, Security and, of course a Family.

title: Promoting Health & Equality Issues in Kenya
description: This project in a remote part of Kenya tackles health and hygiene issues, such as promoting awareness of menstrual health. It supports the production of reusable sanitary napkins by embroiderers at a local refugee camp, making the usual, unhygienic alternatives redundant. This empowers girls, who are forced to miss school during menstruation due to a deep-rooted stigma. The project also promotes hygiene in the community through the construction of toilets and hand-washing stations.

title: Relief Aid for Cancer Patients in Wildfire Areas
description: All donations to this project will be used for the relief and recovery of our affected cancer patients and their families in Turkey fire disaster areas.  Your donations will be used to provide food and emergency medical supplies, hygiene kits and clothes,  to support temporary relief and emergency supplies for those whose houses are burnt and to meet other needs that emerge. LOSEV will use donations to provide free of charge treatment, social and psychological support as well.

title: Provide opportunities for 1000 girls out-of-school
description: School of 2nd Chance is a project of professional integration through sport which aims to promote the employability and social entrepreneurship of 1.000 young Girls in NEET Situation aged between 16 and 25 years, from vulnerable neighborhoods in Morocco. The project is divided into 3 axes: 1. Work-linked training and the acquisition of technical and behavioral skills, 2. Professional experience in structures and programs of education through sport, 3. Support for access to employment.

title: Help unemployed Thai with IT work-study program
description: DigiServe IT Academy Plus provides an 18-month work-study and apprenticeship program for unemployed adults (due to Covid) who desire to start a new career in IT. They are taught web development and life skills in order to prepare them to enter the IT industry and succeed. The program is designed so that they learn alongside experienced professionals through hands-on projects that support other non-profit organizations (the mission of DigiServe)

title: Helping Children Thrive in Albania and Bulgaria
description: Help us improve the lives of thousands of children in Europe, beginning by training 60 leaders in Albania and Bulgaria to pass on vital skills to those who work with vulnerable and orphaned children. World Without Orphans Europe empowers local leaders across Europe to strengthen families at risk, reunite children in alternative care with their birth families when safe to do so, or find new families through fostering or adoption.

title: Karama: a school for 250 Bozo kids in Mali
description: Bozo fishermen use "karama" to mean "respect": for the people, for the river, for their roots and traditions. With this spirit, Karama looks at the Bozo of Bamako which are strongly stigmatized and isolated by the local society due to their poor living conditions on banks of the Niger river.  Through schooling, the project aims at giving the opportunity to younger generations to compose their own future and apprehend the situation of their community with positivity, ambition and confidence.

title: Transforming Brazil through high quality education
description: This project will offer quality education to 20 students, 14 to 17 years old from the juvenile justice system, who will receive classes three times a week in the subjects of reading, writing, mathematics, for 9 months, in Sao Joao do Meriti, in Rio de Janeiro. Additionally, we will offer the Discovery classes, which are contemporary topics, permeated by socio-emotional support activities, taken to class every week to expand cultural repertoire.

title: Advancing Services for Adults with Disabilities
description: Choice Living Community is committed to creating an atmosphere that will promote and advance services for adults with disabilities in Texas. We have secured a new center to be able to grow and expand these services for our clients and will need to continue fundraising efforts to sustain our project during Covid-19.

title: Jinja Youth Tree Nurseries
description: Youth in Jinja area have been planting fruit trees with their communities and schools. These trees provide a tangible benefit as well as engaging young people in ecology and building green leaders and entrepreneurs over time. Nurseries are founded with local and global support.

title: Rapid Connection: Disaster Response for All
description: NC is committed to equipping all Californians - including elderly, Spanish speakers, farmworkers, and low-income residents - with the resources, knowledge and materials they need to protect themselves from the adverse impacts of wildfires and other disasters. During this wildfire season, our organization is distributing air purifiers, emergency materials including N95 masks to protect from wildfire smoke, and emergency kits and bilingual disaster guides in case residents need to evacuate.

title: Save women and children during Covid pandemic
description: The 100 poor and at risk children and women  in the urban poor communities of Phnom Penh will be saved with the immediate assistance for food and sanitation reliefs.  They will have food to eat with hygiene practice and adapt to the Covid pandemic. The community based organization (CBO) will be organized to raise, plan and include their basic need services in the commune development plans of local commune councils. The children and women will live with food, safety and hope for future.

title: Food security through organic farming in Indonesia
description: The YUM Organic Farm is a social enterprise that grows and sells organic vegetables in West Java, Indonesia. The farm is also a learning facility for young farmers to learn about organic farming practices. Since the pandemic, our farm has been providing vegetables to pregnant mothers and elderly to ensure food security and good health. This project's purpose is to help maintain and scale up the farm's impact so it may continue to serve young farmers, pregnant mothers and the elderly.

title: Empower 60+ communities restore their ecosystems
description: Restoring ecosystems creates a world of abundance and provides humanity with hope for a better future. Ecosystem Restoration Communities is a global movement of everyday people restoring the earth. Around 60 ERCs (projects) have already planted 3,255,917 trees & plants since 2017, and are currently restoring 9,323 ha. Restoring degraded land draws carbon down and cools the surface temperature of the earth. It also increases local biodiversity, restores water systems, and improves food-security.

title: Let's save Mbale's cultural heritage!
description: In the rush to 'modernise', Mbale's historic environment is under immense threat. Across Uganda, older, iconic buildings are fast disappearing and those that do survive are often dwarfed by new construction. This means people are losing important connections to our shared past. And our cities are losing their unique, distinguishing features. Building on successes elsewhere, the Cross-Cultural Foundation of Uganda (CCFU) is now working to safeguard historic buildings in the eastern city of Mbale.

title: The Gift of Education: Help Fund Schools in Ghana
description: A School in the heart of a fishing community in Ghana where the children arrive to an empty classroom with no resources to learn. This is the reality, the schools are under funded and teachers often don't turn up even though the students do, there is no or little learning resources available and limited money to pay teaching staff in the rural areas of Ghana. Our project is working to help fund the local schools and build sustainable income generation for them to succeed and teach the children.

title: Children&Youth Sport in Palestinian Refugee Camps
description: Jafra aims to improve the lives of young Palestinian refugees in camps through the deployment of sports as a developmental tool. Sports in general has long proved its ability to bring people together and promote physical and mental health, while also enhancing leadership and teamwork skills within participants. Our project will secure the chance for 100 Palestinian refugees aged under 18 to take part in various Footballing activities over 4 locations.

title: Disaster Support in Turkey
description: We need your support to help disaster-affected individuals lead dignified lives. Support to life to improve the lives of people who have lost their homes and livelihoods due to fires that have been going on for days in Turkey. You can send us your corporate or individual donations to contribute to a family's need for shelter, livelihood and to participate in our effort to support life. Your donations in determined amounts or any amount you wish will be the lifeline for us to support life.

title: Train eight young Berber men in woodworking skills
description: We train unemployed young men and school-leavers in woodworking. The focus of the training is to create a route to employment, income and increased future prospects. The EBF programme includes a training system in the correct use of hand-tools, the safe operation of machinery, knowledge of different wood varieties and how to sustainably manage local resources and wood waste. Trainees from the programme go on to learn furniture-making and wood-carving skills in a dedicated workshop.

title: Cooking on more efficient clay stoves
description: We empower poor subsistence farmers, where the ability to cook food is a huge problem.  Electricity is expensive & unreliable; charcoal has led to extensive deforestation and traditional cooking methods use large tree trunks. C19 has hugely impacted already poverty-stricken rural Zambia, driving up inflation and ending income from visitors and volunteers from overseas. We promote growing and efficient use of firewood as a source of renewable energy for cooking to reduce poverty & deforestation.

title: Stop Indonesian Children From Dying of COVID-19
description: Funds raised will be used to procure 10L oxygen concentrators that will be donated to over 200 hospitals. The number of oxygen concentrators under 10L that are readily available is not sufficient for hospital use. 10,000 concentrators can immediately impact 30,000 lives in a month and 7 Million+ lives in its lifetime.

title: Protect Journalists Under Threat in Afghanistan
description: In Afghanistan, journalists have played a critical role in providing local communities with accurate and accessible information. The Taliban takeover of Afghanistan is leaving journalists, particularly women journalists, at grave risk. Internews is providing emergency funds to meet the immediate needs of Afghan journalists and to support them over the long term to continue providing trustworthy information to their communities.

title: Helping Displaced Families in Afghanistan
description: This project will supply immediate short-term food relief for displaced families fleeing advancing radicalized troops in Afghanistan.  Gifts up to $50 USD will be matched 50% until September 17th!   It costs $40 to feed a family for 1 week, but with this match $50 will feed almost 2 families (net $75 after the match).  Donate now!

title: Launch the Radiant MLHub Impact Award!
description: This project will establish Radiant Earth Foundation's Radiant MLHub Impact Award! This award will become an annual prize recognizing an individual or organization for their outstanding contribution to real-world applications that address environmental issues using open geospatial training data and machine learning models for Earth observation. The inaugural prize will be awarded for work in the realm of Sustainable Agriculture.

title: First Aid Training for Shipibo Healers
description: Shipibo traditional healers have made a huge impact on the world, sharing their ancestral knowledge and providing healing and spiritual guidance for thousands of foreigners. What we don't see is the essential role that these healers play in their home communities, acting as doctors for many families. The healers have themselves requested training in modern medicine techniques, starting with basic First Aid and basic Injection training.

title: The House that Love Built
description: This project will provide a home for sixty plus (60+) orphaned children and employ 10 staff, including 6 widows. Construction of our new building is complete, and now we have to furnish, equip, and staff the Home. There are thousands of children at risk of being trafficked in India, and we have already rescued some from that fate.

title: TPF Turkey 2021 Wildfire Relief Fund
description: On July 28 and 29 more than 60 fires started in 21 cities in Turkey. As of July 30th, 14 of these fires (in Adana, Osmaniye, Mersin, Antalya, Mugla, Kayseri, and Manisa) are still not under control. The massive fires have been spreading due to high temperatures and winds. The fires are unprecedented in scope and impact. All donations to this fund will support wildfire relief and recovery efforts in Turkey.

title: Special Needs Children Needs You
description: 1 in 8 COVID-19 patients are children. Indonesia has the worst mortality rate in the world for children under 5 years old, with more than 100 deaths a week. In addition to that, children with special needs who are infected with COVID-19 have a higher mortality rate and are four times more likely to contract COVID-19 than others. This is why YCAB Foundation reaches out all parties to join forces in providing vaccination for special needs children.

title: Educate and Feed 22 Orphans in Kilifi, Kenya.
description: This project will educate and feed 22 vulnerable orphans in Kilifi County, Kenya. Kilifi County is one of the poorest counties in Kenya, with one of the highest rates of illiteracy and unemployment. Orphans are particularly vulnerable in such an environment. Secondary schools charge $500 per student per year. Most families cannot afford to feed and educate their children. By feeding them and supporting their education, Upendo will help lift them and their families out of poverty.

title: Transform Lives through Education in Mali, Africa
description: Ouelessebougou Alliance partners with villages to support elementary schools, teachers, literacy training, and continued learning for adults. This project will support our education programs for children, women, and men living in 25 rural villages in Mali, West Africa.

title: Second COVID Emergency Food Relief Program
description: Once again, the 36 families we work with in western Kenya are facing starvation. Yet another lockdown has been put in place that is impacting their livelihoods. With reports of some families already having to limit how many meals they eat in a day, NR has decided to initiate our second ever monthly emergency food relief distribution program. We have committed to provide each family with food supplies, along with masks and sanitary soap for a minimum of six months.

title: Mobilize 5,000 Volunteers at 200 Cleanups Annually
description: The Create a Cleanup campaign aims to mobilize 5,000 volunteers in 200 cleanups annually along U.S. coastlines and waterways with an end goal of recovering 1 million pounds of plastic from the ocean by 2025. Since the project began, Ocean Blue's volunteer-driven cleanups have recovered over 200,000 pounds of plastic to date-with over 82,000 pounds removed in 2019 alone. Our grassroots coalition includes community activists, youth programs, and partnerships with socially conscious businesses.

title: Youth Centre for 100+ Young Leaders in Honduras
description: educate. works to empower young people in Honduras through community-driven educational initiatives. Alongside our scholarship programme for high-potential youth in the rural department of Santa Barbara, we run the department's first Youth Centre and Municipal Library! This centre provides 100+ young leaders with educational opportunities and trainings in entrepreneurship, community engagement and global citizenship. The centre also acts as a local library, open to all.

title: Early Childhood Centre in Tajikistan
description: This project will renovate rooms within a Kindergarten to create an Early Childhood Centre to provide access to early intervention and an inclusive kindergarten program for children with additional needs in Tajikistan.

title: Enroll 1 million Pakistani street kids to school
description: According to UN reports,  currently, Pakistan has the world's second-highest number of out-of-school children with an estimated 22.8 million children aged 5-16 not attending school. In the 5-9 age group, 5 million children are not enrolled in schools and after primary-school age, the number of doubles, with 11.4 million adolescents between the ages of 10-14 not receiving formal education.  The dropout ratio among girls is much more higher.

title: Be The Hope for Youth After The Disasters - Turkey
description: Turkish Education Foundation (TEV) is undertaking a new project named "Be The Hope for Youth After The Fires in Turkey" to support the education of students who are affected by the fire disasters in the summer of 2021 , as well as by the recent floods that greatly disturbed the lives of students residing in Kastamonu and other affected regions in the same year, in Turkey. Scholarship holders of the fund will be supported during their academic life.

title: Support 150 girls in Cameroon with Dignity kits
description: This project will provide 150 Dignity/Menstrual hygiene kits to adolescent girls  for early recovery intervention in a humanitarian crisis. These girls have lost their homes and have displaced to communities in Tubah for safety due to the ongoing humanitarian crisis in the North West and South West Region of Cameroon. They cannot afford clean menstrual hygiene products and WASH kits due to inadequate finances.  The project will support the girls with adequate access to proper Menstrual hygiene

title: Build 5 Houses for rural villagers in Sri Lanka
description: Tarana Foundation plans to build 5 houses in the North Central / Eastern Provinces to support 5 low-income families who are challenged without a proper source of income, and are unable to build a house of their own due to financial and other constraints they are faced with. This will help to fulfil a long uncherished dream of those families of having a a house they can call their own and also, protection from getting wet during the rainy season.

title: Agroforestry for livelihood improvement in Nepal
description: Nepal is one of the disaster-prone countries located in central Himalaya range. Due to the impact of climate change, extreme events such as heavy rainfall patterns & drought have been observed in Nepal in last few years resulting in landslides and flash floods leaving many people homeless with poor livelihood. The project will carry out large-scale plantation of Moringa, Avocado, and Mangoes which will help poor farmers to generate extra income as well as help in climate change mitigation.

title: Support Children on Education & Other Needs
description: This project will mainly support rural students in remote schools as they face hardships to buy school essential items to go to school. These challenges are faced by parents after the pandemic and due to the current economic crisis in Sri Lanka as the prices of school essential items have increased by more than 200%. Other needs of rural schools for student meals, library books, IT requirements, musical instruments, sports goods, and water & sanitation will be supported too from this project.

title: Resettling Internally Displaced Persons in Abuja
description: Resettling Internally Displaced Persons (R-IDP) Project will change the lives of 50 displaced persons selected from the 4 IDP Camps in Abuja (Lugbe, Area 1, New Kuchingoro, and Kuje) by providing technical, vocational, and entrepreneurial skills towards their resettlement. C-STEMP, with the help of donors and partners, will lead the drive towards empowering this neglected group, including women with 4 of the construction skills in-demand, namely: Carpentry, Electrical, Painting, and Plumbing.

title: Plight of Maasai children in Osiligi, Kenya
description: Village Economic Empowerment plans to build six classrooms, a library facility, provide a rich supply of learning materials such as desks, books, teaching aid and critical literacy support services to over 300 children from the community in Osiligi village, Kenya.

title: Support wellbeing of journalists in Georgia
description: The project will support journalists to build resilience and better cope with mental health distress, elevated by pandemic and recent massive attack on journalists from the increasingly growing number of far-right groups in Georgia. This project will provide journalists with first-aid psychological support, psycho-social support and increase their mental health literacy and wellbeing. Indirectly the project will increase mental health literacy among  the Georgian public.

title: Give 30 Poor Mothers in Rio an Income Opportunity
description: Through entrepreneurship this project will provide income opportunities to 30 underprivileged single parent women from Rocinha slum in Rio. The project will provide them:  ENTREPRENEURIAL EDUCATION,  250 DOLLARS IN SEED MONEY,  MENTORING ON THEIR MICROBUSINESSES and 9 MONTHS OF FOOD SUPPLIES.  The food supplies will relieve the women and their children of the humanitarian crisis caused by the pandemic. Empowerment and increased self esteem are other benefits this project will give these women.

title: A new life is a new chance for pregnant women
description: Pregnancy can be the most wonderful thing for a woman, but when the conditions in her life are not appropriate, the pregnancy can test her limits and her will. At VIFAC Guadalajara, we provide housing, food, professional training, medical attention and psychological support to every woman facing a pregnancy in vulnerable conditions, to help her reach her best self for the upcoming baby, herself and other children she may have, giving her another chance by bringing a new life to the world.

title: Help a Child Learn to Swim to Save Their Own Life
description: Join Rising Tide Effect in saving and changing the lives of youth from our most underserved communities. We seek to uplift people experiencing socioeconomic hardship by providing frameworks for not only education and safety, but also personal development, through swimming.

title: Treatment for 74 children with Muscular Dystrophy
description: Our mission is to provide comprehensive health care, as well as emotional and spiritual support for patients with Duchenne or Becker muscular dystrophy and their families, improving their quality of life; involving parents, doctors, volunteers and society in our organization.  The raised funds will be used for:   Medical consultations.   Psychological and end-of life counseling services for the patients and their families.  Medicines

title: Social Health Initiatives in North Carolina
description: There is no mental health without social health. This project engages communities for the meaningful social connections proven to reduce deaths of despair (overdoses and suicides). Free of charge services include facilitated socials, trauma-informed groups, alternative recovery meetings, communication training retreats & courses, and matching individuals for service opportunities among neighbors. These peer-led initiatives will impact 3500 individuals in Asheville, NC and surrounding rural WNC.

title: Help Rural Costa Rica School Kids Get Back Outside
description: This project will ensure rural Costa Rican children can safely return to their varied "outdoor classrooms" and continue their biological and environmental education in Area de Conservacion Guanacaste (ACG), in northwestern Costa Rica, by supplying Covid-19 protection products and by replacing worn and outdated equipment, such as binoculars used in the field, and microscopes used in the local classroom laboratory.

title: Protect rights of refugee families on EUs Border
description: Northern Lights Aid works to provide food, material aid, and employability support to forcibly displaced families in the Asimakopoulou Refugee Camp.  As the situation for refugees in Greece is worsening, we need your help to support families with food and proper nutrition for their babies.  Around 60% of displaced people on the Greek Mainland have been deprived of food and cash assistance and need urgent support.  We ask you to provide whatever you can, every donation helps. Happy Holidays!

title: Help Rural Girls get to Secondary Education
description: In Pakistan, girls suffer from huge disparity of opportunities to access the education at post primary level. The biggest barrier to girls' education is the long-distance schools in the absence of a local transport facility. Friends Welfare Association (FWA) proposes to provide a second School Van to School Management Committee (SMC) of Girls' Secondary School Meilbut as the one vehicle already provided to SMC Meilbut is now insufficient to provide service to  300 girls of the said school.

title: Child Protection in Streets of Mwanza in Tanzania
description: This project will help 196 children living and working in the street of Mwanza to go back home and live with their safe families and help and help 260 children roaming in the street during day time to stay home with their families.

title: Matungu Vertical micro gardening - Kenya project .
description: Vertical micro gardening (VMG) project is focusing its efforts to ensure that vulnerable members of the community in western kanya-Kakamega county have access to quality and highly nutritious food and improve their general hygiene standards to keep them as safe as possible from the covid-19 virus. This virus has deeply affected the elderly and terminally ill patients with Hiv / Aids and this initiative which we are working on seeks to help them fight the pandemic by providing needed food .

title: Livestock Value Chain of 500 farmers in Bangladesh
description: The Project will be implemented at two unions in Faridpur District of Bangladesh.Under the project; increasing livestock productivity and quality of marginal and small farmers, with special focus to women farmers of char island and integrating them with the regional value chain for improved livelihood through enhanced economic and social benefits through facilitate adoption of improve feed, fodder and technology practices to increase milk production,developing milk collection and marketing.

title: Support 30 girls to break the cycle of violence
description: This project will engage 30 Rwandan girls in an in-depth, capacity building experience over 6 months, where they will learn about gender equality, violence, leadership, sexual and reproductive health, consent, healthy relationships and community development. Led by Rwandan women mentors, girls receive 50+ hours of training, execute 5 community projects in small teams, and develop a club to engage other youth and adults to break the intergenerational cycle of gender discrimination and violence.

title: Make every moment count at Children's Hospice
description: "At Martin House, we saw pure joy and happiness - it was like a different world. We couldn't help but feel comforted by the joy we were seeing."    Martin House Hospice provides holistic, family-led care for children and young people with life-limiting conditions in North, West and East Yorkshire. Specialist care is available from diagnosis to death, and beyond, and covers medical, emotional and pastoral care, promising to always be family-focused, responsive and honest.

title: Provide Clean Water to 15 Schools in Honduras
description: Water-borne illnesses keep children from attending school and create long-term health problems for them. To combat these issues, DAUSA will install large Sawyer In-Line Filtration Systems in 15 Honduran schools that currently do not have access to clean water. The incoming water pipes will provide an entire school with 200,000 liters of clean water per day, accessible at several stations throughout their buildings. The filter system will last for many years and is extremely easy to maintain.

title: Save 60,000 Sea Turtles in El Salvador
description: This project will support El Salvador's only women-run sea turtle egg hatchery, the AMBAS hatchery in Barra de Santiago, to rescue 60,000 sea turtle eggs and support the sustainable livelihoods of former poachers. Involving community members, especially women and former poachers, in the decision-making process and encouraging participation in conservation activities increases environmental awareness, creates a sense of ownership over the resource, and ensures more sustainable outcomes.

title: Covering School syllabus through video sessions AL
description: The Covid 19 pandemic has been badly impacting the education system for two years, especiall to the O/L and A/L students from rural areas with financial issues & unavailability of enough infrastructure facilities & suitable devices. So, we understood the problem and want to help them to go through O/L and A/L examinations. We hope to cover their syllabus and past papers through the video session with a qualified lecture panel. It will distribute over the pen drive and CDs and website.

title: Support the education of 500 children in Argentina
description: Educar y Crecer will strengthen the education of  500 children from vulnerable contexts in Argentina in its 15 Student Learning Centers. To ensure that no one is left behind, through innovative and effective educational programs EyC will improve the performance of students in the areas of Reading and Writing and Maths; while also providing them with XXI century skills, necessary to achieve inclusion in the modern labor market.

title: School Gardens for the Underprivileged
description: The School Garden project is aimed at empowering underprivileged educational institutions in Africa by providing self-sustaining meals to community members, students, and orphans. This is achieved through the implementation of sustainable gardens. We educate local community members, faculty, and students to manage gardens with health and nutrition in mind. This enables everyone to obtain at least one proper meal and create financial stability for the whole community.

title: Prosthesis -Solutions for life and happiness
description: Hello! We are Suyay (means Hope in Quechua). Our passion is to help children and adults with disabilities improve their life quality. We have developed an advanced and low-cost technology to make transradial prostheses through the use of a 3D scanner, 3D printers and environmentally friendly materials, fully functional and comfortable. We are a high-tech Startup with a social sense, we won recognition from Unicef within the Top 25 Startup.

title: PROVISION OF BUSINESS STARTER PACK FOR WIDOWS
description: 1.  GOAL OF THE PROJECT The goal is to reduce extreme poverty by empowering women (widows) who lost their better halves and are now left with fending for their children. This women need to be empowered to enable them take on the responsibility of providing for their children's well-being.  2. THOSE THAT WILL BENEFIT Widows and their dependants (children). 3. HOW MANY PEOPLE WILL BE HELPED 10 families every month. Total in a year, 120 families.  4. WHERE IS IT TAKING PLACE  poor areas in NIGERIA

title: Helping our HIV+ Thai Children complete school
description: Our project offers our 10 children, who are infected or affected by HIV, a secure and loving family environment, providing them with a sense of self-worth and value within Thai society. Our children, who range in age and educational ability are between 3 and 17 years old. Our focus will be to add to their educational and social values/norms programs to the same level as other Thai children. This will enable them to reach their dreams of a promising career and return to care for their families

title: Support People in Recovery from Addiction
description: The mission of the Utah Support Advocates for Recovery Awareness (USARA) is to connect and inspire communities to advocate for addiction recovery. We envision a Utah where recovery community and connection are recognized as the most valuable assets for people to recover from addiction. We provide non-clinical, peer-based recovery support services to individuals and families in Utah seeking recovery from substance use disorders.

title: THE SEND A SEED WOMEN'S PROJECT - UGANDA
description: The Send a Seed Women's project in Kabale Uganda is aimed at sustaining the indigenous good seeds and utilizing seeds  not only as food sources but also as an income generating project for the families  involved.Also natural manure and other forms of organic manure are use,and not artificial manure, to increase soil fertility.In times of COVID-19 pandemic,nutritious food is essential.

title: women Climate Entrepreneurship Development  SSD
description: ASIMO's Project will contributes to women entrepreneurship development through improved cooking stoves aimed at improving sustainable climate change Management. This project will improve lives, address social and environmental conditions through effective participation of 4000 women entrepreneurs in climate change adaptation by the end of 2022 which can help transform the lives of the communities by improving their health, reduced pressure of deforestation  and climate risk in Warrap State.

title: WATER FOR LIFE - SUPPORTING FOR DRINKING WATER SUP
description: THE PROJECT AIM TO CREATE ACCESS TO: Water quantity: Provision of facilities and services that increase the amount of water available for drinking, cooking and maintaining good hygiene practices within households, health care facilities or schools; and reduce the time and effort required to collect the water. Water quality: Improvement and protection of the microbiological (or chemical, such as arsenic) quality of drinking-water through water treatment and safe storage or by improving existing w

title: Solar Pathway out of Poverty for Native Americans
description: Your contribution is funding scholarships for Native American men and women to attend indigenous-led Solar Career Training Programs. Trainees move on to well-paying jobs installing solar arrays on their own reservations, and beyond. CTSI is empowering tribes to tap the tremendous potential of solar energy as means to transform their entire economic, ecological and social systems -- facilitating the transition away from energy poverty, extractive fossil fuels, and a return to self-determination.

title: Christmas Meals for 500 needy children in Ghana
description: Christmas is a time where Christians celebrate the birth of Jesus christ through celebrations, feasting and showing love to one another but unfortunately most needy children are left out of this love because of poverty  But you and I can change the narrative by showing our love in a form of donations to enable these needy children have a feast of Christmas day in Ghana

title: Send a South Sudanese Orphan to School for 1 Yr.
description: Gabriel was three years old when his village in South Sudan was attacked and he lost both of his parents. While he was in a state of hopelessness, his story reached a group of people in Texas who committed to fully fund his schooling, and his new life began with fresh hopefulness. Today, he is a graduate of Moi University, and has committed his life to bringing the same hope he was given to today's South Sudanese orphans by providing them with the invaluable gift of education.

title: CORE Haiti Earthquake Response
description: On the morning of August 14, 2021, a 7.2-magnitude earthquake hit the island of Haiti causing high casualties and widespread disaster. CORE has launched an immediate response  to provide emergency support to survivors. CORE will provide emergency shelter, rubble removal support and medical assistance.

title: Preservation (30) ancient and rare Yemeni
description: The project is to restore and maintain (30) manuscripts of the ancient Yemeni manuscripts, which are between (800) and (500) years old, and extend their chronological life by sterilizing the targeted manuscripts and cleaning them from dust and the effects of chemical reactions caused by moisture, and restoring the dilapidated limbs Combating the threats caused by moisture, bacteria and poor storage, re-woven it again, restoring the cover's leather and the decorations and inscriptions on it, and

title: Ensure animal safety during California wildfires
description: As wildfires rage across Northern California, both domestic animals and wildlife are at risk.  Our volunteer veterinarian staff are deployed and already treating animals for severe burns, smoke inhalation and more. By  providing "shelter in place" support, animals are able to remain in their own habitat and still be given the care they need.

title: Haiti Earthquake Relief Fund 2021
description: A 7.2 magnitude earthquake has caused widespread damage in Haiti, where the impact of the deadly 2010 earthquake is still felt. There is widespread damage to buildings and more than 2,000 people have been killed. GlobalGiving is working closely with our partners on the ground to get emergency support to them in this time of need. Your donation will go to vetted nonprofits providing emergency relief, water, food, medicine, and shelter in Haiti.

title: Help 30 Yemeni children with special needs
description: The project aims to provide care for 30 Yemeni children with special needs who come from poor families that cannot afford their treatment costs. These children need treatment sessions that include Physical, psychological and occupational therapy sessions, speech and learning difficulties exercises, and autism and Down syndrome programs In addition to providing them with food and clothing.

title: Haiti Earthquake Relief
description: On Saturday, August 14, 2021, a 7.2 earthquake rocked Haiti, devastating cities, destroying homes and infrastructure, and burying people in the rubble of collapsed buildings.  This earthquake was stronger than the 2010 earthquake, which resulted in more than 200,000 casualties. ActionAid has been working in Haiti since 1997, and is responding immediately with emergency support, while also planning for a longer-term response to support those impacted.

title: Support the Women of Kampala, Uganda
description: This the kickoff campaign to support Advocates for Equal Justice Initiative's (ADVEJI) efforts in providing urgent and comprehensive legal aid advice and support services to victims of sexual abuse and exploitation, violence against children, gender-based violence, and other forms of human rights violations in and around Kampala, Uganda. This project will also provide support to women impacted by COVID-19 in Kampala.

title: Hot food and hope for hundreds of people in Nepal.
description: What can you get for 30 pence?  A piece of fruit? A couple of minutes work on the minimum wage? Your daily shower? OR A NUTRITIOUS MEAL !   The Rotary Club of Danetre, Daventry, UK is working with its partner club in Nepal, the Rotary E-club of District 3292, to support the Kusum Foundation providing hot meals and other support to people in difficulty.  The Foundation is supplying a hot, nutritious, meal with water and fruit to over 100 needy persons every day as well as food packs for families.

title: Life Lifters - Kenya
description: Life Lifters Kenya educates, trains, and empowers high-achieving teenage girls from rural communities in Kenya. We work with underprivileged girls whose last hope for a better future is education. By offering scholarships, resources (such as sanitary towels), and training in leadership and sexual reproductive health,  we transform girls' lives and position them to succeed anywhere in the world.

title: Earthquake Solidarity Project 4 Haiti by Haitians
description: On August 14, 2021, two deadly earthquakes hit Haiti.  Hundreds are dead, thousands hurt and homeless.  ESPWA and the Haiti Community Foundation are fighting FOR communities WITH communities.   Our goal: to meet emergency needs in the 13 Grand'Anse communes: Water supplies,  medical supplies, food, temporary housing/tents.    Our priorities: remote villages that don't get aid and more vulnerable populations: pregnant women, children, elderly, disabled. Hoping to serve 15,000 to 20,000 people.

title: Afghanistan Emergency Fund
description: Across Afghanistan, thousands of civilians have been killed, forced from their homes, or denied basic rights under the Taliban's return to power. Families, communities, and livelihoods are more threatened than ever. GlobalGiving is working with our partners on the ground to get emergency support to people in Afghanistan and those fleeing the country. Your donation will go to vetted nonprofits working in the region, as well as those working to help Afghan refugees and deportees.

title: 2021 Haiti Earthquake Relief
description: Over 11 years since a magnitude 7.0 earthquake decimated Port-Au-Prince, another 7.2 magnitude earthquake has hit just 72 miles south of the country's capital. At a time when Haiti is facing crises at all fronts - a wave of COVID-19 with lack of access to vaccines, political turmoil, heightened food insecurity, and hurricane season just beginning - this could not come at a worse time. PIH has been a trusted figure in the community from 1986 through today and moving forward.

title: An entrepreneur Girl (BIMJA), Tanzania
description: Binti Mjasiriamali(BIMJA) in Swahili means Daughters as Entrepreneurs We are focusing to promote girl's equality right from childhood. We help build confidence, vocational skills, technical upskilling  through hackathons , seminars and webinars  to empower each of our beneficiary. BIMJA project drives increased public and private investment girl's involvement in decent work and employment in formal and informal economies; and deliver concrete, game-changing entrepreneurial projects for girls.

title: UN Migration Relief for Haiti Earthquake Survivors
description: On Aug. 14th, a 7.2 magnitude earthquake hit southwestern Haiti. Thousands have been left homeless and essential infrastructure has been destroyed.     Forced onto the streets, earthquake survivors are vulnerable to COVID-19 and its delta variant. Hospitals are overwhelmed.      Under our UN mandate to coordinate and manage displacement camps globally, IOM is on the ground providing life-saving supplies and building emergency shelters. But the challenges are tremendous, and we need your help.

title: Help for Needy and Displaced Afghans
description: Many poorer Afghan families continue to suffer from economic hardship and poor health due to natural disasters and political and social upheaval.  Desperate families leave their homes and come to the cities to look for work and help.  Many come to AIL centers, offices and clinics seeking help.  We need funds to purchase food and provide clothing, shelter supplies, school supplies, medicines and hygiene items.

title: Haiti Earthquake Response
description: On August 14, a massive 7.2 magnitude earthquake struck Haiti. Thousands of people have been displaced, injured and killed. Initial reports indicate 700 buildings have collapsed and 12,200 houses have been destroyed.  GlobalMedic is responding. We have offered our field hospitals and critical infrastructure tenting along with water purification units.  We are also preparing to send Family Emergency Kits which contain a water purification solution, and Emergency Food Kits.

title: Japan Flood Relief Fund
description: Heavy rain has caused flooding across the Saga Prefecture in Japan, particularly in Omachi and Takeo. Heavy rain has caused the water level of the Rokkaku River to rise, prompting at least 1,406 evacuations. GlobalGiving is working closely with our partners on the ground to get emergency support to them in this time of need.

title: Rebuild & Repair Health Infrastructure in Haiti
description: In response to the magnitude 7.2 earthquake in Southern Haiti, Build Health International is mobilizing to provide urgent healthcare infrastructure relief and repairs to hospitals across the Southern Peninsula. Our largely Haitian team of architects, engineers, and logisticians are on the ground working with partners, assessing existing infrastructure for safety, and constructing a temporary trauma and orthopedic surgery center for injured patients.

title: Water system for orphanage and 70 hog raisers
description: The goal of the project is to pump water uphill from the river using the AIDFI ram pump which is a water powered pump that pumps water 24/7 from a lower situated source such as a spring, stream or river to a higher elevation without the use of electricity or fuel, avoiding the emission of greenhouse gasses.  The water will be delivered to the San Pedro Children's home for food production and cleaning activities in the orphanage and for 70 hog raisers in the village of Dulangan in Digos City.

title: Beyond Primary Education, Building for the Future
description: Hands for Peacemaking Foundation plans to provide education options for thousands of underserved children and adults in the Northwest highlands of Guatemala. Hands for Peacemaking plans to build and equip middle and high schools in nine regions of the Barillas Municipality. Bringing a cost effective choice to the families in over 250 villages.

title: PROTECT SPARROW BIRDS IN INDIA
description: This project has Designed to Conservation innocent Sparrow Bird, which are Rapid Extinct. Along with this, project has prepared to establish eco- friendly Sparrow birds nest (Home) for the protection and breeding of Sparrow. Nest (Home) will be arranged with proper seed and clean water. A public awareness campaign will be organized to Conservation (protect) Extinct innocent Sparrow Bird species.

title: Support 300 children for digital learning gap
description: Turn the educational inequity: Bridging the digital literacy gap for 300 Taiwanese children.  Waker has invested in international humanitarian assistance services at home and abroad for many years. In the process of cooperating with NPOs in various countries, we have learned that food and games are the most basic needs of children, and education is the only way out of poverty, introducing the element of "beloved" while serving is the greatest encouragement for children to work hard.

title: Free Farmers from Poverty & Educate their Children
description: By providing Africa's poorest farmers with high-quality crop varieties best suited to local conditions, and teaching the basics of modern farming, we help them escape the prison of poverty by growing vegetables that double their annual income.  Our unique & proven method has helped 500,000 Ethiopians achieve sustainable economic growth, improve nutrition & health, empower women, & raise the rate of children at school to over 90%. Now with your help we will scale activities to save millions more.

title: Haiti Earthquake Relief Appeal
description: On Saturday, August 14, 2021, Haiti suffered a major 7.2 magnitude earthquake 150km west of Port-au-Prince in South West Haiti, followed by a 5.2 magnitude earthquake also in the South West. Haitian authorities have reported over 2,000 people have died and it's estimated over 12,000 have been injured, though there are fears the true figure could be much higher.

title: Support our Youth Leaders for Sustainability
description: Influential young leaders of oikos have been walking the talk when it comes to creating the future we envision in the world. This is how we approach leadership in our student-led network: together as a team! oikos team has been given a life-changing opportunity to transform higher education, encourage & inspire future conscious leaders and tend to an amazing community of change makers worldwide through variety of programs. We wish to continue this impactful & sustainable work with YOUR help.

title: Help World Central Kitchen Provide Meals in Haiti
description: On August 14, a 7.2-magnitude earthquake struck southern Haiti, claiming over 1,400 lives and destroying 13,000+ homes. Many more are injured as hospitals are overwhelmed, and getting vital supplies to people in need is incredibly difficult, partially due to blocked roads. Days later, Tropical Storm Grace deluged the region with heavy rain, hampering relief efforts. WCK's Chef Relief team is in Haiti to prepare and distribute fresh meals to first responders and communities affected by the quake.

title: Southern Haiti Earthquake Relief
description: Health Equity International/St. Boniface Hospital (HEI/SBH) has been leading the ongoing recovery effort in the wake of the 7.2 magnitude earthquake that devastated southern Haiti in August 2021. After providing urgent care to survivors, we have been working tirelessly to restore survivors' access to care and strengthen the region's health system. Your support will ensure we have the resources to deliver the quality health services survivors need and deserve.

title: Food creativity: healthier families in Guatemala
description: Let's get creative to improve our food! We deliver fruits, veggies & grains to 100 families in Concepcion Pinula village in Guatemala. This is how we elevate education through our food baskets and meals, to visually and tangibly embrace diverse healthy foods, comprehend their value for consumption and production, and to bring knowledge towards resilient livelihoods. All of this is possible thanks to our core team in the community, where they are mastering skills towards food and income security.

title: Go Back to School With Karam!
description: This year, Karam is providing Back to School kits to make virtual schooling possible for Syrian refugee communities in Turkey! Karam Families in Istanbul and Reyhanli, as well as Innovative Education students across the region, will be receiving kits full of the tools they need to succeed! Your support will not only support Karam and the activities of Karam Families, Innovative Education, and Karam Scholars programs, you will empower individuals with the dignity they deserve!

title: Metabolic patient/parent resource bags
description: Our Foundation will provide continued outreach to newly diagnosed families by creating patient/parent resource bags to educate and support parents during the initial days of caring for their child and coping with a rare metabolic disease diagnosis. These resource bags will be handed out at the Children's Hospital by the Genetics Team upon diagnosis/positive newborn screen to assist families with getting the help needed to battle this new diagnosis with confidence.

title: Protect Families in Afghanistan
description: Nearly 40 years of conflict have left Afghanistan with a deadly legacy of landmines and explosives that have killed and injured tens of thousands of people. Also because of the situation, Afghans are particularly vulnerable in times of disaster when floods or earthquakes strike. HALO's work plays a crucial role in stabilizing communities in Afghanistan by clearing explosives and responding in times of natural disaster.

title: Supporting Flood Victims in Japan
description: This project provides humanitarian assistance to victims of recent floods in Japan. As of Aug. 14, 2021, 1.5 million people in Saga, Nagasaki, Fukuoka, and Hiroshima alone have been placed under the highest emergency alert after rivers broke their banks, inundating homes. The danger is spreading, resulting in landslides, evacuations and deaths. In response, we are conducting rescue operations and providing medical support in affected areas, lead by ARROWS, our airborne search & rescue squad

title: Help 5000+ villagers get internet in South Africa
description: Nyara Youth Development is in the process of building a Youth Resource Centre in the centre of Nyara Villages that will encompass a computer lab, library, training auditorium and a counselling/wellness room. In order for this Centre to be fully functional, impactful and 21st Century driven, for the over 1200 youth from 3 schools in the area as well as the 5000 residents, it is imperative that a customized rural Wi-Fi community network be installed for free and affordable access to the internet.

title: Stop the trade and use of tools of torture
description: Activists, human rights monitors, journalists, legal professionals, and others need to be able identify equipment used to commit torture and other ill-treatment in order to advocate for stricter regulation of its trade and use and provide accountability when abuses occur.  Omega will build an online platform to share information about the trade and use of weapons and equipment used to commit acts of violence, including rubber bullets, restraints, electric shock weapons, and tear gas.

title: Protect, Empower and Educate 1800 Girls  in Malawi
description: The project will support 1800 girls at risk of or withdrawn child marriage and teen mothers with school and sanitary materials to continue primary and secondary education while providing ECD services for 3000 children of teen mothers in Malawi. Also providing the girls with continued psychosocial support, counselling and opportunity for empowerment and economic strengthening. Your donation goes extra mile in helping vulnerable girls and children to thrive.

title: The Salaam School Initiative
description: To support the reconstruction of a conducive learning space for children benefiting from the Salaam Initiative in the Boko Haram hit Far North of Cameroon. Since 2018 the initiative is providing free learning, mental health and recreational support to 120 children who are vulnerable to violence. Our pilot learning site was a hut that was recently destroyed by extreme weather. In 2020 we reintegrated 20 kids into formal school. A new learning space will support over 10000 vulnerable children.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, Chinweoke and Hazel have been working with LI to help create & sustain businesses in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to train local entrepreneurs. Through this, vulnerable men and women will develop capacities in vocational & business skills to empower & equip them to escape extreme poverty.

title: Now I am an adult and I need you!
description: Autism is a complex neurobiological disorder (TEA in Spanish and ASD autism spectrum disorder, in English); the condition of ASD is not a disease, but a complex alteration product of a variation in neuronal development, which affects brain function. As a result, we notice significant difficulties in interacting and communicating. Race, sex, social position are not the only issues and there is still no cure, but they require Psycho-educational Therapeutic Treatment to maintain their quality life.

title: Making Happy Tails for Street Dogs in Rwanda
description: Welfare for Animals Guild Rwanda is the only organisation working exclusively to help street dogs in Rwanda. Through our Rescue, Rehabilitate and Rehome model, using foster homes and our small shelter space, rescued dogs receive food, veterinary care, love and socialisation until they are adopted. We also do emergency rescue work and carry out community spays and neuters. The core of our mission is that every dog, regardless of age, breed or sex receives equal investment of resources and care.

title: ABC Health Foundation
description: ABC Health Foundation is daily impacting the lives of Albanians through primary healthcare, medical education and community health. This project will help fund our Cancer Care Center, Family Physician Residency Program for Albanian doctors,  as well as enable us to serve more patients in poor communities throughout Albania.

title: Build a Bridge in Htee Whr Mu, Myanmar
description: This project will build a bridge to allow the Myanmar rural village of Htee Whr Mu, with an isolated population of 335 individuals in 78 households, to access other villages and towns for commerce, health care and economic opportunities.  The Shanta Foundation empowers villagers to determine their own needs and solve their own problems. The village's collective decision to build this bridge will empower the villagers of Htee Whr Mu to further their goal of sustainably improving their lives.

title: Addressing Humanitarian Needs in Lebanon
description: Lebanon is once again reeling from a fuel tanker exploding in Akkar, killing at least 28 people and injuring 79 others. This tragedy comes as the country is in the throes of a devastating economic crisis. The situation has affected the population on all levels and most notably on the access to essential commodities, including medication. To address this need, International Medical Corps is working to provide critical medications, medical supplies and healthcare services.

title: Save Child Leukemia Patients in Yemen
description: Leukemia Treatment Center in Sanaa revealed an increase in cases of leukemia patients among children from 300 to 700 cases. The center's director said that since its opening in 2014, the center has received about "1000" cases, 400 cases are frequently in the center, stressing that 30% of the cases died as a result of their delay in treatment and also as a result of the ongoing war, lack of medicine, and blockade that prevented them from receiving treatment abroad.

title: Venezuelan Refugees and Migrants Need Urgent Aid
description: The number of families fleeing Venezuela is accelerating. Every day, ~2,000 people leave the country, unsure of what the future holds. As the UN's migration organization, IOM is working throughout the region to promote the wellbeing and uphold the dignity of Venezuelan refugees and migrants. The Venezuela Response is critically underfunded compared to other displacement crises. Your generosity helps IOM provide desperately needed humanitarian assistance to those forced to leave their homes.

title: Supporting Human Rights and Free Press for Belarus
description: Across Belarus people have been fighting for human rights and press freedom in their country. Your donation to this fund will provide support to organizations helping Belarusian people, activists, and journalists who are being detained and abused for challenging the Belarusian government.

title: Elephant Conservation through Bee Keeping Project
description: This project will save over 5,000 elephants from death by angry poachers/farmers through creating a natural method of chasing away elephants using bees in the hives. The bee hives will be installed along the crop field and interlinked with wires so that when elephant want to cross from the park to destroy farmers crops when they twist wires, bees will come out and chase the elephants away. The project will mainly benefit 300 reformed poachers turned into bee keepers and farmers.

title: Support our Afghan Staff
description: Sahar is raising funds to support our staff and their families during this difficult time. While our staff is safe, we need to support them and their families as they explore all of their security options in this time of crisis.

title: Build big, build opportunities
description: Build Big, Build Opportunities is an initiative of the Integral Attention axis for girls, adolescents, young people, women in human mobility and vulnerability, which seeks to guarantee access in adequate conditions to rights such as: health, medicines, decent housing, education, food, recreational spaces and psychological support for these populations.  The project will accompany and support the development and quality of life of these populations, contributing to SDG 1,2,3,4 and 5.

title: Connecting the unemployed in Namibia
description: MSR is helping the unemployed in Namibia to upgrade their skills in order to be more competitive in the job market.  We provide the young people with access to a computer to assist them to update their cv's and guide them in the process of applying for jobs.  We are in need of well functioning computers connected to the internet to serve the more than 1000 young people registered on our database, who come to our office on a daily basis seeking help in their job application process.

title: Afghanistan Crisis Appeal
description: Australian Red Cross has launched an appeal to help people affected by the current crisis in Afghanistan.

title: Haiti Earthquake Emergency Response
description: A 7.2 magnitude earthquake struck Haiti on Saturday August 14,  followed by Tropical Storm Grace just two days later, causing major damage and leaving more than 2,100 dead, over 10,000 injured, and over 75,000 homes and buildings damaged in the country's southwest. IsraAID's Emergency Response Team is delivering urgent aid, focusing on relief distributions, hygiene kits, Personal Protective Equipment, safe water filters, and Psychological First Aid.

title: Water & Sanitary Facilities for Ajegunle Slums
description: This  project will provide  clean water and sanitary facilities for  a community in Ajegunle, Nigeria's most notorious slum.  Funds will support the construction of two boreholes and four blocks of modern latrines in Araromi, in Ajegunle; providing more than 5000 residents broader access to potable water and hygienic modern latrines.  The goal is to reduce incidences of  water, sanitation and hygiene-related diseases like cholera, typhoid and hepatitis among the very low income residents.

title: Empower Marginalized Youth via Enhanced Education
description: Ann Foundation (AF) brings progressive education and technology to the underprivileged and strives to instill a lifelong passion for learning in them. Through our Empowering Marginalized Youth via Enhanced Education (EMYEE) Program, we provide technology & educational resources; conduct online English & Computer classes; and nurture social skills to better equip students for success in the modern digital world. We offer sustainable solutions so our beneficiaries become self-reliant & confident.

title: Ensuring Afghan children are safe and in school
description: A humanitarian crisis is taking place in Afghanistan, and Street Child are uniquely placed to continue to supply vital education through this conflict. Street Child, with your support, aim to bring life-sustaining education to 40,000 Afghan children this year, many for the very first time.

title: Open a Centre for 200 young people in Mozambique
description: The young people of Tofo, Mozambique need a space to play and learn new skills in a supportive environment. Through a variety of fun and educational workshops, they will learn to express their feelings and needs, be mentored in sustainable practices and thrive by acquiring new skills that will uplift them out of the vicious cycle of poverty.

title: Providing Critical Medicines and Supplies in Haiti
description: Direct Relief has a long history of support to medical facilities and health care partners throughout Haiti, including during the 2010 earthquake and the subsequent recovery efforts that would take place over the next decade. Direct Relief has provided more than $321 million in medical resources to health clinics and hospitals over the past decade and long-standing relationships with local organizations providing care in the country allow the organization to rapidly respond to the recent quake.

title: Emergency Aid: Help Afghan women and children
description: At this dark time, Central Asia Institute remains committed to doing all we can to continue our education programs. But for now, we're shifting our immediate focus to the urgent needs of those who are most vulnerable. At present, we're working with our local partners to assess the most immediate needs of the displaced, especially children, many of whom lack food, water, shelter, and healthcare.

title: Train 700 Youth to become Builders of Peace.
description: Uganda Unites will set up 35 peace clubs in the seven regions of Uganda that are the most prone to violence. The peace clubs will identify and work with 700 young people at risk of radicalization and violent extremism. These youth will be equipped with leadership, peacebuilding and conflict transformation skills. Aged between 13 and 25 years old, they will become agents of change within their communities advocating and educating for peace to end the cycles of violence that plague the country.

title: Communities Acceptance of Prisoner's Children
description: PAM rescued prison children, provided accommodation and education. Being unruly and undisciplined they were not socially acceptable in communities and school  PAM started judo training from 2009 to make disciplined. They were champions in judo and won games abroad. Yet, they were not socially acceptable so community children were invited for judo training and to use library and gym. PAM wants to continue accommodating 35 prison children and 30 community children to build their future careers.

title: Haiti Earthquake Relief Response
description: A 7.2 magnitude earthquake has caused widespread damage in Haiti, where the impact of the deadly 2010 earthquake is still felt. There is widespread damage to buildings and more than 2,000 people have been killed. Any support you can provide will be extremely appreciated and will help get supplies into the country. Thank you for ANY amount of a donation you can provide and if you cannot donate, your prayers and well wishes will also be greatly appreciated.

title: Help Tibetans in Need of Urgent Care in Tibet
description: The Urgent Care Fund helps fill a critical gap between Bridge Fund planned healthcare programs and mounting requests from Tibetans in immediate need of care.  The Fund will provide financial and companion assistance to Tibetans living in remote Tibetan areas of western China so that they can access potentially live-saving medical care in an urgent and culturally affirming way.  A recent case of a Tibetan nun with advanced but untreated breast cancer required $4000 in travel and medical costs.

title: Women-led, One Health Solutions in Tanzania
description: The Women's EARTH Project (WEP) provides women in underserved areas of Tanzania with peer-to-peer training in One Health. One Health is an innovative approach that recognizes the interdependency of human, animal, and ecosystem health, and is critical to restoring the balance between humans and nature. By improving health and livelihoods using solutions rooted in One Health, WEP graduates will inspire a local movement of change that safeguards communities, animals, and the resources they share.

title: Empower Cambodian Children with Education
description: This project will provide quality education to nearly 2000 Cambodian children experiencing poverty and will also combat the diverse barriers to education by providing supportive services like food, healthcare, childcare, etc. to ensure the community can thrive.

title: Empower The Left-Behind, One Child at a Time
description: Chen Yong is an 8 year old boy and a star student who is often praised by teachers and classmates. However, his parents are migrant workers. He lives with his 60-year-old grandfather, helping him take care of his four siblings. His family situation is difficult, and their financial obstacles have only been exacerbated by the circumstances of the Covid-19 pandemic. Donations raised will go 100% towards supporting Chen Yong and his peers through funding EFA educational programs and scholarships.

title: Educate Her, Make Her Independent
description: India is home to 4.1 million out of school girls. It is a fact that sending girls to school brings social & economic benefits to our society. Educate Girls works towards enrolling the rural, marginalised girls back in school, ensuring quality education & transforming the community mindset towards girls' education. Your donation will be matched & supported by one of our funders to enrol girls in schools. When you support us, you help girls enter the schooling system.

title: Rural Women's Digital Literacy Course
description: The project is dedicated to improving the digital literacy of female students in higher vocational (secondary) schools in underdeveloped areas. Through the development of digital literacy training and employment support public welfare projects, to open up women's employment opportunities and personal growth space.

title: REWIND - Reclaimed, regenerated second hand goods.
description: * REWIND creates from waste a healthy environment by offering a sustainable model to transport and transform waste into value-added products. * Using waste and recyclable materials that contribute to the production industry, preventing environmental consumption and reducing pollution hazards.  * Targeting establishments, cities, rural areas and underprivileged communities to create a sustainable chain of income and resources. Such income would improve the livelihood of those communities.

title: Supporting Mental Wellbeing
description: Poor mental wellbeing can make it difficult to cope with daily life. Many veterans experience mental wellbeing problems as they leave the services and move into civilian life. FirstLight Trust provides the right support in the right place at the right time. Practical, real solutions laced with a dose of humour - help us make our communities thrive.

title: Support for Afghanistan
description: The humanitarian crisis in Afghanistan is unfolding rapidly, with hundreds of thousands of people displaced in their own country. This humanitarian emergency is exacerbating an existing food crisis. According to the World Food Program, 14 million people in Afghanistan are facing severe food shortages, including 2 million children who are at risk of malnutrition.  ActionAid will expand our long-standing programming and provide food, water, hygiene kits, and counseling support.

title: Be the Hope Giver to Feed Orphanage Children
description: The St. Joseph Orphanage is located in Jirapa Municipality in the Upper West Region of Ghana. The orphanage currently has a total of 17 non-sponsored children, 6 girls and 11 boys ranging in age from three years to seven years.  The orphanage survives on philanthropic support from civil society groups, individuals, and religious congregations. The Orphanage needs funds in order to consistently provide food for the children to live an active, productive and healthy life.

title: Haiti earthquake response: Rehab & Prosthetics
description: On August 14, a 7.2 magnitude earthquake hit Haiti causing major damages in Les Cayes. As of August 20, the Haitian Civil Protection reports over 2,189 deaths and 12,268 injured. This devastation, which left 75,000 families without healthcare access, was aggravated by the rains brought by Tropical Storm Grace. Our goal is to provide primary care to the largest number of people needing rehabilitation and prosthetics. We will prioritize people with disabilities and delivery of life-saving supplies

title: Grant Cycle 2.0
description: This initiative helps to support further endeavours at The Friends of Moldova. We aim to provide financial, material, and educational support for youth and social entrepreneurial initiatives. By donating 35 dollars or more, you are automatically included as a member of the Friends of Moldova and gain eligibility to be part of the grant selection process. Email friendship@thefriendsofmoldova.com to learn more about membership.  *100% of collected funds will be used to support *

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, Jianing, Xiaofei, and Zihan have been working with LI to research and learn about public health crises in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to create a public health campaign and community workshop to raise awareness and educate the people of Bauchi on these various public health issues.

title: Enhance Food Security for 300 Returned Migrants
description: This project aims to address issues of food insecurity, inadequate livelihoods, and gender inequality for 300 returned migrants and at-risk populations (50% women) in disadvantaged communities of Cambodia. Project will provide the training in climate change resilient agricultural techniques, gender-sensitive and transformative as well as peacebuilding. Project will distribute vegetable seeds, fish fingerlings, farming tools, chickens, etc. to households to produce food to meet the family's need.

title: Cross-border investigative journalism from Japan
description: As governments, corporations, and criminals increasingly work across borders, so too must the journalists who investigate them. Tansa, an investigative newsroom based in Tokyo, collaborates with journalists around the world to hold Japan's powerful to account, whether at home or over the horizon. Our cross-border investigations cover topics such as dirty energy, public health, fraud, and rights abuses in supply chains. This project supports reporting costs.

title: Primary School Khoja Mohammad Parsa, Afghanistan
description: The Khoja Mohammad Parsa primary school is located in one of the poorest districts of the Afghan capital of Kabul. The school building and the sanitary facilities for the around 600 students are in such a desolate condition that the children were evacuated to a neighboring school. Together with our local partner OASE, we plan to build new classrooms and sanitary facilities. In addition, we will implement hygiene workshops and trainings for teachers.

title: Gender Engagement and Empowerment "GEMPOWER"
description: The goal is to improve gender relations between men and women at households and community level in the suburbs of Juba County. The project targets 300 beneficiaries mainly women, community leaders, youth and media houses to become advocates for Gender equality in their communities. The funds will enable TIDE organise gender equality community engagement dialogues, and trainings on the importance of women involvement in governance and development in the family and community levels.

title: Sustainable Livelihoods for Deafblind Adults
description: The project will support 125 deafblind adults to start and sustain micro-enterprises. They will be provided training and capacity building in areas of entrepreneurship development, business development, marketing, financial management, communication skills etc. for successful growth of their income generation activities. They would be involved in trades such as agriculture and farming, dairy, animal husbandry, grocery shops, book shops, manufacturing - bags, jewelry, soaps.

title: Supporting Homeless' Mental Health in Buenos Aires
description: This project will support 100 homeless people in the City of Buenos Aires. We will provide individual and group psychotherapy, occupational therapy, and coaching services. Our main goal is to achieve social inclusion focusing on decent work and we know that without mental health support it couldn't be possible.

title: Habitat for Humanity: Haiti Earthquake Response
description: The project will respond to critical shelter needs in southwestern region through distribution of emergency shelter kits to 2,000 families whose homes have been severely damaged or destroyed by the recent earthquake. Primary beneficiaries will include vulnerable groups such as people living with disabilities, lactating and pregnant women, older adults, and women and child headed households, who will also receive training on content and utilization of the shelter kits.

title: Support beyond Entrepreneurship
description: Women Palante is a 501(C)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to establishing opportunities for low and middle-income Latinx women and children, a historically marginalized group, to start and grow their own businesses.We support and mentor women as they develop their unique business plans and launch their companies as Irma, a mexican mother immigrant, came to D.C with a lot of expectations about the American dream. She found in WomenPalante a "family" to develop her business and wellness.

title: COVID9 Hunger Poverty Alleviation Program SriLanka
description: The end of the war in Sri Lanka continues with various issues, such as conflicts and natural disasters. Attempts towards Livelihoods, Reconciliation, and prosperity have not been successful. The prevalence of the COVID19 epidemic, which is currently wreaking havoc on the population, has been reported in Sri Lanka and over Deaths 7560 and 394,355 cases have been reported to date of 23.08.2021. As a result, poor families, widows, women and children are deprived of daily food, education and health

title: Learning Centre for waste pickers children, India
description: This project will setup a permanent transformational creative learning Centre for the abandoned waste picker families' children in the slum of Guntur, India.  This Centre will provides quality education to enhance children ability,  confidence, learning levels and skills and also makes a part of formal school to  ensure that they do not drop out from schools and to complete their education timely. And also will provide health care and daily nutritive  meal to  50  waste pickers children.

title: COVID Crisis: Orphaned children need our support!
description: This project will help protect the rights of the orphaned children who have lost either or both parents especially the breadwinner due to COVID 19.

title: Creating child-friendly Learning Center in Nepal
description: Dhanushadham lies in the southern belt of Nepal. The Musahar population in Dhanushadham is the most vulnerable and marginalized in terms of access to resources.
