description: Since 2015, Zigen has supported the establishment of Green Eco Villages in rural areas, especially supporting young people who have stayed in and returned to their hometowns, improved the environment in their hometowns, preserved traditional culture, and took care of the living needs of left-behind children and lonely elderly people. Helping people to build knowledge, awareness, and skills in important areas of sustainable development. To promote "village revitalization" in China.

title: Children in the immigration village
description: The so-called "Ningxia has people from all over the world, but there are no Ningxia people in the world." The vast majority of Ningxia people come from all over the world. However, the people who immigrate here basically have no arable land. The main economic income is from young and middle-aged laborers who go out to work. At this time, the family Those who have the elderly can take care of their children. If there are no elderly in the family, the older children will become the "pare

title: Rehabilitate & Monitor Rescued Pangolins
description: Have you heard of a pangolin? If not, don't worry. You are not alone and yet they are the most trafficked mammal in the world! Pangolins are facing a crisis, but it is not to late to save them. This project is to ensure the survival of the Temminck's ground pangolin in South Africa. Providing rehabilitation and post-release monitoring of pangolins rescued from the illegal wildlife trade. Be part of the movement committed to giving these amazing animals a second chance in life. Donate today.

title: Crisis of mental health medicines in Uganda
description: BNUU provides access to quality community based mental health services in remote areas of northern Uganda. Our mandate is to train health workers in primary health care facilities to assess and treat persons with mental illness. Our beneficiaries are empowered to set-up community drug banks at the health facilities, to ensure consistent access to mental health medicines. This project will provide start-up medicines to the community drug bank, and seed capital to self-help groups' loaning schemes

title: Empowering 200 Girl Leaders in Nigeria annually
description: Elara Study Centre plans to expand its reach to at least 200 teenage girls annually by building a standard facility in Lagos to host our virtue-based leadership educational programs, which enable girls to develop a sense of responsibility in their studies and inspires them to impact disadvantaged communities across Nigeria through service projects. Our vision is to nurture selfless and influential female leaders who will contribute to society and bring about meaningful change.

title: Empower Artisans in Palestine through Fair Trade
description: Palestine is a country rich with cultural heritage. Small artisan groups provide work to women, who create beautiful crafts to support their families.  Yet, this once-thriving local industry is declining under decades-long Israeli military occupation, and women's work and family livelihood are increasingly under threat.  Join us to empower small artisan groups in Palestine.  Help us provide them vital services to overcome their challenges, and build a sustainable and viable heritage industry.

title: SKILLING FOR 350 VULNERABLE YOUNG PEOPLE IN UGANDA
description: Why am I so unlucky at my young age? Nothing seems to be working. The most affected population categories by the Covid-19 pandemic in Uganda continues to be adolescent girls and young people who are currently out of school and the home environment does not protect them from sexual abuse, child marriage and teenage pregnancy.  This project will provide tailoring skills to 350 vulnerable young people in Uganda

title: Build a reading corner for girls in rural Rwanda
description: Literacy is crucial in life, but unfortunately, books are not something girls in our program area have access to. Our core program, Her Voice Matters, uses books to help girls learn new perceptive and explore the world. have already built and run a reading corner, with great success. It provides space for girls to talk about books they have read, as well as other well as issues they face daily. This project will apply our learning and expand our reading corners into rural Rwanda.

title: Agroecology for farmers & nature health in Ecuador
description: Ecuador has a deforestation rate of 95,000 hectares per year, due to illegal logging, expansion of the agricultural and livestock frontiers, one of the highest in South America. Agroecology is a production and soil management technique friendly with farmers, consumers, and nature. Farmers need to be trained in these techniques and support the marketing of their products. This project aims to double the direct beneficiaries of Mushuk Tukuy Agroecological Network, which currently are 100.

title: Promote digital learning in 15 informal schools
description: The world today is driven by technology thats why our digital literacy project focuses on working with informal schools from disadvantaged communities in Thika to train learners and teachers on digital literacy. Through this project we facilitate learning through distributing laptops to informal schools and training teachers and our trainers so that they can facilitate digital education to learners in schools  The learners/children also participate in sports and play based life skills trainings

title: Protect the Earth Community - West Papua
description: Protect the Earth Community Project will mobilise children and women from the city of Jayapura in West Papua to collect and recycle rubbish, providing an increase in income to at least 200 households and cleaning up the beaches and rivers of the city.

title: Build 9 internet antennas for 9 rural communities
description: Monte Adentro plans to build and install 9 internet towers with the necessary equipment to guarantee connectivity to the inhabitants of 9 vulnerable rural communities located in the province of Chaco, Argentina, in order to bridge the "digital gap"

title: Empower single mothers in Macedonia in freelancing
description: The covid-19 pandemic brought our labour system in a downfall. Many had to shut down operations  leaving many people without work. The freelance market has been functioning well before the pandemic, and it has been in constant growth. The benefits of competitive pay and the ability to work remotely have attracted many. We strive to bring the digital world closer to 10 women, single mothers, with low economic opportunities, by covering vocational education specific to freelancing.

title: Promote quality and Inclusive Education for IDPs
description: In a bid to ensure over 2000 IPs children of who fled violence in the Anglophone regions, settled in neighboring towns in the West to school, we planned to build the first free-tuition nursery, primary and secondary school to promote inclusive education.   Your support will help these children, other vulnerable groups  access education, most effective tool, to help them build a strong foundation; enabling them to free themselves from the vicious cycle of ignorance, poverty and disease.

title: Vocational Training within Flood Recovery
description: This project will repair disaster survivors homes for families who have no means of recovery on their own.  We will be teaching home repairs to individuals that have barriers to employment, giving them an opportunity for a new vocation and life.  This project will Make Homes Home Again for both natural disaster survivors and personal disaster survivors.

title: Urgency in Haiti
description: Emergency in Haiti. Saturday, August 14, an earthquake of magnitude 7 struck Haiti. In Cayes, the epicenter of the earthquake located in the south of the island of Haiti, the situation is very difficult.

title: Rebuild Info Pathways: Haiti Earthquake Relief
description: An earthquake and storm struck Southwest Haiti in August 2021. A key piece of recovery is to ensure two-way communications with affected communities, using trusted channels. We are working with local Haitian and humanitarian partners to help affected communities: 1) receive lifesaving information and 2) voice their concerns and needs to help rebuild their lives. We'll strengthen local networks, including local media, and restore radio equipment and infrastructure in affected communities.

title: Lift 300+ Zambian Women Out Of Extreme Poverty
description: This project will end extreme poverty for over 300 women farmers. This project will work through their cooperatives to diversify their crop production and nutrition from maize to vegetables. Vegetables are a high-value and high-demand crop in Zambia because 50% of the country's vegetables are imported from thousands of kilometers away from South Africa. We will train them to produce thousands of tons of vegetables which we will sell to large buyers, who can provide the farmers with a good price.

title: Invisible Heritage: Identity, Memory and Our Town
description: Our project is an intervention crafted to meet our community's concrete needs for habitable buildings and viable employment through the restoration of six historic structures in Free Gut. CHANT Building Arts Institute provides training and education and creates career pathways in the traditional building arts, preserving local artisanal building skills for 40 young people in Frederiksted with barriers to employment.

title: Food aid for Women & Children In South Africa
description: As South African's continue to to face challenges due to massive job losses, many families continue to grapple with hunger,basic necessities,healthcare and poverty. Our highest unemployment rate is at 32,6%.  In communities across South Africa, we are provide robust pandemic relief. Join us at  Hope SA foundation in the fight against Poverty Alleviation. Help us combat malnutrition and give Hope to babies, women and children in dire need of support.

title: 791 Orphans in need of food, sanitation & uniform
description: Children of the Dawn has a beneficiary base of 791 orphans and vulnerable children from eight (8) impoverished rural areas in 5 South African provinces. Help us feed 22 families monthly.  Also, our Centre in Mathabatha village supports 87 beneficiaries; unfortunately there are pit toilets that are dilapidated.  This project seeks to restore the dignity of the orphans and vulnerable and build a new block of flushable toilets, children need proper sanitation regardless of their social status.

title: Provide Safe Drinking water for Women and Children
description: SUMMARY  Provide Safe Drinking, Water for 8,400 Women and Children, in (12) Communities in Monrovia, Liberia.Rehabilitate water wells, currently the existing wells being used by these communities are open unlined wells, and the communities are suffering from cholera and other water related illnesses as a result of this.

title: Thuto Teacher Development Programme
description: The Thuto Teacher Development Programme aims to produce public school teachers who will impact the lives of children ages 6 to 13 during their Primary School years (Grade 0 to 7). This addresses the entire phase of a child's fundamental learning on which strong foundations for higher education can be built.  We seek to produce effective, motivated, inspirational, and professional teachers for South African schools in scarce skills.

title: Trauma Equipment for Earthquake Relief in Haiti
description: This project will help deliver critical orthopedic trauma equipment to the Haitian state hospitals and help accommodate their overwhelming need in the wake of the August 14th 7.2 magnitude earthquake.    This not only significantly change lives on an individual level, but will also help curb the social and economic impact of limited access to orthopedics by preventing unnecessary amputations and long term physical disabilities.

title: Workshops on Lifeskills for Care Leavers in Poland
description: This is a long-term program enabling the care leavers to meet on regular basis during the school year (twice a month, every workshops last about 5 hours) and learn important life-skills in group, and at the same time get emotional support. Program helps care leavers to preaper to independent life. Part of these meetings is dedicated to housing, law, health and vocational topics -training, writing CV, job appointment,  labor standards and rules ect.

title: Read On! - Books for 200 deaf children in Zimbabwe
description: Deaf children in Zimbabwe have been out of school for 12 out of the last 18 months. There are no libraries, no online lessons, and no resources for home schooling. Nzeve will provide picture books for deaf children in Manicaland province of Zimbabwe to borrow, so they can enjoy learning with their families and friends even during lockdown periods.

title: Help young lives learn how to farm in Africa
description: ROOT BIZ is a program that will build youth interest in agriculture and entrepreneurship in Cameroon, Africa by providing monthly - quarterly workshops that will provide agricultural skills, tips, and insight into sustainable agriculture. Participants will spend a day with NASLA and experience a 3-hour classroom training with professional instructors then participants will tour local farms within the community for field demonstration. ROOT BIZ is geared toward youth and young adults.

title: A place to fulfill dreams: Corporacion Hogar
description: Corporacion Hogar  will carry out the construction of a Comprehensive Service Center: a place to fulfill dreams, through two stages. The first stage is made up of 5 floors, where 500 children and young people from the city of Medellin will be attended, who are in a situation of abandonment, abuse or violence. We will offer five programs: formal education (primary and secondary), therapeutic care, training for young people, an innovation laboratories and a music room.

title: Transform Mistreated Youth to Proud Professionals
description: There is a clear link between abuse and academic performance. Studies show that children who have been mistreated have difficulty concentrating, demonstrate disruptive behavior, and are more likely to drop out before completing high school. Since 1994, Nuevo Futuro has provided a holistic approach to help our youth overcome the scars of abuse and excel in school. We provide a nurturing environment with psychological and educational support. We are proud of our 100% university graduation rate.

title: Provide Clean Water for a School in Gilgil, Kenya
description: This project will provide the Morop Mixed Day Secondary School with a new 10,000 liter water tank that will supply clean and safe water to the children and the surrounding community.  This will increase the retention of students in school.  Having clean water reduces student absence due to infection from water borne diseases.  With clean water, the school can implement a tree planting program as well as kitchen gardens which can augment the lunch program.

title: My sanitary Pads My Education {Pads 4 school girl}
description: This project will assist young vulnerable girls in urban slum schools in Uganda to access free sanitary pads despite the lockdown caused by COVID-19 pandemic, where Girls always need improved hygiene at all times to support themselves achieve greater heights. These girls come from deprived families that cannot afford sanitary pad (1 U$ day). As a result many end by being irregular at school and eventually drop out of school. The project will support 1000 girls from 10 schools as for the start.

title: Desde adentro: A Documentary Feature Film
description: In the midst of uncertainty and socio-political oppression, "Desde adentro" follows young community leaders committed to fighting for their right to remain in Puerto Rico through sustainable community development. This feature-length documentary shows a distinctive angle that follows the slow path of recovery and the dialogue between their self-managed projects and political and economic undertones of colonialism.

title: Auroville, India: Support a Tree in the Bio-region
description: We regenerate land by planting forests of native species of which 95% were destroyed due to human pressure. Such species are resilient to a changing climate and will be invaluable for preserving biodiversity and recharging aquifers. They also support local wildlife such as insects, birds and mammals. 15000 plants of over 100 species will be planted and protected on 15 acres of degraded land over a period of 8 years. These forests are planted using natural succession techniques.

title: Hurricane Ida Relief Mission
description: Our rescue team arrived to Louisiana one day before the storm arrived.  The following morning we saw the devastation all around us.  The lowest water points we saw were no less than 30-inches. Homes and businesses had their roofs torn away and nearly every power pole had been snapped. The further south we traveled to do rescue, the higher the water: up to nearly 10 feet in some neighborhoods, with people stranded on rooftops. They have no electricity. Our neighbors in Louisiana need our help.

title: Gender equality and Women's empowerment
description: Gender discrimination and violence against women and girls continue to be an enormous problem in Indian society despite high rates of economic growth. While India has been progressing on the economic and technological front, on the social front it finds no change in social norms which result in women's secondary status within the household and at workplaces compared to men. The patriarchal mindsets which put restrictions on women's agency and burden them with social boundaries have not changed.

title: Help Afghan Women Continue their Education
description: For the past 20 years, Afghan women, with the support of the international community, have received education and worked in all walks of life. With the Taliban back in power, the gains women have made particularly in education and women's rights are subject to reverse. This project will help us transition our current blended learning program to online studies so that 1000 students can continue receiving a quality higher education without facing discrimination and danger.

title: Change the future of young high-potential girls
description: This project will provide a high-potential young female living with disadvantage the opportunity to change her future. A scholarship for our well-renowned 3 year Leadership Program will be awarded to 40 young Australians. Combining corporate mentoring and financial relief for Years 11, 12, and the first year of further education/training, this program builds valuable leadership skills and substantially improves the Year 12 completion rate and secures pathways to university or employment.

title: Women and Children Pandemic Food Security in Bali
description: As the pandemic continues, the devastation to Bali's tourism economy worsens. Many people have lost jobs and returned to subsistence farming to survive. With tourism unlikely to return for 2 more years, food security is becoming a serious issue. Women and child health is of special concern. Bumi Sehat has developed a delivery program of regular food packages which meet the basic nutritional needs of mothers and children. We have a funding shortfall to run this program for another year.

title: An egg a day for kids in rural China
description: The "One Egg" project, launched by Shanghai Lianquan Public Welfare Foundation (SUF), aims to improve the health of children in remote and poor areas in China by having children aged 3-12 eat one egg a day. The SUF works with local nonprofit organizations and rural schools on the program. The "One Egg" project has been running for 10 years. According to statistics at the end of 2020, the program supported 326 schools, totaling 246,257 teachers and students, and consumed 24,246,088 eggs.

title: #Exam ready
description: $6 will give a student the equipment they need to prepare for upcoming exams. Not only will they have the pens, pencils, ruler, hand sanitiser and books they need, they will also know that someone out there wants them to succeed; for them to be the best they can be.  This campaign will see 250 students in five rural schools in Botswana get what they need.  Schooling has been disrupted since April 2020 & without access to online learning, they are struggling to catch up.   Let's give them a boost

title: Break Barriers to Education for Cambodian Children
description: Every child has the right to quality education, healthcare, and play. Through our holistic Education Programme, ISF is creating opportunities for disadvantaged Cambodian children living in poverty to enjoy these rights and build brighter futures.

title: Do not stop studying
description: Given the current circumstances of the country the declared humanitarian emergency & the local current Covid 19 context, the formal education system has been seriously affected in the dimension of infrastructure, teaching staff and students with deep needs of education and schooling, and that is why from our SUPERATEC platform we are stimulating children, young people and their families not to desert from the formal schooling and offering additional education to do other complementary training

title: Entrepreneurship Skills Training for Young Women
description: GPI's six month entrepreneurship skills training program provides out of school girls and young women information on small business management as well as skills training in either sewing, shoe making, or fish farming.  The training is followed by a 3 month internship with local businesses, and graduates have the opportunity to use GPI's Creative Commune of machines and tools for one year afterwards.  Graduates of the program have better chance in being financially independent.

title: Help Venel Rebuild His Home
description: After the recent 7.2 magnitude earthquake struck Haiti's southern peninsula, many homes and buildings were brought down. Unfortunately, Poured Out's very own Venel Dona was affected by the earthquake - his home was severely damaged and is currently uninhabitable. Now, Venel is working on getting his foundation ready for rebuilding and we need your help in funding the reconstruction of his walls and roof so he and his family have a home to live in. He lives with his fiance, son, and newborn baby.

title: Help raise Philipina's cheetah cubs to release
description: Join the conservation journey to save the cheetah that is fast becoming extinct in its traditional range and help raise and release 5 cheetah cubs born to mom Philipina at the Hoedspruit Endangered Species Centre. We'll release the cubs at the age of around three years to boost the numbers and genetic diversity of the species to prevent inbreeding and in so doing contribute to saving the cheetah for future generations to cherish.

title: Protect CIWY's Wildlife Sanctuaries from Fire
description: Help protect CIWY's wildlife sanctuaries! The 2020 wildfires destroyed over 400 hectares of Ambue Ari's land. In 2021 we managed to keep the fires off our land, thanks to amazing volunteers and donors like you. In 2022, wildfire reached Jacj Cuisi for the first time. Please help us protect these critical wildlife habitats from increasingly severe Amazon fires.

title: Citizen Observatory of Water Justice
description: The Magdalena river basin, which is home to 49% of the Colombian population and recieves the direct wastewater discharge from 128 municipalities, is now recognized as legal entity. This project seeks to consolidate the Citizen Observatory of Water Justice in Colombia by monitoring critical points of the Magdalena river across the country, training  grassroots organizations in water quality monitoring and legal procedures to protect the rights of the river and other water bodies in the country.

title: HALF MARATHON SUPPORTING MACMILLAN CANCER SUPPORT
description: The members of the Rotary Club of Ballymena are supporting a half marathon with funds raised being donated to Macmillan Cancer Support which provides specialist health care, information and financial support to people affected by cancer.

title: 20 Sewing Machines for Persons with Disabilities
description: Sujawal is one of the poorest districts of Sindh with a high prevalence of persons with disabilities. With negligible job and educational opportunities, the majority of persons with disabilities remain in the vicious circle of poverty. NOWPDP aims to initiate its Skills Training Center at our Sujawal Campus with trades like Rickshaw Driving, Sewing, and Embroidery. For this center, we are urgently looking for donations to get 10 domestic and 10 industrial sewing machines.

title: Support Our COVID-19 Vaccine Clinic for Seniors
description: Hundreds of elderly people across Kenya are struggling to access the COVID-19 vaccine & Kenya is at risk of missing its vaccination target. In cities, seniors are waking up as early as 3AM only to find long lines at the health center. For those living in rural communities, the problems are only exacerbated by limited refrigeration and logistic hurdles in delivering the vaccine. This project will begin by providing the vaccine to 2,000 seniors with the ability to expand upwards to 10,000 elders.

title: Innovative Education for Social Transformation
description: UWC Costa Rica is a high school like no other!  We believe in the power of innovative education to drive positive social transformation. We bring together an intentionally diverse community of 194 students from 125+ nationalities, 82% of whom receive scholarship support.  Grounded in experiential education, our students live, dream, and learn together.  They are empowered to look beyond prejudice and labels and instead connect through their shared humanity to address local and global challenges.

title: Changing the World, One Child at a Time
description: They say it takes a village to raise a child: Our village spans across the globe. With your help, we are able to provide an education, healthcare and nutrition for over 200 children from 30 different indigenous Mayan communities in Rural Guatemala.  Casa Guatemala's Children's Village provides a safe and loving environment where children receive a free primary education, healthy meals and medical care. We focus our projects on families who don't have access to these services otherwise.

title: Becas Comunidad- Scholarships in Oaxaca, Mexico
description: Becas Comunidad (Community Scholarships) is a program designed to combat the school dropout of 50 young Oaxacans studying for high school, in different rural and indigenous communities, allowing them to continue their studies during the current health contingency caused by COVID-19.

title: Healthy Lunchboxes for our Preschoolers
description: It is with much excitement this September that we welcome back our popular Kinder class of four-year-olds to COVID-safe classrooms! In Batey Libertad, most parents work informal, unskilled jobs, and many families are unable to provide nutritious, healthy meals for their children every day. It is well-documented that nutritious food is vital for healthy childhood development, and nothing compares to a warm, home-cooked meal. This year, our students will receive healthy food, prepared with love!

title: Orphans' Dormitory Up-gradation Project
description: It is a project initiated by Bangladesh Buddhist Missionary Society for providing a secured accommodation for the orphan children sheltered within our facility. The existing 1-storyed dormitory has become very old and is in dilapidated condition. The situation is worse when the natural calamities take place frequently as ours is a land of rivers and natural disasters. Already the rooftop is damaged badly and needs immediate renovation. Such project is a crying need to eradicate the sufferings.

title: Blankets and Books
description: Help Comfort Cases secure blankets and journal books for its Comfort Cases. We need an additional 2,000 blankets and journal books this year. Our current supply of blankets and journal books is a challenge to fulfill.  Help Comfort Cases ensure every need is met by donating to purchase blankets ($6 each for bulk order) and/or journal books ($2 each for bulk order). We work hard to get the right pricing and ensure every Comfort Case contains the same meaningful items.

title: Stuffies!
description: A stuffed toy is a toy doll with an outer fabric sewn from a textile and stuffed with flexible material. They are known by many names, such as plush toys, plushies, stuffed animals, and stuffies. We like to call them stuffies, and we put one in every Comfort Cases. With 24,000 Comfort Cases being distributed each year, that's a lot of stuffies needed!

title: Language Program for Refugee and Migrant Children
description: Reachout Foundation aims to provide refugee and migrant children in Bulgaria with Bulgarian Language training and comprehensive support to integrate them into the Bulgarian Education System and Society. Reachout shall conduct the Bulgarian classes in three groups, distinguished by age, held twice a week during the students' first year of enrollment, providing a total 2500 hours of Bulgarian language education.

title: Livelihood Training for 60 COVID Widows in India
description: India's second pandemic wave has left in its wake many young COVID widows, who isolated and unemployable, face unnavigable societal hurdles. Of the over 6,500 COVID widows under 35 years of age in Andhra Pradesh, WEP partner Aarti Home has identified 60 to attend the Leadership Academy, a life skills and alternative livelihoods training program.  The program will address immediate sustenance needs and empower the young widows to create a sustainable future for their families.

title: KIWL 2021 Go-Go Run
description: The 2021 Knights in White Lycra Go-Go Run is working in tandem with YouMeWe NPO to provide funding for Tokyo area children's homes. Throughout November, run or jog a minimum distance of 55km (55 means "go go" in Japanese). Measure your distance using a GPS watch or a GPS activity tracker app on your smartphone and upload to KIWL's club for the event.

title: Wells for Water drilling project Palu, Indonesia
description: Wells for Water is a community development program designed to drill water wells in the greater Palu, Sulawesi, Indonesia area.  Back in 2018 and simultaneously a tsunami/earthquake/liquefaction event occurred destroying an estimated 90% of the water wells in this area.    Our goal is to begin drilling water wells up to 100 meters in depth in the communities that were the hardest hit.  Each well could deliver water to several hundred families and several thousand people.   $1,500USD per well

title: Support families affected by the earthquake
description: The earthquake of November 26, 2019 caused considerable damage to many vulnerable Albanian families' homes and produced severe psychological stress which continues nowadays. People lost their homes and nowadays there are families who continue living at tents and still do not fulfill basic needs. Diakonia Agapes received feedback from affected families and wants to support 10 vulnerable families and provide humanitarian and psychological assistance in order to help them rebuild their lives.

title: Building Dormitories for 100 Orphans in Uganda
description: "Building Dormitories for 100 orphans in Uganda" is a sub-project of our biggest project - "Building a Primary school, kindergarten and orphanage" in rural Uganda. The project is partially funded, and till now we have built a Primary school and Kindergarten for about 400 children. Our next step is to build dormitories for 100 orphans and to give them home, appropriate care and education.

title: EV Retrofits for Clean Sustainable Mobility in UG
description: Mobility is key to economic dev't and human welfare; but fossil fuel-driven transport is unsustainable, contributes to Climate change and pollution. Approx. 90% of urban air pollution in developing countries is attributable to vehicle emissions. Uganda has over 2,300,000 ICE vehicles. This pilot will initiate EV retrofitting in Uganda focusing on the popular, poorly maintained public transport Toyota Hiace. Subsequent low-cost conversions will generate some revenue for related project support

title: Developing Young Environmental Champions in Ghana
description: Solid waste management is a major problem in Ghana. The exponential growth in population and changes in consumer patterns have resulted in incessant littering and indiscriminate dumping in public spaces that have dire consequences on the environment, wildlife and public health.  We will create ECO- CLUBS in various schools to engage kids and teachers in waste management techniques such as reducing, reusing, recycling and composting. We will also undertake greening and beautification activities.

title: Boarding schools emergency needs
description: To maintain the high education quality and to welcome the boarding students, ESMABAMA must now, due to COVID19 and local situation, bear higher costs for meeting  the boarding schools' needs. To solve this situation ESMABAMA and this project must buy monthly for the poor 1.600 boarding students : 23,2 T of cereals, 3 T of beans, 2 300 L of Edible oil, 464 Kg of salt and 2,3 T of sugar and various hygiene material to maintain the cleanliness of the 4 boarding schools in 3 rural districts.

title: Education, food and healthcare for street children
description: Every day, a bus collects the vulnerable children living on the streets or at the Sealdah railway station in Kolkata, India to a school run by our partners, streetchildren.dk. Here they receive food, education, healthcare and shelter. At the school, they learn English, Hindi, Bengali, General Knowledge, Science and develop their cognitive skills and knowledge. They are also provided with washing facilities and clothes. In this way, the children are nurtured to lead a healthy and safe childhood.

title: Nourish 25 families in Mexico's mountain ranges
description: 25 backyard systems will be installed in 10 localities benefiting 25 families with 125 members where 53% are women and 47% are men and with advice and training the families will produce a variety of foods to improve the diet of those who live in one of the most marginalized regions of Mexico.

title: Give enrichment activities to 100 at-risk youth
description: Puerto Rico's at-risk students need to reconnect with their support systems through activities that spark their interest in learning after months of being isolated due to remote learning. This project will allow 100 youths from marginalized communities to participate in unique enrichment activities in a supportive and safe environment. These activities will nurture their creativity, communication, collaboration, cultural and motor skills much needed for their growth and and positive development.

title: A powerful approach to change 46 children's lives
description: 46 children and their families want to break the poverty spiral and reduce the negative impact it has on their physical and mental health. They live in (extreme) poverty, and to survive they work on the street in solidarity with their families. Due to lack of resources - economic, educational, and socio-emotional - and harsh environments, their mental health is at risk. To improve the dynamics within the homes, our two psychologists attend the families, to help them create dignified lives.

title: Typhoon Jolina Relief Fund
description: Typhoon Jolina made landfall with sustained winds of 65 miles an hour. This relief fund will support emergency aid like food, water, medicine, and shelter. After initial needs are met, the fund will transition to provide long-term assistance as needed. All donations to this fund will exclusively support Typhoon Jolina relief and recovery efforts in the Philippines.

title: Education for 50 children in the Andes of Peru
description: Kuska offers high-quality education to rural children in Peru who lack access to it due to financial constraints. With 68% of our students benefiting from the Scholarship Fund this year, your donation will help maintain and improve the school's infrastructure, provide learning materials, enhance classrooms, and more. Your support will enable us to continue our mission of making education accessible and affordable to all children, regardless of their socioeconomic background.

title: Help us rescue the Feminaria Library
description: Tierra Violeta is a feminist cultural center that hosts the Feminaria Library, which is unique in Latin America. It has a collection fo 21000 books dating from the XIX century to date. During the COVID 19 pandemics we've suffered two major floodings that caused severe damage to our documents, computers and many books We are in need of urgent help to recover part of the damaged materials. If we don't act now we will lose for good valuable materials that are unavailable in other libraries

title: Bridging the digital gap for homeless people
description: This project will fund a Digital Lab for homeless people in Buenos Aires, with the main goal of bridging the digital gap between them and the rest of Buenos Aires' citizens. The digital skills that will be taught in this Lab will contribute to the process of getting out of the streets through decent, required and actual jobs.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, Alia, Sana, Rameen, Shilvi, Srija, and Priyanka have been working with LI to help create & sustain businesses in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to train local entrepreneurs. Through this, vulnerable men and women will develop capacities in vocational & business skills to empower & equip them to escape extreme poverty.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, Caitlin, Caroline, Trevor, Ryan, Kyle, and Aidan have been working with LI to research and learn about public health crises in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to create a public health campaign and community workshop to raise awareness and educate the people of Bauchi on these various public health issues.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, Bryson, Alex, Kevin, and Jayden have been working with LI to help create & sustain businesses in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to train local entrepreneurs. Through this, vulnerable men and women will develop capacities in vocational & business skills to empower & equip them to escape extreme poverty.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, Shivangi, Stephanie, Shreya, and Riya have been working with LI to research and learn about public health crises in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to create a public health campaign and community workshop to raise awareness and educate the people of Bauchi on these various public health issues.

title: Support The Lives of Those Who Support Ours
description: Over the years we've improved the management of over 2.5 million hectares of marine protected area, a further 1,000 hectares of Ipo Watershed, main source of water for Metro Manila, and brought environmental education to 1,093,586 students in our effort to inspire the next generation of environmental leaders. In 2020 alone we reached out to almost 4,000 farmers and over 6,000 fishers, and oversaw the passing of 2 sustainable banking policies to pave the way for more wins for the environment.

title: Livelihood for 21 fishing communities in the PH
description: WWF-Philippines has been working on two handline yellowfin tuna Fishery Improvement Projects (FIPs) in Lagonoy Gulf and Mindoro Strait areas since 2011 and has a deep and strong relationship with the local fishing communities. WWF-Philippines has held a series of training on tuna value-adding and processing. These trainings are meant to enable women to start their own small businesses and add value to the tuna caught in the area.

title: Environmental Education for Filipino Children
description: Filipino children will learn from our biodiversity and conservation module where they will be taught about the interrelationships of various components in the environment, as well as different wildlife species and their habitats. At a young age, they will learn to appreciate the role of the environment in the different aspects of their lives and be encouraged to take the initiative to protect the environment, their fellow Filipinos, and their country.

title: Acapulco Mexico Earthquake Relief Fund
description: On Sept. 7, 2021, a 7.0M earthquake near Acapulco, Mexico caused widespread damage. This relief fund will support emergency aid like food, water, medicine, and shelter. After initial needs are met, the fund will transition to provide long-term assistance as needed. All donations to this fund will exclusively support relief and recovery efforts in the region.

title: Grow Resilience: Cultivating Healthier Communities
description: Grow Resilience is Urban Harvest's strategy to respond to COVID-19 and ensure all Houstonians stay healthy, active & nutritiously fed. With your support, we will sustain the largest farmers market in our region including 110 hard-hit local farms & small businesses while offering a safe way for community members to access food; reach 19,500 Houstonians with organic gardening and nutrition education at no cost, and match SNAP benefits dollar-for-dollar on fresh produce at farmers markets citywide.

title: Help Afghan Refugees Resettle in America
description: Through MALA's national network, there are hundreds of Afghan-Americans from the diaspora communities. Many of their families fled Afghanistan, while many still remain in danger.  We have identified one family who have recently relocated to Texas, and are in need urgent financial assistance to secure housing, employment, transportation, and to pay for basic needs such as toiletries, diapers, and legal assistance.

title: Endowment Fund of NDF Pakistan
description: NDF Pakistan has established an Endowment Fund to park donations, savings in the restricted bank account.  An endowment fund is an investment portfolio with the initial capital deriving from donations. Typically, the principal value of an endowment fund is kept intact, while the investment income can be used for certain purposes, like recurring cost of core staff & the program. The Endowment Fund is sustainability of the organization to generate revenue permanently.

title: Donate for Disabled People Organizations Training
description: NDF develops capacity of office bearers of Disabled People Organizations (DPOs) for the protection of disability rights. It is unfortunate that the organizations working for the rights of people with disabilities but lack adequate capacity and resources to help their target groups. The DPOs are weak in decision making, exploring, identifying, utilizing and mobilizing local resources. NDF will develop DPO's capacity through training & sub-grants to implement social action projects.

title: Help 20 poorest families overcome Covid-19 crisis
description: The Covid-19 crisis in Ho Chi Minh city has left many poor, urban families without a way to make a living. This project helps the most precarious families, with mothers engaged in prostitution, recover stability and eliminate the risk of their children leaving school early. We do this through holistic support, including food packages and hygiene kits, health insurance, medicine, school fees for children, and regular staff visits to identify their challenges and quickly provide effective support.

title: Combating violence against children in France
description: In France, since 2014, CAMELEON has been conducting awareness workshops on children's rights and international solidarity for pupils from primary to high school. We consider that it is essential for young people to know their rights in order to be better protected, including on the Internet and social networks, and to be active players in society. We have developed a global approach to preventing violence, offering modules to teachers and parents, informing the general public and institutions.

title: Feeding the Hungry
description: Your generosity will help communities in Guatemala with a continuous source of food provided by local farmers, restaurants, and your GOD'S CHILD Project.  100% of your donation will support the families of our project with access to healthy and sustainable food.

title: Training 1000 girls in computer science in Togo
description: The project consists of the training and mentoring of 1000 girls between the ages of 10 and 25 in basic computer science, robotics, artificial intelligence and programming. After the training, they will be placed in companies for professional internships and those who want to create their own company or continue their studies in high schools, will all be financially supported.

title: Help Afghanistan
description: The United Nations estimates that approximately 550,780 people across Afghanistan are currently displaced and without shelter, food and water.   Therefore, Hagar will focus on providing 4 key relief activities for 13,000 people over the coming months: (1) food provisions for vulnerable families; (2) providing a mobile clinic & healthcare; (3) shelter for displaced children; (4) safe spaces where children can continue to play and attend school.

title: Together to Reduce Hunger
description: Vulnerable families in Lebanon are suffering from the price rocketing of essential food items as well as long hours' power outage leading many to skip their basic meals. Therefore AICA used the Global Giving's donation to rehabilitate the community "House of Wisdom Kitchen - HOWK" and is selling hot cooked meals for underprivileged families who cannot afford to buy for 0.15USD$/meal making beneficiaries buy, even with minimal cost, instead of having meals for free preserving their dignity.

title: Health service is a right for every child
description: The idea of the project is to conduct free surgeries in Union of Health Work Committees' (UHWC) health facilities for about 100 children of patients registered on the waiting lists in the Ministry of Health (MoH) out of 3000 registered patients, who are waiting for their turn for a period that may exceed 12 months due to the deterioration in the health services provided in the MoH as a result of the unjust siege, repeated Israeli military escalations and Palestinian political internal division.

title: Food & Medicine for Orphans in Kenya with AIDS
description: Raising money to feed, clothe, educate, house, and provide medical assistance for orphans in Kenya. Each of the orphans is between one and eighteen years old and has AIDS. Our main challenge is to maintain the health of the children since they all have AIDS. Medicine is expensive. The solution is to increase awareness of our need and hope for donations. We are also applying for government grants. The long-term impact of all this is to save lives and help our children become productive citizens

title: Armath Engineering Labs in Schools
description: At Armath Engineering Laboratories kids aged 10-18 are introduced to science, technology, engineering, and math education through interactive after-school classes, exciting competitions, innovative camps, and more.  Education programs of Armath engineering laboratories are based on advanced learning methodologies and tools, a leading research and education institution in the fields of physical sciences and engineering. In 2022 we have 641 engineering laboratories in the world.

title: HELP 100 GIRLS AND BOYS  COMPLETE HIGH SCHOOL
description: This Project will help girls and boys by providing education , literacy, advocacy in the community ,reduce the drop out rate and help more young people be economically empowered. The community growth and achievement is depends on one of these boys and girls education  and provision of social enterprise alleviation of poverty High school completion is a huge milestone to income opportunity for their families.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, Noella, Rohan, Joy, Danika, and Camila have been working with LI to help create & sustain businesses in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to train local entrepreneurs. Through this, vulnerable men and women will develop capacities in vocational & business skills to empower & equip them to escape extreme poverty.

title: Support the Rainforest Guardians in Sri Lanka
description: Rainforest Guardians are full-time community based rangers employed to monitor and safeguard the conservation forests currently under Rainforest Protectors Trust and surrounding protected forest reserves. Threats to the forests such as encroachment, illegal felling of trees, poaching, fire hazards, smuggling of protected species will be addressed by Rainforest Guardians. Additionally, these guardians will also be engaging in the removal of invasive species and reforestation as necessary.

title: Mexico Landslide Relief Fund
description: On Sep 10, 2021, heavy rain caused a large landslide in a residential area near Calle Legion Aconcahuac and Ixpomalin, west of Mexico City. This relief fund will support emergency aid like food, water, medicine, and shelter. After initial needs are met, the fund will transition to provide long-term assistance as needed. All donations to this fund will exclusively support relief and recovery efforts in the region.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, Bryson, Alex, Kevin, and Jayden have been working with LI to help create & sustain businesses in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to train local entrepreneurs. Through this, vulnerable men and women will develop capacities in vocational & business skills to empower & equip them to escape extreme poverty.

title: Decent housing for construction foremen -Antioquia
description: The master builder beneficiary of the ParaConstruir Foundation develops his trade independently, in addition, his income is basically from day to day, his families are large, which hinders the economic solvency of the home, therefore, it does not allow to have a programmed saving to make improvements or endowment of your home. This project will contribute to the possession of a decent home, transforming the social and family environment of the master builder.

title: Winter Appeal For Syrian Refugees
description: This an URGENT appeal to secure the most important winter necessities and medicine for Syrian displaced families in North of Syria.  Winter clothes for children include: underwear, a jacket, pants, a sweater, socks, a wool hat, a scarf and shoes, with a total cost of 60$ per child.  Other winter necessities include: blankets, rugs, insulation sheets for tents at a cost of $50 per family.  We aim to cover 6000 prescriptions of the most requested winter medicine at a cost of $10 per prescription.

title: Consolidating youth education and health in Petare
description: This project provides comprehensive care in the area of education, nutrition and health to 165 out-of-school children and adolescents in two alternative schools located in the Petare neighborhood, in the midst of a pandemic that has worsened their socioeconomic situation.

title: EmPOWER Education in Rural Philippines
description: To bridge the literacy gap in rural Philippines, the Solar Village Foundation aims to provide solar power to education and learning facilities. This project will provide solar-powered printers to 10 isolated schools, and training teachers and village-based technicians, to maintain, and repair the systems. With the effects of the pandemic on education, these systems will ensure that students and teachers have access to light, printer systems, and charging for phones and educational equipment.

title: La Palma Volcano Relief Fund
description: A volcano has erupted on the island of La Palma in the Canary Islands, spewing lava from two fissures with eight mouths. This relief fund will support emergency aid like food, water, medicine, and shelter. After initial needs are met, the fund will transition to provide long-term assistance as needed. All donations to this fund will exclusively support relief and recovery efforts in the region.

title: COVID-19 Recovery Project in the Philippines
description: This project aims to help poor and vulnerable Filipinos recover from the physical, economic, educational, socio-emotional, and environmental effects of the COVID-19 pandemic. This will be achieved through the following project components:  1) Humanitarian Assistance for COVID-19 Affected Families & Frontliners 2) Mental Health Sessions for Families and Communities 3) Community Pandemic Control Initiatives 4) Distance Learning Support for Learners 5) Livelihood Assistance for Communities

title: Preventing 5000 children from drowning in Cambodia
description: Helpcode plans to prevent 5.000 children from drowning in Cambodia by teaching them and their community water safety, safe rescue skills and how to swim.

title: Care for orphan children living with HIV
description: This project will provide protection and care services to children and adolescents diagnosed with HIV or AIDS between 0 and 17 years of age, in a situation of abandonment or social risk and will help our first generation of children who were born with the diagnosis and are today adults in independent life.  La Casa de la Sal invests in the education of this population as well as in transitional houses to start an independent life accompanied by our specialists in psychology and social work.

title: Gol de Letra's new headquarters renovation
description: The Gol de Letra Foundation has the opportunity to establish our headquarters again in the heart of Vila Albertina, close to our sports center. But for that, we need to carry out a reform. And we need your help to make that happen.

title: Rescue, Rehab and Re-home Street Dogs in Africa
description: We get hundreds of calls each week from people attacking dogs with acid to others grooming dogs to fight. The situation we face is real and it is expensive but we never leave a god alone. Our team are out rescuing these puppies as well as providing a weekly service in a township where we provide vaccinations and help manage breeding through our neutering program. We fund this project 100% through donations, you are the people saving these puppies!

title: HELP 100 CHILDREN IN HAITI GET TO SCHOOL TODAY
description: This October, schools will be re-opening in Haiti. Unfortunately, many children will not be able to attend school because their families will not be able to afford the associated costs of schooling. With a crippling economy, the Covid-19 pandemic, the national insecurity, coupled with the effects of the recent earthquake in August, Haitian families need your help and support now more than ever.  You can help send 100 children to school today. Every dollar counts.

title: SAVING THE AMAZON WITH YOUR HELP
description: Yachana is producing short, educational videos by Douglas McMeekin.  You can find then on TikTok    www.tiktok.com/@yachana.com   Our message is getting to people around the world with over 185,000 followers and viewed over 10 million times.  This is raising awareness of our work in Amazon conservation.  We own 1,000 hectares (2,500 acres) of rainforest.  Funds will go toward purchase of additional forest to protect it and acquire better equipment for the video project.

title: 50 Dominican kids urgently need school supplies
description: Projects Hearts wants to ensure that 50 of the most empoverished students in the rural area of Baitoa, Dominican Republic have all the school supplies they need in order to begin attending classes.

title: Support the Clontarf Foundation
description: The Clontarf Foundation is a charitable not-for-profit organisation registered as an unlisted public company limited by guarantee. Its purpose is to improve the education, discipline, self-esteem, life skills and employment prospects of young Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander men and by doing so, equips them to participate more meaningfully in society. Since opening its first academy in Perth, WA in 2000 the Foundation has grown to support 9492 boys across WA, NT, NSW, QLD, SA and VIC.

title: Tackling GBV through skills training
description: Eswatini has high rates of gender-based violence and young men need mentorship so they can be the fathers of tomorrow,  and grow to be peaceful and respectful men. This project will provide professional skills development for 30 young men and vocational skills training for 15 young men so these young men can develop their professional and vocational skills, and earn steady income. Employment is a key aspect of fulfilment and men who can support their families are less likely to harm them.

title: Thailand Flood Relief Fund
description: Tropical Depression Dianmu has caused widespread flooding in Southern Chaiyaphum, Thailand. Multiple districts are reporting flooding, with more than 1,500 people impacted. GlobalGiving is working closely with our partners on the ground to get emergency support to them in this time of need.

title: Greece Earthquake Relief Fund
description: A 6.0M earthquake located nine miles southeast of Ano Arhanes, Greece caused widespread damage. This relief fund will support emergency aid like food, water, medicine, and shelter. After initial needs are met, the fund will transition to provide long-term assistance as needed. All donations to this fund will exclusively support relief and recovery efforts in the region.

title: Provide Early Intervention for 100 kids in Mexico
description: The project will provide specialized services for six months to 100 low-income children aged 0 to 6  in Mexico City who have high neurological risk of triggering a disability due to birth conditions. APAC's Detection and Early Intervention program helps reduce or prevent long-term physical damage, make timely diagnoses and initiate rehabilitation treatments. The program has treated more than 1000 children. Of those, 500 have been integrated into conventional early childhood programs and schools.

title: Better Alliances Better Forests
description: Reforestamos developed an initiative to plant and monitor trees in degraded forests during 3 years, ensuring the survival of 80% of the trees planted, improve the livelihood of local communities by generating jobs and increase forest awareness among urban people, which derives in better private and public political will to develop initiatives for the benefit of protected and unprotected forests.

title: For the education of Tarahumara indigenous youth
description: For the education of Tarahumara indigenous youth, it ensures educational continuity for 125 middle and high school students, who due to the COVID-19 pandemic were limited in the access to technologies and the internet. With the accompaniment and extracurricular support, they will reinforce academic knowledge and skill development to achieve the conclusion of the academic year. At the end of this school year, we ensure that 20 students will achieve their registration to the next educational level

title: Transition 43 women from welfare to work
description: We help disadvantaged women face their job search with the confidence, clothing and tools to get hired. Due to the pandemic, our services are more important than ever.  Our Sweat for Success team is running to support 43 women transition from welfare to the work. Runners will run the iconic (virtual) City2Surf between 17-24 October; selecting and tackling their own 14k route.  We've had to cancel several fundraising events due to lockdown in Australia - please help give our team a boost!

title: TB patients need support during COVID19 in Vietnam
description: Vietnam has instituted strict lockdown procedures in many locations in order to control the spread of COVID19. However, TB continues to be a persistent problem, killing over 13,000 per year, and access to TB services has been severely limited due to the pandemic response. Many families who are impacted by TB are facing unemployment, food shortages and challenges obtaining consistent medication. Your donation will allow FIT to provide treatment adherence support packages to people with TB.

title: Impact of musical intervention in children with LD
description: The main hypothesis is that music can positively impact both cognitively and structurally in children with neurological disorders. Therefore, this project consists of implementing a musical intervention aimed at promoting the development of neurocognitive skills (including prosodic ones) and evaluating a possible structural change in the brain physiology of children with severe language impairment.

title: Impact Probiotics on Microbiota Autistic Spectrum
description: When the microbiota is altered, our health system weakens. In the case of children with ASD, it has been shown that the composition of their microbiota is altered. Likewise, there are studies that have suggested that these alterations can contribute to various gastrointestinal and neurological symptoms. Compared to healthy people, the feces of people with ASD have a higher concentration of Clostridia, Bacteroidetes, Desulfovibrio, Sutterella spp, and lower levels of Firmicutes and Verrucomicrobi

title: Being Deaf in an Inclusive Mexico
description: The project is implemented through strategic solutions: Education, Inclusive Employability and Health Suport, Education: UTECA University Audiobecas, scholarships of  Design and Multimedia Art. for young people in a superior level  who have hearing disabilities Inclusive Employability : Training awareness, implementation and contracting in companies through a workshop developed Healt Suport : medical atention   and Donation of hearing aids

title: Provide the essentials to Kiwi kids in need
description: KidsCan is New Zealand's leading charity dedicated to helping Kiwi kids affected by poverty. We help children experiencing hardship by providing food, jackets, shoes and health products to schools and early childhood centres across New Zealand. With these essentials, kids can participate in learning and have the opportunity for a better future.

title: Enable Better Education of Students in Leskovac
description: We seek to support local education and build the skills of the next generation by raising funds to purchase of computers for schools in local villages and communities in Leskovac municipality.

title: Production Training for Young Filmmakers of Color
description: Production Training for Young Filmmakers of Color supports women and non-binary filmmakers, and gives our emerging filmmakers of color paid on-the-job learning and shadowing opportunities. With support from donors like you, our PA Certification graduates have received stipends for 70+ hours on BIPOC-led film sets. Many of them have gone on to work full-time at major studios.

title: Agavi:  Brazilian Forest Schools Digitalization
description: This project develops digital classrooms-in-a-box for distribution to forest schools in the Atlantic and Amazon rain forests, and trains teachers to use them.  Forest and river schools are small single-classroom rural schools that serve impoverished students deep in the forested regions of Brazil.  We are building and deploying kits with smartphones and Raspberry Pis (plus our learning system Agavi) and helping local educators develop appropriate learning activities and resources.

title: Livelihood opportunities for BT Survivors
description: This project will train and equip 200 bride trafficking survivors in 4 districts of Haryana, with the skills and capital to set up their own LED bulb recycling and manufacturing unit which will help them earn their livelihood against loss of family income during the Covid-19 pandemic, raise their voice against violence, provide education, health and play facilities to their children and strengthen their resolve to eradicate the evil practice of trafficking in their respective communities.

title: End the Killing of Elephants for VN Ivory Trade
description: Ivory demand is the leading cause of African elephant poaching, and a large part of it stems from Asia. Vietnam plays a major role in the demand and illegal trade of ivory. To end the killing of African elephants, Education for Nature - Vietnam (ENV) educates the public, targets the illegal ivory trade in Vietnam, and supports the prosecution of Vietnamese ivory traffickers. To strengthen our approach to end Vietnam's ivory trade and protect African elephants, we need international support.

title: 100 E-Learning Tabs aid to children in rural Sindh
description: In 2015, an initiative began to provide children with Android tablets in rural Sindh Pakistan for schools to integrate E-learning as part of the school curriculum as they are remote and vulnerable areas. Furthermore, 46 PEP schools are using android tablets as part of their curriculum. But due to the shortage of Tablets, many children can't have e-learning. Currently, 100 tablet devices are needed to sustain digital learning in 46 primary schools.

title: Help the Shipibo Regenerate from the Pandemic
description: ASOMASHK, the Shipibo-Konibo Association of Onanyabo (ancestral healers), has developed a treatment and revitalization protocol for Shipibo communities heavily hit by COVID-19. In partnership with Chaikuni Institute and the Temple of the Way of Light, they successfully reached 333 people in 10 communities. And now, also supported by the Shipibo Conibo Center, they aim to reach farther along the Ucayali River to continue their work and develop strategies for long-term care and crisis response.

title: Send A Child To School In Ghana
description: Since the inception of World Inspiring Network in 2016, our top priority has been to provide a better future to disadvantaged children as well as youth in Ghana through education. With the support of our donors, volunteers, and partners, we proudly see our beneficiaries taking new steps towards fresh directions in life. We currently have 120 students enrolled in 4 rural communities in Ghana - who likely wouldn't have gotten access to quality education, with little hope to improve their future.

title: GEC Parent Microgrant Initiative
description: This project will help enrolled GEC families receive start-up funding or ongoing support in the form of micro-grants, to be used to start or grow a family business and contribute to our whole-family and whole-child approach for creating long-term change.

title: Provide Furniture to 50 Schools in Rural Sindh
description: Primary Education Project (PEP) has been providing education in the rural area of Sindh Pakistan for over 18 years. PEP took the initiative for the School Rebuilding Project as a response to floods last year in rural Sindh. But due to lack of minimum school furniture in 50 Rural Primary Schools had affected the learning capacity of children and also make learning difficult for them because they have to sit on the hot muddy ground under the shed to learn and memorize.

title: Employment  opportunities for 500 youth in Kilifi
description: Have you ever considered how technical skills such as metalwork, hairdressing, or electrical installation can change someone's life? At the Mabati Technical Training Institute, our students are able to learn these, alongside life skills, entrepreneurship & IT skills to earn a decent income. Ever since Covid-19 came along, our students aren't able to afford the training fees and risk dropping out. Support our project and empower our vulnerable students to lead better lives.

title: A Classroom and a Soccer Field in Iztapalapa, Mx.
description: The first stage of the main project is to build a classroom and a soccer field in Iztapalapa, Mexico to start a sports and arts academy for 30 adolescents who come from the most dangerous and poorest sectors of society in the CDMX.  The main project in the future is to build a middle school to solve the problem of adolescents joining organized crime, drug use and dropping out of school.

title: Keep pupils studying in the High Atlas Mountains
description: This project will develop a new study centre for Asni, a small town in the foothills of the High Atlas Mountains. The centre will support school pupils enrolled in secondary education who are studying for their Baccalaureate exams. It will provide a quiet place to revise, and help those who have a long journey to and from school to study in between lessons. The centre will house a small library of new books to promote learning and enrichment.

title: Educational centers for rural women in Iraq
description: At least 220  women each month beautification and will learn tailoring and how to run a small tailoring business from their homes. Women enter the course not knowing the basics; they leave with a means to a livelihood and the capacity to provide for their own families sewing needs.

title: Help children get back to School in Akkar Lebanon
description: The double threat of the economic crisis and financial meltdown in Lebanon is hard-hitting the education sector. In Akkar - the city that suffers from severe marginalization at all levels, the parents are struggling to secure their daily needs, and education for them has become quite expensive. Consequently, this ongoing crisis is forcing them to withdraw their children from school due to the inability to pay all costs related to education. Help us lower the rate of school dropouts in Akkar.

title: Radio Education for Rural Girls in Kenya
description: The Esila (for girls in Maasai) project provides vulnerable Kenyan girls with Fenix solar-radio lights to listen to school lessons. Curriculum-based lessons for grades 1-7 are aired by our partner, Kenya Broadcasting Corporation. The rate of girls missing school and falling behind a year due to family responsibilities, poverty, their periods or early pregnancy remains alarmingly high. With the light girls can study or walk safely at night. Girls & their families can stay informed about Covid-19.

title: Support 100 of Life Savers in Syria
description: We invite you to contribute to a humanitarian opportunity that aims to train and educate 100 students working in the health sector in North of Syria, which would make a qualitative leap in developing the health vocational education systems in the most volatile and collapsing part of the world and help in saving more lives in Syria.

title: Parenting skills for 30 orphanage-leavers
description: Parents who grew up in Russian orphanages often have great difficulty bonding with their children and looking after them practically.  They are also wary of the authorities and find it difficult to ask for help.  This puts their children at risk of neglect or abandonment.  We have many years' experience of motivating and equipping orphanage-leavers to improve their own lives and the lives of their children.  We can help them become the loving parents they never had themselves.

title: School for Indigenous teenagers in Nayar, Mexico
description: We will build a self-sustainable and self-sustainable boarding school in the Sierra del Nayar, Mexico for 400 young leaders who live in vulnerable contexts such as illiteracy, marginalization, extreme poverty, etc. Providing them with integral quality education at the secondary and high school level by granting 100% scholarships, forming their personal, artistic, sports, and academic areas, through life skills from transcendence to excellence that are a characteristic pillar of our pedagogy.

title: Fire Management across Australia
description: Implementing Australia's largest non-Government fire program.  The primary objective of AWC's Northern fire program is to measurably reduce the frequency and extent of late season wildfires on a vast, landscape-scale. This objective is achieved through the delivery of prescribed burning operations across 7.5 million hectares covering multiple tenures, including AWC land, indigenous land and commercial pastoral land.  Eco-fire is a template for best-practice fire management in northern Australia.

title: Harnessing Artificial Intelligence
description: The key to reversing the decline in Australia's threatned wildlife is taking practical steps to deliver effective on-ground management. Technological innovations are providing exciting opportunities to achieve greater efficiencies and generate substantially better outcomes for biodiversity across the country. AWC is committed to trialling and deploying a suite of innovative new technologies in our science program and we welcome your support for this program.

title: Join  IP Children & Elders Replant 1000 Trees
description: This project aims to support indigenous children and elderlies outplant endemic forest and fruit trees parcel by parcel in their disintegrating forest cover brought about by burning grass and trees for pasture use.   They  target  to cover at least a hectare per year or more as soon as other community members will join them in replanting activities to prevent erosion and flood that put them at high risks for physical damage both for themselves, their food farms, houses, rising local temperature

title: Maternal HealthCare & Family Planning in Nigeria
description: This project provides basic healthcare -and education in the least developed area of Southeast, Nigeria. Some of the government health system is dysfunctional. Maternal and child mortality rates are in the increase. More than 50,000 people live in the district. The project is integrated with education on Family Planning and income generation projects to promote a healthier lifestyle and a secure future for, particularly, women and children.

title: Providing Education to 200 Children in Bujumbura
description: The Murakaza School provides an education and life saving food to primary school children living in a slum just outside Bujumbura. They receive key skills education, mentoring to reintegrate into mainstream schools confidently, healthcare on site and a life-saving daily meal. The school is in urgent need of funds to cover ongoing costs of teaching, materials, uniforms, medical supplies and meals so that the next generation of children can look forward to a much brighter future.

title: Help us transform Edie's life
description: Edie is a remarkable 9 year old girl who lives in Chew Stoke in the UK with her mum and dad, teenage brother and sister and pet cat Mr Fluffles and dog Sylka. Edie has battled through life from birth with health issues and disabilities but despite all this she loves life and is such a joyful little girl. The family enjoy getting out and about there is a need for an all-terrain wheelchair

title: Support 20 'WASH' Projects in Rural S/East Nigeria
description: The crisis in the Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) sector extends to institutions, 50 per cent of all rural communities and schools in IMO STATE do not have basic water supply and sanitation facilities while 50 per cent of health care facilities lack clean water and 88 per cent of them lack basic sanitation.  Nearly 60 thousand children die before they start school from diseases caused by poor levels of access to WASH.

title: FOOD 4 KIDS IN NEED INT'L DAY OF GIVING IN NIGERIA
description: Every day, millions of children around the world go to school on an empty stomach. Hunge affects their concentration and ability to learn. There are also millions of children-particularly girls,who simply do not go to school. In conflict-affected countries, children are twice as likely to be out of school than their peers in stable countries. Our mission is to ensure that all school aged children have access to school meals and are healthy and ready to learn.

title: SUPPORT 350 OLD PEOPLE WITH DEMENTIA IN IMO STATE
description: This project will assist the aged living with dementia. About one-third of all people age 85 or older may have some form of dementia, but it is not a normal part of aging. Many people live into their 90s and beyond without any signs of dementia. There are several different forms of dementia, including Alzheimer's disease. As many as 7% of adults aged 60 and older suffer from dementia. Along with problems with memory, language, and decision-making abilities.

title: Empower 300 women & girls in southeast, Nigeria
description: Mentoring women entrepreneurs'  project will provide and enhance income opportunities to 300 underprivileged single parent women from the Southeastern part of Nigeria. The project will provide them: ENTREPRENEURIAL EDUCATION, 300 DOLLARS IN SEED MONEY, MENTORING ON THEIR MICROBUSINESSES and 9 MONTHS OF FOOD SUPPLIES. The food supplies will relieve the women and their children of the humanitarian crisis caused by the pandemic. Empowerment and increased self esteem are other benefits.

title: FEED 500 INSANE PATIENTS  IN  SOUTHEAST, NIGERIA
description: This project will focus on people with mental problem and how we can extend help to them. Mental illness affects people of all ages, education, income levels, and cultures; however, systemic inequalities such as racism, poverty, homelessness, discrimination, colonial and gender-based violence, among others, can worsen mental health and symptoms of mental illness, especially if mental health supports are difficult to access. Major depression affects approximately 5.4% of the Southeast population.

title: Help fight Japa trend among youths in Nigeria now
description: Nigerian youths desire prosperity. the high cost of living & low standard of living,  weak economy, social distress, underemployment, poverty, hunger and mounting insecurity are the causes of 'japa' of the Nigerian youths. Mass migration has lots of debilitating effects on the economy and on various aspects of a country's life. Nigeria's large population should be a blessing. The contest of strength is not only a contest of military and economic power but also a contest of human power & morale.

title: Help 100 physically challenged in S/East Nigeria
description: This project will see to the needs of  the physically challenged persons in the society. A person may develop a physical disability for a variety of causes. These can result from severe accidents, brain injuries, infections, diseases, and other conditions, like dementia and a stroke. Accessibility in physical environments and on the Internet, social exclusion, the absence of assistive technology, and barriers in healthcare and in the workplace impact people with disabilities Attitudinal Barriers

title: Train 150 Youths in Vocational Skills in  Nigeria
description: The aim of this project is to inspire, provide respite and joy to our teaming youths. We have a deep and abiding passion to inspire, fight cultural amnesia, and diminish the mindsets of scarcity that have kept our people in generational poverty.
