Our organization is committed to promoting healthy lifestyle for the people but as a result of lack of access to good roads, we find it difficult to engage effectively with some communities, as some of the communities require a motorcycle in order to be able to navigate through them.

title: Support a Nigerian Nonprofit to Buy a Project Car
description: This project will support us to buy a car for our organization. Our organizational activities is being limited because of lack of a project car, as we spend a lot of money to transport ourselves from one project site to another. Having our own project car will surely save us the cost of transportation, support us to cover more communities in our work and also help us to continue carrying out our projects during the rainy season.

title: Fire Emergency Appeal Pakistan
description: On the eve of 18 April 2022, two fire incidents caused havoc in the two villages (Rajab Ali Rind, Tahsil Khairpur Nathan Shah and Faiz Mohammad Chandio Tahsil Mehar) of Dadu district. The magnitude of the fire was intense in village Faiz Mohammad Chandio which took several lives (5 Women and 4 Kids), burned animals, houses, food and other assets.

title: Empower 10 kids in India with Prosthetic Limbs
description: Mobility is more than movement, it's a human right. This project will empower 10 children living with limb disabilities in the state of Gujarat in Western India with our Joshi modular prosthetic limbs and the life-changing gift of mobility. When you give a child the chance to move you give them the excitement of entering the classroom for their first day of school, the freedom to enjoy their childhood, the tools to live self-sufficiently, and the confidence to pursue their dreams.

title: Help Fire incident affected families in Sindh
description: Fire incidents occurred commonly in Sindh during March & April each Year. The big fire incident took place in Village Faiz Muhammad Chandio near Mehar city of District Dadu in Sindh Province of Pakistan. No rescue was available to help the innocent villagers & resulted 09 children, woman killed & several injured in fire incident along with 50 Houses were reduced to ashes. This kind of huge loss of humanity is unbearable loss, it is dire need to have Fund established to meet such emergency.

title: With chickenfeed against climate change & poverty
description: Farmers in Katete District Zambia rely on their crops to feed their families and livestock, but Climate change has changed the only rainy season in Zambia into a guessing game. This season again a lot of seedings were lost, because after a promising start the rains stopped short. With the increasing heat, yields are also lower than before. One easy source of high protein food is keeping chicken. But the factors above even make keeping healthy chicken a real challenge. Tiko wants to change this.

title: Relief fund typhoons Agaton and Malakas
description: After the floods of January 2021 and Typhoon Rai that hit the Philippines last December at Christmas, the country was once again hit by two consecutive typhoons Agaton and Malakas, that struck in mid-April on the islands of Panay and Negros, where our 3 centers as well as the dormitory and CAMELEON offices are located. The winds reached 150 km per hour in some areas. We are appealing to your generosity in order to provide first aid and to make future home repairs for our beneficiaries.

title: Cycle Kosovo for Children -  8th Edition
description: Cycle Kosovo for Children is a fundraising event, organized annually since 2014.  Since then, a group of 40-50 enthusiastic cyclists take part in the annual tour, cycling through major cities in Kosovo, including 500 km of cycling and 6,000 meters of climbing. The money raised this year will be used to purchase medical equipment to cover the needs of the Pediatric Clinic at the Regional Hospital in Gjilan so that children in this municipality are provided with quality health services.

title: Building PARKS Holistic Housing for Women
description: PARKS (Positively Affirming Reality & Knowledge in Sisterhood) is a holistic, community-based development that provides eco-friendly housing using the power of green spaces and sisterhood to promote positive physical, mental, and spiritual health.  PARKS provides supportive housing for over 100 women in the Baltimore metropolitan area in Maryland.

title: HIV Prevention campaign among 3000 youth in Uganda
description: The Project will support the Uganda Government efforts to reduce the spread of HIV, it will also support the Government to implement a comprehensive Behavior Change Communication (BCC) action plan, including mass media and community outreach to effect behavior change and reduce the risk of HIV infection among youth (15-24 years). The Project will be implemented in Mpigi District in central Uganda targeting 35,000 youth in all the 9 lower local governments in a period of 3 years (2022-2025)

title: Cryoguns for children with albinism to halt cancer
description: Through this event, GOBS Foundation in partnership with MULIA Foundation and Herona Hospital Uganda anticipates to raise funds for the purchase of cryo guns to help in the early detection of pre-cancerous cells and subsequently burning them down hence reducing on the cancer death rates among people with albinism. This will add onto the existing efforts of the partnered organization (SNUPA) that currently owns the single cryogen gun used by close to 5,000 persons with albinism across the country.

title: Support Crucial Veterinary Services in Nicaragua
description: This project will provide medication, vitamin supplements and surgical care for animals in the rural communities surrounding Leon, Nicaragua. These procedures help to lower the burden of zoonotic diseases on the community while simultaneously improving the health of the community's animals. Additionally, this project will provide scholarships to students interested in pursuing careers as veterinarians with the aim of improving future access to these types of services.

title: Support Sri Lankan Hospitals' urgent medical needs
description: Sri Lanka's state-run hospitals are running out of essential medicine as a result of the current economic crisis.  There are shortages of anesthetic drugs used in the surgery, hypertension and life-saving medicines, and antibiotics drugs. The project will support these hospitals with the essential drugs required to treat life-threatening situations.

title: PROTECT PETS FROM UKRAINE!
description: Tens of thousands of pets have already been reported missing in Ukraine during the wartime. We need to ensure that all pets can easily be returned to their loving families in this time, when a pet may be all that people have left.    We have already provided 250,000+ tags and registrations for people and pets in Ukraine.  We estimate that there are 200,000 more pets that need this service, so we need to raise $120,000 in order to ensure all pets are covered.   Thanks for donating & helping pets!

title: Remote Education for Girls in Brazil
description: Direction Digital is a project focused in digital inclusion  primarily for girls in Brazil. It enables continuing development of new school teachers in educational digital technologies, community orientation and resources to families in remote areas to have access to education digitally, specially after COVID-19. Funds will provide resources deployed to families with girls from 04 to 14 years old, food and school supplies for the most vulnerable students and develop monitors as village leaders.

title: Daytrips to Connect Children to African Wildlife
description: This project will take children from rural, marginalised communities on a conservation immersion field trips. Through our Green Kidz trips we can give children their first exposure to wildlife, and have a profound impact, through changing mindsets. We aim to fight poaching through environmental education, in areas where children have had little to no other exposure to nature. Help us bring children into Nature, to create wildlife ambassadors through experience, immersion and understanding!

title: Bring children with autism back to the classrooms
description: To achieve the most impact in skill development in a child or adolescent with autism by providing full-time in-person specialized education, coupled with a structured and predictable environment at home. Today, there are no longer COVID19 restrictions on fully opening our classrooms. A child in school develops the skills to become more independent and, in turn, their family. In addition, teachers and their families benefit from the opportunity to work and thrive.

title: Oral health for children with cancer
description: For AMANC SLP it is very important to have the appropriate tools for childrens proper health care, in order to avoid complications in their treatment due to lack of financial resources. Hence the idea of adding a free dental office to our different support that we offer to the beneficiaries, which we were able to obtain more than 10 years ago, where fortunately, hundreds of children and teenagers with cancer from low-income families have been treated.

title: Gift Happiness for 300 Differently Abled Children
description: VOICE Trust plans to take 300 Differently Abled Children whose parents are rural dailywage employers. We will take them to various new places to give them a new experience, exposure, knowledge, and a change that they have not experienced at least once in their lifetime.

title: Be a champion of wildlife underdogs
description: Have you ever heard of the Silvery Pigeon, the Big-headed Turtle or the Black Crested Macaque? Chances are you haven't, but they are just as threatened as tigers, pandas and elephants. Their populations are plummeting mainly due to illegal and/or unsustainable trade, yet because no one has even heard of them, little is done to prevent them from slipping towards extinction. We focus on these underdogs to stop their declines before they are lost forever.

title: Providing Pet Food
description: Feeding Pets of the Homeless is struggling to provide pet food to food banks, church pantries, and soup kitchens.

title: A Happy Meal
description: There are over 450 preschoolers in Kandavalai - North Sri Lanka, but not all of them have enough food to eat these days due to the current economic crisis prevailing in the country. We want to make sure all of them gets a meal every day at their preschool. You too can join and gift a meal.

title: Sponsorship Program
description: The Sponsorship Program supports orphans, vulnerable children, families, and the elderly living in poverty support through sponsorships. This program offers cash assistance  to families, orphans, and children in need to support them in covering their basic expenses.

title: Financial Sustainability for Women in India&Kenya
description: This project aims to invest in women whom are already part of our project, but are yet to find a stable job opportunity. By providing these women with sustainable income as a result of their work in our organization, we are contributing to their self-esteem, family stability and community impact. Check on the right how your donation impacts their salary and lives.

title: Help to Release 30.000 Sea Turtles in Guatemala!
description: ARCAS will hire local guides (the majority ex-poachers), conduct educational activities and purchase nests with the goal of incubating at least 30,000 olive ridley, green and leatherback sea turtle eggs in the Hawaii Hatchery on the Pacific coast of Guatemala.  The project will contribute to the conservation of these endangered species while also contributing to the sustainable livelihoods of low-income local residents.

title: Save the Children Philippines
description: To achieve the best impact, we are prioritizing areas of high hunger and malnutrition rates, such as Samar Island, and the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao.  We provide Immediate solutions like the provision of food baskets for hungry children & their families; Cash transfers  for food and livelihood; Sustainable solutions such as promoting positive behaviors and practices among parents and and caregivers at home, resulting to better nutrition for their children.

title: Emergency Relief For Rural Sri Lankan Households
description: This project will provide emergency aid packages to support rural households in Sri Lanka devastated by a months-long economic crisis. As a result of COVID as well as poor economic and agricultural policies, Sri Lanka's currency has all but collapsed, leading to runaway inflation. Trunks & Leaves is a not a humanitarian aid organization, but our staff and partners on the ground can provide each household with a month's supply of basic food, sanitation and dry rations across the country.

title: Threatened biodiversity in Madagascar
description: Nearly 20% of known animal species and 60% of known plant species in Madagascar are threatened with extinction, alongside a 44% decline in forest cover since the 1950s. On top of these alarming statistics, almost 80% of the human population lives below the international poverty line and communities in rural areas are often dependent on the declining forest resources. Since 2010 SEED has been working to preserve and protect the threatened biodiversity and ecosystems before we lose them forever.

title: Emergency relief for 5 families left homeless
description: TECHO is an experienced organization that works to improve the living conditions of the population in informal settlements throughout Latin America. On this occasion, we are working to raise funds to build emergency housing for 5 families who lost their homes to a fire. This project will support them not only in building a new home but also in starting a new life.

title: Assist needy parents educate a child
description: Sheepcare Community Centre since its inception is committed to providing quality education to orphans and vulnerable children whose parents or guardians are not able to afford quality education as well as other basic needs.  This project will provide a forum for raising funds to help educate the less fortunate children.

title: Stop online sexual exploitation and trafficking
description: Free a Girl fights sexual exploitation of children (SEC). We have rescued over 6000 minor girls since 2008 and are now fighting part of that battle online. The use of social media platforms to lure, sell and exploit minor children is growing and must be stopped immediately. Our Smart Rescue Project develops software that makes tracking down exploiters online easier. The software will be used by local partners who will analyze the data to locate and rescue girls from SEC.

title: Help rescue children from sexual violence in India
description: Free a Girl fights sexual exploitation of children (SEC). Since 2008, we have rescued over 6000 minor girls. We investigate potential cases, conduct rescue raids with local police and provide immediate aftercare, such as safe shelter, counseling, and medical care, but also education and vocational training. With your help, we will do absolutely everything we can to rescue these girls, help them recover, fight for justice, and put every exploiter behind bars.

title: Help empower survivors of sexual exploitation
description: The School for Justice program is a unique and innovative educational program founded by Free a Girl, giving survivors of sexual exploitation the right tools to change the system from within. The students enrolled in the program, get an education to become the best lawyers, paralegals, police officers, social workers, and journalists in their country, influencing governments and communities to help combat SEC through their work and their personal connection with their communities.

title: New Mexico Wildfire Relief Fund
description: Numerous deadly wildfire outbreaks are ripping through New Mexico, forcing thousands of residents to evacuate and destroying hundreds of homes. Your donation to this Fire Relief Fund will help people in impacted communities, including those in San Miguel and Mora Counties and the Las Vegas metropolitan.

title: DIDESEX
description: This organization wants to proactively promote and strengthen a social environment that respects human rights, where diversity is recognized as a value, with emphasis on the development of vulnerable groups such as young people, people with HIV, men who have sex with other men, the LGBT community, among others. They will achieve this through the promotion of sports, positive models of coexistence and collaboration with indigenous government institutions and key actors of civil society.

title: Class Equipment Support for Children with Autism
description: 43.000 of 575.000 autistic people aged 0-19 have access to education in Turkey. The classrooms of autistic children are insufficient. In addition to the physical equipment, the teachers need to be educated about technological tools, behavior problems and individualized teaching. Parents of the children with autism need support and education. Autistic children and young individuals, their teachers and their parents are directly served within the scope of this project.

title: Help women's sustainable businesses in Costa Rica
description: "Employability of women and young people in sustainable green businesses" is a project of employability for women from three communities in social vulnerability in Costa Rica. This project promotes the leadership of women in economically, socially and environmentally sustainable businesses, increasing their abilities in entrepreneurship such as business management, gender equality, human, sexual and reproductive rights, fight against discrimination and access to health services.

title: 10 Women Friendly Public Health Centers in Egypt
description: What if you could have a role in providing healthcare services that are suitable for women especially in underprivileged areas? The Women Friendly Services project enables women all over Egypt to have access to safe, accessible and acceptable healthcare services. This is done by supporting the existing public health centers and enabling them with all the necessary training, equipment and referral systems to meet the needs and expectations of local women without stigma or discrimination.

title: Drill a Well and Irrigate a new farm in Benin
description: Association Saint-Camille (ASC), a comprehensive mental health provider, will open the first residential addiction center in West Africa. The center, in Benin, is anticipated to receive 256 patients Summer 2024.  The well, water tower, and irrigation system will supply 17 hectares (42 acres) with water for cashews, fruit trees and various produce. The larger farm will supply sources of nutrition, income, and employment. This project is important toward the ASC goal of financial self-sufficiency.

title: Feed Hungry & Poor Vulnerable Children in Nigeria
description: This project will support orphanages and rehabilitation centers in Nnewi and it's environs with food items and other essential needs, in order to take good care of the children therein. HIV/AIDS pandemic, insurgency and COVID-19 has produced millions of orphans and vulnerable children in Nigeria, who are left to experience untold economic hardship, lack of love, withdrawal from school, poor health, poor nutrition etc. Without financial provisions, the future of these children is at stake.

title: Specialist medical treatment for community member
description: A young woman in our community of Puerto Morelos, Mexico, is afflicted by  Moyamoya Disease - a rare blood vessel (vascular) disorder in which the carotid artery in the skull becomes blocked or narrowed, reducing blood flow to your brain.  This is a severe condition and the treatment is particularly expensive.  While the family works hard and is doing their best to provide for their child, the cost of the treatment is overwhelming and the family has reached out to the community for assistance.

title: Getting between the Animals and the Poachers
description: Effective anti-poaching initiatives are essential in protecting all wildlife and the natural habitats they rely on to survive. Ensuring future generations can enjoy our natural world and the incredible species that live within it. Poaching is increasing in all shapes and forms and there is no better prevention than presence. The Rhino Task Team provide preventative measures by conducting foot and vehicle patrols, road blocks, vehicle searches and observations in hot spot areas.

title: Help save the jaguar in the Yucatan Peninsula
description: Since 2004, our project has focused on gathering information about local population status, protecting important areas of the Jaguar, and minimizing conflicts with ranchers.  - For 19 years we've been studying the natural history of jaguars and their prey to ensure their protection and identify their priority areas.  - Protecting Jaguars lets us save much more species in tropical forests and preserve the ecosystem services they provide directly and indirectly to humans and nature.

title: Family Compass Programm
description: Since 2013, Emfasis Foundation supports systematically families living in extreme poverty. The Family Compass program aims to relief, empower and mobilise 6 of those families, in the region of Attica, Greece, through a partnership approach, where we tackle their greatest needs: food/nutrition, health issues, employment & family advisory. The families are mainly single-parent with minor children (some with disabilities) facing eviction & long term health challenges, without the ability to survive

title: Supporting  205 Ukrainian  children
description: Children in Ukraine are being killed by war on daily basis. Fortunately, all 205 Ukrainian children they our center sheltered in Albania last year are still alive, but living in very difficult conditions and under huge stress. We plan to continue helping them even in this second year of war with Russia. Our support will go in 2 different ways: we will support 155 children by sending trucks with food, warm clothes, generators, etc. and secondly will take 50 orphans to be sheltered in Albania.

title: Improving food security in the Dominican Republic
description: The proposed project consists of the design and implementation of vegetable gardens in the rural area of Puerto Plata, which will integrate sustainable and traditional agriculture.  Aligned with the UNDP Sustainable Development Goals, the gardens will be located in areas with scarce economic resources and built and managed with the cooperation of locals.

title: Our changing rooms change lives
description: When difficulty comes your way, who do you turn to?  When Anita walked through our doors she had lost her confidence. She had been out of work for 13 years, had gone through a relationship breakdown, and was struggling in a job market which had changed dramatically in her absence.  We were the main connection for Anita as she sought support to rebuild her life.  To help more women like Anita to get a job that can provide a safe, secure future for their family, we need your support!

title: Adha Together
description: Eid al-Adha involves slaughtering an animal and sharing the meat in three equal parts - for family, relatives and friends, and poor people. The goal is to make sure every Muslim gets to eat meat. This year the amount of people needing aid has risen drastically. The projects targets all vulnerable communities in Lebanon considering that the consecutive crises has had a massive impact on the lives of all people living in Lebanon.

title: Providing Fuel Relief in Ukraine
description: The ongoing conflict in Ukraine has caused fuel supply chain disruptions across the country. Widespread damage to civilian infrastructure in eastern regions has affected water and electricity supply, and access to fuel is a matter of increasing concern for humanitarian organizations working on the ground. In addition to providing an emergency fuel supply for NGOs operating in Ukraine, Fuel Relief Fund plans to distribute fuel directly to civilians impacted by the conflict.

title: Save a 6 acre Tropical Rainforest in Sri Lanka
description: Through this project, "Rainforest Protectors Trust" of Sri Lanka will purchase and permanently protect a privately-held pristine tropical rainforest currently on sale and in danger of being clearcut, bordering the Sinharaja UNESCO Biosphere Reserve/World Heritage Rainforest. Spanning 6 acres with crystal clear freshwater streams, this land provides habitat to many endangered and endemic species, and is crucial for protecting the biodiversity of Sinharaja, our last viable primary rainforest.

title: Vegetable Seed Production and Distribution Project
description: We will grow, produce and distribute vegetable seeds for farmers so that they are able to produce their own food and increase their nutrition, food security and incomes. The main problem with food production by the growing of vegetables is the difficulty in getting high-quality seeds. The commercial seeds are very expensive and inaccessible by the poor. We will utilize a 2-hectare farm solely for the production of seeds of different vegetables.

title: Fruit and Timber Tree Seedlings for Biodiversity
description: We will provide fruit and timber tree seedlings of Philippine high-valued and most important fruit and timber trees to poor farmers in order to improve biodiversity and combat climate change. We will also provide technical assistance and training as well as organize them so that they will be able to secure good markets for their produce.

title: Women-led Fruit and Vegetable Production Project
description: Women farmers love to improve their production and income by the growing of high-valued fruit trees as well as vegetables but the problem is acquiring seedlings and seeds are difficult and there is a need to provide them with these in a sustainable manner and in so doing they surpass this singular barrier in increasing their income and providing food security.

title: Palliative Care For Orphaned Children
description: Goals: To provide quality palliative care and pain management to orphaned and abandoned young children with a loving, homely environment at no cost.  To advocate for the rights of children with complex medical conditions to be adopted or placed in loving alternative homes instead of institutanalised care and prolonged hospitalisation. To educate members of the public about children's palliative care and the rights of children to be afforded loving care and dignity in death.

title: Donate for Self-made Roshni Schools in rural areas
description: Education is back bone of Development of every society. Education is fundamental right of child but remote rural areas of Sindh in District Shaheed Benazir Abad are deprived of this right to education. NDF has adopted self-made 03 Roshni schools from NGO that existed from area in Tesils Sakrand and Kazi Ahmed. NDF will keep continue services of Education through donations & limited resources of NDF to keep educating 1000 children in need. Parents are very poor to bear fee of child.

title: Amplify impact for 1200+ students worldwide
description: oikos International supports the development of over 1,200 future leaders & student change agents. With 35 years of experience in over 40 universities worldwide, your gift funds the international team working on running our programs to prepare students with personal & professional competencies for 21st century global challenges. As a non-for-profit we need YOU, private donors, to help us amplify our influence on more campuses and therefore more students.

title: Two New Centers Help 100+ Orphaned  Children
description: In our relentless devotion to assure that Orphans and Vulnerable Children (OVC) in Kenya grow up to be productive adults, NR is looking to develop two new community groups of families over the next 12 months.  These family groups will not only take these OVC into their homes to support and nurture in their adolescent years, but support each other to make the most of their experience collectively for all concerned in these families.

title: Support for Children in Ukraine
description: Access to education is essential for children: their individual development and future opportunities depend on it. The humanitarian situation caused by the war is catastrophic and the need for basic assistance is ever more pressing. At the same time, with children being among the most affected groups in humanitarian crises, it is important to provide them with educational measures and learning support to ensure children's right to education - especially in times of war.

title: Help to feed Hungry and Malnourished children!
description: Children in Indian streets, slums, and villages are malnourished as their families cannot afford three meals a day. They spend each day hoping that they will find some food to eat at least for the day. The food is either begged, donated by a kind soul, picked from the trash, or by other means. The children don't know if they will be lucky enough the next day to get food.  Your support can help these children get three nutritious and delicious meals a day and ensure a better life for them.

title: Lifesaving Global Rare Disease Patient Registry
description: Changes in a gene called CACNA1C, which is highly expressed in the brain and the heart,  cause incredibly complex and variable symptoms - some of these can be life limiting. There are limited treatment options. This project supports the running of a worldwide patient registry for this rare genetic disease. It will allow researchers the ability to advance their knowledge of the condition and develop a means for prevention and treatment.

title: Empowering Girl Students in Ghana
description: Unsafe sex is the largest risk factor for young women's mortality and the second biggest for young men in Sub-Saharan Africa. The benefits of sex education have been highlighted including a reduction in unwanted pregnancies. The Empowering Girls project provides sexual health education for adolescent youth, especially girls. The workshops focuses on sexual maturation, mental health, menstruation, hygiene management and sexual and reproductive health, including HIV/ AIDs and teenage pregnancies.

title: Reforesting Crucial Orangutan Habitat in Borneo
description: Please help us save orangutans from extinction by reforesting crucial orangutan habitat!  We want to raise 50,000 USD to reforest at least 40 hectares of land within our Mawas Conservation Program in Central Kalimantan.  In this area, an estimated 2,550 wild orangutans live under the threat of illegal logging and forest fires, both of which still occur to this day.

title: Mt. Bulusan Eruption Emergency Relief Operation
description: The phreatic eruption of Mt. Bulusan left villages in a blanket of thick ashes in Juban, Sorsogon, Bicol Region, Philippines. Around 2784 families were affected due to the hazardous ashfalls. This Relief fund will support Emergency Relief Delivery operations composed of food, water, medicines, face masks, and hygiene kits. The response will be implemented by Tarabang para sa Bicol (TABI) and with the support of the Local Government Unit.

title: Save the lives of 100 Hepatitis C patients
description: Hepatitis C is one of the biggest causes of mortality in Pakistan which has the second highest burden of this disease in the world. Untreated Hepatitis C can lead to liver cirrhosis which can then lead to liver cancer.  Our program includes blood testing, PCR confirmation test (which is done twice/treatment), medicinal treatment with regular followups upto 24 weeks to save the lives of Hep C patients .We also provide counselling and awareness to the local community and patient family members.

title: Take Environmental Education to the Next Level!
description: The 2022-2023 school year will mark our fourth year of Environmental Education at the Los Algarrobos School. This year, we have created a new position "Environmental Education Coordinator" to take the program to new heights! Jenn, native of Alaska is taking charge and including more activities, topics and workshops than ever before. With her help, we will also be able to take these activities beyond the classrooms at Los Algarrobos and include members of the greater community.

title: Help Build a HOME 4 HOPE for Ukrainians
description: Krzysztof (Kris) Moll is a regular guy living in Osweicim, Poland.  He is doing EXTRAORDINARY work giving a home to Ukrainians fleeing Putin's War - personally housing 6 refugees in his own home and 7 in a home he had planned on selling.  Now, he is renovating a third home to house up to 20 refugees and HE NEEDS YOUR HELP!  Kris, when he's not delivering food to Ukrainians, is on site every day working with volunteers.  You can go to Poland to help with labor and/or DONATE HERE.  PRAY 4 PEACE!

title: Powering Community Gardens Across the US
description: This project works with partners across the country to bolster garden programs for communities in need. From school and community gardens to urban gardens and rural ones - we help strengthen food security while connecting people to their community and to their food, from soil to table.  By providing quality seed of adapted vegetable varieties and the knowledge needed to successfully grow, use, and even market vegetables, we build food resilience across the USA.

title: End Child Labour in Southern Nepal
description: Over 90 boys and girls as young as 6 years old currently work in brick factories in Rautahat, Southern Nepal, instead of going to school. This project will ensure the children will receive a good quality education and no longer work in the factories. Their families will be supported so they don't suffer financially as a result of their children attending school.  Once all 90 children are helped, we will replicate the project in neighbouring villages where the need is equally large.

title: End Menstruation Exile.
description: During the practice of Chhaupadi, which is wide-spread in parts of Nepal, girls and women are regarded as 'impure' during their period.   They are excluded from participating in socio-economic and school life, locked out of the house (sometimes sleeping in sheds), refused access to public areas, cannot eat certain foods and have no contact with men.  This project decreases discriminatory practices surrounding periods, transforms assumptions and repairs the self-confidence of affected women.

title: Survival packages for war-torn areas of Ukraine
description: This project will provide critically needed food, medication and hygiene supplies for the victims of the war in the Eastern and Southern regions of Ukraine. Each package will be delivered and given directly to the people that are still staying near the battlegrounds or were moved a little further from them. Our organization will purchase, package and deliver 500 boxes of these essentials. All humanitarian actions are coordinated with the local authorities.

title: Fund Community Health Screening in Madina, Ghana
description: This project will provide crucial health screening for common but serious health conditions impacting this community such as Malaria, HIV, Hepatitis B, Hypertension and Diabetes. These conditions are associated with a high morbidity and mortality but are easily treatable if diagnosed early. Eye screening will also be available as good vision is critical for individuals to work and provide for themselves and their families. Health counselling is also provided to improve good health practices.

title: Support small vulnerable farmers from winter wave
description: This project seeks to support 100 small farmers from rural municipalities of Bogota affected by the winter wave by providing  technical support  to recover and sale their crops. With this support, farmers would improve their economic and nutritional means, while at the same time reducing agricultural waste surpluses.

title: Emergency Food & Medicines for Sri Lanka families
description: In response to Sri Lanka's worst economic crisis since its independence from Britain in 1948, Peace Winds will provide direct food aid (including rice, flour, sugar, tea, biscuits, instant noodles, canned fish, etc.) and basic medicines for 500 low-income families.

title: Train 500 Youth in aprenticeship/skills in Uganda
description: This project provides appreticeship trainings to young people,they are taught different skills in Sewing and Tailoring, Knitting, Computer training, welding and metal fabricating and baking. Other skills like Paper bag making, Leather Tanning, Hand Craft training, Mechanics and Party Decoration, Environment management, making soap, charcoal briquettes,jelly among others

title: Sport changing lives for young Syrian refugees
description: Youth Sport Trust International is passionate about the power of sport to change young people's lives.  We are seeking funding to expand our youth sport leadership training for young Syrian refugees living in camps in Beirut, Lebanon.

title: Digital Citizenship For Africans
description: The African We Want and the quest to create an Africa Fit for Children. Africa needs Digital citizens know how to use digital technology  sensibly, and how to behave online. They know how to protect their own rights and information, and are careful with the rights of the people they communicate and  interact with online.  In the online world in just a couple of clicks children, especially younger children and more adventurous teens, can encounter problems.

title: Young City Makers
description: The new urban generation is growing up in an increasingly complex world with big challenges.  At the same time young people take the streets or fight for their future in other ways. We need a new generation city makers who find new solutions to urban challenges. Technology won't be enough. A new way of thinking and doing is essential. YCM prepares all youngsters with the right skills to create a better future, starting today.

title: Heirloom Seeds Collection and Distribution Project
description: We will collect heirloom vegetable and tree seeds, reproduce them in our farm and then distribute them to individual farmers and local interest groups. The request of many farmers is to grow crops using their own seeds that they are able to use over and over again and this could not be done by using hybrid seeds. Besides, hybrid seeds are expensive and could not be re-used as they will not produce good, quality crops anymore.

title: Michigan Tornado Relief Fund
description: A state of emergency has been declared after a deadly tornado touched down in Gaylord, Michigan, injuring dozens of people, destroying homes and businesses, and leaving thousands without electricity. Your donation to this Tornado Relief Fund will help people in impacted communities.

title: HELP NINOS DE MARIA FEED ELDERS AND CHILDREN IN EC
description: Many people in the community we serve in La Comuna, Quito/Ecuador don't have access to food every day. This project's goal is to help the pregnant, the orphans, and elders have 3 meals a day. We will build the communal dining "San Jose Center" and secure food for them.

title: Football Academy for deprived Youth to stay sober
description: Don Bosco Veedu Society, Trivandrum, is an Indian Charity, implementing a wide range of services for the underprivileged and marginalized youth and women. Don Bosco Veedu has opened a Football Academy for the youth at MSK Nagar(a slum). This would help the drug-addicted youth to stay sober and shift their focus on more productive activities. Through this project, Don Bosco Veedu Society is planning to provide sport supplies to 34 youth members, with an expense of Rs.30,000 per month, for a year.

title: Treat Cognitive Mental ADHD Issue/s in Children
description: At Jiguar Foundation, we work towards identifying any developmental or behavioral concerns in children as early as possible.  We aim to detect these concerns in the rural communities where there is very little help. Our team in rural Gujarat does screening programs and camps in schools, spreads awareness among parents and teachers, and educates the doctors for picking up these children as early as possible.   These children then get placed and treated by the near by therapy centers

title: Help drought hit families in Cholistan Pakistan
description: This appeal is launched in response to help the 500 families of Cholistan affected by Drought in May 2022. Through your financial assistance AWARD intends to serve the most vulnerable families with food and water supply in this crucial time. Thousands of people along with their cattle has been experiencing worst condition of drought and scarcity of water and food in Cholistan as adequate rains did not fall for long time. However, a large number of people are seeking for help in the harsh summers

title: Education Animal Welfare Romania
description: Education and spay/neuter are key factors to reduce homeless animal population in Romania. ROLDA education programs addressed to the Romanian communities are diverse and include: ABC online guide for youngest pet owners National Study to interact with people who own dogs with behavior problems and offer them advices to avoid giving up on their pets Veterinary advices which people can access online on our website (Romanian version) The campaign "Speak Toto's language" to help people better unders

title: Sponsor A Student at Los Algarrobos School
description: The Los Algarrobos School is the only alternative to an over-burdened public school in Canoa, Ecuador. We offer English language, music, environmental education, a library, and a maximum class size of 20 students. Sponsorship allows families with little or unstable income to provide their children a more personalized and modern education. Over half of our students' families receive a sponsorship. Become a godparent today and support a family in Canoa!

title: Save people in Ukraine
description: "Daruj Dobro" is currently helping people in Kharkiv and other affected areas in Ukraine by providing all the necessary humanitarian aid. Since the beginning of the war, we have delivered over 500 tons of aid.   People were left alone, without food and basic necessities. Kids have lost their parents, wives have lost their husbands, and mothers have lost their children. We can make a change and give those people hope and happiness.

title: Remedial Education for Children in Slums
description: Don Bosco Veedu plans to provide an after-school tutoring program for the children living in slums in Trivandrum. Children from slums are often neglected by the entire school system. Due to poverty, they don't have access to other study materials too. 'Remedial Education Program' aims to aid children in acquiring perfect grades with the help of quality educators and to also provide additional study materials (guides, etc). We wish to support them to reach new heights and uplift their community.

title: Love Is Home: Supporting Refugees from Ukraine
description: PCI Media Impact is raising support to launch a communications program that will raise awareness and advocate for the millions of people forced from their homes in Ukraine and around the globe, in partnership with USA for UNHCR.

title: After school - Learning centres for slum Children
description: BASS India operate  3 After-School Transformational Learning centres for the slum children in Guntur. These slums are situated far from city and where no educational facilities are available. Most of the children's families are living in poverty and are not able to send their children too far to private educational institutions. This project  provides quality primary education to enhance children's ability, confidence, learning levels and skills  and also makes a part of local formal schools.

title: Help IDPs & Landmine Victims in Myanmar
description: The people of Myanmar have suffered the longest-running civil war in history and are experiencing the devastating triple effects of coup, COVID, and climate crisis. Hundreds of thousands of people have been killed or displaced. Deadly landmines threaten lives, stop farmers from cultivating their land and families from returning home. As IDP figures surpass 1 million, HALO's provision of safe passage through risk education, and provision of sanitation items to tackle COVID, is critical.

title: Sri Lanka Health Care in Crisis
description: Sri Lanka is in the midst of a social and economic crisis - a crisis that has hit the health care system still recovering from the impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic.  Families are struggling to meet even basic needs securing enough food, fuel and medicine for their families.  Two Worlds Cancer Collaboration is launching a Humanitarian Appeal in support of our partners in Sri Lanka. One Hundred percent (100%) of funds raised will go to our partners to purchase much needed medical supplies.

title: Life Saving Equipment Needed in Kabul
description: Afghanistan is facing serious consequences of a disrupted environment from over the past two years if it does not receive the life saving equipment needed to give citizens standard health services.   Medical equipment is needed in AfDs' CHC in Kabul, Afghanistan in their maternity ward and general health care services ranging from lab testing supplies, delivery tables, and ultra-sound machine.    Your donation will make an incredible impact on the lives of families and we need your support.

title: Creation of a shared vegetable garden in Bogota
description: The Foundation Proyectar Sin Fronteras wants to implement a solidarity project based on food security and sharing. Our objective? To combine the distribution of food with the creation of a solidarity vegetable garden in the illegal neighborhood of Tocaimita, located in the town of Usme on the outskirts of Bogota, the capital of Colombia.   We carry out this work with the indigenous leaders of the community, who are our relay in the organization of workshops and in the creation of our garden.

title: Empowering and centering community voice
description: At Feedback Labs, our work is rooted in the belief that people are the best experts in their lives and they should drive the policies/programs that affect them. We also aim to leverage our place in the feedback field to amplify and uplift the voices of those most often excluded from the conversation. This project seeks to support our programs and enable us to collectively empower and center community voices in the feedback field.

title: Help Bring 16 Deaf Kids to School in Mexico
description: EEESMA celebrates its 10 Year Anniversary of service to children and young adults who are Deaf in San Miguel and surrounding rural communities. There is good reason to celebrate! Families far and wide now turn to EEESMA to ensure their children receive special education in Mexican Sign Language so that they may have the opportunity to learn and grow in life.  The school's enrollment and service area expands each year but still many families struggle to get their children to school every day.

title: Help to Clear Ukraine Land With the Help of Drones
description: A baby leg prosthesis that will allow a child to walk costs $60,000. Today you can make sure that you do not have to buy it. The brutal, bloody war and the violation of all the Geneva Conventions by the Russian army are strewing our lands with mines, shells and bodies of children who are no longer destined to grow up. Right now it is clear that the demining of Ukraine will take from 5 to 10 years, and during that time innocent people will die or become disabled every day. We can significantly re

title: HELP REBUILD A RURAL NIGERIAN SCHOOL
description: The project seeks to provide a safe, healthy,and sustainable learning environment for Oka primary pupils and schools in Nigeria, where infrastructures such as improved learning classrooms,toilets, and water facilities are lacking, and students are bitten by snakes in the bush while defecating.  The project will assist the school with basic learning facilities as well as reduce vulnerability to assault and hazards, especially for girls,who defecate in bushes and walk many miles in search of water

title: Women of the Rio Napo:
description: Support indigenous women-led enterprises in 5 indigenous Kichwa communities in the Ecuadorian Amazon Rainforest.  Economic resilience and forest stewardship go hand in hand.   Over 100 women are organizing sustainable projects like agroforestry, traditional crafts, and pisciculture to support themselves while protecting this incredibly biodiverse and essential area of the Amazon.   These women are forging a new future for themselves and their communities-- and the forest they call home.

title: Fishan Brave Elephant who Survived a Fractured leg
description: Fishan, meaning 'something smaller'. In September 2018, one of the older bulls of the Jabulani Herd, Fishan, stepped into a deep hole and fractured his ulna bone in his front left leg.  It was a serious injury that required the attention of some of South Africa's top wildlife veterinarians. He underwent two procedures to treat his leg and for four months Fishan could not walk far distances and stayed back during the day in the stables area while the rest of the herd spent their days in the wild.

title: Goma-DR of Congo's IDPs and Refugees Relief Fund
description: May 25, 2022, armed fights occurred in Goma, Eastern Congo, between the governement and rebel movement of M23, forcing 72.000 people to leave their homes for security. This is after the region was put under the state of siege by the government and endured over 25 years of armed conflict. Leaving their homes for their lives, refugees are obliged to leave all that they have. This fund will support relief work of partner community-based associations offering relief supports to refugees and IDPs.

title: Save a Poor Divorcee from Breast Cancer in Nigeria
description: This project will support Mrs Helen to undertake all the necessary treatment that is required to manage breast cancer. Mrs Helen is a 54-year-old poor divorcee and a mother of three, who has been feeding from hand to mouth and finds it very hard to take care of herself and her children. She was diagnosed with breast cancer last month and has been at the emergency unit of Nnamdi Azikiwe University Teaching Hospital Nnewi-Anambra State, receiving treatment. Your donations will help to save her.

title: Girl Climate Corps Fellowship
description: In 2022, G4CA aims to empower 170 girl/young women climate leaders through our programs in 3 cities (Jinja, Mbale and Kasese). Young women and girls suffer the impacts of climate change first hand. The project will bring together young women and girls from indigenous and marginalised communities to be trained in climate leadership, activism, adaptation, mitigation and movement building. These will be empowered to contribute to local decision making and holding their leaders accountable.

title: Gift Entrepreneurship Training for African Youth
description: Despite considerable economic progress across the world, poverty continues to pervade many areas in African countries due to bad infrastructure, poor good education, limited jobs, corruption and more.  Entrepreneurship training is often the only ladder for youth to climb out of poverty. Money4YOU creates bright futures by delivering culturally appropriate entrepreneurship training to 500 young people annually. This enables them to start businesses that solve local problems and create jobs.

title: Bairam Donation for Darussafaka Society
description: Darussafaka Society provides talented children who have lost their father or mother and have limited financial means, with a full scholarship, college-level, boarding-school education by our society's equal opportunities in education mission since the year 1863. Donations made as "Bairam" are spent for the needs of our students in Darussafaka Schools. During the Bairam period, Darussafaka Society invites you to support the education of our children by donations.

title: Help to refugees  (mother + children) in Ukraine
description: This project will supply food packages, medicines sets, medical items, items of prime necessity and domestic tools for displaced families with special needs who live in refugee camps or shelters in Ukraine. With this project we support the most vulnerable people who lost their homes and have  nowhere to go.

title: Help us Recover - 5 years since Hurricane Maria
description: In Loiza there are 100+ homes with blue tarps as ceilings, in state of vulnerability and uninhabited by families who didn't have the means to repair them. 5 years after the severe political disaster following the hurricane, we are still working to see our communities recover. Your donation will help us keep empowering and helping sustain women and families by providing access to preparation materials, essential items, food, water, community vegetable gardens, micro-business trainings and more!

title: Help Poor Families in Nigeria to pay House Rent
description: This project will support 50 poor families in Nnewi-Anambra State, to pay their house rent, as house rent has gradually become very costly, both old and new houses. Homelessness is a very terrible situation to be in and shelter is one of the basic needs of a man besides food and clothing. Your donations will help to protect these families by supporting them to continue having a roof over their heads, thus saving them from environmental dangers.

title: Nelly's #Climb4Cancer
description: #Climb4cancer In few days, Nelly Attar will be attempting the world's second highest mountain K2, "The Savage Mountain" (8,611m above sea level). Nelly's climb is dedicated to all the little fighters climbing the mountain of cancer at the Children's Cancer Center of Lebanon (CCCL). Join Nelly on her 45 day climb, as she takes every brave and tenacious young fighter with her to the world's second highest mountain - by donating, spreading the word, and/or supporting the children at the center.

title: Empowering Dads through School-Based Chapters
description: This fall, Fathering Together is launching school-based dad groups in local elementary schools to support deeper engagement between dads and their kids. These groups will work with school administration and parenting organizations like PTA/PTO. Our goal is to shift dads from "dropping off" their kids to "stepping in" to their children's development, education, and growth.

title: Build a Rescue Center for GBV survivors in Kenya
description: We run a safe house where we house women who are survivors of GBV and their children. We take them through counselling and the healing process. During their stay, we offer them vocational skills they can use to support themselves once they leave the shelter.  Our current shelter is rented, hence expensive to maintain. The new safe house is meant to ensure funds are maximized in assisting the women. We plan to have a vocational unit that additional serves other women from vulnerable backgrounds.

title: Aid for the recovery of the Oaxacan coast
description: Fundacion Comunitaria Oaxaca will collaborate, through its RedComun program, directly with the communities, grassroots organizations, local authorities, and civil society organizations to, in the first stage, provide the necessary inputs to cover the basic needs of food, shelter, and health of its inhabitants, after the damage caused by Hurricane Agatha. RedComun will promote the recovery of affected communities, focusing on local development and strengthening community resilience.

title: Happy School Girl Project (HSGP)
description: This project is aimed at providing reusable period panties (sanitary pads) to at1000 girls in Ghana annually. The HSGP is committed to ensuring menstrual dignity for girls while protecting the environment. Therefore investing in their menstrual hygiene management is consolidating girls education. An action which goes beyond LEARNING to guaranteeing their protection, support and empowerment to reach their full potential.

title: Australian Red Cross
description: Australian Red Cross supports the most vulnerable people in our local communities, here in Australia and across the Asia Pacific.  Your donations helps us address the impacts of some of the world's most challenging humanitarian problems: forced migration and displacement, natural disasters, entrenched injustice and more.

title: Help Preschool Kids with Disabilities in Ashkelon
description: The project is to build and equip a fortified, state-of-the-art early childhood center for children with disabilities in Ashkelon. The young children have autism, developmental delays, genetic syndromes and other disabilities, with the majority living at or below the poverty line.  Chimes Israel's current early childhood facilities in Ashkelon are in four overcrowded, inadequately repurposed residential homes. The building will serve 80 children with disabilities.

title: Help a Poor HIV+ Orphan to Survive in Nigeria
description: This project will support Jane financially and otherwise to continue living without allowing the death of her parents to deter her from achieving her goals in life. Jane is a 15-year-old girl living with HIV, an orphan who lost her father few years back while her mother died as a result of AIDS on February. She's left with no one to take care of her and her only younger brother. Your donations will surely help to support her feeding, education, clinic appointments etc.

title: Help school students read great books and think
description: Armenia is way behind regional and developed countries benchmarks: 35% of school students are not able to read and understand a short text for 10 y.o.. In developed countries the share is 2-7%, in Georgia and Azerbaijan 14% and 23% correspondingly.  Apart from that, there are also 42$ of population who live in poverty. It means Human Capital is under a huge danger. [World Bank data]  Zartnir will purchase great books and organize reading clubs in 20 schools and engage 400 school students.

title: Self-Advocacy for Women & Teens with Disabilities
description: The program empowers women and teens with disabilities with the knowledge, personal strategies and professional resources to enable them to avoid and escape unwelcome and harmful situations. It is critical to reducing violence against women through:  1. Educating on femininity and sexuality, as it pertains to their relationships and social circles 2. Helping them identify potentially harmful, violent or exploitative relationships 3. Conveying tools and skills to enhance personal protection.

title: Supporting Literacy for 1500 Children At Home
description: "Early Literacy lasts a lifetime" is the slogan to drive our July Bonus Day with Global Giving.   South Africa is currently facing a huge literacy challenge, with 78% of 10 year old children unable to read with meaning.     This project will provide books for the children as well as host language and literacy workshops for parents, who receive little emotional support and advice on what they can do to give their child a start in life.

title: Rehab 50 persons with disabilities in Cochabamba
description: This project will provide 50 persons with disabilities who live in far locations of Cochabamba  with home physiotherapy sessions, assistive devices and medicines. Additionally, training sessions will be developed to individuals,  their families and disability people organizations, allowing 200 persons to strengthen their self-esteem, capabilities and advocacy skills.

title: Keeping at-risk children with disabilities safe
description: We are seeking support to extend the hours of the early intervention program we run in Tel Aviv for at-risk preschool children with disabilities. The Chimes Holland Center for Early Childhood Treatment & Rehabilitation operates from 8am to 3:30pm in Tel Aviv-Jaffa. The project seeks to keep the center operating until 6:30pm, as an alternative to home care. During the extended time at the center, there will be rehabilitating and nurturing care, dinner, and leisure activities.

title: Buy a car to connect youth from Mitrovica
description: Mitrovica in Kosovo has been ethnically divided since the end of the Kosovo war, with Serbs living north of the river and Albanians in the south.   Our Mitrovica Rock School brings together Albanian, Serb and other youth through daily rock music lessons and sessions of ethnically mixed bands. To travel safely to the other side of town, the Rock School drives students by car - but its car is broken beyond repair.  We are looking to raise USD 6,000 to buy a second-hand car to drive our students.

title: Housing for the Vulnerable Refugees of Lesvos
description: This program provides community-based housing, medical and psychosocial support, access to the labor market, and the provision of food, clothing, and hygiene items on Lesvos. The housing program accommodates refugees in need, responding to the inhumane living conditions in refugee camps. Safe housing restores people's dignity and provides security, independence, social inclusion and empowerment. Support for people's needs is provided by a team of mental health and social work professionals!

title: Education & Empowerment for the refugees of Lesvos
description: Mosaik Support Center is a place that aims to provide a sustainable solution and to give refugees the tools they need to integrate into the local society and in Europe. Mosaik is a place of meeting, exchanging ideas and evolving, open to all. A variety of courses, an open library, cultural and environmental awareness events, all take place in a beautiful building that embodies solidarity and multiculturalism. English, Arabic, Greek and IT courses are currently offered to everyone for free.

title: Hannah needs your help!
description: Hannah is a single mother with a daughter who is special needs, they have been kicked out of their home and have nowhere to go.   By donating towards Hannah you will be providing her with a sustainable future for them both.  Hannah wants to open a hair salon, can you help?

title: Changing lives through music
description: Sonidos Para La Vida is a non-profit organization dedicated to transforming the lives of children and young people in Guatemala through the practice of a musical instrument. The more than 800 children and youth in our program are away from gangs, leisure, and many harmful activities, all because they learn the passion for something good in their lives and, with it, achieve all its benefits. When you help Sonidos Para La Vida, you are helping to change the life of one more child in Guatemala.

title: Employment Skills Mentoring for 1.500 youngsters
description: This Project seeks to empower young people in entrepreneurship, technological and labor skills, providing them the opportunity of inclusion at the digital labor market.

title: Support NOWPDP's New Center of Excellence!
description: Every year, NOWPDP, through our setup, facilitates 500 trainees annually through programs and interventions for skill development and economic empowerment bringing sustainable and long-term changes in their lives. We aim to expand this number three-fold in the next year by building the Center of Excellence in Karachi.

title: Help women thrive through employment support
description: Know the story of Rita, a Chilean woman that became a mother at a young age and had to leave her job for years. Thanks to the EMPLEA foundation from Hogar de Cristo, she got the skills/job training to return to the labor market. An inspiring story of overcoming obstacles that certainly will inspire other women. Over 1.6 million from this vulnerable segment have the potential to become part of the labor market in Chile but do not have skills/job experience and need an opportunity to start over.

title: East Africa Hunger Relief Fund
description: Across East Africa, millions of people are facing famine. Climate-crisis-induced drought, regional and local conflict, and long-reaching impacts of the war in Ukraine and COVID-19 are creating a dire situation in multiple countries, including Ethiopia, Somalia, South Sudan, and Sudan. Your donation to the East Africa Hunger Relief Fund will provide emergency relief, food, water, medicine, and other essential supplies to people in need.

title: Help Empower 131 Artisans in Kenya
description: Almost half of Kenya's population lives on less than $1.90 a day. Many families struggle to afford bare necessities such as food and shelter. At Imani Collective we believe that empowering people means providing access to market-demanded skills, which can support an above minimum income and standard of living. We believe that if people are given access to training and dignified work, they will take charge of their journey out of poverty. They are changemakers, not just a subject of help.

title: Support a Widow & Her Disabled Children in Nigeria
description: This project will support a poor widow, to take good care of herself and her 3 disabled children. Mrs Faith is a mother of nine children and about 7 years ago, the last three of her children who use to be healthy, a boy of 21 years plus two girls of 23 and 19 years respectively, suddenly became disabled within a year. This woman has no source of livelihood, stays home to take care of these children and relies on the support from people in doing so. Please refer to the photos section for more.

title: Healthy Minds, Healthy Lives-600 Girls in Kenya
description: Your gift will help construct and resource a dedicated counselling office that provides a safe and private space for one-on-one and group psychosocial counselling, life skills development, health, child rights education, and career guidance and support at Village Impact's new Negya Girl's High School in Mai Mahui, Kenya. Through this, you'll help 600 vulnerable girls acquire the skills and support they need to complete high school and realize brighter futures.

title: Eid Adha Together
description: Eid al-Adha involves the slaughter of an animal and the sharing of the meat in three equal parts - for family, relatives, friends and the poor. The goal is to ensure that every Muslim eats meat. This year, the number of people who need assistance has increased significantly due to the high prices and the lack of Palestinian income. The projects target all vulnerable groups in Palestine, given that successive crises have had a significant impact on the lives of all people living in Palestin camps

title: #BuildBridges: Support Atlas Corps Global Leaders
description: Atlas Corps is a global community of 1,500 social change leaders from 115 countries! Support our international professionals as they engage on a talent journey to inspire positive social change at home and abroad. We build bridges by connecting dynamic talent to opportunity and to one another. Join us as we continue to develop our ambitious strategic plan to envision the evolution of our global community - #AtlasCorps2025. Together, we are Atlas Corps!

title: Lebanese Red Cross - Crisis Response
description: This project will alleviate the suffering of the most vulnerable families in Lebanon, by reducing catastrophic out-of-pocket expenses for healthcare, and by ensuring that the free national health services of the Lebanese Red Cross (ambulance emergency response and blood transfusion), remain functional despite the loss of all local funding.  Every year, more than half a million persons benefit from free healthcare services provided by the Lebanese Red Cross all over the country. Help us continue!

title: Help PR Montessori public school transformation
description: Instituto Nueva Escuela serves 45 school communities by providing support in the process of transforming the community from a traditional methodology to a Montessori one where shared governance is established, we certify teachers in the Montessori philosophy and methodology, and we serve the families of the schools that have been victims of abuse. Our vision for 2025 is that 100 communities in Puerto Rico have access to a Montessori public education of excellence.

title: Stray Animals Emergencies Funding in Colombia
description: Based on the socio-cultural conditions in which we live in, we would like to be able to provide emergency cares such as of immediate veterinary care and a temporary foster care for cats and dogs who were the victims of   car accidents or extreme neglect  in Tabio, Colombia.

title: Playground for Sivaraja Deaf and Blind School
description: The Power of Play has partnered with the students of Emily Carr University of Art + Design and the Guangdong University of Technology to design an innovative playground for sight- and hearing-impaired children at the Sivaraja Deaf and Blind School in Nattandiya, Sri Lanka. Students from the universities have gathered for a two-week workshop alongside local students from Sri Lanka to design a playground that is incorporating sensory play, is accessible, and is sustainable.

title: Community Schools: Promoting Active Learning
description: We will set up 5 community schools for 500 children in the most marginalized districts of Balochistan & Sindh where there are no primary schools for girls and have the lowest literacy rates worldwide.  These will be cost effective models working on the latest educational techniques incorporating e-lessons on Single National Curriculum to be at par with the rest of the country.   ALBBS aims to empower these children through literacy & essential lifelong learning skills for a brighter future.

title: Help Children Orphans in Nigeria to Attend School
description: This project will support children orphans in Anambra State, to complete their primary and secondary education. Being an orphan is one of the worst thing that can happen to any child, as children needs parental care, support and guidance to grow and become useful and not a menace to the society. It is said that children of today are the leaders of tomorrow and as such, we must bring them up properly with the right skills and attitude, to prepare them for future challenges.

title: Feed and Support Poor Hungry Widows in Nigeria
description: This project will feed and support poor hungry widows in Anambra State. The death of a husband is a tragedy that befalls a woman as it involves a physical break in their relationship, which is very stressful and devastating. The widowhood condition exposes women to psychological and physical abuse, as well as a whole range of health-related problems including HIV/AIDS. Your donations will support these women to have a source of livelihood and take good care of themselves and their children.

title: Relief to 10000 flood survivors in South Sudan
description: The project will provide relief packages including food and non items to 10,000 flood survivors in (Twic East County of Jonglei State and Terekeka county of Central Equatoria State in South Sudan. Communities are not aware of flood control and disaster management methods to retain water that can't be carried out within stream channels or retained in natural pound lakes. The project will inform the flood survivors to create man-mad channels to divert water around their homes and plant

title: Planting community orchards in England
description: The Fruit Tree Planting Foundation is excited to launch our first-ever orchard projects in the United Kingdom! FTPF will be working with British tree-planting groups to plant orchards in underserved neighborhoods, schools, and other publicly-accessible locations in England (with the hope to expand to the rest of the UK in the future). We will be focusing on urban orchards, turning under-used spaces into vibrant oases of greenery, community, activity, and, of course, fresh and nutritious fruit!

title: Provide Diapers for Vulnerable Children in Nigeria
description: This project will provide disposable diapers for poor vulnerable children at home and in the rehabilitation centers in Anambra State, to support them. Disposable diapers are believed to be more convenient and sanitary than clothe diapers, keeps a baby dry and less likely to make them suffer from diaper rash. Parents who cannot afford to provide enough diapers for their child are forced to leave their baby in a soiled diaper longer than is appropriate, leading to diaper rash and other infections.

title: Help the Salhiah Family Win Their Case in Court
description: Six days before their court hearing, without demolition orders, the Jerusalem Municipality demolished the Salhiya family's businesses. The family stood on the roof of their home to stop bulldozers. Then, at 2am on January 18 2022, the police and army invaded both Salhiya family homes, forcibly detained family members, releasing them only after the houses were destroyed. Though the families lost everything, the court requires them to pay fees before they can sue for damages. They ask your help.

title: Diversity & Inclusion: LIVES Art Project
description: In Japan, it is rare to see Artwork in office spaces. Some offices have big meeting rooms they use frequently and nothing on the wall. There are many positive benefits that an Artwork can create. In addition, Outsider Art in Japan is undervalued compared to other countries. This project will help two needs where it will increase productivity in the workplace by displaying Art in office space and will also lead to appropriate evaluation of Outsider artwork and its purchasing.

title: Help send 50 girls back to school in Zimbabwe
description: This project will send back 50 out of school girls into school through formal and Non Formal education. The project will also purchase uniforms, stationery, sanitary pads and also pay examination fees and provide career guidance and mentorship to the girls.  The target is girls who have dropped out of school due to pregnancy and other reasons including  lack of school and examination fees.

title: BUILD A SKILL IN 30 YOUTHS IN BAMENDA-CAMEROON
description: This project will offer 30 young people in Bamenda-Cameroon whom the ongoing Anglophone crisis has brought them untold misery, frustration, anger, despair, malice, anxiety, an opportunity to equip themselves for the job market and community growth with productivity skills and behavioral skills, tools, mind-sets and strategies to drive positive change in our community.

title: Build a Training Center: Transform a Community
description: The Tumaini Initiative is an innovative year-long technical textile design and self-development business training program that will over 5 years enable 180 people across 4 areas of Kenya to start their journey out of generational poverty. Individuals will be certified in a market demand skill set and placed into ethical jobs with us or with one of our vetted partners, allowing them to take that first step towards financial and social stability.

title: Aid for Ukraine's Women & Children
description: The war in Ukraine has left millions of women and children to uproot their lives. Millions of refugees live in Poland, and millions more are internally displaced in Ukraine. Humanitarian need is high - and NuDay needs your support to get aid where it is most needed. Your donation will help ensure that NuDay can continue its work of delivering empowering and dignified aid to vulnerable civilians affected by Russia's war.

title: Hope in Crisis Fund
description: Millions of people around the world are living through crises, but their stories are rarely heard in the mainstream news or raised to global awareness. The Hope in Crisis Fund will help communities struggling through intensifying natural and human-made disasters, including armed conflict, famine, persecution, and climate catastrophes.

title: #SOS PERNAMBUCO
description: The IBGE (Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics) ranked Pernambuco as the third most unequal state in Brazil. The situation of some cities, which were already in a position of great social vulnerability, worsened with the heavy rains that hit the state between the end of May and the beginning of June.   Faced with this calamitous situation, Aldeias Infantis SOS, which has been operating in Pernambuco since 2009, activated its Emergency Program to support families located in the cities

title: A new home for 20 families in emergency in Mexico
description: TECHO is a youth led non-profit organization present in Latin America & the Caribbean. Through the collaborative work of families living in extreme poverty with youth volunteers. Your Donation will contribute to the work that TECHO has done with the communities by giving solutions for the housing deficit in which millions of colombian families currently are living and will provide finnacial resources to the community development projects.

title: Moms Dont Want Welfare - We Want WEALTHFAIR!
description: Did you know when a welfare mom works, she is immediately cut off, reduced, and or experiences increases in her life-sustaining benefits(i.e. healthcare, food, and housing)?  Uncle Sam will give her the world as long as she stays home and does nothing!  Then our media portrays these "welfare moms" as lazy, apathetic leeches to the system!   MOMS DON'T WANT WELFARE- THEY WANT WEALTHFAIR!    We have taken to the road in a beautifully wrapped RV with a message of hope and liberation for families.

title: New Disability Care Center for Children in Zambia
description: SHN's Community Care Centers (CCCs) are at the heart of SHN's catalyst program. Each CCC will run a 2-year program, including a home group for every family and move to a new compound every 4 years, engaging more children in more compounds than our previous model. These are free programs at each CCC and are coupled with a cash transfer program to support the families and incentivize faithful attendance. There are no other programs like this in Zambia. Each center provides a space for 60 children

title: Ladies .. It's Your Right to Know Your Rights!
description: AICA is working to enhance the rights of marginalized groups in North Lebanon targeting refugees, stateless, migrant &  vulnerable beneficiaries. Its main activities includes provision of legal services & conducting awareness/advocacy activities. AICA's protection team will receive legal claims from mainly battered women then direct eligible cases to legal team for follow-up, AICA will also focus on family issues like identification papers & reconsideration for prejudged under-age individuals.

title: Sustainable & Profitable Livelihood Program (SPLP)
description: The project aims to develop and test vocational training activities for agricultural microenterprises for girls in the Aumazo tutoring program. Priorities are for girls who attended the program, passed the high school entrance exam, and had to drop out of high school for lack of tuition support. Also, girls in current tutoring program will benefit from vocational training and acquire livelihood skills. The project will test curricula approaches for broader use while enabling employment creation.

title: Your Generosity Can Transform a Community
description: Imani Collective is working to provide dignified work to Turkana artisans. This work provides self-development for the artisans and their families, empowering them to break the generational poverty in the region.
