Imani's goal is to build a new foundation for growth by providing improved workstations, bathrooms and sanitation, training programs, mentorship, and guest housing for team members and visitors. This organic development will uplift communities without disturbing the rich

title: Help Rural Cambodians Escape Hunger and Poverty
description: Trailblazer Foundation, a community development NGO, is working in Siem Reap province; one of the poorest regions of Cambodia. Through our Food Security and Economic Development programs, we focus on improving the quality and quantity of food our rural partners eat, thereby reducing the villagers' hunger and poverty. We provide wells, agriculture trainings, help establish Farmer Community Groups and start-up chicken farms.  Success for us is when a rural village no longer needs our services.

title: Protect Thai Children from Online Sex Trafficking
description: IWF called 2021 the "worst year on record" for child sexual abuse online. The HUG Project is addressing this issue by sharing a vital tool called Exposed to help children protect themselves from online predators. Exposed was created in cooperation with a survivor, known as "Meetoo",  who decided to reclaim her story by helping other victims find a path to recovery through this handbook. We printed over 500 books but we have already given all of them away to children and families.

title: The Accelerator. Innovative therapy child cancer
description: "La Aceleradora" is the initiative to ensure that all children with childhood cancer can exercise as a non-pharmacological therapy and thus positively influence their cure and quality of life. Hand in hand with administration and La Paz hospital, we are going to accelerate the cure of childhood cancer through physical exercise. And how?  1. Creating a Physical Exercise Research Unit. 2. Developing a technological application for hospitals. 3. Investigating, improving evidence through big data

title: Help Children of Ukraine Survive the Winter
description: In harsh winter conditions, millions of Ukrainians are still under attack or have fled their homes, seeking safety across the border. GFC has disbursed over $1.9 million to support 60+ of local organizations helping children and youth survive conflict and crisis. Your support this holiday season means that GFC can provide critical support to our partners whenever it is necessary. In a crisis situation, young people don't have weeks or months to wait for food, shelter, and security.

title: Saving Children on the Roads in Sierra Leone
description: At least 32 children died in 2020 due to road accidents in Sierra Leone. This is a tragedy that happens all too often, with most fatalities occurring while children are either going to school or on their way back home. The Youth Partnership for Peace and Development (YPPD) is working to change this, with programs that educate both children and adults on road safety. YPPD also works with over 200 hundred schools, 400 teachers, and 300 youth, ensuring the constant protection of children.

title: Transport for emergency care for the elderly
description: During the war, one of the most vulnerable sections of Ukraine's population - lonely sick elderly people - became even more vulnerable. Many of them cannot move on their own and need constant assistance. In total, our foundation cares for more than 15,000 elderly people. Every week, we deliver food, medicine, personal care products, wheelchairs, household items and even furniture to the elderly. Our help can save many lives, so we need to act fast. So we really need help with delivery.

title: Afghanistan Earthquake Relief Fund
description: A powerful earthquake in Afghanistan killed more than 1,000 people and wounded and displaced hundreds more on June 22, 2022. Your donation to the Afghanistan Earthquake Relief Fund will provide emergency assistance to people in need and support long-term recovery efforts led by local organizations.

title: Help Airlink Deliver Aid - Afghanistan Earthquake
description: Airlink is coordinating with our global network of nonprofit relief partners and airline and logistics partners to respond to the deadly Afghanistan Earthquake. Immediate needs include: medical aid, WASH supplies, search and rescue teams, food aid, and shelter. Airlink's mission is to remove the high costs & logistical challenges of transporting emergency humanitarian aid to more efficiently reach people in need. Your donation provides sustainable funding to secure/fund airlift & logistics.

title: Empower Under-Resourced Girls in Costa Rica
description: Soy Nina (I am a Girl) works to empower girls to prevent all types of gender-based violence. We believe that early intervention and prevention is the strongest resource to fight the gender inequality. Our goal is to guide girls into becoming confident and brave. Girls who are self-aware, make informed decisions, and believe in the power of their dreams.

title: Support Our African Women Skills Training Centre
description: Women in Africa drop out of education early and the two main reasons is to take up running the home or due to lack of sanitary wear. Either way the number of unskilled women across Africa is alarming and we need to help women take control and get back into work. This project allows women to train for free and get skills that will result in them getting local employment or setting up their own micro-business to sell to the tourist trade. Who doesn't love an Africa bag?

title: Environmental Education to Change Lives
description: 1400 disadvantaged youth will learn about the interconnectedness of all life. Enabling them to bring their world back into balance, and how they can improve their own life through more constructive decision making and actions. The CoEco Curriculum is aimed at learners aged 12 to 14. It will be delivered in 28 schools and eco clubs. learners will also be mentored so that they are instilled with knowledge and confidence.

title: Responding to the Afghanistan Earthquake
description: On Wednesday, June 22, a 5.9-magnitude earthquake hit the Paktika and Khost provinces of Afghanistan killing at least 1,000 people, injuring more than 1,500 and causing widespread damage to infrastructure and homes.   International Medical Corps was the first to respond in Gayan district-the worst-affected area. Our teams have confirmed that many villages have sustained significant damage, with most residents either killed or injured.

title: Earthquake Relief in Paktika, Afghanistan
description: On June 22, 2022, a 5.9 magnitude earthquake struck the central region of Afghanistan, impacting Paktika and Khost provinces, claiming the lives of more than 1,000 people, injuring 1,500, and affecting an estimated 30,000 and counting. ActionAid is on the ground and will be working in the affected areas to address people's immediate needs, supplying food and water in the short term and assessing what support will be needed in the longer term, including cash transfers.

title: Education for All in Kaolack, Senegal
description: The Diapalante Community Education Centre in Kaoalack, Senegal helps adults, young people and children gain skills they need to improve their job prospects. 500 people each year benefit from the Centre's free sessions which teach both academic and practical skills. Just 3 staff organise all the activities, but they are helped by many volunteers. The time and expertise contributed by local volunteers keep the costs are low but your help is needed to fund the Centre's unavoidable overheads.

title: Support Victims of Earthquake in Afghanistan
description: Between June 21-22, 2022 a devastating 5.9 magnitude earthquake occurred in the region of Paktika and Khost Provinces, eastern Afghanistan bordering Pakistan.   According to a report released by the OCHA on June 23, approximately 770 people were estimated to have been killed. The number of deaths continues to rise and is currently estimated to be nearly 1,150.

title: On The Scent: Meet the Dogs Protecting 200 Rhinos
description: Sadly, the demand for rhino horn has decimated rhino populations in Africa and on average, one rhino is poached every day on the continent. Here on Ol Pejeta, we fight the war on poaching 24/7 and our pack of eight elite working dogs are paramount to our anti-poaching operation. Our K9 Unit is heavily reliant on donations and urgently needs your support.

title: Safe housing for women victims of violence
description: City of Split in Croatia has less than 10% of the necessary capacity for accommodation for women who are leaving violent relationships and because of that Domine started running an unofficial crisis center.  Crisis center offers urgent, safe and free accommodation for women in crisis situations where they have access to free psychological, legal and psychosocial help and support.

title: Mercy In Action's First 1,000 Days
description: This project will pay for specially trained home visitors to follow up on all the babies born at Mercy In Action birth centers in the Philippines through the first 1,000 days of the child's life. These Mercy Kasamas (health companions) will work closely with the midwives to educate the parents on how to identify early malnutrition so it can be treated before causing life-long damage. Mercy In Action's First 1,000 Days program will also gift books and food to the children in our communities.

title: Food for 250 Street Dogs and 40 Cats in Romania
description: On our DsN farm in Giurgiu, Romania we are currently taking care of 251 dogs and 40 cats. Some of them brought to us in person, many of them dropped off in small boxes or even thrown over the fence of our farm. Most of these dogs are undernourished and suffering different deseases. Costs for food are enormous for a small organization like DsN e.V. - especially special food for our ill animals. On average we need 3 tons of food every month to feed all our animals on the farm.

title: Mental Health Support for Makomborero Students
description: Our students work phenomenally hard and are under immense pressure from themselves, their families and sponsors, to succeed academically. Young people can understandably often find these expectations crushing.  This fundraising campaign is to enable Makomborero to continue to provide access to professional mental health support for all our internal and external students.

title: Support Children's Literacy in Afghanistan
description: Charmaghz is an Afghan education non-profit based in Kabul that has run mobile libraries for marginalized children since 2018. Now more than ever, we believe Afghan children have a right to quality education as well as a peaceful future--both of which must begin with a strong foundation in literacy and numeracy. We are doubling-down on our commitment to support Afghan children to develop critical skills in reading, writing, and basic maths. Our country's future depends on it.

title: PROVIDE QUALITY EDUCATION TO INDONESIAN YOUTH
description: This project will provide Indonesian underprivileged youth with vocational training on several topics including coding, programming, 21st-century skills, entrepreneurship, and work readiness to prepare them to enter the fourth industrial revolution (Industry 4.0).

title: Mobile Charging Stations for Cameroon Communities
description: The NDES Foundation provides support in education, health, and infrastructure to communities in Cameroon, empowering individuals and families to help themselves become self-reliant and economically sustainable. Mobile hand trucks, fitted with solar panels, are being provided to families as 're-charging stations' to support them and their wider communities.

title: Menstrual and sexual education workshops
description: Our project is based on the organization of menstrual and sexual education workshops in the shantytown of Tocaimita located in the suburbs of Bogota. This poor neighborhood has many women, mostly indigenous, in a situation of economic vulnerability. We wish to accompany them in their learning of their body and in the discovery of the options which are at their disposal. The courses will be given by women who are used to this kind of workshop: psychologists, activists, association leaders.

title: Abaco Strong Breakfast for Children Program
description: Research has shown that access to breakfast for school-age children can significantly improve their ability to concentrate throughout the school day and positively impact their academic performance. Our goal is to provide breakfast four mornings a week for the children in attendance at The Coopers Town Primary School in North Abaco in order to improve the chance of academic and personal success for each child.

title: Bring Unity & Creativity to Cape Town Youths
description: Cape Town possesses true beauty, yet apartheid's scars linger. Especially for youths, 13-25, who represent 34% of the population. Separated by diverse cultures, religions, socio and economic standings, they also face many similar issues like COVID's mental health crises of anxiety, depression and sobriety. Breaking Walls creates unified, empathetic, hopeful youth communities through its Community-Based Initiative. Here young artists from unique cultures partake in a collective Arts experience.

title: URGENT HELP FOR A MALNOURISHED AND SICK BABY
description: We hope that your urgent response will be a source of hope for a malnourished and sick baby living in a rural Ugiri village in Nigeria.Uche's recent visit to the family showed how the baby's health has deteriorated.The mother survived a fire disaster in 2019 which damaged her two breasts, making it impossible to breastfeed the baby.The family's unstable income and hard times are responsible for the lack of adequate meals and healthcare for the baby.Your donations will is critical to his survival

title: Prevention, Education, Scholarship dealing w/ HIV
description: Defeating HIV is faces complacency in the world. There is a feeling that HIV has been defeated because of the development of new medication. This assumption is far from true. Thailand has worked tirelessly to address this issue, but now it must double its efforts and continue focusing on education and prevention. Recently, a report was published that over 60% of High School students in northern Thailand were tested with HIV.

title: 3D printed prosthetic arms and hands
description: In Bolivia, it is exceedingly difficult for any low-income amputee to get a prosthetic limb due to the cost and lack of availability. Our project's goal is to ensure that 20 low-income Bolivian amputees will be able to use their hands and arms again with a durable and functional prosthesis made with a 3D printer. Having a hand will allow these amputees to regain their sense of dignity, allow them to find employment, and contribute to their families and communities.

title: Training Centre - 100 Women with Disabled Children
description: This program will educate 100 mothers of children with special needs and set up a training centre in Kitengela, Kenya. Women will graduate from a registered college with a business diploma, a loan for their business start-up, and a two-year mentorship program.

title: Help orphaned baby rhino Little Thaba
description: Meet little Thaba, a baby white rhino who was left orphaned in mid-2022 when his mom was shot and killed by poachers for her horn, which was hacked off. Believed to be around 3 months old, he was brought through to the Hoedspruit Endangered Species Centre, where he will be taken care of for quite a few years until he is fully grown and ready to be released into the wild.

title: Support Childline Thailand's Call Centre
description: Every month thousands of children reach out to Childline Thailand for emergency assistance. Our Call Centre is online 24/7 and we receive calls and messages from vulnerable children asking for help every 15 minutes. Childline provides all of its services for free, including professional counselling. links to emergency services, case management, and legal assistance to children and youths under 18 years of age.

title: Safe drinking water for 20 schools in Uganda
description: We will install 30 drinking water filters and 40 pedal handwashing facilities in 20 schools to reduce water-borne diseases such as diarrhea in 150,000 children. This will reduce student dehydration in schools, resulting in better cognitive abilities and higher school performance. Water and sanitation are basic human rights for all children and are necessary for dignity, empowerment, and prosperity. Without them, thousands of children become ill, and 63 under the age of 5 die every day.

title: Plant 1,000 fruit trees in Mozambique
description: ESMABAMA plans to plant 1,000 fruit trees in the co-managed schools in the South of Sofala Province, Mozambique, improving food security, fighting climate change and creating income for the community in the region. The fruit trees will also benefit the students' families and the communities (more than 300,000 people estimated).

title: Help grow eco-minded startups in Africa
description: Sustainable Entrepreneurship allows us to address and meet the needs of the present and the future of this generation, without compromising the needs of the future in all polyfunctional tools that are designed to meet true needs of humanity. The Association of African Entrepreneurs (AAE) encourages sustainability of designed products that lies in the capacity of producing general services to the needs of humans, society and the environment.

title: Feed 1,440 disadvantaged students in Mozambique
description: ESMABAMA will provide 3 hot free meals per day during the full school year to 1,440 boarding students, girls and boys, from disadvantaged backgrounds in rural areas of Mozambique, avoiding them of drop-out school. These students are orphans or from poor/ disadvantaged families, some of them also disabled. Help us give them the opportunity to study and break the poverty cycle in rural families!

title: Building a Women's Weaving Cooperative
description: Madagascar has one of the highest poverty rates in the world, with 77% of the population, including 90% in the southeast, surviving on less than US$1.90 per day. Women are particularly affected by Madagascar's poverty as they are restricted in generating an income due to entrenched cultural limitations and domestic responsibilities. Project Mahampy, Phase II, aims to improve the sustainability of mahampy reed weaving as a traditional women's livelihood activity in southeast Madagascar.

title: Invest in 10 women entrepreneurs in Northern Kenya
description: Our Kenyan partner Children Peace Initiative Kenya (CPIK) is seeking $15,000 to help 10 women entrepreneurs from the Pokot and Samburu tribes launch small businesses and trade with each other. This innovative approach will produce incomes for these women, strengthen ties between their communities and show how women can build peace in fragile environments. Josephine (photo), a Samburu businesswoman who trades maize across tribal lines, inspired the startups and will head the Samburu network.

title: GRACE Smiles: Dental Hygiene Project
description: By supplying basic dental hygiene items (toothbrush, tooth paste, dental floss, and mouth wash) to the children we service in Thailand, as well are other areas in need, we hope to bring forth a better quality of life to those in need. Dental hygiene kits will be sent around the world to children who may not have adequate dental care available to them.

title: Back to School in Palestine, Lebanon and Jordan
description: The new school year is approaching fast. Help Anera celebrate and promote our Back-To-School campaign, starting August 15!  The campaign will emphasize that education is a multifaceted approach, which requires a multitude of factors to keep kids in school and ensure they receive quality education.   Anera provides resources in Palestine and Lebanon to make this possible, such as providing children's parents with jobs, providing children with proper nutrition at school, and so much more.

title: #BIPOCMentalHealthMatters: A W2W Fundraiser
description: In honor of BIPOC Mental Health Month, we are looking to sustain our impact supporting clinicians who work with historically marginalized communities, many of whom face the highest mortality during the COVID pandemic. Our recent efforts include launching the podcast "We Do Hope," six-part series presents easy-to-absorb material through a conversational format, briefly exploring topics such as chronic sorrow and self-compassion. With the help of our supporters, we aim to do even more.

title: Help Mercy to Amputate her Decaying Leg in Nigeria
description: This project will support Mrs Mercy to amputate her remaining leg (right), which is decaying as a result of an infection. Mrs Mercy, a poor divorcee with two children, who lost her source of livelihood as a result of her health, is at the emergency unit of Nnamdi Azikiwe University Teaching Hospital Nnewi. Her left leg was amputated last month, as a result of an infection which led to the decaying of the flesh and this has also affected the right one, which also needs to be amputated.

title: Clean Water for the Watha
description: Access to clean water is a major issue for the Watha people. Although there is a constant threat of crocodile attacks as well as the possibility of contracting cholera and typhoid, the only option for many Watha is to collect water from nearby contaminated rivers. The Watha Project, working with village elders and volunteers, will construct a fifth well to provide clean and safe water to hundreds of Watha and provide water and health education to all, drastically improving their quality of life.

title: Support a Student, Strengthen a Community
description: Donations received from 1st Sept '22 will provide additional support to some students in critical need.  Education is essential in empowering young people from tea estate communities in Sri Lanka to expand their career prospects, realise their potential and help lift their families out of extreme poverty. Our Tea Leaf Centres provide young people between the ages of 18 and 26 years old with free professional development and vocational training centres.

title: Help us address the dynamic needs of LGBTQI people
description: This is a five year project that will use data to bring solutions for  LGBTQI+ people's biggest challenges in Tanzania. We humanize data, find hidden stories, and map ways to communicate more effectively with the LGBTQI+ community and stakeholders. Then develop a framework for LGBTQI+ communities to normalize tolerance, respect and equality for all persons across greater communities and develop replicable systems that enable LGBTQI+ communities to dispel bias and inspire respect and acceptance

title: Teach Tech Innovation to Girls & Women in Tanzania
description: Twende will offer free Creative Capacity Building workshops for girls and women, allowing them to learn creative problem solving through technological innovation without the stigma or barriers they may face in local schools. During the workshop, participants learn the fundamentals of design thinking and innovation by identifying a challenge they currently face and then developing and building their own technology to address that challenge. Transportation and meals will be included.

title: Give Healthy Meals to Disabled Romanian Orphans
description: At our Delia's Learning Center for underserved, special needs children we will continue to provide healthy meals to kids who have physical, developmental, and cognitive disabilities including autism. Many of our kids live in rural villages, without refrigeration or running water. Our goal is to improve physical well-being and positively impact academic success through proper nutrition. We aim to serve 4,000 meals to 40 kids attending our Center in one of the poorest areas of the E.U.

title: Feeding 190 stunted children with a balanced diet
description: This project aims to provide 190 stunted children with a balanced diet within six months and provide each households with 3 best egg-producing chickens and nutrition education. Stunting is caused by not eating enough or eating foods that lack growth-promoting nutrients, and persistent infections or chronic illnesses that lead to insufficient nutrient intake. The project will solve the problem of children suffering from malnutrition and stunting in the two sectors of eastern province/Rwanda.

title: Agri-Business as Income bolster For IDPs Cameroon
description: FCDA, is poised to working with 60 IDPs who are willing to engage in farming activities by cultivating potatoes, cassava, yam and maize in 20,000sq. m (2 Hectare) of land in Bertoua for a period of 1 (one) year from August 2022 to July 2023. We hope to move geometrically the total land to be cultivated annually.  Apart from securing income for themselves, they will also have the opportunities to be food sufficient and advance their education initiatives around modern farm techniques.

title: Summer Feeding Project Kpaola Village
description: According to the World Food Programme, millions suffer from acute hunger largely due to man-made conflicts, and climate change & economic downturns. As food prices continue to rise around the world, children still go to bed hungry with acute starvation. Food Security plays a central role in SDG 2 ( Zero hunger)  This project will provide Free lunch for the children of Kpaola Village in the Southern part of Sierra Leone, West Africa where a meal a day is a luxury for many of the children.

title: Support Darlington's Medical Treatment in Nigeria
description: This project will support Mr Darlington, to visit a good hospital and see an orthopedic doctor, concerning the bony outgrowth/bulge that developed around the styloid process of his ulnar bone. Mr Darlington, who is one of our project leaders, is having so much pain as he palpates the area and has spent a lot of money buying and taking medications, which didn't yield any result. Check the photos section to see the X-ray he did and the result. He's in dire need of support to go for treatment.

title: Nutrition Gardens for People Living with TB
description: Zimbabwe is a high Tuberculosis (TB) burdened country. The treatment for TB require patients to consume enough nutrients in their diets to reduce the risk of side effects such as skin rush and severe headaches. TB patients are among the poorest who cannot afford the nutritional support they need. Treatment side effects caused by lack of nutritional diet have led many patients to default their medication. Hence, increasing the chance for the development of drug resistant TB & onward transmission.

title: 100 children from Manchay improve their wellbeing
description: The Ruwa Seeds Project develops the social and emotional skills of 100 children from Manchay, Lima, Peru. The children will participate in arts, sports, and play workshops to strengthen their confidence and self-esteem. We will share a report every three months with an update on the project's impact on the children and their families. Our children are between 3 and 14 years old.

title: Small Business support for South Sudanese Refugees
description: Terra Renaissance promotes social economic development and peaceful coexistence of South Sudanese refugees and Ugandan host communities towards sustainable self-Reliance. The refugee community lacks access to land for cultivation of much needed foods such as vegetables and grains hence the more dependency on humanitarian food aids whose rations have dwindled of late leading to high risk of undernutrition, slow growth in children, risk of illnesses and low productivity as a hungry person.

title: Teaching Reading in Poor Communities in Jakarta
description: Reading is the beginning of a child's education, but more than half of Indonesian children leave primary school unable to read and understand a simple text. This project will equip teachers working in poor communities in Jakarta with high-quality teaching materials and inspiring practical training, enabling them to spark a love of reading in the children they serve.   https://www.sayasukamembaca.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Indonesia-Learning-Poverty-Brief-2021.pdf

title: How can I read if there are no books? (Indonesia)
description: Half of Indonesian classrooms have no reading books available apart from textbooks. Without great reading books, children will not learn to read well.  For more than ten years, our team has built working relationships with local governments, schools and charities, all of whom are desperate for good quality reading books.  This project will provide a "library in a box" to at least five schools in every one of Indonesia's 34 provinces (170 schools in total).

title: Support teachers in remote Eastern Indonesia
description: Reading is the beginning of a child's education, but more than half of Indonesian children leave primary school unable to read and understand a simple text.  This project will equip teachers working in remote Eastern Indonesia with high-quality teaching materials and inspiring practical training, enabling them to spark a transformative love of reading in the children they teach.   See: https://www.sayasukamembaca.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Indonesia-Learning-Poverty-Brief-2021.pdf

title: Sensitisation & Support to 30 Trafficked Survivors
description: This project will create awareness on human trafficking in Uganda and provide psychosocial support and economic empowerment to 30 survivors to reduce vulnerability.

title: Promote Wellness & Economic Empowerment with Arts
description: The Healing Hands project provides interpersonal counseling, group talk therapy, psychoeducation resources and specialist referrals through artwork in Dar, Tanzania. Clients learn traditional beading as a skill during counseling sessions. The project promotes the economic growth of trained grandmothers who are implementing psychosocial interventions. Funds raised from the beaded jewelry will help sustain free & accessible mental health services, support, and resources in underserved communities.

title: Help argentinean youth take climate action
description: Eh!Copate is a hands-on education programme that empowers 120 argentinean students from Cordoba's public schools with the skills and confidence to launch their own community-benefiting environmental projects.

title: Empower young entrepreneurs in Kenya
description: Every $500 raised provides another loan to a Kenyan entrepreneur operating a small or mid-sized business. The impact of your generous donations is multiplied as each loan can be redeployed ~10 times. Our loans provide access to capital that would otherwise not be available to these entrepreneurs, and combined with high-quality mentorship, help accelerate the growth of our entrepreneurs' businesses.

title: Help Build a Community Centre at St Martins School
description: We are working together with St Martins School Kibagare under the Nilinde Nijijenge program to work and support families within the community through sustainable home projects where families are classified and supported with a goal to transform the needy and vulnerable households to be self-reliant and creating a safe environment for the women and children.

title: Send a child to school in Nigeria
description: The poor child who is off school because the parents cannot pay for school fees who have the opportunity to go back to school and be happy. Your donation would make it possible for those children  to have better and brighter future. Many children are orphans in Nigeria because of killings and unrest in the country. The school is the only place of refuge for them.

title: College Education Sponsorship for Poor students
description: Many poor students in India are unable to afford the college and hostel fees after HIgh school education due to poverty of their families.  Hence many students  are not completing their higher studies and dropping out their  College education and go for works and life become worst. This project  will support  with tuition and hostel fee to the  students to continue their college education from Intermediate  to professional  Graduation courses likes Degree, Engineering and Nursing courses.

title: Virginia Flood Relief Fund 2022
description: At least 100 homes have been damaged after flooding caused by torrential rains swept through rural communities in the US state of Virginia. Each passing hour reports of the damage grow, as more than a dozen search-and-rescue teams canvass difficult-to-reach areas.  GlobalGiving is working closely with our partners on the ground to get emergency support to impacted communities in this time of need.

title: SUPPORT SRI LANKA
description: Support Sri Lanka is established to provide critically needed food, medicines and other vital supplies to at-risk people in Sri Lanka.  Funds donated to Support Sri Lanka will support Aarogya Seva's existing efforts on the ground to distribute aid as quickly as possible.  Supplies will be purchased in the US and India as much as possible to get it in the hands of those who need it most as fast as possible.

title: Defending Reproductive Justice
description: This project will help us tell reproductive justice stories through an intergenerational lens. We have begun the work of interviewing people across generations about how reproductive justice has shaped their lives, what they hope to see for the future, and how abortion fits into a holistic reproductive justice framework. In addition to filming these stories, we are researching new ways to share information about abortion in the United States.

title: Hand to Hand 800km Bike Ride
description: Our Hand to Hand Foundation staff and families are riding 800km from 17/10/22 to 02/11/22. Most of the riders are people whom the Hand to Hand Foundation regularly supports by providing education, food, job  training, housing and a safe refuge for trafficked children. Some of the team have never ridden a bike before and they had to learn this skill first.  The whole team are riding 2nd hand bikes that have been donated.  The team is training every week and getting fitter and faster by the day.

title: Support for storm victims in Carinthia
description: This project provides unbureaucratic emergency aid for households and families that have been hit particularly hard by the devastating thunderstorms in Carinthia in the night of June 29th 2022.

title: Empower the next generation of girls in technology
description: This project aims at supporting and uplifting young women, in all their diversity, as they discover their potential as tech creators and become catalysts for change in their communities across Latin America.   Through a systemic approach to tackle gender stereotypes surrounding STEM fields, we provide 4000+ young women each year with opportunities to explore, learn and pursue academic and professional paths in technology, enhancing their own quality of life and that of their communities.

title: Transform lives of 71 child laborers in India
description: HEARDS helps them to provide a joyful and activity-based learning methodology of education for children who are affected by the worst forms of child labor and child trafficking, to enable them to recover and regain hope.

title: Medical Care for Ukrainian Patients
description: Some health conditions are chronic and require long term treatments and multiple regular visits to the hospital. And some life-threatening conditions require immediate attention and specialized intervention. Cancer chemotherapy, dialysis, blood transfusions in thalassemia coronary artery disease are some examples.   When Russia invaded Ukraine more than four months ago, hundreds of Ukrainians who needed such treatments lost access to care overnight.

title: AID FOR 100 CHILDREN IN TABORA, TANZANIA
description: Christian Education and Development Organization (CEDO) signaled its commitment of protecting  children from gender based violence and support them in education by providing basic human needs. Our target is to reach 100 children vulnerable aged 8 to 17 years old. Given that there is a high number of violence against children in Tabora, Tanzania. Experience from Tabora police station shows that more than 63 children were violated from January to May 2022 in Tabora region,Tanzania.

title: Boyaca Children's Rights: Keep 120 Kids in School
description: In the Sogamoso region of Boyaca, Colombia financial crisis and extreme poverty have led children to work in coal mines and charcoal burning to support their families. CEPALC is working with children and their communities to keep kids in school, offer children's rights education, and strengthen support networks to address child labor exploitation. This project also trains kids and youth in communication tools like writing, music, theater, and art to lift up their voices and promote peace.

title: Feed Hungry Families in San Ramon, Costa Rica
description: The Community Action Alliance of Costa Rica (CAA) in San Ramon, is a group of expats and Costa Ricans who are committed to helping families who face the stark reality of being hungry every day. While there are local non-profit organizations whose mission is to help, the need is great and additional support from the local community is critically important to address the issue of hungry families.

title: Help Airlink Airlift Aid - Horn of Africa Drought
description: 17+ M people are facing severe food insecurity following the Horn of Africa's fourth failed rainy season. Ongoing conflicts & other crises make a streamlined supply chain in response to this emergency that much more challenging. Across the region, high transportation cost is a major blocker for the humanitarian community. Airlink is mobilizing airline and freight forwarding partners to provide a reliable and sustainable transportation network to overcome these logistical & financial challenges.

title: Empower 300 Social Innovation Projects in China
description: Undergraduates are the future of our society. We as a non-profit organization, empower more than 300 people the social innovation projects. We are determined to promote social responsibility through project-based learning. The funding will be directed provided to students' project such as "Rest for Love", dedicated to solve the dilemma of caring for elders with dementia and disability, to alleviate the pressure of caregivers by developing prototypes products suitable for the elders.

title: Help keep our services free
description: AAE needs support to be able to offer many of our entrepreneurs in need support services for free. You can learn more about our services to assist African entrepreneurs on our website These funds are to help pay for equipment, rent and internet access for the AAE head office in Ghana as well as the hosting fees for the AAE website.

title: Empower 30 Low-Income Women in Argentina
description: Based on Muhammad Yunus' microcredit model to empowering underprivileged women, we provide loans, training and advising to women living in poverty. This way, they can launch their own business enterprises and generate extra household income. Our entrepreneurs live in communities with few formal work opportunities. With additional income they are better equipped to meet urgent needs such as providing their children with adequate meals, healthcare, education, and a more promising future.

title: Provide Better Life for 100 Widows in Nigeria
description: WealthyGen develops sustainable livelihood activities for widows in poor households who are struggling to feed their children and fight poverty after the loss of their husbands. This project will establish businesses and other income generating activities for 100 widows in Nigeria to help them earn their own income, become less dependent and give their kids sound education. Your donation will purchase everything for the business, provide financial education and skills training to be successful.

title: Shelter for Ukrainians who have lost their homes
description: Record numbers of refugees have been documented in 2022, the war in Ukraine has contributed greatly to the statistics. Since the full-scale russian invasion more than 8 million have been forced to flee their homes and move to more peaceful regions. 100 000 people have nowhere to come back to. Russians destroyed their homes with missiles, houses left standing were looted and deliberately damaged. The figures are quite understated, Ukraine will be able to calculate the damage when the war is over.

title: Liquid soap making to improve hand hygiene
description: Safe Water and AIDS Project (SWAP) has been operating in Western Kenya with public health programs, research and emergency response since 2005. SWAP will produce hand washing liquid soap to support rural health care facilities with improved hand hygiene to reduce hospital acquired infections among patients and health care workers. We shall also provide hot spot areas with the same. This hand washing liquid soap is essential to mitigate the spread of COVID-19 and other emerging infections.

title: Take Actions! Help Tackle CLIMATE Change Crisis.
description: SHARE is Planting tree's! Believes every Child deserves a healthy and safe environment now and a sustainable future. We want to ensure that all children can enjoy these rights. The climate crisis affects everyone, vulnerable communities are taking the strongest hit. If left unchecked, climate change will undo a lot of the progress made over the past years in development. It can also exacerbate, as we are already seeing, current threats such as food and water scarcity, which can lead to conflict.

title: Support life change to babies born in rural areas
description: In our daily life, Babies and Mothers have continued to multiply globally. But just in an imagination at a season of inflationary pressure in the African economy and infrastructure of rural impact, Babies in common have met unhappy life and mothers have regretted during their labor times. When lockdown is pronounced, babies aged 6month+ miss milk, clothing, medication in an appropriate time and other body building nutrients to help their growth.

title: Build Primary School for 200 Students in Liberia
description: Safe Community Inc plans to build Six(6) classrooms  primary school to provide free education for 200 children yearly who never been to school and dropped out of school from the poorest background of Logan town, Kpelle town, Wein town, Lorma quarter and New Israel communities within Johnsonville LIBERIA. Education empowers children at their adult age to establish successful careers and give back to their communities. We need your help to raise 14K  to construct the primary school.

title: Improve Food Security for 250 Families in Kumbo.
description: To fight the adverse effects of climate change in Kumbo, the project will address high rate of deforestation and unsustainable agriculture practices by fostering community engagement of smallholder farmers and peasant women in reforestation. Through community outreach, farmers will be trained on agroforestry practices, climate-smart agriculture, sustainable bee keeping, horticulture and vegetables gardening to achieve food security and economic growth for 250 families in Kumbo.

title: Lets Help to Flood Effected People in Balochistan
description: The recent flood widespread destruction, National Disaster Management Authority reported that the floods have resulted in more than 1100 deaths and 1600 people have been injured. More than 325000 households destroyed, 733000 damaged, 735000 Livestock effected, 2 Million Acres of Crops affected in Pakistan of which 60% are in Balochistan. More than 600 Schools damaged in Balochistan only.

title: Free  School for Street Children & Child Labour
description: The project aim is addressing to protect 200 street and child labor children against their harmful works with an exploitation/discrimination by helping accessible and affordable formal and non-formal education considering the age of 5-17 years. This project is implementing in faridpur district of Bangladesh to ensure sustainable life of the vulnerable children through accessible free of cost school education and livelihood improvement for their parent with involvements conditional cash support.

title: Help Ukrainian children now
description: The war in Ukraine is still raging and girls' lives are at stake. Your gift supports Plan International's response to the crisis in Ukraine, which is focused on refugee children and their families in Poland, Moldova and Romania, including work in the areas of protection, psychosocial support, emergency education and meeting basic needs for children and families that fled their homes with little more than the clothes on their backs.

title: Help Stop Human Wildlife Conflict in Zimbabwe
description: Human population and settlements in Mutoko rural district of Zimbabwe are rapidly expanding and encroaching on wildlife habitat leading to people coming into contact with dangerous wild animals such as hyenas. Over 60 cases of livestock attacked by hyenas have been reported in various parts of the district and some villagers are now resorting to retaliatory killing of the wild animals which is unlawful and dangerous.

title: Enriching Life Through Italian Baroque Music
description: In 1984, a 10 year-old child in Merseyside listened to Vivaldi's Four Seasons on the radio for the very first time. The encounter resulted in a lifetime's dedication to the music of 18th-century Venice for violinist Adrian Chandler and the birth of La Serenissima: a world-class ensemble bringing life-affirming Italian baroque music to a global audience. This fund will help support delivery of the organisation's mission at a time when opportunities for public performance remain scarce.

title: Providing Dignified Births in Mexico
description: Obstetric violence is defined as the situation during labor where a woman suffers from mistreatment, is forced to go through unexplained medical procedures, is shouted at and overall disrespected. This affects negatively their emotional and psychological wellbeing.   Companeros En Salud wants to make sure women in rural Mexico experience respectful births, and stay healthy during the process. We want to make possible a reality where quality healthcare services reach pregnant women and babies.

title: Support Children's Literacy in Honduras
description: JustWorld partners with Asociacion Compartir to provide a Mobile Library to communities in rural Honduras. The JustWorld Mobile Library brings learning directly to children living in remote towns where it is economically and geographically too challenging for children to attend school. Books help children develop basic language skills, critical thinking skills, they help nourish imaginations, answer questions, create questions, inspire, comfort, and offer a great escape.

title: Provide fresh water for poor girls in Guatemala
description: This project will fund a pump for a new water well to support 780 girls at our charity girls' school in Guatemala. Well construction is complete and a submersible pump is now essential to extract the fresh water from the borehole for our girls' drinking and sanitation. The school frequently suffers water shortages during the dry season and needs to pay for 3 tons of water weekly. This new well is a cost effective, efficient, sustainable solution for safe drinking water for the poorest girls.

title: Scholarships for kids with rare deseases
description: Our biggest project is: The School of Celia & Pepe, located in Madrid, Spain. This is a unique school specialized in kids with special needs, most of them with rare diseases and language disorders.   We are proud to welcome 35 girls and boys, aged from 4 to 16 years, for the coming school year 2022-2023. We will ensure inclusive and equitable quality education for each of them, providing specialized programs that will help them flourish to their full potential.

title: Drought & Looming Famine in East Africa
description: The worst drought in decades is ravaging East Africa, destroying crops and driving the cost of food out of reach of many. This project will help scale aid efforts to reduce the levels of death and suffering in East Africa and worldwide.

title: Help Children of Incarcerated Parents Thrive
description: 105,000 children in New York are impacted by parental incarceration, threatening their developmental well-being. In response, partnering with organizations like Children of Promise, MindLeaps works with system-impacted children in Brooklyn and the Bronx, to develop social-emotional and cognitive skills to increase emotional resilience.

title: Empowered Girls Uplifting Others in Honduras
description: Through leadership training, activism, and networking, this project empowers adolescent girls and rural youth to be the agents of change in their own communities. By learning new skills and developing strong friendships, the girls and young women form a network of leaders capable of  defending their rights, amplifying the voices of the invisible, seeking strategies for fair and equitable employment, and participating as equal members of society.

title: Plant 40,000 Trees In iraq
description: Through this project, Bothoor Alkhaer for Development and Relief (BAORD) will plant and maintain 40,000 trees in North Diyala region, enabling environmental protection as well as economic support for the local Iraqi community in 5 rural sectors in Baquba, Muqdadiya and Khalis. Your donation will go to BAORD to plant and maintain 40,000 trees

title: Solar Panel System and UPS at Talara Medical Post
description: Ecoswell proposes to take advantage of the year-round solar radiation of the region to implement a UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) and Solar Panel system at the Medical Center of Talara. After successfully installing a similar system in the Lobitos Health Center, the EcoSwell team aims to replicate it in other medical centers and have a large-scale impact on the local healthcare system.

title: Help Us Cover the Gap!
description: Help us not to say NO to any child approaching the Children's Cancer Center of Lebanon for treatment. The battle is on so many fronts: the unavailability of medications, the devaluation of the Lebanese currency, the scarcity of foreign currency needed to secure medications and cover treatment, the decrease in value of third party guarantors' share and several other hardships and challenges that the children living in Lebanon face along with their families.

title: Luzon Philippines Earthquake Relief Fund
description: On July 27th, 2022 a 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck the northern Philippines, killing at least five people and injuring more than 120 others. Survivors need access to emergency supplies like food, water, and medicine in addition to longer term recovery assistance.  All donations to this fund will exclusively support local relief and recovery efforts from this earthquake.

title: Ensure Americans Fair Entry to Palestine
description: On October 20th, Israel is set to implement new restrictions preventing Palestinian Americans from visiting their families & restricting entry of students, academics, bus. leaders, & volunteers. The US Government is weighing extending the U.S. Visa Waiver Program to citizens of Israel. In turn, Israel is required to provide Visa Waivers to U.S. citizens without discrimination - this is our opportunity. Help sustain a Contact Congress Campaign to ensure Americans the reciprocity required by law.

title: Flood 2022-Pakistan Needs Support
description: This project will provide immediate relief of food and non-food items to the 250 families who are suffering from Floods 2022. The response will be executed in Sindh Province where 114 million people are affected. The Disaster Response teams are already there to identify the most deserving ones; especially women headed households, families with people with disable and family with aged people.

title: Support Tutoring Class for 150 Children in Liberia
description: Safe Community Inc, established After School Tutor program to make learning more easy for 150 students attending Safe Community Academy. Tutoring Children after school in their deficiency of their lessons will be known as problem, we get to them with solution and work on them one on one through the after school tutor program. The program runs for 3 hours daily and 5 days a week. We all can do it together.

title: Alis exists - child protection
description: Alis is a project that aims to shed light on the experiences of young girls in Colombia who have been part of the foster care system due to violence, poverty, drug use, or homelessness. Our goal is to create a safe space where these girls can belong after leaving the system. We have established a club-house that offers emotional and professional support to help them start a new life, pursue education and employment opportunities.

title: Kentucky and Appalachia Flood Relief Fund
description: Deadly flash floods left a trail of destruction in eastern Kentucky, killing more than two dozen people and destroying homes and businesses along Appalachian valleys. Torrential rains also damaged parts of Virginia and West Virginia. Your donation to the Kentucky and Appalachia Flood Relief Fund will provide immediate and long-term relief in affected communities.

title: Provide healthy water & food for 5,953 children
description: The project aims to carry out water drilling and produce vegetables through agroecological practices in  11 primary schools in rural areas. To allow  5,953 pupils  to have drinking water and and healthy lunches. The member of parent associations from each school will be trained in agroecology techniques to help schools produce organic vegetables. We hope to fight  food insecurity and malnutrition in 5,953 students, including 52 orphaned and 106 displaced students in rural areas.

title: Empowerment of Dalits in India
description: Dalit Solidarity works for the empowerment of Dalits through whatever means available. We tirelessly advocate for their rights and lobbying for their cause. We have concrete measures to support the education of children, vocational training for the school dropouts and social & developmental projects for widows and the marginalised. We work in the States of Tamil Nadu, Andrapradesh, Odisha and Uttrapradesh

title: Empower Women and Children by Livelihood Options
description: Proposed project aimed to address Asset building strategy that increases financial and tangible assets focuses  of individuals, families and communities at Kurigram District in Bangladesh. VIEW plans to 0rganizing 500 women for developing groups' solidarities, 200 Adolescents girls providing life skill training and 900 children who are out reach of education from extreme poor families and also providing assets to 100 women. Community Health services to 5000 beneficiaries and emergency responses.

title: OVD-Info: stop political persecutions in Russia
description: OVD-Info is an independent media project on human rights and political persecutions in Russia. We provide and coordinate legal assistance in cases related to the restrictions of freedom of peaceful assembly and study the emerging problems this helps both to develop tactical solutions for today, and to lay the foundation for future changes. By donating to OVD-Info, you contribute both to the support of specific people and to changing the whole picture of human rights observance in Russia.

title: SUPPORTING TALENTS 4.0, WOMEN IN THE 4TH IR
description: Geek Girls LatAm promotes diversity, inclusion and gender equity so that women in the creative, scientific and technological areas enhance their opportunities and leadership. As a social company, it works with female talent, promoting values such as leadership, talent, collaboration, sisterhood and service to fulfill its objectives. We consolidated a team of Women with Talent and Heart to continue contributing to the fulfillment of the 2030 SDGs.

title: Support the Home iNAMi children's home in Namibia
description: The children's home "Home iNAMi" was set up in 2016 with three children in a backyard silver check located in the former township Katutura. Over the last years it has grown into 17 children aged one to eighteen years. In 2019 we were fortunate enough to buy a proper house big enough to accommodate everyone and turned it into a safe home. Furthermore, we built two classrooms to open a kindergarten/ afternoon care, we renovated the house and extended it & built a vegetable garden & chicken coop.

title: United against torture
description: The mission of "En Vero" is to eradicate torture in all its forms, promoting and protecting fundamental human rights around the world, since its inception we are committed to fight tirelessly to eliminate suffering and abuse, regardless of race, gender, religion or social status, we work to raise awareness in society about the seriousness of torture and its devastating effects on victims and their families. Our commitment is to work to create a world where torture is an eradicated practice.

title: Bridges of Hope for 5000+Girls in Kampala City
description: Join Katika Child Africa (KCA) in empowering 5000+ girls fight for their rights in public spaces in Kampala City. This project will build a Vocational skilling center for the most vulnerable girls in Kampala, providing hands-on skills in tailoring, hair dressing and employability skills. Further, sensitization in Entertainment places, Streets, Schools, Churches, Markets and Transportation means where girls are abused will be done. & Support enforcement, deliver justice to victims of this abuse.

title: Help to cure newborns from jaundice in Kazakhstan
description: Since 2007, AYALA charity foundation has covered 36 cities, population centers, and 67 medical facilities in Kazakhstan under the "Breath life" project. "Breath life" is a project on the equipping children ICUs with vitally important equipment for saving newborn baby's lives.  Under this project, our foundation plans to equip a "Kostanay regional hospital" with 5 phototherapy lamps in order to cure newborns from jaundice and following damages.

title: Help Children to Read and Connect!
description: Libraries are safe havens for kids, providing after-school homework help, games, and book clubs. Reading breeds curiosity and stimulates the imagination and appetite for writing one's own stories.  At Hope for Youth school, many children find the time for the library their best time at school because they want to listen to their teachers read stories about places and children of the world.  This library is now a place where they discover the heroes in their lives.

title: Support for 100 families of Czech cancer patients
description: This project aims to fill in the gap of provision of comprehensive care for cancer patients and their loved ones. Its aim is to ensure an easy access to psychosocial support and verified information for families that struggle with a family member's cancer through help of psychologists, social workers and other professionals. The project focuses on multidisciplinary cooperation of  professionals, volunteers and a patient organisation Amelie providing help for cancer patients and their close ones.

title: Amazon Protection - support 270 indigenous people
description: A FOREST OF PEACE is an initiative by Fundacao Lama Gangchen para a Cultura de Paz and Instituto A Nossa Jornada. The project will strengthen the HuniKui and Shanenawa INDIGENOUS ETHNIC GROUPS to guarantee their existence in the AMAZON RAINFOREST, which is being increasingly devastated. It will provide drinking water, food security, education and transport for 270 PEOPLE who were born and live in the forest. Indigenous people and territories are an important ecosystem for life on the planet.

title: Protecting Tiger Protectors
description: Over 1000 brave men & women risk their lives daily to protect wild tigers & their fragile forest home. They endure extreme weather conditions & risk attack by wild animals, & the humans who encroach into the forest. These brave anti-poaching patrols walk 1000s of miles day & night each year to remove snares & quench forest fires which threaten the lives of endangered wild tigers, elephants, pangolin & other animals too. We need to equip & protect our patrols so they can keep wild tigers safe!

title: Please Help Moby & His Friends Fly to Canada
description: Moby and 8 of his friends are SURVIVORS. They've been through the unimaginable. Moby's front legs are permanently deformed from his life on the streets. Fiona was chained for six long years.   They waited years for this chance. A life of color awaits them in Canada. On August 16, 2022, they can start a new chapter - a life filled with long walks, a dog bed, affection, and comfort. They deserve happiness.  Please help them board a plane to Montreal, where they can be adopted into loving families.

title: Assist 300 Families Access Local Homegrown Produce
description: The Lufkin Urban Garden & Market is a community garden that grows and sells organic products in the heart of Angelina County. This community and surrounding towns suffer from the worst health outcomes in Texas and has pockets of food deserts where residents can't access fresh produce for miles. Our mission is to address food security by employing local people to produce for their neighbors year-round and increase food sovereignty by educating the community on regenerative farming practices.

title: Support the rights of 125 children to education
description: Since 2000,  BASICS has been committed to its mission in Ghana by protecting the basic human rights of children to education, shelter, food and safety.    We aid women and children living in unsafe environments and engaging in harmful activities (illiteracy, child labor, trafficking, child marriage, teenage pregnancy to school dropouts) which hinders their overall health, well-being and developmental growth.  Our programs provide access to education, skills and opportunities to empower.

title: Cash For Trash & Waste Education for 200 Families
description: Bali has a massive waste problem, starting at the household level where plastic and organic matter is thrown away as trash. Our waste education and recycling program trains 200 families to use less plastic, generate less waste and recycle. Working with a local recycling company, Bumi Sehat and a local women's group organizes monthly trash-for-cash collections and student waste education programs. This results in less waste going to landfills, more household income & awareness of waste issues.

title: Happy Meal for Rideegama
description: With the current economic crisis and food crisis in Sri Lanka, more and more families are cutting down on their meals. Parents find it hard to pack food into their preschooler's lunchbox. Past few months we have seen children bring less food to preschool.  World Vision is now fundraising to provide a nutritious meal for 528 preschool children in Rideegama for 6 months!

title: Housing for Victims of Sexual Assault/Trafficking
description: Portside Suites is Fair Haven Rape Crisis Center's future vision come to life!  This project supports our building acquisition, renovation & expansion to include secure, non-congregate (private living spaces) housing for adults fleeing from dating violence, sexual assault, stalking or human trafficking.   Fair Haven's non-congregate housing will provide residents with individual living spaces, offering a level of privacy and will include comprehensive, wrap-around services for Survivors.

description: The Puntacana Cultural Center seeks to investigate, explore and share the unique cultural and naturalist history of the Dominican Republic, which has rich culture, traditions, music, dance, art, cuisine, and biodiversity. Puntacana Cultural Center will create experiences and events sharing this culture.
