title: Uplift Education Fund; Philippines
description: Due to COVID-19, all public schools in the Philippines were closed for over 750 consecutive days - the longest educational shutdown in the world.  Of the 3,625 public schools across the Philippines, less than 15% have connectivity or computers for students to access learning resources, and over 23 million children are in learning poverty. This has contributed to an education emergency threatening an entire generation that might be forced to give up on their basic right to quality education.

title: Mental Health for Young Mothers in Kilifi, Kenya
description: This project will provide low-cost, community-based, person-centred mental health interventions to 480 adolescent and young mothers from 16 rural villages in Kilifi, Kenya. These mothers are predisposed to mental health problems as they must adjust to the demands of parenting coupled with economic and social disadvantages. These experiences predispose them to poor functioning, increasing the risk of poor development in their children.

title: Build a Health Center in a Nigerian Rural Village
description: This project will build a Primary Health Center in Abor-Ani village Awgbu, Anambra State, to make healthcare services accessible to the people therein. This is one of the villages in Awgbu, that has no Primary Health Center or Hospital. The inhabitants, who are mainly poor farmers and petty traders, treks to a neighboring village for medical treatment and this has led to loss of lives and worsening of some health conditions, that would have been averted by receiving immediate medical attention.

title: TECHNOLOGY TRANSFORMING LIVES IN BRAZIL
description: Brazilian statistics show that every 17 minutes a young person dies as a result of violence and lack of perspective.  Computer labs are tools for social transformation, as their structure provides the technical and behavioral development of socially vulnerable young people, preparing them for opportunities in the world of work. Young Brazilians need opportunities to soar and change their reality and that of their families and that is why Rede Cidada counts on your support!

title: /Empowering-women-in-the-mining-industries-in-DRC
description: This project will provide supportive services and vocational alternatives to 80 rights-deprived women in the toxic cobalt mines of Kolwezi, DR Congo. Our training will provide women with skills on various topics including on financial and savings-awareness raising concerning associated health risks, informing their human rights. To address the lack of protective equipment, we will distribute safety jackets, helmets, protective gloves, safety shoes for women who must work in the mining industry.

title: Providing life-saving services to injured in Gaza
description: The idea of the project is to strengthen the capacities of Al-Awda Health & Community Association to provide life-saving health services to the injured through its 8 health facilities due to the recent Israeli attacks on the Gaza Strip, which have claimed the lives of 31 martyrs so far, including 6 children & 4 women, in addition to injuring 275 persons, as these services will contribute to saving the lives of the injured, reducing complications & limiting disabilities, mainly children & women.

title: Help Educate 300 Students in Guyana
description: Blossoms of Guyana plans to donate a minimum of 300 books to provide literacy education for 300 primary school children who come from the poorest areas in Guyana.  Blossoms will also provide three desktop computers to help support teachers in their work along with teaching supplies and learning aids to help support the education of students.  Blossoms donations will also include school supplies for students and teaching supplies for teachers along with a printer for the school.

title: Distribution of food meals to marginalized student
description: The project aims to provide nutritious breakfast meals for children to 320 marginalized black students in Yemen, Taiz. It also aims to reduce the hunger of students on the school day, which will increase attention and ease of learning, and avoid the need for marginalized children to drop out of school and prevent the apparent dropout from schools. It also aims to Achieving equality and non-discrimination. It also encourages marginalized black students in Yemen to complete their studies and becom

title: ACQUIRING 10 ACRES LAND FOR PROJECT SUSTAINABILITY
description: This proposed project is aiming at acquiring 10 acres of land that shall be used for agricultural practices and in this way shall help us to alleviate hunger and create self-sustainability at H4HU and the communities where it operates.  We believe that if we can acquire this agricultural land, the project shall be able to grow enough food to feed children under its care, destitute widows and vulnerable elderly people who can't make it through the day.

title: Child Advocacy Centre-for child survivors of crime
description: Sri Lanka has one of the highest rates of child abuse in South Asia and there have been hardly any convictions in the last 05 years.   Sri Lanka also does not have a single official Child Advocacy Center-a place . This Project hopes to launch Sri Lanka first ever Child Advocacy Centre in an attempt to encourage Multi Disciplinary Approach to Child Protection together with the State Actors. https://www.facebook.com/111433129464238/posts/pfbid0kf9NxDXBTqAaJ6LhCyjtp2mrnXXwdarmprhjAgEg1qxnarfgdvyAU

title: Provide School Meals to 150 Poor Students in Ghana
description: Provide free meals to over 150 students from poor-house-holds, poverty-stricken, and food-deficit deprived communities in Buboo and Mwankuri Goziiri, Jirapa Municipality, Upper West Region of Ghana for an academic year. The aim is to encourage and boost school enrollment and attendance, improve literacy and learning, keep the students motivated, increase the students participation in school programs and potential development, educational attainment, social and cognitive ability of the children.

title: Girls have the right to say NO
description: Rise 2 Shine Project will empower 1500 school going adolescents in the Hardap Region of Namibia through Behavior Change Communication strategies to make healthy and positive decisions regarding their sexual and reproductive health lifestyles by end 2023. Through face-to-face prevention interventions, and a youth conference R2S will built self-esteem of these adolescents to confidently say NO to early sexual encounters and/or be able to negotiate safer sex methods.

title: Teen Mothers' Empowerment Project (TeenMEP} Abia
description: This project targets advocacy to change negative policy and practices and promote quality SRHR, education, welfare, healthcare and empowerment services for 100 at-risk girls, would-be and existing teenage mothers in 10 selected communities in Abia state. In addition to contributing a Pilot Child Care Centre to serve the two nearby Umuezeagwu and Amaeke Communities, ultimately, This project will this project will return at least 10 girls to school and skill up at least 40 girls

title: Feeding children in San Juan Bautista, Peru
description: Our soup kitchen supports some of Lima's poorest and most vulnerable residents, 89 school-age children. However, this project has been operating with worn-out utensils and lacks adequate furniture especially as the number of beneficiaries has increased due to COVID-19. Many children are eating on the floors, often with their hands. With your help, we will provide new equipment that will increase the access to our food, as well as provide a space for educational reinforcement classes.

title: Building a  Dream Room in the  Pediatric Ward
description: A Dream Room is a space in the hospital( children's pediatric ward )where the foundation build or convert the space into a happy place where kids can go and feel better. The room  provide  children with simulation that they wouldn't necessarily get by lying in the hospital bed. This distraction although in hospital enable kids to leave the hospital ward and engage with educational activities such as Imaginary Play, Educational Games, Creative Crafts and Electronics Distractions.

title: Protect women from sex trafficking in Mumbai
description: Trafficking, although illegal under Indian law, remains a significant problem. Women are frequently trafficked through India for the purposes of commercial sexual exploitation, forced and bonded labour. A specific centre of El Shaddai Charitable Trust caters to these women and children and has started a project in one of the red light area, Mumbai where more than 4,000 women work and daily earn through prostitution. This project rescues women and children and relocates them to a safe home.

title: Rainforest Therapies for Healthy Communities
description: Across the world, people rely on medicinal plants for their primary health needs, and scientists agree that one in four "modern" medicines derive from rainforest plants. Yet, the destruction continues apace and species become extinct every year. Our goal is to promote the conservation of medicinal plants in Brazil's Atlantic Rainforest, rescuing, documenting, and sharing traditional knowledge about their uses by promoting a sustainable income-based relationship between the community and forest.

title: Support widows & out of school children in Nigeria
description: This project is to ensure that the less-privileged in the Society are elevated from extreme poverty through empowerment Programs, ensuring that the Rights of widow's children are protected by sending them to school. Most Fatherless children are out-of-school. The reason is, when a husband is late, his family sends the wife away from the home. This is a frustrating situation for the widows. They are left with nothing and could barely provide three square meals for their children.

title: Donate for community renovation in Kharale/DRC
description: This project aims to renovate classrooms at Institut Tupendane, a school we started building 6 years ago that has 10 classrooms in Kharale /Bukavu. The project will also support the building of a community library, computer room, basketball court, and washrooms in the school. this will provide literacy support service and IT basic knowledge, access to sanitation as well as access to the internet to the Kharale community.

title: Support our ESports Club
description: ANIMA is an educational organization with the goal to bring together the job market and the world of education by providing at-risk Uruguayan youth with tuition-free education in the areas of IT and business administration.   Our students run an Scholar ESports club where they can learn abilities while they play. From running the club, as well as Social Emotional skills. It started as an USEmbassy in Montevideo initiative but we now look forward for funding to sustain it in the long run.

title: Agroecological Gardens in Schools in Argentina
description: This project will contribute to the promotion and technical support of agroecological gardens in rural and urban schools in Argentina through training and advice spaces that promote adequate nutrition for children. We will train community leaders to be promoters in their educational communities. We will promote that the gardens are spaces for comprehensive curricular learning, spaces for children to be trained as future promoters of environmental care.

title: Kiwimbi's Prep for Success
description: The 'Kiwimbi Prep for Success' program aims to deliver on the UN Sustainable Development Goal #4 (Quality education- ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all) by providing programs and transformative opportunities that help students, at three Focus Schools, develop the skills, knowledge and habits needed to succeed throughout their primary school. Our goal is to ensure that our beneficiary children have a solid educational foundation.

title: Give a child in Ghana 10years Health insurance.
description: Parents hardly go for ANC or take their children to hospitals due to financial difficulties and this fuels malnutrition and late detection of life threatening conditions. The current infant mortality rate for Ghana in 2022 is 31.768 deaths per 1000 live births. With a health insurance card, a child or pregnant woman can access free basic healthcare services across Ghana. This encourages frequent visitation to health centers which will reduce the rate of morbidity and mortality among children.

title: Support Introducing Islamic Mathematics to America
description: The Hope Foundation of Palestine will be supporting a summer undergraduate research grant program for faculty and students at colleges and universities in the USA to produce high quality materials  about mathematics of Islamic Civilization between the 8th and 16th centuries that are suitable to be used in the K12  education system in the USA. The grant will be housed within Mathematical Association of America HOM SIGMAA, with the start date of Summer 2023.

title: Auroville - Empower a regenerative Future
description: Auroville is a leader in evolutionary regenerative design; a project with 3200 people from 60 countries dedicating their lives to the future of humanity. Integrating conscious living, sustainability, alternative energy; acting as a green demo site and training center for 54 years, it's a unique place for progress and creating change locally, regionally and internationally. Although endorsed by UNESCO, PM`s, Presidents of India and the Dalai Lama, Auroville's potential is severely under threat.

title: provide a safe haven for kids when not in school
description: AKLOWAH - meaning Village in 'Ga' is a fresh-air sleepaway camp situated on eight acres of land that opens up a new world for urban youth. During long school breaks and holidays, the camp will become their home away from home.  It is an eco-friendly serene, refreshing and welcoming environment for up to 150 children at any one time and serving thousands yearly.   Children whom spend time in the outdoors in nature conservation programs garner a greater understanding to the world around them.

title: Empowerment for indigenous People; Batwa in Rwanda
description: The overall goal of the project is to empower indigenous people "Abatwa" through integrated social, health and economic interventions. The project will offer about 1,000 Abatwa, a platform to further their education, and improve the Batwa group's socio-economic status through personal talent development and income generation micro-projects. The project also will provide basic literacy skills on reading and writing for out-of-school youth and parents.

title: Helping Afghan Children Go to School in Pakistan
description: Pakistan currently hosts approximately 3,000,000 Afghan refugees.   37% of the total Afghan population living in Pakistan are school-age children between the ages of 5 and 16. Only 20% of these children are enrolled in school.  Relief International is working to change this by collaborating with Afghan communities in Pakistan to improve girls' and boys' access to education.

title: Help Us Keep the Lights On!!
description: Emergency Fundraising Appeal From Tiny Toones. Like many others providing social services to the most vulnerable, we have been hit hard by Covid-19. At a time when our students are in most need, our funding sources have decreased drastically. With our funders and supporters feeling the impacts of the pandemic, our online donations and merchandise sales down and we are facing the biggest challenge in over 18 of operating. We urgently need your support to keep the centre open. Every dollar helps.

title: Sports , Education for Child Protection- Zimbabwe
description: This project will promote better livelihoods  for 1000 Children in 6 villages between the ages of 3- 10  .  The program will    build and promote 6 Community  based centres In rural Western Zimbabwe.Children from underpriviledged families , will learn lifeskills ,basic literacy and numeracy skills as well as discipline centred sporting activities.we have 5 years working with children from poor families in our community  due to age and disability.Our aim is to ensure they become better leaders.

title: Establishment of Animal Sanctuary in Quetta
description: In Pakistan more than 60,000 dogs die every year on the streets of Pakistan and it is the government itself that orders the mass killing and poisoning of the animals in almost every city of the country. They are shot or poisoned and then their dead bodies are collected by municipal workers, loaded and piled onto trucks for disposal. Quetta, Karachi and Lahore have the highest rate of dog killings each year with over 40,000 dogs killed in these three cities alone. Animals need to be safe.

title: Back to School Emergency Campaign
description: With the ongoing economic crisis, it has become extremely difficult for students in Lebanon to continue their education. After the success of last year's project, URDA is relaunching the Back to School Emergency Campaign for this school year. We aim to support students to continue their education journey by providing them with student sponsorships, school bags and stationary, and transportation support.

title: The People of Ukraine
description: The conflict in Ukraine continues to escalate, resulting in massive displacement and destruction not seen in Europe since World War II. Some 15.7 million people inside Ukraine need humanitarian assistance, including 2.1 million children. More than 6.3 million people are displaced, and about 5.5 million have registered for temporary protection in neighboring countries. CARE and our partners are on the ground in Ukraine and neighboring countries, providing life-saving assistance.

title: Venezuelan Baseball School for low income kids
description: We have started a baseball school in Caruao - Vargas, Venezuela with over 80 kids. Our goal is to keep the school running , by maintaining facilities, compensating coaches and restocking all of the necessary equipment. By bringing sports  to this community we keep kids out of drugs, teach them values and  help them grow as responsible adults.As an interesting fact, Venezuela is the third country with the most MLB players. We believe that with this project we can help to seed more basebal talent!

title: Hunger-Free Education for 300 rural preschoolers
description: The Hunger-Free Education Program at Tarkwa Breman Girls' School, supported by Cocoa360, is more than just a meal - it's a lifeline for students in rural cocoa communities who are often faced with poverty, deprivation, and limited amenities. For many of these children, the hot lunch they receive every day is the only nutritious meal they will have all day, and without it, they would struggle to stay focused in class and keep up with their studies.

title: Crisis in Ukraine: Maintaining Trauma Supply Lines
description: This project aims to provide a sustainable supply of orthopaedic equipment to Ukrainian hospitals, so that they can better treat the influx of patients with gunshot wounds and other injuries. By delivering this essential equipment, we can help to save lives and reduce the suffering caused by this ongoing conflict.

title: #ForColombia a New Home
description: The will is the greatest weapon to change the world.  Colombia is a country in the far north of South America. Actually, there are more than 19 million people in poverty. This can mean many things: improvised houses, dirt floors, lack of access to public services such as water and sanitation and being ignored and excluded from the rest of society.   That's why at TECHO, #ForColombia we want to build 150 houses for families who live in poverty for protects dignity and creates opportunities.

title: Counseling to help 62 Iraqi Suicidal bombers
description: BAORD plan to expand existing counselling offered in Iraq  zoom, particularly to those who self harm or have suicidal thinking. This project would subsidise 250 more counselling hours and 50 more support group hours, to those who are in need. In 2022 there were three times more male suicides than female; highest age group was 22-38 years for men and 20-35 years for women. BAORD seek to offer help and hope to those struggling with poor mental health.

title: Build an EcoVillage to Save Our Mangrove Forest
description: This project will create an EcoVillage Network with the communities who steward the largest remaining mangrove forest on Earth: the Sundarbans Reserve Forest in Bangladesh. The Sundarbans EcoVillages will use the power of tourism to tackle poverty, promote gender equality, provide safe drinking water, and regenerate ecosystems-ensuring tourism helps nature and people thrive together.

title: Build classrooms and teach kids in Syrian camps
description: This project aims to build 10 new classrooms in the IDP camps of Afrin region in NorthWest Syria, provide salaries for 10 teachers in the classrooms for 3 months, and cover the operational fees (Stationery items, books, chairs, etc.) of these classrooms for a year.

title: Creating Dignified Lives for 1.000+ Asylum Seekers
description: Habibi.Works is a free-to-use, community-organized maker space bringing together asylum-seekers, international makers, and Greek locals to share knowledge, skills, and experiences. Situated just 300 meters across from the Katsikas refugee camp, the 15 different working areas, ranging from wood and metal work to IT classes and music production, center the needs of individuals, working at eye level with them to create a space where individual freedom, potential, and agency can be restored.

title: Instruments for over 380 young musicians
description: At Nucleo we believe every child should have the opportunity to learn music. Our free, immersive programme aims to make this a reality for the young people in the areas we serve, from every background and circumstance.  We build strong, connected musical communities in which children discover and fulfil their potential, developing a range of learning and life-skills that can have a truly transformational impact. Running a free programme and providing free instruments is critical to these aims.

title: Provide Clean Water for a Rural School in Nigeria
description: This project will drill a borehole to provide clean water for a rural primary school in Nnewi, Anambra State. Inyaba Community Primary School, is one of the schools in Nnewi without any source of water supply. The pupils treks to a hilly stream in the village, to fetch water and two persons have died in the process. This project will also help to improve the health of these children, as drinking clean water will protect them from waterborne diseases such as typhoid fever, cholera, dysentery etc.

title: Empowered Youth in Brazil
description: We want to encourage 20 or more, socially vulnerable DLW participants to choose education, inspiring them to dream and aim higher. Despite corresponding to 53% of Brazilians, the black population still struggles to eliminate inequalities and discrimination. With this, we are seeking to train young black people for the job market in the technological and administrative fields. We encourage socially vulnerable young people to choose education, inspiring them to dream and aim higher.

title: Emergency Relief to Face Floods and Disasters
description: Yemen suffers from a severe weakness in the infrastructure as a result of the repercussions of the war that has been raging for nearly eight years, which made the effects of the floods deepen the tragedy of the population. A report issued by the UN Office in Yemen stated that "preliminary reports issued by local authorities and humanitarian partners in Yemen indicate that 77 people,  including children, were killed as a result of rain and floods that hit 85 districts in 16 governorates

title: Sphoorti After-School Study Centers
description: This project seeks to establish Study Centers for School Going Children at Villages in Tirupati municipalities of Chittoor District, Andhra Pradesh to help 750 to 800 school going children who live in the 20 slums and 30 centers of Tirupati. These study centers will help children improve their standards in terms of their academics and behavioral aspects and build confidence in them to take on bigger challenges in life.

title: Help homeless animals access life-saving treatment
description: Each year thousands of homeless animals become sick & injured. With no owners to take them to the vet, their medical problems can become life-threatening.   In the Himalayan town of Manali, India, Manali Strays is the only animal rescue and vet hospital for homeless animals. We treat their medical problems, sterilise, and vaccinate them against the deadly rabies virus.  We aim to end the suffering of street animals by creating a healthy, sterilised population that live in harmony with humans.

title: Sponsor our kids to the National Games of India
description: We are now proud to announce that 7 of our kids; 2 Girls and 5 Boys have been qualified to participate in the 36th National Games of India. They will be representing the states of Kerala and Andhra Pradesh and come from rural underserved communities. All of them will be participating in the Skateboarding event which is the newest Olympic Sport. We need your support to equip them and to compete at a national level.

title: Pool Fund for Disaster Emergency in Pakistan
description: Pakistan is deadly affected during monsoon seasons, people suffer lot during rain emergencies. Due to climate change recent monsoon season in Sindh August 2022, heavy rains destroyed 1000s of villages in Sindh. 1000s people lost their crops, houses, cattle & other livelihood resources. During these days rapid response is required to intervene in food supply, temporary shelters, NFIs so that NDF needs to establish the Pool Fund for Disaster Emergency in Pakistan to help at urgent base

title: Build a US Water House at Beaverland Farms!
description: We are building another US Water House in Detroit at Beaverland Farms! This farm serves its community in many ways, including food access, agricultural education, maple syrup collection, a tool-sharing program, a resource center, and more! We will provide a rainwater catchment and filtration system that runs off solar energy for the farm and resource center. This will create more food production at lower costs for the community in a more accessible way to hundreds of people each year!

title: Build a chocolate school in a low income community
description: Develop an entrepreneurship program and provide training to the local community to generate economic growth in Caruao, Venezuela.  With the creation of the chocolate factory in Caruao, we will promote the sustainable sowing and production of Cocoa, build a chocolate brand in the area, and activate economic growth for the community by selling chocolate and promoting new source of incomes for the local community.

title: Help us Build a Student Residence
description: We are excited to share that we are on our way to finally receive all necessary regulatory approvals to commence the construction of the USAP Community School at our permanent campus in Marondera, Zimbabwe in September 2022!  This project will build one of six student residence at the USAP Community school to provide boarding facility for high-achieving, low-income students from across Zimbabwe who otherwise would not have an opportunity to receive quality transformative education.

title: Literacy outreach for children in Mexico for 2023
description: Mexico is a country of great economic disparity. For children, this means a seemingly insurmountable education gap as well.  The rural poor do not have the same opportunities that wealthier families and urban populations have.  Since 2013, LPT has been bridging the gap and igniting a love of books and learning for children in underserved rural communities.

title: Before I Die Wall,  Sacred Dreams into Words
description: The Before I Die Wall will mark the beginning of our first 4-day all-community event ending on the Day of the Dead in Mexico and then again in 2023.  This art project consists of a blackboard wall that will be placed in our community center.  The location of our first wall will be The Lake Chapala Society, where anyone can write a meaningful message about "Before I die I want to___________." It will be constructed by the students at our school Have Hammer Will Travel A.C woodworking school.

title: Creating a Culture of Sustainability
description: Transformation of society through education is the DNA of UWC Costa Rica. We bring together 210 teens of 70+ nationalities and across the socio-economic spectrum to live, dream, and learn together for two years in a unique immersive and holistic educational experience grounded on experiential learning. Here they build bridges, visibilizing interconnections to generate new, collaborative ways of thinking to take action towards a more peaceful and sustainable future.

title: Jaguar Friendly Pledge
description: The natural beauty that attracts tourists to southern Mexico is due in large part to the presence of jaguars, which in their role as keystone and umbrella species keep these ecosystems balanced. Unfortunately, jaguars are seriously threatened.  Animal Karma and Panthera have created the Jaguar Friendly Pledge, a certification that endorses tourist activities in order to encourage responsible and conscious tourism that promotes the conservation of  jaguars and their habitat in Mexico.

title: Digital upgrade to improve clinic operations
description: Lack of technological infrastructure has been a persistent problem affecting work efficiency and patient care. Digital upgrade can add great value to the fields like recording and tracking patients, their health improvements, changing medicines based on response, focusing on preventive medication and care, changing programme design based on new areas of need, medical research. A new digital solution for healthcare management will be a huge leap towards modernizing healthcare operations.

title: Relief & Rehabilitation for Pakistan Flood Victims
description: In 2022, it rained 500% more than in the last 30 years and piled miseries across Pakistan. These massive rains have hit areas with the highest poverty rates in the country, washing away entire homes, roads, and bridges, affecting 33 million people. Al-Mustafa rescued the victims trapped in the water & supported 1.7 Million people with tents, food, ration, safe water, medical aid, etc. Your donation will help us to rehabilitate thousands of families who have lost everything to the floods.

title: Girl Child Outreach Program
description: In a slum, where most people live below the poverty line, girls and women education takes the back seat. Poverty, underdevelopment, mass illiteracy, ignorance, urban backwardness and conservatism cause a majority of girls in slums to be deprived of their basic right to education. Various   other   social   problems   such   as   child   marriage,   trafficking   and discrimination leads toward the undermining of girl's right to education. Limited access to education means many are stuck.

title: Empowering  conflict-affected people in DR Congo
description: As the Japanese NGO working in conflict/disaster-affected areas for world peace since 2001, victims of the crisis in DR Congo should not be ignored. We assist those affected but struggling to live a better life, especially women and children. Giving vocational skills training such as tailoring to help them lead a self-sufficient life and provide financial and material assistance to children. We wish everyone a bright future.

title: Help Provide 171 Artisans Warm Meals for 1 Month
description: Imani Collective is a socio-economic empowerment program on a mission to alleviate poverty in Kenya. We provide holistic support to support our artisan's journey to economic freedom. During the LBL campaign, we are working to fully fund one month of nutritious meals for 137 employees and their children. We currently serve 3,100 free meals a month, ensuring our employees have the nutrition they need to work hard and the certainty that their children will grow up strong.

title: Support AFARI Fellow's High-Impact Rural Projects
description: This project will support Fellows to implement micro farm projects in their rural communities. Each fellow works in their rural community to implement projects relating to food security. Fellows engage community members in training and implementation of kitchen gardens, organic farming, and sustainable agriculture. A fellow's work impacts their entire rural community. This project supports the fellow's training, project implementation, and professional development.

title: Supports Colombian families affected by the winter
description: The winter wave has begun in Colombia. Torrential rains and floods have hit extremely hard to families in conditions of poverty throughout the Colombian territory. At TECHO we want to deliver food kits to those affected and emergency housing, especially to low-income families and women. As an NGO, we have been working for more than 16 years in Colombia and 25 years in Latin America to guarantee a dignified life for the people who need it most.

title: Prevention of sexual violence against children
description: Sexual violence against children and adolescents is a growing reality in Latin America and the Caribbean, one that has been increased with the recent Covid 19 pandemic. Claves has been working on its prevention through a methodology called "Empowering ourselves through play to cope with hard situations" for over twenty years and training educators in over 15 countries of Latin America. By collaborating with this project you can help prevent sexual violence towards children in the region.

title: Donate to the Iraq Emergency Response Fund
description: Bothoor Alkhaer for Relief and Development established the Emergency Response Fund to provide critical assistance in Iraq facing some of the most complex crises in the world, ranging from conflict, instability, the COVID-19 crisis, the drought in Iraq, youth-led demonstrations, to the effects of climate change. Your support helps ensure our teams move quickly and help people recover, even after the headlines have faded.

title: The Climate Changemakers Fellowship Program
description: The Climate changemakers fellowship program is designed to provide young people across Ghana the opportunity to learn and investigate the societal impact of climate change. Through this, students are empowered to establish innovative solutions to climate-induced business and community-related problems. The expected outcome of the program is to spark innovation, create awareness of climate change, and facilitate a contribution to a sustainable society and development

title: Drought Crisis in the Horn of Africa
description: For more than 40 years, Action Against Hunger has led emergency nutrition programs providing lifesaving milks, foods and medicines to those suffering from malnutrition. Right now, 29 million people face the threat of hunger in the Horn of Africa. Our programs save lives but we need more resources to reach more people. Our emergency nutrition program has a cure rate of over 90% and $.91 cents of every dollar goes directly to our programs. Please help us reach more of those in need.

title: Flood-affected Pakistani families call for help
description: This project will provide food for one month to 1,000 flood-affected displaced families and financial assistance in building their homes.  Heavy rains have triggered flash floods and wreaked havoc across much of Pakistan leaving 903 dead 184,000 displaced to relief camps and about 50,000 people homelessly. Their livestock and crops are wiped out and they are seeking help to survive. Lets help the displaced families of Tehsil Rojhan of district Rajanpur who are affected the most worst.

title: Support 50 children join  school in Mombasa
description: Glad's House wants to enable & support 50 children get education . We made contact with these  individuals while they were at a greater risk of becoming homeless and some were already in the streets. All of them have been out of school for more than 3 years while some have  never been to school at all. This project will give each individual a chance to live in a  family again and access catch up education in the safe space and finally join a mainstream school through after care activities.

title: Flood Affectees in Sindh-2022
description: More than 1000 people have lost their lives whereas 365 just died in Sindh and millions have lost their houses. according to surveys 130 districts of Pakistan are affected by these floods. Primary Education Project Diocese of Hyderabad has identified 3500 families whose children are in 104 schools. PEP-DoH has raised 2500 packages having food and non-food items. PEP-DoH would like to submit 1000 more packages for these families from our global giving family.

title: Empower Nepali Women with Entrepreneurship Skills
description: This project will provide young Nepali women with the holistic resources and training they need to start lucrative careers in Nepal's growth sectors - starting each on her journey to an empowered future. Resources include trade school scholarships, skills training courses, entrepreneurship classes, microgrants, job placement support, and more!

title: Let's renovate! Digital inclusion for youth
description: A fresh start to the school year - help us renovate in Cambodia!  With your help, we can update our centre to better enable the success of our students.  Our mission is to unlock the potential of underprivileged youth by empowering them with innovative education in key digital and soft employability skills.  We provide digital training that leads to quality jobs that allow students & their families to sustainably escape poverty and contribute to the socio-economic development of their country.

title: Pakistan Flood Relief Fund
description: Flooding across Pakistan since June 2022 has affected at least 33 million people. The government has declared a national emergency as the floods killed more than 1,200 people and destroyed homes, crops, and livestock. At least 30 million people are in need of shelter. Your donation to the Pakistan Flood Relief Fund will provide immediate and long-term relief in affected communities.

title: Medical Relief for Flood Affectees In Pakistan
description: The severity of floods rains in Pakistan has left millions without homes, food or medical support. To play our part in the relief efforts, SHINE Humanity is arranging medical relief camps in Sindh province, for the flood-affected population. Through these medical interventions, we will be providing consultations, medicines and water purification tablets.

title: Donate to the Desmond De Silva Development Centre
description: I am Desmond De Silva's wife, Phyllis. Since he passed, it's been a challenging and difficult time, but I am healing with the wonderful support of family and friends. I am also ensuring Des's life is celebrated in the ways he would have wanted. I am raising funds to continue the Tea Leaf Trust's great work and establish a legacy for Des.   Everyone who donates will have their name on Des's legacy wall.

title: Upliftment from poverty to prevent sex trafficking
description: The Nat community in India, growing under the shadows of a metropolitan city, still forces its young girls into commercial sex work in the name of tradition. This tradition succumbs the families into a web of poverty that they find difficult to exit. Creating alternate livelihood options helps families to choose a better future for their daughters, free from abuse. One such livelihood opportunity is goat rearing where families are able to sell protein-rich milk in their communities and dairies.

title: ABKT's Flood Relief & Rehabilitation Initiative
description: ABKT's Flood Relief & Rehabilitation Initiative is a much-needed project that can provide critical support to the communities affected by the 2022 devastating floods in Pakistan.   The project aims to address the immediate needs of the affected population i.e. food & dignity kits & also provide long-term rehabilitation support to restore income generation activities of the affected communities.  The project focuses on two districts of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Pakistan, namely Lower Dir, & Upper Dir.

title: Reading for Life: A book in every Child's Hands
description: This project aims to enhance access to reading material by children in rural primary schools in Kericho County, Kenya, by establishing a pilot library in partnership with a community so as to help eradicate learning poverty

title: Help Create Opportunity For Single Mothers
description: In La Comuna neighborhood of Quito, Ecuador, single mothers have very limited options to support their families with most living off of $20 a month. This project's goal is to build a recycling plant to employ 80 of the most vulnerable mothers to help them and their children have a better future

title: Businesses for 60 Changemaker Women in DR Congo
description: This project will advance new initiatives of women's economic development within the context of peacebuilding in Rwenena, DR Congo. Economic progress is unsustainable without peace. We provide business start-up training and provisions for more than 60 women. Households are working cooperatively to advance the enterprises and ensure basic needs are met. Our facilitated peace summits have become beacons of hope in and beyond Rwenena.

title: Mobile Learning Units make Rajasthan future ready
description: In a world that has already shifted towards Artificial Intelligence, rural India is still struggling to provide basic computer education to its children. But not anymore! iPartner is engaging girls from the most marginalised communities from 27 villages of Rajasthan through a Mobile Learning Unit (MLU). Targeted primarily towards girls who are most vulnerable to commercial sexual exploitation, the MLU, which has multiple government-certified courses move every 3 months to a new village.

title: Safe Play Space for all-round development of girls
description: Holistic education is not found just in books. Children also need access to a stimulating environment where they get to play, interact with others and develop their knowledge. To that end, iPartner is creating 10 recreational safe spaces from recycled material in government schools using design and maintenance help from the local youth.  Such spaces help children to express themselves more openly and have a direct relation to increased enrolment while keeping them safe from violence and abuse.

title: Support personalised education for refugee youth
description: Young refugees are being denied their right to education. Data shows only 37% of refugee children globally have access to secondary education and only 6% to tertiary level. In countries like Greece, dropouts amongst older refugee children remain alarming. In response, we are launching our award-winning education programme, Gekko Kids, in Athens. Our non-traditional teaching methods and individualized approach to education will help students obtain accreditation and widen their future prospects.

title: Build a school for 1,150 students in NW-Syria
description: This project aims to build a whole new school that serves 1,150 Syrian students in the city of Al-Bab in NW-Syria.

title: Help Young Brazilians to access their first job
description: Cepac intends to use access to the right to education, culture and work as a weapon to break the cycle of extreme poverty among young people, creating opportunities for income, economic growth and a life project. Currently, Cepac serves more than 600 children/adolescents in situations of vulnerability and social risk in SP/Brazil with free projects and programs aimed at reducing social inequalities, early pregnancy, drug use and abuse, informal work and involvement with crime.

title: Protect brazilian children victims of violence
description: CEPAC has been fighting for 30 years to protect children from the marginalized outskirts of Barueri (Sao Paulo, Brazil) aiming to take them out of the cycles of poverty, violence and family abandonment. We develop projects of professional training, psychological assistance and sociocultural inclusion, making it possible to strengthen the families of 260 beneficiaries.Therefore, through the integral protection and care, we increase their chances of building a worthy, happy and new-faced future.

title: Professionalize and empower 180 Congolese families
description: Support for production on 120 hectares, including 90 Ha of  maize crops in the rainy season and 30 Ha of gardens (fruits and vegetables) in the dry season with 180 producers including 115 women and 65 of the young people working on 50 ares of maize and 20 ares of market garden crops (apple cabbages, tomatoes, celery, green beans and chives/chives, green corn), with dry season support for Irrigators irrigation and 2  boreholes of 65-meters . They will receive agricultural inputs, training.

title: Pakistan Flood Relief
description: Pakistan is the midst of devastating floods in Baluchistan, Punjab, SWAT and Sindh, with horrific impact.  More than 33 million people are displaced and without home, over 1,000 have been killed, more than 500,000 houses destroyed and close to 1 billion livestock deaths.  This project is to give food rations and medicines to those most suffering.

title: Girls soccer in Brazil, changing gender norms
description: Our goal is to break gender norms in sports. In what has historically been a male-dominated sport, soccer - we will provide twice-weekly indoor soccer classes for 240 female students across 6 elementary schools in Diadema, Brazil. In addition, we will utilize safe spaces in schools to provide these young girls with educational workshops centered around women's health & hygiene, gender equality and empowerment.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, high school students Izzy, Skylar, Kiran, and Ariel have been working with LI to research and learn about public health crises in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to create a public health campaign to raise awareness and educate the people of Bauchi on these various public health issues.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, high school students Jeslyn, Judah, Merissa, Cyiana, and Darren have been working with LI to research and learn about public health crises in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to create a public health campaign to raise awareness and educate the people of Bauchi on these various public health issues.

title: Drill for Water for Our Leadership Center in Haiti
description: This project was to raise money to drill a reliable source of water for the La Gonave Community Leadership & Development Center. We raised a total of $36,000 between on and offline donations, including $23,000 on Global Giving! Thank you to everyone who supported this project!

title: Restoring Vision for Aging Impoverished Peruvians
description: This project will correct the age-related near-vision loss (otherwise known as presbyopia) of 500,000 impoverished Peruvians aged 65 and older over the next two years. It will ensure that these individuals have access to the vision services and glasses they need to restore their vision. This project begins in Q4 2022 and concludes in Q4 2024. We are currently fundraising for Q4 2022, when we will provide vision screenings and glasses to 75,000 people.

title: Pakistan - provision of safe water
description: We are arranging to send up to 500 of our Water Survival Boxes to Pakistan and these will be distributed by our well-established NGO partners in country.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, high school students, Anupama, Abimbola, and Alexei have been working with LI to research and learn about public health crises in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to create a public health campaign to raise awareness and educate the people of Bauchi on these various public health issues.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, high school students, Advithi, Aparna, Mananya, and Laasya have been working with LI to research and learn about public health crises in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to create a public health campaign to raise awareness and educate the people of Bauchi on these various public health issues.

title: Responding to Floods in Pakistan
description: Extreme monsoon rains have triggered floods and landslides across much of Pakistan over the past weeks, leading to widespread loss of life, livelihoods and infrastructure. According to the United Nations, the floods have affected 33 million people in Pakistan and 6.4 million need assistance.  International Medical Corps is responding by providing the health services, medicines and supplies devastated communities need to get back on their feet.

title: People of Ukraine
description: Russia's invasion of Ukraine threatens to exacerbate the country's ongoing humanitarian crisis, forcing families from their homes in search of safety. Now entering its seventh month, the conflict in  Ukraine has already taken a heavy toll, with over 2.9 million people in need of humanitarian assistance and 1.5 million displaced from their homes.

title: Pakistan Emergency - Catastrophic Floods
description: Catastrophic floods in Pakistan, affecting over 30 million people, have killed more than 900 people in the past few weeks, and the situation continues to deteriorate, with continued heavy rains causing flooding and landslides. The sheer scale of the disaster has led the Government of Pakistan to declare a National Emergency. CARE International in Pakistan, and its implementing partners, are distributing relief items to affected communities including tents, emergency latrine kits, etc.

title: Uganda Fight Against Hunger and Malnutrition Fund
description: The Blue Atlas Project is pioneering a project in Fort Portal, Uganda to build a farm with an innovative approach to fighting hunger and malnutrition with a focus on children. The Spirulina Development Insititute  (SDI) is a multi-phase project that will build a sustainable farm which will grow spirulina, a complete nutritional profile. We will be partnering with 5 schools in Fort Portal by building and infusing drinking stations with spirulina to reach more than 1800 students

title: Global Hunger Crisis
description: War in Ukraine Creates Deadly Shock Waves of Hunger. In February 2022, war broke out between Russia and Ukraine. As the world bears witness to its atrocities, a global hunger crisis looms for an estimated 863 million people in 91 countries facing hunger and insufficient food consumption.      When crisis happens in one part of the world, it can send shock waves across the globe.

title: REACHING FLOOD AFFECTED CHILDREN IN PAKISTAN
description: Pakistan has seen the worst flood in country's history killing over 1,136 causing catastrophic destruction because of heavier than usual monsoon rains and melting glaciers. Millions have been displaced, losing their life stock, land, crops, and homes. It has been categorized as the world's deadliest floods since 2017 South Asian floods leaving the people and children in dire need of humanitarian and medical support.

title: Pakistan Floods 2022: Relief & Rehabilitation
description: Pakistan Floods 2022: an unprecedented natural disaster. Over 30 million people affected. Everything is gone; no shelter, no food, no crops. Outbreak of disease threatens not only health of flood affectees but also livelihoods. Income shocks from damage to crops and cattle, as well as health emergencies, can push entire households into starvation. Fatima Memorial Hospital in collaboration with Nur Foundation is providing relief in the areas of South Punjab and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

title: Skilling Women Farmers in India to Earn an Income
description: Women in Rural India earn their income from tending to their farmlands or taking care of their farm animals. Over the past 5 years, we have been facing droughts, unseasonal rainfall and increasing temperatures. Ashwini is a women farmer who spent more than INR 25,000 on her farm land but she is afraid of being able to make even INR 5000 back after selling her produce. There is a dire need to train women on scientific ways of farming to build climate resilience and ensure they earn higher incomes

title: Improving healthcare through technology in Burundi
description: The Village Microclinic plans to build a tech-enabled platform that combines virtual and in person care to connect patients to health services providers in Burundi. Patients will have unlimited access to qualified clinicians over the phone, saving patients' time and money related to transport from home to nearest health facility. Clinicians, labs, and pharmacies will expand their services to reach more customers who are seeking medical online services.

title: Support Kidney Failure Patients In Syria
description: We launch this emergency campaign as an urgent call to inform you that our patients are at risk due to the shortage of drugs and the limited operational resources in the dialysis center in Kafr Takhareem in north of Syria. While we send you this call, a patient's life is on the line!

title: Educate underserved girls in Kibera.
description: The project aims to enable 120 vulnerable girls from Kibera slums to successfully complete their secondary school education. The girls will be supported with school fees, school uniforms and sanitary products.   Keeping these girls in school will help curb some of the challenges they encounter such as school dropout, Sexual and Gender-based violence, early marriage and early pregnancy hence reducing their vulnerability and enabling them to fulfill their potential.

title: Send a Child to School in Bangladesh for a Year
description: * This project will established 10 Non-Formal school cum library to provide free education in remote areas at Kurigram Sub-District in Bangladesh providing nutrias  food & biscuit to 200 malnourished poor children. * The project aim to build a school cum library  well equipped with necessary books and critical literacy support to 200 poor outreach children. * The project plans to fulfilling the nutritional requirements of school-going children and establishing children's right to education.

title: The Academy of the Future helps children
description: Akademia Przyszosci (the Academy of the Future) is a project which helps children with low self-esteem since 2003. The Academy is a safe, creative space where a child meets another person, an adult who wants to devote their time and attention to the child and be a wise companion for them. The Academy equips children with resources and experiences, thanks to which they can overcome the existing obstacles and cope in future adult life - above all, it helps children believe in their potential.

title: One Dollar Appeal for Flood 2022 Affected Families
description: The aim of collecting one dollar is to minimize sufferings of flood affected 1,161,392 men, women and children of those families who lost their 282,533 houses either fully or partially and living in self made tents on road sides in district Mirpurkhas of Sindh province of Pakistan. Your 1 dollar donation will make enable us to respond their urgent humanitarian emergency needs like cooked/dry food items, clean drinking water, hygiene/sanitary items, mosquito nets, temporary shelter/latrine.

title: Enhance social wellbeing in small scale fisheries
description: This project is designed to strengthen the artisanal fishing communities of Santa Rosalia, San Bruno and H. Mulege in BCS MX through the development and adoption of social responsibility to complement their wellbeing. The objectives of this project are aligned with an integral Fisheries Improvement Project (FIP) complementing other objectives that address environmental, biological and technological impacts in order to achieve and maintain the sustainability of fisheries.

title: Help Save An Elephants' Home
description: It is essential that we tend to the surrounding land in the vicinity where the elephants traverse regularly enroute to the further areas of the reserve. The operation involves the rehabilitation of previously cultivated land to a more stable and naturally representative state. Once we reach our target, we will be able to apply preventative management techniques to the surrounding land to prevent environmental degradation shaped by the elephants.

title: School tuitions for Lebanese children
description: Between the dollarization of tuition fees in schools, the strikes of teachers, and the absence of plans and solutions by the Ministry of Education, we are on the verge of a major school dropout that Lebanon has not witnessed before. A school fee average is around 500usd, but the average salary in Lebanon is equivalent to 50usd. Therefore most of the families will not be able to send their children to school. If we join toghether we can support the future of young lebanese a student at a time!

title: Silence the Silent Killer 'High Blood Pressure'
description: According to Kenya's Ministry of Health, nearly one in every four Kenyans aged 20 to 50, and one in every two Kenyans over 50, has hypertension. Sadly, more than half of Kenyans have never had their blood pressure checked. Tharaka Nithi County recorded 27,136 hypertension cases in 2020 and 55,755 outpatient visits in 2021.  Providing BP Machines to CHVs will increase community screening, enhance early diagnosis and treatment and silence the silent killer- Hypertension.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, high school students, Jing-Ran, Tzu-Chieh, and Megumi have been working with LI to research and learn about public health crises in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to create a public health campaign to raise awareness and educate the people of Bauchi on these various public health issues.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, Sana, Irene, Omar, Sami, Krish, and Lindsay have been working with LI to help create & sustain businesses in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working on training local entrepreneurs. Through this, vulnerable men and women will develop capacities in vocational & business skills to empower & equip them to escape extreme poverty.

title: Gift quality education to girls in Mardan Pakistan
description: The project is intended to facilitate, educate and bring about 70 new girls' children to school from Pre-Nursery to Class 10th annually in Jalala area of District Mardan in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province, where 75% of the people work in brick kilns for generations. They don't send their children, especially girls, to school due to their lack of awareness, poor socio-economic situation, and other cultural restraints. The funds will be spent on scholarships and a safe school environment.

title: Help Afghan Refugees to Launch a Catering Business
description: This project seeks $5,000 to help a 27-member family of Afghan refugees in Maryland start a business selling homemade Afghan food. Back in Kabul, the female family-members worked alongside the men as interpreters, photojournalists, teachers, and engineers. One owned an HVAC business. Another was a professional boxer. Then came Taliban rule. The women became targets and were among the last to be evacuated. Your donations will provide the start-up capital for their new life in the US!

title: Help JA Worldwide reach 100 million youth by 2050
description: As one of the world's largest and most-impactful youth-serving NGOs, JA delivers hands on, immersive learning in entrepreneurship, financial health, work readiness, sustainability, STEM, economics, citizenship, ethics, and more.  Our new strategic plan sets us on a path to reach 100 million students annually by 2050 through geographic expansion, partnerships, reaching the underserved, and accelerating technology/digital. Your support will help us empower young entrepreneurs around the globe.

title: Young people empowering themselves the employment
description: We will strengthen the personal, labor, and social development of 20 young people in vulnerable situations in Mexico who are in search of employment. We will provide a comprehensive training program that allows the generation of socio-labor, technological and administrative skills necessary for this new century, allowing young people to strengthen their confidence and increase the possibilities of joining a dignified and well-paid job.

title: Pakistan Flood Emergency Supplies, and Shelter
description: Disaster Aid USA has worked in Pakistan previously including the 2010 floods. We have many trusted contacts on the ground, including village and district leaders to local Rotary clubs.  We are getting pictures and video in daily of the needs in their area. Real time info. We will first buy what supplies we can in Pakistan and transport to the affect area. Supplies not found locally will be sourced through our network of suppliers and shipped in quickly.

title: LEONATON: Support Families in Northwest Argentina
description: LEONATON plans to provide much needed support to over 3000 families in Northwest Argentina, delivering books, scholarships, and family orientation services, focusing on women and girls, people with disabilities, and seniors.

title: Pakistan Flood Appeal 2022
description: Over 4.2 million people have been affected by torrential rains and flash floods in all provinces of Pakistan. More than 1200 people have lost their lives with Balochistan having the highest toll of 234. Almost 4,800 people have been injured and about 736,000 houses have been damaged. 3,082 kilometers of roads and 145 bridges are destroyed. The loss of livestock has been estimated up to 793,995.

title: Reefs of Hope: Saving Corals in Warming Oceans
description: Coral reefs are predicted to die out within 30-50 years from intense marine heat waves.  Reefs of Hope is a revolutionary intervention to rescue heat resistant "super corals", found at the upper limit of possible survival, and in danger of dying out in the face of Global Warming.  Samples of these heat adapted corals are moved to the safety of cooler outer reef areas, creating heat resistant breeding populations of corals, which in turn accelerate natural coral adaptation and recovery processes.

title: Justice for All:Tackling Nukes and Climate Change
description: Commemorating the 40th Anniversary of the June 12, 1982 Rally for Nuclear Disarmament, our documentary intends to draw attention to the multi-varied perspectives of activists who were present at the historic event by specifically highlighting the work and memories of activists of color. In doing so, we intend to reveal the intertwined relationship between the struggles for environmental justice, social justice, and human rights.

title: New Community Cafe and Shop for Brixton
description: Brixton People's Kitchen will be increasing access to affordable, healthy food, as well as creating a space where people can meet and socialise, by setting up a new Community Shop and Cafe

title: Strong Foundations: Early Education in Rural Nepal
description: Our "Strong Foundations" project will improve the early childhood education experience for hundreds of children ages 3-5 in 23 classrooms in Ramdhuni Municipality, Nepal.  ETC and partner Save the Earth will:    1. Provide classroom materials, furniture, and recreational items; 2. Offer best-practice-based teacher training; 3. Host regular networking opportunities for the teachers (all women); and 4. Encourage parents' active involvement and support.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, high school students Tiffany, Anrica, Phoebe, Samuel, Darren, and Claire have been working with LI to research and learn about public health crises in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to create a public health campaign to raise awareness and educate the people of Bauchi on these various public health issues.

title: QUALITY EDUCATION & 21st CENTURY SKILLS FOR GIRLS
description: In the 21st century, it is not enough to graduate from a high school or a university. Everyone but especially young generations need new skills to be successful in the information age. Unfortunately, these skills are not covered in the formal education curriculum in Turkey. Therefore, CYDD started two new projects for its socio-economically disadvantaged secondary and high school female students. Seminars' contents are prepared and conducted by professional instructors.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, high school students, Nadia and Nura have been working with LI to research and learn about public health crises in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to create a public health campaign to raise awareness and educate the people of Bauchi on these various public health issues.

title: Love for Literacy: Support 85 Students this Year!
description: Yspaniola's Learning Center serves over 85 children in Batey Libertad, a marginalized community in the agricultural heart of the Dominican Republic. Our Center provides small-group Spanish literacy instruction for children in the community, including many who speak Haitian Creole at home with their families. This project will help sustain our programs for at-risk youth this school year: all funds donated will cover vital core costs including teaching materials, books and teacher's salaries.

title: Improve the Lives of Poor Hungry Widows in Nigeria
description: This project will provide $20 monthly support, to 20 poor widows each in Anambra State. The widowhood condition is a very stressful and devastating one, exposing women to psychological and physical abuse. In Nigeria, widows are being maltreated and face a lot of challenges like denial of property rights, rape, forced marriages, disinheritance etc. Raising at least $500 every month for this project, will help us keep it alive and we'll increase the number of the beneficiaries with more donations.

title: Helping Torture Victims in Bahrain
description: This project will help victims of torture in Bahrain get access to medicine and care for their conditions and injuries, and obtain legal help to fight their unjust imprisonment and inhumane treatment.

title: Fund our Financial Aid Program
description: Cape CARES is committed to welcoming a diverse and inclusive volunteer brigade. We recognize that the costs of volunteering, while necessary to cover the expenses of our work in rural communities of Honduras, can be a financial hardship for qualified and competent volunteers. That is why we are introducing a financial assistance program that will support volunteers in participating in our brigades by awarding scholarships to cover all or a portion of the $900 trip fee.

title: Support Composting by Women in Kibera, Kenya
description: The Advocacy Project is seeking $2,000 to help Shield of Faith, a dynamic woman's association, use vermiculture as a way to improve nutrition and reduce pollution in Kibera. Led by their inspiring coordinator Stella, seen in the photo, the group has set ambitious goals for this year: compost 500 kilos of food waste; grow a third of their vegetables in kitchen gardens; and sell 50 liters of leachate (fertilizer) produced by their worms. They feel this will inspire others to change their behavior.

title: CLEAN WATER FOR 1000 FULANI PEOPLE IN FOUMBOT.
description: The project will construct a manual well to provide clean and safe drinking water to over 1000 Fulani people in Mogni Village of Foumbot Sub-Division of The West Region of Cameroon. It aims to reduce infant mortality and the prevalence of cholera and other water born diseases among Fulani women and their children who shares water from dirty sources with livestock, and currently have no support for the provision of clean water. It will also provide training on sanitation and water treatment.

title: Educating for Wellbeing
description: Significant neurodevelopmental and socioemotional change occurs during early childhood, making it a period of great vulnerability, as well as great potential. It is an ideal time to cultivate social emotional competencies (SEC) and is particularly impactful for children living in poverty and with delays in SEC development. These types of support in early childhood helps close the inequality gap by equipping children with the skills they need to navigate challenging situations and succeed in life

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, Alec, Zedd, and Owen have been working with LI to help create & publicize human rights campaigns for various rights issues in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to connect with local nonprofits in Bauchi to research, document, and advocate for various human rights issues within the area.

title: PADS AND TRAINING FOR 250 GIRLS IN BAMENDA.
description: The project will work in under resource communities in Bamenda, to mobilize and organize economically disadvantaged in/out of school adolescent girls' (8-17) and women (18+) into 5 Self Help Groups mini-factories (each with 50 members) to locally manufacture and distribute their own high-quality feminine hygiene products to secure their own livelihoods and address menstruation-related absenteeism and trauma. It aims to provide menstrual hygiene education and empowerment for vulnerable girls.

title: Educate a child, prevent gender-based violence.
description: This project will seek to build four (4) classrooms to provide free education for children ages 3-35 who have witnessed their parents being brutally killed by gender-based violence and are turning to crime and violence for a living in the poorest areas in Jamaica.  They will be engaged in live classes, meals will be provided and they will be taught life skills, positive youth development, psychoeducational, basic counseling to be empowered with self-care strategies to move on to higher pathways.

title: Primary Health Center & Lab to Serve 30,000 People
description: Tender Grassroots will run a health center, complete with diagnostic lab and pharmacy to serve over 30,000 people in Kitubulu and surrounding communities in Kabale, Wasiko, Uganda. The clinic will significantly improve access to health care as the only affordable and comprehensive primary care center in the region. The clinic will respond to population needs and disease burdens, and focus first on prenatal care, health prevention and management for chronic diseases like diabetes and hypertension

title: Empower Aboriginal Women through Cultural Burning
description: Aboriginal women have played a significant role in care for Country through Cultural Burning for thousands of year. Over the past 250 years, women's connection to this ancient practice has been impacted by colonisation and the displacement of people from their ancestral lands.  We look forward to a future where Aboriginal women across Australia are provided opportunities that strengthen their connection to Country and allow for the continuance of culture, knowledge and storytelling.

title: Help Street Children Start Again in Uganda
description: A gift to this project WILL change the life for a young child on the streets of Uganda. Our team work on limited funds as our work is 100% funded by donations only. We work with children of all ages to help bring them off the street and into a community group for change. Offering shelter, accommodation, dance, education, sport and other activities to help these children develop. Our long term aim is to build a creative centre in the community where the children can come, learn and be safe.

title: From Victims to Community Peacebuilding Champions
description: Uganda Unites will set up 24 peace clubs in the 3 districts of Eastern Uganda that are prone to violence. The peace clubs will identify and work with 480 young people at risk of radicalization and violent extremism. These youth will be equipped with leadership, peacebuilding and conflict transformation skills. Aged between 13 and 25 years old, they will become agents of change within their communities advocating and educating for peace to end the cycles of violence that plague the country.

title: Protect women from sex trafficking in Mumbai
description: Project Rena is a project of El Shaddai based in Mumbai has been started to fight against child prostitution among the red light district of Turbhe Navi Mumbai for the development of women and children who are living under captivity. This project will also help in basic literacy, rescuing, life skill lessons, medical needs, and sewing projects to better their life along with empowering  women. Project Rene plans to have a safe House for the women and children who want to be rescued.

title: People On the Move, Suspended Futures
description: The project aims at meeting the urgent and acute needs of the apprehended unregistered refugees attempting to enter Turkiye through provision of most vital needs of the individuals. The target groups include the individuals rescued at sea, apprehended at the border regions of Turkiye or within the country's territories. With the raised funding, ASAM will provide clothing, shoes, food, hygiene, temporary shelter, medical assistance, transportation etc to alleviate the urgent needs.

title: Pakistan Flooding - Help Airlink Airlift Aid
description: Pakistan is grappling with its worst flooding in living memory. An estimated one-third of the country is underwater.  Airlink is supporting our partners responding in the region by providing airlift resources for critical emergency supplies. The most critical needs are currently food, shelter, mosquito nets, safe drinking water, access to water, sanitation, and hygiene services, and healthcare.

title: Pakistan floods 2022 Emergency Food & Shelter
description: Since June 2022, floods in Pakistan have affected over 33 million people and killed over 1,500 people, it is described as the worst flood disaster in country's history. The victims in this situation are facing various difficulties; most of the people have lost their homes, crops and livestock and are in urgent need for shelter, food, temporary tents. Your donation to Association for Humanitarian Development (AHD) will provide Emergency Support for the Floods 2022 in Pakistan.

title: Hearing health Tours 2023
description: Every year in Fundacion Oir es Vivir (FOV) we have two Hearing Health Tours (Gira Auditiva), where we go out to a rural location or low income communities in the city. We take our whole team to check on +150 children, ages 0-14, otorhinolaryngologists, audiologists, speech therapists and volunteers.  During this whole day session, children get their ears checked, wax removed and those that do not pass the hearing tests are remitted to our free clinic in Panama City.

title: Medical Relief for patients of CDS Nyakira
description: CDS Nyakira, a local clinic in Kanyosha, Burundi, serves residents of the commune. It is one of the few clinics in the area that provide leniency in repaying medical debt. Patients are allowed to get treatment and afterward have the option of paying immediate payment options or debt forgiveness. Beauty out of Dust wants to provide medical debt relief to families and individuals who demonstrate financial hardship clear their portions of medical debt to CDS Nyakira.

title: Help Ukrainian Schools affected by War
description: 2,104 schools were bombed and shelled during the full-scale war. 215 of them were completely destroyed. At the same time, there are schools that we can support right now. We have selected schools in Chernihiv, Sumy, Donetsk, Kharkiv, Sumy  and Kyiv regions, and we invite you to help more than 100,000 children return to better education - in online or offline format. These schools need equipment to replace what was destroyed or stolen: computer equipment or demonstration materials for lessons.

title: Guarantee Internet Access for Mayan Ixil Youth
description: NOVANET is a community Internet social project, created with the inspiration of connecting the Maya Ixil population of Chajul with everyone, at all times. Since its creation in 2016, NOVANET has connected organizations and families who have been able to pay a reasonable fee for the service; we have maintained accessibility and speed of the internet service in the community. This is notable because, due to the monopoly of companies in Guatemala, Internet service is very expensive, and this makes

title: Transform 50 children and youth through Education
description: This project helps 50 underprivileged children and youth in Ayapel, between 6 and 14 yeas, by providing educational opportunities. We establish a learning center, offer personalized tutoring, and mentorship programs to children and youth that are out of the education system or are lagging behind. By bridging the educational gap, we empower these children to overcome barriers and realize their full potential. we empower them to break the cycle of poverty through education.

title: Provide Former Children Soldiers A Brighter Future
description: This project will support the expansion of four programs that build professional vocational trade skills and create economic opportunities for 200 former child soldiers. In addition this project will help expand the "kids helping kids" community reintegration and trust building initiatives.

title: Healthy snacks allow kids a better education
description: In Educar y Crecer we work to strengthen the education of  500 children from vulnerable contexts in Argentina in 11 Student Learning Centers with innovative and effective educational programs.   Still, due to worsened socio-economic conditions, we have found the need to supplement the nutrition of our students, as many have manifested to eat only once a day. Thus, we provide them with healthy snacks that include fruit and superfoods, specially designed to cater for children's nutritional needs.

title: Financial Abuse Legal Service - Australia
description: Help us provide legal assistance to victim-survivors of financial abuse and other forms of domestic violence across New South Wales, Australia.
