Since establishment we have assisted over 400 victim survivors to resolve their legal and financial problems and regain their financial independence. In our first year alone, we helped our clients waive $600,000 of debt and recover $240,000 in compensation so they could move forward debt-free after escaping financially abusive relationships.

title: Fund Research on Drinking Water Supply in Nepal
description: The access to WASH is a human right. In Nepal however, millions of people lack access to basic water supply. Nepal Water for Health (NEWAH), an award winning NGO is developing and strengthening WASH (Water Sanitation and Hygiene) services and won't stop until everyone in the country, irrespective of gender, class, ethnicity or belief, is able to access their right to WASH. An essential part of NEWAH's work is carrying out research. Help NEWAH funding one of its major objectives.

title: Free Flood Relief Medical/Eye Camps in Pakistan
description: Pakistan has been hit the most devastating calamity in our history. Recent heavy monsoon floods have left 33% of the country submerged in water. More than 33 million people have been affected leaving them shelter less and economically disfranchised. Those left shelter less are now vulnerable to  water borne diseases and infections, and are in dire need of medical assistance. LRBT is holding free medical camps across Pakistan  by mobilizing its field team to provide relief to flood affectees.

title: The Noble Gift support Families in need in Poland
description: The Noble Gift is a nationwide social program in which dedicated material help is delivered before Christmas to people in need. Its main premise is the idea of providing direct aid, so that it is effective, concrete and meaningful, but also giving hope and an impulse of change. By regularly supporting our activities, you allow us to expand and contribute to smart and direct aid impacting the lives of thousands of people by giving them a chance for a better future.

title: Help 24 Million Nepalese with access to safe water
description: The latest study of UNICEF in Nepal revealed that 81% of Nepal's population has no access to water labeled as "safely managed". That's about 24 Million people. Nepal Water for Health (NEWAH), an award winning nepalese NGO is developing and strengthening WASH (Water Sanitation and Hygiene) services and won't stop until everyone in the country, irrespective of gender, class, ethnicity or belief, is able to access their right to WASH. Support NEWAH and help achieving their mission.

title: Healing Hands Shelter for the Vulnerable
description: Whilst carrying out their daily activities it has been proven that the need for shelter just not solely lie with women and children. There is a great number of street dwellers within our Metro, people that have unfortunately become victims of circumstance, due to financial constraints, substance abuse, victims of violence or disaster and are now unfortunately homeless.  seeing the great improvement the Shelter for women and children has established, we have undertaken to open a fulltime shelter

title: Help Ukrainians prepare for winter
description: Looks like a cold one is on the horizon, and not just for those who are officially recognized as refugees. Since February 24th, Katalyst Kitchens has been distributing healthy, local food to thousands of families every week, over HALF A MILLION POUNDS in the first six months. We served over 16,000 families, and with your help, we'd like to help them through the winter, with clothing, bedding and home repairs.

title: Empowering Teens through Community and Leadership
description: The GRACE Teen Ambassador program is designed to empower teens though community service and leadership. This goal is achieved through instilling leadership skills by giving our ambassadors active roles in our human trafficking prevention centered projects. Each project is designed to assist in eradicating the vulnerabilities associated with human trafficking - poverty and illiteracy. Our areas of focus are educational, wellness, and nutritional support.

title: Help Brighten the Lives of Children in Poverty
description: The stark reality of poverty significantly impacts the lives of many families in  San Ramon Costa Rica. While every family member is affected, it can be especially difficult for children who deserve to have a childhood free from worry and care. The Community Action Alliance of Costa Rica (CAA) in San Ramon, is a group of expats and Costa Ricans who are actively working to create some bright spots in the lives of those children whose world is impacted by poverty.

title: Famine Relief for Karamoja, Uganda
description: For the past 2 years because of a lack of consistent rainfall, there has been significant crop failures in the remote area of Karamoja, in NE Uganda.  The families living there are the poorest of the poor in Uganda. Today they are experiencing life threatening famine.  Local authorities have estimated that close to 800 have died so far. Serve Uganda has responded quickly with funds for life saving food.  We are expecting another need for food early in 2023.

title: Wool for Ukraine
description: The therapeutic benefits of working with wool are very well known and documented. At the Zywiec Development Foundation we have launched a programme to assist with supporting and providing relief to refugees from the Ukrainian War. This is a "Wool for Ukraine" programme which uses the therapeutic benefits of working with wool to offset the effects of the distress and growing spread of Post Traumatic Stress Disorders caused by this conflict and focuses on support for both children and adults.

title: California Wildfire Relief Fund
description: California is facing another severe wildfire crisis, with more than a dozen active fires burning thousands of acres and threatening entire towns. Two people were killed and one injured in the fast-moving Fairview Fire. All donations to this fund will support wildfire relief and recovery efforts in California. Your donation will go to vetted nonprofits providing food, water, and shelter. This fund will remain open through fire season and beyond to support the most impacted communities.

title: AGROSOCIALE
description: Food insecurity, health crisis, global warming, erosion of biodiversity The world seems to find itself trapped at the crossroads of multiple crises. The most vulnerable populations are the first victims. Faced with these difficulties,  AFRICAN IMPACT is intended by this project called "AGROSOCIAL" to fight against hunger and poverty and also to take appropriate measures to produce crops at any time of the year without waiting for more precipitation in order to resist the anomaly. Climatic

title: HEALTHY NUTRITION FIRST THOUSAND DAYS
description: The Pan y Panela Foundation is a non-profit organization aimed at contributing to the needs of food, clothing and comprehensive care in vulnerable communities in the city of Barranquilla and/or the department of Atlantico. Likewise, it seeks to stimulate cultural and recreational activities that aim to improve the quality of life of people who are in a condition of poverty and/or extreme poverty through the creation of projects, programs and alliances with public and private entities.

title: HOUSE PURCHASE FOR CHILD CARE CENTER IN CARTAGENA
description: This project is developed from the purchase of a house, for the operation of the center for children care. The center will benefit in feed, psycosocial attention and education to more than 300 children in vulnerability, need and poverty status, in order to improve their quality of life.

title: Help1000 malnourished vulnerable fatherless kids
description: The project will support malnourished vulnerable fatherless children at Ngoma district in Rwanda. Each beneficiary will receive 2 eggs , 2 bananas, 2 Tamarillos  and 1L of  milk plus talent detection & career development per week to 4 quarters. Every Friday.   We work with Abajyanama b'ubuzima. Your support will help to rescue them  from malnutrition, void of father roles. note that 100% of malnourished vulnerable fatherless are helpless and voiceless.

title: Value Based Skills Oriented Quality Education
description: Bhagavatula Charitable Trust (BCT) provides a three part curriculum for rural and tribal children of Visakhapatnam district of Andhra Pradesh and enabling them to pursue technical higher education. With the best of the teaching and learning methodologies, these children are able to gain knowledge much better than their peers around while becoming leaders in their villages, creating a better future for everyone around.  This project aims at increasing the number of children to be educated.

title: Rehabilitate a Poor School in a Village in Yemen
description: This project rehabilitates a poor rural school in in a village in Al-Abr district in Yemen including rehabilitation of 4 classrooms, 5 bathrooms and other maintenance in Al Amira school. The project comes to support the access of 388 vulnerable student (204 boys and 184 girls) to the school and provide support for 15 teachers through 15 teaching kits and incentives for their transportations to the village for a year.

title: Food and Emergency Support for Internal Refugees
description: We will provide food and emergency support for internal refugees in order for them to survive and rebuild their lives. Several factors has increased the number of internal refugees in recent years and these are climate change that results to more severe and frequent typhoons, massive soil loss resulting to poor crops, drying of rivers and waterways but flooding during monsoon rains, insurgency in the countryside and general malaise and lawlessness.

title: Giving foods to 68 children in Quang Tri, Vietnam
description: This project will give milks to 68 children in Cam Lo and Dong Ha, Quang Tri, each child get a carton of milk (180ml) per day to supplement nutrition for the child physical improvement. Besides, we will also support necessities and dry food monthly for 32/68 children. The daily maintenance of milk intake will supplement the children's nutrition, improve their physical health, and enable them to be healthy enough to study, get rid of school dropout and illiteracy.

title: Malagasy students - access to employability in IT
description: Our project supports 50 disadvantaged youth in Madagascar to increase their employability which will open the doors to tech higher education in Madagascar, with a goal of finding quality work.  A sustainable end to poverty.   Madagascar is experiencing a growing need for technical IT skills in all areas, with almost all digital sectors represented on the Big Island, and a demand for digital talent that will grow in the coming years.

title: Socio-aesthetics for patients at hospital
description: Cancer treatment is very intense and the child then experiences the painful body or its alteration (skin alteration, hair and eyebrow loss, weight...). For several years, we offers weekly therapeutic support workshop sessions to patients at the Lille & Dunkerque hospitals. It brings them relief, enhance self-esteem, facilitate family relations & many other psychological/physical positive effects. In a few years, the services have seen an increase in the number of patients welcomed.

title: Dental Hygiene Education in Mexico
description: SoulGives Company is directing a 48 month program in Cozumel to educate 5,000 children and adults about the effects of frequent sugar consumption and to teach them proper dental hygiene. We seek donations to fund essential dental products and educational materials, and then sponsor follow-up treatment from local dentists for those needing special care.

title: Fighting the MMIP Epidemic and Healing Survivors
description: There is an ongoing epidemic of violence against Indigenous Peoples. Too many are stolen from their families by traffickers, never to return. Searches for our missing Indigenous Peoples are community led, time is of the essence, and many are left to try to heal alone.  There are also isolated Indigenous people who have survived residential boarding schools and separation from their communities who deserve healing and care. This Missing and Surviving Indigenous Peoples Initiative is for them.

title: Pakistan Flood Response 2022
description: Pakistan has been experiencing a brutal monsoon season and currently more than a third of the country is flooded with 33 million people affected. This outpaces the record setting flood season from 2010 and puts millions of people at risk from lack of access to clean drinking water, food, shelter, and medical care. GlobalMedic is responding to re-establish access to some of these basic resources, including food and clean drinking water, and get help to those most vulnerable.

title: Preventing Diabetic Retinopathy Blindness in China
description: Diabetic retinopathy is now the leading cause of blindness among working age, if not properly managed, may lead to permanent blindness. China has the largest number of diabetes and the prevalence of diabetic retinopathy is high. A DR early intervention and network building program is sorely needed in order to build a system delivering proper comprehensive medical care to diabetic patients in rural China.

title: Pakistan Humanitarian Crises: Flood Emergency 2022
description: Over 35 Million humans are affected by Flooding across Pakistan since June 2022. Severe Health risks along with food insecurity.  The Federal Government of Pakistan has declared a national emergency as the floods killed more than 1,300 people and destroyed homes, crops, and livestock. At least 33 million people are in need of shelter. Your donation to the Pakistan Humanitarian Crises: Flood Emergency 2022 will provide immediate Support and Relief to the affected communities of Pakistan.

title: Help a Poor Brainy Nigerian Girl to Stay in School
description: This project will support Michelle, an intelligent girl from a poor family and an undergraduate at Nnamdi Azikiwe University Nnewi campus, to buy an android phone in order to aid her education, as hers was stolen and this is seriously affecting her studies. Phones are not only used as a means of communication but also used by students to learn and research online for assignments. May you be richly blessed as you donate to help us in supporting this poor intelligent girl.

title: Good, Decent Toilets for 49 families in Zimbabwe
description: In the Matopos region of Zimbabwe, local volunteers identified 49 families infected or affected with HIV/AIDS who lack a toilet. This means that these families are defecating and urinating in the tall grasses or forests surrounding their homes. AFCA will build long drop toilets (loos) using recycled materials, providing the families with decent and safe toilets. A solar lamp will complete the package, allowing beneficiaries to use the facilities with the aid of a light.

title: Mercy Health Neonatal Services
description: This project will raise much needed funds for Mercy Hospital for Women's Neonatal Intensive Care Unit and Special Care Nursery to purchase vital equipment. This equipment is necessary to continue providing care for the smallest and sickest premature babies, who often need help to breathe.

title: Back to School_Uniform Need
description: The Children is returning to school after long time school closed due to Covid 19 pandemic. There is a need for school shoes, uniforms and stationery. Many children walk long distances to school and a comfortable pair of shoes is a necessity. We are looking for support to support many vulnerable children. We have seen and hear directly that Uniform is a need for them back to school.

title: Mobility  Devices  for children with special needs
description: Parents of children have 3 questions 1.When will my child talk? 2.When will my child walk? 3 After me who will take care? APD is constantly engaged to find answers and rehabilitate these children with special need to be functionally independent. APD thus believes in the philosophy of EQUIP, ENABLE & EMPOWER By providing the right type of mobility aids such as personalized  Ankle Foot Orthosis, walkers, crutches, wheelchairs, hearing aids, commodes, rollators  we are able to make their lives easy

title: Solar panels for our refugee food bank
description: Before the Ukraine crisis, Katalyst Kitchens was an organic farm and food business incubator, however, on February 24th, they pivoted to start feeding thousands of families every week, delivering over HALF A MILLION POUNDS of healthy, local food so far. Due to the war, the price of heating gas and electricity are expected to jump 400-500% this winter.  Help Katalyst provide uninterrupted refugee support by installing solar panels and backup batteries, achieving energy independence.

title: Provide digital inclusion for 500 Kenyan children
description: This project will construct a library and ICT hub and provide digital literacy education to 500 pupils who are digitally excluded.  Connectivity will be a gamechanger: fostering learning, connecting with other communities in Kenya and beyond, and equipping children and young people with the skills they need to thrive in today's digital economy.

title: Responsible sourcing cobalt
description: The project will improve the working conditions of 200 women through technical and financial support based on leadership training, entrepreneurship and especially financial support based on the legalization to enable the completion of SOCOMIB, an artisanal mining women co-op registration process as well as foster the granting by the authorities of an artisanal site dedicated to women in Biwaya. It will integrate women into the formal economy transforming the lives and safety of their children .

title: Rescuing independent LGBT Russian language media
description: This is an appeal to save the Parni PLUS website, the leading Russian language media outlet produced by, and for LGBTQ+ people and allies since 2008. The site provides information about HIV, sexual health and lifestyle while fighting myths about homosexuality.   In 2022, the organization has been recognised as a foreign agent by the state, forcing our journalists to work incognito or leave Russia altogether. We seek your help to save the valuable resource that Parni PLUS has become from collapse

title: Fruit for the life &Climate Mitigation in Hiran.
description: This campaign generates greater income &uplifts farming communities out of poverty by planting high-quality organic fruit &N-fixing trees.BUDO and cooperatives raise the trees in community-managed nurseries and then distribute them to farmers and schools in Yucub-Somalia. Beneficiaries of the new project are 150 households, 50 female and 100 male. project will cover include Tamarindus indica, Sesban sesbania,Tamarinda mentalis, Zisphus,moritaniana, Gliricidia sepium,NEEM tree, Lemond, date,olive

title: Childhood Cancer awareness month
description: Did you know that cancer is one of the major causes of death during childhood in the World? And only 44% of children, due to lack of adequate diagnosis, receive the right treatment on time?   September is Childhood Cancer awareness month, and with your help in Fundacion Nuestros Hijos we will be able to provide one-month pain relief medication for 20 children with cancer.

title: Educate a Child with Disability
description: The Association of People with Disability(APD) has a very strong vision and mission of promoting inclusive education for children with special needs in the state of Karnataka. Our founder Ms. N.S Hema believed in the philosophy that people with disabilities must learn to live in a world that has a majority of able-bodied people. 48 years ago, she pioneered the concept of Inclusive Education with the goal of mainstreaming children with disabilities into regular schools.

title: Distribution of Hygiene Kits to Flood Affectees
description: The project will be implemented in 10 selected villages of Union Councils (UCs) Gara Baloch & Pai District Tank, province Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Pakistan. The Provincial Disaster Management Authority (PDMA) Peshawar has declared these 10 villages as severely affected by flash flood.  The project will provide hygiene kits and information to 500 families with the aim to improve their living conditions as these items were lost in the flooding and which are at risk of diseases.

title: Save patients with cancer in Venezuela
description: Healing Venezuela Infrastructure Programme will develop projects to repair, reinstate and buy important medical equipment which is needed to improve the Venezuelan health system.  With your help, an operating theatre at the most important cancer hospital, Padre Machado - which is located in the low income neighbourhood of "El Cementerio" in Caracas - will be back in service to attend not just patients with cancer from the capital, but also individuals from surrounding areas.

title: Dance/Music Arts Festival for Schools in Mali
description: We need your urgent help! Please support Kono Gnaga's mission to uphold the rich cultural arts traditions for the next generation of Mali and our promise to the children and families who have come to rely on the annual festival for a sense of HOPE, CONNECTION and JOY! We are in Critical Need of $5000 to fully fund the 5th annual community school dance and drum festival serving local artists, 3 schools, 80+ children and 300+ members across three communities.

title: Italy Flood Relief Fund 2022
description: On September 16, 2022, deadly flooding hit Italy's central Marche region. Severe weather wreaked havoc in and around Ancona, the region's capital, with extremely above average amounts of rain falling in the space of a few hours. Survivors climbed trees or rushed up to rooftops to await rescue. At least 10 people are dead, 50 are injured and 4 are still missing with hundreds of displaced. All donations to this fund will exclusively support local relief and recovery efforts.

title: SPL Rescue Center Construction
description: - This project will build a rescue center as a temporary home to protect and care for Stray Dogs of Loreto.    -Stray Paws Loreto will continue providing spay and neuter clinics as well as veterinary care for stray dogs  - This project will help to find forever homes for strays  - Stray Paws Loreto will partner with local community to run a permanent awarness campaigns about local animal protection laws and responsible pet ownership Helping one by one until there are None.

title: Hurricane Fiona Emergency Response
description: On September 18, 2022, Puerto Rico was hit once again by a natural disaster. Hurricane Fiona caused catastrophic and historic flooding throughout the Island. A total blackout is currently affecting the Island and there are dozens of isolated areas without access or communication.  On this date, 5 years ago, Hurricane Maria caused extreme damage from which Puerto Rico was still recovering.

title: Hurricane Fiona Relief Fund
description: Hurricane Fiona has caused widespread destruction and catastrophic flooding in multiple locations, killing at least 16 people, cutting off access to running water, and spurring island-wide power outages in Puerto Rico near the five-year anniversary of Hurricane Maria. Communities in the Dominican Republic and Canada are also facing major damage and displacement after Fiona hit. Your donation to the Hurricane Fiona Relief Fund will provide immediate and long-term relief in affected communities.

title: Taiwan Earthquake Relief Fund
description: On September 18, 2022, a 6.8-magnitude earthquake struck Taiwan, killing at least one person and injuring more than 140 people. Survivors need access to emergency supplies like food, water, and medicine.  All donations to this fund will exclusively support local relief and recovery efforts from this earthquake.

title: Puerto Rico Hurricane Fiona emergency supplies.
description: Disaster Aid USA core relief expertise is in shelter, clean water, emergency supplies as in solar lighting that also charge cell phones, hygiene kits, mosquito nets, tarps, food etc.  We worked in Puerto Rico extensively after Hurricane  Maria bring clean water and shelter to remote communities.  DAUSA try to find the communities other don't reach as they concentrate on larger cities.

title: Help NYC's Students in Need Catch Up at School
description: This project will provide academic interventions, tutoring, homework help, GED classes, and other supports to New York City's students who fell behind during the pandemic - especially those who live in poverty, a group that was disproportionately impacted.

title: Learning resources for Colombian rural schools
description: Fundacion Escuela Nueva will provide learning resources and materials to five rural schools in Vaupes (Colombia), benefiting approximately 125 under-resourced children, mostly indigenous. These didactic resources can contribute to educational quality by encouraging the development of students research spirit and autonomy and fostering the active and cooperative learning processes and environment promoted by the Escuela Nueva model.

title: A hungry child cannot study
description: In Venezuela, 35% of children under two years of age have chronic malnutrition, characterized by growth retardation, according to the Venezuelan Food Security Observatory. The first years of life are key to the development of children. Malnutrition is a serious problem that we must avoid, to achieve the healthy growth of our children and that they can study. A hungry child cannot study! We need to feed our children and young people, so that they can be the positive leaders that Venezuela needs.

title: Empower Girls' Education With Clickfunnels
description: Girls' education is not just about getting girls into school-it's about equipping girls with the life skills, knowledge, and confidence necessary to make informed decisions about their lives and future. By delivering access to one-on-one and group psychosocial counselling, life skills development, gender equity and child rights education, and career guidance and support, you'll help 600 vulnerable girls in Naivasha, Kenya, to complete high school and realize their full potential.

title: Help 200 students stay in school
description: The project aims to provide knowledge and skills development activities for 200 children from underprivileged families in Bulgaria. Through free summer activities in different locations, we will work to prevent children from dropping out of school and will help them fill the gaps in their knowledge.  Your support will contribute to the organisation of Summer START academies in different locations and will cover costs related to the execution of the Academies such as food, training materials,etc.

title: 365 days of health for those who need it
description: The Hours of Life, dedicates every day to bring health to the people in situations of social vulnerability. We know that in a country with so much inequality, every hour counts and every support makes a difference in someone's life.  Health is serious business. To renew the our commitment to society, we will launch the 365 days of health campaign for those in need to collect donations and convert them into consultations and exams for people in social vulnerability.  Come with us to save lives.

title: Join us to repair a building in El Shouf Lebanon
description: We are launching a crowdfunding campaign to repair a building in the Baasir-Shouf, Lebanon, which is threatened with collapse and contains 5 families, including children and widows. The campaign aims to shelter the residents and restore the building in a transparent process that is not linked to any political party.

title: Life after transplantation in Venezuela
description: It is a campaign aimed at meeting the needs of those transplanted children who need assistance related to tests, laboratories, ultrasounds, blood drug levels, evaluations, etc, so that the path after surgery is completed successfully. The post-transplant treatment is vital for the patient, and the immunosuppressive drugs are for life - so that no rejection of the transplanted graft is generated. Therefore, it is essential to accompany the patient after surgery and monitor their health every two

title: SCHOOL FOR 500 BORDER CONFLICT VICTIMS
description: This project will construct a school for 500 border conflict victims in Isfara City of Tajikistan bordering with Kyrgyzstan. Three schools were destroyed in this city  during the armed conflict at the Tajik-Kyrgyz border on September 14-17, 2022. The school will resume the access of 500 local children  to quality education. We believe you will spare no effort to support the education of vulnerable victims of the borders conflict in Tajikistan. We are confident, we can do a lot with your support.

title: Ubuntu Education Fund
description: Since 2012 this fund has educated /trained 26 orphaned and vulnerable youth in the Uthukela District of KwaZulu Natal, South Africa.  Providing education has been recognized as powerful in mitigating factors of orphanhood and poverty. High performing but impoverished or orphaned youth are referred by teachers and local leaders for eligibility. Our experienced, local, multi cultural team awards funding. Each student   has a mentor who provides close support and advice, mitigating personal risk.

title: Mobile disaster unit
description: As Heartland Equality has created an entirely new division with Allies in Action dedicated to helping those in Kentucky, Illinois, Missouri, and Tennessee in times of disaster (as seen in the December 10th Storms that ravaged Western Kentucky & Tennessee, and the historic flooding and devastation in Eastern Kentucky).  Heartland Equality has donated more than 18 truckloads worth of goods from food to blankets and housing supplies to both immediate and long-term recovery.  A truck is in dire need

title: Water, essential element for Venezuelan Children
description: The project proposes the installation of a drinking water plant and a deep well to provide this essential element for the life and health of the community of Turgua in Venezuela. The goal is to meet the basic needs of access to drinking and healthy water for consumption by families and especially children, who are part of this student community.

title: 3rd ANNUAL BACK -TO- SCHOOL BOOK RIDE 2022
description: WE NEED YOUR SUPPORT!!!  The need is simple: Children and students in Liberia need books and learning materials. Learning Squared is organizing its 3rd annual back-to-school book ride throughout our project areas in Liberia, distributing learning materials, notebooks, pens, and pencils to underprivileged students and community schools.  Many vulnerable and underserved children whose families cannot afford to keep them in school are without books and supplies for the school year.

title: Sport, Art and Therapy for 50 children in Zambia
description: This project provides a highly effective 10 week sports and arts programme combined with group therapy to 50 children and youth in conflict with the law in Lusaka, Zambia to improve their mental and physical health and help them reintegrate into society. The programme will focus on reinforcing positive behaviours and reducing anti-social behaviour. 50 parents are also reached through weekly support groups.  A new group of teens and parents will start in June 2023 if funding goals are reached.

title: For Marche Region after flood
description: A new subscription, after a new tragedy. Following last week's floods that have struck Marche region, the Foundation is committed to help reconstruct the areas that have been severely damaged by the waters. Specchio has already done some first site inspections to understand the type of intervention that is needed. To the pain for the many, too many deaths, there were in fact very heavy damages in some municipalities already appear to be huge at a very first evaluation.

title: Help a Poor Girl to escape Hunger in Nigeria
description: This project will support Victoria to start a stockfish, dried fish and crayfish business, in order to earn a living and be able to take good care of herself and her younger ones. Victoria is a 26-year-old girl, who lost her mother while she was 6 years old. She resides in Nnewi and has been struggling to survive, finding it difficult to feed and sleeps on the floor in a small room that she rented. She really needs support to start this business, as this business is very lucrative in Nigeria.

title: Build a grade six classroom
description: We established Nenkashe Primary School in January 2022. The new school follows the new government enforced Competency Based Curriculum (CBC) where learning is based on the needs and potential of individual learners under flexible framework and parameters that move and shift according to the learner's needs. Our urgent need for now is to build a permanent Grade 6 classroom for use in January 2023 when the new academic year begins.

title: Educate a Girl, Educate a Nation - iraq
description: Unfortunately, in many iraq families, girls traditionally have relatively less or limited access to educational opportunities as boys receive education preference. We are helping to level the playing field by providing scholarships to girls at risk of dropping out of school. The girls receive guidance to help them stay on track with their educational goals. They also receive reproductive health education. This helps ensure that they don't drop out of school due to early motherhood.

title: To give back joy to 400 traumatized Ukrainian kids
description: This project helps 400 traumatized Ukrainian children, living now in small towns and rural areas of Poland due to military conflict in Ukraine, regain their joy of life and builds strength for their future. We will do it through organizing a year-long plays and workshops for 400 children. We will base our work on mutual integration and education between Ukrainian and Polish children supported by guardians, psychologists and cultural exchange.

title: Help us build PawzUp, first cage free shelter
description: First cage-free shelter from Romania projected to bring people and animals together and allow them to help one another and enjoy each other's company. Why PawzUp? Because we always dream for a better place for animals and also, because both animals and people in Romania needs this project completed as a legacy for the generations that come after us.  The total estimated cost to build entire PawzUp exceeds 5 milion dollars but initially we fundraise for the first building, the dog shelter.

title: Fund Surgery and Education for 3 Orphans in Kumbo.
description: The project will fund the surgery of an orphan and the education of this child and his two brothers, who are helpless due to poverty and lost of their father. The project will fund complete medical surgery for a  15 year old boy, "A", who has been suffering from growth since he was about 5 years old. Additionally, it will provide educational support for him and his two brothers, "B and C" by paying their tuition fees, books, uniform and shoes for 5 years in Kumbo.

title: Plant 25000 Agroforestry Trees in Foumban.
description: The project will establish 5 tree nurseries in 5 villages of Foumban Municipality to voluntarily provide 25000 agroforestry tree seedlings to 500 rural households to combat climate change, poverty and malnutrition. It will focus on Moringa tree planting as cash crop. However, other economic trees like pear, Mangoes, Oranges, Papaw and large herbs like bananas and plantains remains the main focus in achieving food security and economic growth for low income families in the area.

title: DONATE A TREE: CAPTURE THE CARBON
description: Friendship is planting mangrove trees managed by local communities in the south of Bangladesh, adjacent to the Sundarbans-the world's largest mangrove forest. Mangroves absorb carbon much faster than other forest ecosystems. They are also an essential income source and natural barrier against cyclones, tidal surges and salinisation. This project is one of 20 best-practice examples of Forest and Landscape Restoration in Asia-Pacific as per IUCN.

title: Water drilling for clean water in 2 remote village
description: Developing the water supply services/facilities for 2 remote rural villages Goko and Koyo in Mali where diseases spread easily, where women spend exhausting hours to bring filthy water to cook and daily needs.

title: Feed and Support Poor Hungry Beggars in Nigeria
description: This project will provide financial support and food items for poor beggars in Nnewi, Anambra State, in order to help them survive the economic challenges being faced in Nigeria. Nigeria is known as the poverty capital of the world, with about 90 million (45%) of it's population living below poverty line. These beggars include men, women and children who are poor, sick, blind, deaf and dumb, disabled etc.Your donation will help to provide them with the basic needs of life, which includes food.

title: Hurricane Ian Relief Fund
description: Hurricane Ian is one of the strongest hurricanes to hit the United States, landing in Florida and then South Carolina after its deadly sweep across Cuba. The powerful hurricane has caused rising fatalities, catastrophic damage, and mass displacement. Your donation to the Hurricane Ian Relief Fund will provide immediate and long-term relief in affected communities.

title: Xiaohusai Tea
description: Xiaohusai is a student-run social enterprise, named after a village in southwest China and based in Shanghai. We partner with tea farmers from the Yunnan Province of southwest China by selling organic tea-leaves- sourced directly from their farms- and return 100% of the profits back to them. The funds collected often go towards merit-based scholarships for the village children, but infrastructural projects are included within our vision as well.

title: Improving Maternal and Child Health in Madagascar
description: With health expenditure among the lowest in the world, Madagascar's limited access to healthcare and knowledge of sexual and reproductive health poses a significant risk to the health of children, young people, and mothers. In Fort Dauphin, misinformation exacerbates poor health outcomes, with low education levels of mothers linked to increased rates of under-five mortality amongst their children.  Project Votsira is a two-year project that aims to improve maternal and child health.

title: KIWL 2022 Go-Go Run
description: The 2022 Knights in White Lycra Go-Go Run is working in tandem with YouMeWe NPO to provide funding for Tokyo area children's homes. Throughout November, run or jog a minimum distance of 55km (55 means "go go" in Japanese). Measure your distance using a GPS watch or a GPS activity tracker app on your smartphone and upload it to KIWL's club for the event.

title: Hurricane Ian
description: Disaster Relief Response with rescue boats, backhoes, chainsaw, tarping, and muck an gut teams is what we do best with over 45 Domestic disaster deployments in the last 10 years. Florida teams are deploying and Louisiana and Texas teams on the way as of 9/27. East coast teams will come to assist also.  Clearing roads and trees off house, General Debris removal, delivering  supplies to most affected areas, and coordinating logistics for a continuous supply chain is just a few task we perform.

title: Emergency Response to Hurricane Ian
description: Ian strengthened into a Category 4 hurricane while moving toward Florida, making landfall in the state on Wednesday afternoon. Ian is expected to bring life-threatening storm surges between 12 to 18 feet along the coastal Fort Myers area, from Englewood to Bonita Beach; catastrophic winds from 150 to 190 mph in southwest Florida; and widespread, flooding rain of 12 to 14 inches in central and northeastern Florida.  International Medical Corps is currently on the group ready to respond.

title: Support children with facial differences in Taiwan
description: Sunshine Social Welfare Foundation will support 300 children with facial difference and their families annually, by addressing their medical, financial, psychosocial and educational concerns through medical information, financial aid for medical interventions not covered by the national health insurance, emotional support and psychological counseling, school re-entry programs and educational programs. Services will be provided throughout Taiwan by our six regional service centers.

title: End Period Poverty
description: Through this project, URDA plans to provide 400 women with the awareness and supplies needed to better understand and take care of their personal hygiene through awareness sessions and the distribution of hygiene kits.

title: Help for victims of Hurricane Fiona
description: Hurricane Fiona's trajectory  through the Dominican Republic has left thousands of vulnerable families without homes, increasing the level of food insecurity in the affected areas of the East and Northeast Zones of the country. The RD Food Bank is receiving and distributing the aid, but food donations are not enough, so we need financial resources to buy food and cover the costs of transportation and distribution of the aid that our affected brothers and sisters need.

title: Help Airlink Airlift Aid - Hurricane Ian
description: Hurricane Ian made landfall on Florida's Gulf Coast as a dangerous Category 4 hurricane - battering communities across Florida. The damage is still being assessed but so far millions of people are without power and many are displaced from their homes. Airlink is currently working with our NGO and airline partners to provide immediate needs for those affected by Hurricane Ian. Those needs include: response teams focused on home repair, clean-up, WASH, medical assistance, and more.

title: Help Airlink Airlift Aid - Hurricane Fiona
description: Hurricane Fiona has heavily impacted communities across Puerto Rico, the Dominican Republic and Canada with heavy winds and rain creating flooding, mudslides, and significant damage to homes.  We are currently working with relief partners who are on the ground assessing critical needs and assisting our NGO partners by coordinating airlift for emergency responders.

title: Rebuilding Hope for Ukrainian families
description: The war in Ukraine has made life even more difficult for children and their families already struggling to treat life-threatening cancers. By transforming an old, abandoned hostel near Lviv into a new apartment complex, Soleterre has given a home to 30 Ukrainian families in need. But the war isn't over, and these families still need our support. Help Soleterre to provide families with a place to live free of charge, easy access to cancer treatment, a sense of community and peace of mind.

title: Digital inclusion to end poverty
description: Established in 2005, our flagship program provides vocational training in the digital sector to underprivileged youth.  We presently operate in Cambodia, Philippines, and Vietnam and most recently in Madagascar.  Passerelles numeriques (PN) offers a IT training program at our center, for the most vulnerable and marginalized youth. Our mission is to truly develop our students' employability which will allow them and their families to escape poverty in a sustainable way.

title: Protect QTBIPOC Access to Abortion Care
description: Reproductive choice and access to healthcare is under attack across the United States. Seeding Sovereignty knows that BIPOC and gender expansive community members seeking abortions will be hardest hit. Our new grassroots Abortion Doula Training Program provides essential skills, healing care, critical funds and networks for people to support themselves and their community during an abortion. We believe that all people should have access and tools as compassionate  informed abortion companions.

title: Improving healthcare access in Bolivar, Venezuela
description: Fundacion Proyecto Maniapure es una ONG con mas de 25 anos de experiencia que busca incrementar y mejorar el acceso a servicios de salud primaria de calidad para comunidades indigenas y criollas, de dificil acceso, del sur de Venezuela | Fundacion Proyecto Maniapure is an NGO with more than 25 years of experience that provides access to healthcare to indigenous and creole communities in southern Venezuela, specifically in the state of Bolivar, Venezuela, in the districts Cedeno and Gran Sabana.

title: Provide Fresh Meals to Hurricane Ian Survivors
description: This project will provide much-needed disaster relief aid to the Ft. Myers, FL area in the form of fresh healthy meals including fresh leafy greens from our aquaponics farm in Southeast, FL. We are partnering with area soup kitchens and other community groups to help distribute salads and other greens based meals. Post-storm, many individuals are forced to eat unhealthy canned goods and for many especially with health issues this can be very damaging.

title: Empower women trough a charpentry workshop
description: "Todavia es tiempo'' (It's still time) foundation works with around 250 families in vulnerable situation in Paso del Rey, Buenos Aires, providing trainings in fields such as carpentry, ceramics, bakery, chocolate and production of artisan jams with the aim of generating job opportunities for women in the community. Currently the spaces allocated to these workshops are insufficient. This project involves the construction of a new 600 m2 building.

title: Leave NO ONE behind
description: Although we have made progress towards building a better world, too many people have been left behind. People who are unable to benefit from human development, innovation or economic growth.  In fact, millions of people around the world cannot afford a healthy diet, putting them at high risk of food insecurity and malnutrition. But ending hunger isn't only about supply. Enough food is produced today to feed everyone on the planet.

title: One Day. One Focus:  Ending   Polio 24 October
description: Polio used to be common in the United States. Before the polio vaccine, the disease killed thousands of people and paralyzed about 15,000 each year. Thanks to the polio vaccine, we've come close to ending polio, but it continues to threaten communities in parts of the globe. In rural communities, infants, babies have commonly suffer innocently in this danger.  Getting vaccinated is the best way to prevent polio.

title: Build a small business for families in Cambodia
description: "Building a small business for families in Cambodia" is a campaign that aims to help families in rural Cambodia raise chickens to create a sustainable, continuous income that supports them in meeting their basic needs and allows them to be more self-reliant. Donations will provide the startup costs and counseling on successful chicken raising and small business management. By providing startup capital, materials and support, these families can improve their livelihoods for years to come.

title: ARGOS, Dog therapy for children with disability
description: ARGOS with a noble mission, play an essential role in caring for children with disabilities. Argos aims to improve the quality of life and emotional, social, cognitive, and physical functioning by providing comprehensive care for children with different disabilities. Argos does a spectacular job playing with them, visiting their homes, and teaching them to socialize, among many other things. Thanks to ARGOS, the children have now improved their relationships; their cognitive and  physical skills

title: Women Protection Behind Bars
description: This project will help women who are trapped in Yemini prisons without legal representation (currently over 50 women but the number is growing everyday) by providing legal support to these women by providing qualified field lawyers at no charge to represent them and argue their cases in front of courts and public prosecution, They will also provide the necessary legal advice, support, and follow up so these women are not left alone to  fight an unfair system or languish in prison.

title: Healing Hands Christmas Luncheon With Love
description: We will be hosting a traditional Christmas Luncheon for 250 adult homeless member of the PE Metro. They will be brought in to our shelter early in the morning for a shower, a clean set of clothes and a haircut and a shave. They will then be treated to a full traditional luncheon, dessert station, tea/coffee bar. Father Christmas will be on hand to hand out gifts to all attendees. And we will have music, and games for entertainment. Healing Hands upholding the spirit of Giving.

title: Disability - Sports - Empowerment - Diversity
description: The Special Olympics World Games are the world's largest inclusive sports event. Thousands of athletes with intellectual disabilities compete together in 26 sports. Nine days of exciting and inspiring competitions, by athletes and for athletes.  From 17 to 25 June 2023, the Special Olympics World Games will take place in Berlin - the first time that Germany will host the Games! We are looking forward to a colorful international festival of sports.

title: 20K matching for Vulnerable Children's Education
description: At The Small World, our Child Education Sponsorship Program is deeply rooted within and bonded to the child's family, school, and community. This framework ensures a positive and supportive background that ripples throughout the children's lives, benefiting them as well as their relationships.  Our goal is to support immediately over 500 children in urgent need of return back to school for their continued education in remote Himalayan communities of Nepal.

title: Hurricane Ian Response
description: Direct Relief is responding to Hurricane Ian's impacts, which are still unfolding across the state of Florida. The organization is currently coordinating multiple rapid response shipments of medical aid across the state, and will continue to respond to requests in the coming days and weeks. Direct Relief has prepositioned a dozen Hurricane Prep Packs with our health center partners in Florida and is responding to additional requests for emergency medicines, backup power systems, and more.

title: Fund Drones for Appalachia Flood Victim Recovery
description: On July 28, 2022, extreme weather decimated poor communities in Appalachia: 39 people were killed and 2 remain missing. Our Youth Drone Responder Program sends drones, provides training, licenses, insures - and pays - youth leaders in these flooded-out communities who also will receive fresh drinking water and mutual aid disaster supplies to help replace what was lost in these historic floods before winter's cold and to prepare for the predictable climate catastrophes this coming Spring.

title: Eradicating Chronic Child Malnutrition in Ecuador
description: We are a non-profit organization that seeks to eradicate chronic child malnutrition in Ecuador with a community based therapeutic program. Since we are the second country in Latin America and the Caribbean with the highest rate of malnutrition. Our program is based on the administration of ready-to-use therapeutic food for 500 children under 5 years old, treating them correctly and in time, this will prevent the repercussions of malnutrition becoming irreversible, affecting their future.

title: Install 20 litter traps and 160 steel fish in NZ
description: WAI Wanaka will increase our community's capability and capacity to deliver on the ground environmental action by co-ordinating our own volunteer activities and partnering with local environmental groups to expand the effectiveness of volunteer efforts in our region. We want to support our volunteers and ensure that the right people are in the right roles doing the right thing at the right time.

title: Restoring Eyesight to Children in Africa
description: Eyes of Africa's purpose is to sight screen and identify children in need of eye care and to promote the importance of eye health and protection in some of Africa's most vulnerable communities. The importance of a child's vision cannot be underestimated as it affects every part of their everyday life. Addressing visual impairment at a young age will assist the child to become productive independent members of their communities and society at large.

title: Water for 250000 people Wells in Uganda.
description: The project will drill 15 wells and build five  protected spring wells  for 250000 vulnerable people who dont have access to save  water.

title: Save Corals in Fiji by Moving to Cooler Outer Reef
description: As the tropical summer months approach, there is an urgent need to relocate heat-resistant corals to the cooler outer reefs.  The nucleus of the work is happening now near one of the original coral nurseries where species have been selected for their resilence against the warming seas.  Since the pattern now is for certain areas and island countries to be subjected to higher sea temperatures for longer, this makes the situation for coral reef survival even more dire.

title: Let's renew our school bus
description: We need to renovate our school bus so that all visually impaired children in our school have safe transportation and guaranteed access to quality and specialized education to achieve their maximum development.

title: Ocean Conservation through the eyes of the Octopus
description: As a kid, Founder, Warren Carlyle was curious about the world around him. On a class field trip, he saw an amazing octopus!  Wanting to learn more, he went to the library to check out a book on them.  When he asked his librarian for information, there were no resources in existence. Now, Team OctoNation reaches hundreds of millions with it's educational content & is seeking to expand its programming to continue to develop fun & entertaining resources to inspire wonder of the ocean. Let's go!

title: Sophrology - Help blood cancer patients
description: Cancer treatment is very intense : numerous hospitalitions, painful body, psychological isolation & distress, side effects (skin alteration, hair and eyebrow loss, weight...). For several years, we offers weekly therapeutic support workshop of sophrology. They are aimed at evacuating tensions, recovering one's tonus, positivizing, taking care of oneself, and transmitting techniques to practice these exercises on a daily basis.

title: STUDENTS SUPPORT
description: The purpose of the program is to help impoverished students with school fees, school uniform and learning materials so that they have an opportunity to finish school and be able to go to college and in the future they can also help others and become a productive citizen.

title: Education for Palestinian and Syrian IDPs in Syria
description: Jafra's project will allow 1200 children and youth Palestinian and Syrian internally displaced students to access education in several locations in Syria. One of the consequences of war was the fall back of the educational sector where a significant number of schools were shut down due to the insufficient resources. Jafra believes that education is crucial for creating community resilience. Thus, Jafra's students are also supported in their preparation to sit for official governmental exams.

title: Resources for Refugees
description: This project will provide a portable digital library of over 600 books and audiobooks + educational videos to supplement math, literacy, health and digital education to refugee children and youth in Kenya + teacher training on using the solar powered devices.

title: Help poor Venezuelans with food and education
description: This organization delivers food kits to soup kitchens and low-income houses in Venezuelan cities like: Caracas, Barquisimeto, Carora, Valera, Maracaibo and, also, immigrants and non-immigrants in the U.S.A. Coromoto2020 supports the most vulnerable Venezuelan families by offering both nutritious meals and soft skills workshops. // Esta organizacion apoya a las familias venezolanas mas vulnerables ofreciendo alimentacion nutritiva y formacion en Venezuela y Estados Unidos.

title: Hurricane Ian Relief
description: As Hurricane Ian hit southwest Florida, we witnessed firsthand the massive amounts of destruction and loss. We saw entire homes washed away, businesses bombarded with water and dreams destroyed. Within the first 4 hours of landfall, we had 3 rescues near the downtown area alone; 22 overall.  These residents really did lose everything. The storm surge washed out entire city areas (like Arcadia, Sanibel and Ft Myers Beach). We want to help them by providing essentials to cope in the months ahead.

title: Kenya Big dream against Female Genital Mutilation
description: In many cultures, female genital mutilation (FGM), is a valued traditional practice : removal of part or the whole of the external female genitalia. But it has devastating short-term and lifelong physical and psychological effects on girls. Around 200 million women and girls alive today are concerned . This harmful practice can hold dangerous implications for girls' marriage, health, education, furtur work. This project aims at expanding in West pokot region alternative options to protect girls.

title: Restore 4 classrooms for 67 poor deaf and dumb
description: With Your contribution, Maniema Libertes plans to restore 4 classrooms to allow 67 deaf and dumb children from poor families in the city of Kindu to study in rooms that do not ooze when it rains We must also provide the school with benches, chairs and tables to allow children to sit and write well, because several children occupy the same bench, which is dangerous in the context of COVID .  Also unclog the latrines and arrange the doors and windows.

title: Help Argentine mothers find their children
description: The trafficking of babies and the violation of the right to identity are long-standing problems in Argentina. NPP provides DNA tests to mothers who were separated from their children at birth. In this way these women have concrete possibilities to search for and find them. Your donation will bring hope and real chance to find their children.

title: Support Pinar Del Rio Cuba for Hurricane relief
description: To provide financial support to the people of Pinar Del Rio Cuba who were affected by the devastation of Hurricane Ian. Pinar Del Rio was the first region hit by this hurricane and suffered substantial damage to its farmlands.

title: This Giving Tuesday help me get into school!
description: The Hope School In Santa Luzia do Itanhy, Brazil, provides an immersive art and technology-centered education to children starting from daycare and extending through to 5th grade. These children come from extremely vulnerable environments where the average income per person is under $30.00 USD per month. While we have raised 83% of our goal, we need your help to ensure that the project is finished and that the children can receive the education they deserve.

title: Give hope & help to impoverished women and girls
description: We serve desperately poor young women and children in southeastern Uganda -- many of whom are or were teenage mothers -- through literacy & vocational skills training, sexual / domestic violence prevention, mental health counseling, suicide prevention, parenting & childbirth resources, training in menstrual health management, micro-financing for small businesses, school sponsorships, and  intervention to respond to medical, housing and nutritional crises.

title: Enhancing Capacity of Students in Leadership.
description: This concept note indicates a means through which a proposed capacity building project for youth in leadership positions in schools in Juba Central Equatoria State will be implemented. These series of activities will be implemented for one year with an average of one activity per month. This project is expected to benefit three hundred (300) students selected from various schools. Your donations towards this project will inspire the next generation of students leaders in South Sudan.

title: Relief to Victims of Floods
description: HDO will provide blankets, mosquito nets and solar lamps to 500 flood affected families in order to enable them to live comfortably. HDO often overlook these basic items but with very poor families possessing blankets, mosquito nets and solar lamps is often a luxury and not given priority. With blankets, they will not sleep cold at night, with mosquito nets, they prevent mosquito-borne diseases and with solar lamps, they can do productive work early evenings.

title: Veterinary Care and Food for Loreto Stray Dogs
description: With your donation you supply food and basic veterinary attention, sterilization  for stray dogs giving them a chance to find a family and live a long healthy and happy life.

title: Urgent Appeal to Save Syrians from Cholera
description: We send you this urgent call to save cholera patients in north of Syria. A little bit of delay may lead to killing hundreds of healthy people in hours. Help us combat the spread of Cholera in northern Syria, treat the Cholera patients and save their lives.

title: Individual People
description: This project is a personable way of donating to a specific cause that you care for. Our goal is to direct our efforts to improve lives by focusing on specific areas of every beneficiaries life. From basic needs, to education, health and human rights, this is a space where donors can follow up and receive reports about the progress. The donor can choose one of the sub-projects to make a donation to an individual or donate to this parent-project and Dufatanye will find a suitable beneficiary.

title: Join us in establishing a neighborhood greenhouse.
description: Around 10,000 children from low-income households live in Muyumbu, Kabale district. In reality, food shortages brought on by climatic causes and irregular seasonal shifts force young children to battle with hunger. This affects both their performance and regular attendance at school. Since we believe every child has the potential to become a valuable member of society, we intend to create a community greenhouse that will offer year-round food support.

title: Educational Scholarship for a Child in Africa
description: Bhongolethu Foundation is a non-profit organization that offers quality education to children in the community, Masiphumelele, Cape Town. Children are fortunate to be a part of the family at Bhongolethu. Sponsorship is a large part of Bhongolethu's daily functioning. When children receive sponsorship, their education security is taken care of.

title: Women Economic Empowerment by Skill Development
description: Most of the rural women of the Terai region of Nepal are illiterate and also lack certain skills to generate income for themselves which often leaves them on the lurch and below the poverty level. Thus, this project aims to improve the livelihoods of these helpless rural women by helping them to learn skills to generate income through various skill development training and workshops. For ex: vegetable farming, tailoring, handicrafts, bee-keeping, pickle making, mushroom farming, carpentry, etc.

title: Help Ballymena Rotary make lives better!
description: The Rotary Club of Ballymena aims to raise funds to support the international Rotary Foundation initiatives. The Foundation aims to advance world understanding, goodwill and peace through strengthening global partnerships and provide sustainable and measurable benefits to communities across the world, thereby making lives better.

title: Stop LGBTQ Suicide through Parent Education
description: This project will build a Suicide Prevention course specifically for parents with LGBTQ children to help them understand how to recognize the signs of suicide and how to seek support for their children. Mama Dragons will build the course and train 3,000 parents in suicide prevention in the next two years at a cost of $40,000.

title: Water for our Venezuelan children
description: Our children are not consuming water and are getting sick. Due to the distance of the area, lack of services, transportation, electricity, water, our children in Turgua, Miranda State, Venezuela, do not consume water. We need to install a water treatment plant, to be able to provide for our children and their families. Plan: Well, plant, distribution. You can help us, they are the future.

title: Free Healthcare for 1000 Pregnant women in Nigeria
description: This programme will provide quality and critical antenatal care services to a thousand pregnant women from low income households living in underserved communities  in Western Nigeria for one year. Young girls of reproductive age and babies will also receive free healthcare services.

title: Empower the youth - let's give them voice
description: We'll organize the Masurian League of Oxford Debates to give youth from rural schools the safe space to practice a substantive discussion, the art of debating, public speaking, and verifying information sources through experience, not in theory. We invite teams from 4 schools to take part in training on public speaking, formulating a thesis, and searching for arguments. Then, these teams will take part in the 1st Masurian League of Oxford Debates to compete for the title of Master of Debates.

title: SUPPORT TO UGANDA'S EBOLA PREVENTION PROGRAM
description: The extent at which Ebola virus is spread in Uganda is very high and warring every one and health workers have started avoiding patients.  This project contributes to the reduction of Ebola virus spread by increasing awareness on prevention strategies through community mobilization and sensitization to enable illiterate community members understand well and utilize Ebola standard operating procedures (SOPs). And also provide personal protective gears (PPEs) to health workers

title: Hurricane Julia Relief Fund
description: Dozens of people have been killed, more than 1 million people are without power, and thousands have been displaced following the aftermath of Hurricane Julia. Communities across Central America, Mexico, and Venezuela have been devastated by heavy rains, flooding, and landslides.  All donations to this fund will exclusively support relief and recovery efforts in areas affected by this storm.

title: A safe place to live for Ukrainian refugees
description: Due to Russian aggression, 6.5 million Ukrainians have become internally displaced persons, and 3.2 million have gone abroad due to a full-scale Russian invasion. Many of them have nowhere to go back.  Khust Hostel provides comfortable shelter to people who have been forced to leave their homes. No hostel can replace a home, but it can provide decent living conditions. Since the outbreak of hostilities, we have hosted more than 112 children and 386 adults. There are currently 72 people living in

title: Giving Tuesday: Fund 40,000 Meals before 2023 ends
description: We are setting a challenge in 2023 to provide 40,000 school dinners through this one project. This will help us with other feeding programs to relive the pressure. We will not use this fund for anything else except fund food so we can feed our hungry children in Brazil, Costa Rica, Uganda, Zimbabwe, Kenya and South Africa. $1 is all it costs to feed a child for 1 day...  While other projects will fundraise to build sustainable veggie gardens and food sources this project is about giving a meal

title: Zero emission van for our volunteering projects
description: Our van needs replacing because of costly repairs and new environmental regulations which would make it impossible to do our work unless we find a low-emission vehicle. We decided to take it even further and go zero-emission! By buying an electric van, we will be able to keep doing our beloved projects like Present A Home, Social Gardening etc. with our volunteers. Let's make the future of The Hague durable, together we build a green tomorrow! :)

title: Support our Foster Youth
description: For the last 40 years, Camp Horizon has had a tremendous impact on the greater Atlanta community, by providing a safe space, love, and support for foster youth of all ages. Driven by a shared goal of investing in the future of our community, our organization along with sponsors and volunteers, have combined to enrich the lives of the bruised and broken hearted.

title: DigiServe - Tech solutions for the most vulnerable
description: Social welfare organizations are great at stretching supplies to reach the people they are trying to help. When they're ready to grow, they need updated systems and new technology that's easy for them to implement in their unique context. DigiServe provides tech solutions for children's homes in Thailand and other organizations reaching the most vulnerable and needy.

title: Improving children's lives through education
description: Lilipad is on a mission to improve children's lives by promoting the love of learning and reading. We open children's libraries in marginalised communities and we strive to transform them into safe havens where the children can learn, grow and have fun. Since 2017, we have installed 10+ libraries in Uganda, Morocco, Germany, and France. Our objective for 2023 is to continue growing our reach and impact. Our vision is for every child in our communities and beyond to reach their full potential.

title: SUPPORT SOCCER SCHOOL FOR 400 KIDS IN ARGENTINA
description: Through our soccer school we promote values and attitudes of respect for the environment and the community for 400 young people from 6 to 17 years old so we can combat addictions, school desertion, child labor, depression and abuse.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, high school students Riya, Reshab, Sneha, and Tanisha have been working with LI to help create & publicize human rights campaigns for various rights issues in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to connect with local nonprofits in Bauchi to research, document, and advocate for various human rights issues within the area.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, Kadence, Summer, and Hailey have been working with LI to research and learn about public health crises in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to create a public health campaign to raise awareness and educate the people of Bauchi on these various public health issues.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, high school students Mareez, Arpita, Gianna, Kadiza, Ishrat, and Humayra have been working with LI to research and learn about public health crises in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to create a public health campaign to raise awareness and educate the people of Bauchi on these various public health issues.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' [LI] International Internship Program, high school students Ishaan, Raghav, Sarika, Shadab, and Ridhi have been working with LI to research and learn about public health crises in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to create a public health campaign to raise awareness and educate the people of Bauchi on these various public health issues.

title: Hai Africa Primary School and Annual Rent
description: Hai Africa is dedicated to keeping children learning. That mission hasn't changed for 2023. This campaign has the objective of not only keeping our Hai Center up and running but also raising funds to send & support 66 students to continue their education at elementary schools. The cost to sponsor schools for all of our students is $220/per child. The annual rent for the facility where we operate is $3,840. So, we need your help to raise $19,760 to keep our children in school.

title: Help refugees live with dignity in a new place
description: We teach Polish refugees from Ukraine. Knowing the basics of Polish helps them to communicate in the store, office, and job search. We run such classes in September and we know that they need to continue. We work with a qualified teacher whom the students liked. But our funds have already run out and we need support to continue. 30 people are waiting for help to learn Polish and have a better life. While adults are having lessons, their children need care - we will hire a Ukrainian art teacher.

title: Donate 500 Entrepreneurship Books to GS Mvumba
description: This project of donating 500 noble entrepreneurship books to GS Mvumba school known as (TWELVE YEARS BASIC EDUCATION FOR ALL) in eastern province of Rwanda.There're a million reasons to donate entrepreneurship books to schools like GS Mvumba to improve the quality of education and support over 4,066 students from the horrible poor community to overcome dim (illiteracy) to become noble entrepreneurs based on competency. For sure one teacher one pen & one entrepreneurship book can change the world

title: Engage 1B People Practicing Emotional Intelligence
description: What would the world look like if a billion people were practicing emotional intelligence? At Six Seconds, the world's largest emotional intelligence network, we research and share scientific, global, transformational tools & methods to support that goal. Since 1997 we have reached 9.6M people in schools, workplaces, families and communities to practice emotional intelligence. Changing communities and countless lives for good. Our model teaches how to actually use and grow emotional intelligence

title: Treatment of Children with Leukemia & Cancer
description: Each year 200.000 people receive cancer diagnosis. Unfortunately, treatment is expensive, centers are inadequate & quality of care is low. Due to this reason, LOSEV-Foundation for Children with Leukemia has been providing complimentary treatment at its LOSANTE Hospital for more than 65.000 registered patients since 1998.Treatment & accommodation are completely free of charge for our patients & all donations are used for this purpose. Thank you for supporting our fight against cancer!

title: Save Our Wildlife - Save Your Christmas
description: In 2022, SVW has run 66 rescue trips and saved 191 wild animals of 30 different species, including 39 pangolins. We released 180 pangolins and carnivores back into the wild while taking care of 30 pangolins and carnivores permanently at the rescue centers. We have worked hard to provide the best welfare for the animals through daily veterinary and captive care activities. Seven surgeries were performed successfully, 34 animals requiring special veterinary treatment had made a full recovery.

title: SAVE 500 WILD ANIMALS FROM ILLEGAL TRADE
description: Save Vietnam's Wildlife rehabilitates between 300 and 500 pangolins and other rescued wild animals from Vietnam's illegal trade at two rescue centres. After a period of care, around 60% of them are fully recovered and released into protected habitat. Animals that can't be released due to lack of natural instinct or missing part of the body, are provided a permanent home in large, natural enclosures customised to their needs.

title: Improve health equity in 10 hospitals in Brazil
description: Small philanthropic hospitals outside large capitals are responsible for serving 70% of the Brazil population..  Hacking Health Brazil facilitates knowledge transfer and social impact redistribution from patient safety experts and associations to provide  professionals from these small  hospitals have  to mentoring, training. This 1st phase of the project takes place in  the southern region of Brazil  with an impact on 200 health professionals and 10,000 patients.

title: 10-for-10 - Cervical Cancer Screening
description: HERhealthEQ and Lutech Medical are donating  100 Lutech LT-300 colposcopes to local community-based healthcare clinics in 10 countries (including Costa Rica, Egypt, Fiji, Ghana, Lebanon, Mexico, Romania, South Africa, Zambia, and more).   This project will screen 500,000 women for cervical cancer in just two years. When fully deployed, the program will have an impact of more than 450,000 women each year.

title: AFK Mobility Equipment Provision Service
description: We fund specialist mobility equipment for disabled children and young people from birth to age 25 from all round the UK. The equipment we fund is recommended by, but unavailable from, the NHS and improves physical, mental and emotional health and increases inclusion. This includes powered, manual and sports wheelchairs, specialist trikes and buggies, power assists, risers, car seats, hoists and walkers. Uniquely, and crucially, we cover all repair and maintenance costs for equipment provided.

title: Educating children for brighter futures
description: Pestalozzi World provides exceptionally bright children from some of the poorest communitites in Africa and Asia with a child-centred education, that produces young adults capable of changing the world.

title: Give menstrual health and childbirth resources
description: Our goal is to train 3,000 women and girls to make reusable menstrual pads and to supply Mama kits to 100 pregnant women in the greater Jinja area of southeastern Uganda.  Sanitary products are unaffordable for many young women and girls, forcing them to miss classes or drop out of school at puberty. Similarly, pregnant women must supply their own childbirth essentials (called Mama kits) to receive hospital care during labor and delivery.

title: Empowering disadvantaged youth through education
description: CAMELEON works for vulnerable children in the Philippines, especially sexually abused girls and underprivileged youth in Western Visayas region, islands of Panay and Negros. We work for their well-being with a holistic and individualized approach. We make access to education a priority for our beneficiaries. Since 2001, 920 students (girls and boys) from disadvantaged families and 10 special scholars have been accompanied. Since 2012, 474 beneficiaries have graduated and 367 found a stable job.

title: Rent & Equip houses for 20 street connected youths
description: Life on the streets is dangerous and more so for young women. We hope to house 20 young people (as well as 3 babies under 1 year). To ensure that rents are affordable the houses are very basic, usually semi-permanent. We plan to pay the rent for a year to 18 months depending on the young persons circumstances. As the young person starts their life away from the street we look to equip their house with basic essentials such as bedding, seats, cooking utensils and a starter pack of foodstuffs.

title: Join us in prayer: Pray for the hungry
description: "For I was hungry and you gave me something to eat."   - Matthew 25:35 (NIV).  Today, more than 50 million people are one step away from starvation. A deadly mix of conflict, climate change and the economic fallout of COVID-19 are driving ever worsening hunger for millions of children and their families.

title: Haiti Crisis Relief Fund
description: Millions of Haitians are confronting a complex crisis driven by political and economic turmoil, leading to widespread violence and food and water scarcity. Haiti is also struggling to recover from and prepare for hurricanes and earthquakes.
