We are asking for your donation to improve our e-commerce store so that anyone can buy their awesome crafts from anywhere.

title: Empowering Indigenous Women Artisans in Oaxaca
description: This project empowers indigenous female artisans in Oaxaca, Mexico by providing business skills training to help them build their own traditional handicraft microenterprises. We have faced many economic crises and territorial dispossession of land, and currently live in the region with the highest percentage of unemployment in the state. With your support, we can improve the quality of life for 80 Zapotec families, reduce economic violence, and boost local economic development

title: Enhancing Mental Health Literacy in Schools
description: The project will foster a culture of mental health awareness, reduce stigma, and create a supportive environment for the mental well-being of 1,280 students. It will empower young individuals with the knowledge and skills necessary to navigate mental health challenges. TEWWY will develop a mental health literacy curriculum and facilitate training workshops, resource creation, implementation of student workshops, establishment of peer support networks, and community engagement initiatives.

title: Support our Children with Cancer on Giving Tuesday
description: Hatice was one of our registered patients and had met with leukemia 10 years ago. She overcame the disease after 3 years of treatment with the support of LOSEV. She has been working in LOSEV administrative affairs since 2 years and now supporting other children with leukemia in their fight against the disease. Thanks to your donations to LOSEV. Thousands of children like Hatice are getting better and holding on to life with your donations.

title: Healthcare for 20,000 people in Ukraine
description: In response to the conflict in Ukraine, Medicos del Mundo (Doctors of the World) is supporting the Healthcare System, working with the affected health centers and hospitals by providing medicines and attending physical and mental health. We use mobile clinics to reach older and isolated people. We intend to continue giving healthcare to 20,000 people in the Eastern area. Doctors of the World has been present in Ukraine since 2014, that gives us the know-how for a rapid and efective response.

title: Innovative Solar Power for Zimbabwe
description: We have been offered a state of the art new solar panel project and we would like to implement 50 systems in households across Zimbabwe and then install 10 in local farms to run Aquaponic systems to provide crops to the community and then a further 10 systems in schools across Zimbabwe as education is seriously impacted due to long cuts of the electricity, often 11 hours at a time. We want to showcase solar and renewable energy across Africa.

title: Provide life-saving health and disability care.
description: Hope Health Action is a Christian NGO with a mission to build long-term partnerships with local communities and health systems to facilitate sustainable, innovative and life-saving health and disability care for the most vulnerable. We seek to bring hope, health and action to the world's poorest and believe every person has the right to quality health-care without discrimination.

title: For peace in the Tarahumara region
description: The Sierra Tarahumara is a mountain range with a series of deep ravines in the state of Chihuahua, Mexico; where the Raramuri people (foot runners) struggle against different forms of violence and discrimination that have affected their way of life. Engaging the people with their identity, helping them exercise their rights while respecting their own ways, is a way towards building peace in the Tarahumaras. Join the effort.

title: Zenon Dance Youth Outreach
description: Zenon Dance School's Youth Outreach Project will provide over 100 youth dancers, ages 3-18 with access to high-quality youth dance classes for one-year at Zenon's Minneapolis, Minnesota dance studios, and at off-site partnerships with local public schools and arts organizations. Access to dance for young dancers is more important than ever, enabling young people to communicate across economic, racial and gender lines - building respect and understanding in a our challenging world.

title: Meals with Dignity for Unsheltered in Houston
description: Community LUV is a meal and resource program for people experiencing homelessness and food insecurity. It will provide breakfast snacks and hot nutritious lunch in a "sit down- dine in" experience for 50-65 people each month. Prior to lunch, we will provide participants with free access to hot showers, clean underwear, a selection of clothing, sanitizer, PPE, and access to free barber/beauty services. Additionally, social services providers will be available to address sustainability needs.

title: Puerto Rican Youth from Despair to Hope
description: Flooding, a pandemic, hurricanes Maria and Fiona and earthquakes have impacted and challenged the youth of Puerto Rico for the past five years. PECES offers support and services that revive the indomitable spirits of these youth. From education to leadership training to community service the lives of the youth are transformed from desperation to hope, from despair to empowerment.  PECES impacts over 1500 youth each year through our alternative high school and a variety of other services.

title: Dormitory for Effective Eductaion
description: Cogswell School of Beauty, Art and Design is a reputable private school in Jjeza, Mpigi District, Uganda. It was found on January 2017. It is managed by.  Another Hope Children's Ministries and organization that takes care of vulnerable children, their families and communities over the past 5 years, our school has been provided holistic quality vocational skills to students from different backgrounds. However, lack of a Dormitory building limits us to serve many children

title: Rent it out to meet the basic needs of a child
description: Another Hope Children's Ministries in addition to supporting children in the communities, we still have a good number of children that are accommodated and we need a constant flow of funds to meet their basic needs. Starting the Rent it out to meet the basic needs of the child, a project aimed at purchasing 1 vehicle as well as improving the already available Vehicle will go a long way in meeting these needs

title: Educate 32000 underserved children in India
description: Our mission is to deliver an excellent, transformative education to every child, so we can realize an India free of poverty, and filled with love. Your gift will enable Teach For India's 1,000 teachers to continue to dream bigger for their 32,000 students today, and unleash their fullest potential. Teach For India aims to transform the lives of 1 in 10 children in TFI regions by 2032.

title: Empowered Me- VI
description: All children-including our at-risk youth-can and should be part of life's "winner's circle." Project Promise's Empowered Me program is a holistic enrichment program designed to empower St. Croix youth with the tools and attitudes they need to be winners in life.   Participants will attend engaging Saturday classes held at Project Promise's downtown Christiansted facility. During each 12-week session, the age-group-specific classes and activities will center around six programming pillars.

title: TRAINING PROGRAM FOR WOMEN HEAD OF HOUSEHOLD
description: This project will train 200 women head of household in entrepreneurship; psychosocial, ethics,legal and working areas; and will provide a seed plan program, in order to empower them, helping them to be productive and sefl-sustaining. The project will take place in Cartagena, Colombia, specifically in the Olaya Herrera neighborhood.

title: Helps us find a new place
description: Soydoy is a Colombian NGO with 15 years of experience in Food Security, that has impacted more than 21,000 people.    Today we need your help! We really appreciate your generosity.    The resources from this campaign are for: transportation of all our furniture and materials to take it to a warehouse, rent of the warehouse for 6 months, rent of a new office to continue working to achieve our goal: support 105,000 families more in the next 5 years.

title: Cambodian Eye Mission- newsflash $100,000 donation
description: THE BLINDNESS FOUNDATION  has received over $100,000.00 of donated medical supplies from a major US manufacturer.     These are being shipped ahead of our November-December Eye Mission to Phnom Penh Hospitals.  We have been invited back again to assist in their Doctor Training program at two major hospitals and Outreach Cataracts for Cambodia's poor, now that Covid is behind us.  You donation can help make this mission another great success  Bless you all, Dr. Chris Lyon THE BLINDNESS FOUNDATION

title: Help Cover Funeral Expenses for 2 Orphans
description: 2 children in care at Joseph House, a children's home we support in Ethiopia, died last week. Mekdelawit and Sisay did not have mothers or fathers but found a family at Joseph House. The cost of medical and burial for both children comes to $950 and any additional amount raised will go towards scholarships for the older children who are preparing to go to trade school or get further education.

title: Rainwater Conservation and Harvesting
description: At Warm Heart we aim for resilience and self-sufficiency. Water is a critical component for our success.  We have added gutters and rainwater harvesting tanks to some buildings, but we still have a long way to go. Strong storms have damaged some of the gutters channeling rainwater. As the staff and children add biochar to the gardens and test other agricultural techniques, they know it will all come back to access to water to keep the gardens growing and our children fed.

title: Startup toolkit for graduates with disabilities
description: In Tanzania, there are still stigma and discrimination practices in the community regarding employing people with disabilities, and this has made it a challenge for graduates with disabilities to access decent jobs. The option remaining is to enhance self-employment for the youth with disabilities who have acquired technical skills. This project will be providing start-up tools and life skills training that will enhance the graduate to establish his/her business

title: Financial support for poor women
description: Despite the difficulties of the day, inflation and climate change impose difficult living conditions on developing countries. But women are the most victims of poverty. This is why African Impact is implementing this project to train poor women in the creation and management of income-generating activities and to finance the activities of poor women deemed bankable. Study, support and monitor women in the implementation of their income-generating activity.

title: 2022 Campaign: Educate at-risk youth in Kenya
description: We operate a residential school in rural Kenya where we support more than 220 orphans and at-risk youth from preschool through 8th grade, providing them with a nurturing home, food, medical care, and one of the best academic programs available in the region. We consistently rank among the top schools in our district of over 140 schools and have ranked 1st multiple times in the last 5 years. We work hard to maximize the impact of our resources and operate on a lean budget of $1 per child per day.

title: DONATE FOR EDUCATIONAL SUPPORT TO POOR CHILDREN
description: The proposed project will be implemented in the Kurnool Urban Slum areas of Kurnool City. The beneficiaries have been migrated from the different parts of the District. They have constructed small thatched houses, huts and living outside of the town. Their Children parents are going for daily labor, Building construction works, working as Domestic servants and engaging in various types of menial works. Their daily earning is not sufficient to fulfill their basic and recurring needs.

title: Seeds of Opportunity for 200+ Youth in Rural UG
description: Our primary program promotes access to quality education for 200+ young vulnerable people. Additionally, we run a primary school, a children's home, and community/garden development activities that promote positive parenting and the wellness of the children.

title: Support Bike Workshops to Empower People on Lesvos
description: OpenBike aims to empower vulnerable people on Lesvos, both the refugee community and locals, through the benefits of cycling, teaching them to fix their bicycles and helping them gain deeper connections with their environment. Furthermore, it can give them skills to grow their confidence and lead to a better future.

title: WATER PROJECT IN TANZANIAN SCHOOLS
description: This project will provide access to clean and safe water services to 6000 schoolchildren in rural areas of Iringa, Tanzania who do not have access to clean water, good sanitation, and hygiene at the school level.      Afyaplus Organization plans to build hand-washing stations in 10 schools whereby 8 students can wash their hands at once including students with disabilities with the aim of protecting them from water-related diseases which will affect their school attendance and performance.

title: Open doors to discoveries for our students
description: The student clubs are some of CasaSito's key tools for helping our students grow and learn. Each CasaSito student participates in at least 3 clubs a year, which include: debate, theater of the oppressed, English, math, science, accounting, art, music, dance, reading, and sports.  Clubs meet weekly and are led by local professionals, long-term volunteers, or paid teachers.

title: Refugee Girls High School Scholarship Program
description: In order to help Barakat school graduates, our Scholarship Program for High School Girls is working to provide financial backing as well as social support to girls. They in turn will serve as role-models to others in their own Afghan refugee community in Pakistan. The program serves not just to support financially, but also to encourage the girls and their family members with regard to continuing their education. Send these girls to High School.  Give them a boost.

title: Help Deaf Kids in Mexico Learn to Code
description: EEESMA School for the Deaf aims to develop a program to promote, inspire, empower and spark innovation among its students, all 30 of them, through the world of computer programming.

title: Please Help Royal & Friends
description: After months and years of cruelty and neglect, a lucky dozen have been chosen to fly to the US this December for a chance to live in a warm home this holiday season. Some have been living at the shelter for over 3 years.  Each one is an abuse victim, but most importantly they are SURVIVORS. They deserve a better life., and this flight is the key to their happiness.  PLEASE help them ring in the New Year in a loving home for once.

title: Bring Modern Education to 900 kids in Cameroon
description: The College Socka Bongue, a secondary school in rural Cameroon has fallen into severe decay due to lack of leadership, innovation, and financial investment. The school is in desperate need of revitalization so that it aligns with the needs of today's students. The goal is to transform the school by incorporating modern and sustainable technologies. This will enable the Manengouba Foundation to provide support for new educational programs that will improve the quality of life of new generation.

title: Relief Food Appeal for Drought Affected Kenyans
description: Kenya government has declared more than 3.1 million Kenyans are facing high levels of acute food insecurity, widespread livelihood loses and displacement in 23 ASAL counties. 2,400 people in East Pokot alone are in emergency state - a familiar sites and memories of low-pitched cries accompanying distressed furrow brow and smelling decomposing carcasses. East Pokot is predominantly inhabited pastoralists and severe vegetation deficits  increases vulnerability to climate shocks and stresses.

title: The Seed of Life Provides Hope & Feed Hunger
description: The SOL Foundation is a registered nonprofit organization in Illinois, USA, providing assistance in Kenya, Tanzania, Sri Lanka, District of Congo, Cameroon, Bangladesh, and India. We work with under-served communities, marginalized women, orphans, and disabled people.   Your donation can save a life, give hope, and provide at least one nutritional meal to the community.

title: Support adult education in Haiti
description: English in Mind Institute (EIM) provides high quality, affordable English classes to adults in Port-au-Prince, along with job placement assistance.

title: Support Racejay's Imperforate Operation
description: The goal of this project is to improve Racejey's life by having an Imperforate procedure.   3-year-old Racejey resides in Eastern Samar, Philippines. He was born with an Imperforate Anus, a congenital flaw that develops when a baby is still in the early stages of pregnancy. After birth, there is no way to let the feces out.  This will cover the expenses for his check-ups, the actual procedure, consultations, laboratory tests, and other expenses related to the procedure.

title: Build an Ancestral Bio-Cultural Park   Teotihuacan
description: The archaeological site of Teotihuacan is being destroyed by illegal constructions. The legislation is outdated and useless, the authorities do not have the capacity to protect it, and that the villagers lack sufficient knowledge to value and protect it.We propose the creation of a Pre-Hispanic Bio-cultural park that preserves and protects the archaeological remains, as well as the opportunity for the inhabitants of the area to carry out controlled ecotourism activities,  without damaging them

title: Support to 200 Orphans children in Bangladesh
description: The project will target to 200 orphans around the Sub-District of District Kurigram in Bangladesh. The children aged between 0-15 years those are living below the poverty line. We empower the orphans by working closely with various institutes. We will support orphans by providing them with good food, quality education, psycho-social support,  health services ,cultural program and extra-curricular interventions  for orphans. We reach out to children through a family-centered approach .

title: Support LuiJay Hirschsprung Disease Operation
description: The goal of this project is to improve LuiJay's life by undergoing surgery. LuiJay is already in Grade 7 and resides in Eastern Samar, Philippines. He was born with Hirschsprung's Disease, a condition that affects the colon and causes problems with passing stool. The condition is present at birth (congenital) as a result of missing nerve cells in the muscles of the baby's colon. This will cover the expenses for his surgery, consultations, and other expenses related to the procedure.

title: Help us care for 900 street rescues at our refuge
description: We have nearly 900 street dogs at our animal refuge, rescued from certain death on the street or in the city dog pound.   We receive no government funding but are determined to work positively for a better life for all animals.  We desperately need donations to pay for food and medical care bills, especially to make sure all the dogs are neutered and vaccinated against rabies. Our larger, remote refuges need donations to maintain the refuges and pay for water as well as to pay staff wages .

title: Kibagare Pad Project - Giving women Dignity
description: Many women and girls in our community struggle with coping with their monthly periods. Many have no access to sanitary pads or clean water, and are faced with taboos and customs that discourage and or look down on issues relating to the menstrual cycle every month. Kibagare Pad Project aims to bring Compostible Sanitary Pads to the community and help educate, support and guide women, not only with their monthly cycle, but also with female health, education and provide Dignity Packs.

title: Women&youth Empowerment through skilling in Luuka
description: Unemployment is one of the burning issue among women and youth. Due to lack of right skills, poor people are unable to utilize the available local resources. The poor people include the Luuka District communities in busoga sub-region of the country. forcible migrating to different places in Uganda  and working as a daily labors, construction workers, cooks, brick workers  and daily wages. The girls and women physically and sexually harassed by brick owners and contractors.

title: Support Women's Post-Pandemic Education
description: The Asherah Foundation offers scholarships to women from all over the world who have survived civil wars, extreme poverty, forced marriages, and discrimination, among others. Around the world, 82.4 million individuals, mostly women and children, have been forced to be displaced. Under these fragile and conflict affected situations, only 13% of females are enrolled in higher education. This project works towards raising funds to help women in these circumstances continue their higher education.

title: Saving over 2000 stray dogs per month in Ahmedabad
description: This project provides free medical treatment to more than 2000 stray dogs every month who roam on the street without shelter, proper food, and care through our animal hospital in Ahmedabad. Jivdaya Charitable Trust treats injured and diseased stray dogs who are rescued and brought to us and saves all stray lives in need with our on-field treatment vans with a team of vet and vet assistants.

title: Children from Poland need psychological support!
description: Children from Poland need direct psychological support. Poland is a second country in Europe with the highest number of suicides among young people!  The loneliness of children is a problem that is much talked about but little done. Anxiety, depression, isolation, is the everyday life of lonely children.    Every fifth child in Poland feels lonely and is left alone. There is a lack of "here and now" access to specialists, professional people who can help children in a crisis situation.

title: Restore environment for Sustainable living
description: Unleashing the world's underground forests thanks to Farmer Managed Natural Regeneration (FMNR), a regenerative approach pioneered in Niger with a group of farmers, combined with holistic grazing management and water-harvesting techniques that can completely transform once degraded landscapes. From Senegal to Somalia, India to East Timor and beyond, millions of farmers are learning about and applying principles which restore tree and grass cover with amazing results! Now let's help Ghana.

title: Help Us Close the Access Abyss to Palliative Care
description: Forty million people and their families living in a low or middle-income country are not able to access palliative care each year, causing unnecessary suffering for the most seriously ill. The Worldwide Hospice Palliative Care Alliance has members in over 100 countries. We need your support to help our members close this 'access abyss'. We are building a movement to ensure that palliative care is included in universal health coverage in all countries.

title: The value of a breath
description: The children hospital, Dr. Jorge Lizarraga, located in Venezuela serves children whose second cause of morbidity and mortality constitutes respiratory illnesses. Our proposal consists of endowing the hospital with all the implements necessary to determine a child's pulmonary function, among which we have: a spirometer, plethysmograph, and oscillometer, a fenobreath, an ecography machine. With your help, we can provide a better quality of life to more than 130 children monthly.

title: Clean Water & Food Forest for 300+ Kenyan children
description: This project will provide plentiful water, hygiene facilities and plant a food forest at Elong'o primary school pupils and staff can easily grow their own food.  With access to clean water, children will no longer have to carry jerrycans of water to school. Illness and disease will be reduced with improved hygiene facilities.  The forest will invigorate the barren landscape around the school, provide the children with a more varied diet, and provide an income source to the school.

title: Creating Pathways to Freedom
description: Creative Life Foundation connects children and parents in urban and rural Thailand to critical resources, creating a pathway to freedom and preventing human trafficking. Through access to education, a path to citizenship, and holistic care, we are helping break generational cycles of poverty, prevent child marriage, and strengthen communities. Our programs are directly impacting 200+ people.

title: Music helping save the lives of  Wayuu children
description: We are pleased to have started music classes for the children of Mara on the border between Venezuela and Colombia.  With 230 children from 17 communities, the classes are taught by El Sistema (the National System of Youth and Children's Orchestras and Choirs of Venezuela) twice a week, organized into two groups by age.   WITH YOUR HELP, WE CAN PROVIDE A LIFE-CHANGING OPPORTUNITY FOR THE WAYUU CHILDREN.

title: Provide opportunities to 100 girls for education
description: This project will empower 100 girls from rural communities and help them to acquire skills and support they need in order for them to aspire high education. Leadership trainings, coupled with mentorship and space for self-guided learning will not only allow these girls to feel motivated and ready to fight for education but it will also create solidarity and support among themselves.

title: Growing Learning about a rare Tropical Ecosystem
description: The Friends of the Pterocarpus Forest plan to create a bilingual, illustrated and interactive online catalog of flora, fauna, and fungi to make a more in-depth appreciation of this rare 52-acre swamp forest in eastern Puerto Rico.  The catalogue is central to furtherance of the Forest's mission of environmental education and will require an extensive inventory, creativity in nature photography, expertise in the use of social media and the collaboration of the local scientific community.

title: Software4Organizational Management and Learning
description: In 2022, AIDEST received software grants from Digital Lift that helped our NPO to purchase, install and upgrade the technology that included Accountbook, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe acrobat, Adobe photoshop, Dropbox, Adobe reader, Microsoft office, Outlook, Publisher, Whatsapp, WordPress, monday.com. We seek to raise US$1,000 to purchase 10 software at a discount rate including GoodCRM, Casebooks, Avast, FDO, upgrade www.aidest.org using WordPress, Mailchamp for scale up.

title: LEAP - Leadership purpose for a sustainable world
description: LEAP - oikos 10 month leadership program prepares each year 40 international students with the necessary competencies, qualities, practices, tools and global network to become conscious leaders in the co-creation of thriving and sustainable societies. Since 2015, 300 participants from 30 countries have been equipped with knowledge and capacity for conscious leadership on transformative change for sustainability; empowered and inspired to act as conscious leaders in their communities.

title: Saving Orphans from Cholera Outbreak
description: We have a critically urgent situation developing as 7 orphans in 2 of our HRI supported orphanages in Haiti have contracted CHOLERA, a preventable albeit very deadly disease.  With 122 children in one of the orphanages alone, this situation is devastating. We urgently need to hire an additional few nurses to provide immediate prevention programs and services not only to this orphanage, but for more than 400 children in 13 HRI supported orphanages for a minimum of three months.

title: Help Us Scratch those Fleas!
description: In 2018 we rescued over 800 street dogs from a desperate situation.  Most of them are still in our large refuges.  We have no government funding, relying on donations and grants to care for the animal care.  This year the summer in Morocco was long and dry and our refuges have no access to mains water.  With the drought we struggled to deliver enough water to keep the dogs hydrated.  We did not have enough to wash the dogs and disinfect the ground.... and now we have a plague of ticks and fleas.

title: Loving Pre-School Education in Java, Indonesia
description: TCKN Foundation offers quality Montessori pre-school education for toddlers and pre-schoolers aged 1-6. Now 20% of them learn free of charge; TCKN plans to increase this number so that cost is not a barrier for any child and to expand its facilities as it has reached the capacity of its current traditional wooden village house.  It emphasises a nourishing values-based learning environment in which children feel cared for, loved, safe and can learn and grow in harmony with the natural world.

title: Learning with dignity
description: The project focuses on girls, boys and adolescents, we seek educational strengthening through workshops and training that promote continuity or school reinsertion, reinforcing teaching in the city of San Cristobal de Las Casas. In our city live many children who come from the different nearby communities that speak languages such as Tzotzil or Tseltal, most of them find themselves behind in education, with parents who do not write Spanish or who have a minimum school level, not having the power.

title: A School Vehicle in Rural Nepal
description: Modern Model Residential School currently provides education and boarding facilities to 32 orphans and children in a remote village in Western Nepal. Furthermore, 125 other children attend school during day time. A newly built basic road has brought so much hope. An affordable used pickup or a new one bought with a 50% down payment would help our school transport food and school items from the city to the village, and help take our children and locals to a hospital during a health emergency.

title: Bring Music to Special Education with GITC!
description: With your gifts, Guitars & Ukes in the Classroom will provide special educators, paraprofessionals, and specialists, and their students with adaptive musical instruments, musical materials, supplies, & free training so students who've been excluded from music classes can experience the joy of singing, drumming, and strumming. We'll give free virtual classes each week, plus in-person workshops throughout 2023!

title: Social Enterprise Grants for the Common Good
description: Nonprofit philanthropy should contribute more than marginal economic improvements. A more holistic approach is needed for transformational outcomes, enabling marginalized groups to sustain their own economic prosperity. Donations made through Common Good will support small business needs in the US and Guatemala, fostering a cooperative partnership with small-business entrepreneurs, rather than a lender-borrower relationship. The Common Good's goal is to assist in long-term wealth creation.

title: RECYCLING FASHION
description: The fashion industry is one of the most polluting on the planet, and instead of reducing consumption there is more and more of it. We consider it necessary that each designer, brand or artisan dedicated to producing garments takes social and environmental responsibility by introducing recycling methods. Through the recycler, we will recover materials such as fabrics and threads for designers and artisans to produce new garments using traditional techniques.

title: Carbon Credit For Solar Power and Clean Water
description: The average American is responsible for about 18 tons of carbon dioxide emissions per year. You can offset 2 tons of your emissions by helping The Appropriate Technology Collaborative provide solar power and clean water to families that currently light their homes with candles and kerosene lamps.  You can help families improve their lives, see better at night and drink clean water.  ids do homework at night for the first time and girls don't hike long distances to charge the family phone.

title: Early learning for Mozambican children
description: This project will support the opening of a preschool in Chate village, Mozambique, providing quality nutrition and early childhood education to 150 vulnerable children ages 3-5 years.

title: Maleku Indigenous Herb and Tea Business
description: The Maleku tribe is one of the smallest indigenous people groups in Latin America. Located in the mountains of central Costa Rica, they previously had a subsistence income from giving classes to tourists at hotels, crafting items from what the forest provides, and hosting tours at their remote village. They have been making teas from local plants for generations and we want to help them develop commercial teas so they won't have to be dependent exclusively on tourism.

title: A Model Elementary School Focused on Literacy
description: Restore Hope: Liberia is partnering with Rebuild Africa, a local nonprofit, to develop a model primary school focusing on literacy and numeracy from early childhood through sixth grade and accelerated learning classes for overage students.The investment in teachers, through merit-based selection, skills training, and on-going mentorship along with targeted literacy instruction, will result in the highest quality of education available in the district.

title: [KKOOM] Christmas Gifts for 167 Korean Children
description: This project will give Christmas cheer to 167 children living in Korea's social welfare system. For many of the children we serve, this may be their only Christmas gift. Thanks to the amazing KKOOM community, we get to fulfill individual wishes through these precious gifts. This is an annual tradition for Korean Kids and Orphanage Outreach Mission, so the children we serve look forward to the holidays the most for this reason.

title: Let's support women's education in Afghanistan
description: We are a group of like-minded women and men in the US and Canada supporting a non-profit social enterprise college in Afghanistan that was rendered inoperable after August 15, 2021 when the Taliban took over.   We are committed to continuing the mission of the college.

title: I Want To Sing, Learn and Play In The Waves
description: In Cozumel, Mexico, Waves of Grace and SoulGives Company are partnering to help the children to sing, play and learn again. Through tutoring, mentors, and workshops at the planned community center, we will help hundreds of children, especially those who live nearby and whose parents earn less than a dollar an hour. This program will keep kids in school help build a future for themselves.

title: Support Women's Education in Afghanistan
description: For the past 20 years, Afghan women, with the international community's support, have received education and worked in all walks of life. With the Taliban back in power, the gains women have made, particularly in education and women's rights, are subject to reverse.   This campaign will help a non-profit social enterprise college, ASCENT, launch an online program so 1000 female students in Afghanistan and those in refugee camps in the neighboring countries can study.

title: Support Anthony's Hernia Operation
description: The goal of this project is to improve Anthony's life by having a Hernia procedure.  Anthony is a grade 7 student residing in Eastern Samar, Philippines. He has Hernia, an internal organ that pushes through a weak spot in a muscle or tissue, particularly on the child's scrotum. This should be treated immediately. This will cover the expenses for his check-ups, the actual procedure, consultations, laboratory tests, and other expenses related to the procedure.

title: TPNW Universalization and Implementation
description: The entry into force of the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons (TPNW) in 2021 has turned nuclear weapons abolition from a distant dream to a part of international law. The TPNW needs our help! We need to make the treaty universal by getting all countries that haven't done so to sign it or ratify it. Our particular focus is on implementation of the humanitarian provisions of the treaty, which aim to help victims of nuclear testing and use and to remediate their environments.

title: Rising Through Resilience
description: The community's ability to rise above adversity and rebuild, rests on its capacity to cope with the crisis. The mission of the Bahamas Resilience Center is to promote healthy adaptation and growth in the face of change, challenges, and stress, through the provision of education, wellness, therapeutic services, and opportunities for connection to individuals and the community as a whole.

title: Our PHCC, a medical resort for the vulnerable !
description: Alzahraa Medical Center (AMC) established on the 23rd of November 2008, owned by the Alawite Islamic Charity Association (AICA) is a primary health care center (PHCC) located in Tripoli within the reach of a huge population estimated around 400,000 people. The center is considered to be part of health relief for the population especially after the catastrophic financial crisis that Lebanon and its cities are facing where the minimum wages dropped down from 450 USD to around 30 USD per month.

title: Tiko program: Preventing hunger and malnutrition
description: We have developed a program 'steps out of poverty' - in use for more than 5 years. The goal is to teach villagers proven methods to take certain steps. Following as many steps as possible contributes to prevent hunger and malnutrition - this can be done in a family or in a group like the 'women's clubs'. We want to fund the activities in form of seminars including: permaculture, agriforestry, livestock, organic fertilizer, agriprotein etc. There will be sub projects following.

title: Building feminist lawyers in Sierra Leone
description: There are approximately 500 lawyers in Sierra Leone, for a population of 7.5 million. A low proportion of these lawyers are women. We believe that a stronger pool of female lawyers & paralegals would contribute to a more gender-responsive justice system. With your support, we will fund a scholarship scheme that helps women to overcome the financial barriers of attending law school & paralegal training. We will also create an internship scheme to expose law students to feminist lawyering.

title: Help 1,000 children with disabilities like Miracle
description: Miracle was born with Spina Bifida. Her parents were told nothing could be done to help. That all changed the day she met the KCDC team. Physiotherapists would help her strength and mobility, while occupational therapists would give her some independence. Miracle soon joined KIMS. With its inclusive ethos, KCDC is perfect for Miracle. Children are taught in small classes where teachers and therapists provide individual support. Help us give 1,000 children like Miracle the chance they deserve.

title: Beach Cleanup Vilanculos 2023
description: Every week, 25 volunteers cover 17 kilometers of beach removing about 7.5 tons of litter per year - of which about 1.2 tons gets recycled. The partnership that provided funding in 2022 came to an end. Fortunately a local business has committed to covering 25% of the project's annual budget of $6,643. With your help, we are raising the other 75%. Our team of out of work youth and elders with a passion for conservation are counting on your support to keep plastic out of the Indian Ocean in 2023!

title: Indonesia Earthquake Relief Fund
description: A powerful 5.6-magnitude earthquake struck Indonesia, killing at least 268 people and injuring hundreds more, many of them children. Your donation to this fund will provide shelter and emergency supplies like food, water, and medicine, as well as support for long-term recovery efforts in affected communities.

title: West Java, Indonesia Earthquake Disaster Relief
description: West Java, Indonesia experienced a 5.6-magnitude earthquake on the afternoon of November 21, 2022. Initial reports state that over 260 people have died and hundreds more were injured as a result of the disaster. Several thousand homes have been damaged or destroyed and as many as 58,000 people have been displaced. We have begun initial disaster response efforts in the affected areas and will continue to serve these communities with long-term efforts after the initial emergency response.

title: Emergency support for earthquake damage on Java
description: A-PAD and Peacewinds have been dispatched to provide emergency support for earthquake damage on Java Island in Indonesia. A 5.6-magnitude earthquake struck western Java in Indonesia on the afternoon of November 21. At least 162 people were killed and 700 injured, according to Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency. The epicenter was found to be about 10 kilometers deep in Chiangjur County, about 100 kilometers southeast of the capital Jakarta.

title: Birthday Tree Planting Project
description: In response to the problem of environment degradation which resulted severe erosion, depleted water basins, and dry rivers in Babati District, TAJPI intend to support and encourage 8,000 students from 8 secondary schools located in Babati Districts to establish their own tree woodlots with emphasis on ecological conversion with a view to achieving self-sufficiency in firewood supply, improve on nutrition and make schools livable places. In a long run environment shall be conserved.

title: Giving Orphan Children a Home and Hope in Zimbabwe
description: We try our best to make sure children stay with family as nobody wants to put them in a home, but sometimes there is nobody and this is why we try our best to be different. Our children's home is made up of 15 houses that sleep up to 8 children, each house has two house mothers that cooks and responsible for the children so it feel like a family home, on site we have additional resources to help then engage with everyone but the family feeling is so important to this project.

title: IGA Projects for children with disabilities
description: At Mama Kevina Hope Centre, for children with disabilities, we try to generate incomes throuhgt small projects give a profession to our children. For ex. we have a small farm or a oil sun flower machine. We have detected two new opportunities:     1. Sweater knitting machine. With this one we could made the sweaters for several schools arround the center. This machine costs $ 1,500   2. Small oven. We will bake for the center and also we will try to sell on our area. This oven costs $ 1,000

title: Indonesia West Java Earthquake Emergency Response
description: IDEP is currently coordinating and networking with our local partners to identify the most urgent needs of the affected communities. During the emergency relief, IDEP will support the affected communities by providing basic needs (food, clothing, shelter materials, basic medicine, etc.), especially during the first 30 days after the disaster. For recovery and rehabilitation (medium to long-term) phase, IDEP will work with schools and local communities in preparedness and earthquake-safe building

title: Global Healthcare & Disease Awareness Project
description: Action Change funds around 20 Health and Wellbeing projects globally; our projects are run by locals on the ground and with our support tackle inequality of access to healthcare, provide disease awareness training, and enable good sanitation, to stop populations getting ill in regions across Africa, India, Latin America, Southeast Asia and the Pacific.  Projects include: Community health clinics, HIV, COVID, Cancer, Rehab for Disable Children, WASH workshops, good health outreach and much more

title: NOTES for NOTES
description: Bromley Youth Music Trust (BYMT) needs to raise 50,000 so our young musicians can keep making music. This year we have been OVERWHELMED with requests for financial assistance towards music lessons. PLEASE HELP BYMT to keep making music - we want to make sure EVERY child has the opportunity to play a musical instrument or sing in a choir. We know MUSIC CHANGES LIVES . Now, more than ever before, the benefits of music are essential for the future wellbeing of our young people.

title: Helping Tapanuli Orangutans Thrive
description: The precious rainforests of Batang Toru in Sumatra are the only place in the world where Tapanuli orangutans are found in the wild, yet with fewer than 800 individuals remaining they are critically endangered.  Please help protect, connect and rewild the Tapanuli's forest home to ensure they have a thriving future. This project will also support communities living alongside the orangutans to safeguard the rainforests & establish sustainable livelihoods, so that people & nature can both flourish.

title: UK Cost-of-Living Crisis Relief Fund
description: The UK is facing the worst cost-of-living crisis in 50 years, with millions of people earning a wage that doesn't meet actual living costs. This crisis is plunging households across the UK into hardship. Your donation to this fund will help to support those most in need, equipping them with food, shelter, and mental health support.

title: Healthcare for mothers and children in South Sudan
description: The main objective is to help reduce morbidity and mortality of women of reproductive age, children under 5 years and internally displaced people in remote areas of Bor South County. The expected results are: access  to primary healthcare services , improvement  of health and well being of pregnant women and improvement of nutritional status of children under 5 years of age

title: Christmas is coming at Educar y Crecer
description: The school- year is coming to an end in Argentina, and the time has come to celebrate our achievements; to give and receive, and to share with those who we love and those who need it the most.  It's now time to celebrate! This year, we will be preparing boxes with food, gifts and Christmas decorations to be distributed among our students' families. We want Christmas to be different; we want all families to be able to share a nice meal, and we want all children to receive a present.

title: The Season of Giving 2022
description: Your donation will help Red Cross support the most vulnerable people in our local communities, here in Australia & across the Asia Pacific. Right now, Red Cross teams are on the ground helping thousands of people affected by disaster, conflict & other crises. From flood-affected towns in the south east, to the remote communities of our Top End, to the armed conflict in Eastern Europe, we are there. People helping people, no matter what, to find safety, opportunity & friendship in a crisis.

title: Empower Rwandan women to be community educators
description: This project will directly fund 5 women to join the PCR team as champions of change and help us scale our transformative gender work across Rwanda, a region where violence against girls and women is on the rise. Through this project, we will be able to transform harmful gender norms and support girls and boys to be advocates for social justice.

title: Learning from endangered lemurs
description: Lemurs live alongside agricultural communities through much of Madagascar. Within these forest-farm mosaics we implement research and outreach to ensure people and wildlife, not only co-exist, but thrive. By monitoring lemurs, critical habitat resources are identified, allowing residents to learn what to conserve and how to equitably share their area's natural capital, securing the use of these resources for generations of people and wildlife to come.

title: Health Check-up for 1,000 Vulnerable Children
description: Majority of child deaths are due to disease conditions that could be easily prevented or treated given access to health care and improvements to their quality of life. Healthcare services for children in low resource settings can make a huge impact, providing them with the opportunity grow well and reach their full potential.  Your support for this project will help to reach 1,000 vulnerable children through medical outreach programs for health services and health education provision

title: Medical Outreach
description: We are going to continue our medical outreach to our community. We are offering free testing, medical examination, and treatment to 100 members of our community. Many people in our community are too poor to get medical treatment from health facilities; hence we are lending a helping hand to this set of people. Some will be given instant treatment, while others will be referred to a specialist, and the cost of treatment will be taken care of by us.

title: X-MAS GIFT FOR UNDERPRIVILEGED CHILDREN
description: Our Nourish year-end celebration always includes as special a time as possible, when our little ones graduate from creche, get to show off their songs and dances to their proud parents, get a new school uniform, share a hearty meal together, and have lots of fun with food, sweets, prezzies and games. It is also a time to cherish the team, who teach, cook, educate and take field trips, for all the positive work they do all year - everyone deserves the gift of joy - Help us make it possible!

title: Sponsorship of Children in India
description: As the education is the key for social transformation and powerful tool for social equality, we launched 'Student-Sponsorship' program in 2002. The goal is to encourage poor Dalit children to continue their schooling despite poverty of their family background. Our sponsorship program matches generous-hearted benefactors across the world with needy students, so children can pursue their education without interruption due to lack of funds.

title: Educate 50 Kids Affected by Armed Conflict
description: Most public primary schools in the rural communities of the conflict plagued English regions of Cameroon have been shut down leaving the education of children with limited parental care especially orphans in the hands of privately-owned schools. The requirement to pay tuition in these schools inhibits thousands of children from attaining basic primary education. This project ensures that these continue to acquire primary education by providing tuition, vital learning material and basic hygiene

title: Drinking water to save lives
description: At the request of 5 communities in its intervention area, the NGO CAV proposes to implement a program to support to have access to improved water sources. This project consists of the installation of 4 boreholes, a water extension in a health center and the protection of a market gardening site for women's groups. This is about to contribute to the improvement of the health of the communities estimated at 18,612 inhabitants, by providing them with quality drinking water in all season.

title: Winter Relief Campaign for families in Afghanistan
description: Donate warmth - together we can ensure that 277 internally displaced Afghan families get through the cold season this winter!  Every year, Afghan winters result in deaths from frost and starvation. In the ongoing humanitarian catastrophe, the population is particularly vulnerable this year - and the first snow is falling already. If we take action now, we can provide a refugee camp in the north of the country with essential food and resources. Will you join us?

title: Educate vulnerable children in Rwanda
description: We aim to provide high-quality, holistic education to vulnerable children from low-income backgrounds to give them opportunities to flourish and prosper.  In 2021 we started a nursery school for children aged 3-6 years using the principles of Early Childhood Development (ECD) and now have a total of 75 children studying with us. This year the children graduating from that program will enter our new primary program of excellence bringing the total to 100 students and growing.

title: Support the School for Hearing Impaired Students
description: A school for hearing impaired children was established in 2006 with funding from an NGO. Due to lack of funding, this school was closed during the 2019-2020 school year. Thus, a woman from Sokode offered to take over the schooling of these children in a school that was created in the school year 2020 - 2021. In order to achieve the result 3 of its strategic plan 2021-2025, the NGO CAV proposed the project: "Institutional support to the School of Local Initiative for Hearing Impaired Children".

title: Human rights, tools for children and adolescents
description: This project prevents human trafficking and sexual crimes in students from elementary to high school. Reduce gender violence. It is based on Art, so it raises awareness and helps prevent violence with aesthetic experiences. 50 Human Rights and Violence Prevention workshops will be given through Theater in 10 schools for 1,500 children and adolescents from highly marginalized communities. He specializes in the Maestros de Mexico elementary school in Cuajimapla de Morelos.

title: Christmas Fundraiser 2022
description: The Christmas countdown has begun! We are pulling out the decorations, dusting off our trees and preparing to wrap another boat load of presents or all the amazing kids, staff and volunteers here at the Mission! Once again we are looking for help to provide all the holly, jolly and cheer needed to make this yet another amazing Christmas at the Farm.

title: Empower Cambodian children with English language
description: This project will enable 200 underprivileged children to receive quality, low-cost English lessons and become proficient in reading, writing, listening and speaking. ODC employs and trains local teachers and also provides teacher-training scholarships and academic scholarships to students from low-income families. We believe that a good English education will offer greater opportunities for higher education and employment, empower individuals and help combat inequality.

title: EDUCATE,FEED,TRAIN 70 DEAF CHILDREN IN MADAGASCAR
description: ROJO MANOHISOA contributes to poverty alleviation through education, entrepreneurship, nutrition, environmental activities and fight against gender-based violence.  Our most recent programs shed the light on deaf talented children and young people through quality education, nutrition and entrepreneurial skills development so that they may have a bright future and become positive agents of change in Madagascar.

title: Italy Landslide Relief Fund
description: Torrential rainfall has caused a deadly landslide on the Italian island of Ischia. 3 people have been killed, 11 are missing, and more than 200 had to be evacuated. The landslide has also destroyed dozens of homes, buildings, and roads. Your donation to the Italy Landslide Relief Fund will provide emergency support to impacted communities.

title: New car for transporting 48 children with cancer
description: We support children with cancer so that they do not interrupt their treatments due to lack of transportation from their communities to the hospital in several cities of  Mexico, which are from 1 hour to 9 hours away, they in their majority come rural localities. If these patients did not receive our free service  they could not by their own means arrive at the hospital, for their (weekly) treatments of chemotherapy or hospitalization, since they are mostly economically disadvantaged.

title: Camp improvements
description: It's not Sexy, it's not Glamorous, but my goodness it is necessary. STORAGE UNIT required.. Running an elephant NGO in a remote bush camp in Botswana isn't glamorous and this year we really need your support to help us purchase a large storage unit. After much thought and reflection, this is the most important and impactful item currently need.

title: School Screening Project
description: The well being of the world's children is a responsibility we all share. With your special gift, you support our work to identify and correct poor vision in the  children of Nepal.

title: Christmas boxes for children living in Refuges
description: Cases of Domestic abuse continue to rise dramatically. Many more children than ever before are now living in Refuges, as their homes are no longer safe. Parents are often not able to afford even basic necessities, as many families fled with just what they were wearing. Life is stressful enough for victims of violence but even more so at this time of year if you are worrying about the possibility of not having a Christmas/Seasonal Holiday gift for your child/ren on Christmas Day.

title: Feeding 1000 children in the South of Madagascar
description: This project will feed 1000 kids in Southern Madagascar, who are victim of drought through school canteen in  preschool and primary school, also to support children to continue their study.

title: Health For All through AarogyaSeva
description: Health and Healthcare are basic amenities that everyone should have access to irrespective of their financial status, geographic location or other factors. Ultimately we all seek to be healthy to be happy. But millions of marginalized, vulnerable and underserved communities are deprived of this only because they are poor or live in rural areas or are affected by factors like disaster, war, politics, exploitation etc.

title: Giving Tuesday What about the children
description: www.teamchildren.org has over 500 low-cost high quality refurbished laptops that need a new home. Our computers are loaded with amazing learning programs and links.   Over 50% of kids in elementary schools throughout the US can not read or do math above 50% proficiency.   Our laptops and software can transform this condition.  Your contribution will make a difference!

title: help children with cancer in iraq
description: Bothor AlKhaer Organization helps children and supports Iraqi hospitals by purchasing medicines and providing them with financial grants and the necessary medical supplies. With your help, children can get the most effective medicines, even if they can only be found abroad. Your charitable donations make children's treatment more effective and bring children closer to recovery. You can read about the impact you're making in our regular reports and on social media. Iraqi children are brave in the

title: OKI and HIJI want to reach children
description: We designed two backpacks to meet basic education and hygiene needs of children who start working when they are school age, remaining out of school and have to live in unhealthy and unhygienic conditions due to poverty. Our purpose is to send children OKI backpacks that would meet their stationery needs, refreshing their connection to school and HIJI backpacks that would meet their hygiene needs with your donations.

title: University Computer Assistive Technology Support
description: Blind and Visually Impaired students who have not interacted with our Computer Assistive Technology program find it hard to transition to tertiary education because their learning to date is through Braille and does not include computer instruction. inABLE is building an extension of its primary/high school Computer Assistive Technology program to give blind university law students a learning lifeline - laptop +Assistive Technology software+computer instruction.

title: Education to nurture kindness in Chinese children
description: ACTAsia believes that respect for people, animals, and the natural world will lead to a more compassionate and sustainable world. Our project aims to help 250 Chinese children, aged between 6 and 12 years old, to develop a sense of compassion and responsibility. The curriculum teaches kindness, develops empathy, and cultivates compassion towards animals, people, and the environment. Since 2012 we have trained over 3,751 educators reaching 118,354 children.

title: Give Spaulding Patients Hope for the Holidays
description: With your help, we'll make the holidays warmer and brighter for the youngest patients in our care at Spaulding Rehabilitation Hospital. You can sponsor special holiday gifts and activities for our pediatric inpatients, or help us meet the unique needs that come up for each patient and their family this time of year - especially around transportation, food, and other resources.

title: Water supplies for children in Haiti
description: Urgent needs:  Children with malnutrition, injuries or illnesses such as cholera need access to nursing and medical services. Families need tools to clean their water.

title: Upgrade Syejumba Outreach Post to help 8000 people
description: Syejumba Outreach Post serves a population of 8000 people. However, there is no water, no proper building, no staff, no medical equipment and no toilets.  This means the community are forced to walk 16kms to the nearest Health Post to receive treatment when they are unwell.  We would like to upgrade Syejumba from an Outreach Post to a Health Post and provide the community with proper medical care.

title: Support APOPO's HeroRATs' life-saving missions!
description: APOPO trains African giant pouched rats (nicknamed HeroRATs) to detect landmines and tuberculosis (TB) using their amazing sense of smell. APOPO's HeroRATs have huge potential to relieve human suffering and promote development when used in landmine detection and TB detection. With your support, APOPO is also training HeroRATs for search and rescue and wildlife trafficking prevention leading the way in animal scent detection innovation, all for the purpose of saving lives.

title: 2023 Mayor Potencial Annual Fund
description: We are adding local Spanish education and advocacy in the Tompkins County and region for the upcoming year. We are sponsoring Spanish families for the holidays.  In El Rodieto, we will be continuing to work on Education, Clean Water, Medication, Food, and Clothing.

title: Perfect Crossing - Playing a Big Game
description: Sport has the power to change the world. This phrase by Nelson Mandela indicates the power of transformation of sport. In our institution, sport is a tool for education. In this way, we use sports, education and culture as instruments for the integral formation of children and adolescents in situations of socioeconomic vulnerability. The goal is to promote social leadership and develop different SDGs in order to impact the community in which they live.

title: Ecobricks and the impact in Uganda
description: Our Ecobrick Project started as a solution to help remove plastics from the surrounding community to help tackle the health and environmental problems faced by plastic pollution. Ecobricks serve as an alternative to traditional bricks and have a far greater life span, therefore acting as a long-term solution to the current plastic waste problem. Our goal is to use these bricks to build benches throughout the community which currently has no public seating areas in place.

title: Empowering  Rural Women with Vocational Skills
description: Liberia went through 15 years of civil conflict that destroyed lives and displaced the population. An Ebola pandemic hit followed by the Coronavirus.  The economic and social impacts of the pandemic and years of war have deprived rural girls and women of access to cash, health, and a future. The project will provide marketable vocational skills for 150 women and girls to increase their income capacity.  The project will also provide tuition assistance to 180 girls and 20 orphans.

title: Emergency Winter Response - Aarsal
description: With over 140 refugee camps in Aarsal, many refugees are no longer able to afford the necessary items needed to keep themselves and their families warm. Through this project, URDA aims to provide assistance to refugees living in informal settlements with little to no shelter to help them make it through this winter season.

title: Help save a child's life this winter.
description: The Winter Warmth Appeal gives blankets and warm clothing directly to families and children who live on the streets and in desperately poor communities in Bihar India

title: Green jobs for young rural Sahelians
description: The funds raised thanks to your contribution will allow the implementation of the training activities of the season, including: - the technical training of masons on construction sites in real conditions and in academic modules - training groups of women in coating techniques - entrepreneurial training for artisans wishing to develop their own business - recognition of NV training courses through a basic qualification certificate  100% of your donations are invested in training courses.

title: Support evicted people in Mexico
description: Since 1976, HIC has been working globally for the right to adequate housing and against forced evictions. In Latin America and Mexico, we confront the effects of housing policies focused on the purchase of housing through credit for sectors inserted into the formal economy, which leaves out the majority of the population. Our work includes the proposal of new public policies to confront the situation and the defense of the most vulnerable people against the violation of their right to housing.

title: A Gift of an Education..Will Change a Generation.
description: Our mission: Have Hammer Will Travel A.C. (HHWT) teaches Mexican youths (both boys and girls) life skills through woodworking, carpentry and CAD. The current job market requires more advanced skills. As vocational leaders, we are committed to filling gaps in education and life skills to ensure that local Chapala's Mexican youths ages 13 to 19 in year 2023 receive these skills, gain confidence and the required training they need to excel in this job market.

title: Meet me at the movies....Memories, unlocked
description: Memories, unlocked is a dynamic interactive online film program designed to ignite the mind, awaken imagination and foster wellbeing by bringing people with dementia, caregivers and communities together. Our goal is to compile a library of classic film clips accompanied by questions and guidance to stimulate conversation,  engage in meaningful moments by rediscovery of cultural heritage. This initiative includes a training and facilitator's guide for programs, caregivers and community partners.

title: Help children off the streets into school
description: In Rwanda, since 2012 Root Foundation is working on saving children from a life on the street by taking them through personal development programs, and sponsoring education as one way to create hope and a future for them. Over 1,500 children have engaged in our programs, but with limited resources we've been able to sponsor about 15%. For a donation of $30 and more you can support a child through a term and for $100 a child can study for a full academic year with all required materials

title: Support our 155 scholars in Academic year 2023/24
description: Root Foundation opened early childhood education program to help children from vulnerable families to attend pre-primary education. Root Foundation created a safe space for these children who are in danger due to staying home alone when their parents went for hand to mouth jobs.  100 children acquire pre-primary academic skills as well social skills. The mothers of these children get short-term vocational training to be able to get careers and start earning income to cover basic family needs.

title: Fund Transportation Cost For Poor Dalit School Bus
description: Dalit Solidarity is a humble 501(c)(3) charity founded and managed by Father Ben Chinnappan, a priest in good standing. This charity helps the poorest of the poor in India's Dalit communities. The Dalits, have been socially and economically oppressed for more than a thousand years.  The Dalit children need bus transportation to school. We are looking for 40 donors to donate $50 a month, to meet this transportation cost. Your donation will make a difference in their future!

title: Ukraine Sanitation and Food Security Project
description: Due to repeated inquiries and requests from numerous partners during past disasters (eg. Typhoon Haiyan) for us to help affected families in Ukraine, we are launching a Sanitation and Food Security Project focusing on Ukraine citizens who have taken refuge in neighboring countries and in Ukraine itself, if safety conditions permit. We will partner with others and focus on sanitation and the growing of vegetables and bringing in our expertise in past disaster in Nepal and in the Philippines .

title: Help Burundian poor population in hard situation
description: This project will provide food items for 5000 poor families in in Burundi for first round . Food is one of the basic needs of a man, taken to provide energy, maintain life and stimulate growth. Unfortunately, Nigeria is known as the poverty capital of the world, with about 12million of it's population living below poverty line. Having enough food to eat, will help these families to avoid many health problems and maintain a healthy life.

title: Recycling plastic to oil,cobblestones, plant trees
description: Our project seeks to generate positive changes in environmental habits of Burundi in order to improve their quality of life and help ward off plastic pollution at sea. How? By empowering some people , strengthening environmental education, providing technical assistance for the implementation of "sustainable actions"  conservation of ecosystems and biodiversity, reforestation, better residue management and recycling.  Recycling plastic to produce  oil and cobblestones, plant trees

title: Support the education of 40 women in Quito
description: [Eng.] The 'School for Feminist and Popular Political Education' supports educational processes based on literacy, knowledge exchange, women's leadership, co-research and participation in public debates from popular-feminism's perspective | [Esp.] La 'Escuela de Formacion Politica Feminista y Popular' sostiene procesos educativos basados en alfabetizacion, intercambio de saberes, formacion de lideresas, co-investigacion, publicacion y participacion en debates publicos desde el feminismo popular.

title: Christmas Gifts & Party for Hospitalized Children
description: This Christmas, Bethlehem Arab Society for Rehabilitation will host a party for its in-patient children who receive medical and rehabilitation interventions. During this party, children will enjoy several activities with clown, participate in games, and receive gifts.   In the last two years, these parties were disturbed by COVID-19 restrictions. So, having this party will bring joy in this holiday season.

title: WITH MY SCHOOL, I DISCOVER THE CHILLON RIVER
description: Children and adolescents from three public schools will uncover (discover) the Chillon River and its problems through multidisciplinary research (Communication, Geography and History, Science, Technology and Environment).  The final objective is to elaborate school projects for eco-efficient solutions in the Chillon river basin.  For this, the following components are proposed: Awareness-raising, training and social mobilization actions, such as photographic exhibitions workshops and environment

title: Help develop a Youth Friendly Space in Simonga
description: The first Youth Friendly Space (YFS) at Simonga will require the renovation and expansion of a container, where teens and young adults can meet to talk about pressing issues around sexual and reproductive health and positive hygiene practices. The users will have access to a computer for school work and other administrative tasks, as well as a safe space to learn through play and discussion. We intend for the YFS at Simonga to be a centre of excellence and a pilot for future YFS in Zambia.

title: Child Protection Centers
description: Alkhidmat Foundation intends to provide educational opportunities to street children through a sophisticated system of more than 50 learning centers across Pakistan. These Children are either born unprivileged or due to economic conditions are forced to work in their childhood under harsh conditions. Children Protection Centers are the continuity of AKFP's effort to support weak and vulnerable segments of the society.

title: Hunger Crisis Appeal
description: Climate change, dwindling food supply, poor soil fertility is spawning hunger in remote villages and the need to supply food is imperative. We badly need your support in order for us to raise superfoods such as Moringa and a lot of vegetables and lentils, process and mix them with rice in order to provide nutritious meal to targeted 300 malnourished children in 5 villages. We need your help in order to educate mothers as well as to jump-start their vegetable gardening activities.

title: Food Crisis Mitigation Project
description: Involuntary hunger or being hungry and not having anything to eat is becoming more common especially in remote farming villages. This is caused by climate change, unaffordable food, high inflation and expensive farming inputs making crop production poor. We appeal to mitigate food crisis by providing direct food support to poor families and we will target 250 most vulnerable families in this project. Aside from direct food aid, we will provide small livelihood support also.

title: Women Volunteers Mobilization Project
description: This project will train and mobilize 120 women and girls in order for them to fully participate in implementing local initiatives initiated by our organization. In so doing we expand our reach, strengthen our capacity to implement and manage local initiatives and embed in the villages warm bodies that are able to continue and sustain what we have started.

title: Inclusive Tech Center
description: The main objective is to have a platform where persons with disabilities will grow in tech while learning, collaborating and innovating their local and affordable Digital Assistive Technologies that meet their needs. The idea came after reviewing the activities of our past trainings on ICT and coding for persons with disabilities, and also after consulting our beneficiaries. The center will start training 30 youth with disabilities (Blind an Deaf) on basic digital skills and on advanced skills.

title: Blackout in Ukraine. Help Us Survive This Winter.
description: Imagine that you and your family are sitting at home in the cold, without electricity, water and internet for several days, cringing at the air alarms. This is the situation for millions of Ukrainians this winter. Their suffering only intensifies... We have already supported thousands of migrants and poor families affected by the war in Odessa city with housing, food and other assistance. Now it is critical to provide these people with the means to survive the blackouts. Help us do it today!

title: Feed a Hungry Child
description: We will seek-out and provide nutritious food to each hungry child in 7 remote villages. We estimate a total of 1,200 children whom we will provide food. Our food supply will consist of rice, milk, meat, fish and vegetables. Our goal is to alleviate hunger and malnutrition and improve the chances of good mental and physical health for the child. We shall include the provision of vegetable gardening supplies so that the families will start their own gardens and secure local nutrition and income.

title: Grow Peace in Afghanistan: Educate Street Children
description: "From the Streets to Classrooms" project aims to break the cycle of poverty through education. These children often have to work or beg on the streets to support their families, and they miss out on the opportunity to have an education. With Afghanistan having the world's highest illiteracy rate, this project will offer hope and a new beginning.  Students will receive uniforms, books, stationery, and transportation.  We provide monthly food items to the families.

title: Empowerment of Dalit Women in India
description: Dalit Solidarity serves as a lifeline to those living at the fringes of society, encouraging and developing them. We are actively serving a population often forgotten and oppressed. Widows have been neglected and marginalized for centuries and even today in our Indian society. They are deprived of equal opportunity and human rights. We have been serving them pride and joy for the last 20 years and promoted their wellbeing and development.

title: Sailabilty Belgium  --  G-Sailing
description: In simple terms the objectives of Sailability are to promote the benefits of sailing to people with mental and physical handicaps.  This extends to everyone regardless of age, class, gender, ethnicity and physical status including the disadvantaged and those who cannot contribute financially.  These latter we will support and will not allow to be excluded on financial grounds. We also welcome able bodied members (usually family members) to encourage and reinforce the integration of disabled peop

title: A WORLD TO SUSTAIN
description: This campaign will increase RUWAI's overall program in 2023 and drive significant transformations in achieving food security and improving household diets,developing skills and growing local businesses to alleviate poverty, and environmental damage and improve livelihoods in Nigeria.Such programs like teaching agroforestry and supplying rural farmers (including flooding victims) with trees and early-maturing seeds to strengthen local food systems and restore ecosystems and skills development.

title: Emergency Response Project
description: The protracted conflict in different parts of Nigeria continues to devastate the lives of millions of Nigerians resulting in a serious humanitarian crisis across the country. In addition, many communities in Nigeria are prone to flood and other natural disasters which affects an average of 4 million Nigerians each year. This project hopes provide emergency humanitarian support to cushion any hardship faced by the victims to restore their human dignity and livelihood.

title: Build an Orphan Care Center
description: This project will help Orphan Children inside Pakistan to get excess to quality education and living through a chain of Orphan Care Homes in different localities across Pakistan. According to reports, there are more than 4.5 million orphans in Pakistan, thus, Aghosh Homes provide shelter, food, clothes, education, recreational activities, physical/mental development and contributes in overall/holistic development of an orphan kid.

title: Sailability -- a new boat-set for a new hub
description: Sailability Belgium, currently operating at 6 different locations in Flanders with 18 G-sailing boats, has been contacted by an interested water sports club on the Belgian coast to assist, technically and materially in cooperation, in creating a G-sailing hub, for people with mental and/or physical disabilities.

title: Ranger Protect Cover for our Wildlife Warriors
description: The Zululand Conservation Trust partners with Manyoni Private Game Reserve to provide security to critical wildlife populations of South Africa.  We would like to register our 60 wildlife guardians with the Game Ranger Association of Africa to increase their access to gear, training, skills-improvement and added cover; and with their Ranger Protect programme for improved access to medical care, medical evacuation and coverage for death and disability. For as little as $4/a month, you can help!

title: Training for life: the sport beyond movement
description: This project seeks to promote sport as a tool to educate children and adolescents in social and economic vulnerability in the favelas of Rio de Janeiro. For us, sport is more than a movement: it is a learning language.
