description: Devastating earthquake hits Turkiye (Turkey) and Syria.  The death toll continues to rise with many more feared dead. The aftershocks are as powerful as the earthquake which was one of the strongest to hit these areas in 100 years. Buildings and homes are unsafe with people stranded outside in the freeing temperatures.   Please give now to rush emergency aid including food, shelter, hygiene kits, warm weather supplies and cash assistance. Your gift helps us reach thousands of vulnerable people.

title: WE SUPPORT TO LIFE IN EARTHQUAKE ZONE
description: One of the strongest earthquake in more than 100 years in the region hit Turkiye. On the morning of February 6, the 7.7 magnitude earthquake, which took place in the province of Kahramanmaras, near the center of Turkey, affected more than 10 provinces in the southeast. Multiple strong aftershocks have been felt across the region for hours after the first quake, including a severe quake measuring magnitude 7.5.

title: Turkey Search & Rescue, Connectivity & Solar Power
description: In the aftermath of the 7.8 magnitude earthquake which hit in the early hours of this morning, a SmartAID Search & Rescue team is left this afternoon in Gaziantep quake affected region in Turkey to rescue people who are trapped in the rubble of collapsed buildings.  SmartAID is aims to install connectivity, solar energy and clean water units to support survivors, first responders and charities arriving to the field.

title: Now is time to help all the Syrians
description: Over a decade of war and destruction, paralysing international sanctions, the debilitating Covid-19 pandemic and a massive earthquake have left millions of people in Syria out in the snow, homeless and with nowhere to turn to. Regardless of political beliefs, religious creeds, and polarising divisions, now is the time to help these people that have lost everything and have been living from one trauma to another tragedy.

title: Urgent Earthquake Response in Turkey and Syria
description: 6 MONTH UPDATE: On February 6th, a 7.8 magnitude earthquake struck the southern part of Turkey and northern Syria, killing more than 55,000 people. ActionAid has reached more than 100,000 people in Syria with life-saving humanitarian assistance. The earthquake also left more than 2.3 million women and girls without access to proper healthcare, making them especially vulnerable. ActionAid has responded by funding a hospital that has provided 5,000 women and girls with urgent medical care.

title: Portraits for Texas/Mexico Border Migrant Families
description: As migrant families flee persecution and terror in their home countries across the Caribbean/Central/South America, they travel dangerous routes through Mexico until they come to the borders between the US and Mexico. They legally try to seek asylum. As hundreds of desperate families go through this, they often spend days at shelters on both sides of the border waiting for next steps. We are giving free portraits to these families and bringing them a bit of joy through new keepsakes.

title: Turkey and Syria Earthquake Relief
description: Malteser International's (MI) emergency relief team has been sent to the region to coordinate with our local partners to provide urgent support, especially in the refugee areas in the north of Syria where hundreds of thousands of people are living in simple shelters and are now defenseless after the earthquake. Temperatures in the region are currently freezing and it is raining extensively. In the hospitals where we work, the number of injured earthquake victims is increasing by the hour.

title: Responding to Earthquakes in Turkey and Syria
description: On February 6, a massive 7.8-magnitude earthquake hit the south of Turkey close to the town of Gazantiep, affecting thousands of communities in southern Turkey and northern Syria. Hours later, a 7.5-magnitude quake hit just outside Ekinozu-100 km to the north of the previous one.   International Medical Corps is responding in both Turkey and Syria, where we have worked since 2008.  We expect to provide basic needs as well as robust health services.

title: Build Laundry and Shower Facilities in Turkiye
description: The aim of this project is to construct laundry and shower facilities in Tanisma, Turkiye. The village was heavily impacted by an earthquake, which destroyed around 80% of the area. As a result, there is a severe shortage of hygiene and laundry facilities, leading to itchiness among the villagers. Although this issue can be resolved with clean bedding, the lack of laundry facilities exacerbates the situation. As summer approaches, the situation is expected to worsen.

title: Emergency support for earthquake damage on Turkey
description: On February 6, an earthquake measuring 7.8 on the Richter scale hit southeastern Turkey. At least 641 people have died so far, local authorities say, but much more casualties and injuries are expected. About 284 people died in Turkey and about 357 people died in Syria. It is estimated that more than 1,500 people were injured so far. Many casualties occurred as medical facilities were underdeveloped and residents lived in an aging environment. Medical support for the injured is also not easy.

title: Turkey Earthquake Response
description: Disaster Aid USA is working in close contact with Rotarians on the ground through  our sister Org.  Disaster Aid Europe. They are assessing the area and requesting shelter, blankets, generators,  and other emergency supplies.   We are in contact with our suppliers, and  their warehouses and have located tents already in Turkey, we just need donors and funds to keep the supply lines open.

title: 2023 Turkey Earthquake Response
description: This project will support Civic Force's response to the powerful magnitude 7.8 earthquake that struck Turkey on February 6, 2023. Civic Force's emergency response team, ARROWS, is dispatching to the disaster site and conducting needs assessments in collaboration with Turkey-based NGO, GEA. ARROWS will work with GEA to provide search-and-rescue operations, medical assistance and emergency relief item distribution. ARROWS' first response team is comprised of two doctors, one nurse, one rescue spec

title: Turkey & Syria Earthquake Emergency Assistance
description: In early morning of 6th of February (local time), a huge earthquake struck southern part of Turkey and more than 4,800 people have died, more than 20,000 people have been injured (as of 17:00(JST) 7th Feb.) JEN has been providing assistance to Syrian refugees and host communities with a partner organization in exactly the same areas, Gaziantep in Turkey where the earthquake hit. In order to support people's lives and livelihoods, we will provide emergency assistance to the affected people.

title: Turkiye and Syria Earthquake Relief Appeal
description: On 6th Feb 2023 two major earthquakes of the magnitude of 7.8 & 7.5 struck border areas of Turkiye and Syria on the same day, killing more than 4,000 people and injuring thousands more. More than 3000 Buildings have been turned into rubbles Homes, businesses, and critical infrastructure have been destroyed under layers of rubble. The earthquake affected people of Turkiye and need immediate help and support. Turkiye and Syria Earthquake Relief Appeal will provide emergency relief and long-term

title: 2023 Turkey Earthquake Recovery for Children
description: With this project, we aimed to meet the most basic needs of 500 children living in the disaster-affected region, such as baby formula, diapers and blankets, and we achieved our goal with your donations. However, in this period, after two weeks of the earthquake, children need psychological recovery as well as their basic needs such as food and diapers. Therefore, we want to continue by adding a toy set to food, diapers and hygiene items for 1000 babies and children.

title: M 7,8 Earthquake Relief Fund For Turkey
description: This project aims to support people affected by the 7.8 magnitude earthquake that occurred on February 6 in Pazarck/Kahramanmaras and affected 10 different provinces of Turkey. After the main earthquake, a second earthquake with a magnitude of 7.6 occurred. Until now, the authorities announced more than 3,549 deaths and 21,103 injured,  5,775 destroyed buildings, and the toll is expected to increase.

title: EMERGENCY RESPONSE:EARTHQUAKE IN SYRIA AND TURKEY
description: Medicos del Mundo (Doctors of the World) teams are already mobilizing to reach the most affected areas for an initial emergency response.  This earthquake only adds to a crisis already being experienced by millions of people on Syrian territory and on the border with Turkey.

title: 7.8 Magnitude Earthquake Emergency Appeal Turkey
description: On the morning of February 6th, a powerful 7.8 magnitude earthquake struck east of Gaziantep, causing widespread destruction and prompting many to flee into the streets. In response, the Alkhidmat Foundation Pakistan has initiated relief efforts from its international office in Turkey to assist those affected by the disaster. The organization is providing aid to those in need in the severely affected cities, which were the epicentre of the quake.

title: Earthquake Turkey and Syria
description: After the devastating earthquake in the Turkish-Syrian border area in the night from Sunday to Monday, the situation in the affected region remains unclear.  Local authorities say thousands have been killed and millions injured after the earthquake struck and collapsed thousands of buildings. German aid organizations from our alliance Aktion Deutschland Hilft are on site and providing immediate aid. Further emergency aid teams from Germany are being sent to the affected areas.

title: Melipona Beecheii Conservation
description: Conserving,documenting and increasing wild and domesticated colonies of Melipona beecheii, a native stingless bee sacred to the Maya indigenous people in the Yucatan, through the empowerment of communities,the restoration of ecosystems and the awareness raising on a national and international level.The project will contribute to strengthening the bond between Maya and biodiversity by promoting their traditional knowledge and establishing sustainable conservation and local development strategies.

title: Turkiye Earthquake Emergency Response
description: A colossal 7.8 magnitude earthquake struck Turkiye and neighboring Syria early on February 6, 2023, followed by a second 7.5 magnitude quake less than 12 hours later. More than 5,000 people have been killed and tens of thousands are seriously injured and/or trapped. Just 30 hours after the first quake, IsraAID deployed a team to Turkiye to provide immediate relief to devastated communities. This includes distributing warm winter supplies, hygiene kits, and water filters.

title: HALO Syria Earthquake Support
description: On February 6, earthquakes devastated Syria and Turkey, causing thousands of casualties and displacing tens of thousand. HALO is working in NW Syria with the Syria Civil Defence and using our excavator, usually used for landmine clearance, to help excavate people trapped from the rubble. The huge levels of additional displaced people makes the landmine crisis even more dangerous, and HALO is on call to respond and destroy landmines & explosives to keep displaced families and aid workers safe.

title: Ensure care for 30 destitute women in Mandya india
description: 1. Getting the help from the police and other local authorities to locate abandoned persons in public places 2. Bring them to the shelter home and provide care and protection. 3. Medical assistance and regular follow up 4. Providing regular professional counseling and conducting regular recreational activities 5. Reintegrating them into their families and or finding safe placements. 6. Funeral services

title: Syria Earthquake Relief Efforts
description: Two powerful earthquakes struck  Syria on the same day, killing more than 3,000 people and injuring thousands more. Homes, businesses, and critical infrastructure have been destroyed under layers of rubble. Your donation to the  Syria Earthquake Relief Fund will provide emergency relief and fuel long-term recovery efforts in  Syria.

title: Turkiye (Turkey) & Syria Earthquake Response
description: The 7.8 magnitude earthquake that struck Southeast Turkiye (Turkey) and Northwest Syria in February 2023 has created an unprecedented level of damage in the region. Survivors have been left devastated as every aspect of daily life has been affected. Relief International teams are providing emergency relief but can only do so with your help.

title: Help Families in Turkey Devastated by Earthquakes
description: A 7.8 magnitude earthquake struck Turkey and parts of Syria, killing more than 3,800 people and injuring thousands more. Families are displaced and thousands of homes are destroyed, causing a state of distress and uncertainty for the future of many people in the region.   Due to the freezing winter temperatures, GHNI and trusted partners are bringing critical supplies to families such as blankets, sleeping bags, cooking fuel, and food boxes.

title: Help for Turkey and Syria: Earthquake survivors
description: Urgent plea for help: Help the survivors of the Turkey earthquake.  In the early hours of 6 February 2023, a 7.8 magnitude earthquake hit Turkey and Syria. This was followed by another 7.5 magnitude earthquake afterwards. Reports have put the death toll at more than 40 000 people with but it is expected that this number will rise and that there will be aftershocks.  The scale of destruction is vast with millions displaced, sleeping on the floor in the snow. Survivors need urgent aid.

title: Turkiye-Syria Earthquakes Appeal
description: Act now and help save lives.  Thousands of people have been killed and over 17,000 people have been injured after two major earthquakes struck Turkiye and northern Syria on Monday 6 February. You can help. The scale of need is immense, with many thousands of people in desperate need of emergency relief assistance such as first aid, health, shelter, and non-food items Donate now to our Turkiye-Syria Earthquakes Appeal to help ensure that the people of Syria and Turkiye receive lifesaving support.

title: Earthquake Response in Syria and Turkiye
description: UNICEF Field Office teams are currently undertaking assessments and providing emergency aid. The initial focus of UNICEF's emergency response is on water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH), child protection services, nutrition and education. In addition to assessing the impact of the quakes on water systems, UNICEF is distributing hygiene kits and ensuring access to safe water. UNICEF is also working to protect unaccompanied children and reunite those who have become separated from their families.

title: Earthquake Emergency Response in Turkey and Syria
description: The magnitude 7.8 earthquake struck the city of Kahramanmaras, Turkiye in the early hours of 6 February 2023. Tremors and aftershocks were felt across the region. More than 3,800 dead and 16,000 were injured. Besides, more than 5,600 buildings collapsed in Turkey and Syria. The Mustard Seed Mission immediately contact the local partner to send relief supplies to the affected people and families.

title: SOS Turkey and Syria
description: This project aims to support people affected by the earthquake in Turkey and Syria. Our Polish Humanitarian Action Emergency Relief Team is on the site to assess the scale of the needs and immediately begin relief efforts, which will focus on humanitarian assistance in the form of food/hygiene kits and shelter. Support this fundraising and help us respond as soon as possible!

title: Build Beraketa a Primary School
description: The high-priority project, requested by the community, aims to dramatically improve the quality of health and education at Beraketa primary school, in rural Madagascar. SEED will construct three classrooms, sanitation facilities, a water supply with handwashing stations, and housing for a teacher and their family. Infrastructure provision will be complemented by sustainable water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) education. CO2 emissions from the build will be offset with community tree planting.

title: Support survivors of the earthquake in Syria
description: We are on the ground in Syria providing lifesaving assistance such as winter packages, food, water, clothing and blankets. In order to help more people, we need your help. Support our efforts in Syria for those affected by the earthquake. All funds raised will go towards our work to help the survivors.

title: Emergency response to Turkey and Syria Earthquake
description: Bonyan is working with local authorities to provide essential aid including food, water, housing, medical assistance, winter clothing and warm blankets. The 7.9 magnitude earthquake that struck Turkey and N-Syria, left a devastating destruction with over 9000 fatalities and 60,000 injured. Thousands families are without shelter, food or medical aid. Your donation, no matter the amount, can save a life and support families in need. Help us to save more lives and sheltering countless families.

title: Turkey and Syria Earthquake Emergency Response
description: Southeast Turkey and Northern Syria was devastated by a 7.8 magnitude earthquake on Monday, followed by a second magnitude 7.5 quake nine hours after the main jolt. More than 8,000 people have been killed in the wake of the earthquake, although the toll is likely to climb further as freezing weather and multiple aftershocks are hampering the rescue efforts, despite international assistance.

title: Turkiye & Syria Earthquakes Response
description: Project HOPE deployed staff to Gaziantep within hours of the initial quake. Project HOPE has initiated the coordination & shipment of three Interagency Emergency Health Kits (IEHKs), medical supplies, & pharmaceuticals. Through coordination with local partners, we are deploying K-9 search & rescue team in Turkiye. Project HOPE has a Type 1 Emergency Medical Team ready to deploy to provide primary care services, stabilize patients with acute trauma injuries & refer patients for specialized care.

title: Turkey and Syria Emergency after Earthquake
description: The death toll from the two earthquakes of magnitude 7.8 and 7.5 respectively that struck southeastern Turkey and northwestern Syria on Monday continues to rise to more than 11 000. More than 53 000 people have been injured in both countries. Partner NGO's have travelled to the field to save people trapped under the rubble.

title: Turkiye - Syria Earthquake
description: This project aims at providing urgent relief items, including shelter, winter clothing, mobile heaters, and blankets to the survivors of the earthquakes that hit southeast Turkiye and northwest Syria.

title: Donate for the victims of Syria-Turkey earthquake
description: Help us provide urgent aid to victims of the devastating earthquakes that struck Syria and Turkey, causing 43,000 deaths and thousands of injuries. Thousands are trapped under rubble, waiting to be rescued. Survivors now face new challenges - surviving in the cold without shelter and basic necessities like food. Your donation can make a difference by providing vital aid directly to those in need. Please donate now and help us alleviate the suffering of those affected by this tragedy.

title: Help communities raise magnifying kitchen gardens
description: Sustain for Life has developed a comprehensive organic agriculture project bringing it to the grassroot level at most to family level in most communities of Bukedea - Uganda for the purpose of feeding malnourished children and helpless families in communities in terms of food sustainability. In addition, kitchen gardens promote entrepreneurship and rural development, helping to uplift families and ensure that their children can grow healthily and learn to their best abilities.

title: TURKEY - SYRIA EARTHQUAKE EMERGENCY
description: Support population by sending and distributing essential goods (food, water, medicines, medical aids, personal hygiene products, blankets, tents and cots) Support local hospitals and medical teams, supplying emergency medical equipment and material. Our front line work involves collaboration with local partners and on-site volunteers and the dispatchment of doctors and medical specialists for specific interventions. We are setting up a base point in Kilis for the distribution of basic goods

title: LOSEV - Earthquake Relief Aid in Turkey
description: On the morning of February 6, 2023, an earthquake with a magnitude of 7.5 occurred, which developed in Kahramanmaras (east of the country) and deeply affected 9 different cities in Turkey. The damage was further increased by a second 7.7 magnitude earthquake which was occurred 9 hours later. According to the official institutions, the earthquake affected more than 13.5 million people. The death toll continues to rise in the earthquake and more than 12.000 houses/buildings collapsed or damaged.

title: Emergency Relief for Turkey & Syria Earthquake
description: With our Search & Rescue team returning to South Africa, we continue to provide emergency medical care at our two hospitals in Syria. We are providing emergency relief items such as tents, sleeping bags, gas heaters and portable toilets, and daily meals to those affected. From our kitchen in Darkoush we serve meals as far as Northern regions of Syria, & Turkey. Additionally, we've established a compound along the Turkish border that provides shelter to more than 350 families.

title: Earthquake in Syria and Turkey
description: The other night, a 7.8 magnitude earthquake hit the border area between Turkey and Syria.  Specchio dei tempi Foundation immediately took action by launching a subscription to help the affected populations, making 50,000 available immediately. Today, more than ever, we need everyone's solidarity.

title: Turkey Relief Tour to Support Earthquake Survivors
description: Disasters can only be overcome with solidarity, which is why Clown Me In will be working with Clowns Without Borders on the ground to alleviate the sufferings of people in Turkey, who have been affected by the earthquake that hit the country on Feb 6. Providing psychosocial support is crucial to enable people to process what has happened and deal with the trauma, the same way we successfully did after the explosion in Beirut. A little girl who had stopped talking, talked after one of our shows!

title: Emergency Appeal Earthquake Victims in Syria
description: On Feb 6, two strong earthquakes struck Turkiye and Syria. As of today, more than 19,300  dead, 70,000 wounded, 23 million people affected, tens of thousands of people left homeless. With 20 years of expertise in Syria, Jafra has the potential to assist the country's inhabitants in times of catastrophes and is on the scene to attend to the most immediate needs especially in Aleppo, Al-Ramel, Handarat and Al-Neirab Palestinian camps. Thousands of people will find shelter thanks to your support.

title: Mudslides Relief Funds
description: The rains in Peru have activated ravines causing landslides that have harmed different areas, causing collapse of houses and flooding of entire communities in the regions of Lima, La Libertad, Lambayeque y Piura.

title: Together for Chile
description: As we did in 2017, let's rebuild together the homes of families who lost everything in the mega-fires. Let's fit out for a new life the interior of a thousand emergency homes, with refrigerators, tables, chairs, microwaves, kettles, gas cylinder, towels. Thanks to you, we will refurnish and equip 1000 homes.

title: Earthquake Relief Efforts (Syria & Turkey)
description: The situation in Syria and Turkey is heartbreaking! People are trapped under rubble with temperatures plunging below freezing.  Thousands of people have been severely wounded during the massive earthquake that ripped through northwestern Syria and southeastern Turkey. The number of deaths is still on the rise and many families are left homeless, hungry and cold. What's next?

title: EARTHQUAKE RELIEF AID TO STUDENTS
description: Two earthquakes of magnitudes above 7.5 hit southeastern Turkey on Feb 6th, razing villages and cities like Hatay, Antakya. Hundreds of thousands of families lost their houses, families and loved ones. As the area hit was immense, rescue efforts for  people under the rubble and immediate aid for those lucky to be above  need the support of every organization.

title: Earthquake Emergency Relief/Search and Rescue
description: Rapid response immediately following a major earthquake is the key to providing immediate, life-saving humanitarian assistance. Peace Winds deployes specialized technical teams with search and rescue expertise, along with emergency medical personnel.   Peace Winds has now deployed our Response Team in central Morocco following Sep 9th 6.8 magnitude earthquake, which has killed more than 2,900. Our team continues in Southern Turkiye 6 months after 7.8 quake in February 2023, which killed 60,000.

title: Aid for Survivors of the Earthquake in Turkey
description: Fuel Relief Fund is facilitating the purchase and distribution of fuel for survivors of the devastating earthquake that struck Turkey on Monday, February 6th, leaving hundreds of thousands of people without access to basic necessities.

title: Support the Child Blind Mission
description: Cico Uganda introduced an Eye intervention that has worked in eye health for more than 5 years. The work of the Inclusive Eye Health (IEH) Initiative Team at Cico Uganda also includes programs to tackle Neglected Tropical Diseases (NTDS) since some of these can lead to eye conditions, including blindness. Our aim is to ensure that everyone has access to effective eye care and that those permanently affected by vision impairments get the support and opportunities they need.

title: Good360 Getting Goods to Turkiye and Syria
description: On Feb 6 , 2023, earthquakes struck Turkiye and Syria, followed close behind by a 7.5 magnitude aftershock. More than 22,000 killed, 75,000 injured, and 700,000 displaced during extreme cold weather. Good360 is getting critical product needs to nonprofit partners based on specific requests. We need funding to help cover shipping and direct costs. Products include hygiene kits, first aid, blankets, tents, tarps, heaters, non-perishable foods, OTC medications to partners like IMC, Map Int., GEM

title: Turkey and Syria relief -100% donations to locals
description: This is a difficult summary to write, and different to our other projects. Our CEO lived in Gaziantep and visited it monthly for years - it was a her second home. She worked together with two local Syrian non-profit organisations Lawyers and Doctors of Human Rights (LDHR) and Amal Healing & Advocacy Center (AHAC), and many of their staff members became her friends, some as close as family. With the powerful earthquake, staff and family members were lost and the recovery will take years.

title: The Child Amputees of Turkiye Earthquake
description: The purpose of Project CATE is to help amputee children grow as functional adults and be part of society by building the infrastructure of social, psychological, and physical rehabilitation opportunities. This initiative will start by ensuring child amputees receive age-appropriate orthopedic aids such as orthoses and prostheses, physical therapy and psychological support in tandem with their long-term education.

title: School Gardens to Save Eastern Chimpanzee
description: This Project aims to advance youth education towards their effective involvement in biodiversity conservation that benefits both humans and nature through actions that support school tree nurseries role in the restoration of the critical of newly MAB-designated landscape of Mukura-Gishwati, home to Eastern Chimpanzee and many other species endemic to the Rift Albertin.  This Project proposes to use the school land ( 4 ha) to establish GS Kibara as a "role-model" school of Ecosystems-Based Adapt

title: Rebuild flood damaged Savannah Research Centre
description: The Savannah Research Centre has contributed vastly towards biodiversity conservation in a global biodiversity hotspot. The centre is in Mbuluzi Game Reserve in Eswatini, Southern Africa & has contributed over 170 publications since 2005. It provides important data & skills for conservation action. Students from universities such as UNESWA, UF, UWITS, Wageningen, UEA, Auburn etc. make valuable contributions. The research centre has been massively hit by floods and we are striving to rebuild it.

title: Support victims of earthquake in Turkey and Syria
description: Monday morning around 4 a.m. an earthquake with a magnitude of 7.8 struck Turkey and Syria. More than 28,000 people have been killed and tens of thousands injured. Many are trapped under the rubble and access to basic needs and medical care has become limited. Though the survival window is closing, there have been remarkable rescues and victims of the earthquake that need your help. With your donations to Turkey and Syria, AfD will provide emergency relief and fuel long-term recovery efforts.

title: Return to Turkey/Ukraine from S.Korea war donation
description: Koreans are aware of allied nations gratitude including USA, even Ethiopia provided troops, medical and daily necessities during/after Korea war. S.Korea developed so fast in terms of Politics, Economics by allied donations. It is time to return from aid-recipient country to donor country for Turkey, Syria and Ukraine. This project, along with Memoral Association of UN Particpation in Korean War and INGO on refugee camps, Warsaw Poland, will proceed with food support, child protection, etc.

title: Regular support for vulnerable groups in Kharkiv
description: The project aims at providing humanitarian assistance to the elderly, people with disabilities, people with limited mobility, and people evacuated from liberated territories who currently have no one to take care of them. We provide them with food kits, hygiene products twice a month as well as equipment (crutches, beds, flashlights, wheelchairs, etc.) needed to ensure decent living conditions.   Currently, we take care of 595 people in the city of Kharkiv.

title: Support vulnerable community in Akkar, Lebanon
description: ALFARES charity strives to bring happiness to all the poor and needy who are suffering from the difficulty of having the basic necessities of life and to bring joy to children who are deprived of the basic childhood rights in Akkar especially after the consecutive crises in Lebanon accompanied by the increase in the proportion of the poor and the needy. Let's help them in the cause of their happiness and the making of their dignified lives and their basic rights as food, clothing and meds.

title: Support Visit of Expert for Youth Empowerment
description: This project will empower 500 young talents from Tajikistan by bringing Mr. Benjamin Burg, Founder and President of Trips Beyond the Classroom, to Tajikistan. He'll meet young talents, engage with teachers, visit schools, and create an impactful video. Benjamin is an exceptional teacher who has been educating Tajikistani students virtually. Now, we need funds for his travel expenses to bring his inspiring message to rural Tajikistan.  Your contribution will make a difference.

title: EMERGENCY RELIEF EARTHQUAKE  DISASTER IN TURKEY
description: Children, pregnant mother, old aged, Person with disabilities and their families  in Turkey  Planning, measuring and counting to implement adequate service delivery in action on free  food  distribution,cloth etc  as well as shelter and health services. Employing more staff in the office. Also by assisting Government in social service as well.And also by TIKA Bangladesh office Turkey (by  TIKA  Bangladesh office)

title: Unite All Schools
description: This project-- Unite All Schools-- will provide meaningful opportunities for teachers and their students to develop as global citizen leaders by engaging them in real life projects with their peers from diverse countries across the world through innovative virtual exchange programs.  Students and teachers will develop the 21st century problem-solving, collaboration, and leadership skills to solve local and global challenges in partnership across communities and the world.

title: Support 30-year-old human rights NGO in Russia
description: The Civi Assistance Committee is a charitable human rights NGO that has been operating in Russia for over 33 years. But due to the intensification of repression against civil society in Russia, the work of the organization is under threat. This project will help pay for the rent of the premises, the salaries of employees, so that this NGO can continue what it has been doing all this time - to protect and help migrants and refugees in Russia.

title: Support Digital Literacy in Kpaduma Village, Abuja
description: This project will help build a conducive computer learning center with at least 200 computers (desktops/Laptops) in Kpaduma village in Abuja, Nigeria, providing an efficient power supply for proper studies for 1000 children unable to have access to digital literacy opportunities. Julie Helping Hands Foundation intends to employ 10 more trainers so as to accomplish the objectives of this project, as we currently have one trainer training over 50 children weekly for a duration of 12 months.

title: Kilometer of Nutrition
description: The Food Bank of Honduras will deliver a pantry of healthy and nutritious food, composed mostly of fruits and vegetables rescued from different productive sectors of Honduras; benefiting 2,800 families in 22 communities in vulnerable and food insecure situations in the departments of Francisco Morazan, Cortes and Choluteca; supporting 11,200 people: 831 infants, 2,938 children, 1,858 adolescents, 5,074 adults and 499 seniors.

title: Better Tomorrows - Sponsor 61 Orphans in Medellin
description: Our goal is to provide essential resources, such as food, education, clothing, and recreation, to 61 orphaned children (7-18 years old) in the Acarpin orphanage in Medellin. These resources are critical to giving these children the opportunity to live more dignified lives. Your support will enable us to provide these essential resources and ensure that these children have the chance to grow, learn, and thrive, building a better future for themselves and their communities.

title: Help Nepali Children Walk on Their Own Two Feet
description: For three years, the COVID-19 pandemic forced our teams to cancel going to Nepal.  Now we can return!  Every year 782 children in Nepal are born with clubfoot.  This condition limits a child's ability to stand, walk, run, and go to school.  This April 2 - 9, 2023, our HTC Southern California Medical Team will travel to Nepal again to bring the gift of healing. We hope to assess 70 patients, perform 55 surgical procedures on 20 patients.  Changing lives forever!

title: Post-earthquake Psychosocial Support in Turkiye
description: We are now working to meet the immediate needs of survivors in the earthquake zone. We are providing shelter, hygiene support, and psychosocial activities for our children and their families in Sanlurfa and Adana and our 7 mobile education trucks (Fireflies) in the region. We have also taken steps to deploy our 17-vehicle fleet from other provinces. We are planning post-traumatic psychosocial support activities for children, parents, teachers, and volunteers at our activity points and schools.

title: A Beacon of Hope: Constructing Houses for Refugees
description: This project aims to build high-quality housing for homeless Syrian families affected by the earthquake instead of the weak tents they live in.

title: Reviving Traditional Uses of Forest Plants
description: Across the world, people rely on medicinal plants for their primary health needs, and scientists agree that one in four modern medicines derives from rainforest plants. Yet forest destruction continues apace and species become extinct every year. Our goal is to promote the conservation of medicinal plants in Brazil's Atlantic Rainforest, rescuing, documenting, and sharing traditional knowledge about their uses by promoting a sustainable income-based relationship between community and forest.

title: Wash program at several schools in Uganda
description: The WASH (Water, Sanitation, Hygiene) program is launching a project at seven government elementary schools to improve hygiene standards, menstrual hygiene and promote sustainable school structures, including various workshops. The seven project schools are located in Otuke district, a rural area in northern Uganda where the infrastructure in education and the supply of water and electricity has come to a partial standstill as a result of conflicts.

title: Fighting child malnutrition in poor areas of Peru
description: The project helps to improve the nutritional status of children from 0 to 3 years of age in shanty towns in Lima, Peru. To achieve this, we work with parents, increasing their knowledge about healthy eating, positive parenting and caring for their children. Because Peru is the third country in Latin America with the highest rate of childhood anemia, we focus on improving the knowledge of parents in the preparation of foods rich in iron.

title: Help CAV Cabo Pulmo keeps its services!
description: Cabo Pulmo National Park in Mexico is home to the only coral reef in the California Gulf and the Mexican North Pacific. However, coastal development and increasing tourism represent severe threats to its conservation. Pronatura Noroeste & Baja Coastal Institute aims to strengthen locals and visitors through the Visitors Center, informing more than 22,000 yearly visitors about sustainable management, good practices for responsible tourism, and the conservation of natural resources in the region.

title: Cyclone Gabrielle Relief Fund
description: Cyclone Gabrielle has devastated large parts of the North Island in New Zealand. At least five people have been killed after the storm with towns cut off, thousands of people uncontactable, and many more without power. Your donation will go to vetted nonprofits on the front lines of response and recovery.

title: Help 100 LGBTQ+ people acquire cake baking skills
description: Building on the success of our 2018 Cake Baking program which helped 100 LGBTQ community members find gainful employment, we are looking to our donors to once again help us teach baking, bakery management and financial literacy skills to 100 additional community members. This program will rebuild and renew LGBTQ communities throughout Western Uganda impacted by poverty. We aim to raise $5,000 to help 100 unemployed sexual minorities find gainful employment by 2021.

title: Keep Them in School
description: As TEV, we remain deeply grieved by the earthquake that hit Kahramanmaras and the surrounding 11 provinces. We offer our heartfelt condolences to all our citizens who have lost their lives in this disaster, and we hope for the speedy recovery to tens of thousands who remain critically wounded. Lastly, we'd like ensure all our supporters that we will do our part in the aftermath of this disaster by prioritizing a sustainable plan to secure the continuity of the education of students.

title: Support for Brazilian families
description: Children all over the world are growing up without the care, protection and guidance they need. SOS Children's Villages is there, working with children, young people and families to tackle this global issue on a local level.  We work to keep families together, provide alternative care when needed, support young people on their path to independence, and advocate for the rights of children. Together with donors, partners, communities, and governments, we lay the foundations for a brighter future.

title: Water is Health Project
description: This Project is designed to improve access to clean water for rural community at Mambilla plateau through drilling of local borehole with a surface tank and distribution pipes powered by a solar energy in rural communities. This project plans to construct ten (10) water supply systems across 10 communities in Mambilla plateau with over 10000 population. The water systems will be constructed at the community health facilities that can also be accessed by the villagers for their household use.

title: Ramadan Food Drive: Feeding Families in Pakistan
description: The Ramadan Food Drive provides essential food packages to underprivileged families in Pakistan during the holy month of Ramadan. With donor support, we distribute nutritious meals to promote spiritual reflection, while alleviating the burden of inadequate nutrition. The drive also promotes community engagement and compassion. Join us in making a significant impact on those in need.

title: Support manufacturing of e-cargo bikes in Tanzania
description: Through this project, Greenfoot Africa in partnership with Twende Social Innovation Centre is developing a purpose-built electric cargo bike aimed at improving the affordability and sustainability of transporting goods in Tanzania's urban and rural centers.  The project goal is to set up an initial production facility, develop operating tools, and launch a pilot in Arusha, Tanzania with a fleet of ten (10) electric cargo bikes.

title: End digital violence against Palestinian women
description: About half of Palestinian women and girls in Israel have experienced gender-based digital violence like blackmailing, harassment, or hate speech. Kayan empowers victims to speak up, and not face digital violence alone. Through our emergency and support hotline, we provide psychological and legal counselling and support to individual victims. Through workshops, events, and campaigns, we raise public awareness, break the taboo, generate a conversation and develop skills for mutual support.

title: Relief for Syria/Turkiye Earthquake Victims
description: The catastrophic pair of earthquakes on 6 February in Turkiye and Syria surpassed the death toll to 46,000. Thousands are injured, and yet more have lost their homes and belongings. Families, including children, are forced to live in open spaces amid cold and snow. Al-Mustafa is providing hot meals, clothing, winterized tents and medical aid to the surviving families. Your funds will help us to reach out to more victims, especially in the already war-afflicted region of Syria.

title: Reimagining Education
description: Virtual workshops, led by specialists via Zoom, will run for approximately four months. Participating teachers will develop innovative learning experiences and share them with their peers through learning communities and presentations of best practices.

title: Emergency Earthquake Relief to Turkey
description: Turkey recently experienced a devastating earthquake that left over 42,000 people were lost, countless families displaced and in desperate need of assistance. We are raising funds to provide emergency relief to those affected by this tragedy.

title: Sponsor Monthly Meals for Malawi Students
description: The project aims to provide a monthly food pack to students attending public colleges in Blantyre, Malawi. These students come from vulnerable backgrounds & are unable to afford tuition, boarding fees & food, but are determined to secure a brighter future for their country through education. Sponsorships are available for tuition & boarding fees, but there isn't support for the provision of food - this is where Gift of the Givers bridges the gap for Malawi's youth, & future leaders.

title: Emergency relief - earthquake in Turkey and Syria
description: On the morning of February 6, a 7.9 magnitude earthquake struck the border region of Turkey and Syria, followed the same day by another 7.5 magnitude earthquake. Even if we are not normally active in the region, our network with Visions for Children e.V. gives us the opportunity to implement humanitarian emergency aid.  More than 10,000 people have already died, another 49,000 are injured and local help is urgently needed. Please support us and donate now for the survivors.

title: Help provide Aid to earthquake victims in Syria
description: Through our connections with the Syrian community and our experience in filling gaps in the humanitarian aid sector, we have connected with local organization Independent Doctors Association. Together with them we are fundraising for a mobile hospital for the town of Afrin. Once this hospital is funded, Movement will focus on  connecting with IDA and more local partners to provide shelter and coordinate long term, sustainable solutions to help refugees in Syria.

title: Humanitarian Aid for Turkey and Syria
description: More than 25000 people have died and several million helpless, vulnerable people are fleeing their homes with barely any supplies or belongings to reach the safety of temporary shelters and relief camps because of the devastating earthquake that hit Turkey and Syria on February 6th 2023. There is an immediate need for emergency medical supplies, basic food and essential supplies to fulfill the needs of these overcrowded centers. This need will continue to grow in the coming weeks and months.

title: Life Changer for Children
description: Life Changer for Children is a community sponsorship program to help children and their families enjoy a healthier, safer, and brighter future. We seek out the children and communities most impacted by inequality and discrimination. Harnessing the spirit of bayanihan or community spirit, we co-design and implement solutions for children and with children to help address the needs on education, health and protection of children in Iligan and Lanao del Sur in Mindanao, Philippines.

title: I Want to Be a Firefighter!
description: Through the partnership, children ages 7 to 18 years old get to attend a basic firefighter training course, first-aid workshops, & live simulations. In addition, they can accompany firefighters to visit nursing homes, participate in parades promoting the environment & provide training & orientation to schools & communities where there are no fire departments. Every Sunday morning, children visit the fire department to start a new adventure. They wear white T-shirts with "Child Firefighter''.

title: Bablu Bhai's School Bag
description: This project will donate a school bag to a deserving child in flood-affected areas, low-functioning schools, and remote villages where they lack good books, copies, and stationery. This project will provide school bags to 1,000 financially disadvantaged children in Pakistan.   What's Included? - 1 Pencil Case - Stationery(Pencils, Rubber, Sharpener, Crayons) - Bablu Bhai Storybook - 3 Copies and 1 Sketch Book - 1 Bablu Bhai Melamine Plate or Bowl - 1 Hoopoe Book with activity manual

title: New Small Animal Clinic for ReWild Wildlife Centre
description: This project will build a permanent clinic at Rewild Rehabilitation Centre. Providing a safe space to house, treat and care for orphaned, injured or misplaced indigenous wildlife so they can be returned as fit, healthy animals back into the wild and ultimately contribute to the survival of their species.

title: For $30 educate and support vulnerable children
description: It's no secret that education is a critically important path out of poverty for children in slums and depressed rural areas in Northern Uganda. Our LEAD education program is unique, long-term, and integrated with our other programs to maximize success. CHILD aims to alleviate poverty and facilitate lasting change in the lives of the most vulnerable children and families living in Northern Uganda through education, health, and livelihood programs.

title: Sponsor the next physician in Uganda
description: Asher wants to become a physician in future, this project will pay for his school tuition and requirements untill he completes six levels of secondary school Education, he recounts how he spent six years bedridden suffering from stomach complications, missing school and going throigh trauma,despite  all the challenges he went through in his Primary school grade, he passed level seven with high grades making him one of the best students in the region

title: Prevents domestic violence of 200 women in Ecuador
description: The cycle of violence in which many women grow up prevents them from living fully, normalizes harmful behaviors and subjects them to constant insecurity. Its impact is immediate and far-reaching, including multiple physical, sexual, psychological, and even lethal consequences; it negatively affects women's well-being and prevents their full participation in society.

title: La Jacarina Dog shelter
description: La Jacarina Foundation is a Sanctuary for rescued dogs, its members pursue the well-being of our 4-legged friends and also those who live around us. We seek to reduce the stray dog population that exists in Cuenca, through spay and neuter, education and raising awareness programs; because we know that there is no home for everyone.

title: Aid to victims of explosion of the Kakhovska HPP
description: On June 6, Russia blew up the Kakhovska HPP. As a result, more than 80 populated villages on the right and left banks of the Dnipro are at risk of complete flooding. The water has already reached Kherson and flooded part of the city. Funds are needed for the purchase of boats, inflatable vests, pumps and other equipment needed for the evacuation of the civilian population, in particular from the occupied Left Bank, where evacuation is not carried out

title: Ladrillo Verde Supporting Rural Families
description: This project is located in Punta Hacienda, a rural population in the mountain, has no drinking water or sewage system, approximately 270 low-income families living there, children with malnutrition, abandoned and sick elderly people and also feeling hungry every day without access to basic medicines or food. This population managed to build a medical center with plastic bottles used as bricks, recycling 20,000 plastic bottles, this community needs support to activate their space.

title: Help a Poor Crippled Orphan to Live & Stay Healthy
description: This project will support Miss Blessing, a 20-year-old poor crippled orphan, to take good care of herself and also continue receiving medical treatment. Blessing suddenly became crippled alongside her mother 7 years ago, and both were confined to a wheelchair since then. Her mother died recently on February 19 and this is worsening blessing's already bad state of health. Your support is needed as plans are under way to take her to a good hospital outside Nigeria, for  better medical treatment.

title: Sponsor Scholarships for Poor Students in Laos
description: Our fight to tackle UNSDG 4-Quality Education. A gift to this project increasing the number of scholarships available for Lao students. This helps to achieve increased access to education for students. Our aim is to assist locals in gaining opportunities to continue and further their educational journey by supporting fees and associated costs for male and female students who may otherwise not have the chance to study, ultimately contributing to SDG 10-Reduced Inequalities.

title: 10 Years of Equipping Changemakers in Stellenbosch
description: Join us in celebrating 10 years of empowering changemakers in Stellenbosch. Since 2013 we've educated 900+ children, equipped 770+ coaches, & created 30 jobs, but more important than the numbers are the names & experiences behind them. We're a diverse family united around a love for education, sport, & transformation; these first 10 years have exceeded our wildest dreams, & we invite you to help propel training4changeS into the next decade of changemaking.

title: Shelter and Feed DV Survivors in Lagos, Nigeria
description: Our Project provides shelter, feeding, healthcare and LOVE for survivors of domestic abuse in Lagos, Nigeria. We take these women and their children (if they come with them) in and shower them with love by feeding them and taking care of all their welfare and health needs.  In our care, these desperate, dejected and hopeless women find a renewed sense of self-worth and hope for their future and that of their children.

title: Aid to Drought & Conflict Affected People Ethiopia
description: This project will provide an emergency aid to internally displaced persons (IDPS) who have been displaced from Wolega and are currently taking refuge in DebreBirhan &  Drought affected people in Wag Himra Zone in Amhara and  Borena in Oromia Region. Without recovering from the damage caused by the war in Northern Ethiopia, unfortunately there are more than 37,000 Internally Displaced Persons (IDPS) in need of assistance in Debre Birhan who have not received any humanitarian assistance yet.

title: Transcendent education in Urubamba, Cusco
description: Ensena Peru work with the Fundacion Ninos del Arcoiris's school to contribute provide transcendental education for the students in Urubamba, Cusco. Through the leadership program of Ensena Peru, three professionals play the role of teachers of elementary school students, positively impacting the education of girls and boys.

title: Empowering Flood-Affected Families in Pakistan
description: The project aims to help families affected by recent floods in Pakistan by providing them with fruit and vegetable carts, along with training and resources to start their own small businesses. The goal is to provide at least 100 carts, costing $200 each, to empower families to earn a sustainable source of income and rebuild their lives. The project will make a real difference in the lives of those affected by the floods and provide them with hope for a brighter future.

title: Inspire the Future - FIRST Israel
description: FIRST is the world's leading youth-serving nonprofit advancing STEM education. We're an inclusive, global robotics community working together to prepare young people for the future. Whether it's finding their people or finding their path, FIRST students gain the skills and confidence to forge ahead and build their future. Will you support our mission and help make FIRST programs available to every student?

title: Fight the injustice of human trafficking in Rwanda
description: This project intend to Fight the injustice of human trafficking in Rwanda through education of youth and land transit monitoring and helping potential victims find a safe passage back to their homes. "Transit Monitoring involves the identification, interception, support the police to arrest traffickers and assistance of actual or high-risk trafficking victims at transit points (such as airports, borders, and bus or train stations) before they reach the destination where they will be exploited''

title: Enhance Rural Education in Cambodia
description: This project will build the digital literacy skills of 76 school teachers from 11 rural primary schools in Cambodia by providing training, classroom support and equipment, enabling 1,668 children to receive a better education

title: CleanUp 5 million Pounds of Post-Disaster Debris
description: This ocean cleanup nonprofit Ocean Blue Project aims to recover 5 million pounds of plastic and disaster debris from coastal communities hit hardest by hurricanes and other disasters. Every 1 U.S. Dollar donated funds the recovery of 5 pounds of disaster debris. Climate change and warming waters means both coastal communities of people and marine animals need us now more than ever.

title: Zakat Appeal - Your Support Can Save Lives
description: 10.04 million deserving patients have been treated free of cost or at highly subsidized rates at Fatima Memorial Hospital since 1977 through the ZAKAT funds. With as low as 0.07 % maternal mortality rate and 2.07% neonatal mortality rate, FMH commits to provide quality medical services, with a mission to make healthcare services accessible and affordable. We hope you choose to continue the cycle of giving by supporting our cause. - Your support can save lives.

title: Build 2 Classrooms and Toilets for 700 Pupils.
description: Integrated Agricultural Association (I.A.A) aims to help provide quality education to 700 pupils in Mogni-Kouffen community in Foumbot area who do not have access and support in education. This project will construct two classrooms, administrative office, teachers' toilet, two toilets for female and male children and construct a well with manual pump, to ensure a conducive learning environment for pupils and teachers of GBPS Mogni-Kouffen, in Foumbot, west region of Cameroon.

title: Boosting Education to build Resilience in Chiapas
description: Thanks to the alliance with the Jcananotic, a Mayan group of peasants who are trainers in agroecology, this project seeks to increase the resilience of 1,200 people in Chiapas. This will be achieved through the social production of 2 community centers to strengthen education; 15 rainwater harvesting systems; 7 dry toilets; 10 agroecological orchards. These implementations will serve to generate locally adapted solutions and train promoters who can replicate the process and expand the impact.

title: Help us respond to the next emergency
description: The first few hours after a disaster are critical. It is life or death. The faster we respond to disasters, the more lives we save. Together, let's ensure that life-saving resources are readily available for distribution, so we are prepared even before the disaster strikes. With a prepositioned emergency fund, we can immediately conduct rapid assessment and mount an emergency response, have ready stocks of life-saving kits, and be able to train staff on essential humanitarian skills.

title: Help 3,000 kids participate in EyC programs!
description: Educar y Crecer is a Civil Society Organization with more than 15 years of experience.  It designs, implements and evaluates effective, innovative and easy to replicate educational programs to support the school trajectories of children in vulnerable situations.

title: Plant 10,000 Trees in Northern China
description: Shanghai Roots & Shoots aims to reduce the negative impacts of desertification on the local environment and communities in northern China by planting trees while providing an opportunity for individuals and organizations to fight climate change. Since 2007,  R&S has been working with local communities and authorities in Inner Mongolia, together with individuals and organizations all over the world, to plant trees and bring positive changes to the planet.

title: Improve gender equity in sports for refugees
description: Our goal is to highlight the inspiring women in our community and raise awareness towards discrimination and stereotypes around women in sport.  We aim at raising money to support women in our team, bring more women to our activities, answer their specific needs with appropriate equipment and make men more aware of inclusivity so that our mixed activities feel safe and welcoming.  This month will be full of activities, training, and focused on solidarity, mutual understanding and support.

title: Medical and educational aid for civilians in UA
description: Bevar Ukraine is providing humanitarian aid to Ukraine since 2014 and have therefore a well established process as well as good knowledge of the most urgent needs and efficient partners in Ukraine. Bevar Ukraine sent 173 trucks to Ukraine for the moment. Money spent for sending the trucks to Ukraine (1700 tons, 41 millions DKK) are used very efficiently as for every crown used for transportation provides around than 10 times higher value as content of trucks is donated by danish donors.

title: Feed a special birthday meal to 200 children
description: The children attending our education programmes look forward to their daily school meals. Usually, tea and mandazi (a form of local donut) for breakfast and rice with beans or githeri (a mix of boiled maize and beans) or ugali (dense porridge from maize flour) with some vegetables. As Turning Point turns 20 years in this month of March, we would like to feed the children a birthday meal that is special and unique from what they eat every day at home and in school.

title: Protecting pangolins in Southern Africa
description: Pangolins, essential for biodiversity due to their seed-dispersing and insect-controlling abilities, are facing extinction as they are poached in large numbers to meet illegal wildlife trade demand. To combat this, we are working with local grassroot partner, PCRF, to conduct pangolin research, hire local people as community rangers, provide community food packs to prevent pangolin hunting for meat, and educate local people about pangolin conservation.

title: Let's go to Carnaval
description: EFTC turns 20 this year! Since 2003 we have been serving the community of Jocotenango, Guatemala.  Our big celebration month will be July and we want to include each and every student including our alumni. We are planning have a Carnaval on Sunday July 23 where we plan to invite current students, past students and their family members.  Help us celebrate the students that have worked so hard to get to where they are today.

title: 30 goats to 30 Women of rural Balawoli
description: The project will empower 30 women in balawoli kamuli district, Through rearing goats as an income-generating activity for rural women, while improving the nutrition and food security of their children. Priority is given to single mothers who have more than 3 children, HIV-positive mothers, or with other illnesses like cancer, who struggle to earn an income to sustain their family.

title: 2023 Malaysia Flood Relief Fund
description: Heavy rains and flooding have severely affected communities across four states in Malaysia. Johor continues to be the worst-affected state at this time. Four people have been killed and tens of thousands have been displaced. Your donation to the 2023 Malaysia Flood Relief Fund will help people in impacted communities.

title: Volunteer Bicycle Messengers for Disaster Response
description: Support for this project will allow the Bike Scouts to provide basic safety equipment, bicycles for communication and supplies delivery, and essential training on disaster reporting and response for its community-based Volunteer Bicycle Messenger teams around the Philippines. Bike Scouts serve in some of the most disaster-vulnerable areas of our country that's ranked with the highest disaster risk among 193 countries around the world with 74% of the population is susceptible to their impact.

title: Save the CT2 troop
description: In 2022, the City of Cape Town withdrew rangers from the CT2 troop leaving the baboons at risk. Very busy roads and some intolerant residents, who use high powered weapons to shoot at baboons, resulted in the deaths of at least 4 of the troop and one female has disappeared.  We have employed two teams of experienced monitors to keep the baboons off dangerous roads and out of houses for as much time as possible to reduce the conflicts. Please help us to cover the costs of our hardworking teams.

title: Send Them Back To School Project
description: In 2023, Send Them Back To School Project will support  45 underprivileged children (40 children and 5 young adults) from Kicukiro District , Kigali, Rwanda.  This project will cover tuition fees and purchase school supplies for at least 40 primary and secondary school children. As well, as help cover the cost of school supplies and laptops for 5 young adults that are attending university.

title: Nutritious meals for 50 hungry children in Soweto
description: The project serves 50 beneficiaries ranging in age from 3 - 18 years who come from the Emdeni township in Soweto. The children have been affected by HIV and AIDS & TB. Some have been orphaned, some live with ill parents and some with Grandparents. No child should go hungry. Children cannot perform in school if they are hungry or take medicine. This project will supply 50 vulnerable children with daily meals and assist their families with sustenance farming and emotional support..

title: Therapy for 50 Children with Disability in Nigeria
description: The project will provide early intervention therapy for 50 children with disability particularly Cerebral Palsy through Physio, occupational expressive  and speech therapy. It will empower them to be independent and develop their social skills. Parents and caregivers will also be empowered to improve on care and other service delivery. The project will target children of indigent families who cannot access these services in Nigeria.

title: Support a youth football academy in Uganda
description: This soccer academy provides additional weekly training for boys and girls aged 6-13 regardless of their ability or previous playing experience.  The goal of this project is to offer appropriate opportunity for maximal development of talent in youth training and nurturing of their talents in football players

title: Send Pain Relief to 40 remote districts in Uganda.
description: Your donation will help us conclude a fundraiser to acquire a new vehicle that will facilitate our team's travels to the 40 remaining districts in Uganda without hospice and palliative care services. Our old vehicle of 12 years is no longer able to take us to the remaining poor and rural communities to establish palliative care teams, conduct mentorship, support supervision, and streamline access to pain relief medicines for people facing serious health-related suffering due to severe illnesses.

title: Eastern Cape Flood Response
description: Eastern Cape communities have suffered the effects of severe rains over the period of 08 - 11 February 2023. Among those worst affected are families who lost their mud homes and all their belongings that were washed away during the flooding. Gift of the Givers responded to these families with emergency relief aid providing meals and blankets at their place of refuge. We've commenced our long-term intervention that entails the rebuilding of homes and infrastructure.

title: Solar-Powered Lights for Off-Grid Poor Families II
description: We will purchase at volume and distribute to our small self-help groups on credit ultra-affordable study and work solar lanterns that will provide 4 hours bright light on a full day's charge using highly efficient light-emitting diodes.  Our lantern provides focused light that can be oriented in any direction, making it ideal for studying or working. The solar panel is conveniently integrated into the lamp to make solar charging simple and easy. We will target 2,500 beneficiaries for Phase 2.

title: Help Us Transform the Surf Industry in Mozambique
description: This project continues our support for Manuel 'Manu Shapes' and at the same time strengthening our partnership with 'Lwandi Surf' a nonprofit organisation in Ponta do Ouro, Mozambique. We will bring two expert surfboard shapers to teach and share their knowledge of a sustainable and innovative shaping technique. This technique uses only natural or recycled materials that have almost zero impact on the ocean environment and will empower a new generation of sustainable artisans.

title: Fundacion Todo Mejora Chile
description: In Todo Mejora Chile Foundation where we are deeply committed to promote the wellbeing and safety of LGBTIQA+ adolescents and youth. Our primary mission revolves around empowering this vibrant community through comprehensive programs dedicated not only to prevent suicide but also aim to eradicate homophobic bullying, creating safe and inclusive environments where our young individuals can thrive.

title: Ramadan Feed Fasting - Help Us Feed the Poor
description: Feed the poor during the holy month of Ramadan. The project aims to provide food packages to 10,000 families in rural areas of Balochistan. The food packages will include essential items such as rice, flour, lentils, oil, and spices, which will help families break their fasts and have enough to eat during this holy month. This will allow families to focus on their religious observances during Ramadan without worrying about where their next meal will come from.

title: Safe bathrooms + Menstrual health for 100 families
description: Plenty of families in vulnerable communities do not have access to an adequate and safe bathroom, which has a direct impact on their health, well-being and self-esteem.    The lack of sanitation generates, in turn, greater complications for menstruating people, who face the taboo of menstruation and, not having a safe place to manage it, can see their social, work or educational life completely affected.    We want to provide vulnerable families with a concrete solution to improve their lives.

title: Send 5 NYC Children in Need to Summer Camp!
description: With summer around the corner, we want to give five children living in need the opportunity to attend the beautiful Wagon Road Camp in Chappaqua, New York. These five lucky children will enjoy recreation and exercise through various activities including  swimming, ropes course, horseback riding, nature hikes, and more! They will also be able to participate in fun and engaging learning projects that stimulate their curiosity and wonder.

title: Sponsorship program for 1,000 children in Vietnam
description: Within 9 years of operation, project A New Page of Life has supported 229 children to get birth certificates so that they can have access to education and children's basic rights; more than 2,100 children are supported in education, health, and nutrition in HCMC.  Following previous successes, we aim to continue to support nearly 1,000 orphans, disadvantaged, and disabled children and youth in HCMC and Hanoi in 2023 by providing opportunities for them to access education, health, and nutrition.

title: Future-proofing higher education |oikos TE program
description: oikos Transforming Education (TE) initiative is empowering and accompanying student change agents from >20 countries to collaborate with key players at the university ecosystem and make the youth voices heard. Embedded in the global oikos network, students tackle the sustainability challenges of our time and take ownership of their education. Through the TE initiative we progressed teaching and learning at >30 Universities and we continue to foster their sustainable development.

title: Rebuild Hope
description: A devastating earthquake struck Turkey on February 6. The earthquake not only caused great material damage and loss of life, but also affected the education of many university students in the region.Buldan Foundation aims  to provide computer donations to these students with this project. Providing computers will enable them to  attend online classes, complete assignments and access educational resources, regardless of their location or circumstances.

title: Food Kit for homeless and poor people
description: Trivandrum Don Bosco Veedu will provide food kits to 100 street dwellers who are starving in Trivandrum's streets. The homeless people are mostly mentally ill, abandoned, elderly, and migrant refugees. The state facilities to shelter these people are scarce, and the existing shelters are not functioning. Hence, these people beg for a living.  Providing meals would help them move a day without starvation. Food kits will help poor people feed their family.

title: Realizing child's right via ahealthy environments
description: Environmental hazards have been linked to a range of significant health risks for children. For example, the global rise of cancer, diabetes, neurodevelopmental disorders and asthma has accompanied a surge in air pollution, e-waste and the use of harmful chemicals in everyday products.

title: Make a Difference - Ramadan Aid Project
description: The Holy month of Ramadan is upon us, and like every year, needy families are struggling to make ends meet or even survive. This year URDA is launching an initiative that aims to remind the vulnerable and the privileged alike that anyone can make a difference and impact other people's lives, one good deed at a time.

title: Happier childhoods and brighter futures
description: This project will take AfriKids to 60 new communities in northern Ghana, ensuring some of the world's hardest to reach and poorest children are healthy, safe and in school and have hope for a brighter future.

title: Provide 1000 schoolbags to schoolchildren in Yemen
description: As education is a vital factor for the children who are regarded as the future hope, BFD appeals for assistance to provide 1000 schoolbags, chair and desk, uniform and meals for schoolchildren in Amran governorate. We envision education as a means of empowering the city to overcome poverty, which is one of the sustainable development goals.

title: Rainwater Systems to cope with climate change
description: Over 9 million Argentineans lack access to safe drinking water. Especially in the north region and during the dry season aggravated by the climate crisis, the lack of safe water poses a significant health risk. On top of that, groundwater is contaminated with arsenic in this area and is not suitable for human consumption. EWB-Ar works to implement rainwater harvesting and storage systems in these isolated areas, including the San Antonio Oeste community, a little village with 200 inhabitants.

title: May Higher Learning Fund
description: The May Higher Learning Fund offers graduates of Jifundishes's Independent Study program and Houston Scholarship Fund the opportunity to attend University.  These hard-working, well-deserving students have overcome tremendous odds to reach this milestone, and this comprehensive Fund offers support for tuition, supplies, room & board, and a laptop.

title: Emergency Response to the Caribbean Coral Crisis
description: Coral reefs provide food, shelter, and protection to many marine species. For millions of people, coral reefs support livelihoods, preserve cultures, feed families, and protect homes from storms. But our coral reefs are dying, and we're in danger of losing them forever. The Perry Institute for Marine Science (PIMS) is leading the fight to save these precious ecosystems in the Caribbean, where coral reefs are the foundation of the region's economy, culture, and way of life, and we need your help.

title: Feed 50 at risk babies in Tigray, Ethiopia
description: This project will provide baby formula and follow-up for 75 high risk babies who have been abandoned after birth or their mother has died in childbirth and the extended family is in need of support in order to keep the baby within the family.

title: No One Can Thrive on an Empty Stomach
description: By supporting our Food Intervention caused by a long drought, YOU can make a real difference rallying donations online to support this food intervention in our food basket program for 2000 households. With 700 people relying on charitable food assistance intervention, Cico Uganda Virtual Food Drives have become an important and impactful way individuals and across communities to help provide meals to neighbors in need and join the fight against hunger.

title: Syria earthquake relief response for children
description: Hundreds of thousands of children and their families are homeless in the wake of the earthquake. These children are now even more vulnerable to family separation, exploitation, and abuse. With buildings unsafe, they also are unable to return to school. In northern Syria, the threats to children from abuse were already extreme. The soaring poverty, within a warzone, now devastated by earthquakes, has created an unimaginable number of challenges, and suffering for children. They need your help !

title: Plant the seeds of tomorrow for an Orphan child
description: These children are some of many hundreds of AIDS Orphans that likulezi has helped over the past 30 years to be enabled to go to primary school by supporting their Guardian with household costs, and business loans. With the advent of retroviral drugs for HIV infection Likulezi began to use resources to extend the education  from primary  into Secondary and from there  to get some as far as 3rd level! this has been a great boost to this poor  community as Education is their  way out of Poverty .

title: Higher Education for 90 Andean Young People
description: Do you think it's fair that where you live dictates your level of education? In Peru, young people from rural areas are far less likely to complete higher education than their urban peers, due to lack of financial resources, preparation, and support. Our Transitions Project enables indigenous young people from the Andes to become the first in their families to study after secondary school, leading to better employment opportunities and empowering them to break the poverty cycle.

title: Lent Project
description: Every Lent period, a number of community issues are worked on and these help to improve the lives of people. Issues addressed are water,

title: The Maternal Health Initiative
description: With the aim to decrease the infant mortality rate Imkaan established a 24/7 maternity home in January 2018. The only maternity home catering to a population of 800,000 people, the women of the community can finally opt to give birth in a medically conducive environment, get a consultation on high-risk pregnancies, track the progress of their baby, and be guided regarding nutrition throughout their pregnancy and initiating a process of learning and awareness regarding their own health issues

title: Paris Marathon '23 - Jaydeep & Xavier
description: Last year, when my good friend, Xavier, completed a full Ironman, it inspired me to challenge myself in the year that I turn 50 years old. Xavier spiced up the challenge by offering to sponsor me to run the Paris marathon. We run together in Paris on 2nd April 2023 - for the organisation we both love, and the beneficiaries we serve at CR. CR is at the forefront of NGO work - working with urban slum communities to improve healthcare, education and living conditions. Please make it a special 50th.

title: Assist our Rehabilitation and Therapy Outreach.
description: In Tanzania, many individuals with disabilities (PWDs) face the harsh reality of poverty. Unfortunately, health insurance companies often fail to cover essential assistive devices such as wheelchairs and vital rehabilitation services. As a result, numerous people with disabilities are confined to their beds at home, which exacerbates their poverty levels and exposes them to additional health challenges, including pressure sores, contractures, and hypostatic pneumonia.

title: Send a Child to School in Kenya for Year 2023-2024
description: Victory Foundation Programme's plan to provide gift hampers to 3000 Children of Kibera, Mathare and Mihango slums in Kenya from 2023 & 24 containing nutritious food, pens, books, sanitary towels and clothing to increase school completion, improve their health and nutritional needs, to improve attention and concentration levels to improve academic performance. This will be through provision of quality education and free feeding to the children admitted, empowering them for sustainable livelihood.

title: CALL TO ERADICATE ILLITERACY & CHILD LABOR IN YOBE
