description: This project looks to enroll 550 children in schools, while empowering 150 households with income generating activities following these three criteria: 400 children aged between 3-16 years enrolled into primary schools, where at least 60% will be young girls 150 children between the age of 18 and 25 years, enrolled in vocational training to ensure acquisition of skills that can be applied to the field of work to generate income. 120 households introduced to IGA of their Interest

title: Send an orphan  to school in  Rumbek  for a year.
description: This project will put to class 50 children (orphans) that have lost their parents during the conflicts in Rumbek, providing them with excess to primary education.  The project will also provide support services to 100 orphans traumatized by the conflicts who are pursuing  their studies through the sponsorship of their relatives.

title: Educational Sponsorship for 300 children
description: Refugio Rafael in Marquina, Bolivia started in 2017 with an after-school program to support the children of the migrant community whose parents did not have the educational preparation to help their children with homework. As the children and the community have grown, we have recognized the need to help children learn technical skills for the workforce. We believe each person should be able to pursue a field of study that helps them provide for their own and their families' basic needs.

title: With you, it is possible Amigos de San Cristobal
description: We need you! To continue working and strengthening our Community Foundation. With your support, we can continue building a better community through community philanthropy, channeling resources to organizations that work on the most critical issues and with the most disadvantaged people in The Highlands of Chiapas region. With your contributions, we can continue maintaining and strengthening our operational team and cover various expenses of our daily work.

title: Promoting Gender Equality in Public Schools.
description: This project aims to strengthen inclusion and gender equalityty in Public Elementary schools in Mexico to improve children self- esteem, promote human rights, empower girls and promote respect between boys and girls. We promote inclusion and gender equity through the implementation of different human development programs where children will obtain socio emotional abilities to generate safe, inclusive family and school environments, where gender equity and healthy coexistence is essential.

title: Turkey Earthquake Relief-Reducing Pain and Trauma
description: The next step in supporting earthquake survivors in Turkey is to provide trauma-informed care to reduce severe physical pain and traumatic stress. This September, AWB is sending a health care team to the Antalya region of Turkey where over 50,000 survivors are relocated. In partnership with local organizations, we will provide at least 5,000 acupuncture treatments and train local physicians to perform ear acupuncture for traumatic stress and pain reduction. Our field team is ALL VOLUNTEER.

title: REBUILDING LIVES OF 20 TEENAGE MUMS IN KIBERA SLUM
description: Poverty in many cases drive adolescent girls to trade sex in exchange of life essentials, leading to among other things unwanted pregnancies and early parenthood. This project is seeking to support 20 teenage mothers in Kibera Slums of Nairobi, Kenya to rebuild their lives through vocational training. The girls will be take through an incubation to unlock their potential, then facilitate them to go back to school or vocational training. A daycare for the babies will also be set

title: Women's Empowerment: Dominicans & South Sudanese
description: GRACE Cares, in partnership with our local heroes, will provide women's empowerment opportunities to Project Hearts in Baitoa, Dominican Republic, and the Base for Hope and Human Rights Organization (BHHRO) in South Sudan. In the Dominican Republic, Project Hearts will train women in basic health and leadership skills in their Community Health Leadership program; and in South Sudan, BHHRO will provide training and seed money to young mothers to start or expand their small businesses.

title: Spring Fill the Clinic with Cape CARES
description: Cape CARES clinics have treated families and communities for three generations, making us one of the oldest NGO's in Honduras! Returning to each community multiple times a year has allowed for Cape CARES to build a team-centered primary care practice that provides medical and dental treatment, follow up care, preventive care, health education, and community needs assessments. Our largest cost is pharmaceuticals and supplies. That is where you come in.

title: Strengthening the health of 99 Tseltal families.
description: In IXIM A. C.  Our mission is to accompany Tseltal communities in Chiapas so that they build, from their own values, alternatives of dignified and self-managed life in harmony.  For this we work for 6 years with groups of women, children and young people, in the areas of health, social organization, environment and economy, so that they can reach the Buhts'an Qu'inal, which is the Tseltal concept to describe harmony with oneself, with the environment and with transcendence and that can be transl

title: Improve refugees' life conditions in Greece
description: Our goal is to empower and integrate refugees whilst seeking asylum through sport, with a community-led model. Today, we enable over 3 500 refugees per month to develop their skills and have better opportunities, using sport as a tool to improve their mental and physical health, be part of a close-knit community and encourage integration. We aim at raising money to improve our gyms and equipment, offer a wider range of sports, participate in more local races and support our community in any way.

title: emergency help to victims of cyclone freddy
description: This project is shall be overruled by The Chinseu Community Based Organization but there is a special committee that is set to look for the help received and where it shall be distributed (logistic committee). This committee is comprising of different members of the societies like Member from the office of the Ward Councilor, Area development committee, Village development committee, Representative from the religious group and chaired by the Chinseu CBO - Disaster Program Officer.

title: SOLVE WATER PROBLEM FOR CHILDREN WITH DYSLEXIA
description: This project provides clean water for 250 children with dyslexia and other neurobiological disorders at Rare Gem Talent School. Sinking a borehole will provide running water to ensure a hygienic environment and prevent the children from contracting cholera which has already been reported in the neighborhood.  The water will serve the school and the community around it.

title: Digital Literacy Skills for 50 schoolgirls
description: This project will provide digital literacy skills training for 50 schoolgirls in Gboko on Internet access, Basic computer literacy, cybersecurity and digital marketing to make them competitive for the Nigerian labor market and help them decrease the poverty rates of rural areas of the nation.  For this theoretical and practical training will be offer to girls who have never gotten soft skills or computational skills, leaving them out of the job market.

title: Linking Arms
description: Dunyoi rushdi jomea and local partners are working in the area of: - Rehabilitation of children with disabilities - Entering children with disabilities into mainstream schools - Conduct parents, government institutions (education, health, social), children and adult with disabilities on Inclusive education, rehabilitation, equal rights - Conduct advocacy events for people with disabilities and protection of rights - Ratification of UN CRPD convention in Tajikistan

title: The Blessed Ramadan Project in Iraq
description: The Holy month of Ramadan is upon us, and like every year, needy families are struggling to make ends meet or even survive. This year BAORD is launching an initiative that aims to remind the vulnerable and the privileged alike that anyone can make a difference and impact other people's lives, one good deed at a time.

title: Provide Urgent Heart Care to a Venezuelan Child.
description: Our project addresses a serious lack of care and resources affecting nearly 6000 children born in Venezuela annually with congenital heart disease. Fundacion Estrellita de Belen will provide access to medical treatment, medicines, nutrition and simple heart procedures to over 200 children suffering from congenital heart disease in Venezuela.

title: Prevent Sexual Violence
description: We are the Sexual Violence Prevention Association- a nonprofit dedicated to preventing sexual violence systemically. We work within three pillars- policy, research, and institutions which include colleges, companies, and K12 schools.

title: EMERGENCY RELIEF FUND - CYCLONE FREDDY IN MALAWI
description: Cyclone Freddy has hit Malawi on March 13th and is shaping up to be the longest-lasting storm on record since its arrival in southern Africa in late February. Malawi is bearing the brunt of the storm: more than 11,000 people have been affected, and the south-central regions, where Aleimar has been operating since 2014, are at the brink of collapse. The cyclone's impact has aggravated the situation in a country grappling with the deadliest cholera epidemic in its history.

title: Help an Elephant, Help a Herd
description: HERD Trust (Hoedspruit Elephant Rehabilitation and Development) was established in 2021 following a 24-year journey in caring for elephants displaced or orphaned due to human-elephant conflict. As South Africa's first dedicated elephant orphanage and homestead, HERD Trust supports a total of 16 elephants, 11 orphans who found a new family with each other, and 5 elephants born to them. We are committed to ensuring the elephants' well-being for their natural lives. Every elephant needs a herd.

title: Ration to 200 Children with Disabilities
description: Sindh is home to a vulnerable group of approximately 7.18 million people with disabilities. With the ongoing global economic crisis, we need your support now more than ever! Help us provide essential food items to families of 200 children with disabilities hailing from one of the poorest districts in Sindh.

title: You can change the future, support a student of PR
description: Boys & Girls Club of Puerto Rico is a non-profit organization with 55 years of service providing comprehensive services to youth runs 11 Clubs throughout the island, which are a second home to more than 12,000 children and youth. Providing a safe and supportive place during critical times of the day, strong role models, and programming organized around education, careers, health and life skills, arts, leadership, sports, and recreation.

title: Plant Seeds of Hope!
description: Help establish a school garden to be used as an educational tool where all the children will explore and learn about the food cycle of food growth, harvest, consumption and disposal within the context of classwork. Likewise, the garden will be a valuable resource for the school snack and lunch program. Help us to provide fresh produce for the school and snack program, thereby improving the quality and nutritional value of the food served and enabling school garden financial sustainability.

title: Personalised education for displaced young people
description: Displaced young people (15-24) living in Athens face considerable challenges to attending public school. Better Days' award-winning flagship project, Gekko, offers personalised, trauma-aware education for young people to pursue quality education in a dignified space. We recognize that the uncertainty of displacement poses significant barriers to learning. Our experienced educators work one-on-one with students to set clear goals and develop step-by-step plans for achieving their dreams.

title: Tropical Cyclone Freddy Relief Fund
description: Cyclone Freddy is the longest-lived tropical cyclone ever recorded. The storm has killed hundreds of people and displaced tens of thousands across communities in Madagascar, Mozambique, and Malawi. It is one of the deadliest storms in southern Africa in recent years. Your donation will go to vetted nonprofits on the front lines of relief and recovery.

title: Education for the Amazon
description: We connect educators to the Amazon rainforest & conservation initiatives through professional workshops & research. Our lives depend on this ecosystem's health.  Opportunities to acquire the knowledge & skills needed to take action are limited & undervalued. Our programs empower teachers to engage students in scientific investigations so that we may inspire the next generation of environmental stewards and create a more sustainable future.

title: Save Malnourished Children in Rural Indonesia
description: Malnutrition is still a nutritional problem in Indonesia. This is reflected in the prevalence of stunting under five, which is still at 24.4%. In order to improve the quality of superior and qualified human resources, we are targeting under-5 stunting to be 14% by the end of 2024. The results of the Indonesian Ministry of Health's Study on Nutritional Status (SSGI) show that 24.5% of infants under 5 years of age (toddlers) in West Java will experience stunting in 2022

title: Fighting anemia with medical care to 480 children
description: This project will provide medical care for 480 children under five suffering from anemia. As well, we look forward to giving the children the necessary capacities to learn at an average rate, so they won't be left behind in these matters. With the donations, we will work in the district of Santa Rosa, Lima-Peru, to improve both their health and learning capabilities by providing close support and control, food supplements, and training their parents to implement iron-based diets at a low cost.

title: Support 1000 women affected by the earthquake
description: This project aims to support 1000 women affected by the disaster with basic hygiene, health and dignity kits and to provide them with access to protection systems against violence.

title: Pre-school Education for Underprivileged Children
description: Aangun Early Childhood Education Pre-school is helping underprivileged, working-class children to bridge the development gap that they have to endure due to an impoverished learning environment.  These objectives are achieved through a highly interactive activity-based and child-centred curriculum and pedagogy grounded in the local culture, supplemented with the training of teachers and parents and community engagement.

title: Vital medicines for 7,530 patients in Sierra Leone
description: Inter Care provides medical supplies to rural health units across sub-Saharan Africa to support patients who are living in poverty and cannot afford to pay for their treatment. Many of the medicines we supply, are lifesaving. If we were unable to send these medicines, many vulnerable patients' lives would be at risk.  This project aims to send medicines to rural health units in Sierra Leone to provide treatment free of charge and support approximately 7,530 of the poorest patients.

title: Help Feed Hungry School Children.
description: No children should have to learn in an stomach. Our community based school feeding project is part of our hunger relief program where we deliver hot meals to school children in under-developed areas in Nigeria and Uganda. The food we provide goes hand-in-hand with the education these children receive. Your donation will feed & get children out of the street and into school, increasing enrollment rate and reducing absenteeism. Giving them basic nutrients to grow and focus more on education.

title: Hospice Home "Casa de la Bondad"
description: "Casa de la Bondad" (House of Kindness) provides comprehensive palliative care to terminally ill patients derived from public hospitals.  The main objective is to care for, love and accompany the sick person in distress. The right to have a dignified death must be a universal right. This is why the nurses, staff and volunteers of Manos Abiertas attend, approximately 40 patients a year. The house attended more than 400 people in 13 years.

title: LITERACY PROJECT FOR AT-RISK CHILDREN IN AFRICA
description: Literacy is the fundamental driver of all the changes education brings to mankind.  Studies show that just learning to read and write (LITERACY) could lift 171 million people out of poverty.  BMAN is expanding this  Literacy Project to urban and rural communities to equip at-risk children to be proficient in literacy skills.

title: Hearts for Ukrainians
description: With the escalation of the war, by the beginning of 2023, more than 5 million internally displaced persons were officially registered in Ukraine, most of whom are women and children. Every day, a large number of IDPs in need of humanitarian, medical, psychological and social assistance arrive in the Odesa region. For more than a year, we have been continuously providing such assistance to vulnerable population, and we greatly need your support to reach more of those who need our help.

title: L.I.F.E SUPPORT FUND
description: Low Income Families Education (L.I.FE) Support Fund.  It is an annual education endowment fund for children who are forced out of school due to financial constraints beyond their control. L.I.F.E Support Fund will serve as an emergency support fund to students from single parent homes who are challenged with funding while schooling at all educational levels due to unavoidable circumstances. Imagine the number of individuals who were robed of their full potentials due to lack of school fees!

title: Ecuador and Peru Earthquake Relief Fund
description: On March 18, 2023, a 6.8 magnitude earthquake struck southern Ecuador near the town of Balao. At least 16 people have been killed in both southern Ecuador and northern Peru. Hundreds more have been injured and many people remain missing underneath rubble.  Your donation to the Ecuador and Peru Earthquake Relief Fund will go to vetted nonprofits on the front lines of relief and recovery.

title: Call for support to eradicate water crisis in GLN
description: A successful survey conducted by HOPLE were we find out some communities are in difficult situation regarding water challenge especially in Gulani Local Governments, Yobe State Northeast Nigeria, Water has became their main challenges, women and children most go far to fetch water. HOPLE plans to eradicate the water crisis by construction of 20 borehole, and support 100 women and adolescents girls with Livelihoods opportunities.

title: Help Run Ambulance, Upgrade Clinic and Save Lives!
description: The clinic provides medical care to the community in the immediate vicinity of the campus. The number of deaths in Uganda could be drastically reduced if there were better health care and emergency transport to hospital. Large numbers of people still die from conditions that are treatable such as malaria, pneumonia, infectious diseases, complications of childbirth & severe injuries from accidents. The Ambulance & Clinic upgrade would provide improved health care facilities and & Save lives.

title: Supporting Nurse's Training for Women in Guatemala
description: The Kateri Tekakwitha Fund is supporting young Indigenous women in the Guatemalan Highlands who are studying nursing, awarding scholarships for study, and helping to cover the costs of the materials and equipment needed for their programs.

title: OSCASI: 65 years empowering communities in Petare
description: OSCASI's mission is to provide education to out-of school-children and help transform realities through comprehensive training programs.  After 65 years, we continue to invest in the development and improvement of the Petare community, With this project we will provide our 165 students with: -Special education so out-of-school children can complete primary education and continue to study regularly - Individualized health care - Nutrition - Local entrepreneurship trades - Emotional containment

title: Sponsor a Vulnerable Child Today
description: Our project, "Transforming Lives Through Education: Sponsor a Vulnerable Child Today," aims to provide educational opportunities for underprivileged children. By partnering with sponsors, we will ensure access to quality schooling, resources, and mentorship, enabling these children to break the cycle of poverty and realize their full potential. Join us in making a lasting impact on their lives and empowering them for a brighter future.

title: Migrantland:  A base for the future
description: There are over 2 million Migrant Workers on the Thai/Myanmar border who work under slave-like conditions in Thai factories and farms, most often for less than half of minimum wage.  These workers are harassed, scammed, trafficked, exploited and extorted by Thai police and other authorities. Yet they continue to cross the border for work to avoid starvation in Myanmar. Addiction and violence are rife in this population due to the extreme abuse they have suffered.

title: Remote Reading Fellows for Left-behind Children
description: This program is to make remote reading education available for the left-behind children who study in elementary school in poor areas of China. As reading fellows, volunteers will record children audiobooks, using their voices to send care, raise their interest of reading, develop literacy skills and get inspiration from the content. We will also complement cartoon booksmarks, physical books, portable audio players and e-education materials for schools to formalize the reading education course.

title: Syria: reconstruction after the earthquake
description: The project aims to support the recovery of people and the reconstruction of houses and buildings that where severely damaged by the massive 7.8 magnitudo earthquake that rocked Turkey and Northern Syria. The reconstruction activities will be carried out in Aleppo, Latakia and other cities in Syria. The earthquake and its following tremors took more than 50,000 lives and caused an estimated $5.1 billion in damages. The impact in Syria has been exacerbated by the ongoing decade-long conflict.

title: Home rehabilitation for 50 child with brain tumor
description: Brain tumors are the first cause of death in children, yet they have a better chance of being cured than adults. Unfortunately, the treatments often leave important disabilities that require early and intensive rehabilitation, which exploits the plasticity of the central nervous system of children, but which the public health service rarely offers.  HELP IRENE Association to provide home rehabilitation services to children being treated for brain tumors at the Bambino Gesu Pediatric Hospital.

title: HELP STOP BLINDNESS IN ITS TRACKS FOR 700 CHILDREN
description: There are an estimated 1.4 million blind children worldwide. Approximately three quarters of these live in the poorest regions of Africa and Asia.The burden of disability in terms of blind years in these children represents a major social, emotional, and economic burden for the children, their families, the communities, and the nation.This is an initiative taken to accelerate the efforts to elevate, integrate and activate child eye health to meet the growing eye care needs among our children.

title: Create Environmental Clubs in  Ugandan Schools
description: This project will plant more seed beds to increase the planting of more trees in Uganda and create school environmental clubs to ensure students plant trees every Monday in a one-student one-tree campaign. Over 10,000 trees will be planted in the seed beds in 10 Schools and 6 villages.    The 10 clubs established in schools and MULIA youth-led club will manage and distribute the trees to communities where they come from and give assembly lectures on the importance of planting more trees.

title: Help 30 women and girls escape human trafficking
description: Hagar's Survivor Care project in Cambodia will provide victims of human trafficking, slavery, and abuse with holistic and life-saving care. The trauma of trafficking runs deep, but as Hagar's dedicated frontline team supports each individual, survivors will heal and rebuild their lives. This project will provide holistic, wraparound care for each survivor for one year, including safe shelter, trauma counseling, medical care, education, job placement, and small business start-up support.

title: Lovely Home for abandoned Cats
description: Stray cats often do not have proper shelter and are often forced to live on the streets, even experiencing violence. In this project, we want to build a safe and comfortable shelter for stray cats around the city. This shelter will serve as a place of refuge for cats, medical facility and play ground so they can be protected from harsh weather, predation, and other dangers that may occur outside.

title: TRUE COLOURS- HELP US KEEP ADESEWA'S LEGACY ALIVE
description: ADESEWA AME SENBANJO passed away on February 5, 2021 at age 19 from intra-cardiac lymphoma, an aggressive cancer of the heart.  Her death was a devastating experience for her parents, younger siblings and close family members.  Adesewa left behind a variety of artwork, drawings, two completed manuscripts of her unpublished books, video scripts and art illustrations. While alive, she had a note stuck to her bedroom door proclaiming her positive approach to life: "LET YOUR TRUE COLOUR SHINE!

title: JA BizTown & JA Finance Park
description: Through this proposal, JA North respectfully requests support for our JA BizTown & JA Finance Park programs as we provide over 17,000 students with personal finance and career readiness skills through both in-person and virtual program opportunities in the upcoming 2023-2024 program year.

title: Cyclone Freddy Disaster Response in Malawi
description: Cyclone Freddy hit southern Malawi on Monday, March 13 has broken world records as one of the strongest and longest sustained tropical storms ever recorded. As of Monday, March 20, Malawi has reported 476 deaths, 918 missing, and 717 injured. The estimated number of households affected has reached over 200,000. Increasing cholera cases-additional resources are needed to address the health impacts of the cyclone; your solidarity and support is timely and necessary.

title: Empower & educate girls and create social change!
description: We create social change with communities for the equality of girls and the improvement of their education. We help around 200 girls between 10 and 21 years old in 2 communities where teen pregnancy-, school drop out- and illiteracy rates are high.

title: Housing-rural girls with university scholarship
description: This project is aimed at low-income girls in rural areas who have received a scholarship to study at ICSEF, a university far from their home, and do not have the resources to cover accommodation, care and food.  The housing provided to 30 rural women, is located to 5 minutes walking from the campus,  Vereda Usatama, in the municipality of Fusagazuga, Colombia.  We seek to make it self-sustaining thru fundraising, planting and selling vegetables, catering and event services.

title: Post Syrian Earthquake Aid
description: An earthquakes struck Syria on 6 February 2023, leaving more than 5000 casualties between deaths and injuries in addition to displacing thousands more. Today after more than a month from the catastrophe date, needs are still the same yet new needs are arising such as psychosocial support for children and wash issues to control diseases and pandemics. Your donation to the Syria Earthquake Relief Fund will provide emergency relief and other sectors responses during this long-term recovery process.

title: Ensure Kimbilio children eat - as food costs rise
description: Food prices are rising around the world and D.R.Congo is no exception. With its low level of food production DRC is reliant on imports. Fuel cost increases have already added to food prices in DRC shops. The price of flour is now rapidly increasing due to shortages of flour in neighbouring Zambia. Zambia is reducing sales to DRC leading to food shortages, with those in need struggling to afford the basics. Kimbilio is seeing increased numbers of children at the day centre. Please help.

title: Scholarship's for Slum Kids in Pattaya Thailand
description: The Hand to Hand Foundation supports poor families living in the slums so that they can continue caring for their children, rather than abandoning them into ophanages. Our scholarship program is crucial as the lack of finances for education is one of the key factors parents abandon their child. In an orphanage their child will get free education, food and housing. For some, the decision to leave their child, is the most loving choice they have. We believe every child needs their family.

title: Cyclone Yaku in Rio Seco (Cieneguilla, Lima-Peru)
description: Cyclone Yaku hit Peru at the beginning of March 2023. The  Peruvian National Meteorological and Hydrological Service (SENAMHI) described it as as an "unorganised tropical cyclone" not seen since 1983 or 1998.  Yaku impacted the life of many Peruvians, among them, the 2500 families of Rio Seco in Cieneguilla (Lima).  Rio Seco's population is settled in the ravines of the area. The mudslides originated by Cyclone have destroyed their houses and leave them with nothing: no house, food or clothes.

title: Share food for 60.000 poor people in west Java
description: this project aimed to providing essential food supplies for underprivileged communities in west java, Indonesia. With the help of volunteers and donations, we aim to distribute food packages to 60,000 individuals and families in need. Our goal is to ensure that no one goes and to promote the spirit of giving and charity in our society.

title: Menstrual health for deaf women in Zimbabwe
description: Due to communication barriers, deaf girls and women in Zimbabwe are excluded from mainstream information on menstrual health. Consequently, some deaf girls and women resort to using materials, such as old t-shirts or newspapers during their mensuration, sometimes leading to an infection.  This project plans to train deaf girls to manufacture and then distribute sanitary packs and educate other deaf women on menstrual hygiene and improve the health outcomes of 80 deaf women in Manicaland.

title: Make a Difference (Aarsal) - Ramadan Aid Project
description: The Holy month of Ramadan is upon us, and like every year, needy families in Aarsal, which is a rural village in Northeastern Lebanon, are struggling to make ends meet or even survive. This year URDA is launching an initiative that aims to remind the vulnerable and the privileged alike that anyone can make a difference and impact other people's lives, one good deed at a time.

title: Reaching a 1000 children, changing a 1000 futures
description: This project will provide 1,000 children, youth, and adolescents between 6 and 17 years old with a safe and secure place during the time after school. We offer our club members well-oriented activities such as arts, music, sports, recreation, homework help, computer tutoring, and nutritional programs, thereby promoting the health, social, educational, vocational, and character development and the necessary skills to succeed in their lives.

title: Build a US WaterHouse!
description: We've been expanding our water initiatives to the US! In the past 2 years, we have been partnering with urban farms throughout the US to supply them with safe, decentralized water to use for irrigation and produce washing! We have completed 3 projects so far, with a 4th coming up in just a few weeks! We are looking to fund a 5th US project so we can continue to supply water infrastructure to urban farms so they can better serve their communities with amazing fruits and veggies.

title: Camera Traps For Wildlife Conservation
description: After 12 years of anti-poaching program and 6 years of habitat restoration effort, endangered wildlife species are showing signs of recovery in and around the most important wildlife corridor in Malaysia. In addition to sign surveys, we monitor the recovery and movements of rare rainforest mammals such as the Malayan tiger and sambar deer by using motion sensor camera traps. Wildlife monitoring is essential to test the efficacy of the conservation actions and guide future efforts.

title: Who is my neighbor? - Somalia Hunger Crisis Appeal
description: Who is my neighbour? Today the world is much smaller, and we are better connected to our fellow humans. As such, someone a world apart is still in fact my neighbour, and their wellbeing concerns me. Somalia is experiencing the worst drought in over 40 years, and in 2022, at least 43,000 people died. This has put significant strain on people's ability to support themselves. With this campaign, we hope to come together through the spirit of our collective concern to support our global neighbours.

title: Water tank system for 52 children in South Africa
description: Due to water scarcity and inconsistent supply in Johannesburg, Hearts of Hope South Africa needs to install a water tank and pump system at 2 of its houses to provide a clean and reliable water source for the 52 orphaned and vulnerable children and their housemothers who live there.

title: Transport for 10 school children in South Africa
description: Hearts of Hope South Africa plans to buy a 10-seater transporter bus to safely take our primary school children to the local government school in Johannesburg.

title: Support Mobile Libraries for Children in Kabul
description: Charmaghz provides marginalized Afghan children with education opportunities through mobile libraries. We operate the largest chain of children's libraries in Afghanistan--including 16 mobile libraries in Kabul--that welcome children into a safe, supportive, creative, and booked-filled environment. In our libraries, trained Librarians support children to build basic reading and math skills, engage in games and art activities, and explore the world of storybooks.

title: Championing a More Resilient Arts + Culture Sector
description: Houston Arts Alliance is a local arts and culture organization whose principal work is to implement the City of Houston's vision, values, and goals for its arts grantmaking and civic art investments. HAA also executes privately funded projects to meet the needs of the arts community, such as disaster preparation, equity in the arts and arts education, research on the state of the arts in Houston, and temporary public art projects.  HAA helps artists and nonprofits be bold, productive and strong.

title: Food support to 400 orphans family's in Rwanda
description: This project will funding seeds  for 400  small vegetable gardens for 400 orphans families managed by children's to grow, plant and harvest their own food .  This will help ensure food security  and hope to eat to this vulnerable orphan children families.

title: Educate Pakistan's most underprivileged children
description: This project will disrupt the cycle of poverty by educating the first generation of the highest need communities in Pakistan. Students from the poorest communities will have access to schools on par with the best in the country. It will combat gender inequities by employing an all-female faculty and enrolling girls in parity with boys - challenging traditional gender norms at every opportunity.

title: Touch a life with the gift of education in Ghana
description: Since 2012, the NAPE Foundation has awarded over 500 scholarships to Ghanaian students to pursue higher education. Palm Institute, a private liberal arts University College in Ghana has been educating the youth for 10years. The mission of the University College is to produce not just regular graduates, but educated ethical and excellent leaders who have the burden to change the story of the African continent in the area of leadership.

title: Home for a Displaced Family from Artsakh
description: During the 2020 44-day devastating war in Nagorno Karabakh, 65-year-old Ms. Victoria had to experience 4th displacement in her lifetime. Currently the 12 member family lives in a rented apartment in the city of Charentsavan in horrible conditions. The only income is Ms. Victoria's pension, her daughter's salary and the disability pension of the 2nd daughter, which does not cover even the basic needs of the family.  With very small donations we can ensure safe and dignity life for this family.

title: Break Barriers: Yasmin Bibi Girls College
description: The lack of higher education institutions for girls in the Pirsaddi area of Mardan, Pakistan is a significant challenge that forces many female students to quit their studies. To address this problem, we have established the Yasmin Bibi Girls high school and college. Our project aims to provide girls with access to higher education, which will help them pursue their academic and professional goals. The annual required budget is $19208 to provide higher education to 180 girls students.

title: Help educate & feed 100 Children in Nigeria
description: The Hope For The Addicts Initiative plan to support 100 displaced, refugee and orphaned children and teenagers  affected by the insurgency and natural disaster, in South west and Northern Nigeria Nigeria.  This project build a farm and a library at the shelter space, providing children with food, clothes, healthcare, clean water, and basic education with life skills services.

title: Fund a Burn Victim's Future
description: Funding acid survivors in Pakistan, primarily women, to get medical assistance as well as vocationally training for jobs.

title: Giving Sight to HIM Will Empower HIS Family
description: Sight is one of the greatest of all blessings; losing sight means losing hope for a better tomorrow, and living a life of dependency by becoming a burden on the family.  A sight lost is a life lost  The underprivileged in Pakistan are deprived of basic necessities. They are struggling to cope with financial worries as Pakistan goes through the roughest economic patches in its history. Inflation is at its peak to the extent that a common man cannot afford to feed his family properly. In such tryi

title: BEING A MAN-Mentoring Boys, Empowering Generations
description: Boys are like mirrors, and their lives reflect the world which we adults have created for them. There is the need to view boys as assets and resources, not as problems or liabilities. Our collective support is needed to cultivate them into becoming valuable, healthy, and thriving members of society. For us to promote and achieve gender equality, ensure the protection of women and girls and end gender-based violence and harmful practices, rigorous training and mentorship of boys and men is vital.

title: Help us rebuild a school in rural Nigeria
description: This project will renovate and construct additional blocks of classrooms to an existing school building. Ifite community primary school is in a deplorable condition. We will also equip the school with classroom furniture such as chairs, desks, blackboards, and help set up a playground.

title: Underwear for Needy Boys in Africa
description: Underwear is the most needed items of all clothing.  Many boys especially those from low income parents are deprived of underwear and lots of them wear worn and torn undies. Hardly would you find children from needy homes in Africa having more than one or two underwear and had to wear for two or three days and wash overnight to wear again the following day. We're fundraising to buy new boxers at wholesale and distribute to needy boys to boost their self-esteem and promote good underwear hygiene.

title: HELP 500 WOMEN VICTIMS OF ARMED CONFLICTS
description: The project will help distribute 100 bags of rice among the Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs), distribute 500 numbers of blankets to 500 women, provide 200 mattresses among their families and distribute detergents for washing clothes to 500 women. The project will help women children with mattresses, rice supplies, and detergents for washing to ameliorate conditions of women affected by armed conflicts and criminal violence which has led to a surge in raids on communities in Zamfara State.

title: Bright Future for Rural Youth
description: This project supports Bayazet Center for Armenian youth various provinces, including Gavar, Sevan and Martuni. The Center's mission is to contribute to the development of Civil Society in Armenian rural areas through Social Research, Non-Formal Education and Awareness Building.

title: Ramadan Kareem 2023
description: Ramadan 2023 is here! There's no better time than now to make sure that families suffering from poverty, conflict, and famine are able to observe Ramadan and have food to break fast with. By donating a Ramadan Food Box, you can help alleviate the hunger pangs of children, mothers, fathers, grandparents

title: Empower children to plant gardens and trees
description: This project will enable students in our community schools in rural Ghana to plant school gardens and fruit trees. The gardens provide an opportunity for environmental education and learning about sustainable farming, while also producing nutritious foods for our school lunch program.

title: Midwest and Southeast US Tornado Relief Fund
description: Deadly tornado outbreaks have hit communities across more than a dozen states since the beginning of 2023. More than 30 people have been killed and thousands have been left homeless, including in places like Rolling Fork, Mississippi. Your donation to the Midwest and Southeast US Tornado Relief Fund will meet emergency needs and help survivors recover in the most affected communities.

title: Food Drive During the Month of Ramadan
description: For the last 8 years, we delivered food items to our students who were widows and fed 100 people per day during the month of Ramadan.  Due to the current economic situation, we have expanded our program to provide food to 150 of the most destitute families during the month of Ramadan. The project will aim to provide daily food to 1000 individuals, who are facing extreme economic hardship due to the ongoing conflict and economic crisis in the country.

title: Foster Financial Education for Rural Communities
description: To offer a dynamic, culturally responsive financial education course to fishing and ranching communities in Mexico that are among the most vulnerable populations in the country. The course includes nine workshops that guide people to make informed decisions that  improve their economic opportunities and overall well being.

title: Fundraising for new Cancer Hospital in Pakistan
description: A new cancer hospital is being built in Karachi, Pakistan and we are crowd-fundraising for the founder wall and the mammogram room.

title: Certify Pakistani Women to Serve on Boards
description: Fund the training and certification of Pakistani women to serve on boards.  There is a gender gap in Pakistan top to bottom and leading boards legally must have female representation but there is a dearth in qualified, certified women.  Fund a woman to be trained today!

title: Tackling Ocean Bound Plastic Pollution in Gambia.
description: This project supports individuals and communities effected by open dumping and burning of waste in The Gambia. WasteAid provides networking, business incubation and resources to enable entrepreneurs to develop their waste innovations which: Reduce air pollution and emissions, Prevent waste from entering mangrove forests and oceans, Improve the health of the environment and community, Enable people to earn dignified livings.  WasteAid also delivers awareness campaigns to inspire community action.

title: Empower 200 Girls to Save Them From Child Marriage
description: This project aims to train 150 vulnerable girls in market-targeted vocational skills such as computer training, baking, sewing, beadmaking, etc., and provide them with financial literacy and business management skills. The project will also provide financial support to beneficiaries in the form of seed grants and support 50 adolescent girls to return to and finish secondary education. The project's strategic goal is to create opportunities for girls, not spouses.

title: Empowering ecuadorian girls for stopping violence
description: This project is looking for developing a safe space for young girls of Socio Vivienda II community allowing them to develop the necessary skills for their empowerment. Regarding the challenges in terms of all types of violence and poverty that they face, through this club they will have the necessary tools to defend themselves and promote equal rights to become community leaders, getting rid of the cultural stigmas that surround them.

title: Build a computer Lab for 60 students in Colombia
description: We haven been giving scholarships for outstanding students for 50 years, it is time we have our own computer room!!! This project will build a computer Lab for our 60 students in Bogota, providing opportunities to integrate innovative complementary tools to our integral education program which guarantees low desertion rates for university students.

title: Helping young Venezuelan doctors scholarship
description: This project will continue helping more young Venezuelan doctors to complete their training. Currently, Healing Venezuela sends each of the 100 students a monthly scholarship of $50, allowing them to cover their basic expenses and thus successfully complete their studies.   The doctors are studying in areas of primary importance such as pediatrics, neurology, gynecology and obstetrics, and cardiology, among others. We help alleviate the health crisis in Venezuela.

title: MS Tornado Response Chainsaw and Backhoe teams
description: Disaster Aid USA is deploying Louisiana  & Ohio Teams 1st, then the Texas team will follow. Backhoe and Chainsaw teams are deploying now to MS. We will be clearing roads and  debris off homes. Teams will also be tarping roofs of homes still livable.  We are coordinating with the local EOC, Churches and Rotary Clubs.  This is our 13th year responding to domestics disasters.  We are all volunteers and according to our bylaws money raised for a this  disaster will be spent on  this disaster  only

title: At-risk youth and marine conservancy alliance
description: Help us  empower at-risk youth to take charge of their future through marine conservation.   Our marine conservancy program, consisting of snorkeling, surfing and scuba diving field trips, is a big success. While on the road we openly discuss human reproductive rights as part of natural equilibrium. By addressing two -apparently disconnected-  issues: marine endangered species and teen pregnancy we are empowering at risk youth to take charge of their future.

title: Reunite 75 Exploited Children with their families
description: Haiti, although bountiful in natural beauty, the majority of people in the country face extreme poverty and famine. Through years of natural disasters and political unrest, generations of warm-hearted Haitians have been negatively affected and their livelihoods devastated. 78% of families live on less than $2/day, forcing parents/guardians to send their children away to be cared for or work. Unbeknownst to them, the children are being abused and exploited.

title: Help Rescue and Rehabilitate Threatened Primates
description: Worryingly the demand for our 24hr emergency animal rescue and rehabilitation program has intensified over the years, due to increased development within Diani, Kenya. Therefore, this Campaign will help us ensure our much-needed animal welfare, rescue, and rehabilitation program is funded for the next four months. Also, this campaign aims to lift the financial worry from Team Colobus and allow the team to provide the best possible care and support needed for the primates in Diani to thrive.

title: Save dogs in the Agadir City Pound from Starvation
description: In 2020 shocking images of starving dogs held in the cities dog pound shocked animal lovers all over the world.  We are the only organisation who are actively working to make sure these scenes are never repeated.  Each month we deliver 3000 USD of food to the dogs in the pound to save them from starving.  We also pay for extra staff to make sure the animals are looked after and visit regularly to rescue the very young or old dogs, as well as those injured or sick.

title: Provide relief to women in Afghanistan
description: In 2023, Afghanistan is one of the hardest places in the world to be a woman.  This project will deliver urgent and lifesaving assistance, such as emergency cash, food parcels and animal feed to women. It will also focus on rebuilding their livelihoods through working with rural women so they have the skills, resources and confidence needed to cultivate their own food and to enable them to harness their untapped potential.

title: Break the cycle with Digital School for Nairobi
description: We assist children living in Nairobi's slums by building schools, providing medical care, and establishing orphanages. We offer promising students hotel training at Italian cooking academy, which has been proven to be effective in responding to unemployment. The next phase involves creating the first digital high school and vocational campus for students in Nairobi's slums. It will enable these students to stand out from their peers and secure good job, regardless of their background.

title: support the immense hunger crisis in South Sudan
description: According to OCHA's February 2023 Humanitarian Needs Overview, Widespread Emergency (IPC Phase 4) outcomes will persist across South Sudan during the post-harvesting period and into the lean season (May through September), given atypically low food availability and access at the household level tied to the long-term impacts of conflict and flooding on livelihood activities, trade flows, and humanitarian interventions, as well as rising prices amidst continued poor macro-economic conditions.

title: Hungerfree in Ramadan - Humanitarian Relief
description: For this year's humanitarian relief for Ramadan, we want to specifically address children living with disabilities. Decades of violence have left large parts of the population with disabilities due to injuries. However, they lack urgently needed support and are far too often forgotten when it comes to humanitarian aid, medical care or educational opportunities. Together we can reach 600 families with food packages so that they can go through the holy month of Ramadan free of hunger!

title: Educational Opportunities for Girls  in Ethiopia
description: This project will continue our ongoing program to provide critical educational opportunities for 15 girls and 4 young women in Ethiopia. Enhance Worldwide will provide school-age children with uniforms, shoes, backpacks, books, personal hygiene and nutritious food to learn, grow and succeed. The project will also provide young women enrolled in university studies with tuition, books, and food while also supporting their tuition and providing transportation.

title: DISASTER IN ALAUSI - LANDSLIDE
description: In the community of Aluasi, where we treat 125 children, a landslide has occurred, leaving 16 people dead so far, 20 not found, more than 500 injured and 163 houses destroyed. Unfortunately we have lost the lives of mothers with their children participating in our program during this tragedy. We need your help to provide food, clothing, water and shelter for the affected families.

title: Ramadan Food Aid in Palestine, Lebanon and Jordan
description: For the families we serve, food parcels and vouchers mean they can celebrate the month of Ramadan with nutritious iftar and suhoor meals to break and start their fast for the day. But food prices across the region continue to rise along with unemployment and inflation - meaning even more families will be left feeling anxious about how to put food on the table rather than celebrating this year. Your support will help families across Palestine, Lebanon and Jordan celebrate comfortably.

title: Helping Indigenous Communities Protect their Lands
description: Frayba accompanies the indigenous communities in Chiapas in their struggle to defend the rights to autonomy, their land and territory. Facing corporate threats, militarization, dispossession and the interests of organized crime, the communities organize themselves to carry out a comprehensive and collective struggle to defend their lands, their lives and their human rights. Together, we defend the communities, their autonomy and Mother Earth.

title: Heroes Needed
description: Nobody can deny we all need heroes in life. These are the people who help us get ahead. We all need people to champion our causes and support us during the times we need support. Not to sound cliche, but heroes don't wear capes; if you want to see what a real hero looks like, all you have to do is look in the mirror.

title: Carayaca Educational Project - Venezuela
description: Coromoto2020 and the Center for Educational Innovation (CIED) of the Andres Bello Catholic University have come together to bring hope to the parish of Carayaca in the State of La Guaira in Venezuela. This pilot test will be carried out for 1 YEAR, led by a team of 10 UCAB professors. Through this alliance, we seek to provide support in socio-emotional tools and good practices in the classroom to respond to the innovation needs in teacher teaching and in student learning.

title: Cancer App for school kids to detect cancer early
description: The goal of the Cancer Smart App is to educate school children about all cancer that often remains undetected in young adults due to the diverse society in South Africa, where cultural taboos, stigmas and a lack of knowledge about the subject is widespread.    Due to the household situation in South Africa one child will reach up to another 7 people at home with the information we provide at schools. We need US$ 1.10 to educate a child about the importance to detect cancer early.

title: Emergency Earthquake response: Turkey
description: The project aims to contribute to the DDD earthquake relief efforts in Hatay/Antakya, in order to ensure the continuity of health, psychosocial support, medication, protection, water and basic sanitation (WASH) services provided by 3 Medical mobile teams and through safe spaces in Hatay province.

title: Economic empowerment of women' farmers in Albania
description: Despite recent progress, Albanian women still have limited access to resources and opportunities.  The project goal is that: Women in rural areas in Central Albania to improve their socio-economic situation by engaging in economic activities. The project will support 6 women farmers to construct and operate greenhouses aiming to improve their economic situation as well as will train 20 women farmers in food processing to improve knowledge and skills on preservation, hygiene and quality standard.

title: Support 10K  growers for nutrition security in BGD
description: This project will reach to 5000 marginal farmers of Shyamnagar Upazilla of Satkhira district in Bangladesh through homestead vegetable cultivation. The project will contribute in household food security of nutrition vulnerable group of coastal communities of Bangladesh in South Asia.

title: support for 2,600 people  victims of malnutrition
description: Madagascar faces the phenomenon of undernutrition known locally as "Kere". According to media and United Nations sources, for the month of November 2022 to March 2023, 2,023,000 people are in the grip of famine, of which 1.97 million in crisis phase, 250,000 people are classified in a situation of alert and 72% of Madagascar South people on advanced famine.  The project contribute to strengthening the resilience of vulnerable 2.600 persons hit by famine in the regions of the South and South Est

title: Help 300 flood affected children in Namibia
description: The northern part of Namibia is prone to natural hazards- seasonal flooding that have caused major economic and human loss and left children and young women highly vulnerable to development, protection concerns and severe health problems

title: Bring Health and Wellness to Imagine Scholar!
description: This project will provide health and wellness resources to our community of over 200 students. We believe in the importance of investing in mental and physical health for holistic well-being, and we dedicate time in our weekly programming for activities like yoga, volleyball, mindfulness, gardening, and basketball! Help us buy resources to enhance these practices for our students!

title: Ensure food supplies help us build a Pantry
description: Victims of domestic abuse who are vulnerable, poor and reside in marginalized communities still cannot afford to provide food, shelter and basic utilities for themselves and their families. We provide a food bag every two weeks, however we do not have enough space to buy bulk and repackage. We are planning to build a pantry room to store all the goods necessary to help our community.   To date, we have supported from January 2023 to March 2023, 169 households totaling 726 persons.

title: Dormitorios dignos para 30 ninos de un Albergue
description: Este proyecto planea acondicionar y amueblar dormitorios  para 30 ninos resguardados en el albergue infantil de Irapuato, que han atravesado grandes adversidades dandoles la oportunidad de tener un espacio digno el cual ahora es su nuevo hogar.

title: Parents of LGBTQ Children - Therapy Support Groups
description: Parents of LGBTQ children are their first line of defense. Supporting parents by providing therapist-led education can help parents understand how to best support their LGBTQ child's mental health needs. Mama Dragons will provide bi-monthly therapist-led virtual support groups for parents whose LGBTQ children are struggling with depression, anxiety, self-harm, eating disorders, and suicidal ideation.  - This project will impact 384 parents and their 500 LGBTQ children annually.

title: Help 500 Smallholder Farmers in Sub-Saharan Africa
description: 70% of the world's poor are rural families who make their living through small-scale farming. One Acre Fund models a solution; through a complete bundle of services - last-mile delivery of farming supplies, training, post-harvest support, and financing - enabling farmers to build a permanent pathway to prosperity. The typical farmer in the areas where we work lives on less than $1 a day - your gift will help them increase their yearly profits by nearly half, allowing them to overcome hunger.

title: Provide Reusable Menstrual Kits to Girls in Uganda
description: Help distribute AFRIpads reusable menstrual kits to local women and girls in Kazo District, Uganda. Menstrual hygiene is essential for women and girls' reproductive health, as well as their economic and educational equality. Joy of Community Foundation is a 501(c)(3) working to incorporate menstrual kits as part of its healthcare center and school partnerships.

title: Basic education for children and illiterate
description: This project proposes to enhance the basic education of children and illiterate Adults in the five villages in Base ( District,) Basang,  villages and will serve approximately 1200 families in Tanje, and 900 families in Farafeni

title: Help strengthen mexican community foundations
description: In Mexico, we have a very low rate of citizen participation to solve community problems. Comunalia aims to involve the community in the identification and solution of local problems through the work of community foundations. This project will benefit 17 community foundations, their 650 allies, and more than 500,000 beneficiaries. Together with community foundations, we actively promote community philanthropy for long-term solutions.

title: Youth Changing Haiti One Tree At A Time
description: Haiti's population: approximately 11 million & youth (under 25) are more than 1/2 of the population. Haiti has one of the highest levels of food insecurity in the world. The World Food Program's Haiti stats: the number of food insecure Haitians has tripled since 2016,  22 % of children are chronically malnourished and 10 % underweight. This compromises their development & leads to lifelong health issues.  Generous donations can provide: 2,500 trees to 500 youth AND invaluable health education.

title: Support 550 Displaced Girl Children Back to School
description: This Initiative aims at raising support and awareness of the plight of the internally displaced girls in our community. This is to help 550 Girl children back to school by providing breakfast and lunch, non-tuition fees, books, pens, uniforms, shoes, and sanitary pads. 550 out-of-school girls in our community need to be back in school. Your support will help give them a leg up in life and strengthen our community's future. Also, it will help prevent forced marriage and absenteeism from school.

title: Support Free Media for a Democratic Dividend
description: In a world of multi-media platforms, a fragile unstable East Africa region has concentrated ownership of media channels in the rich elite power brokers. The dominant political and economic powers have disempowered the majority citizens. URN supports local voices of youth, women and the marginalized rural poor to have their voices on community radio and online, cutting through misinformation and disinformation to raise civic awareness, demand participation and responsiveness from the state.

title: Access to Primary Healthcare in Kabul, Afghanistan
description: Action for Development (AfD) plans to establish a hybrid-financed primary health care facility in Kabul, Afghanistan, to ensure affordable quality services to a population of 50,000.   This project enables the establishment of a facility (Phase 1)  that can then be sustained in the long-term (Phase 2) by user-fees and a small annual donation of USD $7,500.

title: Countdown Begins-Street Child Cricket World Cup
description: Help us to raise funds for the upcoming street children cricket world cup , scheduled for September 2023 in Chennai India- organized by Street Child United. Salaam Baalak Trust is one of the 21 teams participating-  we have a mixed team of 8 boys and girls. To participate our children along with coach and staff need to travel from Delhi to Chennai which involves food, accommodation and transportation cost.Our Children are weaving a dream to win. WE NEED YOUR SUPPORT TO MAKE THIS DREAM COME TRUE!

title: Prevention of Teenage Pregnancy and Child Marriage
description: In Liberia, teen rights have been undermined due to cultural and traditional prevalence. Teens are made to believe especially in the remote areas of the country that they are meant to be at the service of men in the name of marriage, and unplanned childbearing. Their physical, emotional, and social development are also horrible and some suffer death during childbirth. We provide sex education, promote gender equality, and emphasize the importance of delaying marriage and childbirth in Liberia.

title: Clean Water for 2,500 Women & Children in Uganda
description: This project will build a clean water source in remote village in NE Uganda.  2,500 in Nakisilet Village are in dire need of a clean water borehole and the hope and health that it can bring.

title: Help break the cycle of violence and poverty
description: Studies show that poverty and violence stifle children's natural curiosity. R3Cre0 is a program designed to stimulate the curiosity, creativity and critical thinking skills of approximately 20 children in the Barbacoas neighborhood in Medellin which will help them in their daily lives, in their academic careers and will help them to break out of the cycles of poverty, criminality and violence.

title: Train Montessori HS teacher in Eswatini
description: What happens to children who don't fit the education mold in a third world nation? This project will train a Montessori HS teacher for the only high school that is focused on serving children who do not fit the IGCSE curriculum.  The Montessori school is located in Eswatini (Swaziland) and attracts families from throughout Eswatini as well as outside Eswatini.

title: AfterSchool Tutoring for PACOs Children Home
description: The children's home provides comprehensive care to an average of 43 children and adolescents per year. Each one of them attends a formal educational institution in Mexico, however, after school activities are necessary that allow them to reinforce what they have learned in class, do their homework and continue developing skills to become the leaders of the future. For this we have a team of educators who strive every day to provide the support and affection that children need.

title: Ramp up for an Inclusive Life
description: The main aim of the project is to make the learning environments safe, accessible and inclusive for children with disabilities. Our organisation and partners have been advocating and working in the field of disability and inclusion for many years, with projects that focus on practical ways to see inclusion of children with disabilities in all aspects of life including in education. This project is a part of wanting to see the UN CRPD, SDG and National Development Strategy realised in Tajikistan

title: Emergency Vehicle for Rescue
description: Haiti, although bountiful in natural beauty, the majority of people in the country face extreme poverty and famine. Through years of natural disasters and political unrest, generations of warm-hearted Haitians have been negatively affected and their livelihoods devastated. 78% of families live on less than $2/day, forcing parents/guardians to send their children away to be cared for or work. Unbeknownst to them, the children are being abused and exploited.

title: Our cup is overflowing, help us help more students
description: After 13 years running Tea Leaf education centres in Sri Lankan tea estates communities, we know just how essential education is in empowering young people from these communities to expand their career prospects, realise their potential and help lift their families out of extreme poverty. Our Tea Leaf Centres which provide free professional development and vocational training for young people (18 - 26 yrs old) are life changing for them and their families.

title: Feed the Child and Starve the Cancer
description: To provide nutritional assistance to children with Cancer who are from poor to extremely poor families. Most of these families cannot afford a protein-rich diet for their children. Fresh and dry fruits along with nuts in the diet of a child fighting cancer can make a huge difference.  (16% between the first and the last visit of the child to the hospital). While in the city for treatment an earning member of the family becomes a full-time attendee for the patient. We provide meals for them too.

title: Support Early Learning for Children in El Salvador
description: This project will support our early childhood learning program at Amun Shea school by providing school supplies, age-appropriate learning tools, developmental toys, and teacher/aide funding. Children living in poverty deserve a high-quality education; this project will help make this happen.

title: 2023 Midwest and South US Tornado Relief Fund
description: An outbreak of tornadoes tore through states in the midwest and southern United States on March 31, taking lives and causing damage, including in Arkansas, Alabama, Illinois, Iowa, Indiana and Mississippi. Your donation to the 2023 Midwest and South US Tornado Relief Fund will meet emergency needs and help survivors recover.

title: Educate 850 Mainly Muslim Girls out of Poverty
description: Girls in the Old City of Hyderabad, India, face challenges in getting a proper education which would help them break out of poverty.   The MJM school, which serves them, was once a top tier school but has fallen on hard times as its funding, infrastructure and teaching quality have declined. Enrollment which at its peak was 2500 has fallen to 450. Girls have to walk 4-6 kms to a government school  The project would modernize curriculum, improve teaching and take girls to financial independence.

title: Kung Fu for girls at risk to human trafficking
description: This project will support Kung Fu and Karate classes for 50 children in the red-light area of Forbesganj in Bihar, India. These martial arts classes will help the girls and boys to fight off human traffickers and empower them to take control of their bodies. The children live in an area where human traffickers and criminals are always on the lookout for vulnerable kids to prey upon.

title: Sight for 5,000 Poor Blind Children in Bangladesh
description: This project will give the gift of SIGHT to 5000 poor blind children in Bangladesh who suffer from curable blindness due to Cataract. The only issue is they can either not access or afford the treatment and turn needlessly blind. Blindness is in itself a stark reality but childhood blindness is worse as the number of years ahead are much more.The good news is that their vision can be restored by donating only $82 to DDEF-the largest free eye trust with 1 hospitals and 2 Eye clinics in Bangladesh

title: Educate, protect and nurture 500 young Ugandans
description: This project will increase the life chances of five hundred young Ugandans by improving education, health care, safeguarding and vocational opportunities in four impoverished communities.

title: "1-Help 500 USA Students Excel in STEAM"
description: We aim to resolve the Educational and Excellence Gap in Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Math (STEAM) for marginalized underserved children ages 5 to 18 years old. Inequity in education is pervasive globally. The students we serve are from Africa, the Caribbean and the USA. We help students who are struggling in school to improve their grades through our Cancer Smancer Reimagined - Living Your Best Sustainable Life program. Longterm they are steered toward careers in STEAM.

title: Let's help lonely elderly living in Hungary
description: As hard as it is to accept, we all grow old!  Hungary is also one of the aging societies. The number of elderly people living alone and isolated is increasing.    The Friends of the Elderly Program of the Voluntary Center Foundation aimed to reduce the number by organising more volunteers who visit the seniors, who help in their daily problems, trying to eliminate their loneliness and solitude.  With your help we can increase the elderly/volunteer groups in Budapest from 5 to 15 this year!

title: July Bonus Day 2023! Educate Girls in Morocco!
description: Education is a basic right, yet girls from the High Atlas in Morocco cannot access school due to the distance from their villages and lack of transport. This has led to generations of girls trapped in poverty, early marriage, and a destiny that doesn't reflect their potential. The good news is Education For All Morocco is changing this by building and staffing boarding houses close to the schools. Join us in sponsoring girls through their education! Educate a girl, and you educate a nation!

title: Send a Child in Bangladesh to School for a Year
description: DDEF focus is to provide access to quality education to the children in disadvantaged Costal and tribal areas through highly effective education interventions. Children are enabled to continue their education, having become confident, independent learners. DDEF approach includes mainstreaming children through bridge schools and strengthening government schools therefore, increasing their chances of retention.

title: "2-Help 500 African/Carib'n Students XL in STEAM"
description: Your donation will support Inner-city students from Africa, the Caribbean, and the USA to go from average or struggling with their grades to honor roll through our Award Winning enrichment programs. We aim to resolve the Educational and Excellence Gap in Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Math (STEAM) for marginalized under-served children ages 5 to 18 years old. Long-term they are steered toward careers in STEAM.   Imagine the impact your donation would have on their future!

title: Build a skill center for young moms in Uganda!
description: A changed mom changes her family and community: Hoffnung fuer Uganda is building a vocational training center for moms in a rural community in Uganda. Why? Because young Ugandan people lack education/jobs, especially teen moms. We train skills like sewing, soap making and sustainable agriculture, so that moms can support their own families. So far we have 1 building, but need to add classrooms. 40 women were empowered so far. With your help, we can add 20 more/year and transform the whole area!

title: Home of Hope:  Safeguarding Our Inclusive Center
description: In our quest to make the world more inclusive, empathetic, and equitable, we've taken on an endeavor - securing the future of our Learning Center, a sanctuary for children and orphans with disabilities. We are in a race against time to purchase the property that has been our home and a beacon of hope for the community, thereby securing it for future generations. With no special education in Rural Romania, we are committed to assisting kids with disabilities in receiving educational assistance.

title: Empower and Educate DDEF girls in rural Bangladesh
description: DDEF works with girls to transcend poverty, HIV/AIDS, disabilities issues and gender-based violence. We do this by creating environments that produce exceptional young women who drive change in their communities. We build self-esteem, provide access to health education and knowledge, and produce academic high achievers. This project will provide education, food, housing, clothing, psychosocial support, access to university-quality labs, computers, and hands-on learning opportunities to 240 girl.

title: Feed Muslim Orphans
description: This project will support daily feeding of 100 Muslim orphans in this time of extreme hunger and poverty in Nigeria from the conflict affected areas. The project beneficiaries are mainly less-privileged, orphans and Persons with disability that faces hardship in getting food to eat.

title: Education for 270 orphaned girls in Namibia
description: This project help 270 orphaned girls attend school and not deterred from full participation through lack of financial means, material or psycho-social need, stigma, discrimination or any other constraints. Moreover, the out of school orphans and vulnerable girls are encouraged to return to schools or provided with appropriate educational opportunities.

title: High Density Water Pipe Rolls Project
description: The project targets to provide 18 rolls of high density black plastic water pipe rolls to Nkoansiyo village which do not have access to water where villagers will dig trenches about 2.5 kilometers from nearest water source and lay down the water rolls which will aid to bring water closer to their home hence reducing long walking searching for water, reduce water born disease problems and encourage more number of children to attend school.

title: The Boring Project
description: We are dedicated to bringing a sustainable source of safely managed water to those in need.   The primary focus of our work is centred on offering families the ability to own their own borehole, which creates not only dignity but long-term  sustainability and self-sufficiency.  Our on-plot pumps provide readily accessible water for drinking, cooking, washing, cleaning, etc. and it means no longer having to rely on contaminated open community wells which are often located far from the home.

title: Forest restoration in northern Mexico
description: This project will contribute to the environmental restoration of two micro-watersheds in the indigenous Raramuri communities of the Sierra Tarahumara in northern Mexico. Achieving through the reforestation of 20,000 pines. It will conduct workshops on hygiene and sanitation, 1 community water diagnosis, and provide training for the construction of 4 communal dry toilets. These efforts will increase forest coverage and improve water quality for 4 springs enhancing the conditions of 60 families.

title: Open women-owned small businesses in Ghana
description: We plan to construct and open women-owned small businesses in our partner villages in rural Ghana this year. Each business will provide income for the owner, as well as an opportunity for two other young women to begin vocational training. By expanding local economic opportunities these businesses inspire young people to pursue educations, support gender equality, and reduce risky migrations to urban centers.

title: Unbroken Kids
description: UNBROKEN KIDS Center is a unique place where children affected by war will receive comprehensive, qualified medical treatment including reconstructive surgery, orthopedics and custom robotic prosthetics. Its purpose is to treat, rehabilitate and support the children of Ukraine by providing excellent medical care and psychological support for healing war trauma.

title: Give Prizes & Promote Learning for School Children
description: This project will support primary school children in Anambra State, with gifts such as stationeries, school bags, money etc, after their exams in order to encourage and motivate the best performing pupils. It is said that children of today are the leaders of tomorrow and as such, we must bring them up properly with the right skills, attitude and mindset to prepare them for future challenges. Your donation will help to create a healthy competition among the pupils, making them to read/learn more.

title: 773 Dance Project Free Class Series
description: 773 Dance Project's mission is to provide professional-level dance classes, workshops, and performances to Chicago communities on the South and West sides. Access to arts includes those who participate and those who facilitate. This Project will allow us to offer a summer series of 4 dancing in the park classes for free and still be able to pay our teachers a competitive wage.

title: Empowering Young Women Through Sports in Nablus
description: Soccer is more than a sport - it can improve mental and physical health and provide a sense of belonging. However, in Nablus, Palestine, teenage girls face limited access to sports activities, impacting their physical and mental well-being. TYO launched a soccer league for girls to develop their mobility, stress management, communication, and teamwork skills in a safe and supportive environment. The program provides a much-needed opportunity for girls to improve their overall well-being.

title: Life changing opportunities through soccer
description: The Cazuca Futbol Club (CFC) is a high-performance soccer team born in the heart of Altos de Cazuca, one of the most vulnerable areas around Bogota. It provides young people with the opportunity to build their life projects through soccer and become professionals, so that they can stay away from risky environments such as illegality, gangs, and drug use. Currently, the CFC brings together more than 100 players who dream of reaching the big teams and having entire stadiums shout their names.

title: Social care services for the homeless in Cape Town
