description: The Hope Exchange (THE) is a 41-year-old NPO in the heart of Cape Town that helps the homeless and people at risk of becoming so. Hope starts with dignity and THE allows the homeless to be respected for who they are, to be acknowledged and not dismissed. We provide our clients with the opportunity to shower, wash their clothes, get clinic care, attend vocational training and receive social support. Additionally, THE has a second-phase shelter for 40 men who are on the path to reintegration.

title: Delivering food to Colombia's neediest communities
description: Imagine living in a remote community without access to resources to maintain proper nutrition and struggling every day to get food and survive. Sadly, this is a reality for many families around the world.  At PAN, our mission is to improve the quality of life of these people by providing more than 5,000 nutritional packages every month to children and families living in remote communities. Our purpose is to ensure that every person has the right to access food.

title: Cianjur Post-Earthquake Relief Program
description: November 2022 - a magnitude 5.6 earthquake devastated Cianjur, Indonesia. At least 602 deceased and tens of thousands injured, while hundreds of thousands displaced. It has been more than five months but their lives have still not recovered. The majority of them lost their source of income. Children are missing school. ASAR Humanity is working with stakeholder pushing through post-disaster programs. Building shelters, WASH facilities, temporary schools, and providing people empowerment programs.

title: Safer floors to play on
description: Habitat para la Humanidad Argentina is part of the initiative "100,000 floors to play on", developed jointly by Humanity and the Inter-American Cement Federation (FICEM). We want to contribute to the health of Argentinian children and families who do not have an adequate floor in their homes. Help us create healthier spaces for kids; help us build safer floors to play on!

title: Murle War Affected Family Relief In Gambella
description: The Nuer Development Association has planned to provide educational support to children who have been left orphans, traumatized and also to constructs residential homes to disabled persons from murle milita war in Gambella.

title: Alzheimer's onlive
description: Alzheimers is the other pandemic with more than 1,8 million families affected in Mexico. Alzheimer's has no cure yet, but drug-free therapy is available that slows down dementia's progress so that persons with dementia and their families will have more quality of life. This is proven by semestral screening. Help Centro Mexicano Alzheimer, pioneer in offering non-drug therapy online in real time (onlive) and National Health Award 2022, to reach all Mexican states and Spanish speaking communities

title: SEA TURTLE CONSERVATION RESEARCH CENTER
description: This project will build a facility for research, an educational center, a hatchery and a watcher's quarters that will contribute to the protection and conservation of Hawksbill and Green Sea Turtle Species threatened to extinction.

title: UKRAINE MENTAL HEALTH RELIEF FUND
description: As of February 24, 2022, Ukraine is facing one of the biggest emergencies in Europe since World War II. Currently, more than 14.6 million people are seeking psychological assistance, due to stress and anxiety caused by the recent war in Ukraine. Thanks to the extensive experience of Cooperas staff in mental health and psychosocial support in emergency situations, we plan to train 30 Ukrainian psychologists to provide treatment to over 72.000

title: Empowering women in the construction sector
description: The Construction sector is one of the sectors that generates the most jobs in Colombia, and is characterized by the majority of male participation. This is a gender inclusion project, which begins to break paradigms in the sector, seeks to highlight and exalt the capacities and qualities that women have in construction. seeks to generate employability to reduce circles of poverty and violence, generating economic autonomy transforming their lives.

title: The FIGS Club - Educating Tomorrow's Scientists
description: The Future Indigenous Guardians of Science (FIGS) Club is an afterschool science and environmental education program for the youth of Wanang Conservation Area (WCA). 20 years ago WCA turned to conservation after rejecting loggers. Since then research at WCA has brought sustainable development for the whole village. Each year the FIGS Club will lay the foundations for 30 Wanang youth to pursue careers as local research assistants and conservationists bringing personal and community development.

title: Give 550 Moroccan street animals food & shelter
description: This project aims to provide shelter, food and medical care to 550 animals in Southwestern Morocco that are unable to survive on the streets due to being a victim to road accidents, abuse, abandonment or severe illnesses and injuries.

title: End Period Poverty in Rural Schools in Malawi
description: Period poverty means lack of funds to buy basic personal hygiene items: sanitary  pads, soap, underwear, no access to toilets and running water, and no basic knowledge about menstruation. In Malawi many young girls experience period poverty, therefore they don't go to school during menstruation, which causes dropping out of school and, consequently, the end of education. YORGHAS Foundation aims to help 500 school age girls gain access to menstrual supplies and knowledge on menstrual hygiene.

title: New Dawn relief
description: The project goal is to enable survival and self-sufficiency of displaced people due to the conflict in Myanmar. This is achieved through the provision of humanitarian relief in the following areas:      - Shelter and non-food items    - Food, health & hygiene items    - Medical support    - Livelihood grants  - Education support

title: Educate and Feed 50 Poor Children in India
description: The Truevine Umeed Project will facilitate primary education and a feeding program for 50 destitute children in a slum colony situated on the Sangrur - Sunam road in Sangrur, Punjab State. The Project builds on work started in 2022 by Mrs Sonia Pankaj, a qualified teacher who feeds and teaches about 25-30 children in a makeshift classroom made of polythene sheets. Funds donated will increase the capacity to serve 50 poor children in properly equipped classrooms and provide food for the children.

title: Hidden Girls
description: Hidden Girls is a project that we have created especially for girls that are victim of physical and/or sexual violence.We focus on girls that live in safe houses, these shelters are based on secret locations.Our female coaches offer a trauma relief movement program in the form of weekly dance and sports trainings sessions.We developed this program in collaboration with trauma specialists to have more impact on the trauma relief.

title: Water4Life: Hand Pump for Drinking water in Nepal
description: This is an undeniable fact that water is life, 60% of human bodies are water. Therefore, it is important to ensure that our water must be clean and safe to drink. Nepal has faced many crises in the short period of time. However, one of Nepal's most pressing crises is the problem of access to clean water. The Importance of water in Islam: It was narrated that Sa'ad bin Ubadah Said: "I said: O messenger of Allah, what kinds of charity is best?' He said: 'providing drinking water.'" R:an-nasai 3664

title: Help 50 Nigerian Schools Combat Child Abuse
description: This project aims to provide teachers, students, and community members in North-Central Nigeria with the necessary knowledge and tools to prevent and address child abuse. With your support, we can grow a child protection network across the region. This network is crucial for identifying and addressing instances of abuse and neglect, and it also ensures that affected children and families receive the necessary after-care support. In this phase of the project, we plan to assist 50 schools.

title: Bring Palliative Care to Lebanese Cancer Patients
description: This project is the first HBPC program in North Lebanon. It provides holistic home-based hospice care to chronically ill patients in the absence of medical coverage to ill patients. Sanabel has a trained medical team in palliative care that allows them to provide a wide range of medical services including medication expense coverage, equipment for promoting quality of life, psychological support, including services aiming to preserve patient's dignity in their own home surrounded by loved ones.

title: Nepal - Save 1 million lives
description: We offer organ donation and transplantation training for 1 healthcare professional and 2 weeks internship in a Spanish reference centre. This training will allow a team of professionals to learn more about this topic and start implementing it in Nepal. This will improve Nepal's quality of life.

title: Sri Lanka - Save 1 million lives
description: We offer organ donation and transplantation training for 1 healthcare professional and 2 weeks internship in a Spanish reference centre. This training will allow a team of professionals to learn more about this topic and start implementing it in Sri Lanka. This will improve Sri Lanka's quality of life.

title: Happy Summer for Children of Syunik and Artsakh
description: This project will provide a 7-day Summer Camp for 50 children affected by conflict in close-to-border areas in the shores of Lake Sevan in Armenia. The project will improve the social-emotional wellbeing of children through Mental Health and Psychosocial support activities (art therapy, yoga, swimming, team-building games, etc), empower them with life skills and give them tools to improve their communities. Upon return children will implement mini-projects in their villages.

title: Healing with Art and Music: Nablus' Refugee Youth
description: Our arts and music program will offer theater, music, and dance classes for Palestinian refugee children in Nablus provides a safe and supportive environment for them to channel their negative energy and emotions into something positive while discovering and developing their artistic skills. With limited access to education and resources, these children face unique challenges, but through our program, they can express themselves and build their self-confidence.

title: Education Scholarship for 100 Female Students
description: Nigeria like many countries in the world deals with its own refugee crises. The bane of bandits attacks that led to widespread displacement of people in the North Western part of the country. Homes and whole communities have been destroyed, and survivors lost access to educational right of their children. This project will therefore support 100 less privileged female students affected by conflict and lost access to education from Primary to Tertiary level in Nigeria.

title: Recovery Camp for Children Affected by War
description: The Sincere Heart Foundation's Recovery Camp, in partnership with TEEI, provides rehabilitation camps for children who have suffered profound psychological trauma from  Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine. The devastating impact of war can leave a lasting imprint on young minds, causing anxiety, depression, and other mental health issues that may rob them of their childhood joy. Our camp provides a safe and supportive environment where these children can find solace and healing.

title: STEM Education for 25 Women Youth in South Africa
description: This project will provide Technical Information Technology training to educate and empower 25 young women from South African townships and informal settlements. They will graduate as Professional Computer Support Technicians and System Engineers with skills to service and repair computers, printers, mobile phones and other hand-held devices. By providing technical skills, the project will open doors to both employment or self-employment opportunities for young women in a field dominated by men.

title: Empower girls like Priti in Slums in Pune, India.
description: 13-year-old Priti lives in Vishrantwadi, a slum of corrugated iron huts in the suburbs of Pune. This project helps 1,100 girls like Priti take control of their lives each year. Without access to tools, girls can't escape the cycle of poverty illiteracy, child-labour, child-marriage and illness. This project provides girls with the resources needed to challenge traditional views and stereotypes about gender roles and reclaim their independence.

title: Home Sweet Home Project/YUVA
description: After a devastating earthquake, according to WHO, the affected regions in Turkey and Syria are home to around 23 million people including 1.4 million children. Shelter has been critical area of intervention those who has lost their houses and businesses. With this project, we try to solve shelter problem with sustainable YUVA Project.  YUVA will be a solution shelter problem for families and also support local manufactures in the region.

title: Support Our Amazon Youth Project
description: Our Amazon Youth Project works in remote communities of the Peruvian Amazon. We run capacity-building and personal development workshops for 400 young people aged 15-18 years old. We are also training 30 educators on topics of sexual and reproductive health, cultural identity and vocational skills, while providing higher education scholarships and a Youth Hub for 11 students. Our goal is to empower resilient young people who will contribute to a sustainable future for the Amazon region.

title: Heal & Ascend: Pathway to Mental Health Resilience
description: TEWWY's annual mental health promotion and suicide awareness campaign aims to bridge treatment gaps. Through expert-led workshops and educational sessions, we will emphasize the vital connection between mental health and physical exercise, nutrition, building community, and connecting with nature. Additionally, a Mount Kilimanjaro charity climb will raise suicide awareness. And a virtual campaign will engage people in fitness challenges, fostering personal growth and making a meaningful impact.

title: Feed the Animals in Disaster Area
description: After the devastating earthquake that occurred in Turkey, we have been working tirelessly to support life since the first day. As Support to Life in the earthquake zone, we have focused on supporting small-scale livestock farmers. Our goal is to help them maintain their livelihoods by meeting the feed. This project goal is to meet the feed needs of small-scale livestock farmers who have not received support and to connect them with buyers, especially those living in remote villages.

title: Send a child to school in Honduras for one year
description: For orphaned and vulnerable children in Honduras, attending school is often an unattainable dream. Support disadvantaged children in receiving an education, a key component to lifting them out of poverty and into a thriving, sustainable life - both for themselves and for generations to come. Your gift contributes to school tuition for one year at our bilingual, private, Christian school, including book fees, meals, school materials, computer access, extra curricular activities and more.

title: Ensuring Education for Poor Philippines Children
description: When Typhoon MEGI swept the Philippines in 2010, the city's poor region, Bagong-Silangan, was devastated. Parents who make a living by picking up trash don't want their children to live the same life. To help solve this, we opened a daycare center in 2012 with the youth here. However, everything is old, and parents can't afford to pay for expensive textbooks. This is the only daycare center in the village with cracked walls. Help children study in a safe environment and dream about the future!

title: Forest restoration and food production
description: This project will provide fruits trees to the 3000 farmers in the community of lushoto for the improvements of agriculture activities due to the presence of huge poverty and hunger also the project will establish 3000 organic food gardens to the 3000 woman's who are widows and adults in the 30 villages to increase the economic opportunities and nutrition to their families.The project will produce and supplies 20000 fruits trees to the community including 3000 farmers.

title: Nurturing Learning Communities in a Time of Crisis
description: Our era in human history is unprecedented in the range of beautiful possibilities available to us AND in the scale of destruction already present and on its way due to the climate emergency and related crises. All of us are called upon to orient ourselves thoughtfully in this rapidly changing world. This project supports the growth of learning communities that can nurture young Asian leaders who are already bringing about change locally and beyond. It will address a variety of needs to do this.

title: Nutrition for 1000 Malnourished children in Nig
description: The conflict in Northeast Nigerian has caused widespread displacement,destruction of infrastructure and the collapse of economic and basic services. 8.3 Million People are in Need of Humanitarian Assistance among which 58% are children. The prevalence of acute malnutrition among children under 5 in Borno increased from 11.8 per cent in 2021 to 12.3 per cent  in 2022.  The project seek to treat 1000 malnourished children to prevent mortality among Children in Conflict affected region in Borno.

title: Reconstruction of Women's Cooperatives
description: After the devastating earthquake that occurred in Turkey on February 6th, we have been working tirelessly to support life since the first day. As Hayata Destek in the earthquake zone, we have focused on supporting 'Reconstruction of Women's Cooperatives'. Our goal is to increase employment in the region by quickly restoring women's cooperatives to production.

title: Sudan Emergency Fund
description: Sudan is on the brink of civil war, as a violent clash for power threatens the lives of people in the country. Hundreds of Sudanese have been killed and many more injured in fighting that erupted in April 2023. People are fleeing the capital Khartoum and conflict-plagued Darfur region due to violence and limited access to food, water, and healthcare. Your donation to the Sudan Emergency Fund will provide emergency relief, food, water, medicine, and other essential supplies to people in need.

title: Supports trans volleyball players amidst discrimin
description: Support the transgender women's volleyball team and contribute to the fight for human rights and the visibility of transgender people in sports. Your donation will allow them to compete for the first time as a Mexican national team, feeling supported and empowered. This will help to make transgender people visible in sport and raise awareness about their challenges, equality in sport and the lives of transgender people in the midst of prohibition.

title: Thrive Philippines: School Meals Change Lives
description: Many children in the Philippines suffer from poor diet and inadequate nutrition often leading to undernourishment and negatively impacting mental and physical development. However, with proper nutrition cognitive development is improved and children are more likely to stay in school longer, giving them a chance at a better life (World Bank 2021).   At Thrive our aim is to provide the brain fuel children need to start their day and reach their full potential one healthy meal at a time.

title: Nepal Food, Health and Nutrition Project
description: Following our highly successful food, health and nutrition initiative in Nepal during the earthquake of 2015 and with overwhelming request from local leaders and organizations we are launching a similar project focusing on the same thematic areas with the main aim of improving the lives of poor villagers. We will target 1,000 poor households in the provision of food and farming inputs, technical knowledge and nutrition improvement capabilities.

title: 20000 Solar Lights to 20000 Households by June-23
description: Pollinate Group works at the intersection of multiple SDGs to address energy poverty by improving access to clean energy products for marginalised communities in India and Nepal. We are dedicated to ensuring that communities living in extreme poverty can access solar products that will enhance their health and the health of the environment and save them money. This Year we are raising support to bring light to 20000 households in India.

title: Purchase of milk for families/people in need
description: In 2022 FESBAL and its 54 associated Food Banks received and distributed 17 million kilos of milk, which, for several reasons, are not available this year. But they are very necessary. Additionally, milk price has increased more than 30% this year due the inflation, ukranian crisis, etc, so the Food Banks can buy less milk with the same amount of donations. Also the donations have decreased due to the overall crisis, so in short there is no milk in the FB and its purchase its more expensive.

title: The 50km walk challenge : Help refugees in Lesvos
description: 7 members of our community have set themselves the challenge of walking 50 km on the 29th of of April to raise money for the refugees of Yoga and Sports with Refugees in Lesvos, an NGO helping with physical and mental health of refugees through sport. Lesvos is a Greek island known for being a major arrival point for refugees. Yoga and Sport with Refugees addresses a crucial need for support, structure and community for people during the asylum process.

title: Feed 150 vulnerable childrens from Belo Horizonte
description: The Centro de Acolhida Betania (CAB) welcomes children and adolescents with difficult backgrounds coming from the suburbs of Belo Horizonte, Brazil. We support these kids by offering them a place where they can learn, play and just be kids, as well as offering free psychological support to those in need. Many of the kids come from uncertain backgrounds and, therefore, a main mission of ours is to ensure that each kid at the CAB is offered two proper meals a day.

title: Field sports access for 3500 refugees in Greece
description: In order for displaced people in our locations to be able to join our free field sport activities, we run our Field Sport Campaign and try to secure the funding needed for the field rent for one year! We want to take this opportunity to highlight the importance that sport, specifically team sport, has for those living in uncertainty and poor conditions. In particular, sport builds resilience and improves mental and physical wellbeing.

title: A life changing USA tour for OSCAR children.
description: Creating travel opportunities, inspiring & motivating OSCAR girls & boys is at the core of OSCAR's work & we are delighted to announce the first OSCAR USA Tour. Aanya Shah, of The Pingry School has been organising the tour, navigating huge challenges, passports, visas. Owning a passport, travelling in a plane, making friends with kids from vastly different background is a dream come true for not only the child, but their family & wider community. We're very excited for this inaugural US Tour.

title: Restore hope to sexual abuse survivors in Zambia
description: This project will provide healing, justice and restored hope for survivors of church sexual (and other types of) abuse through providing paralegal services in criminal cases of sexual offences; sharing resources on trauma-informed care best practices to families of survivors; training law enforcement on trauma informed approaches in dealing with survivors of sexual abuse; and training communities on safeguarding and mental health support of survivors.

title: Help Us Fight Breast Cancer Deaths in Nigeria
description: In Nigeria, 1 in 2 women living with breast cancer dies from it due to late diagnosis and limited healthcare access. Women present extremely late to the hospital as a result of lack of funds and awareness. To prevent these avoidable deaths, this project will provide healthcare access to 450 underprivileged women from screening, to timely diagnosis and quality treatments. Your donation will help us to change these current narratives so breast cancer will no longer be a death sentence in Nigeria.

title: Empower young women through STEAM careers
description: Red MenTe is a community of +1000 women of 15 and 30y/o who have graduated from at least one of our programs.Through your participation you can collaborate to reduce the gender gap that exists in STEAM careers by allowing them to experience and consider technology as part of their professional development.Red MenTe allows them to have access to talks with professional women in STEAM, access courses that allow them to level their knowledge of technological tools and opt for certifications

title: 2000 meals for people in need in Vietnam
description: 2,000 meals will be serve to people in need as street vendors, motocycle taxi drivers, patients, children in shelters,....through Peace & Happiness Shops of LCF in Central Vietnam to help them have full and enough energy meal. For each meal, the symbolic price is 1,000 VND - 2,000 VND. We hope that with each meal, peo pel in need can save a little more money for other more urgent living expenses; children will have nutrition meals.

title: Research, Remember, Recognise their history
description: The Kresy-Siberia Virtual Museum is dedicated to research, remember and recognize Poland's citizens' fight for freedom and survival in eastern Poland and in forced exile during World War II. We need to make  a major upgrade to the Virtual Museum to make it up to date, reliable and secure. Though this will require serious funding, it is a small investment to ensure the ongoing operation of the Virtual Museum and the invaluable stories of wartime survival that it will preserve for years to come.

title: Give Zambians the health they deserve
description: With this project, we seek to help "Sichili Mission Hospital" improve the health services they provide to a population of around 40,000 people who live in extreme poverty. We send volunteer medical doctors to triplicate the capacity of the hospital, saving lives. Giving them better health care, dental care and tools to improve their nutritional knowledge, will prevent future diseases and, in the long term, will allow the community to be self-sufficient in the way of managing their health system.

title: Emergency Fund to Ugandan Transgender youth.
description: The project is based in western uganda and our aim is to establish a long term shelter , nutritional support , hygienic supplies and utilities  for rural transgender youth and gender diverse youth in western Uganda  during these difficult times as the Anti homosexuality bill 2023 is forcing landlords who have been tolerating transgender and gender diverse  persons  to evict them from their premises for fear of getting arrested if the bill becomes becomes law.

title: Freddy Emergency aid for 159 families in Africa
description: The district of Machanga, Sofala province, Mozambique, was affected by flooding resulting from Cyclone Freddy between February and March 2023. The floods affected 10,269 families (over 50,000 people). ESMABAMA hosted 159 of the families. More than 15.000 ha of crops and 25,500 ha of pasture were destroyed. Many animals belonging to the families are at risk of survival. Some Infrastructures and 77 boreholes have also been damaged (making the water unfit for consumption).

title: Let's Educate and Empower - Children/Teens Autism
description: To provide access to outstanding diagnostic and specialized education for children and adolescents with autism. When a child develops the skills to become more independent and autonomous, his family dynamics get better; The professionals that serve them -and their families- benefit from the opportunity to work and thrive. As a result, the well-being of all parties involved improves.

title: Build a school for 216 underprivileged children
description: This project is building a basic school for children strongly affected by poverty in the fishing community Kokrobite, Ghana. Aside from free of cost and high quality education it daily provides a healthy freshly cooked meal and offers creative activities. The new school building will contain 9 classrooms, an IT-Lab, a library, a kitchen, a dining hall, inclusive washrooms, an office space, a school garden and playground.  216 students and their parents from 5 communities are the beneficiaries.

title: Sport changing young people's lives in Pakistan
description: Youth Sport Trust International is a sport for development charity passionate about the power of sport to improve young people's life chances. We are seeking funding to upskill practitioners in 500+ schools in Karachi, Pakistan and increase sporting opportunities for children.

title: Empowering Ugandan youth  through Arts Education
description: EarlyBird256 is dedicated to improving the health and wellness of young girls in Uganda - equipping them with the knowledge and resources they need to become strong women. We do this by securing scholarships for students, as well creating our own programs that provide free breakfast, tutoring, and creative arts. We want students to have a safe space to freely express themselves, heal and learn how to love and care for themselves and their communities.

title: Help Colombian women become social entrepreneurs!
description: Todos Podemos seeks to help 25 women living in low-income neighborhoods of Medellin, Colombia follow their dream of starting a business. With your support, they will get 4 months of training and 6 months of mentoring. This will allow them to develop the necessary skills to build and sustain their own small businesses, while fulfilling their communities' needs. As a sponsor for one of these women, you will also be able to interact with them and become a source of motivation and knowledge!

title: EMERGENCY APPEAL TO HELP CHILDREN IN DARFUR
description: Kids for Kids is appealing for emergency funding to help families without any food, water and basic supplies in Darfur, Sudan. Kids for Kids is the only organization, working from the regional capital  El Fasher helping children in remote villages.  Emergency funding is essential to help provide for thousands of families in desperate need of food, water, shelter and medical care.  Our team is not evacuating.  We are staying in Darfur & our established network will get help to those in need.

title: Transgender Community need to be mainstreamed
description: Transgender is not socially accepted by our society but termed as socal stigma. They have no civic rights to live their life meanwhile Human Rights Declaration has given same fundamental rights as to others to live independently. Due imbalance of society this segment of society is left behind in all walks of life and are most vulnerable human there is dire need to be mainstreamed through long untiring efforts, solid sustainable plans to bring their life normal as others.

title: Free uniforms to keep 10,000 students in school
description: This project ensures Educational advancement among rural girls and boys through provision of full school uniforms including shoes, underwear and menstrual hygiene supplies in Western Kenya. Our target for  this year is to provide school uniforms to 10,000 students from 30 secondary and junior high schools to increase school enrollment and student retention. The beneficiaries are disadvantaged rural boys and girls and orphans/vulnerable children from different schools within the community.

title: Empower young women in Nepal to be leader in tech
description: Women Leaders in Technology (WLiT) firmly believes that women can and should hold leadership positions in computer technology. We offer a nine-month fellowship program for university-level IT students identifying as women. Every year, 15 participants get selected through an open call to join this multifaceted career development program focusing on technology, leadership, and community in Kathmandu. With your support, we can add cohort of 15 participants in the city of Pokhara.

title: Help Migrant Children Travel to School!
description: Migrant children in Thailand face many barriers to education. One of these barriers that the children are facing right now is no transport to their classes. This is due to the high cost of transportation for parents and guardians. It might seem to be a small issue, however one that seriously affects their access to education.   We need your help to fund a safe and free transport service for these children to get to school. Without such support, they will miss out on their education.

title: GBV Victims Transport Required
description: We at Healing Hands Community Project are in dire need of a secondary vehicle for our organisation. We currently have a VW Polo 2010 model and it is too small to accomodate the many shelterees that need transportation from our establishment for medical, legal appointments etc. As well allowing us to fetch them from their premises as well as transporting them and their luggage etc to their permanent place of safety.

title: Educate and Feed 25 Orphans Children in Uganda
description: This project will help build brick walled classrooms to replace the mud walled semi-permanent classrooms currently used by 25 orphans and vulnerable children at the Bukhonzo Samar Children's Home and school situated in rural Uganda. The project will as well provide free nutritious meals and care for the children from rural villages in Bukhonzo location of Eastern Uganda. Donations towards this project will benefit 25 orphans providing them with meals and a suitable learning environment.

title: Support the European LGBTI movement
description: ILGA-Europe work for LGBTI people's safety, equality and freedom. In collaboration with and on behalf of over 700 LGBTI member organisations across 54 countries Europe and Central Asia, we are a driving force for political, legal and social change. We work for a world in which each and every LGBTI person is free, equal and safe, through advocating for LGBTI equality and supporting frontline activists in the most crucial contexts.

title: Empower Women: Help mothers have job opportunities
description: The aim of this project is to accompany and strengthen mothers, that live in low-income neighborhoods, in the development of employability skills. We propose training in the trade of sewing and textile production while we accompany them in the development of their own entrepreneurial skills. This will allow them to improve their income while gaining economic stability and independence.

title: Empower 50 GBV survivors in Fako, Cameroon
description: -This project will provide livelihood support and empower 100 internally displaced (IDP) women who are gender-based violence survivors by providing them with vocational training opportunities in hairdressing as well as ensuring they have start-up kits to start their own businesses after training.       -Hadassah Foundation also plans to reduce the risk of experiencing GBV by providing continuous psychosocial support/counseling to the women to enhance their psychological well-being.

title: Daily & Lifelong Reading for Every Girl in India
description: Billion Readers (BIRD) ensures daily & lifelong reading practice a for billion Indians by adding Same Language Subtitling (SLS) on mainstream entertainment like Bollywood movies, serials and cartoons! By sliding reading into something that girls & women already do - watch TV regularly throughout their lives, reading becomes joyful, fun and engaging.  Every girl in every village in India is transformed into a fluent reader unlocking unimaginable possibilities of dignity, skill, and empowerment.

title: Food for 400 orphanages.
description: The project is well dedicating to serve 400 orphans in one of orphanage centre situated in lushoto district. The 400 orphans are currently suffering with lack of enough blankets , towels, beds and absence of enough toilets for their serving. This has been happening due to the bankrupt of the Lutheran Church which was the only one which was supported this orphanage centre. The project is aim to provide 1000 blankets to 400 orphans,300 towels and 50 beds to 400 orphans at Irente orphanage center.

title: Tax awareness in Argentina
description: Logica is the non-partisan organization dedicated to raising awareness about the serious fiscal problems suffered in Argentina: public spending, taxes and inflation. The objective is to promote tax education on the importance of such problems in the daily life of the population, providing tools to achieve a real and sustainable change in the country.

title: Fundraising relay in Lesvos : running 320km in 32h
description: The challenge is the following : 320 km. 32 hours. 20 runners. Raise 1.000.  Together, as members of Yoga and Sport with Refugees, we have set ourselves this challenge to raise money to support the YSR project in Lesvos. Our NGO focuses on improving the physical and mental wellbeing of refugees through sport, working towards integration and building a community. We currently facilitate 500 students per week - with your support, we can continue to offer a healthy and safe space to refugees.

title: Build Western Cape's 1st Wildlife Rehab Centre
description: The Kogelberg Biosphere Wildlife Rehabilitation Centre will mitigate the loss of biodiversity in this unique UNESCO recognised region, by providing a welfare service for sick, injured and orphaned indigenous wildlife with the goal of returning them to their natural habitat. By offering conservation education programs, the KBWR will advance the studies of ethical wildlife rehabilitation, set the standard for wildlife rescue, and impact the conservation of threatened species worldwide.

title: Responding to Violence in Sudan
description: On April 15, conflict between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) erupted in Khartoum, the nation's capital. Since then, there have been clashes between the SAF and RSF in Kassala, North Darfur, North Kordofan and South Darfur states.  To respond to the crisis, International Medical Corps is prioritizing the  safety and security of staff and the continuity of essential services in Sudan, while scaling up activities and pre-positioning critically needed supplies.

title: Bee Sanctuary in Colombia
description: The worldwide bee population has decreased by nearly 40% in the past five years.   However, Colombia is home to 10% of the planet's bee species and harbors more than 22,500 flowering plant species. Our project will develop a bee sanctuary and educational center in the southern Colombian mountains. The region is suitable for many species, including the Apis meliferas. It has native forests and waters, and from test hives we installed we know it is excellent for bee relocation and protection.

title: SUDAN CONFLICT  2023: Mass Influx of Refugees
description: Following a week of brutal fighting between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) that has killed more than 400 people and injured 5,000, parties to the conflict have negotiated a 72-hour ceasefire. Since April 15, persistent gunfire and airstrikes had been terrorizing civilians and led to evacuations of diplomatic personnel from Sudan's capital, Khartoum. The fighting also severely impacted humanitarian groups, leading to the deaths of four U.N. staff.

title: House for 20 Tribe Families living into forest
description: PALIYAN Tribal a group is very backward in Tamil Nadu. For longtime, tribe life was at caves and risk conditions in Sirumalai Hills and Palani Hills. ROSI FOUNDATION has retrieved 365 families from risk life and they are being rehabilitated in temporary shelter with solar light and health support since 2010. In this project, they are to be supported for a reasonable habitation. First batch of 20 tribe families are provided by House in this project.

title: Give hope to  continue our Journey
description: - One-third of all tumors are treated by means of scientific research findings. This is what made Shefaa Al-Orman Hospital pay great attention to scientific research, as the hospital harnessed its capabilities to facilitate and support scientific research based on sound foundations in its broad and true concept. In order to prevent cancer and improve the rates of recovery of patients in Upper Egypt.

title: Save Cancer Children with Installation of Solar
description: Due to Global Market instability and increasing energy prices  and foreign currency challenges in Egypt with massive increasing in electricity fares prices we decided to develop our energy infrastructure in Shefa Alorman hospital with installing solar panels to replace with the traditional one as we can save cost and directed it to the patients and reduce carbon emission

title: SUPPORT TO TRAINING SCHOOL FOR DEAF & BLIND YOUTH
description: The Wisdom Vocational College is for Students with physical and mental disabilities. There are 70 boarders at any one time who live at the college 24/7. Students range from 12 years old up to 25 years. Once they are 25, they must leave the College. This project looks at supporting the college by improving the sanitation and classroom facilities. The project will also look at ways to improve how the young people are living at the college.

title: Help floods victims in Nyalenda KENYA.
description: Nyalenda community sits in Kisumu  county which is one of the 47 counties within Kenya. Nyalenda  has a population of around 100,000 people who lives in the slums and who lives below a dollar a day. Due to heavy rains this year most houses have been marooned in flood waters. The area has been experiencing  perennial  flooding and people have been displaced each and every year. The women and children and elderly living in the slums have been displaced hence needs urgent interventions.

title: Help1,700 survivors of  flooding in Kinshasa-DRC
description: In December 2022 flooding hit some parts of Kinshasa the DRC Capital City and  affected more vulnerable people who lost everything they had in order to survive. The flooding caused deaths of people and destroyed houses and business which the lives of many depended, the survivors are now living in camps without assistance. This project will focusing of solving their key problems which is about shelter, livelihood activities and social opportunities such as education and health services.

title: Treatment of Endometriosis support to Sumaya
description: UYSTO is fundraising for one Sumaya, our trainee single mother who has been diagnosed with Endometriosis condition. The treatment is expensive for her, she needs feeding while on the medication and she has a burden of debts on her as she has been borrowing to purchase drugs. UYSTO is financially helping her but still the support is not enough as she needs to take the treatment until August 2023 and yet has no other support from anyone.

title: Support vulnerable children in Colombia
description: PAN helps over 26,000 vulnerable people living in the most remote rural areas of Colombia overcome adversity each year. By collaborating with those who are committed to making a difference, PAN aims to enhance its programs for children and their families. Through education, nutritional support, and healthcare, PAN works towards improving their quality of life, while also empowering them to make positive changes in their communities over the long term.

title: UAEM Innovation Fund
description: The biomedical research system is failing to address global need-8/10universities in the U.S. and Canada spend less than 2% of their research dollars on treatments and prevention for neglected diseases, which affect nearly 2 billion people around the world.   Universities Allied for Essential Medicines (UAEM) is launching an innovation fund to help us train new researchers to tackle these diseases and increase the open-access publication of biomedical research.

title: Urgent Action for Palestinian Human Rights
description: First their homes, farms, infrastructure, and now their schools. Palestinian existence on their land is under threat. Next step: help bring Palestinian youth to Congress to share their stories and their visions of peace. This has proven effective in the past when Senators and Representatives intervened with the Government of Israel to stop demolitions and keep homes and villages standing. Help Rebuilding Alliance bring these youth to Congress and join us to advocate for Palestinian rights.

title: Give 200 Children in Rural Nigeria an Education!
description: We provide out-of-school children without access to education in a safe space to learn basic literacy and numeracy skills on weekends, helping them transition into formal schools after 9 months. Our beneficiaries are children in Northern Nigeria with access to only traditional Arabic learning. The absence of schools in their communities, and guardians who harbor false myths about Western education, means these children are likely never to gain a formal education. Our project gives them a chance!

title: Empower Young Entrepreneurs in Kenya
description: With just $500, we can provide an entrepreneur with a loan that has the potential to be redeployed up to 10 times. It's a small investment that can have a big impact on their business. By generously donating to our cause, you can help us offer affordable loans and mentorship that can accelerate the growth of our entrepreneurs' businesses. Together, we can empower these individuals to achieve their dreams and make a positive impact in their communities.

title: Provide Sudanese People an Information Lifeline
description: The brutal fighting in Sudan has sparked a major humanitarian crisis. The UN estimates that more than 840,000 people have already been forced to leave their homes. In this incredibly difficult context, we at Internews are supporting people to access the information they need to make life-saving decisions for themselves and their families, by identifying dangerous mis- and disinformation, and by providing people with trustworthy and reliable alternatives.

title: 21st Century skills in Nigerian public schools
description: Imagine being a school child who has never played with puzzles or watched an animated movie. For some kids, it's their reality.  The NOBLE Club provides public primary school children in disadvantaged communities with the practical and hands-on learning they don't receive in classrooms. We expose them to new experiences and broaden their imaginations, which enables them to dream bigger and different. We provide them with the essential 21st-century skills necessary for their development.

title: Support Food Bank to feed poor people in Nigeria
description: Approximately 25 million Nigerians are currently suffering from severe hunger. The nation's already imploding economy was exacerbated by COVID-19, leaving millions of homes without food and other basic needs. The Ogadagidi Global Empowerment Initiative has launched a food bank in the Edem-Ani community to provide food and other assistance to very poor people and families. By tackling food insecurity, we hope to provide greater access to health, education, and a more productive future.

title: Mental health for deaf youth in Colombia
description: According to the World Health Organization, 1 in 4 people will have a mental disorder in their lifetime.  It is estimated that the pandemic has increased the prevalence of depression and anxiety by 25/27% worldwide (UN 2022).    The change we seek is to eliminate the barriers of accessibility to psychological services the deaf population faces in Colombia.  In particular, your donation will support deaf youth get direct attention from psychologists competent in the Colombian Sign Language.

title: Sound of Youth Scholarship Program
description: Sound of Youth Scholarship Program has supported 200 young people who were affected by the devastating earthquakes that took place in the southeastern part of Turkey on February 6th, 2023. In cooperation with Spotify, TOG provided scholarships to university students affected by the earthquake by enabling them to continue their academic education. Now, the Sound of Youth Scholarship Program is looking for your support to reach more people.

title: Education & Food for 50 Orphan Children in Kenya
description: Hope Children's Home situated in the Kawangware slum of Nairobi, hosts 50 orphaned and abandoned children. On a very limited budget, the home provides upkeep and accommodation for children as young as two years. The home also facilitates their education starting from early childhood education through primary and high school. Donations towards this project will benefit 50 OVC children by providing them with education, free nutritious meals, upkeep and a suitable living environment to call home.

title: Power the potential of women and girls
description: Poverty and inequality plague numerous communities around the world, and women and girls are disproportionately impacted. BRAC creates proven, scalable solutions to uplift women and girls and alleviate poverty and inequality. Through social enterprises to programs targeting health care, education, climate change, youth empowerment, financial inclusion, and more. With the help of your donations, BRAC has reached over 100 million people with poverty solutions and tackled pressing issues of gender

title: Saving abandoned & homeless older people in rural
description: Challenge Older people in rural and remote areas are often alone without family or their wider community. Older persons experienced abandonment, isolation or exclusion. Through the years in Cambodia, a significant increase in older people left alone with no homes or family to take care of them.

title: Fight Malnutrition in Filipino Children
description: The scope of the project is the distribution of healthy and nutritious meals to indigenous children attending Lantuyang Elementary School and Adong Mangyan School on Mindoro Island, in the Philippines.  Children in this area of the island are severely affected by malnutrition, which leads to developmental and health issues and hinders their capacity to learn and their access to education.

title: Relief for families affected by Flooding in Rwanda
description: Rwanda is vulnerable to a wide range of natural hazards including floods, landslides, earthquake and rainstorms. Following the floods caused by the heavy rain on 2 and May 2023 in Northern Western, and Southern provinces, where this disaster left thousands of families without shelter, food, and other basic life. 130 deaths in this week more than 5,000 homes were destroyed (figures as of 4th May 2023). The project will provide basic needs and will also provide home-to-home counseling therapy.

title: Italy Flood Relief Fund
description: Throughout May 2023, deadly flooding and landslides have struck Italy's northern Emilia-Romagna region. More than 10,000 people have been evacuated and nearly 10 people have been killed after 14 rivers burst their banks in the region following heavy rainfall. All donations to this fund will exclusively support local relief and recovery efforts.

title: 210 Orphaned Children will Receive Free Education
description: There are approximately 2500 children living in the central province of Sri Lanka, without their parents. These children are living in extended family homes or with guardians. Unlike the children living in our orphanages, who receive adequate food, clothing and education, these children often do without basic needs. Many of these families living in poverty often struggle to provide for themselves and certainly for the children they have taken into their homes.

title: Help Provide Love, Shelter & Food for DV Survivors
description: Our Project provides shelter, feeding, healthcare and LOVE for survivors of domestic abuse in Lagos, Nigeria. We take these women and their children (if they come with them) in and shower them with love by feeding them and taking care of all their welfare and health needs.  In our care, these desperate, dejected and hopeless women find a renewed sense of self-worth and hope for their future and that of their children.

title: Help Soy Nina go to Women Deliver 2023 in Rwanda
description: Thank you so much! Three of us were able to attend Women Deliver thanks to your generosity. You should have received a thank you e-mail with photos and testimonies. If you did not, please let us know!

title: Menstrual items & Awareness for 200 village girls
description: In our villages, women and girls are STILL using old rags, causing infections &  disease. Besides this during their monthly cycles women are considered impure and it is for these reasons that many girls are forgoing school. Sanitary Pads & items of hygiene are equally expensive and they'd rather buy food. So by this Menstrual Hygiene day, we plan to provide 200 girls in 5 different schools with Sanitary pads, dustbins and soaps for maintaining menstrual hygiene followed by Awareness classes!

title: EmpowerOrphans
description: EmpowerOrphans is focused on Bulgaria's orphaned children and those in foster care, providing tailored entrepreneurship education and sports classes. We're building outdoor gyms to create a healthier environment for them. Join us today and help transform futures. Your generous donation can unlock the untapped potential of these deserving children, providing them a stepping stone towards a brighter future. Invest in their tomorrow, today!

title: Give back their dignity
description: We empower teenage refugees from Cameroon through our skill acquisition program in the Leni Keller workshop in Uyo, Nigeria. After acquiring skills in tailoring, hairbraiding or craft training in modern and traditional accessories, we support the trainees earn a a living through using the machines in our space  or support them find employment in the local market. We also offer psycho-social support for the 50 refugees to recover from the traumatic expereinces made during war.

title: Art Therapy for Early Intervention Children
description: Children with developmental delays or disabilities show improvements in their tolerance for frustration, motivation, and spontaneous initiation when participating in our intervention programs. With our art therapy, we will appropriately make adjustments in creative modes based on specific diagnoses, development age and physiological limitations. Emphasizing a partially self-directed and spontaneous work mode for children also multiplies the effectiveness of various intervention programs.

title: Buy new clothes for 200 Syrian orphans north Syria
description: With the deterioration of the economic conditions in Lebanon and Syria, the priority of families fleeing the war in Syria has become to secure water and food, while neglecting the children's need for joy in new clothes. Therefore, this project will target the most affected and poorest group of families and provide new clothes for their children. This project will provide new clothes for 200 Syrian orphans in the camps of Lebanon and northern Syria.

title: Sponsor destitute university students in Liberia
description: This project provides fourteen full university scholarships (undergraduate programs) to young underprivileged students who graduated from our school and have been affected directly or indirectly by the Liberian civil war, Ebola, and extreme poverty and who otherwise would not be able to afford their schooling. It is our hope that through this project, we train these youths to become teachers and will come back to our school to help provide quality education to other underprivileged students.

title: Assistive Devices For Persons With Disabilities
description: Assistive devices are critical tools for enabling persons with disabilities (PWDs) to achieve independence and participate fully in society. Unfortunately, the high cost of these devices presents a significant challenge for many individuals who need them. Through our fundraiser, we seek to provide essential mobility aids such as tricycles, hearing aids, and hand crutches to a deserving group of PWDs.

title: SW London Music School teaching children in need
description: Our Reach out and Play project will give local children with special needs (SEND), autism and those from disadvantaged backgrounds the chance to play a musical instrument and perform in front of an audience!  We'll provide 20 local families on low income up to 6 months of free lessons, and additionally will assist 100 current students with the cost of lessons, books, instrument hire and grade fees.

title: Community Development Builders
description: The LEAD Coalition is a Community Development Corporation that convenes stakeholders to develop and implement authentic, collaborative solutions to neighborhood challenges. The LEAD Coalition of Bay County, Inc., is a nonprofit 501(c)(3) tax-exempt charitable organization registered in Florida.This sponsorship will allow LEAD to develop new programs and form partnerships with local businesses and organizations that will greatly benefit the community at large.

title: Elimu Resource Centre - a digital hub for learners
description: Based in Malindi, Kenya, Elimu runs Elimu Resource Centre (ERC) - a digital hub for learners. The Centre enhances access to education, improves digital literacy in the community, and helps youth find pathways to more meaningful futures through skills development, employment planning and entrepreneurship. It provides solutions for vulnerable children whose parents cannot afford to keep them in school or provide for their further studies after high school.

title: Developing a Pre-Hospital Emergency Care System
description: This project builds on our previous work on improving in-hospital emergency care and aims to improve out-of-hospital emergency care to save lives. This pilot program will have ECPs serve in two week rotations on the ambulance service in Kampala, providing full time coverage for the ambulances with a focus on responding to the most critical cases. Given their extensive experience, they will give input into how the model of staffing ambulances with non-physician emergency care providers functions.

title: Food Security for 500 families in WestPokot Kenya
description: West Pokot is an Arid Land of Kenya, where the drought has devastating effects on the livelihoods of the rural communities. CEFA supports resilience-building through training on modern beekeeping and beehives distribution for 50 beekeepers, construction of 1 honey processing unit and beehives carpentry, training on nutrition sensitive agriculture and distribution of drought-resistant seeds for 100 farmers, construction of 5 water points in 5 villages for 250 households and their livestock.

title: Refugee Women Skills Project
description: Our project helps refugee women from primarily South Sudan, the DRC, and Somalia using a  hands-on training approach. FIDRA engages, empowers, and trains young adolescent refugees in tailoring and baking skills. We use a market and evidence driven curriculum to ensure that at the end of the program, the women can be competitive in starting businesses with their newly acquired skills.

title: 20 higher education scholarships for rural youth
description: This program seeks to accompany 20 young people from rural areas of Argentina so that they can access higher education. We provide an economic scholarship according to what they need to cover. We also follow up periodically to support their educational trajectory, because they come from low-income families and are generally the first generation that can access university, tertiary or technical studies.

title: SUPPORTING UKRAINIAN ATHLETES AFFECTED BY WAR
description: This project aims to support young Ukrainian athletes who have been affected by the war in Ukraine and are in a difficult financial situation. The project includes providing monthly support to 32 Ukrainian athletes for continuing their careers, as it provides them with the necessary resources to train and compete at the highest level. Without this support, many talented athletes may not have the opportunity to pursue their dreams, which would be a significant loss for them and for their country.

title: Food Security during financial crisis in Sri Lanka
description: Street Child together with the Department of Health Services (Government of Sri Lanka) conducted a household-level rapid needs assessment across the Northern and Eastern Provinces of Sri Lanka in 2022/23 Year.From this,it was revealed that malnutrition and out of school dropouts  prevailed in the respective provinces at household level. In order to respond to the growing issues, Street Child alongside our local partners have developed an innovative food security programme to support 100 families

title: 10 FOR 10 - Give 10 to Celebrate 10 Years
description: In honor of Global Health Charities' 10 year anniversary we are setting a goal of funding and assembling 10,000 Clean Birth Kits (CBKS). We are challenging our generous donors to help us celebrate by supporting us with a gift of 10 for 10. $10 for one CBK or $100 for 10 CBKs. Each CBK potentially saves the lives of a mother and her child. CBKs have been distributed globally to 19 countries in some of the most economically depressed countries as well as areas in conflict. .

title: Education through music for Brazilian teenagers
description: The mission of Aldeias Infantils SOS Brasil is to support vulnerable children, adolescents, young people and families, boosting their development and autonomy in a protective family and community environment. This project seeks the continuity of the music classes that we carry out for children and adolescents in a high situation of social vulnerability in the City of Caico - Brazil.

title: SKP: Culinary Training for Refugees in Athens
description: At Saffron Kitchen Project we offer free culinary vocational training in partnership with IEK Delta, a Greek educational center, for refugees. The training provides a combination of culinary and soft skills, including teamwork and time management. Recognised by the Greek Ministry of Education, each graduate receives an accredited certificate. As well as the training students obtain employability workshop, support writing their CVs and are connected to jobs within the Greek hospitality industry

title: Saffron Kitchen Project - Nourish and Employ
description: At Saffron Kitchen Project (SKP) our mission is to support displaced people in building healthy, autonomous lives, using food as a toolkit. We are a community that leverages food so people can eat, cook, learn and most importantly, feel that they belong. We are a registered non-profit organisation that creates high quality, nutritious meals for vulnerable communities in Athens and employ chefs from the refugee community.

title: It's Time For Action- End Period Poverty!
description: Menstruation is a natural process that affects 3.5 billion women and girls worldwide. However, it is often stigmatized and surrounded by misinformation, which leads to discrimination. At least 500 million women and girls globally experience period poverty - the inability to access menstrual hygiene products. This lack of access directly affects their physical, reproductive, and mental health.

title: Bikes for Ukrainian War Orphans
description: Our project aims to make a meaningful impact on the lives of war orphans in Ukraine who have been devastated by the ongoing conflict. We are fundraising  to collect used bikes from Western Europe and transport them to Ukrainian cities where they are desperately needed. By supporting the costs of transportation and distribution of bikes, you can directly contribute to bringing hope and practical solutions to these war orphans.  Join us today and be a part of this transformative journey.

title: Holistic Support to Children in Rural South Africa
description: Thanda provides a holistic response to the critical needs of children in rural Mtwalume through high- quality early learning, parenting, and social-emotional out-of-school education programmes, as well as organic farming interventions enable food security in order for households to thrive.

title: The Farmington Charity Challenge
description: Every year over 287,000 women die during childbirth. It's not just their newborn baby left motherless but any siblings as well. Global Health Charities is committed to help significantly reduce these deaths by providing Clean Birth Kits (CBKs). The CBKs provide a clean birth environment thereby reducing the chance of infection for both mother and baby.

title: GIVE A MENSTRUATION  KIT TO KEEP A GIRL IN SCHOOL
description: With your support, we wish to help many teenagers to have a bright future by staying in school during her periods. With USD 17, you will have helped a girl not only to get a Menstruation kit but also stay in school hence reducing the literacy problem and allow this young girl be self-sustaining when she finishes her education and find or create a job opportunity. Your donation further will impact the country when few domestic violence issues will be recorded, less or no child abuses

title: Cyclone Mocha Relief Fund
description: Cyclone Mocha made landfall with winds as strong as a Category 5 hurricane in coastal areas of Myanmar and Bangladesh already in the grip of a longstanding humanitarian and refugee crisis. Your donation to the Cyclone Mocha Relief Fund will help survivors access food, water, shelter, and emergency supplies.

title: Train 150 AGYW (10-24 Years) on Menstrual Hygiene
description: This project will train 150 AGYW (10-24 Years) on menstruation management, pads making and donating/distribution of reusable sanitary pads to rural underprivileged Adolescent girls & Young Women (AGYW). This will increase their knowledge, attitude & practice on menstruation thus increased access to hygienic menstrual materials that'll reduce infections, school absenteeism, dropout, child marriage & unwanted pregnancies which are  key contributing factors to school dropout in Uganda.

title: Keeping Girls In School in Uganda
description: This project will provide 800 vulnerable girls in Wakiso District in Uganda with reusable sanitary towels and underwear, helping them to stay safe and stay in school.

title: Support for displaced families in West Darfur/Chad
description: Recent internal conflicts in West Darfur, Sudan led to thousands of families being redisplaced from the current Internal Displacement Centers to new IDP Centers. Thousands of new families also have been displaced from their homes. Nearly 1.9 million people have fled to safer locations outside the country. Therefore we are asking for your donation support to provide food, tarpaulin, clothes, shoes, blankets, and sleeping mats. Any amount of donation will make a huge difference.

title: Expanding education in Cambodia
description: This project will develop a mobile library and provide educational resources for young children, students, parents and teachers.  Educational resources and schooling were harshly affected following the civil war and, more recently, the pandemic. This project strives to bridge those gaps with resources and education programs.  Developing English skills is a key focus. Siem Reap is a popular tourist destination, and English skills open the doors to further education and employment opportunities.

title: A Happy Meal - Mullaitivu
description: With the current economic crisis in Sri Lanka and high inflation more and more families are cutting down on their meals. Parents find it hard to pack food into their preschooler's lunchbox. In the past several months we have seen children bring less food to their preschool. Since last year World Vision Lanka (WVL) has supported nearly 5000 children across 17 locations in Sri Lanka. WVL is now fundraising to provide a nutritious meal for at least 100 preschool children in Mullaitivu for 6 months.

title: Help 10 disabled persons with urinary incontinence
description: Man is a social animal and likes to be in the company of others. However, no one likes to be near a person with urinary incontinence.  A disabled and bedridden child is prone to urinate several times a day which requires frequent change of clothing and drying and involving disinfectants. This is also frequently accompanied with emptying the bowel. The obnoxious smell tends to permeate the entire living environment causing stress to the family and guests.

title: Support Local Therapists Access Clinical Trainings
description: Access to continuous clinical training is essential to good practice, professional satisfaction and better patient outcomes. When MOTO interviewed local therapists in Tanzania, 71% stated that they did not have access to regular clinical skills training. We want to change that. Our project will support OTs, PTs and SALTs to access new and exciting clinical skills training developed collaboratively and delivered by therapists across the world.

title: children's passions of children from orphanages
description: Ignite Passions is a transformative project committed to nurturing the passions of children in orphanages for football, basketball, and acting. Recognizing the lack of resources and opportunities for these children to explore their talents, this project aims to bridge the gap and foster an environment for their personal growth.  The project is set in the inspiring location of the Giant Mountains, utilizing various pitches and rooms for its activities.  The project not only allows children to exp

title: Provide Breakfast for 200 Students in Kenya
description: The CUP program provides breakfast porridge (UJI) for approximately 200 students enrolled in the early childhood program at Kimbo-Githurai Primary School. The program aims to decrease school hunger and encourage regular school attendance resulting in improved general learning and performance.

title: Housing For Impoverished Families
description: This project will build houses for impoverished families, primarily single mothers and widows with children, and those who are sick or disabled.

title: Blankets for Babies
description: We are asking our generous donors to help us support women and their babies in economically depressed regions of the world with a gift of ??? to buy baby blankets for our Clean Birth Kits (CBKs). Each CBK potentially saves the lives of a mother and her child by helping to prevent infections during childbirth. CBKs have been distributed globally to 19 countries in some of the poorest areas of the world as well as areas in conflict.

title: Bring Best Medical Treatment to Orphans in China
description: Chunhui Care Home project partners with welfare institutions in Chinese mainland to bring infants and toddlers born with life-threatening diseases and defects to Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou for the best medical treatment available. The proposed fund of $25,000 will sponsor a bed and help four children recover from desease at the earliest possible date and recieve around-the-clock loving care from Chunhui Mamas.

title: Conserve Whales and Marine Life in Canary Islands
description: Tenerife is a popular tourist destination. Unfortunately, tourism can negatively impact marine life, including whale species. Our project supports research in the region. Research plays a crucial role in monitoring the effects of tourism in Tenerife. It helps measure changes in population dynamics, study habitat degradation, and develop sustainable management strategies. It guides conservation and responsible tourism efforts to ensure the long-term well-being of whale and marine populations.

title: Providing food with compassion to refugees, Greece
description: foodKIND runs a free market in Athens, Greece, at which we support refugees and asylum seekers who are food insecure. We provide dried and tinned goods, as well as some hygiene items. We are currently supporting about 400 people, who go through a needs assessment according to a set of vulnerability criteria. There has been a sharp increase in the need for food amongst the community of forcibly displaced people. We are raising funds to expand our project and help as many people as possible.

title: Summer camps for children with disabilities.
description: In Poland there are only few summer camps for children with disabilities. They do want to spend their time just like their able peers. Our aim is to organize such camps even for children with severe disabilities. We provide great fun and a lot of exciting and engaging activities for them instead of dull, traditional rehabilitation. Throughout couple of days of the summer camps, kids have an opportunity to learn self-dependence. For most of them it is the first adventure without parents.

title: Protecting lemurs in Madagascar
description: Conserving lemurs in Madagascar is crucial for the country's biodiversity and long-term ecological health. Lemurs play a vital role in the ecosystem as seed dispersers and pollinators. This project partners with Lokobe National Park on the island of Nosy Be to research endangered and threatened endemic species, including the black lemur, hawk's sportive and mouse lemur.  Fishing and tourism can negatively impact the region so research and conservation strategies are vital.

title: Quality education in Madagascar
description: While most children in Madagascar do attend school, the standard of education is inconsistent and schools are often under-resourced and overcrowded. Our project aims to improve the education of women and children in the Nosy Be region through classroom support and educational workshops.  We aim to improve access to educational resources for teachers and students as we strive to make a positive impact on the lives of families and, through education, empower them for a better future.

title: Eid for All
description: The "Eid for All" project is dedicated to ensuring an inclusive celebration of Eid Al Adha for displaced individuals residing in Beqaa, Lebanon. By emphasizing the values of inclusivity, empathy, and compassion, this project aims to create a sense of unity and joy during the festive season and ensures that poor families have access to nutritious food and can experience the spiritual significance of the occasion.

title: Empowering 20 People with Disabilites in Chihuahua
description: By supporting this project, you can make a meaningful impact in the lives of 20 individuals with motor disabilities in Chihuahua, Mexico, who face economic challenges due to limited opportunities. Discrimination and lack of inclusion present significant barriers to their employment prospects. We aim to address this issue by fostering an entrepreneurial mindset, equipping them with knowledge and tools to develop and launch their own ventures, and empowering them to become lifelong entrepreneurs.

title: Saving patients lives worldwide through stem cells
description: Every 27 seconds, a patient receives the devastating news that they have been diagnosed with blood cancer or a blood disorder. Their journey towards a possible cure begins, and for many, that cure lies in a stem cell transplantation. However, the odds of finding a matching stem cell donor are incredibly low, like finding a needle in a haystack. 50% of patients find their lifesaving donor in another country through the global database. This database is a lifeline for patients in need.

title: Support the Third Gender Population in Bangladesh
description: As a person with a heart, you are being called to stand by the backward third-gender community in Bangladesh. Your donation will lead to the socio-economic development of these communities by imparting Motor Driving training to them.

title: Dog Food for our 110+ Collie Dogs (Wales, UK)
description: We are a registered charity who rescue, rehabilitate and rehome dogs (mainly border collies).  We are based in Wales, UK.    Our dogs live, play and have fun together in large packs.  Many of our dogs were due to be put to sleep from their owners after having no where else to turn.  Many were rejected from other rescues.  We have around 100 to 130 dogs. The majority are Collies or Collie crosses.

title: Build classrooms and latrines in Majak Goi village
description: The Mawoudit Foundation intends to build  8 classrooms and 16 pit latrine blocks at  Deng Maker Primary School in Majak Goi village, South Sudan to provide a conducive environment for learning to kids from humble backgrounds in Majak Goi village. The project will also provide free meals, and solar torches to 500 pupils and train 8 teachers at Deng Maker Primary School. With this project, we will introduce digital library for pupils and teachers by using tablet.

title: Winter Warmer - Homelessness Relief - Australia
description: Did you know that Tweed Shire, NSW has the highest number of people sleeping rough compared to other LGAs in the state?  Winter Warmer is a campaign aimed at helping the homeless community in the Northern Rivers region of Australia during the winter season.  With winter approaching and homeless communities facing the challenges of sleeping rough in cold, wet, and harsh conditions, we have an opportunity to make a difference in their lives.  Bringing hope and warmth to our homeless communities.

title: Provide Medical Treatment & Save Frank from Cancer
description: This project will support Mr Frank, to receive all the necessary medical treatment he needs in order to become healthy again. Mr Frank, who is a native of Lilu in Ihiala Local Government Area of Anambra State, use to be a successful trader until the year 2019, when he was diagnosed with cancer of the neck. He has exhausted his savings trying to save his life and his health is now fast deteriorating with no money to support him and finance his treatment. Remain blessed as you donate to save him.

title: Building a Path to Education for At-Risk Youth
description: MindLeaps transitions at-risk children to stable lives in school and the workplace through programs in Africa, the US and the Balkans. This begins with our dance program, engaging kids in fun classes based on a methodology crafted to develop cognitive and social-emotional skills vital to success. With our ongoing support, children are sponsored in formal education. MindLeaps also strengthens the family unit through small business investments and access to computer training and technology.

title: Provide Clean Water for Rural Villages in Nigeria
description: This project will drill boreholes for rural communities in Anambra State, in order to provide them with clean water and protect the lives of the children therein. Clean water is important for public health, whether it's for drinking or domestic use. Many residents in Anambra treks to hilly streams to fetch water. Over 60 million people in Nigeria still lack access to clean water, leading to transmission of waterborne diseases like diarrhea, killing over 700,000 children under 5 years annually.

title: Stop Violence Against Women in Pakistan
description: The "Stop Violence Against Women in Balochistan, Pakistan" project aims to address the pervasive issue of violence against women specifically in the Balochistan province. The project duration is 24 months and will be implemented by Balochistan Rural Development Program.
