The project focuses on raising awareness, providing support services, strengthening local capacity, and advocating for policy reforms to create a safer environment for women in Balochistan, Pakistan

title: Support Refuges and Returnees in South Sudan.
description: South Sudan is experiencing a large influx of refugees and returnees fleeing from Sudan due to political Instability seeking safety, stability and humanitarian assistance within its borders. Facilitating Action for Community Empowerment recognizes the urgent need to support these vulnerable populations. This concept note outlines our proposal to provide essential assistance in the areas of food security, non-food items (NFIs), and livelihood support.

title: Tropical Cyclone Mocha Relief Aid
description: Asar Humanity aims to deliver relief aid for those who are affected by the devastating storm at Rohingya refugee camp between Bangladesh's Cox's Bazar district and the city of Rakhine region, Myanmar. The storm destroyed almost all the houses, shelters, schools, medical facilities and other public infrastructures in Sittwe. There are around 130,000 Rohingya living in refugee camps since 2012. This project is targeted to provide urgent basic needs and recovery programs for the affected people.

title: Help to give colour where the sound is missed
description: Raise awareness and educate the population on hearing health issues is a constant task. We believe that one of the best ways to do this is to teach about it from the earliest ages. For this purpose, before 2023 ends, we want to print 5000 copies of the coloring book for children, where they can learn diferents ways to take care of their hearing.  We will be glad to count with your support in this projects, to make visible the importance of hearing health in our society.

title: Empower Abused Homeless Children
description: WOW Tanzania plans to send abused, impoverished, and homeless children to private boarding schools, where they will be provided with top education, safe living space, and 3 square meals a day. Providing education and a safe space for these traumatized children is the first step in breaking the cycle of poverty.

title: Provide Chest for Shelter to 10 Ukrainian Schools
description: Smart Osvita is committed to supporting the education and emotional well-being of Ukrainian schoolchildren during the full-scale russian invasion of Ukraine. Our professionally developed  "Chest for Shelter" is a tool-kit aimed at strengthening psychological resilience, reducing stress, maintaining focus, alleviating anxiety, and providing a continuous learning environment for children forced to spend a lot of time in a bomb shelter during their education process.

title: Helping Young People Rise Out of Refugee Camps
description: Boy With a Ball's Love Your City efforts send skilled, passionate teams out into slums and refugee camps to build relationships with the young people and their family members living there.  As trust and relationship form, these teams learn from the families and youth what obstacles they are currently facing to reach their dreams.  Team members then launch mentoring relationships and developmental small groups (job skills training, tutoring centers, language classes and more) to help them rise.

title: Empower Community Development in Puerto Rico
description: This program will aid in the planning, design, implementation, restoration, and construction of projects that seed from and respond to the needs of marginalized and vulnerable communities across Puerto Rico.

title: World Quinua Congress, Mushuk Yuyay, Canar-Ecuador
description: At the culmination of the VIII World Quinua Congress in Potosi, Bolivia in April of this year, the Organizing Committee invited Mushuk Yuyay to host the IX World Quinua Congress in 2025. This will take place at the Mushuk Yuyay headquarters Canar, Ecuador. This Congress will include field demonstrations, presentations by experts, cultural events, and an exchange of ideas and knowledge. This is a wonderful opportunity for Mushuk Yuyay to showcase the impact and importance of the work they do.

title: Resilience.help - Let`s Build Resilience Together!
description: 60% of Ukrainian teachers and schoolchildren suffer from symptoms of mental health disorders due to the war. Existing supply of psychologists is not enough to cope with this challenge. Resilience.help is a psychological platform for Ukrainian teachers and school psychologists. It offers free training and resources on how to provide psychological help to themselves and students in distress. All materials are science-proven. The platform also features blogs by certified professionals.

title: Vet Books for Africa 2023/2024
description: African veterinary faculties are battling to adequately educate their veterinary students due to the lack of resources. South African veterinary students aim to empower other students by delivering much need resources to African universities, communities and sanctuaries during a 7 week expedition, creating a ripple effect in the struggle that is conservation.

title: July 2023 - Match Day for 75 Students in Guatemala
description: Since early 2012 The Integral Heart Family School has been serving 75 children from 42 families from the villages near Antigua, Guatemala. At our school, we cultivate the love of learning. Our students are cognitively and emotionally stimulated through educational activities and games. In addition to helping children, this program empowers mothers to work in other jobs than in the fields, not only improving their financial situation, but also increasing self-worth.

title: Civic Force
description: Respond to disasters and collaborating  with other sectors including the government, business and social sectors.

title: Psychological trainings for 500 Ukrainian teachers
description: Smart Osvita aimed to improve the psychological skills of 500 Ukrainian teachers and school psychologists by providing free training. We offer science-based training programs, which include widely recognized techniques such as EMDR, CBT, and Mindfulness, adapted to the Ukrainian context. Each training is held by practical psychologist with a degree. Educators will gain theoretical knowledge, methods, and tools for providing initial pre-medical psychological self-help and assistance to children.

title: Sak Odheya
description: 1Sak=1/7 Buffalo  Sak Odheya Balady 7750 EGP /250USD: -Slaughter will be done on the days of El Tashreeq, according to Islamic law,after 20 minutes from sunrise on the first day of Eid until the after noon of the fourth day of Eid ,in Egypt .

title: Empowering Children through Education Learning
description: This project is to empower 275 boys and girls in primary school to complete secondary level by providing them with essentials learning school supplies there by enhancing their educational opportunities and seeking funds to fostering their overall development and transform their lives. The project is seeking funds to addressed the lack of access to learning materials and empower 100 adult girls at vocational tech as we aim to bridge the educational gap and promote equality in education for all.

title: WIDOW'S CAN PROJECT FOR ECONOMIC EMPOWERMENT.
description: The  Widows can project is a project is being implemented in informal settlements of Nairobi Kenya.  Namely; Kibera, Dandora, Mathare and muru Kwa njenga. The project builds on the social empowerment processes initiated under that seeks to adopt an integrated approach in the four informal settlement to strengthen simultaneously all the key dimensions of widows' empowerment - social, economic and leadership.  Diversify economic opportunities and choices that lead to sustainable increase in HHs.

title: Build a community school to educate 150 children
description: We will construct and open a community learning center with five classrooms in rural Northern Ghana, for 150 young children to attend school for the first time. In a region with limited school access, our community partners have chosen education as their highest priority. Local teachers use culture and environmental curriculums to inspire children to learn. A small kitchen for school lunches will reduce malnutrition. Solar power and rainwater catchment help make the schools sustainable.

title: SUPPORTING GIRLS & WOMEN WITH DISABILITY
description: Provision of holistic high-quality support , monthly food support , support group meeting , setting up center for people with disability , justice interim of abuse & violence,   and support to vulnerable and underprivileged women and men with disability in business for better resource exploitation, management and control for improved quality of life for the families at household level. In order to improve the situation of these, people with disability who pass through violence.

title: Provide Meat Shares to Those in Need in Syria
description: Join our campaign to bring the spirit of Eid Al-Adha to 1000 displaced families in northern Syria. With your support, we aim to provide a meat shares per family, weighing 1.5-2 KG each, offering nourishment and joy during this sacred occasion.

title: Stories Change Power New Professionals Cohorts
description: Stories Change Power provides professional development in effective advocacy communications. We help all team members at mission-driven organizations - from new professionals to experienced leadership - make the most of their time, talent, funding, and opportunities through people-centered, research-based programming anchored in respect, candor, and growth. This project specifically supports cohorts of new professionals entering the field of advocacy communications.

title: Mindanao Buffalo Bank Project
description: Water buffalo is a farmer's best friend and there are many benefits a buffalo can provide such as help in farm work and carry heavy loads. They are also docile and feed only on grasses. The female provide offspring once every year and the offspring are great investment for the farmer. Milk which is very needed for improvement in nutrition among children is also provided by female buffalo.

title: Support 50 Amputee Children in Syria
description: The conflict in Syria has resulted in the loss of limbs for many innocent children in the northern regions. We are seeking your support to provide financial assistance to 50 of these amputee children and help them secure their basic needs. Your sponsorship of $100 per month per child will bring hope and joy to their lives, and make a positive difference for six months. Join us in supporting these vulnerable children and making a meaningful impact in their lives.

title: The "Unbreakable Ukraine"
description: Project is a charity festival of patriotic songs and poetry by visually impaired artists. Goal: creative union of gifted blind poets and performers of the author's patriotic song around national Ukrainian culture and the idea of victory of Ukraine for the sake of peace, interaction and mutual understanding of all people, formation of a positive image of Ukrainians with disabilities as creative and self-sufficient people. Support for fighters who lost their sight during combat operations.

title: Canada Wildfire Relief Fund
description: Canada is experiencing its worst wildfire season in recorded history. Nearly every province in Canada has at least one active wildfire. Hundreds of fires are burning out of control, displacing thousands of people, burning millions of acres of land, and triggering dangerous air quality concerns for millions of people from New York to Minnesota in the US. Your donation to the Canada Wildfire Relief Fund will support emergency response and long-term recovery efforts.

title: Support Menstrual Hygiene Education For Girls
description: Menstrual hygiene is crucial to the health & well-being of girls. Proper MH management prevents infections, promotes self-esteem & ensures equal education & workplace opportunities. Approximately 500 million girls lack access to adequate menstrual hygiene products or facilities. This situation affects their education, health & overall quality of life. Educating girls & their communities about MH is empower them & dispel myths & misconceptions. Knowledgeable girls can make informed decisions.

title: Saturday Feeding Program, Feeding 1500 Children
description: Every Saturday, St Martins School in the Kibagare slum, opens their door to 1500 slum children to give them a free warm and nutritious meal. The majority of these children have no guarantee of a meal during weekends. Giving them at least this one meal helps households where there may be up to 6 small children. Life is hard and there are many shortages due to the drought in Africa. Providing one meal can make a BIG difference to a young child who is hungry. Help us with a Monthly Gift of Just $10

title: Sustainable solutions for orphans in rural Uganda
description: Save the Children of Mbale, France, supports a child care home for 50 orphans and 70 single,vulnerable Mothers, called Mbale Child Care Foundation. MCCF provides basic daily necessities. Our goal is to create sustainable solutions that encourage self-reliance through empowerment projects for the community Mothers to learn trades for their independance, keeping families together. Additionally, MCCF aspires to expand on land of their own, creating programs and expanding sustainability  efforts.

title: Nutrition and Food Security garden for 50 families
description: This project will help 50 SAN households in Oshikunde to adapt land use to reduce the vulnerability of San communities in Oshikunde Constituency of Ohangwena Region  of Namibia to the impacts of climate change. This means re-assessing, and where necessary changing the land use, to prevent overgrazing while supporting the local communities in adapting their livelihoods to ensure their survival.

title: Help Blind Cats See a Future!
description: Blind Cat Rescue & Sanctuary is a loving and permanent home to cats who don't have a future.  Blind cats are considered unadoptable and euthanized in most shelters before they ever get a chance for a home.  Since opening in 2005, we've been that chance for these cats, offering them a forever home and making sure they are never abandoned, hungry or frightened again. In 2011, we opened our doors and hearts to cats who test positive for FIV and feline leukemia, offering them the same safe forever.

title: English Literacy for Indian Youths and Children
description: Support Solve Education! in providing quality education worldwide, including those lacking access or receiving ineffective schooling. Our mobile platforms offer personalized learning through gamification, social networks, and incentives. By addressing the global education crisis, Solve Education! equips students with essential skills for the future workforce. Donations fund product development, research, and community engagement, ensuring continuous improvement and expanded partnerships.

title: Empowering Singapore's Youth with Digital Literacy
description: Empower Singaporean youth in English and math through game-based learning. Support our crowdfunding campaign for equal access to critical skills, economic knowledge, and problem-solving confidence. Join us in transforming the futures of at least a thousand young individuals in Singapore through quality education.

title: Empowering STEM Education
description: Solve Education! empowers global youth through quality education. We tackle limited STEM teachers and outdated resources by providing engaging game-based learning platforms and robust monitoring. Our goal: empower youth, foster creativity, communication skills, and STEM knowledge, shaping confident and engaged global citizens.

title: Transform 90 children's lives in a favela (Brazil)
description: The Alagados favela is a 50,000 inhabitants urban neighborhood in Salvador de Bahia, one of the poorest of Brazil's large cities. It is infested by both human and drug trafficking. And of course the poorest children and teenagers are particularly vulnerable. With our program 'Being a Child in the Alagados', we offer secure and free school support. We serve 90 children between 6 and 15 years old, who receive tutoring, lessons in ecology, and training in care for others, along with 2 meals a day.

title: Impulsing Vocations for 4 Students in Yucatan
description: Impulso Universitario supports youth in socioeconomic vulnerability conditions in Yucatan so they access and remain in their university studies. With the project, we want to back up 4 young students for a year on their way to achieving their vocations and completing their studies. We invite people to support our efforts to provide financial aid to our Youth. Through aid and the complementary programs of the organization, we make access and permanence in higher education possible.

title: Summer Workcamps free for teenagers from Romagna
description: We present an exciting opportunity for 30 young individuals from flood-affected areas in Romagna, Italy. Our project aims to provide them with a memorable summer camp experience, combining fun, education, and volunteering. By joining forces with Italian and international participants, these workcamps will allow them to temporarily escape their flood-impacted territories while engaging in meaningful activities. Importantly, this endeavor is entirely free of charge for all participants, relieving

title: Run for Calcutta Rescue - Amsterdam's marathon 23
description: Calcutta Rescue is an NGO that works to make life better for people living in the slums and on the streets of Kolkata, India. They provide free medical care for poor people, free education for their children, and skills training to help them to become self-reliant. With some friends, we are running the marathon and the semi-marathon in Amsterdam in October 2023 and thought it would be a good idea to raise some money for CR!

title: Education for Change: Guatemala's Brighter Future.
description: Ninos de Guatemala supports 3 schools that provide elementary and secondary quality education to children near Antigua Guatemala who cannot otherwise afford education. Our educational program curriculum has adopted a holistic approach that fosters academic, socio-emotional, nutrition, critical thinking and character formation programs. Our students grow and learn in a safe and joyful environment. Your donation goes towards learning materials, textbooks and nutritional foods for each school.

title: Food for Thought- Feeding Students in Rural Kenya
description: Funds are desperately needed to continue providing a nutritious daily lunch to the grade 8 students in our Prep for Success program who are preparing for a national gateway exam. The cost of food in Kenya has, at a minimum, quadrupled AND the number of students in our program has swelled from the typical 200 to over 265 this year because word of the academic success of the students in our program has spread! Your gift will help provide a DAILY lunch for EVERY STUDENT.

title: Baking for Independence
description: Support individuals like Ah Wei in pursuing dreams and overcoming obstacles. Your contribution helps them gain valuable skills, employment opportunities, and celebrate milestones. Together, let's make a difference, empowering people with intellectual disabilities to realize their full potential. Donate now and be part of their inspiring stories of resilience and determination.

title: Treatment support for burn children in Mongolia
description: There are a total of 9 districts in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. Each district treats burns at general hospitals, but most of them are sent to the burn department of the National Severe Trauma Center. In particular, Children account for the highest proportion of 70% ~80% of Burn patients. U9change will support moisturizers and burn ointments to heal burned children's scars who were admitted to the Intensive care unit and general ward of the National Severe Trauma Center in Mongolia.

title: Food for 1000 children's. at mkuzi secondary Schoo
description: The project is well dedicating to help 1000 students at mkuzi secondary School which they are suffering from absence of enough food especially at lunch time.The students are suffering since we are currently facing economic difficulties in lushoto district where by some of supporters who were supporting mkuzi secondary School has been bank rupted this has causing mkuzi secondary School children's to face hunger during their studies time which is hindering their education learnings.

title: LOSEV 2023 Eid-al-Adha/Kurban Campaign
description: "Every penny you donate has a great value and 290$ can buy 12 months of food for a child with Leukemia."  All our activities and programs are funded by donations and support of our volunteers and  donors. Among all our activities throughout the year, The Kurban Campaign, is of special importance for LOSEV. With Qurban donations, we provide and distribute much-needed fresh meat products to our children under cancer treatment and families in poverty in the next 12 months.

title: Response Food and Drought Crisis in Somalia
description: This project will increase long-term resilience to climate change, social crisis, and political crisis, for communities in Somalia. Across Somalia, millions of people are facing famine. Climate-crisis-induced drought, local conflict included communities displaced by Al-Shabaab, and impacts of the war in Ukraine and COVID-19. Your support to the Response Food and Drought Crisis in Somalia Project will provide emergency relief, food, water, medicine, and other essential supplies to people in need.

title: #BIPOCMentalHealthMatters: A W2W Fundraiser
description: In honor of BIPOC Mental Health Month, we are looking to sustain our impact supporting clinicians who work with historically marginalized communities, many of whom face the highest mortality during the COVID pandemic. Our recent efforts include launching the podcast "We Do Hope," a six-part series that presents easy-to-absorb material through a conversational format, briefly exploring topics such as chronic sorrow and self-compassion. With the help of our supporters, we aim to do even more.

title: Empowering Agents of Change to study in Yucatan
description: We believe in education as a way of generating better outcomes for the lives of all those who get it. Impulso Universitario works towards generating opportunities to receive higher education for young people in a situation of socio-economic disadvantage by providing financial aid and additional resources. Through our programs, the project also intends to create conditions for change in the communities of Yucatan, beginning with the students we support acting as catalyzers.

title: Accountability towards informal settlers in Nepal
description: PHASE Nepal works to uplift the livelihood, access to health and education; especially the vulnerable group of population. Through an accountability themed Project, PHASE Nepal has been conducting research among people living in informal settlement in three major cities of Nepal; Kathmandu, Pokhara, and Bhaktapur. It aims to assess the living condition, access to services of people and strengthen relationships between relevant stakeholders and improve accountability towards them.

title: Udhiyah/Qurbani for Orphans and IDPs in Nigeria
description: This project aimed to provide Eidl Adha Udhiyah/Qurbani and Eid clothes to at least 1,000 Orphans, less privileged families and Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) in Nigeria. The project will provide relief to those who need it the most, and give them a reason to celebrate happiest Eid.

title: Acces to education in El COCUY ( Colombia )
description: This project is about helping children from the El Carrizalito school attached to the main school of El Cocuy, Jose Santos Gutierrez.   One of the ain problems of this school is the need of new options to have a better development of education. Currently the school has a technology room which has 2 old computers.    In order to be able to help them with fiber optic internet and electronic devices. In this way improve education in places far from cities such as the Cocouy in Boyaca, Colombia.

title: Educate a nurse in Infection Control & Prevention
description: The certificate in infection control and prevention is co-designed building on our projects on:  1. Expanding use of video technology to improve midlevel health care providers infection control management in rural/urban health care setting in Uganda" we developed 25 videos and accompanying script for education communication and research (https://luziibangi.org/) 2. Re-enforcing COVID-19 risk communication in Uganda  3. Situation analysis of infection prevention and control in Uganda 2023, MOH

title: Project to create a cybercafe in Kparatao
description: The cybercafe project will make it possible to alleviate the difficulties of the populations, particularly young people, by creating a Multi Services which offers individuals various services ranging from the cybercafe to word processing, including photocopying, document binding, scanning, training in computers, screen printing etc. This project will be carried out in Kparatao with qualified technical staff to boost the development of the targets, in particular the young people of the community.

title: Feeding Community Facing Food Insecurity
description: Our mission is clear: to feed those impacted by food insecurity, while tackling the challenges of the climate crisis head-on. With love and care, we're cultivating a movement stewarded by our QTBIPOC community. From growing and sharing food to saving and exchanging seeds, and hosting empowering trainings and workshops, we're sowing seeds of change.

title: Veterinary Equipment Fund
description: This project aims to procure a portable digital x-ray system that will play a vital role in assessing wildlife injuries in situations where transporting animals to a veterinary clinic is not feasible. The system will revolutionize wildlife healthcare by providing immediate access to high-quality imaging capabilities, improving injury assessment accuracy through digital imaging, and enhancing treatment outcomes by enabling timely intervention based on accurate diagnosis.

title: Mental Health among informal settlers in Nepal
description: PHASE Nepal, a non-governmental organization dedicated to improving health, education, and livelihood opportunities in remote and disadvantaged communities of Nepal, has undertaken a significant research initiative through the ARISE Responsive Fund. This research focuses on understanding the unique challenges faced by people living in informal settlements in three major cities of Nepal: Kathmandu, Pokhara, and Bhaktapur.

title: Provide Food & Learning for War Victim Children
description: Help provide food and learning will strive to reach children in Ethiopian Regions such as Amhara, Afar and Tigray through the integrated education and child immunity program which attempts to integrate fundamental services in health, primary education, child care and psycho-social development.  We plan to support amazing projects that help the lives of war victim children and schools from across different regions of the country by repairing damaged school learning materials and purchasing new.

title: Environmental Education For Better Life
description: Hazara Khyber is an area in Pakistan that has a rich and diverse landscape, with the immense beauty and abundant wildlife. The area has a big population with very little conservation education, this has created a problem with litter, over-use and poaching.  A team of 22 volunteer are going to take on this challenge and run:  1. Environmental and Awareness campaigns for children and adults. 2. Implement practical projects such as litter clean-ups and upcycling.

title: Water Access in the Context of Poverty in Mexico
description: This project will implement Rainwater-Collecting Systems for 250 families living in human settelments along 6 States in Mexico. Today 56 million people in this country live in poverty situation, whit your donation we can bring to them the access to clean water! With this Rainwater-Collecting Systems they can colleted  16,800 liters of water per year.

title: Empowering Girls: STEAM Through game & creativity
description: In Costa Rica, due to the culture and socially imposed roles, women only cover less than 10% of the total space in STEAM degrees. If we get them to see themselves reflected in activities related to innovation and technology careers from a young age, we can start a movement to reduce the gender gap in career choice and the job market. Ninas Hacia El Espacio program uses the game to promote the involvement of girls in Costa Rica in STEAM areas. With your support we can make it possible.

title: Empower 2500 girls in Tanzania: Sew self made pads
description: The project aims at teaching 2500 girls from rural areas in Tanzania how to make their own reusable sanitary pads using locally available materials. The project will provide girls with a sustainable, affordable, and eco-friendly alternative to disposable menstrual products. On top of that, it will not only help girls in managing their periods with dignity, but also educate them about sustainability, health, and hygiene, and encourage them to take responsibility for their own well-being.

title: A dignified life for the forgotten girls of India
description: Rajasthan, India. Thousands of girls inherit HIV at birth. From the poorest caste, at the age of 6 or 7 they see their parents die from the virus. They do not appear in any registry and the rest of their families disowns them... they are invisible. Alone, with nothing, hungry and afraid, they wander the city until the virus destroys their immune system and they fall ill in the ditch of some road. Help us giving them a Home, Medical care, Feeding, and Schooling... Help us giving them a LIFE...

title: LGBTQ Education for Parents, Social Media Campaign
description: LGBTQ-affirming parenting is the most significant way to reduce LGBTQ youth suicide. Social media platforms offer a powerful means to impact LGBTQ education for parents. Social media provides a space for diverse voices within the LGBTQ community and allies to share personal stories, resources, and educational content. Mama Dragons will use platforms like Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram to create a dedicated campaign that focuses on providing information and support for parents.

title: Aid for children and families Flood Dominican Rep.
description: Flooding across the Dominican Republic in June 2023 has affected at least 1,500 families. The government has declared a national emergency as the floods and destroyed homes, crops, and livestock. At least 300 people are in need of shelter. Your donation to the Dominican Republic Flood Relief Fund will provide immediate and long-term relief in affected communities.

title: Emergency Response - UKRAINE: Kakhovka Dam Crisis
description: Destruction of dam displaces thousands as landmines float downstream  A critical dam on the frontline of the Ukraine conflict was destroyed on Tuesday, June 6, 2023, on the eve of an expected Ukrainian counter-offensive. Huge quantities of water surged downriver from the hydroelectric Kakhovka Dam, which holds back the Kakhovka reservoir on the Dnipro river, providing drinking water and electricity to the Dnipro, Kherson and Zaprozhzhia regions in Ukraine.

title: Fund to Support Victims of the Beirut Explosion
description: It has been three years since the horrific explosion in Beirut, which killed at least 228 people, injured 7,000, damaged or destroyed 77,000 homes or businesses, and displaced 300,000 people. Three years later, the injured continue to die or suffer from trauma and physical wounds, while families of victims, still grieving, are unable to cover their basic needs due to the economic and financial collapse. This fund will provide support to those left behind by continued governmental negligence.

title: Dam Collapse Relief for Survivors in Ukraine
description: Join the urgent fundraiser to support survivors of a dam break on the Dnipro River in Ukraine! The Hydroelectric Dam in the occupied city of Nova Kakhovka in Kherson region was damaged by Russian military troops and the wall collapsed on June 6th. Millions of tons of water rushed down from the reservoir, destroying everything in its path. We are collecting now humanitarian aid needed to survive, mitigate risks and restore houses for people affected by this disaster.

title: Kakhovka Dam. Help Ukrainian Red Cross save people
description: 700,000 people are affected due to the destruction of the Kakhovka dam. They require essentials: clean drinking water, food, clothes and hygiene basics. 16,000 people are in the critical flood zone and need evacuation. The Ukrainian Red Cross is working both at the site and throughout Ukraine to help the affected population and alleviate their suffering.

title: Technology for students in rural Morocco
description: This project will help students in the High Atlas Mountains to take control of their learning. We are equipping our study centre programme with 25 extra computers for students who will benefit from access to online learning materials. Traditional textbooks can be costly, limited and shared among many. Digital connectivity will give these students a chance to enhance their studies, improve exam grades and prepare them for the future workplace. The project will also benefit primary school pupils.

title: Ukraine: Urgent Appeal for Help for Flooded Areas
description: The horrifying destruction of Ukraine's Nova Kakhovka dam on June 6th is potentially an ecological disaster. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy condemned the incident as mass environmental damage. People have died, many have lost their homes, and access to food and water is limited. As floods sweep the region, people need urgent access to essentials! We help affected people access the basics for survival, such as food, water and medicines.

title: Humanitarian support for the children of Haiti
description: UNICEF estimates 4 million children are in need of urgent support in Haiti, as they face the compounding crises of gang violence and civil unrest, internal displacement, malnutrition and food insecurity, and the resurgence of cholera. UNICEF and partners will work to ensure access to basic goods and continuity of services including essential vaccinations, screening and treatment for malnutrition, protection from violence, continued learning opportunities and access to safe water and hygiene.

title: Help Provide Veterinary Care for Vulnerable Horses
description: Horses that come into SEO's care from neglect cases are some of the most vulnerable animals you may ever see. Each year, we budget an estimated amount of funds to be set aside to cover the myriad of veterinary needs the horses may have. This year, that need has far outpaced our budget. Funds raised will allow us to continue to offer the much-needed veterinary services.

title: Elevating the Empowerment Experience
description: Each year, Dress for Success Sydney helps over 2,500 women across NSW regain financial independence from our 3 showrooms in Sydney, Illawarra, and Newcastle-Hunter.   Over the last 3 years, an increase in demand for our services mean we are no longer able to help women without moving.   This EOFY give generously to help us, help more women transform their lives across NSW. We're raising funds for both the Sydney and Illawarra showrooms and need your donation to support this move.

title: Educate One Empower Thousands 2023
description: We aim to raise $13,500 to assist three young women complete their higher education. We believe that these bright and motivated women have the potential to empower members of their communities and improve the lives of many. Higher education is vital for assisting these young women into leadership roles to ultimately enact life-changing policies in their communities. It is a critical time in Myanmar and we need your support now more than ever!

title: Bridging The Gap; Providing Identity For All
description: Identity is crucial to one's well-being and is their right as defined by the law. However, the process of obtaining a Special CNIC (SCNIC) for persons with disabilities is tedious and can take up to 12 weeks. To facilitate the process, NOWPDP conducts One-Window Camps that reduce the time taken to process an SCNIC to 1 day. Through this fundraiser, we aim to transform the lives of 125 PWDs by empowering them in seeking their identity and becoming equal citizens of the law.

title: Ukraine Dam Disaster Relief
description: Our Angels of Hope team has been on the ground in Kherson since Tuesday, June 6 responding to the destruction of the Nova Kakhovka dam and hydroelectric station on the Dnipro River in southern Ukraine.

title: Let's help teens like Mauricio to finish school
description: Mauricio (23) came to our re-entry school from an alcohol and drug rehabilitation home at the age of 16 without knowing how to read or write. Despite not having the support of his family and living alone, he made it through thanks to the academic, economic and emotional help he received from  Hogar de Cristo. We need your support to replicate Mauricio's success story and provide an opportunity to hundreds of teens.

title: Crisis Intervention for Girls in Transmara, Kenya
description: This project will provide rescue, rehabilitation, and reintegration services for children in acute danger of female genital mutilation (FGM), child marriage, and gender-based violence.

title: Clean Drinking Water for Urban and rural  in Egypt
description: This project seeks to provide  clean potable water for neediest people in urban and rural areas  in Egypt. Approximately 60% of rural Moroccans lack piped potable water. Unhealthy drinking water causes frighteningly high infant mortality (many families lose half their children to water-borne diseases), shorter life spans and reduced energy for livelihoods. Further, time spent to procure non-potable water adds to the already substantial burden of women and girls and prevents their participation i

title: Medicine to lushoto dispensary.
description: The project which is being implemented by green land Group is focusing and dedicating to serve 10000 members of lushoto district who are in lushoto district dispensary. This is due to the fact that lushoto district dispensary is facing lack of enough medical boxes,few beds for woman's during birth moment this has made and create more than 1000 deaths of children's and woman's who are dying during birth moment.

title: Reading Coaches
description: The Adult Literacy Trust is seeking support towards our volunteer-supported programme Reading Coaches, to strengthen the literacy of disadvantaged adults. We believe that literacy is a right, not a privilege, and want every adult to have access to this critical life skill. Complementing formal teaching in over-crowded community classrooms, the programme will help to accelerate reading progress for  disadvantaged adult learners, supported by trained volunteers recruited from local communities.

title: Provide 3 Dairy Cows For Milk To Tanzanian orphans
description: This project will provide 3 milk cows to the Mwaji Secondary School in Tanzania. This school educates orphans to give them opportunities to have a better life. These cows will provide milk to the students. Due to persistent rural poverty with drought, food shortages, and and lack of available milk,  it is difficult to source milk for the students. Having dairy cows provides a consistent source of necessary nutrition for the orphan students so they are able to concentrate in learning at school.

title: Improve the future for over 150 Cambodia Children
description: Our project will support over 150 Cambodian Children to achieve a better life through our school, Dolphin school of English. For 8 years, we've helped vulnerable and disadvantaged children from poor families in Kratie. By working with the registered NGO of 28 years, the Khmer Association for Development of Countryside (KAFDOC), DSE will continue to teach English, along with Maths, Khmer, agriculture studies, music, and IT to 150 students .

title: Welfare Support for Cameroon's Political Prisoners
description: This fundraiser will provide basic humanitarian needs for thousands of mostly Southern Cameroonian prisoners of Conscience arrested from 2017 till date. They are being held by the Cameroon regime in horrendous conditions in the aftermath of protest initiated by teachers and lawyers. The crisis has now degenerated into a full blown war for basic rights of the minority English-speaking people. VRF will work in collaboration with ReleaseThem Campaign Team to identify and prioritize these needs.

title: Help Us Upgrade 350 Chairs for Safer Learning
description: Help us provide a safe learning environment for 300+ girls at our tuition-free academy in Monrovia. Your donation will fund the purchase of 350 durable and pest-resistant plastic chairs, ensuring a conducive space for quality education and empowering these girls to become leaders in their community. Join us in creating a brighter future through safe and comfortable learning environments.

title: 2DegreesC Crowdsourced Climate Data Sensor Fund
description: This project supports our mission to deploy climate sensors in remote areas that are presently underserved by the existing network of climate observations. The lack of detailed data about the weather and environment in these areas prevents us from fully understanding the impact of climate change on these communities, including the biodiversity that call these areas home. Or purpose with partners is to distribute sensors globally in remote areas on land, and using our UNESCO project in the ocean.

title: The Imago Foundation - Build a school in Malawi
description: The Imago Foundation will build and run a nursery and primary school in the village of Namaso in Mangochi, Malawi which will provide education to around 350 children once complete. The school will deliver a tailored curriculum comprised of theoretical and practical knowledge for the best chance of understanding the world we live in.

title: Puerto Rico's Food Sovereignty Fund
description: As an effort to support the sector that is in charge of the arduous task of feeding Puerto Rico's population, we launched the Food Sovereignty Fund.  Its goal is to aid farmers and fishers that have suffered losses due to natural disasters and tropical climate events and also minimize future loss. The Food Sovereignty Fund consists of providing economic support through grants, voluntary work brigades, and the just recovery of the agricultural landscape.

title: OVD-Info: stop political persecutions in Russia
description: OVD-Info is an independent media project on human rights and political persecutions in Russia. We provide and coordinate legal assistance in cases related to the restrictions of freedom of peaceful assembly and study the emerging problems this helps both to develop tactical solutions for today, and to lay the foundation for future changes. By donating to OVD-Info, you contribute both to the support of specific people and to changing the whole picture of human rights observance in Russia.

title: Offline Computer Lab for Children
description: This project will provide an offline computer Lab for Children in remote Pre-schools in Sierra Leone and provides educational technology learning to children that dose not have a consistent access to internet and computers. This project will focuses on the setting up physical computers lab in community schools where the children can able to learn and explore computer skills and applications offline and the project seeks to bridge the digital divide and ensure equal opportunities for every child.

title: Queen Rearing: Save a Greek Bee
description: Bees are vital to our health and the environment. 71/100 of plants which are responsible for 90% of the global food supply rely upon the bee-pollinators. Queen Rearing Program completely transforms beekeeping in Greece by optimizing the regional genetic material to develop more resilient and productive bee colonies, while youth in the Greek provinces secure a career. The program secures our ecosystem's protection but also its empowerment and resistance towards the challenging climate conditions.

title: The Lighthouse Baby Shelter
description: The Lighthouse Baby Shelter takes care of orphaned, neglected, abused, and abandoned children who range from little babies to 17 years of age. The Lighthouse also has a door in the garden wall, called 'THE MOSES BASKET' where unwanted babies can be placed anonymously, which has saved so many lives. We need your help to cover their needs this winter!

title: Summer Meals for Philly Kids
description: For kids and families who depend on free and reduced-cost school meals, it can be challenging to provide these additional meals over the summer months - especially here in Philadelphia where kids experience food insecurity at a rate of 25.5%. That's double the national average.  At the Coalition Against Hunger we work to ensure Philly kids have access to free, healthy meals throughout the summer by operating a live Summer Meals Hotline and maintaining a Summer Meals Map for our 5-county area.

title: Casa de Maria y el Nino: an ALLIANCE FOR CHILDHOOD
description: Casa de Maria y el Nino has restored children's rights for over 40 years, giving them hope and care. Today, we face a crucial moment of transformation and adaptation to the new realities: According to Colombian law, institutions like ours (for children aged 0 to 8 years) will cease to operate, and the beneficiary children will be placed in foster homes. Therefore we will redirect all our efforts towards a new mission: supporting pregnant or breastfeeding mothers in situations of vulnerability.

title: Together weaving paths to never forget
description: Imagine awakening to a world where all you are and all you know has vanished, lost in a haze of forgotten memories. This haunting reality awaits countless individuals as our population grows and ages, ushering in a surge of dementia cases, specifically Alzheimer's. However, hope emerges on the horizon, brought forth by Fundacion MyA. Together, we can weave a brighter tapestry of life for those affected by this devastating condition and their dedicated caregivers.

title: Support St. Andrew's International School
description: Founded in 1948, St Andrew's has a long and proud tradition of providing an education of the highest quality to our students. Our reputation for Ethics and Excellence is recognized nationally, regionally and internationally, with many of our graduates going on to study at the world's leading universities, including: Yale, Harvard, Stanford, Brown, McGill, Queen's, Vassar, and many others.

title: Help Vulnerable Kids Enroll and Remain in School
description: Do you take your kids to school or see community members taking their kids to the bus stop every school day? In Liberia, many children do  have this opportunity. UNESCO reports that Liberia has one of the highest rates of out-of-school children globally, particularly girls. Tragically, many of these children struggle with abuse and neglect with no hope for the future. However, you have the power to make a difference. Through your donation, we will support these vulnerable children today.

title: Primary Healthcare Center
description: Your donation to our Primary Healthcare Center in Syria makes a tangible difference in the lives of thousands affected by the war, providing vital medical care, addressing urgent healthcare needs, and offering hope and resilience to a community in need.

title: Save the Temminck's Pangolin in South Africa
description: Pangolins are facing a crisis, but it is not too late to save them! This project is to ensure the survival of the Temminck's pangolin in South Africa, by providing the rescue, rehabilitation, release and monitoring that an individual pangolin must go through so they may be successfully released back into the wild. Be part of the movement committed to giving these amazing animals a second chance in life.

title: Cancer Care for Children in Bangladesh
description: We are currently working with seven government hospitals to improve paediatric oncology services in Bangladesh. We also working with International Children's Palliative Care Network to improve services for children with life-limiting conditions requiring palliative care.  It's estimated that around 9,000 to 12,000 children develop cancer in Bangladesh every year. However, unfortunately, only one third receive a proper diagnosis.

title: Improve lives of young Zulu dancers
description: 3 out of 5 children in rural areas in South Arica face lives of poverty. Young underprivileged children between the ages of 6 and 14 years of age walk miles from their rural homes, to reach the area where they spend their day training in Zulu dance to perform outside Hluhluwe Wildlife Park. Often, they have no lunch, or shelter from rain. Our project will provide meals, and studio shelter for arts, dance, and conservation, to empower them to be leaders while expanding their talent nationally.

title: Help a child begin school in rural Ghana
description: Our community learning centers provide young children with the opportunity to attend school in rural Northern Ghana. Each child receives a daily lunch, school uniform, and learning supplies. Classes, taught by local teachers, use environmental and cultural themes. With your help, we can begin two new kindergarten classes. In our partner communities, adult literacy is low and parents greatly value the opportunity to send their children to school.

title: Dreamfactory: Empower & Create to Sustain
description: The Dreamfactory, empowers marginalized individuals by providing social employment and a creative recycling makerspace, tackling unemployment and waste in Curacao, while fostering a sustainable and inclusive community.

title: Help the victims of child slavery in India
description: When we started our Rescue Centre (Rescue Junction) we quickly became involved in rescuing child labourers from all over India. Over the years we have rescued more than two thousand child labourers sometimes a hundred at a time or just one child.  We have reunited them with families, got them back in mainstream education, and supported them with care and protection restoring their childhoods which were stolen from them. We need your help to reach out and help more children in slavery.

title: Formula and Baby WASH for the babies in Ethiopia
description: MHO is among a few NGOs in Ethiopia that provides unique pivotal loving Day drop services for children of poor mother . Every day MHO reached out  homeless women and children in Addis Ababa and Bahir Dar who have been  forced to live  street for a variety of reasons, including abject poverty,  GBV persecution  , family breakdown, Parental deaths, parental neglect, and other social. There are 130 impoverished mothers and 250 children presently sheltered In MHO  rehabilitation In A.A and Bahir Dar

title: Early Intervention Service Program
description: Since 1994, Eden Social Welfare Foundation has seen the difficulties of families with developmentally delayed children. Now, Eden enters its 30th year of providing early childhood intervention. Through daycare, hourly care, in-home, and community-based services, we develop individualized programs for each child and teach parents home care and care-giving skills. This helps developmentally delayed children grow up healthily and also eases the burden on the family.

title: Solar Power for 10 health care centres  In Uganda
description: Currently, 70% of public health centres in rural communities in Uganda do not have access to electricity of which 3 out of every 4 health centres are without access to reliable power,1 in 4 health facilities in rural communities are without access to any power at all. This Project will provide health care facilities with installation of 1200 W solar panels, 20 kWh batteries of powered lighting system for 10 health centres in the vulnerable communities to handle emergency health situations,

title: Reproductive health for girls and women in Kenya
description: This project supports reproductive health for girls and women in Nairobi and two rural towns. We offer free counselling, screening, pregnancy care and general medical care. We work together with local partners, train our partners and pay for the treatment of our needy patients. By supporting girls and women we stabilize the society and offer sustainable support according to the SDGs 1,3,5,10,17 by the UN.

title: "Child space" - Help children from IDP families
description: The project supports the work of two Children's Spaces for children from families of internally displaced persons in the city of Odessa and the urban-type settlement of Ovidiopol. Thanks to your support and donations, children will have access to quality educational activities and psychological support! During the year, more than 500 children will improve their psycho-emotional state and raise their educational level!

title: Scholarship for Girl Education.
description: Increasing the scholastic achievement of girls is a challenge in much of the developing world. The research study show that the scholarship program has a large, positive effect on the school enrollment and attendance of girls. Scholarships give promising learner an opportunity to pursue their education regardless of their financial circumstances. In order to help learners, Kamboo Project is providing the budget to a female learner to continue with their schooling without worries families.

title: Food for all
description: This project will offer 10,000 additional nutritious, cooked meals to displaced and homeless people in Athens, Greece. At the moment we offer 250 meals per day.  As we are witnessing the need to increase the portions, we are increasing the served number of meals.  Our goal is to reach the 350 portions on daily basis. Help us support more people in need to access healthy meals contributing to their physical, mental and emotional health.

title: Empower Tibetans to Build Sustainable Livelihoods
description: The project will reduce poverty and food shortages for vulnerable Tibetan refugee families - approximately 1,150 people - in the Solukhumbu District of Nepal. By creating food generation and livelihood opportunities through agricultural support and training, and providing skills building and vocational training to support Tibetans to either set up their own businesses or find gainful employment, the project will support the families to build self-sufficient sustainable livelihoods.

title: "Alimento al Futuro: Un plato a la vez"
description: The Boys & Girls Clubs of Puerto Rico food program has managed to distribute almost half a million plates of meals since its creation in 2019. This program guarantees food for over 12,000 children and youth that we impact annually through our 11 service centers from Mayaguez to Vieques. Through this program we ensure that participants have access to nutritious and balanced meals that help them focus on their education and personal development.

title: Spreading Joys - Biporjoy Cyclone Affected
description: This is no Joy in Biporjoy Cycolne. The Biporjoy cyclone was very devastating and affected people in Gujarat; mainly in Saurashtra and Kutch regions on 15th June 2023. This severe cyclonic storm with a maximum sustained wind speed of 125-135 kmph. Many poor people lost their Kacchha houses in this cyclone. The poor people and people with disabilities have lost their livelihood means, BPA has intiaiated relief work in affected areas by providing Ration kits, assistive devices, and livelihood.

title: Support 15 disabled children attending pre-school.
description: This project will help 15 children with disabilities who have both mobility and financial challenges to have access to Early Childhood Development services at the center through a scholarship scheme. The scholarship will cover transport costs from home to the center, meals, and other care at the center. parents will be required to contribute to the school uniforms.

title: Solar Water Pump And Irrigation Project
description: The purpose of the project is to increase access to portable solar water pumps for 400 smallholder farmers in Chipata and katete Districts, in Eastern Province of Zambia

title: Mayon Volcano Eruption Emergency Response
description: Children and their families affected by the Mayon volcano eruption need your help!   The June 13 Mayon volcano eruption has forced more than 13,000 residents, including small children, to take refuge in 22 evacuation centers in Albay province. We are providing immediate and lifesaving  assistance including multipurpose cash assistance, psychosocial support, and support for learning continuity for affected learners.

title: Restore Hope: Help Us Relocate Our Accra Store
description: Providing sustainable income generating opportunities for women continues to be the driving force behind our work. One of the most significant ways we do this is through operating our fair trade retail store in Accra, Ghana. Global Mamas depends on this store for nearly 25% of our annual revenue. It is crucial to our mission of providing a steady, predictable income to the Mamas. Sadly, we were unable to renew our store lease due to the deterioration of the building.

title: Zaragosa Home for Abandoned Elders
description: Hogar Giuseppe Angelucci in Zaragosa, El Salvador is a home for abandoned older people - those who have been left on the streets and have no family. The facility has 30 beds, but police drop off people  regularly and now there are 47 people! Dilapidated couches line the main room, regular cleaning is needed as well as a new refrigerator, freezer, fans, pans, bedding and a few TV's. Residents are provided with two meals a day and a medical team comes regularly, but this home is in dire need.

title: Protect 50,000 families from exploitation
description: Millions of people in South Asia are migrant workers, forced to travel large distances to find daily wage work in sectors such as construction, agriculture and domestic work.  This kind of insecure work is often the only choice for people from excluded communities who are typically landless and rarely have access to education or vocational skills.  Karuna is working with local partner organisations with well-established networks in areas that are especially vulnerable to exploitation.

title: Support Social Learning For Kids With Disabilities
description: Through My Eyes is working to inspire change and create a shift in the narrative  surrounding persons with disabilities in Kenya. One way we intend to achieve  this is to build an inclusive play center for disabled kids. This center will hold up to 250 kids and be a warm, welcoming home where the kids will receive personalized care  with the intent of improving their personal, social & emotional skills. We are intent in making sure  that a child with a disability lives to their full potential.

title: Help fund a porridge kitchen for children in Kenya
description: Increasing food prices and climate change have caused a spike in malnutrition among vulnerable children in Kakamega County, Kenya. Children not yet in school are unable to benefit from free school meals and often go without a meal. The Nasio Trust's porridge kitchen would ensure that children do not go hungry and lead healthy lives.

title: Support 20 young leaders to change Latam's future
description: Improve Latin America's future by investing in its next generation. Sponsor 20 Latin Americans from 14-20 y/o to enroll in a lifelong development community. Students committed to social impact will join our Leadership Camps during the next 12-18 months to discover their leadership potential, connect with their purpose and expand their networks. After the program, they'll enter LALA's community, where they'll get access to a network of worldwide changemakers, mentorship, professional opportunitie

title: Care for Wildlife at the Virginia Living Museum
description: The Virginia Living Museum is a leader in LIVING exhibits. It provides a home for 1,000 native animals representing 180 species of mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, and fish, including threatened and endangered species. Many animals have been rehabilitated and deemed un-releasable by veterinary professionals. Fully accredited, the Museum provides the animals a safe environment and enriching, natural habitats while they serve as ambassadors of their species - delighting & educating guests.

title: Rebuilding Brazilian schools Cyclone Relief Fund
description: This project will focus on rebuilding schools heavily impacted by a natural disaster in south of Brazil.  Elementary School Nossa Senhora de Fatima and Preschool Soneca had lost most of its facilities due to the strongest extratropical cyclone in Santo Antonio da Patrulha since 1961; We aim to rebuild school`s facilities, furnish classrooms, a new library, purchase IT equipment and focus on expanding the resources to increase number of full-time program capacity to help most vulnerable kids.

title: Defy the Taliban, Coding Classes for Afghan Girls
description: Currently, the Underground TechSheroes Program serves over 100 girls and women between 14 and 25 years of age. We provide all training and financial support for teachers who run these secret courses from their homes. These inspiring young women and teachers are actively working to undo the damage of Taliban rule on themselves and their communities.  The current program spans 3 to 6 months, starting with basic computer skills and ending with advanced back and front-end coding.

title: House of Life Mama and Baby Shelter - San Salvador
description: Life for many Salvadoran girls can be fraught with sexual violence by family members and the problem is little talked about.  The House of Life Mama and Baby Shelter will be a safe haven where 30 pregnant, abused teens can heal, have healthy babies and learn how to bond and care for their babies, and about their human right to live in an abuse-free environment. ThIs will be the first such shelter in the country as there is currently no adequate place to send pregnant teens in El Salvador.

title: Support Mt. Mayon evacuees in the Philippines
description: The ongoing threat of catastrophic eruption of Mt. Mayon has a devastating impact on the lives of over 39,000 individuals from eight towns, forcing them to evacuate their homes. The CDRC and its regional partner TABI are actively monitoring the situation and urgently seeking assistance to support the affected communities. Your donation can provide vital aid, including food, clean water, medical assistance, and essential supplies. Let us come together to make a difference in their lives.

title: Help 150 Communities Plan and Design Their Future
description: This project will produce an open source tangible and digital dissemination toolkit that offers communities an educational and methodological resource for participatory planning, organization, and design for them to facilitate their own community projects. Our goal is to produce 150 Community Toolkits islandwide.

title: Biparjoy Hits Fishermen of Keti Bundar!
description: Cyclone Biparjoy has left the already extremely vulnerable fishermen's families of Keti Bandar, Sindh,  paralyzed and abandoned - like fish washed on land.  They live without fulfillment of even their basic needs for food and shelter.  NHSD is distributing food rations in the area. Please help in reconstruction of fishing huts and distribution of food rations. NHSD has previously worked in Tharparkar during last year's floods. We wish to carry it forward to these vulnerable populations.

title: Educate Local Leaders for Community Development
description: Your gift empowers local leaders directing six grassroots change initiatives in communities in Latin America and Africa. Leaders will receive training, tools, and ongoing mentorship to develop skills needed for success: strategic planning, financial management, fundraising, program implementation, etc. Programs develop culturally appropriate solutions for impoverished communities, and include women's empowerment in South Sudan, financial literacy in Guatemala, water access in Kenya, and others.

title: Building Works To Flood-Proof Our Animal Hospital
description: TOLFA has experienced significant flooding and structural damage from the annual monsoon as well as  unseasonable weather events since 2019. A result of climate change in the desert region of India in which we are based, these conditions are proving challenging in many ways. We have raised the floor level of some of our kennels and buildings, but require more funds to complete this work across our hospital and shelter. Severe flooding affects our sick & injured animals as well as our staff.

title: Bountiful heritages: Protecting Pakistani Peacocks
description: When one considers vibrant colors, a peacock is a notable example. This creature is a native of the country and holds social and cultural importance for the people. It is also a very sensitive creature. Unfortunately, due to decreased environmental protection, and increasing occurrences of Newcastle disease, peacocks are becoming an endangered species in the country. This project focuses on enclosures for the protection of the remainder peacock species against environmental and other threats.

title: Support build classes , dormitories  for boarders
description: This project will raise funds to build classrooms and dormitories at Entebbe Bright Christian School to meet the growing numbers of vulnerable students. The facility will support learners to study in a conducive learning environment that suits the minimum standards of the ministry of education & sports in Uganda.

title: Fighting Deforestation Using Coconut Husk Charcoal
description: The Advocacy Initiative for Development (AID) and Intellico ECO have formed a strategic partnership to combat deforestation in Sierra Leone by harnessing the potential of coconut waste. Our project aims to promote the use of coconut husk waste charcoal as a sustainable and environmentally-friendly alternative to wood-based fuel. Through empowerment, education, and community engagement, we seek to address the pressing issue of deforestation while promoting sustainable livelihoods.

title: Take Action for Refugees in Europe
description: We are raising urgent funds to help the women, men and children living in extreme poverty having become refugees. As they journey through Europe, in hope of safety and a new home, refugees face unfathomable hostility and even violence. Knowing this is wrong we work passionately to help ensure each person can access their daily needs for life.

title: Provision of Safe Drinking Water with Water Filter
description: The lack of access to safe, clean drinking water and proper sanitation is a pressing issue in Sierra Leone. With only 6% of the population having access to improved sanitation and 55% to drinking water, there is an urgent need to address this challenge. This project aims to provide water filters to communities in Sierra Leone, promoting safe drinking water and improving overall health and well-being. By focusing on water filtration, education, and hygiene promotion, we strive to enhance the qual

title: Love, Care. Educate and Empower 40 Girls in India
description: This project  provides a safe shelter home and nurturing environment for girls who have been abandoned , trafficked, abused or neglected by their families or society.  Provide  Education, healthcare,  counseling, life skills  and vocational training for the girls, helping them to develop their skills and become self-reliant and confident members of society. Support and sponsor  girls to complete from their formal high school  education to professional Graduation courses to secure employment

title: Support the Needs of 100 Orphans in Northern Syria
description: Support the basic necessities of 100 orphans in northern Syria for a month for $35! Your sponsorship will help provide them with social care, psychological support, and educational guidance.

title: Empowering Her: Shattering Taboos, Far West, Nepal
description: This project aims to empower adolescent girls in Dilasaini rural municipality by providing menstrual health education, enhancing access to hygiene resources, and combating stigma. It includes training on sanitary pad kits, installing dispensers in schools and communities, conducting awareness campaigns, and addressing harmful traditions. With 50% of the funding support from the rural municipality's government, the project aims to improve girls' school attendance by addressing social barriers.

title: Farming Tools for 200 Refugee Youths at Adjumani
description: This project will provide farming tools (Hoe, Watering Can, Panga, Gumboot, Rake,), seeds including high yielding vegetable seeds as well as critical modern farming knowledge to 200 refugee youths at Adjumani refugee settlement of Uganda to help them produce their own food and earn income. The goal is to promote self reliance and address acute food shortages among refugee households. Targeted Youths are child mothers, child heads of households, orphaned youths, those with disabilities.

title: Future for Buds Network
description: The BUDS Network project, established in 2007, was a program designed to provide care and support to children living with HIV/AIDS. A group was formed between these children and other willing, able members of the community, in order to reduce social stigma and discrimination and build support networks. The project focuses on three main areas; educational progression, physical education and life-skills.

title: Food, water and healthcare for Ugandan children
description: MCANAAN FOUNDATION ORPHAN AND NEEDY CHILD DEVELOPMENT provides care for 45 children either orphaned or from vulnerable homes that risk child abandonment in Uganda.  We provide the children with food, necessities, good education, clothing and medical care.  We need to build good structures to house our children properly with clean water. We've created agricultural/poultry farming and a sewing vocational school for sustainability but we're lacking resources to be efficient providing for them.

title: Give them Chance , Give them Hope
description: Alorman Developed schools provide high quality school education to rural children in Egypt who cannot otherwise access or afford it. The schools adopt a nurturing, holistic approach to education, helping children learn joyfully. 64% of the children get full equal treatment. Your donation goes towards critical infrastructure like learning material classrooms, school bus, etc. for 10 Alorman developed  rural schools & Govt. Schools Support Program.

title: Help 300 children learn personal development progr
description: This project will support 300 street and needy children to access our talent and personal development education program. These children come at our center with no hope, poor behaviors, depression etc but most importantly with more inner potential to shape their future. Our program helps them to know themsleves; strength and opportunities and the ways to transform their lives. Children are able to identify, develop and full-fill their potential starting from their talents and shaping their charac

title: Empower 350 Indigenous Youth in Guatemala
description: Do you believe that every person has innate talents that deserve to flourish? We do. At the Atz'umak training center, Mayan instructors provide unique opportunities for local youth to cultivate those talents in a series of wide-ranging trainings on conservation, development, climate resilience, and leadership skills. With your support, 350 Mayan youth and young adults will benefit from these empowering opportunities that support sustainable livelihoods with equity, justice, and solidarity.

title: Pollinator Protectors
description: Native pollinators are necessary to ensure healthy habitats and foods for people. However, native pollinators and the plants they rely on face significant habitat loss and other threats, including pesticide impacts and a changing climate. In parallel, due to government and corporate policies, many marginalized neighborhoods have been cut off from healthy, thriving biodiversity. ESC works with local residents and leaders to restore pollinator habitats and bring biodiversity back to communities.

title: A Decade of Dreams: Empower Show Me the World!
description: Celebrate 10 years of Show Me the World Project! With your support, we've ignited curiosity, inspired exploration & brought equity to global travel for over 100 student leaders. Help us break barriers, broaden perspectives, and empower youth from under resourced communities through global travel & educational programs. Your donation funds scholarships, program expansions, and outreach initiatives, ensuring life-changing journeys as we fundraise to support 100 more students in honor of 10 years!

title: Cycle of Hope: Empowering Refugees through Bicycle
description: The "Cycle of Hope" project aims to make a positive impact on the lives of Syrian refugee students in Lebanon by providing them with bicycles as a mean of transportation to school and a source of entertainment .  This initiative recognizes the profound importance of bicycles and new schoolbags in promoting their physical and emotional well-being, fostering social integration, and empowering them to explore new opportunities.

title: Life Skills-Based Education for Girls
description: This project furthers Zindagi Trust's commitment to creating a holistic and contextually relevant life skill-based curriculum at both our adopted schools and all across Pakistan. The programme involves teacher training, contextually relevant resource-building materials for teachers and students, and engaging activities for students. The program aims to impact 3200 girls empowering them with skills to deal with the challenges of daily life and to normalize LSBE in schools nationwide via advocacy.

title: Providing Affordable Energy Access in Sierra Leone
description: The lack of access to electricity in Sierra Leone poses a significant challenge to inclusive growth and sustainable development. In partnership with Intellico ECO, AID is embarking on a new project aimed at addressing this energy disparity by providing unique solutions for rural and energy-deprived areas. The project's focal point is the introduction of an entry-level solar lantern, a reliable and affordable off-grid solar solution, which will revolutionise the lives of individuals & communities

title: Help Maintain Our Monkey Enclosures
description: By donating to us you will be ensuring we can continue to provide a safe and nurturing environment for our monkeys as they embark on their rehabilitation journey back to the wild. Regular maintenance of the enclosures is an ongoing requirement to protect the monkeys in our care from potential risks and ensure their physical and mental well-being is maintained. Your support will make a tangible difference in their lives and contribute to their successful rehabilitation and eventual release.

title: Change Lives: Spaying & Neutering Cats Works!
description: Unfixed cats can produce three litters a year resulting in as many as 200 kittens; within three years those cats can produce more than 2,000 kittens!  In several rural North Carolina counties stray and feral cat colonies experience great suffering and many die from the elements, human cruelty or being euthanized in animal shelters. Our spay/neuter program works with TNR groups to lower this number and reduce suffering.  Our 2023 goal is 2,700 procedures.  Please help those who have no voice.

title: Medication to Treat and Prevent Blindness
description: Too many people live in areas that have access to little or no eye care. Unfortunately, without access to basic eye care - like the provision of antibiotics to treat eye infections, like trachoma - these people face a lifetime of blindness. And sadly, children are especially at risk of catching this disease. Fortunately, a low-cost antibiotic effectively prevents and treats this disease. With your support, Orbis can distribute this vital medication in Ethiopia, ensuring widespread availability.

title: Educate 5240 Honduran children living in poverty
description: Educate 5240 children by building and equipping four classrooms at our school in Honduras. More than 400 children are currently enrolled, and we need more space to meet the needs of the community. This school offers a bilingual, private, Christian education to children, and provides full and partial scholarships to children facing or at-risk of poverty.

title: Restoring Vision in Ethiopia within 20 Minutes
description: Too many people live in areas that have access to little or no eye care services. Unfortunately, without access to basic eye care, treatable eye infections like trachoma can cause people a lifetime of blindness. Trachoma is a painful bacterial eye infection that, if untreated, can rob individuals of their sight permanently. Supporting this project enables Orbis to perform surgeries reversing the impact of trachoma, and preserving vision and averting a lifetime of blindness.

title: Free Childcare Service for poor mother in Ethiopia
description: PProject was born out of lessons & a harrowing tale of sudden death 115 informal waste pickers due massive landslide at the Koshe dumpstite of which main victims were women caring children &based upon first hand personal story we heard from a single mother of five children beneficiaries of MHO's free community-based childcare, who lives in a rented house &unable to provide food &care for all of them and given up two of her children for adoption before she has joined the MHO fee Childcare service

title: MIKE's Mentored Health Education for Fall 2023
description: Our Mentored Health Education program needs $25k to fill a critical funding gap and provide impactful programming to all registered sites in the communities we serve for this fall.  Programming Objectives: Increase knowledge and behaviors toward nutrition and healthy eating Increase numbers of adolescents and time spent in physical activity Increase exposure to healthcare career pathways Increase advocacy and promotion of equity and justice Increase basic health knowledge and access to resources

title: Empower an Afghan Girl to Find Her Voice
description: This program enables 20 girls per 6-month course to access educational opportunities in Afghanistan. Per UNESCO, Currently, 80% of school-aged Afghan girls and young women - 2.5 million people are out of school. This program allows girls whose education was interrupted by the Taliban takeover to continue learning vital skills which enable them to find employment or transition to online education after program completion. Your support will help these girls plan for a better future!

title: Operation Potcake 2024
description: Operation Potcake 2024 will take place January 18-28th.  A mass spay/neuter program with the aim to sterilize 3,000 animals in eight days.
