A collaboration of the Bahamas Humane Society, Baark! and Animal Balance, supported by the Ministry of Agriculture, Ministry of Tourism and the VMAB to humanely and kindly reduce the dog and cat populations of the Bahamas. A project fueled by compassion and infused with synergetic love for all.

title: Pathway to success: scholarships to needy students
description: This project will provide scholarships to forty secondary school students from an impoverished rural community in the eastern Rwanda.  The community is still rebuilding and recovering from the aftermath of the 1994 Tutsi Genocide as evidenced by the large number of child-headed households. These three-year scholarships  change the course of a student's life. Additionally, these funds contribute to the revitalization of livelihoods and consequently, the socio-economic growth of the community.

title: MICRO FINANCE SUPPORT FOR THE PEOPLE IN THE GAMBIA
description: Our goal is to provide essential seed capital and technical assistance to young African Leaders, less privileges, Men and women and farmers and many more to lunch or expand their revenue- generating-ventures and also linking leaders with business development partners to facilitate mentoring, provide professional advice and technical know-how, and improve business outcomes...

title: Safe Eye Care for Women & Girls in Ethiopia
description: In Ethiopia, many barriers particularly prevent women from accessing eye care services. Without targeted efforts to provide eye services for women, gender-based disparities in vision loss will persist. Orbis is committed to bridging this gender blindness gap by prioritising the sight-saving needs of women and girls. With your support, Orbis will provide 900 pairs of glasses to empower women and girls, enabling them to pursue education and work independently, reducing their reliance on others.

title: New Classrooms for CasaSito development centers
description: This new classroom project will provide free quality education to our scholars in Guatemala. CasaSito will expand its development centers to support its community of youth, teachers, and families, offering psycho-social support, extracurricular activities, and workshops in a safe environment.

title: Sponsor a Child's Education!
description: African Impact Foundation is committed to reducing education inequality in Zambia, where over a quarter of a million children are not enrolled in school and 47% do not finish primary school. Our sponsorship program covers school fees, uniforms, learning materials, and much more per year, while also offering regular student support, parent engagement workshops, and preparatory coaching for post Grade 12 planning.

title: Promote Indigenous Women's Health in Rural Peru
description: The goal of SVH's Women's Health Program is to improve women's access to reproductive health care and information so that they are able to adopt preventative practices and feel empowered to make informed decisions about their bodies. By training health workers in Women's Health, this program will give women in remote, indigenous communities in Peru life changing education about really important topics like menstrual hygiene, contraception methods, pre- and post-natal care, and breastfeeding.

title: Empowering Lives of Teenage Mothers in Medellin
description: In Medellin (Colombia), extreme poverty is the great shadow of some of our teenage mothers who live in vulnerable situations. Their futures and projects are clouded by the lack of opportunities when they become pregnant at an early age.  You can give them back hope and allow them to make their dreams and those of their children come true.

title: Cocoa Biochar
description: We want to use this new innovation to transform cocoa shells into biochar, the "black gold of agriculture", to achieve the sustainability goals.   Biochar cocoa is a biofertiliser made from cocoa pod husks, designed to improve soil fertility and boost crop yields. Our biochar cocoa is environmentally friendly and more cost-effective than chemical fertilisers. Biochar cocoa makes it possible to grow healthy plants while improving the sustainability and health of the soil.

title: Elevate the Knowledge of Teenage Moms
description: In the communes of Medellin, Colombia, the situation of adolescent mothers living in extreme poverty is especially difficult and challenging. These communes are urban areas with high rates of violence and lack of opportunities. In this context, adolescent mothers are forced to assume responsibility by becoming mothers at an early age, which further complicates their socioeconomic situation and they are forced to put their studies aside.

title: Northern Caribbean Disaster Response Fund
description: Blue Atlas works on the ground post disasters to provide immediate assistance for farmers to re-establish the food supply chain and increase food security and restore livelihoods. Our focus is to rebuild a strong and sustainable food system.  Through our programs:  1. Scaling up Local Ag (SULA) Grant, we provide small to medium size grants to rebuild, repair or replace.  2. Our SULA Fund will allow farmers to scale up to commercial production capacity. 3. Build a climate smart ag training center

title: Building a Brighter Future for Migrant Youth
description: BEAM aspires to raise money and support for Migrant Learning Centers (MLCs) in Southern and Western Thailand, in the cities of Mae Sot, Ranong, and Chumphon. The proceeds raised will be allocated to four key areas: increasing the number of teachers at MLCs, a safe and free transport service for children to get to school, operational costs, and building expansions, as a means to cater to the growing influx of migrant populations who want to register to become students at MLCs.

title: Provide Emergency Medical aid in Africa
description: The Emergency  Assistance  project in Nigerian hospitals aims to address the pressing issue of limited access to urgent medical care for indigent patients. Recognizing the financial constraints faced by vulnerable individuals, especially those from low-income backgrounds, the project seeks to provide timely and life-saving medical assistance.

title: Support Ukrainian children of war
description: This project is dedicated to providing long-term comprehensive aid to Ukrainian children who have lost one or both parents due to ongoing war. The project encompasses psychological rehabilitation, educational assistance, crisis management, legal aid, and vital necessities like food, clothing, and shelter when needed. We aim to empower these children and give them a chance for a brighter future so that they can realize their full potential and successfully integrate into global society.

title: Healthy Homes for families in Egypt
description: Housing rehabilitation  grant programs provide funding to repair, improve, or modernize dwellings, and remove health or safety hazards from those dwellings. Programs primarily serve families with low and no  incomes, and may prioritize services for households with vulnerable members such as young children and older adults. These programs can adopt a comprehensive housing improvement strategy or focus on individual housing components such as heating and insulation, plumbing, structural

title: Educate Children on Buyiga Island, Uganda, Africa
description: The project shall facilitate better learning at Buyiga Secondary School, Buyiga Island, Uganda, by building a brick and cement classroom block with a well-polished concrete floor and a library section, at the school. The library shall be furnished with textbooks, novels and manuals. The project shall also involve construction of 8 pit latrines to improve the sanitation and hygiene at the school. The project shall climax with putting up of 2 water tanks, with one put at the latrines and another

title: Resilience  Building for GBV Survivors
description: The Anglophone crisis in the Northwest Region of Cameroon has led to a significant increase in gender-based violence (GBV), with one in every three women experiencing violence, coercion, or abuse. This project aims to improve the social, economic, and legal protection of GBV survivors while fostering their resilience. The project aims to provide comprehensive social support, economic empowerment, and legal protection, focusing on psychosocial care, economic stability, and self-reliance.

title: Fongoli Savanna Chimpanzee Project
description: The Fongoli Savanna Chimpanzee Project has continued, uninterrupted, since the year 2001. Along with longterm  behavioral research on these chimpanzees, which live at the edge of the species' range in Senegal, we focus on conservation and research that takes into account how humans and chimpanzees have and can continue to co-exist here. The goal of this project is to raise funds to establish an endowment so that future generations, especially Senegalese, can continue this work.

title: Bring Medical and Dental Care to Honduras
description: Honduras, like many countries, faces various social and economic challenges, including poverty, inequality, and inadequate access to healthcare and education. Cape CARES is one of the longest tenured organization in the Dry Corridor of Honduras who work on the ground to provide essential services and support to vulnerable communities. By giving to Cape CARES, you can contribute to humanitarian efforts aimed at alleviating suffering and improving the lives of those in need.

title: Nembe River cleanup Project
description: The Nembe river has been neglected by the government and oil companies and have deteriorated to a very bad level, affecting aquatic life that is the main economic stay of the people.

title: Free childhoods in Argentinian prision
description: More than 200 children visit their mothers, sisters, aunts and grandmothers in Unit 46 of the San Martin Prison in a space with a covered sector and another in the open air. The space is insufficient, deteriorated and inadequate to the needs of the children who visit them. This project seeks that women deprived of their liberty and affected by multiple inequalities become protagonists in the construction of a suitable environment for themselves and their families.

title: Supporting Palliative Care in Sudan during wartime
description: Since the war started, the palliative care program in Khartoum was halted. Members of the team are afraid to venture the streets, struggling for survival. This project will help Palliative Unit Team members to cover internet fees for care providers and patients to enable distant consultations, pay for travel expenses to conduct face-to-face homecare wherever possible (Damar, Medani, outskirts of Khartoum), and to buy medical supplies and essential medicines for patients.

title: Literacy, art, culture, & environmental education
description: Engage Globally educates over 400 children in community learning centers in rural Northern Ghana. We also support the education of youth, young adults, and women in our nine partner villages. This project will enhance learning through arts, culture, and environmental programs including teaching of traditional basket weaving and dance, along with sustainable farming. Additionally, we hope to establish the first community libraries in the region using books on African culture and conservation.

title: Cultivating Capacity: Empower Rural Ugandan Youth!
description: In the face of widespread unemployment among youth, TYoFU offers a regenerative model to both empower youth and nourish the community. On rich farmland, TYoFU trains and employs youth, including young women, ages 15-30 from rural Wakiso, providing beautiful produce and clean drinking water to the community. Now it's time to increase youth employment, and to build infrastructure for sustainable livestock practices, youth housing, and an office. Thank you for caring about our shared future!

title: Grants for disabled children in Bangladesh
description: Approximately 1,000 Children with disabilities and others disadvantaged children of District: Jamalpur in BANGLADESH will directly benefit from this project. The disabled children will get education, health services ,Wheel-chairs, Treatment & medical support, also get different ability and skills. involved in various "income generating activities , relief & rehabilitation support to any disaster period,  ".

title: Hotline services for Refugees in Bulgaria
description: The Foundation for Access to Rights - FAR is a Bulgarian NGO, which provides legal aid and information to migrants, refugees, asylum seekers and stateless people. This project aims to improve the access to information and legal aid to refugees and migrants  in Bulgaria through a hotline service. The hotline service is part of the holistic voice and digital tools that FAR uses to support refugees' and migrants' integration in Bulgaria.

title: Help 150 rural Uganda women with employment skills
description: This project will assist 30+ Ugandan women to start-up and run Karacel Bakery & Training Center in Northern Uganda. Karacel Bakery & Training Center is women owned and operated business that was founded to give young women the opportunity for meaningful employment, personal growth, and professional development. It also benefits the local community by offering business training and access to nutritious breads made with soya flour that are high in protein and otherwise unavailable on the market.

title: Recovery Efforts- Guam Farmers from Super Typhoon
description: Oceanic Ascent Education aka Guahan Sustainable Culture will help our farmers, in areas of financial support, mental health, well-being needs, and more, as well as help provide food for those in need. The financial support will allow them to purchase the resources needed to replant their farms and restore their livelihoods as well as provide fresh, local food to the people of Guam.

title: Joyful Aging-Embracing the Beauty of Life Together
description: Taiwan is projected to become a super-aged society by 2025, with the elderly population reaching 20%. This means out of every five people, there will be one elderly over the age of 65. Hondao has developed over 40 programs, in six different aspects: "Healthy Aging", "Quality Care", "Financial Security", "Self-Actualization", "Friendly Environment" and "Talent Cultivation" to maintain the personal health of seniors, improve the system, and build positive images of aging.

title: Psychosocial Support For Displaced Women In Greece
description: SAO Association operates two Day Centres on Lesvos and in Athens for displaced women where trauma-oriented, psychosocial services and workshops are offered. Displaced women receive specific and individual access to information, assistance and consultation through psychologists, social workers and translators.

title: Young Enterprise Inspiring Futures
description: In the UK's most disadvantaged communities, increased opportunity and access to support is vital for young people. Young Enterprise provides learning pathways enabling young people to develop confidence and key skills such as teamwork, problem solving and resilience. Through our Company Programme and Employability Masterclass, we raise aspirations, develop enterprising mindsets and offer inspiring role models as mentors, equipping young people to overcome social mobility barriers and to thrive.

title: Zero Waste Gili: Transforming Island Trash
description: Gili Eco Trust is making significant impacts on Gili Trawangan, establishing the island's first recycling facility & processing tons of recyclable waste to minimize landfill. By partnering with FMPL, we are solving the problem of inadequate waste management while creating employment opportunities for locals and working towards a zero-waste-to-landfill island. Your contribution will directly benefit the environment, the local community, and our collective mission of achieving a sustainable island

title: Academy's Young Financiers
description: The aim of the project is to provide educational support to children aged 13-17 from orphanages in Poland by improving their competences in the field of financial education (workshops), material support (autumn and winter kits).

title: Swim for Good: Help Refugees Reconnect With Water
description: Join Swim for Good : Support refugees to develop a life-saving skill by donating to the Yoga and Sport With Refugees swimming program in Lesvos, Greece. More than 10,000 people each year travel a treacherous 12 km distance from Turkey to Greece in the search of a safer future. We want to raise awareness about the refugees' journey and ask for your support to fund our unique trauma-sensitive, learn-to-swim program providing safety, mental and physical health, and peaceful relationship with water.

title: Educate 500 Orphans in Syria
description: In Syria... did you know that thousands of orphans are deprived of their fundamental right to education? They suffer poverty and displacement without parental care. These young children carry significant burdens at such a tender age.  Through our project, we strive to reach out and provide free education to 500 orphaned students in Syria. We are dedicated to offering an opportunity for a better future to these children facing challenging circumstances.

title: Improving Maternal & Child Health in Balochistan
description: Our project aims to tackle the high maternal and child mortality rates in Balochistan through a comprehensive approach. By strengthening healthcare services, improving access to care, enhancing nutrition, and raising awareness, we aim to reduce maternal mortality from 300 to 200 per 100,000 live births and child mortality from 86 to 60 per 1,000 live births. Through the establishment of health centers, mobile clinics, nutrition programs and community engagement to save lives in Balochistan

title: Help us to not worry about Vet Bills
description: This project is to support the ongoing vet bills that mount up as we continue to help Huskies & Akitas across Ireland find their forever home. Help us not to worry so we can help them !

title: JUNIOR SECONDARY SCHOOL BUILDING PROJECT
description: "Build a school for rural community" is a project which seeks to provide educational facility for Gandorhun community in the Kpanga Krim Chiefdom, Pujehun District, Southern Sierra Leone, West Africa. The project seeks to put up a 1No. 6-unit Classrooms block, 1No.1-Unit Administrative Block, 2 No. 4-unit VIP latrine rooms and 1No.1 water-well with hand-pump facilities to help improve the social well-being of children from the above mentioned community.

title: Equip 200students with computer skills in Tanzania
description: This project will involve establishing a computer lab in a low resource public school in Tanzania as well as strengthening the capacity of teachers on e-teaching skills and establishing sustainable student ICT clubs to ensure 200 students  acquire desirable digital skills for their academic and professional development.

title: Without spaces
description: The project will support a shelter for young women with children who have experienced or witnessed violence. Services will be rendered in the shelter in accordance with international standards. Services for children will also be supported, which will give them the opportunity to return to a peaceful life, without gaps. Sheltor is designed for the simultaneous stay of 12 people, there is also a children's space for group activities and games.

title: Help 14 y.o. Olexandra from Ukraine with surgery
description: This project aims to raise funds for a crucial surgery for a 14-year-old girl named Olexandra, who has lost her father in the ongoing war in Ukraine. The funds raised will cover the cost of the operation, including the implant and the necessary preparation and rehabilitation. By supporting this project, you can make a significant impact on Alexandra's life, enabling her to regain the full use of her hand and pursue a healthy and productive future.

title: Educate a Child for a year in Kumba-Cameroon
description: With no access to education and, the economic situation of inhabitants in many rural communities in Kake-Cameroon. As a result of the about seven years conflict in the North West & South West Regions, hundreds even thousands of Children especially in  remote areas can no go to school. Your generous support and donations will enable us assist the most vulnerable children back to school. We have registered about 235 of them this year for the project.

title: A Vehicle to support human rights in Pakistan
description: The organization needs a vehicle for its street theater team to travel to the marginalized rural areas of Punjab on a monthly basis to deliver human rights education to the marginalized. Currently, we rent vans, but they charge too much for a day, making it hard for us to sustain our activities and promote human rights. With our own vehicle, we could save on rental costs, and it would be easier for us to reach the desired areas.

title: Stop Paying the Polluter
description: Big Oil has us over a barrel. Investor state dispute settlements, backed by international treaties and free trade mechanisms mean billions of dollars are being handed to fossil fuel investors in cases where positive climate action by governments is damaging fossil fuel asset values. Not only is this paying polluters, but the fear of being sued prevents governments from acting. This research project exposes the scale of the payments, the extent of the fear, and pushes for renegotiation.

title: Educate 500 Syrian Refugee Students
description: The project will provide free education using remote learning platforms like Microsoft Teams to 500 students who have been deprived of education due to the challenging circumstances, disruptions, displacement, and poverty in northern Syria. Most of these students come from vulnerable groups such as orphans, children with disabilities, and those living in refugee camps in the north of the country.

title: Build 20 Hand Washing & Sanitation Stations
description: Over 700 children under age 5 die every day world wide of diarrhoeal diseases due to lack of appropriate hand washing practices and infrastructure. In some rural communities, such as Chaco and Salta provinces of Argentina, primary schools lack basic sanitation and water resulting in children being put at risk for getting sick and missing school. This project will go towards installing 20 Hand Washing Stations (HWS) across Argentina to improve access to water, sanitation and handwashing.

title: Support Smallholder farming a path out of poverty
description: Agriculture is a proven engine for poverty reduction. Growth Domestic Product generated by agriculture is more effective in reducing poverty than growth in any other sector. In sub-Saharan Africa, growth in agriculture reduces poverty up to 11 times faster than growth in other sectors. By advocating for poor rural people and financing projects that transform rural areas, our work is critical to the achievement of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.

title: Build a Health Clinic to Change Lives
description: This health clinic will  provide the much needed free medical and dental care as well as free medications.   Currently the nearest hospital is 4 hours away in Tegucigalpa.  Through the construction of this free clinic we will provide services not only to El Rodeito but to all the nearby communities.

title: The SBMf basketball clinic for 750 kids in Nigeria
description: The SBM Foundation plans to use sports as a tool to build partnerships with families in Port Harcourt, Nigeria and also a means to help the underprivileged kids reach their peak in not just athletic success but also in their academics.  By hosting basketbal clinics and championships, while taking time to renovate and build basketball courts where necessary. Our vision is to strive to build a safe haven for youths of all ages while helping them harness their God-given talents.

title: Transforming lives: Vulnerable children, Neiva Col
description: Join our transformative project in the Panorama neighborhood, Neiva, Colombia, where we are empowering more than 1000 individuals, children and their families. Through our comprehensive approach, we are fighting extreme poverty by nurturing individual talents, providing basic education, promoting the circular economy, develop artistic skills and offer technological knowledge. Every participant experiences an increase in their family social responsibility and improved self concept.

title: StudentAid: Student Relief Fund
description: Student Relief Fund is a scholarship programme for talented students who are facing financial difficulties and thus are forced to give up their academic career. The goal of the project is to prevent them from taking such steps. We believe that one talented man or woman - with appropriate support - could implement many innovative changes in the future.

title: Support the Climate-Affected Families in West Bali
description: This project will provide temporary infrastructure, boat repairs, Cash Voucher Assistance, shelters, and psychosocial aid to families in Pebuahan, West Bali, affected by abrasion and high waves triggered by extreme weather following the climate crisis. It will also provide educational activities for 1,200 families on disaster adaptation and mitigation. Our recovery plan includes disaster preparedness and economic rehabilitation, closely linked to adaptation efforts due to the climate crisis.

title: Guide 100 US Veterans/Spouses To Rewarding Careers
description: Annually, Hire Heroes USA serves the employment needs of thousands of unemployed/underemployed veterans, active-duty service members transitioning out of the military, and their job-seeking spouses/caregivers. We provide 1:1 career coaching, resume and interview assistance, expert mentorship, connections to employers and jobs, and wraparound referrals, significantly improving the employability of our nation's heroes and placing them on a pathway toward upward mobility and greater opportunity.

title: Her Path to Success: Education & Emotional Support
description: Our project aims to empower women by providing them with access to quality education and comprehensive support. By offering scholarships, psycho-emotional therapy and skills development workshops, we are committed to breaking the cycle of limited opportunities and thus promote gender equality. Join us in making a difference in the lives of these talented and determined women!

title: Building daycare center in Phum Brammouy, Cambodia
description: Cambodia, garment factories employ nearly 700,000 people, approximately 90% of whom are women. These women have the dual burden of caring for their children and providing income for their families. As a result, some women leave their children in their home villages to work in urban areas, or they leave their children with family, friends or other caregivers all day, six days per week to work.

title: Improve Menstrual Hygiene of 3000 IDPs in Cameroon
description: This project will improve the Health & Menstrual Hygiene of women/girls by providing, a pad & a pant to 3000 vulnerable & traumatize IDPs in  Kosala- Cameroon. This will reduce the rate of inffections related to poor menstral hygiene. Targeting 40 villages with no access to medical facilities.

title: Northeast US Flood Relief Fund
description: Dangerous flash floods in Vermont, Pennsylvania, Massachusetts, New York, and other parts of the Northeast US have caused widespread and historic destruction, taking multiple lives and leaving towns devastated. Your donation to the Northeast US Flood Relief Fund will provide immediate and long-term relief in affected communities.

title: 800km sponsored bike ride 2023
description: Our Hand to Hand Foundation is are riding 800km in the month of October and there will be shorter ride of 240km for the kids! Most of the riders are people whom the Hand to Hand Foundation regularly supports by providing education, food, job  training, housing and a safe refuge for trafficked and abused children. The whole team are riding 2nd hand bikes that have been donated and the team is training every week and getting fitter and faster by the day. Sponsor us, or do your own ride and donate.

title: Flood Recovery Support :Chungcheongdo, South Korea
description: Heavy rain of up to 530mm has been scratching the country for four days. According to the Central Disaster and Safety Countermeasures Headquarters (Central Disaster and Safety Countermeasures Headquarters), 36 people have died or disappeared nationwide as of midnight on the 16th. (26 people, including 17 in Gyeongbuk, 4 in Chungnam, 4 in Chungbuk, and 1 in Sejong). The Korea Meteorological Administration predicts that more than 200mm of additional rain will fall. Please, Help us!

title: Fruit Processing Equipment for Improved Incomes
description: We will support a local farmer's association process their excess fruits into wines, vinegar, jams and jellies for increase in income and well-being. Fruits that are in season often deteriorate quickly due to tropical climate and the price go down tremendously in a short time. There is a need to process these in order to increase value, increase shelf-life and improve the livelihoods of local farmers.

title: Educate 100 underprivileged girls. Let them dream.
description: BREADS supports girl children who are rescued from dangerous situations of child labour or other child rights violations and places them in Don Bosco rehabilitation centres. They are provided residential short-term remedial education and then admitted to formal schools to complete their education.

title: Save 200 Children From Sex Trafficking in Delhi
description: It is estimated that half a million children are trafficked for sex into India's red-light districts. Raising funds is crucial to provide hope and support to these innocent lives. iPartner India is determined to continue partnering with Society for Participatory Integrated Development (SPID), which works tirelessly in Delhi's red-light area. Due to the loss of donations during COVID-19, funds are urgently needed to provide education and empowerment for these vulnerable children.

title: Northeast Flooding Relief for Craft Artists
description: This summer's dangerous flash floods in Vermont, Pennsylvania, Massachusetts, New York, and other areas of the Northeast US have caused widespread and historic destruction.  This project will provide craft artists with much-needed additional emergency relief grants of $3,000 to aid affected craft artists with immediate financial support to restore their careers, safeguard their studios, and provide relief during this crisis.

title: Seed Bank to empower indigenous women and girls.
description: The native, endemic plants are in danger of extinction, since the cultural and ecological environment of the highlands and jungle region is being devastated. For this reason, the seed bank that will serve as a base nursery within the indigenous communities is proposed, promoting the protection of plants in danger of extinction. The collaboration between the collection of seeds by women and girls will generate a synergy of local commerce through a collaborative scheme of knowledge and economic em

title: Rescue 10 villages from covid 19 at mlesa village
description: The project is aiming and going to prevent the current eruption of covid 19 pandemic disease in mlesa village which has roughly affected 100 citizens of mlesa village since it's currently eruption where this project is going to rescue and prevent 2000 members of mlesa village who are in threat of being affected hugely by covid 19. We are going to provide education, purchase of 1000 dozens of mask,1000 baskets for hand washing and purchase of sanitizers for virus elimination.

title: Supporting 200 poor families in northern Syria
description: This project is a support operation for 200 very poor families, including families of dead, detained, or injured persons who are unable to work. The association will provide each of these families with a food basket containing the basic living materials, including wheat, sugar, legumes, and other essentials.

title: Support food risky communities raise green house
description: The Cico Uganda community projects are driven by some of the main principles of agroecology: responsible land stewardship, respect for local knowledge, and profitable production. That is to say that our work strives to support the culture of farming just as much as the ecological production of food. For over a decade, we have been helping communities take advantage of greenhouse technology to build and maintain greenhouses that help with a communities dietary diversity and economic development.

title: Flood Relief Fund, Himachal Pradesh & Bihar 2023
description: iPartner India seeks support to relieve flood-affected families in Himachal Pradesh and Bihar. Funds for 1,200 families are being raised to help provide the victims with temporary shelters, solar lanterns, food, water, medicine, and fodder. The devastating floods and landslides have caused extensive damage, with collapsed bridges, washed-away markets, and disrupted connectivity. By partnering with compassionate donors, the project aims to provide essential assistance to flood-affected families.

title: Crisis Relief to People in Myanmar
description: The people of Myanmar need support to weather this devastating upheaval and rebuild their lives safely.  As with any crisis, those in the most vulnerable positions will be impacted the hardest-this includes women and children, those from minority ethnic and religious groups, and those up against other socio-economic barriers.

title: Send medical equipment & supplies to Sierra Leone
description: In late Summer, we are aiming to send a 20ft shipping container of medical supplies to be distributed to 7 health units in Sierra Leone.   This container will consist of vital medical equipment and resources that will help to provide the best diagnosis and treatment to vulnerable children and adults across Sierra Leone. 99% of the items have been donated to Inter Care by the local community and beyond, however the freight costs to send this container will  be approximately 4,000.

title: EMBRACE Project
description: Kidsave's EMBRACE initiative which stands for Expanding Meaningful Black Relationships and Creating Equity, aims to address the overrepresentation of Black children in the foster care system due to systemic racism, to identify the barriers Black families face to mentorship and adoption, and to cultivate solutions in practice and policy to improve outcomes for Black youth in foster care.

title: Support Ukraine in Need with Nordic SOS
description: Our organization, Nordic SOS Ukraine, is collecting equipment for the people of Ukraine who are in need. We are a group of volunteers from Norway who want to help Ukraine in its difficult situation. Our goal is to send the equipment to Ukraine by the end of autumn 2023. We need your support to cover the transportation costs of sending the equipment from Norway to Ukraine. Please donate to our fundraising campaign and help us make a difference. Thank you for your generosity and compassion.

title: A World of Creativity-Healing for Cape Town Youth
description: Cape Town possesses true beauty, yet apartheid's scars linger. Especially for youths, 13-25, who represent 34% of the population. Separated by diverse cultures, religions, socio and economic standings, they also face many similar issues like COVID's mental health crises of anxiety, depression, and sobriety. Breaking Walls creates unified, empathetic, hopeful youth communities through its Community-Based Initiative. Here young artists from unique cultures partake in a collective Arts experience.

title: PROJECT MITHRA - (Female Afghan Prosecutors)
description: Jewish Humanitarian Response (JHR), incubated by the Aleph Institute (Aleph), has been evacuating vulnerable Afghans who are on Taliban kill lists and resettling them in countries abroad. We have served many groups that the Taliban have sworn to kill, one of them being Afghan prosecutors. Many have been successfully relocated to Germany and Spain, and we continue to try to secure pathways for them in welcoming countries where they can start new lives in safety after all they have endured.

title: 5-Year ICT Training for 24 Girls in Care Homes
description: This project is a 5 year roadmap designed for 24 girls aged 10 to 22 residing in 3 selected  children homes (otherwise known as orphanages) in Ibadan, Nigeria with the aims of enhancing their computer literacy, providing them with laptops and ICT learning resources, and establishing an ICT incubator platform for mentorship and peer learning programs.

title: Sisters are doing it for themselves
description: Our Women's sewing centres provide a chance to earn a skill which can give women an all-important source of independent income. Based in some of the poorest villages in India these centres are much more than just a classroom. They provide a safe and supportive environment for women to meet and support each other in a culture where such opportunities can be rare.

title: Better Nutrition for the Nigerian Child Via ADHFP
description: Nigeria, diverse and populous, grapples with child well-being in remote areas, marked by inadequate nutrition and healthcare access. Malnutrition affects 1 in 3 children in developing countries like Nigeria. (1) According to UNICEF, as of 2020, Nigeria had over 10 million out-of-school children, many of whom were from remote communities, with high child malnutrition rates, and approximately 2.5 million children are suffering from severe acute malnutrition. These challenges require urgent support

title: Art, for our Future
description: Since 2007, we have placed children at the heart of our intervention. Through weekly interventions in ZEP schools, in collaboration with engaged teachers, we create dynamic learning spaces that cater to the unique needs of vulnerable children. By integrating arts into academic subjects, we empower children with diverse backgrounds to thrive and succeed. Through art, children develop skills such as questioning, critical thinking, imagination, emotional control, and effective communication.

title: Building Brighter Futures For The Ugandan Kids
description: At Sofraa, we believe that education is the key to breaking the cycle of poverty and empowering communities to thrive. That's why we are dedicated to transform education in Uganda and ensure that every child has access to a quality learning environment. We are excited to present our vital project: the enhancement and completion of Sofraa Primary School, a beacon of hope for 350 Wakisi's young learners.

title: Back to School Project 2023/2024
description: The Back to School project in Lebanon aims to address the impact of the economic crisis on education for refugees and host communities. Over a million students have already left education, and the numbers are expected to increase in the upcoming 2023-2024 school year. The project seeks to provide access to quality education, reduce dropouts, and foster a supportive learning environment, empowering vulnerable children and youth for a better future.

title: BRING WATER SAVE 25000 LIVES IN MAHOLE-CAMEROON
description: This project intends to provide 3 boll hole water points to Mahole village with over 25,000 inhabitants & several surrounding villages suffering for many years with just one water point. Your generous donation will not only bring more water points to this community but it will equally Save Lives.

title: Women of Worth Fund
description: L'Oreal Paris Women of Worth honors extraordinary women who selflessly volunteer their time to serve their communities. This signature philanthropic program embodies the L'Oreal Paris belief that 'Every Woman Is Worth It' by elevating women who find beauty in giving back. In the spirit of collaboration and cultivating a culture of empowering extraordinary women, L'Oreal Paris is launching the Women of Worth Fund to support women in creating positive change in their communities.

title: Save lives of mom and babies of rural Nepal
description: 1. This project aims to address the urgent healthcare needs in the rural municipality of Jumla, which contributes to one of the highest maternal and newborn mortality due to its extreme remoteness by providing essential renovations, medical equipment, and birthing kits for health facility.  2.This health facility will be fully equipped with two hospital beds, a newborn corner, warmer, an autoclave, and other medical equipment to improve healthcare services, and save lives of  villagers.

title: Support education & conservation with ecobursaries
description: Arabuko-Sokoke Forest and Mida Creek (Kenya) support some of Africa's rarest wildlife. But as communities fight for survival, they resort to unsustainable exploitation of their local ecosystem. ASSETS is a pioneering community conservation project that lifts children out of poverty through secondary school bursaries and engages families in ecotourism and practical conservation activities. With 775 students sponsored, ASSETS has a proven track-record of success. Help sponsor 100 students in 2024!

title: Supporting Small Business by Poor Entrepreneurs
description: Poor entrepreneurs have difficulty improving their enterprises because of lack of capital, lack of knowledge in business management and lack of linkages and connections. There is a need to assist poor entrepreneurs in order to make the economic situation in villages more vibrant and energized. We shall focus our support to 200 poor entrepreneurs in 2 towns with multi-faceted assistance with the main goal of improving their lives.

title: Support Older People in Ukraine
description: As a result of the Russian invasion, the lives of millions of older Ukrainians are at risk. They're in danger of being displaced by the conflict, denied access to essential services or forced to flee to neighboring countries. Those unable to move are often abandoned in war-torn areas. One-fourth of Ukrainians are 60+ and more than half said the war had harmed their mental health. We're working with our partners on the ground to provide food, medicine, hygiene supplies, home-based care and more.

title: Cleaning water for poor children in Cambodia
description: Phnom Srouch district, more than 85% of the people ae agriculture as mango that is a potential crop after the rice crop, which is creating opportunities for local people to create jobs through the processing of mangoes and fresh fruits in many places. Yeay Maopichnil commune has 9 villages, Phum Brammouy village is in this commune with 2387 people (540 families). People live here is depending on rainy and underground water for consumption as food, cleaning and agriculture.

title: Typhoon Doksuri/Egay Relief Fund
description: Typhoon Doksuri, known locally in the Philippines as Typhoon Egay, has already caused extensive damage in the Philippines, southern China, and Taiwan, with additional impacts still anticipated. Nearly one million have been affected in the region, and hundreds of thousands have been evacuated as loss of life, injury, and weakened infrastructure continue to take their toll. All donations to this fund will exclusively support relief and recovery efforts for Typhoon Doksuri/Egay.

title: Mediterranean Wildfire Relief Fund
description: Wildfires are displacing communities across countries including Algeria, Greece, Italy, and Tunisia. Thousands of firefighters are battling these devastating fires which have been fueled by scorching temperatures and strong winds. The fires have killed dozens of people, especially in Algeria. Thousands of families have been evacuated. Your donation to the Mediterranean Wildfire Relief Fund will support emergency response and long-term recovery efforts in the most affected countries.

title: Grant Support for  Dengue Outbreaks in Bangladesh
description: The recent Dengue outbreak in Bangladesh has reached critical stage with notable surge in cases and deaths this year. Project aim to address above-mentioned issues & provide support to protect the health and well-being of Children and Persons with Disabilities in Jamalpur, Bangladesh. As 30th July 2023, country has reported more 200 fatalities caused by the mosquito-borne illness. Disease has now spread 60 districts and Jamalpur district has witnessed surge in Dengue cases.

title: Bringing Hope and Health to the Unreached
description: Our project aims to make a meaningful impact on the lives of underserved communities by providing essential healthcare services through mobile health camps. Many marginalized and remote areas lack access to proper medical facilities, leaving countless individuals without vital healthcare support. Through our initiative, we will set up mobile health camps, staffed by dedicated healthcare professionals, to deliver much-needed medical care, screenings, vaccinations, and health education.

title: Shingiro Women Centre
description: Shingiro Women's Centre is part of Partners For Conservation's (PFC) vision to become the haven for education, learning and employment to improve capabilities of marginalised, young women in the Volcanoes National Park.  PFC plans to provide as a plethora of services to women to expand capabilities. The centre will possess a training centre for soft skills development like sewing/handicraft, enhancing Kinyarwanda and English language abilities, as well as a nursery to allow women work.

title: Digitalisation of education in 20 rural schools.
description: A project of Reaching Hand called 'Namma shale', which means My School in Kannada, aims to empower government schools by digitising schools to provide inclusive education in the following ways: - 1. Quality education by supporting teachers on a temporary basis. -2. Developing minor infrastructure in schools. -3. Providing stem labs, computer labs & digital panels etc.-4. Providing necessities like bags, water bottle etc. -4. Conducting co-curricular activities for holistic development.

title: Empowering the Poorest by Building Homes
description: WOW Tanzania aims to provide affordable housing for impoverished widows with children, orphans, street children, and single-parent families in need. With a brick making machine, we'll create cost-effective, resilient homes while empowering the community through skill training. This project will enhance lives, promote sustainability, and foster a sense of community.  Together, we're building a brighter future for the most vulnerable in one of the poorest countries in the world!

title: Educate 150 underprivileged children at Nepal
description: A large numbers of underprivileged children at Nepal are forced to drop out from schools not completing the full cycle of primary and secondary education due to their poverty, low household income, child marriage and child labor. To address this needs and challenge Social Development Organization Nepal aims to retain 150 underprivileged and reunited  children to continue their school education, providing them tution fees, stationery sets, and school bags.

title: Conservation and activation of the Cultural Center
description: The objective is the reconstruction of the halls of the old La Ensenanza normal school, using traditional construction techniques to preserve the La Ensenanza Cultural Center. Our goal is to enable new spaces for exhibitions, workshops and cultural events, focused on the local community and visitors to San Cristobal. The reconstruction of these spaces will reinforce the activities of the center and ensure a prosperous future for the cultural heritage of our city.

title: Education Empowerment for Kenya's Slum Adolescents
description: This project will pay tuition fee for 50 needy and vulnerable slum adolescent girls transitioning to high school in 2024, and set up an equipped Community Learning Centre in Kibera slum providing opportunity for technical skills training and knowledge acquisition to 100 vulnerable and disadvantaged teen mothers from Kenya's informal settings. The centre will provide child support space for the babies of the teen mothers who can not afford to pay for childcare nor have no one to leave the baby.

title: Assistance for children with cancer in Brazil
description: The project aims to provide comprehensive assistance to patients and families at the Instituto do Cancer Infantil, through care provided by a multidisciplinary team from different specialties and assistance benefits such as food baskets, clothing, special exams, and medication. The project encompasses children and adolescents undergoing cancer treatment or palliative care. With the project, it is estimated the improvement in the quality of life of patients and their families.

title: Conquer Mt. Kili to Challenge Menstrual Taboos
description: We believe that every woman and girl deserve to live a life free from the challenges and limitations imposed by menstruation. Still, for many women around the world access to menstrual health products, education/information, supportive facilities and professional support remains a significant barrier.   To address this issue head-on we are embarking on an extraordinary journey that combines adventures and advocacy: the Kilimanjaro Climb.

title: Bududa Learning Center
description: We are trying to help some of the poorest and most at risk children in rural, Eastern Uganda. We have a vocational school teaching them marketable skills, an orphan's program providing support and lodging and a women's micro finance initiative. Your money will keep our initiatives running for the next year, thank you for your support.

title: Earth Voice: Inspiring Shift
description: To expand the connection between middle and high school students in underserved communities to the climate justice movement, Earth Guardians' (EG) youth leaders will visit 28+ public schools nationwide to deliver a keynote on the climate crisis, lead students in a hands-on project outdoors, and support each school in starting an EG Crew with ongoing support. Our mission is for our youth mentors to inspire youth agency, community engagement, and positive climate impact in the most affected areas.

title: Youth and Community Empowerment Fund
description: In Zanzibar, Tanzania we support youth and the community by providing education resources, supporting feeding and hygiene initiatives to improve wellness, and building and renovating education facilities to improve the learning environment. Further, we teach locals how to drive boats ethically, conserve the environment, and promote ecotourism.  This fund will enable us to provide education, wellness, livelihood, and conservation programs in Zanzibar.

title: An urgent plea to help abused dogs in Egypt
description: Over the past few years, we have seen a worrying increase in abuse and cruelty against dogs in Egypt, and the victims come to the Animal Protection Foundation (APF) clinic every day. The APF shelter has more than 3000 dogs to care for. With the increasing numbers of dogs rescued and the limited resources, we reached a point where providing the bare necessities of survival has become very difficult. We need your help to keep helping more dogs in need and provide for the dogs under our care.

title: Together to fight against HIV AIDS (SIDA)
description: The save life make difference association also fights against inequalities and violence against women with HIV. For this, the association goes beyond medical care, and offers women psychological and social support, in particular with the organization of support groups.

title: Care for Special Needs Orphans in Cairo
description: We are currently working with Dar El-Sondos, an orphanage for 212 moderate to severe special needs children founded in 2003, with 4 homes throughout Cairo. Your donations go towards areas such as:  -One on one care givers for each child -Special education -Medical care -Rehabilitation and speech therapy -Salaries for facility administrators and staff -Utility expenses for the homes

title: Send 60 Children to Preschool in Laikipia, Kenya
description: Would you believe that many children living in the communities around the Land of Hope school in Laikipia County, Kenya, do not attend school? It's true. If you were to drive through the community you would see children as young as 4-years old tending to the family's herd of 30-50 goats. But Land of Hope is slowly beginning to persuade the local community members that education is meaningful. And they are sending their preschoolers to school. You can help us to continue this meaningful project!

title: Empowering 33 Mayan families to overcome poverty.
description: We serve 33 Mayan families in San Pedro la Laguna, Guatemala, empowering them with literacy and traditional art/crafts classes which help mothers work in the tourist industry or gain income while at home.  Youth can attend technical training to improve their job opportunities in their home pueblo, rather than emigrate, or drop out of school to work at the same menial labor of their parent - thus continuing the cycle of poverty.   Re-integrating cultural traditions promotes pride in their roots.

title: Noor Rehabilitation building 2023
description: We at Noor society  for People with Disabilities believe that people with disabilities are able to improve and can be independent in many life functions. We cannot let grief, loneliness and helplessness destroy their lives, it is important to provide rehabilitation and treatment as soon as possible.. Our rehabilitation center is located in Aida Palestinian refugee camp and covers an area of 120 square meters. We still need the money to buy a bigger building of 270 square meters with four floors.

title: Give Water Save Life
description: This project will construct Three (3) water boreholes for the three identified communities in Nigeria for them to have safe and clean water for many years to come.

title: Small Business Support for Young Entrepreneurs
description: Young, aspiring entrepreneurs are often handicapped by the lack of capital and mentoring in order to start or expand their business and in this regard we will provide young entrepreneurs with pump-priming capital, mentoring and handholding so that the success of their business enterprises is ensured. We will target 700 young entrepreneurs for this initiative.

title: Protect our ocean & safeguard livelihoods in Kenya
description: Life on the Kenyan coast is precarious. Overfishing has severely depleted local waters, and the local community, who rely on this essential food source, are working hard to improve and increase local marine biodiversity, whilst ensuring they can still source food to eat and earn a living.

title: Emergency Response to July 2023 Japan Floods
description: The typhoon and rainy season front that occurred in July this year stayed in the Japanese archipelago for a long period of time, causing extensive damage throughout the country. More than 7,000 houses (totally, partially, or partially) have been destroyed. JPF will deliver assistance in accordance with the actual situation and needs in the area so that people whose houses and other structures have been damaged by the serious torrential rain disaster and who are facing difficulties.

title: Hawaii Wildfire Relief Fund
description: The worst wildfires in Hawaii's history have caused more than 100 deaths, left dozens injured, and reduced towns to ash. Dozens of people are missing. Strong winds from Hurricane Dora fueled the flames in Maui and the Big Island. Your donation to the Hawaii Wildfire Relief Fund will support wildfire relief and recovery efforts in affected communities.

title: ECD building project
description: We would like to build an ECD centre for Children in the Community of Mamelodi in South Africa,  and currently raising funds for the building of the project

title: Children with Parent in Prison-Game with Mum & Dad
description: This Europe-wide project organises football games within prison walls between an imprisoned mum or dad and their children. Child-parent contact when a parent is behind bars is a known protective factor. Yet prisons are rough places. Children undergo searches, hear metal doors slamming. We offer an alternative way to promote contact and inclusion and empower kids.  "It was short but beautiful. Dad and I haven't had fun together for 2 years. Being with him makes me happy. I thank you." -8-year-old

title: Community Health Worker Program
description: Our project proposes to train local women, too often excluded from professional opportunities in Lobitos, into future community health workers. Thanks to house visits and community workshops, as well as through public health education, they will help combat and prevent ever increasing-diseases in the area such as hypertension, diabetes, and anaemia - the main contributors to local mortality and morbidity.

title: Veterinary ambulance for spaying campaigns
description: A veterinary ambulance will allow us and the other non profits in the area that focus on animal rescue to spay dogs and cats in more remote areas, which in turn will decrease abandonment of dogs and cats that die on the streets either by illness, accidents or in the hand of people.  Asociatia Dumbrava lui Patrocle plans to offer spaying campaigns in Cluj county and in the nearby counties, in partnerships with vets and active animal rescue non profits.

title: Help us preserve Georgia's heritage & landscapes
description: Georgia possesses hundreds of historic sites worthy of saving and promoting, but lacks sufficient resources and skills. It has a highly distinctive culture and depends financially on its tourism.  The National Trust of Georgia provides practical support & sustainable methods of preserving Georgia's historic built environment and landscape. We support major restoration projects, provide workshops, consultation and advice to private owners, local neighborhoods, developers, & other organisations.

title: Food for the animals in our care
description: In our care, there are 60+ dogs, 12 cats, one pony and one goat. Some have health problems and some are very scared so their chances of adoption are really small. They need food, every month. Some of the food comes from donations abroad, but if there are no adoptions, we don't receive food either.  We try to provide them medium quality food, to avoid expensive visits to the vets caused by the poor food quality.

title: Therapy for our children for the next 3 months
description: This project will allow 7 children from our community to continue going to therapy for the following 3 months.  Their problems are diverse, from panic attacks to ADHD.

title: Help Airlink Send Responders - Hawaii Wildfires
description: Airlink is working with its NGO and airline partners to provide free-of-charge flights for responding personnel to reach communities in Maui. Volunteer relief responders will be providing critical services including telecommunications connectivity, debris removal, heirloom recovery, and shelter support. Affected residents most in need of support will be prioritized.

title: Road to Healing:50 Self-Care Kits for Abused Girls
description: The journey it takes to understand the importance of loving yourself and taking care of yourself, after experiencing abuse of any kind can be a hard one. We want to create care packages that will assist young ladies with their journey of self-care.

title: Giving Light & Hope to Families - Maui Wildfires
description: Giving Light & Hope to Families in Maui SmartAID Wildfire Response   Join us in strengthening Maui and all our loved ones on the Island.  We are combining clean energy solutions, telecommunications, access to WiFi and distribution of much need basic items from food to bedding, sheets, towels, hygiene kits and more, this to ensure every child, mother, and family can live in dignified manner.

title: Floods in Slovenia Emergency
description: Slovenia has faced the worst-ever natural disaster in its history, Prime Minister Robert Golob said. The devastating floods have killed at least 6 people and destroyed roads, bridges and houses in the small Alpine country, causing damages estimated at half a billion euros.  From the very beginning, ADRA has responded promptly to the consequences of the disaster in Slovenia. On the ground, in cooperation with the fire brigade and civil protection, they have helped many residents in a dynamic and

title: Empower students: Bilingual education in Colombia
description: Our movement is based on our belief that to tackle the educational challenges in Colombia we need exceptional leadership on different levels of the system. Being part of this project means that you are helping us bring more talented bilingual professionals to different Colombian regions; professionals that we train and support throughout 2 years. Let's work together so that students in Colombia learn English to create more powerful life projects and develop their maximum potential.

title: Help Us Fight Hunger Across Egypt
description: Feeding the hungry homeless elderly, women, children patients, disabled across all Egypt as part of zero hunger., many of those people  lives and sleep with empty stomachs ,. Our aim to feed the hungry destitute, abandoned senior people Donate today to help us to serve & elevate the hungry pain.

title: Educate 100 Children with Disabilities in Syria
description: In Syria, over 10,000 children with physical disabilities face educational challenges. Already burdened by the birth defects and war injuries, living in makeshift camps far from schools, they lack the necessary support and resources to continue their studies. Our goal is to extend a helping hand to these students, enabling them to receive quality education and thrive in society. With your support, we can empower more than 100 students with physical challenges. Help them learn and grow.

title: Wildlife research collars
description: In partnership with the Endangered Wildlife Trust we aim to fund the collaring of 5 spotted hyenas and 5 lions as part of an expanded project that monitors vulture feeding data. Information gathered from tracking these animals helps to better protect them and as an early detection system to locate poached animals, snare lines and poisoned carcasses.  This VITAL research works both with local communities and researchers to be able to reduce poaching and poisoning. $11,000.00 in matched funds.

title: Humanitarian Surge Fund Globally
description: CARE reaches more than 20 million people a year with humanitarian aid, but it's not enough. The Humanitarian Surge Fund is the key, as it allows us to respond immediately and make a significant impact. This reserve fund can be deployed in the first days of an emergency, often before any other help is available.

title: Help the Ukrainian Team Play at Homeless World Cup
description: Way Home Foundation runs the Street Football program in Ukraine since 2004, utilizing street soccer as a tool for social rehabilitation and intervention for people in crisis.  Our Ukrainian national street soccer team has achieved remarkable success at the Homeless World Cup in the past and has taken part in 2023 World Cup in Sacramento. We are seeking funds to train and support our team formed from combat veterans in Ukraine, ensuring their participation at this tournament in 2024.

title: Kolkata Girls: Anti-trafficking / Pro-Empowerment.
description: Our safe house has been operating since 2012. We have 16 girls receiving 24/7 care. They come from one of the very biggest source sex-trafficking districts in India - Murshidabad, West Bengal. We have just accepted a further 6 girls which has meant that we have had to rearrange our whole budget! Because of the poverty from which they have come, we are working hard to offer quality food. Hence we are seeking support specifically for nutritious/clean food for our girls for a full 12-month period.

title: Heating for the winter months
description: This project will allow us to have activities with the children all year round, no matter how cold it is outside.  The activities include helping them with homework, crafting, games, movie events, reading.

title: The John B. McGrath Library in Honduras
description: John McGrath has become a prolific writer, amongst many other things, throughout his life. In his name, we are working to set up the John B. McGrath community library in El Progreso, Honduras, creating a vibrant space of learning and engagement led by and for young people.

title: Borehill Drilling
description: Clean Water in Nakuru, Kenya, is a vital resource that brings not only health but also hope and numerous opportunities. We are striving to drill a 250-meter borehole, which requires $12000. We need $4000 to fulfill this project. Once completed, water availability will pave the way for transformative initiatives such as our ecosystem farm, livestock ventures, trade school, and the upliftment of the local community. With your support, we can provide clean water.

title: Food parcels for single elderly people in Ukraine
description: This project helps lonely elderly people in Ukraine to have enough food every month and live in decent conditions.  Many of them are unable to move around on their own, buy food and need outside help. Now, during the war, we continue to help them.  Every month, we deliver essential food packages: cereals, porridge, canned food, flour, oil, sugar, tea and other products to help lonely elderly people eat well. We need to continue working on this problem and act quickly to save these people's lives

title: Send deaf Tanzanian children to school
description: In Tanzania, over 500,000 deaf individuals face enormous barriers to education and communication. Our project is focused on proactive outreach. We're not waiting for change; we're sending our local volunteer, Patrick, into rural villages in Dodoma to find the deaf children who need a chance at education. Our mission is to locate these children and provide them with tailored education, including teaching Tanzanian Sign Language for effective communication.

title: Spreading the love of reading in rural Mexico
description: We work with the most marginalized communities in the municipalities of San Miguel de Allende and Dolores Hidalgo, implementing free educational campaigns and events. Our goals for the 2023-2024 school year are to implement 2 Big Read campaigns (600 children in each), 1 new community library, continued tutoring to at least one school, 3 summer camps (for a total of 75 children), and to take a book club from a rural community to the International Book Fair in Guadalajara.

title: The Maui Resilience Project- Thriving and Coping
description: Offering yoga, meditation, tai chi and other mindfulness resources as well as Reiki, Healing Touch and hands on Trauma Therapy and exercises. These will be free offerings both online and in person on the island of Maui. The trauma and grief are very large and giving tools to be able to process and release the horror of the Wild Fire Tragedy with empower them to thrive and function.

title: Scholarships to empower girls in Pakistan
description: Due to numerous socio-cultural obstacles, female education in Pakistan continues to have considerable difficulties affecting their personal growth, socioeconomic development, and empowerment.  The gender-biased approach and male dominancy have severely affected women's contributions to a sustainable and empowered society. AWARD aims to support young girls with disadvantaged backgrounds in three districts of Punjab in completing their higher education through the provision of scholarships.

title: Food For The Hungry
description: The removal of fuel subsidies has led to skyrocketing food prices, pushing already impoverished families to the brink. Your contribution will provide immediate relief, ensuring that no child goes to bed hungry and no parent faces the torment of being unable to provide for their family.  With your support, we can bring nutritious meals to hungry children, empower women to become self-sufficient and ensure that every person has the chance to lead a dignified life, regardless of their situation.

title: STEM Education for 350 Vulnerable Youth in Vietnam
description: Kidspire uses STEM education to engage Vietnamese youth and help them regain an interest in learning, transitioning from students who have given up on school into students who believe they can pursue meaningful career goals.  But we need your help to ensure that this project reaches the kids who need it most.

title: Support Rural Leaders in Training Connections
description: Transportation is the most significant barrier to attending the Rural Leaders Training Program. Without funds to support travel to the Asian Rural Institute, rural leaders cannot participate and transformation cannot occur. Eight out of ten participants return to become rural leaders implementing sustainable agricultural strategies in their community, impacting hundreds. Travel is the first step in building leadership in sustainable agricultural development, the building block of society.

title: Christian in Jaranwala need immediate support
description: A charged mob of around 7,000 people stormed a Christian colony in the Jaranwala Tehsil of Faisalabad district on Wednesday morning, where they ransacked and torched couple of Christian colonies (houses), 22 churches to ashes over blasphemy allegations, locals and police said. In addition to this, mob also attacked nearby Christian graveyard. At least, 1000 Christian families got directly affected. Pak Mission Society will support through cash-based transfer for meeting the immediate needs.

title: Every Mind Matters
description: Engaging in sports is one of the best ways to help children improve their mental well-being. This project will support children and youth in Kilinochchi to gain better access to sports with professional coaches and provide a pathway to improve their mental well-being.

title: STRENGTHENING COMMUNITY CONSERVATION IN UGANDA
description: In the border areas of national parks in Uganda, wildlife and people compete over land and natural resources. 50% of wildlife live on people's land. Umoja strengthens the capacity of communities to deal with human-wildlife conflicts, establish conservancies and protect, manage and benefit from wildlife, by training scouts on anti-poaching and human-wildlife conflict mitigation measures, increasing public awareness on conservation benefits and improving governance structures of conservancies.

title: Lahaina Fires - Good360 Longterm Recovery Support
description: Good360 is working proactively with partners on projects to aid responders and survivors.   This includes a logistical cohort with LIFT Nonprofit Logistics, ALAN Aid, Airlink, Maersk, The UPS Foundation, to ensure efficient shipping of critical items We are setting up a shared warehouse space to receive, sort, and ship items for Maui. Also, Aloha Kits to help survivors get through the weeks ahead - kitchenware, household items, bedding AND a Volunteer Fire Safety Kit with appropriate PPE.

title: Empower 50 Women in Syria with Education
description: This project will empower Syrian women impacted by conflict and social injustices. Amid challenges of early marriages and displacement, we aim to provide education and support to 50 women through our free online platform. Let's help them regain control over their lives, learn new skills, and shape a brighter, equitable future.

title: Plants-4-Hunger: Feed People, Protect the Planet
description: The United Nations has urged that we will need to produce 70% more food by 2050 without using any more land. According to the UN, we could feed 3.5 billion more people simply by growing crops for human consumption on land currently used to grow feed for livestock. Our Plants-4-Hunger program sponsors plant-based feeding, farming and disaster food relief projects around the world that feed more people using far less land, water, and energy, while protecting animals, ecosystems, and the climate.

title: Angaza: Help a Kenyan Student Receive an Education
description: Angaza, which means illuminate in Swahili, is a program that provides underprivileged children with access to quality education and a brighter future. This is done through a comprehensive package that covers not just tuition, but also school supplies, transportation, uniforms, and mentorship. For just $1,500 per year or $6,000 for four years you can equip a student in need with the necessary tools to succeed. Join us in rekindling the flame of education and hope.

title: Safe & Secure Toilet for females in Sindh-pakistan
description: In a recent monsoon of 2023 communities continue to fight against diseases, a follow-on of catastrophic flooding in 2022, submerged a third of the country, killing 1700 people, and displacing more than 8 million. Building 500 toilets in the Southern province of Sindh will facilitate women, and adolescent girls to adhere to health and hygiene practices, and remain safe. The absence of toilets increases women's dignity concerns at a critical level, causing physiological and emotional stress.

title: Help 65 poor women to start Beekeeping in Uganda
description: Beekeeping is a sustainable, cost-effective, and ecologically friendly way for rural smallholder farmers to generate income and enhance household food security. GivingHope Foundation aims to support 65 rural Ugandan farmers who have expressed interest in developing beekeeping and honey production. This initiative will benefit both their families and the environment. With this project, we seek to establish 195 new beehives and provide technical support to new beekeepers.

title: LINKING YOUNG PEOPLE TO BRIGHT FUTURE
description: Despite the challenges in in Juhudi children in crisis we have been able to support most orphans, single parent children and less fortunate in the community to access to both primary and secondary education. It is through these efforts that a good number of our beneficiaries have and want to proceed to either university or college. We expose youth to new opportunities to grow, learn and serve their communities that encourage them to see beyond their neighborhoods.

title: Help to Feed the Orphan and Poor Baloch Children
description: The "Help to Feed the Orphans and Poor Baloch Children" project by BRDP aims to alleviate hunger and malnutrition among vulnerable children. Through regular nutritious meals, health monitoring, and community engagement, the project seeks to enhance their well-being, promote education, and empower local communities for a stronger, healthier Balochistan.

title: Educational Scholarships for Orphans
description: Many children in Indonesia are orphans and/or come from underprivileged families. According to government data, perhaps as many as hundreds of thousands of them. Their families or guardians are not able or are barely able to suffice their economic needs, and their very crucial educational needs.  Seeing this,  Rumah Zakat Foundation of Indonesia, has launched a project of providing educational scholarships in the form of cash assistance to orphans and underprivileged children.

title: Donate to Refugees hit hardest by hunger in Africa
description: Refugees and displaced families across the Horn of Africa are caught in a hunger crisis, and the dire situation in the region isn't letting up. We need your support to keep reaching refugees and displaced families.   Help the Hardest Hit by Hunger today.

title: Provide water for Indonesian villages
description: The global warming phenomena has caused changes, good or bad, to weather and climate all over the world. Locations impacted negatively include several regions of Indonesia, which are currently experiencing unprecedented drought. Such conditions create water shortage which in turn will impact food availability and health of communities.  In response, Rumah Zakat Indonesia is launching the water well program to help provide water-acquiring facilities for villages experiencing drought.

title: Help little Alya recover from brain tumor!
description: Little Alya is only 5 years old. A very sweet, cheerful and lovable girl. Yet sadly at a very young age, she already suffers from a brain tumor, which requires her to undergo brain surgery. Thankfully, the procedure was successful, and Alya is now recovering. The cost of her operation was covered by a government subsidy, however, the postoperative treatment she must undergo is not.  At the moment, Alya's parents are at a considerable problem in trying to cover for the expense.

title: Sponsor10 refugees in DRC to attend this UN Summit
description: Refugees in the Democratic Republic of Congo are among the most forgotten ones in the world, at all levels (International, Regional, National and Local Levels ) they are not considered. This year in December from 12-15th, 2023 the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) is hosting the second Global Refugee Forum in Geneva. This remains one among the best opportunities to raise issues of refugees in DRC.  But this is only possible if Refugees and Actors of the Civil Society attend.

title: Vocational Skills to Empower Underprivileged Boys
description: Since 1991, CR is supporting hundreds of vulnerable slum children of Kolkata through educational programme. Apart from imparting education it emphasizes holistic development of its students, who enter the centres at a tender age of 4 and are supported till their youth stage when they are able to earn a living for themselves. Vocational training is an important component of CR's holistic education. Youth students put into various vocation stream to get employment opportunities with earned skills.

title: Support Food to Nepali Women
description: The project will provide comprehensive food support to 100 women from who abandon by their family and facing the challenges of mental health conditions.  we will alleviate their nutritional insecurity and enhance their overall well-being, fostering an environment of care, empathy, and empowerment for these vulnerable women.

description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' (LI) International Internship Program, Kira, Kiara, and Kara have been collaborating with local entrepreneurs, to address critical grassroots challenges facing small business owners in Bauchi, Nigeria.
