title: Empower children in poverty with healthcare access
description: Poverty has many faces. Sometimes they're obvious: sunken cheek bones, bodies maligned from malnourishment and harsh living conditions. But often, poverty shows itself in what we don't see: the energy to dance or run across a sports field, plates of food at mealtimes, or clean water in cups. These examples point to the same truth: a lack of healthcare access is both a cause and an effect of poverty, keeping those affected trapped within its vicious cycle. We're on a mission to break it.

title: Help Imagine Scholar Students with University Fees
description: We're proud 100% of our students have been accepted to university, but not always with full financial aid. NSFAS is South Africa's financial aid program, which many of our students rely on to cover university costs. Oftentimes, it can take 1-2 months to begin, so Imagine Scholar provides support for bus tickets, book money, or 1st month's rent through our Sustainable Student Opportunity Fund, a no-interest loan that any student can apply for and later repay so future youth can use as well.

title: Join Us in Saving Lives of Children
description: At the Health Fund for Children of Armenia, we are dedicated to making a lasting difference in the lives of children facing severe health challenges. Our journey began in 2020, and since then, we've been working tirelessly to provide lifesaving treatments both in Armenia and beyond and create a brighter future for these young warriors.

title: Global Run 2023: Solidarity Run for Refugees
description: Join our annual Global Run, 2023 edition: Support refugees by donating to Yoga and Sport With Refugees and help us to continue building happier and healthier communities through the power of sport. We invite you to get involved! Run alongside us on the 10th of September by joining one our organised runs (Berlin, Athens, Paris and more) or simply going out and running with friends in solidarity with people on the move.

title: A community Center for & with refugees in Greece
description: We combat social exclusion and poverty in urban contexts with a longterm, sustainable and comprehensive approach. Our center is accessible, supports efforts of integration as well as emergency support on a drop-in basis and promotes social inclusion through community-building, participation, and holistic support services. Via collaboration and open communal spaces, we promote interaction, idea development, relationship-building & appropriate services to empower people seeking refuge.

title: Help baby Maryam with her  heart surgery!
description: Maryam is only months old, yet she suffers from the swelling of the heart. She is need of urgent surgery, but her weight does not qualify for a safe procedure, therefore Maryam is undergoing a weight gaining treatment. But recently she was admitted to the intensive care because of failure to breathe. To compund her ordeal, her father, the provider of the family, suffered a stroke and currently disabled.  We are inviting you to lend your hand to help Maryam battle her disease, and help her family

title: Empower Nepal's Organic Coffee and Beekeeping
description: Nepal's beauty is tarnished by political instability, corruption & pushing its promising youths to seek low-paying & harsh jobs abroad. A transformative vision seeks to empower locals through sustainable initiatives like Organic Arabica Coffee farming & Beekeeping. These projects offer hope for community development of rural villages bringing economic independence to women and youths and also support for community tourism development.Join us in this great journey to illuminate Nepal's potential.

title: Kind Hope Organisation Resource Mobilization
description: To empower 50,000 youths in Harare Metropolitan Province high density suburbs by 2026 through:Imparting social, educational and economic knowledge into the youths through workshops,billboards ,TV and Radio Shows;Helping the vulnerable students through provision of school fees and material support;impart entrepreneurial skills;Imparting leadership and responsibility skills into the youths;Reducing Alcohol and Drug abuse amongst the youths.Providing SRHR education and material support.

title: Support Nigeriens During this Critical Time
description: The attempted coup in Niger creates an uncertain future. Border closures and sanctions limit access to food, electricity, and other basic goods and services. No one knows when life will get back to normal. Niger needs our support now, more than ever before. Show Nigeriens that you stand with them. Give today to help families meet their basic needs as they fight to hold onto their democracy.

title: 35 Cents Feeds a Hungry Child
description: A Haitian proverb states "A hungry child cannot hear what you are saying."   When children come to school hungry, they struggle to hear or learn.  We believe that one of the most important components of educating children is providing a nutritious meal at school.  For most, this is their ONE and ONLY meal that day.  This lunch is life-sustaining and saves 3,000 children from starvation and malnutrition.  Just 35 cents will provide a child with a strengthening meal and meet a most vital need.

title: Masai  Community Health Project
description: Each year 2.3 million children die in the first month of life.  5 million children around the world do not live until their 5th birthday.  According to the WHO over 313,000 mothers die each year in child birth or shortly after due to complications of birth.  Medic Outpost is training and developing community health workers that will have the equipment and expertise to treat illness, provide education on maternal and newborn health, provide evaluation and follow up in the villages themselves.

title: Plant Food Trees for Climate and Hunger
description: The UN says conserving forests and planting more trees could provide nearly one third of urgent climate mitigation needed in the next ten years. Food trees uniquely address the triple crises of global hunger, climate change, and biodiversity loss by providing food and income, carbon sequestration, and wildlife habitat, while reducing widespread deforestation driven by animal agriculture. Our Food Trees for Climate and Hunger Fund supports food tree and food forest plantings around the world.

title: Restore Habitat for Cao Vit Gibbons
description: The Cao Vit Gibbon is one of the world's most endangered primates. It is currently found only along the border between China and Vietnam, with an estimated 130 individuals in the wild. Gibbons are highly dependent on trees for their survival. Therefore, in order to protect them, Shanghai Roots & Shoots plans to restore their only habitat in China that has been previously destroyed by human activities by planting trees to provide them with food and habitat.

title: Therapy for 30 disabled children in rural Moldova
description: There is very little support for disabled children and their families in Moldova, particularly in rural areas.  Most often a diagnosis only brings stigma rather than the assistance that can help children reach their potential.  So the Dorintsa centre (The Wish) is the only place local families can turn.  We provide an individualised multi-disciplinary programme for each child including physiotherapy, speech and language therapy, play therapy and accessible education.

title: Indigenous women accessing local markets
description: Market access is essential for the development of indigenous communities. Historically, family farming, the transformation of local products and handicrafts are the sources of family and community income for the rural population in Honduras. However, these sources of life have been hit hard with  an economic model that excludes family farming and community economic initiatives. Community markets have been invaded by imported agricultural produce and used clothing.

title: Employ 50 individuals with Disabilities in Texas
description: The Best Buddies Texas Jobs project will impact 50 individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities that are seeking employment. Our program model allows BBTX to deliver high touch training to prepare participants to enter the workforce. The Best Buddies Jobs program secures jobs for people with disabilities, allowing them to earn an income, pay taxes, and  independently support themselves. Best Buddies builds careers that match the job seeker's interests and talents, like all of us.

title: helping 500 blind students with glasses in lushoto
description: project is helping 500 blind students in lushoto center with eye glasses to access them in their daily programs and daily lives.

title: Lotus School: Safe Haven for Domestic Survivors
description: Support Lotus Flower Community School: Be a Beacon of Hope for domestic violence survivors. Your contribution ensures safety, renewal, and resilience for abused women and children, guiding them to brighter tomorrows. Join us in nurturing hope through our transformative sanctuary and support services, including shelter for respite and healing of 60 women in Ndola. Stand with us to transform nightmares into liberation. Your kindness sparks renewal, guiding survivors from darkness to light.

title: Help Ngao Foundation Purchase land for programs
description: This project will enable us to purchase land to implement new projects and also help in expanding our programs. Our current rented space is not enough to accommodate our growing programs, staff, volunteers, and beneficiaries. The need is just enormous. We face constant challenges such as high rent, and constant conflicts with the landlords, so it takes time before a decision is made. These challenges affect our ability to deliver quality programs and services to the people who need them most.

title: Quality SRH Care for 1000 Youth in Ethiopia
description: Bridge for Development Organization plans to train 30 health care workers from 10 health centers in Addis Ababa. The health workers will learn how to provide quality and adolescent and youth friendly sexual health and family planning program approach and fill the supply side gaps. Following the training the health worker will work with improved strategies and program quality improvement indicators.

title: Supporting Children and Teens' Education at risk
description: At PACO IAP, Childrens Home, we are committed to the well-being and future of the children and teenagers who call our institution their home. Having successfully provided comprehensive care, we are excited to introduce our educational project aimed at securing a quality education for them. Our goal is to equip these children and adolescents with the necessary tools and unwavering support to help them realize their academic and personal potential. Together we can make it possible.

title: EmpowerHER Africa: Training for Gender Equality
description: At Cameras For Girls, we are developing a sustainable training program to advance Cameras For Girls' mission of promoting gender equality in Africa. This initiative will empower former students to mentor new students, fostering growth and skill development. Simultaneously, this program will significantly enhance gender equity within Africa's male-dominated journalism and photography sectors, promoting greater opportunities and representation for women in these industries.

title: Building His Future With Wood
description: Raphael has a plan set in oak: Become a carpenter and a wood carving artist to help support his family; one older brother and a single mother. That's why he, like his brother before him, is a student at Have Hammer...Will Travel.   For those students who can afford it, there is a nominal tuition. For those who can't, like Raphael, it's free. Your donations not only pay rent, utilities, teachers, materials and upkeep of machinery and tools, but give kids like Raphael hope for the future.

title: Support Schooling for 300 Children in Syria
description: Join our urgent campaign to enable 300 children in northern Syria to return to school. Economic hardships faced by displaced families have left many unable to provide their children with the necessary educational resources. Together, we can make a difference by ensuring these children have the tools they need to continue their education.

title: Tele-Medical
description: This project is planned to support disabilities children, enabling them to undergo assessments by Prosthetics and Orthotics specialists. This ensures that the equipment they are using is well-suited for their developmental needs, facilitating proper physical support. Moreover, it offers fund for new equipment requirements, following expert diagnoses and recommendations.

title: Hurricane Idalia Relief Fund
description: Hurricane Idalia is the strongest storm to make landfall in Florida's Big Bend region in more than 125 years. The powerful hurricane brought catastrophic and record-breaking storm surge, flooding, and damaging winds to Florida, Georgia, and the Carolinas. Your donation to the Hurricane Idalia Relief Fund will provide immediate and long-term relief in affected communities.

title: Empower school dropout for self reliance.
description: This project will empower school dropout adolescent youth by providing vocational training, such as tailoring, hair dressing, carpentry, block laying and concrete practice. computer/information technology skills, which are essential for success in a challenging economy. Additionally, a small loan will be given to them to support in starting and growing their small businesses.

title: Help Bhumi Plant 10,000 Trees
description: Bhumi's "Think Green Initiative" combats deforestation by planting over 10,141 trees. Through community partnerships, they source saplings and instill environmental responsibility. With 2,662 volunteers, 90 events have been held, and there's a goal to plant 10,000 more trees in FY 23-24. Aligned with Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) - 15, Bhumi underscores environmental stewardship as a collective duty and invites everyone to join in restoring the environment.

title: Supporting children with cancer in Myanmar
description: Approximately 2,000 children are expected to develop cancer each year in Myanmar. Due to a lack of awareness of childhood cancer, an inability to accurately diagnose cases and the prohibitive cost of transport, the number of newly diagnosed cases is far lower than expected for the country.

title: Construction Phase 1 for Haiti Leadership Center
description: We are helping our partner in Haiti, Rasin Devlopman, build a permanent community leadership and development center on the island of La Gonave. Thanks to the generous support of our donors, we've already raised the money to purchase the land, hire the architect, and drill a well. Now, we are raising money for the first phase of construction! Money raised on Global Giving will go towards "Building D" of the Center, which includes a veranda, reception area, and office space for staff.

title: Developing Minds in Maniapure
description: Centro La Milagrosa is the host of " Preescolar Padre Miguel Gonzalez", the only preschool in a 1,500 km2 area. Run by Asociacion Damas Salesianas, this center provides quality education and nutritional support to children aged 3-6, belonging to over 35 Indigenous and Creole communities located in the far south of Venezuela, in Maniapure.

title: Digital Equity for 200 Minnesota Students
description: MN Tech for Success' (MTFS) mission is to provide digital equity to students in need by offering technology access, engaging STEM programming, and IT workforce development in underserved communities. We will provide workforce development and skills training to 200 low-income, majority BIPOC youth and adults this year. Programs offer students stackable, industry-recognized certifications and hands-on skills training, to meet the growing demand for IT professionals across all employment sectors.

title: Going To The Dogs
description: This project will build secure yards and TuffSheds for our Livestock Guardian Dogs. Funds from this project will also provide on-going veterinary care, food and enrichment items for our Guardians.

title: Growing Vegetables in 1000 families in Uganda
description: Your donation will aim at supporting growing vegetables in the kitchen gardens in 2000 kitchen gardens and 1000 families with malnourished children in  Ntoroko district, Uganda. Kichen gardens helps women in having vegetables for nutritious food and generate income, protect them from illness and hunger and climate restoration "we learned that sanitation, nutrition, kitchen gardens, saving for the children family planning and health education from RAFUG have helped us to have good life."

title: HOUSING FIRST MODEL: Everything starts at home!
description: The Housing First concept is precisely that: a social program that provides immediate access for people experiencing homelessness to permanent housing. Its fundamental principle is that everyone deserves adequate/enduring housing as an essential right before improving anything else. Every night, an estimated 19,000+ people find themselves without a place to go or sleep with dignity and security in Chile. Homelessness is one of the cruelest and most degrading ways of poverty.

title: Scholarship for poor girls to study nursing
description: This project is to provide scholarships to 60 girls to study the nursing course in St. Mary's School of Nursing organized by Women for Women (WFW). They were stopped with 12th standard because of poverty. The girls have the interest and motivation in studying the professional course. WFW is willing to admit the girls for the course. With the scholarship the girls will be able to meet the expenses relating to books, notebooks, uniforms, exam fees, training materials, and hostel expenses.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' (LI) International Internship Program, our team has been working with LI to research and learn about public health crises and potential solutions in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to create a public health campaign to raise awareness and educate the people of Bauchi on these various public health issues.

title: Leadership Initiatives Students Creating Change
description: As members of Leadership Initiatives' (LI) International Internship Program, our team has been working with LI to research and learn about public health crises and potential solutions in Bauchi State, Nigeria. To transform lives, the team & LI are working to create a public health campaign to raise awareness and educate the people of Bauchi on these various public health issues.

title: The Heart of Our Programs: Supporting 50,000 Lives
description: At Hearts of Gold we're dedicated to helping our community, from children to adults, who benefit from our programs. Our participants come from all walks of life, seeking education, support, and opportunities for growth. With your support, we can ensure that our home, the heartbeat of our programs, remains strong and vibrant.  Your donation will cover critical costs such as rent, utilities, and internet for our central facility -where our programs take root, flourish, and transform lives.

title: Diabetes Prevention and Control in 250 Villages
description: Recent studies report that 8-10 percent of people in rural villages have diabetes. The reports has been a marked increase in diabetic cases in the lower income groups as compared to the prevalence of diabetes in the higher and middle income groups. As per this study about 13 percent of people in the lower income groups have been found to have diabetes. India is stated to become the number one country in the world for diabetes by 2026.

title: Disability Project Nepal
description: The living condition of disabled people in rural Nepal is severely bad because of immobility, discrimination, poverty and lack of access to the social protection and healthcare. This project will work closely with 700 disabled people in Mahadewa rural municipality by providing them assistive devices, improve social inclusion, create livelihood opportunities, enable them through education and advocacy so they can benefit from available social protection and health care services.

title: Sijonge Kuwe Food Gardening Project
description: Food Security is one of the imprtant tool to fight poverty and unemployment in underdeveloped countries in Africa.Sijonge Kuwe has sarted food gardening project in Khayelitsha.Youth,women and people with disabilities are encouraged to have food gardening in their homes and will be trained on food gardening skills as well as business skills training.We intend to train 20 people in this quarter.On completion of training these individuals will be supplied with   small tools,seeds and fertilizer.

title: New Headquarters for Taller Salud
description: We are thrilled to announce an ambitious and essential project that will significantly enhance our ability to make a lasting impact on the lives of those we serve. We are embarking on a campaign to raise funds for a new headquarters, which will serve as the heart of our operations and allow us to expand our reach and services to even more community members.  Our current facilities have served us well, but we have outgrown them in our mission to create a stronger, safer, and more just community.

title: JANNAH WATER WELLS, AFRICA
description: Our Jannah Water Wells project for Africa, started in February 2019. We have built already 218 water wells in 6 African countries, Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria, Cameroon, Chad and Mali. In the desert lands of Nigeria, more than 800 000 people, most of them children, are dying from Hepatitis B, every year, in consequence of the contaminated water they drink. Our water wells are the only source of clean water for villages of more than 1000 people in Nigeria and more than 300 people in Uganda. Help us!

title: Improving water and sanitation facilities at Isalo
description: To lessen the WASH issue caused by the insufficient access to clean and safe water, shortage of students latrines' drop-holes in the primary schools in the Mbozi District, SHIPO plans to build the girls' latrine block (8-drop holes/rooms, 1 changing room or MHM unit with installed incinerator); and water project facilities (with 1 water point, hand washing facility with 8 hygienic taps installed) at Isalalo Primary School by December 2023.

title: Send back 2000 forced out-of-school CHILDREN
description: Citadel Charity Women Organization is a non-governmental organization that is committed to a mission that transcends borders and defies adversity. The issue we address is one that strikes at the very heart of humanity: the plight of children forcibly uprooted from their educational journey by the relentless insurgency in Nigeria. For over a decade, Boko Haram's violence has inflicted immeasurable suffering on communities, leaving a trail of destruction and displacement in its wake.

title: Connecting 200 girls from Petare in Technology
description: Superatec will train 200 girls and women between 15 and 29 years old from Petare, through the STEM Skills Program, providing skills in learning science, technology, engineering, and mathematics, including educational training kits.   Participation of girls and women in the sciences is important because of their capacity for innovation and resilience, which improves their access to new jobs and the connection of ideas along frontiers and cultures by technology.

title: Rainwater harvesting system in 3 rural communities
description: This project will build rainwater harvesting systems for 3 vulnerable rural communities in the Azuero Peninsula in Panama which are currently affected by climate change induced droughts. This projects also provides the community schools with an orchard where the children will learn how to produce their own food organically.

title: Create 100 Jobs in Nigeria in 2024
description: At Leadership Initiatives (LI), we believe in the power of communities to rise above systemic underdevelopment. Our mission is simple: empower individuals to be the catalysts for positive change within their own communities. We partner with local community and business leaders to provide promising individuals with the tools they need to become entrepreneurial leaders at a grassroots level.

title: Caring for the elderly in Venezuela
description: This project aims to promote the care of the elderly in the city of Merida (Venezuela) by training 100 young people and women from low-income sectors as integral caregivers and community monitors for the elderly through a university course in theory and practice that includes community service in nursing homes in their local communities.

title: ST.Mary's Hospital needy Equipment's and building
description: We started ST.Mary's Hospital and Nursing school with 100 poor students  studying Diploma in Nursing in three year course.  We are running Rental  building. It is not sufficient for Teaching class room and and hostel.  We are working 100 rural villages, they need 24 Hours Emergency clinic for snack biting, BP, Sugar, accident.  35 K.M. distance to the near hospital. We need some medical equipment and Hospital building. It will be very useful for poor students and poor villagers.

title: Empowering Teen Girls Globally
description: She is the Universe empowers teenage girls from 50+ countries around the world through storytelling, mentorship, and leadership development. This project will support our leadership development and mentorship program by providing a full scholarship to all 90 girls from our next cohort. Regions where girls are based include North America, South America, Middle East, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

title: Menstrual Cups: Support 1000 Girls in Uganda.
description: The project will support 1000 school girls in fishing communities in Uganda with a free menstrual cup enabling the girls to stay at school during menstruation. A single menstrual cup, costing USD. 5, supports a school girl for a minimum of 5 years.

title: Improve food production for 120 farmers
description: Burundi has over 11 millions of inhabitants, with an average annual growth rate of 2.4% and a galloping demographic pressure. Ensuring food security for an ever-growing population is generating massive land occupation, with heavy consequences on land-related economic activities, such as livestock farming. In the provinces of Ruyigi and Rutana the project will promote new practices for improving livestock food production and income generating activities, by involving 120 local farmers.

title: Provide 250 IDP families with food packages!
description: This project will provide 250 IDP families with food kits and personal hygiene products currently residing in the city of Odesa, Ukraine.

title: Pipas Labs
description: Pipas Labs is an educational program that distributes creative technology kits in marginalized urban areas in Brazil to combat systemic inequality. The kits include the tools, materials and lessons for participants to create playful, culturally-relevant projects while building necessary skills and knowledge needed to participate in the 21st century economy.

title: Holistic Development of Youths with Disabilities
description: The project will work closely with key duty bearers and rights holders at national and local level to improve their capacity in coordination, data system management, reporting, advocacy for disability inclusive environment and promoting disability inclusive skills training and employment. The project emphasizes meaningful participation of Youth Disabled in all aspects, with particular focus on advocating on key areas and are capacitated to meaningfully contribute to the societies.

title: Present A Home
description: We aim to give underprivileged residents (teenage mothers and refugees) of The Hague a home, giving them the opportunity to participate in society again. We offer our volunteers the chance to contribute to the quality of life of fellow citizens. As a side effect, we offer the children of the target group a clean and safe environment and create understanding between different groups in society. At the end of every project there is a tangible result: a home.

title: Empower 250 Orphans thru ICT-Integrated Education
description: In Uganda, orphaned children endure unimaginable hardships. This project will empower 250 vulnerable young souls through education. Our vision is to establish an ICT-integrated primary school, where these children can uncover their potential, conquer adversity, and embrace a future filled with promise. With your support, we bridge the gap between dreams and reality, reaching out to compassionate hearts worldwide. Together, we uplift these orphans, nurturing a legacy of love and hope.

title: School First, Education Always
description: We are rebuilding our campus to provide quality education to children affected by the recent earthquakes in Turkiye.  Support our campaign with your donations, light the future of our children!

title: Urgent Administrative Costs Support
description: The funds will enable us to meet critical office administrative costs including staff wages, office rent, and needed communication and stationery costs. Without this support our operations are at stake of being disrupted, affecting the critical work we are doing in skilling and supporting refugee youths to produce their own food and become self reliant. 500 young people are currently benefiting from our Agricultural program and need continued mentorship and technical support from our staffs.

title: Delivery Kits Bank: Saving Mothers and newborns!
description: On the 26/08/2023, during our distribution of emergency delivery kits to 10 needy women, a recipient told us that she was diagnosed HIV+ during her last pregnancy. Because she did not have money to purchase delivery kits, she ended up having home delivery, at the mercy of neighbours. Two years later, her daughter was also diagnosed of HIV.   Our delivery kits bank banks delivery kits to encourage hospital births and save mothers and babies, regardless of HIV status. Support us support women!

title: Reusable Menstrual Pads for S. Cameroons Refugees
description: If Southern Cameroons Refugee girls stay in school, then the poverty cycle can be broken. A reusable menstrual pad has proven to be key: sustainable menstrual health she can count on. With it, she can avoid infections, shame, exploitation and early marriages. Your support of this project provides refugee girls quality washable sanitary pads and important reproductive health, hygiene, and sewing training. Refugee girls, families and communities are empowered as they learn to sew and gain skills.

title: Together we can warm up Ukraine!
description: The upcoming winter in Ukraine will be as difficult as last winter. Constant bombardments by the Russian Army left a lot of civilian infrastructure damaged and many homes without heat and electricity.  Last year RememberUs.org & vocational school in Kremenchyk, Ukraine made ~ 200 wood-burning stoves/heaters. We distributed these units for free to private homes, hospitals, schools and shelters in Eastern Ukraine. Please, help us to repeat this project again. Help us to heat homes & save lives.

title: Build Bright Colombian Futures through STEM
description: Did you know that out of 10 students in Colombia, 4 graduate high school and only 2 access higher education?   You can be part of the solution! MAKAIA's STEM programs ignite passion for technology, equipping vulnerable youth with STEM skills, IT concepts, robotics, and life skills.    Unlock the potential of 100 students through our project-based methodologies Innovation Labs and STEM Talents Incubator. Let's foster innovation and break down barriers for professional training opportunities

title: Sustain Lives of 15 Orphaned Children in Tigray.
description: The war in Tigray has orphaned countless children. Mebriata Children's Foundation aims to support 15 of these orphans for a year, providing essentials like food, clothing, shelter, medical care, and schooling. These children will reside with a responsible adult, ensuring proper fund utilization. Our goal is to permanently care for these children and, with enough support, expand our assistance to more children trapped in dire conditions.

title: Light Libraries for Students in Sierra Leone
description: In partnership with the World Food Programme in Sierra Leone, Unite to Light will create Light Libraries in 200 schools so that students can "check out" a solar light to take home and complete their homework after dark. Access to solar lights improve educational outcomes, and "Light Libraries" are an efficient use of funds as many students can share one light.

title: Morocco Earthquake Relief Fund
description: A powerful earthquake hit Morocco on Sept. 8, killing more than 2,800 people, injuring thousands more, and causing widespread damage. Your donation to the Morocco Earthquake Relief Fund will provide emergency relief and long-term support to affected communities.

title: Earthquake Crisis Appeal
description: On the night of September 8, a 6.8 magnitude earthquake hit the High Atlas region where all our boarding houses are located. There has been significant damage to all of our houses. We are now trying to get updates from the girls who were back in their villages. In addition to repairing our houses, we anticipate emergency and longer-term support for the girls and their families. Any help you can give at this time will be gratefully received.

title: Become Active And Support
description: This September marks 8 years of Be Aware And Share (BAAS) and 1 year of our Community Centre in Ioannina. As proud as we are of our organisation, we are incredibly disheartened that in 8 years not enough has changed in the political and social climate that means our services are still required. There are still countless displaced people seeking safety in Greece with adequate support and protection still not being provided.

title: Earthquake Relief for Moroccan Communities
description: On September 8, 2023, an earthquake left more than 2,900 dead and 5,500 injured in the provinces of Al Haouz, Taroudant, Azilal, Ouarzazate and Chichaoua. The tremors caused significant damage to homes and key infrastructure, collapsing wells, destroying agricultural terraces, making roads inaccessible, and leaving, in some cases, entire villages leveled and without access to water, food, or medical care.

title: Planting Hope: Empower Girls with Fruit Trees
description: We aim to support girls nutrition and climate justice clubs plant 10,000 fruit trees in 50 communities in Uganda, providing a sustainable source of fruits, healthy  diets, reducing micro-nutrient deficiencies, and support girls as environmental stewards.  As we help girls nurture these fruit trees in Ugandan schools, we support biodiversity and ecosystem restoration, contributing to carbon dioxide sequestering to mitigate impacts of greenhouse gases leading to cool temperatures, and cleaner air.

title: Morocco Earthquake Response Fund
description: On 8th September 2023, Morocco was hit hard by a strong earthquake measuring magnitude 6.8. Remote communities in the High Atlas Mountains were badly affected. The Eve Branson Foundation has worked quickly with our partners to lead a co-ordinated response to get emergency relief on the ground in Asni and support long-term recovery efforts. Providing aid and support for families and staff from EBF and Kasbah Tamadot is our priority and to ensure nearby communities have adequate shelter.

title: Supporting Morocco to face the Earthquake
description: A 6.8 magnitude earthquake has hit Morocco, killing at least 2,800 people, injuring more than 2,500, damaging ancient buildings, and sending terrified people fleeing into the streets for safety.  EFE-Maroc is providing support to these communities by assisting local NGOs and authorities with immediate relief fundraising necessary to rescue victims, provide food, temporary shelters, and survival kits for homeless families, as well as others affected.

title: Support Earthquake victims in Taroudant
description: In the wake of the catastrophic earthquake that struck Taroudant, Morocco, on the night of September 8th to 9th, 2023, Tibu Africa is launching a comprehensive initiative to aid the victims of this unprecedented disaster. Our goal is to raise $65,000 to provide vital assistance to the affected families and communities. Let us come together in solidarity and make a profound impact on the lives of those in need.

title: Emergency appeal for Morocco
description: A 6.8 magnitude earthquake has hit and devastated Marrakech in Morocco! Reports of casualties and damages are coming in. From the latest report, more than a thousand people have been killed by the earthquake, while thousands more are injured. The statistics of the earthquake are:  The quake hit just after 11 pm local time (22:00 GMT). The epicentre of the earthquake was at a depth of 18.5km (11.5 miles) and occurred about 72km (44 miles) northeast of Marrakesh, the US Geological Survey (USGS) sa

title: Rabies Vaccination Drive 2023
description: We're excited to share our upcoming initiative for World Rabies Day on September 28th. Stray Animal Foundation of India is on a mission to vaccinate 1000 street dogs in Hyderabad, India, focusing on dog and human health. Supporting our vaccination drive contributes to saving human and canine lives and fosters a safer, healthier India. Together, we can eliminate rabies and create a better future for all living beings. Thank you for your support, and let's work together for a rabies-free India.

title: Morocco Earthquake Emergency Response - IBC
description: The International Blue Crescent Relief & Development Foundation is responding to provide immediate relief to survivors of the devastating 6.8-magnitude earthquake that struck Morocco at 11pm local time on Friday, September 8th. IBC has extensive experience with earthquake response and is acting to support emergency responders now. IBC is mobilizing food, clean water, warm blankets, and shelter to provide core relief items. Together, with your help, we can support the people of Morocco.

title: Will you support 8key people for child development
description: Child sponsorship play a key role in freeing a child from poverty. In fact, they ensure that a child has the tools they need to thrive. Many people are involved in a child's development. As the saying goes, it takes a village to raise a child.

title: BAAS Community Centre supporting displaced people
description: Be Aware And Share (BAAS), has been running a community centre in the city centre of Ioannina, Greece since July 2022. With this project, BAAS wants to offer the local community of refugees a safe place where everyone is welcome. The centre is a meeting place for refugees and asylum seekers in Ioannina, for people living in the nearby refugee camps and for the local population. BAAS offers services such as language and IT classes, a free clothing store, social activities and washing machines.

title: Rehabilitation program 2024
description: Congenital heart diseases are one of the leading causes of death not only in Bulgaria, but also in the world. In Bulgaria, about 600 children are born annually with congenital heart malformations. About 400 heart operations are performed annually. Rehabilitation programs create an environment in which children feel safe to examine new behaviors and to build skills. They become an adults that are visible and included into the society life. They change attitudes.

title: Earthquake Emergency in Morocco
description: A devastating earthquake has hit Morocco. The scale of destruction is massive, with thousands dead, injured and even more without homes. We must act immediately! Help survivors of this disaster today. Donations will directly support children and families who have lost everything, are struggling financially, and can no longer access the medical care and lifesaving medicines they need in Marrakech. Help us bring aid to those impacted by this unprecedented natural disaster!

title: Moroccan Teen Girls Earthquake Relief
description: On September 8 a powerful 6.8 magnitude earthquake hit Morocco, causing a devastating loss of 2000+ lives and significant damage to infrastructures. It is essential to remember that menstruation does not stop during natural disasters, reason why Project Soar has decided to focus every effort on the collection and distribution of menstrual products, diapers & other first aid essential needs to women and girls living in the badly affected villages of the High Atlas region.

title: Help Airlink Airlift Aid - Morocco Earthquake
description: Just hours after the 6.8-magnitude earthquake struck Central Morocco more than 2,000 people were declared dead and another 2,000 were injured. Volunteers and aid are needed for search and rescue operations, emergency medical care, and food and shelter.  The Airlink team is already coordinating relief efforts with our NGO partners to send shipments and responders, from the US, Israel, Canada, the UK, and Germany as a start, where NGOs have been requested by the government of Morocco.

title: Morocco Earthquake Relief and Recovery
description: Since 1987, Near East Foundation has partnered with many of the Moroccan communities hit hardest by the the recent earthquake. As aftershocks continue, families are sleeping in the streets, fearful of sheltering in their damaged homes.  Our staff in Morocco are mobilizing resources to assist the hardest hit communities and are asking for your support. Your donation will support impacted communities to meet critical basic needs, restore basic services, and begin to recover from the disaster.

title: Morocco Earthquake Emergency Response
description: On Friday, September 8th, a powerful 6.8 magnitude earthquake struck Morocco, killing at least 2,800 people and leaving another 2,500 people injured. IsraAID arrived in Morocco less than 48 hours after the earthquake to begin initial assessments, meet with community partners, and distribute essential humanitarian aid. IsraAID is further assessing urgent needs in Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene, and Mental Health and Psychosocial Support.

title: Rehousing aid for Moroccan earthquake victims
description: The most powerful seismic event to have shaken our country in over a century, the devastating magnitude 6.8 earthquake in southern Morocco on the night of Friday, September 8, 2023, whose epicenter was located in the province of Al-Haouz, southwest of Marrakech, which shook the entire nation and caused extensive human and material damage, resulting in a human tragedy. Millions of poor survivors urgently need help.

title: Movement on the Ground Morocco Earthquake Relief
description: Morocco has been hit by a devastating earthquake already taking more than 2000 lives. Immediate assistance is crucial.   Movement On The Ground is providing emergency relief. Time is of essence! Safe lives! Donate now!

title: Support to Give  clean Water  Give life
description: The World Health Organization (WHO) has identified more than 1,000 cases of cholera in cities across the Republic of Burundi. Burundi is an East African country that has been plagued by violence, disease and poor sanitation for years. Most of the population lives in rural areas where drinking water is unsafe and sanitation practices are nearly non-existent. This has created the perfect storm for cholera to spread quickly across the country. It has led to six deaths.

title: Improve School Readiness for Vulnerable Children
description: This project will work with caregivers of Children with disabilities and other community members to establish Inclusive Home-based Early Childhood Learning centers in Kamuli District Uganda to prepare children with disabilities and other vulnerable children for early enrolment in mainstream schools. The project will counteract some of the barriers to early school enrolment of these children including the high cost of early childhood education, long distance, knowledge gap on inclusive education.

title: Responding to the Earthquake in Morocco
description: On September 8th, a devastating 6.8- magnitude earthquake struck central Morocco in the High Atlas Mountains, about 45 miles southwest of Marrakech, a popular tourist destination with a population of about 840,000 people.   In response, International Medical Corps is deploying an Advance Emergency Medical Team to Marrakech to coordinate with government authorities, local organizations and international agencies to prioritize critical needs and establish logistics support.

title: Urgent Earthquake Response in Morocco
description: On Friday, September 8, 2023, a 6.8 magnitude earthquake - the most powerful in Morocco's modern history - struck outside of Marrakesh. More than 2,500 people have been killed and the number of people injured and displaced is increasing by the hour as aftershocks continue to spread.     ActionAid is working alongside local partners to evaluate the immediate needs of some of the worst-affected communities.

title: Morocco 6.8 EQ victims needs your donations
description: Rescue and relief efforts are underway in Morocco following a devastating earthquake that struck on September 8, 2023. The earthquake has resulted in significant loss of life and widespread damage, particularly in isolated mountain areas. The situation remains challenging, with rescuers facing difficulties in accessing affected regions. As of the latest reports, more than 3,000 people have been confirmed dead and another 4,000 people are severely injured.

title: Libya Floods : help the survivors!
description: The Mediterranean storm 'Daniel' has caused heavy rain that poured into coastal towns of Libya. The heavy rain caused two dams to break, causing an enormous flash flood that swept into residential areas, including those in Derna.  The Mayor of Derna reported that 2,000 people have been killed and as many as 5-6,000 people are still missing. Many buildings have also collapsed. It is a major catastrophe.   The government of Libya and the Libyan Red Cross is on the field tending to the survivors.

title: ZA Cheetah Conservation - Animal Care Bills
description: ZA Cheetah Conservation is a non profit organization that focuses on Cheetah Breeding and Wildlife Conservation Education.  As a non Profit we rely on donations from supporters, our income from Educational tours and our volunteers to help cover the day to day bills such as food for the animals, medications, supplements and enclosure maintenance.  We are home to a variety of different wildlife including a Tiger, Non Breeding lions, leopard, puma, cheetahs, serval, caracals and other small animals

title: Save Lives In Libya
description: On September 11, 2023, Libya was struck by the devastating Mediterranean Hurricane Daniel, resulting in catastrophic flooding and the loss of more than 12,000 lives in a few days, with thousands still missing.

title: Watch over a migrating bird in Central America!
description: Each year, more than half of North America's bird species migrate to (or through) Central America. You can help protect them in Nicaragua and El Salvador by giving to this project. There, we want to take action to protect birds' winter habitat and key stopover sites. These include protecting and restoring habitat, doing scientific monitoring, and building ecotourism opportunities as well as local love and expertise for birds.

title: Morocco Earthquake Response 2023
description: Around 11pm local time on September 8, a 6.8 magnitude earthquake struck the High Atlas mountain range, 72 km southwest of Marrakech, Morocco, a city home to 840,000 people. The quake was followed by a 4.9 magnitude aftershock. This has been the biggest earthquake felt in the region. Extensive damage has been reported with buildings collapsed and critical infrastructure severely damaged. GlobalMedic's Rapid Response Team is on the ground providing support to those affected by the quake.

title: Libya Flood Relief Fund
description: Devastating floods hit Libya's eastern region on Monday, killing thousands of people, injuring thousands more, and causing widespread damage. Your donation to the Libya Flood Relief Fund will provide emergency relief and long-term support to affected communities.

title: Small gifts, mighty impact: East Africa essentials
description: HHA has been working in the refugee settlements of Uganda since 2017, providing disability care, nutritional support and education in vulnerable communities. Our incredible local team is passionate and resourceful, but often lack the basic items they need to carry out our projects. We've put together a 'shopping list' of items that, while simple, will have tangible impact: from improving the wellbeing of our team and beneficiaries, to making our projects run smoothly. Every little helps!

title: Feed Hungry Children Plant-Based School Meals
description: As increasing climate disasters worsen global food insecurity, climate-friendlier food aid is needed. A Well-Fed World sponsors culturally appropriate plant-based school meals for kids in need in communities experiencing hunger and poverty around the globe. For some children these lunches are their only full meal of the day, providing crucial nutrition and improved learning outcomes. Free school meal programs we've sponsored or sponsor include schools in Ethiopia, Nepal, Uganda, India and Haiti.

title: Offer Tailoring and embroidery skills to 100 Women
description: National Education Statistics 2016 and Management Information System (EMIS), show that 73% of men and 84% of women above 15 years of age are illiterate with 3 out of 5 school-aged children not enrolled in primary school, and the teacher -pupil ratio averaging 48.154 per teacher. Vocational training and offering livelihood skills to the youth and women can change the population economic situation. CSD is on the struggle to build the capacities of young women for business purposes.

title: Abortion Access through Technological Innovation
description: In Latin America, barriers such as restrictive laws, harmful gender norms and stigma, and a lack of access to reliable sexual health information and services contribute to 39,000 deaths and many more injuries from unsafe abortion each year. Through this campaign, Ipas LAC will scale-up our digital innovations to promote greater access to safe abortion options and services for women and girls in Latin America. Our efforts will contribute to improve gender equality and foster resilient communities

title: Support Abandoned Intellectually Disabled Children
description: Sri Arunodayam is a home in Chennai for abandoned children with intellectual disability's (ID). Our home came into existence in 2002 on account of the unfortunate practice of families who abandon their vulnerable children on account of ignorance, poverty, social stigma, anda lack of moral conscience that has never been disciplined to safeguard our country's most vulnerable citizens. Abandoned children with ID continue to be found in public places such as hospitals, bus and railway stations

title: Libya Flood Emergency Response
description: The "Libya Flood Emergency Response" is a critical emergency relief project aimed at addressing the dire consequences of the recent devastating flooding in Libya, caused by Storm Daniel on September 10, 2023. This unprecedented natural disaster has washed away vital infrastructure, worsened the humanitarian crisis in the region, and disrupted the lives of thousands.

title: Morocco Earthquake Emergency Response
description: The "Morocco Earthquake Emergency Response" is a vital emergency relief project designed to address the immediate and long-term consequences of the catastrophic 6.8-magnitude earthquake that struck the High Atlas Mountains south of Marrakesh on September 8, 2023. This devastating natural disaster has resulted in an alarming loss of life, injuries, and widespread destruction.

title: Elephants for Africa's Community Empowerment
description: We invite you to join our herd and support our community initiatives in the Makgadikgadi region of Botswana, where elephants and humans are in competition for resources. By empowering communities with knowledge, fostering coexistence, and building sustainable livelihoods, we can pave the way for a future where both elephants and humans thrive.

title: Support menstrual education for girls in Bulgaria
description: Endometriosis and Reproductive Health Foundation Bulgaria supports women in their reproductive journey especially if they have chronic illnesses and infertility issues. In our 4+ years of operation we came to realize women in Bulgaria need better understanding of their menstrual health and how to support it and this has to start in early adolescent years.

title: PADS AND PANTS INITIATIVE, NYAMIRA COUNTY, KENYA
description: This project aims to address critical issues of rampant teenage pregnancy and menstrual hygiene in the marginalized areas of Nyamira, Kenya. This multifaceted initiative combines mentorship for girls and boys, awareness campaigns for perpetrators, workshops for parents, and the distribution of sanitary towels to empower teenage girls. All stakeholders will be informed, and girls will have the knowledge and resources they need to lead healthier lives and make informed choices.

title: Support for Libya Flood and Crises Worldwide
description: The Mediterranean storm Daniel caused massive flooding in Libya, which broke dams and swept away entire neighborhoods, killing over 5,000 people and displacing more than 34,000. Climate change has worsened weather events - such as storms and floods - so that they are more frequent, longer, and more intense. Repeated shocks make it difficult for people and communities to cope and rebuild, especially when compounded with conflict and economic instability.

title: SOS Earthquake Solidarity Morocco
description: Morocco has been hit hard by a violent earthquake with a magnitude of 6.8, leaving 2946 people dead and 5674 injured. Isolated communities in the High Atlas have been hard hit. The Fondation Orient Occident in coordination with the local authorities and associations, is working to deploy its intervention plan to help the population affected by the earthquake.  Our priority is to meet the urgent and long-term needs for hit population in rural areas who receive no intervention.

title: Abot-Kamay Community Solidarity Fund
description: Support community-led actions that change lives - the overarching theme of Abot-Kamay Community Solidarity Fund with its 32 initially supported community-led actions in Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao islands in the Philippines.  Can you imagine if we have more community-led actions in critical and strategic areas of the country?  This builds and expands the organizations' assets, agency, and trust to transform their communities and society.

title: Sponsoring school fees for young people in Brazil
description: The Adote project was created as a solution to help children study in private schools. By "adopting" a child's education, the Adote project directs the funds donated to pay school fees at private schools. In 2022, the Adote project grew to include young university students looking for support to take the next step and find a dignified life for their families.

title: Support children with disabilities in Afghanistan
description: Afghanistan has one of the largest disabled populations in the world, with nearly 20% of Afghan children living with a disability. The Enabled Children Initiative supports over 1,000 Afghan children with disabilities and their families, providing education, training, humanitarian and emergency relief services. This project will allow us to enroll 15 additional children/families with disability living in poverty into our Community-based Disability Awareness & Support program.

title: Empower Small Scale Tomato Farmers in Egypt
description: In partnership with CARE Egypt's She Feeds the World Initiative, the Sun-Dried Tomato Project aims to fund materials and training needed by small scale farmers and workers living below the poverty line in Luxor and Qena, Egypt, especially those impacted by the COVID.  The funds will be used to support the revitalization of tomato crops, particularly for single-income women farmers striving to remain competitive in the market and provide for their families.

title: Thousands of people displaced by floods
description: More than 10,000 people have been displaced by devastating floods following heavy rains that have battered parts of Burundi in the recent weeks. Individuals from the rural area of Gatumba, in the province of Bujumbura, have been forced to seek shelter in schools, churches or sometimes in improvised makeshift shelters by the roadside. In addition to losing their homes, many have lost their livelihoods as the flooding has destroyed crops and damaged businesses.

title: Prepare South African Teens to Succeed in School,
description: South African teens growing up in marginalized communities can propel themselves and their families out of generations of poverty and into the middle class in one generation - if they finish 12th grade and go to college.   As part of our Infinite Family, you provide wrap-around support and structures that allow teens to not only improve their prospects at school but, critically, beyond that, in work and life. You provide the tech access and support they need to succeed in the 21st century.

title: Liberia Adolescent Empowerment Initiative
description: The link between poverty and the high rate of school dropouts in Liberia is evident. The financial strain imposed by poverty often leads to families struggling to cover essential education-related expenses, such as school fees, uniforms, textbooks, and transportation costs. At YDCA, we provide financial aid and scholarships as well as mentorship to adolescents' girls & children in Liberia, helping to open doors to a brighter future and empowering them to make informed life decisions.

title: Give Hope from Home for Persons with Disabilities
description: Give Hope from Home is a fundraising project  for the benefit of Las Pinas Persons with Disability Federation, Inc. (LPPWDFI) during the COVID-19 crisis. Help fund diapers for children and adults with disabilities.

title: Preventive Initiative Focusing Children from Risks
description: This initiative will help children in their learning by starting a coaching class at 6 different villages in central but geographically challenging, hilly areas for 180 children. At this coaching place, children will get help in their academic and mainly developing self-capacity to speak up for their needs and capable of making the right decision by ignoring barriers created intentionally and by the situation. This initiative is expected to be a model one.

title: Flooding Relief Libya
description: The situation in Libya is catastrophic after the severe storm. It is unclear how many people have lost their homes, beloved friends and relatives. Thousands of children, women and men are still considered missing. The country's government expects many dead. Aktion Deutschland Hilft has declared an emergency: Organizations in the alliance are launching urgently needed acute emergency aid for the affected people.   Photo  : picture alliance / REUTERS | Esam Omran Al-Fetori

title: Thrive Global: School Meals Change Lives
description: Thrive's mission is to deliver healthy meals to hungry schoolchildren.   Since 2012, we have fed 3 million school meals across two countries, with the support of over 1,500 donors and hundreds of volunteers.  And more children need us.  Post-pandemic, 25% more children face daily hunger, and our immediate waitlist is more than 5,000 schoolchildren.

title: Build a school for underprivileged children
description: The restoration of poor children through Free Schooling. Life Givers is Committed to providing basic education to underprivileged children. Our educational initiatives include Primary School [3-5 years], Secondary School  Education [5-15 years]. An education that educates underprivileged children who are under difficult circumstances, such as child labor, children of poorest of the parents, street and runaway children, children with rare disabilities, disaster struck children and slum children.

title: Supportive Education for Underserved Children
description: Of the world's poorest 1.2 billion people, India is home to 33%. It largely affects the already vulnerable populations of children and comprises of a lack of resources especially education and extracurricular activities. This project is a two stage - poverty alleviation programme that aims to provide 200 underserved children of all ages from the slums of New Delhi, India with with a range of after school services.

title: Enabling Potential in 86 Persons with Disabilities
description: The Society for Minors' Protection and Development (SMPD) aims to enhance the quality of life for 86 persons with disabilities by providing them with essential assistance for better social engagement opportunities. This includes distributing 15 hearing aid devices, 57 wheelchairs, and 14 crutches to offer vital support to persons with disabilities.

title: Book donation Project in Sri Lanka
description: With the current economic imbalances in the country, the prices of goods in the country have increased rapidly, but there has not been a corresponding increase in wages and it has put a lot of pressure on people's lives. In such a situation, not being able to carry out educational activities has had various effects on the lives of the sons and daughters who are in the country. The aim of this project is to provide a set of school equipment needed for  the next school term for 500 students

title: Reforestation for rural livelihoods in Honduras
description: FTPF has launched our newest program: planting thousands of native and fruit trees throughout rural, low-income communities in Honduras. This is a simple, effective way to have lasting impacts on Honduran families' livelihoods, nutrition, and overall well-being, while also fighting climate change and improving local soils, waterways, and air quality. Participants partake in workshops, led collaboratively by our team and local on-the-ground partners, on sustainable planting and tree care.

title: Help 300 beekeepers obtain organic certificate
description: The main concern of smallholder producers is to whom they will sell their honey and at what price.  It is in this sense that the organic certification procedure is essential 1)It assures producers a fair price 2)It safeguards the environment by encouraging sustainable practices 3)Organic production contributes to the health of ecosystems 4)Organic certification helps the livelihoods of local communities 5)Organic certification encompasses the ethical treatment of bees ensuring their well-being

title: Library in a labour colony in Bangalore, India
description: Sampark aims to create a transformative impact by establishing 100 libraries with a collection of STEM and storybooks in Bangalore's labour colonies, providing migrant children with the opportunity to access education and unlock their potential, ultimately addressing the educational gap they face.

title: New housing for Naba Kustha Ashram leprosy village
description: This project will help to repair and rebuild the houses of 40 elderly people in Nabha Kustha Ashram leprosy village in West Bengal. These people have been sadly neglected by the government, and risk having their houses falling down around them. Their houses are currently open to wild animals and they are unsafe while sleeping. We aim to give them dignity, safety and comfort for their last years. They have endured enough pain.

title: Saving Wildlife On The Cayes of Belize
description: Aces Wildlife Rescue is the only multi-species wildlife rescue, sanctuary, and rehabilitation facility for the cayes of Northern Belize. We provide 24/7 emergency response to all calls of distressed animals on Ambergris Caye and our neighboring island Caye Caulker, while specializing in bird and reptile rehabilitation of injured, ill, orphaned or displaced wildlife, assisting in their recovery and preparing them for their release back into the wild.

title: Education material for school children
description: 10 Middle school in west Arni Block, Thriuvannamalai district. 2000 poor children studying in their respective schools. Quality education is an essential requisite in today's competitive environment. Technology has affected us in every aspect. The smart class rooms are a modernized method of education in Indian education scenario which provides quality education to poor students by helping them in better concept formation & elaboration, improvement in reading skills and academic achievement.

title: 54 health-groups'll get indoor games in Nepal
description: Covid taught communities to be prepared. In 3 rural villages, Console Mission started 54 health groups focuses on prevention. And to impact their community at once, children can play an important role. Therefore, strengthening children's capacity by investing in to develop psychosocial behaviors is most important. To do that, indoor games are prioritized, suitable for both girls and boys. 'Carrom board' helps in developing hand and eye coordination, teamwork and fair play sticking with rules.

title: PIFBS Disaster Relief Fund
description: Pitch In For Baseball & Softball (PIFBS) reduces barriers to play and promotes youth development by donating baseball/softball equipment in underserved communities. In times of tragedy, children are the most affected. Baseball and softball can help to restore a sense of normalcy amidst the chaos. This projects seeks to raise funds to help PIFBS build reserves of equipment to increase organizational efficiency in response to natural disasters such as Hurricane Idalia and the Maui wildfires.

title: Sea Turtle Rescue and Conservation in Playa Grande
description: Playa Grande, Cahuita is home to three unique species of marine turtles: critically endangered Hawksbill and Leatherbacks and endangered Caribbean Green turtles.  The area is home to terrestrial species, such as green iguanas, howler monkeys and coatis. Cahuita Turtle Rescue leads community-based conservation efforts such as beach cleans, nest harvesting, turtle releases and educational campaigns to ensure the survival of the marine turtle population and protect their rights to survive and nest.

title: Aid for regain normalcy from Morocco earthquake
description: A devastating magnitude 6.8 earthquake struck Morocco on the night of 8 September local time, with a death toll of more than 3,000. This is the largest earthquake to hit Morocco in 60 years, since 1960, so it is time for a rapid response. The aim of the project is to help the victims of the Moroccan earthquake recover from the earthquake damage as quickly as possible and return to their daily lives.

title: Educate 150 Women with disabilities in Pakistan
description: Our project aims to empower 150 women with disabilities through education and skills training. We'll partner with local institutions, offer tailored courses, and create a supportive network to enhance their independence and self-reliance to become a productive part of society  Disabled Welfare Association is dedicated to uplifting the lives of disabled women in our community as they are the most vulnerable part of our society as they doubly discriminated both through gender and their disability.

title: Responding to the Flooding in Libya
description: On September 10, a powerful "medicane" dubbed Storm Daniel made landfall in Libya, bringing strong winds and such heavy rainfall to northeastern areas of the country that two dams upstream of the coastal city of Derna collapsed the next day. The breach and resulting floodwaters had catastrophic consequences for the city's people and infrastructure.  International Medical Corps is responding by deploying a medical team and using other lifesaving health interventions.

title: Feed 150 families during the long school holidays.
description: Turning Point Trust would like to feed 180 vulnerable children from 150 households in Kibera during the upcoming 9-week school holiday in November and December with an aim of reducing short term hunger among the children, and to keep them from engaging in crime and child labour in order to find food when schools are out.

title: Libya Flood Emergency Response - IBC
description: International Blue Crescent Relief and Development Foundation (IBC) having vast experience in responding to emergencies and recovery situations in Turkey, Iran, Pakistan, and Indonesia has mobilized its emergency response team To Marrakesh, and on-site assessments about different areas for response are identified. IBC focuses on the needs of the remote villages primarily in Libya. Priority will be given to food, drinking water, medical and hygiene kits distribution, and etc.

title: Mindset Motivation For Youth in Botswana
description: Stepping Stones International's Walktober Challenge 2023 kicks off 'mindset motivation', fundraising for the mental health of vulnerable children and youth in Botswana. Many youth face psychological problems that are left untreated. With the money raised, we will ensure that at least 100 children and youth suffering from depression, suicide ideation, anxiety, or trauma receive specialised counseling.  Mental health professionals will also receive counseling training.

title: Connect girls with a mentor for a brighter future
description: Education is life-changing. But for many of the women and girls we work with, education alone is not enough to thrive. When girls are connected with a mentor, they gain a trusted source of support. A mentor can guide them through challenges, help them develop problem-solving skills, and connect them to new people and opportunities. Over time, the women and girls we work with can gain the resources, skills, and confidence they need to develop personal agency and reach their full potential.

title: Home help for mothers and newborns in Albania
description: This project will fund a part-time salary for an Albanian nurse for a year as well as an educational awareness campaign to help us reach more mothers. We will train the nurse to offer lactation help and teach our prenatal courses.   MamiCare is a project of the Mother and Child Hospital Foundation in Albania. We are focused on equipping mothers for birth and breastfeeding. We offer prenatal courses and home visits for lactation help.

title: Wash-programm Alebtong
description: After the first WASH (Water, Sanitation, Hygiene) program started in Otuke District in 2022, August 2023 marks the start of the project in the Alebtong region. At seven schools in rural northern Uganda, the project aims to improve hygiene standards, promote menstrual hygiene, educate about mental health issues and develop sustainable school structures with the help of various workshops.

title: Build a vocational training institute for rural
description: This project will build a vocational training institute in Pajian village and all around in Pakistan. Providing computer course and different IT professional trainings that help students to direct apply for Job and be economically strong. This project works on reducing unemployment and giving a respectable job. Poorest students and girls get free trainings. We will build classroom, need tables and computers for this project.

title: Malnourished Boy and sick need your favor
description: Help save a child from the deadliest form of malnutrition  Child malnutrition in Burundi was reported at 1 in 2020, according to the World Bank collection of development indicators, compiled from officially recognized sources. Burundi - Child malnutrition - actual values, historical data, forecasts and projections were sourced from the World Bank on September of 2023.   In the case of this child from the Cankuzo commune, he suffers from poor nutrition at the same time he is seriously .

title: Help Burundian poor population in hard situation
description: This project will provide food items for 5000 poor families in in Burundi for first round . Food is one of the basic needs of a man, taken to provide energy, maintain life and stimulate growth. Unfortunately, Nigeria is known as the poverty capital of the world, with about 12million of it's population living below poverty line. Having enough food to eat, will help these families to avoid many health problems and maintain a healthy life.

title: A Safe Haven: Constructing Homes for 200 Orphans
description: At Roshni Homes Trust, we are dedicated to providing orphaned children with more than just a shelter - we aim to offer them a place they can truly call home. Our "Building Forever Homes for Orphans" project envisions the construction of four generous apartment-style residences, each spanning 2300 sq. ft. These homes will offer comfort, security, and a sense of belonging, giving orphaned children the opportunity to thrive in a loving environment.

title: sponsor a child in northern Uganda.
description: Getting into inclusive and quality education for all children is the belief that education is one of the most powerful and proven means for sustainable development. This project will ensure that all girls and boys complete primary and secondary schooling. It also aims to provide equal access to affordable vocational training, to eliminate gender and wealth disparities, and achieve access to a quality education.

title: Breaking the cycle of poverty through education
description: Tusekwile Imiti Ikula Foundation is dedicated to breaking the cycle of poverty through the provision of quality, equitable and inclusive education to the most vulnerable and marginalized children in our community. Your support will help us instill life skills to children and youths and transform their lives.

title: Protect 100K people in Pakistan with 3 flood walls
description: Twelve months after devastating floods in Pakistan, Relief International has aided 11,000 people with flood diversion walls, reviving livelihoods and offering protection. However, additional funding is urgently required to safeguard 15 more villages and 100,000 individuals from future floods and support more families with cash grants, technical assistance and training to rebuild businesses.

title: Thousands of people displaced by floods in Burundi
description: More than 10,000 people have been displaced by devastating floods following heavy rains that have battered parts of Burundi in the recent weeks. Individuals from the rural area of Gatumba, in the province of Bujumbura, have been forced to seek shelter in schools, churches or sometimes in improvised makeshift shelters by the roadside. In addition to losing their homes, many have lost their livelihoods as the flooding has destroyed crops and damaged businesses.

title: reduce more than 1000 deaths of women giving birth
description: The project is more focusing on the reduction of more than 1000 deaths of woman's who are dying during birth at lushoto district hospital.This is due to the presence of lack of enough tools and materials at lushoto district hospital that driving the rate of woman's deaths during birth.The problem has been caused by poor government supplies of important needs such as beds, medicine,cottons, wounds medicines .This has been leading to the presence of more than 1000 deaths of woman's and children's.

title: Support a Girl child With Menstrual Products
description: Most girls from rural schools struggle to access and afford menstrual products like pads and nickers which make them miss school lessons. Some girls start befriending men in trading centers in their villages so that they can offer them cash to buy the sanitary pads. In the end this has costed so many girls to fall victims of child marriages and teenage pregnancies.  And most girls, when they acquire teenage pregnancies, they drop out of school. Let's break menstrual stigma together.

title: Inspire children for IT and programming
description: The Hacker School wants to inspire children and young people for programming. Our vision is that every young person should have programmed once in order to build understanding for the digital world and develop possible future perspectives.

title: Support education in Nepal
description: Deep poverty in Nepal has a terrible impact on children. Many kids go to school barefoot, holding their books in hands or in plastic bags.  FOH will help 250 children in rural Ramechhap, Nepal, by providing them with school uniforms, shoes, sweatshirts, school bags and basic school supplies.  Let's make education a Way Out of poverty!

title: Check your Help this month
description: This project will provide food items for 5000 poor families in in Burundi for first round . Food is one of the basic needs of a man, taken to provide energy, maintain life and stimulate growth. Unfortunately, Nigeria is known as the poverty capital of the world, with about 12million of it's population living below poverty line. Having enough food to eat, will help these families to avoid many health problems and maintain a healthy life.

title: Help displaced children and families in Armenia
description: In the aftermath of the harrowing military conflict in Artsakh (Nagorno-Karabakh), the plight of thousands of displaced Armenians, including a staggering 30,000 children, has brought forth a crisis that demands our immediate attention and unwavering. More than 100,000 people are facing severe conditions with limited or no access to food, clothing, and medicine. According to humanitarian organizations (Red Cross Armenia, VIVA) working in place, the situation is critical and demands rapid response

title: Build Hospital for Pajian Village.
description: Life Givers is located in Pajian Village. There is no hospital in the village that provide medical facility to this village and all others villages that are located around this village. In emergency, villagers go far away hospitals and on the way chances of death raises. This hospital will reduce the chances of death and time and provide health facility to its rural people.

title: Give 36,000 students access to great teachers
description: Students across Australia are dreaming big, but for many, educational disadvantage radically impacts the type of education they can access - and their whole future. Help Teach For Australia provide an education can give all children a greater choice of future.

title: Feed 100 Children in Syria
description: In the Syrian camps, nutritional and educational challenges emerge, where children suffer from poverty and hunger. We aim to provide education and food for 100 children from the camps, believing that support can transform these children into influential leaders in the future.

title: Accessible Family Planning 4 Rural Colombian Women
description: Women for Conservation facilitates mobile healthcare clinics in hard to reach communities living around biodiversity hotspots.  Help us provide over 300 women in Colombian rural communities with comprehensive reproductive healthcare and voluntary family planning resources. This initiative empowers women to plan their futures, stay in school, pursue conservation careers, and actively engage in grassroots efforts.
