title: Saving a Critical Wetland for Endangered Frogs
description: Support women in Anori, Northern Colombia, as they restore a drained wetland, vital for endemic frogs and endangered bird species. Invasive grasses have taken over due to past mining. Women will lead native plant restoration, fighting invasive species and replenishing flora. Help us empower new women conservation leaders and safeguard a biodiversity hotspot for frogs and birds on the brink of extinction.

title: Soy Nina in Honor of the Day of the Girl 2023
description: Soy Nina is a nonprofit organization that currently works with 170 girls ages 6-15 in Desamparados, south of San Jose, Costa Ricas capital. We have been working through a weekly after-school club for the past almost six years and we have seen first hand the positive impact that our program has on girls empowerment and confidence.   In honor of this years International Day of the Girl, we would like to raise a total of $25,000, including $10,000 through this crowdfunding page.

title: "Dignity in Care "Serving 500 PWDs in Pakistan"
description: The project aims to empower 500 individuals with severe disabilities in Pakistan through a comprehensive program that focuses on providing independent living skills and support services. Currently most of them confined to their homes, facing isolation and neglect, as their families perceive them as burdens and often do not provide the care and attention they need. Our initiative seeks to break this cycle of isolation and neglect by offering a two-fold approach (Attendant Service & IL Trainings).

title: Books and Library for children in rural Indonesia
description: Indonesia is facing a literacy emergency! The geographical conditions of Indonesia, with its islands and mountainous terrain, make it more challenging to distribute access to education and suitable reading materials for children. Uneven technological advancements further compound the difficulties faced by children in the mountains and remote areas in accessing proper reading materials and textbooks.

title: Healthcare for Underprivileged Indonesian Kids
description: Our mission: safeguard the health of underprivileged children in Indonesia's slums and villages. We offer regular, comprehensive check-ups, including dental, growth, and eye health. Parents are actively involved for immediate action, like baby tooth extraction.

title: Feathers of Hope: Empowering by Poultry Farming
description: This poultry business not only provides sustainable income for impoverished widows and orphans but also empowers them with economic independence and the means to secure a better future.  With the income from this business we can help many families and children break the cycle of poverty.

title: Wigs of Hope - Wigs for Breast Cancer Patients
description: Wigs of Hope!  Working with cancer patients, we have been able to see the high level impact wigs can have on self esteem and possitive attitude towards overcoming chemotherapy treatments.   We are looking to make our program more sustainable, in order to keep up with the demand of wigs. We want to help all women that come to the national hospitals; One wig, costs $100.00 to produce and it takes up to two months as we only have 1 person that has the training to construct the wigs.

title: Hear the echo of their screams, stand with Idlib
description: Extend your heart and hand to offer a lifeline to the victims of the relentless artillery and missile onslaught in Syria's Idlib and Aleppo regions, spanning from October 4 to today, October 7.  As reported by the White Helmets, these attacks have involved aerial, artillery, and missile bombardments, as well as the deployment of internationally banned incendiary and cluster weapons.   Hundreds are dead, including women and children due to the heavy bombardment.

title: Buy 500 sewing machines to 500 teenage mothers
description: This project will buy 500 sewing machines for the abandoned teenage mothers in Eastern Uganda, enabling them to work and take good care of their children.

title: Afghanistan Earthquake Relief Fund
description: Multiple powerful earthquakes in Afghanistan have killed and injured more than 2,000 people, destroyed homes and villages, and overwhelmed hospitals and clinics. Your donation to the Afghanistan Earthquake Relief Fund will provide emergency assistance to people in need and support long-term recovery efforts led by local organizations.

title: Drink water filter plant for rural  people
description: In Pajian village, rural people have no clean water to drink . They drink from handpump or a male go far away to bring water for family. Females can not go far away so they start drinking water from handpump. Water from handpump makes us sick, stomach hurt, and become a cause of  teeth and mouth diseases. This clean water system will provide water to all to live healthy.

title: Sanitary Pads for rural Kenya
description: This project will provide 200 girls in rural Kenya with sanitary pads and hygiene education to complete the 2023 school year.

title: Gaza Emergency Relief
description: The Gaza Emergency Relief Project is a vital humanitarian initiative aimed at providing essential healthcare and relief, to the people of Gaza Strip who have endured a challenging humanitarian crisis for over 17 years. In the face of recurring Israeli attacks and limited resources, our dedicated teams work in collaboration with the Ministry of Health to deliver critical medical aid, rehabilitation, and shelter support to those in need.

title: Provide Medical aid for civilians in Palestine
description: The escalating humanitarian crisis in Palestine, particularly in Gaza, as Israeli forces have been attacking since October 7th, 2023, causing destruction, casualties, and shortages of essential resources. The campaign seeks to raise funds for urgent medical care, food and water distribution, shelter for the displaced, and educational support for children affected by the conflict

title: Transform Lives of Goa's Underprivileged Women
description: Transform Lives of Goa's Underprivileged Women through Crafts Training. Fundraising for Craft Training Programs aimed at empowering marginalised women to attain financial stability.

title: Send Urgent Aid to Civil Society Groups in Gaza
description: This campaign aims to deliver urgent aid directly to Sunbula's partner organizations in Gaza - Atfaluna Society and Sulafa Embroidery Centre. These groups provide income generation opportunities and critical services to hundreds of marginalized people, including women, refugees, and persons with hearing disabilities. As with everyone in Gaza, they are currently facing a catastrophic crisis.  This emergency aid will be sent directly to address the most pressing humanitarian needs of the families.

title: Emergency Relief in Palestine
description: The war in Palestine and Israel since October 7 has caused a severe humanitarian crisis. 1,200+ Palestinians have been killed and thousands injured. Urgent aid is needed. Many face displacement and lack basic necessities like water, electricity, fuel, food and medicine. Anera in Gaza is providing vital supplies, procuring 2,000 food parcels and 800 hygiene kits for UNRWA schools. Outside Gaza, Anera is preparing emergency supplies and medicines for distribution once a humanitarian corridor opens

title: SHELTER CARE FOR VIOLENCE VICTIMS
description: Jabala is fundraising to provide a supporting institutional framework for women who have been victims of violence and adversity, allowing them to live with dignity and conviction. It envisions providing these women with housing, food, clothes, and health care, as well as economic and social stability. It also anticipates that the specific requirements of these women be met and that they should never be left alone or abandoned since this might lead to their exploitation and despair.

title: Earthquake Assistance
description: A 6.3 magnitude earthquake struck Heart Province on Saturday, Oct 7th, causing widespread damage and suffering. The exact number of casualties is still unknown, but preliminary reports indicate that more than 2400 people have been injured or killed. The UN estimates that 11,585 people have been affected by the disaster and warns that this figure may rise.  Our organization is committed to providing emergency relief to the affected communities. We have a team of volunteers and staff in Heart Pro

title: Israel-Palestine Crisis Relief Fund
description: Conflict is escalating in Israel and Palestine, and thousands of innocent civilians have been killed and injured. Millions are facing a devastating humanitarian crisis. Your donation to the Israel-Palestine Crisis Relief Fund will provide emergency relief and long-term support to people in need.

title: Support Urgent Medical Aid in Palestine
description: Gaza is currently facing an urgent humanitarian crisis due to a complete blockade and relentless bombardment by the Israeli forces. The situation is dire, with a total halt of essential services such as water, electricity, and communication. The closure of hospitals looms, posing a catastrophic threat to the lives of the people in Gaza. Our aim is to provide the necessary support to these hospitals and offer a lifeline to the people of Gaza, who are enduring unbearable conditions.

title: Support Bhumi to Brighten Children's Lives
description: Bhumi is committed to nurturing the dreams of underprivileged children and creating a brighter future for them. Our project, "Empowering Dreams - Transforming Lives," is an embodiment of this vision. With unwavering dedication, we aim to provide holistic support to 10,000 underprivileged children, laying the foundation for a life full of opportunities and possibilities.

title: Support urgent medical needs of Palestinians
description: This campaign aims to provide BASR, as a main healthcare provider, with urgently needed medical supplies and equipment, essential for the continuation of healthcare provision for  the Palestinian population in light of recent escalations by the Israeli Occupation in the West Bank and Gaza, through BASR's rehabilitation and surgical hospital. Together, with your support, we can ensure that healthcare providers have the lifeline they need to deliver critical care during the most challenging times.

title: Palestine Emergency Relief
description: The Palestinian people are in desperate need of aid amid an ongoing crisis that has claimed hundreds of lives and left many injured and displaced. The death toll is expected to rise significantly. Immediate needs include a range of vital resources including medicines, consumables, medical equipment, transport to hospitals, fuel for hospital generators, hygiene kits, clothing, towels for patients, food parcels for vulnerable families and the procurement and delivery of essential chronic medicines
